local CARD_THEME_NAMES = {'Custom', 'Glass', 'Neon Edge', 'Solid Dark', 'Holo', 'Sunset', 'Cyber', 'Royal', 'Aurora', 'Ember', 'Frost', 'Toxic', 'Blood Moon', 'Mono Clean', 'Sakura', 'Gold Foil', 'Void', 'Bloxy Classic', 'Deep Ocean', 'Candy'}
-- How many M1 hits a character's weapon has. Auto reads the game's Melee<N> animations for the moveset and
-- stance; every weapon defaults to 4 and the Playful Cloud has 5. Fixed 4 skips the animation lookup.
local M1_STAGE_SETTINGS = {mode = 'Auto'}
local M1_STAGE_CACHE = {}
local function m1ChainLength(model: any): number
    local info = model:FindFirstChild('Info')
    local stanceValue = info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
    local stance = if stanceValue and stanceValue:IsA('StringValue') then stanceValue.Value else ''
    local moveset = tostring(model:GetAttribute('Moveset'))
    local key = M1_STAGE_SETTINGS.mode .. '|' .. moveset .. '/' .. stance
    local cached = M1_STAGE_CACHE[key]
    if cached then return cached end
    local lowered = string.lower(stance .. ' ' .. moveset)
    local cloud = string.find(lowered, 'cloud', 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(lowered, 'playful', 1, true) ~= nil
    local count = 0
    if cloud then count = 5
    elseif M1_STAGE_SETTINGS.mode == 'Auto' then
        local animations = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Animations')
        local kit = animations and animations:FindFirstChild(moveset)
        if kit then
            local melee = kit:FindFirstChild('Melee')
            local folder = kit
            if melee then folder = (if stance ~= '' then melee:FindFirstChild(stance) else nil) or melee end
            for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
                local number = child.Name:match('^Melee(%d+)$')
                if number and child:IsA('Animation') then count = math.max(count, tonumber(number) or 0) end
            end
        end
    end
    count = if count > 0 then math.min(count, 5) else 4
    M1_STAGE_CACHE[key] = count
    return count
end
local SharedHooks: {[string]: any} = {}
SharedHooks.loadProfile = {t0 = os.clock(), marks = {}}
local function trace(...: any)
    if DebugTrace.enabled then print(...) end
end
pcall(function()
    local environment = getgenv()
    if type(environment) == "table" then environment.ShenaniganismDebug = DebugTrace end
end)

local Tracers = (function(): any
-- Persistent two-pixel GUI tracers; no Drawing hooks or world/character writes.
local Tracers: {[string]: any} = {}

function Tracers.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local world = host.workspace
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, itemsEnabled = false, playersEnabled = false,
        items = {}, players = {}, elapsed = 0,
    }
    local gui = host.Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset = "ShenaniganismTracers", false, true
    gui.ZIndexBehavior, gui.Enabled = host.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, false
    control.gui = gui

    local function finite(value)
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end

    local function clear(records)
        for target, record in records do
            record.line:Destroy()
            records[target] = nil
        end
    end

    local function attachGui()
        local parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if gui.Parent ~= parent then gui.Parent = parent end
        local root = menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        local main = root and (if root:IsA("ScreenGui") then root else root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui"))
        gui.DisplayOrder = if main then main.DisplayOrder - 1 else 0
        gui.Enabled = parent ~= nil and (control.itemsEnabled or control.playersEnabled)
    end

    local function representative(target)
        local hitbox = target:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true)
        if hitbox and hitbox:IsA("BasePart") then return hitbox end
        if target:IsA("BasePart") then return target end
        if target:IsA("Model") and target.PrimaryPart then return target.PrimaryPart end
        return target:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end

    local function makeLine()
        local line = host.Instance.new("Frame")
        line.Name, line.BorderSizePixel, line.BackgroundTransparency = "TracerLine", 0, 0
        line.AnchorPoint, line.Size = host.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), host.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
        line.Active, line.Visible, line.ZIndex, line.Parent = false, false, 1, gui
        return line
    end

    local function reconcile(records, folder, characters)
        local wanted = {}
        if folder then
            for _, target in folder:GetChildren() do
                local humanoid = nil
                if characters then
                    if target == player.Character or not target:IsA("Model") then continue end
                    humanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
                end
                local part = if characters then target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
                if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then part = representative(target) end
                if not part then continue end
                wanted[target] = true
                local record = records[target]
                if not record or not record.line.Parent then
                    if record then record.line:Destroy() end
                    record = {line = makeLine()}
                    records[target] = record
                end
                record.part, record.folder, record.humanoid = part, folder, humanoid
            end
        end
        for target, record in records do
            if not wanted[target] then record.line:Destroy(); records[target] = nil end
        end
    end

    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if control.itemsEnabled then reconcile(control.items, world:FindFirstChild("Items"), false) end
        if control.playersEnabled then reconcile(control.players, world:FindFirstChild("Characters"), true) end
        attachGui()
    end

    local function draw(records, folder, camera, width, height, color)
        local originX, originY = width * 0.5, height
        for target, record in records do
            local line, part, humanoid = record.line, record.part, record.humanoid
            if not folder or record.folder ~= folder or not target:IsDescendantOf(folder)
                or not part.Parent or (part ~= target and not part:IsDescendantOf(target)) or not line.Parent
                or (humanoid and (target == player.Character or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0)) then
                line:Destroy()
                records[target] = nil
                continue
            end
            line.BackgroundColor3 = color
            if not camera or width <= 0 or height <= 0 then line.Visible = false; continue end
            local point = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if not finite(point.X) or not finite(point.Y) or not finite(point.Z) or point.Z <= 0 then
                line.Visible = false
                continue
            end
            local dx, dy = point.X - originX, point.Y - originY
            -- Clip an offscreen endpoint to the viewport, preserving its direction.
            local fraction = 1
            if dx < 0 then fraction = math.min(fraction, originX / -dx)
            elseif dx > 0 then fraction = math.min(fraction, (width - originX) / dx) end
            if dy < 0 then fraction = math.min(fraction, originY / -dy)
            elseif dy > 0 then fraction = 0 end
            dx, dy = dx * fraction, dy * fraction
            local length = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
            if not finite(length) or length <= 0.5 then line.Visible = false; continue end
            line.Position = host.UDim2.fromOffset(originX + dx*0.5, originY + dy*0.5)
            line.Size, line.Rotation = host.UDim2.fromOffset(length, 2), math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
            line.Visible = true
        end
    end

    function control.update(delta)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.elapsed += delta
        if control.elapsed >= 0.15 then control.elapsed = 0; control.refresh() else attachGui() end
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        local width, height = 0, 0
        if camera then width, height = camera.ViewportSize.X, camera.ViewportSize.Y end
        local color = menu.ui and menu.ui.palette and menu.ui.palette["Theme Color"] or host.Color3.fromRGB(0, 235, 245)
        if control.itemsEnabled then draw(control.items, world:FindFirstChild("Items"), camera, width, height, color) end
        if control.playersEnabled then draw(control.players, world:FindFirstChild("Characters"), camera, width, height, color) end
    end

    function control.setItems(value)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.itemsEnabled = value == true
        if not control.itemsEnabled then clear(control.items) end
        control.refresh()
    end
    function control.setPlayers(value)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.playersEnabled = value == true
        if not control.playersEnabled then clear(control.players) end
        control.refresh()
    end
    local connection = host.game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(control.update)
    attachGui()
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        connection:Disconnect()
        clear(control.items)
        clear(control.players)
        gui:Destroy()
    end
    return control
end

return Tracers
end)()

local M1Assist = (function(): any
-- Changes only a held, native Melee request; the game still performs the attack.
-- Explicit calibration overrides readiness derived from the native animation chain.
local M1Assist: {[string]: any} = {}

function M1Assist.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local heartbeat = host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat
    local workspace = host.game:GetService("Workspace")
    local scripts = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local controllers = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
    local characterControllers = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("Character")
    local module = characterControllers and characterControllers:FindFirstChild("ToolController")
    local tool
    if module then
        tool = host.require(module)
    else
        -- PlayerScripts may have been removed after native Knit initialized.
        -- Resolve only the already-loaded named controller, without scanning globals.
        local storage = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage and storage:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local knitModule = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        if knitModule then
            local loadedKnit, knit = pcall(host.require, knitModule)
            if loadedKnit and type(knit) == "table" and type(knit.GetController) == "function" then
                local gotController, cached = pcall(knit.GetController, "ToolController")
                if gotController and type(cached) == "table" and type(cached.UseSetService) == "function" and type(cached.Melee) == "function" then
                    tool = cached
                end
            end
        end
    end
    assert(type(tool) == "table" and type(tool.UseSetService) == "function" and type(tool.Melee) == "function", "Native Melee is unavailable")
    local original = tool.UseSetService
    local debugInfo = if host.debug and type(host.debug.info) == "function" then host.debug.info else debug.info
    local currentMoveset = player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("Moveset")
    local control: any = {
        alive = true,
        enabled = false,
        method = "Downslam",
        generation = 0,
        finisherIndex = nil,
        finisherMoveset = currentMoveset,
        nativeMelee = tool.Melee,
        nativeChaseBridge = true,
        toolController = tool,
        pending = nil,
        focused = true,
        connections = {},
        readinessSource = "Unresolved",
        readinessIndex = nil,
        lastReason = "Finisher index has not been verified",
        controls = nil,
    }
    local function selectedMethod()
        return if control.method=='Random' then control.randomMethod or 'Neutral' else control.method
    end
    local function chooseRandomMethod()
        control.randomMethod=({'Downslam','Uppercut','Neutral'})[math.random(1,3)]
        return control.randomMethod
    end

    local function bindingHeld(binding: any): boolean
        local value = binding.KeyCode
        local valueType: string = typeof(value)
        if valueType ~= "EnumItem" then return false end
        local mouseNames = {
            MouseLeftButton = "MouseButton1",
            MouseRightButton = "MouseButton2",
            MouseMiddleButton = "MouseButton3",
            MouseButton1 = "MouseButton1",
            MouseButton2 = "MouseButton2",
            MouseButton3 = "MouseButton3",
        }
        local mouse = mouseNames[value.Name]
        local held = if mouse then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[mouse]) else value.EnumType == host.Enum.KeyCode and value ~= host.Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and value.Name ~= "None" and input:IsKeyDown(value)
        if not held then return false end
        local modifier = binding.PrimaryModifier
        local modifierType: string = typeof(modifier)
        if modifierType == "EnumItem" and modifier.Name ~= "None" and modifier.Name ~= "Unknown" then
            if modifier.EnumType ~= host.Enum.KeyCode or not input:IsKeyDown(modifier) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end

    function control.userM1Held(): boolean
        if not control.focused or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or menu.recording then return false end
        local keybinds = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Keybind")
        local combat = keybinds and keybinds:FindFirstChild("Combat")
        local action = combat and combat:FindFirstChild("Melee")
        if not action then return false end
        for _, binding in action:GetDescendants() do
            if binding:IsA("InputBinding") and bindingHeld(binding) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function permitted(character: any, humanoid: any, ownThird: boolean?): boolean
        if not character or player.Character ~= character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
        local state = humanoid:GetState()
        if humanoid.PlatformStand or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0) > 0 or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then return false end
        if character:GetAttribute("Stun") == true or character:GetAttribute("TrueStun") == true then return false end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return false end
        for _, name in {"Stun", "TrueStun", "Block", "Knockback", "InSkill", "DomainClash", "Throwable"} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) and not (name=="InSkill" and ownThird==true) then return false end
        end
        local item = info:FindFirstChild("Item")
        if item and item:FindFirstChild("M1") then return false end
        if character:FindFirstChild("CustomM1") then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function numberedChain(folder: any): number?
        if not folder then return nil end
        local indices, maximum = {}, 0
        for _, animation in folder:GetChildren() do
            if not animation:IsA("Animation") then continue end
            -- Split stages need their native handler; Melee3_2 is not hit 3.
            if animation.Name:match("^Melee%d+_") then return nil end
            local number = tonumber(animation.Name:match("^Melee(%d+)$"))
            if number then
                indices[number] = true
                maximum = math.max(maximum, number)
            end
        end
        if maximum < 2 or maximum > 5 then return nil end
        for index = 1, maximum do if not indices[index] then return nil end end
        return maximum
    end

    local function activeAnimationFolder(character: any): any
        local moveset=character and character:GetAttribute("Moveset")
        if type(moveset)~="string" then return nil end
        local animations = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Animations")
        local set = animations and animations:FindFirstChild(moveset)
        if not set then return nil end
        local ultimate = character:GetAttribute("InUlt") == true and set:FindFirstChild("MeleeUlt")
        local folder = ultimate or set:FindFirstChild("Melee")
        -- Weapon movesets keep distinct native chains below Melee. The active
        -- stance selects one of these folders; their hit counts need not agree.
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local stance = info and info:FindFirstChild("Stance")
        local value = if stance and stance:IsA("StringValue") then stance.Value else nil
        local weapon = folder and type(value) == "string" and folder:FindFirstChild(value)
        return weapon or folder
    end

    local chainConnections = {}
    local function disconnectChain()
        for _, connection in chainConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(chainConnections)
    end
    local function chainContext(character: any): any
        local info = character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local stance = info and info:FindFirstChild("Stance")
        local value = if stance and stance:IsA("StringValue") then stance.Value else nil
        local moveset = character and character:GetAttribute("Moveset")
        local inUlt = character and character:GetAttribute("InUlt")
        local folder = character and activeAnimationFolder(character)
        local current = control.chainContext
        if current and current.character == character and current.moveset == moveset and current.inUlt == inUlt
            and current.stance == stance and current.stanceValue == value and current.folder == folder then return current end
        disconnectChain()
        control.generation += 1
        control.randomMethod, control.confirmedThird, control.confirmedSecond, control.earlyJumpFlight = nil, nil, nil, nil
        if control.clearThirdPreparation then control.clearThirdPreparation() end
        control.finisherIndex, control.explicitFinisher = nil, nil
        control.readinessIndex = nil
        current = {character=character, moveset=moveset, inUlt=inUlt, stance=stance, stanceValue=value, folder=folder}
        control.chainContext = current
        if folder then
            local function invalidate()
                -- Replaced children must be reread even if the folder itself survives.
                current.scanned, current.index, current.source = nil, nil, nil
                control.readinessIndex = nil
                control.explicitFinisher, control.finisherIndex = nil, nil
                control.generation += 1
                control.confirmedThird, control.confirmedSecond, control.earlyJumpFlight = nil, nil, nil
                if control.clearThirdPreparation then control.clearThirdPreparation() end
            end
            table.insert(chainConnections, folder.ChildAdded:Connect(invalidate))
            table.insert(chainConnections, folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(invalidate))
        end
        return current
    end

    local function variantsAvailable(character: any): boolean
        local folder = chainContext(character).folder
        if not folder then return true end -- Explicit profiles may supply custom readiness.
        local down, up = folder:FindFirstChild("Down"), folder:FindFirstChild("Up")
        if not down or not up or not down:IsA("Animation") or not up:IsA("Animation") then
            control.readinessIndex = nil
            control.readinessSource = "Active native M1 set has no finishing variants: "..folder:GetFullName()
            control.lastReason = control.readinessSource
            return false
        end
        return true
    end

    function control.discoverFinisher(character: any): (number?, string)
        if character:FindFirstChild("CustomM1") or character:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") then
            return nil, "Custom M1 requires explicit calibration"
        end
        local context = chainContext(character)
        local moveset = context.moveset
        if type(moveset) ~= "string" then return nil, "Moveset is unavailable" end
        if context.scanned then return context.index, context.source end
        local folder = context.folder
        local index = numberedChain(folder)
        context.scanned = true
        if not index then
            context.source = "Active native M1 animation chain is ambiguous or unavailable"
            return nil, context.source
        end
        local down, up = folder:FindFirstChild("Down"), folder:FindFirstChild("Up")
        if not down or not up or not down:IsA("Animation") or not up:IsA("Animation") then
            context.source = "Native finishing variants are unavailable"
            return nil, context.source
        end
        context.index = index
        context.source = "Active native animation chain: "..folder:GetFullName().." ("..index.." hits)"
        return index, context.source
    end

    function control.finisherReady(character: any): boolean
        if not variantsAvailable(character) then return false end
        if type(menu.M1FinisherReady) == "function" then
            control.readinessSource = "Explicit native readiness predicate"
            control.readinessIndex = nil
            local ok, ready = pcall(menu.M1FinisherReady, character)
            return ok and ready == true
        end
        local context = chainContext(character)
        local explicit = control.explicitFinisher
        local index
        if explicit and explicit.context == context then
            index = explicit.index
            control.readinessSource = "Explicit calibration for the current native M1 set"
        else
            local source
            index, source = control.discoverFinisher(character)
            control.readinessSource = source
        end
        control.readinessIndex = index
        if type(index) ~= "number" or index < 1 or index > 5 or index % 1 ~= 0 then
            control.lastReason = control.readinessSource
            return false
        end
        -- CurrentM1 names the upcoming request after the preceding swing ends.
        -- Three-hit weapons therefore finish at 3, four-hit chains at 4.
        return character:GetAttribute("CurrentM1") == index
    end

    local function watchNativeSwings(character: any)
        local moveset = character and character:GetAttribute("Moveset")
        if control.swingCharacter == character and control.swingMoveset == moveset then return end
        if control.swingConnection then control.swingConnection:Disconnect(); control.swingConnection = nil end
        if control.swingTimingConnection then control.swingTimingConnection:Disconnect(); control.swingTimingConnection = nil end
        if control.clearThirdPreparation then control.clearThirdPreparation() end
        control.confirmedThird, control.confirmedSecond, control.earlyJumpFlight = nil, nil, nil
        control.swingCharacter, control.swingMoveset = character, moveset
        if not character or type(moveset) ~= "string" or type(tool.GetToolService) ~= "function" then return end
        local ok, service = pcall(tool.GetToolService, tool, moveset.."Service")
        if not ok or not service or not service.Effects then return end
        control.swingTimingConnection = character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CurrentM1"):Connect(function()
            local context = control.chainContext
            local swing = context and context.swingStarted
            if not context or context.character ~= character or not swing or character:GetAttribute("CurrentM1") ~= swing.stage+1 then return end
            local duration = host.os.clock()-swing.at
            if duration < 0.08 or duration > 1.5 then return end
            context.swingDurations = context.swingDurations or {}
            local previous = context.swingDurations[swing.stage]
            context.swingDurations[swing.stage] = if previous then math.max(duration,previous*0.9) else duration
        end)
        control.swingConnection = service.Effects:Connect(function(effect: any, caster: any, stage: any)
            if not control.alive or not control.enabled or caster ~= character or player.Character ~= character then return end
            if effect ~= "Swing2" then return end
            local context = chainContext(character)
            local explicit = control.explicitFinisher
            local index = if explicit and explicit.context == context then explicit.index else control.discoverFinisher(character)
            if type(index) ~= "number" then return end
            context.swingStarted = {stage=stage,at=host.os.clock()}
            if stage == 1 then
                control.confirmedSecond, control.earlyJumpFlight = nil, nil
            end
            if stage == 2 and index == 4 and control.method == "Downslam" and control.userM1Held() then
                control.confirmedSecond = {character=character, moveset=moveset, inUlt=character:GetAttribute("InUlt"), context=context, index=index, stage=2, deadline=host.os.clock()+1.2}
            end
            if stage == index-1 and control.userM1Held() then
                local preparation = control.thirdPreparation
                local retain = preparation and preparation.third == control.confirmedSecond and preparation.context == context
                if not retain and control.clearThirdPreparation then control.clearThirdPreparation() end
                if control.method=='Random' then chooseRandomMethod() end
                control.confirmedThird = {character=character, moveset=moveset, inUlt=character:GetAttribute("InUlt"), context=context, index=index, deadline=host.os.clock()+0.8}
                if retain then preparation.third, preparation.stamp = control.confirmedThird, character:GetAttribute("LastM1") end
                control.confirmedSecond = nil
                if control.prepareThirdJump then control.prepareThirdJump() end
            elseif stage == index then
                control.confirmedThird, control.confirmedSecond, control.earlyJumpFlight = nil, nil, nil
                control.randomMethod=nil
                if control.clearThirdPreparation then control.clearThirdPreparation() end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function thirdSwingBusy(character: any): boolean
        local record = control.confirmedThird
        if not record then return false end
        if record.character ~= character or host.os.clock() > record.deadline
            or character:GetAttribute("Moveset") ~= record.moveset or character:GetAttribute("InUlt") ~= record.inUlt or chainContext(character) ~= record.context
            or not control.userM1Held() then
            control.confirmedThird = nil
            return false
        end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info or character:GetAttribute("Stun") == true or character:GetAttribute("TrueStun") == true then
            control.confirmedThird = nil
            return false
        end
        for _, name in {"Stun", "TrueStun", "Block", "Knockback", "DomainClash", "Throwable"} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then control.confirmedThird = nil; return false end
        end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not permitted(character,humanoid,true) then
            control.confirmedThird = nil
            control.clearThirdPreparation()
            return false
        end
        -- The server's ending restriction and upcoming-hit counter can arrive
        -- in either order. Neither partial update may release a neutral M1
        -- ahead of the reserved final variant.
        local stage = character:GetAttribute("CurrentM1")
        return stage == record.index-1 or stage == record.index and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill") ~= nil
    end

    local function restoreJump(record: any)
        if not record then return end
        record.jumpRequested = false
        local hook = record.jumpHook
        local manualJump = false
        if hook then
            local ok, held = pcall(hook.original, hook.controller)
            manualJump = ok and held == true
            if hook.controller.GetIsJumping == hook.wrapper then
                hook.controller.GetIsJumping = hook.previousOwned
            end
            record.jumpHook = nil
        end
        if record.changedJump and not manualJump and record.humanoid.Parent and record.humanoid.Jump == true then
            record.humanoid.Jump = record.previousJump
        end
        record.changedJump = false
    end

    local function reserveNativeJump(record: any, permittedNow: any): boolean
        if not control.controls then
            local playerModule = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if playerModule then
                local ok, controls = pcall(function() return host.require(playerModule):GetControls() end)
                if ok then control.controls = controls end
            end
        end
        local controller = control.controls and control.controls.activeController
        if not controller or type(controller.GetIsJumping) ~= "function" then return false end
        local existing = record.jumpHook
        if existing then
            -- The penultimate preparation can already own this getter when
            -- the final native click arrives after Humanoid.Jump was reset.
            -- Reuse that reservation so cleanup restores the real getter.
            if existing.controller ~= controller or controller.GetIsJumping ~= existing.wrapper then return false end
            record.jumpRequested = true
            return true
        end
        local originalJump = controller.GetIsJumping
        local hook: any = {controller = controller, original = originalJump, previousOwned = rawget(controller, "GetIsJumping")}
        hook.wrapper = function(self: any, ...: any): any
            local nativeJump = originalJump(self, ...)
            if nativeJump then return nativeJump end
            if record.jumpRequested and (control.pending == record or control.thirdPreparation==record) and permittedNow()
                and control.controls.activeController == controller and controller.GetIsJumping == hook.wrapper then
                return true
            end
            return nativeJump
        end
        record.jumpHook, record.jumpRequested = hook, true
        controller.GetIsJumping = hook.wrapper
        return true
    end
    function control.clearThirdPreparation()
        restoreJump(control.thirdPreparation)
        control.thirdPreparation=nil
    end
    local function earlyAirWindow(record: any): boolean
        local context, humanoid = record.context, record.humanoid
        local duration = context.swingDurations and context.swingDurations[record.third.index-1]
        local gravity = workspace and tonumber(workspace.Gravity)
        if not duration or not gravity or gravity <= 0 then return false end
        local launch = if humanoid.UseJumpPower then humanoid.JumpPower else math.sqrt(2*gravity*math.max(0,humanoid.JumpHeight))
        if launch <= 0 then return false end
        local remaining = duration
        local swing = context.swingStarted
        local info = record.character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if swing and swing.stage == record.third.index-1 and info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill") then
            remaining = math.max(0,duration-(host.os.clock()-swing.at))
        end
        -- Preserve a quarter of the measured physical flight for replication
        -- and landing variance. Unknown or too-slow chains use the final jump.
        return remaining <= (2*launch/gravity)*0.75
    end
    function control.prepareThirdJump()
        local flight=control.earlyJumpFlight
        if flight and (not control.alive or not control.enabled or not control.userM1Held() or flight.humanoid.Health<=0
            or control.generation~=flight.generation or host.os.clock()>flight.third.deadline or player.Character~=flight.character
            or chainContext(flight.character)~=flight.context) then control.earlyJumpFlight=nil end
        if control.pending then return end
        local third=control.confirmedThird or control.confirmedSecond
        local record=control.thirdPreparation
        local character=if record then record.character else third and third.character
        local humanoid=if record then record.humanoid else character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not record and third and humanoid and selectedMethod()=="Downslam"
            and character:GetAttribute("CurrentM1")==third.index-1 then
            record={character=character,humanoid=humanoid,previousJump=humanoid.Jump,changedJump=false,generation=control.generation,
                moveset=third.moveset,inUlt=third.inUlt,context=third.context,health=humanoid.Health,third=third,stamp=character:GetAttribute("LastM1")}
            control.thirdPreparation=record
        end
        if not record then return end
        local function allowed()
            local stage=character:GetAttribute("CurrentM1")
            local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
            return control.alive and control.enabled and selectedMethod()=="Downslam" and control.userM1Held()
                and control.generation==record.generation and (control.confirmedThird or control.confirmedSecond)==record.third and host.os.clock()<=record.third.deadline
                and (stage==record.third.index-1 or stage==record.third.index) and character:GetAttribute("LastM1")==record.stamp
                and character:GetAttribute("Moveset")==record.moveset and character:GetAttribute("InUlt")==record.inUlt and chainContext(character)==record.context
                and humanoid.Health>=record.health and permitted(character,humanoid,stage==record.third.index-1)
                and (not record.jumpRequested or (info and not info:FindFirstChild("NoJump") and (if humanoid.UseJumpPower then humanoid.JumpPower>0 else humanoid.JumpHeight>0)))
                and (not record.jumpHook or (control.controls.activeController==record.jumpHook.controller and record.jumpHook.controller.GetIsJumping==record.jumpHook.wrapper))
        end
        record.allowed=allowed
        if not allowed() then
            if control.confirmedSecond==record.third then control.confirmedSecond=nil end
            control.clearThirdPreparation();return
        end
        if humanoid.FloorMaterial==host.Enum.Material.Air then record.airborneReached=true;restoreJump(record);return end
        if record.airborneReached then return end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if info:FindFirstChild("NoJump") or (if humanoid.UseJumpPower then humanoid.JumpPower<=0 else humanoid.JumpHeight<=0) then return end
        local early = record.third == control.confirmedSecond
        if early and not earlyAirWindow(record) then return end
        if not record.jumpRequested then
            if not reserveNativeJump(record,function()return record.allowed()end) then control.clearThirdPreparation();return end
            record.changedJump=record.previousJump~=true
            if early then control.earlyJumpFlight=record end
        end
        humanoid.Jump=true
        control.lastReason="Preparing normal downslam jump during the confirmed penultimate swing"
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,heartbeat:Connect(control.prepareThirdJump))

    local function cancel()
        control.generation += 1
        control.randomMethod=nil
        control.confirmedThird, control.confirmedSecond, control.earlyJumpFlight = nil, nil, nil
        control.clearThirdPreparation()
        restoreJump(control.pending)
        control.pending = nil
    end

    function control.pauseForFailsafe()
        -- Retain the selected feature configuration while retiring every
        -- owned reservation, including any yielded native finisher request.
        cancel()
    end

    table.insert(control.connections, input.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
        control.focused = false
        cancel()
    end))
    table.insert(control.connections, input.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
        control.focused = true
    end))
    if player.CharacterRemoving then
        table.insert(control.connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
            cancel()
            disconnectChain()
            control.chainContext, control.explicitFinisher = nil, nil
            control.readinessIndex, control.finisherIndex = nil, nil
            if control.swingConnection then control.swingConnection:Disconnect();control.swingConnection=nil end
            if control.swingTimingConnection then control.swingTimingConnection:Disconnect();control.swingTimingConnection=nil end
            control.swingCharacter, control.swingMoveset = nil, nil
        end))
    end

    function control.setEnabled(enabled: boolean)
        control.enabled = control.alive and enabled == true
        if not control.enabled then cancel() end
    end

    function control.setMethod(method: string)
        if method ~= "Random" and method ~= "Neutral" and method ~= "Downslam" and method ~= "Uppercut" then return end
        if control.method ~= method then cancel() end
        control.method = method
    end

    function control.setFinisherIndex(index: number, moveset: string?): boolean
        if type(index) ~= "number" or index < 1 or index > 5 or index % 1 ~= 0 then return false end
        local name = moveset or (player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute("Moveset"))
        local character = player.Character
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or not character or character:GetAttribute("Moveset") ~= name then return false end
        cancel()
        local context = chainContext(character)
        control.explicitFinisher = {context=context,index=index}
        control.finisherMoveset, control.finisherIndex = name, index
        control.lastReason = "Finisher index verified for "..name
        return true
    end

    local function nativeVariant(character: any, humanoid: any): any
        local airborne = humanoid.FloorMaterial == host.Enum.Material.Air
        local jumping = humanoid.Jump == true
        if character:GetAttribute("Moveset") == "Hanami" then
            return if jumping then "Up" elseif airborne then "Down" else false
        end
        return if airborne then "Down" elseif jumping then "Up" else false
    end

    local wrapper: any
    wrapper = function(self: any, action: string, ...: any): ...any
        -- Other menu actions and synthetic direct service calls pass unchanged.
        local caller = debugInfo(2, "f")
        if control.alive and action=='Chase' and menu.frontDash and type(menu.frontDash.observeNativeChase)=='function' then
            pcall(menu.frontDash.observeNativeChase,caller)
        end
        local aimAssist = menu.m1AimAssist
        if control.alive and action == "Activated" and caller == control.nativeMelee and aimAssist and type(aimAssist.beforeRequest) == "function" then
            aimAssist.beforeRequest()
        end
        if control.method=='Neutral' then
            -- Leave manual jump/airborne inputs to the game; this mode never
            -- reserves a finisher request, waits for a jump, or forces one.
            return original(self,action,...)
        end
        -- A second native held loop must not bypass the reserved final click
        -- when jumping, focus, or the game's own animation changes its state.
        if control.alive and action == "Activated" and caller == control.nativeMelee and control.pending then return end
        local held = control.userM1Held()
        if not held then control.confirmedThird, control.confirmedSecond, control.earlyJumpFlight = nil, nil, nil;control.randomMethod=nil;control.clearThirdPreparation() end
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or action ~= "Activated" or caller ~= control.nativeMelee or not held then
            return original(self, action, ...)
        end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        watchNativeSwings(character)
        if control.method=='Random' and control.randomMethod=='Neutral' then return original(self,action,...) end
        -- Once the native game confirms the penultimate hit, stop sending
        -- competing held-loop variants until the final-hit boundary.
        if character and thirdSwingBusy(character) then
            control.lastReason = "Waiting for the confirmed penultimate swing to finish"
            return
        end
        if not permitted(character, humanoid) or not control.finisherReady(character) then
            return original(self, action, ...)
        end
        if control.method=='Random' and not control.randomMethod then chooseRandomMethod() end
        local method=selectedMethod()
        if method=='Neutral' then return original(self,action,...) end
        if method == "Uppercut" and humanoid.FloorMaterial == host.Enum.Material.Air then
            control.lastReason = "Uppercut requires the character to be grounded"
            return original(self, action, ...)
        end
        local flight = control.earlyJumpFlight
        if method == "Downslam" and flight and flight.context == chainContext(character) and flight.airborneReached
            and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= host.Enum.Material.Air then
            control.lastReason = "The earlier normal jump has landed; no second automatic jump"
            return original(self,action,...)
        end
        local args = table.pack(...)
        local record: any = control.thirdPreparation or {humanoid = humanoid, previousJump = humanoid.Jump, changedJump = false, generation = control.generation,
            moveset = character:GetAttribute("Moveset"), inUlt = character:GetAttribute("InUlt"), context=chainContext(character), health = humanoid.Health}
        control.thirdPreparation=nil
        control.pending = record
        local function jumpBlocked(): boolean
            local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
            return info ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild("NoJump") ~= nil
                or (if humanoid.UseJumpPower then humanoid.JumpPower <= 0 else humanoid.JumpHeight <= 0)
        end
        local function preparationAllowed(): boolean
            -- This is one already-received native click. Releasing that click
            -- does not discard it while the normal jump is being prepared.
            return control.alive and control.enabled and control.focused and not input:GetFocusedTextBox() and not menu.recording
                and control.generation == record.generation and permitted(character, humanoid) and control.finisherReady(character)
                and character:GetAttribute("Moveset") == record.moveset and character:GetAttribute("InUlt") == record.inUlt
                and chainContext(character) == record.context
                and humanoid.Health >= record.health
                and (not record.jumpRequested or not jumpBlocked())
                and (not record.jumpHook or (control.controls.activeController == record.jumpHook.controller
                    and record.jumpHook.controller.GetIsJumping == record.jumpHook.wrapper))
        end
        local function abandon(reason: string)
            restoreJump(record)
            if control.pending == record then control.pending = nil end
            control.lastReason = reason
        end
        record.allowed=preparationAllowed
        -- Downslam requires an actual normal jump. Uppercut selects the native
        -- grounded Up payload without setting the physical Jump flag or
        -- waiting for the preceding hit's NoJump marker to expire.
        if method == "Downslam" and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= host.Enum.Material.Air and not humanoid.Jump and jumpBlocked() then
            local ending = host.os.clock()+0.4
            repeat
                heartbeat:Wait()
                if not preparationAllowed() then abandon("Finisher preparation was cancelled by native state or input focus"); return end
            until not jumpBlocked() or host.os.clock() >= ending
            if jumpBlocked() then
                abandon("Normal jumping is unavailable")
                return original(self, action, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
            end
        end
        if method == "Downslam" and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= host.Enum.Material.Air and not humanoid.Jump then
            if not reserveNativeJump(record, preparationAllowed) then
                abandon("Native jump controls are unavailable")
                return original(self, action, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
            end
            record.changedJump = true
            humanoid.Jump = true
        end
        if method == "Downslam" and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= host.Enum.Material.Air then
            local ending = host.os.clock()+0.25
            repeat
                heartbeat:Wait()
                if not preparationAllowed() then abandon("Finisher preparation was cancelled by native state or input focus"); return end
            until humanoid.FloorMaterial == host.Enum.Material.Air or host.os.clock() >= ending
            restoreJump(record)
            if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= host.Enum.Material.Air then
                control.pending = nil
                control.lastReason = "Normal jump did not leave the ground"
                return original(self, action, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
            end
        end
        if not preparationAllowed() then
            restoreJump(record)
            if control.pending == record then control.pending = nil end
            control.lastReason = "The finishing hit is no longer ready"
            return
        end
        args[1] = if method == "Uppercut" then "Up" else nativeVariant(character, humanoid)
        args.n = math.max(args.n, 1)
        if aimAssist and type(aimAssist.beforeRequest) == "function" then aimAssist.beforeRequest() end
        local results = table.pack(pcall(original, self, action, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)))
        restoreJump(record)
        if control.pending == record then control.pending = nil end
        if not results[1] then error(results[2], 0) end
        control.lastReason = "Native finisher request prepared"
        return table.unpack(results, 2, results.n)
    end
    tool.UseSetService = wrapper

    function control.hasRequestHook(): boolean
        return control.alive and tool.UseSetService == wrapper
    end

    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive, control.enabled = false, false
        cancel()
        disconnectChain()
        if control.swingConnection then control.swingConnection:Disconnect(); control.swingConnection = nil end
        if control.swingTimingConnection then control.swingTimingConnection:Disconnect(); control.swingTimingConnection = nil end
        if tool.UseSetService == wrapper then tool.UseSetService = original end
        for _, connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end

    return control
end

return M1Assist
end)()

local SideDisplays = (function(): any
-- Small transparent side gauges; native cooldown cards keep their original layout.
local SideDisplays: {[string]: any} = {}
function SideDisplays.warningAlpha(age: number,now: number): number
    if age~=age or now~=now or age<0 or age>=.35 or math.abs(now)==math.huge then return 1 end
    return if (now*12)%1<.5 then .1+.9*age/.35 else 1
end
function SideDisplays.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local world, players = host.workspace,host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local function isDisplayNPC(model,name)
        return model and model.Name==name
            and (type(players.GetPlayerFromCharacter)~="function" or players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)==nil)
    end
    local control: any = {alive=true,records={},elapsed=0,barThickness=3,resourceHeight=320,selfResourceHeight=320,resourceSide="Automatic",selfResourceSide="Automatic",cooldownTransparency=0.75,cooldownScale=1,selfCooldownScale=1,metersPerStud=1,nextRecordId=0,visibilityClock=0,perspectiveScaleEnabled=true,perspectiveReferenceDepth=25,sourceCandidates={},sourceBootstrapScans=0,holderMetricScans=0}
    control.deadModels=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    local function deadState(state)
        local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        return states~=nil and state==states.Dead
    end
    local function actorDead(model,humanoid)
        if not model then return false end
        humanoid=humanoid or model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if model:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then return true end
        if humanoid and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' and deadState(humanoid:GetState()) then return true end
        local died=control.deadModels[model]
        if died then
            if humanoid and humanoid~=died and humanoid.Health>0 then control.deadModels[model]=nil
            else return true end
        end
        return humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health<=0
    end
    -- Roblox's standard scale is 28 cm/stud: https://create.roblox.com/docs/physics/units
    function control.studsToMeters(studs)
        local amount=tonumber(studs) or 0
        if amount~=amount or amount==math.huge or amount==-math.huge then return 0 end
        return math.max(amount,0)*control.metersPerStud
    end
    control.resourceOffset=host.Vector3.zero
    control.selfResourceOffset=host.Vector3.zero
    -- TintedGlassesOn sets the native Reveal cooldown display to 75 studs.
    -- This shared bar limit uses character distance and leaves name ESP separate.
    control.maxViewDistance=75
    control.resourceBarSpacing,control.resourceCardSpacing=4,4
    control.selfSpecialEnabled=true
    -- Per-part switches for every cooldown viewer (yours and other players'): HP bar, HP numbers, evasive, special, ultimate, skill cooldowns.
    control.viewerShow={health=true,numbers=true,evasive=true,special=true,ult=true,cooldowns=true}
    function control.setViewerShow(key,value)
        if control.viewerShow[key]==nil then return false end
        control.viewerShow[key]=value==true;return true
    end
    control.enemySpecialEnabled=true
    control.frontDashEnabled=true
    control.frontDashPlacement='Below Cooldowns'
    control.frontDashColor=host.Color3.fromRGB(40,145,255)
    control.frontDashTransparency=0.35
    control.sideDashColor=host.Color3.fromRGB(255,220,35)
    control.sideDashTransparency=0.55
    control.dashBarBackgroundColor=host.Color3.fromRGB(18,24,30)
    control.dashBarBackgroundTransparency=1
    control.dashBarOutlineColor=host.Color3.fromRGB(18,24,30)
    control.dashBarOutlineTransparency,control.dashBarOutlineThickness=.35,2
    control.dashBarLength,control.dashBarThickness=100,4.5
    control.dashBarOffsetX,control.dashBarOffsetY=0,0
    control.barDepth=1
    control.dashOverlayOrder='Side Over Front'
    control.sideDashOverlayEnabled,control.dashStatusTextEnabled=true,false
    control.barLayoutVersion=0
    control.barSettings={}
    for _,role in {'Health','Evasive','Special','Ultimate','Cooldown'} do
        control.barSettings[role]={width=100,length=100,x=0,y=0,fillMode='Natural',fillColor=host.Color3.new(1,1,1),
            fillTransparency=if role=='Ultimate' then 0 elseif role=='Cooldown' then .75 else .4,
            backgroundColor=if role=='Ultimate' then host.Color3.new(1,1,1) else host.Color3.fromRGB(18,24,30),
            backgroundTransparency=if role=='Ultimate' then .5 elseif role=='Cooldown' then .75 else 1}
    end
    control.barOutlines={}
    for _,role in {'Health','Evasive','Special'} do
        control.barOutlines[role]={color=host.Color3.fromRGB(18,24,30),transparency=.35,width=2}
    end
    control.barOutlines.Ultimate={color=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),transparency=0,width=2}
    control.barOutlines.Cooldown={color=host.Color3.new(.77,.53,0),transparency=0,width=2}
    control.cooldownOffsetY=0
    -- The bar data (values and text) refreshes 90 times a second; where the bars sit is still presented every frame, so motion stays smooth.
    control.updateRate,control.renderBudget,control.renderDelta=90,0,0
    control.dataElapsed,control.dataUpdates=0,0
    control.renderUpdates,control.renderSkipped=0,0
    function control.setUpdateRate(value)
        local rate=tonumber(value)
        if not rate or rate~=rate or math.abs(rate)==math.huge then return false end
        control.updateRate=math.clamp(rate,30,240)
        control.renderBudget,control.renderDelta=0,0
        return true
    end
    function control.displaySide(model)
        return if model~=nil and model==player.Character then control.selfResourceSide else control.resourceSide
    end
    function control.displayOffset(model)
        return if model~=nil and model==player.Character then control.selfResourceOffset else control.resourceOffset
    end
    function control.displayScale(model)
        return if model~=nil and model==player.Character then control.selfCooldownScale else control.cooldownScale
    end
    function control.perspectiveFactor(_unitsPerPixel,_rigScale)
        -- Reference layout units; the native stud-sized BillboardGui handles
        -- projection. Camera zoom never rewrites rendered geometry.
        return 1
    end
    function control.barHeight(unitsPerPixel,rigScale,model)
        -- Saved dimensions are reference units, converted to world studs
        -- using the game's own native viewer height.
        local own=model~=nil and model==player.Character
        local height=if own then control.selfResourceHeight else control.resourceHeight
        local scale=control.displayScale(model)
        return height*scale*control.perspectiveFactor(unitsPerPixel,rigScale)
    end
    function control.healthColor(fraction)
        local health=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
        local red,yellow,green=host.Color3.fromRGB(255,65,65),host.Color3.fromRGB(255,210,60),host.Color3.fromRGB(30,220,85)
        return if health<=0.5 then red:Lerp(yellow,health*2) else yellow:Lerp(green,(health-0.5)*2)
    end
    local gui = host.Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name,gui.ResetOnSpawn,gui.IgnoreGuiInset="ShenaniganismSideDisplays",false,true
    gui.ZIndexBehavior=host.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    control.gui=gui
    function control.syncLayer()
        local root = menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        local main = root and (if root:IsA("ScreenGui") then root else root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui"))
        local order = if main then main.DisplayOrder - 1 else 0
        if gui.DisplayOrder ~= order then gui.DisplayOrder = order end
    end
    local function isInfoTarget(model)
        if model == player.Character then return true end
        if menu.infoTargetOnly ~= true then return true end
        if type(menu.isInfoTarget) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, allowed = pcall(menu.isInfoTarget, model)
        return ok and allowed == true
    end
    local function make(class,parent)
        local object=host.Instance.new(class);object.Parent=parent;return object
    end
    local function put(object,property,value)
        local previous=object[property]
        if previous==value then return end
        -- Roblox stores GUI numbers as floats; readback rounding must not
        -- turn an unchanged transparency into a write every render update.
        if type(previous)=='number' and type(value)=='number' and math.abs(previous-value)<=1e-6 then return end
        object[property]=value
    end
    local listen,disconnect
    -- Ult's chrome is neutral: keep meter palettes and opacity settings on the
    -- original frames, and layer its dark-to-light depth on owned children.
    local function chromeStyle(): any
        if control.barChromeStyle then return control.barChromeStyle end
        local white,black=host.Color3.new(1,1,1),host.Color3.new(0,0,0)
        local sequence,keypoint=host.NumberSequence,host.NumberSequenceKeypoint
        local outerAlpha=sequence and (if keypoint then sequence.new({keypoint.new(0,0),keypoint.new(.773006,.502762),keypoint.new(1,.530387)}) else sequence.new(0,.530387))
        local style={borderSize=2,borderColor=black,outerColor=host.ColorSequence.new(white,white),outerAlpha=outerAlpha,
            outerRotation=90,depthAlpha=sequence and sequence.new(0,1),depthRotation=-90,source='Ult defaults'}
        local ok,native=pcall(function()
            local storage=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
            local utils=storage and storage:FindFirstChild('Utils')
            local reveal=utils and utils:FindFirstChild('Reveal')
            return reveal and reveal:FindFirstChild('Ult')
        end)
        if ok and native then
            style.source='Native Reveal.Ult'
            style.borderSize=tonumber(native.BorderSizePixel) or 2
            style.borderColor=native.BorderColor3 or black
            local outer=native:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
            if outer then style.outerColor,style.outerAlpha,style.outerRotation=outer.Color,outer.Transparency,outer.Rotation end
            local fill=native:FindFirstChild('Fill')
            local depth=fill and fill:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
            if depth then style.depthRotation=depth.Rotation end
        end
        control.barChromeStyle=style
        return style
    end
    local function restoreChrome(record: any,target: any)
        local chrome=record.barChrome and record.barChrome[target]
        if not chrome then return end
        if control.appearanceAdapter then control.appearanceAdapter.unbind(chrome) end
        disconnect(chrome.connections)
        for object,properties in chrome.original do
            if object.Parent then
                for property,value in properties do
                    if object[property]==chrome.applied[object][property] then put(object,property,value) end
                end
            end
        end
        for _,object in chrome.owned do if object.Parent then object:Destroy() end end
        record.barChrome[target]=nil
    end
    local function writeChrome(chrome: any,object: any,property: string,value: any)
        chrome.original[object]=chrome.original[object] or {}
        chrome.applied[object]=chrome.applied[object] or {}
        if chrome.applied[object][property]==nil then chrome.original[object][property]=object[property] end
        chrome.applied[object][property]=value
        put(object,property,value)
    end
    local function decorateChrome(record: any,target: any,kind: string,adopted: boolean?): any
        if not target or not target.Parent then return nil end
        record.barChrome=record.barChrome or {}
        local found=record.barChrome[target]
        if found then return found end
        local style=chromeStyle()
        local chrome: any={target=target,kind=kind,adopted=adopted==true,connections={},owned={},original={},applied={}}
        record.barChrome[target]=chrome
        local function own(class,parent,name)
            local object=make(class,parent)
            object.Name=name;object:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismBarChrome',true)
            table.insert(chrome.owned,object)
            return object
        end
        local function adopt(object,property,value)
            writeChrome(chrome,object,property,value)
        end
        if kind=='Fill' and style.depthAlpha then
            local shade=own('Frame',target,'ShenaniganismUltDepth')
            shade.BorderSizePixel=0;shade.BackgroundColor3=host.Color3.new(0,0,0)
            shade.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1);shade.Position=host.UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
            shade.ZIndex=target.ZIndex or 1
            local gradient=own('UIGradient',shade,'ShenaniganismUltDepthGradient')
            gradient.Color=host.ColorSequence.new(host.Color3.new(1,1,1),host.Color3.new(1,1,1))
            gradient.Transparency,gradient.Rotation=style.depthAlpha,style.depthRotation
            chrome.shade,chrome.gradient=shade,gradient
            local function syncAlpha()
                local depth=if control.appearanceAdapter then control.appearanceAdapter.depthFor(chrome.appearanceRole,control.barDepth) else control.barDepth
                local alpha=1-(1-(tonumber(target.BackgroundTransparency) or 0))*depth
                if shade.Parent then put(shade,'BackgroundTransparency',alpha);put(shade,'Visible',alpha<1) end
            end
            chrome.syncAlpha=syncAlpha
            syncAlpha()
            if type(target.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function' then listen(target:GetPropertyChangedSignal('BackgroundTransparency'),syncAlpha,chrome.connections) end
        elseif kind=='Track' and style.outerAlpha then
            local gradient=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
            if gradient then
                for property,value in {Color=style.outerColor,Transparency=style.outerAlpha,Rotation=style.outerRotation,Enabled=true} do adopt(gradient,property,value) end
            else
                gradient=own('UIGradient',target,'ShenaniganismUltTrackGradient')
                gradient.Color,gradient.Transparency,gradient.Rotation,gradient.Enabled=style.outerColor,style.outerAlpha,style.outerRotation,true
            end
            chrome.gradient=gradient
            if adopted then adopt(target,'BorderSizePixel',0) end
        end
        return chrome
    end
    local function appearanceRole(chrome: any,role: string)
        if not chrome then return end
        chrome.appearanceRole=role
        if control.appearanceAdapter then control.appearanceAdapter.bind(chrome,role) end
    end
    function control.setAppearanceAdapter(adapter)
        if adapter==control.appearanceAdapter then return true end
        local previous=control.appearanceAdapter
        for _,record in control.records do for _,chrome in record.barChrome or {} do if previous then previous.unbind(chrome) end end end
        control.appearanceAdapter=adapter
        for _,record in control.records do for _,chrome in record.barChrome or {} do
            if adapter and chrome.appearanceRole then adapter.bind(chrome,chrome.appearanceRole) end
            if chrome.syncAlpha then chrome.syncAlpha() end
        end end
        return true
    end
    local function syncCooldownOutline()
        local native=menu.nativeBaseFeatures
        if not native then return end
        local style=control.barOutlines.Cooldown
        if native.cooldownReadyColor then style.color=native.cooldownReadyColor end
        if type(native.cooldownReadyTransparency)=='number' then style.transparency=native.cooldownReadyTransparency end
        local settings=control.barSettings.Cooldown
        settings.fillColor=native.cooldownBarColor or settings.fillColor
        settings.fillTransparency=native.cooldownFillTransparency or settings.fillTransparency
        settings.backgroundColor=native.cooldownBackgroundColor or settings.backgroundColor
        settings.backgroundTransparency=control.cooldownTransparency
    end
    local function applyBarOutline(record: any,target: any,role: string)
        local style=control.barOutlines[role]
        if not target or not target.Parent or not style then return end
        local chrome=record.barChrome and record.barChrome[target] or decorateChrome(record,target,'Outline',true)
        if not chrome then return end
        chrome.outlineRole=role
        local outline=chrome.outline
        if not outline or outline.Parent~=target then
            outline=target:FindFirstChild('Outline') or target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIStroke')
            if not outline or not outline:IsA('UIStroke') then
                outline=make('UIStroke',target)
                outline.Name=if role=='Cooldown' then 'Outline' else 'ShenaniganismBarOutline'
                outline:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismBarChrome',true)
                table.insert(chrome.owned,outline)
            end
            chrome.outline=outline
        end
        if chrome.adopted then writeChrome(chrome,target,'BorderSizePixel',0) end
        writeChrome(chrome,outline,'Color',style.color)
        writeChrome(chrome,outline,'Transparency',style.transparency)
        writeChrome(chrome,outline,'Thickness',style.width)
        appearanceRole(chrome,role)
    end
    local function applyAllBarOutlines()
        syncCooldownOutline()
        for _,record in control.records do
            for target,chrome in record.barChrome or {} do
                if chrome.outlineRole and target.Parent then applyBarOutline(record,target,chrome.outlineRole) end
            end
        end
    end
    function control.setBarOutlineColor(role,value)
        local style=control.barOutlines[role]
        if not style or (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        local native=menu.nativeBaseFeatures
        if role=='Cooldown' and native and native.setCooldownReadyColor then native.setCooldownReadyColor(value) end
        style.color=value;applyAllBarOutlines();return true
    end
    function control.setBarOutlineTransparency(role,value)
        local style=control.barOutlines[role];local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not style or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        amount=math.clamp(amount,0,100)
        local native=menu.nativeBaseFeatures
        if role=='Cooldown' and native and native.setCooldownReadyTransparency then native.setCooldownReadyTransparency(amount) end
        style.transparency=amount/100;applyAllBarOutlines();return true
    end
    function control.setBarOutlineThickness(role,value)
        local style=control.barOutlines[role];local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not style or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        style.width=math.clamp(amount,0,10);applyAllBarOutlines();return true
    end
    function control.setBarDepth(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.barDepth=math.clamp(amount,0,100)/100
        for _,record in control.records do for _,chrome in record.barChrome or {} do if chrome.syncAlpha then chrome.syncAlpha() end end end
        if control.appearanceAdapter then control.appearanceAdapter.refreshDepth() end
        return true
    end
    local function changeBarSetting(role,field,value,minimum,maximum)
        local settings=control.barSettings[role];local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not settings or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        settings[field]=math.clamp(amount,minimum,maximum)
        control.barLayoutVersion+=1
        control.customBarLayout=false
        for _,current in control.barSettings do
            if current.width~=100 or current.length~=100 or current.x~=0 or current.y~=0 then control.customBarLayout=true;break end
        end
        control.update(0);return true
    end
    function control.setBarWidth(role,value)return changeBarSetting(role,'width',value,10,300)end
    function control.setBarLength(role,value)return changeBarSetting(role,'length',value,10,300)end
    function control.setBarOffsetX(role,value)return changeBarSetting(role,'x',value,-300,300)end
    function control.setBarOffsetY(role,value)return changeBarSetting(role,'y',value,-300,300)end
    local function refreshBarColors()
        control.update(0)
    end
    function control.setBarFillMode(role,value)
        local settings=control.barSettings[role]
        if not settings or role=='Cooldown' or (value~='Natural' and value~='Custom') then return false end
        settings.fillMode=value;refreshBarColors();return true
    end
    function control.setBarFillColor(role,value)
        local settings=control.barSettings[role]
        if not settings or (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        settings.fillColor=value
        local base=menu.nativeBaseFeatures
        if role=='Cooldown' and base and base.setCooldownBarColor then base.setCooldownBarColor(value) end
        refreshBarColors();return true
    end
    function control.setBarBackgroundColor(role,value)
        local settings=control.barSettings[role]
        if not settings or (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        settings.backgroundColor=value
        local base=menu.nativeBaseFeatures
        if role=='Cooldown' and base and base.setCooldownBackgroundColor then base.setCooldownBackgroundColor(value) end
        refreshBarColors();return true
    end
    local function setBarAlpha(role,field,value)
        local settings=control.barSettings[role];local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not settings or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        amount=math.clamp(amount,0,100);settings[field]=amount/100
        local base=menu.nativeBaseFeatures
        if role=='Cooldown' then
            if field=='fillTransparency' and base and base.setCooldownFillTransparency then base.setCooldownFillTransparency(amount)
            elseif field=='backgroundTransparency' then control.setCooldownTransparency(amount) end
        end
        refreshBarColors();return true
    end
    function control.setBarFillTransparency(role,value)return setBarAlpha(role,'fillTransparency',value)end
    function control.setBarBackgroundTransparency(role,value)return setBarAlpha(role,'backgroundTransparency',value)end
    function control.setDashOverlayOrder(value)
        if value~='Side Over Front' and value~='Front Over Side' then return false end
        control.dashOverlayOrder=value;control.update(0);return true
    end
    function control.setSideDashOverlayEnabled(value)control.sideDashOverlayEnabled=value==true;control.update(0);return true end
    function control.setDashStatusTextEnabled(value)control.dashStatusTextEnabled=value==true;control.update(0);return true end
    local function offsetValue(record,key,x,y)
        local cached=record[key]
        if not cached or cached.x~=x or cached.y~=y then
            if not cached then cached={};record[key]=cached end
            cached.x,cached.y,cached.value=x,y,host.UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
        end
        return cached.value
    end
    local function scaleValue(record,key,x,y)
        local cached=record[key]
        if not cached or cached.x~=x or cached.y~=y then
            if not cached then cached={};record[key]=cached end
            cached.x,cached.y,cached.value=x,y,host.UDim2.fromScale(x,y)
        end
        return cached.value
    end
    local function rectangleValue(record,key,x,y,w,h)
        local rectangle=record[key]
        if not rectangle then rectangle={};record[key]=rectangle end
        rectangle.x,rectangle.y,rectangle.w,rectangle.h=x,y,w,h
        return rectangle
    end
    local function finiteAnchor(value)
        if not value then return false end
        local x,y,z=value.X,value.Y,value.Z
        return type(x)=='number' and type(y)=='number' and type(z)=='number'
            and x==x and y==y and z==z and math.abs(x)<math.huge and math.abs(y)<math.huge and math.abs(z)<math.huge
    end
    function control.presentAnchor(record,root,localOffset,_delta)
        -- The native root attachment owns all movement. Keep its configured
        -- local offset exact instead of counter-transforming a prior world pose.
        record.anchorPresentation=nil
        put(record.attachment,'Position',localOffset)
        local anchor=record.attachment.WorldPosition
        if finiteAnchor(anchor) then return anchor end
        local frame=root.CFrame
        if frame and type(frame.PointToWorldSpace)=='function' then
            anchor=frame:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
            if finiteAnchor(anchor) then return anchor end
        end
        if type(root.GetRenderCFrame)=='function' then
            local okay,rendered=pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame,root)
            if okay and rendered and type(rendered.PointToWorldSpace)=='function' then
                anchor=rendered:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
                if finiteAnchor(anchor) then return anchor end
            end
        end
        if not frame and finiteAnchor(root.Position) then
            anchor=root.Position+localOffset
            if finiteAnchor(anchor) then return anchor end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function presentationFrame(record,point)
        -- Both canvases and the late presenter share the same world pose.
        -- Cache only its value construction; put() still checks native state.
        if record.cachedPresentationPoint~=point or not record.cachedPresentationFrame then
            record.cachedPresentationPoint=point
            record.cachedPresentationFrame=host.CFrame.new(point)
        end
        return record.cachedPresentationFrame
    end
    function control.bindCanvas(record,canvas)
        local attachment=record.attachment
        if not attachment then return false end
        local root=attachment.Parent
        local target=if root and root.Parent and type(root.IsA)=='function' and root:IsA('BasePart') then attachment.WorldPosition else nil
        local adornee=attachment
        if finiteAnchor(target) and host.CFrame and type(host.CFrame.new)=='function' then
            local folder=control.anchorFolder
            if not folder or folder.Parent~=world then
                if folder then folder:Destroy() end
                folder=make('Folder',world);folder.Name='ShenaniganismHudPresentation'
                control.anchorFolder=folder
            end
            local anchor=record.worldAnchor
            local frame=presentationFrame(record,target)
            if not anchor or anchor.Parent~=folder then
                if anchor then anchor:Destroy() end
                -- Configure before parenting: this display-only part must never
                -- enter the character assembly, its bounds, or world queries.
                anchor=host.Instance.new('Part')
                anchor.Name,anchor.Size,anchor.Transparency='DisplayOnlyAnchor',host.Vector3.new(.01,.01,.01),1
                anchor.Anchored,anchor.CanCollide,anchor.CanTouch,anchor.CanQuery=true,false,false,false
                anchor.CastShadow=false
                anchor.CFrame,anchor.Parent=frame,folder
                record.worldAnchor=anchor
            else put(anchor,'CFrame',frame) end
            -- Exact world position, independently of character-root transform
            -- interpolation. Both canvases share this one native 3D anchor.
            adornee=anchor
        end
        put(canvas,'Adornee',adornee)
        put(canvas,'StudsOffset',host.Vector3.zero)
        put(canvas,'StudsOffsetWorldSpace',host.Vector3.zero)
        if canvas==record.source then
            local applied=record.sourceBindingApplied
            if not applied then applied={};record.sourceBindingApplied=applied end
            applied.Adornee,applied.StudsOffset,applied.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=adornee,host.Vector3.zero,host.Vector3.zero
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.presentWorldAnchors()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.presentationUpdates=(control.presentationUpdates or 0)+1
        for model,record in control.records do
            local anchor,attachment=record.worldAnchor,record.attachment
            if record.hardHidden or not model.Parent or not anchor or anchor.Parent~=control.anchorFolder
                or not attachment or not attachment.Parent then continue end
            local point=attachment.WorldPosition
            if finiteAnchor(point)then put(anchor,'CFrame',presentationFrame(record,point))end
        end
    end
    listen=function(signal,callback,connections)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then
            local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
            table.insert(connections,connection)
        end
    end
    disconnect=function(connections)
        for _,connection in connections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    -- The legacy registry retains destroyed objects until unload. Scan it only
    -- once; newly parented monitors arrive through the world's lifecycle signal.
    local sourceConnections,pendingSources={},{}
    local function forgetSource(source)
        local candidate=control.sourceCandidates[source]
        if candidate then disconnect(candidate.connections);control.sourceCandidates[source]=nil end
    end
    local function observeSource(source)
        if not control.alive or not source:IsA('BillboardGui') or not menu.state.instances[source]
            or control.sourceCandidates[source] then return end
        local candidate={connections={}}
        control.sourceCandidates[source]=candidate
        -- Name can be assigned after Parent by native UI constructors.
        candidate.named=source.Name=='CDVIEW_AbilityMonitor'
        local function suppressDeadSource()
            if not control.alive or not candidate.named then return end
            local model=source.Parent and source.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
            if model then candidate.model=model else model=candidate.model end
