            if model and actorDead(model) then put(source,'Enabled',false) end
        end
        if type(source.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function' then
            listen(source:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),function()
                candidate.named=source.Name=='CDVIEW_AbilityMonitor'
                suppressDeadSource()
            end,candidate.connections)
            listen(source:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Enabled'),suppressDeadSource,candidate.connections)
        end
        listen(source.AncestryChanged,suppressDeadSource,candidate.connections)
        listen(source.Destroying,function() forgetSource(source) end,candidate.connections)
        suppressDeadSource()
    end
    function control.noteOwnedBillboard(source)
        if not control.alive then return end
        -- The managed constructor has already recorded ownership. Geometry
        -- and Parent may still be assigned by subsequent VM instructions.
        pendingSources[source]=true
        observeSource(source)
    end
    local function bootstrapSources()
        if control.sourceBootstrapScans>0 then return end
        control.sourceBootstrapScans+=1
        for source in menu.state.instances do
            if source.Parent and source:IsA('BillboardGui') then observeSource(source) end
        end
    end
    local function stopHolder(record)
        disconnect(record.holderConnections)
        for _,connections in record.holderNodes or {} do disconnect(connections) end
        record.holderConnections,record.holderNodes,record.holderDirty=nil,nil,nil
    end
    local function observeHolder(record)
        local holder=record.holder
        record.holderConnections,record.holderNodes,record.holderDirty={},{},true
        local function dirty() if control.alive and record.holder==holder then record.holderDirty=true end end
        local function watch(object)
            if record.holderNodes[object] then return end
            local connections={}
            record.holderNodes[object]=connections
            local property=if object:IsA('Frame') and object.Parent==holder then 'Visible'
                elseif object:IsA('UIAspectRatioConstraint') then 'AspectRatio'
                elseif object:IsA('UIListLayout') and object.Parent==holder then 'Padding' else nil
            if property and type(object.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function' then
                listen(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property),dirty,connections)
            end
        end
        -- Observe the structure once and retain only relevant property signals.
        for _,object in holder:GetDescendants() do watch(object) end
        listen(holder.DescendantAdded,function(object) watch(object);dirty() end,record.holderConnections)
        listen(holder.DescendantRemoving,function(object)
            local connections=record.holderNodes[object]
            if connections then disconnect(connections);record.holderNodes[object]=nil end
            local original=record.cardProperties[object]
            if original~=nil and object.Parent and object.BackgroundTransparency==control.cooldownTransparency then
                object.BackgroundTransparency=original
            end
            record.cardProperties[object]=nil
            dirty()
        end,record.holderConnections)
    end
    local function detachPanel(record)
        local panel,screen=record.panel,record.screenDisplay
        if not panel or not screen or not panel.Parent or not screen.Parent then return false end
        -- Destroying can be deferred until after descendant destruction. A
        -- destroyed Instance has a locked Parent and cannot be resurrected.
        return pcall(function()
            put(panel,"Parent",record.display)
            put(panel,"Position",record.fallbackPanelPosition or host.UDim2.fromOffset(34,14))
            if record.fallbackPanelSize then put(panel,'Size',record.fallbackPanelSize) end
            if record.width and record.height and record.textWidth and record.textHeight then
                local projection=record.perspectiveFactor or 1
                put(record.text,'Position',scaleValue(record,'healthTextPositionValue',(record.width-record.textWidth)*.5/record.width,(-record.textHeight-2*projection)/record.height))
            end
        end)
    end
    local function detachDistance(record)
        local label=record.distanceLabel
        if label and label.Parent and gui.Parent then pcall(function() put(label,"Parent",gui) end) end
    end
    local function detachFrontDash(record)
        for _,key in {'frontDashTrack','frontDashHorizontalTrack'} do
            local track=record[key]
            if track and track.Parent and record.display and record.display.Parent then
                pcall(function() put(track,'Visible',false);put(track,'Parent',record.display) end)
            end
        end
    end
    function control.feetPosition(record,root,position)
        position=position or root.Position
        return host.Vector3.new(position.X,record.stableY-(record.feetDrop or 3*record.scale)+.5,position.Z)
    end
    local function restoreUltimateStyle(record)
        for object,properties in record.ultimateStyleOriginal or {} do
            if object.Parent then
                local applied=record.ultimateStyleApplied[object]
                for property,value in properties do
                    if applied and object[property]==applied[property] then put(object,property,value) end
                end
            end
        end
        local owned=record.ultimateOwnedGradient
        if owned and owned.Parent then owned:Destroy() end
        record.ultimateFill,record.ultimateGradient,record.ultimateOwnedGradient=nil,nil,nil
        record.ultimateStyleOriginal,record.ultimateStyleApplied=nil,nil
    end
    local function applyUltimateStyle(record,object,property,value)
        record.ultimateStyleApplied[object][property]=value
        put(object,property,value)
    end
    local function restoreSource(record,dead)
        stopHolder(record)
        for target,chrome in record.barChrome or {} do if chrome.adopted then restoreChrome(record,target) end end
        if record.sourceDestroying then record.sourceDestroying:Disconnect();record.sourceDestroying=nil end
        -- Move only our gauges back to their screen fallback before the native
        -- monitor is removed. The native Holder and its tween references stay put.
        detachPanel(record)
        detachDistance(record)
        detachFrontDash(record)
        record.mergedSource=nil
        record.contentRect,record.fullGroupRect,record.groupCanvas=nil,nil,nil
        restoreUltimateStyle(record)
        if record.holder and record.holder.Parent then
            for property,value in record.holderProperties or {} do
                if record.holder[property]==record.holderApplied[property] then pcall(function() record.holder[property]=value end) end
            end
        end
        if record.ultimate and record.ultimate.Parent then
            for property,value in record.ultimateProperties or {} do
                if record.ultimate[property]==record.ultimateApplied[property] then put(record.ultimate,property,value) end
            end
        end
        record.ultimate,record.ultimateProperties,record.ultimateApplied=nil,nil,nil
        record.holderProperties,record.holderApplied=nil,nil
        if record.source and record.source.Parent then
            for property,value in record.properties do
                local binding=record.sourceBindingApplied
                local owned=if binding and binding[property]~=nil then record.source[property]==binding[property]
                    else property~='Adornee' or record.source.Adornee==record.attachment
                if owned and (property~="Enabled" or (not dead and record.sourceEnabledApplied~=nil and record.source.Enabled==record.sourceEnabledApplied)) then
                    pcall(function() record.source[property]=value end)
                end
            end
        end
        record.sourceBindingApplied=nil
        for object,value in record.cardProperties do if object.Parent then object.BackgroundTransparency=value end end
        record.source,record.holder=nil,nil
        record.sourceEnabledApplied=nil
        record.cooldownAspect=nil
        record.cooldownMetrics,record.cooldownFit,record.cooldownContentHeight,record.cardWidth,record.cardCanvasHeight=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        record.cardAspects,record.cardListLayout=nil,nil
        if record.barAppearanceTargets then record.barAppearanceTargets.Ultimate=nil end
        record.visibilitySurrendered=nil
        record.cooldownStable,record.cooldownWanted,record.cooldownChangeAt=nil,nil,nil
        table.clear(record.properties)
        table.clear(record.cardProperties)
    end
    function control.detachOwnedViewer(source)
        if not control.alive or not source then return false end
        local detached=false
        for _,record in control.records do
            if record.source==source then
                -- Retiring an out-of-range native viewer must not destroy the
                -- independently owned health, resource, distance, or dash UI.
                restoreSource(record)
                record.dataDirty=true
                detached=true
            end
        end
        return detached
    end
    function control.refreshOwnedViewer(source)
        if not control.alive or not source or not source.Parent then return false end
        control.noteOwnedBillboard(source)
        if control.viewerRefreshQueued then return true end
        control.viewerRefreshQueued=true
        local function refreshViewer()
            control.viewerRefreshQueued=false
            if not control.alive then return end
            control.refresh()
            control.update(0)
        end
        if host.task and type(host.task.defer)=='function'then host.task.defer(refreshViewer)
        else refreshViewer()end
        return true
    end
    local function sourceVisible(record,visible)
        local source=record.source
        if not source or not source.Parent then return end
        if actorDead(record.model,record.humanoid) then put(source,'Enabled',false);return end
        if record.visibilitySurrendered then record.properties.Enabled=source.Enabled;return end
        if (record.sourceEnabledApplied~=nil and source.Enabled~=record.sourceEnabledApplied)
            or (record.sourceEnabledApplied==nil and source.Enabled~=record.properties.Enabled) then
            -- A later native toggle owns its new value; preserve that intent.
            record.properties.Enabled=source.Enabled
            record.sourceEnabledApplied=nil
            -- A native renderer or later feature now owns Enabled. Do not
            -- fight it by writing the opposite value again every frame.
            record.visibilitySurrendered=true
            return
        end
        local desired=visible and record.properties.Enabled~=false
        if source.Enabled~=desired then source.Enabled=desired;record.sourceEnabledApplied=desired end
    end
    function control.resourcesVisible(projectedRigHeight,height)
        return projectedRigHeight>=math.max(32,height*0.65)
    end
    function control.resolveLOD(record,projectedRigHeight,height)
        local threshold=math.max(32,height*0.65)
        if record.lodVisible==nil then record.lodVisible=projectedRigHeight>=threshold
        elseif record.lodVisible then record.lodVisible=projectedRigHeight>=threshold*0.9
        else record.lodVisible=projectedRigHeight>=threshold*1.1 end
        return record.lodVisible
    end
    function control.resolveDepthBand(record)
        local band=record.depthBand
        if band==nil or record.depth<band*4-1 or record.depth>(band+1)*4+1 then
            band=math.floor(record.depth/4);record.depthBand=band
        end
        return band
    end
    function control.resolveCooldownVisibility(record,wanted,forceHidden)
        if forceHidden then
            record.cooldownStable=false
            record.cooldownWanted=false
            record.cooldownChangeAt=control.visibilityClock
            return false
        end
        if record.cooldownStable==nil then
            record.cooldownStable=wanted
            record.cooldownWanted=wanted
            record.cooldownChangeAt=control.visibilityClock
        elseif wanted~=record.cooldownWanted then
            record.cooldownWanted=wanted
            record.cooldownChangeAt=control.visibilityClock
        elseif wanted~=record.cooldownStable and control.visibilityClock-record.cooldownChangeAt>=0.18 then
            record.cooldownStable=wanted
        end
        return record.cooldownStable
    end
    function control.rectsOverlap(a,b,margin)
        local gap=margin or 2
        return a.x<b.x+b.w+gap and b.x<a.x+a.w+gap and a.y<b.y+b.h+gap and b.y<a.y+a.h+gap
    end
    function control.cooldownGeometry(record,height)
        local metrics=record.cooldownMetrics
        if not metrics then return height*(record.cooldownAspect or 0.35),height,height end
        local fit=record.cooldownFit
        if fit and fit.requestedHeight==height and fit.version==record.cooldownGeometryVersion then
            return fit.width,fit.canvasHeight,fit.contentHeight
        end
        -- Native move cards are width-driven squares. The holder's height is
        -- only their canvas: list padding can make the actual stack taller.
        local count,ratio=metrics.count,metrics.ratio
        local gaps=count-1
        local intendedGap=math.max(0,metrics.gapScale*height+metrics.gapOffset)
        local width=math.max(0.001,(height-gaps*intendedGap)/count*ratio)
        local rowHeight=width/ratio
        local canvasHeight=height
        if gaps>0 and metrics.gapScale>0 then
            canvasHeight=math.max(0.001,(height-count*rowHeight-gaps*metrics.gapOffset)/(gaps*metrics.gapScale))
        end
        local contentHeight=count*rowHeight+gaps*(metrics.gapScale*canvasHeight+metrics.gapOffset)
        fit={requestedHeight=height,version=record.cooldownGeometryVersion,width=width,canvasHeight=canvasHeight,contentHeight=contentHeight}
        record.cooldownFit=fit
        return width,canvasHeight,contentHeight
    end
    local function groupBounds(record,rectangle)
        local layout,source=record.layout,record.source
        if not layout or not source or not source.Parent or record.properties.Enabled==false or record.showCooldowns==false then return rectangle,nil end
        local centerX=rectangle.x+(record.width or rectangle.w)*0.5
        local centerY=(if record.cooldownMetrics then math.floor(rectangle.y+0.5) else rectangle.y+layout.frameY+14)+record.height*0.5-control.cooldownOffsetY
        local width=record.cardWidth or (source.Size.X.Scale/layout.unitsPerPixel+source.Size.X.Offset)
        local height=record.cooldownContentHeight or (source.Size.Y.Scale/layout.unitsPerPixel+source.Size.Y.Offset)
        local side=if centerX>=layout.anchorX then 1 else -1
        local cardX=centerX+side*((record.cardGap or 9)+width*0.5)
        local card=rectangleValue(record,'groupCardRectValue',cardX-width*0.5,centerY-height*0.5,width,height)
        local x,y=math.min(rectangle.x,card.x),math.min(rectangle.y,card.y)
        return rectangleValue(record,'groupBoundsRectValue',x,y,math.max(rectangle.x+rectangle.w,card.x+card.w)-x,math.max(rectangle.y+rectangle.h,card.y+card.h)-y),card
    end
    local function barRectangle(record,role,x,y,width,height,projection)
        local settings=control.barSettings[role]
        local w,h=width*settings.width/100,height*settings.length/100
        record.barRects=record.barRects or {}
        local rectangle=record.barRects[role]
        if not rectangle then rectangle={};record.barRects[role]=rectangle end
        rectangle.x,rectangle.y=x+(width-w)*.5+settings.x*projection,y+(height-h)*.5+settings.y*projection
        rectangle.w,rectangle.h=w,h
        return rectangle
    end
    local function resourceRectangles(record,x,y,projection)
        local thickness=control.barThickness*projection
        local secondX=x+thickness+control.resourceBarSpacing*projection
        local split=if record.showSpecial then record.height*.5 else 0
        barRectangle(record,'Health',x,y,thickness,record.height,projection)
        barRectangle(record,'Evasive',secondX,y+split,thickness,record.height-split,projection)
        barRectangle(record,'Special',secondX,y,thickness,record.height*.5,projection)
    end
    local function placeResourceRectangles(record,x,y)
        for role,target in {Health=record.track,Evasive=record.evadeTrack,Special=record.specialTrack} do
            local rectangle=record.barRects[role]
            put(target,'Position',scaleValue(record,role..'CustomPosition',(rectangle.x-x)/record.width,(rectangle.y-y)/record.height))
            put(target,'Size',scaleValue(record,role..'CustomSize',rectangle.w/record.width,rectangle.h/record.height))
        end
    end
    local function originalLayoutValue(record,object,property)
        local chrome=record.barChrome and record.barChrome[object]
        local original=chrome and chrome.original[object]
        return if original and original[property]~=nil then original[property] else object[property]
    end
    local function applyCardScale(record)
        local settings=control.barSettings.Cooldown
        local xScale,yScale=settings.width/100,settings.length/100
        for constraint in record.cardAspects or {} do
            if constraint.Parent then
                local value=originalLayoutValue(record,constraint,'AspectRatio')*xScale/yScale
                if xScale~=1 or yScale~=1 or record.barChrome and record.barChrome[constraint] then
                    local chrome=record.barChrome[constraint] or decorateChrome(record,constraint,'Layout',true)
                    writeChrome(chrome,constraint,'AspectRatio',value)
                end
            end
        end
        local layout=record.cardListLayout
        if layout and layout.Parent then
            local original=originalLayoutValue(record,layout,'Padding')
            if original.Offset~=0 and (yScale~=1 or record.barChrome[layout]) then
                local chrome=record.barChrome[layout] or decorateChrome(record,layout,'Layout',true)
                writeChrome(chrome,layout,'Padding',host.UDim.new(original.Scale,original.Offset*yScale))
            end
        end
    end
    local mergedRecordKeys={'source','holder','height','width','textWidth','textHeight','perspectiveFactor','worldUnit','cardWidth','cardCanvasHeight','cooldownContentHeight','cooldownGeometryVersion','showSpecial','showResources','showFrontDashBeside','showFrontDashHorizontal','showFrontDashTop','frontDashTrack','frontDashHorizontalTrack','customBarLayoutApplied','scale'}
    local mergedControlKeys={'customBarLayout','barLayoutVersion','cooldownOffsetY','resourceBarSpacing','resourceCardSpacing','barThickness','dashBarLength','dashBarThickness','dashBarOffsetX','dashBarOffsetY'}
    local function mergedLayoutMatches(record,source,ultimate)
        local cache=record.mergedLayoutCache
        if not cache or record.panel.Parent~=source or cache.ultimate~=ultimate
            or cache.ultimateVisible~=(ultimate and ultimate.Parent and ultimate.Visible or false)then return false end
        for _,key in mergedRecordKeys do if cache.record[key]~=record[key]then return false end end
        for _,key in mergedControlKeys do if cache.control[key]~=control[key]then return false end end
        for _,entry in cache.expected do
            if not entry.object.Parent then return false end
            for key,value in entry.properties do if entry.object[key]~=value then return false end end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function projectMergedBounds(record,layout,bounds)
        local factor=record.worldUnit/layout.unitsPerPixel
        local x,y=layout.anchorX-bounds.width*factor*.5,layout.anchorY-bounds.height*factor*.5
        record.contentRect=if record.showResources==false then rectangleValue(record,'contentRectValue',x+bounds.cooldownLeft*factor,y+bounds.cooldownTop*factor,(bounds.width-bounds.cooldownLeft)*factor,bounds.cooldownHeight*factor)
            else rectangleValue(record,'contentRectValue',x,y,bounds.width*factor,bounds.contentHeight*factor)
        record.groupRect=record.contentRect
        record.fullGroupRect=rectangleValue(record,'fullGroupRectValue',x,y,bounds.width*factor,bounds.height*factor)
    end
    local function rememberMergedLayout(record,source,ultimate,bounds)
        local cache=record.mergedLayoutCache or{record={},control={},expected={}}
        record.mergedLayoutCache=cache;cache.bounds=bounds;cache.ultimate=ultimate
        cache.ultimateVisible=ultimate and ultimate.Parent and ultimate.Visible or false
        for _,key in mergedRecordKeys do cache.record[key]=record[key]end
        for _,key in mergedControlKeys do cache.control[key]=control[key]end
        table.clear(cache.expected)
        local function expected(object,keys)
            if not object or not object.Parent then return end
            local properties={};for _,key in keys do properties[key]=object[key]end
            table.insert(cache.expected,{object=object,properties=properties})
        end
        expected(source,{'Size','ClipsDescendants'})
        expected(record.panel,{'Position','Size','Parent'})
        expected(record.text,{'Position'})
        expected(record.holder,{'Position','Size','AnchorPoint'})
        expected(ultimate,{'Position','Size'})
        expected(record.frontDashTrack,{'Position','Size','Parent'})
        expected(record.frontDashHorizontalTrack,{'Position','Size','Parent'})
        control.mergedLayoutBuilds=(control.mergedLayoutBuilds or 0)+1
    end
    local function moveResources(record: any,rectangle: any)
        local previous=record.resourceRect
        local deltaX,deltaY=rectangle.x-previous.x,rectangle.y-previous.y
        -- World billboards own the rendered gauges. Moving their unused legacy
        -- screen frame on every camera turn only invalidates the ScreenGui.
        if record.panel.Parent==record.screenDisplay then
            if record.layout and record.layout.frameX and record.layout.frameY then
                put(record.screenDisplay,"Position",host.UDim2.fromOffset(rectangle.x+record.layout.frameX,rectangle.y+record.layout.frameY))
            elseif deltaX~=0 or deltaY~=0 then
                local position=record.screenDisplay.Position
                record.screenDisplay.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(position.X.Offset+deltaX,position.Y.Offset+deltaY)
            end
        end
        record.resourceRect=rectangle
        if record.textRect then
            record.textRect=rectangleValue(record,'movedTextRectValue',record.textRect.x+deltaX,record.textRect.y+deltaY,record.textRect.w,record.textRect.h)
        end
        record.groupRect,record.cooldownRect=groupBounds(record,rectangle)
        record.contentRect=if record.showResources==false then record.cooldownRect else record.groupRect
        local layout,source=record.layout,record.source
        if record.showCooldowns==false then
            -- Gauges must remain visible when their shared cooldown canvas is hidden.
            if record.panel.Parent~=record.screenDisplay then detachPanel(record) end
            detachFrontDash(record)
            record.mergedSource=nil
            return
        end
        if not layout or not source or not source.Parent or not record.attachment then
            return
        end
        local currentUltimate=record.ultimate
        if mergedLayoutMatches(record,source,currentUltimate)then
            control.bindCanvas(record,source)
            projectMergedBounds(record,layout,record.mergedLayoutCache.bounds)
            control.mergedLayoutCacheHits=(control.mergedLayoutCacheHits or 0)+1
            return
        end
        local cardWidth=record.cardWidth or source.Size.X.Offset
        local cardCanvasHeight=record.cardCanvasHeight or source.Size.Y.Offset
        local side=if control.displaySide(record.model)=="Left" then -1 else 1
        local projection=record.perspectiveFactor or 1
        local gap=record.cardGap or 9
        local gaugeX=if side>0 then 0 else cardWidth+gap-record.width*0.5
        local cardX=if side>0 then record.width*0.5+gap else 0
        local minimumCardGap=control.resourceCardSpacing*projection
        if side>0 then cardX=math.max(cardX,gaugeX+record.width+minimumCardGap) end
        local ultimate=record.ultimate
        local ultimateVisible=ultimate and ultimate.Parent and ultimate.Visible
        local ultimateX=cardX+cardWidth+(control.resourceBarSpacing+2)*projection
        local ultimateWidth=control.barThickness*projection
        if side<0 then
            local previousEdge=if ultimateVisible then ultimateX+ultimateWidth else cardX+cardWidth
            gaugeX=math.max(gaugeX,previousEdge+minimumCardGap)
        end
        local textWidth=record.textWidth or 54
        local textLeft=gaugeX+(record.width-textWidth)*0.5
        local left=math.min(gaugeX,cardX,textLeft)-2*projection
        gaugeX-=left;cardX-=left;ultimateX-=left
        -- Expand only the invisible shared canvas. The gauges keep their world
        -- position and dimensions; only the cooldown holder moves up/down.
        local shiftY=-control.cooldownOffsetY*(record.perspectiveFactor or 1)
        local top=(record.textHeight or 12)+4*projection+math.max(0,-shiftY)
        local cardTop=top+shiftY
        local groupWidth=math.max(gaugeX+record.width,cardX+cardWidth,gaugeX+(record.width+textWidth)*0.5)+2*projection
        if ultimateVisible then groupWidth=math.max(groupWidth,ultimateX+ultimateWidth+2*projection) end
        local frontDashX,frontDashWidth,padding=0,control.barThickness*projection,0
        if record.showFrontDashBeside and record.frontDashTrack then
            local edge=math.max(gaugeX+record.width,cardX+cardWidth)
            if ultimateVisible then edge=math.max(edge,ultimateX+ultimateWidth) end
            frontDashX=edge+(control.resourceBarSpacing+2)*projection
            padding=math.max(0,frontDashX+frontDashWidth+2*projection-groupWidth)
            -- Equal blank padding on the opposite side keeps the centered
            -- Billboard and all existing gauges/cards at their exact old
            -- character-relative positions when the new column appears.
            groupWidth+=padding*2
            gaugeX+=padding;cardX+=padding;ultimateX+=padding;frontDashX+=padding
        end
        record.frontDashPadding=padding
        local dashBelowX=math.min(gaugeX,cardX)
        local dashBelowRight=math.max(gaugeX+record.width,cardX+cardWidth)
        if ultimateVisible then
            dashBelowX=math.min(dashBelowX,ultimateX)
            dashBelowRight=math.max(dashBelowRight,ultimateX+ultimateWidth)
        end
        local dashSpan=dashBelowRight-dashBelowX
        local dashBelowWidth=dashSpan*control.dashBarLength/100
        dashBelowX+=(dashSpan-dashBelowWidth)*.5+control.dashBarOffsetX*projection
        local contentHeight=math.max(top+record.height,cardTop+(record.cooldownContentHeight or record.height))
        local groupHeight=math.max(top+record.height,cardTop+cardCanvasHeight)+2*projection
        local dashBelowTop=cardTop+(record.cooldownContentHeight or record.height)+control.resourceBarSpacing*projection
        local dashBelowHeight=control.dashBarThickness*projection
        local healthTextTop=top-(record.textHeight or 12)-2*projection
        if record.showFrontDashTop then
            -- Top placement reserves the space between the label and first
            -- card by moving only the label upward. Downward offsets stop at
            -- the card edge; upward offsets remain freely adjustable.
            dashBelowTop=math.min(top,cardTop)-control.resourceBarSpacing*projection-dashBelowHeight+math.min(control.dashBarOffsetY,0)*projection
            healthTextTop=math.min(healthTextTop,dashBelowTop-control.resourceBarSpacing*projection-(record.textHeight or 12))
        else dashBelowTop+=control.dashBarOffsetY*projection end
        local verticalPadding=0
        local horizontalPadding=0
        if record.showFrontDashHorizontal and record.frontDashHorizontalTrack then
            horizontalPadding=math.max(0,2*projection-dashBelowX,dashBelowX+dashBelowWidth+2*projection-groupWidth)
            groupWidth+=horizontalPadding*2
            gaugeX+=horizontalPadding;cardX+=horizontalPadding;ultimateX+=horizontalPadding
            frontDashX+=horizontalPadding;dashBelowX+=horizontalPadding
            verticalPadding=math.max(0,2*projection-math.min(dashBelowTop,healthTextTop),dashBelowTop+dashBelowHeight+2*projection-groupHeight)
            -- Symmetric vertical padding preserves every existing child's
            -- position around the character-owned Billboard center.
            groupHeight+=verticalPadding*2
            top+=verticalPadding;cardTop+=verticalPadding;dashBelowTop+=verticalPadding;healthTextTop+=verticalPadding
            contentHeight=math.max(contentHeight+verticalPadding,dashBelowTop+dashBelowHeight)
        end
        record.frontDashVerticalPadding=verticalPadding
        record.frontDashHorizontalPadding=horizontalPadding
        local customCooldownHeight=record.cooldownContentHeight or record.height
        local customUltimateHeight=record.height
        local hpTextX=nil
        if control.customBarLayout or record.customBarLayoutApplied then
            resourceRectangles(record,gaugeX,top,projection)
            local cards=barRectangle(record,'Cooldown',cardX,cardTop,cardWidth,cardCanvasHeight,projection)
            local ult=barRectangle(record,'Ultimate',ultimateX,cardTop,ultimateWidth,record.height,projection)
            local health=record.barRects.Health
            customCooldownHeight*=control.barSettings.Cooldown.length/100
            customUltimateHeight=ult.h
            local healthSettings=control.barSettings.Health
            if healthSettings.width~=100 or healthSettings.length~=100 or healthSettings.x~=0 or healthSettings.y~=0 then
                healthTextTop=health.y-(record.textHeight or 12)-2*projection
                hpTextX=health.x+health.w*.5
            end
            cardX,cardTop,cardWidth,cardCanvasHeight=cards.x,cards.y,cards.w,cards.h
            ultimateX,ultimateWidth=ult.x,ult.w
            if record.showFrontDashBeside then
                frontDashX=math.max(gaugeX+record.width,cardX+cardWidth,ultimateX+ultimateWidth)+(control.resourceBarSpacing+2)*projection
            end
            if record.showFrontDashHorizontal then
                local start=math.min(health.x,cardX,ultimateX)
                local finish=math.max(health.x+health.w,cardX+cardWidth,ultimateX+ultimateWidth)
                local span=finish-start
                dashBelowWidth=span*control.dashBarLength/100
                dashBelowX=start+(span-dashBelowWidth)*.5+control.dashBarOffsetX*projection
                if record.showFrontDashTop then
                    dashBelowTop=math.min(health.y,cardTop)-control.resourceBarSpacing*projection-dashBelowHeight+math.min(control.dashBarOffsetY,0)*projection
                    healthTextTop=math.min(healthTextTop,dashBelowTop-control.resourceBarSpacing*projection-(record.textHeight or 12))
                else dashBelowTop=cardTop+customCooldownHeight+control.resourceBarSpacing*projection+control.dashBarOffsetY*projection end
            end
            local minX: any,maxX: any,minY: any,maxY: any=0,groupWidth,0,groupHeight
            for role,rect in record.barRects do
                if role~='Special' or record.showSpecial then
                    minX,maxX=math.min(minX,rect.x-2*projection),math.max(maxX,rect.x+rect.w+2*projection)
                    minY,maxY=math.min(minY,rect.y-2*projection),math.max(maxY,rect.y+rect.h+2*projection)
                end
            end
            local labelX=hpTextX or gaugeX+record.width*.5
            minX,maxX=math.min(minX,labelX-textWidth*.5-2*projection),math.max(maxX,labelX+textWidth*.5+2*projection)
            minY=math.min(minY,healthTextTop-2*projection)
            if record.showFrontDashHorizontal then
                minX,maxX=math.min(minX,dashBelowX-2*projection),math.max(maxX,dashBelowX+dashBelowWidth+2*projection)
                minY,maxY=math.min(minY,dashBelowTop-2*projection),math.max(maxY,dashBelowTop+dashBelowHeight+2*projection)
            end
            if record.showFrontDashBeside then maxX=math.max(maxX,frontDashX+frontDashWidth+2*projection) end
            local padX,padY=math.max(-minX,maxX-groupWidth,0),math.max(-minY,maxY-groupHeight,0)
            groupWidth+=padX*2;groupHeight+=padY*2
            gaugeX+=padX;cardX+=padX;ultimateX+=padX;frontDashX+=padX;dashBelowX+=padX
            top+=padY;cardTop+=padY;dashBelowTop+=padY;healthTextTop+=padY
            if hpTextX then hpTextX+=padX end
            for _,rect in record.barRects do rect.x+=padX;rect.y+=padY end
            contentHeight=math.max(contentHeight+padY,groupHeight-2*projection)
            placeResourceRectangles(record,gaugeX,top)
            applyCardScale(record)
            record.customBarLayoutApplied=control.customBarLayout
        end
        -- Include every rendered child in the Billboard's actual canvas.
        -- ClipsDescendants=false alone does not give negative-position gauges
        -- a canvas of their own and left health text previously lived above it.
        put(source,"Size",scaleValue(record,'attachedCanvasWorldSize',groupWidth*record.worldUnit,groupHeight*record.worldUnit))
        -- Both canvases use the exact same independent world presentation part;
        -- the character attachment remains the sole source of its position.
        control.bindCanvas(record,source)
        put(source,"ClipsDescendants",false)
        put(record.panel,"Parent",source)
        record.mergedSource=source
        local holder=record.holder
        if holder and holder.Parent then
            local applied=record.holderApplied
            applied.Size=scaleValue(record,'holderSizeValue',cardWidth/groupWidth,cardCanvasHeight/groupHeight)
            applied.Position=scaleValue(record,'holderPositionValue',cardX/groupWidth,cardTop/groupHeight)
            applied.AnchorPoint=record.holderAnchorValue or host.Vector2.new(0,0)
            record.holderAnchorValue=applied.AnchorPoint
            put(holder,'Size',applied.Size);put(holder,'Position',applied.Position);put(holder,'AnchorPoint',applied.AnchorPoint)
        end
        if ultimate and ultimate.Parent then
            local applied=record.ultimateApplied
            applied.Size=scaleValue(record,'ultimateSizeValue',ultimateWidth/groupWidth,customUltimateHeight/groupHeight)
            applied.Position=scaleValue(record,'ultimatePositionValue',ultimateX/groupWidth,(if control.customBarLayout and record.barRects then record.barRects.Ultimate.y else cardTop)/groupHeight)
            put(ultimate,'Size',applied.Size);put(ultimate,'Position',applied.Position)
            -- The game's Handle owns Ult.Fill and its original gradients.
        end
        if record.frontDashTrack then
            local track=record.frontDashTrack
            if record.showFrontDashBeside then
                put(track,'Parent',source)
                put(track,'Position',scaleValue(record,'frontDashPositionValue',frontDashX/groupWidth,cardTop/groupHeight))
                put(track,'Size',scaleValue(record,'frontDashSizeValue',frontDashWidth/groupWidth,record.height/groupHeight))
            else put(track,'Visible',false);put(track,'Parent',record.display) end
        end
        if record.frontDashHorizontalTrack then
            local track=record.frontDashHorizontalTrack
            if record.showFrontDashHorizontal then
                put(track,'Parent',source)
                put(track,'Position',scaleValue(record,'frontDashHorizontalPositionValue',dashBelowX/groupWidth,dashBelowTop/groupHeight))
                put(track,'Size',scaleValue(record,'frontDashHorizontalSizeValue',dashBelowWidth/groupWidth,dashBelowHeight/groupHeight))
            else put(track,'Visible',false);put(track,'Parent',record.display) end
        end
        put(record.panel,"Position",scaleValue(record,'panelPositionValue',gaugeX/groupWidth,top/groupHeight))
        put(record.panel,"Size",scaleValue(record,'panelSizeValue',record.width/groupWidth,record.height/groupHeight))
        local healthTextX: any=if hpTextX then (hpTextX-gaugeX-textWidth*.5)/record.width else (record.width-textWidth)*.5/record.width
        put(record.text,'Position',scaleValue(record,'healthTextPositionValue',healthTextX,(healthTextTop-top)/record.height))
        local canvas=record.groupCanvas
        if not canvas or canvas.width~=groupWidth or canvas.height~=groupHeight or canvas.gaugeX~=gaugeX or canvas.cardX~=cardX or canvas.top~=top or canvas.cardTop~=cardTop then
            if not canvas then canvas={};record.groupCanvas=canvas end
            canvas.width,canvas.height,canvas.gaugeX,canvas.cardX,canvas.top=groupWidth,groupHeight,gaugeX,cardX,top
            canvas.cardTop=cardTop
        end
        local screenFactor=record.worldUnit/layout.unitsPerPixel
        local groupX,groupY=layout.anchorX-groupWidth*screenFactor*.5,layout.anchorY-groupHeight*screenFactor*.5
        local cooldownTop=if record.showFrontDashHorizontal then math.min(cardTop,dashBelowTop) else cardTop
        local cooldownVisibleHeight=if record.showFrontDashHorizontal then math.max(cardTop+customCooldownHeight,dashBelowTop+dashBelowHeight)-cooldownTop else customCooldownHeight
        local cooldownLeft=if record.showFrontDashHorizontal then math.min(cardX,dashBelowX) else cardX
        record.contentRect=if record.showResources==false then rectangleValue(record,'contentRectValue',groupX+cooldownLeft*screenFactor,groupY+cooldownTop*screenFactor,(groupWidth-cooldownLeft)*screenFactor,cooldownVisibleHeight*screenFactor)
            else rectangleValue(record,'contentRectValue',groupX,groupY,groupWidth*screenFactor,contentHeight*screenFactor)
        record.groupRect=record.contentRect
        record.fullGroupRect=rectangleValue(record,'fullGroupRectValue',groupX,groupY,groupWidth*screenFactor,groupHeight*screenFactor)
        rememberMergedLayout(record,source,ultimate,{width=groupWidth,height=groupHeight,contentHeight=contentHeight,
            cooldownLeft=cooldownLeft,cooldownTop=cooldownTop,cooldownHeight=cooldownVisibleHeight})
    end
    function control.placeResources(record,resources)
        local layout=record.layout
        if not layout then
            for _,rectangle in resources do if control.rectsOverlap(record.resourceRect,rectangle) then return false end end
            return true
        end
        local original=record.resourceRect
        local viewport=layout.viewport
        local maxX=viewport.X-original.w-4
        if maxX<4 then return false end
        local baseY=original.y
        local bodyGap=record.bodyGap or 10
        local rightX=layout.anchorX+layout.halfWidthPixels+bodyGap
        local leftX=layout.anchorX-layout.halfWidthPixels-bodyGap-original.w
        local positions={}
        local selectedSide=control.displaySide(record.model)
        local sides=if selectedSide=="Left" then {{key="left",x=leftX}}
            elseif selectedSide=="Right" then {{key="right",x=rightX}}
            else {{key="right",x=rightX},{key="left",x=leftX}}
        -- A display belongs to this body's own silhouette. Other actors and
        -- cooldown panels must never provide a distant replacement anchor.
        for _,side in sides do
            table.insert(positions,{key=side.key,x=side.x,y=baseY,edge=side.x})
        end
        if layout.near then
            for _,side in sides do
                for _,offset in {18,-18} do
                    table.insert(positions,{key=side.key..offset,x=side.x+offset,y=baseY,edge=side.x})
                end
                for _,offset in {-12,12} do
                    table.insert(positions,{key=side.key.."y"..offset,x=side.x,y=baseY+offset,edge=side.x})
                end
            end
        end
        -- Keep the selected side at every distance. Camera zoom or tiny
        -- depth changes must not restart an Automatic right/left search.
        if record.placementKey then
            local index=nil
            for positionIndex,position in positions do if position.key==record.placementKey then index=positionIndex;break end end
            if index then
                local previous=table.remove(positions,index)
                if previous then table.insert(positions,1,previous) end
            end
        end
        local retainedRectangle=nil
        for _,position in positions do
            local x=math.clamp(position.x,4,maxX)
            if math.abs(x-position.edge)>18 then continue end
            local rectangle={x=x,y=position.y,w=original.w,h=original.h}
            if rectangle.y+rectangle.h<=0 or rectangle.y>=viewport.Y then continue end
            if position.key==record.placementKey then retainedRectangle=rectangle end
            local blocked=false
            local margin=if position.key==record.placementKey then -3 else 2
            for _,occupied in resources do if control.rectsOverlap(rectangle,occupied,margin) then blocked=true;break end end
            if not blocked then
                if retainedRectangle and position.key~=record.placementKey and control.visibilityClock-(record.placementAt or 0)>=0.18 then
                    if record.pendingPlacementKey~=position.key then
                        record.pendingPlacementKey,record.pendingPlacementAt=position.key,control.visibilityClock
                    end
                    if control.visibilityClock-(record.pendingPlacementAt or control.visibilityClock)<0.18 then
                        -- Transient crowd collisions retain the owner's old
                        -- side while visibility performs the same short hold.
                        moveResources(record,retainedRectangle)
                        return false
                    end
                end
                if record.placementKey~=position.key then record.placementAt=control.visibilityClock end
                record.pendingPlacementKey,record.pendingPlacementAt=nil,nil
                record.placementKey=position.key
                local placement=record.placementDeltaValue
                if not placement then placement={};record.placementDeltaValue=placement end
                placement.x,placement.y=x-original.x,position.y-original.y
                record.placementDelta=placement
                record.tetherDelta=math.abs(x-position.edge)
                moveResources(record,rectangle)
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local kept={}
    function control.applyVisibility(candidates)
        table.clear(kept)
        for _,record in candidates do
            local layout=record.layout
            if layout then
                -- Left/right is local to the actor's root. The native attachment
                -- is the sole position owner; projection is only for visibility.
                local left=control.displaySide(record.model)=="Left"
                local x=record.resourceRect.x
                record.placementKey=if left then "left" else "right"
                local placement=record.placementDeltaValue
                if not placement then placement={};record.placementDeltaValue=placement end
                placement.x,placement.y=x-record.resourceRect.x,0
                record.placementDelta=placement
                record.tetherDelta=0
                local rectangleKey=if record.resourceRect==record.placedResourceRectValue then 'alternatePlacedResourceRectValue' else 'placedResourceRectValue'
                moveResources(record,rectangleValue(record,rectangleKey,x,record.resourceRect.y,record.resourceRect.w,record.resourceRect.h))
            end
            kept[record]=true
            record.visibilityReason="visible"
        end
        for _,record in control.records do
            if record.contentCulled then
                -- Feet labels use a separate projection and must never retain
                -- an old screen position while their resource panel is culled.
                put(record.distanceLabel,"Visible",record.distanceCandidate==true and record.distanceHardHidden~=true and isInfoTarget(record.model))
                continue
            end
            local wanted=kept[record]==true
            local hardHidden=record.hardHidden==true
            local visible=wanted and not hardHidden
            local resourcesVisible=visible and record.showResources~=false
            put(record.screenDisplay,"Visible",resourcesVisible)
            put(record.display,"Enabled",resourcesVisible)
            put(record.panel,"Visible",resourcesVisible)
            put(record.track,"Visible",resourcesVisible and record.showHealth~=false)
            put(record.evadeTrack,"Visible",resourcesVisible and record.showEvasive~=false)
            if record.specialTrack then put(record.specialTrack,"Visible",resourcesVisible and record.showSpecial==true) end
            if record.ultTrack then put(record.ultTrack,"Visible",resourcesVisible and record.showUlt==true) end
            if record.frontDashTrack then put(record.frontDashTrack,'Visible',visible and record.showCooldowns~=false and record.showFrontDashBeside==true and record.mergedSource==record.source) end
            if record.frontDashHorizontalTrack then put(record.frontDashHorizontalTrack,'Visible',visible and record.showCooldowns~=false and record.showFrontDashHorizontal==true and record.mergedSource==record.source) end
            if record.text then
                put(record.text,"Visible",resourcesVisible and record.textCandidate==true and record.showHealthNumbers~=false)
            end
            -- Feet distance has its own projection. Resource XYZ controls or
            -- an offscreen card canvas must not relocate or hide it.
            put(record.distanceLabel,"Visible",record.distanceCandidate==true and record.distanceHardHidden~=true and isInfoTarget(record.model))
            sourceVisible(record,visible and record.showCooldowns~=false)
        end
    end
    local function release(model,dead)
        local record=control.records[model]
        if record then
            dead=dead==true or actorDead(model,record.humanoid)
            if dead then control.deadModels[model]=record.humanoid end
            disconnect(record.lifeConnections)
            record.lifeConnections=nil
            local source=record.source
            if dead and source then put(source,'Enabled',false) end
            restoreSource(record,dead)
            if dead then
                for candidateSource,candidate in control.sourceCandidates do
                    local owner=candidateSource.Parent and candidateSource.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
                    if candidate.model==model or owner==model then put(candidateSource,'Enabled',false) end
                end
            end
            for target in record.barChrome or {} do restoreChrome(record,target) end
            record.panel:Destroy();record.distanceLabel:Destroy();record.screenDisplay:Destroy();record.display:Destroy()
            if record.worldAnchor then record.worldAnchor:Destroy();record.worldAnchor=nil end
            if record.attachment then record.attachment:Destroy() end
            control.records[model]=nil
        end
    end
    local function create(model,humanoid)
        local display=make("BillboardGui",gui)
        display.Name,display.AlwaysOnTop,display.ResetOnSpawn="ShenaniganismSideGauges",true,false
        display.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(54,90)
        local screenDisplay=make('Frame',gui)
        screenDisplay.Name,screenDisplay.BackgroundTransparency,screenDisplay.BorderSizePixel='ShenaniganismScreenGauges',1,0
        screenDisplay.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(54,90)
        local panel=make("Frame",display)
        panel.Name,panel.BackgroundTransparency,panel.BorderSizePixel="SideHPAndCooldowns",1,0
        panel.Position,panel.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(34,14),host.UDim2.fromOffset(14,72)
        local text=make("TextLabel",panel)
        text.Name,text.BackgroundTransparency,text.TextSize="HP",1,10
        text.Font,text.TextColor3=host.Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,host.Color3.new(1,1,1)
        text.TextStrokeColor3,text.TextStrokeTransparency=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),0.35
        local distanceLabel=make("TextLabel",gui)
        distanceLabel.Name,distanceLabel.BackgroundTransparency,distanceLabel.BorderSizePixel="FeetDistance",1,0
        distanceLabel.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(72,16)
        distanceLabel.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(0,0)
        distanceLabel.Font,distanceLabel.TextSize,distanceLabel.TextScaled=host.Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,12,false
        distanceLabel.TextXAlignment=host.Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        distanceLabel.TextColor3,distanceLabel.TextStrokeColor3=host.Color3.new(1,1,1),host.Color3.new(0,0,0)
        distanceLabel.TextStrokeTransparency,distanceLabel.ZIndex,distanceLabel.Visible=0.15,10,false
        local function gauge(name)
            local track=make("Frame",panel)
            track.Name,track.BackgroundTransparency,track.BorderSizePixel=name.."Track",1,0
            local trackCorner=make('UICorner',track)
            trackCorner.CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(0,if name=='Health' then 0 else 1)
            local outline=make("UIStroke",track)
            outline.Thickness,outline.Transparency,outline.Color=chromeStyle().borderSize,0.35,chromeStyle().borderColor
            local fill=make("Frame",track)
            fill.Name,fill.BorderSizePixel,fill.BackgroundTransparency=name.."Fill",0,0.4
            local fillCorner=make('UICorner',fill)
            fillCorner.CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(0,if name=='Health' then 0 else 1)
            fill.BackgroundColor3=host.Color3.new(1,1,1)
            fill.AnchorPoint,fill.Position=host.Vector2.new(0,1),host.UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
            local gradient=make("UIGradient",fill);gradient.Rotation=-90
            return track,fill,gradient
        end
        local track,fill,gradient=gauge("Health")
        local evadeTrack,evadeFill,evadeGradient=gauge("Evasive")
        evadeGradient.Color=host.ColorSequence.new(host.Color3.fromRGB(4,58,82),host.Color3.fromRGB(8,103,139))
        local specialTrack,specialFill,specialGradient=gauge('Special')
        specialTrack.Visible=false
        -- Ultimate: a thin strip under the bars, filled from the player's own Ultimate value (0-100) the game replicates.
        local ultTrack=make('Frame',panel)
        ultTrack.Name,ultTrack.BorderSizePixel,ultTrack.BackgroundTransparency='UltTrack',0,0.55
        ultTrack.BackgroundColor3,ultTrack.Visible=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),false
        make('UICorner',ultTrack).CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(0,1)
        local ultStroke=make('UIStroke',ultTrack);ultStroke.Thickness,ultStroke.Transparency,ultStroke.Color=1,0.35,host.Color3.fromRGB(255,190,50)
        local ultFill=make('Frame',ultTrack)
        ultFill.Name,ultFill.BorderSizePixel,ultFill.BackgroundTransparency='UltFill',0,0.15
        ultFill.BackgroundColor3,ultFill.Size=host.Color3.fromRGB(255,190,50),host.UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
        make('UICorner',ultFill).CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(0,1)
        control.nextRecordId+=1
        local record: any={model=model,humanoid=humanoid,display=display,screenDisplay=screenDisplay,panel=panel,text=text,distanceLabel=distanceLabel,track=track,fill=fill,gradient=gradient,order=control.nextRecordId,
            evadeTrack=evadeTrack,evadeFill=evadeFill,evadeGradient=evadeGradient,
            specialTrack=specialTrack,specialFill=specialFill,specialGradient=specialGradient,ultTrack=ultTrack,ultFill=ultFill,
            properties={},cardProperties={},halfWidth=2,halfHeight=3,scale=1}
        record.barNatural={Health={color=fill.BackgroundColor3,enabled=true},Evasive={color=evadeFill.BackgroundColor3,enabled=true},Special={color=specialFill.BackgroundColor3,enabled=true}}
        record.barAppearanceTargets={Health={track,fill,gradient},Evasive={evadeTrack,evadeFill,evadeGradient},Special={specialTrack,specialFill,specialGradient}}
        for _,meter in {track,evadeTrack,specialTrack} do decorateChrome(record,meter,'Track',false) end
        for _,meter in {fill,evadeFill,specialFill} do decorateChrome(record,meter,'Fill',false) end
        applyBarOutline(record,track,'Health');applyBarOutline(record,evadeTrack,'Evasive');applyBarOutline(record,specialTrack,'Special')
        for role,objects in record.barAppearanceTargets do appearanceRole(record.barChrome[objects[2]],role) end
        control.records[model]=record
        record.lifeConnections={}
        local function died()
            if control.records[model]~=record then return end
            control.deadModels[model]=humanoid
            release(model,true)
        end
        local function checkLife()
            if actorDead(model,humanoid) then died() end
        end
        listen(humanoid.Died,died,record.lifeConnections)
        listen(humanoid.StateChanged,function(_,state)
            if deadState(state) then died() else checkLife() end
        end,record.lifeConnections)
        listen(humanoid.HealthChanged,function(health)
            record.dataDirty=true
            if type(health)=='number' and health<=0 then died() else checkLife() end
        end,record.lifeConnections)
        if type(humanoid.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function' then
            listen(humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Health'),function()record.dataDirty=true;checkLife()end,record.lifeConnections)
            listen(humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal('MaxHealth'),function()record.dataDirty=true end,record.lifeConnections)
        end
        if type(model.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function' then listen(model:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Dead'),checkLife,record.lifeConnections) end
        return record
    end
    local function cooldownsEnabled()
        local cached=control.cooldownEntry
        if cached then return cached.widget.Get()==true end
        for _,entry in menu.entries do if entry.name=="Cooldown Viewer" then control.cooldownEntry=entry;return entry.widget.Get()==true end end
        return false
    end
    local function dashStatus(status)
        if type(status)~='table' then return nil,nil end
        local fraction=tonumber(if status.displayFraction~=nil then status.displayFraction else status.fraction)
        if not fraction or fraction~=fraction or math.abs(fraction)==math.huge then return nil,nil end
        return status,math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
    end
    local function dashFill(track,horizontal,name,zIndex)
        local fill=make('Frame',track)
        fill.Name,fill.BorderSizePixel,fill.ZIndex=name,0,zIndex
        fill.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(0,if horizontal then 0 else 1)
        fill.Position=host.UDim2.new(0,0,if horizontal then 0 else 1,0)
        local corner=make('UICorner',fill);corner.CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(0,1)
        return fill
    end
    local function dashAnimation(record,key,status,fraction,now)
        record.dashAnimations=record.dashAnimations or {}
        local state=record.dashAnimations[key]
        if not state then state={};record.dashAnimations[key]=state end
        if not status then
            state.ready,state.readyAt,state.mode=nil,nil,'Hidden'
            return state
        end
        local ready=status.displayRecharging~=true and (status.ready==true or status.ready==nil and fraction~=nil and fraction>=1)
        if ready and state.ready==false then state.readyAt=now end
        if not ready then state.readyAt=nil end
        state.ready=ready
        -- Native resource pauses freeze only their own presentation; Failsafe
        -- pauses never stop the read-only cooldown clock or another channel.
        local paused=if status.displayPaused~=nil then status.displayPaused else status.paused
        if paused~=true or state.phaseNow==nil then state.phaseNow=now end
        local indeterminate=if status.displayIndeterminate~=nil then status.displayIndeterminate else status.indeterminate
        state.mode=if ready then 'Ready' elseif indeterminate==true then 'Indeterminate' else 'Recharging'
        state.phase=((state.phaseNow*.85+(if key=='Side' then .47 else 0))%1.3)-.18
        local age=state.readyAt and math.max(now-state.readyAt,0)
        state.flash=if age and age<.24 then (1-age/.24)^2 else 0
        return state
    end
    local function dashRecharge(record,key,track,fill,horizontal,status,fraction,state,color,alpha,visible)
        local effect=record[key..'Recharge']
        if not effect then
            local clip=make('Frame',track)
            clip.Name,clip.BorderSizePixel,clip.BackgroundTransparency='DashRechargeClip',0,1
            clip.ClipsDescendants=true
            clip.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(0,if horizontal then 0 else 1)
            clip.Position=host.UDim2.fromScale(0,if horizontal then 0 else 1)
            local gleam=make('Frame',clip)
            gleam.Name,gleam.BorderSizePixel='DashRechargeSweep',0
            local gradient
            if host.NumberSequence and host.NumberSequenceKeypoint then
                gradient=make('UIGradient',gleam)
                gradient.Name='DashRechargeSoftEdges'
                gradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new({host.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),
                    host.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,0),host.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
                gradient.Rotation=if horizontal then 0 else 90
            end
            effect={clip=clip,gleam=gleam,gradient=gradient}
            record[key..'Recharge']=effect
        end
        local flashing=state.mode=='Ready' and state.flash>0
        local active=visible and status~=nil and alpha<1 and (state.mode~='Ready' or flashing)
        put(effect.clip,'Visible',active)
        if not active then return end
        -- A traveling segment explicitly means unknown timing. It never
        -- changes the native fill or masquerades as completed progress.
        local span=if state.mode=='Indeterminate' then 1 else fraction or 0
        put(effect.clip,'Size',scaleValue(record,key..'RechargeClipSize',if horizontal then span else 1,if horizontal then 1 else span))
        put(effect.clip,'ZIndex',fill.ZIndex)
        local gleam=effect.gleam
        put(gleam,'ZIndex',fill.ZIndex)
        put(gleam,'BackgroundColor3',color)
        put(gleam,'BackgroundTransparency',1-(1-alpha)*(if flashing then .3*state.flash else .28))
        if effect.gradient then put(effect.gradient,'Enabled',not flashing) end
        put(gleam,'Size',scaleValue(record,key..'RechargeSize',if flashing or not horizontal then 1 else .18,if flashing or horizontal then 1 else .18))
        put(gleam,'Position',scaleValue(record,key..'RechargePosition',if flashing or not horizontal then 0 else state.phase,
            if flashing or horizontal then 0 else 1-state.phase-.18))
    end
    function control.refreshFrontDash(record,serverTime)
        record.showFrontDash=false
        record.showFrontDashBeside,record.showFrontDashBelow=false,false
        record.showFrontDashTop,record.showFrontDashHorizontal=false,false
        record.frontDashStatus,record.sideDashStatus=nil,nil
        local readiness=menu.frontDashReadiness
        if record.model~=player.Character or not control.frontDashEnabled or not record.showCooldowns
            or not record.source or not record.source.Parent or not readiness then return end
        local status,fraction=dashStatus(if type(readiness.getStatus)=='function' then readiness.getStatus(record.model,serverTime) else nil)
        local sideStatus,sideFraction=dashStatus(if type(readiness.getSideStatus)=='function' then readiness.getSideStatus(record.model,serverTime) else nil)
        if not status and not sideStatus then return end
        record.frontDashStatus,record.sideDashStatus=status,sideStatus
        local now=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock() else os.clock()
        local frontAnimation=dashAnimation(record,'Front',status,fraction,now)
        local sideAnimation=dashAnimation(record,'Side',sideStatus,sideFraction,now)
        local dashControl=menu.dashControl
        local rejectionCount=tonumber(dashControl and (dashControl.frontDeniedCount or dashControl.rejections)) or 0
        if record.dashRejectionCount and rejectionCount>record.dashRejectionCount then record.dashRejectedAt=now end
        record.dashRejectionCount=rejectionCount
        local rejectAge=record.dashRejectedAt and now-record.dashRejectedAt
        record.dashRejectionPulse=rejectAge~=nil and rejectAge>=0 and rejectAge<.35
        record.showFrontDash=true
        record.showFrontDashBeside=control.frontDashPlacement=='Beside Ultimate' or control.frontDashPlacement=='Both'
        record.showFrontDashBelow=control.frontDashPlacement=='Below Cooldowns' or control.frontDashPlacement=='Both'
        record.showFrontDashTop=control.frontDashPlacement=='On Top (Below Health Text)'
        record.showFrontDashHorizontal=record.showFrontDashBelow or record.showFrontDashTop
        local label=if status then tostring(status.name or 'Front Dash') else tostring(sideStatus.name or 'Side Dash')
        local sideLabel=if sideStatus then tostring(sideStatus.name or 'Side Dash') else nil
        for index=1,2 do
            local horizontal=index==2
            local trackKey=if horizontal then 'frontDashHorizontalTrack' else 'frontDashTrack'
            local fillKey=if horizontal then 'frontDashHorizontalFill' else 'frontDashFill'
            local sideFillKey=if horizontal then 'frontDashHorizontalSideFill' else 'frontDashSideFill'
            local track=record[trackKey]
            local wanted=if horizontal then record.showFrontDashHorizontal else record.showFrontDashBeside
            if not track and not wanted then continue end
            if not track then
                track=make('Frame',record.display)
                track.Name,track.BackgroundTransparency,track.BorderSizePixel=if horizontal then 'FrontDashReadinessBelow' else 'FrontDashReadiness',1,0
                track.Visible=false
                local corner=make('UICorner',track);corner.CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(0,1)
                local outline=make('UIStroke',track)
                outline.Thickness,outline.Transparency,outline.Color=2,.35,host.Color3.fromRGB(18,24,30)
                record[trackKey..'Outline']=outline
                record[trackKey],record[fillKey]=track,dashFill(track,horizontal,'FrontDashFill',2)
                record[sideFillKey]=dashFill(track,horizontal,'SideDashFill',3)
                local statusLabel=make('TextLabel',track)
                statusLabel.Name,statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency,statusLabel.BorderSizePixel='FrontDashStatus',1,0
                statusLabel.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1);statusLabel.Position=host.UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
                statusLabel.Font=host.Enum.Font.GothamSemibold;statusLabel.TextScaled=true;statusLabel.TextWrapped=not horizontal
                statusLabel.TextColor3,statusLabel.TextStrokeColor3=host.Color3.new(1,1,1),host.Color3.new(0,0,0)
                statusLabel.TextStrokeTransparency,statusLabel.ZIndex=.15,5
                record[trackKey..'StatusLabel']=statusLabel
                local pulse=make('Frame',track)
                pulse.Name,pulse.BorderSizePixel,pulse.BackgroundColor3='DashBlockedPulse',0,host.Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70)
                pulse.Size,pulse.Position=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1),host.UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
                pulse.BackgroundTransparency,pulse.Visible,pulse.ZIndex=1,false,4
                record[trackKey..'BlockedPulse']=pulse
                local warning=make('UIStroke',pulse)
                warning.Name,warning.Color,warning.Thickness='DashDeniedOutline',host.Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70),1.5
                warning.Transparency=1
                record[trackKey..'BlockedStroke']=warning
                decorateChrome(record,track,'Track',false)
                decorateChrome(record,record[fillKey],'Fill',false)
                decorateChrome(record,record[sideFillKey],'Fill',false)
                appearanceRole(record.barChrome[record[fillKey]],'FrontDash')
                appearanceRole(record.barChrome[record[sideFillKey]],'SideDash')
            end
            put(track,'BackgroundColor3',control.dashBarBackgroundColor)
            put(track,'BackgroundTransparency',control.dashBarBackgroundTransparency)
            local outline=record[trackKey..'Outline']
            if outline and outline.Parent==track then
                put(outline,'Color',control.dashBarOutlineColor)
                put(outline,'Transparency',control.dashBarOutlineTransparency)
                put(outline,'Thickness',control.dashBarOutlineThickness)
            end
            local fill=record[fillKey]
            put(fill,'Visible',status~=nil)
            put(fill,'Size',scaleValue(record,fillKey..'Value',if horizontal then fraction or 0 else 1,if horizontal then 1 else fraction or 0))
            put(fill,'BackgroundColor3',control.frontDashColor)
            put(fill,'BackgroundTransparency',control.frontDashTransparency)
            put(fill,'ZIndex',if control.dashOverlayOrder=='Front Over Side' then 3 else 2)
            local frontChrome=record.barChrome and record.barChrome[fill]
            if frontChrome and frontChrome.shade then put(frontChrome.shade,'ZIndex',fill.ZIndex) end
            local sideFill=record[sideFillKey]
            put(sideFill,'Visible',sideStatus~=nil and control.sideDashOverlayEnabled)
            put(sideFill,'Size',scaleValue(record,sideFillKey..'Value',if horizontal then sideFraction or 0 else 1,if horizontal then 1 else sideFraction or 0))
            put(sideFill,'BackgroundColor3',control.sideDashColor)
            put(sideFill,'BackgroundTransparency',control.sideDashTransparency)
            put(sideFill,'ZIndex',if control.dashOverlayOrder=='Front Over Side' then 2 else 3)
            local sideChrome=record.barChrome and record.barChrome[sideFill]
            if sideChrome and sideChrome.shade then put(sideChrome.shade,'ZIndex',sideFill.ZIndex) end
            dashRecharge(record,fillKey,track,fill,horizontal,status,fraction,frontAnimation,control.frontDashColor,control.frontDashTransparency,status~=nil)
            dashRecharge(record,sideFillKey,track,sideFill,horizontal,sideStatus,sideFraction,sideAnimation,control.sideDashColor,control.sideDashTransparency,sideStatus~=nil and control.sideDashOverlayEnabled)
            local statusLabel=record[trackKey..'StatusLabel']
            if statusLabel then
                put(statusLabel,'Visible',control.dashStatusTextEnabled)
                if control.dashStatusTextEnabled then
                    local text='Front Dash Unknown'
                    if status then
                        local ready=status.ready==true or (status.ready==nil and fraction and fraction>=1)
                        local remaining=tonumber(status.remaining)
                        text=if ready then 'Front Dash Ready' elseif remaining and remaining==remaining and math.abs(remaining)<math.huge then string.format('Front Dash %.1fs',math.max(remaining,0)) else 'Front Dash Recharging'
                    end
                    put(statusLabel,'Text',text)
                end
            end
            local pulse=record[trackKey..'BlockedPulse']
            if pulse then
                put(pulse,'Visible',record.dashRejectionPulse)
                put(pulse,'BackgroundTransparency',1)
                local warning=record[trackKey..'BlockedStroke']
                if warning then put(warning,'Transparency',if record.dashRejectionPulse then SideDisplays.warningAlpha(rejectAge,now) else 1) end
            end
            if track:GetAttribute('AbilityName')~=label then track:SetAttribute('AbilityName',label) end
            if track:GetAttribute('SideAbilityName')~=sideLabel then track:SetAttribute('SideAbilityName',sideLabel) end
            if track:GetAttribute('FrontRechargeMode')~=frontAnimation.mode then track:SetAttribute('FrontRechargeMode',frontAnimation.mode) end
            if track:GetAttribute('SideRechargeMode')~=sideAnimation.mode then track:SetAttribute('SideRechargeMode',sideAnimation.mode) end
        end
    end
    function control.refreshSpecialSource()
        -- Read the native local HUD instead of guessing each moveset's color,
        -- cooldown or special resource. Re-resolve this short path on refresh
        -- so a recreated HUD/respawn cannot leave a stale meter attached.
        local playerGui=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
        local main=playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild('Main')
        local controls=main and main:FindFirstChild('Controls')
        local ultimate=controls and controls:FindFirstChild('Ultimate')
        local ultimateBar=ultimate and ultimate:FindFirstChild('Bar')
        local ultimateFill=ultimateBar and ultimateBar:FindFirstChild('Fill')
        control.ultimateSource=if ultimateFill and ultimateFill:IsA('Frame') then ultimateFill else nil
        control.ultimateSourceGradient=ultimateFill and ultimateFill:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
        local special=ultimate and ultimate:FindFirstChild('Special')
        local fill=special and special:FindFirstChild('Fill')
        control.specialSource=if fill and fill:IsA('Frame') then fill else nil
        local gradient=fill and fill:FindFirstChild('UIGradient')
        control.specialSourceGradient=if gradient and gradient:IsA('UIGradient') then gradient else nil
    end
    local function finite(value)
        return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function refreshSpecialPalette()
        if control.specialPalette or type(host.require)~='function' then return end
        local now=os.clock()
        if now<(control.nextSpecialPaletteRead or 0) then return end
        control.nextSpecialPaletteRead=now+5
        local modules=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Modules')
        local source=modules and modules:FindFirstChild('UltNames')
        if not source then return end
        local ok,palette=pcall(host.require,source)
        if ok and type(palette)=='table' then control.specialPalette=palette end
    end
    function control.characterResourceStyle(record)
        local model=record.model
        local moveset=model:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        local palette=control.specialPalette and control.specialPalette[moveset]
        if type(palette)~='table' or not palette[2] or not palette[3] then return nil end
        local custom=model:GetAttribute('CustomUltC')
        local cached=record.nativeResourceStyle
        if cached and cached.moveset==moveset and cached.custom==custom and cached.palette==palette then return cached end
        local base,gradient=palette[2],host.ColorSequence.new(palette[3],host.Color3.new(1,1,1))
        if type(custom)=='string' then
            local colors={}
            for item in custom:gmatch('%S+') do
                local r,g,b=item:match('^([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)$')
                r,g,b=tonumber(r),tonumber(g),tonumber(b)
                if finite(r) and finite(g) and finite(b) then
                    table.insert(colors,host.Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(r,0,255),math.clamp(g,0,255),math.clamp(b,0,255)))
                end
            end
            base=host.Color3.new(1,1,1)
            if #colors<2 then gradient=host.ColorSequence.new(colors[1] or base)
            else
                local points={}
                for index,value in colors do table.insert(points,host.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new((index-1)/(#colors-1),value)) end
                gradient=host.ColorSequence.new(points)
            end
        end
        cached={moveset=moveset,custom=custom,palette=palette,base=base,gradient=gradient}
        record.nativeResourceStyle=cached
        return cached
    end
    function control.refreshEnemySpecial(record)
        local model=record.model
        local duration,last=model:GetAttribute('M2_CD'),model:GetAttribute('LastM2')
        local style=control.characterResourceStyle(record)
        record.specialAvailable=style~=nil and finite(duration) and duration>=0 and finite(last)
        record.specialInfo=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not record.specialAvailable then return end
        record.specialMoveset,record.specialCustom,record.specialPalette=style.moveset,style.custom,style.palette
        put(record.specialFill,'BackgroundColor3',style.base)
        put(record.specialGradient,'Color',style.gradient)
        put(record.specialGradient,'Enabled',true)
        put(record.specialGradient,'Rotation',-90)
        local natural=record.barNatural.Special
        natural.color,natural.enabled=record.specialFill.BackgroundColor3,true
    end
    function control.refreshUltimate(record)
        local ultimate=record.ultimate
        local fill=ultimate and ultimate.Parent and ultimate:FindFirstChild('Fill')
        if not fill or not fill:IsA('Frame') then restoreUltimateStyle(record);return end
        record.barNatural=record.barNatural or {}
        if not record.barNatural.Ultimate or record.barNatural.Ultimate.fill~=fill then
            local nativeGradient=fill:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
            record.barNatural.Ultimate={fill=fill,color=fill.BackgroundColor3,enabled=nativeGradient and nativeGradient.Enabled~=false,
                originalColor=fill.BackgroundColor3,originalEnabled=nativeGradient and nativeGradient.Enabled~=false}
        end
        if record.ultimateFill~=fill then
            restoreUltimateStyle(record)
            record.ultimateFill=fill
            record.ultimateStyleOriginal={[fill]={BackgroundColor3=fill.BackgroundColor3}}
            record.ultimateStyleApplied={[fill]={}}
        end
        local ownSource=if record.model==player.Character then control.ultimateSource else nil
        local ownGradient=ownSource and control.ultimateSourceGradient
        local style=if not ownSource then control.characterResourceStyle(record) else nil
        if not ownSource and not style then
            restoreUltimateStyle(record)
            local natural=record.barNatural.Ultimate
            local chrome=record.barChrome[fill]
            local applied=chrome and chrome.applied[fill]
            local nativeGradient=fill:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
            local gradientApplied=chrome and nativeGradient and chrome.applied[nativeGradient]
            natural.color=if applied and fill.BackgroundColor3==applied.BackgroundColor3 then natural.originalColor else fill.BackgroundColor3
            natural.enabled=if gradientApplied and nativeGradient.Enabled==gradientApplied.Enabled then natural.originalEnabled else nativeGradient and nativeGradient.Enabled~=false
            return
        end
        local gradient=record.ultimateGradient
        if not gradient or gradient.Parent~=fill then
            gradient=fill:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
            if not gradient then
                gradient=make('UIGradient',fill);gradient.Name='ShenaniganismUltimateColor'
                record.ultimateOwnedGradient=gradient
            end
            record.ultimateGradient=gradient
            record.ultimateStyleOriginal[gradient]={Color=gradient.Color,Enabled=gradient.Enabled,Rotation=gradient.Rotation,Transparency=gradient.Transparency}
            record.ultimateStyleApplied[gradient]={}
        end
        applyUltimateStyle(record,fill,'BackgroundColor3',if ownSource then ownSource.BackgroundColor3 else style.base)
        if ownSource then
            local gradientValid=ownGradient~=nil and ownGradient.Parent==ownSource
            applyUltimateStyle(record,gradient,'Enabled',gradientValid and ownGradient.Enabled~=false)
            if gradientValid then
                applyUltimateStyle(record,gradient,'Color',ownGradient.Color)
                applyUltimateStyle(record,gradient,'Rotation',ownGradient.Rotation)
                applyUltimateStyle(record,gradient,'Transparency',ownGradient.Transparency)
            end
        else
            applyUltimateStyle(record,gradient,'Color',style.gradient)
            applyUltimateStyle(record,gradient,'Enabled',true)
        end
        local natural=record.barNatural.Ultimate
        natural.color,natural.enabled=fill.BackgroundColor3,gradient.Enabled~=false
    end
    local function writeBarAppearance(chrome: any,object: any,property: string,value: any)
        local applied=chrome.applied[object]
        if applied and applied[property]==value then
            -- Keep the native readback check, without rewriting unchanged
            -- ownership metadata on every data update.
            put(object,property,value)
        else writeChrome(chrome,object,property,value) end
    end
    function control.applyBarAppearance(record)
        local roles=record.barAppearanceTargets
        local ultimate=record.ultimate
        if ultimate and ultimate.Parent then
            local fill=ultimate:FindFirstChild('Fill')
            if fill and (not roles.Ultimate or roles.Ultimate[2]~=fill) then roles.Ultimate={ultimate,fill,fill:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')} end
        else roles.Ultimate=nil end
        for role,objects in roles do
            local track,fill,gradient=objects[1],objects[2],objects[3]
            local settings,natural=control.barSettings[role],record.barNatural[role]
            if track and fill and natural then
                local trackChrome=record.barChrome[track] or decorateChrome(record,track,'Outline',true)
                local fillChrome=record.barChrome[fill] or decorateChrome(record,fill,'Appearance',true)
                writeBarAppearance(trackChrome,track,'BackgroundColor3',settings.backgroundColor)
                writeBarAppearance(trackChrome,track,'BackgroundTransparency',settings.backgroundTransparency)
                writeBarAppearance(fillChrome,fill,'BackgroundColor3',if settings.fillMode=='Custom' then settings.fillColor else natural.color)
                writeBarAppearance(fillChrome,fill,'BackgroundTransparency',settings.fillTransparency)
