                if gradient then writeBarAppearance(fillChrome,gradient,'Enabled',settings.fillMode=='Natural' and natural.enabled==true) end
                if fillChrome.appearanceRole~=role then appearanceRole(fillChrome,role) end
            end
        end
    end
    function control.enemySpecialProgress(record,now)
        local duration,last=record.model:GetAttribute('M2_CD'),record.model:GetAttribute('LastM2')
        if not finite(duration) or duration<0 or not finite(last) or not finite(now) then return nil,nil end
        local info=record.specialInfo
        -- Match the native Special.Fill cooldown formula and no-cooldown state.
        if duration==0 or (info and info.Parent and info:GetAttribute('CD')) then return 1,0 end
        local elapsed=math.max(0,now-last)
        return math.clamp(elapsed/duration,0,1),math.max(0,duration-elapsed)
    end
    function control.refresh()
        syncCooldownOutline()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.refreshSpecialSource()
        refreshSpecialPalette()
        bootstrapSources()
        for source in pendingSources do
            pendingSources[source]=nil
            if source.Parent then observeSource(source) end
        end
        local wanted,sources={},{}
        if cooldownsEnabled() then
            for source,candidate in control.sourceCandidates do
                if candidate.named and source.Parent then
                    local model=source.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                    if actorDead(model) then put(source,"Enabled",false)
                    elseif model and (source:FindFirstChild("Moveset") or source:FindFirstChild("Holder")) then sources[model]=source end
                end
            end
        end
        local function include(model)
            if not model or wanted[model] or not model.Parent or not model:IsA("Model") then return end
            local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not actorDead(model,humanoid) then wanted[model]=humanoid end
        end
        -- Native victims and player characters may live outside Characters.
        -- Reuse bounded discovery records so feet labels follow the same actors.
        if menu.visuals and type(menu.visuals.infoCandidates)=="function" then
            for _,model in menu.visuals.infoCandidates() do include(model) end
        else
            local characters=world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            if characters then for _,model in characters:GetChildren() do include(model) end end
        end
        for model in menu.autoCounterFilter and menu.autoCounterFilter.records or {} do include(model) end
        local players=host.game:GetService("Players")
        if not (menu.visuals and menu.visuals.playerRoster) and type(players.GetPlayers)=="function" then
            for _,currentPlayer in players:GetPlayers() do include(currentPlayer.Character) end
        end
        include(player.Character)
        for model,humanoid in wanted do
            local record=control.records[model]
            if record and record.humanoid~=humanoid then release(model);record=nil end
            if record and (not record.panel.Parent or not record.screenDisplay.Parent or not record.distanceLabel.Parent) then release(model);record=nil end
            record=record or create(model,humanoid)
            record.humanoid=humanoid
            if model~=player.Character then control.refreshEnemySpecial(record) end
            local nextSource=sources[model]
            local nextHolder=nextSource and (nextSource:FindFirstChild('Moveset') or nextSource:FindFirstChild('Holder'))
            if record.source~=nextSource or record.holder~=nextHolder then
                restoreSource(record)
                record.source=sources[model]
                if record.source then
                    record.holder=nextHolder
                    record.holderProperties={Size=record.holder.Size,Position=record.holder.Position,AnchorPoint=record.holder.AnchorPoint}
                    record.holderApplied={}
                    record.ultimate=record.source:FindFirstChild('Ult')
                    if record.ultimate then
                        record.ultimateProperties={Size=record.ultimate.Size,Position=record.ultimate.Position}
                        record.ultimateApplied={}
                    end
                    observeHolder(record)
                    if record.source.Destroying then
                        local nativeSource=record.source
                        record.sourceDestroying=nativeSource.Destroying:Connect(function()
                            -- Destroying the native monitor must not also destroy
                            -- the gauges needed while Cooldown Viewer is off.
                            if record.panel.Parent==nativeSource then detachPanel(record) end
                            if record.distanceLabel.Parent==nativeSource then detachDistance(record) end
                            detachFrontDash(record)
                            if record.mergedSource==nativeSource then record.mergedSource=nil end
                        end)
                    end
                    for _,property in {"Adornee","StudsOffset","StudsOffsetWorldSpace","ExtentsOffset","ExtentsOffsetWorldSpace","Size","Enabled","ClipsDescendants"} do record.properties[property]=record.source[property] end
                    if record.source:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismDisplayManaged')==true then
                        record.properties.Enabled=true
                        record.sourceEnabledApplied=record.source.Enabled
                    end
                    local size=record.properties.Size
                    record.cooldownAspect=if size.Y.Scale>0 and size.X.Scale>0 then size.X.Scale/size.Y.Scale
                        elseif size.Y.Offset>0 and size.X.Offset>0 then size.X.Offset/size.Y.Offset else 0.35
                end
            end
            control.refreshUltimate(record)
            if record.ultimate then applyBarOutline(record,record.ultimate,'Ultimate') end
            -- Animation/cooldown progress does not change card geometry. Only
            -- actual structure, visibility, aspect or padding edits dirty it.
            if record.holder and record.holder.Parent and record.holderDirty then
                record.holderDirty=false
                control.holderMetricScans+=1
                local cardCount,cardRatio,gapScale,gapOffset,uniform=0,nil,nil,nil,true
                record.cardAspects=record.cardAspects or {}
                for constraint in record.cardAspects do if not constraint.Parent then record.cardAspects[constraint]=nil end end
                for _,object in record.holder:GetDescendants() do
                    if object.Parent==record.holder then
                        if object:IsA("UIListLayout") then
                            local padding=originalLayoutValue(record,object,'Padding')
                            gapScale,gapOffset=padding.Scale,padding.Offset
                            record.cardListLayout=object
                        elseif object:IsA("Frame") and object.Visible~=false then
                            cardCount+=1
                            local constraint=object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
                            local ratio=constraint and originalLayoutValue(record,constraint,'AspectRatio')
                            if constraint then record.cardAspects[constraint]=true end
                            if not ratio or ratio<=0 or (cardRatio and math.abs(cardRatio-ratio)>0.0001) then uniform=false
                            else cardRatio=ratio end
                        end
                    end
                    if object:IsA("Frame") and object:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismBarChrome')~=true and record.cardProperties[object]==nil then
                        local originalTransparency=object.BackgroundTransparency
                        record.cardProperties[object]=originalTransparency
                        -- Native card alpha is initialized during creation only.
                        -- Apply a new card once; render frames never revisit it.
                        if originalTransparency<1 and object:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismCooldownFill')~=true then put(object,"BackgroundTransparency",control.cooldownTransparency) end
                        if object.Parent==record.holder then
                            decorateChrome(record,object,'Track',true)
                            applyBarOutline(record,object,'Cooldown')
                            local fill=object:FindFirstChild('Fill')
                            if fill and fill:IsA('Frame') then appearanceRole(decorateChrome(record,fill,'Fill',true),'Cooldown') end
                        elseif object:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismCooldownFill')==true then appearanceRole(decorateChrome(record,object,'Fill',true),'Cooldown') end
                    end
                end
                local metrics=record.cooldownMetrics
                if uniform and cardCount>0 and cardRatio and gapScale~=nil then
                    if not metrics or metrics.count~=cardCount or metrics.ratio~=cardRatio or metrics.gapScale~=gapScale or metrics.gapOffset~=gapOffset then
                        record.cooldownMetrics={count=cardCount,ratio=cardRatio,gapScale=gapScale,gapOffset=gapOffset}
                        record.cooldownGeometryVersion=(record.cooldownGeometryVersion or 0)+1
                        record.cooldownFit=nil
                    end
                elseif metrics then
                    record.cooldownMetrics,record.cooldownFit=nil,nil
                end
            end
            for object in record.cardProperties do if not object.Parent then record.cardProperties[object]=nil end end
            for object in record.barChrome or {} do if not object.Parent then restoreChrome(record,object) end end
            for target,chrome in record.barChrome or {} do
                if chrome.outlineRole and target.Parent then applyBarOutline(record,target,chrome.outlineRole) end
            end
            local ok,scale=pcall(function() return model:GetScale() end)
            scale=if ok then math.clamp(scale,0.25,5) else 1
            record.halfWidth,record.halfHeight,record.scale=2*scale,3*scale,scale
            -- Cache unanimated rig dimensions at the discovery cadence.
            -- R6 HipHeight excludes leg length; R15 includes it.
            local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local rootHeight=root and root.Size and tonumber(root.Size.Y)
            local hip=tonumber(humanoid.HipHeight)
            local leg=model:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") or model:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
            local legHeight=leg and leg.Size and tonumber(leg.Size.Y)
            if rootHeight and rootHeight==rootHeight and rootHeight>0 and rootHeight<math.huge
                and hip and hip==hip and hip>=0 and hip<math.huge then
                record.feetDrop=rootHeight*0.5+hip+(if legHeight and legHeight==legHeight and legHeight>0 and legHeight<math.huge then legHeight else 0)
            else record.feetDrop=3*scale end
        end
        for model in control.records do if not wanted[model] then release(model) end end
    end
    function control.contentOutsideViewport(record,point,viewport,unitsPerPixel)
        if not record.dataInitialized or record.holderDirty or record.barLayoutVersion~=control.barLayoutVersion
            or record.contentScale~=record.scale or record.splitResourceBar~=record.showSpecial then return false end
        local anchor,source=record.worldAnchor,record.source
        if not anchor or anchor.Parent~=control.anchorFolder or not record.display or record.display.Adornee~=anchor then return false end
        if source and (record.mergedSource~=source or not source.Parent or source.Adornee~=anchor)then return false end
        if not finite(point.X)or not finite(point.Y)or not finite(point.Z)or not finite(unitsPerPixel)or unitsPerPixel<=0 then return false end
        if viewport.X<=0 or viewport.Y<=0 then return false end
        local halfWidth,halfHeight=0,0
        local function include(canvas)
            if canvas.StudsOffset~=host.Vector3.zero or canvas.StudsOffsetWorldSpace~=host.Vector3.zero
                or canvas.ExtentsOffset~=host.Vector3.zero or canvas.ExtentsOffsetWorldSpace~=host.Vector3.zero then return false end
            local size=canvas.Size
            halfWidth=math.max(halfWidth,(math.abs(size.X.Scale)/unitsPerPixel+math.abs(size.X.Offset))*.5)
            halfHeight=math.max(halfHeight,(math.abs(size.Y.Scale)/unitsPerPixel+math.abs(size.Y.Offset))*.5)
            return true
        end
        if not include(record.display)then return false end
        if source and not include(source)then return false end
        if point.Z<-.1 then return true end
        if point.Z<=.1 then return false end
        -- A full extra quarter viewport prevents edge popping during fast pans.
        -- The actual world-sized canvas bounds include all attached gauges.
        local margin=math.max(256,math.min(viewport.X,viewport.Y)*.25)
        return point.X+halfWidth < -margin or point.X-halfWidth > viewport.X+margin
            or point.Y+halfHeight < -margin or point.Y-halfHeight > viewport.Y+margin
    end
    local candidates={}
    function control.update(delta)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.dataElapsed+=math.max(0,tonumber(delta)or 0)
        local dataDue=delta==0 or control.dataElapsed+1e-8>=1/60
        if dataDue then control.dataElapsed%=1/60;control.dataUpdates+=1 end
        control.visibilityClock+=math.clamp(tonumber(delta) or 0,0,0.1)
        control.elapsed+=delta
        if control.elapsed>=0.15 then control.elapsed=0;control.refresh() end
        local parent=player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if gui.Parent~=parent then gui.Parent=parent end
        control.syncLayer()
        put(gui,'Enabled',parent~=nil)
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        local viewport=camera and camera.ViewportSize
        local depthToPixels=camera and viewport.Y>0 and 2*math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView)*0.5)/viewport.Y
        local character=player.Character
        local serverTime=if type(world.GetServerTimeNow)=='function' then world:GetServerTimeNow() else nil
        local localRoot=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local localPosition=localRoot and localRoot.Parent and localRoot.Position
        if localPosition then control.referencePosition=localPosition end
        table.clear(candidates)
        local lockedTarget=menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget
        for model,record in control.records do
            if not record.panel.Parent or not record.screenDisplay.Parent or not record.distanceLabel.Parent then release(model);continue end
            record.distanceCandidate=false
            record.distanceHardHidden=true
            record.contentCulled=false
            record.textCandidate=false
            record.layout=nil
            record.visibilityReason="offscreen"
            record.hardHidden=true
            local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if actorDead(model,record.humanoid) then release(model,true);continue end
            if not root or not root.Parent then release(model);continue end
            if not camera then continue end
            if model~=character and not localPosition then record.visibilityReason="no character";continue end
            -- The whole information group shares the same recent-hit policy.
            -- Keep the cached panels, but stop projecting/painting other actors.
            if not isInfoTarget(model) then record.visibilityReason="not attacked";continue end
            local fields=menu.infoVisibility and menu.infoVisibility.fieldsFor and menu.infoVisibility.fieldsFor(model)
            -- Fully filtered enemy groups have no position or meter data to
            -- paint. Keep lifecycle validation above and the final hide pass;
            -- resume all data/geometry work on their first visible frame.
            -- Self special visibility intentionally has its own policy.
            if model~=character and fields and not (fields['Health Bar']==true or fields['Health Numbers']==true
                or fields['Evasive Bar']==true or fields['Special Bar']==true or fields['Skill Cooldowns']==true or fields.Distance==true) then
                record.showHealth,record.showHealthNumbers,record.showEvasive,record.showSpecial=false,false,false,false
                record.showCooldowns,record.showDistance,record.showResources=false,false,false
                record.showFrontDash,record.showFrontDashBeside,record.showFrontDashBelow=false,false,false
                record.showFrontDashTop,record.showFrontDashHorizontal=false,false
                record.frontDashStatus,record.sideDashStatus=nil,nil
                record.visibilityReason='wall or distance'
                continue
            end
            local rootPosition=root.Position
            local distance=if localPosition then (rootPosition-localPosition).Magnitude else 0
            local barsInRange=model==character or control.studsToMeters(distance)<=control.maxViewDistance
            local showHealth=not isDisplayNPC(model,"HarutaSwordNPC")
            record.showHealth=showHealth and (not fields or fields['Health Bar']==true)
            record.showHealthNumbers=showHealth and (not fields or fields['Health Numbers']==true)
            record.showEvasive=not fields or fields['Evasive Bar']==true
            local specialSource=control.specialSource
            local ownSpecial=model==character
            local enemySpecialFraction,enemySpecialRemaining
            if not ownSpecial and control.enemySpecialEnabled and record.specialAvailable then
                enemySpecialFraction,enemySpecialRemaining=control.enemySpecialProgress(record,serverTime)
            end
            record.showSpecial=if ownSpecial then control.selfSpecialEnabled and specialSource~=nil and specialSource.Parent~=nil
                else enemySpecialFraction~=nil and (not fields or fields['Special Bar']==true)
            record.specialRemaining=enemySpecialRemaining
            record.showCooldowns=not fields or fields['Skill Cooldowns']==true
            control.refreshFrontDash(record,serverTime)
            record.showDistance=not fields or fields.Distance==true
            local viewer=control.viewerShow
            record.showHealth=record.showHealth and viewer.health
            record.showHealthNumbers=record.showHealthNumbers and viewer.numbers
            record.showEvasive=record.showEvasive and viewer.evasive
            record.showSpecial=record.showSpecial and viewer.special
            record.showCooldowns=record.showCooldowns and viewer.cooldowns
            do
                local ultOwner=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                local ultValue=if ultOwner then tonumber(ultOwner:GetAttribute('Ultimate')) else nil
                record.showUlt=viewer.ult and ultValue~=nil and ultValue==ultValue and record.ultFill~=nil
                    and (not fields or fields['Evasive Bar']==true or fields['Health Bar']==true)
                if record.showUlt then
                    local fraction=math.clamp(ultValue/100,0,1)
                    if record.ultFraction~=fraction then
                        record.ultFraction=fraction
                        record.ultFill.Size=host.UDim2.new(fraction,0,1,0)
                        record.ultFill.BackgroundColor3=if fraction>=1 then host.Color3.fromRGB(255,235,140) else host.Color3.fromRGB(255,190,50)
                    end
                end
            end
            if not barsInRange then
                record.showHealth,record.showHealthNumbers,record.showEvasive,record.showSpecial,record.showCooldowns,record.showUlt=false,false,false,false,false,false
                record.visibilityReason="bar distance"
            end
            record.showResources=record.showHealth or record.showHealthNumbers or record.showEvasive or record.showSpecial or record.showUlt==true
            if (fields and not (record.showResources or record.showCooldowns or record.showDistance))
                or (not fields and menu.infoVisibility and not menu.infoVisibility.isVisible(model)) then
                record.visibilityReason="wall or distance"
                continue
            end
            -- Snapshot native position properties once for this synchronous render pass.
            local rawY=rootPosition.Y
            record.stableY=record.stableY or rawY
            local targetY=rawY
            if record.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=host.Enum.Material.Air and math.abs(rawY-record.stableY)<0.2 then targetY=record.stableY end
            if math.abs(rawY-record.stableY)>8 then record.stableY=rawY end
            record.stableY+=(targetY-record.stableY)*(1-math.exp(-24*math.min(delta,0.1)))
            if record.showDistance and model~=character and menu.visuals.infoEnabled and isInfoTarget(model) and localPosition then
                local feet=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(control.feetPosition(record,root,rootPosition))
                if feet.X==feet.X and feet.Y==feet.Y and feet.Z==feet.Z and math.abs(feet.X)<math.huge
                    and math.abs(feet.Y)<math.huge and feet.Z>0 and feet.Z<math.huge
                    and feet.X>=0 and feet.X<=viewport.X and feet.Y>=0 and feet.Y<=viewport.Y then
                    distance=(rootPosition-localPosition).Magnitude
                    local x,y=math.floor(feet.X-36+0.5),math.floor(feet.Y+4+0.5)
                    if record.distanceLabel.Parent~=gui then detachDistance(record) end
                    local roundedDistance=math.floor(control.studsToMeters(distance)*10+0.5)
                    if record.distanceTextValue~=roundedDistance then
                        record.distanceTextValue=roundedDistance;record.distanceText=string.format("%.1f m",roundedDistance/10)
                    end
                    put(record.distanceLabel,"Text",record.distanceText)
                    put(record.distanceLabel,"Position",offsetValue(record,'feetPositionValue',x,y))
                    local visual=menu.visuals
                    if type(visual.applyInfoField)=='function'then visual.applyInfoField(record.distanceLabel,'Distance')end
                    local position,size=record.distanceLabel.Position,record.distanceLabel.Size
                    record.distanceRect=rectangleValue(record,'feetRectValue',position.X.Offset,position.Y.Offset,size.X.Offset,size.Y.Offset)
                    record.distanceCandidate=type(visual.infoFieldVisible)~='function'or visual.infoFieldVisible('Distance')
                    record.distanceHardHidden=false
                end
            end
            if not record.showResources and not record.showCooldowns then continue end
            local resourceOffset=control.displayOffset(model)
            if not record.attachment or record.attachment.Parent~=root then
                if record.attachment then record.attachment:Destroy() end
                record.attachment=make('Attachment',root)
                record.attachment.Name='ShenaniganismResourceAnchor'
            end
            local side=if control.displaySide(model)=='Left' then -1 else 1
            local localOffset=host.Vector3.new(side*3*record.scale,.5*record.scale,0)+resourceOffset
            local anchor=control.presentAnchor(record,root,localOffset,delta)
            if not anchor then continue end
            local point= camera:WorldToViewportPoint(anchor)
            if point.Z~=point.Z or point.X~=point.X or point.Y~=point.Y or math.abs(point.Z)==math.huge
                or viewport.X<=0 or viewport.Y<=0 then
                continue
            end
            -- The engine clips the actual character-attached Billboard every
            -- rendered frame. Never switch it off from a throttled camera/anchor
            -- sample: that clips partially visible panels and flashes on pans.
            local unitsPerPixel=math.max(math.abs(point.Z),0.001)*depthToPixels
            if unitsPerPixel~=unitsPerPixel or unitsPerPixel<=0 or unitsPerPixel==math.huge then continue end
            if delta~=0 and control.contentOutsideViewport(record,point,viewport,unitsPerPixel)then
                -- Keep the native Billboard enabled and the independent anchor
                -- moving at presentation cadence. Only unseen content work waits.
                control.bindCanvas(record,record.display)
                record.contentCulled,record.hardHidden,record.dataDirty=true,false,true
                record.visibilityReason="outside content viewport"
                control.contentCullSkips=(control.contentCullSkips or 0)+1
                continue
            end
            distance=distance or (if control.referencePosition then (rootPosition-control.referencePosition).Magnitude else 0)
            -- Native geometry is fixed in character-relative studs. Camera
            -- projection is used only for visibility and screen bounds.
            local nativeHeight=record.source and tonumber(record.source:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismNativeHeightStuds')) or 4
            if not nativeHeight or nativeHeight<=0 then nativeHeight=4 end
            record.worldUnit=nativeHeight*record.scale/320
            -- Display Scale applies to the complete group, not just its
            -- height. Bars, health text, spacing and Ultimate share one factor.
            local perspective=control.perspectiveFactor(unitsPerPixel,record.scale)*control.displayScale(model)
            local height=control.barHeight(unitsPerPixel,record.scale,model)
            local thickness=control.barThickness*perspective
            local gap=control.resourceBarSpacing*perspective
            -- The special meter shares the evasive column: special
            -- above, evasive below, while HP keeps its full-height column.
            local width=thickness*2+gap
            local fontSize=math.clamp(10*perspective,1,100)
            local textHeight=12*perspective
            local textWidth=54*perspective
            local sizeChanged=record.height~=height or record.width~=width or record.textWidth~=textWidth or record.textHeight~=textHeight
                or record.splitResourceBar~=record.showSpecial or record.barLayoutVersion~=control.barLayoutVersion
            record.barLayoutVersion=control.barLayoutVersion
            record.projectedRigHeight=6*record.scale/unitsPerPixel
            -- Visibility has no distance-size threshold, so scaling never
            -- toggles a pair merely because its projected height changed.
            record.visibleLOD=true
            record.distance=distance
            record.height,record.width=height,width
            record.cameraDepth,record.scaleDistance,record.perspectiveFactor=point.Z,distance,perspective
            record.bodyGap=10*perspective
            record.cardGap=(5+control.resourceCardSpacing)*perspective
            record.textWidth,record.textHeight=textWidth,textHeight
            put(record.text,"TextSize",fontSize)
            local canvasWidth,canvasHeight=54*perspective,height+28*perspective
            record.fallbackPanelPosition=scaleValue(record,'fallbackPanelPositionValue',(canvasWidth-width)*.5/canvasWidth,14*perspective/canvasHeight)
            record.fallbackPanelSize=scaleValue(record,'fallbackPanelSizeValue',width/canvasWidth,height/canvasHeight)
            if sizeChanged then
                record.splitResourceBar=record.showSpecial
                record.screenDisplay.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(canvasWidth,canvasHeight)
                record.track.Position,record.track.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(0,0),host.UDim2.fromScale(thickness/width,1)
                local halfHeight=height*.5
                local splitHeight=if record.showSpecial then halfHeight else 0
                record.evadeTrack.Position,record.evadeTrack.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale((thickness+gap)/width,splitHeight/height),host.UDim2.fromScale(thickness/width,(height-splitHeight)/height)
                if record.specialTrack then
                    record.specialTrack.Position,record.specialTrack.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale((thickness+gap)/width,0),host.UDim2.fromScale(thickness/width,halfHeight/height)
                end
                record.text.Position,record.text.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale((width-textWidth)*.5/width,(-textHeight-2*perspective)/height),host.UDim2.fromScale(textWidth/width,textHeight/height)
                if record.ultTrack then
                    record.ultTrack.Position,record.ultTrack.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(0,(height+3*perspective)/height),host.UDim2.fromScale(1,math.max(4*perspective,2)/height)
                end
            end
            if (not record.source or record.showCooldowns==false) and (control.customBarLayout or record.customResourceLayoutApplied) then
                control.customFallbackPasses=(control.customFallbackPasses or 0)+1
                -- Attached native layouts also mutate barRects; reuse only the
                -- source-free layout while its exact geometry and owners match.
                local cached=if not record.source then record.customFallbackGeometry else nil
                local reusable=cached and cached.baseWidth==canvasWidth and cached.baseHeight==canvasHeight
                    and cached.width==width and cached.height==height and cached.perspective==perspective
                    and cached.textWidth==textWidth and cached.textHeight==textHeight
                    and cached.special==record.showSpecial and cached.version==control.barLayoutVersion
                    and cached.scale==record.scale and cached.nativeHeight==nativeHeight
                    and cached.custom==control.customBarLayout and cached.cooldowns==record.showCooldowns
                    and cached.attachment==record.attachment and cached.root==root
                    and cached.panel==record.panel and cached.canvas==record.screenDisplay and cached.text==record.text
                    and cached.track==record.track and cached.evadeTrack==record.evadeTrack and cached.specialTrack==record.specialTrack
                    and cached.rects==record.barRects and cached.panelParent==record.panel.Parent
                if reusable then
                    canvasWidth,canvasHeight=cached.canvasWidth,cached.canvasHeight
                    record.fallbackPanelPosition,record.fallbackPanelSize=cached.panelPosition,cached.panelSize
                else
                    control.customFallbackBuilds=(control.customFallbackBuilds or 0)+1
                    record.customFallbackBuilds=(record.customFallbackBuilds or 0)+1
                    local baseWidth,baseHeight=canvasWidth,canvasHeight
                    local panelX,panelY=(canvasWidth-width)*.5,14*perspective
                    resourceRectangles(record,panelX,panelY,perspective)
                    local minX,maxX,minY,maxY=0,canvasWidth,0,canvasHeight
                    for role,rect in record.barRects do
                        if role=='Health' or role=='Evasive' or role=='Special' and record.showSpecial then
                            minX,maxX=math.min(minX,rect.x-2*perspective),math.max(maxX,rect.x+rect.w+2*perspective)
                            minY,maxY=math.min(minY,rect.y-textHeight-2*perspective),math.max(maxY,rect.y+rect.h+2*perspective)
                        end
                    end
                    local padX,padY=math.max(-minX,maxX-canvasWidth,0),math.max(-minY,maxY-canvasHeight,0)
                    canvasWidth+=padX*2;canvasHeight+=padY*2;panelX+=padX;panelY+=padY
                    for _,rect in record.barRects do rect.x+=padX;rect.y+=padY end
                    placeResourceRectangles(record,panelX,panelY)
                    record.fallbackPanelPosition=scaleValue(record,'customFallbackPanelPosition',panelX/canvasWidth,panelY/canvasHeight)
                    record.fallbackPanelSize=scaleValue(record,'customFallbackPanelSize',width/canvasWidth,height/canvasHeight)
                    put(record.screenDisplay,'Size',offsetValue(record,'customFallbackCanvas',canvasWidth,canvasHeight))
                    local settings=control.barSettings.Health
                    if settings.width~=100 or settings.length~=100 or settings.x~=0 or settings.y~=0 then
                        local hp=record.barRects.Health
                        put(record.text,'Position',scaleValue(record,'healthFallbackCustomText',(hp.x+hp.w*.5-panelX-textWidth*.5)/width,(hp.y-panelY-textHeight-2*perspective)/height))
                    end
                    record.customResourceLayoutApplied=control.customBarLayout
                    record.customFallbackGeometry=if not record.source then {
                        baseWidth=baseWidth,baseHeight=baseHeight,width=width,height=height,perspective=perspective,
                        textWidth=textWidth,textHeight=textHeight,special=record.showSpecial,version=control.barLayoutVersion,
                        scale=record.scale,nativeHeight=nativeHeight,custom=control.customBarLayout,cooldowns=record.showCooldowns,
                        attachment=record.attachment,root=root,panel=record.panel,canvas=record.screenDisplay,text=record.text,
                        track=record.track,evadeTrack=record.evadeTrack,specialTrack=record.specialTrack,rects=record.barRects,
                        panelParent=record.panel.Parent,canvasWidth=canvasWidth,canvasHeight=canvasHeight,
                        panelPosition=record.fallbackPanelPosition,panelSize=record.fallbackPanelSize} else nil
                end
            else
                record.customFallbackGeometry=nil
            end
            if record.panel.Parent==record.display then
                put(record.panel,'Position',record.fallbackPanelPosition)
                put(record.panel,'Size',record.fallbackPanelSize)
            end
            local screenFactor=record.worldUnit/unitsPerPixel
            local positionX,positionY=point.X-canvasWidth*screenFactor*.5,point.Y-canvasHeight*screenFactor*.5
            control.bindCanvas(record,record.display)
            put(record.display,'Size',scaleValue(record,'attachedFallbackWorldSize',canvasWidth*record.worldUnit,canvasHeight*record.worldUnit))
            put(record.text,'TextScaled',true)
            record.textCandidate=height*screenFactor>=12
            local roundedHealth,roundedMax
            local nativeHealth,nativeMaxHealth=record.humanoid.Health,record.humanoid.MaxHealth
            local dataThisFrame=dataDue or record.dataDirty or not record.dataInitialized
            if dataThisFrame then roundedHealth,roundedMax=math.round(nativeHealth),math.round(nativeMaxHealth) end
            if roundedHealth and (record.roundedHealth~=roundedHealth or record.roundedMax~=roundedMax) then
                record.roundedHealth,record.roundedMax=roundedHealth,roundedMax
                record.healthText=tostring(roundedHealth)..'/'..tostring(roundedMax)
            end
            put(record.text,"Text",record.healthText)
            record.resourceRect=rectangleValue(record,'resourceRectValue',point.X-width*screenFactor*.5,point.Y-height*screenFactor*.5,width*screenFactor,height*screenFactor)
            record.textRect=rectangleValue(record,'textRectValue',record.resourceRect.x+(width-textWidth)*screenFactor*.5,record.resourceRect.y-(textHeight+2*perspective)*screenFactor,textWidth*screenFactor,textHeight*screenFactor)
            local layout=record.layoutValue
            if not layout then layout={};record.layoutValue=layout end
            layout.viewport,layout.anchorX,layout.anchorY=viewport,point.X,point.Y
            layout.halfWidthPixels,layout.unitsPerPixel,layout.near=record.halfWidth/unitsPerPixel,unitsPerPixel,distance<=30
            layout.frameX,layout.frameY=positionX-record.resourceRect.x,positionY-record.resourceRect.y
            record.layout=layout
            local hp=math.clamp(nativeHealth/math.max(nativeMaxHealth,1),0,1)
            local evade=math.clamp((tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Evade")) or 0)/50,0,1)
            if record.hpFraction~=hp then
                record.hpFraction=hp
                record.fill.Size=host.UDim2.new(1,0,hp,0)
                local color=control.healthColor(hp)
                record.gradient.Color=host.ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(host.Color3.new(1,1,1),0.12),color)
            end
            if record.evadeFraction~=evade then record.evadeFraction=evade;record.evadeFill.Size=host.UDim2.new(1,0,evade,0) end
            if record.showSpecial then
                local fraction=enemySpecialFraction
                if ownSpecial then
                    local size=specialSource.Size.X
                    fraction=size.Scale
                    if size.Offset~=0 then
                        local nativeWidth=specialSource.Parent.AbsoluteSize.X
                        if nativeWidth>0 then fraction+=size.Offset/nativeWidth end
                    end
                end
                fraction=if fraction==fraction and math.abs(fraction)<math.huge then math.clamp(fraction,0,1) else 0
                if record.specialFraction~=fraction then
                    record.specialFraction=fraction
                    record.specialFill.Size=host.UDim2.new(1,0,fraction,0)
                end
                if ownSpecial and dataThisFrame then
                    local nativeColor=specialSource.BackgroundColor3
                    put(record.specialFill,'BackgroundColor3',nativeColor)
                    local gradient=control.specialSourceGradient
                    local gradientParent=gradient and gradient.Parent
                    local gradientEnabled=gradient and gradient.Enabled
                    put(record.specialGradient,'Enabled',gradient~=nil and gradientParent==specialSource and gradientEnabled)
                    if gradient and gradientParent==specialSource then
                        put(record.specialGradient,'Color',gradient.Color)
                        put(record.specialGradient,'Transparency',gradient.Transparency)
                        put(record.specialGradient,'Rotation',gradient.Rotation)
                    end
                    local natural=record.barNatural.Special
                    natural.color,natural.enabled=nativeColor,gradient~=nil and gradientEnabled~=false
                end
            end
            if dataThisFrame then control.applyBarAppearance(record);record.dataInitialized=true;record.dataDirty=nil end
            local source=record.source
            if source and source.Parent then
                local cardWidth,cardCanvasHeight,contentHeight=control.cooldownGeometry(record,height)
                record.cooldownContentHeight=contentHeight
                record.cardWidth,record.cardCanvasHeight=cardWidth,cardCanvasHeight
                record.sourceWorldOffset=host.Vector3.zero
                put(source,"ExtentsOffset",host.Vector3.zero)
                put(source,"ExtentsOffsetWorldSpace",host.Vector3.zero)
            end
            record.contentScale=record.scale
            record.hardHidden=false
            record.priority=if model==lockedTarget then 0 elseif model==character then 1 else 2
            record.depth=point.Z
            table.insert(candidates,record)
        end
        control.applyVisibility(candidates)
        table.clear(candidates);table.clear(kept)
    end
    function control.setCooldownTransparency(percent)
        local transparency=math.clamp(tonumber(percent) or 75,0,100)/100
        if control.cooldownTransparency~=transparency then
            control.cooldownTransparency=transparency
            for _,record in control.records do
                for object,originalTransparency in record.cardProperties do
                    if object.Parent and originalTransparency<1 and object:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismCooldownFill')~=true then put(object,"BackgroundTransparency",transparency) end
                end
            end
        end
        control.update(0)
    end
    function control.setFrontDashEnabled(value)
        control.frontDashEnabled=value==true
        control.update(0)
    end
    function control.setFrontDashPlacement(value)
        if value~='Below Cooldowns' and value~='Beside Ultimate' and value~='Both' and value~='On Top (Below Health Text)' then return false end
        control.frontDashPlacement=value;control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    local function setDashDimension(field,value,minimum,maximum)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control[field]=math.clamp(amount,minimum,maximum);control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setDashBarLength(value) return setDashDimension('dashBarLength',value,10,200) end
    function control.setDashBarThickness(value) return setDashDimension('dashBarThickness',value,1,30) end
    function control.setDashBarOffsetX(value) return setDashDimension('dashBarOffsetX',value,-240,240) end
    function control.setDashBarOffsetY(value) return setDashDimension('dashBarOffsetY',value,-240,240) end
    function control.setFrontDashColor(value)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        control.frontDashColor=value;control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setFrontDashTransparency(value)
        local alpha=tonumber(value)
        if not alpha or alpha~=alpha or math.abs(alpha)==math.huge then return false end
        control.frontDashTransparency=math.clamp(alpha,0,100)/100
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setSideDashColor(value)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        control.sideDashColor=value;control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setSideDashTransparency(value)
        local alpha=tonumber(value)
        if not alpha or alpha~=alpha or math.abs(alpha)==math.huge then return false end
        control.sideDashTransparency=math.clamp(alpha,0,100)/100
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    local function setDashStyleColor(field,value)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        control[field]=value;control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    local function setDashStyleAlpha(field,value)
        local alpha=tonumber(value)
        if not alpha or alpha~=alpha or math.abs(alpha)==math.huge then return false end
        control[field]=math.clamp(alpha,0,100)/100;control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setDashBarBackgroundColor(value) return setDashStyleColor('dashBarBackgroundColor',value) end
    function control.setDashBarBackgroundTransparency(value) return setDashStyleAlpha('dashBarBackgroundTransparency',value) end
    function control.setDashBarOutlineColor(value) return setDashStyleColor('dashBarOutlineColor',value) end
    function control.setDashBarOutlineTransparency(value) return setDashStyleAlpha('dashBarOutlineTransparency',value) end
    function control.setDashBarOutlineThickness(value)
        local width=tonumber(value)
        if not width or width~=width or math.abs(width)==math.huge then return false end
        control.dashBarOutlineThickness=math.clamp(width,0,10);control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setPerspectiveScaleEnabled(value)
        control.perspectiveScaleEnabled=value==true
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    local function setSpacing(field,value)
        local spacing=tonumber(value)
        if not spacing or spacing~=spacing or math.abs(spacing)==math.huge then return false end
        control[field]=math.clamp(math.round(spacing),0,40)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setResourceBarSpacing(value)
        return setSpacing('resourceBarSpacing',value)
    end
    function control.setResourceCardSpacing(value)
        return setSpacing('resourceCardSpacing',value)
    end
    function control.setCooldownOffsetY(value)
        local offset=tonumber(value)
        if not offset or offset~=offset or math.abs(offset)==math.huge then return false end
        control.cooldownOffsetY=math.clamp(math.round(offset),-240,240)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setMaxViewDistance(value)
        local distance=tonumber(value)
        if not distance or distance~=distance or math.abs(distance)==math.huge then return false end
        control.maxViewDistance=math.clamp(distance,0,5000/0.28)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setCooldownScale(value)
        local scale=tonumber(value)
        if not scale or scale~=scale or scale==math.huge or scale==-math.huge then return false end
        control.cooldownScale=math.clamp(scale,0.25,30)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setSelfCooldownScale(value)
        local scale=tonumber(value)
        if not scale or scale~=scale or scale==math.huge or scale==-math.huge then return false end
        control.selfCooldownScale=math.clamp(scale,0.25,30)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setSelfSpecialEnabled(value)
        control.selfSpecialEnabled=value==true
        control.refreshSpecialSource()
        control.update(0)
    end
    function control.setEnemySpecialEnabled(value)
        control.enemySpecialEnabled=value==true
        control.refresh()
        control.update(0)
    end
    function control.setResourceHeight(value)
        local height=tonumber(value)
        if not height or height~=height or height==math.huge or height==-math.huge then return false end
        control.resourceHeight=math.clamp(math.floor(height+0.5),80,480)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setSelfResourceHeight(value)
        local height=tonumber(value)
        if not height or height~=height or height==math.huge or height==-math.huge then return false end
        control.selfResourceHeight=math.clamp(math.floor(height+0.5),80,480)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setResourceSide(value)
        if value~="Left" and value~="Right" and value~="Automatic" then return false end
        control.resourceSide=value
        for model,record in control.records do if model~=player.Character then record.placementKey=nil end end
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setSelfResourceSide(value)
        if value~="Left" and value~="Right" and value~="Automatic" then return false end
        control.selfResourceSide=value
        local record=control.records[player.Character]
        if record then record.placementKey=nil end
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    local function setOffset(field,axis,value)
        if axis~="X" and axis~="Y" and axis~="Z" then return false end
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or amount==math.huge or amount==-math.huge then return false end
        local offset=control[field]
        amount=math.clamp(amount,-15/0.28,15/0.28)
        control[field]=host.Vector3.new(if axis=="X" then amount else offset.X,if axis=="Y" then amount else offset.Y,if axis=="Z" then amount else offset.Z)
        control.update(0)
        return true
    end
    function control.setResourceOffset(axis,value)
        return setOffset("resourceOffset",axis,value)
    end
    function control.setSelfResourceOffset(axis,value)
        return setOffset("selfResourceOffset",axis,value)
    end
    local runService=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local function renderDisplays(delta)
        if not control.alive then return end
        if type(delta)~='number' or delta~=delta or delta<=0 or delta==math.huge then return end
        control.renderBudget+=delta;control.renderDelta+=delta
        local interval=1/control.updateRate
        if control.renderBudget+1e-8<interval then control.renderSkipped+=1;return end
        local elapsed=control.renderDelta
        control.renderBudget=math.max(0,control.renderBudget-interval*math.floor((control.renderBudget+1e-8)/interval))
        control.renderDelta=0;control.renderUpdates+=1
        control.update(elapsed)
    end
    local connection,renderName,positionConnection,presentationName,presentationPriority
    if type(runService.BindToRenderStep)=='function' and host.Enum.RenderPriority then
        renderName='ShenaniganismSideDisplayData'
        -- Camera, shoulder-offset restoration, lock-on and character facing
        -- have all committed before sampling distance-label screen coordinates.
        runService:BindToRenderStep(renderName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+4,renderDisplays)
        presentationName='ShenaniganismSideDisplayPresentation'
        -- Present after the native character/camera update rather than waiting
        -- for all late data/layout work. The live phase trial was smoother,
        -- with the same exact character-local anchor and world dimensions.
        local characterPriority=host.Enum.RenderPriority.Character or host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last
        presentationPriority=characterPriority.Value+1
        runService:BindToRenderStep(presentationName,presentationPriority,control.presentWorldAnchors)
    else
        connection=runService.RenderStepped:Connect(renderDisplays)
        positionConnection=runService.RenderStepped:Connect(control.presentWorldAnchors)
    end
    control.renderName=renderName
    control.presentationName=presentationName
    control.presentationPriority=presentationPriority
    control.refresh()
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end;control.alive=false
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        if positionConnection then positionConnection:Disconnect() end
        if renderName then runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderName) end
        if presentationName then runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(presentationName) end
        disconnect(sourceConnections)
        table.clear(pendingSources)
        table.clear(candidates);table.clear(kept)
        for source in control.sourceCandidates do forgetSource(source) end
        for model in control.records do release(model) end
        if control.anchorFolder then control.anchorFolder:Destroy();control.anchorFolder=nil end
        table.clear(control.deadModels)
        gui:Destroy()
    end
    return control
end
return SideDisplays
end)()

local AutoPunish = (function(): any
-- One to three native M1 attacks after a confirmed block, while the enemy is unblocked.
-- BlockService sends the defender only. A unique recent, facing M1 can identify
-- its likely attacker; ambiguous encounters are deliberately ignored.
local AutoPunish: {[string]: any} = {}

function AutoPunish.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, bindings: any): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local heartbeat = host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local kindOf = host.typeof or typeof
    local methods=menu.targetMethods
    local sourceKeys = {"LastAttacker", "LastAttackerUserId", "Attacker", "AttackerUserId", "DamageSource", "HitBy", "LastHitBy", "creator", "SourceUserId"}
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, enabled = false, range = 6, focused = true,
        onlyWhileBlocking = false,
        targetMode = if methods then methods.normalize('All threats') else 'All threats',
        targetModes = if methods then methods.choices() else {'All threats','Locked target','Last hit target','Locked or last hit'},
        connections = {}, characterConnections = {}, generation = 0,
        pending = nil, metadata = {}, usedM1 = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        blockPauseUntil = 0, lastReason = "Auto Punish is disabled",
        ready = false, blockedHits = 0, punishInputs = 0, nativeRequests = 0, nativeCadenceInterval = 0.025,
        -- The game's own Block/M1 client code has no marker gate: both just fire a
        -- RemoteEvent and the server decides, in order. So the M1 is requested
        -- right after Block is released and retried briefly (negative = window).
        inferenceWindow = 0.35, releaseTimeout = -0.1,
        enemyReleaseWindow = 2, punchDelay = 0, sequenceTimeout = 2.5, acceptanceTimeout = 0.8,
        acceptedM1s = 0, requestedM1s = 1, cadenceSource = "Bounded native submissions after acceptance and recovery",
        nativeRecoveryTimeout = 0.8, projectileWindow = 0.25,
        projectiles = {}, recentThreats = {}, nativeSignals = {}, nativeSwings = {},
        swingServices = {}, swingCharacters = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}), nativeM1Signals = {}, nativeBlockReady = false, guardReason = nil,
    }
    local function resetTargetSwitch()
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and type(aim.resetAimTargetSwitch)=='function' then aim.resetAimTargetSwitch('Punish') end
    end

    local function aliveModel(model: any): boolean
        if not model or not model.Parent or model == player.Character then return false end
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil
    end

    local function modelFrom(value: any): any
        if kindOf(value) == "Instance" then
            if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
            if value:IsA("Model") then return value end
            return value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        elseif type(value) == "number" then
            local source = players:GetPlayerByUserId(value)
            return source and source.Character
        elseif type(value) == "string" then
            local source = players:FindFirstChild(value)
            if source and source:IsA("Player") then return source.Character end
            local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(value)
        end
        return nil
    end

    function control.getTargetMode(): any
        return control.targetMode
    end

    function control.allowsTarget(candidate: any): boolean
        local target=modelFrom(candidate)
        if not control.alive or not aliveModel(target) or (((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(target))) then return false end
        local pending=control.pending
        if pending and pending.external then return target==pending.target end
        if methods then
            local context=methods.context({eligible=aliveModel})
            local blocked=control.lastBlockedAttacker
            local window=menu.autoCounterFilter and menu.autoCounterFilter.hitWindow or 2
            if blocked and blocked.character==player.Character and clock()>=blocked.at and clock()-blocked.at<=window then
                local previous=context.histories['Last attacker']
                if not previous or blocked.at>=(previous.at or -math.huge) then context.histories['Last attacker']={model=blocked.target,at=blocked.at} end
            end
            if methods.has(control.targetMode,'Closest to cursor') or methods.has(control.targetMode,'Closest to character') then
                -- A punish owns the confirmed blocked-hit source. Never pick
                -- an unrelated actor to satisfy a spatial preference; the
                -- actual source must itself qualify on screen for cursor mode.
                return methods.choose(control.targetMode,methods.screenContext({target},context))==target
            end
            return methods.allowsScope(control.targetMode,target,context)
        end
        if control.targetMode=='All threats' then return true end
        local filter=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if filter and filter.alive==false then filter=nil end
        local locked=if filter and type(filter.lockedTarget)=='function' then filter.lockedTarget()
            else modelFrom(menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget)
        if control.targetMode=='Locked target' then return target==locked end
        -- Read the shared observer's accepted own-hit record. Incoming damage
        -- remains separate and participates only in the combined target mode.
        local record=filter and type(filter.getLastHitRecord)=='function' and filter.getLastHitRecord()
        local last=if record and record.character==player.Character then record.target else nil
        if control.targetMode=='Last hit target' then return target==last end
        if control.targetMode=='Locked or last hit' then
            local incoming=filter and type(filter.incomingAttacker)=='function' and filter.incomingAttacker()
            return target==locked or target==last or target==incoming
        end
        return false
    end

    local function parseKey(value: any): any
        if kindOf(value) ~= "EnumItem" or value.Name == "Unknown" or value.Name == "None" then return nil end
        local aliases = {MouseLeftButton = "MouseButton1", MouseRightButton = "MouseButton2", MouseMiddleButton = "MouseButton3"}
        local mouse = aliases[value.Name] or (value.Name:match("^MouseButton[123]$") and value.Name)
        if mouse then return {kind = "Mouse", name = mouse} end
        if value.EnumType == host.Enum.KeyCode then return {kind = "Keyboard", name = value.Name} end
        return nil
    end

    function control.meleeBinding(): any
        local folder = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Keybind")
        local combat = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Combat")
        local action = combat and combat:FindFirstChild("Melee")
        if not action then return nil end
        local list, saved = {}, action:FindFirstChild("Keyboard")
        if saved then table.insert(list, saved) end
        for _, object in action:GetDescendants() do
            if object ~= saved then table.insert(list, object) end
        end
        for _, object in list do
            if object:IsA("InputBinding") then
                local result = parseKey(object.KeyCode)
                if result then result.modifier = parseKey(object.PrimaryModifier); return result end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function mainHeld(binding: any): boolean
        if not binding then return false end
        -- The M1 this punish is holding itself is not a manual press.
        local own = control.ownHold
        if own and own.kind == binding.kind and own.name == binding.name then return false end
        return if binding.kind == "Mouse" then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name]) else input:IsKeyDown(host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name])
    end

    local function held(binding: any): boolean
        return binding~=nil and mainHeld(binding) and (not binding.modifier or held(binding.modifier))
    end

    local function cloneBinding(binding: any): any
        if not binding then return nil end
        return {kind=binding.kind,name=binding.name,modifier=cloneBinding(binding.modifier)}
    end

    local function sameBinding(a: any,b: any): boolean
        if not a or not b then return a==b end
        return a.kind==b.kind and a.name==b.name and sameBinding(a.modifier,b.modifier)
    end

    function control.isBlocking(character: any): boolean
        local info = character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        return (info ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild("Block") ~= nil) or (character and (character:GetAttribute("Block") == true or character:GetAttribute("Blocking") == true)) or false
    end

    local function nativeM1Track(character: any): boolean
        local automatic = menu.autoBlock
        local ids = automatic and automatic.animationIds or {}
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then return false end
        for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            local animation = track.Animation
            local id = animation and tostring(animation.AnimationId):match("%d+")
            local descriptor = id and ids[id]
            if track.IsPlaying ~= false and descriptor and descriptor.kind == "M1" then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function ownM1Busy(character: any, marker: any): boolean
        local record = control.pending
        if not record or record.character ~= character or record.phase ~= "Executing" or not (record.nativeActive or record.completed) then return false end
        -- Recorded game captures create InSkill BEFORE Swing2, and update
        -- LastM1 only at swing completion. A native accepted Swing2 plus the
        -- exact marker and catalogue-confirmed Melee track identifies our M1.
        if nativeM1Track(character) then record.m1AnimationObserved=true end
        -- Any InSkill marker that first appears while a swing of this sequence is
        -- outstanding (or just accepted) is that swing, however late the game's
        -- acceptance signal arrives; once adopted it stays ours for its whole life.
        if marker then
            local adopted=record.adoptedSkills
            if not adopted then adopted=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'});record.adoptedSkills=adopted end
            if adopted[marker] then return true end
            local now=clock()
            local window=math.max(control.acceptanceTimeout,.6)
            if (record.submitted or 0)>0 and (now-(record.lastRequestedAt or -math.huge)<=window
                or now-(record.lastAcceptedAt or -math.huge)<=window) then
                adopted[marker]=true;return true
            end
        end
        -- The swing's own InSkill is ours once the game accepted it. The old rule
        -- also demanded a catalogued Melee animation, which most of your M1s are
        -- not, so the guard treated your own swing as "another skill" and the
        -- sequence stopped after the first punch (a Punch Back Hits of 2+ never worked).
        -- ownedSkill is nil when the InSkill marker appeared after the acceptance
        -- signal; an InSkill inside the window after our accepted swing is still ours.
        if (record.ownedSkill == marker or record.ownedSkill == nil) and record.nativeAccepted == true
            and clock()-(record.lastNativeAcceptedAt or -math.huge)<=control.acceptanceTimeout then return true end
        -- Requested but the acceptance signal has not arrived yet: an InSkill that
        -- appears right after our own request is that swing.
        if record.awaitingAcceptance and clock()-(record.lastRequestedAt or -math.huge)<=control.acceptanceTimeout then return true end
        return false
    end

    local function externalEnabled(external: any): boolean
        local owner=type(external)=='table' and external.owner
        if owner==nil or owner~=menu.autoBlock or owner.alive==false or owner.enabled~=true
            or not owner.referenceSettings or (owner.referenceSettings.punchBack~=true and external.force~=true) then return false end
        if not external.ready then return true end
        local okay,ready=pcall(external.ready)
        return okay and ready==true
    end
    local function permitted(character: any, executing: boolean?, waiting: boolean?, external: any?): boolean
        control.guardReason=nil
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput()=='M1' then control.guardReason='Manual M1 input priority';return false end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then control.guardReason='Emote menu is open';return false end
        external=external or control.pending and control.pending.external
        if not control.alive or (if external then not externalEnabled(external) else not control.enabled)
            or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false end
        if control.pending and not control.allowsTarget(control.pending.target) then control.guardReason='Attacker no longer matches Auto Punish Targets';return false end
        if not character or character ~= player.Character or not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then return false end
        local humanoid, info = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info then return false end
        local state = humanoid:GetState()
        if state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then return false end
        if (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0) > 0 or character:GetAttribute("TrueStun") == true then return false end
        for _, name in {"TrueStun", "Knockback", "DomainClash", "Throwable"} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        local skill = info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        if skill and not (executing and ownM1Busy(character,skill)) then control.guardReason="Another native skill is active";return false end
        if not executing and (info:FindFirstChild("Attacking") or info:FindFirstChild("Melee")) then return false end
        if character:FindFirstChild("CustomM1") or character:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") then return false end
        local item = info:FindFirstChild("Item")
        if item and item:FindFirstChild("M1") then return false end
        -- A normal stun accompanying Block may be the game's block stun. It is
        -- left untouched, and native combat still decides whether M1 is allowed.
        return true
    end

    function control.distance(target: any, character: any): number
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local other = target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return if root and other then (root.Position - other.Position).Magnitude else math.huge
    end

    local function facesTarget(root: any, target: any, threshold: number): boolean
        local difference = target.Position - root.Position
        local flat = host.Vector3.new(difference.X, 0, difference.Z)
        local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
        look = host.Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        return flat.Magnitude > 0.05 and look.Magnitude > 0.05 and look.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit) >= threshold
    end

    function control.noteProjectile(owner: any, part: any, velocity: any)
        local character = modelFrom(owner)
        if not aliveModel(character) or not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        control.projectiles[part] = {owner = character, part = part, position = part.Position, velocity = velocity or part.AssemblyLinearVelocity, at = clock(), created = clock()}
    end

    local function nearImpact(record: any, root: any, now: number): boolean
        if not record or not record.position or now-(record.at or now) > control.projectileWindow then return false end
        local position = if record.part and record.part.Parent then record.part.Position else record.position
        if (position-root.Position).Magnitude <= 3.5 then return true end
        local velocity = record.velocity
        if not velocity or velocity.Magnitude < 1 then velocity = record.predictedVelocity end
        if not velocity or velocity.Magnitude < 1 then return false end
        local travel = velocity*math.clamp(now-(record.at or now),0,control.projectileWindow)
        if travel.Magnitude <= 0.001 then return false end
        local toward = root.Position-position
        local fraction = math.clamp(toward:Dot(travel)/(travel.Magnitude^2),0,1)
        return (toward-travel*fraction).Magnitude <= 3.5
    end

    function control.captureThreats()
        local now, automatic = clock(), menu.autoBlock
        if automatic and automatic.lastTarget and now-(automatic.lastThreatAt or -math.huge)<=control.projectileWindow then
            local target = modelFrom(automatic.lastTarget)
            if aliveModel(target) then control.recentThreats[target] = now end
        end
        for target, at in control.recentThreats do if now-at>control.projectileWindow or not aliveModel(target) then control.recentThreats[target] = nil end end
        for model,attack in control.nativeSwings do if now-attack.at>control.inferenceWindow or not model.Parent then control.nativeSwings[model]=nil end end
        for part, record in control.projectiles do
            if part.Parent then
                local position = part.Position
                if now>record.at then
                    local measured = (position-record.position)/(now-record.at)
                    if measured.Magnitude>0.5 then record.velocity = measured end
                end
                record.position, record.at = position, now
            elseif now-record.at>control.projectileWindow then control.projectiles[part] = nil end
            if now-record.created>8 then control.projectiles[part] = nil end
        end
    end

    function control.findAttacker(character: any, explicit: any): (any, string, any)
        local supplied = modelFrom(explicit)
        if aliveModel(supplied) then return supplied, "Native blocked-hit source", nil end
        control.captureThreats()
        local now, chosen, chosenSource,chosenToken = clock(), nil, nil,nil
        local function consider(target: any, source: string): boolean
            if not aliveModel(target) then return true end
            if chosen and chosen ~= target then return false end
            chosen, chosenSource = target, source
            return true
        end
        for _, record in control.metadata do
            if now - record.at <= 0.20 and aliveModel(record.target) then
                if chosen and chosen ~= record.target then return nil, "Ambiguous recent source metadata", nil end
                chosen = record.target
            end
        end
        if chosen then return chosen, "Fresh replicated attacker metadata", nil end
        local folder, root = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not folder or not root then return nil, "Attacker is unavailable", nil end
        local automatic = menu.autoBlock
        local function projectileCandidate(record: any): boolean
            return not nearImpact(record,root,now) or consider(modelFrom(record.owner),"Native projectile caster after confirmed block")
        end
        if automatic then
            for _, record in automatic.projectileIndex or {} do
                if not projectileCandidate(record) then return nil,"Ambiguous blocked projectile casters",nil end
            end
            local latch = automatic.latch
            if latch and latch.projectile and not projectileCandidate(latch.projectile) then return nil,"Ambiguous blocked projectile casters",nil end
        end
        for _, record in control.projectiles do
            if not projectileCandidate(record) then return nil,"Ambiguous blocked projectile casters",nil end
        end
        for target, at in control.recentThreats do
            if now-at<=control.projectileWindow and not consider(target,"Fresh Auto Block attack evidence after confirmed block") then return nil,"Ambiguous blocked attack evidence",nil end
        end
        for target, attack in control.nativeSwings do
            if now-attack.at<=control.inferenceWindow and aliveModel(target) and control.distance(target,character)<=control.range then
                local other=target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if facesTarget(other,root,0.15) then
                    if not consider(target,"Native Swing2 attacker after confirmed block") then return nil,"Ambiguous native M1 attackers",nil end
                    chosenToken=attack
                end
            end
        end
        local serverNow, stamp = host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), nil
        for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if not aliveModel(model) or control.distance(model, character) > control.range then continue end
            local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local last = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
            local age = last and serverNow-last
            if not age or age < -0.05 or age > control.inferenceWindow then continue end
            if not facesTarget(other, root, 0.45) or not facesTarget(root, other, 0.15) then continue end
            if not consider(model,"Inferred: unique recent facing M1 after confirmed block") then return nil,"Ambiguous nearby M1 attackers",nil end
            stamp = last
        end
        if chosen then return chosen, chosenSource, chosenToken or stamp end
        return nil, "No recent identifiable M1 attacker", nil
    end

    -- Console trace of the punish sequence after a blocked hit: every phase with
    -- its time since contact, your markers and the enemy's markers, so the real
    -- marker that lets an M1 through can be read. Set control.punishTrace=false to silence.
    control.punishTrace=true
    local function plog(record: any, message: string)
        if not control.punishTrace then return end
        pcall(function()
            local character=player.Character
            local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local names={}
            if info then for _,child in info:GetChildren() do table.insert(names,child.Name) end end
            local enemy=record and record.target
            local enemyInfo=enemy and enemy:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local enemyNames={}
            if enemyInfo then for _,child in enemyInfo:GetChildren() do table.insert(enemyNames,child.Name) end end
            trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] Punch +%dms: %s | you=[%s] | enemy=[%s]',
                record and record.started and math.floor((clock()-record.started)*1000) or 0,message,
                table.concat(names,','),table.concat(enemyNames,',')))
        end)
    end
    local function releaseMelee(record: any)
        -- Native M1 is an instantaneous game action. Stopping this bounded
        -- request loop needs no keyboard/mouse release or private upvalue write.
        if record then record.nativeActive=false end
        local own=control.ownHold
        if own and (not record or own.record==record) then
            control.ownHold=nil
            if type(bindings.send)=="function" then pcall(bindings.send,own.binding,false) end
        end
    end

    local function nativeM1Request(record: any): boolean
        if not control.allowsTarget(record.target) then return false end
        if (record.submitted or 0)>=record.required or record.awaitingAcceptance then return false end
        local tool=control.nativeTool
        if not tool or type(tool.UseSetService)~="function" then return false end
        local character=record.character
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local melee=control.meleeBinding()
        local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not humanoid or not info or not melee or mainHeld(melee) or (control.isBlocking(character) and not record.early) then return false end
        for _,name in {"Stun","TrueStun","Knockback","InSkill","Melee","Attacking","DomainClash","Throwable"} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end end
        local airborne=humanoid.FloorMaterial==host.Enum.Material.Air
        local jump=humanoid.Jump==true
        local variant
        if character:GetAttribute("Moveset")=="Hanami" then variant=if jump then "Up" elseif airborne then "Down" else false
        else variant=if airborne then "Down" elseif jump then "Up" else false end
        -- Selection already proved this exact blocked-hit source. A second
        -- native GetTarget query may return an unrelated actor in its FOV and
        -- silently bypass the saved cursor/history choice. Submit the retained
        -- proven source for normal punish and immediate Punch Back alike.
        local target=record.target
        -- Publish the bounded submission before calling the native action;
        -- its acceptance signal can arrive synchronously in some hosts.
        record.submitted=(record.submitted or 0)+1
        record.awaitingAcceptance=true
        record.lastRequestedAt=clock()
        control.nativeDispatch={action="AutoPunishM1",at=clock(),accepted=record.accepted}
        local sent,problem=pcall(tool.UseSetService,tool,"Activated",variant,target)
        control.nativeDispatch=nil
        if not sent then control.lastNativeError=tostring(problem);return false end
        control.nativeRequests+=1
        -- Punch Back already waits for native acceptance and the preceding
        -- swing's real busy markers; it needs no additional fixed interval.
        record.nextRequest=clock()+(if record.external then 0 else control.nativeCadenceInterval)
        return true
    end

    local function resumeManualBlock(record: any)
        if not record or not record.nativeUnblocked or not record.manualWasHeld then return end
        record.nativeUnblocked=false
        local function eligible(early: boolean?): boolean
            local character=record.character
            if not control.alive or not control.focused or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or player.Character~=character or not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute("Dead")==true
                or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false end
            local humanoid,info=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"),character:FindFirstChild("Info")
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0)>0 then return false end
