            if not sameBinding(record.block,bindings.get("Block")) or not (bindings.manualBlockHeld and bindings.manualBlockHeld(record.block)==true) then return false end
            for _,name in {"TrueStun","Knockback","DomainClash"} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end end
            if character:GetAttribute("TrueStun")==true then return false end
            if not early and (info:FindFirstChild('Stun') or info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') or character:GetAttribute('Stun')==true) then return false end
            return true
        end
        local generation=control.generation
        host.task.spawn(function()
            local started=clock()
            local requests,lastRequest,readyAttempt=0,-math.huge,false
            local function restore()
                requests+=1;lastRequest=clock()
                if control.nativeTool and type(control.nativeTool.Block)=='function' then pcall(control.nativeTool.Block,control.nativeTool) end
            end
            -- Forward the already-held physical guard immediately. The native
            -- game decides whether Block can interrupt our current M1; no Info
            -- marker or native restriction is removed to force acceptance.
            if eligible(true) then
                local alreadyReady=eligible()
                restore();readyAttempt=alreadyReady
            end
            while clock()-started<control.nativeRecoveryTimeout do
                if not control.alive or control.generation~=generation or control.pending~=nil or player.Character~=record.character or not control.focused or not sameBinding(record.block,bindings.get("Block")) or not (bindings.manualBlockHeld and bindings.manualBlockHeld(record.block)==true) then return end
                if control.isBlocking(record.character) then return end
                if eligible() then
                    -- First real recovery update has no padding. Further
                    -- unacknowledged Block requests are bounded, never M1 spam.
                    if requests>=16 then return end
                    if not readyAttempt or clock()-lastRequest>=.04 then
                        readyAttempt=true;restore()
                        if control.isBlocking(record.character) then return end
                    end
                end
                heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function clearRecord(record: any, reason: string?)
        releaseMelee(record)
        if record then for _, connection in record.connections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end;table.clear(record.connections or {}) end
        if control.pending == record then control.pending = nil;control.blockPauseUntil = 0 end
        if reason then control.lastReason = reason end
        if record then plog(record,'ended: '..tostring(reason)..' (accepted '..tostring(record.accepted)..'/'..tostring(record.required)..')') end
        if record and record.diagnostic then
            record.diagnostic.phase=if record.completed then 'Completed' else 'Cancelled'
            record.diagnostic.reason=reason
            record.diagnostic.accepted,record.diagnostic.submitted=record.accepted,record.submitted
        end
        resumeManualBlock(record)
        if record and record.external and record.external.onDone and not record.externalNotified then
            record.externalNotified=true
            pcall(record.external.onDone,record.accepted,record.submitted,record.completed==true,reason)
        end
    end

    local function cancel()
        control.generation += 1
        clearRecord(control.pending)
        control.blockPauseUntil = 0
    end

    function control.invalidateExcludedTargets()
        if not control.pending or not ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(control.pending.target)) then return false end
        cancel()
        control.lastReason='Target is protected by friend exclusions'
        return true
    end

    function control.cancelForManualBlock()
        local record=control.pending
        if record then record.nativeUnblocked=false end
        cancel()
        control.lastReason='A fresh physical Block press cancelled Auto Punish immediately'
    end

    function control.pauseAutomaticBlock(): boolean
        local external=control.pending and control.pending.external
        return control.alive and (control.enabled or external and externalEnabled(external))
            and ((control.pending ~= nil and control.pending.phase == "Executing") or clock() < control.blockPauseUntil)
    end

    function control.onBlockedHit(defender: any, _perfectBlock: any, explicitAttacker: any, external: any?): boolean
        if defender ~= player.Character then return false end
        local blockedHook=SharedHooks.blockedHook or SharedHooks.blockedHit
        -- Only the game's own block confirmation animates, once per contact. A second contact (a real second hit) is >0.15 s later.
        if blockedHook and external==nil and (not control.hookedAt or clock()-control.hookedAt>=.15) then
            control.hookedAt=clock()
            pcall(blockedHook,_perfectBlock==true)
        end
        local diagnostic={at=clock(),character=defender,phase='Contact',external=external~=nil,enabled=control.enabled,perfect=_perfectBlock==true}
        control.lastTrigger=diagnostic
        local function skip(reason)
            diagnostic.phase,diagnostic.reason='Skipped',reason;control.lastReason=reason
            plog({started=diagnostic.at,target=(diagnostic :: any).target},'skipped: '..tostring(reason))
            return false
        end
        local circling=menu.frontDash
        if circling and circling.circlingActive and circling.circlingActive() then return skip('Dash circling has priority') end
        local dodging=menu.targetJumpDash
        if dodging and dodging.dodgeActive and dodging.dodgeActive() then return skip('A dodge in progress has priority') end
        if not control.alive or (if external then not externalEnabled(external) else not control.enabled) then return skip('Retaliation is disabled or its owner is paused') end
        local range=if external then external.range else control.range
        -- When handing the return to the Punch Back engine, use its reach: the
        -- 6-stud Auto Punish range threw away blocks from 7-8 studs.
        if not external then
            local reachOwner=menu.autoBlock
            if reachOwner and reachOwner.alive~=false and reachOwner.enabled==true and type(reachOwner.downReach)=="function" then
                range=math.max(range,math.min(reachOwner.downReach(),tonumber(reachOwner.range) or range))
            end
        end
        control.blockedHits += 1
        local savedBlock=bindings.get("Block")
        local manualAtContact=bindings.manualBlockHeld and bindings.manualBlockHeld(savedBlock)==true
        local automaticAtContact=menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.held~=nil
        local sharedContact=menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.lastBlockedContact
        local sharedContactAge=sharedContact and clock()-sharedContact.at
        local confirmedOwnedContact=sharedContact and sharedContact.character==defender and sharedContact.wasOwned==true and sharedContactAge>=0 and sharedContactAge<=0.05
        local blockedAtContact=control.isBlocking(defender) or manualAtContact or automaticAtContact or confirmedOwnedContact==true
        local lockOwner=menu.autoBlock
        if lockOwner and lockOwner.referenceSettings and lockOwner.referenceSettings.manualBlockLock==true and manualAtContact then
            return skip('Manual Block held: only your manual M1 overrides it')
        end
        if not external and control.onlyWhileBlocking and not blockedAtContact then return skip('Only while blocking: your native Block is no longer active') end
        if control.pending then return skip('A bounded retaliation is already pending') end
        if not permitted(defender,false,true,external) then return skip(control.guardReason or 'The local character cannot punish this block') end
        local target, reason, stamp = control.findAttacker(defender, explicitAttacker)
        control.lastSource = reason
        if not target then return skip(reason) end
        diagnostic.target,diagnostic.source=target,reason
        control.lastBlockedAttacker={character=defender,target=target,at=clock(),source='Confirmed native BlockService contact: '..tostring(reason)}
        if not external and not control.allowsTarget(target) then return skip('Blocked attacker does not match Auto Punish Targets') end
        if control.distance(target, defender) > range then return skip('Attacker is outside Auto Punish Range') end
        if stamp and control.usedM1[target] == stamp then return skip('This M1 has already been handled') end
        -- Absorb this many blocked hits from the same attacker before unblocking
        -- and punching back. Retries of the same contact are not counted twice.
        local need = control.hitsBeforePunish or 1
        if need > 1 and not (external and external.force) then
            local now = clock()
            local streak = control.blockStreak
            if not streak or streak.target ~= target or now - streak.at > 1.5 then
                streak = {target = target, count = 0, at = now, stamps = {}}
                control.blockStreak = streak
            end
            local fresh = if stamp then not streak.stamps[stamp] else (streak.count == 0 or now - streak.at >= 0.4)
            if fresh then
                if stamp then streak.stamps[stamp] = true end
                streak.count += 1;streak.at = now
            end
            if streak.count < need then
                return skip('Holding Block: '..streak.count..' of '..need..' blocked hits before punishing')
            end
            control.blockStreak = nil
        end
        -- Auto Punish runs on the Punch Back engine whenever Auto Block is on: it
        -- already waits for the game's own markers and was the reliable path.
        -- Without Auto Block (a purely manual guard) the original sequence runs.
        if not external then
            local blockOwner = menu.autoBlock
            if blockOwner and blockOwner.alive ~= false and blockOwner.enabled == true and type(blockOwner.queuePunchBack) == "function" then
                if stamp then control.usedM1[target] = stamp end
                local okay, queued = pcall(blockOwner.queuePunchBack, target, true, true, control.requestedM1s)
                diagnostic.phase = 'Delegated'
                plog({started = clock(), target = target}, 'handed to the Punch Back engine (queued='..tostring(okay and queued)..', hits='..tostring(control.requestedM1s)..')')
                if okay and queued then return true end
                return skip('Punch Back engine did not accept this blocked hit')
            end
        end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and type(aim.applyAimTargetSwitch)=='function' then
            local selected=aim.applyAimTargetSwitch('Punish',target,function(candidate)
                return aliveModel(candidate) and candidate:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true
                    and control.distance(candidate,defender)<=range
                    and not ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(candidate))
                    and (external~=nil or control.allowsTarget(candidate))
            end,defender,defender:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'))
            -- This event belongs only to its confirmed attacker. A retained
            -- target cannot borrow another enemy's block contact for retaliation.
            if selected~=target then return skip('Waiting for the selected Auto Punish enemy before switching targets') end
        end
        local block = bindings.get("Block")
        local melee = control.meleeBinding()
        if not block or not melee or not control.nativeTool or type(control.nativeTool.UseSetService)~="function" then return skip('The native combat action or saved bindings are unavailable') end
        if mainHeld(melee) then return skip('The player is already holding M1') end
        if block.kind == melee.kind and block.name == melee.name then return skip('Block and M1 share the same saved input') end
        if stamp then control.usedM1[target] = stamp end
        local enemyBlocking = control.isBlocking(target)
        control.generation+=1
        -- The most hits a return can have is the active weapon/character's own
        -- M1 chain (3-hit and 4-hit chains differ), so clamp the chosen count to it.
        local wantedHits = if external then external.count else control.requestedM1s
        -- With Auto Block's Punch Back on, both triggers answer the same blocked
        -- hit; the Punch Back hit count is the one you set, so it wins.
        if not external then
            local blockOwner = menu.autoBlock
            if blockOwner and blockOwner.alive ~= false and blockOwner.enabled == true and blockOwner.referenceSettings
                and blockOwner.referenceSettings.punchBack == true and type(blockOwner.punchBackHits) == "number" then
                wantedHits = blockOwner.punchBackHits
            end
        end
        local chainMax = control.chainLimit(defender)
        if chainMax and wantedHits > chainMax then wantedHits = chainMax end
        local record: any = {character = defender, target = target, block = cloneBinding(block), melee = cloneBinding(melee), generation = control.generation, started = clock(), nativeActive = false, phase = "Waiting", observedEnemyBlock = enemyBlocking, enemyReleased = not enemyBlocking, manualWasHeld = manualAtContact, blockedAtContact = blockedAtContact, connections = {}, accepted = 0, submitted = 0, awaitingAcceptance = false, required = wantedHits,range=range,external=external}
        control.pending = record
        record.diagnostic=diagnostic
        diagnostic.phase='Waiting'
        control.lastReason = if enemyBlocking then "Waiting for the enemy's native Block to end" else "Confirmed blocked attack; enemy is unblocked"
        plog(record,'blocked hit confirmed (enemyBlocking='..tostring(enemyBlocking)..', external='..tostring(external~=nil)..')')
        local function observeEnemyBlock()
            local blocked = control.isBlocking(target)
            record.enemyReleased = not blocked
            if blocked then record.observedEnemyBlock = true end
            if blocked and record.phase == "Executing" then clearRecord(record,"Enemy reblocked; remaining punish M1s were stopped") end
        end
        local attachedInfo = {}
        local function watchInfo(info: any)
            if not info or attachedInfo[info] then return end
            attachedInfo[info] = true
            table.insert(record.connections, info.ChildAdded:Connect(observeEnemyBlock))
            table.insert(record.connections, info.ChildRemoved:Connect(observeEnemyBlock))
        end
        watchInfo(target:FindFirstChild("Info"))
        table.insert(record.connections, target.ChildAdded:Connect(function(object) if object.Name == "Info" then watchInfo(object);observeEnemyBlock() end end))
        for _, key in {"Block", "Blocking"} do table.insert(record.connections, target:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(observeEnemyBlock)) end
        host.task.spawn(function()
            while clock()-record.started < control.enemyReleaseWindow do
                if control.pending ~= record or control.generation ~= record.generation then return end
                if not permitted(defender,false,true) or not aliveModel(target) or control.distance(target, defender) > range then clearRecord(record,"Enemy-unblock wait was cancelled by movement, stun, focus, or death");return end
                observeEnemyBlock()
                if record.enemyReleased then break end
                heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            if control.pending ~= record or control.generation ~= record.generation then return end
            if not record.enemyReleased then
                clearRecord(record,"Enemy never unblocked; no punish was sent")
                return
            end
            local attackWait=clock()
            local function attackEnded()
                local blockOwner=menu.autoBlock
                if external then return externalEnabled(external) end
                if blockOwner and type(blockOwner.retaliationReady)=='function' then return blockOwner.retaliationReady(target,true) end
                local enemyInfo=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
                return enemyInfo~=nil and not enemyInfo:FindFirstChild('InSkill') and not enemyInfo:FindFirstChild('Melee') and not enemyInfo:FindFirstChild('Attacking')
            end
            while not attackEnded() and clock()-attackWait<control.enemyReleaseWindow do
                if control.pending~=record or control.generation~=record.generation then return end
                if not permitted(defender,false,true) or not aliveModel(target) then clearRecord(record,'Native attack-end wait was cancelled');return end
                control.lastReason='Confirmed block; waiting for all observed incoming contact phases to end'
                heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            if not attackEnded() then clearRecord(record,'Incoming attack did not expose a safe retaliation phase');return end
            if not permitted(defender) or control.isBlocking(target) or not aliveModel(target) or control.distance(target,defender)>range or mainHeld(melee) then
                plog(record,string.format('conditions changed: permitted=%s (%s) enemyBlocking=%s alive=%s dist=%.1f/%.1f m1Held=%s',
                    tostring(permitted(defender)),tostring(control.guardReason),tostring(control.isBlocking(target)),tostring(aliveModel(target)),
                    control.distance(target,defender),range,tostring(mainHeld(melee))))
                clearRecord(record,"Enemy unblocked, but punish conditions changed");return
            end
            record.phase = "Executing"
            diagnostic.phase='Executing'
            plog(record,'enemy attack ended; releasing Block to punish')
            -- Optional pause between the blocked hit and the return (Auto Block keeps
            -- guarding meanwhile); aborts like any other wait if the situation changes.
            if control.punchDelay>0 then
                local delayStarted=clock()
                while clock()-delayStarted<control.punchDelay do
                    if control.pending ~= record or control.generation ~= record.generation then return end
                    if not permitted(defender) or control.isBlocking(target) or not aliveModel(target) or control.distance(target,defender)>range+1.5 then
                        clearRecord(record,"Punish cancelled during the punch delay");return
                    end
                    heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                plog(record,'punch delay of '..math.floor(control.punchDelay*1000)..'ms elapsed')
            end
            -- Zero or negative Block Release Wait: request the M1 without waiting
            -- for the Block marker to clear, retrying until the game accepts it.
            -- A Block that is already up (held or automatic) goes straight to M1
            -- requests instead of waiting for its marker to clear.
            record.early = control.releaseTimeout <= 0 or control.isBlocking(defender)
            record.earlyWindow = if control.releaseTimeout <= 0 then math.max(-control.releaseTimeout,.05) else .3
            control.blockPauseUntil = clock()+control.sequenceTimeout
            -- The user's explicit Auto Punish action temporarily leaves native
            -- Block, including while their saved key is physically held. This
            -- uses the exact game's Released action, never a synthetic mouse Up.
            if not control.nativeBlockReady then clearRecord(record,"Native Block release action is unavailable");return end
            record.nativeUnblocked=true
            local automatic=menu.autoBlock
            local released,detail
            -- Only a live owned Auto Block lease needs its state handed off.
            -- A manual guard also works when that component is disabled,
            -- absent, or unloaded; release it through the same native action.
            if automatic and automatic.alive~=false and automatic.held~=nil and type(automatic.releaseForPunish)=="function" then
                local called,result,message=pcall(automatic.releaseForPunish)
                released=called and result==true
                detail=if called then message else result
            else
                released,detail=pcall(control.nativeBlock.Deactivated.Fire,control.nativeBlock.Deactivated)
            end
            if not released then clearRecord(record,"Native Block could not be released: "..tostring(detail));return end
            local releaseStarted = clock()
            while control.isBlocking(defender) and not record.early and clock()-releaseStarted < control.releaseTimeout do
                if control.pending ~= record or control.generation ~= record.generation then return end
                if not permitted(defender) or control.isBlocking(target) then
                    control.releaseAbort={focused=control.focused,textbox=input:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil,enemyBlocking=control.isBlocking(target),manualHeld=bindings.manualBlockHeld and bindings.manualBlockHeld()==true,infoSkill=defender:FindFirstChild("Info") and defender.Info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")~=nil,guard=control.guardReason}
                    clearRecord(record,"Punish cancelled while releasing native Block");return
                end
                heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            plog(record,'own Block marker cleared (isBlocking='..tostring(control.isBlocking(defender))..')')
            local info=defender:FindFirstChild("Info")
            local recoveryStarted = clock()
            while (defender:GetAttribute("Stun")==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild("Stun"))) and clock()-recoveryStarted<control.nativeRecoveryTimeout do
                if control.pending ~= record or control.generation ~= record.generation then return end
                if not permitted(defender) or control.isBlocking(target) or not aliveModel(target) or control.distance(target,defender)>range then clearRecord(record,"Native recovery wait was cancelled");return end
                control.lastReason = "Owned Block released; waiting for native block stun to clear"
                heartbeat:Wait()
                info = defender:FindFirstChild("Info")
            end
            if not permitted(defender) or (control.isBlocking(defender) and not record.early) or control.isBlocking(target) or mainHeld(melee) or defender:GetAttribute("Stun")==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild("Stun")) then
                clearRecord(record,"Native unblock or stun still prevents a punish")
                return
            end
            plog(record,'no Block or Stun left; requesting M1')
            record.lastStamp = tonumber(defender:GetAttribute("LastM1")) or 0
            record.sequenceStarted, record.lastAcceptedAt = clock(), clock()
            table.insert(record.connections,defender:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastM1"):Connect(function()
                if control.pending ~= record or record.phase ~= "Executing" or not record.nativeActive or control.nativeM1Signals[defender:GetAttribute("Moveset")] then return end
                if record.holdM1 and not record.awaitingAcceptance and record.accepted>=record.submitted and record.accepted<record.required then
                    record.submitted=record.accepted+1;record.awaitingAcceptance=true;record.lastRequestedAt=clock()
                end
                if not record.awaitingAcceptance or record.accepted>=record.submitted or mainHeld(control.meleeBinding()) then return end
                local stamp = tonumber(defender:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
                if not stamp or stamp <= record.lastStamp then return end
                local delta = stamp-record.lastStamp
                if record.accepted > 0 and delta >= 0.05 and delta <= 1.5 then control.nativeCadence = delta end
                record.lastStamp, record.lastAcceptedAt = stamp, clock()
                record.accepted += 1
                record.awaitingAcceptance=false
                control.acceptedM1s += 1
                control.lastReason = "Native punish M1 "..record.accepted.."/"..record.required.." accepted"
                plog(record,'M1 '..record.accepted..'/'..record.required..' accepted by the game')
                if record.accepted >= record.required then
                    record.completed = true
                    releaseMelee(record)
                end
            end))
            record.nativeActive=true
            if not nativeM1Request(record) then clearRecord(record,"Native M1 action could not be requested");return end
            -- Multi-hit returns also hold the real M1 input until the last hit is
            -- accepted, like holding the button yourself; it is released on completion.
            if record.required>=2 and type(bindings.send)=="function" then
                local holdBinding=control.meleeBinding()
                if holdBinding and not mainHeld(holdBinding) then
                    local pressed=pcall(bindings.send,holdBinding,true)
                    if pressed then
                        record.holdM1=true
                        control.ownHold={kind=holdBinding.kind,name=holdBinding.name,binding=holdBinding,record=record}
                        plog(record,'holding M1 until '..record.required..' hits are accepted')
                    end
                end
            end
            control.punishInputs += 1
            control.lastTarget, control.lastPunishAt = target, clock()
            control.lastReason = "Native first M1 submitted after confirmed block; waiting for its acceptance"
            local sequenceTimeout=if external then math.max(control.sequenceTimeout,record.required*1.6) else control.sequenceTimeout
            while not record.completed and clock()-record.sequenceStarted < sequenceTimeout do
                if control.pending ~= record or control.generation ~= record.generation then return end
                local currentInfo=defender:FindFirstChild("Info")
                if not permitted(defender,true) or control.isBlocking(target) or not aliveModel(target) or control.distance(target,defender)>range+1.5+(if record.accepted>0 then 3 else 0) or defender:GetAttribute("Stun")==true or (currentInfo and currentInfo:FindFirstChild("Stun")) or mainHeld(control.meleeBinding()) then
                    plog(record,string.format('guard tripped: permitted=%s (%s) enemyBlocking=%s alive=%s dist=%.1f/%.1f stunAttr=%s stunMarker=%s m1Held=%s',
                        tostring(permitted(defender,true)),tostring(control.guardReason),tostring(control.isBlocking(target)),tostring(aliveModel(target)),
                        control.distance(target,defender),range,tostring(defender:GetAttribute("Stun")==true),tostring(currentInfo~=nil and currentInfo:FindFirstChild("Stun")~=nil),
                        tostring(mainHeld(control.meleeBinding()))))
                    clearRecord(record,"Remaining punish M1s stopped: enemy reblocked, range changed, or native/manual controls took priority")
                    return
                end
                -- Early mode: the game ignores an M1 while the Block marker is
                -- still up, so allow a fresh request every 60 ms inside the
                -- window until the first punch is accepted (or your swing starts).
                if record.early and record.accepted==0 and record.awaitingAcceptance and currentInfo
                    and clock()-record.sequenceStarted<(record.earlyWindow or .05)
                    and clock()-(record.lastRequestedAt or 0)>=.06
                    and not currentInfo:FindFirstChild("InSkill") and not currentInfo:FindFirstChild("Melee") and not currentInfo:FindFirstChild("Attacking") then
                    record.submitted=math.max(0,record.submitted-1);record.awaitingAcceptance=false;record.nextRequest=0
                    plog(record,'early M1 not accepted yet; retrying')
                end
                local acceptanceSince=if record.awaitingAcceptance then record.lastRequestedAt else record.lastAcceptedAt
                if clock()-acceptanceSince>control.acceptanceTimeout then clearRecord(record,"Native M1 acceptance stopped; remaining follow-ups were cancelled");return end
                -- The game may reject a request during cooldown. Never poll it
                -- repeatedly: one submission waits for its native acceptance,
                -- and the second waits for the first swing's busy markers.
                local ready=currentInfo~=nil
                if currentInfo then for _,name in {"InSkill","Melee","Attacking"} do if currentInfo:FindFirstChild(name) then ready=false;break end end end
                if record.accepted>0 and record.submitted<record.required and clock()-(record.noteAt or 0)>=.1 then
                    record.noteAt=clock()
                    plog(record,string.format('next M1 %d/%d: ready=%s awaiting=%s accepted=%d submitted=%d nextIn=%.3f',
                        record.submitted+1,record.required,tostring(ready),tostring(record.awaitingAcceptance),record.accepted,record.submitted,(record.nextRequest or 0)-clock()))
                end
                if ready and not record.awaitingAcceptance and record.submitted<record.required and record.accepted==record.submitted and clock()>=(record.nextRequest or 0) then
                    if not nativeM1Request(record) then clearRecord(record,"Manual M1 or unavailable native combat took priority");return end
                end
                heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            if control.pending ~= record then return end
            if record.completed then
                -- Releasing M1 ends our input loop; the second accepted swing
                -- still owns native InSkill. Keep the arbitration lease until
                -- that exact busy marker ends before restoring manual Block.
                local recover=clock()
                while clock()-recover<control.nativeRecoveryTimeout do
                    local finalInfo=defender:FindFirstChild("Info")
                    if not finalInfo or finalInfo:FindFirstChild("InSkill")~=record.ownedSkill or not record.ownedSkill then break end
                    if control.pending~=record or control.generation~=record.generation then return end
                    if not permitted(defender,true) or defender:GetAttribute("Stun")==true or finalInfo:FindFirstChild("Stun") then clearRecord(record,"Native final-swing recovery was interrupted");return end
                    heartbeat:Wait()
                end
            end
            clearRecord(record,if record.completed then record.required.." native M1 attacks completed after enemy unblock" else "Native M1 sequence timed out; remaining follow-ups were cancelled")
        end)
        return true
    end
    function control.requestRetaliation(target: any,options: any): boolean
        local count=type(options)=='table' and tonumber(options.count)
        local range=type(options)=='table' and tonumber(options.range)
        if not count or count%1~=0 or count<1 or count>10 or not range or range~=range or range<=0 or range==math.huge
            or options.owner~=menu.autoBlock or type(options.ready)~='function' or not externalEnabled(options) then return false end
        return control.onBlockedHit(player.Character,false,target,options)
    end
    function control.cancelRetaliation(owner: any)
        if control.pending and control.pending.external and control.pending.external.owner==owner then cancel() end
    end

    local function disconnectCharacter()
        for _, connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        table.clear(control.metadata)
        table.clear(control.projectiles)
        table.clear(control.recentThreats)
        table.clear(control.nativeSwings)
    end

    function control.track(character: any)
        resetTargetSwitch()
        cancel()
        control.lastBlockedAttacker=nil
        disconnectCharacter()
        local attached = {}
        local function attach(object: any, fresh: boolean)
            if attached[object] then return end
            attached[object] = true
            local function remember(key: string, value: any)
                local target = modelFrom(value)
                control.metadata[tostring(object).."/"..key] = if aliveModel(target) then {target = target, at = clock()} else nil
            end
            for _, key in sourceKeys do
                table.insert(control.characterConnections, object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(function() remember(key, object:GetAttribute(key)) end))
                if fresh then remember(key, object:GetAttribute(key)) end
            end
            if object:IsA("ObjectValue") and table.find(sourceKeys, object.Name) then
                table.insert(control.characterConnections, object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function() remember(object.Name, object.Value) end))
                if fresh then remember(object.Name, object.Value) end
            end
        end
        local function attachContainer(container: any)
            attach(container, false)
            table.insert(control.characterConnections, container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(object) attach(object, true) end))
            for _, object in container:GetChildren() do attach(object, false) end
        end
        attachContainer(character)
        if control.watchSwings then control.watchSwings(character) end
        table.insert(control.characterConnections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Moveset"):Connect(function() if control.watchSwings then control.watchSwings(character) end end))
        local humanoid, info = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if humanoid then
            attachContainer(humanoid)
            table.insert(control.characterConnections, humanoid.Died:Connect(cancel))
        end
        if info then attachContainer(info) end
        table.insert(control.characterConnections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(object)
            if object.Name == "Info" then attachContainer(object) end
        end))
    end

    function control.setTargetMode(value: any): boolean
        if methods then
            local normalized,valid=methods.normalize(value)
            if not valid then return false end
            control.targetMode=normalized
        else
            if type(value)~='string' or not table.find(control.targetModes,value) then return false end
            control.targetMode=value
        end
        local pending=control.pending
        if pending and not control.allowsTarget(pending.target) then
            clearRecord(pending,'Auto Punish Targets changed; unmatched follow-ups were cancelled')
        end
        return true
    end

    function control.setOnlyWhileBlocking(value: any)
        -- This checks the confirmed contact snapshot, never the deliberately
        -- unblocked native M1 sequence that follows it.
        control.onlyWhileBlocking=value==true
    end

    -- Length of the active weapon/character's native M1 chain (its finisher
    -- index), when the game's animations make it unambiguous.
    function control.chainLimit(character: any): number?
        local assist=menu.m1Assist
        if not assist or type(assist.discoverFinisher)~='function' or not character then return nil end
        local ok,count=pcall(assist.discoverFinisher,character)
        if ok and type(count)=='number' and count>=1 and count%1==0 then return count end
        return nil
    end
    -- Wait limits in the punish sequence, in seconds. Each wait ends the moment
    -- its marker clears, so these only cap how long the script will wait.
    local function setSeconds(field: string, value: any, low: number, high: number): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control[field]=math.clamp(amount,low,high);return true
    end
    -- Zero or negative means "do not wait for the Block marker": the M1 is
    -- requested right after Block is released and retried for that many seconds
    -- (negative value) until the game accepts it.
    function control.setReleaseTimeout(value: any): boolean return setSeconds('releaseTimeout',value,-0.3,1) end
    function control.setPunchDelay(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.punchDelay=math.clamp(amount,0,2000)/1000;return true
    end
    control.hitsBeforePunish=1
    function control.setHitsBeforePunish(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount%1~=0 or amount<1 or amount>5 then return false end
        control.hitsBeforePunish=amount;control.blockStreak=nil;return true
    end
    function control.setNativeRecoveryTimeout(value: any): boolean return setSeconds('nativeRecoveryTimeout',value,0,2) end
    function control.setAcceptanceTimeout(value: any): boolean return setSeconds('acceptanceTimeout',value,.1,2) end
    function control.setHitCount(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount%1~=0 or amount<1 or amount>5 then return false end
        -- Each sequence snapshots its count; changing this option affects the next punish.
        control.requestedM1s=amount;return true
    end

    function control.setRange(value: any)
        local number = tonumber(value) or 6
        if number ~= number or number == math.huge or number == -math.huge then number = 6 end
        control.range = math.clamp(number, 0, 30/0.28)
        local pending=control.pending
        if pending and not pending.external and control.distance(pending.target,pending.character)>control.range then clearRecord(pending,"Auto Punish Range changed; pending follow-ups were cancelled") end
    end

    function control.setEnabled(value: any)
        control.enabled = control.alive and value == true
        if not control.enabled then resetTargetSwitch() end
        if not control.enabled and not (control.pending and control.pending.external) then cancel(); control.lastReason = "Auto Punish is disabled" end
        if control.enabled and not control.ready then control.lastReason = "Native blocked-hit signal is unavailable" end
    end

    table.insert(control.connections, input.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() resetTargetSwitch();control.focused = false; cancel() end))
    table.insert(control.connections, input.WindowFocused:Connect(function() control.focused = true end))
    table.insert(control.connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(control.track))
    if player.CharacterRemoving then table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()resetTargetSwitch();cancel()end)) end
    table.insert(control.connections,heartbeat:Connect(control.captureThreats))
    if player.Character then control.track(player.Character) end
    local ok, nativeSignal = pcall(function()
        local folder = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local module = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        if not module then return nil end
        local knit = host.require(module)
        control.nativeKnit=knit
        local service=knit.GetService("BlockService")
        control.nativeBlock=service
        control.nativeBlockReady=service and service.Deactivated and type(service.Deactivated.Fire)=="function" or false
        if type(knit.GetController)=="function" then control.nativeTool=knit.GetController("ToolController") end
        return service.Effects
    end)
    if ok and nativeSignal and type(nativeSignal.Connect) == "function" then
        table.insert(control.connections, nativeSignal:Connect(control.onBlockedHit))
        control.ready = true
        control.signalSource = "BlockService.Effects"
    else
        control.lastReason = "Native blocked-hit signal is unavailable"
    end

    function control.watchSwings(character: any)
        if not character or not character:IsA("Model") then return end
        if not control.swingCharacters[character] then
            control.swingCharacters[character]=true
            table.insert(control.connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Moveset"):Connect(function() control.watchSwings(character) end))
        end
        local moveset=character and character:GetAttribute("Moveset")
        if type(moveset)~="string" or control.swingServices[moveset] or not control.nativeTool or type(control.nativeTool.GetToolService)~="function" then return end
        -- Exactly the service name assembled by ToolController.UseSetService.
        local available,service=pcall(control.nativeTool.GetToolService,control.nativeTool,moveset.."Service")
        if not available or not service or not service.Effects or type(service.Effects.Connect)~="function" then return end
        control.swingServices[moveset]=true;control.nativeM1Signals[moveset]=true
        table.insert(control.connections,service.Effects:Connect(function(effect: any,caster: any,stage: any)
            if not control.alive or effect~="Swing2" or type(stage)~="number" or stage<1 or stage>4 then return end
            local model=modelFrom(caster)
            if not model or model:GetAttribute("Moveset")~=moveset then return end
            control.nativeSwings[model]={at=clock(),stage=stage}
            local record=control.pending
            if not record or model~=record.character or record.phase~="Executing" or not record.nativeActive then return end
            -- A held M1 can start the next swing before we asked for it.
            if record.holdM1 and not record.awaitingAcceptance and record.accepted>=record.submitted and record.accepted<record.required then
                record.submitted=record.accepted+1;record.awaitingAcceptance=true;record.lastRequestedAt=clock()
            end
            if not record.awaitingAcceptance or record.accepted>=record.submitted or mainHeld(control.meleeBinding()) then return end
            local info=model:FindFirstChild("Info")
            local nativeSkill=info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
            if record.lastAcceptedStage==stage and (not nativeSkill or nativeSkill==record.lastAcceptedSkill) then return end
            record.ownedSkill=nativeSkill
            record.lastAcceptedStage,record.lastAcceptedSkill=stage,nativeSkill
            record.nativeAccepted=true;record.lastNativeAcceptedAt=clock();record.m1AnimationObserved=false
            local delta=clock()-record.lastAcceptedAt
            if record.accepted>0 and delta>=0.05 and delta<=1.5 then control.nativeCadence=delta end
            record.accepted+=1;record.lastAcceptedAt=clock();control.acceptedM1s+=1
            record.awaitingAcceptance=false
            control.lastReason="Native punish M1 "..record.accepted.."/"..record.required.." accepted"
            if record.accepted>=record.required then record.completed=true;releaseMelee(record) end
        end))
    end
    local characters=host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    if characters then
        for _,character in characters:GetChildren() do control.watchSwings(character) end
        table.insert(control.connections,characters.ChildAdded:Connect(control.watchSwings))
    end
    control.watchSwings(player.Character)

    local function nativeProjectiles(serviceName: string, callback: any)
        local connected, signal = pcall(function()
            local folder = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Knit")
            local module = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
            return module and host.require(module).GetService(serviceName).Effects
        end)
        if connected and signal and type(signal.Connect)=="function" then
            table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback))
            control.nativeSignals[serviceName] = true
        end
    end
    nativeProjectiles("ReserveBallService",function(action: any, owner: any, frame: any, part: any)
        if action == "Fire" and frame then control.noteProjectile(owner,part,frame.LookVector*150) end
    end)
    nativeProjectiles("ReversalRedService",function(action: any, owner: any, part: any)
        if action == "Red" then control.noteProjectile(owner,part) end
    end)
    for _, serviceName in {"FlameArrowService","FurnaceArrowService"} do
        nativeProjectiles(serviceName,function(action: any, owner: any, part: any)
            if action == "Arrow" and part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                control.noteProjectile(owner,part,part.CFrame.LookVector*192)
            end
        end)
    end

    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.setEnabled(false)
        cancel()
        control.alive = false
        disconnectCharacter()
        for _, connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end
    return control
end

return AutoPunish
end)()

local M1Hitbox = (function(): any
-- M1 bounds preview. Ordinary M1 currently has no verified client hit query:
-- this component never resizes character parts or changes native/server reach.
local M1Hitbox: {[string]: any} = {}

function M1Hitbox.new(host: {[string]: any}, _menu: any): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local render = (host.presentationRunService or host.game:GetService("RunService")).RenderStepped
    local vector = host.Vector3.new
    local kindOf = host.typeof or typeof
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, enabled = false, previewEnabled = false,
        size = vector(7,8,8), baseSize = vector(6,6,6), range = 8,
        centerOffset = host.CFrame.new(0,0,-3), centerVerified = false,
        queryVerified = false, ready = false, queryCount = 0, expandedCount = 0,
        connections = {},
        lastReason = "Ordinary M1 client query is unavailable; proposed bounds preview only",
    }

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
    end
    local observedHumanoid,deathConnection,observedDead=nil,nil,false
    local function destroyPreview()
        if control.previewFolder then control.previewFolder:Destroy() end
        control.previewFolder,control.previewPart,control.previewFill,control.previewOutline = nil,nil,nil,nil
    end
    local function observeHumanoid(humanoid)
        if observedHumanoid==humanoid then return end
        if deathConnection then deathConnection:Disconnect();deathConnection=nil end
        observedHumanoid,observedDead=humanoid,false
        if humanoid and humanoid.Died then deathConnection=humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            observedDead=true;destroyPreview()
        end)end
    end
    local function createPreview()
        if control.previewPart then return end
        local folder = host.Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name = "ShenaniganismM1Bounds"
        folder.Parent = host.workspace
        local part = host.Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = "ProposedM1Bounds"
        part.Anchored,part.CanCollide,part.CanQuery,part.CanTouch = true,false,false,false
        part.Transparency,part.CastShadow = 1,false
        part.Size = control.size
        part.Parent = folder
        local color = host.Color3.fromRGB(0,210,255)
        local fill = host.Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        fill.Name,fill.Adornee,fill.Size = "M1BoundsFill",part,control.size
        fill.Color3,fill.Transparency,fill.AlwaysOnTop,fill.ZIndex = color,0.94,false,5
        fill.Parent = part
        local outline = host.Instance.new("SelectionBox")
        outline.Name,outline.Adornee = "M1BoundsOutline",part
        outline.Color3,outline.Transparency,outline.SurfaceTransparency,outline.LineThickness = color,0.15,1,0.02
        outline.Parent = part
        control.previewFolder,control.previewPart,control.previewFill,control.previewOutline = folder,part,fill,outline
    end
    function control.refreshPreview()
        if not control.alive or not control.previewEnabled then destroyPreview();return end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        observeHumanoid(humanoid)
        local dead=observedDead or humanoid and humanoid.Health<=0
        if character and type(character.GetAttribute)=='function' and character:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then dead=true end
        if humanoid and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' and host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType then
            local ok,state=pcall(humanoid.GetState,humanoid)
            if ok and state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then dead=true end
        end
        if not character or not character.Parent or not root or not humanoid or dead then
            destroyPreview();return
        end
        createPreview()
        local frame=root.CFrame
        if type(root.GetRenderCFrame)=='function' then
            local ok,rendered=pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame,root)
            if ok then frame=rendered end
        end
        control.previewPart.CFrame = frame*control.centerOffset
        control.previewPart.Size,control.previewFill.Size = control.size,control.size
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: any)
        control.enabled = control.alive and value == true
        control.lastReason = if control.enabled then
            "Proposed M1 bounds enabled; native/server M1 reach remains unverified"
            else "M1 range extension is disabled"
    end
    function control.setRange(value: any)
        local amount = tonumber(value)
        control.range = if finite(amount) then math.clamp(amount,1,30) else 8
        control.size = vector(7,8,control.range)
        control.refreshPreview()
    end
    function control.setSize(value: any)
        if kindOf(value) ~= "Vector3" or not finite(value.X) or not finite(value.Y) or not finite(value.Z) then return end
        control.size = vector(math.clamp(value.X,1,30),math.clamp(value.Y,1,30),math.clamp(value.Z,1,30))
        control.range = control.size.Z
        control.refreshPreview()
    end
    function control.setPreview(value: any)
        control.previewEnabled = control.alive and value == true
        control.refreshPreview()
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,render:Connect(control.refreshPreview))
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive,control.enabled,control.previewEnabled = false,false,false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        observeHumanoid(nil)
        destroyPreview()
    end
    return control
end
return M1Hitbox
end)()

local JujutsuerAutoControls = (function(): any
-- Register only through the existing menu widgets; appearance remains menu-owned.
local Controls = {}

function Controls.create(menu)
    if menu.jujutsuerAutoControlsCreated then return end
    local autos = menu.jujutsuerAutos
    local group = menu.tabs and menu.tabs.Automatic
    if not autos or not group then return end
    menu.jujutsuerAutoControlsCreated = true
    local tab = group.tab
    local specifications = {
        {name='Auto Triple Sentence',key='TripleSentence',group='Higuruma',description='Repeat the follow-up during your Triple Sentence animation.'},
        {name="Auto Judgement's Reach",key='JudgementsReach',group='Higuruma',description="Use the follow-up when your Judgement's Reach animation starts."},
        {name='Auto Final Judgement',key='FinalJudgement',group='Higuruma',description='Automatically respond during the available judgement interaction for your character and the nearest eligible target.',interval='Final Judgement Interval (s)',maximum=2},
        {name='Auto Beam Clash',key='BeamClash',group='Skill interactions',description='Automatically respond during an active beam clash.',interval='Beam Clash Interval (s)',maximum=1.5},
    }
    for _,spec in specifications do
        local feature=spec.key
        if not menu.entries['Automatic/'..spec.name] then
            tab:CreateToggle({Name=spec.name,Description=spec.description,Default=false,AllowHoldKeybind=true,
                JujutsuerPortTab='Automatic',JujutsuerPortGroup=spec.group,
                PortRelatedNames=spec.interval and {spec.interval} or {},
                Callback=function(value)return autos.setEnabled(feature,value)end})
        end
        if spec.interval and not menu.entries['Automatic/'..spec.interval] then
            tab:CreateSlider({Name=spec.interval,Description='Minimum time between native responses. Zero checks once per rendered frame while enabled.',
                Min=0,Max=spec.maximum,Default=0,Step=.01,Precision=2,QuickSettingsOnly=true,
                JujutsuerPortTab='Automatic',JujutsuerPortGroup=spec.group,
                PortVisibleWhen=function()return autos.enabled[feature]==true end,
                Callback=function(value)return autos.setInterval(feature,value)end})
        end
    end
end

return Controls
end)()

local JujutsuerAutos = (function(): any
-- Recovered Jujutsuer Auto clauses. UI and shared targeting remain menu-owned.
-- Source: autos-integration-runtime-character/callback.structured.luau and
-- autos-integration-runtime-render/callback.structured.luau. No camera/input writes.
local Autos = {}
local ANIMATIONS = {
    TripleSentence = "rbxassetid://124243904748268",
    JudgementsReach = "rbxassetid://133869529005453",
}
local PERIOD_LIMITS = {FinalJudgement = 2, BeamClash = 1.5}

function Autos.new(host, menu)
    local game = host.game
    local players = game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local replicated = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local run = game:GetService("RunService")
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local control = {
        alive = true,
        enabled = {TripleSentence = false, JudgementsReach = false, FinalJudgement = false, BeamClash = false},
        -- These are explicit port defaults. Source scalar initializers were not recovered.
        intervals = {FinalJudgement = 0, BeamClash = 0},
        requests = {TripleSentence = 0, JudgementsReach = 0, FinalJudgement = 0, BeamClash = 0},
        lastAt = {FinalJudgement = 0, BeamClash = 0},
        lastReason = "Disabled",
    }
    local character, humanoid, episode
    local frameConnection, animationConnection, addedConnection, removingConnection, childConnection
    local generation = 0
    local dispatching, stepping = false, false
    local suspended = false
    local refresh
    local function disconnect(connection)
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        return nil
    end
    local function anyEnabled()
        for _, enabled in control.enabled do if enabled then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function current()
        if suspended or not control.alive or not character or character ~= player.Character or not character.Parent then return nil end
        local ownHumanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not ownHumanoid or ownHumanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
        return character
    end
    local function nativeRemote(serviceName)
        local knit = replicated:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        knit = knit and knit:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local services = knit and knit:FindFirstChild("Services")
        local service = services and services:FindFirstChild(serviceName)
        local events = service and service:FindFirstChild("RE")
        local remote = events and events:FindFirstChild("Activated")
        if remote and type(remote.FireServer) == "function" then return remote end
        return nil
    end
    local function toolFor(own, name)
        local moves = own and own:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
        return moves and moves:FindFirstChild(name)
    end
    local function send(feature, remote, ...)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled[feature] or not current() or not remote or not remote.Parent or type(remote.FireServer) ~= "function" then return false end
        local call = menu.nativeCounter and menu.nativeCounter.callNative
        local ok, message
        dispatching = true
        if type(call) == "function" then
            local called, result, detail = pcall(call, remote.FireServer, remote, ...)
            ok, message = called and result == true, if called then detail else result
        else ok, message = pcall(remote.FireServer, remote, ...) end
        dispatching = false
        if ok then
            control.requests[feature] += 1
            control.lastReason = feature .. " native request sent; server acceptance is unverified"
        else control.lastReason = tostring(message) end
        return ok == true
    end
    local function nearestRoot(own)
        local root = own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local characters = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not root or not characters then return nil end
        local nearest, distance = nil, math.huge
        for _, candidate in ipairs(characters:GetChildren()) do
            if candidate ~= own and candidate.Parent and not (((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(candidate))) then
                local targetRoot = candidate:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if targetRoot then
                    local nextDistance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if nextDistance < distance then distance, nearest = nextDistance, targetRoot end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end
    function control.step()
        if not control.alive or stepping then return end
        stepping = true
        local now, own = clock(), current()
        local pending = episode
        if pending then
            if not own or pending.character ~= own or pending.generation ~= generation or not control.enabled.TripleSentence or toolFor(own, "Triple Sentence") ~= pending.tool then
                episode = nil
            elseif now >= pending.due then
                if not send("TripleSentence", pending.remote, pending.tool, nil) then episode = nil
                else
                    pending.remaining -= 1
                    pending.due = now + 0.2
                    if pending.remaining == 0 then episode = nil end
                end
            end
        end
        if own then
            if control.enabled.FinalJudgement and now - control.lastAt.FinalJudgement >= control.intervals.FinalJudgement then
                control.lastAt.FinalJudgement = now
                local targetRoot = nearestRoot(own)
                local targetRemote = targetRoot and targetRoot.Parent and targetRoot.Parent:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent")
                if targetRemote then send("FinalJudgement", targetRemote, true) end
                local ownRemote = own:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent")
                if ownRemote then send("FinalJudgement", ownRemote, true) end
            end
            if control.enabled.BeamClash and now - control.lastAt.BeamClash >= control.intervals.BeamClash then
                control.lastAt.BeamClash = now
                local beams = workspace:FindFirstChild("Beams")
                local remote = beams and beams:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent")
                if remote then send("BeamClash", remote, true) end
            end
        end
        stepping = false
        refresh()
    end
    local function onAnimation(track)
        local own = current()
        if dispatching or not own or not track or not track.Animation then return end
        local id = track.Animation.AnimationId
        if control.enabled.JudgementsReach and id == ANIMATIONS.JudgementsReach then
            local tool = toolFor(own, "Judgement's Reach")
            if tool then send("JudgementsReach", nativeRemote("JudgeReachService"), tool) end
        end
        if control.enabled.TripleSentence and id == ANIMATIONS.TripleSentence then
            if episode and episode.track == track then return end
            local tool = toolFor(own, "Triple Sentence")
            local remote = nativeRemote("TripleSentenceService")
            if tool and remote then
                episode = {character = own, generation = generation, track = track, tool = tool, remote = remote, remaining = 20, due = clock()}
                control.step()
            end
        end
    end
    local function bindCharacter(nextCharacter)
        generation += 1
        episode = nil
        animationConnection = disconnect(animationConnection)
        childConnection = disconnect(childConnection)
        character, humanoid = nextCharacter, nil
        if character then
            humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoid and character.ChildAdded then
                childConnection = character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if child:IsA("Humanoid") then
                        childConnection = disconnect(childConnection)
                        humanoid = child
                        refresh()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        refresh()
    end
    refresh = function()
        local enabled = control.alive and not suspended and anyEnabled()
        if enabled and not addedConnection then
            addedConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)
            removingConnection = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(removing)
                if removing == character then bindCharacter(nil) end
            end)
            if player.Character ~= character then bindCharacter(player.Character) end
        elseif not enabled then
            addedConnection = disconnect(addedConnection)
            removingConnection = disconnect(removingConnection)
            childConnection = disconnect(childConnection)
            episode = nil
        end
        local needsAnimations = enabled and humanoid and (control.enabled.TripleSentence or control.enabled.JudgementsReach)
        if needsAnimations and not animationConnection then animationConnection = humanoid.AnimationPlayed:Connect(onAnimation)
        elseif not needsAnimations then animationConnection = disconnect(animationConnection) end
        local needsFrames = enabled and (control.enabled.FinalJudgement or control.enabled.BeamClash or episode ~= nil)
        if needsFrames and not frameConnection then frameConnection = run.RenderStepped:Connect(control.step)
        elseif not needsFrames then frameConnection = disconnect(frameConnection) end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(feature, value)
        if not control.alive or control.enabled[feature] == nil then return false end
        control.enabled[feature] = value == true
        if feature == "TripleSentence" and not value then episode = nil end
        control.lastReason = if value then "Waiting for native " .. feature .. " context" else "Disabled"
        refresh()
        return true
    end
    function control.setInterval(feature, value)
        local limit = PERIOD_LIMITS[feature]
        if not limit or type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return false end
        control.intervals[feature] = math.clamp(value, 0, limit)
        return true
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        suspended=true
        generation+=1
        episode=nil
        refresh()
    end
    function control.onFailsafeResume()
        suspended=false
        refresh()
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        generation += 1
        episode = nil
        refresh()
        frameConnection = disconnect(frameConnection)
        animationConnection = disconnect(animationConnection)
        character, humanoid = nil, nil
    end
    control.destroy = control.Destroy
    return control
end
return Autos
end)()

local JujutsuerOPIntegration = (function(): any
-- v53 menu adapter for source-recovered Jujutsuer clauses. Creates controls
-- through the existing tab factories, without creating or restyling GUI parts.
local Integration = {}
type IntegrationState = {alive: boolean, created: boolean?, seen: {[any]: any}, configs: {[any]: any},
    connections: {any}, status: {[any]: any}, [string]: any}

function Integration.new(host: any, menu: any, OP: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player, world = players.LocalPlayer, host.workspace
    local input = host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local environmentOf = getfenv
    local taskRuntime = host.task or environmentOf(0).task
    local control: IntegrationState = {alive = true, seen = {}, configs = {}, connections = {}, status = {}}
    local function paused()
        return menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() == true
    end
    local function blocked(character, humanoid, recover)
        if paused() or not menu.alive or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return true end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then return true end
        if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return true end
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        if block and ((block.manualBlockHeld and block.manualBlockHeld() == true) or block.held ~= nil) then return true end
        local env = menu.environment or {}
        if env.LockedTarget and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected ~= false then return true end
        local lock = menu.autoLock
        if lock and (lock.skillFacing or (lock.currentPendingSkill and lock.currentPendingSkill())) then return true end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        for _, name in {'InDash', 'InSkill', 'Block', 'Melee', 'Attacking', 'DomainClash', 'Knockback'} do
            if (name~='Knockback' or not recover)
                and (character:GetAttribute(name) == true or info and info:FindFirstChild(name)) then return true end
        end
        if not recover and ((tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')) or 0) > 0
            or humanoid.PlatformStand or character:GetAttribute('Stun') == true
            or character:GetAttribute('TrueStun') == true
            or info and (info:FindFirstChild('Stun') or info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun'))) then return true end
        return false
    end
    local native = {
        player = player, players = players, workspace = world,
        runService = host.game:GetService('RunService'), CFrame = host.CFrame,
        Vector3 = host.Vector3, Enum = host.Enum,
        clock = host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock,
        delay = taskRuntime.delay,
        getCamera = function() return world.CurrentCamera end,
        canMove = function(_, character, humanoid) return not blocked(character, humanoid, false) end,
        canRecover = function(character, humanoid) return not blocked(character, humanoid, true) end,
        canCamera = function(_, character, humanoid) return not blocked(character, humanoid, false) end,
        canKnockback = function() return not paused() and not (menu.knockbackControl and menu.knockbackControl.enabled) end,
        isPaused = paused,
        onStatus = function(feature, reason) control.status[feature] = reason end,
    }
    local runtime = OP.new(native)
    control.runtime = runtime
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        if runtime.onFailsafePause then runtime.onFailsafePause() end
    end
    function control.onFailsafeResume()
        if runtime.onFailsafeResume then runtime.onFailsafeResume() end
    end
    function control.resetCapability()
        return menu.respawnControl~=nil and type(menu.respawnControl.forceReset)=='function'
    end
    local movementKeys = {tpWalking=true, orbit=true, loopTp=true}
    local function syncToggle(key, value)
        for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if entry.config and entry.config.JujutsuerOPKey==key and entry.widget and entry.widget.Set then entry.widget.Set(value,false) end
        end
    end
    native.onStateChanged=syncToggle
    local function set(key, value)
        if not control.alive then return false end
        if value==true and movementKeys[key] then
            for other in movementKeys do
                if other~=key and runtime.state[other] then runtime.set(other,false); syncToggle(other,false) end
            end
        end
        if key=='knockbackMult' and value==true and menu.knockbackControl and menu.knockbackControl.enabled then
            local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries['Main/Knockback Force']
            if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Set then entry.widget.Set(false,true)
            elseif menu.knockbackControl.setEnabled then menu.knockbackControl.setEnabled(false) end
        end
        local ok, reason = runtime.set(key, value)
        if ok == false then control.status[key] = reason end
        return ok
    end
    local function setTarget(value)
        return set('targetName', if type(value) == 'string' and value ~= '' then value else nil)
    end
    local specs = {
        {role='target', tab='Player', kind='CreateDropdown', name='Target', group='Target',
            description='Select a server player. The roster refreshes when players join or leave.', callback=setTarget},
        {role='targetTeleport', tab='Player', kind='CreateButton', name='Teleport To Target', group='Target',
            description='Move to the selected player when manual combat, native actions and target lock are idle.', callback=runtime.teleportTarget},
        {role='orbit', tab='Player', kind='CreateToggle', name='Target Orbit', group='Target', key='orbit',
            description='Circle the selected player using the recovered Heartbeat orbit. Manual block, skills, dashes and target lock take priority.'},
        {role='orbitSpeed', tab='Player', kind='CreateSlider', name='Target Orbit Speed', group='Target', key='orbitSpeed', minimum=1, maximum=30, default=1, step=.1,
            quick=true, description='Degrees added per Heartbeat, matching the reference orbit.'},
        {role='orbitDistance', tab='Player', kind='CreateSlider', name='Target Orbit Distance', group='Target', key='orbitDistance', minimum=5, maximum=50, default=5, step=.1,
            quick=true, description='Orbit radius in studs.'},
        {role='spectate', tab='Player', kind='CreateToggle', name='Target Spectate', group='Target', key='spectate',
            description='View the selected player through the native camera subject. Combat actions and lock-on pause spectating; disabling restores the owned camera subject.'},
        {role='loopTp', tab='Player', kind='CreateToggle', name='Teleport To Everyone', group='Target', key='loopTp',
            description='Move your own character through the native Characters roster. Pauses for manual block, skills, dashes and lock-on.'},
        {role='loopTpInterval', tab='Player', kind='CreateSlider', name='Teleport To Everyone Interval', group='Target', key='loopTpInterval', minimum=0, maximum=1, default=0, step=.01,
            quick=true, description='Seconds between visits. Zero visits at most one character per Heartbeat.'},
        {role='speed', tab='Main', kind='CreateToggle', name='Speed Hack', group='Movement', key='tpWalking',
            description='Use the recovered Translate or WalkSpeed movement method. Native attacks, manual block, dash and target lock take priority.'},
        {role='speedValue', tab='Main', kind='CreateSlider', name='Speed Hack Speed', group='Movement', key='tpWalkSpeed', minimum=0, maximum=500, default=16, step=.1,
            quick=true, description='Translate adds this speed to normal movement. WalkSpeed applies this native speed.'},
        {role='speedMethod', tab='Main', kind='CreateDropdown', name='Speed Hack Method', group='Movement', key='tpWalkingMethod', options={'Translate','WalkSpeed'}, default='Translate',
            quick=true, description='Choose TranslateBy movement or the Humanoid WalkSpeed property.'},
        {role='knockback', tab='Main', kind='CreateToggle', name='Incoming Knockback Multiplier', group='Knockback', key='knockbackMult',
            description='Multiply each arriving native KnockbackForce BodyVelocity once. This recovered method scales the full velocity, including vertical lift.'},
        {role='knockbackValue', tab='Main', kind='CreateSlider', name='Incoming Knockback Multiplier Amount', group='Knockback', key='knockbackAmount', minimum=0, maximum=100, default=1, step=.01,
            quick=true, description='Velocity factor: 0 is zero velocity, 1 is unchanged, 100 is one hundred times.'},
        {role='ragdoll', tab='Main', kind='CreateToggle', name='Anti-Ragdoll Physics', group='Ragdoll & recovery', key='antiRagdoll',
            description='Apply the recovered State and/or Motor6D response when native Ragdoll becomes 1. Combat input and actions retain priority.'},
        {role='ragdollMethods', tab='Main', kind='CreateDropdown', name='Anti-Ragdoll Physics Methods', group='Ragdoll & recovery', options={'None','State','Motor6D','Both'}, default='None',
            quick=true, checkboxes={'State','Motor6D'}, description='State requests Running for one second. Motor6D enables the current character motors. Choose either or both.',
            callback=function(value) return set('ragdollMethod', {State=value=='State' or value=='Both', Motor6D=value=='Motor6D' or value=='Both'}) end},
        {role='reset', tab='Game', kind='CreateButton', name='Force Reset', group='Game utilities',
            description='Request the game\'s full character reset, including health and respawn. The game may enforce a wait.', callback=function()
                if paused() then return false end
                if not control.resetCapability() then control.status.reset='Native reset request unavailable'; return false end
                -- Breaking joints alone can leave game health unchanged and a
                -- stranded ragdoll. Use the existing server reset/lifecycle owner.
                local reset=menu.respawnControl
                local sent,remaining=reset.forceReset()
                control.status.reset=reset.status or (if sent then 'Sent' else 'Not sent')
                return sent,remaining
            end},
    }
    local byName, byRole = {}, {}
    for _, spec in specs do byName[spec.name], byRole[spec.role] = spec, spec end
    control.specs = specs
    local related = {speed={'speedMethod','speedValue'}, orbit={'orbitSpeed','orbitDistance'},
        loopTp={'loopTpInterval'}, knockback={'knockbackValue'}, ragdoll={'ragdollMethods'}}
    local function configure(spec, config, preserve)
        config.JujutsuerOPRole, config.JujutsuerOPGroup, config.JujutsuerOPKey = spec.role, spec.group, spec.key
        config.JujutsuerPortTab = if spec.tab=='Game' then 'Main' else spec.tab
        config.JujutsuerPortGroup = spec.group
        if related[spec.role] then
            config.PortRelatedNames={}
            for _, role in related[spec.role] do table.insert(config.PortRelatedNames,byRole[role].name) end
        end
        for parent, roles in related do
            if table.find(roles,spec.role) then
                local key=byRole[parent].key
                config.PortVisibleWhen=function() return runtime.state[key]==true end
                break
            end
        end
        config.Description = spec.description
        if spec.quick then config.QuickSettingsOnly = true end
        if spec.kind == 'CreateToggle' then config.Default = false; config.AllowHoldKeybind = true
        elseif spec.kind == 'CreateSlider' then
            config.Min, config.Max, config.Default, config.Step = spec.minimum, spec.maximum, spec.default, spec.step
            config.Precision, config.DistanceUnitAdapter, config.FixedRangeLimit = 2, true, true
        elseif spec.kind == 'CreateDropdown' then
            if spec.role == 'target' then
                local options={''}
                for _, name in runtime.getPlayerNames() do table.insert(options, name) end
                config.Options = options
                config.Default = if type(menu.selectedTarget)=='string' and table.find(options,menu.selectedTarget) then menu.selectedTarget else ''
                config.NoConfig = true
            else config.Options, config.Default = spec.options, spec.default end
            if spec.checkboxes then config.CheckboxOptions = spec.checkboxes end
        end
        local previous = if preserve then config.Callback else nil
        local callback = spec.callback or function(value) return set(spec.key, if spec.kind=='CreateToggle' then value==true else value) end
        config.Callback = function(value, ...)
            if not control.alive then return false end
            -- Preserve the existing player target selection's footer, morph and
            -- other consumers, while every new OP action shares that selection.
            if previous then previous(value, ...) end
            return callback(value, ...)
        end
        control.seen[spec.role], control.configs[spec.role] = true, config
        return config
    end
    function control.wrapConfig(tabName, kind, config)
        if not control.alive or config.JujutsuerOPRole then return config end
        local spec = byName[config.Name]
        if not spec or spec.kind ~= kind then return config end
        if spec.role == 'target' and tabName ~= 'Player' then return config end
        if spec.role == 'reset' and not control.resetCapability() then return config end
        -- Exact named features reuse the original row; no second UI is created.
        return configure(spec, config, spec.role == 'target')
    end
