    local function targetEntry()
        for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if entry.config and entry.config.JujutsuerOPRole == 'target' then return entry end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.refreshRoster()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local entry = targetEntry()
        if not entry or not entry.widget then return end
        local names={''}
        for _, name in runtime.getPlayerNames() do table.insert(names,name) end
        local before = runtime.state.targetName
        local selected = if before and table.find(names,before) then before else ''
        local config = entry.config
        config.Options = names
        if entry.widget.SetOptions then entry.widget.SetOptions(names) end
        if entry.widget.Set then entry.widget.Set(selected,false) end
        if selected ~= (before or '') then config.Callback(selected) end
    end
    function control.createControls()
        if not control.alive or control.created then return end
        control.created = true
        for _, spec in specs do
            if not control.seen[spec.role] and (spec.role ~= 'reset' or control.resetCapability()) then
                local destination = menu.tabs[spec.tab] or menu.tabs.Main
                local config = configure(spec, {Name=spec.name}, false)
                destination.tab[spec.kind](destination.tab, config)
            end
        end
        if menu.selectedTarget then setTarget(menu.selectedTarget) end
        for _, signal in {players.PlayerAdded, players.PlayerRemoving} do
            if signal then table.insert(control.connections, signal:Connect(function()
                -- PlayerRemoving fires before GetPlayers updates on some clients.
                taskRuntime.defer(control.refreshRoster)
            end)) end
        end
        control.refreshRoster()
    end
    function control.relatedSettings(entry)
        local role = entry.config and entry.config.JujutsuerOPRole
        local roles = role and related[role]
        if not roles then return nil end
        local records={}
        for _, record in menu.rows or {} do
            local candidate = record.config and record.config.JujutsuerOPRole
            if candidate and table.find(roles,candidate) then table.insert(records,record) end
        end
        return records
    end
    function control.groupFor(record)
        if not record.config or not record.config.JujutsuerOPRole then return nil end
        return if record.tab=='Game' then 'Main' else record.tab, record.config.JujutsuerOPGroup
    end
    function control.isControlVisible(record)
        local role = record.config and record.config.JujutsuerOPRole
        local parentRole
        for parent, roles in related do if role and table.find(roles, role) then parentRole=parent; break end end
        if not parentRole then return nil end
        local parent = byRole[parentRole]
        return runtime.state[parent.key] == true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        for _, connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        runtime.Destroy()
    end
    return control
end

return Integration
end)()

local JujutsuerOP = (function(): any
-- Port of recovered Jujutsuer OP runtime clauses, not the protected callbacks.
-- Evidence: work/deobfuscation/op-port-recovery and dependencies-highlevel.
-- Host supplies the current game objects and recovered native/data bindings.
-- Unrecovered features deliberately have no pretend setter-only implementation.
local OP = {}

local function bounded(value, low, high, fallback)
    value = tonumber(value)
    if not value or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return fallback end
    return math.clamp(value, low, high)
end

function OP.new(host, initial)
    assert(host and host.player and host.runService and host.workspace, "OP: missing host services")
    local environmentOf = getfenv
    local runtimeGlobals = if host.CFrame and host.Vector3 and host.Enum and host.delay then host else environmentOf(0)
    local CF, V3, enums = host.CFrame or runtimeGlobals.CFrame, host.Vector3 or runtimeGlobals.Vector3, host.Enum or runtimeGlobals.Enum
    local clock = host.clock or os.clock
    local schedule = host.delay or runtimeGlobals.task.delay
    local state = {
        tpWalking = false, tpWalkingMethod = "Translate", tpWalkSpeed = 16,
        orbit = false, orbitSpeed = 1, orbitDistance = 5, targetName = nil,
        spectate = false, loopTp = false, loopTpInterval = 0,
        autoBring = false, autobringPos = nil, autoBringTpBack = false,
        knockbackMult = false, knockbackAmount = 1,
        antiRagdoll = false, ragdollMethod = {State = false, Motor6D = false},
        instaR = false, rGo = false, ragdollFix = false, isInvis = false, selectedItem = nil,
    }
    local control = {state = state, alive = true, status = {}, connections = {}}
    local charConnections, changedConstraints, changedParts, changedCollision = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local bodyParts = {}
    local character, root, humanoid, speedLease, cameraLease
    local constraintFolder
    local angle, tourIndex, lastTour, ragdollUntil = 0, 1, -math.huge, 0
    local lastRagdollNudge = -math.huge
    local generation, invisTrack, animator, parkourHooked = 0, nil, nil, false
    local invisibleAnimation
    local pickup
    local syncSubscriptions
    local heartbeatConnection, renderConnection
    local suspended = false
    local function paused()
        return suspended or (host.isPaused and host.isPaused() == true)
    end

    local function connect(signal, callback, list)
        if not signal then return nil end
        local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(list or control.connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function disconnectAll(list)
        for _, connection in ipairs(list) do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(list)
    end
    local function note(feature, reason)
        control.status[feature] = reason
        if host.onStatus then host.onStatus(feature, reason) end
        return false, reason
    end
    local function restoreSpeed()
        local lease = speedLease
        speedLease = nil
        if lease and lease.object.Parent and lease.object.WalkSpeed == lease.applied then
            lease.object.WalkSpeed = lease.previous
        end
    end
    local function restoreCamera()
        local lease = cameraLease
        cameraLease = nil
        if lease and lease.camera.CameraSubject == lease.applied then
            local previous = lease.previous
            if not previous or not previous.Parent then previous = humanoid end
            if previous then lease.camera.CameraSubject = previous end
        end
    end
    local function camera()
        return host.getCamera and host.getCamera() or host.workspace.CurrentCamera
    end
    local function finishPickup()
        local lease = pickup
        pickup = nil
        if not lease then return end
        if lease.root.Parent and lease.generation == generation and lease.root.CFrame == lease.applied then
            lease.root.CFrame = lease.previous
        end
        if lease.remote.Parent == nil then lease.remote.Parent = lease.remoteParent end
        if lease.camera.CameraType == enums.CameraType.Scriptable and lease.camera.CFrame == lease.cameraFrame then
            lease.camera.CameraType = lease.cameraType
        end
    end
    local function target()
        if not state.targetName or state.targetName == host.player.Name then return nil end
        local player = host.players:FindFirstChild(state.targetName)
        local model = player and player.Character
        local part = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not part or not part.Parent or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
        return model, part, hum
    end
    local function canMove(feature)
        if paused() or not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
        -- The enclosing menu owns manual block/dash/skill arbitration. This hook
        -- prevents a second movement writer from freezing native actions.
        return not host.canMove or host.canMove(feature, character, humanoid) == true
    end
    local function restoreAppearance()
        for part, lease in pairs(changedParts) do
            if part.Parent and part[lease.property] == lease.applied then part[lease.property] = lease.previous end
        end
        table.clear(changedParts)
    end
    local function restoreCollision()
        for part, previous in pairs(changedCollision) do
            if part.Parent and part.CanCollide == false then part.CanCollide = previous end
        end
        table.clear(changedCollision)
    end
    local function stopInvisibleTrack()
        if invisTrack then pcall(function() invisTrack:Stop() end); invisTrack = nil end
        if invisibleAnimation then invisibleAnimation:Destroy(); invisibleAnimation = nil end
        animator = nil
    end
    local function setAppearance(transparency)
        if paused() then return false end
        if not host.invisibilityParts then return note("isInvis", "Recovered body-part list has not been supplied") end
        for _, name in ipairs(host.invisibilityParts) do
            local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                changedParts[part] = changedParts[part] or {property = "Transparency", previous = part.Transparency}
                changedParts[part].applied = transparency
                part.Transparency = transparency
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function setupInvisible()
        stopInvisibleTrack()
        if paused() or not state.isInvis then restoreAppearance(); restoreCollision(); return true end
        if not humanoid or not host.invisibilityParts or not host.newInstance then
            return note("isInvis", "Recovered part list or animation constructor unavailable")
        end
        animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then animator = host.newInstance("Animator"); animator.Parent = humanoid end
        invisibleAnimation = host.newInstance("Animation")
        invisibleAnimation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://108081843941348"
        invisTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(invisibleAnimation)
        invisTrack.Priority = enums.AnimationPriority.Action4
        setAppearance(0.5)
        return true
    end
    local function restoreConstraints()
        for constraint, lease in pairs(changedConstraints) do
            if constraint.Parent and constraint.Enabled == lease.applied then constraint.Enabled = lease.previous end
        end
        table.clear(changedConstraints)
    end
    local function updateRagdollFix()
        if paused() or not state.ragdollFix then restoreConstraints(); return end
        local folder = character and character:FindFirstChild("RagdollConstraints")
        if not folder then return end
        for _, constraint in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            changedConstraints[constraint] = changedConstraints[constraint] or {previous = constraint.Enabled}
            changedConstraints[constraint].applied = false
            constraint.Enabled = false
        end
    end
    local function applySpectate()
        restoreCamera()
        if paused() or not state.spectate then return true end
        if host.canCamera and host.canCamera("spectate", character, humanoid) ~= true then return false end
        local _, _, hum = target()
        local cam = camera()
        if not hum or not cam then return note("spectate", "Selected player has no live humanoid") end
        cameraLease = {camera = cam, previous = cam.CameraSubject, applied = hum}
        cam.CameraSubject = hum
        return true
    end
    local function onRagdoll()
        if paused() or not character then return nil end
        local ragdoll = character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")
        if state.antiRagdoll and ragdoll == 1 and (not host.canRecover or host.canRecover(character, humanoid) == true) then
            -- Repeated Ragdoll events (every dash press can re-raise it) must not
            -- keep extending the window, or the fight with the physics never ends.
            if state.ragdollMethod.State and clock() >= ragdollUntil then ragdollUntil = clock() + 1 end
            if state.ragdollMethod.Motor6D then
                for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("Motor6D") then part.Enabled = true end
                end
            end
        end
        if ragdoll == 2 and state.instaR and not (host.isBypassing and host.isBypassing()) then
            if not host.replicateSignal then return note("instaR", "replicatesignal capability unavailable") end
            state.rGo = true
            host.replicateSignal(humanoid.ServerBreakJoints)
            local token = generation
            local seconds = host.pingAdjustedSeconds and host.pingAdjustedSeconds(0.4) or 0.4
            schedule(seconds, function()
                if control.alive and generation == token then state.rGo = false end
            end)
        end
        if syncSubscriptions then syncSubscriptions() end
        return nil
    end
    local function onRootChild(child)
        if paused() then return end
        if child.Name == "KnockbackForce" and state.knockbackMult and child:IsA("BodyVelocity")
            and (not host.canKnockback or host.canKnockback(character, humanoid) == true) then
            child.Velocity = child.Velocity * state.knockbackAmount
        end
        if child.Name == "GrabWeld" and state.autoBring and canMove("autoBring") then
            local destination = host.areas and host.areas[state.autobringPos]
            if not destination then note("autoBring", "Recovered area transform unavailable"); return end
            local ownRoot, token, saved = root, generation, root.CFrame
            ownRoot.CFrame = destination
            local connection
            connection = child.Destroying:Connect(function()
                connection:Disconnect()
                if control.alive and not paused() and generation == token and state.autoBringTpBack and ownRoot.Parent then
                    ownRoot.CFrame = saved
                end
            end)
            table.insert(charConnections, connection)
        end
    end
    local function bindCharacter(model)
        finishPickup()
        generation += 1
        disconnectAll(charConnections)
        restoreSpeed(); restoreCamera(); stopInvisibleTrack(); restoreAppearance(); restoreCollision(); restoreConstraints()
        table.clear(bodyParts)
        character, root, humanoid = model, nil, nil
        constraintFolder = nil
        state.rGo, ragdollUntil = false, 0
        if syncSubscriptions then syncSubscriptions() end
        if not model then return end
        local boundRoot
        local function refresh()
            root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if root and root ~= boundRoot then
                boundRoot = root
                connect(root.ChildAdded, onRootChild, charConnections)
            end
            local folder = model:FindFirstChild("RagdollConstraints")
            if folder and folder ~= constraintFolder then
                constraintFolder = folder
                connect(folder.ChildAdded, updateRagdollFix, charConnections)
                if state.ragdollFix then updateRagdollFix() end
            end
        end
        refresh()
        for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Collide" then bodyParts[part] = true end
        end
        connect(model.DescendantAdded, function(part)
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Collide" then bodyParts[part] = true end
        end, charConnections)
        connect(model.DescendantRemoving, function(part) bodyParts[part] = nil end, charConnections)
        connect(model.ChildAdded, function()
            local old = humanoid
            refresh()
            if old ~= humanoid and humanoid and state.isInvis then setupInvisible() end
            if state.isInvis then setAppearance(0.5) end
        end, charConnections)
        connect(model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ragdoll"), onRagdoll, charConnections)
        if humanoid and state.isInvis then setupInvisible() end
        if state.ragdollFix then updateRagdollFix() end
    end

    function control.set(key, value)
        if not control.alive then return false end
        if key == "tpWalkSpeed" then value = bounded(value, 0, 500, 16)
        elseif key == "knockbackAmount" then value = bounded(value, 0, 100, 1)
        elseif key == "orbitSpeed" then value = bounded(value, 1, 30, 1)
        elseif key == "orbitDistance" then value = bounded(value, 5, 50, 5)
        elseif key == "loopTpInterval" then value = bounded(value, 0, 1, 0)
        elseif key == "tpWalkingMethod" then
            if value ~= "Translate" and value ~= "Walkspeed" and value ~= "WalkSpeed" then return false end
        elseif key == "ragdollMethod" then
            if type(value) ~= "table" then return false end
            value = {State = value.State == true, Motor6D = value.Motor6D == true}
        elseif key == "isInvis" and value and not (host.invisibilityParts and host.newInstance and host.parkour and host.hookFunction and host.restoreFunction) then
            return note(key, "Recovered animation/body-part/Parkour bindings unavailable")
        elseif state[key] == nil and key ~= "targetName" and key ~= "autobringPos" then
            return note(key, "Feature mechanism is not yet recovered")
        end
        if key == "tpWalking" and not value or key == "tpWalkingMethod" then restoreSpeed() end
        if key == "antiRagdoll" and not value then ragdollUntil = 0 end
        if key == "targetName" then angle = 0 end
        state[key] = value
        if key == "spectate" or key == "targetName" then applySpectate() end
        if key == "ragdollFix" then updateRagdollFix() end
        if key == "isInvis" then
            if value and not paused() and not parkourHooked then
                host.hookFunction(host.parkour, function() return nil end); parkourHooked = true
            elseif (not value or paused()) and parkourHooked then host.restoreFunction(host.parkour); parkourHooked = false end
            setupInvisible()
        end
        if syncSubscriptions then syncSubscriptions() end
        return true
    end
    function control.teleportArea(name)
        if not canMove("teleportArea") then return false end
        local destination
        if name == "Dummy" then
            local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            local dummy = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Dummy")
            local part = dummy and dummy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            destination = part and part.CFrame
        elseif name == "random domain" then
            local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Domains")
            local domains = folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}
            if #domains == 0 then return note("teleportArea", "No native domain is present") end
            local random = host.random or math.random
            destination = domains[random(1, #domains)].CFrame
        else destination = host.areas and host.areas[name] end
        if not destination then return note("teleportArea", "Recovered area transform unavailable") end
        root.CFrame = destination
        return true
    end
    function control.getAreas()
        local names = {"Dummy", "random domain"}
        for name in pairs(host.areas or {}) do table.insert(names, name) end
        table.sort(names)
        return names
    end
    function control.teleportTarget()
        local _, part = target()
        if not part or not canMove("teleportTarget") then return false end
        root.CFrame = part.CFrame
        return true
    end
    function control.reset()
        if paused() then return false end
        if not humanoid or not host.replicateSignal then return note("reset", "replicatesignal capability unavailable") end
        host.replicateSignal(humanoid.ServerBreakJoints)
        return true
    end
    function control.rejoin()
        if paused() then return false end
        if not host.teleportService or not host.placeId or not host.jobId or not host.rejoinMethod then
            return note("rejoin", "Recovered rejoin method or server identity unavailable")
        end
        host.teleportService[host.rejoinMethod](host.teleportService, host.placeId, host.jobId, host.player)
        return true
    end
    function control.getItems()
        local names = {}
        if host.items then
            for _, item in ipairs(host.items:GetChildren()) do table.insert(names, item.Name) end
        end
        table.sort(names)
        return names
    end
    function control.getPlayerNames()
        local names = {}
        for _, player in ipairs(host.players:GetChildren()) do
            if player.Name ~= host.player.Name then table.insert(names, player.Name) end
        end
        table.sort(names)
        return names
    end
    function control.selectItem(name)
        local item = host.items and host.items:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not item then return note("selectedItem", "Selected native item is unavailable") end
        if not host.itemPreview then return note("selectedItem", "Recovered item-preview viewport binding unavailable") end
        host.itemPreview:SetObject(item:Clone())
        host.itemPreview:Focus()
        state.selectedItem = name
        return true
    end
    function control.pickUp()
        if pickup or not canMove("pickUp") then return false end
        local item = host.items and host.items:FindFirstChild(state.selectedItem)
        local remote, cam = host.pickupCameraRemote, camera()
        local prompt = item and item:FindFirstChild("ProximityPrompt")
        if not item or not prompt or not remote or not host.firePrompt or not cam then
            return note("pickUp", "Recovered item/prompt/camera-remote bindings unavailable")
        end
        pickup = {root = root, previous = root.CFrame, applied = item.CFrame,
            generation = generation, remote = remote, remoteParent = remote.Parent,
            camera = cam, cameraType = cam.CameraType, cameraFrame = cam.CFrame, prompt = prompt, count = 0}
        remote.Parent = nil
        cam.CameraType = enums.CameraType.Scriptable
        cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame
        root.CFrame = item.CFrame
        if syncSubscriptions then syncSubscriptions() end
        return true
    end
    function control.step(dt)
        if not control.alive or paused() then return end
        if pickup then
            local lease = pickup
            if lease.count >= 50 or not lease.prompt.Parent or lease.generation ~= generation then finishPickup()
            else
                local ok = pcall(host.firePrompt, lease.prompt)
                lease.count += 1
                if not ok then finishPickup(); note("pickUp", "Native prompt invocation failed") end
            end
            return
        end
        if state.isInvis and invisTrack then
            if not invisTrack.IsPlaying then invisTrack:Play() end
            invisTrack:AdjustSpeed(0); invisTrack.TimePosition = 7
        end
        if not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid then restoreSpeed(); return end
        if state.instaR and state.rGo then root.CFrame = CF.new(root.Position.X, 9e9, root.Position.Z) end
        if clock() < ragdollUntil and (not host.canRecover or host.canRecover(character, humanoid) == true) then
            -- Forcing Running every frame fights the game's ragdoll physics and
            -- jerks the character, worst while you spam dash. Nudge at most ~8
            -- times a second, only while the humanoid is actually still in a
            -- ragdoll state, and never while a dash is moving the character.
            local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
            local dashing = character:GetAttribute("InDash") == true
                or (info ~= nil and (info:FindFirstChild("InDash") ~= nil or info:FindFirstChild("Dash") ~= nil))
            local types = enums.HumanoidStateType
            local current = humanoid:GetState()
            local stuck = humanoid.PlatformStand or current == types.Physics or current == types.Ragdoll or current == types.FallingDown
            if not dashing and stuck and clock() - lastRagdollNudge >= 0.12 then
                lastRagdollNudge = clock()
                humanoid.PlatformStand = false
                humanoid:ChangeState(types.Running)
            end
        end
        local movementAllowed = canMove("automatic")
        if state.orbit and movementAllowed then
            local _, enemy = target()
            if enemy then
                angle += state.orbitSpeed -- exact reference increments per Heartbeat
                local position = (CF.new(enemy.Position) * CF.Angles(0, math.rad(angle), 0) * CF.new(state.orbitDistance, 0, 0)).Position
                root.CFrame = CF.lookAt(position, V3.new(enemy.Position.X, position.Y, enemy.Position.Z))
            else
                state.orbit = false
                if host.onStateChanged then host.onStateChanged('orbit', false) end
            end
        end
        if state.tpWalking and movementAllowed then
            if state.tpWalkingMethod == "Translate" then
                restoreSpeed()
                if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then character:TranslateBy(humanoid.MoveDirection * state.tpWalkSpeed * dt) end
            else
                if not speedLease or speedLease.object ~= humanoid then
                    restoreSpeed(); speedLease = {object = humanoid, previous = humanoid.WalkSpeed}
                end
                speedLease.applied = state.tpWalkSpeed
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = state.tpWalkSpeed
            end
        else restoreSpeed() end
        if state.loopTp and movementAllowed and clock() - lastTour >= state.loopTpInterval then
            lastTour = clock()
            local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            local targets = {}
            if folder then
                for _, model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if model ~= character then
                        local part = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if part then table.insert(targets, part) end
                    end
                end
            end
            if #targets > 0 then
                if tourIndex > #targets then tourIndex = 1 end
                root.CFrame = targets[tourIndex].CFrame
                tourIndex += 1
            end
        end
        if state.spectate then
            local _, _, hum = target()
            if host.canCamera and host.canCamera("spectate", character, humanoid) ~= true then restoreCamera()
            elseif not hum then
                state.spectate = false; restoreCamera()
                if host.onStateChanged then host.onStateChanged('spectate', false) end
            elseif not cameraLease or cameraLease.applied ~= hum or cameraLease.camera ~= camera() then applySpectate() end
        end
        if syncSubscriptions then syncSubscriptions() end
    end
    function control.render()
        if not control.alive or paused() or not state.isInvis then return end
        if invisTrack and invisTrack.IsPlaying then invisTrack:Stop() end
        for part in pairs(bodyParts) do
            if part.Parent then
                if changedCollision[part] == nil then changedCollision[part] = part.CanCollide end
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        suspended = true
        finishPickup()
        generation += 1
        state.rGo, ragdollUntil = false, 0
        restoreSpeed(); restoreCamera(); stopInvisibleTrack(); restoreAppearance(); restoreCollision(); restoreConstraints()
        if parkourHooked then host.restoreFunction(host.parkour); parkourHooked = false end
        if syncSubscriptions then syncSubscriptions() end
    end
    function control.onFailsafeResume()
        suspended = false
        if not control.alive or paused() then return end
        if state.isInvis and not parkourHooked then
            host.hookFunction(host.parkour, function() return nil end); parkourHooked = true
        end
        if state.isInvis then setupInvisible() end
        if state.ragdollFix then updateRagdollFix() end
        if state.spectate then applySpectate() end
        if syncSubscriptions then syncSubscriptions() end
    end
    function control.destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if heartbeatConnection then heartbeatConnection:Disconnect(); heartbeatConnection = nil end
        if renderConnection then renderConnection:Disconnect(); renderConnection = nil end
        finishPickup(); generation += 1
        disconnectAll(control.connections); disconnectAll(charConnections)
        restoreSpeed(); restoreCamera(); stopInvisibleTrack(); restoreAppearance(); restoreCollision(); restoreConstraints()
        if parkourHooked then host.restoreFunction(host.parkour); parkourHooked = false end
    end
    control.Destroy = control.destroy
    -- Feature work subscribes only while a continuous feature is active. The
    -- off state retains lifecycle/attribute listeners, with no frame callback.
    syncSubscriptions = function()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local heartbeatNeeded = not paused() and (state.tpWalking or state.orbit or state.loopTp or state.spectate
            or state.isInvis or state.rGo or pickup ~= nil or clock() < ragdollUntil)
        if heartbeatNeeded and not heartbeatConnection then
            heartbeatConnection = host.runService.Heartbeat:Connect(control.step)
        elseif not heartbeatNeeded and heartbeatConnection then
            heartbeatConnection:Disconnect(); heartbeatConnection = nil
        end
        if state.isInvis and not paused() and not renderConnection then
            renderConnection = host.runService.RenderStepped:Connect(control.render)
        elseif (not state.isInvis or paused()) and renderConnection then
            renderConnection:Disconnect(); renderConnection = nil
        end
    end
    control.syncSubscriptions = syncSubscriptions
    connect(host.player.CharacterAdded, bindCharacter)
    connect(host.player.CharacterRemoving, function(model) if model == character then bindCharacter(nil) end end)
    bindCharacter(host.player.Character)
    if initial then
        for key, value in pairs(initial) do control.set(key, value) end
    end
    return control
end

return OP
end)()

local AutoBlock = (function(): any
local ReferenceAutoBlockPolicy=(function()
-- Decision policy recovered from runtime:RunService.Heartbeat:3.
-- Native input ownership, character facing and UI belong to the host adapter.
-- Waits become cancellable deadlines; overlapping callbacks share one guard lease.
local Policy = {}
type PolicyEntry = {[string]: any}
type PolicyState = {queue: {PolicyEntry}, active: PolicyEntry?, pending: PolicyEntry?, generation: number, seen: any, [string]: any}
function Policy.new(adapter: any): any
    local self: PolicyState={queue={},active=nil,generation=0,seen=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),presence=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})}
    function self.cancel(reason)
        if self.pending and self.pending.evidence then self.seen[self.pending.evidence.token]=false end
        self.generation+=1;table.clear(self.queue);self.active=nil;self.pending=nil
        adapter.release(reason)
    end
    function self.observe(target,track)
        local s=adapter.settings()
        if not s.enabled or not adapter.subscribed(target) then return false end
        if adapter.ignore and adapter.ignore(target,track) then return false end
        local id=track and track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
        local m1=id~=nil and adapter.m1(id)
        local move=not m1 and adapter.actionPriority(track and track.Priority)
        if not ((s.blockM1s and m1) or (s.blockMoves and move)) then return false end
        if adapter.random(1,100)>s.chance then return false end
        if s.facingCheck and not adapter.facing(target,s.sensitivity) then return false end
        if #self.queue>=32 then table.remove(self.queue,1) end
        table.insert(self.queue,{target=target,track=track,kind=if m1 then 'M1' else 'Move',
            due=adapter.now()+adapter.adjustedDelay(s.blockDelay),generation=self.generation})
        return true
    end
    function self.step()
        local s=adapter.settings()
        if not s.enabled then self.cancel('Auto Block is disabled');return end
        -- A physical Block press or another action cancels pending synthetic work.
        -- This is the input-ownership integration boundary, not an extra game bypass.
        if not adapter.available() then
            self.cancel('Native/manual controls own Block')
            -- Manual and automatic Block share one guard: whichever is up
            -- protects. Attacks already seen (and consumed) before your press
            -- must be eligible again when you let go, or the guard would drop
            -- under a live attack. Tokens are re-rolled once control returns.
            if adapter.syncManual and adapter.syncManual() and next(self.seen)~=nil then
                self.seen=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
            end
            return
        end
        if adapter.predict then
            -- Resample ongoing attacks: AnimationPlayed may precede range entry.
            -- One owner handles animation, dash and projectile evidence alike.
            local now=adapter.now()
            local target,reason,projectile,timing,evidence=adapter.predict()
            local active=self.active
            if active and not adapter.owns(active.lease) then self.active=nil;active=nil end
            local token=evidence and evidence.token
            local ignored=adapter.ignore and evidence and evidence.track and adapter.ignore(target,evidence.track)
            local allowed=token and not ignored and (if adapter.allow then adapter.allow(evidence) else ((evidence.kind=='M1' and s.blockM1s) or (evidence.kind~='M1' and s.blockMoves)))
                and not (s.afkCheck and adapter.afk()) and not (s.typingCheck and adapter.typing())
            if token and adapter.staleHold then
                -- A token that keeps reporting long after its contact time (or
                -- far beyond a normal attack) is stale and must not hold Block
                -- forever. The record resets once the token has been absent.
                local seenAt=self.presence[token]
                if not seenAt or now-seenAt.last>.25 then seenAt={first=now,last=now,stale=false};self.presence[token]=seenAt
                else seenAt.last=now end
                if timing and type(timing.remaining)=='number' and timing.remaining<-.4 or now-seenAt.first>adapter.staleHold() then seenAt.stale=true end
                if seenAt.stale then allowed=false end
            end
            if not allowed then target,evidence,token=nil,nil,nil end
            if token and active and active.evidence and active.evidence.token==token then
                active.releaseAt=now+adapter.adjustedDelay(s.unblockDelay)
                adapter.maintain(active)
            elseif token then
                local pending=self.pending
                -- Add-on: while the owned Block is still unblocking and this
                -- attack has started, skip chance, delay and the consumed-token
                -- rule and block at once. Normal Auto Block is unchanged outside it.
                local rush=adapter.reblockWindow~=nil and adapter.reblockWindow(evidence)==true
                if not pending or pending.evidence.token~=token then
                    if rush then self.seen[token]=true
                    elseif self.seen[token]==nil then self.seen[token]=adapter.random(1,100)<=s.chance end
                    if self.seen[token]==true then
                        local delay=adapter.adjustedDelay(s.blockDelay)
                        if rush then delay=if adapter.reblockDelay then adapter.reblockDelay() else 0
                        elseif timing and type(timing.remaining)=='number' then
                            delay=math.min(delay,math.max(0,timing.remaining-adapter.lead()))
                        end
                        pending={target=target,reason=reason,projectile=projectile,timing=timing,evidence=evidence,
                            kind=evidence.kind,due=now+delay,generation=self.generation}
                        self.pending=pending
                        if active then
                            -- A separately proven next punch extends the existing
                            -- native guard through its contact deadline. Do not
                            -- drop Block in the gap between overlapping tokens.
                            active.releaseAt=math.max(active.releaseAt,pending.due+adapter.adjustedDelay(s.unblockDelay))
                            active.startedAt=now
                            adapter.maintain(active)
                        end
                    else self.pending=nil;pending=nil end
                end
                if pending and now>=pending.due then
                    local lease=adapter.press(pending)
                    if lease then
                        self.pending=nil;self.seen[token]=false
                        pending.lease=lease;pending.startedAt=now
                        pending.releaseAt=now+adapter.adjustedDelay(s.unblockDelay)
                        self.active=pending;active=pending
                    else
                        -- A transient refusal (manual input, dash suppression,
                        -- binding briefly unavailable) must not consume the
                        -- token, or this attack is never blocked. Retry a
                        -- bounded number of frames, then give the token up.
                        pending.attempts=(pending.attempts or 0)+1
                        if pending.attempts>=12 then self.pending=nil;self.seen[token]=false end
                    end
                end
            else self.pending=nil end
            local protecting=active and token and (active.evidence.token==token
                or self.pending and self.pending.evidence.token==token)
            local heldFor=now-(active and active.startedAt or now)
            if active and not protecting and ((now>=active.releaseAt and heldFor>=(adapter.minHold and adapter.minHold() or 0)) or heldFor>=adapter.maxHold()) then
                self.active=nil;adapter.release('Incoming attack ended; unblock delay completed')
                if s.punchBack then adapter.punchBack(active.target) end
            end
            return
        end
        adapter.refreshTargets()
        local active=self.active
        if active and not adapter.owns(active.lease) then self.active=nil;active=nil end
        if active and adapter.now()>=active.releaseAt then
            self.active=nil;adapter.release('Configured unblock delay completed')
            if s.punchBack then adapter.punchBack(active.target) end
            active=nil
        end
        if active then return end
        while #self.queue>0 do
            local item=self.queue[1]
            if item.generation~=self.generation or not adapter.subscribed(item.target) then
                table.remove(self.queue,1)
            elseif adapter.now()<item.due then return
            else
                table.remove(self.queue,1)
                if adapter.ignore and adapter.ignore(item.target,item.track) then continue end
                -- Reference checks AFK/typing AFTER the block-delay wait.
                if (s.afkCheck and adapter.afk()) or (s.typingCheck and adapter.typing()) then continue end
                local lease=adapter.press(item)
                if lease then
                    item.lease=lease
                    item.releaseAt=adapter.now()+adapter.adjustedDelay(s.unblockDelay)
                    self.active=item;return
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return self
end
return Policy

end)()
-- Detect replicated incoming attacks and hold the game's saved Block binding.
-- Native blocking rules, unblockable attacks, and replication latency still apply.
local AutoBlock: {[string]: any} = {}

function AutoBlock.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, bindings: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local heartbeat = host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local control: any = {alive = true, enabled = false, range = 10, meleeReach = 6, reactionHorizon = 0.18, focused = true, held = nil, connections = {}, characterConnections = {}, records = {}, animationIds = {}, animationCount = 0, recordCount = 0, ready = false, projectileParts = {}, projectileIndex = {}, projectileModelParts = {}, projectileNames = {}, projectileModelNames = {}, expectedInput = {}, manual = {}, lastProjectileScan = -math.huge, lastThreatAt = -math.huge, latch = nil, maxHold = 8, buffer = 0.08, lastReason = "Auto Block is disabled", downs = 0, ups = 0}
    control.enemyAttackAngle,control.enemyShoulderMargin=220,1.5
    local enemyFacingDot=math.cos(math.rad(control.enemyAttackAngle*.5))
    function control.setEnemyAttackAngle(value: any): boolean
        if type(value)~='number'or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.enemyAttackAngle=math.clamp(value,60,360)
        enemyFacingDot=math.cos(math.rad(control.enemyAttackAngle*.5));return true
    end
    function control.setEnemyShoulderMargin(value: any): boolean
        if type(value)~='number'or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.enemyShoulderMargin=math.clamp(value,0,4);return true
    end
    control.projectileRange=50

    control.hitCountReleaseEnabled=false

    control.blockedHits=0

    control.duringRecoverableStun=false
    control.blockWhileHit=false

    function control.setInstantBlockEnabled(value: any)
        control.instantBlockEnabled=value==true
        if not control.instantBlockEnabled then

        end

    function control.setBlockWhileHit(value) control.blockWhileHit=value==true;control.update() end
    function control.timedContactEnabled() return control.perfectBlockEnabled or control.attackTiming=='Near impact' end
    control.staleHold=5
    control.minHold=.25
    -- Manual and automatic Block cooperate: whichever blocks an attack holds
    -- the guard, and automatic Block takes over again if you release your
    -- key while that attack is still live. Set false for strict manual priority.
    control.manualSync=true
    -- Your own M1 outranks everything: it releases a manual or automatic Block
    -- and pauses the assists, even when Action Overlap would let the two coexist.
    -- Block outranks M1: while a Block is live, your M1 does not override it.
    function control.blockFirstActive(): boolean
        if control.referenceSettings.blockFirst~=true then return false end
        -- M1 Input Override is the explicit "M1 beats Block" switch: Block-first never holds it back.
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.inputPriorityEnabled==true then return false end
        if aim and aim.manualPriority==true and control.manualBlockHeld()~=true then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return info~=nil and info:FindFirstChild('Block')~=nil
    end
    function control.m1Supreme(): boolean
        return control.referenceSettings.manualM1Supreme==true and not control.blockFirstActive()
    end
    -- Auto Block may fill in for a manual hold that did not produce a guard (the
    -- game dropped or refused the press, for example during a stun): if you have
    -- held your Block key for 0.12 s and there is still no Block marker, a proven
    -- incoming attack lets Auto Block press Block itself. A guard that is up stays yours.
    control.autoOverManual=true
    function control.manualOverridable(): boolean
        if not control.autoOverManual or control.referenceSettings.manualBlockLock then return false end
        local down=control.manualDownAt
        if not down or clock()-down<.12 then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return info~=nil and info:FindFirstChild('Block')==nil
    end
    -- An ordinary (non-true) stun no longer stops Auto Block from trying, so a
    -- live M1 is blocked on the first frame the game accepts Block again.
    control.blockAfterStun=true
    -- Keep guarding while ragdolled or getting up. The game still decides
    -- whether a Block press is accepted in that state; this only stops the
    -- assist from refusing to try. Set to false for the old behaviour.
    control.blockWhileDown=true
    function control.ownDown(): boolean
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false end
        local types=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        return (tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')) or 0)>0 or humanoid.PlatformStand==true
            or state==types.Physics or state==types.Ragdoll or state==types.FallingDown
            or state==types.GettingUp or state==types.PlatformStanding
    end
    -- Reach differs by weapon and character, and the game does not publish
    -- it. Use the larger of the melee default and your configured M1 bounds.
    function control.downReach(): number
        local hitbox=menu.m1Hitbox
        local size=hitbox and hitbox.size
        return math.max(control.meleeReach,tonumber(size and size.Z) or 0)
    end
    control.fastLookahead=40
    -- The contact is seen one network trip late, so keep Block up a little
    -- longer after the animation's contact time before calling it finished.
    function control.contactTail(): number
        return .12+math.clamp((tonumber(control.referenceSmoothedPing) or 0)/1000,0,.15)
    end
    control.motion=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    -- Detection window grows with ping so the press can still land before
    -- contact; the policy's own lead already subtracts ping from its delay.
    function control.threatHorizon(): number
        local ping=(tonumber(control.referenceSmoothedPing) or 0)/1000
        return math.clamp(math.max(control.reactionHorizon,control.heartbeatStep+ping+.06),control.reactionHorizon,.6)
    end
    -- Replicated AssemblyLinearVelocity reads zero for CFrame/tween-driven
    -- movers, so sample the part's real displacement and keep the faster one.
    function control.enemyVelocity(part: any): any
        local reported=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local now=clock()
        local position=part.Position
        local sample=control.motion[part]
        if not sample then
            control.motion[part]={position=position,at=now,velocity=host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)}
            return reported
        end
        local elapsed=now-sample.at
        if elapsed>=1/240 then
            local raw=(position-sample.position)/elapsed
            -- Over 1500 studs/s or a stale sample is a teleport, not motion.
            sample.velocity=if elapsed<=.25 and raw.Magnitude<=1500 then raw else host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            sample.position,sample.at=position,now
        end
        if not reported or sample.velocity.Magnitude>reported.Magnitude then return sample.velocity end
        return reported
    end
    control.dashBlockEnabled=true
    control.activeDashRecords={}
    control.dashRecentWindow=10
    control.dashEndHold=0.2
    control.postOwnDashEnabled=false;control.postOwnDashTime=1;control.postOwnDashDelayMs=250
    control.postOwnDashFront=true;control.postOwnDashSide=true
    control.ownDashAnimationIds={}
    function control.ownDashAllowed(side: string?): boolean
        if side=='Front' then return control.postOwnDashFront end
        if side=='Left' or side=='Right' then return control.postOwnDashSide end
        if side=='Back' then return false end
        -- Unclassified native state may use the old behavior only when both
        -- choices are selected; a single choice waits for native direction.
        return control.postOwnDashFront and control.postOwnDashSide
    end
    local function ownDashSide(character: any,track: any?): string?
        local animation=track and track.Animation
        local id=animation and animation.AnimationId and animation.AnimationId:match('%d+')
        if id and control.ownDashAnimationIds[id] then return control.ownDashAnimationIds[id] end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info');local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash')
        if marker then
            for _,name in {'Direction','Side','DashDirection','DashType'} do
                local value=marker:GetAttribute(name)
                if value=='Front' or value=='Left' or value=='Right' or value=='Back' then return value end
            end
        end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local animator=humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
        if animator and type(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks)=='function' then
            for _,playing in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
                local item=playing.Animation
                local playingId=item and item.AnimationId and item.AnimationId:match('%d+')
                if playing.IsPlaying and playingId and control.ownDashAnimationIds[playingId] then return control.ownDashAnimationIds[playingId] end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    control.dashPredictionEnabled=false;control.dashPredictFront=true;control.dashPredictSide=true;control.dashSideRange=10
    control.manualReblockEnabled=false
    -- Add-on: re-block at once when an enemy attack starts while your Block is unblocking.
    control.unblockReblockEnabled=true;control.unblockReblockWindow=.4;control.unblockReblockDelay=0;control.unblockReblockTrace=true
    function control.noteOwnDashPress(character: any)
        if not control.alive or not control.postOwnDashEnabled or not control.focused or character~=player.Character
          or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        -- A request is not a dash. Cooldown/restriction failures never arm Block.
        control.lastOwnDashPressAt=clock()
        return true
    end
    local function confirmOwnDash(character: any,source: string,track: any?)
        if not control.alive or not control.postOwnDashEnabled or not control.focused or character~=player.Character
          or not character.Parent or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return end
        local now=clock()
        local side=ownDashSide(character,track)
        local phase=control.ownDashPhase
        -- AnimationPlayed and InDash are two observations of the same dash.
        if phase and phase.character==character and (track and phase.tracks[track] or now-phase.at<=.1) then
            if track then phase.tracks[track]=true end
            if side then phase.side=side end
            return
        end
        control.ownDashPhase={character=character,at=now,confirmedAt=now,source=source,side=side,
          triggerAt=now+control.postOwnDashDelayMs/1000,tracks={}}
        if track then control.ownDashPhase.tracks[track]=true end
        control.ownDashUntil=nil
    end
    function control.noteOwnDash(character: any,track: any)
        local animation=track and track.Animation
        local id=animation and animation.AnimationId and animation.AnimationId:match('%d+')
        if not track or not track.IsPlaying or (track.Speed or 1)<=0 or not id or not control.ownDashAnimationIds[id] then return end
        confirmOwnDash(character,'Native dash animation',track)
    end
    function control.sampleOwnDash()
        local phase=control.ownDashPhase
        if not control.alive or not control.postOwnDashEnabled or not phase or phase.character~=player.Character then control.ownDashUntil=nil;return end
        if not control.ownDashAllowed(phase.side) then control.ownDashUntil=nil;return end
        if phase.finished or clock()<phase.triggerAt then return end
        -- Start only after the game actually begins a dash, not a key request.
        -- Native Block is attempted even if the game still reports InDash.
        phase.finished=true;phase.startedAt=phase.triggerAt
        control.ownDashUntil=phase.triggerAt+control.postOwnDashTime
    end
    function control.ownDashProtection(): boolean
        return control.alive and control.postOwnDashEnabled and control.ownDashPhase~=nil
            and control.ownDashAllowed(control.ownDashPhase.side)
            and control.ownDashPhase.finished==true and control.ownDashPhase.character==player.Character and clock()<(control.ownDashUntil or -math.huge)
    end

    control.perfectBlockLimit="Server acceptance, replication latency and unexposed contact timing still apply"
    control.perfectAttempts=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    control.heartbeatFrame=0

    control.completedContacts=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})

    local function unBlockable(object: any): boolean
        return object and (object:GetAttribute("Unblockable") == true or object:GetAttribute("Blockable") == false or object:GetAttribute("BlockBreak") == true or object:GetAttribute("BreakBlock") == true)
    end
    local threatKeys={M1='blockM1s',Move='blockMoves',Projectiles='blockProjectiles',Bombs='blockBombs',Bullets='blockBullets',
        ['Move Variants']='blockMoveVariants',Explosions='blockExplosions',Swarms='blockSwarms'}
    local threatAliases={projectile='Projectiles',projectiles='Projectiles',bomb='Bombs',bombs='Bombs',grenade='Bombs',
        bullet='Bullets',bullets='Bullets',variant='Move Variants',['move variants']='Move Variants',explosion='Explosions',explosions='Explosions',swarm='Swarms',swarms='Swarms'}
    local function attr(object,key)
        return object and type(object.GetAttribute)=='function' and object:GetAttribute(key) or nil
    end
    function control.threatOwner(value)
        if type(value)=='number' and type(players.GetPlayerByUserId)=='function' then local owner=players:GetPlayerByUserId(value);return owner and owner.Character end
        if type(value)=='string' then
            local owner=type(players.FindFirstChild)=='function' and players:FindFirstChild(value)
            if owner and owner:IsA('Player') then return owner.Character end
            local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters');return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(value)
        end
        if value and (type(value)=='table' or type(value)=='userdata') and type(value.IsA)=='function' then
            if value:IsA('Player') then return value.Character elseif value:IsA('Model') then return value end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.projectileCategory(source,part,record)
        if record and threatKeys[record.category] then return record.category end
        for _,object in {source or false,part or false} do if object then
            for _,key in {'ThreatCategory','AttackType','ProjectileType'} do
                local value=attr(object,key);local category=type(value)=='string' and threatAliases[value:lower()]
                if category then return category end
            end
            if attr(object,'IsExplosion')==true then return 'Explosions' end
            if attr(object,'IsBomb')==true or attr(object,'Explosive')==true then return 'Bombs' end
            if attr(object,'IsSwarm')==true or attr(object,'SwarmId')~=nil then return 'Swarms' end
            if attr(object,'IsBullet')==true then return 'Bullets' end
            local known=control.projectileKinds and control.projectileKinds[object.Name]
            if known then return known end
        end end
        return 'Projectiles'
    end
    function control.threatCategory(evidence)
        if evidence.category and threatKeys[evidence.category] then return evidence.category end
        if evidence.projectile then local r=evidence.projectile;return control.projectileCategory(r.source,r.part,r) end
        if evidence.kind=='M1' then return 'M1' end
        local animation=evidence.track and evidence.track.Animation
        for _,object in {evidence.skill or false,animation or false} do if object then
            if attr(object,'Variant')==true or type(attr(object,'Variant'))=='string' or attr(object,'MoveVariant')==true then return 'Move Variants' end
            local parent=object.Parent
            for _=1,4 do
                if not parent then break end
                if parent.Name:lower():find('variant',1,true) then return 'Move Variants' end
                parent=parent.Parent
            end
        end end
        return 'Move'
    end
    function control.allowsThreat(evidence)
        if type(evidence)~='table'then return false end
        local settings=control.referenceSettings
        if not settings then return true end
        local key=threatKeys[control.threatCategory(evidence)]
        return key~=nil and settings[key]~=false
    end
    control.projectileKinds={}
    local function indexedCategory(name)
        name=name:lower()
        if name:find('swarm',1,true) then return 'Swarms' end
        if name:find('bullet',1,true) then return 'Bullets' end
        if name:find('bomb',1,true) or name:find('grenade',1,true) then return 'Bombs' end
        if name:find('explosion',1,true) then return 'Explosions' end
        if name:find('projectile',1,true) then return 'Projectiles' end
        return nil
    end
    local function singleContact(object: any): boolean
        return object and (object:GetAttribute("SingleHit")==true or object:GetAttribute("SingleContact")==true or object:GetAttribute("HitCount")==1) or false
    end
    local function normalizedId(id: any): string
        return type(id) == "string" and (id:match("%d+") or id) or ""
    end
    local function dashSide(animation: any): string?
        local side=animation.Name:match('^Dash(.+)$')
        if side=='Front' or side=='Left' or side=='Right' then return side end
        if animation.Name=='Chase' and animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name:lower():find('melee',1,true) then return 'Front' end
        return nil
    end
    local function animationType(animation: any): string?
        local name = animation.Name:lower()
        if unBlockable(animation) then return "Ignore" end
        if animation:GetAttribute("Blockable") ~= true and (name == "down" or name:find("downslam",1,true) or name:find("unblockable",1,true) or name:find("blockbreak",1,true) or name:find("domain",1,true)) then return "Ignore" end
        local parent = animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name:lower() or ""
        if name:match("^melee%d+[_%d]*$") or ((name == "up" or name == "chase") and parent:find("melee",1,true)) then return "M1" end
        if dashSide(animation) then return 'Dash' end
        if animation:GetAttribute("Blockable") == true then return "Move" end
        -- Generic skill evidence requires an active native InSkill marker too.
        for _, excluded in {"idle","walk","run","block","stun","ragdoll","death","ultimate","counter","adapt","hit","react","dodge"} do
            if name:find(excluded,1,true) then return nil end
        end
        local ancestor = animation.Parent
        while ancestor and ancestor.Parent do
            if ancestor.Name == "Misc" then return nil end
            if ancestor.Parent.Name == "Animations" then return "Move" end
            ancestor = ancestor.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.isEmoteTrack(model,track)
        local animation=track and track.Animation
        local id=animation and normalizedId(animation.AnimationId)
        local descriptor=id and control.animationIds[id]
        -- A native basic-attack/dash identity is stronger than a shared pose ID.
        -- Other concurrent real attacks keep their independent track evidence.
        if descriptor and (descriptor.kind=='M1' or descriptor.kind=='Dash') then return false end
        if animation and type(animation.GetAttribute)=='function' and animation:GetAttribute('Blockable')==true then return false end
        local names=menu.moveNames
        return names and names.isEmoteTrack and names.isEmoteTrack(model,track)==true or false
    end
    function control.indexAnimation(animation: any)
        if not animation:IsA("Animation") then return end
        local id, category = normalizedId(animation.AnimationId), animationType(animation)
        local ownSide=animation.Name:match('^Dash(.+)$')
        if id~='' and (ownSide=='Front' or ownSide=='Left' or ownSide=='Right' or ownSide=='Back' or dashSide(animation)=='Front') then control.ownDashAnimationIds[id]=ownSide or 'Front' end
        if id == "" or not category then return end
        local existing = control.animationIds[id]
        if not existing or category == "Ignore" or (category == "M1" and existing.kind ~= "Ignore") then
            local meleeFolder=animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name:lower():find("melee",1,true)
            local counterKind=if category=="Ignore" then (if meleeFolder and (animation.Name:lower()=="down" or animation.Name:lower():find("downslam",1,true)) then "M1" else nil) else category
            control.animationIds[id] = {kind = category, counterKind = counterKind, name = animation.Name,dashSide=dashSide(animation)}
            if not existing then control.animationCount += 1 end
        end
    end
    local animations = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Animations")
    if animations then
        for _, animation in animations:GetDescendants() do control.indexAnimation(animation) end
        table.insert(control.connections, animations.DescendantAdded:Connect(control.indexAnimation))
    end

    local function cloneBinding(binding: any): any
        if not binding then return nil end
        return {kind = binding.kind, name = binding.name, modifier = cloneBinding(binding.modifier)}
    end
    local function sameBinding(a: any, b: any): boolean
        if not a or not b then return a == b end
        return a.kind == b.kind and a.name == b.name and sameBinding(a.modifier, b.modifier)
    end
    local function inputHeld(binding: any): boolean
        local down = if binding.kind == "Mouse" then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name]) else input:IsKeyDown(host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name])
        return down and (not binding.modifier or inputHeld(binding.modifier))
    end
    local function signature(binding: any): string
        return binding.kind..":"..binding.name
    end
    local function sendOwned(_binding: any, down: boolean)
        if down then
            local tool=control.nativeTool
            if not tool or type(tool.Block)~="function" then return false,"Native ToolController.Block is unavailable" end
            return pcall(tool.Block,tool)
        end
        local service=control.nativeBlock
        if not service or not service.Deactivated or type(service.Deactivated.Fire)~="function" then
            return false,"Native BlockService.Deactivated is unavailable"
        end
        return pcall(service.Deactivated.Fire,service.Deactivated)
    end
    local function nativeInput(object: any): any
        local kind = object.UserInputType and object.UserInputType.Name or ""
        if kind:match("^MouseButton[123]$") then return {kind="Mouse",name=kind} end
        local key = object.KeyCode
        if key and key.Name ~= "Unknown" and key.Name ~= "None" then return {kind="Keyboard",name=key.Name} end
        return nil
    end
    local previousManual = bindings.manualBlockHeld
    local manualReader
    manualReader = function(requested: any): boolean
        if previousManual then local ok,held=pcall(previousManual,requested);if ok and held then return true end end
        local current=requested or bindings.get("Block")
        if not current then return false end
        local key=signature(current)
        if control.manual[key]==true then
            if inputHeld(current)then return true end
            -- Focus loss can omit InputEnded. Cached input is not a permanent
            -- physical lease once the current saved binding is released.
            control.manual[key]=nil
            if sameBinding(current,bindings.get('Block'))then
                control.manualOwnsHeld=false;control.manualBlockObserved=nil
                control.manualForwardCharacter=nil
            end
        end
        if not control.held and not control.releasing and inputHeld(current) then
            control.manual[signature(current)]=true
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    bindings.manualBlockHeld=manualReader
    function control.manualBlockHeld(binding: any): boolean return manualReader(binding) end
    local function reconcileManualInputs()
        table.clear(control.manual)
        local current=bindings.get('Block')
        local held=current and not control.held and not control.releasing and inputHeld(current)
        control.manualOwnsHeld=held==true
        if held then control.manual[signature(current)]=true end
        control.manualBlockObserved=nil;control.manualForwardCharacter=nil
    end
    local function overlapAllows(context: string): boolean
        local overlap=menu.actionOverlap
        return overlap~=nil and type(overlap.allows)=='function' and overlap.allows('Block',context)==true
    end
    function control.blockDashConcurrent(): boolean
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        if menu.actionOverlap and not overlapAllows('Dash') then return false end
        return dash~=nil and type(dash.blockDashConcurrent)=='function' and dash.blockDashConcurrent()==true
    end
    function control.blockDashSuppressed(): boolean
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        if dash and type(dash.blockDashUnblocking)=='function' then return dash.blockDashUnblocking()==true end
        local pending=dash and dash.blockDashPending
        return pending~=nil and (pending.phase=='Unblocking' or pending.phase=='AwaitingDash') or false
    end
    control.blockDashBlockRequests,control.blockDashBlockAccepted=0,0
    control.lastBlockDashBlockState='No concurrent native Block request'
    function control.observeBlockDashAcceptance()
        local attempt=control.blockDashBlockAttempt
        if not attempt then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local now=clock()
        if character~=attempt.character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or character:GetAttribute('Dead')==true
            or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) or not control.focused then
            control.blockDashBlockAttempt=nil;control.lastBlockDashBlockState='Concurrent Block observation cancelled';return
        end
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')
        if marker and marker~=attempt.priorBlock and control.blockDashConcurrent() then
            if marker~=control.blockDashAcceptedMarker then
                control.blockDashBlockAccepted+=1;control.blockDashAcceptedMarker=marker
                control.blockDashBlockProof={character=character,marker=marker,at=now,requestedAt=attempt.at}
            end
            control.blockDashBlockAttempt=nil;control.lastBlockDashBlockState='Native Block observed during active dash'
        elseif now<attempt.at or now-attempt.at>.6 or not control.blockDashConcurrent() then
            control.blockDashBlockAttempt=nil;control.lastBlockDashBlockState='Native Block was not confirmed during dash'
        end
    end
    function control.getBlockDashStatus(): any
        local proof=control.blockDashBlockProof
        return {requests=control.blockDashBlockRequests,accepted=control.blockDashBlockAccepted,
            state=control.lastBlockDashBlockState,concurrent=control.blockDashConcurrent(),
            awaiting=control.blockDashBlockAttempt~=nil,lastAcceptedAt=proof and proof.at}
    end
    -- Emergency Guard: a safety net for an accidental M1. While a proven attack is about
    -- to land, your M1 no longer overrides Auto Block, so the guard still comes up.
    -- Dash input is never affected. Checked once per frame.
    control.emergencyGuard=true
    control.emergencyWindow=.35
    function control.setEmergencyGuard(value: any)
        control.emergencyGuard=value==true;control.emergencyFrame=nil;return true
    end
    function control.setEmergencyWindow(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.emergencyWindow=math.clamp(amount,50,1000)/1000;control.emergencyFrame=nil;return true
    end
    -- Block after your own M1: the game lets a guard come up out of an M1's recovery, but the swing's
    -- Melee/Attacking marker used to keep Auto Block waiting for the whole animation. Once this long has
    -- passed since your swing began, a proven incoming attack may raise the guard through that marker.
    control.m1BlockCancel,control.m1CancelDelay=true,.1
    function control.setM1BlockCancel(value: any)control.m1BlockCancel=value==true;return true end
    function control.setM1CancelDelay(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.m1CancelDelay=math.clamp(amount,0,500)/1000;return true
    end
    function control.m1CancelOpen(): boolean
        if not control.m1BlockCancel then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local last=character and tonumber(character:GetAttribute('LastM1'))
        if not last or last<=0 then return false end
        local okay,server=pcall(host.workspace.GetServerTimeNow,host.workspace)
        if not okay or type(server)~='number' then return false end
        return server-last>=control.m1CancelDelay
    end
    function control.emergencyActive(): boolean
        if not control.emergencyGuard or not control.alive or control.emergencyBusy then return false end
        local frame=control.heartbeatFrame
        if control.emergencyFrame==frame then return control.emergencyValue==true end
        control.emergencyBusy=true
        local okay,target,_,_,timing,evidence=pcall(control.findThreat)
        control.emergencyBusy=false
        control.emergencyInfo=if okay and target~=nil then {target=target,timing=timing,evidence=evidence}else nil
        local value=okay and target~=nil and type(timing)=='table' and type(timing.remaining)=='number' and timing.remaining<=control.emergencyWindow
        control.emergencyFrame,control.emergencyValue=frame,value==true
        return value==true
    end
    function control.m1OverrideActive(): boolean
        if overlapAllows('M1') and not control.m1Supreme() then return false end
        if control.emergencyActive() then return false end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        return control.alive and aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput()=='M1' or false
    end
    function control.manualActionHeld(pressed: any?): boolean
        if menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or not control.focused then return false end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        local m1Priority=aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput()=='M1'and(not overlapAllows('M1') or control.m1Supreme())
        local blockFirst=control.blockFirstActive()
        if m1Priority and not pressed then return true end
        if manualReader()and not m1Priority then return false end
        local melee=menu.m1Assist
        -- A held M1 may own the next combat request, but an unrelated Jump
        -- input is not another M1 press. Match its actual native binding below.
        if not blockFirst and(m1Priority or melee and melee.userM1Held and melee.userM1Held())and(not overlapAllows('M1') or control.m1Supreme())then
            if not pressed then return true end
            local keybinds=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Keybind')
            local combat=keybinds and keybinds:FindFirstChild('Combat')
            local action=combat and combat:FindFirstChild('Melee')
            local mouseNames={MouseLeftButton='MouseButton1',MouseRightButton='MouseButton2',MouseMiddleButton='MouseButton3'}
            if action then for _,binding in action:GetDescendants() do
                if binding:IsA('InputBinding') then
                    local key=binding.KeyCode
                    local name=key and key.Name
                    if name and (mouseNames[name] or name)==pressed.name then return true end
                end
            end end
        end
        for _,role in {'Dash','Move1','Move2','Move3','Move4','Special'} do
            local binding=bindings.get(role)
            local context=if role=='Dash' then 'Dash' else 'Skill'
            if not overlapAllows(context) and binding and (not pressed or signature(binding)==signature(pressed)) and inputHeld(binding) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.forwardManualBlock(freshPress: boolean?): boolean
        if control.blockDashSuppressed() then return false end
        if control.m1OverrideActive() then return false end
        if not control.instantBlockEnabled then return false end
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then return false end
        local binding=bindings.get('Block')
        if not binding or not manualReader(binding) or not inputHeld(binding) then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not info then return false end
        if not freshPress and info:FindFirstChild('Block') then control.manualForwardCharacter=nil;return true end
        if (control.manualForwardAttempts or 0)>=16 then return false end
        control.manualForwardAttempts=(control.manualForwardAttempts or 0)+1
        control.manualForwardCharacter=character
        -- A fresh physical request has no script delay or automatic-block gate.
        -- Native animation, cooldown and busy-state acceptance remain unchanged.
        local ok,detail=sendOwned(binding,true)
        control.manualRecoveryAt=clock()
        if player.Character==character and info.Parent==character and info:FindFirstChild('Block') then control.manualForwardCharacter=nil end
        control.lastReason=if ok then 'Forwarded your physical Block immediately' else 'Native manual Block request failed: '..tostring(detail)
        return ok
    end
    function control.ownBlockRecovery(): boolean
        local anti=menu.antiStunSpeed
        return anti~=nil and type(anti.blockRecoveryEligible)=='function' and anti.blockRecoveryEligible(player.Character)==true
    end
    function control.retryManualRecovery(): boolean
        if control.blockDashSuppressed() then return false end
        if control.m1OverrideActive() then return false end
        -- Physical guard ownership remains with the player. Never synthesize
        -- a key, acquire an automatic lease, or issue an automatic release.
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() or not control.nativeReady
            or not control.ownBlockRecovery() then return false end
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        if punish and punish.pauseAutomaticBlock and punish.pauseAutomaticBlock()==true then return false end
        if bindings.blockSuppressed then
            local ok,blocked=pcall(bindings.blockSuppressed)
            if not ok or blocked then return false end
        end
        local current=bindings.get('Block')
        if not current or not manualReader(current) or not inputHeld(current) then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info or info:FindFirstChild('Block')
            or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')) or 0)>0 or character:GetAttribute('TrueStun')==true
            or character:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then return false end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
            or state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp
            or state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then return false end
        if (control.manualRecoveryAttempts or 0)>=16 or clock()-(control.manualRecoveryAt or -math.huge)<0.04 then return false end
        control.manualRecoveryAt=clock();control.manualRecoveryAttempts=(control.manualRecoveryAttempts or 0)+1
