        local ok,detail=sendOwned(current,true)
        control.lastReason=if ok then 'Resubmitted your held native Block immediately after your action' else 'Native manual Block retry failed: '..tostring(detail)
        return ok
    end
    function control.noteOwnActionEnded(character: any)
        if not control.alive or character~=player.Character then return end
        control.manualRecoveryAt=nil;control.manualRecoveryAttempts=0
        control.recoveryRearmAttempts=0;control.rearmFailedLatch=nil
        -- The end notification comes from an actual native InSkill/InDash
        -- instance being removed, never from a requested input on cooldown.
        control.update()
    end
    control.inputObservationReady=true
    local function observeInput(object: any, down: boolean, processed: boolean?)
        local binding=nativeInput(object)
        if not binding then return end
        local key=signature(binding)
        local dashBinding=bindings.get('Dash')
        local isDashInput=dashBinding~=nil and key==signature(dashBinding)
        if down and not processed and not (menu.isMenuInput and menu.isMenuInput(object))
            and control.manualActionHeld(binding) and not (not isDashInput and control.emergencyActive()) then
            if control.m1OverrideActive() then control.releaseForM1() else control.release() end
            control.latch=nil
            control.manualActionYieldUntil=clock()+0.05
            control.lastReason='Your attack or dash input released Auto Block immediately'
        end
        local dash=bindings.get('Dash')
        if down and not processed and dash and key==signature(dash) and not (menu.isMenuInput and menu.isMenuInput(object)) then
            control.noteOwnDashPress(player.Character)
        end
        control.lastObservedInput={object=object,down=down,synthetic=false,key=key}
        control.manual[key]=if down then true else nil
        local current=bindings.get("Block")
        if current and key==signature(current) then
            if down then
                control.manualBlockObserved=nil
                control.manualReblockPending=nil
                control.manualRecoveryAt=clock();control.manualRecoveryAttempts=0
                control.manualDownAt=clock()
                control.lastReason="Manual saved Block input has priority"
            end
            -- Auto Block never synthesizes input; this observed saved key press
            -- belongs to the player and owns the native block until release.
            if down then
                -- Hand ownership to the physical key in this input callback,
                -- before another heartbeat/perfect-block release can run.
                control.manualOwnsHeld=true
                control.held=nil;control.heldBinding=nil;control.deferredRelease=nil
                control.heldThreat=nil;control.latch=nil;control.activeDashThreat=nil
                control.holdReleasePending=nil;control.perfectPending=nil;control.perfectHeldToken=nil
                control.blockedHits=0;control.hitSequenceUntil=nil
                local punish=menu.autoPunish
                if punish and punish.cancelForManualBlock then pcall(punish.cancelForManualBlock) end
                if bindings.noteManualBlockPress then pcall(bindings.noteManualBlockPress) end
                local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
                if aim and aim.cancelForManualBlock then pcall(aim.cancelForManualBlock) end
                local approach=menu.m1Approach
                if approach and approach.cancelForManualBlock then pcall(approach.cancelForManualBlock) end
                control.manualForwardAttempts=0
                if not (menu.isMenuInput and menu.isMenuInput(object)) then control.forwardManualBlock(true) end
            end
            if not down then
                control.manualForwardCharacter=nil;control.manualForwardAttempts=0
                control.manualRecoveryAt=nil;control.manualRecoveryAttempts=0;control.manualDownAt=nil
                control.manualOwnsHeld=false;control.held=nil;control.heldBinding=nil
                local character=player.Character
                local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                if control.manualReblockEnabled and control.enabled and
                  (control.manualBlockObserved==character or info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')) then
                    control.manualReblockPending={character=character,at=clock(),frame=control.heartbeatFrame+1}
                    control.latch=nil;control.heldThreat=nil;control.holdReleasePending=nil
                    control.perfectPending=nil;control.contactReleaseFrame=nil
                end
                control.manualBlockObserved=nil
            end
        end
        if not down then
            local deferred=control.deferredRelease
            -- The native physical release already submits Block.Deactivated.
            -- Clear a transferred automatic lease without a second release.
            if deferred and signature(deferred)==key then control.deferredRelease=nil end
        end
    end
    if input.InputBegan then table.insert(control.connections,input.InputBegan:Connect(function(object,processed) observeInput(object,true,processed) end)) end
    if input.InputEnded then table.insert(control.connections,input.InputEnded:Connect(function(object) observeInput(object,false) end)) end
    function control.release()
        if control.referencePolicy and not control.referenceReleasing then
            control.referencePolicy.generation+=1
            table.clear(control.referencePolicy.queue);control.referencePolicy.active=nil
            control.referenceAimTarget=nil
        end
        control.manualReblockPending=nil;control.manualReblockNow=false
        local owned = control.held
        control.blockedHits=0;control.hitSequenceUntil=nil
        control.holdReleasePending=nil;control.heldStartedAt=nil
        control.perfectPending=nil;control.perfectHeldToken=nil
        control.heldThreat=nil
        control.activeDashThreat=nil
        control.releasing=true
        control.held = nil
        control.heldBinding = nil
        control.blockStunUntil=nil;control.blockStunCharacter=nil;control.rearmAttempts=0
        if owned then
            if control.manualOwnsHeld or control.manual[signature(owned)]==true or manualReader() then
                control.deferredRelease=owned
                control.lastReason="Manual Block priority preserved without automatic release"
            else
                sendOwned(owned,false)
                control.ups += 1
            end
        end
        control.releasing=false
    end
    local function releaseAfterHold(reason: string?)
        -- Dash-only protection has its own deadline from the actual track end,
        -- rather than the generic minimum measured from the initial press.
        if control.heldThreat and (control.heldThreat.kind=='Dash' or control.heldThreat.kind=='OwnDash') then
            control.release();if reason then control.lastReason=reason end;return
        end
        if control.held and clock()<(control.heldStartedAt or control.lastPressAt or clock())+control.holdTime then
            control.holdReleasePending={reason=reason}
            control.lastReason="Keeping owned Block for the configured minimum hold time"
            return
        end
        control.release()
        if reason then control.lastReason=reason end
    end
    function control.releaseForPunish(): (boolean, any)
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        if not control.alive or not punish or type(punish.pauseAutomaticBlock)~="function"
          or not punish.pauseAutomaticBlock() then return false,"No active Auto Punish handoff" end
        -- The user requested an unblock even for a physically held manual
        -- guard. Leave manual observations intact so the original guard can
        -- resume after the bounded punish, without a deferred second release.
        control.releasing=true
        control.held=nil;control.heldBinding=nil;control.deferredRelease=nil
        control.blockedHits=0;control.hitSequenceUntil=nil
        control.holdReleasePending=nil;control.heldStartedAt=nil
        control.manualOwnsHeld=false
        control.perfectPending=nil;control.perfectHeldToken=nil
        control.heldThreat=nil
        control.blockStunUntil=nil;control.blockStunCharacter=nil
        control.rearmAttempts=0;control.rearmFailedLatch=nil
        local ok,detail=sendOwned(nil,false)
        control.releasing=false
        if ok then control.ups+=1 end
        return ok,detail
    end
    function control.releaseForM1(): boolean
        if not control.m1OverrideActive() then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')
        local previous=control.m1InterruptedBlock
        if previous and previous.character==character then return true end
        if not marker and not control.held and not control.manualOwnsHeld and not manualReader() then return true end
        -- M1 explicitly interrupts both physical and automatic guard ownership.
        -- Keep actual key observations intact; never synthesize a key release.
        control.held=nil;control.heldBinding=nil;control.manualOwnsHeld=false
        control.deferredRelease=nil;control.manualForwardCharacter=nil
        control.release();control.latch=nil
        local ok,detail=sendOwned(nil,false)
        if ok then
            control.ups+=1;control.m1InterruptedBlock={character=character}
            control.lastReason='M1 interrupted Block'
        else control.lastReason='M1 unblock request failed: '..tostring(detail) end
        return ok
    end
    function control.releaseForDash(): (boolean, any)
        if not control.alive or not control.blockDashSuppressed() then return false,'No active Block-to-dash handoff' end
        local character=player.Character
        local binding=bindings.get('Block')
        local resume=binding and manualReader(binding) and inputHeld(binding)
        -- The held key remains a physical observation. Release the actual
        -- native guard once; no synthetic key-up and no local marker deletion.
        control.blockDashInterrupted={character=character,binding=if resume then cloneBinding(binding) else nil}
        control.blockDashBlockAttempt=nil
        control.held=nil;control.heldBinding=nil;control.deferredRelease=nil;control.manualOwnsHeld=false
        control.manualForwardCharacter=nil;control.manualForwardAttempts=0
        control.manualReblockPending=nil;control.manualReblockNow=false
        control.heldThreat=nil;control.latch=nil;control.activeDashThreat=nil
        control.holdReleasePending=nil;control.perfectPending=nil;control.perfectHeldToken=nil
        control.heldStartedAt=nil;control.blockedHits=0;control.hitSequenceUntil=nil
        control.blockStunUntil=nil;control.blockStunCharacter=nil
        if control.referencePolicy then
            control.referencePolicy.generation+=1
            table.clear(control.referencePolicy.queue);control.referencePolicy.active=nil
        end
        control.referenceAimTarget=nil
        local ok,detail=sendOwned(nil,false)
        if ok then control.ups+=1;control.lastReason='Your dash released the native Block guard' end
        return ok,detail
    end
    function control.syncBlockDash()
        if control.blockDashSuppressed() then return end
        control.observeBlockDashAcceptance()
        local interrupted=control.blockDashInterrupted
        if not interrupted then return end
        if interrupted.character~=player.Character or not interrupted.binding or not sameBinding(interrupted.binding,bindings.get('Block')) or not inputHeld(interrupted.binding)
            or not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) or control.m1OverrideActive() then control.blockDashInterrupted=nil;return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not info or character:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then control.blockDashInterrupted=nil;return end
        local states=host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        if states and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' then
            local state=humanoid:GetState()
            if state==states.Dead then control.blockDashInterrupted=nil;return end
            if state==states.Physics or state==states.Ragdoll or state==states.FallingDown or state==states.GettingUp then return end
        end
        if humanoid.PlatformStand then return end
        local concurrent=control.blockDashConcurrent()
        local stun=info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
        local selfBusy=stun and stun:IsA('BoolValue') and stun.Value==false and character:GetAttribute('Stun')~=true
            and (concurrent or info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') and overlapAllows('Skill')
                or (info:FindFirstChild('Melee') or info:FindFirstChild('Attacking')) and overlapAllows('M1'))
        for _,name in {'Stun','TrueStun','Knockback','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Downed','InSkill','InDash','Dash','DomainClash'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            local allowed=concurrent and (name=='InDash' or name=='Dash') or name=='InSkill' and overlapAllows('Skill')
                or name=='Stun' and selfBusy
            if not allowed and (value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0) or info:FindFirstChild(name)) then return end
        end
        control.manualOwnsHeld=true
        control.manualForwardAttempts=0;control.manualRecoveryAttempts=0;control.manualRecoveryAt=nil
        if concurrent then
            if not info:FindFirstChild('Block') and (interrupted.attempts or 0)<6
                and clock()>=(interrupted.nextAttemptAt or -math.huge) then
                interrupted.attempts=(interrupted.attempts or 0)+1;interrupted.nextAttemptAt=clock()+.06
                sendOwned(interrupted.binding,true)
            end
        else
            control.blockDashInterrupted=nil
            if not info:FindFirstChild('Block') then sendOwned(interrupted.binding,true) end
        end
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        control.blockDashInterrupted=nil
        control.blockDashBlockAttempt=nil
        if control.cancelPunchBack then control.cancelPunchBack('Failsafe paused retaliation') end
    end
    function control.syncM1Override()
        if control.blockDashSuppressed() then return end
        if control.m1OverrideActive() then control.releaseForM1();return end
        local interrupted=control.m1InterruptedBlock
        if not interrupted then return end
        control.m1InterruptedBlock=nil
        local binding=bindings.get('Block')
        if control.focused and not menu.recording and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            and not (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen())
            and interrupted.character==player.Character and binding and inputHeld(binding) then
            -- Resume the still-held physical guard through its normal controller.
            control.manualOwnsHeld=true;sendOwned(binding,true)
        end
    end
    local function suppressed(): boolean
        if control.blockDashSuppressed() then return true end
        if bindings.blockSuppressed then
            local ok, result = pcall(bindings.blockSuppressed)
            if not ok or result then return true end
        end
        local punish = menu.autoPunish
        return punish and punish.pauseAutomaticBlock and punish.pauseAutomaticBlock() == true or false
    end
    function control.permitted(ignoreTyping: boolean?): boolean
        local circling=menu.frontDash
        if circling and circling.circlingActive and circling.circlingActive() then control.lastReason='Dash circling has priority';return false end
        if control.m1OverrideActive() then control.lastReason='M1 First priority';return false end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then return false end
        if not control.alive or (not control.enabled and not control.ownDashProtection()) or not control.focused or menu.recording or (not ignoreTyping and input:GetFocusedTextBox()) or suppressed() or (manualReader() and not control.manualOverridable()) then return false end
        -- Yield for the fresh press, not for the entire physical hold. Native
        -- action markers below govern the action itself and its completion.
        if clock()<(control.manualActionYieldUntil or -math.huge) and not control.emergencyActive() then control.lastReason='Brief handoff for your new attack or dash input';return false end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid, info = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local down = control.blockWhileDown and control.ownDown()
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or (humanoid.PlatformStand and not down) or not info or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return false end
        local state = humanoid:GetState()
        if state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then return false end
        if not down and (state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or state == host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) then return false end
        if ((tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0) > 0 and not down) or character:GetAttribute("TrueStun") == true or character:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then return false end
        local blocking = info:FindFirstChild("Block") ~= nil
        local confirmedBlockStun=control.held~=nil and control.blockStunCharacter==character and clock()<(control.blockStunUntil or -math.huge)
        local anti=menu.antiStunSpeed
        local recoverable=control.blockWhileHit or control.ownBlockRecovery() or down or (control.duringRecoverableStun and anti and anti.enabled==true)
            or (control.blockAfterStun and character:GetAttribute("TrueStun")~=true)
        local concurrent=control.blockDashConcurrent()
        local stun=info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
        local selfBusy=stun and stun:IsA('BoolValue') and stun.Value==false and character:GetAttribute('Stun')~=true
            and (concurrent or info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') and overlapAllows('Skill')
                or (info:FindFirstChild('Melee') or info:FindFirstChild('Attacking')) and overlapAllows('M1'))
        if (character:GetAttribute("Stun") == true or stun) and not selfBusy and not blocking and not confirmedBlockStun and not recoverable then return false end
        for _, name in {"TrueStun","Knockback","InSkill","InDash","Dash","DomainClash","Attacking","Melee"} do
            local allowed=(name=='InDash' or name=='Dash') and concurrent or name=='InSkill' and overlapAllows('Skill')
                or (name=='Attacking' or name=='Melee') and (overlapAllows('M1') or control.emergencyActive() or control.m1CancelOpen())
            if not allowed and info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        if character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true and not concurrent then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function hostile(model: any): boolean
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(model)) then return false end
        if not model or model == player.Character or not model.Parent then return false end
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return false end
        local targetPlayer = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        -- Optional: leave NPCs (robots, decoys, summons, anything that is not a
        -- real player's character) alone, for Auto Block and its projectile owners.
        if control.referenceSettings.ignoreNpcs and not targetPlayer then return false end
        if targetPlayer and player.Team and targetPlayer.Team == player.Team and not player.Neutral and not targetPlayer.Neutral then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function facing(root: any, position: any, threshold: number): boolean
        local difference = position-root.Position
        local horizontal = host.Vector3.new(difference.X,0,difference.Z)
        local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
        look = host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        return horizontal.Magnitude <= 0.05 or (look.Magnitude > 0.05 and look.Unit:Dot(horizontal.Unit) >= threshold)
    end
    -- Console trace of every hit you take (and what Auto Block was doing), with
    -- each nearby enemy's relative angles and its Info markers. Used to find
    -- which in-game markers and angles precede the hits that get through.
    -- Set control.angleTrace=false to silence it.
    control.angleTrace=true
    function control.traceHit()
        if not control.angleTrace then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not humanoid or not root then control.traceHealthValue=nil;return end
        local previous=control.traceHealthValue
        control.traceHealthValue=humanoid.Health
        if not previous or humanoid.Health>=previous-0.01 then return end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local ownMarkers={}
        if info then for _,child in info:GetChildren() do table.insert(ownMarkers,child.Name) end end
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
        local ownLook=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        local rows={}
        for model,record in control.records do
            local other=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if other and (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=20 then
                local to=other.Position-root.Position
                local flat=host.Vector3.new(to.X,0,to.Z)
                local distance=flat.Magnitude
                local ourAngle,theirAngle=0,0
                if distance>.05 and ownLook.Magnitude>.05 then
                    ourAngle=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(ownLook.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit),-1,1)))
                    local theirLook=other.CFrame.LookVector
                    local theirFlat=host.Vector3.new(theirLook.X,0,theirLook.Z)
                    if theirFlat.Magnitude>.05 then theirAngle=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(theirFlat.Unit:Dot(-flat.Unit),-1,1))) end
                end
                local markers={}
                local enemyInfo=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
                if enemyInfo then for _,child in enemyInfo:GetChildren() do table.insert(markers,child.Name) end end
                local tracks=0
                for _ in record.tracks do tracks+=1 end
                table.insert(rows,string.format('%s dist=%.1f behindYou=%.0f° enemyAimOff=%.0f° elev=%.0f° turn=%.0f°/s anims=%d markers=[%s]',
                    model.Name,distance,ourAngle,theirAngle,math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y,math.max(distance,.01))),
                    math.deg(control.enemyYawRate(other)),tracks,table.concat(markers,',')))
            end
        end
        trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] HIT TAKEN -%.0f hp | autoBlockHeld=%s ownBlockMarker=%s reason=%s | you=[%s] | enemies: %s',
            previous-humanoid.Health,tostring(control.held~=nil),tostring(info~=nil and info:FindFirstChild('Block')~=nil),
            tostring(control.lastReason),table.concat(ownMarkers,','),if #rows>0 then table.concat(rows,' || ') else 'none within 20 studs'))
    end
    -- Measured turn rate of an enemy (radians/second), so a fast-turning enemy
    -- can be treated as facing you before its heading has finished the turn.
    control.yawMotion=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    function control.enemyYawRate(root: any): number
        local now=clock()
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
        local yaw=math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z)
        local sample=control.yawMotion[root]
        if not sample or now<sample.at or now-sample.at>.25 then
            control.yawMotion[root]={yaw=yaw,at=now,rate=0};return 0
        end
        local elapsed=now-sample.at
        if elapsed>=1/240 then
            local change=math.atan2(math.sin(yaw-sample.yaw),math.cos(yaw-sample.yaw))
            sample.rate+=(change/elapsed-sample.rate)*(1-math.exp(-elapsed/.05))
            sample.yaw,sample.at=yaw,now
        end
        return sample.rate
    end
    function control.enemyFacing(root: any,position: any,sensitivity: number?): boolean
        if not root or not root.Position or not root.CFrame or not root.CFrame.LookVector or not position then return false end
        local settings=control.referenceSettings
        if settings and settings.facingCheck==false then return true end
        local amount=if sensitivity~=nil then sensitivity else settings and settings.sensitivity or 0
        if type(amount)~='number'or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        local threshold=enemyFacingDot+(1-enemyFacingDot)*math.clamp(amount,0,1)
        if facing(root,position,threshold) then return true end
        -- A fast-turning enemy swings onto you within the reaction window, so
        -- check where it will point instead of dropping an attack from an odd angle.
        local rate=control.enemyYawRate(root)
        if math.abs(rate)<math.rad(120) then return false end
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
        local yaw=math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z)+rate*control.threatHorizon()
        local difference=position-root.Position
        local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(difference.X,0,difference.Z)
        if horizontal.Magnitude<=0.05 then return true end
        return host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw),0,-math.cos(yaw)):Dot(horizontal.Unit)>=threshold
    end
    local function enemyMeleeSweep(root: any,position: any): boolean
        if not root or not root.Position or not root.CFrame or not root.CFrame.LookVector then return false end
        local delta=position-root.Position
        if math.abs(delta.Y)>6 then return false end
        local flat=host.Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector;look=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if look.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
        local forward=flat:Dot(look.Unit)
        local lateral=math.sqrt(math.max(0,flat.Magnitude^2-forward^2))
        return forward>=-(.5+control.enemyShoulderMargin)and lateral<=3.5+control.enemyShoulderMargin
    end

    local function discardTrack(record: any, track: any)
        local state = record.tracks[track]
        record.tracks[track] = nil
        if state and state.stopped then state.stopped:Disconnect() end
        local phase=record.dashPhase
        if phase and phase.tracks[track] then
            phase.tracks[track]=nil
            if next(phase.tracks)==nil and not phase.endedAt then phase.endedAt=clock() end
        end
    end
    local function pairM1Swing(record: any,track: any,state: any,swing: any)
        if not swing or not state or state.descriptor.kind~='M1' or state.nativeSwing or swing.trackState
            or control.completedContacts[swing] or math.abs(state.at-swing.at)>.22 then return end
        state.nativeSwing=swing;swing.trackState=state;swing.track=track
    end
    local function rememberM1Contact(record: any,evidence: any)
        local stamp=evidence.lastM1 or evidence.stamp
        if stamp then record.blockedLastM1=math.max(record.blockedLastM1 or stamp,stamp)end
        record.unstampedM1Contact=not stamp
    end
    function control.onAnimation(record: any, track: any, animationPlayed: boolean?)
        if control.isEmoteTrack(record.model,track) then discardTrack(record,track);return end
        local animation = track.Animation
        local descriptor = animation and control.animationIds[normalizedId(animation.AnimationId)]
        if not descriptor and animation and control.referenceM1Ids and control.referenceM1Ids[animation.AnimationId] then
            descriptor={kind='M1',counterKind='M1',name=animation.Name}
        end
        if not descriptor and menu.moveNames and menu.moveNames.skillNameForTrack then
            local ok,name=pcall(menu.moveNames.skillNameForTrack,record.model,track)
            local info=record.model:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if ok and name and info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') and not unBlockable(animation) then
                descriptor={kind='Move',counterKind='Move',name=name}
            end
        end
        if not descriptor then return end
        discardTrack(record, track)
        local life = if descriptor.kind == "M1" or descriptor.kind == "Ignore" then 0.65 else 2.5
        local state: any = {descriptor = descriptor, at = clock(), expires = clock()+life}
        state.singleContact=descriptor.kind=="M1" or singleContact(animation)
        if descriptor.kind=='M1' then
            local stamp=tonumber(record.model:GetAttribute('LastM1'))
            local age=stamp and host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp
            -- Associate only the stamp already observed for this play. A later
            -- global update can belong to the next punch while this tail plays.
            if age and age>=-.05 and age<=.22 and (not record.blockedLastM1 or stamp>record.blockedLastM1) then state.lastM1Stamp=stamp end
        end
        -- Named native contact keyframes, when exposed, distinguish a cast's
        -- windup from the brief incoming hit phase. No fixed cast delay is guessed.
        if type(track.GetTimeOfKeyframe)=="function" then
            for _,name in {"Hit","Impact","Attack","Damage","Contact"} do
                local ok,time=pcall(track.GetTimeOfKeyframe,track,name)
                if ok and type(time)=="number" and time==time and time>0 and time<math.huge then
                    state.contactTime=if state.contactTime then math.min(state.contactTime,time) else time
                end
            end
        end
        record.tracks[track] = state
        pairM1Swing(record,track,state,record.nativeSwing)
        if descriptor.dashSide then
            local phase=record.dashPhase
            if not phase or phase.endedAt or phase.character~=player.Character then
                phase={at=clock(),character=player.Character,tracks={}}
                record.dashPhase=phase
            end
            phase.tracks[track]=state;phase.side=descriptor.dashSide
            control.activeDashRecords[record]=phase
        end
        if track.Stopped then state.stopped = track.Stopped:Connect(function()
            discardTrack(record,track)
            if descriptor.dashSide and control.enabled then control.update() end
        end) end
        if control.enabled then control.update() end
    end
    -- Marker discovery: print each enemy animation once, with the attributes the
    -- game attached to it (Blockable, Unblockable, BlockBreak, ...) and the
    -- enemy's Info markers, so real data can drive the block logic.
    -- Set control.markerTrace=false to silence it.
    control.markerTrace=true
    control.markerSeen={}
    -- Unblockable attacks: grabs, throws, domains, ultimates, down slams and break moves. The game has no flag for
    -- them on the animation, so they are recognised by name; add your own words in the menu.
    control.blockAnySkill,control.skillTrace=true,false
    control.unblockWords={'grab','throw','domain','ultimate','downslam','lasso','breaker','unblock','blockbreak','execute','finisher','seize'}
    control.unblockSeen=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    function control.setBlockAnySkill(value)control.blockAnySkill=value==true;return true end
    function control.setSkillTrace(value)control.skillTrace=value==true;return true end
    function control.setUnblockWords(value)
        local words={}
        for word in tostring(value or ''):gmatch('[^,%s]+') do table.insert(words,word:lower()) end
        if #words==0 then return false end
        control.unblockWords=words;return true
    end
    function control.isUnblockableName(name: string, parentName: string?): boolean
        local lower=name:lower()
        if lower=='down' and parentName and parentName:lower():find('melee',1,true) then return true end
        for _,word in control.unblockWords do if lower:find(word,1,true) then return true end end
        return false
    end
    function control.isUnblockable(model: any): boolean
        local seen=control.unblockSeen[model]
        return seen~=nil and clock()-seen.at<=1.2 and (not seen.track or seen.track.IsPlaying~=false)
    end
    -- The nearest enemy that has just started an unblockable attack and is facing you.
    function control.unblockableThreat(root: any,range: number): (any,any)
        local best,bestSeen,bestDistance=nil,nil,math.huge
        for model,seen in control.unblockSeen do
            if model.Parent and not seen.handled and clock()-seen.at<=1.0 and (not seen.track or seen.track.IsPlaying~=false) then
                local other=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                if other and hostile(model) then
                    local distance=(other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance<=range and distance<bestDistance and control.enemyFacing(other,root.Position) then best,bestSeen,bestDistance=model,seen,distance end
                end
            end
        end
        return best,bestSeen
    end
    local rawOnAnimation=control.onAnimation
    control.onAnimation=function(record: any, track: any, animationPlayed: boolean?)
        if animationPlayed and record and record.model~=player.Character then
            pcall(function()
                local animation=track.Animation
                local parentName=animation and animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name
                local nativeDown=animation and animation.Name:lower()=="down" and parentName and parentName:lower():find("melee",1,true)~=nil
                local info=record.model:FindFirstChild("Info")
                local skill=info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
                local verified=animation and (unBlockable(animation) or skill and (unBlockable(skill) or unBlockable(info) or unBlockable(record.model)) or nativeDown and animation:GetAttribute("Blockable")~=true)
                if animation and not control.isEmoteTrack(record.model,track) and (verified or animation:GetAttribute("Blockable")~=true and control.isUnblockableName(animation.Name,parentName)) then
                    control.unblockSeen[record.model]={at=clock(),name=animation.Name,track=track,verified=verified==true}
                    if control.skillTrace then trace('[Shenaniganism] SKILL UNBLOCKABLE '..record.model.Name..' | '..animation.Name) end
                elseif control.skillTrace and not control.isEmoteTrack(record.model,track) then
                    trace('[Shenaniganism] SKILL ANIM '..record.model.Name..' | '..animation.Name..' | InSkill='..tostring(record.model:FindFirstChild('Info') and record.model.Info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil))
                end
            end)
        end
        if control.markerTrace and animationPlayed and record and record.model~=player.Character then
            pcall(function()
                local animation=track.Animation
                local id=animation and tostring(animation.AnimationId)
                local key=record.model.Name..'|'..tostring(id)
                if not id or control.markerSeen[key] then return end
                control.markerSeen[key]=true
                local attributes={}
                for name,value in animation:GetAttributes() do table.insert(attributes,name..'='..tostring(value)) end
                local info=record.model:FindFirstChild('Info')
                local markers={}
                if info then
                    for _,child in info:GetChildren() do
                        local childAttributes={}
                        for name,value in child:GetAttributes() do table.insert(childAttributes,name..'='..tostring(value)) end
                        table.insert(markers,child.Name..(if #childAttributes>0 then '{'..table.concat(childAttributes,',')..'}' else ''))
                    end
                end
                trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] ENEMY ANIM %s | %s name=%s priority=%s length=%.2f | animAttrs=[%s] | Info=[%s]',
                    record.model.Name,id,tostring(animation.Name),tostring(track.Priority),tonumber(track.Length) or 0,
                    table.concat(attributes,','),table.concat(markers,',')))
            end)
        end
        return rawOnAnimation(record,track,animationPlayed)
    end
    local markerUpdateQueued=false
    local function requestMarkerUpdate()
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or markerUpdateQueued then return end
        markerUpdateQueued=true
        -- Native marker replication arrives in batches at combo transitions.
        -- Inspect the final batch once, without adding a frame/timer delay.
        -- AnimationPlayed, LastM1 and native Swing2 still update immediately.
        host.task.defer(function()
            markerUpdateQueued=false
            if control.alive and control.enabled then control.update() end
        end)
    end
    function control.track(model: any)
        if control.records[model] or model == player.Character then return end
        local record: any = {model = model, tracks = {}, markers = {}, connections = {}, attached = {}}
        control.records[model] = record
        control.recordCount += 1
        local function attach(object: any)
            local animator=object:IsA("Animator")
            -- Only nodes with observers belong in this lifetime registry.
            -- Temporary effects/cosmetics need no watcher or retained handle.
            if not animator and object.Name~="Info" then return end
            if record.attached[object] then return end
            record.attached[object] = true
            if animator then
                table.insert(record.connections, object.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track) control.onAnimation(record,track,true) end))
                for _, track in object:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do control.onAnimation(record,track) end
            elseif object.Name == "Info" then
                table.insert(record.connections, object.ChildAdded:Connect(requestMarkerUpdate))
                table.insert(record.connections, object.ChildRemoved:Connect(requestMarkerUpdate))
            end
        end
        table.insert(record.connections, model.DescendantAdded:Connect(attach))
        table.insert(record.connections, model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastM1"):Connect(function() if control.enabled then control.update() end end))
        table.insert(record.connections, model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Moveset"):Connect(function() if control.watchNativeSwings then control.watchNativeSwings(model) end end))
        for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do attach(object) end
        if control.watchNativeSwings then control.watchNativeSwings(model) end
    end
    function control.untrack(model: any)
        local record = control.records[model]
        if not record then return end
        control.activeDashRecords[record]=nil
        control.records[model] = nil
        control.recordCount -= 1
        for track in record.tracks do discardTrack(record,track) end
        for _, connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    local function dashHitSnapshotChanged(source: any,previous: any,snapshot: any): boolean
        -- The tracker replaces immutable contact records. Dash history consumes
        -- only these three fields; also detect their in-place corrections.
        return source~=previous or not snapshot or source.at~=snapshot.at
            or source.character~=snapshot.character or source.target~=snapshot.target
    end
    function control.sampleDashHitHistory()
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        local own=player.Character;local now=clock()
        local function fresh(record: any): boolean
            return type(record)=='table' and record.character==own and type(record.at)=='number'
                and record.at==record.at and record.at<=now and now-record.at<=10
        end
        local outgoing=tracker and tracker.lastHitRecord
        local incoming=tracker and tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        if fresh(outgoing) and outgoing.accepted==true and dashHitSnapshotChanged(outgoing,control.dashLastVictimSource,control.dashLastVictim) then
            control.dashLastVictim=table.clone(outgoing);control.dashLastVictimSource=outgoing
        end
        if fresh(incoming) and dashHitSnapshotChanged(incoming,control.dashLastAttackerSource,control.dashLastAttacker) then
            control.dashLastAttacker=table.clone(incoming);control.dashLastAttackerSource=incoming
        end
    end
    function control.dashThreat(record: any,root: any): (boolean, number?)
        local phase=record.dashPhase;local now=clock()
        -- Completed dash history stays available if the hold setting changes,
        -- but an expired inactive phase needs no live actor/targeting reads.
        if phase and next(phase.tracks)==nil and (not phase.endedAt or now>=phase.endedAt+control.dashEndHold) then return false end
        if phase and control.completedContacts[phase] then return false end
        if (not control.dashBlockEnabled and not control.dashPredictionEnabled) or control.range<=0 or not phase
            or phase.character~=player.Character or not hostile(record.model) or not root then return false end
        for track,state in phase.tracks do
            if track.IsPlaying==false or now-state.at>10 then discardTrack(record,track) end
        end
        local active=next(phase.tracks)~=nil
        if not active and (not phase.endedAt or now>=phase.endedAt+control.dashEndHold) then return false end
        local other=record.model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not other then return false end
        local distance=(other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
        local filter=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if filter and filter.attackIntent and not filter.attackIntent(record.model) then return false end
        local delta=root.Position-other.Position
        local velocity=(control.enemyVelocity(other) or host.Vector3.new(0,0,0))-(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or host.Vector3.new(0,0,0))
        local closing=velocity.Magnitude>=2 and delta:Dot(velocity)>0
        local eta=if closing then math.max(0,(distance-control.meleeReach)/velocity.Magnitude) else 0
        local closest=if closing then math.clamp(delta:Dot(velocity)/(velocity.Magnitude^2),0,control.reactionHorizon) else 0
        local intersects=(delta-velocity*closest).Magnitude<=control.meleeReach
        local incomingFront=active and phase.side=='Front'and closing and intersects
        phase.incomingTrajectory=incomingFront==true
        if incomingFront then
            local along=delta:Dot(velocity)/velocity.Magnitude
            local lateralSquared=math.max(0,delta:Dot(delta)-along*along)
            eta=math.max(0,(along-math.sqrt(math.max(0,control.meleeReach^2-lateralSquared)))/velocity.Magnitude)
        end
        -- A live closing trajectory can hit across the attacker's shoulders.
        -- Stationary startup keeps its original narrow heading proof.
        local frontFacing=if incomingFront then true else facing(other,root.Position,.15)
        if active and phase.side=='Front' and control.dashBlockEnabled then
            if not intersects or velocity.Magnitude>=2 and not closing or not frontFacing then return false end
            phase.qualified=true;phase.contactRemaining=eta
        end
        if active and not incomingFront and filter and filter.approaching then
            local approaching=filter.approaching(record.model,control.range)
            local liveVelocity=other.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local starting=not liveVelocity or liveVelocity.Magnitude<2
            -- Recheck the live trajectory instead of latching a passing dash
            -- as a threat for the rest of its animation.
            if not approaching and not (starting and phase.side=='Front' and facing(other,root.Position,.65)) then return false end
        end
        if control.dashPredictionEnabled then
            local front=phase.side=='Front'
            if (front and not control.dashPredictFront) or (not front and not control.dashPredictSide) then return false end
            if not front and distance>control.dashSideRange then return false end
            if active and not phase.predictionQualified then
                if front and not frontFacing then return false end
                phase.predictionQualified=true
            end
            if phase.predictionQualified then phase.qualified=true end
        end
        if active and not phase.qualified then
            for _,hit in {control.dashLastVictim,control.dashLastAttacker} do
                if hit and hit.character==player.Character and hit.target==record.model
                    and now-hit.at>=0 and now-hit.at<=control.dashRecentWindow then phase.qualified=true;break end
            end
        end
        if not phase.qualified or (not active and (not phase.endedAt or now>=phase.endedAt+control.dashEndHold)) then return false end
        -- Static range is the guard radius, not the point to begin reacting to
        -- an already-proven dash about to cross it. Keep the prediction bounded
        -- to the existing reaction horizon; distant/passing dashes stay excluded.
        local rangeNow=if control.blockWhileDown and control.ownDown() then math.max(control.range,control.downReach()) else control.range
        if distance>rangeNow and not(incomingFront and eta<=control.reactionHorizon
            and distance<=rangeNow+velocity.Magnitude*control.reactionHorizon)then return false end
        return true,distance
    end
    local function contactSoon(track: any,state: any,horizon: number?): (boolean, number?, number?)
        if not state.contactTime then return true,nil,nil end
        local position=tonumber(track.TimePosition)
        local speed=tonumber(track.Speed) or 1
        if not position or position~=position or speed~=speed or speed<=0 or speed==math.huge then return false end
        local remaining=(state.contactTime-position)/speed
        return remaining>=-control.contactTail() and remaining<=(horizon or control.threatHorizon()),remaining,speed
    end
    function control.characterThreat(record: any, root: any, serverNow: number, forCounter: boolean?): (boolean, string?, any, any)
        local model = record.model
        if not forCounter and control.range<=0 then return false end
        if not root or not model or model==player.Character or not model.Parent then return false end
        local other=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not other then return false end
        local distance=(other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
        local downNow=not forCounter and control.blockWhileDown and control.ownDown()
        local outerReach=if forCounter then control.meleeReach elseif downNow then math.max(control.range,control.downReach()) else control.range
        local enemyVelocity=if forCounter then nil else control.enemyVelocity(other)
        local approachHorizon=control.threatHorizon()
        -- A fast closer can enter reach within the horizon; the approach
        -- distance below still has to land inside reach before it counts.
        local lookahead=0
        if enemyVelocity and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity then
            lookahead=math.min((enemyVelocity-root.AssemblyLinearVelocity).Magnitude*approachHorizon,control.fastLookahead)
        end
        if distance>outerReach+lookahead or not hostile(model) then return false end
        local info=model:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local skill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        local reach=outerReach
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local turnToBlock=assist and assist.blockAimEnabled and assist.blockAimSpeed>0 and
            (assist.blockAimAutomatic or assist.blockAimAfterHit)
        local approachDistance=distance
        if not forCounter and enemyVelocity and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity then
            local delta=other.Position-root.Position
            local velocity=enemyVelocity-root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local speed2=velocity:Dot(velocity)
            local eta=if speed2>1 then math.clamp(-delta:Dot(velocity)/speed2,0,approachHorizon) else 0
            approachDistance=math.min(distance,(delta+velocity*eta).Magnitude)
        end
        if not info or approachDistance > reach
            or (not forCounter and not turnToBlock and not downNow and not facing(root,other.Position,0.05))
            or (if forCounter then not facing(other,root.Position,.15)else not control.enemyFacing(other,root.Position)) then return false end
        -- Reject distant/ineligible actors before reading their replicated
        -- targeting metadata. The melee helper already includes aimedAtUs.
        local filter=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if not forCounter and filter and filter.attackIntent then
            if not filter.attackIntent(model)then return false end
            if not skill and not enemyMeleeSweep(other,root.Position)then return false end
        elseif not skill and filter and filter.meleeAimedAtUs then
            if not filter.meleeAimedAtUs(model) then return false end
        elseif filter and filter.aimedAtUs and not filter.aimedAtUs(model) then return false end
        if not forCounter and not skill and not filter and not enemyMeleeSweep(other,root.Position)then return false end
        if (not forCounter and (unBlockable(model) or unBlockable(info))) or (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0)>0 then return false end
        if info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun') or model:GetAttribute('TrueStun')==true or model:GetAttribute('Stun')==true then return false end
        for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do
            if marker.Name=='Stun' and (not skill or not marker:IsA('BoolValue') or marker.Value~=false) then return false end
        end
        if skill and not forCounter and unBlockable(skill) then return false end
        local currentM1, move, phasedTrack, livePhasedTrack = false, false, false, false
        local unblockTrack = false
        local m1Timing,moveTiming=nil,nil
        local m1Evidence,moveEvidence=nil,nil
        local untimedM1,untimedMove=false,false
        local untimedM1Evidence,untimedMoveEvidence=nil,nil
        for track, state in record.tracks do
            if control.isEmoteTrack(model,track) then discardTrack(record,track);continue end
            local maximum=if state.descriptor.kind=="M1" then 1.5 else control.maxHold
            if track.IsPlaying == false or clock()-state.at>maximum or (track.IsPlaying == nil and clock() > state.expires) then discardTrack(record,track);continue end
            local kind=if forCounter then state.descriptor.counterKind else state.descriptor.kind
            if kind=='Dash' then continue end
            if kind == "Ignore" or (state.descriptor.kind=="Ignore" and not kind) then unblockTrack = true;continue end
            if not forCounter and control.completedContacts[state] then
                if kind=="M1" then
                    phasedTrack=true
                end
                continue
            end
            if not forCounter and kind=="Move" and skill and control.completedContacts[skill] then continue end
            if state.contactTime then phasedTrack=true;livePhasedTrack=true end
            local horizon=if not forCounter and (control.manualReblockNow or control.attackTiming=='Windup' or control.attackTiming=='Mid attack') then control.maxHold
                elseif not forCounter and control.timedContactEnabled() then math.max(control.threatHorizon(),control.perfectBlockLead)
                else control.threatHorizon()
            if not forCounter and not control.manualReblockNow and control.attackTiming=='Mid attack' and state.contactTime
                and (tonumber(track.TimePosition) or 0)<state.contactTime*.5 then continue end
            local soon,remaining,speed=contactSoon(track,state,horizon)
            if not soon then continue end
            local timing=if remaining then {token=state,track=track,remaining=remaining,speed=speed,kind=kind} else nil
            local evidence={token=state,record=record,track=track,kind=kind,single=state.singleContact or singleContact(skill),skill=skill,lastM1=state.lastM1Stamp}
            if kind == "M1" and approachDistance<=reach then
                currentM1 = true
                if not timing then untimedM1=true;untimedM1Evidence=evidence
                elseif not m1Timing or timing.remaining<m1Timing.remaining then m1Timing,m1Evidence=timing,evidence end
            elseif kind=="Move" and skill then
                if record.skillMarker~=skill then record.skillMarker,record.skillStarted=skill,clock() end
                move=clock()-(record.skillStarted or clock())<=control.maxHold
                record.skillAttack=move
                if move then
                    if not timing then untimedMove=true;untimedMoveEvidence=evidence
                    elseif not moveTiming or timing.remaining<moveTiming.remaining then moveTiming,moveEvidence=timing,evidence end
                end
            end
        end
        if unblockTrack and not currentM1 and not move then return false end
        if currentM1 or move then
            -- An untimed simultaneous threat keeps ordinary Block protection.
            if untimedM1 or untimedMove then
                local evidence=untimedM1Evidence or untimedMoveEvidence
                return true,if evidence.kind=="M1" then "Native M1 animation" else "Native skill animation and InSkill",nil,evidence
            end
            local useM1=m1Timing and (not moveTiming or m1Timing.remaining<=moveTiming.remaining)
            local timing,evidence=if useM1 then m1Timing else moveTiming,if useM1 then m1Evidence else moveEvidence
            return true,if timing.kind=="M1" then "Native M1 animation" else "Native skill animation and InSkill",timing,evidence
        end
        local swing=record.nativeSwing
        if swing and distance<=reach and clock()-swing.at<=0.22 and (forCounter or not control.completedContacts[swing]) then
            return true,"Native incoming Swing2",nil,{token=swing,record=record,kind="M1",single=true,lastM1=if swing.stamp and (not record.blockedLastM1 or swing.stamp>record.blockedLastM1) then swing.stamp else nil}
        end
        -- A known future/past contact phase cannot be overridden by the broad
        -- LastM1 or InSkill markers from the same cast.
        local last = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
        local age = last and serverNow-last
        local freshM1=age and distance<=reach and age>=-.05 and age<=.22 and (forCounter or not record.blockedLastM1 or last>record.blockedLastM1)
        if phasedTrack and (forCounter or livePhasedTrack or not freshM1) then return false end
        if freshM1 then
            -- With no stamp associated with the completed play, late old
            -- replication and the next punch are ambiguous. Keep native guard
            -- protection without inventing another confirmed contact token.
            if not forCounter and record.unstampedM1Contact then return true,"Unassociated fresh replicated LastM1"end
            if record.lastM1Stamp~=last then record.lastM1Stamp,record.lastM1Token=last,{stamp=last} end
            return true, "Fresh replicated LastM1",nil,{token=record.lastM1Token,record=record,kind="M1",single=true,stamp=last}
        end
        for _, name in {"Attacking","Melee","InSkill"} do
            local marker = info:FindFirstChild(name)
            local anySkill = name == "InSkill"
            if anySkill and (not control.blockAnySkill or control.isUnblockable(model)) then marker = nil end
            if marker and distance<=reach and not unBlockable(marker) and (forCounter or not control.completedContacts[marker]) then
                record.markers[marker]=record.markers[marker] or clock()
                if clock()-record.markers[marker]<=control.maxHold then
                    if control.skillTrace then trace(string.format("[Shenaniganism] SKILL BLOCKABLE %s | %s marker | %.1f studs", model.Name, name, distance)) end
                    return true, "Native "..name.." marker",nil,{token=marker,record=record,kind=if skill or anySkill then "Move" else "M1",single=if anySkill then singleContact(marker) else (not skill or singleContact(marker)),skill=skill} end
            end
        end
        -- A dedicated replicated hitbox/attack marker is usable without an
        -- animation when the game explicitly says that it is blockable.
        if skill and skill:GetAttribute("Blockable") == true and (forCounter or not control.completedContacts[skill]) then
            record.markers[skill]=record.markers[skill] or clock()
            if clock()-record.markers[skill]<=control.maxHold then return true, "Native blockable skill marker",nil,{token=skill,record=record,kind="Move",single=singleContact(skill),skill=skill} end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.projectileThreat(projectile: any, root: any, source: any, observed: any, ignoreRange: boolean?, predictionHorizon: number?): (boolean, number?)
        if not projectile.Parent or not projectile:IsA("BasePart") or unBlockable(projectile) or unBlockable(source)
            or (not ignoreRange and (control.projectileRange<=0 or (projectile.Position-root.Position).Magnitude > control.projectileRange)) then return false end
        if (((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(source)) or ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(projectile))) then return false end
        -- These client templates have no verified blockability metadata. Keep
        -- them excluded unless the live game explicitly marks them blockable.
        local unresolved = {PurpleProjectile = true, WorldSlashProjectile = true}
        if (unresolved[projectile.Name] or (source and unresolved[source.Name])) and projectile:GetAttribute("Blockable") ~= true and (not source or source:GetAttribute("Blockable") ~= true) then return false end
        local owner = source and (source:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") or source:GetAttribute("Owner") or source:GetAttribute("Character"))
        local ownerModel=control.threatOwner(owner)
        if owner == player.UserId or owner == player.Character or owner == player or ownerModel==player.Character then return false end
        local record=control.projectileIndex[projectile]
        if record and not record.owner then record.owner=ownerModel end
        if ownerModel and not hostile(ownerModel) then return false end
        local category=control.projectileCategory(source,projectile,record)
        if not ignoreRange and not control.allowsThreat({kind='Projectile',category=category}) then return false end
        if not ignoreRange and record and control.completedContacts[record] then return false end
        if record and (record.owner==player.Character or record.owner==player) then return false end
        local recordedOwner=record and (control.threatOwner(record.owner) or record.owner)
        if recordedOwner and not hostile(recordedOwner) then return false end
        if (((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(owner)) or record and ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(record.owner))) then return false end
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local turnToBlock=assist and assist.blockAimEnabled and assist.blockAimSpeed>0 and (assist.blockAimAutomatic or assist.blockAimAfterHit)
        if not turnToBlock and not (control.blockWhileDown and control.ownDown()) and not facing(root,projectile.Position,0.05) then return false end
        local delta, velocity = root.Position-projectile.Position, projectile.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if observed and observed.Magnitude>0.5 then velocity=observed end
        local horizon=if not ignoreRange and control.timedContactEnabled() then math.max(control.threatHorizon(),control.perfectBlockLead) else control.threatHorizon()
        if type(predictionHorizon)=='number' and predictionHorizon==predictionHorizon and predictionHorizon>0 then horizon=math.max(horizon,math.min(predictionHorizon,.5)) end
        local movingBomb=category=='Bombs' and velocity.Magnitude>=1 and record and hostile(record.owner)
            and (attr(source,'IsProjectile')==true or attr(projectile,'IsProjectile')==true
                or control.projectileNames[projectile.Name] or source and control.projectileModelNames[source.Name])
        if (category=='Bombs' and not movingBomb) or category=='Explosions' then
            -- A visual explosion alone says nothing about a future hit. Require
            -- native blockability, radius and a live fuse/impact or active hitbox.
            if attr(source,'Blockable')~=true and attr(projectile,'Blockable')~=true then return false end
            local radius=tonumber(attr(source,'BlastRadius') or attr(source,'ExplosionRadius') or attr(projectile,'BlastRadius') or attr(projectile,'ExplosionRadius'))
            if not radius or radius~=radius or radius<=0 or radius>200 then return false end
            local remaining=tonumber(attr(source,'FuseRemaining') or attr(source,'TimeToImpact') or attr(projectile,'FuseRemaining') or attr(projectile,'TimeToImpact'))
            local deadline=tonumber(attr(source,'DetonateAt') or attr(source,'ImpactAt') or attr(projectile,'DetonateAt') or attr(projectile,'ImpactAt'))
            if deadline and deadline==deadline and math.abs(deadline)<math.huge then remaining=deadline-host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end
            if attr(source,'DamageActive')==true or attr(projectile,'DamageActive')==true then remaining=0 end
            if not remaining or remaining~=remaining or remaining<-.05 or remaining>horizon then return false end
            remaining=math.max(0,remaining)
            local ownVelocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            local impact=projectile.Position+velocity*remaining
            return (root.Position+ownVelocity*remaining-impact).Magnitude<=radius+2.5,remaining
        end
        if velocity.Magnitude < 1 then return false end
        local relative=velocity-(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or host.Vector3.new(0,0,0))
        if relative.Magnitude<1 then return false end
        local time = delta:Dot(relative)/(relative.Magnitude^2)
        local size=projectile.Size
        local radius=2.5+(size and math.min(math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)*.5,2) or 0)
        if time==time and time >= 0 and time <= horizon and (delta-relative*time).Magnitude <= radius then return true,time end
        -- A fast projectile can cross the player between two samples, so the
        -- closest approach is already behind it. Test the segment it just swept.
        local previous=record and record.previousPosition
        if previous and not ignoreRange and time==time and time<0 and time>=-.12 then
            local segment=projectile.Position-previous
            local length2=segment:Dot(segment)
            if length2>0 then
                local along=math.clamp((root.Position-previous):Dot(segment)/length2,0,1)
                if (previous+segment*along-root.Position).Magnitude<=radius then return true,0 end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.imminentThreat(target: any, forCounter: boolean?): (boolean, string?, any?, any?, any?)
        local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return false end
        local record=control.records[target]
        if record then
            local threatened,reason,timing,evidence=control.characterThreat(record,root,host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),forCounter)
            if threatened then return true,reason,nil,timing,evidence end
        end
        for _,projectile in control.projectileParts do
            if projectile.owner==target and control.projectileThreat(projectile.part,root,projectile.source,projectile.velocity,forCounter==true) then
                return true,"Incoming native projectile at contact horizon",projectile
            end
        end
        return false,"Attack is outside its incoming contact phase or reach"
    end
    local function projectileInside(part: any, source: any): boolean
        local parent=part.Parent
        if parent==source then return true end
        if type(part.IsDescendantOf)=='function' then return part:IsDescendantOf(source) end
        while parent do if parent==source then return true end;parent=parent.Parent end
        return false
    end
    function control.addProjectile(source: any, changedObject: any?)
        if not source or #control.projectileParts>=300 then return end
        local isModel=source:IsA('Model')
        local hitbox,part
        if isModel then
            local cached=control.projectileModelParts[source]
            if changedObject and changedObject~=source and changedObject.Name~='Hitbox' and cached
                and cached.part.Parent and control.projectileIndex[cached.part]
                and cached.primary==source.PrimaryPart and projectileInside(cached.part,source) then
                -- Incidental emitters/parts under an already resolved native
                -- Hitbox cannot change its priority. Direct source discovery
                -- stays uncached, as do actual Hitbox/root replacement events.
                if cached.hitbox and cached.part.Name=='Hitbox'
                    or cached.primary==cached.part and not changedObject:IsA('Model')
                    or cached.primary==nil and not changedObject:IsA('BasePart') and not changedObject:IsA('Model') then return end
            end
            control.projectileModelParts[source]=nil
            hitbox=source:FindFirstChild('Hitbox',true)
            part=hitbox or source.PrimaryPart or source:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart',true)
        elseif source:IsA('BasePart') then part=source end
        if not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA('BasePart') then return end
        local existing=control.projectileIndex[part]
        if isModel and (not existing or existing.source==source) then
            control.projectileModelParts[source]={part=part,primary=source.PrimaryPart,hitbox=hitbox==part}
        end
        if existing then return end
        local record={part=part,source=source,position=part.Position,at=clock(),velocity=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity}
        record.category=control.projectileCategory(source,part)
        record.owner=control.threatOwner(attr(source,'OwnerUserId') or attr(source,'Owner') or attr(source,'Character') or attr(part,'OwnerUserId') or attr(part,'Owner'))
        control.projectileIndex[part]=record
        table.insert(control.projectileParts,record)
    end
    function control.projectileCreated(object: any)
        local source=object
        local known=control.projectileNames[object.Name]==true or object:GetAttribute("IsProjectile")==true or object:GetAttribute("Projectile")==true
            or attr(object,'IsBomb')==true or attr(object,'IsBullet')==true or attr(object,'IsSwarm')==true or attr(object,'IsExplosion')==true
        if object:IsA("Model") and control.projectileModelNames[object.Name] then known=true end
        local parent=object.Parent
        while not known and parent and parent~=host.workspace do
            if parent:IsA("Model") and control.projectileModelNames[parent.Name] then known=true;source=parent;break end
            if parent.Name=="Projectiles" then known=true;break end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        if known then control.addProjectile(source,object) end
    end
    local utilities=host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Utils")
    if utilities then for _,object in utilities:GetDescendants() do
        local category=indexedCategory(object.Name)
        if category then
            control.projectileKinds[object.Name]=category
            if object:IsA("BasePart") then control.projectileNames[object.Name]=true elseif object:IsA("Model") then control.projectileModelNames[object.Name]=true end
        end
    end end
    function control.refreshProjectiles()
        if clock()-control.lastProjectileScan < 0.15 then return end
        control.lastProjectileScan=clock()
        for index=#control.projectileParts,1,-1 do local record=control.projectileParts[index];if not record.part.Parent then
            control.projectileIndex[record.part]=nil
            local cached=control.projectileModelParts[record.source]
            if cached and cached.part==record.part then control.projectileModelParts[record.source]=nil end
            table.remove(control.projectileParts,index)
        end end
        local dedicated=host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Projectiles")
        if dedicated then for _,source in dedicated:GetChildren() do
            if source:IsA("Folder") then for _,nested in source:GetChildren() do control.addProjectile(nested) end else control.addProjectile(source) end
        end end
        local effects=host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Effects")
        if effects then for _,source in effects:GetChildren() do
            control.projectileCreated(source)
            if source.Name=="Projectiles" and source:IsA("Folder") then for _,nested in source:GetChildren() do control.addProjectile(nested) end end
            if #control.projectileParts>=300 then break end
        end end
    end
    function control.findDashThreat(): (any, string?, any, any, any)
        local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local selected,distance,remaining,recent=nil,math.huge,math.huge,false
        local last=control.dashLastVictim;local now=clock()
        for record,phase in control.activeDashRecords do
            local model=record.model
            if control.records[model]~=record or record.dashPhase~=phase or phase.character~=player.Character
                or next(phase.tracks)==nil and(not phase.endedAt or now>=phase.endedAt+control.dashEndHold)then
                control.activeDashRecords[record]=nil;continue
            end
            local threatened,d=control.dashThreat(record,root)
            if threatened then
                local eta=record.dashPhase.contactRemaining or 0
                local wasHit=last and last.character==player.Character and last.target==model and type(last.at)=='number'
                    and now>=last.at and now-last.at<=control.dashRecentWindow or false
                if eta<remaining-.03 or math.abs(eta-remaining)<=.03 and(wasHit and not recent
                    or wasHit==recent and(d<distance or d==distance and(not selected or model.Name<selected.model.Name)))then
                    selected,distance,remaining,recent=record,d,eta,wasHit
                end
            end
        end
        if selected then
            return selected.model,'Incoming native '..tostring(selected.dashPhase.side)..' dash',nil,
                {remaining=selected.dashPhase.contactRemaining or 0,kind='Dash'},
                {token=selected.dashPhase,kind='Dash',single=false,record=selected,incomingTrajectory=selected.dashPhase.incomingTrajectory==true}
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.findApproaching()
        local filter=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if not filter or not filter.approaching then return nil end
        local selected,best=nil,math.huge
        for model in control.records do
            if hostile(model) then
                local approaching,eta=filter.approaching(model,control.range)
                if approaching and (eta<best or eta==best and (not selected or model.Name<selected.Name)) then selected,best=model,eta end
            end
        end
        return selected
    end
    -- Physical reach gate: an attack only counts when it can really get to you. An M1 must be within weapon
    -- reach (plus how far the attacker can still travel before contact); a skill within its reach; a projectile
    -- must pass within its own size of your body. Anything that cannot land is ignored, so Auto Block, the aim
    -- assists and Auto Dodge stay quiet for attacks that go nowhere near you.
    control.reachGate,control.m1Reach,control.skillReach,control.reachMargin=true,7,20,1.5
    function control.setReachGate(value)control.reachGate=value==true;return true end
    control.setM1Reach=function(value)local n=tonumber(value);if not n or n~=n or math.abs(n)==math.huge then return false end;control.m1Reach=math.clamp(n,3,15);return true end
    control.setSkillReach=function(value)local n=tonumber(value);if not n or n~=n or math.abs(n)==math.huge then return false end;control.skillReach=math.clamp(n,6,60);return true end
    control.setReachMargin=function(value)local n=tonumber(value);if not n or n~=n or math.abs(n)==math.huge then return false end;control.reachMargin=math.clamp(n,0,6);return true end
    function control.physicallyReaches(evidence,projectile,root,position,timing)
        local kind=evidence.kind
        if kind=='Dash' or kind=='OwnDash' then return true end
        local margin=control.reachMargin
        local remaining=if timing and type(timing.remaining)=='number' and timing.remaining==timing.remaining then math.max(timing.remaining,0) else 0
        if kind=='Projectile' then
            local part=projectile and projectile.part
            if not part or not part.Parent then return true end
            local velocity=projectile.velocity or part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local offset=root.Position-part.Position
            local speedSquared=velocity.X*velocity.X+velocity.Y*velocity.Y+velocity.Z*velocity.Z
            local closest=offset.Magnitude
            if speedSquared>1 then
                local time=math.clamp(offset:Dot(velocity)/speedSquared,0,remaining+.35)
                closest=(offset-velocity*time).Magnitude
            end
            local size=part.Size
            return closest<=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)*.5+2.5+margin
        end
        local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(position.X-root.Position.X,0,position.Z-root.Position.Z).Magnitude
        local model=evidence.record and evidence.record.model
        local attackerRoot=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local speed=0
        if attackerRoot then local v=attackerRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity;speed=math.sqrt(v.X*v.X+v.Z*v.Z) end
        local travel=math.min(speed,60)*remaining
        return horizontal<=(if kind=='M1' then control.m1Reach elseif type(evidence.reach)=='number' then evidence.reach else control.skillReach)+margin+travel
    end
    function control.findThreat(ignorePast: boolean?): (any, string?, any, any, any)
        if not ignorePast then control.dodgeForecast=nil end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or (control.range <= 0 and control.projectileRange<=0) then return nil end
        local serverNow = host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        local selectedTarget,selectedSource,selectedProjectile,selectedTiming=nil,nil,nil,nil
        local selectedEvidence=nil
        local bestRank,bestDistance,bestName=math.huge,math.huge,''
        local function choose(target,source,projectile,timing,evidence,position)
            local settings=control.referenceSettings
            if not control.allowsThreat(evidence) then return end
            -- Retaliation only: an M1 whose contact moment has already passed is
            -- over (its damage part ended), so it must not hold the punch back.
            if ignorePast and evidence.kind=='M1' and timing and type(timing.remaining)=='number' and timing.remaining<=0 then return end
            if settings and settings.facingCheck and evidence.record and not(evidence.kind=='Dash'and evidence.incomingTrajectory)
                and not control.enemyFacing(evidence.record.model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'),root.Position,settings.sensitivity) then return end
            if control.reachGate and not control.physicallyReaches(evidence,projectile,root,position,timing) then return end
            local remaining=timing and timing.remaining
            local rank=if type(remaining)=='number' and remaining==remaining then math.max(0,remaining) else 0
            local distance=(position-root.Position).Magnitude
            local name=if type(target.GetFullName)=='function' then target:GetFullName() else target.Name
            if rank<bestRank-.002 or math.abs(rank-bestRank)<=.002 and
                (distance<bestDistance or distance==bestDistance and name<bestName) then
                bestRank,bestDistance,bestName=rank,distance,name
                selectedTarget,selectedSource,selectedProjectile,selectedTiming,selectedEvidence=target,source,projectile,timing,evidence
            end
        end
        for model, record in control.records do
            if not model.Parent then control.untrack(model);continue end
            local threatened, source,timing,evidence = control.characterThreat(record,root,serverNow)
            if threatened then
                choose(model,source,nil,timing,evidence,model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart').Position)
            end
        end
        control.refreshProjectiles()
        for _,record in control.projectileParts do
            local now=clock()
            if now>record.at then
                local observed=(record.part.Position-record.position)/(now-record.at)
                record.velocity=if observed.Magnitude>0.5 then observed else record.predictedVelocity or record.part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                record.previousPosition=record.position
