                record.position,record.at=record.part.Position,now
            end
            local threatened,remaining=control.projectileThreat(record.part,root,record.source,record.velocity,false)
            if threatened then
                local evidence={token=record,kind="Projectile",category=control.projectileCategory(record.source,record.part,record),single=true,projectile=record}
                local timing={token=record,remaining=remaining,kind="Projectile"}
                choose(record.source,if evidence.category=='Projectiles' then 'Incoming native projectile trajectory' else 'Incoming native '..evidence.category..' contact',record,timing,evidence,record.part.Position)
            end
        end
        if not control.referenceSettings or control.referenceSettings.blockMoves then
            local target,source,projectile,timing,evidence=control.findDashThreat()
            local other=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if other then choose(target,source,projectile,timing,evidence,other.Position)end
        end
        -- Evidence from the game's own combat announcements (chains and start-ups).
        local feed=menu.threatFeed
        if feed and feed.enabled and (not control.referenceSettings or control.referenceSettings.blockM1s or control.referenceSettings.blockMoves) then
            local target,source,timing,evidence=feed.activeThreat(root,control.range)
            local other=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if other then choose(target,source,nil,timing,evidence,other.Position)end
        end
        if selectedTarget then
            if not ignorePast then control.dodgeForecast={target=selectedTarget,timing=selectedTiming,evidence=selectedEvidence,at=clock(),character=character} end
            return selectedTarget,selectedSource,selectedProjectile,selectedTiming,selectedEvidence
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.latchOngoing(): boolean
        local latch=control.latch
        -- A short, bounded bridge between confirmed M1 contacts allows the
        -- chosen hit count to span a combo without holding an obsolete guard.
        if control.hitCountReleaseEnabled and control.held and control.blockedHits>0
            and control.blockedHits<control.hitsBeforeRelease and clock()<(control.hitSequenceUntil or 0) then
            local record=latch and control.records[latch.target]
            local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local other=record and record.model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if root and other and hostile(record.model) and (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=math.min(control.range,control.meleeReach)
                and facing(root,other.Position,.05) and control.enemyFacing(other,root.Position)and enemyMeleeSweep(other,root.Position)then return true end
        end
        if latch and latch.evidence and latch.evidence.kind=='OwnDash' then return control.ownDashProtection() end
        if latch and latch.evidence and latch.evidence.kind=='Dash' then
            local record=control.records[latch.target]
            local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if record and record.dashPhase==latch.evidence.token and control.dashThreat(record,root) then return true end
            control.latch=nil;return false
        end
        if not latch or clock()-latch.at>control.maxHold then control.latch=nil;return false end
        if latch.evidence and control.completedContacts[latch.evidence.token] then control.latch=nil;return false end
        local evidence=latch.evidence
        if evidence and evidence.single and evidence.track and evidence.token.contactTime then
            local _,remaining=contactSoon(evidence.track,evidence.token)
            if remaining and remaining< -0.12 then
                control.completedContacts[evidence.token]=true
                if evidence.record and evidence.kind=='M1' then
                    rememberM1Contact(evidence.record,evidence)
                end
                control.latch=nil
                return false
            end
        end
        if latch.projectile then
            local record=latch.projectile
            local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root or not record.part.Parent then control.latch=nil;return false end
            local delta=root.Position-record.part.Position
            -- Keep an incoming projectile latched beyond its first range entry.
            if record.velocity.Magnitude>0.5 and delta:Dot(record.velocity)<-0.1 then control.latch=nil;return false end
            return true
        end
        local record=control.records[latch.target]
        if not record or not hostile(latch.target) then control.latch=nil;return false end
        local info=latch.target:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local skill=info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        local ownRoot=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local other=latch.target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not ownRoot or not other or (other.Position-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude>math.min(control.range,control.meleeReach)
            or not facing(ownRoot,other.Position,0.05)or not control.enemyFacing(other,ownRoot.Position)
            or not skill and not enemyMeleeSweep(other,ownRoot.Position)then control.latch=nil;return false end
        if unBlockable(latch.target) or unBlockable(info) or unBlockable(skill) then control.latch=nil;return false end
        for track,state in record.tracks do if state.descriptor.kind=="Ignore" and track.IsPlaying~=false then control.latch=nil;return false end end
        if record.skillAttack and skill==record.skillMarker and not control.completedContacts[skill] and clock()-(record.skillStarted or 0)<=control.maxHold then return true end
        if info then for _,name in {"Melee","Attacking"} do
            local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name)
            if marker and not control.completedContacts[marker] and not unBlockable(marker) and record.markers[marker] and clock()-record.markers[marker]<=control.maxHold then return true end
        end end
        for track,state in record.tracks do
            local maximum=if state.descriptor.kind=="M1" then 1.5 else control.maxHold
            if not control.completedContacts[state] and (state.descriptor.kind=="M1" or (state.descriptor.kind=="Move" and skill)) and track.IsPlaying~=false and clock()-state.at<=maximum and (track.IsPlaying~=nil or clock()<state.expires) then return true end
        end
        local last=tonumber(latch.target:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
        if last and last~=record.blockedLastM1 and host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-last<=0.35 then return true end
        control.latch=nil;return false
    end
    function control.onBlockedHit(defender: any)
        local manual=manualReader()
        local manualRetaliation=control.enabled and control.referenceSettings and control.referenceSettings.punchBack and manual
        if not control.alive or (not control.enabled and not control.ownDashProtection()) or (not control.held and not manualRetaliation) or defender~=player.Character then return end
        control.lastBlockedAt=clock()
        control.lastBlockedContact={character=defender,at=control.lastBlockedAt,wasOwned=control.held~=nil,manual=manual}
        control.blockStunCharacter=defender
        control.blockStunUntil=clock()+0.35
        local evidence=control.heldThreat
        if not evidence and manualRetaliation then
            -- BlockService confirms contact, but publishes no attacker. Use
            -- only a currently proven incoming M1, never a nearby bystander.
            local _,_,_,_,incoming=control.findThreat()
            if incoming and incoming.kind=='M1' then evidence=incoming end
        end
        if not manual then control.blockedHits+=1 end
        -- The recovered policy owns its unblock deadline; keep contact evidence
        -- available to Punish without starting the replaced contact-release loop.
        local countedRelease=control.hitCountReleaseEnabled and not manual and control.blockedHits>=control.hitsBeforeRelease
        if evidence and (evidence.single or evidence.kind=='M1' or countedRelease) then
            control.completedContacts[evidence.token]=true
            for _,marker in evidence.attackMarkers or {} do control.completedContacts[marker]=true end
            local record=evidence.record
            if record then
                local token=if type(evidence.token)=='table' then evidence.token else nil
                local contactAt=token and token.at or control.lastPressAt or clock()
                if evidence.kind=="M1" then
                    rememberM1Contact(record,evidence)
                    local swing=record.nativeSwing
                    -- AnimationPlayed and Swing2 may arrive in either order.
                    -- Pair each actual play state, even when all combo stages
                    -- reuse the same AnimationId. A next play gets a new state.
                    local alias=swing and token and token.nativeSwing==swing
                    if swing and (swing.at<=contactAt or alias) then control.completedContacts[swing]=true end
                    -- Only this confirmed contact is consumed. Another M1
                    -- track can have started earlier but still hit later.
                    local info=record.model:FindFirstChild("Info")
                    if info then for _,name in {"Melee","Attacking"} do local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name);if marker and (record.markers[marker] or math.huge)<=contactAt then control.completedContacts[marker]=true end end end
                elseif evidence.skill then
                    control.completedContacts[evidence.skill]=true
                    if countedRelease then
                        for _,state in record.tracks do if state.descriptor.kind=='Move' then control.completedContacts[state]=true end end
                    end
                end
            end
            if evidence.kind=='M1' and control.referenceSettings and control.referenceSettings.punchBack then
                -- This exact contact has landed in Block. Its animation tail
                -- and the configured unblock delay are not another threat.
                -- Resample so a separate next M1 still keeps the guard up.
                control.retaliationThreatAt=nil
                local target=record and record.model
                if target and control.queuePunchBack then control.queuePunchBack(target,true) end
                if control.stepPunchBack then control.stepPunchBack() end
            end
            if control.referencePolicy then return end
            if control.hitCountReleaseEnabled and not manual and not countedRelease then
                if evidence.kind=='M1' then control.hitSequenceUntil=clock()+.35 end
                control.perfectHeldToken=nil;control.rearmAttempts=0
                control.lastReason='Confirmed blocked hits: '..control.blockedHits..' / '..control.hitsBeforeRelease
                return
            end
            control.latch=nil
            control.contactReleaseFrame=control.heartbeatFrame
            if countedRelease then
                control.lastReleasedHitCount=control.blockedHits
                if evidence.kind=='OwnDash' then control.ownDashUntil=nil end
                control.release()
                control.lastReason='Released Auto Block after '..control.lastReleasedHitCount..' confirmed blocked hits'
                return
            end
            releaseAfterHold("Confirmed single contact ended; waiting for the next native attack")
            return
        end
        -- The timed contact has completed. Ordinary held-block recovery may
        -- now protect later unphased hits in the same native skill.
        control.perfectHeldToken=nil
        control.blockStunCharacter=defender
        control.blockStunUntil=clock()+0.35
        control.rearmAttempts=0
    end
    function control.rearm(): boolean
        local tool=control.nativeTool
        local recovery=control.ownBlockRecovery()
        if not tool or type(tool.Block)~="function" or (if recovery then (control.recoveryRearmAttempts or 0)>=16 else (control.rearmAttempts or 0)>=3) then
            control.rearmFailedLatch=control.latch
            return false
        end
        if recovery then control.recoveryRearmAttempts=(control.recoveryRearmAttempts or 0)+1
        else control.rearmAttempts=(control.rearmAttempts or 0)+1 end
        control.lastPressAt=clock()
        local ok,detail=pcall(tool.Block,tool)
        control.lastReason=if ok then "Rearming owned native Block after its temporary transition" else "Native Block rearm failed: "..tostring(detail)
        return ok
    end
    -- Recovered AnimationPlayed policy replaces the old incoming decision loop.
    -- Counter/Punish continue to use the sensor and owned-input facade above.
    control.referenceSettings={blockM1s=true,blockMoves=true,blockProjectiles=true,blockBombs=true,blockBullets=true,
        blockMoveVariants=true,blockExplosions=true,blockSwarms=true,chance=100,facingCheck=true,sensitivity=0,
        blockDelay=.2,unblockDelay=.2,rangeType='Static',minimumRange=6,
        punchBack=false,afkCheck=false,typingCheck=true,sticky=false,lookAt=true,ignoreNpcs=false,manualBlockLock=true,manualM1Supreme=true,blockFirst=true,
        visualizer=false,visualizerColor=host.Color3 and host.Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255) or nil}
    control.punchBackHits,control.punchBackAfterAttack=1,false
    control.punchBackAccepted,control.punchBackSequences=0,0
    function control.setPunchBackHits(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount%1~=0 or amount<1 or amount>10 then return false end
        control.punchBackHits=amount;return true
    end
    function control.setPunchBackAfterAttack(value: boolean): boolean
        if type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.punchBackAfterAttack=value;return true
    end
    function control.cancelPunchBack(reason: string?)
        control.punchBackPending=nil
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        if punish and punish.cancelRetaliation then punish.cancelRetaliation(control) end
        if reason then control.punchBackReason=reason end
    end
    -- Cut in between hits: an enemy chain no longer holds the punish until its last swing. A swing whose contact is still at least the
    -- margin away does not count as a live threat, so the punch goes in the gap; once the next contact is closer than the margin the
    -- punch yields to Block again (interruptRetaliationForThreat uses the same check), so you are not hit.
    control.cutInEnabled,control.cutInMarginMs=true,260
    -- Auto Punish is not Auto Block: its returns (afterAttack == false) do not wait on, or yield to, Auto Block's incoming-attack
    -- logic. They go in on Auto Punish's own timing: after the blocked hits you set, at the end of that M1.
    control.punchIgnoresThreats=true
    function control.setPunchIgnoresThreats(value) control.punchIgnoresThreats=value==true;return true end
    function control.setCutIn(value) control.cutInEnabled=value==true;return true end
    function control.setCutInMargin(value)
        if type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.cutInMarginMs=math.clamp(value,0,1000);return true
    end
    function control.retaliationReady(target: any,afterAttack: boolean?): boolean
        if not hostile(target) then return false end
        if afterAttack==false and control.punchIgnoresThreats then control.retaliationWhy='Auto Punish: own timing, not waiting on Auto Block';return true end
        local now=clock()
        if not control.retaliationThreatAt or now<control.retaliationThreatAt or now-control.retaliationThreatAt>=.025 then
            local incoming,why,_,timing,proof=control.findThreat(true)
            control.retaliationWhy=if incoming then tostring(why)..' / '..tostring(proof and proof.kind) else nil
            control.retaliationThreatAt=now
            local live=incoming~=nil and not (proof and proof.kind=='OwnDash')
            if live and control.cutInEnabled and type(timing)=='table' and type(timing.remaining)=='number' then
                local remaining=timing.remaining
                if remaining<.03 then
                    -- That swing's contact has already happened (it is the hit you just blocked, still finishing its animation).
                    -- It is no reason to wait: the punch goes in right at the end of it, not after the whole chain.
                    live=false
                    control.retaliationWhy='Cutting in: that swing already made contact'
                elseif remaining>=control.cutInMarginMs*.001 then
                    live=false
                    control.retaliationWhy='Cutting in: next contact '..string.format('%.0f',remaining*1000)..' ms away'
                end
            end
            control.retaliationThreatLive=live
        end
        if control.retaliationThreatLive then return false end
        if afterAttack==false then return true end
        local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info then return false end
        for _,name in {'InSkill','Melee','Attacking'} do
            local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name)
            if marker and not control.completedContacts[marker] then return false end
        end
        local record=control.records[target]
        for track,state in record and record.tracks or {} do
            local kind=state.descriptor and state.descriptor.kind
            if (kind=='M1' or kind=='Move') and track.IsPlaying~=false and not control.completedContacts[state]
                and now<=(state.expires or state.at+control.maxHold) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.interruptRetaliationForThreat()
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        local pending=punish and punish.pending
        if not pending or not pending.external or pending.external.owner~=control then return false end
        -- Returns started by Auto Punish (force) never wait for the enemy attack to end.
        if control.retaliationReady(pending.target,if pending.external.force then false else control.punchBackAfterAttack) then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        control.punchBackDefense=if info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then {character=character,skill=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')} else nil
        if punish.cancelRetaliation then punish.cancelRetaliation(control) end
        control.punchBackPending=nil
        control.punchBackReason='New incoming contact interrupted return punches; native Block has priority'
        return true
    end
    function control.queuePunchBack(target: any,confirmedContact: boolean?,force: boolean?,count: number?): boolean
        -- With Auto Punish on, it owns the return and hands each blocked hit
        -- here (force), so this engine and its settings run under Auto Punish.
        local punishOwner=menu.autoPunish
        if force~=true and punishOwner and punishOwner.alive~=false and punishOwner.enabled==true then return false end
        if not control.enabled or (not control.referenceSettings.punchBack and force~=true) or not hostile(target) or control.punchBackPending then return false end
        local defense=control.punchBackDefense
        if defense then
            local info=defense.character==player.Character and defense.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')==defense.skill then
                control.punchBackReason='Keeping your restored guard through the interrupted native M1 recovery';return false
            end
            control.punchBackDefense=nil
        end
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        if punish and punish.pending then return false end
        control.punchBackPending={character=player.Character,target=target,count=count or control.punchBackHits,at=clock(),confirmedContact=confirmedContact==true,force=force==true}
        control.punchBackReason='Confirmed return target; waiting only for native readiness and separate incoming threats'
        return true
    end
    function control.stepPunchBack()
        local pending=control.punchBackPending
        if not pending then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not control.enabled or (not control.referenceSettings.punchBack and not pending.force) or pending.character~=character
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) or (manualReader() and not pending.confirmedContact)
            or clock()<pending.at or clock()-pending.at>8 or not hostile(pending.target) then
            control.cancelPunchBack('Retaliation context ended');return
        end
        local melee=menu.m1Assist
        if melee and melee.userM1Held and melee.userM1Held() then control.cancelPunchBack('Manual M1 takes over');return end
        -- Manual Block Priority: a Block you are holding is only overridden by your own M1.
        if control.referenceSettings.manualBlockLock and manualReader() then control.cancelPunchBack('Manual Block held: only your manual M1 overrides it');return end
        -- A skipped request used to be retried every frame (hundreds of times a
        -- second of work while out of range or knocked back); retry at 7 Hz.
        -- Trace of why a queued return has not started yet (first 6 notes only).
        local function note(message: string)
            local punishOwner=menu.autoPunish
            if not (punishOwner and punishOwner.punishTrace) or (pending.noted or 0)>=6 then return end
            pending.noted=(pending.noted or 0)+1
            trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] Punch step +%dms: %s',math.floor((clock()-pending.at)*1000),message))
        end
        if pending.retryAt and clock()<pending.retryAt then note('waiting for retry timer');return end
        -- Auto Punish owns the return: it fires on the first allowed moment, so the
        -- "wait until the attack passes" option does not apply to forced returns.
        local waitForAttack=if pending.force then false else control.punchBackAfterAttack
        if not control.retaliationReady(pending.target,waitForAttack) then
            note('not ready, live threat = '..tostring(control.retaliationWhy)..' (afterAttack='..tostring(waitForAttack)..')')
            return
        end
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        if not punish or type(punish.requestRetaliation)~='function' or punish.pending then
            note('Auto Punish busy (pending='..tostring(punish~=nil and punish.pending~=nil)..')')
            return
        end
        -- Weapons reach further than the 6-stud default melee value, so a block
        -- from 7-8 studs was reported "outside Auto Punish Range". Use the larger
        -- of the melee default and your configured M1 bounds.
        local options={owner=control,count=pending.count,force=pending.force,range=math.min(control.range,control.downReach()),
            ready=function()return control.retaliationReady(pending.target,waitForAttack)end,
            onDone=function(accepted,submitted,completed,reason)
                control.punchBackAccepted+=accepted
                control.punchBackLast={accepted=accepted,submitted=submitted,completed=completed,reason=reason,target=pending.target}
                control.punchBackReason=reason
            end}
        local okay,started=pcall(punish.requestRetaliation,pending.target,options)
        note('requestRetaliation okay='..tostring(okay)..' started='..tostring(started))
        if okay and started then
            control.punchBackPending=nil;control.punchBackSequences+=1
            control.punchBackReason='Bounded native retaliation started'
        elseif not okay then control.cancelPunchBack('Native retaliation unavailable: '..tostring(started))
        else pending.retryAt=clock()+.03 end
    end

    local function referenceNumber(value,low,high)
        local n=tonumber(value)
        return if n and n==n and math.abs(n)<math.huge then math.clamp(n,low,high) else nil
    end
    function control.setReferenceOption(key,value)
        local s=control.referenceSettings
        local limits={chance={0,100},sensitivity={0,1},blockDelay={0,1},unblockDelay={0,1}}
        if limits[key] then
            value=referenceNumber(value,limits[key][1],limits[key][2]);if value==nil then return false end
        elseif key=='rangeType' then if value~='Static' and value~='Dynamic' then return false end
        elseif type(s[key])=='boolean' then value=value==true
        else return false end
        s[key]=value
        if key=='punchBack' and not value then control.cancelPunchBack('Punch Back disabled') end
        if control.referencePolicy then control.referencePolicy.cancel('Auto Block settings changed') end
        return true
    end
    function control.setReferenceM1Ids(values)
        if type(values)~='table' then return false end
        local ids={}
        for id,value in values do if type(id)=='string' and value~=nil then ids[id]=true end end
        if next(ids)==nil then return false end
        control.referenceM1Ids=ids;return true
    end
    function control.setReferenceDynamicMethod(name)
        -- Accept a recovered named native math operation, never a live callback.
        if name~='sqrt' and name~='log' and name~='log10' and name~='ceil' and name~='floor' then return false end
        if type(math[name])~='function' then return false end
        control.referenceDynamicMethod=name;return true
    end
    function control.setReferenceAFKState(value) control.referenceAFKState=if type(value)=='boolean' then value else nil end
    function control.setReferenceVisualizerColor(value)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        control.referenceSettings.visualizerColor=value
        if control.referenceVisualizer then control.referenceVisualizer.Color=value end
        return true
    end
    function control.setReferenceVisualizerTransparency(value)
        local alpha=tonumber(value)
        if not alpha or alpha~=alpha or math.abs(alpha)==math.huge then return false end
        control.referenceSettings.visualizerTransparency=math.clamp(alpha,0,1)
        if control.referenceVisualizer then control.referenceVisualizer.Transparency=control.referenceSettings.visualizerTransparency end
        return true
    end
    function control.updateReferenceVisualizer()
        local s=control.referenceSettings
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local alive=humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and control.referenceVisualizerDeadCharacter~=character
        if character and type(character.GetAttribute)=='function' and character:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then alive=false end
        if humanoid and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' and host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType then
            local ok,state=pcall(humanoid.GetState,humanoid)
            if ok and state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then alive=false end
        end
        local object=control.referenceVisualizer
        if not control.alive or not s.visualizer or not root or not alive then
            if object then object:Destroy();control.referenceVisualizer=nil end
            control.referenceVisualizerRoot=nil
            return
        end
        if not host.Instance or not host.CFrame or not host.Enum.PartType then return end
        if not object or control.referenceVisualizerRoot~=root then
            if object then object:Destroy() end
            object=host.Instance.new('Part')
            object.Name='ShenaniganismAutoBlockRange';object.Shape=host.Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            object.Anchored=true;object.CanCollide=false;object.CanTouch=false;object.CanQuery=false;object.CastShadow=false
            object.Transparency=s.visualizerTransparency or .7;object.Parent=root
            control.referenceVisualizer=object
            control.referenceVisualizerRoot=root
        end
        local radius=if s.rangeType=='Static' then math.max(s.minimumRange,control.range) else control.effectiveBlockRange or math.max(s.minimumRange,control.range)
        -- Exact recovered RenderStepped:5 ground-cylinder dimensions and pose.
        object.Size=host.Vector3.new(.1,radius*2,radius*2)
        object.CFrame=host.CFrame.new(root.Position-host.Vector3.new(0,2.9,0)+host.Vector3.new(0,.5,0))*host.CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2)
        object.Color=s.visualizerColor
        object.Transparency=s.visualizerTransparency or .7
    end
    function control.referenceReady()
        if not control.referenceM1Ids then return false,'Exact reference M1 animation IDs have not been supplied' end
        if control.referenceSettings.rangeType=='Dynamic' and not control.referenceDynamicMethod then return false,'Reference Dynamic range math key is unresolved' end
        if control.referenceSettings.afkCheck and control.referenceAFKState==nil then return false,'Reference AFK observer state is unavailable' end
        return true
    end
    function control.refreshReferenceTargets()
        local own=player.Character;local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        local s=control.referenceSettings;local selected={};local all=folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}
        local radius=control.range
        if s.rangeType=='Dynamic' then
            local count=0
            if root then for _,model in all do
                local other=model~=own and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                local hum=other and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                if hum and hum.Health>0 and (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=control.range then count+=1 end
            end end
            local reducer=control.referenceDynamicMethod and math[control.referenceDynamicMethod]
            if not reducer then control.referenceSubscriptions={};return end
            local divisor=reducer(math.max(count,1))
            if divisor~=divisor or divisor<=0 or math.abs(divisor)==math.huge then control.referenceSubscriptions={};return end
            radius/=divisor
        end
        radius=math.max(s.minimumRange,radius);control.effectiveBlockRange=radius
        local sticky=if s.sticky then control.referenceStickyTarget else nil
        local function eligible(model)
            local other=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            return root and other and hostile(model) and (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=radius
        end
        if sticky and not eligible(sticky) then sticky=nil end
        for _,model in all do
            if (not sticky or sticky==model) and eligible(model) then
                selected[model]=true
                if s.sticky and not sticky then sticky=model end
            end
        end
        control.referenceStickyTarget=sticky;control.referenceSubscriptions=selected
    end
    local function referencePing()
        local ok,value=pcall(function()
            local stats=host.game:GetService('Stats')
            return stats.Network.ServerStatsItem['Data Ping']:GetValue()
        end)
        if ok and type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then
            if control.referenceSmoothedPing==nil then control.referenceSmoothedPing=value
            else control.referenceSmoothedPing+=(value-control.referenceSmoothedPing)*.1 end
        end
        return control.referenceSmoothedPing or 0
    end
    control.referencePolicy=ReferenceAutoBlockPolicy.new({
        settings=function()
            local s=control.referenceSettings;s.enabled=control.enabled and control.alive;return s
        end,
        now=clock,random=math.random,allow=control.allowsThreat,
        predict=function()
            control.sampleDashHitHistory()
            control.predictionScans=(control.predictionScans or 0)+1
            return control.findThreat()
        end,
        lead=function()return math.max(control.perfectBlockLead,control.heartbeatStep+referencePing()/1000) end,
        maxHold=function()return control.maxHold end,
        staleHold=function()return math.min(control.maxHold,control.staleHold) end,
        syncManual=function()return control.manualSync==true end,
        reblockWindow=function(evidence)return control.unblockWindowActive(evidence)end,
        reblockDelay=function()return control.unblockReblockDelay end,
        minHold=function()return math.min(control.maxHold,control.minHold+referencePing()/1000) end,
        maintain=function(item)
            local own=player.Character;local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if info and not info:FindFirstChild('Block') and clock()-(control.lastPressAt or 0)>=.05 then
                -- Three quick failures (for example during stun) used to end
                -- re-arming for the whole attack. Allow a fresh set later.
                if (control.rearmAttempts or 0)>=3 and clock()-(control.lastPressAt or 0)>=.4 then control.rearmAttempts=0 end
                -- While an ordinary stun is still running the game ignores
                -- Block, so keep trying every tick (not counted) and the guard
                -- is up on the first frame it is accepted again.
                if control.blockAfterStun and (info:FindFirstChild('Stun')~=nil or own:GetAttribute('Stun')==true) then control.rearmAttempts=0 end
                if (control.rearmAttempts or 0)<(if control.unblockWindowActive() then 12 else 3) then
                    control.lastPressAt=clock();control.rearm()
                end
            end
        end,
        adjustedDelay=function(seconds)return math.max(0,seconds-referencePing()/1000) end,
        refreshTargets=control.refreshReferenceTargets,
        subscribed=function(model)return control.referenceSubscriptions[model]==true end,
        ignore=control.isEmoteTrack,
        m1=function(id)return control.referenceM1Ids and control.referenceM1Ids[id]~=nil end,
        actionPriority=function(priority)
            local levels=host.Enum.AnimationPriority
            return levels~=nil and (priority==levels.Action or priority==levels.Action2 or priority==levels.Action3 or priority==levels.Action4)
        end,
        facing=function(target,threshold)
            local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local other=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if not root or not other then return false end
            return control.enemyFacing(other,root.Position,threshold)
        end,
        afk=function()return control.referenceAFKState==true end,
        typing=function()return input:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil end,
        available=function()
            local ready,why=control.referenceReady()
            if not ready then control.lastReason=why;return false end
            return control.nativeReady and control.permitted(true)
        end,
        owns=function(lease)return lease~=nil and control.held==lease and (not manualReader() or control.manualOverridable()) end,
        release=function(reason)
            control.referenceReleasing=true;control.release();control.referenceReleasing=false
            control.referenceAimTarget=nil
            if reason and not control.referenceFailure then control.lastReason=reason end
        end,
        press=function(item)
            if control.blockDashSuppressed() then return nil end
            local current=bindings.get('Block')
            if not current or ((manualReader() or inputHeld(current)) and not control.manualOverridable()) then return nil end
            local continuing=control.held
            local snapshot=continuing or cloneBinding(current)
            if snapshot.modifier and inputHeld(snapshot.modifier) then snapshot.modifier=nil end
            control.held=snapshot;control.heldBinding=cloneBinding(current)
            if not continuing then control.heldStartedAt=clock();control.lastPressAt=clock();control.blockedHits=0 end
            control.rearmAttempts=0
            control.heldThreat=item.evidence or {token=item,kind=item.kind,record=control.records[item.target],single=false}
            control.latch={target=item.target,source=item.reason or 'Native animation',projectile=item.projectile,evidence=control.heldThreat,at=clock()}
            control.lastTarget=item.target;control.lastThreatSource=item.reason;control.referenceStickyTarget=item.target
            control.referenceAimTarget=if control.referenceSettings.lookAt then item.target else nil
            local info=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local ok,detail=true,nil
            if not continuing or not info or not info:FindFirstChild('Block') then
                ok,detail=sendOwned(snapshot,true)
                if ok then control.downs+=1 end
            end
            if not ok then
                if control.held==snapshot then control.release() end
                control.lastReason='Native Block failed: '..tostring(detail);return nil
            end
            control.lastReason='Blocking '..tostring(item.reason or item.kind)
            return if control.held==snapshot then snapshot else nil
        end,
        punchBack=function(target)
            if not manualReader() then control.queuePunchBack(target) end
        end,
    })
    function control.referenceObserve(model,track)
        if control.isEmoteTrack(model,track) then return false end
        local ready=control.referenceReady()
        if not ready or not control.enabled then return false end
        control.refreshReferenceTargets()
        return control.referencePolicy.observe(model,track)
    end
    function control.update()
        if control.referenceUpdating then return end
        control.referenceUpdating=true
        control.retaliationThreatAt=nil
        local ok,detail=pcall(function()
            pcall(control.traceHit)
            control.syncBlockDash()
            control.syncM1Override()
            control.sampleUnblock()
            control.interruptRetaliationForThreat()
            control.retryManualRecovery()
            if control.referenceCharacter~=player.Character then
                control.referencePolicy.cancel('Character changed; old Block episodes cancelled')
                control.referenceCharacter=player.Character;control.referenceStickyTarget=nil
            end
            local ready,why=control.referenceReady();control.referenceFailure=if not ready then why else nil
            control.referencePolicy.step()
            control.stepPunchBack()
            if not host.presentationRunService then control.updateReferenceVisualizer()end
            if not ready then control.lastReason=why end
        end)
        control.referenceUpdating=false
        if not ok then control.release();control.lastReason='Auto Block policy stopped: '..tostring(detail) end
    end
    function control.setRange(value: any)
        local number=tonumber(value) or 13
        if number~=number or number==math.huge or number==-math.huge then number=13 end
        control.range=math.clamp(number,0,60)
        local projectileLatch=control.latch and control.latch.projectile
        if not projectileLatch then control.latch=nil;control.lastThreatAt=-math.huge end
        if control.range<=0 and (not projectileLatch or control.projectileRange<=0) then control.release() end
        control.update()
    end

    end

    -- Tracks the owned Info.Block marker: the window opens when it disappears
    -- (the Block is unblocking) and closes when a new Block appears or it times out.
    function control.sampleUnblock()
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local state=control.unblockState
        if not info then control.unblockState=nil;return end
        if not state or state.character~=character then state={character=character,blocked=false};control.unblockState=state end
        if info:FindFirstChild('Block') then
            state.blocked=true;state.endedAt=nil
        elseif state.blocked then
            state.blocked=false;state.endedAt=clock()
        end
    end
    function control.unblockWindowActive(evidence: any?): boolean
        if not control.unblockReblockEnabled then return false end
        local state=control.unblockState
        local endedAt=state and state.endedAt
        if not endedAt or state.character~=player.Character then return false end
        local elapsed=clock()-endedAt
        if elapsed<0 or elapsed>control.unblockReblockWindow then return false end
        local token=evidence and evidence.token
        if token and control.unblockReblockTrace then
            local logged=control.unblockLogged
            if not logged then logged=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'});control.unblockLogged=logged end
            if not logged[token] then
                logged[token]=true
                trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] Unblock reblock: attack started %dms after Block ended; blocking now',math.floor(elapsed*1000)))
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setUnblockReblockEnabled(value: any)

    local function trackOwn(character: any)
        control.referenceVisualizerDeadCharacter=nil
        reconcileManualInputs()
        control.release();control.lastThreatAt=-math.huge
        control.manualRecoveryAt=nil;control.manualRecoveryAttempts=0;control.recoveryRearmAttempts=0
        control.manualForwardCharacter=nil;control.manualForwardAttempts=0
        control.dashLastVictim=nil;control.dashLastAttacker=nil;control.ownDashPhase=nil;control.ownDashUntil=nil
        control.dashLastVictimSource=nil;control.dashLastAttackerSource=nil
        table.clear(control.perfectAttempts)
        table.clear(control.completedContacts)
        control.untrack(character)
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        local watched={}
        local function attach(object: any)
            if object:IsA("Humanoid") and not watched[object] then watched[object]=true;table.insert(control.characterConnections,object.Died:Connect(function()
                control.referenceVisualizerDeadCharacter=character;control.updateReferenceVisualizer();control.release()
            end))end
            if object:IsA('Animator') and not watched[object] then
                watched[object]=true
                table.insert(control.characterConnections,object.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                    control.noteOwnDash(character,track)
                end))
            end
            if object.Name=='Info' and not watched[object] then
                watched[object]=true
                table.insert(control.characterConnections,object.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                    if child.Name=='InDash' then confirmOwnDash(character,'Native InDash state') end
                end))
                if object.ChildRemoved then table.insert(control.characterConnections,object.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
                    if (child.Name=='InSkill' or child.Name=='InDash' or child.Name=='Melee' or child.Name=='Attacking' or child.Name=='Stun')
                        and control.manualForwardCharacter==character then control.forwardManualBlock() end
                    local anti=menu.antiStunSpeed
                    if not anti or not anti.endlagEnabled or (child.Name~='InSkill' and child.Name~='InDash'
                        and child.Name~='Melee' and child.Name~='Attacking' and child.Name~='Stun') then return end
                    local function refreshRecovery()
                        if control.alive and player.Character==character and control.ownBlockRecovery() then control.update() end
                    end
                    if host.task and type(host.task.defer)=='function' then host.task.defer(refreshRecovery) else refreshRecovery() end
                end)) end
            elseif object.Name=='InDash' and object.Parent==character:FindFirstChild('Info') then
                confirmOwnDash(character,'Native InDash state')
            end
        end
        table.insert(control.characterConnections,character.DescendantAdded:Connect(attach))
        for _,object in character:GetDescendants() do attach(object) end
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(trackOwn))
    if player.CharacterRemoving then table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        control.ownDashPhase=nil;control.ownDashUntil=nil;control.release();control.lastThreatAt=-math.huge
        control.dashLastVictimSource=nil;control.dashLastAttackerSource=nil
    end)) end
    if player.Character then trackOwn(player.Character) end
    local characters=host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    if characters then
        for _,model in characters:GetChildren() do control.track(model) end
        table.insert(control.connections,characters.ChildAdded:Connect(control.track))
        table.insert(control.connections,characters.ChildRemoved:Connect(control.untrack))
        control.ready=true
        control.signalSources="Animator.AnimationPlayed, LastM1, native attack markers, incoming projectile trajectories"
    end
    for _,name in {"Effects","Projectiles"} do
        local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
        if folder then
            for _,object in folder:GetDescendants() do control.projectileCreated(object) end
            table.insert(control.connections,folder.DescendantAdded:Connect(control.projectileCreated))
        end
    end
    control.nativeSignals={}
    local nativeOk,knit=pcall(function()
        local folder=host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        return module and host.require(module)
    end)
    if nativeOk and knit then
        local function connectEffect(serviceName: string, callback: any): boolean
            local ok,signal=pcall(function() return knit.GetService(serviceName).Effects end)
            if ok and signal and type(signal.Connect)=="function" then
                table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback))
                control.nativeSignals[serviceName]=true
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        if type(knit.GetController)=="function" then
            local ok,tool=pcall(knit.GetController,"ToolController")
            if ok and tool and type(tool.Block)=="function" then control.nativeTool=tool end
        end
        if control.nativeTool then
            control.originalBlock=control.nativeTool.Block
            control.blockWrapper=function(self,...)
                -- While an Auto Punish sequence is releasing Block and swinging, a
                -- Block key you are still holding must not put the guard back up
                -- over it. Your hold resumes when the sequence ends.
                local punishOwner=menu.autoPunish
                if punishOwner and type(punishOwner.pauseAutomaticBlock)=='function' and punishOwner.pauseAutomaticBlock()==true
                    and not (control.referenceSettings.manualBlockLock and manualReader()) then return end
                if control.blockDashSuppressed() then return end
                if control.m1OverrideActive() then control.releaseForM1();return end
                local attempt
                if control.blockDashConcurrent() then
                    local character=player.Character;local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                    local dash=menu.dashControl
                    if dash and dash.observeBlockDash then dash.observeBlockDash(control.referenceAimTarget or control.lastTarget) end
                    attempt={character=character,at=clock(),priorBlock=info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')}
                    control.blockDashBlockRequests+=1;control.blockDashBlockAttempt=attempt
                    control.lastBlockDashBlockState='Native Block requested during active dash'
                end
                local results=table.pack(pcall(control.originalBlock,self,...))
                if not results[1] then
                    if control.blockDashBlockAttempt==attempt then control.blockDashBlockAttempt=nil end
                    if attempt then control.lastBlockDashBlockState='Native Block request failed: '..tostring(results[2]) end
                    error(results[2],0)
                end
                if attempt then control.observeBlockDashAcceptance() end
                return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
            end
            control.nativeTool.Block=control.blockWrapper
        end
        local blockOk,blockService=pcall(knit.GetService,"BlockService")
        if blockOk then control.nativeBlock=blockService end
        control.nativeReady=control.nativeTool~=nil and control.nativeBlock~=nil and control.nativeBlock.Deactivated~=nil
        function control.watchNativeSwings(model: any)
            local moveset=model:GetAttribute("Moveset")
            if type(moveset)~="string" or control.swingServices[moveset] then return end
            local connected=connectEffect(moveset.."Service",function(action: any,caster: any,stage: any)
                if action~="Swing2" or type(stage)~="number" or stage<1 or stage>4 then return end
                local record=control.records[caster]
                if not record or caster:GetAttribute("Moveset")~=moveset then return end
                local candidate,candidateTrack,ambiguous=nil,nil,false
                for track,state in record.tracks do
                    if state.descriptor.kind=='M1' and not state.nativeSwing and not control.completedContacts[state] and track.IsPlaying~=false
                        and clock()-state.at>=0 and clock()-state.at<=.22 then
                        if candidate then ambiguous=true;break end
                        candidate,candidateTrack=state,track
                    end
                end
                local previous=record.nativeSwing
                local stamp=tonumber(caster:GetAttribute('LastM1'))
                -- An echoed native stage within this same play is one contact.
                -- A fresh AnimationPlayed state always permits the next attack.
                if not candidate and not ambiguous and previous and previous.stage==stage and previous.stamp==stamp and previous.trackState
                    and record.tracks[previous.track]==previous.trackState and clock()-previous.at<=.22 then return end
                record.nativeSwing={at=clock(),stage=stage,stamp=stamp}
                if candidate and not ambiguous then pairM1Swing(record,candidateTrack,candidate,record.nativeSwing) end
                if control.enabled then control.update() end
            end)
            if connected then control.swingServices[moveset]=true end
        end
        for model in control.records do control.watchNativeSwings(model) end
        connectEffect("BlockService",control.onBlockedHit)
        connectEffect("ReversalRedService",function(action,character,part)
            if action~="Red" or not part then return end
            control.addProjectile(part)
            local record=control.projectileIndex[part]
            if record then record.owner=character end
        end)
        for _,name in {"FlameArrowService","FurnaceArrowService"} do
            connectEffect(name,function(action,character,part)
                if action=="Arrow" and part then
                    control.addProjectile(part)
                    local record=control.projectileIndex[part]
                    if record then record.owner=character end
                elseif action=="Interp" and character then
                    control.addProjectile(character)
                    local record=control.projectileIndex[character]
                    if record then record.predictedVelocity=character.CFrame.LookVector*192;record.velocity=record.predictedVelocity end
                end
            end)
        end
        connectEffect("ReserveBallService",function(action,character,fireFrame,part)
            if action=="Fire" and part then
                control.addProjectile(part)
                local record=control.projectileIndex[part]
                if record then
                    record.owner=character
                    -- ReserveBallController's native Interp moves this anchored
                    -- part along its LookVector at exactly 150 studs per second.
                    record.predictedVelocity=part.CFrame.LookVector*150
                    record.velocity=record.predictedVelocity
                    if control.enabled then control.update() end
                end
            elseif action=="Interp" and character then
                control.addProjectile(character)
                local record=control.projectileIndex[character]
                if record then record.predictedVelocity=character.CFrame.LookVector*150;record.velocity=record.predictedVelocity end
            end
        end)
        connectEffect('GraniteBlastService',function(action,part)
            if action~='Interp' or not part or not part:IsA('BasePart') then return end
            control.addProjectile(part)
            local record=control.projectileIndex[part]
            if record then
                record.category='Bullets'
                -- Verified native GraniteBlastController extrapolation speed.
                record.predictedVelocity=part.CFrame.LookVector*180
                record.velocity=record.predictedVelocity
            end
        end)
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: any)
        control.heartbeatFrame+=1
        if type(delta)=="number" and delta==delta and delta>0 and delta<math.huge then control.heartbeatStep=math.clamp(delta,1/240,0.25) end
        control.update()
    end))
    if host.presentationRunService and host.presentationRunService.RenderStepped then
        table.insert(control.connections,host.presentationRunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if control.alive then control.updateReferenceVisualizer()end
        end))
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.setEnabled(false);control.alive=false
        control.m1InterruptedBlock=nil
        control.blockDashInterrupted=nil
        control.blockDashBlockAttempt=nil;control.blockDashBlockProof=nil;control.blockDashAcceptedMarker=nil
        if control.nativeTool and control.nativeTool.Block==control.blockWrapper then control.nativeTool.Block=control.originalBlock end
        control.updateReferenceVisualizer()
        if bindings.manualBlockHeld==manualReader then bindings.manualBlockHeld=previousManual end
        for model in control.records do control.untrack(model) end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        table.clear(control.projectileModelParts)
    end
    return control
end
return AutoBlock
end)()

local AutoCounterFilter = (function(): any
-- Passive target selection for the existing native Auto Counter trigger.
-- This component does not send input, replace moves, or modify characters.
local AutoCounterFilter = {}

function AutoCounterFilter.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local replicated = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local runService = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local clock: any = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local kindOf: any = host.typeof or typeof
    local methods=menu.targetMethods
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, characterAlive = false, mode = if methods then methods.normalize('All threats') else "All threats",
        modes = if methods then methods.choices() else {"All threats", "Locked target", "Last hit target", "Locked or last hit"},
        connections = {}, characterConnections = {}, targetConnections = {}, records = {},
        nativeSignals = {}, nativeSignalCount = 0, ready = true, trackingReady = false,
        lastHitTarget = nil, lastHitAt = nil, lastHitSource = nil,
        lastHitRecord = nil, hitWindow = 2, lastHitListeners = {}, outgoingHitCount = 0,
        lastHitInferred = false, lastReason = "All threats are allowed",
        inferenceWindow = 0.35, inferenceReach = 6, minFacingDot = 0.5,
        recentNativeHits = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        recentNativeContacts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        recentNativeSwings = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        nativeContactListeners = {},
        damageListeners = {}, incomingDamageListeners = {}, damageEvidenceWindow = 1,
        nativeContactReady = false,
    }
    local sourceKeys = {"LastAttacker", "LastAttackerUserId", "Attacker", "AttackerUserId", "DamageSource", "HitBy", "LastHitBy", "creator", "Creator", "SourceUserId"}

    local function connect(list: any, signal: any, callback: any): any
        if not signal or type(signal.Connect) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local connection = (signal :: any):Connect(callback)
        table.insert(list, connection)
        return connection
    end

    local function disconnect(list: any)
        for _, connection in list do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(list)
    end

    local function modelFrom(value: any): any
        if kindOf(value) == "Instance" then
            if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
            if value:IsA("Model") then return value end
            return value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        elseif type(value) == "number" then
            local source = players:GetPlayerByUserId(value)
            return source and source.Character
        elseif type(value) == "string" then
            local source = players:FindFirstChild(value)
            if source and source:IsA("Player") then return source.Character end
            local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(value)
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function living(model: any): boolean
        if not model or not model.Parent or model == player.Character then return false end
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and model:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true
    end

    local function damageVictim(model: any): boolean
        -- The final health change can precede the hit effect. Keep lethal hits
        -- available to display listeners, but never retain them as counter targets.
        return model ~= nil and model.Parent ~= nil and model ~= player.Character
            and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil
    end

    function control.clearLastHit(reason: string?)
        disconnect(control.targetConnections)
        control.lastHitTarget = nil
        control.lastHitAt = nil
        control.lastHitSource = nil
        control.lastHitRecord = nil
        control.lastHitInferred = false
        if reason then control.lastReason = reason end
    end

    function control.refreshLastHit(): any
        local record = control.lastHitRecord
        if not record then return nil end
        local age = clock() - record.at
        if control.hitWindow <= 0 or not control.characterAlive or record.character ~= player.Character
            or not living(record.target) or age < 0 or age > control.hitWindow then
            control.clearLastHit("Last hit target expired or became unavailable")
            return nil
        end
        return record
    end

    function control.setHitWindow(value: any)
        local amount = tonumber(value) or 2
        if amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then amount = 2 end
        control.hitWindow = math.clamp(amount, 0, 30)
        control.refreshLastHit()
    end
    control.setRecentHitWindow = control.setHitWindow
    control.setLastHitWindow = control.setHitWindow

    function control.getLastHitRecord(): any
        local record = control.refreshLastHit()
        return if record then table.clone(record) else nil
    end

    function control.onLastHit(callback: any): any
        if not control.alive or type(callback) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local connection: any = {Connected = true, callback = callback}
        function connection:Disconnect()
            if not self.Connected then return end
            self.Connected = false
            local index = table.find(control.lastHitListeners, self)
            if index then table.remove(control.lastHitListeners, index) end
        end
        table.insert(control.lastHitListeners, connection)
        return connection
    end

    function control.onDamageHit(callback: any): any
        if not control.alive or type(callback)~="function" then return nil end
        local listener: any={Connected=true,callback=callback}
        function listener:Disconnect()
            if not self.Connected then return end
            self.Connected=false
            local index=table.find(control.damageListeners,self)
            if index then table.remove(control.damageListeners,index) end
        end
        table.insert(control.damageListeners,listener)
        return listener
    end
    function control.onIncomingDamageHit(callback: any): any
        if not control.alive or type(callback)~='function'then return nil end
        local listener: any={Connected=true,callback=callback}
        function listener:Disconnect()
            if not self.Connected then return end
            self.Connected=false
            local index=table.find(control.incomingDamageListeners,self)
            if index then table.remove(control.incomingDamageListeners,index)end
        end
        table.insert(control.incomingDamageListeners,listener)
        return listener
    end

    function control.rememberHit(victim: any, source: string, inferred: boolean?, at: number?, attackKind: string?, evidence: string?, nativeProof: any?): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.characterAlive then return false end
        local model = modelFrom(victim)
        if not damageVictim(model) then return false end
        local own = player.Character
        local humanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not own or not own.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
        local now = clock()
        local stamp = at or now
        if stamp ~= stamp or math.abs(stamp) == math.huge or stamp > now then stamp = now end
        disconnect(control.targetConnections)
        local classifier: any=control.m1EvidenceCurrent
        local verifiedM1=type(classifier)=="function" and (classifier :: any)() or false
        local m1=source=="Unique recent M1 damage inference" or source=="Unique native M1 hit inference"
            or ((source=="Fresh replicated outgoing damage source" or source=="Native local contact damage inference")
                and verifiedM1)
        local classification=if m1 then "M1" elseif attackKind=="Skill" then "Skill" else "Unknown"
        local record = {target = model, at = stamp, source = source, inferred = inferred == true, character = own,
            attackKind=classification,evidence=evidence or (if source=="Unique native M1 hit inference" then "native-victim-hit" else "health-delta"),accepted=true,nativeProof=nativeProof}
        if living(model) and control.hitWindow > 0 and now - stamp <= control.hitWindow then
            control.lastHitTarget, control.lastHitAt = model, stamp
            control.lastHitSource, control.lastHitInferred = source, inferred == true
            control.lastHitRecord = record
            local targetHumanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            connect(control.targetConnections, targetHumanoid.Died, function()
                if control.lastHitTarget == model then control.clearLastHit("Last hit target died") end
            end)
            connect(control.targetConnections, model.AncestryChanged, function()
                if control.lastHitTarget == model and not model.Parent then control.clearLastHit("Last hit target was removed") end
            end)
        else
            control.clearLastHit("Last hit retention is disabled or expired")
        end
        control.lastReason = source
        control.outgoingHitCount += 1
        for _, listener in (table.clone(control.lastHitListeners) :: {any}) do
            if listener.Connected and control.alive then pcall(listener.callback, model, stamp, source, inferred == true, record) end
        end
        return true
    end

    function control.onConfirmedHit(attacker: any, victim: any, source: string): boolean
        if not control.alive then return false end
        local owner, target = modelFrom(attacker), modelFrom(victim)
        if not owner or not target then return false end
        local track: any=control.trackModel
        if type(track)=="function" then (track :: any)(target) end
        local proof={owner=owner,at=clock(),source=source,evidence="native-caster-victim",character=player.Character}
        control.recentNativeHits[target] = proof
        if owner ~= player.Character or not control.characterAlive then return false end
        control.lastOwnSkillAt=clock()
        local remembered=control.rememberHit(target, source, false,nil,"Skill","native-caster-victim",proof)
        local observed=control.records[target]
        if observed and observed.damageAt and observed.emittedDamageVersion~=observed.damageVersion
            and clock()-observed.damageAt<=control.damageEvidenceWindow then control.onDamage(target) end
        return remembered
    end

    function control.lockedTarget(): any
        local environment = menu.environment
        local target = environment and modelFrom(environment.LockedTarget)
        return if living(target) then target else nil
    end

    function control.incomingAttacker(): any
        -- AutoLock keeps identified incoming damage separate from our outgoing
        -- victim evidence. Read it without emitting any own-hit/display event.
        local record=control.lastIncomingRecord
        if record then
            local age=clock()-record.at
            if control.characterAlive and record.character==player.Character and control.hitWindow>0
                and age>=0 and age<=control.hitWindow and living(record.target) then return record.target end
            control.lastIncomingRecord=nil
        end
        local observer=menu.autoLock
        local stamp=observer and observer.recentHitAt
        local target=observer and observer.recentAttacker
        if not observer or observer.alive==false or type(stamp)~="number" then return nil end
        local age=clock()-stamp
        return if control.characterAlive and control.hitWindow>0 and age>=0 and age<=control.hitWindow and living(target) then target else nil
    end

    function control.setMode(value: any): boolean
        if methods then
            local normalized,valid=methods.normalize(value)
            if not valid then return false end
            control.mode=normalized;return true
        end
        if type(value) ~= "string" or not table.find(control.modes, value) then return false end
        control.mode = value
        return true
    end

    function control.attackIntent(candidate: any): (boolean, string)
        local target=modelFrom(candidate)
        local own=player.Character
        if not target or not own then return false,'Attack target is unavailable' end
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(target)) then return false,'Target is on Friends Exclude' end
        local info = target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        for _, key in {'AttackTarget','AbilityTarget','TargetCharacter','TargetUserId'} do
            local value = target:GetAttribute(key)
            if value == nil and info then
                value = info:GetAttribute(key)
                local marker = info:FindFirstChild(key)
                if value == nil and marker and marker:IsA('ValueBase') then value = marker.Value end
            end
            local selected = modelFrom(value)
            if not selected and type(value)=='string' then
                local actor=players:FindFirstChild(value)
                local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
                selected=actor and actor.Character or (folder and folder:FindFirstChild(value))
            end
            if selected and selected~=own then return false, 'Enemy attack targets someone else' end
        end
        return true,'No conflicting explicit attack target'
    end
    function control.aimedAtUs(candidate: any): (boolean, string)
        local intended,reason=control.attackIntent(candidate)
        if not intended then return false,reason end
        local target=modelFrom(candidate)
        local own=player.Character
        local root=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local ownRoot=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root or not ownRoot then return false,'Attack direction is unavailable' end
        local direction=ownRoot.Position-root.Position
        direction=host.Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
        if direction.Magnitude<0.01 then return true, 'Enemy is at the current position' end
        local forward=root.CFrame.LookVector
        forward=host.Vector3.new(forward.X,0,forward.Z)
        if forward.Magnitude<0.01 or forward.Unit:Dot(direction.Unit)<control.minFacingDot then
            return false, 'Enemy is facing away from you'
        end
        return true, 'Enemy faces your character'
    end
    function control.meleeAimedAtUs(candidate: any): boolean
        if not control.aimedAtUs(candidate) then return false end
        local target=modelFrom(candidate)
        local own=player.Character
        local root=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local ownRoot=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root or not ownRoot then return false end
        local delta=ownRoot.Position-root.Position
        if math.abs(delta.Y)>6 then return false end
        local flat=host.Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector;look=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if look.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
        local forward=flat:Dot(look.Unit)
        local lateral=math.sqrt(math.max(0,flat.Magnitude^2-forward^2))
        return forward>=-.5 and lateral<=3.5
    end
    -- Approaching is useful for block/dash selection, never proof for a counter.
    function control.approaching(candidate: any,range: number?): (boolean, number?)
        if not control.attackIntent(candidate) then return false end
        local target=modelFrom(candidate)
        local own=player.Character
        local root=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local ownRoot=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root or not ownRoot or not root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or not ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity then return false end
        local delta=ownRoot.Position-root.Position
        if delta.Magnitude>(range or 80) or math.abs(delta.Y)>6 then return false end
        delta=host.Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity-ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        velocity=host.Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)
        if velocity.Magnitude<2 or delta.Magnitude<.01 then return false end
        local eta=delta:Dot(velocity)/(velocity.Magnitude^2)
        if eta~=eta or eta<0 or eta>.65 or delta.Unit:Dot(velocity)<2 then return false end
        return (delta-velocity*eta).Magnitude<=4.5,eta
    end

    local function selectedTarget(candidate: any): (boolean, string)
        if not control.alive then return false, "Auto Counter filter is unloaded" end
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        if punish and punish.pending and punish.pending.phase=="Executing" then
            control.lastReason="Auto Punish owns the current interaction"
            return false,control.lastReason
        end
        local target = modelFrom(candidate)
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(target)) then return false,"Target is on Friends Exclude" end
        if not living(target) then control.lastReason = "Counter target is unavailable"; return false, control.lastReason end
        control.refreshLastHit()
        if methods then
            -- Discovery admits each selected scope without comparing an idle
            -- bystander. selectThreat ranks only the complete proven pool.
            local allowed=methods.allowsScope(control.mode,target,methods.context({eligible=living}))
            control.lastReason=if allowed then 'Counter target matches the selected methods' else 'Counter target does not match the selected methods'
            return allowed,control.lastReason
        end
        if control.mode == "All threats" then return true, "All threats are allowed" end
        local locked, last = control.lockedTarget(), control.lastHitTarget
        local incoming=if control.mode=="Locked or last hit" then control.incomingAttacker() else nil
        local allowed = if control.mode == "Locked target" then target == locked
            elseif control.mode == "Last hit target" then target == last
            else target == locked or target == last or target == incoming
        control.lastReason = if allowed then "Counter target matches " .. control.mode else "Counter target does not match " .. control.mode
        return allowed, control.lastReason
    end

    function control.allows(candidate: any): (boolean, string)
        local allowed,reason=selectedTarget(candidate)
        if not allowed then return false,reason end
        return control.aimedAtUs(candidate)
    end

    if methods then
    function control.selectThreat(candidates: any,normalRank: any): any
        if not control.alive or not methods then return nil end
        local scope=methods.context({eligible=living})
        local extra={
            eligible=function(candidate)
                return methods.allowsScope(control.mode,candidate,scope)
                    and not (((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(candidate)))
            end,
            -- Normal retains the native counter's impact-first score. Explicit
            -- spatial methods use only the shared screen/world rank instead.
            normalRank=normalRank,
        }
        local spatial=methods.has(control.mode,'Closest to cursor') or methods.has(control.mode,'Closest to character')
        local context=if spatial then methods.screenContext(candidates,extra) else methods.context(extra)
        context.candidates=candidates
        local target,reason=methods.choose(if spatial then control.mode else {'Normal'},context)
        control.lastSelection=reason
        return target
    end
    end

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local rayParams: any=nil
    local nativeEnum: any=host.Enum
    if host.RaycastParams and nativeEnum and nativeEnum.RaycastFilterType then
        rayParams=host.RaycastParams.new()
        rayParams.FilterType=nativeEnum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rayParams.IgnoreWater=true
    end
    local function clearPath(from: any,to: any,target: any,projectile: any?): boolean
        if not rayParams or type(host.workspace.Raycast)~="function" then return false end
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances={player.Character,target,projectile}
        local ok,hit=pcall(host.workspace.Raycast,host.workspace,from,to-from,rayParams)
        return ok and hit==nil
    end
    -- Counter evidence has its own selected reach. Reuse the passive native
    -- records without changing Auto Block's proven contact/blockability gates.
    local projectileServices={ReserveBallService=true,ReversalRedService=true,PiercingBloodService=true,
        FlameArrowService=true,FurnaceArrowService=true}
    function control.inProjectileFrontLane(target: any): boolean
        local own=player.Character
        local from=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local toward=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not from or not toward then return false end
        local delta=toward.Position-from.Position
        local look=from.CFrame.LookVector
        local forward=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if forward.Magnitude<0.01 then return false end
        local flat=host.Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        local along=flat:Dot(forward.Unit)
        -- A forward corridor replaces the broad melee-facing cone for casts.
        return along>=0 and (flat-forward.Unit*along).Magnitude<=3 and math.abs(delta.Y)<=4
    end
    function control.isProjectileCast(target: any,info: any,name: string?): boolean
        if not info or not info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then return false end
        local moveset=target:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not moveset then return false end
        local cards={}
