        for _,card in moveset:GetChildren() do if card:IsA('NumberValue') then table.insert(cards,card) end end
        local function matches(label: any): boolean
            for _,card in cards do
                if projectileServices[card:GetAttribute('Service')] and (not label or card.Name:gsub('<[^>]->','')==label) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        if name then return matches(name) end
        if #cards==1 then return matches(nil) end
        local skill=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        if projectileServices[skill:GetAttribute('Service')] then return true end
        local names=menu.moveNames
        local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local animator=humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
        if not animator or not names or type(names.skillNameForTrack)~='function' then return false end
        local ok,tracks=pcall(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks,animator)
        if ok then for _,track in tracks do
            local named,label=pcall(names.skillNameForTrack,target,track)
            if named and label and matches(label) then return true end
        end end
        return false
    end
    local function incomingProjectile(target: any,root: any,range: number): (boolean, any,number?,number?)
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local predictor=menu.projectilePrediction
        local function incoming(record: any): (boolean,number?)
            local part=record.part
            if record.owner~=target or not part or not part.Parent then return false end
            if (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>range then return false end
            -- Sampling cannot depend on Auto Block being enabled: Counter may
            -- run alone, and a projectile can change direction mid-flight.
            local now=clock()
            if record.position and finite(record.at) and now>record.at then
                local observed=(part.Position-record.position)/(now-record.at)
                record.velocity=if observed.Magnitude>0.5 then observed else record.predictedVelocity or part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                record.position,record.at=part.Position,now
            end
            local velocity=record.velocity or record.predictedVelocity or part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if not velocity or not finite(velocity.Magnitude) or velocity.Magnitude<1 then return false end
            local delta=root.Position-part.Position
            local moving=velocity-(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or host.Vector3.new(0,0,0))
            if moving.Magnitude<1 or delta:Dot(moving)<=0 then return false end
            local time=delta:Dot(moving)/(moving.Magnitude^2)
            if not finite(time) or time<0 or time>1 or (delta-moving*time).Magnitude>3 then return false end
            return clearPath(part.Position,root.Position,target,record.source or part),time
        end
        for _,record in (block and block.projectileParts) or {} do
            local threatened,remaining=incoming(record)
            if threatened then return true,record,(record.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude,remaining end
        end
        for _,record in (predictor and predictor.records) or {} do
            local threatened,remaining=incoming(record)
            if threatened then return true,record,(record.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude,remaining end
        end
        return false,nil,nil
    end
    local function nativeAttack(target: any,info: any): (boolean, any, boolean, number?)
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local record=block and block.records and block.records[target]
        if not record then return false,nil,false end
        local skill=info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        local phased=false
        local upcoming,upcomingRemaining
        for track,state in record.tracks or {} do
            local descriptor=state.descriptor or {}
            local kind=descriptor.counterKind or descriptor.kind
            local age=clock()-(state.at or -math.huge)
            if track.IsPlaying~=true or age<0 or age>(if kind=="M1" then 1.5 else 8) then continue end
            if kind~="M1" and not (kind=="Move" and skill) then continue end
            local contact=state.contactTime
            local remaining
            if finite(contact) then
                phased=true
                local phase,speed=tonumber(track.TimePosition),tonumber(track.Speed) or 1
                if not finite(phase) or not finite(speed) or speed<=0 then continue end
                remaining=(contact-phase)/speed
                if remaining<-.03 then continue end
                if remaining>0.18 then
                    if not upcomingRemaining or remaining<upcomingRemaining then upcoming,upcomingRemaining=state,remaining end
                    continue
                end
            end
            return true,state,phased,remaining
        end
        return false,upcoming,phased,upcomingRemaining
    end

    local function nativeSkillAttack(target: any,info: any): any
        local skill=info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        local names=menu.moveNames
        if not skill or not names or type(names.skillNameForTrack)~='function' then return nil end
        local record=control.records[target]
        local humanoid=record and record.humanoid
        local animator=humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
        if not animator or type(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks)~='function' then return nil end
        local ok,tracks=pcall(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks,animator)
        if not ok then return nil end
        record.counterSkillTracks=record.counterSkillTracks or setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
        local nonAttacks={AdaptationService=true,SecondWindService=true,StabilizeService=true,BoostOnService=true,FlowingRedScaleService=true}
        for _,track in tracks do
            local matched,name=pcall(names.skillNameForTrack,target,track)
            if not matched or not name then continue end
            local moveset=target:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
            local offensive=false
            for _,card in moveset and moveset:GetChildren() or {} do
                if card:IsA('NumberValue') and card.Name:gsub('<[^>]->','')==name
                  and not nonAttacks[card:GetAttribute('Service')]
                  and card:GetAttribute('Offensive')~=false and card:GetAttribute('Attack')~=false then offensive=true;break end
            end
            if not offensive then continue end
            local state=record.counterSkillTracks[track]
            if not state or state.marker~=skill then
                state={track=track,marker=skill,at=clock(),descriptor={kind='Move',counterKind='Move'},name=name}
                for _,key in {'Hit','Impact','Attack','Damage','Contact'} do
                    local got,contact=pcall(function()return track:GetTimeOfKeyframe(key)end)
                    if got and finite(contact) and contact>=0 then state.contactTime=contact;break end
                end
                record.counterSkillTracks[track]=state
            end
            if clock()-state.at>8 then continue end
            if finite(state.contactTime) then
                local phase,speed=tonumber(track.TimePosition),tonumber(track.Speed) or 1
                if not finite(phase) or not finite(speed) or speed<=0 then continue end
                local remaining=(state.contactTime-phase)/speed
                if remaining< -0.12 or remaining>0.18 then continue end
            end
            return state
        end
        return nil
    end

    function control.allowsTrigger(candidate: any, counterRange: number?): (boolean, string)
        control.lastCounterEvidence=nil
        local allowed,reason=selectedTarget(candidate)
        if not allowed then return false,reason end
        local target=modelFrom(candidate)
        local own=player.Character
        local humanoid=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local info=own and own:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not control.characterAlive or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not info then
            return false,"Your character cannot counter now"
        end
        for _,name in {"Stun","TrueStun","Ragdoll","Knockback","InSkill","NoMove","DomainClash"} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false,"Native "..name.." prevents a new counter" end
        end
        if (tonumber(own:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0)>0 or own:GetAttribute("TrueStun")==true or own:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then
            return false,"Native recovery prevents a new counter"
        end
        local triggerReach=control.inferenceReach
        if finite(counterRange) then triggerReach=math.clamp(counterRange :: number,0,45/0.28) end
        local root=target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local ownRoot=own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not ownRoot or triggerReach<=0 then
            return false,"Incoming attack is outside the selected counter range"
        end
        local projectile,projectileRecord,projectileDistance,projectileRemaining=incomingProjectile(target,ownRoot,triggerReach)
        if projectile then
            control.lastCounterEvidence={target=target,token=projectileRecord,kind='Projectile',remaining=projectileRemaining,source="Incoming native projectile",distance=projectileDistance,at=clock()}
            return true,"Incoming native projectile"
        end
        if (root.Position-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude>triggerReach then
            return false,"Incoming attack is outside the selected counter range"
        end
        local aimed,aimReason=control.aimedAtUs(target)
        if not aimed then return false,aimReason end
        local enemyInfo=target:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not enemyInfo or enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("TrueStun") or (tonumber(target:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0)>0 then
            return false,"Enemy is not in an active attack phase"
        end
        local stun=enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("Stun")
        -- False Stun + InSkill is the native cast's self-lock, not an interrupted
        -- attacker. A real stun remains disqualifying, including marker-only Stun.
        if stun and not (stun:IsA("BoolValue") and stun.Value==false
          and (enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("InSkill") or enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("Melee") or enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("Attacking"))) then
            return false,"Enemy is not in an active attack phase"
        end
        local projectileCast=control.isProjectileCast(target,enemyInfo)
        if projectileCast then
            -- Cast startup is not projectile contact. Only the owned, incoming
            -- trajectory above can arm a projectile counter, including a curved
            -- projectile that enters our path after the caster turns away.
            return false,if control.inProjectileFrontLane(target) then 'Waiting for incoming projectile flight' else 'You are outside the projectile firing lane'
        end
        local attack,attackState,phased,remaining=nativeAttack(target,enemyInfo)
        if attack then
            if rayParams and not clearPath(root.Position,ownRoot.Position,target) then return false,"Incoming attack is obstructed" end
            local kind=attackState.descriptor and (attackState.descriptor.counterKind or attackState.descriptor.kind)
            control.lastCounterEvidence={target=target,token=attackState,kind=if kind=='M1' then 'M1' else 'Skill',remaining=remaining,source="Current native attack animation",at=clock()}
            return true,"Current native attack animation"
        end
        if phased then
            local kind=attackState and attackState.descriptor and (attackState.descriptor.counterKind or attackState.descriptor.kind)
            control.lastCounterEvidence={target=target,token=attackState or target,kind=if kind=='M1' then 'M1' else 'Skill',remaining=remaining,phaseKnown=true,at=clock()}
            return false,"Waiting for the native attack contact phase"
        end
        local skillState=nativeSkillAttack(target,enemyInfo)
        if skillState then
            projectileCast=projectileCast or control.isProjectileCast(target,enemyInfo,skillState.name)
            if projectileCast then return false,'Waiting for incoming projectile flight' end
            if rayParams and not clearPath(root.Position,ownRoot.Position,target) then return false,"Incoming attack is obstructed" end
            control.lastCounterEvidence={target=target,token=skillState,kind=if projectileCast then 'Projectile' else nil,source="Current native numbered skill: "..skillState.name,at=clock()}
            return true,"Current native numbered skill: "..skillState.name
        end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if block and type(block.imminentThreat)=="function" then
            local ok,incoming,source,fallbackProjectile,timing,proof=pcall(block.imminentThreat,target,true)
            control.lastReason=if ok and incoming then source or "Incoming attack is imminent" else "Waiting for an incoming attack to reach you"
            if not ok then return false,control.lastReason end
            if incoming==true then
                -- Actual projectiles already passed through the relative-motion,
                -- range and obstruction check above. Never bypass that check
                -- with a generic skill marker or the shared block horizon.
                if fallbackProjectile then return false,'Waiting for eligible incoming projectile flight' end
                if timing or proof then
                    control.lastCounterEvidence={target=target,token=(timing and timing.token) or (proof and proof.token) or target,
                        kind=(timing and timing.kind) or (proof and proof.kind),remaining=timing and timing.remaining,source=source,at=clock()}
                end
                return true,control.lastReason
            end
        end
        -- If the shared animation/projectile observer has not streamed in yet,
        -- accept only current native M1/contact markers, never generic InSkill.
        -- Native Counter may use its selected range; ownership inference keeps
        -- its separate native contact reach and callers without an override do too.
        local stamp=tonumber(target:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
        local age=if stamp then host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp else math.huge
        local contact=enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("Melee") or enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("Attacking")
        local swing=control.recentNativeSwings[target]
        local swingAge=if swing then clock()-swing.at else math.huge
        local freshSwing=swing~=nil and swingAge>=0 and swingAge<=0.22
        -- A real incoming Swing2 can precede animation/LastM1 replication. This
        -- counter-only evidence does not alter shared block timing or own-hit proof.
        local imminent=freshSwing or contact~=nil or (age>=-0.05 and age<=0.22)
        if imminent and rayParams and not clearPath(root.Position,ownRoot.Position,target) then return false,"Incoming attack is obstructed" end
        if imminent then control.lastCounterEvidence={target=target,token=if freshSwing then swing else contact or stamp,kind='M1',source="Current native M1 phase",at=clock()} end
        control.lastReason=if imminent then "Close current native attack" else "Waiting for an actual incoming attack"
        return imminent,control.lastReason
    end

    local function recentM1(model: any, serverNow: number): boolean
        local stamp = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
        local age = if stamp then serverNow - stamp else math.huge
        return age >= -0.05 and age <= control.inferenceWindow
    end
    local function recentNativeSwing(model: any): boolean
        local record=control.recentNativeSwings[model]
        local age=if record then clock()-record.at else math.huge
        return record~=nil and model.Parent~=nil and age>=0 and age<=control.inferenceWindow
    end
    function control.onNativeSwing(value: any,stage: any): boolean
        local caster=modelFrom(value)
        if not control.alive or not caster or not caster.Parent or type(stage)~="number" or stage~=stage
            or stage<1 or stage>20 or stage~=math.floor(stage) then return false end
        local humanoid=caster:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or caster:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return false end
        local info=caster:FindFirstChild("Info")
        control.recentNativeSwings[caster]={at=clock(),stage=stage,character=caster,skillMarker=info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")}
        return true
    end
    function control.m1EvidenceCurrent(): boolean
        local own=player.Character
        if not own or not control.characterAlive or not recentNativeSwing(own) then return false end
        local record=control.recentNativeSwings[own]
        if control.lastOwnSkillAt and control.lastOwnSkillAt>=record.at and clock()-control.lastOwnSkillAt<=control.inferenceWindow then return false end
        local info=own:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        return not marker or marker==record.skillMarker
    end

    local function canReach(attacker: any, target: any): boolean
        local from = attacker and attacker:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local toward = target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not from or not toward then return false end
        local offset = toward.Position - from.Position
        if offset.Magnitude > control.inferenceReach then return false end
        local flat = host.Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
        local facing = from.CFrame.LookVector
        local look = host.Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
        return flat.Magnitude > 0.05 and look.Magnitude > 0.05 and look.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit) >= 0.2
    end

    local function freshDamageOwner(victim: any): (any, boolean)
        local record = control.records[victim]
        local selected = nil
        if record then
            local now = clock()
            for _, source in record.damageSources do
                local age = now - source.at
                if age >= 0 and age <= control.inferenceWindow and source.owner and source.owner.Parent then
                    if selected and selected ~= source.owner then return nil, true end
                    selected = source.owner
                end
            end
        end
        return selected, selected ~= nil
    end

    function control.onIncomingDamage(): boolean
        local own=player.Character
        local observed=own and control.records[own]
        local at=observed and observed.damageAt
        if not control.alive or not control.characterAlive or not at or clock()-at<0
            or clock()-at>control.inferenceWindow then return false end
        local target,explicit=freshDamageOwner(own)
        local source='Fresh incoming replicated damage source'
        if explicit and not living(target) then control.lastIncomingRecord=nil;return false end
        if not explicit then
            source='Unique fresh incoming native M1 at health loss'
            local serverNow=host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            for candidate in control.records do
                if not living(candidate) or not canReach(candidate,own) then continue end
                local aimed=control.aimedAtUs(candidate)
                if not aimed then continue end
                local info=candidate:FindFirstChild('Info')
                local fresh=recentNativeSwing(candidate) or recentM1(candidate,serverNow)
                if fresh then
                    if target and target~=candidate then control.lastIncomingRecord=nil;return false end
                    target=candidate
                elseif info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then
                    -- A competing nearby cast makes damage ownership ambiguous.
                    control.lastIncomingRecord=nil;return false
                end
            end
        end
        if not living(target) then return false end
        local record: any={target=target,at=at,character=own,source=source,inferred=not explicit}
        control.lastIncomingRecord=record
        -- Incoming health loss has its own observer channel. It must never
        -- refresh outgoing hit history or turn a contact/block into a hit.
        local humanoid=own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local version,delta=observed.damageVersion,observed.damageDelta
        if humanoid and observed.humanoid==humanoid and humanoid.Parent==own and humanoid.Health>0
            and observed.damageCharacter==own and type(observed.health)=='number'and observed.health>0
            and type(version)=='number'and version>0 and version%1==0 and version<math.huge
            and type(delta)=='number'and delta==delta and delta<0 and delta>-math.huge then
            record.accepted,record.exactHealthLoss=true,true
            record.damageVersion,record.version,record.delta=version,version,delta
            record.previousHealth,record.currentHealth=observed.damageBefore,observed.health
            record.evidence='attributed-incoming-health-loss'
            if observed.emittedIncomingDamageVersion~=version then
                -- Mark first so a listener's synchronous reads cannot publish
                -- the same health event again. Source upgrades keep its time.
                observed.emittedIncomingDamageVersion=version
                observed.lastIncomingDamageRecord=record
                for _,listener in (table.clone(control.incomingDamageListeners) :: {any})do
                    if listener.Connected and control.alive then pcall(listener.callback,target,at,source,not explicit,record)end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    function control.onDamage(victim: any): boolean
        if victim==player.Character then return control.onIncomingDamage() end
        if not control.alive or not control.characterAlive or not damageVictim(victim) then return false end
        local own = player.Character
        local ownHumanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not ownHumanoid or ownHumanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
        local observed = control.records[victim]
        local damagedAt = if observed and observed.damageAt then observed.damageAt else clock()
        local function publishDamage(source: string,inferred: boolean,attackKind: string?,proof: any?): boolean
            if not observed or not observed.damageAt or type(observed.damageDelta)~="number" or observed.damageDelta>=0
                or observed.emittedDamageVersion==observed.damageVersion then return false end
            local now=clock()
            if now-damagedAt<0 or now-damagedAt>control.damageEvidenceWindow then return false end
            local record={target=victim,character=own,at=damagedAt,source=source,inferred=inferred,accepted=true,
                exactHealthLoss=true,damageVersion=observed.damageVersion,delta=observed.damageDelta,
                attackKind=attackKind or "Unknown",nativeProof=proof,evidence="attributed-health-loss"}
            observed.emittedDamageVersion=observed.damageVersion
            observed.lastDamageRecord=record
            for _,listener in (table.clone(control.damageListeners) :: {any}) do
                if listener.Connected and control.alive then pcall(listener.callback,victim,damagedAt,source,inferred,record) end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function rememberDamage(source: string, inferred: boolean, attackKind: string?): boolean
            publishDamage(source,inferred,attackKind)
            if observed and observed.damageAt and observed.reportedDamageVersion == observed.damageVersion then
                local record = control.lastHitRecord
                if not inferred and record and record.target == victim and record.at == damagedAt and record.inferred then
                    record.source, record.inferred = source, false
                    control.lastHitSource, control.lastHitInferred = source, false
                end
                return true
            end
            local remembered = control.rememberHit(victim, source, inferred, damagedAt,attackKind)
            if remembered and observed and observed.damageAt then observed.reportedDamageVersion = observed.damageVersion end
            return remembered
        end
        local owner, explicitSource = freshDamageOwner(victim)
        if explicitSource then
            if owner ~= own then
                control.lastReason = "Damage has another or ambiguous replicated attacker"
                local record = control.lastHitRecord
                if record and record.target == victim and record.at == damagedAt and record.inferred then control.clearLastHit(control.lastReason) end
                return false
            end
            return rememberDamage("Fresh replicated outgoing damage source", false,"Skill")
        end
        local explicit = control.recentNativeHits[victim]
        local proofAge=if explicit then clock()-explicit.at else math.huge
        if explicit and proofAge>=0 and proofAge<=control.damageEvidenceWindow then
            if explicit.owner ~= own then control.lastReason = "Damage has another confirmed attacker"; return false end
            -- One caster/victim effect proves one health decrease. Consuming it
            -- once avoids duplicating that hit without swallowing subsequent
            -- ticks/multi-hits which have their own contact or source evidence.
            if observed and observed.damageAt and not explicit.damageVersion then
                explicit.damageVersion=observed.damageVersion
                observed.reportedDamageVersion=observed.damageVersion
                publishDamage(explicit.source or "Native confirmed outgoing damage source",explicit.inferred==true,
                    if explicit.inferred then "M1" else "Skill",explicit)
                return true
            elseif observed and explicit.damageVersion==observed.damageVersion then
                publishDamage(explicit.source or "Native confirmed outgoing damage source",explicit.inferred==true,
                    if explicit.inferred then "M1" else "Skill",explicit)
                return true
            end
        end
        local contact = control.recentNativeContacts[victim]
        local contactAge = if contact then damagedAt - contact.at else math.huge
        local ownContact = contact and contact.owner == own and not contact.ambiguous
            and contact.character == own and contactAge >= -control.damageEvidenceWindow and contactAge <= control.damageEvidenceWindow
        if contact and math.abs(contactAge) <= control.damageEvidenceWindow and (contact.owner ~= own or contact.ambiguous) then
            control.lastReason = "Native contact has another or ambiguous attacker"
            return false
        end
        local info = own:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local serverNow = host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        if not ownContact then
            -- The native Swing2 receipt can precede LastM1 replication. Its
            -- captured marker also distinguishes that M1's own busy interval
            -- from a later skill; use the same evidence as victim-Hit handling.
            local nativeM1 = control.m1EvidenceCurrent()
            local freshSkill = control.lastOwnSkillAt and clock()-control.lastOwnSkillAt <= control.inferenceWindow
            if (freshSkill and not nativeM1) or (info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill") and not nativeM1) then return false end
            if not (nativeM1 or recentM1(own, serverNow)) or not canReach(own, victim) then return false end
        end
        local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not folder then return false end
        for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if model == own or model == victim or not living(model) then continue end
            local enemyInfo = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
            if (recentM1(model, serverNow) or recentNativeSwing(model) or (enemyInfo and enemyInfo:FindFirstChild("InSkill"))) and canReach(model, victim) then
                control.lastReason = "Ambiguous nearby damage attackers"
                return false
            end
        end
        -- A health decrease plus one plausible native M1 attacker is an
        -- inference, not a server-provided attacker identity.
        return rememberDamage(if ownContact then "Native local contact damage inference" else "Unique recent M1 damage inference", true,if ownContact then "Skill" else "M1")
    end

    function control.onNativeVictimHit(value: any): boolean
        -- HandicapService.Hit names the real hit victim even when an invulnerable
        -- dummy loses no replicated health. It does not identify the attacker.
        local victim=modelFrom(value)
        if not control.alive or not control.characterAlive or not damageVictim(victim) then return false end
        local own=player.Character
        local humanoid=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false end
        local serverNow=host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        local ownInfo=own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local freshSkill=control.lastOwnSkillAt and clock()-control.lastOwnSkillAt<=control.inferenceWindow
        local activity=control.m1EvidenceCurrent() or (recentM1(own,serverNow) and not freshSkill and not (ownInfo and ownInfo:FindFirstChild('InSkill')))
        if not activity or not canReach(own,victim) then return false end
        local owner,explicit=freshDamageOwner(victim)
        if explicit and owner~=own then return false end
        local now=clock()
        local proof=control.recentNativeHits[victim]
        local proofAge=if proof then now-proof.at else math.huge
        if proof and proofAge>=0 and proofAge<=control.inferenceWindow then
            if proof.owner~=own then return false end
            -- A caster/victim confirmation already emitted this hit. Keep its
            -- stronger ownership proof and avoid a second inferred notification.
            if proof.inferred~=true then return true end
        end
        local contact=control.recentNativeContacts[victim]
        local contactAge=if contact then now-contact.at else math.huge
        if contact and contactAge>=0 and contactAge<=0.2 and (contact.owner~=own or contact.ambiguous) then
            control.lastReason='Native contact has another or ambiguous attacker'
            return false
        end
        for model in control.records do
            if model==own or model==victim or not living(model) then continue end
            local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if (recentM1(model,serverNow) or recentNativeSwing(model) or (info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill'))) and canReach(model,victim) then
                control.lastReason='Ambiguous native hit attackers'
                return false
            end
        end
        local track: any=control.trackModel
        if type(track)=='function' then (track :: any)(victim) end
        local victimProof={owner=own,at=now,inferred=true,source='Unique native M1 hit inference',evidence='native-victim-hit',character=own}
        control.recentNativeHits[victim]=victimProof
        local remembered=control.rememberHit(victim,'Unique native M1 hit inference',true,now,nil,'native-victim-hit',victimProof)
        local observed=control.records[victim]
        if observed and observed.damageAt and observed.emittedDamageVersion~=observed.damageVersion
            and now-observed.damageAt<=control.damageEvidenceWindow then control.onDamage(victim) end
        return remembered
    end

    function control.onNativeContact(callback: any): any
        if type(callback)~="function" or not control.alive then return nil end
        local listener: any={Connected=true,callback=callback}
        function listener:Disconnect()
            self.Connected=false
            local index=table.find(control.nativeContactListeners,self)
            if index then table.remove(control.nativeContactListeners,index) end
        end
        table.insert(control.nativeContactListeners,listener)
        return listener
    end
    function control.onNativeContacts(attacker: any, victims: any)
        if not control.alive or not control.characterAlive or type(victims) ~= "table" then return end
        local owner = modelFrom(attacker)
        if not owner or not owner.Parent then return end
        local now = clock()
        for _, victim in victims do
            local target = modelFrom(victim)
            if not damageVictim(target) then continue end
            local track: any=control.trackModel
            if type(track)=="function" then (track :: any)(target) end
            local previous = control.recentNativeContacts[target]
            local ambiguous = previous and now - previous.at <= control.damageEvidenceWindow
                and (previous.owner ~= owner or previous.ambiguous) or false
            control.recentNativeContacts[target] = {owner = owner, at = now, character = player.Character, ambiguous = ambiguous}
            if owner==player.Character and not ambiguous then
                for _,listener in (table.clone(control.nativeContactListeners) :: {any}) do
                    if listener.Connected and control.alive then pcall(listener.callback,target,now,owner) end
                end
            end
            local record = control.records[target]
            if record and record.damageAt and now - record.damageAt <= control.damageEvidenceWindow then control.onDamage(target) end
        end
    end

    function control.trackModel(model: any, notifyMenu: boolean?): any
        if not control.alive or not model or not model.Parent or not model:IsA("Model") then return nil end
        if control.records[model] then return control.records[model] end
        local record: any = {connections = {}, humanoid = nil, health = nil, damageSources = {}, watchedSources = {}, damageVersion = 0}
        control.records[model] = record
        local function updateSource(key: any, value: any)
            local owner = modelFrom(value)
            record.damageSources[key] = if owner then {owner = owner, at = clock()} else nil
            if record.damageAt and clock() - record.damageAt <= control.inferenceWindow then control.onDamage(model) end
        end
        local function watchSources(object: any)
            if record.watchedSources[object] then return end
            record.watchedSources[object] = true
            for _, key in sourceKeys do
                connect(record.connections, object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key), function()
                    updateSource(tostring(object) .. "/" .. key, object:GetAttribute(key))
                end)
            end
            local function watchMarker(marker: any, fresh: boolean)
                if marker.Name == "Info" then watchSources(marker); return end
                if not marker:IsA("ValueBase") or not table.find(sourceKeys, marker.Name) or record.watchedSources[marker] then return end
                record.watchedSources[marker] = true
                connect(record.connections, marker:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"), function() updateSource(marker, marker.Value) end)
                connect(record.connections, marker.AncestryChanged, function()
                    if not marker.Parent then record.damageSources[marker] = nil end
                end)
                if fresh then updateSource(marker, marker.Value) end
            end
            for _, marker in object:GetChildren() do watchMarker(marker, false) end
            connect(record.connections, object.ChildAdded, function(marker: any) watchMarker(marker, true) end)
        end
        watchSources(model)
        local function attachHumanoid(humanoid: any)
            if not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or record.humanoid then return end
            record.humanoid, record.health = humanoid, humanoid.Health
            local changed = humanoid.HealthChanged or humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health")
            connect(record.connections, changed, function(eventHealth: any)
                -- Deferred HealthChanged callbacks can arrive after several
                -- skill ticks have already changed the live property. Consume
                -- each event's own health snapshot so every real loss retains
                -- its matching version; property-signal fallback has no value.
                local before = record.health
                local current=if type(eventHealth)=="number" and eventHealth==eventHealth and math.abs(eventHealth)<math.huge then eventHealth else humanoid.Health
                record.health = current
                if before and current < before then
                    record.damageVersion += 1
                    record.damageAt = clock()
                    record.damageDelta=current-before
                    record.damageBefore,record.damageCharacter=before,player.Character
                    control.onDamage(model)
                elseif before and current > before then
                    record.damageAt = nil
                end
            end)
            -- Use the same discovered actors for damage popups, including NPCs
            -- and humanoids added after injection. No hitbox toggle is required.
            local trackDisplay: any=menu.TrackHum
            if notifyMenu~=false and type(trackDisplay)=="function" then (trackDisplay :: any)(humanoid) end
            control.trackingReady = true
        end
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then attachHumanoid(humanoid) end
        connect(record.connections, model.ChildAdded, attachHumanoid)
        connect(record.connections, model.AncestryChanged, function()
            if model.Parent then return end
            disconnect(record.connections)
            control.records[model] = nil
            if control.lastHitTarget == model then control.clearLastHit("Last hit target was removed") end
        end)
        return record
    end

    function control.adoptHumanoid(humanoid: any): any
        if not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") then return nil end
        -- TrackHum owns its display subscription. Do not call it recursively
        -- when it asks us to adopt an actor discovered by the original scan.
        return control.trackModel(humanoid.Parent, false)
    end

    local function characterAdded(character: any)
        disconnect(control.characterConnections)
        control.lastIncomingRecord=nil
        control.clearLastHit("Local character changed")
        table.clear(control.recentNativeHits)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeContacts)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeSwings)
        control.lastOwnSkillAt=nil
        control.characterAlive = true
        local attached = false
        local function attachDeath(humanoid: any)
            if not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or attached then return end
            attached = true
            connect(control.characterConnections, humanoid.Died, function()
                control.characterAlive = false
                control.clearLastHit("Local character died")
            end)
        end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then attachDeath(humanoid) end
        connect(control.characterConnections, character.ChildAdded, attachDeath)
    end
    connect(control.connections, player.CharacterAdded, characterAdded)
    connect(control.connections, player.CharacterRemoving, function()
        control.characterAlive = false
        control.lastIncomingRecord=nil
        control.clearLastHit("Local character was removed")
        disconnect(control.characterConnections)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeHits)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeContacts)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeSwings)
        control.lastOwnSkillAt=nil
    end)
    if player.Character then characterAdded(player.Character) end
    if runService then connect(control.connections, runService.Heartbeat, function() control.refreshLastHit() end) end

    local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    if folder then
        for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do control.trackModel(model) end
        connect(control.connections, folder.ChildAdded, control.trackModel)
    end

    local function nativeSignal(serviceName: string, callback: any, signalName: string?)
        local knitFolder = replicated:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local knitModule = knitFolder and knitFolder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local services = knitModule and knitModule:FindFirstChild("Services")
        if not services or not services:FindFirstChild(serviceName) then return end
        local ok, signal = pcall(function() return host.require(knitModule).GetService(serviceName)[signalName or 'Effects'] end)
        if ok and connect(control.connections, signal, callback) then
            control.nativeSignals[serviceName] = true
            control.nativeSignalCount += 1
            control.trackingReady = true
        end
    end
    nativeSignal("ReserveBallService", function(method: any, attacker: any, victim: any)
        if method == "Hit" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker, victim, "Native Reserve Ball hit") end
    end)
    nativeSignal("GojoService", function(method: any, attacker: any, victim: any)
        if method == "ChaseHit" or method == "AerialHit" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker, victim, "Native Gojo " .. method) end
    end)
    nativeSignal("HakariService", function(method: any, attacker: any, victim: any)
        if method == "ChaseHit" or method == "CounterHit" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker, victim, "Native Hakari " .. method) end
    end)
    nativeSignal("HandicapService", function(attacker: any, method: any, victim: any)
        if method == "Grab" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker, victim, "Native grab hit") end
    end)
    nativeSignal('HandicapService',control.onNativeVictimHit,'Hit')
    nativeSignal('ItadoriService',function(method: any,caster: any,value: any)
        if method=='Swing2' then control.onNativeSwing(caster,value)
        elseif method=='Hit' then control.onNativeVictimHit(caster)
        elseif method=='ChaseHit' or method=='BlackFlashHit' then control.onConfirmedHit(caster,value,'Native Itadori '..method) end
    end)
    -- Only signatures whose first two arguments are caster and victim are used.
    -- Victim-only effects and swing effects cannot establish an outgoing hit.
    local verifiedHits: {[string]: {[string]: boolean}} = {
        LapseBlueService = {Grab=true,Hit=true},
        FocusStrikeService = {Hit = true, BlackFlashHit = true, ChainHit = true,Finisher=true,Finisher1=true},
        BruteForceService = {Hit = true, BlackFlashHit = true},
        DivergentFistService = {DivergentStun = true, BlackFlashHit = true,BlackFlashFinisherHard=true},
        ReversalRedMaxService = {BlackFlashHit=true},
        -- Captured native controllers identify both attacker and victim here.
        -- Victim-only blood hits / position-only explosions are deliberately
        -- left to the shared native contact + actual health-loss route.
        SupernovaService = {Hit=true,Hit1=true,Hit2=true},
        GarudaReboundService = {Hit=true,HeavyHit=true},
        CleaveRushService = {CleaveGrab=true,BlackFlashFinisherHard=true},
        ResoluteSlashService = {BlackFlash=true},
    }
    for serviceName, hitMethods in verifiedHits do
        nativeSignal(serviceName, function(method: any, attacker: any, victim: any)
            if hitMethods[method] then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker, victim, "Native " .. serviceName .. " " .. method) end
        end)
    end

    -- Observe the game's own query results; do not execute a query, change its
    -- victims, or dispatch an attack. A contact alone never emits a damage hit.
    pcall(function()
        local knitFolder = replicated:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local knitModule = knitFolder and knitFolder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local knit: any = knitModule and host.require(knitModule)
        if not knit or type(knit.GetController) ~= "function" then return end
        local getController: any = knit.GetController
        local hitbox = getController("HitboxController")
        local original = hitbox and hitbox.SphereHitbox
        if type(original) ~= "function" then return end
        local wrapper
        wrapper = function(self: any, attacker: any, ...: any): ...any
            local results = table.pack(original(self, attacker, ...))
            if control.alive then pcall(control.onNativeContacts, attacker, results[1]) end
            return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
        end
        hitbox.SphereHitbox = wrapper
        control.nativeContactRestore = function()
            if hitbox.SphereHitbox == wrapper then hitbox.SphereHitbox = original end
        end
        control.nativeContactReady = true
    end)

    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        control.lastIncomingRecord=nil
        if control.nativeContactRestore then pcall(control.nativeContactRestore) end
        control.clearLastHit("Auto Counter filter is unloaded")
        disconnect(control.connections)
        disconnect(control.characterConnections)
        for _, record in control.records do disconnect(record.connections) end
        table.clear(control.records)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeHits)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeContacts)
        table.clear(control.recentNativeSwings)
        for _, listener in (table.clone(control.lastHitListeners) :: {any}) do listener:Disconnect() end
        for _, listener in (table.clone(control.nativeContactListeners) :: {any}) do listener:Disconnect() end
        for _, listener in (table.clone(control.damageListeners) :: {any}) do listener:Disconnect() end
        for _,listener in (table.clone(control.incomingDamageListeners) :: {any})do listener:Disconnect()end
    end
    return control
end

return AutoCounterFilter
end)()

local SprintControl = (function(): any
-- Relax only the native sprint direction test while native sprint intent exists.
local SprintControl: {[string]: any} = {}
function SprintControl.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    menu=menu or {}
    local player = host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local input = host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local guiOk,gui=pcall(function()return host.game:GetService('GuiService')end)
    if not guiOk then gui=nil end
    local read, write = host.getconstants, host.setconstant
    local control: any = {alive=true,enabled=false,active=false,ready=false,focused=true,connections={},characterConnections={},modifiers={},normalThreshold=0.5,anyDirectionThreshold=-2,lastReason='Sprint in Any Direction is disabled',calls=0,relaxedCalls=0}
    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(control.connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function constants(fn)
        if type(read)~='function' then return nil end
        local ok, values=pcall(read,fn)
        return if ok and type(values)=='table' then values else nil
    end
    function control.inspectThreshold()
        local values=control.nativeFunction and constants(control.nativeFunction)
        return values and values[control.constantIndex]
    end
    local function callbackOf(connection)
        local ok, value=pcall(function() return connection.Function end)
        return if ok then value else nil
    end
    local function restricted(value)
        return value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0)
    end
    function control.shiftLocked()
        local behavior=host.Enum and host.Enum.MouseBehavior
        if behavior and input and input.MouseBehavior==behavior.LockCenter then return true end
        local directional=menu.directionalLock
        if directional and type(directional.nativeShiftLocked)=='function' then
            local ok,value=pcall(directional.nativeShiftLocked)
            if not ok or value==true then return true end
        end
        local lease=directional and directional.shiftCursorLease
        return lease~=nil and lease.active==true and behavior~=nil and input~=nil
            and (input.MouseBehavior==behavior.LockCurrentPosition or lease.warping==true and input.MouseBehavior==behavior.Default)
            or false
    end
    function control.discover()
        if control.active then return control.ready end
        if type(host.getconnections)~='function' or type(read)~='function' or type(write)~='function' or not host.debug or type(host.debug.info)~='function' then
            control.ready=false;control.lastReason='Native sprint direction inspection APIs are unavailable';return false
        end
        local ok, list=pcall(host.getconnections,run.Stepped)
        if not ok then control.ready=false;control.lastReason='Native movement callbacks are unavailable';return false end
        local candidates={}
        for _,connection in list do
            local fn=callbackOf(connection)
            if type(fn)~='function' then continue end
            local sourceOk,source,line=pcall(host.debug.info,fn,'sl')
            if not sourceOk or type(source)~='string' or not source:match('MovementController$') then continue end
            local values=constants(fn)
            if not values then continue end
            local found, index, count={},nil,0
            for at,value in values do
                if type(value)=='string' then found[value]=true end
                if value==0.5 then index=at;count+=1 end
            end
            if count~=1 or not (found.MoveDirection and found.Dot and found.NoSprint and found.AutoRun and found.Sprint and found.Stun and found.Block and found.Ragdoll and found.WalkSpeed and found.Parkour) then continue end
            if type(connection.Disable)~='function' or type(connection.Enable)~='function' or connection.Enabled~=true then continue end
            table.insert(candidates,{connection=connection,fn=fn,index=index,source=source..':'..tostring(line)})
        end
        if #candidates~=1 then
            control.ready=false
            control.lastReason=if #candidates>1 then 'Native sprint direction guard is ambiguous' else 'Verified native sprint direction guard is unavailable or already owned'
            return false
        end
        local selected=candidates[1]
        control.nativeConnection,control.nativeFunction,control.constantIndex,control.source=selected.connection,selected.fn,selected.index,selected.source
        -- The recovered movement callback reads its OWN _G.Settings.AutoRun.
        -- Executor/script globals can be a different table (or have no Settings
        -- at all). Retain the callback environment, but read its current Settings
        -- table each update so native settings reloads are respected.
        control.nativeEnvironment=nil
        if type(host.getfenv)=='function'then
            local readOk,environment=pcall(host.getfenv,selected.fn)
            if readOk and type(environment)=='table'then control.nativeEnvironment=environment end
        end
        control.ready=true
        return true
    end
    function control.sprintIntent(character)
        local environment=control.nativeEnvironment
        local globals=environment and environment._G
        local settings=type(globals)=='table' and globals.Settings
        if type(settings)=='table'then
            control.sprintSettingsSource='Native movement _G.Settings'
        else
            -- Compatibility for runtimes without function-environment reads.
            -- Native settings, when available, always win including AutoRun=false.
            local sharedSettings=host.shared and host.shared.Settings
            globals=host._G or host
            settings=if type(sharedSettings)=='table'then sharedSettings else globals.Settings
            control.sprintSettingsSource=if type(sharedSettings)=='table'then 'Shared settings fallback'else 'Script settings fallback'
        end
        return type(settings)=='table'and settings.AutoRun==true or character and character:GetAttribute('Sprint')==true or false
    end
    function control.eligible(character)
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false,'Paused by Failsafe' end
        if not control.focused then return false,'Roblox is unfocused' end
        local focused=host.isrbxactive or host.iswindowactive
        if type(focused)=='function' then
            local ok,active=pcall(focused)
            if not ok or active~=true then return false,'Roblox is unfocused' end
        end
        if input and input.GetFocusedTextBox and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false,'Typing takes priority' end
        if gui and gui.MenuIsOpen or menu.recording or menu.menuKeyCapturing
            or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then return false,'Menu input takes priority' end
        if control.shiftLocked() then return false,'Sprint in Any Direction applies only outside shift lock' end
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or not info or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false,'The character is unavailable or dead' end
        local states=host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        if states and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' then
            local state=humanoid:GetState()
            if state==states.Dead or state==states.Ragdoll or state==states.FallingDown or state==states.Physics then return false,'Native ragdoll recovery takes priority' end
        end
        if player:GetAttribute('Spectate')==true or restricted(character:GetAttribute('Dead')) or restricted(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')) or restricted(character:GetAttribute('CompleteRagdoll')) or restricted(character:GetAttribute('TrueRagdoll')) or humanoid.PlatformStand then return false,'Native recovery or spectator state takes priority' end
        for _,name in {'NoSprint','Stun','Block','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) or restricted(character:GetAttribute(name)) then return false,'Native '..name..' restriction takes priority' end
        end
        for _,name in {'Emote','Emoting','EmoteActive'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) or restricted(value) or type(value)=='string' and value~='' and value~='None' then return false,'Native emote movement takes priority' end
        end
        if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude<=0.05 then return false,'No movement input' end
        if not control.sprintIntent(character)then return false,'Native sprint input or AutoRun is required' end
        return true
    end
    function control.restoreThreshold()
        if control.patchOwned and control.inspectThreshold()==control.anyDirectionThreshold then
            local ok=pcall(write,control.nativeFunction,control.constantIndex,control.normalThreshold)
            if not ok then control.lastReason='Native sprint direction threshold could not be restored';return false end
        end
        control.patchOwned=false
        return true
    end
    function control.release()
        local wrapper=control.wrapperConnection
        control.wrapperConnection=nil
        if wrapper then pcall(function() wrapper:Disconnect() end) end
        control.restoreThreshold()
        local native=control.nativeConnection
        if control.connectionOwned and native and callbackOf(native)==control.nativeFunction and native.Enabled==false then
            local ok=pcall(function() native:Enable() end)
            if not ok then control.lastReason='Native movement callback could not be re-enabled' end
        end
        control.connectionOwned,control.active=false,false
    end
    function control.runNative(...)
        local fn=control.nativeFunction
        local current=control.inspectThreshold()
        if current~=control.normalThreshold then
            control.lastReason='Another component owns the native sprint direction threshold'
            control.release()
            return fn(...)
        end
        local relax=false
        if control.alive and control.enabled then
            local ok,allowed,reason=pcall(control.eligible,player.Character)
            relax=ok and allowed==true
            control.lastReason=if relax then 'Native sprint intent works in every direction outside shift lock' else if ok then reason else 'Sprint eligibility is unavailable; native movement is unchanged'
        end
        if relax then
            local changed=pcall(write,fn,control.constantIndex,control.anyDirectionThreshold)
            if not changed then control.lastReason='Native sprint direction guard cannot be adjusted';control.release();return fn(...) end
            control.patchOwned=true
            control.relaxedCalls+=1
        end
        local arguments=table.pack(...)
        local modifiers={}
        for _,modifier in control.modifiers do
            local success,context=pcall(modifier.before,fn,read,write)
            if success then table.insert(modifiers,{modifier=modifier,context=context})
            else control.lastReason='Native movement modifier failed: '..tostring(context) end
        end
        local ok,result=xpcall(function() return table.pack(fn(table.unpack(arguments,1,arguments.n))) end,function(err) return tostring(err) end)
        for index=#modifiers,1,-1 do
            local item=modifiers[index]
            local success,err=pcall(item.modifier.after,item.context,fn,read,write)
            if not success then control.lastReason='Native movement modifier cleanup failed: '..tostring(err) end
        end
        control.restoreThreshold()
        control.calls+=1
        if not ok then error(result,0) end
        return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
    end
    function control.install()
        if control.active then return true end
        if not control.discover() then return false end
        local native=control.nativeConnection
        local disabled=pcall(function() native:Disable() end)
        if not disabled or native.Enabled~=false then
            control.connectionOwned=native.Enabled==false
            control.release();control.lastReason='The native movement callback cannot be temporarily owned';return false
        end
        control.connectionOwned=true
        local ok,connection=pcall(function() return run.Stepped:Connect(control.runNative) end)
        if not ok then control.release();control.lastReason='Sprint direction wrapper could not be connected';return false end
        control.wrapperConnection,control.active=connection,true
        control.lastReason='Native sprint direction wrapper is ready; shift-lock and input guards apply'
        return true
    end
    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if not control.enabled and next(control.modifiers)==nil then control.release();return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then
            control.release();control.lastReason='Native movement was restored while the character is unavailable';return
        end
        if not control.active then control.install() end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        control.enabled=control.alive and value==true
        if control.enabled or next(control.modifiers)~=nil then control.refresh()
        else control.release();control.lastReason='Sprint in Any Direction is disabled' end
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        control.restoreThreshold()
        control.lastReason='Paused by Failsafe; native movement is unchanged'
    end
    function control.onFailsafeResume()control.refresh()end
    function control.addModifier(id,before,after)
        assert(control.alive and type(before)=='function' and type(after)=='function','Invalid native movement modifier')
        local modifier={before=before,after=after}
        control.modifiers[id]=modifier
        control.refresh()
        return function()
            if control.modifiers[id]==modifier then control.modifiers[id]=nil;control.refresh() end
        end
    end
    function control.track(character)
        control.release()
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        if character then
            local watched={}
            local function attach(object)
                if object:IsA('Humanoid') and not watched[object] then
                    watched[object]=true
                    table.insert(control.characterConnections,object.Died:Connect(control.release))
                end
            end
            table.insert(control.characterConnections,character.ChildAdded:Connect(attach))
            for _,object in character:GetChildren() do attach(object) end
        end
        if character then control.refresh() end
    end
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,control.track)
    if player.CharacterRemoving then connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function() control.track(nil) end) end
    if input and input.WindowFocusReleased then connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()control.focused=false end) end
    if input and input.WindowFocused then connect(input.WindowFocused,function()control.focused=true end) end
    local elapsed=0
    connect(run.Heartbeat,function(delta)
        elapsed+=delta
        if elapsed>=0.25 then elapsed=0;control.refresh() end
    end)
    control.discover()
    if player.Character then control.track(player.Character) end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        table.clear(control.modifiers)
        control.setEnabled(false);control.alive=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.characterConnections)
    end
    return control
end
return SprintControl
end)()

local AntiStunSpeed = (function(): any
-- Scoped native movement reads preserve the game's skill-ending marker lifetime.
local AntiStunSpeed: {[string]: any} = {}
function AntiStunSpeed.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local starter=host.game:GetService("StarterPlayer")
    local clock=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=false,ready=false,speed=starter.CharacterWalkSpeed,connections={},
        normalStunSpeed=0.1,lastReason="Anti-Stun movement speed is disabled",appliedSteps=0}
    local function finite(value)
        return type(value)=="number" and value==value and value~=math.huge and value~=-math.huge
    end
    local function positive(value) return value==true or (type(value)=="number" and value>0) end
    local protectedNames={Stun=true,NoJump=true,NoSprint=true}
    control.endlagEnabled=false
    control.endlagDelay=0
    control.fourthM1RecoveryEnabled=false
    control.fourthM1RecoveryDelay=0
    function control.setFourthM1Recovery(value)
        control.fourthM1RecoveryEnabled=control.alive and value==true;control.refresh()
    end
    function control.setFourthM1RecoveryDelay(value)
        if not finite(value) then return false end
        control.fourthM1RecoveryDelay=math.clamp(value,0,1);return true
    end
    function control.setEndlagDelay(value)
        if not finite(value) then return false end
        control.endlagDelay=math.clamp(value,0,1);return true
    end
    control.skillMovementEnabled=false
    function control.setSkillMovement(value)
        control.skillMovementEnabled=control.alive and value==true;control.refresh()
    end
    function control.noteIncomingRecovery()
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if not record then return end
        record.incomingAt=clock();record.ownAt=-math.huge;record.ownSkill=nil;record.completedAt=nil;record.skillTool=nil;record.pendingSkillTool=nil
        record.m1RecoveryMarker=nil;record.m1RecoveryAt=nil;record.m1Stage=nil
        table.clear(record.ownRecovery)
        table.clear(record.pendingRecovery)
        record.blockAction=nil;record.blockCompletedAt=nil
        table.clear(record.blockRecovery);table.clear(record.blockPendingRecovery)
    end
    function control.setAntiEndlag(value)
        control.endlagEnabled=control.alive and value==true
        control.refresh()
    end
    local function clearSkillGuard()
        control.nativeStartupLease=nil
        local record=control.skillGuard
        control.skillGuard=nil
        if not record then return end
        for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(record.connections);table.clear(record.protected)
    end
    local function currentNativeTool(tool)
        local character=player.Character
        local moveset=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not moveset or not info or not tool or tool.Parent~=moveset or not (tool:IsA('NumberValue') or tool:IsA('Tool')) then return nil end
        local slot,service=tool:GetAttribute('Key'),tool:GetAttribute('Service')
        if not finite(slot) or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>4 or type(service)~='string' or service=='' then return nil end
        local native=control.nativeSkillController
        if not native or native:ReturnKey(slot)~=tool then return nil end
        return {character=character,info=info,moveset=moveset,movesetName=character:GetAttribute('Moveset'),tool=tool,slot=slot,service=service}
    end
    function control.skillStartupProtected(character)
        local lease=control.nativeStartupLease
        if not control.alive or not lease then return false end
        local ok,current=pcall(currentNativeTool,lease.tool)
        if clock()>=lease.untilAt or not ok or not current or current.character~=lease.character
            or current.info~=lease.info or current.moveset~=lease.moveset or current.movesetName~=lease.movesetName
            or current.slot~=lease.slot or current.service~=lease.service then
            control.nativeStartupLease=nil;return false
        end
        return character==lease.character
    end
    local function beginNativeSkill(tool)
        local lease=currentNativeTool(tool)
        if not lease then return nil end
        control.refreshSkillGuard()
        lease.untilAt=clock()+0.65
        control.nativeStartupLease=lease
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if record and record.character==lease.character then
            record.ownAt=clock();record.completedAt=nil;record.pendingSkillTool=tool;table.clear(record.pendingRecovery)
        end
        return lease
    end
    function control.installNativeSkillGuard()
        if not control.alive or control.nativeSkillHook then return end
        if control.nextNativeDiscovery and clock()<control.nextNativeDiscovery then return end
        control.nextNativeDiscovery=clock()+1
        local ok,message=pcall(function()
            local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
            local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
            local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
            local knit=module and host.require(module)
            local native=knit and knit.GetController('ToolController')
            if not native or type(native.UseTool)~='function' or type(native.ReturnKey)~='function' then return end
            local hook={owner=native,original=native.UseTool,active=true}
            control.nativeSkillController=native
            hook.wrapper=function(self,tool,action,...)
                local lease
                if hook.active and control.alive and self==native and action=='Activated' then
                    local started,result=pcall(beginNativeSkill,tool)
                    if started then lease=result end
                end
                local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,tool,action,...))
                if not result[1] then
                    if lease and control.nativeStartupLease==lease then control.nativeStartupLease=nil end
                    error(result[2],0)
                end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
            native.UseTool=hook.wrapper
            control.nativeSkillHook=hook
            control.nativeSkillGuardReady=true
            if type(knit.GetService)=='function' then
                local serviceOk,service=pcall(knit.GetService,'HandicapService')
                if serviceOk and service and service.Hit and type(service.Hit.Connect)=='function' then
                    table.insert(control.connections,service.Hit:Connect(function(victim)
                        if victim==player.Character then control.noteIncomingRecovery() end
                    end))
                end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then control.nativeSkillGuardError=tostring(message) end
    end
    local function currentSkill(record)
        return record.info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil or positive(record.character:GetAttribute('InSkill'))
    end
    local function markSkillRestrictions(record)
        for _,marker in record.info:GetChildren() do
            if protectedNames[marker.Name] then record.protected[marker]=true end
        end
    end
    local function refreshSkillEpisode(record)
        local active=currentSkill(record)
        if active or record.inSkill then
            -- Native ending markers may outlive InSkill. Keep ownership of
            -- their exact instances until native cleanup removes each one.
            record.untilAt=clock()+0.2
            markSkillRestrictions(record)
        end
        record.inSkill=active
        return active or clock()<record.untilAt
    end
    function control.refreshSkillGuard()
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if record and (record.character~=character or record.info~=info or not character.Parent or not info.Parent
            or record.kit~=character:GetAttribute('Moveset')) then clearSkillGuard();record=nil end
        if record or not control.alive or not character or not character.Parent or not info then return end
        record={character=character,info=info,kit=character:GetAttribute('Moveset'),connections={},protected=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),untilAt=-math.huge,inSkill=false,
            ownRecovery=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),pendingRecovery=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),ownAt=-math.huge,incomingAt=-math.huge,
            blockRecovery=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),blockPendingRecovery=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})}
        control.skillGuard=record
        table.insert(record.connections,info.ChildAdded:Connect(function(marker)
            local ownWindow=clock()-record.incomingAt>=0.35 and (clock()-record.ownAt<=0.15 or record.ownSkill and record.ownSkill.Parent==info)
            if marker.Name=='InSkill' and ownWindow and marker:GetAttribute('Emote')~=true and not info:FindFirstChild('Emote') then
                table.clear(record.ownRecovery)
                for pending,addedAt in record.pendingRecovery do
                    if pending.Parent==info and addedAt>=record.ownAt and clock()-addedAt<=0.02 then record.ownRecovery[pending]=true end
                end
                table.clear(record.pendingRecovery)
                record.ownSkill=marker;record.completedAt=nil
                record.skillTool=record.pendingSkillTool;record.pendingSkillTool=nil
                record.m1Stage=if not record.skillTool then character:GetAttribute('CurrentM1') else nil
                record.m1RecoveryMarker=nil;record.m1RecoveryAt=nil
            elseif protectedNames[marker.Name] and ownWindow and marker:IsA('BoolValue') and marker.Value==false and marker:GetAttribute('CullingRecoveryHold')~=true then
                if record.ownSkill and record.ownSkill.Parent==info then record.ownRecovery[marker]=true
                else record.pendingRecovery[marker]=clock() end
            end
            if marker.Name=='Stun' and record.m1Stage==4 and record.ownRecovery[marker]
                and record.ownSkill and record.ownSkill.Parent==info and not record.skillTool then
                record.m1RecoveryMarker=marker;record.m1RecoveryAt=clock()
            end
            -- A real native action marker, rather than Q or a skill key, owns
            -- this short block-recovery episode. Keep its exact restrictions
            -- intact; only native Block requests are retried after it ends.
            if (marker==record.ownSkill or marker.Name=='InDash') and clock()-record.incomingAt>=0.35
                and marker:GetAttribute('Emote')~=true and not info:FindFirstChild('Emote') then
                record.blockAction=marker;record.blockCompletedAt=nil;table.clear(record.blockRecovery)
                for pending,addedAt in record.blockPendingRecovery do
                    if pending.Parent==info and clock()-addedAt<=0.02 then record.blockRecovery[pending]=true end
                end
                table.clear(record.blockPendingRecovery)
            elseif protectedNames[marker.Name] and marker:IsA('BoolValue') and marker.Value==false
                and marker:GetAttribute('CullingRecoveryHold')~=true then
                if record.blockAction and record.blockAction.Parent==info and clock()-record.incomingAt>=0.35 then
                    record.blockRecovery[marker]=true
                else record.blockPendingRecovery[marker]=clock() end
            end
            if protectedNames[marker.Name] and (refreshSkillEpisode(record) or control.skillStartupProtected(character)) then record.protected[marker]=true
            elseif marker.Name=='InSkill' then refreshSkillEpisode(record) end
        end))
        if info.ChildRemoved then table.insert(record.connections,info.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(marker)
            record.protected[marker]=nil
            record.ownRecovery[marker]=nil
            record.pendingRecovery[marker]=nil
            if marker==record.m1RecoveryMarker then record.m1RecoveryMarker=nil;record.m1RecoveryAt=nil end
            if marker==record.ownSkill then record.ownSkill=nil;record.completedAt=clock();record.ownAt=-math.huge end
            record.blockRecovery[marker]=nil;record.blockPendingRecovery[marker]=nil
            if marker==record.blockAction then
                record.blockAction=nil;record.blockCompletedAt=clock()
                local block=menu.autoBlock
                if control.endlagEnabled and block and type(block.noteOwnActionEnded)=='function' then
                    block.noteOwnActionEnded(character)
                end
            end
            if marker.Name=='InSkill' then refreshSkillEpisode(record) end
        end)) end
        if character.GetAttributeChangedSignal then
            table.insert(record.connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('CurrentM1'):Connect(function()
                local current=character:GetAttribute('CurrentM1')
                if type(current)=='number' and current>=1 and current<=4 and clock()-record.incomingAt>=0.35 then
                    -- Native CurrentM1 advances immediately AFTER InSkill cleanup.
                    -- Keep that completed attack's tail until a new InSkill begins.
                    record.ownAt=clock();table.clear(record.pendingRecovery)
                    record.skillTool=nil
                    record.pendingSkillTool=nil
                end
            end))
            table.insert(record.connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Stun'):Connect(function()
                if positive(character:GetAttribute('Stun')) then control.noteIncomingRecovery() end
            end))
        end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid and humanoid.HealthChanged then
            local previous=humanoid.Health
            table.insert(record.connections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
                if health<previous then control.noteIncomingRecovery() end
                previous=health
            end))
        end
        if character.GetAttributeChangedSignal then table.insert(record.connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('InSkill'):Connect(function()
            refreshSkillEpisode(record)
        end)) end
        refreshSkillEpisode(record)
    end
    function control.shouldPreserveNativeMarker(marker)
        -- Called immediately before BOTH legacy Destroy paths (including
        -- after task.wait). Never change another actor's or a bare hit marker.
        if not control.alive or not marker or not protectedNames[marker.Name] then return false end
        control.refreshSkillGuard()
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if not record or marker.Parent~=record.info then return false end
        if refreshSkillEpisode(record) then record.protected[marker]=true end
        return record.protected[marker]==true
    end
    function control.isEnabled()
        local shared=menu.environment and menu.environment._G
        if shared and shared.AntiStun~=nil then return shared.AntiStun==true end
        local entry=menu.entries and (menu.entries["Game/Anti-Stun"] or menu.entries["Main/Anti-Stun"])
        if entry and entry.widget and type(entry.widget.Get)=="function" then return entry.widget.Get()==true end
        return false
    end
    local function toggle(globalName,entryName)
        local shared=menu.environment and menu.environment._G
        if shared and shared[globalName]~=nil then return shared[globalName]==true end
