        local entry=menu.entries and (menu.entries["Main/"..entryName] or menu.entries["Game/"..entryName])
        if entry and entry.widget and type(entry.widget.Get)=="function" then
            local ok,value=pcall(entry.widget.Get)
            return ok and value==true
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.isNoJumpEnabled() return toggle("AntiNoJump","Anti-NoJump") end
    function control.isNoSprintEnabled() return toggle("AntiNoSprint","Anti-NoSprint") end
    local function movementEpisode()
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health<=0 or not info then return nil end
        if player:GetAttribute("Spectate")==true or character:GetAttribute("Dead")==true or humanoid.PlatformStand then return nil end
        for _,name in {"Ragdoll","CompleteRagdoll","TrueRagdoll","TrueStun","Movement","NoMove","NoMovement"} do if positive(character:GetAttribute(name)) then return nil end end
        for _,name in {"Block","TrueStun","Knockback","Ragdoll","CompleteRagdoll","TrueRagdoll","DomainClash","NoMove","NoMovement","Movement"} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return nil end end
        local states=host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        if states and humanoid.GetState then
            local state=humanoid:GetState()
            if state==states.Physics or state==states.Ragdoll or state==states.FallingDown or state==states.GettingUp or state==states.Dead then return nil end
        end
        return {character=character,humanoid=humanoid,info=info}
    end
    function control.episode()
        local episode=movementEpisode()
        if not episode then return nil end
        local character,info=episode.character,episode.info
        local marker
        for _,object in info:GetChildren() do
            if object.Name=="Stun" and object:GetAttribute("CullingRecoveryHold")~=true then marker=object;break end
        end
        if not marker and character:GetAttribute("Stun")~=true then return nil end
        episode.marker=marker
        return episode
    end
    function control.releaseSpeed()
        local record=control.speedRecord
        control.speedRecord=nil
        if not record or record.character~=player.Character or not record.humanoid.Parent or record.humanoid.Health<=0 or record.humanoid.WalkSpeed~=record.applied then return end
        -- A previous stun's 0.1 is never replayed into normal walking/recovery.
        local episode=control.episode()
        if episode and (record.mode=="attribute" or episode.marker) then record.humanoid.WalkSpeed=record.base end
    end
    local function multiplier(humanoid)
        local scale=1
        for _,name in {"Speed","Speed2"} do
            local value=humanoid:GetAttribute(name)
            if value~=nil then if not finite(value) or value<0 then return nil end;scale*=value end
        end
        return scale
    end
    local aliases={NoJump="__ShenaniganismNoJumpMovementRead",NoSprint="__ShenaniganismNoSprintMovementRead",Stun="__ShenaniganismStunMovementRead"}
    local function counterTable(fn,episode)
        if type(host.getupvalues)~="function" then return nil end
        local ok,values=pcall(host.getupvalues,fn)
        if not ok or type(values)~="table" or values[1]~=episode.character or values[3]~=episode.humanoid or values[4]~=episode.info then return nil,false end
        local counters=values[6]
        if type(counters)~="table" then return nil,false end
        for _,name in {"Stun","NoJump","Block","Emote","NoLock"} do if not finite(rawget(counters,name)) then return nil,false end end
        return counters,true
    end
    local function patchRead(context,fn,values,write,name,counters)
        local index,count=nil,0
        for at,value in values do if value==name then index=at;count+=1 end end
        if count~=1 then return false end
        local alias=aliases[name]
        if context.info:FindFirstChild(alias) or (counters and rawget(counters,alias)~=nil) then return false end
        if counters then rawset(counters,alias,0) end
        local changed=pcall(write,fn,index,alias)
        if not changed then if counters and rawget(counters,alias)==0 then rawset(counters,alias,nil) end;return false end
        table.insert(context.patches,{index=index,original=name,applied=alias,counters=counters})
        return true
    end
    local function restoreReads(context,fn,read,write)
        for index=#context.patches,1,-1 do
            local patch=context.patches[index]
            local ok,values=pcall(read,fn)
            if ok and type(values)=="table" and values[patch.index]==patch.applied then pcall(write,fn,patch.index,patch.original) end
            if patch.counters and rawget(patch.counters,patch.applied)==0 then rawset(patch.counters,patch.applied,nil) end
        end
        table.clear(context.patches)
        for _,patch in context.endlagCounts or {} do
            if rawget(patch.counters,patch.name)==patch.applied then rawset(patch.counters,patch.name,patch.original) end
        end
    end
    function control.endlagEligible()
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if not control.endlagEnabled or not record or record.character~=player.Character or record.character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~=record.kit
            or not record.completedAt or clock()-record.completedAt<control.endlagDelay
            or clock()-record.completedAt>control.endlagDelay+0.3 or clock()-record.incomingAt<0.35
            or record.ownSkill or currentSkill(record) or control.skillStartupProtected(record.character) then return false end
        for _,name in {'Counter','Emote','Block','Melee','Attacking','InDash','InRoll','Movement','NoMove','NoMovement','TrueStun','Ragdoll','Knockback','DomainClash'} do
            if record.info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        return not positive(record.character:GetAttribute('Stun'))
    end
    function control.blockRecoveryEligible(character)
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if not control.alive or not control.endlagEnabled or not record or character~=player.Character
            or record.character~=character or not character.Parent or record.info~=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            or record.kit~=character:GetAttribute('Moveset') or not record.blockCompletedAt
            or clock()-record.blockCompletedAt<control.endlagDelay or clock()-record.blockCompletedAt>control.endlagDelay+0.65
            or clock()-record.incomingAt<0.35 or record.blockAction or currentSkill(record)
            or positive(character:GetAttribute('Stun')) then return false end
        for _,name in {'Counter','Emote','Melee','Attacking','InDash','InRoll','Movement','NoMove','NoMovement','TrueStun','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','Knockback','DomainClash'} do
            if record.info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        -- Do not turn an unrelated enemy hit-stun into our own endlag.
        for _,marker in record.info:GetChildren() do
            if marker.Name=='Stun' and (not record.blockRecovery[marker] or not marker:IsA('BoolValue')
                or marker.Value~=false or marker:GetAttribute('CullingRecoveryHold')==true) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.skillMovementEligible()
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if not control.skillMovementEnabled or not record or record.character~=player.Character
            or not record.ownSkill or record.ownSkill.Parent~=record.info or clock()-record.incomingAt<0.35
            or positive(record.character:GetAttribute('Stun')) then return false end
        local ok,tool=pcall(currentNativeTool,record.skillTool)
        if not (ok and tool~=nil and tool.character==record.character and tool.movesetName==record.kit
            and not record.info:FindFirstChild('InDash') and not record.info:FindFirstChild('Counter')
            and not record.info:FindFirstChild('Emote')) then return false end
        -- Skills that move you themselves (lunges, dashes, pulls) keep their
        -- built-in movement: step aside while the game says the skill has its own
        -- movement, or while any mover is pushing the character.
        for _,name in {'NoMove','NoMovement','Movement'} do
            if record.info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        local root=record.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if root then
            for _,child in root:GetChildren() do
                if child.Name~='LookFly' and (child:IsA('BodyVelocity') or child:IsA('BodyPosition') or child:IsA('LinearVelocity')
                    or child:IsA('AlignPosition') or child:IsA('VectorForce')) then return false end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.fourthM1RecoveryEligible()
        local record=control.skillGuard
        if not control.alive or not control.fourthM1RecoveryEnabled or not record or record.character~=player.Character
            or record.character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~=record.kit or record.m1Stage~=4 or record.skillTool
            or record.character:GetAttribute('CurrentM1')~=4 or not record.ownSkill or record.ownSkill.Parent~=record.info
            or not record.m1RecoveryAt or clock()-record.m1RecoveryAt<control.fourthM1RecoveryDelay
            or not record.m1RecoveryMarker or record.m1RecoveryMarker.Parent~=record.info
            or not record.ownRecovery[record.m1RecoveryMarker] or clock()-record.incomingAt<0.35
            or positive(record.character:GetAttribute('Stun')) or control.skillStartupProtected(record.character) then return false end
        for _,name in {'Counter','Emote','InDash','Block','Knockback','Ragdoll','TrueStun','NoMove','NoMovement','Movement','DomainClash'} do
            if record.info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        for _,marker in record.info:GetChildren() do
            if marker.Name=='Stun' and marker~=record.m1RecoveryMarker then return false end
        end
        local humanoid=record.character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude>0.01
    end
    local function patchSkillMovement(context,counters)
        local fourth=control.fourthM1RecoveryEligible()
        if not counters or not (fourth or control.skillMovementEligible()) then return end
        local record=control.skillGuard;local owned=0
        for _,marker in record.info:GetChildren() do
            if marker.Name=='Stun' then
                if not record.ownRecovery[marker] or not marker:IsA('BoolValue') or marker.Value~=false then return end
                owned+=1
            end
        end
        local original=rawget(counters,'Stun')
        if owned<=0 or not finite(original) or original<owned then return end
        local applied=original-owned;rawset(counters,'Stun',applied)
        context.endlagCounts={{counters=counters,name='Stun',original=original,applied=applied}}
        context.skillMovement=true
        if fourth then control.fourthM1RecoverySteps=(control.fourthM1RecoverySteps or 0)+1 end
        control.skillMovementSteps=(control.skillMovementSteps or 0)+1
    end
    local function patchEndlag(context,fn,values,write,counters)
        if not counters or not control.endlagEligible() then return end
        local record=control.skillGuard
        context.endlagCounts={}
        local owned={Stun=0,NoJump=0,NoSprint=0};local foreignSprint=false
        for _,marker in record.info:GetChildren() do
            if record.ownRecovery[marker] and marker:IsA('BoolValue') and marker.Value==false and marker:GetAttribute('CullingRecoveryHold')~=true then
                if owned[marker.Name]~=nil then owned[marker.Name]+=1 end
            elseif marker.Name=='NoSprint' then foreignSprint=true end
        end
        for _,name in {'Stun','NoJump'} do
            local original=rawget(counters,name);local count=owned[name]
            if finite(original) and count>0 and original>=count then
                local applied=original-count;rawset(counters,name,applied)
                table.insert(context.endlagCounts,{counters=counters,name=name,original=original,applied=applied})
            end
        end
        if owned.NoSprint>0 and not foreignSprint then patchRead(context,fn,values,write,'NoSprint',nil) end
        if #context.endlagCounts>0 or owned.NoSprint>0 and not foreignSprint then control.endlagSteps=(control.endlagSteps or 0)+1 end
    end
    function control.beforeNative(fn,read,write)
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then control.releaseSpeed();return nil end
        if not control.alive then control.releaseSpeed();return nil end
        local antiStun,noJump,noSprint=control.isEnabled(),control.isNoJumpEnabled(),control.isNoSprintEnabled()
        if not (antiStun or noJump or noSprint or control.endlagEnabled or control.skillMovementEnabled or control.fourthM1RecoveryEnabled) then control.releaseSpeed();return nil end
        local movement=movementEpisode()
        if not movement then control.releaseSpeed();return nil end
        local context: any={character=movement.character,humanoid=movement.humanoid,info=movement.info,patches={}}
        local ok,values=pcall(read,fn)
        if not ok or type(values)~="table" then return nil end
        local counters,cacheValid=counterTable(fn,movement)
        if cacheValid==false then control.releaseSpeed();return nil end
        patchEndlag(context,fn,values,write,counters)
        patchSkillMovement(context,counters)
        if noJump and counters then context.noJumpPatched=patchRead(context,fn,values,write,"NoJump",counters) end
        if noSprint then context.noSprintPatched=patchRead(context,fn,values,write,"NoSprint",nil) end
        if context.skillMovement then control.releaseSpeed();return context end
        local episode=antiStun and control.episode()
        local scale=episode and multiplier(episode.humanoid)
        if not episode or not scale or scale==0 then control.releaseSpeed();return context end
        context.scale=scale
        if not episode.marker then context.mode="attribute";return context end
        if counters and patchRead(context,fn,values,write,"Stun",counters) then context.mode="attribute";context.suppressedStun=true;return context end
        local index,count=nil,0
        for at,value in values do if value==control.normalStunSpeed then index=at;count+=1 end end
        if count~=1 then control.lastReason="Native hit-stun speed constant is unavailable or ambiguous";return context end
        control.nativeFunction,control.constantIndex=fn,index
        context.mode,context.index,context.applied="constant",index,control.speed
        local changed=pcall(write,fn,index,context.applied)
        if not changed then context.mode=nil;control.lastReason="Native hit-stun speed could not be adjusted";return context end
        return context
    end
    function control.afterNative(context,fn,read,write)
        if not context then return end
        restoreReads(context,fn,read,write)
        if not context.mode then return end
        if context.mode=="constant" then
            local ok,values=pcall(read,fn)
            if not ok or type(values)~="table" or values[context.index]~=context.applied then control.speedRecord=nil;return end
            local restored=pcall(write,fn,context.index,control.normalStunSpeed)
            if not restored then control.lastReason="Native hit-stun speed could not be restored";return end
        end
        local episode=control.episode()
        if not control.alive or not control.isEnabled() or not episode or episode.character~=context.character then control.releaseSpeed();return end
        local humanoid=context.humanoid
        local base,applied
        if context.mode=="attribute" then
            base,applied=if context.suppressedStun then control.normalStunSpeed*context.scale else humanoid.WalkSpeed,control.speed*context.scale
            humanoid.WalkSpeed=applied
        else
            base,applied=control.normalStunSpeed*context.scale,humanoid.WalkSpeed
            if math.abs(applied-context.applied*context.scale)>0.001 then return end
        end
        control.speedRecord={character=context.character,humanoid=humanoid,base=base,applied=applied,mode=context.mode}
        control.appliedSteps+=1
        control.lastReason="Current native hit-stun movement speed adjusted"
    end
    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.refreshSkillGuard()
        control.installNativeSkillGuard()
        control.skillStartupProtected(player.Character)
        control.enabled=control.isEnabled()
        control.noJumpEnabled,control.noSprintEnabled=control.isNoJumpEnabled(),control.isNoSprintEnabled()
        local broker=menu.sprintControl
        if control.broker~=broker then
            if control.unregister then control.unregister();control.unregister=nil end
            control.broker=broker
        end
        if (control.enabled or control.noJumpEnabled or control.noSprintEnabled or control.endlagEnabled or control.skillMovementEnabled or control.fourthM1RecoveryEnabled) and broker and type(broker.addModifier)=="function" then
            if not control.unregister then control.unregister=broker.addModifier("AntiStunSpeed",control.beforeNative,control.afterNative) end
            control.ready=broker.ready==true
        else
            if control.unregister then control.unregister();control.unregister=nil end
            control.ready=false;control.releaseSpeed()
        end
    end
    function control.setSpeed(value)
        local speed=tonumber(value)
        control.speed=if finite(speed) then math.clamp(speed,0,100) else starter.CharacterWalkSpeed
        control.refresh()
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(control.refresh))
    if player.CharacterRemoving then table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() control.releaseSpeed();clearSkillGuard() end)) end
    if player.CharacterAdded then table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() control.speedRecord=nil;clearSkillGuard();control.refresh() end)) end
    control.setSpeed(control.speed)
    function control.Destroy()
        control.endlagEnabled=false
        control.fourthM1RecoveryEnabled=false
        control.skillMovementEnabled=false
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive,control.enabled,control.ready=false,false,false
        local hook=control.nativeSkillHook
        if hook then
            hook.active=false
            if hook.owner.UseTool==hook.wrapper then hook.owner.UseTool=hook.original end
        end
        control.nativeSkillHook=nil;control.nativeSkillGuardReady=false
        if control.unregister then control.unregister();control.unregister=nil end
        control.releaseSpeed()
        clearSkillGuard()
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end
    return control
end
return AntiStunSpeed
end)()

local DistanceUnits = (function(): any
-- Distances display raw game studs with the user's requested m label.
-- Previous meters-v1 saves migrate once while native world distances stay fixed.
local DistanceUnits = {}

function DistanceUnits.new(_host: {[string]: any}, _menu: any): any
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, metersPerStud = 1, legacyMetersPerStud = 0.28, markerKey = "__ShenaniganismDistanceUnits",
        markerValue = "studs-labeled-m-v2", known = {}, aliases = {}, adapted = {},
    }
    local numericNames = {
        "Block Range", "Counter Range", "Auto Counter Range", "Auto Punish Range",
        "Enemy Hitbox Size", "NPC Hitbox Size", "Enemy Hitbox Y", "NPC Hitbox Y", "Enemy Hitbox Z", "NPC Hitbox Z", "Pickup Range (studs)",
        "M1 Hitbox Width (studs)", "M1 Hitbox Height (studs)", "M1 Hitbox Depth (studs)",
        "Resource Bar Offset X", "Resource Bar Offset Y", "Resource Bar Offset Z",
        "Your Resource Bar Offset X", "Your Resource Bar Offset Y", "Your Resource Bar Offset Z",
        "Hip Height", "Debris Spawn Distance",
        "Info Hub Max Distance (m)", "HP / Cooldown View Distance (m)", "Prediction Line Length (m)",
    }

    local function finite(value: any): number?
        local number = tonumber(value)
        return if number and number == number and math.abs(number) < math.huge then number else nil
    end

    function control.toMeters(value: any): any
        local amount = finite(value)
        return if amount then amount else value
    end
    function control.toStuds(value: any): any
        local amount = finite(value)
        return if amount then amount else value
    end

    local function triplet(value: any, factor: number): any
        if type(value) ~= "string" then return value end
        local fields = string.split(value, ",")
        if #fields ~= 3 then return value end
        local result = {}
        for _, field in fields do
            local amount = finite(field)
            if not amount then return value end
            table.insert(result, string.format("%.10g", amount*factor))
        end
        return table.concat(result, ", ")
    end

    function control.displayName(name: string): string
        local label = name:gsub("%([Ss][Tt][Uu][Dd][Ss]?%)", "(m)")
        return if label ~= name or label:find("%(m%)") then label else label.." (m)"
    end

    local function register(name: string, mode: string)
        control.known[name] = mode
        control.aliases[control.displayName(name)] = name
    end
    for _, name in numericNames do register(name, "Number") end
    for _,mode in {"Character","Camera"} do
        for _,axis in {"X","Y","Z"} do register("Lock On "..mode.." Offset "..axis.." (m)","Number") end
    end
    register("Mesh Position", "XYZ")

    function control.isDistance(kind: string, config: any): (boolean, string?)
        local name = tostring(config.Name or config.Title or "")
        local known = control.known[name]
        if known then return kind == "CreateSlider" or kind == "CreateInput", known end
        if kind ~= "CreateSlider" and kind ~= "CreateInput" then return false, nil end
        local lower, description = name:lower(), tostring(config.Description or ""):lower()
        -- Explicit lengths and ranges only. Pixel sizes, scale, speed, angles,
        -- acceleration, time, amounts, and multipliers retain their own units.
        if lower:find("speed",1,true) or lower:find("cooldown",1,true) or lower:find("delay",1,true)
            or lower:find("multiplier",1,true) or lower:find("icon",1,true) or lower:find("font",1,true)
            or lower:find("scale",1,true) or lower:find("gravity",1,true) or lower:find("fov",1,true)
            or description:find("pixel",1,true) then return false, nil end
        if lower:find("stud",1,true) or lower:find("distance",1,true) or lower:find("range",1,true)
            or description:find("stud",1,true) then
            register(name, "Number")
            return true, "Number"
        end
        return false, nil
    end

    function control.replaceUnits(text: any): any
        if type(text) ~= "string" then return text end
        local substitute: any = string.gsub
        local result = substitute(text,"([%+%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%s*%-%s*([%+%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%s*[Ss][Tt][Uu][Dd][Ss]?%f[%A]", function(low,high: string?)
            return string.format("%.10g-%.10g m", tonumber(low) or 0,tonumber(high) or 0)
        end)
        result = substitute(result,"([%+%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%s*[Ss][Tt][Uu][Dd][Ss]?%f[%A]", function(number)
            return string.format("%.10g m", tonumber(number) or 0)
        end)
        result=substitute(result,"%f[%a][Ss][Tt][Uu][Dd][Ss]?%f[%A]", "m")
        return (substitute(result,"%f[%a][Mm][Ee][Tt][Ee][Rr][Ss]?%f[%A]", "m"))
    end

    function control.raiseRangeLimit(kind: string,config: any): any
        if kind~='CreateSlider' or type(config)~='table' then return config end
        local name=tostring(config.Name or ''):lower()
        local isRange=name:find('range',1,true) or name:find('distance',1,true) or name:find('length',1,true)
        local maximum=finite(config.Max)
        if not isRange or not maximum or maximum>=80 or name:find('fov',1,true) or name:find('pixel',1,true)
          or name:find('cooldown',1,true) or name:find('speed',1,true) or name:find('offset',1,true) then return config end
        local result=table.clone(config);result.Max=80;return result
    end
    function control.adaptConfig(kind: string, tabName: string, config: any): any
        if not control.alive or type(config) ~= "table" then return config end
        config=control.raiseRangeLimit(kind,config)
        if config.DistanceUnitAdapter then return config end
        local result = table.clone(config)
        result.Description, result.Content = control.replaceUnits(config.Description), control.replaceUnits(config.Content)
        local distance, mode = control.isDistance(kind, config)
        if not distance then
            if config.Name == "Hitbox Expander" then result.Description = "Adjust enemy and NPC hitbox dimensions (m)." end
            return result
        end
        local name = tostring(config.Name or config.Title)
        result.DisplayName, result.DistanceUnitAdapter, result.DistanceUnit = control.displayName(config.DisplayName or name), true, "m"
        result.DistanceNativeName = name
        if mode == "XYZ" then
            result.Default = triplet(config.Default, 1)
            result.Description = "x, y, z (m)"
        else
            for _, property in {"Min", "Max", "Default", "Step", "Increment"} do
                if config[property] ~= nil then result[property] = control.toMeters(config[property]) end
            end
            if kind == "CreateInput" and type(config.Default) == "string" and type(result.Default) == "number" then
                result.Default = string.format("%.10g",result.Default)
            end
            if not result.Description or result.Description == "" then result.Description = "Distance (m)." end
        end
        local callback = config.Callback
        if callback then
            result.Callback = function(value: any, ...: any): any
                local native = if mode == "XYZ" then triplet(value, 1) else control.toStuds(value)
                if kind == "CreateInput" and type(value) == "string" and type(native) == "number" then native = string.format("%.10g",native) end
                return callback(native, ...)
            end
        end
        control.adapted[tabName.."/"..name] = {name = name, tab = tabName, mode = mode, config = result}
        return result
    end

    local function marker(values: any): any
        local marker = values[control.markerKey]
        return if type(marker)=="table" then marker.Value else marker
    end

    function control.stampValues(values: any, imported: boolean?): any
        if type(values) ~= "table" then return values end
        local result = table.clone(values)
        result[control.markerKey] = if imported then {Kind = "Metadata", Value = control.markerValue} else control.markerValue
        return result
    end

    function control.migrate(values: any, imported: boolean?): any
        if type(values) ~= "table" then return values end
        local result, version = table.clone(values), marker(values)
        for key, value in values do
            if type(key) ~= "string" or key == control.markerKey then continue end
            local prefix = key:match("^[^/]+/") or ""
            local name = key:match("^[^/]+/(.+)$") or key
            local nativeName = control.aliases[name] or name
            local mode = control.known[nativeName]
            if not mode then continue end
            local current = if imported and type(value) == "table" then value.Value else value
            local converted = current
            local oldMeters=version=="meters-v1" or (version==nil and nativeName~=name and control.aliases[name]~=nil)
            if oldMeters then
                if mode == "XYZ" then converted = triplet(current, 1/control.legacyMetersPerStud)
                else
                    local amount=finite(current)
                    converted=if amount then amount/control.legacyMetersPerStud else current
                    if type(current) == "string" and type(converted) == "number" then converted = string.format("%.10g",converted) end
                end
            end
            local newKey = prefix..nativeName
            if imported and type(value) == "table" then
                local entry = table.clone(value)
                entry.Value = converted
                if newKey == key or result[newKey] == nil then result[newKey] = entry end
            elseif newKey == key or result[newKey] == nil then result[newKey] = converted end
            if newKey ~= key then result[key] = nil end
        end
        return control.stampValues(result, imported)
    end

    function control.stampExport(envelope: any): any
        if type(envelope) ~= "table" or type(envelope.Controls) ~= "table" then return envelope end
        local result = table.clone(envelope)
        result.Controls = control.stampValues(envelope.Controls, true)
        result.DistanceUnits = "studs"
        result.DistanceLabel = "m"
        return result
    end

    function control.Destroy()
        control.alive = false
        table.clear(control.adapted)
    end
    return control
end
return DistanceUnits
end)()

local M1AimAssist = (function(): any
-- Smooth horizontal facing during the user's held native M1 input.
-- Native request timing, reach, hit acceptance and attack animations are unchanged.
-- Construct after M1Assist so its native UseSetService caller check stays intact.
local M1AimAssist: {[string]: any} = {}
-- Facing eligibility is a horizontal radius with an independent vertical
-- span. This never changes native melee reach or whether an attack is accepted.
local AssistGeometry = {}
function AssistGeometry.height(value)
    return if type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then math.clamp(value,90,200) else 90
end
function AssistGeometry.verticalOverlap(origin,point,height,offsetY,bottom,top)
    if not origin or not point then return false end
    for _,value in {origin.X,origin.Y,origin.Z,point.X,point.Y,point.Z} do
        if type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
    end
    local half=AssistGeometry.height(height)*.5
    local center=origin.Y+(offsetY or 0)
    return (top or point.Y)>=center-half and (bottom or point.Y)<=center+half
end
function AssistGeometry.withinRange(origin,point,range,height,offsetY,bottom,top)
    if type(range)~='number' or range~=range or range<=0 or math.abs(range)==math.huge
        or not AssistGeometry.verticalOverlap(origin,point,height,offsetY,bottom,top) then return false end
    local x,z=point.X-origin.X,point.Z-origin.Z
    return x*x+z*z<=range*range
end
M1AimAssist.Geometry=AssistGeometry

function M1AimAssist.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local world = host.workspace
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local kindOf = host.typeof or typeof
    local function nativeShiftLocked(): boolean
        local directional=menu.directionalLock
        if directional and type(directional.nativeShiftLocked)=='function' then return directional.nativeShiftLocked()==true end
        return host.Enum.MouseBehavior~=nil and input.MouseBehavior==host.Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    end
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, enabled = false, ready = false, focused = true,
        range = 6, maximumRange = 80, connections = {}, activeCalls = {},
        skillAimEnabled = false, skillAimRange = 30,m1AimSticky=false,skillAimSticky=false,
        skillAimTargets = {'Normal'}, skillAimFacing='Brief turn', skillAimDuration=.35,
        blockAimEnabled=false,blockAimManual=true,blockAimAutomatic=true,blockAimAfterHit=false,blockAimSpeed=14,blockAimRange=8,
        blockAimTrackingSpeed=100,blockAimSticky=true,blockAimKeepAfterRelease=true,blockAimReleaseDistance=20,
        punishAimEnabled=false,counterAimEnabled=false,punishAimSpeed=14,counterAimSpeed=14,punishAimRange=8,counterAimRange=100/0.28,
        turnResponse = 14, skillAimSpeed=14,maximumYawRate = math.rad(720), controls = nil,
        m1AimSmoothingMs=0,blockAimSmoothingMs=0,skillAimSmoothingMs=0,counterAimSmoothingMs=0,punishAimSmoothingMs=0,
        blockAimRecentOnly=false,blockAimHitSources='Both',blockAimHitWindow=2,blockRecentConnections={},
        blockAimBoxEnabled=false,blockAimBoxX=16,blockAimBoxY=90,blockAimBoxZ=8,blockAimBoxVisible=false,
        aimCount = 0, nativeCalls = 0, nativeRequests = 0, lastReason = "M1 Aim Assist is disabled",
    }
    local tool, original, wrapper
    local rotationShared=host._G or host
    control.maximumYawAcceleration=math.rad(14400)
    control.aimPrediction,control.aimMotion={},setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.predictionMotion=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.aimForecasts={}
    control.blockAimDeadTargets=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.aimAreas,control.areaTargets,control.directionalTargets,control.areaVisuals={},{},{},{}
    control.characterTransitionMs=80
    control.blockReleaseCameraGuardMs=120
    control.aimHoldSeconds=0
    control.aimMoveLead=0
    control.assistHandoffMs=160
    -- Seamless handoff: when one assist takes over from another on the SAME enemy and the character already faces them, the new assist
    -- carries on from the laser lock with no intro, ramp or smoothing, instead of acquiring the target from the beginning.
    control.seamlessHandoff=true
    function control.setSeamlessHandoff(value) control.seamlessHandoff=value==true;return true end
    control.dashFreeEnabled,control.dashCameraDelay=true,.3
    for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do
        control.aimPrediction[role]={enabled=true,dashEndpoint=true,leadMs=if role=='Block' then 120 else 80,maxLead=if role=='Block' then 8 else 2,strength=1,x=0,y=0,z=0}
        control.aimAreas[role]={mode='360°',x=16,y=90,z=8,ox=0,oy=0,oz=0,visible=false,curve=100}
    end
    function control.setCharacterTransitionMs(value)
        if type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.characterTransitionMs=math.clamp(value,0,500);control.aimTransition=nil
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        local release=lock and lock.characterRelease
        if control.characterTransitionMs==0 and lock and lock.cancelAssistReturn and not (release and release.humanized) then lock.cancelAssistReturn() end
        return true
    end
    function control.cancelAimHold()
        local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
        if lease then lease.driveAt=nil end
    end
    function control.finishAimHold(lease)
        lease.holdTimer=nil
        if control.shiftLockAimLease~=lease then return end
        local due=lease.driveAt and lease.driveAt+control.aimHoldSeconds
        if due and clock()<due then
            lease.holdTimer=true
            task.delay(due-clock()+.03,function() control.finishAimHold(lease) end)
            return
        end
        -- M1 assist keeps the heading while the enemy is still inside the facing box instead of snapping back to the camera; the return
        -- starts only once the enemy has left the box (or after six seconds).
        if control.m1HoldInBox and lease.role=='M1 Aim' then
            local target=control.m1LastTarget
            local character=player.Character
            local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local humanoid=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and root and lease.driveAt and clock()-lease.driveAt<6
                and control.aimAreaAllowsTarget('M1',target,root,false) then
                lease.holdTimer=true
                task.delay(.1,function() control.finishAimHold(lease) end)
                return
            end
        end
        control.releaseShiftLockAim(true)
    end
    control.m1HoldInBox=true
    function control.setM1HoldInBox(value) control.m1HoldInBox=value==true;return true end
    function control.setAimHoldSeconds(value)
        if type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.aimHoldSeconds=math.clamp(value,0,10)
        if control.aimHoldSeconds<=0 then
            local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
            if lease and lease.driveAt then lease.driveAt=nil;control.releaseShiftLockAim(true) end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setAssistHandoffMs(value)
        if type(value) ~= 'number' or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return false end
        control.assistHandoffMs = math.clamp(value, 0, 800);return true
    end
    function control.setDashFree(value)
        control.dashFreeEnabled = value == true
        if not control.dashFreeEnabled and control.endDashFree then control.endDashFree(true) end
        return true
    end
    function control.setDashCameraDelay(value)
        if type(value) ~= 'number' or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return false end
        control.dashCameraDelay = math.clamp(value, 0, 5);return true
    end
    function control.setAimMoveLead(value)
        if type(value) ~= 'number' or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return false end
        control.aimMoveLead = math.clamp(value, -10, 10);return true
    end
    function control.endBlockReleaseCameraGuard()
        local guard=control.blockReleaseCameraGuard
        control.blockReleaseCameraGuard=nil
        if guard and guard.humanoid.Parent==guard.character and guard.humanoid.AutoRotate==false then
            -- Hand the facing back through the smooth assist return instead of letting shift lock snap the character to the camera.
            local root,lock=guard.root,menu.autoLock
            if root and root.Parent and guard.character==player.Character and lock and lock.beginAssistReturn
                and lock.beginAssistReturn(root,root.CFrame,'Block Aim',{character=guard.character,humanoid=guard.humanoid,previous=guard.previous,owner=control,role='Block Aim'}) then return end
            guard.humanoid.AutoRotate=guard.previous
        end
    end
    function control.setBlockReleaseCameraGuardMs(value)
        if type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.blockReleaseCameraGuardMs=math.clamp(value,0,500)
        if control.blockReleaseCameraGuardMs<=0 then control.endBlockReleaseCameraGuard() end
        return true
    end
    function control.getAimArea(role,presentation)
        local area=control.aimAreas[role]
        if role=='Block' then
            local enabled=if presentation and menu.getFailsafeRequested then menu.getFailsafeRequested(control,'blockAimBoxEnabled') else control.blockAimBoxEnabled
            area.mode=if enabled then (control.blockAimShape or 'Facing Box') else '360°'
            area.x,area.y,area.z,area.visible=control.blockAimBoxX,control.blockAimBoxY,control.blockAimBoxZ,control.blockAimBoxVisible
        end
        if area then area.y=AssistGeometry.height(area.y) end
        return area
    end
    function control.setAimAreaMode(role,value)
        local area=control.aimAreas[role]
        if not area or (value~='Facing Box' and value~='360°' and value~='Half Dome') then return false end
        area.mode=value
        if role=='Block' then control.blockAimBoxEnabled=value~='360°';control.blockAimShape=if value=='360°' then nil else value end
        control.resetDirectionalAim(role..' Aim');return true
    end
    -- Half Dome curvature: 100 is a smooth half ellipse around the front 180 degrees, 0 is a flat-fronted box.
    function control.setAimAreaCurve(role,value)
        local area=control.aimAreas[role]
        if not area or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        area.curve=math.clamp(value,0,100);return true
    end
    -- True when a point (side, forward from the area origin) lies inside the area's horizontal shape.
    function control.areaShapeContains(area,side,forward)
        if area.mode=='Half Dome' then
            local halfWidth,depth=area.x*.5,area.z
            if forward<0 or halfWidth<=0 or depth<=0 then return false end
            local power=2+(100-(area.curve or 100))*.38
            return (math.abs(side)/halfWidth)^power+(forward/depth)^power<=1
        end
        return math.abs(side)<=area.x*.5 and forward>=0 and forward<=area.z
    end
    function control.setAimAreaDimension(role,axis,value)
        local area=control.aimAreas[role]
        if not area or not table.find({'x','y','z','ox','oy','oz'},axis) or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        area[axis]=if axis=='y' then AssistGeometry.height(value) else math.clamp(value,if #axis==2 then -100 else 0,100)
        if role=='Block' and #axis==1 then control['blockAimBox'..axis:upper()]=area[axis] end
        return true
    end
    function control.setAimAreaVisible(role,value)
        local area=control.aimAreas[role];if not area then return false end
        area.visible=value==true
        if role=='Block' then control.setBlockAimBoxVisible(value) end
        return true
    end
    function control.setAimPrediction(role,key,value)
        local settings=control.aimPrediction[role]
        if not settings then return false end
        if key=='enabled' or key=='dashEndpoint' then settings[key]=value==true;return true end
        local limits={leadMs={0,250},maxLead={0,10},strength={0,3},x={-10,10},y={-10,10},z={-10,10}}
        local bounds=limits[key]
        if not bounds or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        settings[key]=math.clamp(value,bounds[1],bounds[2]);return true
    end
    function control.clearBlockRetained()
        local record=control.blockAimRetained;control.blockAimRetained=nil
        if record and record.deathConnection then record.deathConnection:Disconnect();record.deathConnection=nil end
        if record and record.ownDeathConnection then record.ownDeathConnection:Disconnect();record.ownDeathConnection=nil end
        local capture=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.dashAssistCapture
        if record and capture and capture.targets and capture.targets.Block==record.target then capture.targets.Block=nil end
    end
    local function clearBlockMemory()
        control.blockAimMemory=nil
        if control.blockMemoryDeathConnection then control.blockMemoryDeathConnection:Disconnect();control.blockMemoryDeathConnection=nil end
        if control.blockMemoryOwnDeathConnection then control.blockMemoryOwnDeathConnection:Disconnect();control.blockMemoryOwnDeathConnection=nil end
    end
    control.stickyAimMemories={}
    local clearStickyMemory
    control.aimTargetSwitchModes={M1='Default',Skill='Default',Block='Default',Counter='Default',Punish='Default'}
    control.aimTargetSwitchDelayMs={M1=250,Skill=250,Block=250,Counter=250,Punish=250}
    control.aimTargetSwitchState={}
    local switchStickyFields={M1='m1AimSticky',Skill='skillAimSticky',Block='blockAimSticky',Counter='counterAimSticky',Punish='punishAimSticky'}
    local function aimSticky(role)
        local mode=control.aimTargetSwitchModes[role]
        return if mode=='Default' then control[switchStickyFields[role]]==true else mode=='Sticky'
    end
    function control.resetAimTargetSwitch(role)
        if role then control.aimTargetSwitchState[role]=nil else table.clear(control.aimTargetSwitchState) end
    end
    function control.getAimTargetSwitchMode(role)
        local field=switchStickyFields[role]
        return field and control.aimTargetSwitchModes[role] or nil
    end
    function control.setAimTargetSwitchMode(role,value)
        local field=switchStickyFields[role]
        if not field or (value~='Default' and value~='Delay' and value~='Sticky') then return false end
        control.aimTargetSwitchModes[role]=value
        if role=='M1' or role=='Skill' then clearStickyMemory(role)
        elseif role=='Block' then clearBlockMemory();control.clearBlockRetained();control.blockAimSession=nil end
        control.resetAimTargetSwitch(role);return true
    end
    function control.setAimTargetSwitchDelayMs(role,value)
        if not switchStickyFields[role] or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.aimTargetSwitchDelayMs[role]=math.clamp(value,0,5000)
        local state=control.aimTargetSwitchState[role]
        if state then state.challenger,state.since=nil,nil end
        return true
    end
    -- With two or more possible targets, every aim assist faces only someone who has attacked you, the one who attacked last first. Nobody
    -- who has never attacked you is aimed at while others are around. A lone target is untouched.
    control.attackerOnly=true
    control.attackedMeAt=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    function control.setAttackerOnly(value) control.attackerOnly=value==true;control.resetAimTargetSwitch();return true end
    local function noteAttacker(model: any,at: any)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(model)~='Instance' or type(at)~='number' then return end
        if model:IsA('Player') then model=model.Character end
        if not model or model==player.Character or not model:IsA('Model') then return end
        local old=control.attackedMeAt[model]
        if not old or at>old then control.attackedMeAt[model]=at end
    end
    function control.refreshAttackers()
        local me=player.Character
        if control.attackerOwner~=me then control.attackerOwner=me;table.clear(control.attackedMeAt) end
        if not me then return end
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter;local record=tracker and tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        if record and record.character==me then noteAttacker(record.target,record.at) end
        local punish=menu.autoPunish;local blocked=punish and punish.lastBlockedAttacker
        if blocked and blocked.character==me then noteAttacker(blocked.target,blocked.at) end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if block and block.held~=nil and block.heldThreat and block.heldThreat.record then noteAttacker(block.heldThreat.record.model,clock()) end
    end
    function control.preferAttacker(character: any,candidate: any,eligible: any): any
        control.refreshAttackers()
        local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        if not folder then return candidate end
        local mine=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local count,best=0,nil
        -- Among those who have attacked you: one attacking right now first, then the closest, then the most recent attacker.
        for _,model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if model~=character and model:IsA('Model') then
                local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local theirs=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and theirs and eligible(model) then
                    count+=1
                    local at=control.attackedMeAt[model]
                    if at and mine then
                        local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
                        local active=info~=nil and (info:FindFirstChild('Melee')~=nil or info:FindFirstChild('Attacking')~=nil or info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil)
                        local distance=(theirs.Position-mine.Position).Magnitude
                        local better=not best or (active and not best.active)
                            or (active==best.active and (distance<best.distance-.5 or (math.abs(distance-best.distance)<=.5 and at>best.at)))
                        if better then best={model=model,active=active,distance=distance,at=at} end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if count<2 then return candidate end
        -- With several targets the one who attacked you wins; when nobody has attacked you yet there is no attacker to prefer, so the
        -- assist keeps its own pick (it must still work on whoever you are fighting first).
        return best and best.model or candidate
    end
    function control.selectAimSwitchTarget(role,character,root,candidate,eligible,pinned)
        if candidate and not pinned and control.attackerOnly and type(eligible)=='function' and character then
            candidate=control.preferAttacker(character,candidate,eligible)
        end
        if control.aimTargetSwitchModes[role]=='Default' then return candidate end
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not switchStickyFields[role] or not control.alive or not control.focused or not character or not character.Parent
            or not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or character:GetAttribute('Dead')==true
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then
            control.resetAimTargetSwitch(role);return nil
        end
        if control.switchOwnerHumanoid~=humanoid then
            if control.switchOwnerDeath then control.switchOwnerDeath:Disconnect()end
            control.switchOwnerHumanoid=humanoid
            control.switchOwnerDeath=humanoid.Died and humanoid.Died:Connect(function()control.resetAimTargetSwitch()end)
        end
        local now=clock();local state=control.aimTargetSwitchState[role]
        if not state or state.character~=character or state.root~=root or now<(state.observedAt or now) then
            state={character=character,root=root};control.aimTargetSwitchState[role]=state
        end
        state.observedAt=now
        if candidate and not eligible(candidate) then candidate=nil end
        local current=state.target
        if pinned or control.aimTargetSwitchModes[role]=='Default' or not current or not eligible(current) then
            state.target,state.challenger,state.since=candidate,nil,nil;return candidate
        end
        if candidate==current then state.challenger,state.since=nil,nil;return current end
        if aimSticky(role) then state.challenger,state.since=nil,nil;return current end
        local delay=control.aimTargetSwitchDelayMs[role]*.001
        if delay<=0 then state.target,state.challenger,state.since=candidate,nil,nil;return candidate end
        if not candidate then state.challenger,state.since=nil,nil;return current end
        if state.challenger~=candidate then state.challenger,state.since=candidate,now end
        if now-state.since>=delay then state.target,state.challenger,state.since=candidate,nil,nil;return candidate end
        return current
    end
    function control.applyAimTargetSwitch(role,candidate,eligible,character,root)
        return control.selectAimSwitchTarget(role,character,root,candidate,eligible)
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()control.resetAimTargetSwitch()end
    control.stickyAimDeadTargets=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    clearStickyMemory=function(role)
        local record=control.stickyAimMemories[role]
        control.stickyAimMemories[role]=nil
        if record then for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect()end;table.clear(record.connections)end
    end
    local function requestedFlag(owner,key)
        return if menu.getFailsafeRequested then menu.getFailsafeRequested(owner,key)==true else owner and owner[key]==true
    end
    -- When on, M1 assist keeps following an engaged target that ragdolls, is downed or is getting up.
    control.m1AssistRagdolled=true
    function control.setM1AssistRagdolled(value)
        control.m1AssistRagdolled=value==true
        return true
    end
    function control.setM1AimSticky(value)
        control.resetAimTargetSwitch('M1')
        control.m1AimSticky=value==true
        if not control.m1AimSticky then clearStickyMemory('M1')end
        return true
    end
    function control.setSkillAimSticky(value)
        control.resetAimTargetSwitch('Skill')
        control.skillAimSticky=value==true
        if not control.skillAimSticky then clearStickyMemory('Skill')end
        return true
    end
    function control.resetDirectionalAim(role,immediate)
        if not role or role=='Block Aim' then control.clearBlockRetained() end
        if not role or control.dashFacingRole==role then control.dashFacingRole=nil end
        if not role then control.m1HeldSession=nil end
        if not role or (control.aimTurnState and control.aimTurnState.role==role) then control.aimTurnState=nil end
        if not role or control.aimTransition and control.aimTransition.role==role then control.aimTransition=nil end
        if role then control.areaTargets[role:gsub(' Aim$','')]=nil else table.clear(control.areaTargets) end
        local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
        if lease and (not role or lease.role==role) then
            -- The return owner also understands independent per-role Fade/Hold
            -- settings. Shared intro=0 must not silently disable those settings.
            control.releaseShiftLockAim(not immediate)
        end
        if not role or role=='Block Aim' then
            control.blockAimSession=nil;control.blockAimTarget=nil;control.blockAimMotion=nil;control.blockAimForecast=nil
            control.blockLeadState=nil
        end
    end

    control.shiftLockAimEnabled=false
    local function nativeDashActive(character: any): any
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if character==player.Character and lock and lock.dashFacingActive and lock.dashFacingActive() then return true end
        local front=menu.frontDash;local dash=front and front.cameraDash
        if dash and dash.character==character and dash.mover and dash.mover.Parent
            and clock()-dash.started<=(dash.duration or .6)+.05 then return true end
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return character and (character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash')~=nil))
    end
    local function blockDashTarget()
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        if not dash or not dash.blockDashActive or not dash.blockDashActive() or not dash.blockDashTarget then return nil end
        local pending=dash.blockDashPending
        local front=menu.frontDash
        local bridged=front and front.cameraDash
        -- Native dash movement can be character-relative. Character-facing is
        -- safe only after this exact dash has its camera/input mover bridge.
        if not pending or pending.phase~='Dashing' or not bridged or bridged.character~=player.Character
            or not bridged.mover or not bridged.mover.Parent
            or clock()-bridged.started>(bridged.duration or .6)+.05 then return nil end
        local target=dash.blockDashTarget()
        if target then control.blockDashSeenAt=clock() end
        return target
    end
    -- The native InDash marker outlives the block-dash mover by a few frames.
    -- Without this window the rotation lease is dropped in that gap, the
    -- character turns to the camera, and the assist then turns it back.
    function control.blockDashGrace(): boolean
        return clock()-(control.blockDashSeenAt or -math.huge)<=.4
    end
    local function dashAssistTarget(role)
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        return lock and type(lock.dashAssistTarget)=='function' and lock.dashAssistTarget((role or 'M1'):gsub(' Aim$','')) or nil
    end
    local function dashAssistActive()
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        return lock and type(lock.dashAssistActive)=='function' and lock.dashAssistActive()==true or false
    end
    local function dashAssistReady(role)
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        return lock and type(lock.dashAssistFacingReady)=='function' and lock.dashAssistFacingReady((role or 'M1'):gsub(' Aim$',''))==true or false
    end
    local function characterEmoting(character)
        if type(menu.localCharacterEmoting)=='function'then return menu.localCharacterEmoting(character)==true end
        if not character or character~=player.Character or not character.Parent then return false end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        for _,name in {'Emote','Emoting'}do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or type(value)=='string'and value~=''or type(value)=='number'and value==value and value>0 and math.abs(value)<math.huge
                or info and info:FindFirstChild(name)then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function shiftLockAimActive(character: any,humanoid: any,characterLock: boolean?,framingDuringDash: boolean?): any
        if characterEmoting(character)then return false end
        local centered=nativeShiftLocked()
        local toji=menu.nativeTojiAim
        local skillLease=toji and type(toji.facingActive)=='function' and toji.facingActive()
        return control.alive and control.focused and (control.shiftLockAimEnabled or characterLock==true or skillLease==true) and centered
            and character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Parent==character and humanoid.Health>0
            and (framingDuringDash==true or control.dashFacingRole and dashAssistReady(control.dashFacingRole) or blockDashTarget()~=nil or control.blockDashGrace() or not nativeDashActive(character)) and not menu.recording and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            and not (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen())
    end
    local function ownRotationRecord(humanoid: any): any
        local character=player.Character
        local pending=rotationShared.__CullingPendingRotation
        local record=control.shiftLockAimLease or (pending and pending.record)
        if not shiftLockAimActive(character,humanoid) and not (record and record.cameraSteering) then return nil end
        if record and record.owner==control and record.character==character and record.humanoid==humanoid then return record end
        return nil
    end
    -- A punish is queued or running: the next assist continues from the current heading, so a release now must not return to the camera.
    function control.followUpPending(): boolean
        local punish=menu.autoPunish
        if punish and punish.pending then return true end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        return block~=nil and block.punchBackPending~=nil
    end
    function control.releaseShiftLockAim(smooth: boolean?): ()
        if characterEmoting(player.Character)then smooth=false end
        local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
        if lease and smooth==false and control.followUpPending() then smooth=true end
        -- Hold: an assist drove the character recently, so keep its heading until the hold runs out.
        if lease and smooth~=false and control.aimHoldSeconds>0 and lease.driveAt and lease.character==player.Character
            and lease.humanoid.Parent==lease.character and lease.humanoid.Health>0 then
            local due=lease.driveAt+control.aimHoldSeconds
            if clock()<due then
                if not lease.holdTimer then
                    lease.holdTimer=true
                    task.delay(due-clock()+.03,function() control.finishAimHold(lease) end)
                end
                return
            end
        end
        control.shiftLockAimLease=nil
        if not lease then
            local lock=menu.autoLock
            local release=lock and lock.characterRelease
            if not smooth and release and release.assistReturn and release.rotationLease and release.rotationLease.owner==control then lock.finishCharacterRelease() end
            return
        end
        local lock,env=menu.autoLock,menu.environment or {}
        local root=lease.character==player.Character and lease.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if smooth~=false and root and lock and lock.beginAssistReturn
            and lock.beginAssistReturn(root,root.CFrame,lease.role or 'M1',lease) then return end
        if smooth and root and shiftLockAimActive(lease.character,lease.humanoid) and not lease.humanoid.PlatformStand and lease.humanoid.AutoRotate==false
            and not (env.LockedTarget and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected~=false)
            and lock and lock.beginCharacterRelease and lock.finishCharacterRelease then
            lock.beginCharacterRelease(root,nil,lease.role or 'M1')
            local release=lock.characterRelease
            if release and release.root==root and (not release.rotationLease or release.rotationLease.owner==control) then
                release.rotationLease=lease
                release.assistReturn=true
                release.assistReturnSeconds=control.characterTransitionMs*.001
                return
            end
        end
        if lease.role=='Block Aim' and lease.previous==true and control.blockReleaseCameraGuardMs>0
            and lease.character==player.Character and root and lease.humanoid.Parent==lease.character then
            local guard={character=lease.character,humanoid=lease.humanoid,root=root,
                untilAt=clock()+control.blockReleaseCameraGuardMs*.001,previous=lease.previous}
            control.blockReleaseCameraGuard=guard
            lease.humanoid.AutoRotate=false
            -- Safety net: hand rotation back even if the per-frame refresh is not running.
            task.delay(control.blockReleaseCameraGuardMs*.001+.05,function()
                if control.blockReleaseCameraGuard==guard then control.endBlockReleaseCameraGuard() end
            end)
            return
        end
        if menu.restoreRotationLease then menu.restoreRotationLease(lease)
        elseif lease.humanoid.Parent and lease.humanoid.AutoRotate==false then lease.humanoid.AutoRotate=lease.previous end
    end
    function control.pauseForEmote()
        if not characterEmoting(player.Character)then control.emotePaused=false;return false end
        -- Forget only active facing proofs. Sticky identities remain available
        -- for the next actual attack; no delayed return may run over an emote.
        control.emotePaused=true
        control.resetDirectionalAim(nil,true)
        control.lastTarget,control.automaticAimTarget,control.automaticAimKind=nil,nil,nil
        if control.shiftShoulderBaseline then control.shiftShoulderBaseline.held=false end
        control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset()
        control.releaseShiftLockAim(false)
        control.lastReason='Native emote owns character facing'
        return true
    end
    local function effectiveLockActive(): boolean
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        return lock and lock.effectiveLockActive and lock.effectiveLockActive()==true or false
    end
    function control.yieldForLock(): boolean
        if not effectiveLockActive() then return false end
        control.clearBlockRetained()
        control.releaseShiftLockAim(false)
        -- Restart interpolation from the current heading when the lock yields.
        -- Target memories, active combat actions, and user settings stay intact.
        control.aimTransition=nil;control.aimTurnState=nil
        control.lastReason='Active lock-on owns aim'
        return true
    end
    local function retainPendingDashRotation(): boolean
        local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local front=menu.frontDash
        local role=lease and lease.role
        local captured=lease and dashAssistTarget(role)
        local transition=control.aimTransition
        local now=clock()
        local capture=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.dashAssistCapture
        local pending=capture and capture.moverAcknowledged~=true and capture.character==character and type(capture.at)=='number'
            and now>=capture.at and now-capture.at<=.25
        -- The captured actor already owns this heading. Until the exact native
        -- mover is acknowledged, keep only our existing yaw lease: releasing
        -- it here lets shift lock turn to the camera between consecutive dashes.
        -- No new lease, character turn, or movement is allowed in this gap.
        if not lease or lease.owner~=control or lease.character~=character or lease.humanoid~=humanoid
            or not root or root.Parent~=character or not transition or transition.root~=root
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Parent~=character or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.AutoRotate~=false
            or not nativeShiftLocked() or characterEmoting(character)
            or not front or front.cameraRelativeReady~=true or type(front.hooked)~='function' or not front.hooked()
            or not captured or control.directionalTargets[(role or 'M1'):gsub(' Aim$','')]~=captured
            or not pending and not dashAssistReady(role) then return false end
        lease.at=now
        return true
    end
    local shoulderParameters=host.RaycastParams and host.Enum.RaycastFilterType and host.RaycastParams.new()
    function control.yieldForDash()
        if dashAssistActive() then
            -- Input-to-mover acknowledgement may take a frame. Keep the prior
            -- target/intro session and its already-owned rotation through it.
            if not retainPendingDashRotation() then control.releaseShiftLockAim(false) end
            control.lastReason='Retaining active assist; waiting for verified camera-relative dash movement'
            return
        end
        local held=control.shiftLockAimLease
        if held and held.owner==control and control.blockDashGrace() then
            -- A block dash just ended: keep the heading and the Block target
            -- so the character does not snap to the camera and back.
            held.at=clock()
            control.lastReason='Block dash ended; holding heading'
            return
        end
        control.resetDirectionalAim(nil,true)
        control.lastTarget,control.automaticAimTarget,control.automaticAimKind=nil,nil,nil
        control.releaseShiftLockAim(false)
        control.lastReason='Dash input owns facing; block target memory retained'
    end
    if shoulderParameters then shoulderParameters.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;shoulderParameters.IgnoreWater=true end
    local shoulderCharacter,shoulderCamera
    function control.retainShiftLockShoulder()
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or not character or not character.Parent or characterEmoting(character)
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Parent~=character or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand
            or not nativeShiftLocked()
            or not camera or not host.Enum.CameraType or camera.CameraType~=host.Enum.CameraType.Custom
            or camera.CameraSubject~=humanoid or not camera.CFrame or not camera.Focus
            or (camera.CFrame.Position-camera.Focus.Position).Magnitude<=1 then return false end
        local baseline=control.shiftShoulderBaseline
        if not baseline or baseline.humanoid~=humanoid then
            local offset=humanoid.CameraOffset
            if not offset then return false end
            baseline={humanoid=humanoid,x=offset.X};control.shiftShoulderBaseline=baseline
        end
        baseline.held=true
        return true
    end
    function control.captureShiftLockCameraSource()
        control.shiftLockCameraSource=nil
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or not nativeShiftLocked()then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        if not humanoid or not root or not root.CFrame or not camera or not camera.CFrame or not camera.Focus
            or camera.CameraSubject~=humanoid or not humanoid.CameraOffset then return end
        local source=control.shiftLockCameraSourceBuffer or{}
        control.shiftLockCameraSourceBuffer=source
        source.character,source.humanoid,source.root,source.camera=character,humanoid,root,camera
        source.frame,source.focus,source.offset=camera.CFrame,camera.Focus,humanoid.CameraOffset
        source.rootRight,source.at=root.CFrame.RightVector,clock()
        control.shiftLockCameraSource=source
    end
    function control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset()
        local record=control.shiftLockCameraOffset
        control.shiftLockCameraOffset=nil
        if not record then return end
        -- Restore only our complete translation, never half of a camera frame
        -- which another camera owner has changed since presentation.
        if record.camera.CFrame==record.applied and record.camera.Focus==record.appliedFocus then
            record.camera.CFrame,record.camera.Focus=record.previous,record.previousFocus
        end
    end
    function control.prepareShiftLockCameraOffset()
        control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if not control.focused or not nativeShiftLocked() then
            if control.shiftShoulderBaseline then control.shiftShoulderBaseline.held=false end
            return
        end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local release=lock and lock.characterRelease
        local environment=menu.environment or {}
        local characterLock=root and lock
            and ((environment.LockedTarget and environment.LockConn and lock.ownsCharacter and lock.ownsCharacter(root)==true)
                or (release and release.root==root and release.character==character))
        if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.PlatformStand then return end
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        if not root or not camera or not host.Enum.CameraType or camera.CameraType~=host.Enum.CameraType.Custom
            or camera.CameraSubject~=humanoid or not camera.Focus or not camera.CFrame then return end
        if menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.ownsCamera and menu.autoLock.ownsCamera() then return end
        local frame,focus=camera.CFrame,camera.Focus
        if (frame.Position-focus.Position).Magnitude<=1 then return end
        -- Native camera consumed this root/offset before the assist yaw writers.
        -- Using the post-assist root here adds a false shoulder translation on
        -- the acquisition frame, especially when turning through 180 degrees.
        local source=control.shiftLockCameraSource;local now=clock()
        if not source or source.character~=character or source.humanoid~=humanoid or source.root~=root or source.camera~=camera
            or source.frame~=frame or source.focus~=focus or now<source.at or now-source.at>.05 then return end
        local offset=source.offset
        local ownsFacing=characterLock==true or ownRotationRecord(humanoid)~=nil
        local baseline=control.shiftShoulderBaseline
        if not baseline or baseline.humanoid~=humanoid then
            baseline={humanoid=humanoid,x=offset.X};control.shiftShoulderBaseline=baseline
        end
        if ownsFacing then baseline.held=true
        elseif baseline.held then
            if humanoid.AutoRotate==true and math.abs(offset.X-baseline.x)<.0001
                and (frame.RightVector-root.CFrame.RightVector).Magnitude*math.abs(offset.X)<.0001 then baseline.held=false end
        elseif humanoid.AutoRotate==true then baseline.x=offset.X end
        local active=control.shiftLockAimEnabled or characterLock==true or baseline.held==true
        if not active then return end
        -- Retain an already-owned shoulder through dash unlock and native offset
        -- recovery. Facing/input leases still yield to the dash as before.
        if not shiftLockAimActive(character,humanoid,characterLock==true or baseline.held==true,baseline.held==true) then return end
        local shoulderX=if ownsFacing or baseline.held then baseline.x else offset.X
        if math.abs(offset.X)<.00001 and math.abs(shoulderX)<.00001 then return end
        -- Keep the shoulder in the camera's axes across assist/native yaw
        -- handoffs. Never feed temporary values into the native offset tween.
        local delta=frame.RightVector*shoulderX-source.rootRight*offset.X
        local distance=delta.Magnitude
        if distance<.00001 then return end
        if shoulderParameters and type(world.Raycast)=='function' then
            if shoulderCharacter~=character or shoulderCamera~=camera then
                shoulderCharacter,shoulderCamera=character,camera
                shoulderParameters.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,camera}
            end
            local ok,hit=pcall(world.Raycast,world,frame.Position,delta,shoulderParameters)
            if not ok then return end
            if hit and hit.Position then
                local allowed=math.clamp((hit.Position-frame.Position).Magnitude-.1,0,distance)
                delta*=allowed/distance
                if allowed<.00001 then return end
            end
        end
        local applied,appliedFocus=frame+delta,focus+delta
        camera.CFrame,camera.Focus=applied,appliedFocus
        control.shiftLockCameraOffset={camera=camera,previous=frame,previousFocus=focus,applied=applied,appliedFocus=appliedFocus}
        control.shoulderStabilizedFrames=(control.shoulderStabilizedFrames or 0)+1
    end
    function control.setShiftLockAimEnabled(value)
        control.shiftLockAimEnabled=value==true
        if not control.shiftLockAimEnabled then
            if control.shiftShoulderBaseline then control.shiftShoulderBaseline.held=false end
            control.cancelAimHold();control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset();control.releaseShiftLockAim()
        end
    end
    function control.refreshShiftLockAim(root,cameraSteering)
        local character=player.Character
        local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local guard=control.blockReleaseCameraGuard
        if guard and guard.character==character then
            if clock()<guard.untilAt and not nativeDashActive(character) then
                if hum and hum.Parent==character then hum.AutoRotate=false end
                return
            end
            control.endBlockReleaseCameraGuard()
        elseif guard then
            control.blockReleaseCameraGuard=nil
        end
        local active=shiftLockAimActive(character,hum)
        local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
        if cameraSteering or lease and lease.cameraSteering and root then
            active=control.alive and control.focused and character and character.Parent and hum and hum.Parent==character
                and hum.Health>0 and not hum.PlatformStand and not characterEmoting(character)
                and not menu.recording and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
                and not(menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())
        end
        if lease and (not active or lease.humanoid~=hum or (not root and clock()-lease.at>.1)) then
            control.releaseShiftLockAim(active and lease.humanoid==hum);lease=nil
        end
        if not active or not root or root~=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then return end
        local release=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.characterRelease
        if not lease and release and release.assistReturn and release.root==root
            and release.rotationLease and (release.rotationLease.owner==control or release.humanized) and hum.AutoRotate==false then
            local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
            control.pendingAimTurnHandoff={root=root,role=release.assistRole or release.rotationLease.role,
                yaw=release.yaw or math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z),velocity=release.yawVelocity or 0,at=clock()}
            lease=release.rotationLease;release.rotationLease=nil
            lease.owner=control
            menu.autoLock.finishCharacterRelease()
            control.shiftLockAimLease=lease
        end
        local pending=rotationShared.__CullingPendingRotation
        if not lease and hum.AutoRotate==false and pending and ownRotationRecord(hum)==pending.record then
            -- Reclaim only this controller's deferred lease after native movement.
            rotationShared.__CullingPendingRotation=nil
            if pending.connection then pending.connection:Disconnect() end
            lease=pending.record;control.shiftLockAimLease=lease
        end
        if not lease and hum.AutoRotate==true then
            lease={character=character,humanoid=hum,previous=true,owner=control}
            control.shiftLockAimLease=lease
        end
        if lease then
            lease.at=clock()
            if cameraSteering~=nil then lease.cameraSteering=cameraSteering==true end
            hum.AutoRotate=false
        end
    end

    local function connect(signal: any, callback: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect) == "function" then
            table.insert(control.connections, signal:Connect(callback))
        end
    end

    -- Dash free of the camera: the game's own dash loop turns your character to the camera heading for the whole dash unless
