    -- AutoRotate is off. While an aim assist has been steering you, keep AutoRotate off through the dash and for the set
    -- delay after it, then hand the facing back to the camera through the smooth assist return.
    function control.endDashFree(immediate)
        local state = control.dashFreeState
        control.dashFreeState = nil
        if not state then return end
        local humanoid = state.humanoid
        if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.AutoRotate ~= false then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local lock = menu.autoLock
        if not immediate and root and character == state.character and lock and lock.beginAssistReturn then
            local lease = {character = character, humanoid = humanoid, previous = true, owner = control, role = state.role}
            if lock.beginAssistReturn(root, root.CFrame, state.role or 'M1', lease) then return end
        end
        humanoid.AutoRotate = state.previous
    end
    local function stepDashFree()
        if not control.dashFreeEnabled or not control.alive then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then control.dashFreeState = nil;return end
        local now = clock()
        local lease = control.shiftLockAimLease
        if lease and lease.driveAt and now - lease.driveAt <= .6 then control.engagedAt, control.engagedRole = now, lease.role end
        local state = control.dashFreeState
        if nativeDashActive(character) then
            if not state and control.engagedAt and now - control.engagedAt <= .6 then
                state = {humanoid = humanoid, character = character, previous = true, role = control.engagedRole}
                control.dashFreeState = state
            end
            if state then state.endsAt = nil;humanoid.AutoRotate = false end
        elseif state then
            state.endsAt = state.endsAt or (now + control.dashCameraDelay)
            if now < state.endsAt then humanoid.AutoRotate = false
            else control.endDashFree(false) end
        end
    end
    connect(host.game:GetService('RunService').Heartbeat, stepDashFree)
    connect(host.game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped, stepDashFree)

    function control.setEnabled(enabled: boolean)
        control.enabled = control.alive and control.ready and enabled == true
        if not control.enabled then control.resetAimTargetSwitch('M1')end
        if not control.enabled then clearStickyMemory('M1');control.m1HeldSession=nil;control.resetDirectionalAim('M1 Aim');control.lastTarget = nil; control.lastReason = "M1 Aim Assist is disabled" end
    end

    function control.setRange(value: number)
        local amount = tonumber(value) or 6
        if amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then amount = 6 end
        control.range = math.clamp(amount, 0, control.maximumRange)
    end

    end

    function control.blockCursorPoint(root)
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera or not camera.CFrame or not camera.WorldToViewportPoint then return nil end
        local projected,visible=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
        if not projected or projected.Z<=0 or not visible then return nil end
        local lock,framing=menu.autoLock,menu.directionalLock
        local mouse=if framing and framing.cursorCenter then framing.cursorCenter(camera)
            elseif lock and lock.rawCursorPoint then lock.rawCursorPoint(camera)
            elseif nativeShiftLocked()
            then camera.ViewportSize*.5 else input:GetMouseLocation()
        local dx,dy=mouse.X-projected.X,projected.Y-mouse.Y
        if dx*dx+dy*dy<16 then return nil end
        local look,right=camera.CFrame.LookVector,camera.CFrame.RightVector
        local forward=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        local side=host.Vector3.new(right.X,0,right.Z)
        if forward.Magnitude<.001 or side.Magnitude<.001 then return nil end
        local direction=side.Unit*dx+forward.Unit*dy
        if direction.Magnitude<.001 then return nil end
        return root.Position+direction.Unit*75
    end
    local function clearAutomaticAim(kind: string)
        control.resetDirectionalAim(kind..' Aim')
        if control.automaticAimKind==kind then control.automaticAimTarget,control.automaticAimKind=nil,nil end
        local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
        -- Another assist may have used the shared lease later in this frame.
        -- Only the disabled role may relinquish its own current yaw ownership.
        if lease and lease.role==kind..' Aim' then control.cancelAimHold();control.releaseShiftLockAim() end
    end
    function control.setPunishAimEnabled(value: boolean)
        control.punishAimEnabled=value==true
        if not control.punishAimEnabled then control.resetAimTargetSwitch('Punish');clearAutomaticAim('Punish') end
    end
    function control.setCounterAimEnabled(value: boolean)
        control.counterAimEnabled=value==true
        if not control.counterAimEnabled then control.resetAimTargetSwitch('Counter');clearAutomaticAim('Counter') end
    end
    local function physicalBlockHeld(): boolean
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if not block or type(block.manualBlockHeld)~='function' then return false end
        local ok,held=pcall(block.manualBlockHeld)
        return not ok or held==true
    end
    function control.cancelForManualBlock()
        if control.priorityInput and control.priorityInput()=='M1' then return end
        control.lastTarget=nil
        local counter=menu.nativeCounter;local punish=menu.autoPunish
        control.manualCancelledCounter=counter and counter.directionalPhase
        control.manualCancelledPunish=punish and punish.pending
        control.automaticAimTarget,control.automaticAimKind=nil,nil
        local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
        if lease and lease.role~='Block Aim' then control.cancelAimHold();control.releaseShiftLockAim() end
    end
    local function setAssistRange(key: string,value: any,maximum: number?): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control[key]=math.clamp(amount,0,maximum or 100);return true
    end

    function control.hooked(): boolean
        return control.alive and control.ready and tool ~= nil and tool.Melee == wrapper
    end

    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset()
        if control.runService and control.cameraPrepareName then
            control.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(control.cameraPrepareName)
            control.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(control.cameraRestoreName)
            if control.cameraSourceName then control.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(control.cameraSourceName)end
        end
        control.shiftLockCameraSource,control.shiftLockCameraSourceBuffer=nil,nil
        control.releaseShiftLockAim()
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and lock.assistReturnDispatcher==control then
            lock.assistReturnDispatcher=nil
            if lock.cancelAssistReturn then lock.cancelAssistReturn() end
        end
        control.alive, control.enabled, control.skillAimEnabled = false, false, false
        control.resetAimTargetSwitch()
        if control.clearM1ContactObserver then control.clearM1ContactObserver() end
        control.lastTarget = nil
        if control.switchOwnerDeath then control.switchOwnerDeath:Disconnect();control.switchOwnerDeath=nil end
        control.switchOwnerHumanoid=nil
        clearBlockMemory()
        clearStickyMemory('M1');clearStickyMemory('Skill')
        control.resetDirectionalAim()
        table.clear(control.aimMotion)
        local release=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.characterRelease
        if release and release.assistReturn and release.rotationLease and release.rotationLease.owner==control then menu.autoLock.finishCharacterRelease() end
        for _,connection in control.blockRecentConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.blockRecentConnections)
        control.blockAimBoxFolder,control.blockAimBoxPart,control.blockAimBoxFill=nil,nil,nil
        for _,visual in control.areaVisuals do visual.folder:Destroy() end
        table.clear(control.areaVisuals)
        if control.renderName and control.runService then control.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(control.renderName) end
        if tool and tool.Melee == wrapper then tool.Melee = original end
        for _, connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        control.lastReason = "M1 Aim Assist was unloaded"
    end

    local scripts = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local controllers = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
    local characterControllers = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("Character")
    local module = characterControllers and characterControllers:FindFirstChild("ToolController")
    if not host.RaycastParams or not world.Raycast or not host.CFrame then
        control.lastReason = "Native Melee or line-of-sight checks are unavailable"
        return control
    end
    local loaded, result = false, nil
    if module then
        loaded, result = pcall(host.require, module)
    else
        -- PlayerScripts may have been removed after native Knit initialized.
        -- Resolve only the already-loaded named controller, without scanning globals.
        local storage = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local folder = storage and storage:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local knitModule = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        if knitModule then
            local loadedKnit, knit = pcall(host.require, knitModule)
            if loadedKnit and type(knit) == "table" and type(knit.GetController) == "function" then
                local gotController, cached = pcall(knit.GetController, "ToolController")
                if gotController and type(cached) == "table" and type(cached.Melee) == "function" then
                    result = cached
                end
            end
        end
        loaded = result ~= nil
    end
    if not loaded or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.Melee) ~= "function" then
        control.lastReason = "Native Melee is unavailable"
        return control
    end
    tool, original = result, result.Melee
    control.toolController, control.nativeMelee = tool, original

    local function movementHeld(): boolean
        for _, name in {"W", "A", "S", "D", "Up", "Down", "Left", "Right"} do
            local key = host.Enum.KeyCode and host.Enum.KeyCode[name]
            if key and input:IsKeyDown(key) then return true end
        end
        if not control.controls then
            local playerModule = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if playerModule then
                local ok, moduleResult = pcall(host.require, playerModule)
                if ok and moduleResult and type(moduleResult.GetControls) == "function" then
                    local got, controls = pcall(moduleResult.GetControls, moduleResult)
                    if got then control.controls = controls end
                end
            end
        end
        local active = control.controls and control.controls.activeController
        if not active or type(active.GetMoveVector) ~= "function" then return false end
        local reader = active.GetMoveVector
        -- Read genuine input beneath our own movement helpers, so their automatic
        -- approach vectors are not mistaken for the player's manual movement.
        for _ = 1, 4 do
            local previous = reader
            for _, component in {menu.m1Approach, menu.blackflashChain, menu.knockbackControl} do
                local hook = component and component.movementHook
                if hook and hook.controller == active and hook.wrapper == reader then reader = hook.original end
            end
            if reader == previous then break end
        end
        local ok, movement = pcall(reader, active)
        return not ok or (movement and type(movement.X) == "number" and type(movement.Z) == "number"
            and (math.abs(movement.X) > 0.001 or math.abs(movement.Z) > 0.001)) == true
    end

    function control.userM1Held(): boolean
        local assist = menu.m1Assist or menu.m1Approach
        if assist and type(assist.userM1Held) == "function" then
            local ok, held = pcall(assist.userM1Held)
            return ok and held == true
        end
        return false
    end

    control.blockAimCursorPriority=true
    function control.setBlockAimCursorPriority(value)

        control.blockSourceMemory=nil
        return true
    end

        control.blockAimAttackerPriority=value==true
        control.blockSourceMemory=nil
        return true
    end
    -- Close-range stabilizer and engagement latch for Block aim.
    control.blockStabilize,control.blockStabDeadzone,control.blockStabRadius,control.blockStabFlipHold=true,14,5,.16
    control.blockLatch,control.blockLatchSeconds,control.blockLatchRange=true,1.4,22
    control.blockStabFreeze=3
    control.blockMinTurn,control.blockArcHalf,control.blockArcMargin,control.blockLeadSeconds=true,100,15,.12
    function control.setBlockMinTurn(value)control.blockMinTurn=value==true;control.blockStabState=nil;return true end
    control.blockAimPauseOnDash=false
    function control.setBlockAimPauseOnDash(value)control.blockAimPauseOnDash=value==true;return true end
    local function boundedSetter(field,low,high,scale)
        return function(value)
            local amount=tonumber(value)
            if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
            control[field]=math.clamp(amount,low,high)/scale
            return true
        end
    end
    function control.setBlockStabilizer(value)control.blockStabilize=value==true;control.blockStabState=nil;return true end
    control.setBlockStabDeadzone=boundedSetter('blockStabDeadzone',0,45,1)
    control.setBlockStabRadius=boundedSetter('blockStabRadius',1,12,1)
    control.setBlockStabFreeze=boundedSetter('blockStabFreeze',0,6,1)
    control.setBlockArcHalf=boundedSetter('blockArcHalf',1,179,1)
    control.setBlockArcMargin=boundedSetter('blockArcMargin',0,45,1)
    control.setBlockLeadSeconds=boundedSetter('blockLeadSeconds',0,400,1000)
    control.setBlockStabFlipHold=boundedSetter('blockStabFlipHold',0,400,1000)
    function control.setBlockLatch(value)control.blockLatch=value==true;control.blockLatchState=nil;return true end
    control.setBlockLatchSeconds=boundedSetter('blockLatchSeconds',.2,4,1)
    control.setBlockLatchRange=boundedSetter('blockLatchRange',6,60,1)
    -- Bearing noise grows as 1/distance, so near the enemy the aim point is filtered, ignores
    -- tiny angle changes and refuses a left-right-left reversal inside a short hold. Fast movers
    -- (dashes) pass through with light smoothing so a real dash behind is still followed at once.
    function control.stabilizeBlockPoint(root,target,point,dt,now,evidence)
        if not control.blockStabilize then return point end
        local position=root.Position
        local V3=host.Vector3
        -- A fast mover (a dash) is aimed at where it will be a moment from now, not where it is.
        if control.blockLeadSeconds>0 then
            local mover=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if mover then
                local v=mover.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                if v.X*v.X+v.Z*v.Z>400 then point=point+V3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)*control.blockLeadSeconds end
            end
        end
        local dx,dz=point.X-position.X,point.Z-position.Z
        local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
        if distance~=distance or distance<1e-3 then return point end
        local want=V3.new(dx/distance,0,dz/distance)
        -- Least rotation: block covers a wide arc in front of you, so turn only until the enemy is just inside it
        -- (with a margin) instead of squaring up to them. Already covered means no turn at all.
        local uncovered=false
        if control.blockMinTurn then
            local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
            local flatLook=V3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude>.001 then
                flatLook=flatLook.Unit
                local bearing=math.acos(math.clamp(flatLook:Dot(want),-1,1))
                local edge=math.rad(math.max(1,control.blockArcHalf-control.blockArcMargin))
                if bearing<=edge then want=flatLook
                else
                    uncovered=true
                    local cross=flatLook.X*want.Z-flatLook.Z*want.X
                    local turn=-(if cross>=0 then 1 else-1)*(bearing-edge)
                    local c,sn=math.cos(turn),math.sin(turn)
                    want=V3.new(flatLook.X*c+flatLook.Z*sn,0,-flatLook.X*sn+flatLook.Z*c)
                end
            end
        end
        local state=control.blockStabState
        if not state or state.target~=target or state.root~=root or now<state.at or now-state.at>.4 then
            control.blockStabState={target=target,root=root,dir=want,at=now,signAt=-math.huge,sign=0}
            return point
        end
        state.at=now
        local other=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local velocity=other and other.AssemblyLinearVelocity or V3.new(0,0,0)
        local fast=velocity.X*velocity.X+velocity.Z*velocity.Z>900
        local current=state.dir
        local angle=math.acos(math.clamp(current:Dot(want),-1,1))
        local nearness=math.clamp(1-distance/control.blockStabRadius,0,1)
        local hold=false
        if not fast then
            -- Face to face the bearing flips with every step either of you takes: hold the last facing.
            -- Up close the hold is only for an enemy already inside the block arc; one that slipped outside it is turned to at once.
            if not uncovered and (distance<control.blockStabFreeze or angle<math.rad(control.blockStabDeadzone)*nearness) then hold=true
            else
                local sign=if current.X*want.Z-current.Z*want.X>=0 then 1 else-1
                if state.sign~=0 and sign~=state.sign and angle<math.rad(70) and now-state.signAt<control.blockStabFlipHold then hold=true
                else state.sign,state.signAt=sign,now end
            end
        end
        if not hold then
            local token=evidence and evidence.token
            local tau=if fast then .03 else .03+.19*nearness
            if uncovered then tau=math.min(tau,.05) end
            if token and token~=state.token then state.token=token;state.commitUntil=now+.3
            elseif token and not fast and now<(state.commitUntil or 0) and not control.blockSnap then tau*=2.2 end
            if control.blockSnap then tau=math.min(tau,.02) end
            local blended=current+(want-current)*(1-math.exp(-math.max(dt,0)/tau))
            state.dir=if blended.Magnitude>.05 then blended.Unit else want
        end
        local reach=math.max(distance,3)
        return V3.new(position.X+state.dir.X*reach,point.Y,position.Z+state.dir.Z*reach)
    end
    -- Manual input outranks every assist while it is held: your own M1 beats Auto Block and the other assists, your own Block beats the
    -- aim assists and Auto Punish, and a dash beats everything. The assist that belongs to the held input keeps working.
    -- Block Assist snaps the character onto the enemy: no intro curve, no smoothing, the fastest turn the rate cap allows.
    control.blockSnap=true
    function control.setBlockSnap(value) control.blockSnap=value==true;control.aimTransition=nil;return true end
    -- Last-moment prediction: while an attack winds up the aim stays on the enemy's real position, and only at the last moment
    -- (blockCommitDelay after the attack began) one concrete forecast is taken and held for the rest of the swing. A flip of the forecast
    -- direction (the left-right-left jitter) is ignored unless it lasts blockLeadFlipHold.
    control.blockLastMoment,control.blockCommitDelay,control.blockLeadFlipHold=true,.14,.18
    function control.setBlockLastMoment(value) control.blockLastMoment=value==true;control.blockLeadState=nil;return true end
    control.manualPriority=true
    function control.setManualPriority(value) control.manualPriority=value==true;control.resetDirectionalAim(nil,true);return true end
    -- Up close the facing box can lose the enemy (they are inside or behind it), so anything this near is always an eligible target.
    control.closeAim,control.closeAimRange=true,7
    function control.setCloseAim(value) control.closeAim=value==true;return true end
    control.setCloseAimRange=boundedSetter('closeAimRange',2,20,1)
    control.inputPriorityEnabled=false
    function control.setInputPriority(value)
        control.inputPriorityEnabled=value==true
        control.resetDirectionalAim(nil,true)
    end
    function control.priorityInput(): string?
        -- Read input/state only: never ask another facing predicate here.
        -- This keeps lock/assist arbitration free of recursive ownership checks.
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local m1Rule=control.inputPriorityEnabled or (block and block.referenceSettings and block.referenceSettings.manualM1Supreme==true
            and not(block.blockFirstActive and block.blockFirstActive()))
        if not (m1Rule or control.manualPriority) or not control.alive or not control.focused
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then return nil end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return nil end
        if control.userM1Held() and (m1Rule or control.manualPriority) then
            -- A skill you just pressed or are casting outranks a held M1, so skill aim assist keeps the facing.
            local lock=menu.autoLock
            local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if lock and lock.currentPendingSkill and lock.currentPendingSkill() then return nil end
            if info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then
                local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
                -- Native M1 may own this same marker. Use its confirmed swing
                -- evidence without recursing through facing ownership checks.
                if not tracker or not tracker.m1EvidenceCurrent or tracker.m1EvidenceCurrent()~=true then return nil end
            end
            if m1Rule then return 'M1' end
        end
        if control.manualPriority and block and block.manualBlockHeld and block.manualBlockHeld()==true then return 'Block' end
        return nil
    end
    function control.priorityAllows(role): boolean
        local owner=control.priorityInput()
        return owner==nil or owner==(role or 'M1'):gsub(' Aim$','')
    end

    local function modelFrom(value: any): any
        if kindOf(value) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
        return if value:IsA("Model") then value else value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end

    local function torso(model: any): any
        for _, name in {"Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart"} do
            local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part end
        end
        return nil
    end

    control.aimPriorities={Block={'Normal'}}
    control.aimPriorityChoices=menu.targetMethods.choices()
    function control.setAimPriority(role,value)
        local selected,valid=menu.targetMethods.normalize(value)
        if not table.find({'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'},role)or not valid then return false end
        if role=='Skill'then return control.setSkillAimTargets(selected)end
        control.resetAimTargetSwitch(role);control.aimPriorities[role]=selected
        if role=='M1' then control.m1HeldSession=nil end
        if role=='Block' then clearBlockMemory();control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim') end
        if role=='M1'or role=='Skill'then clearStickyMemory(role)end
        return true
    end
    local function validTarget(model: any, character: any, folder: any, blockVolume: boolean?, retainedM1: boolean?, memoryOnly: boolean?): boolean
        if not memoryOnly and menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then return false end
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(model)) then return false end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if not retainedM1 and lock and lock.inFov and not lock.inFov(model,world.CurrentCamera)
            and not (blockVolume and control.blockBodyInFov(model)) then return false end
        if not model or model == character or not model.Parent or not model:IsDescendantOf(folder) then return false end
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local info = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not info then return false end
        if model.Name == "HarutaSwordNPC" or info:FindFirstChild("UroDistort") then return false end
        local owner = model:FindFirstChild("Owner")
        if model:GetAttribute("HitboxNPC") and owner and (owner.Value == character or owner.Value == player) then return false end
        local other = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        local blockSettings = menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.referenceSettings
        if blockSettings and blockSettings.ignoreNpcs and not other then return false end
        if other and not other.Neutral and not player.Neutral and player.Team ~= nil and player.Team == other.Team then return false end
        return torso(model) ~= nil
    end
    local function stickyTargetAlive(model)
        local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=model and model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local dead=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        local latched=control.stickyAimDeadTargets[model]
        if latched and latched~=humanoid and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then control.stickyAimDeadTargets[model]=nil;latched=nil end
        return humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not latched and model:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true
            and not(info and info:FindFirstChild('Dead'))and not(dead and humanoid.GetState and humanoid:GetState()==dead)
    end
    local function m1TargetStanding(model)
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local state=humanoid and humanoid:GetState();local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local ragdoll=model:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')
        return humanoid and not(ragdoll==true or(tonumber(ragdoll)or 0)>0 or humanoid.PlatformStand
            or state==states.Physics or state==states.Ragdoll or state==states.FallingDown or state==states.GettingUp
            or info and(info:FindFirstChild('Ragdoll')or info:FindFirstChild('TrueRagdoll')or info:FindFirstChild('CompleteRagdoll')or info:FindFirstChild('Downed')))
    end
    local function retainedStickyTarget(role)
        local record=control.stickyAimMemories[role]
        if not record then return nil end
        local character=player.Character;local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        local sticky=aimSticky(role)
        local bridge=menu.m1Assist
        local enabled=if role=='Skill'then requestedFlag(control,'skillAimEnabled')else requestedFlag(control,'enabled')
            or bridge and requestedFlag(bridge,'enabled')and(bridge.method=='Neutral'or bridge.method=='Random')
        local target=record.target;local range=if role=='Skill'then control.skillAimRange else control.range
        local ownInfo=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local dead=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        local valid=control.alive and sticky and enabled and record.character==character and record.root==root
            and character and character.Parent and root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and control.stickyAimDeadCharacter~=character
            and character:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true and not(ownInfo and ownInfo:FindFirstChild('Dead'))
            and not(dead and humanoid.GetState and humanoid:GetState()==dead)and folder and stickyTargetAlive(target)
            and validTarget(target,character,folder,true,true,true)
            and control.aimAreaAllowsTarget(role,target,root,true)and control.aimRangeAllows(role,root,target,range,true)
            and(role~='M1'or control.m1AssistRagdolled or m1TargetStanding(target))
        if not valid then clearStickyMemory(role);return nil end
        return target
    end
    function control.getRetainedM1Target()return retainedStickyTarget('M1')end
    function control.getRetainedSkillTarget()return retainedStickyTarget('Skill')end
    local function rememberStickyTarget(role,character,root,target)
        if (role~='M1' and role~='Skill') or not aimSticky(role)then return end
        local record=control.stickyAimMemories[role]
        if record and record.character==character and record.root==root and record.target==target then return end
        clearStickyMemory(role)
        record={character=character,root=root,target=target,connections={}};control.stickyAimMemories[role]=record
        local function death(owner,isOwn)
            local humanoid=owner and owner:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if humanoid and humanoid.Died and type(humanoid.Died.Connect)=='function'then
                table.insert(record.connections,humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                    if isOwn then control.stickyAimDeadCharacter=character else control.stickyAimDeadTargets[target]=humanoid end
                    if control.stickyAimMemories[role]==record then clearStickyMemory(role);control.resetDirectionalAim(role..' Aim',true)end
                end))
            end
        end
        death(target,false);death(character,true)
    end
    function control.getRetainedBlockTarget()
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return nil end
        if not control.blockAimMemory and control.blockMemoryDeathConnection then clearBlockMemory() end
        local record=control.blockAimRetained
        if not record then return nil end
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        local valid=control.alive and control.focused and control.blockAimEnabled and control.blockAimKeepAfterRelease
            and control.blockAimSpeed>0 and control.blockAimReleaseDistance>0 and record.character==character and record.root==root
            and character and character.Parent and root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not humanoid.PlatformStand and info and folder
            and not menu.recording and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            and not (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())
            and not (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) and not effectiveLockActive()
            and not control.userM1Held() and character:GetAttribute('Stun')~=true and control.onlySelfStun(info)
        if valid then
            for _,name in {'TrueStun','Knockback','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Downed','Dead','DomainClash'} do
                local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
                if value==true or type(value)=='number' and value>0 or info:FindFirstChild(name) then valid=false;break end
            end
        end
        local target=record.target
        -- The established actor is independent of the camera, acquisition FOV,
        -- facing box, and recent-hit timers. Never run another target selector.
        if valid then valid=target~=nil and validTarget(target,character,folder,true,true) end
        if valid then
            local targetInfo=target:FindFirstChild('Info');local targetHum=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            local dead=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
            valid=target:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true and not (targetInfo and targetInfo:FindFirstChild('Dead'))
                and not (dead and targetHum.GetState and targetHum:GetState()==dead)
                and control.aimRangeAllows('Block',root,target,control.blockAimReleaseDistance,true)
        end
        if not valid then control.clearBlockRetained();return nil end
        return target
    end
    local function rememberEngagedBlock(root,target)
        if not control.blockAimEnabled or not control.blockAimKeepAfterRelease or control.blockAimReleaseDistance<=0 then return end
        local targetRoot=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not targetRoot or not control.aimRangeAllows('Block',root,target,control.blockAimReleaseDistance,true) then return end
        local record=control.blockAimRetained
        if record and record.character==player.Character and record.root==root and record.target==target then return end
        control.clearBlockRetained()
        record={character=player.Character,root=root,target=target}
        control.blockAimRetained=record
        local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid and humanoid.Died and type(humanoid.Died.Connect)=='function' then
            record.deathConnection=humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                if control.blockAimRetained==record then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim',true) end
            end)
        end
        local ownHumanoid=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if ownHumanoid and ownHumanoid.Died and type(ownHumanoid.Died.Connect)=='function' then
            record.ownDeathConnection=ownHumanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                if control.blockAimRetained==record then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim',true) end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function rememberBlockMemory(character,root,target)
        local record=control.blockAimMemory
        if record and record.character==character and record.root==root and record.target==target then return end
        clearBlockMemory()
        record={character=character,root=root,target=target};control.blockAimMemory=record
        local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid and humanoid.Died and type(humanoid.Died.Connect)=='function' then
            control.blockMemoryDeathConnection=humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                control.blockAimDeadTargets[target]=true
                if control.blockAimMemory==record then clearBlockMemory();control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim',true) end
            end)
        end
        local own=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if own and own.Died and type(own.Died.Connect)=='function' then
            control.blockMemoryOwnDeathConnection=own.Died:Connect(function()
                control.blockAimDeadCharacter=character
                if control.blockAimMemory==record then clearBlockMemory();control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim',true) end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function m1AimEnabled()
        local m1=menu.m1Assist
        return control.enabled or m1 and m1.enabled and (m1.method=='Neutral' or m1.method=='Random')
    end
    local function permitted(character: any, humanoid: any, requestBoundary: boolean?): (boolean, string)
        if not control.alive or not m1AimEnabled() then return false, "M1 Aim Assist is disabled" end
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return false,'Native emote owns character facing'end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()then return false,'Failsafe paused assistance'end
        if aimSticky('M1') and control.stickyAimDeadCharacter==character then return false,'Your remembered character died'end
        if not control.focused or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or menu.recording then return false, "Input is focused elsewhere" end
        if physicalBlockHeld() and control.priorityInput()~='M1' then return false, 'Manual Block owns facing input' end
        -- Walking input and held-M1 yaw can coexist. Native dash and action
        -- ownership checks below still decide when facing must yield.
        if effectiveLockActive() then return false, "Active lock-on owns facing" end
        if control.priorityInput()~='M1' and menu.blackflashChain and menu.blackflashChain.enabled and menu.blackflashChain.movement then return false, "Black Flash follow-up owns facing" end
        if not character or not character.Parent or player.Character ~= character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, "Your character is unavailable" end
        if nativeDashActive(character) then return false, "Native dash owns facing" end
        if not requestBoundary and (control.activeCalls[character] or 0) > 0 then return false, "The native held-M1 entry is already running" end
        local state = humanoid:GetState()
        local states = host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local ownM1=control.ownM1Phase(character)
        if humanoid.PlatformStand or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0) > 0 or state == states.Physics or state == states.Ragdoll or state == states.FallingDown or state == states.GettingUp or state == states.Dead then return false, "Your character cannot face an attack now" end
        if character:GetAttribute("Stun") == true or character:GetAttribute("TrueStun") == true then return false, "Your character is stunned" end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return false, "Native character state is unavailable" end
        for _, name in {"Stun", "TrueStun", "Block", "Knockback", "InSkill", "DomainClash", "Throwable", "Melee", "Attacking"} do
            local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name)
            local ownState=ownM1 and (name=='InSkill' or name=='Melee' or name=='Attacking'
                or name=='Stun' and control.onlySelfStun(info))
            if marker and not ownState then return false, "Native action is busy: "..name end
        end
        local item = info:FindFirstChild("Item")
        if (item and item:FindFirstChild("M1")) or character:FindFirstChild("CustomM1") or character:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") then return false, "This M1 uses a separate native action" end
        local shared = host._G or {}
        if shared.Crow then return false, "Bird control owns this native input" end
        if shared.Settings and shared.Settings.AutoUse == false and tool.Selected and tool.Selected.Value then return false, "A selected native skill owns this input" end
        return true, "Native M1 entry is available"
    end
    function control.onlySelfStun(info: any): boolean
        for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do
            if marker.Name=='Stun' and (not marker:IsA('BoolValue') or marker.Value~=false) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.ownM1Phase(character: any): boolean
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if not character or character~=player.Character or not tracker or not tracker.m1EvidenceCurrent
            or not control.userM1Held() or (menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.skillFacing and control.priorityInput()~='M1') then return false end
        local incoming=tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        if incoming and incoming.character==character and clock()-incoming.at<0.35 then return false end
        local session=control.m1HeldSession
        if tracker.m1EvidenceCurrent()==true then
            if session and session.character==character then
                local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                session.nativeAt=clock();session.skillAt=tracker.lastOwnSkillAt
                session.nativeMarker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            end
            return true
        end
        -- Native swing evidence expires before some weapons finish their
        -- recovery markers. A continuously held, confirmed combo retains its
        -- facing ownership across those gaps, never across a new skill/hit.
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        return session~=nil and session.character==character and session.nativeAt~=nil
            and (not marker or marker==session.nativeMarker)
            and (not tracker.lastOwnSkillAt or tracker.lastOwnSkillAt==session.skillAt)
    end
    function control.manualFacingActive(): boolean
        -- M1 aim tracks the selected opponent; manual yaw belongs only to skills.
        return false
    end
    function control.manualFacingFrame(root: any): any
        if not control.manualFacingActive() or root~=player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then return nil end
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera;local look=camera and camera.CFrame and camera.CFrame.LookVector
        if not look or look.X~=look.X or look.Z~=look.Z or look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z<0.0001 then return nil end
        return host.CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position+host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z))
    end

    local function selectTarget(character,root,skillRange,targetMode,filter,role,pinnedTarget)
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        local range=skillRange or control.range
        if not folder or range<=0 then return nil end
        local priority=control.aimPriorities[role or 'M1']or{'Normal'}
        if role=='Skill'and menu.targetMethods.isNormal(priority)then priority=control.skillAimTargets end
        local camera,lock=world.CurrentCamera,menu.autoLock
        local cursor=camera and lock and lock.rawCursorPoint and lock.rawCursorPoint(camera)
        local params=host.RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local excluded={character};local effects=world:FindFirstChild('Effects');if effects then table.insert(excluded,effects)end
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances=excluded
        local origin=root.Position+host.Vector3.new(0,1,0)
        local distances,projections,eligibility={},{},{}
        local m1Role=role==nil or role=='M1'
        local aimRole=role or'M1'
        if #priority==0 then control.resetAimTargetSwitch(aimRole);return nil end
        local sticky=(m1Role or role=='Skill')and aimSticky(aimRole)
        if sticky and #priority==0 then clearStickyMemory(aimRole);return nil end
        local memoryTarget=if sticky then retainedStickyTarget(aimRole)else nil
        local session=if m1Role and control.aimTargetSwitchModes.M1=='Default' and control.userM1Held() then control.m1HeldSession else nil
        if session and session.character~=character then session=nil;control.m1HeldSession=nil end
        local function eligible(model)
            if eligibility[model]~=nil then return eligibility[model]end
            local retained=control.areaTargets[aimRole]==model
            local heldTarget=m1Role and session~=nil and session.target==model
            local remembered=sticky and(model==memoryTarget or model==pinnedTarget)
            retained=retained or heldTarget or remembered
            if aimRole=='Skill' then
                local context=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.skillFacing
                retained=remembered or retained and context~=nil and control.areaSkillContext==context and context.target==model
            end
            local okay=validTarget(model,character,folder,true,heldTarget or remembered)and(not filter or filter(model))
                and control.aimAreaAllowsTarget(aimRole,model,root,retained)
            if okay and sticky and not stickyTargetAlive(model)then okay=false end
            -- The saved option retains an already engaged victim through
            -- ragdoll/recovery; it never acquires a new downed bystander.
            if okay and m1Role and not (control.m1AssistRagdolled and retained) then
                local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
                local state=humanoid and humanoid:GetState()
                local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
                local ragdoll=model:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')
                if ragdoll==true or (tonumber(ragdoll) or 0)>0 or humanoid.PlatformStand
                    or state==states.Physics or state==states.Ragdoll or state==states.FallingDown or state==states.GettingUp
                    or info and (info:FindFirstChild('Ragdoll') or info:FindFirstChild('TrueRagdoll') or info:FindFirstChild('CompleteRagdoll') or info:FindFirstChild('Downed')) then okay=false end
            end
            local targetRoot=okay and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local distance=targetRoot and(targetRoot.Position-root.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
            if not (role=='Block' and control.blockAimBoxEnabled)
                and not control.aimRangeAllows(aimRole,root,model,range,heldTarget or remembered) then okay=false end
            if okay then
                local part=torso(model);local direction=part.Position-origin
                local hit=if lock and lock.lockThroughWalls then nil
                    elseif menu.visibilityRaycast then menu.visibilityRaycast(origin,direction,params)else world:Raycast(origin,direction,params)
                okay=not hit or(hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model))==true
                if okay and camera and cursor then
                    local point,shown=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if shown and point.Z>0 then projections[model]=point end
                end
            end
            distances[model]=distance;eligibility[model]=okay==true;return okay==true
        end
        if session and eligible(session.target) then
            control.selectAimSwitchTarget(aimRole,character,root,session.target,eligible,true)
            control.areaTargets.M1=session.target
            rememberStickyTarget('M1',character,root,session.target)
            control.lastSelection='Held M1 target'
            return session.target
        end
        if m1Role then control.m1HeldSession=nil end
        if pinnedTarget then
            -- A cast already owns its victim. Sticky memory can never replace
            -- that identity, even if the current victim becomes ineligible.
            if not eligible(pinnedTarget)then return nil end
            control.selectAimSwitchTarget(aimRole,character,root,pinnedTarget,eligible,true)
            control.areaTargets[aimRole]=pinnedTarget;rememberStickyTarget(aimRole,character,root,pinnedTarget)
            control.lastSelection='Current native skill target';return pinnedTarget
        end
        if memoryTarget then
            if eligible(memoryTarget)then
                control.areaTargets[aimRole]=memoryTarget;control.lastSelection=aimRole..' sticky target'
                return memoryTarget
            end
            clearStickyMemory(aimRole)
        end
        local visuals=menu.visuals
        if sticky and visuals and visuals.hitOutlineEnabled then
            local newest=-math.huge;local outlined;local now=clock()
            for model,at in visuals.hitOutlineTimes or{}do
                if type(at)=='number'and at<=now and at>newest
                    and(visuals.hitOutlineUntilDeath or now-at<(visuals.hitOutlineDuration or 300))and eligible(model)then outlined,newest=model,at end
            end
            if outlined then
                control.areaTargets[aimRole]=outlined;rememberStickyTarget(aimRole,character,root,outlined)
                control.lastSelection='Recent hit outline';return outlined
            end
        end
        local target,reason=menu.targetMethods.choose(priority,menu.targetMethods.screenContext(folder:GetChildren(),{
            camera=camera,cursorPoint=cursor,cursorHit=true,eligible=eligible,normalPrefersLock=true,
            normalRank=function(model)
                local distance=distances[model]or math.huge
                if distance==math.huge or not camera then return distance end
                -- Prefer enemies the player is looking toward: an enemy
                -- directly behind ranks up to 60% farther than its real distance.
                local other=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                local look=camera.CFrame.LookVector
                if not other then return distance end
                local toward=host.Vector3.new(other.Position.X-root.Position.X,0,other.Position.Z-root.Position.Z)
                local facing=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
                if toward.Magnitude<.001 or facing.Magnitude<.001 then return distance end
                local cosine=math.clamp(toward.Unit:Dot(facing.Unit),-1,1)
                local rank=distance*(1+.3*(1-cosine))
                -- The enemy Auto Block's frame detection says is attacking you
                -- right now is the natural M1 target: rank it twice as near.
                if control.frameThreat and control.frameThreat()==model then rank*=.5 end
                return rank
            end,
            distanceRank=function(model)return distances[model]or math.huge end,
            cursorRank=function(model)
                local point=projections[model]
                if point and cursor then return math.sqrt((point.X-cursor.X)^2+(point.Y-cursor.Y)^2) end
                -- Off-screen or behind the camera used to rank as "no target" (so
                -- Closest to cursor found nothing with the camera turned away).
                -- Rank it after every on-screen target, nearest to the aim direction first.
                local part=torso(model)
                if not part or not camera then return math.huge end
                local toward=part.Position-camera.CFrame.Position
                if toward.Magnitude<.001 then return math.huge end
                local angle=math.acos(math.clamp(camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(toward.Unit),-1,1))
                return 100000+angle*1000
            end}))
        if aimRole=='M1' or aimRole=='Skill' then target=control.selectAimSwitchTarget(aimRole,character,root,target,eligible)end
        control.areaTargets[role or 'M1']=target
        if target then rememberStickyTarget(aimRole,character,root,target)end
        control.lastSelection=reason;return target
    end
    function control.selectSkillTarget(): any
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return nil end
        if nativeDashActive(player.Character) or dashAssistActive() then return dashAssistTarget('Skill') end
        if not control.priorityAllows('Skill') then return nil end
        if control.yieldForLock() then return nil end
        if not control.alive or not control.skillAimEnabled or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()then return nil end
        local character=player.Character;local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root
            or aimSticky('Skill') and control.stickyAimDeadCharacter==character then return nil end
        local pinned
        if aimSticky('Skill') or control.aimTargetSwitchModes.Skill~='Default' then
            local lock=menu.autoLock;local context=lock and lock.skillFacing
            local now=clock();local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local moveset=character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
            local function currentTool(nativeTool,service)
                return nativeTool and moveset and nativeTool.Parent==moveset and type(service)=='string'and service~=''
                    and type(nativeTool.IsA)=='function'and(nativeTool:IsA('NumberValue')or nativeTool:IsA('Tool'))
                    and nativeTool:GetAttribute('Service')==service
            end
            if context and context.character==character and context.target and not context.manualReleased and not context.detached
                and lock.alive~=false and lock.focused~=false and context.kit==character:GetAttribute('Moveset')
                and context.mode==lock.skillAimMode and currentTool(context.tool,context.service)
                and not(lock.isCounterSkill and lock.isCounterSkill(context.tool))
                and type(context.at)=='number'and now>=context.at and now-context.at<=8
                and(info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')or not context.seenSkill and now-context.at<=(if context.boundaryObserved then .65 else .2))then pinned=context.target end
            local toji=menu.nativeTojiAim;local native=toji and toji.current
            local feature=native and toji.features and toji.features[native.key]
            if native and native.accepted and native.character==character and native.target and type(native.at)=='number'
                and toji.alive~=false and feature and feature.enabled==true and feature.spec
                and currentTool(native.tool,feature.spec.service)and type(toji.eligible)=='function'and toji.eligible(native.key,native.target,false)
                and now>=native.at and now-native.at<=8 and info and(info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')or info:FindFirstChild('RuptureCheck')or info:FindFirstChild('WhiplashAgain'))then pinned=native.target end
        end
        return selectTarget(character,root,control.skillAimRange,nil,nil,'Skill',pinned)
    end

    local function observeAimFacing(root,target,role,frame)
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and lock.noteAssistFacing then lock.noteAssistFacing(root,target,role,frame) end
    end
    function control.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget(role)
        if role~='Skill'and role~='Skill Aim'then return nil end
        local owner=menu.nativeTojiAim
        if owner and owner.alive~=false and type(owner.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget)=='function'then return owner.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget()end
        return nil
    end
    -- One bounded yaw response for all directional assists. Always recompute
    -- from the current root position, including after a native teleport.
    -- Replicated target positions arrive in network-rate steps and animated
    -- parts sway, so the raw aim point steps between frames. An alpha-beta
    -- filter smooths those steps and keeps a velocity estimate so a steadily
    -- moving target is not followed with a lag. Set the time to 0 to disable.
    control.aimPointSmoothingMs=40
    control.m1SnapSeconds=.15
    control.m1SnapResponse=60
    -- Seconds a Block must be held before fast tracking engages (was 0.12);
    -- the slow acquisition speed is what loses a fast circling enemy.
    control.blockTrackingDelay=.04
    control.aimPointFilters={}
    function control.filterAimPoint(key: string, root: any, point: any): any
        local tau=(tonumber(control.aimPointSmoothingMs) or 0)/1000
        if tau<=0 or not point then return point end
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local now=clock()
            local state=control.aimPointFilters[key]
            if not state or state.root~=root or now<state.at or now-state.at>.25 or (point-state.position).Magnitude>15 then
                control.aimPointFilters[key]={root=root,position=point,velocity=host.Vector3.new(0,0,0),at=now}
                return point
            end
            local elapsed=now-state.at
            if elapsed<=.001 then return state.position end
            local alpha=1-math.exp(-elapsed/tau)
            local beta=alpha*alpha/(2-alpha)
            local predicted=state.position+state.velocity*elapsed
            local residual=point-predicted
            state.position=predicted+residual*alpha
            state.velocity=state.velocity+residual*(beta/elapsed)
            state.at=now
            return state.position
        end)
        if ok and result then return result end
        return point
    end
    function control.directionalFrame(root: any, destination: any, dt: number, response: number?, role: string?): (any, boolean?)
        local cameraOwner=menu.autoLock
        if cameraOwner and cameraOwner.assistDirectionFreedomAllowed and not cameraOwner.assistDirectionFreedomAllowed(role)then
            local own=player.Character;local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if own and(info and(info:FindFirstChild('NoRotate')or info:FindFirstChild('NoRotation'))
                or own:GetAttribute('NoRotate')==true or own:GetAttribute('NoRotation')==true)then return nil,false end
        end
        if not control.cameraSteeringPass and cameraOwner and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive() then return nil,false end
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return nil,false end
        local retained=dashAssistTarget(role)
        local whiplash=control.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget(role)
        if (nativeDashActive(player.Character) or dashAssistActive()) and not (role=='Block Aim' and blockDashTarget())
            and not(whiplash and whiplash==control.directionalTargets.Skill)then
            if not retained then control.yieldForDash();return nil,false end
            if not dashAssistReady(role) or retained~=control.directionalTargets[(role or 'M1'):gsub(' Aim$','')] then return nil,false end
        end
        if not control.priorityAllows(role) then return nil,false end
        if control.yieldForLock() then return nil,false end
        if (role=='Counter Aim' and not control.counterAimEnabled)
            or (role=='Punish Aim' and not control.punishAimEnabled) then return nil end
        if not root or not root.CFrame or not destination or type(dt)~='number'
            or dt~=dt or dt<=0 or math.abs(dt)==math.huge then return nil end
        -- Reclaim a returning rotation lease before evaluating this frame's
        -- curve, preserving its angular velocity through a quick reacquisition.
        local release=cameraOwner and cameraOwner.characterRelease
        if release and release.assistReturn and release.root==root then control.refreshShiftLockAim(root,control.cameraSteeringPass)end
        local position,look=root.Position,root.CFrame.LookVector
        if not position or not look then return nil end
        destination=control.filterAimPoint(role or 'M1 Aim',root,destination)
        local dx,dz=destination.X-position.X,destination.Z-position.Z
        if dx~=dx or dz~=dz or math.abs(dx)==math.huge or math.abs(dz)==math.huge
            or look.X~=look.X or look.Z~=look.Z or dx*dx+dz*dz<0.000001 then return nil end
        -- Under about 0.7 studs the heading flips with tiny movements; hold the
        -- current facing instead of spinning the character.
        if dx*dx+dz*dz<.5 then return nil,true end
        local currentYaw,desiredYaw=math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z),math.atan2(-dx,-dz)
        local delta=math.atan2(math.sin(desiredYaw-currentYaw),math.cos(desiredYaw-currentYaw))
        local elapsed=math.clamp(dt,0,.1)
        local roleName=role or 'M1 Aim'
        local smoothing=if roleName=='M1 Aim' then control.m1AimSmoothingMs elseif roleName=='Block Aim' then control.blockAimSmoothingMs
            elseif roleName=='Skill Aim' then control.skillAimSmoothingMs
            elseif roleName=='Counter Aim' then control.counterAimSmoothingMs elseif roleName=='Punish Aim' then control.punishAimSmoothingMs else 0
        local configured=if roleName=='Skill Aim' then control.skillAimSpeed else response or control.turnResponse
        if configured<=0 then control.resetDirectionalAim(roleName);return nil end
        -- Moment-of-hit snap: the swing that lands is decided as the press
        -- begins, so turn at a much higher rate for a short window after each
        -- fresh M1 press instead of easing in. Set m1SnapSeconds to 0 to disable.
        if roleName=='M1 Aim' and control.m1SnapSeconds>0 then
            local okHeld,held=pcall(control.userM1Held)
            held=okHeld and held==true
            if held and not control.m1SnapHeld then control.m1SnapUntil=clock()+control.m1SnapSeconds end
            control.m1SnapHeld=held
            if clock()<(control.m1SnapUntil or 0) then
                configured=math.max(configured,control.m1SnapResponse)
                smoothing=0
            end
        end
        local introResponse,introSmoothing=configured,smoothing
        local tracking=roleName=='Block Aim' and control.blockAimSession and control.blockAimSession.tracking==true
        if tracking then configured=control.blockAimTrackingSpeed;smoothing=0 end
        local snap=roleName=='Block Aim' and control.blockSnap==true
        if snap then tracking=true;configured=math.max(configured,control.blockAimTrackingSpeed,60);smoothing=0 end
        if configured<=0 then control.resetDirectionalAim(roleName);return nil end
        local rate=1/(1/configured+math.max(smoothing,0)/1000)
        local now=clock()
        local target=control.directionalTargets[roleName:gsub(' Aim$','')]
        local previousTransition=control.aimTransition
        local state=control.aimTurnState
        local function currentState(candidate)
            return candidate and candidate.root==root and candidate.role==roleName and candidate.at and candidate.yaw and candidate.position
                and now>=candidate.at and now-candidate.at<=.25
                and math.abs(math.atan2(math.sin(currentYaw-candidate.yaw),math.cos(currentYaw-candidate.yaw)))<=math.rad(45)
                and (position-candidate.position).Magnitude<=6
        end
        if not currentState(state) then
            local velocity=if currentState(previousTransition)then previousTransition.velocity or 0 else 0
            state={root=root,role=roleName,velocity=velocity};control.aimTurnState=state
        end
        local handoff=control.pendingAimTurnHandoff
        if handoff then
            control.pendingAimTurnHandoff=nil
            if handoff.root==root and type(handoff.role)=='string'and handoff.role:gsub(' Aim$','')==roleName:gsub(' Aim$','')
                and type(handoff.at)=='number'and now>=handoff.at and now-handoff.at<=.1
                and type(handoff.yaw)=='number'and handoff.yaw==handoff.yaw
                and type(handoff.velocity)=='number'and handoff.velocity==handoff.velocity and math.abs(handoff.velocity)<math.huge
                and math.abs(math.atan2(math.sin(currentYaw-handoff.yaw),math.cos(currentYaw-handoff.yaw)))<=math.rad(45)then
                state.velocity=handoff.velocity
                previousTransition=nil
            end
        end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        local humanized=lock and lock.isAssistHumanized and lock.isAssistHumanized(roleName)
        local ramp=lock and lock.isAssistRampIntoLaser and lock.isAssistRampIntoLaser(roleName)
        local previousRole,previousAt=control.driveRole,control.driveAt
        control.driveRole,control.driveAt=roleName,now
        if previousRole and previousRole~=roleName and previousAt and now-previousAt<=.35 and control.assistHandoffMs>0 then
            control.handoffRole,control.handoffUntil=roleName,now+control.assistHandoffMs*.001
            local previousTarget=control.directionalTargets[previousRole:gsub(' Aim$','')]
            control.handoffSeamless=control.seamlessHandoff and previousTarget~=nil and previousTarget==target
                and math.abs(delta)<=math.rad(60)
        end
        local bridging=control.handoffRole==roleName and now<(control.handoffUntil or 0)
        local seamless=bridging and control.handoffSeamless==true
        if seamless and not tracking then
            configured=math.max(configured,control.blockAimTrackingSpeed);smoothing=0
            rate=1/(1/configured+math.max(smoothing,0)/1000)
        end
        local transitionSeconds=control.characterTransitionMs*.001
        if ramp then
            transitionSeconds=lock.getAssistRampSeconds and lock.getAssistRampSeconds(roleName)or .08
        elseif lock and lock.getAssistIntroSeconds then
            transitionSeconds=lock.getAssistIntroSeconds(roleName)
        elseif humanized then transitionSeconds=math.clamp(transitionSeconds,.06,.14)end
        if seamless then transitionSeconds=0
        elseif bridging then transitionSeconds=math.max(transitionSeconds,control.assistHandoffMs*.001) end
        if snap then transitionSeconds=0 end
        -- Intro controls own acquisition even when Block has already armed its
        -- fast tracking phase. Explicit zero remains an immediate acquisition.
        local duration=if transitionSeconds>0 then transitionSeconds*14/introResponse+math.max(introSmoothing,0)/1000 else 0
        local introRateLimit=menu.turnRate and menu.turnRate(roleName)or 0
        local introMaximum=if humanized or ramp then math.rad(7200*introResponse/14)else control.maximumYawRate
        if introRateLimit>0 then introMaximum=math.min(introMaximum,math.rad(introRateLimit))end
        local transition=previousTransition
        if not transition or transition.root~=root or transition.role~=roleName or transition.target~=target
            or transition.introSeconds~=transitionSeconds or transition.introResponse~=introResponse or transition.introSmoothing~=introSmoothing
            or transition.maximum~=introMaximum or transition.humanized~=humanized or transition.ramp~=ramp then
            -- A quintic with stationary endpoints peaks at1.875times its mean
            -- rate. Give a capped turn room to curve instead of a linear clamp.
            if duration>0 and humanized then duration=math.max(duration,1.875*math.abs(delta)/math.max(introMaximum,.000001))end
            transition={root=root,role=roleName,target=target,startYaw=currentYaw,goalYaw=currentYaw+delta,elapsed=0,
                duration=duration,startVelocity=state.velocity or 0,introSeconds=transitionSeconds,introResponse=introResponse,
                introSmoothing=introSmoothing,maximum=introMaximum,previousGoal=currentYaw+delta,humanized=humanized,ramp=ramp}
            control.aimTransition=transition
        end
        if transition.elapsed<transition.duration then
            transition.elapsed=math.min(transition.duration,transition.elapsed+dt)
            local goal=transition.goalYaw+math.atan2(math.sin(desiredYaw-transition.goalYaw),math.cos(desiredYaw-transition.goalYaw))
            local goalVelocity=(goal-transition.previousGoal)/dt
            transition.goalYaw,transition.previousGoal=goal,goal
            local fraction=transition.elapsed/transition.duration
            if humanized then
                -- Quintic Hermite: match the current angular velocity when a
                -- target changes, then settle into the live target's velocity.
                -- Moving endpoints stay live; there is no post-intro lag tail.
                local t2,t3=fraction*fraction,fraction*fraction*fraction
                local t4,t5=t3*fraction,t3*fraction*fraction
                local curve=6*t5-15*t4+10*t3
                local tangent=fraction-6*t3+8*t4-3*t5
                local derivative=30*t2*(fraction-1)*(fraction-1)
                local tangentDerivative=1-18*t2+32*t3-15*t4
                local offset=goal-transition.startYaw
                local yaw=transition.startYaw+offset*curve+transition.startVelocity*transition.duration*tangent
                local change=math.atan2(math.sin(yaw-currentYaw),math.cos(yaw-currentYaw))
                local limited=math.clamp(change,-introMaximum*dt,introMaximum*dt)
                local velocity=offset*derivative/transition.duration+transition.startVelocity*tangentDerivative+goalVelocity*curve
                if limited~=change then velocity=limited/dt end
                state.velocity,state.at,state.position=velocity,now,position
                state.response,state.smoothing,state.yaw=introResponse,introSmoothing,currentYaw+limited
                transition.velocity,transition.at,transition.position,transition.yaw=velocity,now,position,state.yaw
                if math.abs(delta)>math.rad(.025)then state.turnSign=if delta>0 then 1 else -1 end
                control.refreshShiftLockAim(root)
                if control.shiftLockAimLease then control.shiftLockAimLease.role=roleName;control.shiftLockAimLease.driveAt=clock() end
                local facing=host.CFrame.lookAt(position,position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(state.yaw),0,-math.cos(state.yaw)))
                observeAimFacing(root,target,roleName,facing)
                if math.abs(limited)<1e-10 then return nil,true end
                return facing,true
            end
            -- Explicitly nonhumanized profiles keep their selected curve.
            fraction=if ramp then fraction^3 else fraction*fraction*(3-2*fraction)
            desiredYaw=transition.startYaw+(transition.goalYaw-transition.startYaw)*fraction
            delta=math.atan2(math.sin(desiredYaw-currentYaw),math.cos(desiredYaw-currentYaw))
        end
        if tracking or humanized or ramp then
            -- Preserve the native 60Hz response at every render rate,
            -- applied only to horizontal character yaw. This catches
            -- a moving goal quickly without snapping to every velocity sample
            -- or carrying spring momentum past it. Keep the user's rate cap.
            local reference=if tracking then 100 else 14
            local responseScale=rate/reference
            local maximum=if humanized or ramp then 7200*responseScale else 7200
            if snap then maximum=math.max(maximum,36000) end
            local explicitMaximum=menu.turnRate and menu.turnRate(roleName) or 0
            if explicitMaximum>0 then maximum=math.min(maximum,explicitMaximum)end
            if math.abs(delta)>math.pi-math.rad(3) and state.turnSign then delta=math.abs(delta)*state.turnSign end
            -- The intro already follows its timed curve. After it completes,
            -- track the live predicted heading tightly without a second spring
            -- tail; lower configured response and explicit turn caps still work.
            -- Intro curves select the goal, never bypass the selected response.
            -- Scale the existing turn ceiling too, so values above the default
            -- remain faster after the normalized response reaches one.
            local nativeAlpha=if humanized or ramp then math.clamp(responseScale,0,1)else math.clamp(.9*responseScale,0,1)
            -- A large heading error means the enemy outran the turn (fast
            -- circling or a dash around you): close it at full rate.
            if (tracking and math.abs(delta)>math.rad(25)) or snap then nativeAlpha=1 end
            local alpha=1-(1-nativeAlpha)^(elapsed*60)
            local change=delta*alpha
            change=math.clamp(change,-math.rad(maximum)*dt,math.rad(maximum)*dt)
            state.velocity,state.at,state.position=change/dt,now,position
            state.response,state.smoothing,state.yaw=configured,smoothing,currentYaw+change
            transition.velocity,transition.at,transition.position,transition.yaw=state.velocity,now,position,state.yaw
            if math.abs(delta)>math.rad(.025) then state.turnSign=if delta>0 then 1 else -1 end
            control.refreshShiftLockAim(root)
            if control.shiftLockAimLease then control.shiftLockAimLease.role=roleName;control.shiftLockAimLease.driveAt=clock() end
            local facing=host.CFrame.lookAt(position,position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(state.yaw),0,-math.cos(state.yaw)))
            observeAimFacing(root,target,roleName,facing)
            if math.abs(change)<.000001 then return nil,true end
            return facing,true
        end
        if math.abs(delta)>math.pi-math.rad(3) and state.turnSign then delta=math.abs(delta)*state.turnSign end
        local velocity=state.velocity
        local omega=3*rate
        local error=-delta
        local spring=(velocity+omega*error)*elapsed
        local decay=math.exp(-omega*elapsed)
        local change=delta+(error+spring)*decay
        local maximum=control.maximumYawRate
        local speed=menu.turnRate and menu.turnRate(roleName) or 0
        if speed>0 then maximum=math.min(maximum,math.rad(speed)) end
        local yawAcceleration=control.maximumYawAcceleration
        local acceleration=yawAcceleration*elapsed
        local previousVelocity=math.clamp(velocity,-maximum,maximum)
        local stopSpeed=math.max(0,math.sqrt(acceleration*acceleration+2*yawAcceleration*math.abs(delta))-acceleration)
        local requested=change/elapsed
        if requested*delta>0 then requested=math.clamp(requested,-stopSpeed,stopSpeed) end
        local limited=math.clamp(requested,math.max(-maximum,previousVelocity-acceleration),math.min(maximum,previousVelocity+acceleration))*elapsed
        -- Stop at the live heading instead of carrying spring momentum past
        -- it and correcting in the opposite direction on the next frame.
        change=if limited*delta>0 then math.sign(limited)*math.min(math.abs(limited),math.abs(delta)) else 0
        if math.abs(delta)<math.rad(.025) and math.abs(velocity)<math.rad(.25) then change=0 end
        state.velocity,state.at,state.position=change/elapsed,now,position
        state.response,state.smoothing=configured,smoothing
        state.yaw=currentYaw+change
        transition.velocity,transition.at,transition.position,transition.yaw=state.velocity,now,position,state.yaw
        if math.abs(delta)>math.rad(.025) then state.turnSign=if delta>0 then 1 else -1 end
        control.refreshShiftLockAim(root)
        if control.shiftLockAimLease then control.shiftLockAimLease.role=roleName;control.shiftLockAimLease.driveAt=clock() end
        local yaw=currentYaw+change
        local facing=host.CFrame.lookAt(position,position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw),0,-math.cos(yaw)))
        observeAimFacing(root,target,roleName,facing)
        if math.abs(change)<.00001 then state.yaw=currentYaw;return nil,true end
        return facing,true
    end
    -- Stability governor for Block and M1 aim. Orbit-chasing an enemy at close
    -- range makes the heading swing wildly, and a target almost directly above
    -- or below has no meaningful heading at all. Urgent turns (the attacker is
    -- behind you) keep full speed; small corrections near the enemy are rate
    -- limited, and a near-vertical target holds the current facing.
    control.spinGovernor=true
    local rawDirectionalFrame=control.directionalFrame
    -- Camera-behind jitter: with shift lock the game (or the camera script)
    -- turns the character toward the camera between our writes, so each frame
    -- the assist started from a heading that something else had pulled away
    -- from the one it just wrote, and the two fought. Before computing a new
    -- step, put the heading back to exactly what the assist last wrote, so the
    -- character follows one continuous path. Set control.reassertFacing=false
    -- to disable. A console line reports how hard something else is fighting.
    control.reassertFacing=true
    control.aimFightTrace=true
    control.facingFight={sum=0,max=0,samples=0,since=0}
    control.directionalFrame=function(root: any, destination: any, dt: number, response: number?, role: string?): (any, boolean?)
        role=role or 'M1 Aim'
        local trackedRole=role=='Block Aim' or role=='M1 Aim'
        if trackedRole and control.reassertFacing then
            pcall(function()
                local last=control.lastFacing
                local now=clock()
                if not last or last.root~=root or now-last.at>.12 then return end
                local current,wanted=root.CFrame.LookVector,last.frame.LookVector
                local currentYaw,wantedYaw=math.atan2(-current.X,-current.Z),math.atan2(-wanted.X,-wanted.Z)
                local deviation=math.abs(math.atan2(math.sin(currentYaw-wantedYaw),math.cos(currentYaw-wantedYaw)))
                local fight=control.facingFight
                fight.sum+=deviation;fight.samples+=1;fight.max=math.max(fight.max,deviation)
                if deviation>math.rad(1.5) then root.CFrame=host.CFrame.new(root.Position)*(last.frame-last.frame.Position) end
                if control.aimFightTrace and now-fight.since>=1 then
                    if fight.samples>0 and fight.max>math.rad(3) then
                        trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] Aim fight: %d frames, mean %.1f deg, max %.1f deg pulled away between writes',
                            fight.samples,math.deg(fight.sum/fight.samples),math.deg(fight.max)))
                    end
                    fight.sum,fight.max,fight.samples,fight.since=0,0,0,now
                end
            end)
        end
        local function finish(frame: any, handled: any): (any, boolean?)
            if frame and trackedRole then control.lastFacing={root=root,frame=frame,at=clock()} end
            return frame,handled
        end
        local facing,handled=rawDirectionalFrame(root,destination,dt,response,role)
        if not facing or not control.spinGovernor or not trackedRole then return finish(facing,handled) end
        local ok,limited=pcall(function()
            local position=root.Position
            local dx,dz=destination.X-position.X,destination.Z-position.Z
            local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
            if math.abs(destination.Y-position.Y)>distance*1.2 and distance<8 then return false end
            local from,to=root.CFrame.LookVector,facing.LookVector
            local currentYaw,newYaw=math.atan2(-from.X,-from.Z),math.atan2(-to.X,-to.Z)
            local change=math.atan2(math.sin(newYaw-currentYaw),math.cos(newYaw-currentYaw))
            if distance>=7 or math.abs(change)>=math.rad(100) then return nil end
