            local ratio=math.clamp((distance-1.5)/5.5,0,1)
            local cap=math.rad(720+1080*ratio)*math.clamp(dt,0,.1)
            if math.abs(change)<=cap then return nil end
            local yaw=currentYaw+(if change>0 then cap else -cap)
            return host.CFrame.lookAt(position,position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw),0,-math.cos(yaw)))
        end)
        if ok and limited==false then return nil,true end
        if ok and limited then return finish(limited,handled) end
        return finish(facing,handled)
    end
    local function finiteAimVector(value)
        local kind=type(value)
        return (kind=='table' or kind=='userdata' or kind=='vector') and type(value.X)=='number' and type(value.Y)=='number' and type(value.Z)=='number'
            and value.X==value.X and value.Y==value.Y and value.Z==value.Z
            and math.abs(value.X)<math.huge and math.abs(value.Y)<math.huge and math.abs(value.Z)<math.huge
    end
    control.aimPingComp=true
    function control.aimPingSeconds(): number
        local now=clock()
        if not control.aimPingAt or now-control.aimPingAt>.5 then
            control.aimPingAt=now
            local ok,value=pcall(function() return host.game:GetService('Stats').Network.ServerStatsItem['Data Ping']:GetValue() end)
            if ok and type(value)=='number' and value==value and value>=0 and value<2000 then
                control.aimPing=if control.aimPing then control.aimPing+(value-control.aimPing)*.3 else value
            end
        end
        return (control.aimPing or 0)/1000
    end
    -- Replicated AssemblyLinearVelocity reads near zero for CFrame/tween-driven
    -- movers (fast dashes), so also measure real displacement and use it when
    -- it is clearly larger than the reported velocity.
    control.measuredMotion=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    function control.measuredVelocity(part: any): any
        local reported=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local now=clock()
        local position=part.Position
        local sample=control.measuredMotion[part]
        if not sample or now<sample.at or now-sample.at>.25 then
            control.measuredMotion[part]={position=position,at=now,velocity=host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)}
            return reported
        end
        local elapsed=now-sample.at
        if elapsed>=1/240 then
            local raw=(position-sample.position)/elapsed
            sample.velocity=if raw.Magnitude<=400 then raw else host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            sample.position,sample.at=position,now
        end
        if not reported or sample.velocity.Magnitude>reported.Magnitude*1.5+1 then return sample.velocity end
        return reported
    end
    -- Observe our own native M1 tracks once per play; no render-loop animation scans.
    control.m1ContactTracks = {}
    control.m1ContactCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = 'k'})
    local function dropM1ContactTrack(track: any)
        local state = control.m1ContactTracks[track]
        control.m1ContactTracks[track] = nil
        if state and state.stopped then state.stopped:Disconnect() end
    end
    local function clearM1ContactTracks()
        if control.m1ContactAnimationConnection then control.m1ContactAnimationConnection:Disconnect();control.m1ContactAnimationConnection = nil end
        for track in control.m1ContactTracks do dropM1ContactTrack(track) end
        control.m1ContactAnimator, control.m1ContactForecast = nil, nil
    end
    function control.clearM1ContactObserver()
        clearM1ContactTracks()
        if control.m1ContactCharacterConnection then control.m1ContactCharacterConnection:Disconnect();control.m1ContactCharacterConnection = nil end
        control.m1ContactCharacter = nil
        table.clear(control.m1ContactCache)
    end
    local function observeM1ContactTrack(track: any, initial: boolean?)
        if not control.alive or control.m1ContactCharacter ~= player.Character then return end
        local animation = track and track.Animation
        local id = animation and tostring(animation.AnimationId):match('%d+')
        local catalog = menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.animationIds
        local descriptor = id and catalog and catalog[id]
        if not descriptor or (descriptor.kind ~= 'M1' and descriptor.counterKind ~= 'M1') or track.Looped then return end
        dropM1ContactTrack(track)
        local cached = control.m1ContactCache[track]
        if not cached or cached.animation ~= animation or cached.id ~= id then
            cached = {animation = animation, id = id, cues = {}}
            control.m1ContactCache[track] = cached
            if type(track.GetTimeOfKeyframe) == 'function' then
                for _, name in {'Hit', 'Impact', 'Attack', 'Damage', 'Contact'} do
                    local okay, time = pcall(track.GetTimeOfKeyframe, track, name)
                    if okay and type(time) == 'number' and time == time and time > 0 and time < math.huge then
                        table.insert(cached.cues, {time = time, name = name})
                    end
                end
                table.sort(cached.cues, function(a, b) return a.time < b.time end)
            end
        end
        local beganAt = clock()
        if initial and type(track.TimePosition) == 'number' and type(track.Speed) == 'number'
            and track.TimePosition >= 0 and track.TimePosition < math.huge and track.Speed > 0 and track.Speed < math.huge then
            beganAt -= track.TimePosition / track.Speed
        end
        local state: any = {track = track, character = player.Character, animator = control.m1ContactAnimator,
            at = beganAt, cues = cached.cues, animationId = id}
        control.m1ContactTracks[track] = state
        if track.Stopped then state.stopped = track.Stopped:Connect(function() dropM1ContactTrack(track) end) end
    end
    function control.bindM1ContactObserver()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local character = player.Character
        if character ~= control.m1ContactCharacter then
            control.clearM1ContactObserver()
            control.m1ContactCharacter = character
            if character and character.DescendantAdded then
                control.m1ContactCharacterConnection = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
                    if object:IsA('Animator') then control.bindM1ContactObserver() end
                end)
            end
        end
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
        if animator == control.m1ContactAnimator then return end
        clearM1ContactTracks()
        control.m1ContactAnimator = animator
        if not animator then return end
        if animator.AnimationPlayed then control.m1ContactAnimationConnection = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(observeM1ContactTrack) end
        local okay, playing = pcall(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks, animator)
        if okay then for _, track in playing do observeM1ContactTrack(track, true) end end
    end
    function control.m1ContactPhase(): any
        control.bindM1ContactObserver()
        control.m1ContactForecast = nil
        local latest: any = nil
        for track, state in control.m1ContactTracks do
            if state.character ~= player.Character or state.animator ~= control.m1ContactAnimator or not track.IsPlaying then
                dropM1ContactTrack(track)
            elseif not latest or state.at > latest.at or state.at == latest.at and track.TimePosition < latest.track.TimePosition then
                latest = state
            end
        end
        if not latest then return nil end
        local track = latest.track
        local position, speed, length = track.TimePosition, track.Speed, track.Length
        if type(position) ~= 'number' or position ~= position or position < 0 or position == math.huge
            or type(speed) ~= 'number' or speed ~= speed or speed <= 0 or speed == math.huge
            or type(length) ~= 'number' or length ~= length or length <= 0 or length == math.huge then return nil end
        for _, cue in latest.cues do
            if cue.time >= position and cue.time <= length then
                latest.remaining, latest.contactTime, latest.contactName = (cue.time - position) / speed, cue.time, cue.name
                latest.position, latest.speed = position, speed
                control.m1ContactForecast = latest
                return latest
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.movementLead(root,target,other,velocity,now,settings,role)
        local zero=host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        local position=other.Position
        local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z)
        local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local active=target:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or (info and (info:FindFirstChild('InDash')~=nil
            or role=='Block' and info:FindFirstChild('Dash')~=nil))
        local observedAt
        local dash=menu.dashStatus;local record=dash and dash.records and dash.records[target]
        if record and type(record.at)=='number' and record.at<=now and (record.activeUntil or 0)>now then
            active=true;observedAt=record.at
        end
        local block=menu.autoBlock;local attack=block and block.records and block.records[target]
        local phase=attack and attack.dashPhase
        if phase and not phase.endedAt and phase.tracks and type(phase.at)=='number' and phase.at<=now and now-phase.at<.4 then
            for track in phase.tracks do if track.IsPlaying~=false then active=true;observedAt=observedAt or phase.at;break end end
        end
        local motion=control.predictionMotion[target]
        if not motion or motion.target~=target or motion.root~=other or now<motion.at or now-motion.at>.25 then
            motion={target=target,root=other,at=now,position=position,velocity=velocity,acceleration=zero,dashing=false}
            control.predictionMotion[target]=motion
        elseif now>motion.at then
            local elapsed=now-motion.at
            local acceleration=(velocity-motion.velocity)*(1/elapsed)
            if acceleration.Magnitude>300 then acceleration=acceleration.Unit*300 end
            motion.acceleration=motion.acceleration+(acceleration-motion.acceleration)*(1-math.exp(-elapsed/.06))
            if velocity.Magnitude<.75 or velocity:Dot(motion.velocity)<0 then motion.acceleration=zero end
            motion.at,motion.position,motion.velocity=now,position,velocity
        end
        if active and not motion.dashing then motion.dashAt=observedAt or now end
        motion.dashing=active==true
        -- The enemy is drawn about half a round trip behind where the server
        -- has it, so lead by that too (capped) on top of the configured lead.
        local latency = if control.aimPingComp then math.min(control.aimPingSeconds()*.5,.12) else 0
        local contact = if role == 'M1' then control.m1ContactPhase() else nil
        -- Positive native keyframes replace only the fixed time estimate. Keep
        -- the existing 250 ms lead ceiling, ping cap and configured distance cap.
        local horizon = (if contact then math.min(contact.remaining, .25) else settings.leadMs*.001) + latency
        local contactHorizon = if contact then horizon else nil
        local dashRemaining=0
        if active and settings.dashEndpoint then
            local duration=math.clamp(tonumber(dash and dash.motionDuration) or .4,.05,.6)
            dashRemaining=math.max(0,duration-(now-(observedAt or motion.dashAt or now)))
            horizon=if contactHorizon then math.min(dashRemaining, contactHorizon) else dashRemaining
        end
        local lead=zero
        if velocity.Magnitude>=.75 and horizon>0 then
            local acceleration=motion.acceleration
            if active and settings.dashEndpoint and horizontal.Magnitude>=.75 then
                -- Integrate measured deceleration up to the estimated end;
                -- never extrapolate braking beyond zero into a reverse dash.
                local direction=horizontal.Unit
                local braking=math.min(0,acceleration:Dot(direction))
                local time=if braking<-.01 then math.min(horizon,horizontal.Magnitude/-braking) else horizon
                lead=direction*math.max(0,horizontal.Magnitude*time+.5*braking*time*time)+host.Vector3.new(0,velocity.Y*time,0)
            else
                local correction=acceleration*(.5*horizon*horizon)
                local correctionLimit=math.min(velocity.Magnitude*horizon*.5,settings.maxLead*.25)
                if correction.Magnitude>correctionLimit then correction=correction.Unit*correctionLimit end
                lead=velocity*horizon+correction
                if lead:Dot(velocity)<0 then lead=zero end
            end
            lead*=settings.strength
            local maximum=settings.maxLead
            if role=='Block' or role=='M1' then
                -- Facing uses X/Z: jump velocity must not consume its lateral prediction budget.
                local lateral=host.Vector3.new(lead.X,0,lead.Z)
                if lateral.Magnitude>maximum then lateral=lateral.Unit*maximum end
                local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local state=humanoid and humanoid.GetState and humanoid:GetState()
                local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
                local airborne=states and (state==states.Jumping or state==states.Freefall)
                local vertical=lead.Y
                if role=='Block' and airborne and type(world.Gravity)=='number' then
                    vertical=(velocity.Y*horizon-.5*world.Gravity*horizon*horizon)*settings.strength
                end
                lead=lateral+host.Vector3.new(0,math.clamp(vertical,-maximum,maximum),0)
            elseif lead.Magnitude>maximum then lead=lead.Unit*maximum end
            -- Prevent an inward forecast from passing through your own body;
            -- lateral forecasts can still use the full configured distance.
            local separation=host.Vector3.new(position.X-root.Position.X,0,position.Z-root.Position.Z)
            if separation.Magnitude>.001 then
                local outward=separation.Unit;local inward=lead:Dot(outward)
                local minimum=-math.max(0,separation.Magnitude-.75)
                if inward<minimum then lead+=outward*(minimum-inward) end
            end
        end
        control.aimForecasts[role]={target=target,position=position+lead,velocity=velocity,
            acceleration=motion.acceleration,lead=lead,dashing=active==true,remaining=dashRemaining,at=now,
            horizon=horizon,contact=contact,contactRemaining=contact and contact.remaining}
        if role=='Block' then control.blockAimForecast=control.aimForecasts[role] end
        return lead
    end
    function control.predictAimPoint(root,target,role,basePoint)
        control.directionalTargets[role or 'M1']=target
        local settings=control.aimPrediction[role or 'M1']
        local other=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local part=target and torso(target)
        local point=basePoint or (part and part.Position)
        if not settings or not root or not finiteAimVector(root.Position) or not other or not finiteAimVector(other.Position) or not finiteAimVector(point) then return point end
        local zero=host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        local lead=zero
        control.aimForecasts[role or 'M1']=nil
        if role=='Block' then control.blockAimForecast=nil end
        if settings.enabled and settings.leadMs>0 and settings.maxLead>0 and settings.strength>0 then
            local now=clock()
            local velocity=control.measuredVelocity(other)
            local validVelocity=finiteAimVector(velocity) and velocity.Magnitude<=400
            if not validVelocity then velocity=zero end
            local sample=control.aimMotion[target]
            if not sample or sample.root~=other or now<sample.at or now-sample.at>.25 then
                sample={root=other,at=now,position=other.Position,velocity=velocity,suppressUntil=0}
                control.aimMotion[target]=sample
            elseif now>sample.at then
                local dt=now-sample.at
                local jump=(other.Position-sample.position).Magnitude
                if jump>math.max(12,velocity.Magnitude*dt*3+3) then
                    sample.velocity=velocity;sample.suppressUntil=now+.08
                elseif velocity.Magnitude<.75 or velocity:Dot(sample.velocity)<0 then
                    -- Real stops and reversals respond immediately. Only
                    -- same-direction replication noise needs stabilization.
                    sample.velocity=velocity
                else
                    local alpha=1-math.exp(-dt/.03)
                    sample.velocity=sample.velocity+(velocity-sample.velocity)*alpha
                end
                sample.at,sample.position=now,other.Position
            end
            if not validVelocity then sample.velocity=zero;sample.suppressUntil=now+.08 end
            if now>=sample.suppressUntil then
                local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
                local dash=menu.dashStatus and menu.dashStatus.records and menu.dashStatus.records[target]
                local attack=menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.records and menu.autoBlock.records[target]
                local phase=attack and attack.dashPhase
                local dashing=target:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or info and (info:FindFirstChild('InDash') or role=='Block' and info:FindFirstChild('Dash'))
                    or dash and (dash.activeUntil or 0)>now or phase and not phase.endedAt and now-(phase.at or -math.huge)<.4
                -- Every assist uses the same stabilized ordinary-motion sample.
                -- Real stops/reversals already reset it above; native dashes
                -- retain their immediate measured endpoint response.
                local measured=if dashing then velocity else sample.velocity
                lead=control.movementLead(root,target,other,measured,now,settings,role or 'M1')
            else control.predictionMotion[target]=nil;control.aimForecasts[role or 'M1']=nil;control.blockAimForecast=nil end
            local maximum=settings.maxLead
            if role~='Block' and (role or 'M1')~='M1' and lead.Magnitude>maximum then lead=if maximum>0 then lead.Unit*maximum else zero end
        end
        local offset=zero
        if role=='Block' then
            local forecast=control.blockAimForecast
            if forecast and control.blockAimSession and control.blockAimSession.tracking then
                local now=clock()
                local state=control.blockLeadState
                local rawLead=lead
                local evidenceNow=menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.heldThreat
                local token=evidenceNow and evidenceNow.token
                local fresh=state and state.target==target and state.other==other and state.root==root
                    and now>=state.at and now-state.at<=.1 and (root.Position-state.position).Magnitude<=6
                if not fresh then state={root=root,other=other,target=target,at=now,position=root.Position,lead=zero,token=token,tokenAt=now} end
                if token~=state.token then state.token,state.tokenAt,state.committed=token,now,nil end
                local prior=state.lead
                local goal=lead
                -- A forecast that points the other way is only believed once it has lasted a moment: single-frame velocity noise would
                -- otherwise swing the heading left, right, left.
                local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(goal.X,0,goal.Z)
                local previous=host.Vector3.new(prior.X,0,prior.Z)
                if horizontal.Magnitude>=.3 and previous.Magnitude>=.3 and horizontal:Dot(previous)<0 then
                    state.flipAt=state.flipAt or now
                    if now-state.flipAt<control.blockLeadFlipHold then goal=prior end
                else state.flipAt=nil end
                if token and control.blockLastMoment then
                    if now-state.tokenAt<control.blockCommitDelay then goal=zero
                    else
                        if not state.committed then state.committed=goal end
                        goal=state.committed
                    end
                end
                local tau=if token and control.blockLastMoment then .02 else .09
                lead=prior+(goal-prior)*(1-math.exp(-math.max(0,now-state.at)/tau))
                local lateral=host.Vector3.new(lead.X,0,lead.Z)
                if lateral.Magnitude>settings.maxLead then lateral=lateral.Unit*settings.maxLead end
                lead=lateral+host.Vector3.new(0,math.clamp(lead.Y,-settings.maxLead,settings.maxLead),0)
                local separation=host.Vector3.new(other.Position.X-root.Position.X,0,other.Position.Z-root.Position.Z)
                if separation.Magnitude>.001 then
                    local outward=separation.Unit
                    local minimum=-math.max(0,separation.Magnitude-.75)
                    local inward=lead:Dot(outward)
                    if inward<minimum then lead+=outward*(minimum-inward) end
                end
                state.at,state.position,state.lead=now,root.Position,lead
                control.blockLeadState=state
                forecast.rawLead,forecast.lead=rawLead,lead
            else control.blockLeadState=nil end
        end
        if settings.x~=0 or settings.y~=0 or settings.z~=0 then
            local camera=world.CurrentCamera
            local frame=camera and camera.CFrame or root.CFrame
            local look=frame and frame.LookVector
            local forward=if finiteAimVector(look) then host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z) else host.Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
            if forward.Magnitude<.001 then
                local right=frame and frame.RightVector
                forward=if finiteAimVector(right) then host.Vector3.new(right.Z,0,-right.X) else host.Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
            end
            if forward.Magnitude<.001 then forward=host.Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
            forward=forward.Unit
            local right=host.Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
            offset=right*settings.x+host.Vector3.new(0,settings.y,0)+forward*settings.z
        end
        -- Your own movement keys: the aim point is moved along (positive) or against (negative) the direction you are steering.
        local moveShift=zero
        if control.aimMoveLead~=0 then
            local own=player.Character
            local ownHumanoid=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            local direction=ownHumanoid and ownHumanoid.MoveDirection
            if direction and finiteAimVector(direction) and direction.Magnitude>.05 then
                moveShift=host.Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)*control.aimMoveLead
            end
        end
        local predicted=point+lead+offset+moveShift
        local forecast=control.aimForecasts[role or 'M1']
        if forecast then forecast.position=predicted end
        return predicted
    end
    function control.directionalTargetPoint(root,target,role)
        control.directionalTargets[role or 'M1']=target
        local point=torso(target).Position
        local other=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if other then
            -- Animation sway is not enemy movement. Use the rig's root for
            -- horizontal aim while preserving the existing vertical aim point.
            point=host.Vector3.new(other.Position.X,point.Y,other.Position.Z)
        end
        return control.predictAimPoint(root,target,role or 'M1',point)
    end
    local function cacheBlockAimHit(key,character,target,at)
        if not character or not target or type(at)~='number' or at~=at or at>clock() then return end
        local prior=control[key]
        if not prior or prior.character~=character or at>prior.at or (at==prior.at and target~=prior.target) then
            control[key]={character=character,target=target,at=at}
        end
    end
    function control.captureBlockAimHits()
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if tracker~=control.blockRecentTracker then
            for _,connection in control.blockRecentConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
            table.clear(control.blockRecentConnections)
            control.blockRecentTracker=tracker
            local function capture(target,at,_source,_inferred,record)
                if not control.alive or type(at)~='number' or at~=at or at>clock()
                    or not record or record.accepted~=true or record.character~=player.Character or record.target~=target then return end
                cacheBlockAimHit('blockAimLastOutgoing',record.character,target,at)
            end
            if tracker then
                for _,method in {'onLastHit','onDamageHit'} do
                    if type(tracker[method])=='function' then
                        local ok,connection=pcall(tracker[method],capture)
                        if ok and connection then table.insert(control.blockRecentConnections,connection) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not tracker then return end
        local own=player.Character
        local outgoing=tracker.lastHitRecord
        if outgoing and outgoing.character==own then
            cacheBlockAimHit('blockAimLastOutgoing',own,outgoing.target,outgoing.at)
        elseif not outgoing then
            cacheBlockAimHit('blockAimLastOutgoing',own,tracker.lastHitTarget,tracker.lastHitAt)
        end
        local incoming=tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        if incoming and incoming.character==own then
            cacheBlockAimHit('blockAimLastIncoming',own,incoming.target,incoming.at)
        end
    end
    function control.blockAimRecentTarget(record: any,character: any): any
        if not record or record.character~=character or control.blockAimHitWindow<=0 then return nil end
        local age=clock()-record.at
        return if age>=0 and age<=control.blockAimHitWindow then record.target else nil
    end
    function control.blockBodySpan(model)
        local root=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then return nil end
        local bottom,top=root.Position.Y,root.Position.Y
        -- Core body only: accessories and expanded hitboxes must not enlarge
        -- the acquisition zone. A jumping body's feet can still be in the box
        -- or cursor FOV even when its root/torso center has left it.
        for _,name in {'Torso','UpperTorso','LowerTorso','Head','Left Leg','Right Leg','LeftLowerLeg','RightLowerLeg','LeftFoot','RightFoot'} do
            local part=model:FindFirstChild(name)
            if part and part.Size and part.Position then
                local size,frame=part.Size,part.CFrame
                local half=if frame and frame.UpVector and frame.RightVector then
                    (math.abs(frame.RightVector.Y)*size.X+math.abs(frame.UpVector.Y)*size.Y+math.abs(frame.LookVector.Y)*size.Z)*.5 else size.Y*.5
                bottom,top=math.min(bottom,part.Position.Y-half),math.max(top,part.Position.Y+half)
            end
        end
        return bottom,top
    end
    function control.blockBodyInFov(model)
        local lock,camera=menu.autoLock,world.CurrentCamera
        local root=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root or not lock or not lock.fovGeometry or not camera or not camera.WorldToViewportPoint then return false end
        local geometry=lock.fovGeometry(camera)
        if not geometry then return false end
        local bottom,top=control.blockBodySpan(model)
        local a=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(host.Vector3.new(root.Position.X,bottom,root.Position.Z))
        local b=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(host.Vector3.new(root.Position.X,top,root.Position.Z))
        if not finiteAimVector(a) or not finiteAimVector(b) or a.Z<=0 or b.Z<=0 then return false end
        local dx,dy=b.X-a.X,b.Y-a.Y
        local low,high=0,1
        local function clip(origin: number,delta: number,minimum: number,maximum: number)
            if math.abs(delta)<.000001 then return origin>=minimum and origin<=maximum end
            local first,last=(minimum-origin)/delta,(maximum-origin)/delta
            if first>last then first,last=last,first end
            low,high=math.max(low,first),math.min(high,last)
            return low<=high
        end
        if not clip(a.X,dx,0,camera.ViewportSize.X) or not clip(a.Y,dy,0,camera.ViewportSize.Y) then return false end
        local center=geometry.center
        if geometry.shape=='Square' or geometry.shape=='Rectangle' then
            return clip(a.X,dx,center.X-geometry.width*.5,center.X+geometry.width*.5)
                and clip(a.Y,dy,center.Y-geometry.height*.5,center.Y+geometry.height*.5)
        end
        local length=dx*dx+dy*dy
        local t=if length>.000001 then math.clamp(((center.X-a.X)*dx+(center.Y-a.Y)*dy)/length,low,high) else low
        return (a.X+dx*t-center.X)^2+(a.Y+dy*t-center.Y)^2<=geometry.radius^2
    end
    -- The box follows the facing you see on screen (the render frame), not the one-frame-old physics frame.
    local function visibleFacing(root: any): (any,any)
        local okay,frame=pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame,root)
        if okay and frame then return frame.LookVector,frame.Position end
        return root.CFrame.LookVector,root.Position
    end
    function control.blockAimBoxContains(root: any,point: any): boolean
        if not control.blockAimBoxEnabled then return true end
        if not root or not root.CFrame or not point or control.blockAimBoxX<=0 or control.blockAimBoxZ<=0 then return false end
        local look,origin=visibleFacing(root)
        if not look or not origin then return false end
        local length=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)
        if length<.0001 or length~=length then return false end
        local fx,fz=look.X/length,look.Z/length
        local area=control.getAimArea('Block')
        local dx,dz=point.X-origin.X,point.Z-origin.Z
        local height=AssistGeometry.height(control.blockAimBoxY)
        if point.Y~=point.Y or math.abs(point.Y-origin.Y-area.oy)>height*.5 then return false end
        local side,forward=-fz*dx+fx*dz-area.ox,fx*dx+fz*dz-area.oz
        return side==side and forward==forward and control.areaShapeContains(area,side,forward)
    end
    function control.aimAreaReach(role)
        local area=control.getAimArea(role)
        local horizontal=math.sqrt((math.abs(area.ox)+area.x*.5)^2+(math.abs(area.oz+area.z*.5)+area.z*.5)^2)
        local vertical=math.abs(area.oy)+AssistGeometry.height(area.y)*.5
        return math.sqrt(horizontal^2+vertical^2),horizontal
    end
    function control.aimRangeAllows(role,root,model,range,retained)
        local other=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local area=control.getAimArea(role)
        if not root or not other or not area then return false end
        local bottom,top
        if not retained and area.mode~='360°' then bottom,top=control.blockBodySpan(model) end
        return AssistGeometry.withinRange(root.Position,other.Position,range,area.y,if retained or area.mode=='360°' then 0 else area.oy,bottom,top)
    end
    function control.aimAreaAllowsTarget(role,model,root,retained)
        local area=control.getAimArea(role)
        local other=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not area or not root or not root.CFrame or not other then return false end
        if area.mode=='360°' then return AssistGeometry.verticalOverlap(root.Position,other.Position,area.y,0) end
        local bottom,top=control.blockBodySpan(model)
        if not AssistGeometry.verticalOverlap(root.Position,other.Position,area.y,area.oy,bottom,top) then return false end
        if area.x<=0 or area.z<=0 then return false end
        local delta=other.Position-root.Position
        if retained then local _,radius=control.aimAreaReach(role);return delta.X^2+delta.Z^2<=radius^2 end
        if control.closeAim and delta.X^2+delta.Z^2<=control.closeAimRange^2 then return true end
        local look,origin=visibleFacing(root);local length=math.sqrt(look.X^2+look.Z^2)
        if length<.0001 then return false end
        delta=other.Position-origin
        local fx,fz=look.X/length,look.Z/length
        local side,forward=-fz*delta.X+fx*delta.Z-area.ox,fx*delta.X+fz*delta.Z-area.oz
        return control.areaShapeContains(area,side,forward)
    end
    function control.blockAimAllowsTarget(model: any,character: any,root: any,retained: boolean?): boolean
        local targetRoot=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=model and model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local dead=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        if not targetRoot or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or control.blockAimDeadTargets[model]
            or model:GetAttribute('Dead')==true or info and info:FindFirstChild('Dead')
            or dead and humanoid.GetState and humanoid:GetState()==dead then return false end
        if not control.aimAreaAllowsTarget('Block',model,root,retained) then return false end
        if not control.blockAimRecentOnly then return true end
        local sources=control.blockAimHitSources
        local outgoing=control.blockAimRecentTarget(control.blockAimLastOutgoing,character)
        local incoming=control.blockAimRecentTarget(control.blockAimLastIncoming,character)
        return ((sources=='By me' or sources=='Both') and model==outgoing)
            or ((sources=='By enemy' or sources=='Both') and model==incoming)
    end
    function control.refreshBlockAimBox(role)
        role=role or 'Block'
        local area=control.getAimArea(role,true);local visual=control.areaVisuals[role]
        if not area then return end
        if not visual and not area.visible then return end
        local character=player.Character;local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local active=control.alive and area.visible and area.mode~='360°'
            and area.x>0 and area.z>0 and root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
        if not active then
            if visual then visual.folder:Destroy();control.areaVisuals[role]=nil end
            if role=='Block' then control.blockAimBoxFolder,control.blockAimBoxPart,control.blockAimBoxFill=nil,nil,nil end
            return
        end
        local look,origin=visibleFacing(root)
        local length=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)
        if length<.0001 or length~=length then return end
        if not host.Instance or not host.Color3 then return end
        if visual and visual.shape~=area.mode then
            visual.folder:Destroy();control.areaVisuals[role]=nil;visual=nil
            if role=='Block' then control.blockAimBoxFolder,control.blockAimBoxPart,control.blockAimBoxFill=nil,nil,nil end
        end
        if area.mode=='Half Dome' then
            local segmentCount=32
            if not visual then
                local folder=host.Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='Shenaniganism'..role..'FacingDome'
                local segments={}
                for index=1,segmentCount+1 do
                    local segment=host.Instance.new('Part');segment.Name='DomeEdge'
                    segment.Anchored,segment.CanCollide,segment.CanTouch,segment.CanQuery,segment.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
                    segment.Material,segment.Color,segment.Transparency=host.Enum.Material.Neon,host.Color3.fromRGB(175,175,175),.25
                    segment.Size=host.Vector3.new(.12,.12,1);segment.Parent=folder;segments[index]=segment
                end
                folder.Parent=world
                visual={folder=folder,shape='Half Dome',segments=segments};control.areaVisuals[role]=visual
            end
            local forwardDirection=host.Vector3.new(look.X/length,0,look.Z/length)
            local rightDirection=host.Vector3.new(-forwardDirection.Z,0,forwardDirection.X)
            local power=2+(100-(area.curve or 100))*.38
            local exponent=2/power
            local function pointAt(index)
                local angle=math.pi*(index-1)/segmentCount
                local cosine,sine=math.cos(angle),math.sin(angle)
                local side=area.x*.5*(if cosine<0 then -1 else 1)*math.abs(cosine)^exponent
                local forwardDistance=area.z*math.abs(sine)^exponent
                return origin+forwardDirection*(forwardDistance+area.oz)+rightDirection*(side+area.ox)+host.Vector3.new(0,area.oy,0)
            end
            local previous=pointAt(1)
            for index=1,segmentCount do
                local following=pointAt(index+1)
                local segment=visual.segments[index]
                local gap=(following-previous).Magnitude
                segment.Size=host.Vector3.new(.12,.12,math.max(gap,.05))
                segment.CFrame=host.CFrame.lookAt((previous+following)*.5,following)
                previous=following
            end
            -- the flat edge across the back of the half dome
            local first,last=pointAt(1),pointAt(segmentCount+1)
            local base=visual.segments[segmentCount+1]
            base.Size=host.Vector3.new(.12,.12,math.max((last-first).Magnitude,.05))
            base.CFrame=host.CFrame.lookAt((first+last)*.5,last)
            return
        end
        if not visual then
            local folder=host.Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='Shenaniganism'..role..'FacingBox'
            local part=host.Instance.new('Part');part.Name='CharacterFacingBounds'
            part.Anchored,part.CanCollide,part.CanTouch,part.CanQuery,part.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
            part.Transparency=1;part.Parent=folder
            local fill=host.Instance.new('BoxHandleAdornment');fill.Name='FaintGrayFill'
            fill.Adornee,fill.Color3,fill.Transparency,fill.AlwaysOnTop,fill.ZIndex=part,host.Color3.fromRGB(128,128,128),.96,false,1
            local outline=host.Instance.new('SelectionBox');outline.Name='FacingOutline'
            outline.Adornee,outline.Color3,outline.LineThickness=part,host.Color3.fromRGB(175,175,175),.025
            outline.Transparency,outline.SurfaceTransparency,outline.Parent=.25,1,part
            fill.Parent=part;folder.Parent=world
            visual={folder=folder,part=part,fill=fill,shape='Facing Box'};control.areaVisuals[role]=visual
            if role=='Block' then control.blockAimBoxFolder,control.blockAimBoxPart,control.blockAimBoxFill=folder,part,fill end
        end
        local forward=host.Vector3.new(look.X/length,0,look.Z/length)
        local right=host.Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
        local center=origin+forward*(area.z*.5+area.oz)+right*area.ox+host.Vector3.new(0,area.oy,0)
        local size=host.Vector3.new(area.x,AssistGeometry.height(area.y),area.z)
        visual.part.CFrame=host.CFrame.lookAt(center,center+forward)
        visual.part.Size,visual.fill.Size=size,size
    end
    function control.refreshAimAreas()
        for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do control.refreshBlockAimBox(role) end
    end
    -- Share Auto Block's enemy-frame detection with Block Assist: the enemy whose
    -- attack animation or markers Auto Block has proven (nearest to contact) is
    -- the one Block Assist turns to, even before the guard is up. Auto Block
    -- is the part that already reads those frames well. Set false to disable.
    control.blockAimFrames=true
    function control.frameThreat(): any
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if not control.blockAimFrames or not block or not block.enabled or type(block.findThreat)~='function' then return nil end
        local now=clock()
        if control.frameThreatAt and now-control.frameThreatAt<1/120 then return control.frameThreatValue end
        control.frameThreatAt=now
        local ok,target=pcall(block.findThreat)
        local model=nil
        if ok and (host.typeof or typeof)(target)=='Instance' and target:IsA('Model') and target~=player.Character
            and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then model=target end
        control.frameThreatValue=model
        return model
    end
    control.blockAfterM1=true
    function control.setBlockAfterM1(value: boolean) control.blockAfterM1=value==true end
    -- The swing's own InSkill marker lasts through the M1 animation. Once the M1 input is released and you hold Block again, the marker is
    -- only recovery, so it must not keep Block Assist off. A real skill (pending cast or skill facing) still does.
    function control.m1TailAllowsBlock(character: any): boolean
        if not control.blockAfterM1 or control.userM1Held() then return false end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and ((lock.currentPendingSkill and lock.currentPendingSkill()) or lock.skillFacing) then return false end
        local stamp=tonumber(character:GetAttribute('LastM1'))
        return stamp~=nil and stamp>0 and host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp<1.5
    end
    function control.blockDirectionalActive(): boolean
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return false end
        local retained=control.getRetainedBlockTarget()
        if control.blockAimDeadCharacter==player.Character or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false end
        if not control.priorityAllows('Block') then return false end
        local dashTarget=blockDashTarget()
        if nativeDashActive(player.Character) and not dashTarget then return false end
        if effectiveLockActive() and not dashTarget then return false end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then return false end
        local character=player.Character;local block=menu.autoBlock
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local manual=block and block.manualBlockHeld and block.manualBlockHeld()==true
        local pending=menu.autoPunish and menu.autoPunish.pending
        local returning=manual and pending and pending.character==character and pending.phase=='Executing'
            and pending.external and pending.external.owner==block
        local automatic=block and block.held~=nil and not manual
        local reference=automatic and block.referenceSettings and block.referenceSettings.lookAt and block.referenceAimTarget~=nil
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or not (control.blockAimEnabled or reference) or control.blockAimSpeed<=0
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or not info or not (retained or dashTarget or info:FindFirstChild('Block') or manual or automatic or control.frameThreat())
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand
            or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')) or 0)>0 or character:GetAttribute('TrueStun')==true then return false end
        local m1Tail=manual and control.m1TailAllowsBlock(character)
        for _,name in {'TrueStun','Knockback','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','InSkill','DomainClash'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) and not (name=='InSkill' and (returning or m1Tail)) then return false end
        end
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter;local hit=tracker and tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        local age=hit and clock()-hit.at or math.huge
        local recent=hit and hit.character==character and age>=0 and age<=(tracker.hitWindow or 2)
        return retained~=nil or dashTarget~=nil or reference or (control.blockAimManual and manual) or (control.blockAimAutomatic and (automatic or (control.frameThreat()~=nil and not manual)))
            or (control.blockAimAfterHit and automatic and recent) or false
    end
    function control.automaticAimContext(): any
        local cameraOwner=menu.autoLock
        if cameraOwner and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive() then return nil end
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return nil end
        if control.priorityInput() then return nil end
        if nativeDashActive(player.Character) then return nil end
        if effectiveLockActive() then return nil end
        local punish=menu.autoPunish;local pending=punish and punish.pending
        local counter=menu.nativeCounter;local phase=counter and counter.directionalPhase
        if not pending and not phase then return nil end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info
            or character:GetAttribute('TrueStun')==true then return nil end
        for _,name in {'Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Downed','TrueStun','Knockback','DomainClash'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0) or info:FindFirstChild(name) then return nil end
        end
        local context
        if control.punishAimEnabled and control.punishAimSpeed>0 and punish and punish.alive and punish.enabled
            and pending and pending~=control.manualCancelledPunish and pending.character==character and pending.phase=='Executing' then
            context={target=pending.target,range=math.min(punish.range,control.punishAimRange),speed=control.punishAimSpeed,kind='Punish'}
        else
            if control.counterAimEnabled and control.counterAimSpeed>0 and counter and counter.alive and counter.enabled
                and phase and phase~=control.manualCancelledCounter and phase.character==character and phase.kit==character:GetAttribute('Moveset') then
                local age=clock()-phase.at
                local marker=info:FindFirstChild('Counter') or info:FindFirstChild('TrueCounter') or info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
                if marker and age<=.4 and not phase.marker then phase.marker=marker end
                if age>=0 and age<=3 and ((phase.marker and phase.marker.Parent==info) or (not phase.marker and age<=.4)) then
                    context={target=phase.target,range=math.min(counter.range,control.counterAimRange),speed=control.counterAimSpeed,kind='Counter'}
                else counter.directionalPhase=nil end
            end
        end
        local root=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        if not context or not root or not folder or not validTarget(context.target,character,folder,true)
            or not control.aimAreaAllowsTarget(context.kind,context.target,root,control.areaTargets[context.kind]==context.target)
            or not control.aimRangeAllows(context.kind,root,context.target,context.range or 0) then return nil end
        if not menu.targetMethods.isNormal(control.aimPriorities[context.kind])then
            -- Counter/punish already chose an actual combat target. Never aim
            -- their active action at an unrelated bystander instead.
            if selectTarget(character,root,context.range,'All targets',nil,context.kind)~=context.target then return nil end
        end
        control.areaTargets[context.kind]=context.target
        context.root=root;return context
    end
    function control.automaticDirectionalActive(): boolean
        return control.automaticAimContext()~=nil
    end
    function control.stepAutomaticAim(dt: number): boolean
        if dashAssistActive()and not control.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget('Skill')then return control.stepDashAim(dt) end
        if control.yieldForLock() then return false end
        local context=control.automaticAimContext()
        if not context then
            if control.automaticAimKind then clearAutomaticAim(control.automaticAimKind) end
            return false
        end
        local facing,handled=control.directionalFrame(context.root,control.directionalTargetPoint(context.root,context.target,context.kind),dt,context.speed,context.kind..' Aim')
        if facing then context.root.CFrame=facing;control.automaticAimCount=(control.automaticAimCount or 0)+1 end
        control.automaticAimTarget=context.target;control.automaticAimKind=context.kind
        return handled==true
    end
    function control.stepBlockAim(dt: number)
        local circling=menu.frontDash
        if circling and circling.circlingActive and circling.circlingActive() then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return false end
        local dodging=menu.targetJumpDash
        if dodging and dodging.dodgeActive and dodging.dodgeActive() then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return false end
        if dashAssistActive() or nativeDashActive(player.Character) then
            -- A dash is never turned by Block aim: it neither faces, circles nor re-aims while you dash.
            if control.blockAimPauseOnDash then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return false end
            if dashAssistActive() then return control.stepDashAim(dt) end
        end
        if control.yieldForLock() then return false end
        if not control.blockDirectionalActive() then control.blockLatchState=nil;control.blockStabState=nil;control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return end
        local character=player.Character;local root=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return end
        local dashTarget=blockDashTarget()
        local retained=control.getRetainedBlockTarget()
        local automatic=menu.autoBlock
        local nativeDashGuard=automatic and automatic.held and automatic.heldThreat and automatic.heldThreat.kind=='Dash'
        local physicalBlock=automatic and automatic.manualBlockHeld and automatic.manualBlockHeld()==true
        if retained and not physicalBlock and not (automatic and automatic.held) and not dashTarget then
            local point=control.directionalTargetPoint(root,retained,'Block')
            local facing,handled=control.directionalFrame(root,point,dt,control.blockAimSpeed,'Block Aim')
            if facing then if root.CFrame~=facing then root.CFrame=facing end;control.blockAimCount=(control.blockAimCount or 0)+1 end
            control.blockAimTarget=if handled then retained else nil
            return handled==true
        end
        if control.blockAimDirection=='Cursor' and not control.blockAimBoxEnabled and not dashTarget and not nativeDashGuard then
            local point=control.blockCursorPoint(root)
            if not point then control.blockAimTarget=nil;return false end
            local facing,handled=control.directionalFrame(root,point,dt,control.blockAimSpeed,'Block Aim')
            if facing then if root.CFrame~=facing then root.CFrame=facing end;control.blockAimCount=(control.blockAimCount or 0)+1 end
            control.blockAimTarget=nil;return handled==true
        end
        control.captureBlockAimHits()
        if #control.aimPriorities.Block==0 then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return end
        local block=menu.autoBlock;local evidence=block and block.heldThreat
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter;local incoming=tracker and tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        local recent=incoming and incoming.character==character and clock()-incoming.at>=0
            and clock()-incoming.at<=(tracker.hitWindow or 2)
        local manual=block and block.manualBlockHeld and block.manualBlockHeld()==true
        local source=if not manual then evidence and evidence.record and evidence.record.model or block and modelFrom(block.lastTarget) else nil
        -- Prefer the enemy Auto Block's frame detection says is attacking right now.
        if not manual then
            local framed=control.frameThreat()
            if framed then source=framed end
        end
        local incomingDashTarget
        if nativeDashGuard and not manual and evidence.record and evidence.record.dashPhase==evidence.token
            and block.dashThreat and block.dashThreat(evidence.record,root)then incomingDashTarget=evidence.record.model end
        local returning=menu.autoPunish and menu.autoPunish.pending
        local returnTarget=if manual and returning and returning.character==character and returning.phase=='Executing'
            and returning.external and returning.external.owner==block then returning.target else nil
        if returnTarget then source=returnTarget end
        -- The box defines its own reach, including its outer corners. Reusing
        -- the spherical aim range here silently cut away much of the preview.
        local boxRange,boxRadius=control.aimAreaReach('Block')
        local range=if control.blockAimBoxEnabled then boxRange
            else control.blockAimRange
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        local now=clock();local previousSession=control.blockAimSession;local session=previousSession
        if session and (session.root~=root or now<session.at) then session=nil end
        local remembered=control.blockAimMemory
        if remembered and (remembered.character~=character or remembered.root~=root or not remembered.target or not remembered.target.Parent) then
            clearBlockMemory();remembered=nil
        end
        -- These tables exist for this synchronous decision pass only. Body
        -- bounds/facing eligibility have no yield or transform writer before
        -- the final directionalFrame call. Retained and ordinary geometry are
        -- separate; recent-hit-only checks keep their original clock reads.
        local ordinaryAllowed,retainedAllowed={},{}
        local function blockAllows(model,retained)
            if model==nil or control.blockAimRecentOnly then return control.blockAimAllowsTarget(model,character,root,retained)end
            local cache=if retained then retainedAllowed else ordinaryAllowed
            local result=cache[model]
            if result==nil then result=control.blockAimAllowsTarget(model,character,root,retained);cache[model]=result end
            return result
        end
        local function computeEligible(model)
            local defensiveDash=model~=nil and model==incomingDashTarget
            local established=aimSticky('Block') and ((session and session.target==model) or (remembered and remembered.target==model))
            if not (model and folder and validTarget(model,character,folder,true,model==dashTarget or established or defensiveDash)
                and (model==dashTarget or defensiveDash or blockAllows(model,established or session and session.target==model))) then return false end
            local delta=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart').Position-root.Position
            if model==dashTarget or defensiveDash then return control.aimRangeAllows('Block',root,model,control.maximumRange,true) end
            return if control.blockAimBoxEnabled then delta.X^2+delta.Z^2<=boxRadius^2
                else control.aimRangeAllows('Block',root,model,range)
        end
        local eligibleResults={}
        local eligibleSession,eligibleTarget=session,session and session.target
        local function eligible(model)
            if model==nil or control.blockAimRecentOnly then return computeEligible(model)end
            local target=session and session.target
            if session~=eligibleSession or target~=eligibleTarget then
                table.clear(eligibleResults);eligibleSession,eligibleTarget=session,target
            end
            local result=eligibleResults[model]
            if result==nil then result=computeEligible(model);eligibleResults[model]=result end
            return result
        end
        -- An accepted automatic block already identified the incoming attacker.
        -- Manual holds still resume the remembered target between presses.
        local stickyTarget=aimSticky('Block') and not eligible(source) and ((session and session.target) or (remembered and remembered.target))
        if stickyTarget and not eligible(stickyTarget) then stickyTarget=nil end
        -- A recent outgoing-hit outline can seed memory before the first block.
        -- Read the existing outline timestamps only while blocking; no idle scan.
        local visuals=menu.visuals
        if not stickyTarget and not eligible(source) and aimSticky('Block') and #control.aimPriorities.Block>0 and visuals and visuals.hitOutlineEnabled then
            local newest=-math.huge
            for target,at in visuals.hitOutlineTimes or {} do
                if type(at)=='number' and at<=now and at>newest
                    and (visuals.hitOutlineUntilDeath or now-at<(visuals.hitOutlineDuration or 10)) and eligible(target) then
                    newest=at;stickyTarget=target
                end
            end
        end
        local stickySource=false
        if stickyTarget and eligible(stickyTarget) then
            local params=control.blockAimRayParams
            if not params then params=host.RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;control.blockAimRayParams=params end
            local excluded={character};local effects=world:FindFirstChild('Effects');if effects then table.insert(excluded,effects) end
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances=excluded
            local origin=root.Position+host.Vector3.new(0,1,0);local direction=torso(stickyTarget).Position-origin
            local lock=menu.autoLock
            local hit=if lock and lock.lockThroughWalls then nil
                elseif menu.visibilityRaycast then menu.visibilityRaycast(origin,direction,params)else world:Raycast(origin,direction,params)
            if not hit or hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(stickyTarget) then source=stickyTarget;stickySource=true else session=nil end
        else session=nil end
        if not eligible(source) then source=nil end
        for _,candidate in {recent and incoming.target or false,
            control.blockAimRecentOnly and control.blockAimRecentTarget(control.blockAimLastIncoming,character) or false,
            control.blockAimRecentOnly and control.blockAimRecentTarget(control.blockAimLastOutgoing,character) or false,
            menu.environment and modelFrom(menu.environment.LockedTarget) or false} do
            if not source and candidate and eligible(candidate) then source=candidate end
        end
        if (manual or not eligible(source)) and not stickySource and not session and not menu.targetMethods.isNormal(control.aimPriorities.Block)then source=nil end
        if not dashTarget and not incomingDashTarget and not stickySource and not session and menu.targetMethods.has(control.aimPriorities.Block,'Closest to cursor') then
            source=nil
        end
        if dashTarget then
            if not eligible(dashTarget) then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return end
            source=dashTarget
        elseif returnTarget then
            if not eligible(returnTarget) then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return end
            source=returnTarget
        end
        if not source then
            source=selectTarget(character,root,range,'All targets',function(model) return blockAllows(model) end,'Block')
        end
        if control.aimTargetSwitchModes.Block~='Default' and not dashTarget and not returnTarget and not incomingDashTarget then
            local function switchEligible(model)
                if not eligible(model) then return false end
                if model==source then return true end
                local lock=menu.autoLock
                if lock and lock.lockThroughWalls then return true end
                local params=host.RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local excluded={character};local effects=world:FindFirstChild('Effects');if effects then table.insert(excluded,effects)end
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances=excluded
                local origin=root.Position+host.Vector3.new(0,1,0);local direction=torso(model).Position-origin
                local hit=if menu.visibilityRaycast then menu.visibilityRaycast(origin,direction,params)else world:Raycast(origin,direction,params)
                return not hit or hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model)
            end
            source=control.applyAimTargetSwitch('Block',source,switchEligible,character,root)
        end
        -- Cursor priority: the enemy your cursor ray is actually over wins over
        -- automatic picks, so several enemies cannot pull the aim away from it.
        local cursorTarget
        local attackerNow=if control.blockAimAttackerPriority and evidence and evidence.record then evidence.record.model else nil
        if attackerNow and not dashTarget and not returnTarget and not incomingDashTarget and eligible(attackerNow) then
            -- A proven incoming attacker outranks the cursor while its attack is live.
            source=attackerNow;cursorTarget=attackerNow
        elseif control.blockAimCursorPriority and not dashTarget and not returnTarget and not incomingDashTarget then
            local okay,pointed=pcall(function()
                local camera=world.CurrentCamera
                if not camera or not folder then return nil end
                local context=menu.targetMethods.screenContext(folder:GetChildren(),{camera=camera,cursorHit=true,eligible=eligible})
                return if type(context.cursorHitTarget)=='function' then context.cursorHitTarget() else nil
            end)
            if okay and pointed and pointed~=character and eligible(pointed) then cursorTarget=pointed;source=pointed end
        end
        -- Hysteresis: with several enemies around, the closest/best one can flip
        -- every few frames and the character spins between them. Hold the
        -- current Block target (0.6 s, or 0.3 s for a proven incoming attacker)
        -- unless the cursor is pointing at the new one.
        local lastSource=control.blockSourceMemory
        if source and lastSource and lastSource.target~=source and cursorTarget~=source and eligible(lastSource.target)
            and not dashTarget and not returnTarget then
            local proven=evidence and evidence.record and evidence.record.model==source
            if now-lastSource.at<(if proven then .3 else .6) then source=lastSource.target end
        end
        if source and (not lastSource or lastSource.target~=source) then control.blockSourceMemory={target=source,at=now} end
        -- Engagement latch: once an enemy is the Block target, a dash behind you or a step out of the
        -- facing box must not drop it. Hold it while blocking until it dies, leaves the latch range or
        -- the latch times out. An explicit cursor pick or a proven new attacker still wins.
        if control.blockLatch and not dashTarget and not returnTarget and not incomingDashTarget then
            local latch=control.blockLatchState
            if latch and (latch.root~=root or not latch.target.Parent) then latch=nil;control.blockLatchState=nil end
            if source and eligible(source) then
                if not latch or latch.target~=source then latch={root=root,target=source,at=now};control.blockLatchState=latch
                else latch.at=now end
            end
            if latch and latch.target~=source and now-latch.at<control.blockLatchSeconds then
                local other=latch.target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                local humanoid=latch.target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local honour=source~=nil and(source==cursorTarget or source==attackerNow)
                if other and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not honour then
                    local gap=(other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
                    if gap<=control.blockLatchRange then
                        source=latch.target
                        if gap<=8 then latch.at=now end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Neutral unless the target is inside the facing box or within the aim reach. A far enemy (a proven attacker, a remembered target or
        -- the latch) never pulls the character toward it.
        if source and not dashTarget and not returnTarget and not incomingDashTarget then
            local other=source:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local _,reach=control.aimAreaReach('Block')
            local flat=if other then host.Vector3.new(other.Position.X-root.Position.X,0,other.Position.Z-root.Position.Z).Magnitude else math.huge
            if not (control.aimAreaAllowsTarget('Block',source,root,false) or flat<=(reach or 0)) then source=nil end
        end
        if not source then control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim');return end
        if not session and previousSession and previousSession.target==source and previousSession.root==root
            and now>=previousSession.at then session=previousSession end
        if not session or session.target~=source then
            session={root=root,target=source,startedAt=now,at=now,tracking=false}
            control.blockAimSession=session
            control.aimTurnState=nil
        end
        session.at=now
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        session.tracking=session.tracking or control.blockAimBoxEnabled
            or (info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')~=nil and now-session.startedAt>=control.blockTrackingDelay)
        local point=control.directionalTargetPoint(root,source,'Block')
        point=control.stabilizeBlockPoint(root,source,point,dt,now,evidence)
        local facing,handled=control.directionalFrame(root,point,dt,control.blockAimSpeed,'Block Aim')
        control.blockAimTarget=if handled then source else nil
        if handled and aimSticky('Block') then
            -- Remember identity only. The active session and facing writer still
            -- stop on block release; the next hold revalidates this target.
            rememberBlockMemory(character,root,source)
        end
        if facing then
            if root.CFrame~=facing then root.CFrame=facing end;control.blockAimCount=(control.blockAimCount or 0)+1
            rememberEngagedBlock(root,source)
        end
        return handled==true
    end
    function control.stepDashAim(dt: number): boolean
        if not dashAssistActive() then control.dashFacingRole=nil;return false end
        if control.yieldForLock() then control.dashFacingRole=nil;return true end
        local character=player.Character
        local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or not character or not character.Parent or not root or not info
            or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or hum.PlatformStand or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then
            control.dashFacingRole=nil;control.resetDirectionalAim(nil,true);return true
        end
        for _,name in {'TrueStun','Knockback','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Downed','Dead'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or type(value)=='number' and value>0 or info:FindFirstChild(name) then
                control.dashFacingRole=nil;control.resetDirectionalAim(nil,true);return true
            end
        end
        if character:GetAttribute('Stun')==true or not control.onlySelfStun(info) then
            control.dashFacingRole=nil;control.resetDirectionalAim(nil,true);return true
        end
        local previous=control.aimTransition and control.aimTransition.role
        local dash=menu.frontDash and menu.frontDash.cameraDash
        local guided=dash and not dash.guidanceDropped and dash.guidanceRole
        local blockSlot=(not control.blockAimPauseOnDash and 'Block Aim' or false)
        local order=if info:FindFirstChild('Block') then {guided and guided..' Aim' or false,blockSlot,previous or false,'M1 Aim','Skill Aim','Counter Aim','Punish Aim'}
            else {guided and guided..' Aim' or false,previous or false,'M1 Aim',blockSlot,'Skill Aim','Counter Aim','Punish Aim'}
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        local role,target
        for _,candidate in order do
            if candidate and control.priorityAllows(candidate) then
                local key=candidate:gsub(' Aim$','')
                local enabled=if key=='M1' then m1AimEnabled() elseif key=='Block' then control.blockAimEnabled
                    or menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.enabled and menu.autoBlock.referenceSettings and menu.autoBlock.referenceSettings.lookAt
                    elseif key=='Skill'then control.skillAimEnabled elseif key=='Counter'then control.counterAimEnabled
                    elseif key=='Punish'then control.punishAimEnabled else false
                local captured=enabled and dashAssistTarget(key)
                local retainedBlock=key=='Block' and control.blockAimRetained~=nil
                if retainedBlock and control.getRetainedBlockTarget()~=captured then captured=nil end
                local range=if retainedBlock then control.blockAimReleaseDistance else control.maximumRange
                if captured and folder and validTarget(captured,character,folder,true,true)
                    and not captured:GetAttribute('Dead') and not captured:FindFirstChild('Info'):FindFirstChild('Dead')
                    and control.aimRangeAllows(key,root,captured,range,retainedBlock) then
                    role,target=candidate,captured;break
                end
            end
        end
        if not role then control.dashFacingRole=nil;control.releaseShiftLockAim(false);return true end
        if not dashAssistReady(role) then
            control.dashFacingRole=nil
            if not retainPendingDashRotation() then control.releaseShiftLockAim(false) end
            control.lastReason='Retaining '..role..' target; native dash movement is not ready'
            return true
        end
        if type(dt)~='number' or dt~=dt or dt<=0 or math.abs(dt)==math.huge then return true end
        control.dashFacingRole=role
        local key=role:gsub(' Aim$','')
        local speed=if key=='M1' then control.turnResponse elseif key=='Block' then control.blockAimSpeed
            elseif key=='Skill' then control.skillAimSpeed elseif key=='Counter' then control.counterAimSpeed else control.punishAimSpeed
        local destination=control.directionalTargetPoint(root,target,key)
        local facing,handled=control.directionalFrame(root,destination,dt,speed,role)
        if facing then root.CFrame=facing;control.dashAimCount=(control.dashAimCount or 0)+1 end
        control.lastReason='Retaining '..role..' on the captured target during verified native dash movement'
        return handled==true
    end
    local function wouldUseThrowable(character: any, root: any, direction: any): boolean
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if info:FindFirstChild("NoThrowable") then return false end
        local map = world:FindFirstChild("Map")
        local destructible = map and map:FindFirstChild("Destructible")
        local folder = destructible and destructible:FindFirstChild("Throwable")
        if not folder then return false end
        local scale = if character.GetScale then character:GetScale() else 1
        local point = root.Position + direction * 3
        for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
            if item.PrimaryPart and not item:GetAttribute("B") and not item:GetAttribute("Hold") and (point - item.PrimaryPart.Position).Magnitude <= 4 * scale then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function aim(character: any, requestBoundary: boolean?, dt: number?)
        if control.yieldForLock() then return end
        if nativeDashActive(character) or dashAssistActive() then return end
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local allowed, reason = permitted(character, humanoid, requestBoundary)
        control.lastReason = reason
        if not allowed then control.resetDirectionalAim('M1 Aim');control.lastTarget = nil; return end
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then control.lastReason = "Your root part is unavailable"; return end
        local target = selectTarget(character, root)
        if not target then control.resetDirectionalAim('M1 Aim');control.lastTarget = nil; control.lastReason = "No visible target within M1 Aim Range"; return end
        if control.userM1Held() and (not control.m1HeldSession or control.m1HeldSession.target~=target) then
            control.m1HeldSession={character=character,target=target}
        end
        local position, destination = root.Position, control.directionalTargetPoint(root,target)
        local horizontal = host.Vector3.new(destination.X - position.X, 0, destination.Z - position.Z)
        if horizontal.Magnitude < 0.001 then
            control.refreshShiftLockAim(root)
            observeAimFacing(root,target,'M1 Aim',root.CFrame)
            control.lastReason = "Holding facing at the target's position"; return
        end
        local desired = host.CFrame.lookAt(position, position + horizontal)
        if wouldUseThrowable(character, root, root.CFrame.LookVector) or wouldUseThrowable(character, root, desired.LookVector) then control.lastReason = "Native throwable interaction owns this input"; return end
        control.lastTarget = target
        control.m1LastTarget = target
        if not dt then control.lastReason = "Tracking "..target.Name.." for smooth native M1 aim"; return end
        local facing=control.directionalFrame(root,destination,dt)
        if not facing then return end
        -- The facing write preserves camera, position, velocity, collision and held input.
        root.CFrame = facing
        control.lastTarget, control.lastAimAt = target, clock()
        control.aimCount += 1
        control.lastReason = "Turning smoothly toward "..target.Name.." during native M1"
    end

    -- One assist session for a whole held chain. The game's own M1 clock (CurrentM1, LastM1 on the server timeline) says the chain is still
    -- running, so M1 assist keeps tracking through every swing of a 3, 4 or 5 hit chain instead of resetting between hits and starting the
    -- turn from the beginning again. It ends when the chain's window passes with no new swing.
    control.m1ChainHold=true
    function control.setM1ChainHold(value) control.m1ChainHold=value==true;return true end
    function control.m1ChainLive(): boolean
        if not control.m1ChainHold then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        if not character then return false end
        local lastM1=tonumber(character:GetAttribute('LastM1'))
        local current=tonumber(character:GetAttribute('CurrentM1')) or 0
        if not lastM1 or lastM1<=0 or current<=0 then return false end
        local age=host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-lastM1
        local window=math.max(.9,(control.m1ChainWindowSeconds or 0))
        return age>=-.25 and age<window and control.m1HeldAt~=nil and clock()-control.m1HeldAt<window
    end
    function control.step(dt: number)
        if control.pauseForEmote()then return end
        if control.stickyAimMemories.M1 then retainedStickyTarget('M1')end
        if dashAssistActive() then control.stepDashAim(dt);return end
        if control.userM1Held() then control.m1HeldAt=clock() end
        local chainLive=not control.userM1Held() and control.m1ChainLive()
        if not control.userM1Held() and not chainLive then control.m1HeldSession=nil end
        if not control.alive or not m1AimEnabled() then return end
        if control.yieldForLock() then return end
        if type(dt) ~= "number" or dt ~= dt or dt <= 0 or math.abs(dt) == math.huge then return end
        if not control.userM1Held() and not chainLive then control.resetDirectionalAim('M1 Aim');control.lastTarget = nil; control.lastReason = "The saved M1 input is not held"; return end
        local ok, failure = pcall(aim, player.Character, true, dt)
        if not ok then control.lastTarget = nil; control.lastReason = "Aim was skipped: "..tostring(failure) end
    end

    function control.beforeRequest()
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if control.priorityInput()=='M1' and block and block.releaseForM1 then block.releaseForM1() end
        control.nativeRequests += 1
        control.lastRouting = "Native Activated request"
        local ok, failure = pcall(aim, player.Character, true)
        if not ok then control.lastReason = "Aim was skipped: "..tostring(failure) end
    end

    wrapper = function(self: any, ...: any): ...any
        local character = player.Character
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if control.priorityInput()=='M1' and block and block.releaseForM1 then block.releaseForM1() end
        local bridge = menu.m1Assist
        if not (bridge and bridge.alive and bridge.toolController == tool and bridge.hasRequestHook and bridge.hasRequestHook()) then
            control.lastRouting = "Native Melee entry fallback"
            local aimed, failure = pcall(aim, character)
            if not aimed then control.lastReason = "Aim was skipped: "..tostring(failure) end
        end
        control.nativeCalls += 1
        if character then control.activeCalls[character] = (control.activeCalls[character] or 0) + 1 end
        -- No wait before the original: a released input cannot be restarted later.
        local results = table.pack(pcall(original, self, ...))
        if character then
            local remaining = (control.activeCalls[character] or 1) - 1
            control.activeCalls[character] = if remaining > 0 then remaining else nil
        end
        if not results[1] then error(results[2], 0) end
