        return table.unpack(results, 2, results.n)
    end
    tool.Melee = wrapper
    control.ready = true
    local presentation=host.presentationRunService
    if presentation and presentation.RenderStepped then
        -- Pure preview drawing remains available while gameplay/input callbacks
        -- are paused for menu editing. It cannot select or face any target.
        connect(presentation.RenderStepped,control.refreshAimAreas)
    end
    local okRunService, runService = pcall(host.game.GetService, host.game, "RunService")
    if okRunService and runService then
      -- Cost counters (seconds per part, control.profile) so the slow part of the assist can be found from the game.
      control.profile={}
      for _,name in {'refreshShiftLockAim','captureBlockAimHits','refreshAimAreas','stepAutomaticAim','stepBlockAim','step','captureShiftLockCameraSource','prepareShiftLockCameraOffset','restoreShiftLockCameraOffset'} do
        local original=control[name]
        if type(original)=='function' then
          control[name]=function(...)
            local startedAt=clock()
            local a,b,c=original(...)
            control.profile[name]=(control.profile[name] or 0)+(clock()-startedAt)
            return a,b,c
          end
        end
      end
      local function dispatchAssist(dt)
        local cameraOwner=menu.autoLock
        if cameraOwner and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive() then return end
        if control.pauseForEmote()then control.refreshAimAreas();return end
        if control.stickyAimMemories.M1 then retainedStickyTarget('M1')end
        if control.stickyAimMemories.Skill then retainedStickyTarget('Skill')end
        if control.userM1Held() then
            local lease=control.shiftLockAimLease
            if control.blockAimRetained or lease and lease.role=='Block Aim' then
                -- M1 picks the facing up from where Block Assist left it: the lease changes owner first, so clearing Block's own state
                -- does not release the character back to the camera direction.
                if lease and lease.role=='Block Aim' then lease.role='M1 Aim';lease.driveAt=clock() end
                control.resetDirectionalAim('Block Aim',true)
            end
        end
        if not control.userM1Held() and not dashAssistActive() then control.m1HeldSession=nil end
        if nativeDashActive(player.Character) or dashAssistActive() then
            if control.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget('Skill')then
                local okay,handled=pcall(control.stepAutomaticAim,dt)
                if okay and handled then control.refreshAimAreas();return end
            end
            if control.stepDashAim(dt) then control.refreshAimAreas();return end
            if blockDashTarget() then
                control.refreshShiftLockAim();control.refreshAimAreas()
                local ok,detail=pcall(control.stepBlockAim,dt)
                if not ok then control.lastReason='Block dash facing skipped: '..tostring(detail) end
            else control.yieldForDash();control.refreshAimAreas() end
            return
        end
        control.dashFacingRole=nil
        if control.yieldForLock() then control.refreshAimAreas();return end
        local priority=control.priorityInput()
        if priority=='M1' then
            control.refreshShiftLockAim();control.captureBlockAimHits();control.refreshAimAreas()
            local block=menu.autoBlock
            if block and block.releaseForM1 then block.releaseForM1() end
            control.step(dt)
            return
        end
        local red=menu.nativeRed
        if red and red.facingActive and red.facingActive() then
            control.releaseShiftLockAim(false);control.refreshAimAreas();return
        end
        control.refreshShiftLockAim()
        control.captureBlockAimHits();control.refreshAimAreas()
        -- Retained, paused, or invalid lock state cannot suppress assist resumption.
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and lock.alive and lock.skillFacingApplied then return end
        if control.stepAutomaticAim(dt) then return end
        local blockOk,blockDetail=pcall(control.stepBlockAim,dt)
        if not blockOk then control.lastReason='Block facing skipped: '..tostring(blockDetail) end
        if blockOk and blockDetail==true then return end
        control.step(dt)
      end
      local function renderAssist(dt)
        dispatchAssist(dt)
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and lock.stepAssistReturn and not characterEmoting(player.Character)then
            lock.assistReturnDispatcher=control
            lock.stepAssistReturn(dt)
        end
      end
      -- Run after native shift-lock yaw so accepted block/punish aim is not overwritten.
      if type(runService.BindToRenderStep)=='function' and host.Enum.RenderPriority then
        control.runService,control.renderName=runService,'ShenaniganismDirectionalAssist'
        runService:BindToRenderStep(control.renderName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+2,renderAssist)
        if host.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera then
            control.cameraPrepareName,control.cameraRestoreName='ShenaniganismAssistShoulderPrepare','ShenaniganismAssistShoulderRestore'
            control.cameraSourceName='ShenaniganismAssistShoulderSource'
            -- Capture after native camera, before AutoLock Last+1 / aim Last+2.
            runService:BindToRenderStep(control.cameraSourceName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value,control.captureShiftLockCameraSource)
            -- Compensate after the final character yaw, before HUD presentation.
            runService:BindToRenderStep(control.cameraPrepareName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+3,control.prepareShiftLockCameraOffset)
            runService:BindToRenderStep(control.cameraRestoreName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value-2,control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset)
        end
      else connect(runService.RenderStepped,renderAssist) end
    end
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased, function() control.resetAimTargetSwitch();control.resetDirectionalAim();control.focused = false; control.lastTarget = nil;control.cancelAimHold();control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset();control.releaseShiftLockAim() end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused, function() control.focused = true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function() control.clearM1ContactObserver();control.resetAimTargetSwitch();clearStickyMemory('M1');clearStickyMemory('Skill');clearBlockMemory();table.clear(control.aimMotion);control.resetDirectionalAim();control.cancelAimHold();control.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset();control.releaseShiftLockAim();control.lastTarget = nil; control.controls = nil end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded, function() control.bindM1ContactObserver();control.resetAimTargetSwitch();clearStickyMemory('M1');clearStickyMemory('Skill');control.lastTarget = nil; control.controls = nil end)
    return control
end

return M1AimAssist
end)()

local M1Approach = (function(): any
-- Ordinary movement input while a held M1 assist is active. Native speed,
-- collisions, stun restrictions and hit acceptance remain authoritative.
local M1Approach: {[string]: any} = {}

function M1Approach.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local replicated = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local world = host.workspace
    local kindOf: any = host.typeof or typeof
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, enabled = false, ready = false, focused = true, characterAvailable = player.Character ~= nil,
        range = 6, maximumRange = 80, stopDistance = 3.5, frameDelta = 1/60,
        connections = {}, controls = nil, movementHook = nil, lastTarget = nil,
        retiredCharacters = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        approachCount = 0, lastReason = "M1 approach is disabled",
    }

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end
    local function finiteVector(value: any): boolean
        return kindOf(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z)
    end
    local function connect(signal: any, callback: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect) == "function" then table.insert(control.connections, (signal :: any):Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function positive(value: any): boolean
        return value == true or (finite(value) and value > 0)
    end
    local function modelFrom(value: any): any
        if kindOf(value) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
        return if value:IsA("Model") then value else value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end
    local function bindingHeld(binding: any): boolean
        local value = binding.KeyCode
        if kindOf(value) ~= "EnumItem" or value.Name == "None" or value.Name == "Unknown" then return false end
        local mouseNames = {MouseLeftButton = "MouseButton1", MouseRightButton = "MouseButton2", MouseMiddleButton = "MouseButton3", MouseButton1 = "MouseButton1", MouseButton2 = "MouseButton2", MouseButton3 = "MouseButton3"}
        local mouse = mouseNames[value.Name]
        local held = if mouse then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[mouse]) else value.EnumType == host.Enum.KeyCode and input:IsKeyDown(value)
        if not held then return false end
        local modifier = binding.PrimaryModifier
        if kindOf(modifier) == "EnumItem" and modifier.Name ~= "None" and modifier.Name ~= "Unknown" then
            return modifier.EnumType == host.Enum.KeyCode and input:IsKeyDown(modifier)
        end
        return true
    end
    local function actionHeld(name: string): boolean
        local keybinds = replicated:FindFirstChild("Keybind")
        local combat = keybinds and keybinds:FindFirstChild("Combat")
        local action = combat and combat:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not action then return false end
        for _, binding in action:GetDescendants() do
            if binding:IsA("InputBinding") and bindingHeld(binding) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.userM1Held(): boolean
        local assist = menu.m1Assist
        if assist and type(assist.userM1Held) == "function" then
            local ok, held = pcall(assist.userM1Held)
            return ok and held == true
        end
        return actionHeld("Melee")
    end
    local function manualMovementHeld(): boolean
        for _, name in {"W", "A", "S", "D", "Up", "Down", "Left", "Right"} do
            local key = host.Enum.KeyCode[name]
            if key and input:IsKeyDown(key) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function permitted(character: any, humanoid: any): (boolean, string)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or menu.alive == false then return false, "M1 approach is disabled" end
        local assist, aim = menu.m1Assist, menu.m1AimAssist
        if not ((assist and assist.alive ~= false and assist.enabled == true) or (aim and aim.alive ~= false and aim.enabled == true)) then return false, "An M1 assist must be enabled" end
        local chain = menu.blackflashChain
        if chain and chain.alive ~= false and chain.enabled == true and chain.movement then return false, "Black Flash follow-up owns movement" end
        if not control.focused or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or menu.recording then return false, "Input is focused elsewhere" end
        if not control.userM1Held() then return false, "The saved M1 input is not held" end
        if not control.characterAvailable or not character or character ~= player.Character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, "Your character is unavailable" end
        if humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.Sit then return false, "Native movement is unavailable" end
        for _, name in {"Dead", "Stun", "TrueStun", "Ragdoll", "CompleteRagdoll", "TrueRagdoll", "NoMove", "NoMovement", "Block", "InSkill"} do
            if positive(character:GetAttribute(name)) then return false, "Native movement is restricted: " .. name end
        end
        local states, state = host.Enum.HumanoidStateType, humanoid:GetState()
        if state == states.Physics or state == states.Ragdoll or state == states.FallingDown or state == states.GettingUp or state == states.Dead then return false, "Native recovery owns movement" end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return false, "Native character state is unavailable" end
        if character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or info:FindFirstChild('InDash')
            or (menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.dashFacingActive and menu.autoLock.dashFacingActive()) then return false, "Native dash owns movement" end
        -- M1 adds InSkill for every punch. The existing native swing tracker
        -- distinguishes that marker from a real skill and rejects recent hits.
        local ownM1=aim and type(aim.ownM1Phase)=='function' and aim.ownM1Phase(character)==true
        for _, name in {"Stun", "TrueStun", "Ragdoll", "CompleteRagdoll", "TrueRagdoll", "Block", "Knockback", "NoMove", "NoMovement", "InSkill", "DomainClash", "Throwable"} do
            local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name)
            local ownState=ownM1 and (name=='InSkill' or name=='Stun' and type(aim.onlySelfStun)=='function' and aim.onlySelfStun(info))
            if marker and not ownState then return false, "Native movement is restricted: " .. name end
        end
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        if block and type(block.manualBlockHeld) == "function" then
            local ok, held = pcall(block.manualBlockHeld)
            if not ok or held == true then return false, "Manual block owns input" end
        end
        if actionHeld("Block") then return false, "The saved block input is held" end
        local item = info:FindFirstChild("Item")
        if (item and item:FindFirstChild("M1")) or character:FindFirstChild("CustomM1") or character:FindFirstChild("CustomChar") then return false, "This M1 uses a separate native action" end
        local shared = host._G or {}
        if shared.Crow then return false, "Bird control owns input" end
        local settings = (host.shared and host.shared.Settings) or shared.Settings
        local tool = assist and assist.toolController
        if settings and settings.AutoUse == false and tool and tool.Selected and tool.Selected.Value then return false, "A selected ability owns input" end
        return true, "Held M1 assist can approach a nearby target"
    end
    local function targetPart(model: any): any
        for _, name in {"Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart"} do
            local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.selectTarget(character: any, root: any): any
        local folder = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not folder or not host.RaycastParams or type(world.Raycast) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local parameters = host.RaycastParams.new()
        parameters.FilterType = host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local excluded = {character}
        local effects = world:FindFirstChild("Effects")
        if effects then table.insert(excluded, effects) end
        parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
        local from = targetPart(character)
        if not from or not finiteVector(from.Position) then return nil end
        local function eligible(model: any): (boolean, number)
            if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(model)) then return false,math.huge end
            if not model or model == character or control.retiredCharacters[model] or not model.Parent or not model:IsDescendantOf(folder) then return false, math.huge end
            local humanoid, other = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local part, info = targetPart(model), model:FindFirstChild("Info")
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not other or not other:IsA("BasePart") or not part or not info or positive(model:GetAttribute("Dead")) then return false, math.huge end
            if model.Name == "HarutaSwordNPC" or info:FindFirstChild("UroDistort") or not finiteVector(other.Position) or not finiteVector(part.Position) then return false, math.huge end
            local owner = model:FindFirstChild("Owner")
            if positive(model:GetAttribute("HitboxNPC")) and owner and (owner.Value == character or owner.Value == player) then return false, math.huge end
            local otherPlayer = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if otherPlayer == player then return false, math.huge end
            if otherPlayer and not otherPlayer.Neutral and not player.Neutral and player.Team and player.Team == otherPlayer.Team then return false, math.huge end
            local distance = (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if not finite(distance) or distance > control.range then return false, distance end
            local direction=part.Position-from.Position
            local result=if menu.visibilityRaycast then menu.visibilityRaycast(from.Position,direction,parameters) else world:Raycast(from.Position,direction,parameters)
            return not result or (result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model)) == true, distance
        end
        local locked = menu.environment and modelFrom(menu.environment.LockedTarget)
        if locked and eligible(locked) then control.lastSelection = "Locked target"; return locked end
        local aim = menu.m1AimAssist
        local previous = (aim and modelFrom(aim.lastTarget)) or control.lastTarget
        if previous and eligible(previous) then control.lastSelection = "Current assist target"; return previous end
        local nearest, best = nil, math.huge
        for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if not model:IsA("Model") then continue end
            local allowed, distance = eligible(model)
            if allowed and distance < best then nearest, best = model, distance end
        end
        if nearest then control.lastSelection = "Closest visible enemy or dummy" end
        return nearest
    end
    function control.approachVector(original: any, controller: any): any
        if not finiteVector(original) then return nil end
        if original.Magnitude > 0 or manualMovementHeld() then control.lastTarget = nil; control.lastReason = "Manual movement takes priority"; return nil end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local allowed, reason = permitted(character, humanoid)
        control.lastReason = reason
        if not allowed then control.lastTarget = nil; return nil end
        if control.range <= 0 then control.lastTarget = nil; control.lastReason = "Target selection range is zero"; return nil end
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not finiteVector(root.Position) then return nil end
        local target = control.selectTarget(character, root)
        control.lastTarget = target
        if not target then control.lastReason = "No visible target within selection range"; return nil end
        local delta = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart").Position - root.Position
        delta = host.Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
        if delta.Magnitude <= control.stopDistance then control.lastReason = "Target is within the stopping distance"; return nil end
        local direction = delta.Unit
        if type(controller.IsMoveVectorCameraRelative) ~= "function" then control.lastReason = "Native movement coordinate mode is unavailable"; return nil end
        if controller:IsMoveVectorCameraRelative() then
            local camera = world.CurrentCamera
            if not camera or not camera.CFrame or not finiteVector(camera.CFrame.LookVector) or not finiteVector(camera.CFrame.RightVector) then return nil end
            local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local forward = host.Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            if forward.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector
                forward = host.Vector3.new(right.Z, 0, -right.X)
            end
            if forward.Magnitude < 0.001 then return nil end
            forward = forward.Unit
            local right = host.Vector3.new(-forward.Z, 0, forward.X)
            direction = host.Vector3.new(direction:Dot(right), 0, -direction:Dot(forward))
            if not finiteVector(direction) or direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then return nil end
            direction = direction.Unit
        end
        control.approachCount += 1
        control.lastReason = "Ordinary movement toward " .. target.Name
        -- Ease to a root-centered punching gap instead of running into the
        -- target at full speed until the final native movement frame.
        local speed=tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed)
        if not finite(speed) or speed<0 then speed=16 end
        local strength=math.clamp((delta.Magnitude-control.stopDistance)/math.max(0.5,speed*control.frameDelta),0,1)
        return direction*strength
    end
    function control.detachControls()
        local hook = control.movementHook
        control.movementHook = nil
        if hook then
            hook.active = false
            if hook.controller.GetMoveVector == hook.wrapper then hook.controller.GetMoveVector = hook.original end
        end
        control.ready = false
    end
    function control.attachControls()
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then control.detachControls(); return end
        if not control.controls then
            local scripts = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
            local module = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if module then
                local ok, result = pcall(function() return (host.require or require)(module):GetControls() end)
                if ok and type(result) == "table" then control.controls = result end
            end
        end
        local active = control.controls and control.controls.activeController
        local current = control.movementHook
        if current and current.controller == active then
            if active.GetMoveVector == current.wrapper then return end
            local chain = menu.blackflashChain and menu.blackflashChain.movementHook
            if chain and chain.active and chain.controller == active and chain.original == current.wrapper and active.GetMoveVector == chain.wrapper then return end
        end
        control.detachControls()
        if not active or type(active.GetMoveVector) ~= "function" then control.lastReason = "Native movement controls are unavailable"; return end
        local original = active.GetMoveVector
        local hook: any = {controller = active, original = original, active = true}
        hook.wrapper = function(self: any, ...: any): any
            local raw = original(self, ...)
            if not hook.active or not control.alive or control.movementHook ~= hook then return raw end
            local ok, direction = pcall(control.approachVector, raw, active)
            if not ok then control.lastReason = "Approach was skipped: " .. tostring(direction); return raw end
            return direction or raw
        end
        control.movementHook = hook
        active.GetMoveVector = hook.wrapper
        control.ready = true
    end
    function control.setEnabled(enabled: boolean)
        control.enabled = control.alive and enabled == true
        control.lastTarget = nil
        control.lastReason = if control.enabled then "M1 approach is enabled" else "M1 approach is disabled"
        control.attachControls()
    end
    function control.cancelForManualBlock()
        -- The existing movement wrapper returns the player's original vector
        -- while Block is held; do not send a competing Move/zero-vector write.
        control.lastTarget=nil
        control.lastReason='Manual Block owns approach input'
    end
    function control.setRange(value: number)
        local amount = tonumber(value) or 6
        if not finite(amount) then amount = 6 end
        control.range = math.clamp(amount, 0, control.maximumRange)
        control.lastTarget = nil
    end
    function control.setStopDistance(value: number)
        local amount = tonumber(value) or 3.5
        if not finite(amount) then amount = 3.5 end
        control.stopDistance = math.clamp(amount, 0.5, control.maximumRange)
    end
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased, function() control.focused = false; control.lastTarget = nil end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused, function() control.focused = true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function(character: any)
        if character then control.retiredCharacters[character] = true end
        control.characterAvailable = false; control.lastTarget = nil; control.detachControls()
    end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded, function(character: any)
        if character then control.retiredCharacters[character] = nil end
        control.characterAvailable = true; control.lastTarget = nil; control.controls = nil; control.detachControls(); control.attachControls()
    end)
    connect(host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function(delta)
        if finite(delta) and delta>0 then control.frameDelta=math.clamp(delta,1/1000,0.25) end
        control.attachControls()
    end)
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive, control.enabled = false, false
        control.lastTarget = nil
        control.detachControls()
        for _, connection in (control.connections :: {any}) do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        table.clear(control.retiredCharacters)
        control.lastReason = "M1 approach was unloaded"
    end
    return control
end

return M1Approach
end)()

local BlackflashChain = (function(): any
-- Normal Vessel continuation uses the actual first native request as its clock.
-- Native requests never guarantee server swing acceptance or a victim hit.
local BlackflashChain: {[string]: any} = {}
local PROFILE_KEY = "__ShenaniganismBlackflashTimingProfiles"
local FIRST_VARIANT = "100962226150441"
local NATIVE_IDS = {[FIRST_VARIANT]=true, ['95852624447551']=true, ['74145636023952']=true}
local function finite(value: any): boolean
    return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)~=math.huge
end
local function validSeconds(value: any): boolean
    return finite(value) and value>=0.05 and value<=0.4
end
local function validMethod(value: any): boolean
    return value=="Hop" or value=="Side"
end
local function acceptedEffect(value: any): boolean
    -- The recovered native controller distinguishes these victim-hit effects from casts.
    return value=="BlackFlashHit" or value=="BlackFlashChain"
end
local function sampleKey(sample: any): string
    return tostring(sample.session or "native")..":"..tostring(sample.requestAt or sample.at)..":"..tostring(sample.seconds)
end
local function sampleCopy(sample: any): any
    if type(sample)~="table" or not validSeconds(sample.seconds) or sample.service~="DivergentFistService" or not acceptedEffect(sample.effect) then return nil end
    if sample.source=="capture" then
        if type(sample.session)~="string" or sample.session=="" or not finite(sample.requestAt) or not finite(sample.confirmedAt) or sample.confirmedAt<=sample.requestAt or sample.confirmedAt-sample.requestAt>0.35 or type(sample.victim)~="string" or sample.victim=="" then return nil end
        return {seconds=sample.seconds,source="capture",service=sample.service,effect=sample.effect,session=sample.session,requestAt=sample.requestAt,confirmedAt=sample.confirmedAt,victim=sample.victim}
    elseif sample.source=="native" and finite(sample.at) then
        return {seconds=sample.seconds,source="native",service=sample.service,effect=sample.effect,at=sample.at}
    end
    return nil
end
local function median(samples: any): number
    local values={}
    for _,sample in samples do table.insert(values,sample.seconds) end
    table.sort(values)
    local mid=math.floor(#values/2)
    return if #values%2==0 then (values[mid]+values[mid+1])/2 else values[mid+1]
end

function BlackflashChain.profilesFromCapture(capture: any): (any, any)
    local result={version=1,profiles={Hop={},Side={}}}
    local stats={accepted=0,rejected=0,requests=0}
    local records=if type(capture)=="table" then capture.records or capture else nil
    if type(records)~="table" then return result,stats end
    local latest={}
    local consumed={}
    for _,record in records do
        if type(record)=="table" and type(record.session)=="string" and record.session~="" and finite(record.at) then
            local detail=record.detail
            if record.kind=="nativeRequest" and type(detail)=="table" and detail.service=="DivergentFistService" and detail.action=="Activated" then
                stats.requests+=1
                -- A later invalid/start request invalidates an earlier continuation candidate.
                latest[record.session]=record
            elseif record.kind=="confirmed" and type(detail)=="table" and detail.service=="DivergentFistService" and acceptedEffect(detail.effect) then
                local request=latest[record.session]
                local animation
                if request and type(request.animations)=="table" then
                    for _,candidate in request.animations do
                        if type(candidate)=="table" and NATIVE_IDS[candidate.id] then
                            if animation then animation=nil;break end
                            animation=candidate
                        end
                    end
                end
                local arguments=request and request.detail.args
                local tool=if type(arguments)=="table" then arguments[1] else nil
                local confirmedAnimation=false
                if animation and type(record.animations)=="table" then for _,candidate in record.animations do
                    if type(candidate)=="table" and candidate.id==animation.id and finite(candidate.time) and candidate.time>=animation.time then confirmedAnimation=true end
                end end
                if request and request.helperEnabled~=true and record.helperEnabled~=true and not consumed[request] and validMethod(request.method) and record.method==request.method and animation and validSeconds(animation.time) and finite(animation.speed) and animation.speed>0 and confirmedAnimation and type(tool)=="table" and tool.service=="DivergentFistService" and tool.key==3 then
                    local sample=sampleCopy({seconds=animation.time,source="capture",service=detail.service,effect=detail.effect,session=record.session,requestAt=request.at,confirmedAt=record.at,victim=detail.victim})
                    if sample then
                        consumed[request]=true
                        local list=result.profiles[request.method]
                        local profile=list[animation.id]
                        if not profile then profile={seconds=sample.seconds,source="capture",samples={}};list[animation.id]=profile end
                        table.insert(profile.samples,sample)
                        stats.accepted+=1
                    else stats.rejected+=1 end
                else stats.rejected+=1 end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,profiles in result.profiles do for _,profile in profiles do profile.seconds=median(profile.samples) end end
    return result,stats
end

function BlackflashChain.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, bindings: any): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local replicated = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local kindOf = host.typeof or typeof
    local ids = NATIVE_IDS
    local shared = host._G or (menu.environment and menu.environment._G) or menu.environment or host
    local stored = shared[PROFILE_KEY]
    local control: any = {
        alive=true, enabled=false, autoEnabled=false, ready=false, focused=true, method="Hop", window=0.19, range=6,
        connections={}, characterConnections={}, pending=nil, movement=nil, held=nil,
        manual={}, expected={}, seen=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}), trackConnections={}, nativeIds={},
        confirmedHits=0, chainLength=0, maxChainHits=1, lastCompletedChainLength=0, continuationRequests=0, generation=0,
        movementHook=nil, controls=nil, movementReady=false, backDistance=3, movementSeconds=1.5,
        calibrated=false, timingVerified=false, verifiedWindows={}, lastCalibration=nil, nativeSignals={}, nextMoveRequests=0,
        profiles={Hop={},Side={}}, timingOverride=false, manualWindow=0.19, manualConfirmed=false, manualConfirmations={Hop={},Side={}}, referenceWindow=0.19,
        activeVariant=FIRST_VARIANT, activeWindow=0.19, activeTimingVerified=false, activeTimingSource="Reference timing",
        nativeTool=nil, nativeActionReady=false, nativeAction="ToolController.UseKey", nativeUseCount=0, nativeReleaseCount=0, nativeHeld=nil, nativeDispatch=nil, lastNativeRequest=nil,
        requestDelay=0.30, requestDelayVerified=false, firstRequest=nil, requestHook=nil, blackflashSwings=0, ordinarySwings=0,
        nativeMovement=nil, nativeDashRequests=0,
        perfectAttempt=nil, perfectStarts=0, perfectCompleted=0, rearConeDegrees=25, skillHook=nil, mode="Native request delay",
        profileVersion=1, persistenceKey=PROFILE_KEY,
        timingSource="Delay between actual native first and second requests",
        lastReason="Auto Black Flash is disabled",
    }
    local cancel: any
    local function profileClone(profile: any): any
        local samples={}
        for _,sample in profile.samples do table.insert(samples,table.clone(sample)) end
        return {seconds=profile.seconds,source=profile.source,samples=samples}
    end
    function control.exportProfiles(): any
        local snapshot={version=1,profiles={Hop={},Side={}},method=control.method,manualOverride=control.timingOverride,manualWindow=control.manualWindow,requestDelay=control.requestDelay}
        for method,profiles in control.profiles do for id,profile in profiles do snapshot.profiles[method][id]=profileClone(profile) end end
        return snapshot
    end
    local function persist()
        shared[PROFILE_KEY]=control.exportProfiles()
    end
    function control.getWindow(_id: string?, _method: string?): (number, boolean, string)
        -- Compatibility getter. Archived animation phases never select the timing mode.
        return control.requestDelay,control.requestDelayVerified,"Delay between actual native first and second requests; native results are observed separately"
    end
    local function syncTiming(id: string?)
        control.timingOverride=false
        control.window,control.timingVerified,control.timingSource=control.getWindow(FIRST_VARIANT)
        control.activeVariant=id or control.activeVariant or FIRST_VARIANT
        control.activeWindow,control.activeTimingVerified,control.activeTimingSource=control.getWindow(control.activeVariant)
        control.manualConfirmed=false
        control.calibrated=control.timingVerified
        table.clear(control.verifiedWindows)
    end
    function control.importProfiles(envelope: any): number
        if type(envelope)~="table" or envelope.version~=1 or type(envelope.profiles)~="table" then return 0 end
        local imported=0
        for _,method in {"Hop","Side"} do
            local profiles=envelope.profiles[method]
            if type(profiles)=="table" then for id,profile in profiles do
                if ids[id] and type(profile)=="table" and validSeconds(profile.seconds) and type(profile.samples)=="table" and (profile.source=="capture" or profile.source=="native") then
                    local current=control.profiles[method][id]
                    local samples,known={},{}
                    if current then for _,sample in current.samples do table.insert(samples,table.clone(sample));known[sampleKey(sample)]=true end end
                    local newSamples=0
                    for index,sample in ipairs(profile.samples) do
                        if index>64 then break end
                        local copy=sampleCopy(sample)
                        if copy and not known[sampleKey(copy)] and #samples<64 then table.insert(samples,copy);known[sampleKey(copy)]=true;newSamples+=1 end
                    end
                    if newSamples>0 then
                        local captured={}
                        for _,sample in samples do if sample.source=="capture" then table.insert(captured,sample) end end
                        -- Only independent recorded observations can replace a threshold.
                        -- Further runtime frame overshoot never changes the first learned value.
                        local seconds=if #captured>0 then median(captured) elseif current then current.seconds else profile.seconds
                        control.profiles[method][id]={seconds=seconds,source=if #captured>0 then "capture" else "native",samples=samples}
                        imported+=newSamples
                    end
                end
            end end
        end
        -- Keep old captures as archived metadata without retiming an active cast.
        syncTiming();persist()
        return imported
    end
    function control.importCapture(capture: any): any
        local envelope,stats=BlackflashChain.profilesFromCapture(capture)
        stats.imported=control.importProfiles(envelope)
        return stats
    end
    if type(stored)=="table" and stored.version==1 then
        if validMethod(stored.method) then control.method=stored.method end
        if validSeconds(stored.manualWindow) then control.manualWindow=stored.manualWindow end
        if validSeconds(stored.requestDelay) then control.requestDelay=stored.requestDelay end
        control.importProfiles(stored)
    end
    syncTiming()
    local function connect(signal: any, callback: any, list: any?)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=="function" then table.insert(list or control.connections, signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function signature(binding: any): string
        return binding.kind..":"..binding.name
    end
    local function held(binding: any): boolean
        if binding.kind=="Mouse" then return input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name]) end
        local key=host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name]
        return key~=nil and input:IsKeyDown(key)
    end
    local function eventKey(event: any): string?
        if event.UserInputType and event.UserInputType.Name:match("^MouseButton[123]$") then return "Mouse:"..event.UserInputType.Name end
        if event.KeyCode and event.KeyCode~=host.Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return "Keyboard:"..event.KeyCode.Name end
        return nil
    end
    local function observeInput(event: any, down: boolean)
        local key=eventKey(event)
        if not key then return end
        local now=clock()
        for index=#control.expected,1,-1 do if now-control.expected[index].at>0.15 then table.remove(control.expected,index) end end
        for index,expected in control.expected do
            if expected.key==key and expected.down==down then table.remove(control.expected,index); return end
        end
        control.manual[key]=if down then true else nil
        if down and bindings and type(bindings.get)=="function" then
            local ok,binding=pcall(bindings.get,"Move3")
            if ok and binding and signature(binding)==key and (not binding.modifier or held(binding.modifier) or control.manual[signature(binding.modifier)]) then
                control.lastSkillEdgeAt=now
                local attempt=control.perfectAttempt
                if attempt then
                    if not attempt.initialInputSeen and now-attempt.at<=0.03 then
                        attempt.initialInputSeen=true
                        return
                    else cancel("A second manual Skill 3 press cancelled the rear preparation");return end
                end
            end
        end
        if down and control.pending and bindings and type(bindings.get)=="function" then
            local ok,binding=pcall(bindings.get,"Move3")
            if ok and binding and signature(binding)==key and (not binding.modifier or held(binding.modifier) or control.manual[signature(binding.modifier)]) then
                local first=control.firstRequest
                if first and not first.initialInputSeen and now-first.at<=0.03 then
                    first.initialInputSeen=true
                    return
                end
                -- A user's second press (or another menu's unowned input) takes priority.
                -- Releasing it before our scheduled phase must not cause a third press.
                control.pending=nil
                control.lastCalibration=nil
                control.lastReason="Your saved Skill 3 input took priority over the automatic second press"
            end
        end
    end
    local function manualSkillHeld(binding: any): boolean
        if not binding then return false end
        local main=held(binding) or control.manual[signature(binding)]==true
        local modifier=binding.modifier
        return main and (not modifier or held(modifier) or control.manual[signature(modifier)]==true)
    end
    local function nativeSkillTool(): any
        local own=player.Character
        if not own or not own.Parent or own:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Itadori' then return nil end
        local controller=control.nativeTool
        if not controller or type(controller.ReturnKey)~="function" or type(controller.UseKey)~="function" then return nil end
        local ok,tool=pcall(controller.ReturnKey,controller,3)
        local character=player.Character
        local moveset=character and character:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
        if not ok or character~=own or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Itadori' or not tool or tool.Name~='Divergent Fist'
            or not moveset or not tool:IsDescendantOf(moveset) or tool:GetAttribute("Service")~="DivergentFistService" or tool:GetAttribute("Key")~=3 then return nil end
        return tool
    end
    local function callNative(callback,...)
        local counter=menu.nativeCounter
        if counter and type(counter.callNative)=="function" then return counter.callNative(callback,...) end
        return pcall(callback,...)
    end
    local function releaseNativeSkill()
        local record=control.nativeHeld
        if not record then return end
        control.nativeHeld=nil
        -- A physical hold belongs to the user; the game's own release will finish it.
        if manualSkillHeld(record.binding) or record.character~=player.Character or nativeSkillTool()~=record.tool then return end
        local ok=callNative(control.nativeTool.UseKey,control.nativeTool,3,"Deactivated")
        if ok then control.nativeReleaseCount+=1 else control.lastReason="Native Skill 3 release was unavailable" end
    end
    local function requestNativeSkill(action: string, pending: any?): boolean
        if control.nativeHeld then return false end
        local tool=nativeSkillTool()
        if not tool then control.lastReason="Native Divergent Fist skill is unavailable";return false end
        local binding
        if bindings and type(bindings.get)=="function" then local ok,value=pcall(bindings.get,"Move3");if ok then binding=value end end
        if action~="Continuation" and action~="PerfectStart" and manualSkillHeld(binding) then control.lastReason="Your saved Skill 3 input has priority over a new cast";return false end
        if nativeSkillTool()~=tool then control.lastReason='The native Vessel skill changed before dispatch';return false end
        local now=clock()
        local dispatch={action=action,at=now,phase=pending and pending.track and pending.track.TimePosition,window=pending and pending.window,variant=pending and pending.id,requestAt=pending and pending.requestAt,deadline=pending and pending.deadline,delay=pending and pending.deadline and control.requestDelay}
        control.nativeHeld={character=player.Character,tool=tool,binding=binding,action=action,at=now}
        control.nativeDispatch=dispatch
        local ok,problem=callNative(control.nativeTool.UseKey,control.nativeTool,3,"Activated")
        control.nativeDispatch=nil
        control.lastNativeRequest=dispatch
        if not ok then releaseNativeSkill();control.lastReason="Native Skill 3 request was unavailable: "..tostring(problem);return false end
        -- The native method returns no dispatch/result boolean. Count requests, not hits.
        control.nativeUseCount+=1
        return true
    end
    local function jumpHeld(): boolean
        local ok,service=pcall(host.game.GetService,host.game,"ContextActionService")
        if not ok or not service then return false end
        local read,info=pcall(service.GetBoundActionInfo,service,"jumpAction")
        if not read or type(info)~="table" then return false end
        for _,key in info.inputTypes or {} do
            if key.EnumType==host.Enum.KeyCode and input:IsKeyDown(key) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function restoreJump()
        local record=control.jump
        control.jump=nil
        if record and record.humanoid.Parent and record.changed and record.humanoid.Jump==true and not jumpHeld() then record.humanoid.Jump=record.previous end
    end
    cancel=function(reason: string?)
        control.generation+=1
        control.pending,control.movement=nil,nil
        control.perfectAttempt=nil
        control.chainLength=0;control.lastTarget=nil;control.lastConfirmedAt=nil
        control.lastCalibration=nil
        control.firstRequest=nil
        for track,connection in control.trackConnections do connection:Disconnect();control.trackConnections[track]=nil end
        table.clear(control.seen)
        releaseNativeSkill();restoreJump()
        if reason then control.lastReason=reason end
    end
    local function detachControls()
        local hook=control.movementHook
        control.movementHook=nil
        control.movementReady=false
        if hook then
            hook.active=false
            if hook.controller.GetMoveVector==hook.wrapper then hook.controller.GetMoveVector=hook.original end
        end
    end
    local function modelFrom(value: any): any
        if kindOf(value)~="Instance" then return nil end
        if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
        return if value:IsA("Model") then value else value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    end
    local function validTarget(target: any, character: any): boolean
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(target)) then return false end
        local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        local humanoid=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local ownRoot=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return target~=nil and target~=character and target.Parent~=nil and folder~=nil and target:IsDescendantOf(folder) and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and root~=nil and ownRoot~=nil and (root.Position-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude<=control.range
    end
    local function permitted(character: any, continuation: any?, waitingRecovery: boolean?): boolean
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput() then return false end
        if not control.alive or not (control.enabled or control.autoEnabled) or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or character~=player.Character or not character or not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute("Moveset")~="Itadori" then return false end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local id=continuation and continuation.Animation and continuation.Animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
        local ownContinuation=waitingRecovery==true or (continuation and continuation.IsPlaying and continuation.Speed>0 and control.nativeIds[id]==true)
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0)>0 or (not ownContinuation and character:GetAttribute("Stun")==true) or character:GetAttribute("TrueStun")==true or character:GetAttribute("TrueRagdoll")==true or character:GetAttribute("CompleteRagdoll")==true then return false end
        if bindings and bindings.manualBlockHeld then local ok,manual=pcall(bindings.manualBlockHeld);if not ok or manual then return false end end
        local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if state==states.Ragdoll or state==states.Physics or state==states.FallingDown or state==states.GettingUp or state==states.Dead then return false end
        if not ownContinuation and info:FindFirstChild("Stun") then return false end
        for _,name in {"Block","TrueStun","TrueRagdoll","CompleteRagdoll","Knockback","DomainClash","Throwable"} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end end
        return true
    end
    local function manualMovementHeld(): boolean
        for _,name in {"W","A","S","D","Up","Down","Left","Right"} do
            local key=host.Enum.KeyCode[name]
            if key and input:IsKeyDown(key) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function clearLine(target: any, character: any): boolean
        if not host.RaycastParams or not host.workspace.Raycast then return false end
        local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetRoot=target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local params=host.RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
        local direction=targetRoot.Position-root.Position
        local hit=if menu.visibilityRaycast then menu.visibilityRaycast(root.Position,direction,params) else host.workspace:Raycast(root.Position,direction,params)
        return not hit or (hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target))==true
    end
    local function chooseTarget(character: any): any
        local locked=menu.environment and modelFrom(menu.environment.LockedTarget)
        if validTarget(locked,character) and clearLine(locked,character) then return locked end
        if validTarget(control.lastTarget,character) and clearLine(control.lastTarget,character) then return control.lastTarget end
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        local recent=tracker and tracker.lastHitTarget
        if validTarget(recent,character) and tracker.lastHitAt and clock()-tracker.lastHitAt<=2 and clearLine(recent,character) then return recent end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and type(lock.closest)=="function" then
            local ok,value=pcall(lock.closest)
            local target=ok and modelFrom(value)
            if validTarget(target,character) and clearLine(target,character) then return target end
        end
        if control.nativeTool and type(control.nativeTool.GetTarget)=="function" then
            local ok,value=pcall(control.nativeTool.GetTarget,control.nativeTool,control.range)
            local target=ok and modelFrom(value)
            if validTarget(target,character) and clearLine(target,character) then return target end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function nativeCastActive(pending)
        local character=pending.character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local stun=info and info:FindFirstChild("Stun")
        if stun and (not stun:IsA("BoolValue") or stun.Value==true) then return false end
        if info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill") then return true end
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then for _,track in humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            local id=track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
            if track.IsPlaying and track.Speed>0 and control.nativeIds[id] and not (pending.nativeFirst.excluded and pending.nativeFirst.excluded[track]) then return true end
        end end
        return false
    end
    local function armNativeFirst(first)
        if not control.autoEnabled or not first then return end
        control.pending={nativeFirst=first,character=first.character,requiresTarget=false,generation=control.generation,at=clock(),requestAt=first.at,deadline=first.at+control.requestDelay,method=control.method}
        control.lastReason="Waiting for Second Use Delay after your native first press"
    end
    function control.onAnimation(track: any)
        if not track.IsPlaying or track.Speed<=0 then return end
        local id=track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
        local character=player.Character
        if not control.nativeIds[id] or control.seen[track] or not permitted(character,track) then return end
        local perfect=control.enabled and control.perfectAttempt
        if control.enabled and (not perfect or perfect.phase~="Casting" or perfect.continuationSent) then return end
        local target=if perfect then perfect.target else chooseTarget(character)
        if not target and not control.autoEnabled then control.lastReason="Lock a nearby visible target or hit one first";return end
        syncTiming(id)
        local first=control.firstRequest
        if first and first.excluded and first.excluded[track] then return end
        if not first or first.claimed or first.character~=character or first.tool~=nativeSkillTool() or clock()-first.at>0.5 or clock()<first.at then control.lastReason="Waiting for a verified native first Skill 3 request";return end
        local deadline=first.at+control.requestDelay
        if clock()>deadline+0.06 then control.lastReason="Native second-use deadline already passed";return end
        first.claimed=true
        control.seen[track]=true
        if track.Stopped then
            local connection
            connection=track.Stopped:Connect(function()
                control.seen[track]=nil
                if control.pending and control.pending.track==track and not control.pending.nativeFirst then control.pending=nil end
                if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
                control.trackConnections[track]=nil
            end)
            control.trackConnections[track]=connection
        end
        control.pending={track=track,id=id,nativeFirst=if control.autoEnabled then first else nil,method=control.method,character=character,target=target,requiresTarget=perfect~=nil,perfect=perfect,generation=control.generation,at=clock(),requestAt=first.at,deadline=deadline}
        control.lastReason="Waiting for the saved delay from the native first request"
    end
    function control.onEffect(kind: string, attacker: any, victim: any, effectSource: string?)
        if control.alive and attacker==player.Character and effectSource=="DivergentFistService" and kind=="DivergentSwing" then
            if victim==true then control.blackflashSwings+=1 elseif victim==false then control.ordinarySwings+=1 end
            return
        end
        local requestTrack=control.lastCalibration and control.lastCalibration.track or control.pending and control.pending.track
        -- Recording a genuine native hit may happen during the attack's own stun.
        -- Movement and subsequent actions still wait for the real native recovery.
        if attacker~=player.Character or not permitted(attacker,requestTrack,true) then return end
        if kind~="BlackFlashHit" and kind~="BlackFlashChain" and kind~="BlackFlashFinisher" and kind~="BlackFlashFinisherHard" then return end
        local previous=control.lastEffect
        local requestAt=control.lastNativeRequest and control.lastNativeRequest.at
        if previous and previous.attacker==attacker and previous.victim==victim and previous.requestAt==requestAt and clock()-previous.at<0.05
            and (previous.kind==kind or acceptedEffect(previous.kind) and acceptedEffect(kind)) then return end
        control.lastEffect={source=effectSource,kind=kind,attacker=attacker,victim=victim,at=clock(),requestAt=requestAt}
        control.lastNativeEffectSource=effectSource
        control.confirmedHits+=1
        if kind:find("Finisher",1,true) then
            control.lastCompletedChainLength=math.min(control.chainLength+1,control.maxChainHits)
            cancel("Native Black Flash finisher confirmed");control.chainLength=0;return
        end
        local calibration=control.lastCalibration
        if acceptedEffect(kind) and (effectSource==nil or effectSource=="DivergentFistService") and calibration and calibration.character==attacker and clock()-calibration.at<=0.35 and (not calibration.target or calibration.target==victim) then
            -- Confirmation does not retime later requests or learn from frame overshoot.
            control.requestDelayVerified=true
            syncTiming(calibration.id);persist()
            control.lastCalibration=nil
        end
        if not control.enabled then
            control.lastReason="Native Black Flash confirmed; standalone timing leaves movement to you"
            return
        end
        local attempt=control.perfectAttempt
        if attempt and attempt.target==victim and attempt.continuationSent then
            control.perfectCompleted+=1;control.lastCompletedChainLength=1
            cancel("One native Black Flash confirmed; no automatic follow-up")
        else control.lastReason="Native Black Flash observed; no automatic follow-up" end
    end
    local function movementAllowed(record: any): boolean
        if record.cancelled or not control.enabled or not permitted(record.character) or not validTarget(record.target,record.character) or record.generation~=control.generation or clock()-record.at>control.movementSeconds then return false end
        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        for _,name in {"NoMove","NoMovement","TrueRagdoll","CompleteRagdoll"} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) or record.character:GetAttribute(name)==true then return false end end
        local skill=info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        if record.phase=="Preparing" and skill then return false end
        return not skill or skill.Value~=false or info:FindFirstChild("AllowDashInSkill")~=nil
    end
    local function cameraBasis(): (any, any)
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil,nil end
        local look=camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local forward=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if forward.Magnitude<0.001 then return nil,nil end
        forward=forward.Unit
        return forward,host.Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
    end
    local function targetFacing(record: any): (boolean, any)
        local root=record.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local target=record.target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local delta=host.Vector3.new(target.Position.X-root.Position.X,0,target.Position.Z-root.Position.Z)
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
        look=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if delta.Magnitude<0.1 or look.Magnitude<0.001 then return false,nil end
        return look.Unit:Dot(delta.Unit)>=0.95,delta.Unit
    end
    function control.inRearCone(record: any): boolean
        if not record or not validTarget(record.target,record.character) then return false end
        local root=record.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local target=record.target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local radial=host.Vector3.new(root.Position.X-target.Position.X,0,root.Position.Z-target.Position.Z)
        local look=target.CFrame.LookVector
        local back=host.Vector3.new(-look.X,0,-look.Z)
        return radial.Magnitude>=0.5 and radial.Magnitude<=math.min(control.range,control.backDistance+0.8)
            and back.Magnitude>0.001 and radial.Unit:Dot(back.Unit)>=math.cos(math.rad(control.rearConeDegrees))
    end
    local function orbitDirection(record: any): any
        local root=record.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local target=record.target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local radial=host.Vector3.new(root.Position.X-target.Position.X,0,root.Position.Z-target.Position.Z)
        local look=target.CFrame.LookVector
        local back=host.Vector3.new(-look.X,0,-look.Z)
        if radial.Magnitude<0.1 or back.Magnitude<0.001 then return nil end
        back=back.Unit
        local waypoint=target.Position+back*control.backDistance
        local final=host.Vector3.new(waypoint.X-root.Position.X,0,waypoint.Z-root.Position.Z)
        record.reached=control.inRearCone(record) and final.Magnitude<=0.8
        if record.reached then
            local facing,direction=targetFacing(record)
            control.lastReason=if facing then "Rear cone and native character facing are ready" else "Normal movement is turning toward the target before the first Skill 3"
            return if facing then nil else direction
        end
        local direction=radial.Unit
        local angle=math.atan2(direction.X*back.Z-direction.Z*back.X,direction:Dot(back))
        local turn=math.clamp(angle,-0.45,0.45)
        local rotated=host.Vector3.new(direction.X*math.cos(turn)-direction.Z*math.sin(turn),0,direction.X*math.sin(turn)+direction.Z*math.cos(turn))
        local nextPoint=target.Position+rotated*control.backDistance
        local delta=host.Vector3.new(nextPoint.X-root.Position.X,0,nextPoint.Z-root.Position.Z)
        return if delta.Magnitude>0.01 then delta.Unit else final.Unit
    end
    local function nativeManualVector(controller: any, fallback: any): any
        local own=control.movementHook
        local getter=own and own.controller==controller and own.original
        local approach=menu.m1Approach and menu.m1Approach.movementHook
        if getter and approach and approach.active and approach.controller==controller and getter==approach.wrapper then getter=approach.original end
        if not getter or (own and getter==own.wrapper) then return fallback end
        local ok,raw=pcall(getter,controller)
        return if ok then raw else fallback
    end
    function control.movementVector(raw: any, controller: any): any
        local record=control.movement
        if not record or not movementAllowed(record) then return nil end
        local manual=nativeManualVector(controller,raw)
        record.manualActive=not manual or manual.Magnitude>0.001 or manualMovementHeld()
        if record.manualActive then record.cancelled=true;control.lastReason="Manual movement takes priority";return nil end
        local direction=orbitDirection(record)
        if not direction then return nil end
        local forward,right=cameraBasis()
        if record.method=="Side" and not record.dashRequested and not record.reached then
            if not right then return nil end
            local sign=if direction:Dot(right)>=0 then 1 else -1
            record.side=sign
            direction=right*sign
        end
        if type(controller.IsMoveVectorCameraRelative)~="function" then return nil end
        if controller:IsMoveVectorCameraRelative() then
            if not forward or not right then return nil end
            direction=host.Vector3.new(direction:Dot(right),0,-direction:Dot(forward))
        end
        return direction
    end
    function control.attachControls()
        local character=player.Character
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not character or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Itadori' then detachControls();return end
        if not control.controls then
            local scripts=player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
            local module=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if module then local ok,value=pcall(function() return host.require(module):GetControls() end);if ok then control.controls=value end end
        end
        local active=control.controls and control.controls.activeController
        local current=control.movementHook
        if current and current.active and current.controller==active then
            if active.GetMoveVector==current.wrapper then return end
            local approach=menu.m1Approach and menu.m1Approach.movementHook
            if approach and approach.active and approach.controller==active and approach.original==current.wrapper and active.GetMoveVector==approach.wrapper then return end
        end
        detachControls()
        if not active or type(active.GetMoveVector)~="function" then return end
        local hook: any={controller=active,original=active.GetMoveVector,active=true}
        hook.wrapper=function(self: any,...: any): any
            local raw=hook.original(self,...)
            if not hook.active or control.movementHook~=hook or not control.alive then return raw end
            local ok,direction=pcall(control.movementVector,raw,active)
            if not ok then control.lastReason="Normal rear preparation was skipped: "..tostring(direction);return raw end
            return direction or raw
        end
        active.GetMoveVector=hook.wrapper
        control.movementHook=hook
        control.movementReady=true
    end
    local function movementStep(record: any)
        if record.cancelled or not control.enabled or not permitted(record.character,nil,true) or not validTarget(record.target,record.character)
            or record.generation~=control.generation or clock()-record.at>control.movementSeconds then control.movement=nil;return end
        local character=record.character
        local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid.Health<record.health then control.movement=nil;control.lastReason="Incoming damage stopped rear preparation";return end
        local active=control.controls and control.controls.activeController
        local raw=active and nativeManualVector(active,nil)
        if not raw or raw.Magnitude>0.001 or manualMovementHeld() then record.manualActive=true;record.cancelled=true;control.movement=nil;control.lastReason="Manual movement has priority over rear preparation";return end
        record.manualActive=false
        if record.manualActive or manualMovementHeld() or not movementAllowed(record) or info:FindFirstChild("InDash") then return end
        local skill=info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        if skill and skill.Value==false and not info:FindFirstChild("AllowDashInSkill") then return end
        if record.reached then
            local facing=targetFacing(record)
            if not facing then control.lastReason="Waiting for normal character facing before the next Skill 3";return end
            local moveset=character:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
            local move
            if moveset then for _,candidate in moveset:GetChildren() do
                if candidate:GetAttribute("Service")=="DivergentFistService" and candidate:GetAttribute("Key")==3 then move=candidate;break end
            end end
            if not move or move:GetAttribute("Paused")==true then control.lastReason="Native Divergent Fist tool is unavailable or paused";return end
            -- A single native action request lets the game decide availability.
            if not control.inRearCone(record) or not clearLine(record.target,character) then record.reached=false;return end
            record.phase="Casting";record.firstAt=clock()
            control.perfectAttempt=record
            if requestNativeSkill("PerfectStart") then
                control.perfectStarts+=1
                control.movement=nil
                control.lastReason="Requested the first native Skill 3 from the rear cone"
            else control.perfectAttempt=nil;record.phase="Preparing" end
            return
        end
        if record.method=="Hop" and not record.jumpRequested then
            if info:FindFirstChild("NoJump") then return end
            if humanoid.FloorMaterial==host.Enum.Material.Air then return end
            local jumpAvailable=if humanoid.UseJumpPower then humanoid.JumpPower>0 else humanoid.JumpHeight>0
            if not jumpAvailable or humanoid.Jump or jumpHeld() then control.movement=nil;control.lastReason="Manual jump or native jump restriction has priority";return end
            control.jump={humanoid=humanoid,previous=humanoid.Jump,changed=true}
            humanoid.Jump=true
            record.jumpRequested=true
            control.lastReason="Requested a normal hop after confirmed Black Flash"
        elseif record.method=="Side" and not record.dashRequested then
            if info:FindFirstChild("NoDash") then return end
            local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
            local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not camera or not root then return end
            local look=camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local frame=host.CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position+host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z))
            local forward=math.round(humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(frame.LookVector))
            local side=math.round(humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(frame.RightVector))
            if forward~=0 or side==0 then control.lastReason="Waiting for normal sideways movement before the saved dash input";return end
            local binding=bindings.get("Dash")
            if manualSkillHeld(binding) then control.movement=nil;control.lastReason="Your saved Dash input has priority";return end
            local native=control.nativeMovement
            if not native or type(native.DashRequest)~="function" then control.movement=nil;control.lastReason="Native dash controller is unavailable";return end
            if not permitted(character) then control.movement=nil;return end
            record.dashRequested=true;control.nativeDashRequests+=1
            local ok=pcall(native.DashRequest,native)
            if not ok then control.movement=nil;control.lastReason="Native dash request was unavailable";return end
            control.lastReason="Requested one native "..(if side>0 then "right" else "left").." dash"
        end
    end
    local function step()
        control.attachControls()
        releaseNativeSkill();restoreJump()
        local pending=control.pending
        if pending then
            local perfect=pending.perfect
            local validRear=not perfect or (control.perfectAttempt==perfect and control.inRearCone(perfect)
                and targetFacing(perfect) and not manualMovementHeld() and clearLine(perfect.target,perfect.character))
            if not validRear then cancel("The target left the rear cone or manual movement took priority")
            elseif not permitted(pending.character,pending.track,pending.nativeFirst~=nil) or (pending.requiresTarget and not validTarget(pending.target,pending.character)) or pending.generation~=control.generation or (not pending.nativeFirst and (not pending.track.IsPlaying or pending.track.Speed<=0)) or clock()-pending.at>3 then control.pending=nil
            elseif clock()+0.0000001>=pending.deadline then
                control.pending=nil
                local timely=clock()<=pending.deadline+0.06
                if timely and (not pending.nativeFirst or nativeCastActive(pending)) and (not pending.requiresTarget or clearLine(pending.target,pending.character)) and requestNativeSkill("Continuation",pending) then
                    control.lastCalibration={id=pending.id,track=pending.track,method=pending.method,time=pending.track and pending.track.TimePosition,requestAt=pending.requestAt,deadline=pending.deadline,at=clock(),character=pending.character,target=if pending.requiresTarget then pending.target else nil}
                    control.continuationRequests+=1
                    if perfect then perfect.continuationSent=true;perfect.phase="Awaiting confirmation" end
                    control.lastReason="Requested native Skill 3 continuation; awaiting native hit confirmation"
                else control.lastReason="Continuation skipped: native window, sight line or saved input unavailable" end
            end
        end
        if control.movement and not control.held and not control.nativeHeld then movementStep(control.movement) end
        local attempt=control.perfectAttempt
        if attempt and ((attempt.phase=="Preparing" and not control.movement)
            or (attempt.firstAt and clock()-attempt.firstAt>1.5)
            or not validTarget(attempt.target,attempt.character)) then cancel("One-shot preparation or native confirmation expired") end
    end
    local function observeCharacter(character: any)
        cancel(if control.enabled or control.autoEnabled then "Waiting for a native Vessel activation" else "Auto Black Flash and Auto Perfect Black Flash are disabled")
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        control.lastTarget=nil
        control.chainLength=0
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then
            if character then connect(character.ChildAdded,function(child) if child:IsA("Humanoid") and character==player.Character then observeCharacter(character) end end,control.characterConnections) end
            return
        end
        connect(humanoid.AnimationPlayed,function(track)
            local first=control.firstRequest
            if first and first.excluded then first.excluded[track]=nil end
            control.onAnimation(track)
        end,control.characterConnections)
        connect(humanoid.Died,function() cancel("Your character died") end,control.characterConnections)
        if type(character.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function' then
            connect(character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Moveset'),function()
                if character~=player.Character then return end
                cancel('Native moveset changed; waiting for a Vessel action')
                control.attachControls()
            end,control.characterConnections)
        end
    end
    local function refreshMode(wasActive: boolean)
        local active=control.enabled or control.autoEnabled
        if not active then
            control.lastEffect=nil
            control.chainLength=0
            cancel("Auto Black Flash and Auto Perfect Black Flash are disabled")
        elseif not wasActive then
            control.lastEffect=nil
            control.chainLength=0
            cancel("Waiting for a native Vessel continuation animation")
        elseif not control.autoEnabled and control.pending then
            local pending=control.pending
            pending.requiresTarget=true
            if not validTarget(pending.target,pending.character) then
                pending.target=chooseTarget(pending.character)
                if not pending.target then control.pending=nil;control.lastReason="Perfect Black Flash needs a nearby visible target" end
            end
        end
        control.attachControls()
        if active then
            local humanoid=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then for _,track in humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do control.onAnimation(track) end end
        end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(_value: boolean)
        -- Retired feature: old profiles cannot restart rear movement.
        local wasActive=control.enabled or control.autoEnabled
        control.enabled=false
        control.movement=nil
        control.chainLength=0
        restoreJump()
        if control.nativeHeld and control.nativeHeld.action~="Continuation" then releaseNativeSkill() end
        refreshMode(wasActive)
    end
    function control.setAutoEnabled(value: boolean)
        local wasActive=control.enabled or control.autoEnabled
        control.autoEnabled=control.alive and control.ready and value==true
        if control.autoEnabled then control.enabled=false;cancel("Normal Auto Black Flash is active; rear preparation is disabled") end
        if control.autoEnabled and control.pending then control.pending.requiresTarget=false end
        refreshMode(wasActive)
    end
    function control.setMethod(value: string)
        if value~="Hop" and value~="Side" then return end
        cancel("Perfect Black Flash preparation method changed")
        control.method=value
        control.activeVariant=FIRST_VARIANT
        syncTiming();persist()
    end
    function control.setWindow(_value: number, _source: string?)
        -- Retired control: old config callbacks cannot restore animation-phase timing.
        syncTiming();persist()
    end
    function control.useProfiles()
        -- Retired control: archived profiles do not replace the native request delay.
        syncTiming();persist()
    end
    function control.setRange(value: number)
        local amount=tonumber(value) or 6
        if amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then amount=6 end
        control.range=math.clamp(amount,0,5/0.28)
        cancel("Perfect Black Flash target range changed")
    end
    function control.setRequestDelay(value: number)
        local seconds=tonumber(value)
        if not seconds or seconds~=seconds or math.abs(seconds)==math.huge then return end
        control.requestDelay=math.clamp(seconds,0.05,0.4)
        control.requestDelayVerified=false
        cancel("Native second-use delay changed")
        syncTiming();persist()
    end
