    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.enabled=false
        control.autoEnabled=false
        cancel("Auto Perfect Black Flash was unloaded")
        detachControls()
        control.alive=false
        local hook=control.requestHook
        if hook then hook.active=false;if hook.signal.Fire==hook.wrapper then hook.signal.Fire=hook.original end end
        local skillHook=control.skillHook
        if skillHook then skillHook.active=false;if skillHook.controller.UseKey==skillHook.wrapper then skillHook.controller.UseKey=skillHook.original end end
        local toolHook=control.toolHook
        if toolHook then toolHook.active=false;if toolHook.controller.UseTool==toolHook.wrapper then toolHook.controller.UseTool=toolHook.original end end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.characterConnections)
    end
    local animations=replicated:FindFirstChild("Animations")
    local set=animations and animations:FindFirstChild("Itadori")
    local variants=set and set:FindFirstChild("Variants")
    if variants then for _,animation in variants:GetChildren() do if animation:IsA("Animation") then local id=animation.AnimationId:match("%d+");if ids[id] then control.nativeIds[id]=true end end end end
    local knitFolder=replicated:FindFirstChild("Knit")
    local knitModule=knitFolder and knitFolder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
    local loaded,knit=false,nil
    if knitModule then loaded,knit=pcall(host.require,knitModule) end
    local found,service=false,nil
    if loaded and knit then found,service=pcall(knit.GetService,"DivergentFistService") end
    local controllerFound,controller=false,nil
    if loaded and knit and type(knit.GetController)=="function" then controllerFound,controller=pcall(knit.GetController,"ToolController") end
    control.nativeTool=if controllerFound then controller else nil
    if loaded and knit and type(knit.GetController)=="function" then
        local ok,native=pcall(knit.GetController,"MovementController")
        if ok and native and type(native.DashRequest)=="function" then control.nativeMovement=native end
    end
    control.nativeActionReady=controllerFound and controller~=nil and type(controller.UseKey)=="function" and type(controller.ReturnKey)=="function"
    control.ready=next(control.nativeIds)~=nil and found and service~=nil and service.Effects~=nil and control.nativeActionReady and bindings~=nil and type(bindings.get)=="function"
    if not control.ready then control.lastReason="Native Vessel continuation signals or saved bindings are unavailable";return control end
    if type(controller.UseTool)=="function" then
        local hook: any={controller=controller,original=controller.UseTool,active=true}
        hook.wrapper=function(self,tool,action,...)
            if not hook.active or not control.alive or not control.autoEnabled then
                return hook.original(self,tool,action,...)
            end
            local first
            if hook.active and control.alive and control.autoEnabled and not control.nativeDispatch and action=="Activated" and tool==nativeSkillTool() then
                if control.pending then
                    control.pending=nil;control.firstRequest=nil;control.lastCalibration=nil
                    control.lastReason="Your native second press took priority"
                elseif permitted(player.Character,nil,true) then
                    local now=clock()
                    local excluded={}
                    local humanoid=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid then for _,track in humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do if track.IsPlaying then excluded[track]=true end end end
                    first={at=now,character=player.Character,tool=tool,excluded=excluded,initialInputSeen=control.lastSkillEdgeAt~=nil and now-control.lastSkillEdgeAt<=0.03}
                    control.firstRequest=first
                    armNativeFirst(first)
                end
            end
            control.activationDepth=(control.activationDepth or 0)+1
            local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,tool,action,...))
            control.activationDepth-=1
            if not result[1] then
                if first and control.firstRequest==first then control.firstRequest=nil;control.pending=nil end
                error(result[2],0)
            end
            -- Either native animation/activation order is valid. Reconcile only
            -- at this actual tool boundary, never from an unrelated animation.
            if first and control.firstRequest==first and not first.claimed then
                local humanoid=first.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid then for _,track in humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do control.onAnimation(track) end end
            end
            return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
        end
        controller.UseTool=hook.wrapper
        control.toolHook=hook
    end
    do
        local hook: any={controller=controller,original=controller.UseKey,active=true}
        hook.wrapper=function(self: any,key: any,action: any,...: any): ...any
            if not hook.active or not control.alive or not control.enabled or control.nativeDispatch or key~=3 or not nativeSkillTool() then
                return hook.original(self,key,action,...)
            end
            if action=="Deactivated" and control.movement and control.movement.phase=="Preparing" then return end
            if action~="Activated" then return hook.original(self,key,action,...) end
            if control.perfectAttempt then
                cancel("A manual Skill 3 activation took priority over the one-shot preparation")
                return hook.original(self,key,action,...)
            end
            local character=player.Character
            if not permitted(character) then return hook.original(self,key,action,...) end
            local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
            local target=chooseTarget(character)
            if not target or info:FindFirstChild("InSkill") then
                control.lastReason="Rear preparation skipped: no nearby visible target or native skill is busy"
                return
            end
            control.attachControls()
            local active=control.controls and control.controls.activeController
            local raw=active and nativeManualVector(active,nil)
            if not control.movementReady or not raw or raw.Magnitude>0.001 or manualMovementHeld() then
                control.lastReason="Rear preparation skipped: native movement unavailable or manual movement has priority"
                return
            end
            cancel()
            local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local now=clock()
            local record={phase="Preparing",character=character,target=target,method=control.method,at=now,
                generation=control.generation,health=humanoid.Health,
                initialInputSeen=control.lastSkillEdgeAt and now-control.lastSkillEdgeAt<=0.03}
            control.perfectAttempt,control.movement=record,record
            control.lastReason="Preparing one rear-cone Black Flash before the first native Skill 3"
            -- Start ordinary preparation immediately at the user's native action boundary.
            orbitDirection(record)
            movementStep(record)
            return
        end
        controller.UseKey=hook.wrapper
        control.skillHook=hook
    end
    if service.Activated and type(service.Activated.Fire)=="function" then
        local hook: any={signal=service.Activated,original=service.Activated.Fire,active=true}
        hook.wrapper=function(self: any,...: any): ...any
            if not hook.active or not control.alive or not (control.autoEnabled or control.enabled) then
                return hook.original(self,...)
            end
            local tool=select(1,...)
            if hook.active and control.alive and tool and tool==nativeSkillTool() then
                if control.nativeDispatch then
                    if control.nativeDispatch.action=="PerfectStart" then control.firstRequest={at=clock(),character=player.Character,tool=tool} end
                elseif (control.activationDepth or 0)>0 then
                    -- The owning UseTool wrapper already observed this request.
                elseif control.perfectAttempt then
                    cancel("An external native Skill 3 activation took priority over rear preparation")
                elseif control.pending then
                    control.pending=nil;control.lastCalibration=nil;control.firstRequest=nil
                    control.lastReason="A native manual Skill 3 second use took priority"
                else
                    -- A new user's cast never reuses an old victim.
                    control.movement=nil;control.chainLength=0;control.lastTarget=nil;restoreJump()
                    local now=clock()
                    control.firstRequest={at=now,character=player.Character,tool=tool,initialInputSeen=control.lastSkillEdgeAt~=nil and now-control.lastSkillEdgeAt<=0.03}
                    armNativeFirst(control.firstRequest)
                end
            end
            return hook.original(self,...)
        end
        service.Activated.Fire=hook.wrapper
        control.requestHook=hook
    end
    for _,name in {"DivergentFistService","ItadoriService"} do
        local capturedName=name
        local available,native=pcall(knit.GetService,name)
        if available and native and native.Effects then
            control.nativeSignals[name]=true
            connect(native.Effects,function(kind,attacker,victim) control.onEffect(kind,attacker,victim,capturedName) end)
        end
    end
    connect(input.InputBegan,function(event) observeInput(event,true) end)
    connect(input.InputEnded,function(event) observeInput(event,false) end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() control.focused=false;cancel("Window focus was lost") end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function()
        control.focused=true
        for key in control.manual do
            local kind,name=key:match("^([^:]+):(.+)$")
            if kind and name and not held({kind=kind,name=name}) then control.manual[key]=nil end
        end
    end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function() cancel("Your character is being removed") end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,observeCharacter)
    connect(run.Heartbeat,step)
    if player.Character then observeCharacter(player.Character) end
    return control
end

return BlackflashChain
end)()

local DirectionalLock = (function(): any
-- Releases menu-owned facing without changing native attack/recovery states.
local DirectionalLock: {[string]: any} = {}
function DirectionalLock.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local hasGuiService,guiService=pcall(host.game.GetService,host.game,'GuiService')
    if not hasGuiService then guiService=nil end
    -- On from the first frame: the toggle's backend must never start out of step with the switch the player sees.
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=true,connections={},lastReason='Normal character facing is available'}
    function control.step()
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then return end
        if menu.localCharacterEmoting and menu.localCharacterEmoting(player.Character) then
            control.lastReason='Native emote owns character rotation';return
        end
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local returning=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.characterRelease
        if returning and returning.assistReturn and returning.character==player.Character then
            control.lastReason='Smooth assist return owns facing';return
        end
        local turn=assist and assist.aimTurnState
        local now=(host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock)()
        if turn and turn.at and now>=turn.at and now-turn.at<=.1 then
            control.lastReason='Active assist owns facing';return
        end
        local shared=menu.environment and menu.environment._G
        if shared then shared.CharacterLockActive=false end
        if menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation then menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation() end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand then return end
        for _,name in {'Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Stun','TrueStun','NoRotate','NoRotation'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0) then control.lastReason='Native recovery currently owns rotation';return end
        end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info then return end
        for _,name in {'Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Stun','TrueStun','NoRotate','NoRotation','InSkill'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then control.lastReason='Native action currently owns rotation';return end
        end
        humanoid.AutoRotate=true
        control.lastReason='Normal character facing is available'
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: boolean)
        control.enabled=control.alive and value==true
        if menu.applyLockMode then menu.applyLockMode() end
        if control.enabled then control.step() else control.lastReason='Anti Directional Lock is disabled' end
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,host.game:GetService('RunService').Heartbeat:Connect(control.step))
    table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(control.step))
    -- Visual camera collision only. Keep native mouse input, requested zoom,
    -- character physics and cutscene ownership intact.
    control.cameraThroughWalls=false
    local function releaseCameraOcclusion()
        local hook=control.cameraOcclusionHook
        control.cameraOcclusionHook=nil
        if not hook then return end
        hook.active=false
        if hook.owner.Update==hook.wrapper then hook.owner.Update=hook.original end
    end
    function control.setCameraThroughWalls(value)
        if not control.alive then return false end
        control.cameraThroughWalls=value==true
        if not control.cameraThroughWalls then releaseCameraOcclusion();return true end
        local existing=control.cameraOcclusionHook
        if existing and existing.active and existing.owner.Update==existing.wrapper then return true end
        releaseCameraOcclusion()
        local ok,message=pcall(function()
            local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
            local playerModule=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('PlayerModule')
            local cameras=playerModule and playerModule:FindFirstChild('CameraModule')
            local module=cameras and cameras:FindFirstChild('Poppercam')
            assert(module and type(host.require)=='function','Native camera collision module is unavailable')
            local native=host.require(module)
            assert(type(native)=='table'and type(native.Update)=='function','Native camera collision API is unavailable')
            local hook={owner=native,original=native.Update,active=true}
            hook.wrapper=function(self,dt,desiredFrame,desiredFocus,...)
                local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
                local own=player.Character;local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                if hook.active and control.alive and control.cameraThroughWalls and camera
                    and host.Enum.CameraType and camera.CameraType==host.Enum.CameraType.Custom
                    and hum and hum.Health>0 and camera.CameraSubject==hum and desiredFrame and desiredFocus then
                    control.cameraOcclusionBypasses=(control.cameraOcclusionBypasses or 0)+1
                    return desiredFrame,desiredFocus
                end
                return hook.original(self,dt,desiredFrame,desiredFocus,...)
            end
            native.Update=hook.wrapper
            control.cameraOcclusionHook=hook
        end)
        control.cameraThroughWallsReady=ok
        control.cameraThroughWallsReason=if ok then 'Native obstruction zoom bypass is active'else tostring(message)
        if not ok then control.cameraThroughWalls=false end
        return ok
    end
    control.setCameraThroughWalls(true)
    -- Visual framing only: no root, joint, velocity, or collision writes.
    control.shiftOffsetsEnabled=false
    control.shiftOffsetReference='Camera'
    control.shiftCharacterOffset={X=0,Y=0,Z=0}
    control.shiftCameraOffset={X=0,Y=0,Z=0}
    -- Move the game's actual cursor without changing its shoulder framing.
    -- Direct screen-pixel offsets, with positive Y pointing up.
    control.shiftCursorEnabled=false
    control.shiftCursorOffset={X=0,Y=0}
    control.shiftCursorFocused=true
    control.shiftCursorResolveAttempts=0
    control.shiftCursorWarpRetries=0
    local cursorClock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local behavior=host.Enum.MouseBehavior
    local function cursorInputPermitted()
        if not control.alive or not control.shiftCursorFocused then return false end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false end
        if type(host.isrbxactive)=='function' then
            local ok,active=pcall(host.isrbxactive)
            if not ok or not active then return false end
        end
        if input.GetFocusedTextBox and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        if guiService and guiService.MenuIsOpen then return false end
        if menu.recording or menu.menuKeyCapturing then return false end
        if menu.panel and menu.panel.Main and menu.panel.Main.Visible then return false end
        for _,popup in {menu.popup,menu.valuePopup,menu.ui and menu.ui.colorPopup} do
            if popup and popup.Parent and popup.Visible~=false then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.nativeShiftLocked()
        if behavior and input.MouseBehavior==behavior.LockCenter then return true end
        local lease=control.shiftCursorLease
        return lease~=nil and lease.active and behavior~=nil
            and (input.MouseBehavior==behavior.LockCurrentPosition or lease.warping and input.MouseBehavior==behavior.Default)
            or false
    end
    function control.shiftCursorActive()
        return control.shiftCursorEnabled and cursorInputPermitted() and control.nativeShiftLocked()
    end
    local function shiftedCursorPoint(camera)
        local offset=control.shiftCursorOffset
        local point=camera.ViewportSize*.5+host.Vector2.new(offset.X,-offset.Y)
        local left,top,right,bottom=0,0,0,0
        if guiService and type(guiService.GetGuiInset)=='function' then
            local ok,inset,opposite=pcall(guiService.GetGuiInset,guiService)
            if ok and inset and opposite then
                left,top=math.max(0,inset.X),math.max(0,inset.Y)
                right,bottom=math.max(0,opposite.X),math.max(0,opposite.Y)
            end
        end
        local maximumX=math.max(0,camera.ViewportSize.X-1-right)
        local maximumY=math.max(0,camera.ViewportSize.Y-1-bottom)
        return host.Vector2.new(math.clamp(point.X,math.min(left,maximumX),maximumX),
            math.clamp(point.Y,math.min(top,maximumY),maximumY))
    end
    function control.cursorCenter(_camera)
        return input:GetMouseLocation()
    end
    local function resetCursorWarpRetries()
        control.shiftCursorWarpRetries=0
        control.shiftCursorRetryAfter=nil
        control.shiftCursorWarpBlocked=nil
    end
    local function restoreNativeCursor()
        local lease=control.shiftCursorLease
        control.shiftCursorLease=nil
        if not lease then return end
        lease.active=false
        local native=lease.native
        local ownsBehavior=native.utils.setMouseBehaviorOverride==lease.behaviorWrapper
        if ownsBehavior then native.utils.setMouseBehaviorOverride=lease.originalBehavior end
        local ownsRotation=native.cameraInput.getRotation==lease.rotationWrapper
        if ownsRotation then native.cameraInput.getRotation=lease.originalRotation end
        local ok,values=pcall(native.debug.getupvalues,native.cameraFunction)
        if ok and values[native.inputIndex]==lease.proxy then
            pcall(native.debug.setupvalue,native.cameraFunction,native.inputIndex,native.input)
        end
        -- Never overwrite a later owner's behavior or restore a gameplay lock
        -- while a menu, text field, or unfocused window needs its free pointer.
        if ownsBehavior and (input.MouseBehavior==behavior.LockCurrentPosition
            or lease.warping and input.MouseBehavior==behavior.Default) then
            local requested=lease.lastNativeBehavior or behavior.LockCenter
            pcall(lease.originalBehavior,if cursorInputPermitted() then requested else behavior.Default)
        end
    end
    local function resolveNativeCursor()
        if control.shiftCursorNative then return control.shiftCursorNative end
        local now=cursorClock()
        if control.shiftCursorResolveAttempts>=3 or now<(control.shiftCursorResolveAfter or 0) then return nil end
        control.shiftCursorResolveAttempts+=1;control.shiftCursorResolveAfter=now+2
        local ok,native=pcall(function()
            local debugApi=host.debug or debug
            assert(type(host.getgc)=='function' and debugApi and type(debugApi.info)=='function'
                and type(debugApi.getupvalues)=='function' and type(debugApi.setupvalue)=='function','Native cursor inspection is unavailable')
            assert(behavior and behavior.LockCurrentPosition and behavior.Default,'Native cursor lock modes are unavailable')
            local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
            local module=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('PlayerModule')
            local cameraModule=module and module:FindFirstChild('CameraModule')
            local utilsModule=cameraModule and cameraModule:FindFirstChild('CameraUtils')
            local inputModule=cameraModule and cameraModule:FindFirstChild('CameraInput')
            assert(utilsModule and inputModule and type(host.require)=='function','Native camera input modules are unavailable')
            local utils,cameraInput=host.require(utilsModule),host.require(inputModule)
            assert(type(utils.setMouseBehaviorOverride)=='function' and type(cameraInput.getRotation)=='function'
                and type(cameraInput.resetInputForFrameEnd)=='function','Native cursor handoff is unavailable')
            -- Failsafe gives this component a guarded UIS view. The native
            -- camera closure captures the actual service, so use the original
            -- environment only for identity, virtual positioning and restoring
            -- that lease. Permission checks and normal input access above stay
            -- on the guarded view.
            local nativeInput=input
            local nativeGame=menu.environment and menu.environment.game
            if nativeGame and type(nativeGame.GetService)=='function' then
                local found,service=pcall(nativeGame.GetService,nativeGame,'UserInputService')
                if found and service then nativeInput=service end
            end
            local cameraFunction,inputIndex,cameraLine
            local constants=debugApi.getconstants or host.getconstants
            assert(type(constants)=='function','Native camera input signature inspection is unavailable')
            -- Resolve only the verified game camera owner. This scan is bounded
            -- to three lazy attempts, then cached; it never runs per frame.
            for _,value in host.getgc() do
                if type(value)~='function' then continue end
                local inspected,source,line=pcall(debugApi.info,value,'sl')
                if not inspected or type(source)~='string' or not source:find('MovementController',1,true) then continue end
                local gotConstants,capturedConstants=pcall(constants,value)
                if not gotConstants or type(capturedConstants)~='table' then continue end
                local signature={}
                for _,constant in capturedConstants do if type(constant)=='string' then signature[constant]=true end end
                if not (signature.Head and signature.CurrentCamera and signature.CFrame and signature.CameraRelative
                    and signature.MouseBehavior and signature.LockCenter) then continue end
                local read,upvalues=pcall(debugApi.getupvalues,value)
                if not read then continue end
                for index,upvalue in upvalues do
                    if upvalue==nativeInput then
                        assert(not cameraFunction,'Native camera input owner is ambiguous')
                        cameraFunction,inputIndex,cameraLine=value,index,line
                    end
                end
            end
            assert(cameraFunction,'Verified native camera input owner is unavailable')
            local virtual=nativeInput:CreateVirtualInput()
            assert(virtual and type(virtual.SendMousePosition)=='function','Native cursor positioning is unavailable')
            return {debug=debugApi,cameraFunction=cameraFunction,inputIndex=inputIndex,cameraLine=cameraLine,input=nativeInput,utils=utils,cameraInput=cameraInput,virtual=virtual}
        end)
        control.shiftCursorSupported=ok
        if not ok then control.shiftCursorReason=tostring(native);return nil end
        control.shiftCursorNative=native
        return native
    end
    local function beginCursorWarp(lease,goal)
        lease.warping,lease.started,lease.sentAt,lease.goal=true,cursorClock(),nil,goal
        -- Keep genuine mouse capture while positioning is pending. Default is
        -- needed only inside the non-yielding native position transaction.
        lease.originalBehavior(behavior.LockCurrentPosition)
    end
    local function installNativeCursor(native,goal)
        local lease={active=true,native=native,originalBehavior=native.utils.setMouseBehaviorOverride,originalRotation=native.cameraInput.getRotation}
        local forwarded={}
        local function requested(value)
            if lease.active then lease.lastNativeBehavior=value end
            if lease.active and control.shiftCursorEnabled and cursorInputPermitted() and value==behavior.LockCenter then
                return behavior.LockCurrentPosition
            end
            return value
        end
        lease.proxy=setmetatable({}, {
            __index=function(_,key)
                local value=native.input[key]
                if type(value)~='function' then return value end
                if not forwarded[key] then forwarded[key]=function(_,...)return value(native.input,...)end end
                return forwarded[key]
            end,
            __newindex=function(_,key,value)native.input[key]=if key=='MouseBehavior' then requested(value) else value end,
        })
        lease.behaviorWrapper=function(value,...)return lease.originalBehavior(requested(value),...)end
        lease.rotationWrapper=function(...)
            return lease.originalRotation(...)
        end
        control.shiftCursorLease=lease
        local ok,reason=pcall(function()
            assert(native.debug.getupvalues(native.cameraFunction)[native.inputIndex]==native.input,'Native input owner has changed')
            native.debug.setupvalue(native.cameraFunction,native.inputIndex,lease.proxy)
            native.utils.setMouseBehaviorOverride=lease.behaviorWrapper
            native.cameraInput.getRotation=lease.rotationWrapper
            beginCursorWarp(lease,goal)
        end)
        if not ok then
            restoreNativeCursor();control.shiftCursorReason=tostring(reason);control.shiftCursorSupported=false
            control.shiftCursorNative=nil;control.shiftCursorResolveAttempts=3
            return nil
        end
        return lease
    end
    function control.updateShiftCursorVisual()
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not control.shiftCursorActive() or not camera or not camera.ViewportSize then
            restoreNativeCursor();resetCursorWarpRetries();return
        end
        if control.shiftCursorOffset.X==0 and control.shiftCursorOffset.Y==0 then restoreNativeCursor();return end
        if not control.shiftRun then control.shiftCursorSupported=false;control.shiftCursorReason='Native cursor render handoff is unavailable';return end
        local point=shiftedCursorPoint(camera)
        local lease=control.shiftCursorLease
        if not lease then
            if control.shiftCursorWarpBlocked or cursorClock()<(control.shiftCursorRetryAfter or 0) then return end
            local native=resolveNativeCursor()
            if not native then return end
            lease=installNativeCursor(native,point)
            if not lease then return end
        end
        local ok,reason=pcall(function()
            assert(lease.native.utils.setMouseBehaviorOverride==lease.behaviorWrapper
                and lease.native.cameraInput.getRotation==lease.rotationWrapper,'Native cursor hooks have a new owner')
            local now=cursorClock()
            local moved=(point-lease.goal).Magnitude>.5
            local drifted=not lease.warping and (input:GetMouseLocation()-lease.goal).Magnitude>1
            if lease.warping or moved or drifted or now>=(lease.nextOwnershipCheck or 0) then
                assert(lease.native.debug.getupvalues(lease.native.cameraFunction)[lease.native.inputIndex]==lease.proxy,'Native input upvalue has a new owner')
                lease.nextOwnershipCheck=now+1
            end
            if moved then beginCursorWarp(lease,point) end
            if lease.warping then
                if not lease.sentAt and now-lease.started>=.1 then
                    local released,releaseReason=pcall(lease.originalBehavior,behavior.Default)
                    local sent,sendReason=false,nil
                    if released then sent,sendReason=pcall(lease.native.virtual.SendMousePosition,lease.native.virtual,lease.goal) end
                    -- Always reclaim the real cursor, including a throwing or
                    -- asynchronous positioning API. No rendered frame may be
                    -- left with a free pointer or suppressed camera rotation.
                    local locked,lockReason=pcall(lease.originalBehavior,behavior.LockCurrentPosition)
                    assert(locked,lockReason)
                    assert(released,releaseReason)
                    assert(sent,sendReason)
                    lease.sentAt=now
                end
                if lease.sentAt then
                    if (input:GetMouseLocation()-lease.goal).Magnitude<=1 then
                        -- Acknowledged positioning must lock immediately. A
                        -- fixed free-pointer wait lets real mouse movement
                        -- take the cursor away before this acknowledgement.
                        lease.native.cameraInput.resetInputForFrameEnd()
                        lease.originalBehavior(behavior.LockCurrentPosition);lease.warping=false
                        resetCursorWarpRetries()
                        control.shiftCursorReason='Native cursor positioned'
                    elseif now-lease.started>=.5 then
                        restoreNativeCursor()
                        control.shiftCursorWarpRetries+=1
                        control.shiftCursorWarpBlocked=control.shiftCursorWarpRetries>=3
                        control.shiftCursorRetryAfter=now+.35
                        -- The owner/API were validated. Position contention
                        -- is transient, not proof that native input is absent.
                        control.shiftCursorSupported=true
                        control.shiftCursorReason=if control.shiftCursorWarpBlocked then
                            'Native cursor positioning interrupted; retry after shift lock, focus, or setting changes'
                            else 'Native cursor positioning interrupted; retrying shortly'
                        return
                    end
                end
            elseif drifted then beginCursorWarp(lease,point) end
        end)
        if not ok then
            restoreNativeCursor();control.shiftCursorSupported=false;control.shiftCursorReason=tostring(reason)
            -- A rejected positioning method must not keep recentering the user.
            control.shiftCursorNative=nil;control.shiftCursorResolveAttempts=3
        end
    end
    function control.updateNativeCursorBeforeCamera()
        local lease=control.shiftCursorLease
        -- Inspect the completed prior native frame. CameraUtils can request
        -- Default before MovementController requests Center in the same frame.
        -- A final native Default means shift lock ended, even during a warp.
        if lease and lease.lastNativeBehavior and lease.lastNativeBehavior~=behavior.LockCenter then
            restoreNativeCursor();return
        end
        control.updateShiftCursorVisual()
    end
    local function refreshCursor()
        control.updateShiftCursorVisual()
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and lock.updateFovVisual then lock.updateFovVisual() end
    end
    function control.setShiftCursorEnabled(value)
        local enabled=value==true
        if enabled and not control.shiftCursorEnabled then
            control.shiftCursorResolveAttempts=0;control.shiftCursorResolveAfter=nil;resetCursorWarpRetries()
        end
        control.shiftCursorEnabled=enabled;refreshCursor()
    end
    function control.setShiftCursorOffset(axis,value)
        local maximum=if axis=='X' or axis=='Y' then 4096 else nil
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not maximum or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        local offset=math.clamp(amount,-maximum,maximum)
        if control.shiftCursorOffset[axis]~=offset then resetCursorWarpRetries() end
        control.shiftCursorOffset[axis]=offset
        refreshCursor();return true
    end
    function control.clearShiftOffset()
        local applied=control.shiftOffsetApplied
        control.shiftOffsetApplied=nil
        if applied and applied.camera==host.workspace.CurrentCamera and applied.camera.CFrame==applied.frame then
            applied.camera.CFrame=applied.frame-applied.delta
        end
    end
    function control.setShiftOffsetsEnabled(value)
        control.shiftOffsetsEnabled=value==true
        if not control.shiftOffsetsEnabled then control.clearShiftOffset() end
    end
    function control.setShiftOffsetReference(value)
        if not table.find({'Cursor','Camera','Character'},value) then return false end
        control.shiftOffsetReference=value;return true
    end
    function control.setShiftOffset(kind,axis,value)
        local vector=if kind=='Character' then control.shiftCharacterOffset elseif kind=='Camera' then control.shiftCameraOffset else nil
        if not vector or vector[axis]==nil or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        vector[axis]=math.clamp(value,-20,20);return true
    end
    function control.shiftOffsetsPermitted()
        local env=menu.environment or {}
        local own=player.Character;local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return control.alive and control.shiftOffsetsEnabled and hum and hum.Health>0
            and control.nativeShiftLocked()
            and not env.LockedTarget and not env.LockConn
    end
    function control.applyShiftOffset()
        control.updateShiftCursorVisual()
        if not control.shiftOffsetsPermitted() then control.clearShiftOffset();return end
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local own=player.Character;local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not camera or not root then return end
        local frame=camera.CFrame;local reference=frame
        if control.shiftOffsetReference=='Character' then reference=root.CFrame
        elseif control.shiftOffsetReference=='Cursor' then
            local cursor=control.cursorCenter(camera)
            local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(cursor.X,cursor.Y)
            reference=host.CFrame.lookAt(frame.Position,frame.Position+ray.Direction)
        end
        local a,b=control.shiftCharacterOffset,control.shiftCameraOffset
        local delta=frame:VectorToWorldSpace(host.Vector3.new(b.X,b.Y,b.Z))-reference:VectorToWorldSpace(host.Vector3.new(a.X,a.Y,a.Z))
        if delta.Magnitude<.00001 then return end
        local result=frame+delta
        camera.CFrame=result
        control.shiftOffsetApplied={camera=camera,frame=result,delta=delta}
    end
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    if run.BindToRenderStep and host.Enum.RenderPriority then
        control.shiftRun=run
        run:BindToRenderStep('ShenaniganismNativeCursorWarp',host.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value-2,control.updateNativeCursorBeforeCamera)
        run:BindToRenderStep('ShenaniganismShiftOffsetRestore',host.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value-1,control.clearShiftOffset)
        run:BindToRenderStep('ShenaniganismShiftOffsetApply',host.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,control.applyShiftOffset)
    end
    if input.WindowFocusReleased then table.insert(control.connections,input.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
        control.shiftCursorFocused=false;control.updateShiftCursorVisual()
    end)) end
    if input.WindowFocused then table.insert(control.connections,input.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
        control.shiftCursorFocused=true;control.updateShiftCursorVisual()
    end)) end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.enabled=false
        control.cameraThroughWalls=false;releaseCameraOcclusion()
        restoreNativeCursor()
        control.alive=false
        control.clearShiftOffset()
        if control.shiftRun then
            control.shiftRun:UnbindFromRenderStep('ShenaniganismNativeCursorWarp')
            control.shiftRun:UnbindFromRenderStep('ShenaniganismShiftOffsetRestore')
            control.shiftRun:UnbindFromRenderStep('ShenaniganismShiftOffsetApply')
        end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end
    return control
end
return DirectionalLock
end)()

local FrontDash = (function(): any
-- Scale a verified native Chase Swing argument once. The game owns the mover,
-- easing, collision checks, lifetime, animation and request/cooldown behavior.
-- Verified capture: ordinary Mahito Front -> root.SwingForce, 0.6 s, -65 local Z.
local FrontDash: {[string]: any} = {}

function FrontDash.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local kindOf: any = host.typeof or typeof
    local debugInfo = if host.debug and host.debug.info then host.debug.info else debug.info
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, enabled = false, ready = false, focused = true,
        multiplier = 1, minimumMultiplier = 0.25, maximumMultiplier = 3,
        requestWindow = 0.5, generation = 0, armed = nil, connections = {},
        used = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        observedRequests = 0, frontDashes = 0, modifiedDashes = 0,
        lastReason = "Front Dash Multiplier is disabled",
        assistGuidedEnabled = true, assistDashRadius = 3.5, assistedDashes = 0,
    }
    local handicap, original, wrapper
    local world = host.workspace
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    control.cameraRelativeReady = world ~= nil and run ~= nil and run.PreSimulation ~= nil
        and host.CFrame ~= nil and host.Vector3 ~= nil and host.RaycastParams ~= nil and host.Enum ~= nil
    control.cameraDashes = 0
    control.cameraUsed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local cameraParams
    if control.cameraRelativeReady then
        cameraParams = host.RaycastParams.new()
        cameraParams.FilterType = host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
        cameraParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {world:FindFirstChild("Map")}
    end

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end
    local function vectorFinite(value: any): boolean
        return kindOf(value) == "Vector3" and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z)
    end
    local function positive(value: any): boolean
        return value == true or (finite(value) and value > 0)
    end
    local function cancel()
        control.generation += 1
        control.armed, control.cameraArmed = nil, nil
    end
    local function connect(signal: any, callback: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect) == "function" then table.insert(control.connections, signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function available(character: any, cameraOnly: boolean?): boolean
        if not control.alive or (not cameraOnly and not control.enabled) or not control.focused or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or menu.recording or menu.alive == false then return false end
        if not character or character ~= player.Character or not character.Parent then return false end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.PlatformStand then return false end
        for _, name in {"Dead", "Ragdoll", "CompleteRagdoll", "TrueRagdoll", "TrueStun"} do
            if positive(character:GetAttribute(name)) then return false end
        end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return false end
        -- Chase itself adds Stun/InSkill. Incoming knockback and other recovery
        -- are different states and must keep their native movement untouched.
        for _, name in {"Knockback", "TrueStun", "Ragdoll", "CompleteRagdoll", "TrueRagdoll"} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end

    function control.setMultiplier(value: number)
        local amount = tonumber(value)
        control.multiplier = if finite(amount) then math.clamp(amount, control.minimumMultiplier, control.maximumMultiplier) else 1
    end
    function control.setEnabled(enabled: boolean)
        control.enabled = control.alive and control.ready and enabled == true
        cancel()
        control.lastReason = if control.enabled then "Waiting for a native front-dash Chase request" else "Front Dash Multiplier is disabled"
    end
    function control.setAssistGuidedEnabled(value: boolean)
        if type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.assistGuidedEnabled=value
        return true
    end
    -- Side Input Only: a dash circles only when you hold left or right. A plain front
    -- dash goes straight at the target. Always Arc: the older behaviour. Never: no circling.
    control.dashCircleMode='Always Arc'
    function control.setDashCircleMode(value: any)
        if value~='Front Dash Only' and value~='Side Input Only' and value~='Always Arc' and value~='Never (Straight)' then return false end
        control.dashCircleMode=value
        return true
    end
    -- While a forward dash is circling its enemy, Auto Block, Block Assist and Auto Punish step aside.
    control.dashIgnoresBlock=false
    function control.setDashIgnoresBlock(value: any)
        control.dashIgnoresBlock=value==true
        return true
    end
    control.overpower=true
    function control.setOverpower(value: any)
        control.overpower=value==true
        return true
    end
    function control.circlingActive(): boolean
        local record=control.cameraDash
        return control.overpower==true and record~=nil and record.guidanceInitialized==true and record.guidanceDropped~=true and record.guidanceRole~=nil
    end
    function control.setAssistDashRadius(value: number)
        if not finite(value) then return false end
        control.assistDashRadius=math.clamp(value,1,30)
        return true
    end

    -- The enemy a forward dash circles: your lock target, else the closest enemy in front of your camera. M1,
    -- Block, Skill, Counter and Punish assists have no say in it.
    local function capturedAssist(root: any)
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and type(lock.dashAssistTarget)=='function' then
            local target=lock.dashAssistTarget('Lock')
            local other=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if other and vectorFinite(other.Position) and (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=100
                and (type(lock.inLockRange)~='function' or lock.inLockRange(target)) then return target,'Lock' end
        end
        local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        if not folder then return nil end
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local look=if camera then camera.CFrame.LookVector else root.CFrame.LookVector
        local flatLook=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if flatLook.Magnitude<.001 then return nil end
        flatLook=flatLook.Unit
        local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        local best,bestDistance=nil,math.huge
        for _,model in folder:GetChildren() do
            local other=model~=player.Character and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local humanoid=other and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if other and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and model:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true
                and not(excluded and excluded(model)) and vectorFinite(other.Position) then
                local delta=host.Vector3.new(other.Position.X-root.Position.X,0,other.Position.Z-root.Position.Z)
                local distance=delta.Magnitude
                if distance>.5 and distance<=45 and distance<bestDistance and delta.Unit:Dot(flatLook)>=.34 then best,bestDistance=model,distance end
            end
        end
        if best then return best,'Free' end
        return nil
    end
    function control.guidedDashDirection(record: any, root: any, localDirection: any)
        if record.guidanceDropped then return nil end
        if not record.guidanceInitialized then
            record.guidanceInitialized=true
            -- Block and dash stay out of each other's way: a dash made while you guard is never steered around anyone.
            local info=record.character and record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local block=menu.autoBlock
            if control.dashIgnoresBlock and (info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')~=nil
                or block and (block.held~=nil or type(block.manualBlockHeld)=='function' and block.manualBlockHeld()==true)) then
                record.guidanceDropped=true;return nil
            end
            if control.assistGuidedEnabled then record.guidanceTarget,record.guidanceRole=capturedAssist(root) end
            if not record.guidanceTarget then record.guidanceDropped=true;return nil end
            local sideInput=math.abs(localDirection.X)>.01
            if control.dashCircleMode=='Never (Straight)' or (control.dashCircleMode=='Side Input Only' and not sideInput)
                or (control.dashCircleMode=='Front Dash Only' and (sideInput or localDirection.Z>-.5)) then
                record.guidanceDropped=true;return nil
            end
            record.orbitSign=if localDirection.X<-.01 then -1 else 1
            record.orbitRadius=control.assistDashRadius
            control.assistedDashes+=1
        end
        local target,role=record.guidanceTarget,record.guidanceRole
        local lock,assist=menu.autoLock,menu.m1AimAssist
        local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        local other=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local hum=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local targetInfo=target and target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local maximum=if role=='Lock' then 100 elseif role=='Free' then 60 else assist and assist.maximumRange or 80
        local invalid=not control.assistGuidedEnabled or not target or not target.Parent or target==record.character
            or not other or not vectorFinite(other.Position) or not hum or hum.Health<=0
            or target:GetAttribute('Dead')==true or targetInfo and targetInfo:FindFirstChild('Dead')~=nil
            or record.targetRoot and record.targetRoot~=other
            or role~='Free' and (not lock or type(lock.dashAssistTarget)~='function' or lock.dashAssistTarget(role)~=target)
            or excluded and excluded(target) or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()
            or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()
        if not invalid then
            local separation=other.Position-root.Position
            invalid=not vectorFinite(separation) or separation.Magnitude>maximum or math.abs(separation.Y)>45
            if role=='Lock' and type(lock.inLockRange)=='function' and not lock.inLockRange(target) then invalid=true end
        end
        if invalid then record.guidanceDropped=true;return nil end
        local now=clock()
        if record.targetPosition and record.targetAt then
            local age=now-record.targetAt
            local velocity=other.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local speed=if vectorFinite(velocity) then math.min(velocity.Magnitude,400) else 0
            if age<0 or age>.25 or (other.Position-record.targetPosition).Magnitude>math.max(12,speed*age*3+3) then
                record.guidanceDropped=true;return nil
            end
        end
        record.targetPosition,record.targetAt,record.targetRoot=other.Position,now,other
        local point=other.Position
        local prediction=assist and assist.aimPrediction and assist.aimPrediction[role]
        if prediction and type(assist.predictAimPoint)=='function' then
            -- Share the assist's measured lead, without its camera-relative
            -- visual offsets. Moving the free camera cannot steer this dash.
            assist.predictAimPoint(root,target,role,point)
            local forecast=assist.aimForecasts and assist.aimForecasts[role]
            if forecast and vectorFinite(forecast.lead) then point+=forecast.lead end
        else
            local velocity=other.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if vectorFinite(velocity) and velocity.Magnitude<=400 then
                local lead=velocity*.08
                if lead.Magnitude>2 then lead=lead.Unit*2 end
                point+=lead
            end
        end
        local delta=host.Vector3.new(point.X-root.Position.X,0,point.Z-root.Position.Z)
        local distance=delta.Magnitude
        local inward
        if distance>.05 then inward=delta.Unit;record.lastRadial=inward
        else
            inward=record.lastRadial
            if not inward then
                local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
                inward=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
                inward=if inward.Magnitude>.001 then inward.Unit else host.Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
            end
        end
        if not record.radiusInitialized then
            record.radiusInitialized=true
            if math.abs(localDirection.X)>.5 then record.orbitRadius=math.max(control.assistDashRadius,distance) end
        end
        local tangent=host.Vector3.new(-inward.Z,0,inward.X)*record.orbitSign
        local direction
        if localDirection.Z>.5 then direction=-inward
        elseif math.abs(localDirection.X)>.5 then
            local correction=math.clamp((distance-record.orbitRadius)/math.max(1,record.orbitRadius)*2,-.8,.8)
            direction=tangent+inward*correction
        else
            local radial=math.clamp((distance-record.orbitRadius)/math.max(1,record.orbitRadius),-1,1)
            direction=inward*radial+tangent*math.sqrt(math.max(0,1-radial*radial))
        end
        if not vectorFinite(direction) or direction.Magnitude<.001 then record.guidanceDropped=true;return nil end
        record.guidancePoint,record.guidanceDirection=point,direction.Unit
        control.lastGuidanceRole=role
        return record.guidanceDirection
    end

    -- Called from the already-owned M1Assist UseSetService wrapper. Installing
    -- another ToolController wrapper would break its native-caller test.
    local function verifiedChaseCaller(caller: any): boolean
        if type(caller)~='function' then return false end
        local okay,source,line=pcall(debugInfo,caller,'sl')
        if not okay or type(source)~='string'or not source:match('Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$')then return false end
        if line==343 then return true end
        -- The native request moved to 407 without changing its Chase
        -- captures or literal contract. Keep the same complete validation;
        -- recognizing the request does not infer its charge/pursuit layout.
        if line~=398 and line~=407 then return false end
        local read=host.getupvalues or(host.debug and host.debug.getupvalues)
        local constants=host.getconstants or(host.debug and host.debug.getconstants)
        if type(read)~='function'or type(constants)~='function'then return false end
        local captured,values=pcall(read,caller)
        local inspected,literals=pcall(constants,caller)
        if not captured or type(values)~='table'or values[1]~=player or type(values[2])~='table'
            or type(values[2].Dash)~='table'or type(values[2].Dash.Fire)~='function'
            or type(values[3])~='table'or type(values[3].GetToolService)~='function'or type(values[3].UseSetService)~='function'
            or not finite(values[4])or values[4]<10000000 or not finite(values[6])or values[6]<0 or values[6]>2 or values[6]%1~=0
            or not inspected or type(literals)~='table'then return false end
        local signature={}
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        for _,literal in literals do
            if dash and type(dash.normalizeNativeDashConstant)=='function'then literal=dash.normalizeNativeDashConstant(caller,literal)end
            if type(literal)=='string'or finite(literal)then signature[literal]=true end
        end
        for _,literal in {'Front','Back','Chase','UseSetService','DisableChase','Knockback','Block','Stun','InSkill','NoDash','NoSprint','Toji','COATM',.4,.3,.45,.8}do
            if not signature[literal]then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.observeNativeChase(caller: any): boolean
        if type(caller) ~= "function" or not available(player.Character, true) then return false end
        if not verifiedChaseCaller(caller)then return false end
        if control.cameraRelativeReady then control.cameraArmed = {character = player.Character, at = clock()} end
        if not control.enabled then return false end
        control.observedRequests += 1
        control.armed = {character = player.Character, at = clock(), generation = control.generation}
        control.lastReason = "Native front-dash Chase request observed"
        return true
    end

    function control.matchesFront(root: any, mover: any, duration: any, velocity: any): boolean
        local record = control.armed
        if not record or record.generation ~= control.generation or not available(record.character) then return false end
        local age = clock()-record.at
        if not finite(age) or age < 0 or age > control.requestWindow then control.armed = nil; return false end
        if kindOf(mover) ~= "Instance" or not mover:IsA("BodyVelocity") or mover.Name ~= "SwingForce" or control.used[mover] then return false end
        local character = record.character
        local nativeRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not nativeRoot or root ~= nativeRoot or mover.Parent ~= nativeRoot then return false end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info or not info:FindFirstChild("DisableChase") then return false end
        -- This is the measured native ordinary-Chase signature, not a blanket
        -- change to every forward attack using HandicapController.Swing.
        if not finite(duration) or math.abs(duration-0.6) > 0.001 or not vectorFinite(velocity) then return false end
        local horizontal = math.sqrt(velocity.X*velocity.X+velocity.Z*velocity.Z)
        if not finite(horizontal) or horizontal < 0.001 or velocity.Z >= 0 or math.abs(velocity.X) > horizontal*0.02 or math.abs(velocity.Y) > horizontal*0.02 then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function stopCameraDash()
        local record = control.cameraDash
        control.cameraDash = nil
        if record and record.connection then record.connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    local sideWrapper, sideCaller
    local function verifiedSideDashCaller(caller: any, line: any, name: any): boolean
        if line==114 then return true end
        -- The current native side/back Dash moved from114 to123. Its name
        -- and line alone cannot prove ownership: match the exact original
        -- captured by our still-owned DashControl wrapper, once per wrapper.
        if line~=123 or name~='Dash' or type(caller)~='function' then return false end
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        local read=host.getupvalues or(host.debug and host.debug.getupvalues)
        local current=dash and dash.movement and dash.movement.Dash
        if not dash or type(dash.hooked)~='function' or not dash.hooked()
            or type(current)~='function' or type(read)~='function' then return false end
        if sideWrapper~=current then
            sideWrapper,sideCaller=current,nil
            local readable,values=pcall(read,current)
            if not readable or type(values)~='table' then return false end
            local count,candidates=0,0
            for _,value in values do
                count+=1;if count>16 then sideCaller=nil;break end
                if type(value)~='function' then continue end
                local okay,source,definition,identifier=pcall(debugInfo,value,'sln')
                if okay and type(source)=='string' and source:match('Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$')
                    and definition==123 and identifier=='Dash' then
                    candidates+=1;sideCaller=value
                end
            end
            if candidates~=1 then sideCaller=nil end
        end
        return sideCaller~=nil and caller==sideCaller
    end
    local function cameraDashMatches(root: any, mover: any, duration: any, velocity: any, source: any, line: any, name: any, caller: any): boolean
        if not control.cameraRelativeReady or control.cameraUsed[mover] or not available(player.Character, true) then return false end
        local character = player.Character
        if root ~= character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or kindOf(mover) ~= "Instance" or not mover:IsA("BodyVelocity") or not vectorFinite(velocity) then return false end
        if not finite(duration) or math.abs(velocity.Y) > .001 or velocity.Magnitude < .001 then return false end
        if mover.Name == "MovementForce" and mover.Parent == character:FindFirstChild("Torso") and math.abs(duration-.4) < .001 then
            return type(source) == "string" and source:match("Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$") ~= nil
                and verifiedSideDashCaller(caller,line,name)
                and (math.abs(velocity.X) < .001 or math.abs(velocity.Z) < .001)
        end
        local armed = control.cameraArmed
        return armed ~= nil and armed.character == character and clock()-armed.at >= 0 and clock()-armed.at <= control.requestWindow
            and mover.Name == "SwingForce" and mover.Parent == root and math.abs(duration-.6) < .001
            and velocity.Z < 0 and math.abs(velocity.X) < velocity.Magnitude*.02
            and character:FindFirstChild("Info"):FindFirstChild("DisableChase") ~= nil
    end
    local function startCameraDash(root: any, mover: any, duration: number, velocity: any, collision: any)
        local speed = mover:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("NumberValue")
        if not speed then return end
        stopCameraDash()
        control.cameraUsed[mover] = true
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local record = {character = character, mover = mover, started = clock(), duration = duration}
        control.cameraArmed = nil
        control.cameraDash = record
        control.cameraDashes += 1
        local localDirection = velocity.Unit
        -- Bind to the actual assist at native mover creation. A later assist
        -- activation must never acquire an ordinary dash already in flight.
        control.guidedDashDirection(record,root,localDirection)
        -- Native Swing owns its speed tween and lifetime. Redirect only this
        -- confirmed dash mover after its native Stepped writer, before physics.
        record.connection = run.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
            if not control.alive or not control.focused or player.Character ~= character or not root.Parent or not mover.Parent or speed.Parent ~= mover
                or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or clock()-record.started > duration+.05 then stopCameraDash(); return end
            local direction=control.guidedDashDirection(record,root,localDirection)
            local forward=direction
            if not direction then
                local camera = world.CurrentCamera
                if not camera then return end
                local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
                forward = host.Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                if not vectorFinite(forward) or forward.Magnitude < .001 then return end
                forward = forward.Unit
                local right = host.Vector3.new(-forward.Z, 0, forward.X)
                direction = right*localDirection.X-forward*localDirection.Z
            end
            local amount = speed.Value
            if not finite(amount) then return end
            local value = direction*amount
            if collision and world:Blockcast(host.CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position+forward), host.Vector3.new(2,2,1), direction*1.8, cameraParams) then
                value = host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            end
            mover.Velocity = value
        end)
    end

    function control.hooked(): boolean
        return control.alive and control.ready and handicap ~= nil and handicap.Swing == wrapper
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive, control.enabled = false, false
        cancel()
        stopCameraDash()
        if handicap and handicap.Swing == wrapper then handicap.Swing = original end
        for _, connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        control.lastReason = "Front Dash Multiplier was unloaded"
    end

    local scripts = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local controllers = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
    local combat = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("Combat")
    local module = combat and combat:FindFirstChild("HandicapController")
    local bridge = menu.m1Assist
    if not module or not bridge or bridge.nativeChaseBridge ~= true or type(bridge.hasRequestHook) ~= "function" or not bridge.hasRequestHook() then
        control.lastReason = "Verified native Chase request bridge is unavailable"
        return control
    end
    local loaded, result = pcall(host.require, module)
    if not loaded or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.Swing) ~= "function" then
        control.lastReason = "Native HandicapController Swing is unavailable"
        return control
    end
    local native, source, line = pcall(debugInfo, result.Swing, "sl")
    if not native or type(source) ~= "string" or not source:match("Controllers%.Combat%.HandicapController$") or (line ~= 55 and line ~= 56) then
        control.lastReason = "Another component owns the native Swing entry"
        return control
    end
    handicap, original = result, result.Swing
    control.nativeSwing, control.handicapController = original, handicap
    wrapper = function(self: any, root: any, mover: any, duration: any, velocity: any, collision: any, ...: any): ...any
        -- A stack frame's line is the current callsite, not its function's
        -- definition. Match the definition of the native dash function.
        local caller=debugInfo(2,'f')
        local source,line,name
        if type(caller)=='function' then source,line,name=debugInfo(caller,'sln') end
        local cameraDash = cameraDashMatches(root, mover, duration, velocity, source, line, name, caller)
        if cameraDash and menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.beginDashFacing then menu.autoLock.beginDashFacing() end
        if control.matchesFront(root, mover, duration, velocity) then
            control.used[mover] = true
            control.armed = nil
            control.frontDashes += 1
            local applied = host.Vector3.new(velocity.X*control.multiplier, velocity.Y, velocity.Z*control.multiplier)
            if vectorFinite(applied) then
                control.lastNativeSpeed = math.sqrt(velocity.X*velocity.X+velocity.Z*velocity.Z)
                control.lastAppliedSpeed = math.sqrt(applied.X*applied.X+applied.Z*applied.Z)
                if control.multiplier ~= 1 then control.modifiedDashes += 1 end
                control.lastReason = "Native front dash scaled; normal easing and duration retained"
                velocity = applied
            end
        end
        local result = table.pack(original(self, root, mover, duration, velocity, collision, ...))
        if cameraDash then startCameraDash(root, mover, duration, velocity, collision) end
        return table.unpack(result, 1, result.n)
    end
    handicap.Swing = wrapper
    control.ready = true
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased, function() control.focused = false; cancel(); stopCameraDash() end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused, function() control.focused = true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving, function() cancel(); stopCameraDash() end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded, function() cancel(); stopCameraDash() end)
    return control
end

return FrontDash
end)()

local NativeCombos = (function(): any
-- Native move continuations. Damage, variants and cooldown acceptance remain game-owned.
-- Evidence: ToolController.UseTool emits Activated(tool, nativeContext). Focus Strike,
-- Brute Force and Cleave Rush have no built-in air/target argument mapping; preserve
-- their observed context through the controller's own ExtraData extension point.
-- GarudaReboundController.Recall(owner, part, startPosition, duration) animates that
-- exact part toward owner's root, then destroys it. Request the same move on
-- observed return; the server still decides whether that rebound is accepted.
local NativeCombos: {[string]: any} = {}
local SPECS = {
    ['Divergent Fist']={service='DivergentFistService',start='Startup',hit='BlackFlashHit',delay=0.33,moveset='Itadori',timed=true},
    ['Focus Strike']={service='FocusStrikeService',start='Startup',hit='BlackFlashHit',delay=0.33,moveset='Mahito',timed=true},
    ['Brute Force']={service='BruteForceService',start='Swing',hit='BlackFlashHit'},
    ['Cleave Rush']={service='CleaveRushService',start='Start',hit='BlackFlashFinisherHard'},
    ['Garuda Rebound']={service='GarudaReboundService',start='Startup',moveset='Yuki'},
    ['Body Repel']={service='BodyRepelService',special=true,moveset='Mahito'},
    ['Resolute Slash']={service='ResoluteSwingService',serviceNames={'ResoluteSwingService','ResoluteSlashService'},start='ChargeEffect',hit='BlackFlash',moveset='Yuta',delay=0.33,timed=true},
}
local function finite(value: any): boolean
    return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)~=math.huge
end
local function activeValue(value: any): boolean
    return value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0)
end

function NativeCombos.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, bindings: any?): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
    local clock=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local dispatchThread: any=nil
    local control: any={alive=true,focused=true,ready=false,features={},connections={},nativeTool=nil,nativeAction='ToolController.UseTool',nativeDispatch=nil,nativeRequests=0,nativeReleases=0,returnRadius=2,garudaPrediction=true,garudaLead=0.03,lastReason='Native combo helpers are disabled'}
    for name,spec in SPECS do
        control.features[name]={name=name,serviceName=spec.service,serviceNames=spec.serviceNames or {spec.service},services={},hooks={},startEffect=spec.start,hitEffect=spec.hit,special=spec.special,moveset=spec.moveset,timed=spec.timed==true,pressTime=0.01,settleTime=0.05,settlingUntil=0,enabled=false,ready=false,suspended=spec.suspendedReason~=nil,suspendedReason=spec.suspendedReason,delay=spec.delay or 0.30,pending=nil,release=nil,hook=nil,requests=0,confirmed=0,starts=0,returns=0,lastReason='Disabled'}
    end
    control.resoluteTeleportEnabled=false
    control.resoluteFinisherDelay=.75
    local function featureEnabled(feature)
        return feature.enabled or feature.name=='Resolute Slash' and control.resoluteTeleportEnabled
    end
    local function callNative(callback,...)
        if menu.nativeCounter and type(menu.nativeCounter.callNative)=='function' then return menu.nativeCounter.callNative(callback,...) end
        return pcall(callback,...)
    end
    local function connect(signal: any,callback: any,list: any?)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(list or control.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function disconnect(list: any)
        for _,connection in list do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(list)
    end
    local qte: any={enabled=false,effective=false,callback=nil,removing=nil,lastReason='Higuruma QTE is disabled'}
    control.legacyQTE=qte
    local function qteCharacter(): any
        local character=player.Character
        if not control.alive or not character or character==qte.removing or not character.Parent
            or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Hiromi' then return nil end
        return character
    end
    function control.refreshLegacyQTE()
        local wanted=qte.enabled and qteCharacter()~=nil and type(qte.callback)=='function'
        if qte.effective==wanted then return end
        qte.effective=wanted
        if qte.callback then
            local ok,message=pcall(qte.callback,wanted)
            if not ok then
                qte.effective=false
                local shared=menu.environment and menu.environment._G
                if shared then shared.HigurumaQTE=false end
                qte.lastReason='Native QTE callback failed: '..tostring(message)
                return
            end
        end
        qte.lastReason=if wanted then 'Higuruma QTE is active for the current Higuruma character'
            elseif qte.enabled then 'Saved Higuruma QTE selection is waiting for Higuruma' else 'Higuruma QTE is disabled'
    end
    function control.bindLegacyQTE(callback: any)
        if not control.alive or type(callback)~='function' or qte.callback==callback then return end
        if qte.callback and qte.effective then pcall(qte.callback,false) end
        qte.callback=callback;qte.effective=nil
        control.refreshLegacyQTE()
    end
    function control.setLegacyQTEEnabled(value: any)
        qte.enabled=control.alive and value==true
        control.refreshLegacyQTE()
    end
    function control.allowsLegacyQTEFire(remote: any,value: any): boolean
        if not qte.enabled or qte.effective~=true or value~=true then return false end
        -- Check immediately before every legacy FireServer call, even if the
        -- character changed between its loop iteration and our next heartbeat.
        local character=qteCharacter()
        if not character or not remote then return false end
        local ok,allowed=pcall(function()
            return remote:IsA('RemoteEvent') and remote.Parent==character and character:FindFirstChild('RemoteEvent')==remote
        end)
        return ok and allowed==true
    end
    local function parse(value: any): any
        local name=if type(value)=='string' then value:gsub('^Enum%.KeyCode%.',''):gsub('^Enum%.UserInputType%.','') else value and value.Name
        local aliases={MouseLeftButton='MouseButton1',MouseRightButton='MouseButton2',MouseMiddleButton='MouseButton3'}
        name=aliases[name] or name
        if not name or name=='None' or name=='Unknown' then return nil end
        if name:match('^MouseButton[123]$') then return {kind='Mouse',name=name} end
        if host.Enum.KeyCode[name] then return {kind='Keyboard',name=name} end
        return nil
    end
    local function savedBinding(slot: any,role: string?): any
        if bindings and type(bindings.get)=='function' then
            local ok,binding=pcall(bindings.get,role or ('Move'..tostring(slot)))
            if ok and binding then return binding end
        end
        local keybind=replicated:FindFirstChild('Keybind')
        local combat=keybind and keybind:FindFirstChild('Combat')
        if not combat then return nil end
        for _,action in combat:GetChildren() do
            local name=action.Name:lower():gsub('[^%w]','')
            local index=name:match('^move([1-4])$') or name:match('^skill([1-4])$') or name:match('^ability([1-4])$') or name:match('^moveslot([1-4])$')
            if (role=='Block' and (name=='block' or name=='blocking')) or (role~='Block' and tonumber(index)==slot) then
                local keyboard=action:FindFirstChild('Keyboard')
                if keyboard and keyboard:IsA('InputBinding') then
                    local binding=parse(keyboard.KeyCode)
                    if binding then binding.modifier=parse(keyboard.PrimaryModifier) end
                    return binding
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function held(binding: any): boolean
        if not binding then return false end
        if binding.kind=='Mouse' then
            local key=host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name]
            return key~=nil and input:IsMouseButtonPressed(key)
        end
        local key=host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name]
        return key~=nil and input:IsKeyDown(key)
    end
    local function bindingEvent(binding: any,event: any): boolean
        if not binding then return false end
        local matches=if binding.kind=='Mouse' then event.UserInputType==host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name] else event.KeyCode==host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name]
        return matches and (not binding.modifier or held(binding.modifier))
    end
    local function manualBlock(): boolean
        if bindings and type(bindings.manualBlockHeld)=='function' then
            local ok,value=pcall(bindings.manualBlockHeld)
            return not ok or value==true
        end
        return held(savedBinding(nil,'Block'))
    end
    -- Original Yuki helpers used bounded Special press/release cycles (100 for
    -- Black Hole, 20 for recharge). Keep that sequence on native actions only.
    local yuki: any={instant=false,recharge=false,dispatching=false,record=nil,requests=0,lastReason='Disabled'}
    control.yukiCharge=yuki
    function control.yukiSoundVolume(sound: any,parent: any): number?
        local session=yuki.audioSession
        local character=player.Character
        if not session or session.character~=character or clock()>session.expires or not character or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Yuki' then return nil end
        local charge=replicated:FindFirstChild('Sounds')
        charge=charge and charge:FindFirstChild('Yuki')
        charge=charge and charge:FindFirstChild('Charge')
        if not charge or not sound or sound.Parent~=charge or not parent or not parent:IsDescendantOf(character) then return nil end
        if session.played then return 0 end
        session.played=true
        return math.min(sound.Volume*0.15,0.2)
    end
    local function yukiAllowed(record)
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or manualBlock()
            or not character or not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Yuki'
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info then return false end
        if record and (record.character~=character or humanoid.Health<record.health) then return false end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','TrueStun','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Knockback','Block','DomainClash','Throwable'} do
            if activeValue(character:GetAttribute(name)) or info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','Physics','FallingDown','GettingUp'} do if states[name] and state==states[name] then return false end end
        return type(control.nativeTool.Special)=='function' and type(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial)=='function'
    end
    local function yukiCall(callback)
        yuki.dispatching=true
        local ok,err=callNative(callback,control.nativeTool)
        yuki.dispatching=false
        return ok,err
    end
    local function cancelYuki(reason)
