        local record=yuki.record;yuki.record=nil
        if record and record.character==player.Character and not held(savedBinding(nil,'Special')) then yukiCall(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial) end
        yuki.lastReason=reason or 'Disabled'
    end
    function control.setYukiInstantEnabled(value)
        yuki.instant=value==true
        cancelYuki('Waiting for your native Yuki Mass activation')
    end
    function control.setYukiRechargeEnabled(value)
        yuki.recharge=value==true
        cancelYuki('Waiting for your native Yuki Mass activation')
    end
    local function yukiStep()
        local record=yuki.record
        if not record then return end
        local now=clock()
        if not (yuki.instant or yuki.recharge) or not yukiAllowed(record) or now-record.at>6 then cancelYuki('Native charge cancelled or timed out');return end
        if record.phase=='Hold' then
            if now>=record.deadline then cancelYuki('Native charge sequence completed; game Charge remains authoritative') end
            return
        end
        local charge=tonumber(record.character:GetAttribute('Charge'))
        if record.cycles>=record.maxCycles or (charge and charge>=100) then
            if yuki.instant then
                local ok=yukiCall(control.nativeTool.Special)
                if not ok then cancelYuki('Native Special unavailable');return end
                record.phase='Hold';record.deadline=now+1.5
            else cancelYuki('Native recharge sequence completed') end
            return
        end
        if not yukiCall(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial) then cancelYuki('Native charge release unavailable');return end
        if not yukiCall(control.nativeTool.Special) then cancelYuki('Native charge activation unavailable');return end
        record.cycles+=1;yuki.requests+=1
        yuki.lastReason='Native Yuki charge cycle '..record.cycles..'/'..record.maxCycles
    end
    local function toolFor(feature: any): any
        local character=player.Character
        local moveset=character and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not moveset or not control.nativeTool or (feature.moveset and character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~=feature.moveset) then return nil end
        for _,tool in moveset:GetChildren() do
            if table.find(feature.serviceNames,tool:GetAttribute('Service')) then
                local slot=tool:GetAttribute('Key')
                if finite(slot) and slot>=1 and slot<=4 then
                    local ok,current=pcall(control.nativeTool.ReturnKey,control.nativeTool,slot)
                    if ok and current==tool then return tool end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function permitted(feature: any,record: any,continuation: boolean): boolean
        local character=record.character
        if feature.name=='Resolute Slash' and (record.finisher or not feature.enabled) then
            local victim=record.teleportVictim;local health=victim and victim.Parent and victim:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if not control.resoluteTeleportEnabled or not health or health.Health<=0 or health.Health>=15 then return false end
        end
        if not control.alive or not featureEnabled(feature) or feature.suspended or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or manualBlock() or character~=player.Character or not character or not character.Parent or toolFor(feature)~=record.tool then return false end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not humanoid or not info or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid.Health<record.health then return false end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','TrueStun','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll'} do
            if activeValue(character:GetAttribute(name)) or info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        for _,name in {'Block','Knockback','DomainClash','Throwable'} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end end
        if not continuation and (activeValue(character:GetAttribute('Stun')) or info:FindFirstChild('Stun') or info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')) then return false end
        local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','Physics','FallingDown','GettingUp'} do if states[name] and state==states[name] then return false end end
        return true
    end
    local function clearPending(feature: any,reason: string?)
        local record=feature.pending
        feature.pending=nil
        if feature.name=='Garuda Rebound' then feature.garudaCast=nil end
        if record and record.connections then disconnect(record.connections) end
        if reason then feature.lastReason=reason;control.lastReason=reason end
    end
    local function releaseSpecial(feature)
        local record=feature.specialHeld
        feature.specialHeld=nil
        if not record or record.character~=player.Character or held(savedBinding(nil,'Special')) then return end
        if type(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial)=='function' then callNative(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial,control.nativeTool) end
    end
    local function bodyRepelSpecial(tool)
        local feature=control.features['Body Repel']
        if not featureEnabled(feature) or feature.specialHeld or tool~=toolFor(feature) or held(savedBinding(nil,'Special')) then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or type(control.nativeTool.Special)~='function' or type(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial)~='function' then return end
        local record={character=character,tool=tool,health=humanoid.Health,at=clock()}
        if not permitted(feature,record,true) then return end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        record.seenInSkill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil
        feature.specialHeld=record
        local ok,err=callNative(control.nativeTool.Special,control.nativeTool)
        if not ok then feature.specialHeld=nil;feature.lastReason='Native Body Repel Special failed: '..tostring(err);return end
        feature.requests+=1;feature.lastReason='Native Special requested alongside your Body Repel'
    end
    local function release(feature: any)
        if control.nativeDispatch then return end
        local record=feature.release
        feature.release=nil
        -- Native Deactivated must not override a human still holding the real move key.
        if not record or record.character~=player.Character or not record.tool.Parent or (not feature.timed and (held(record.binding) or held(savedBinding(record.slot)))) then return end
        local service=feature.services[record.tool:GetAttribute('Service')]
        if not service or not service.Deactivated or type(service.Deactivated.Fire)~='function' then return end
        local dispatch={name=feature.name,action='Deactivated',at=clock()}
        control.nativeDispatch=dispatch
        dispatchThread=coroutine.running()
        local ok=callNative(control.nativeTool.UseTool,control.nativeTool,record.tool,'Deactivated')
        control.nativeDispatch=nil;dispatchThread=nil
        if ok then control.nativeReleases+=1 end
    end
    local function targetModel(value: any): any
        if value and value:IsA('Player') then return value.Character end
        return value
    end
    local function validTarget(value: any): boolean
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(value)) then return false end
        local target=targetModel(value)
        local humanoid=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return target~=nil and target~=player.Character and target:IsA('Model') and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')~=nil
    end
    local function resoluteTarget(context: any): any
        local kind=host.typeof or typeof
        local candidate=if kind(context)=='Instance' then context elseif type(context)=='table' then context[2] else nil
        return if kind(candidate)=='Instance' and validTarget(candidate) then targetModel(candidate) else nil
    end
    local function faceResoluteTarget(record: any)
        local target=record.aimTarget
        if not validTarget(target) or not host.CFrame or not host.Vector3 then return end
        local root=record.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local other=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root or not other then return end
        local position=root.Position
        local direction=host.Vector3.new(other.Position.X-position.X,0,other.Position.Z-position.Z)
        if direction.Magnitude<.01 then return end
        root.CFrame=host.CFrame.lookAt(position,position+direction)
        record.facedTarget=target
    end
    local function dispatch(feature: any,record: any,target: any?): boolean
        if feature.suspended then clearPending(feature,feature.suspendedReason);return false end
        if control.nativeDispatch then return false end
        if not permitted(feature,record,record.accepted==true) then clearPending(feature,'Move unavailable or manual input took priority');return false end
        local native=control.nativeTool
        local oldExtra,extraWrapper,oldTarget,targetWrapper
        if target then
            oldTarget=native.GetTarget
            targetWrapper=function()
                if native.GetTarget==targetWrapper then native.GetTarget=oldTarget end
                return target
            end
            native.GetTarget=targetWrapper
        else
            if type(native.ExtraData)~='table' then clearPending(feature,'Native variant context extension is unavailable');return false end
            oldExtra=native.ExtraData[record.tool.Name]
            extraWrapper=function()
                if native.ExtraData[record.tool.Name]==extraWrapper then native.ExtraData[record.tool.Name]=oldExtra end
                return record.context
            end
            native.ExtraData[record.tool.Name]=extraWrapper
        end
        clearPending(feature)
        local context={name=feature.name,action=if target then 'Rebound' else 'Continuation',at=clock(),firstAt=record.at,delay=if record.finisher then control.resoluteFinisherDelay else feature.delay,variant=record.variant,finisher=record.finisher==true,dispatched=false}
        if feature.name=='Resolute Slash' then faceResoluteTarget(record);context.facedTarget=record.facedTarget end
        control.nativeDispatch=context
        dispatchThread=coroutine.running()
        local ok,err=callNative(native.UseTool,native,record.tool,'Activated')
        control.nativeDispatch=nil;dispatchThread=nil
        if extraWrapper and native.ExtraData[record.tool.Name]==extraWrapper then native.ExtraData[record.tool.Name]=oldExtra end
        if targetWrapper and native.GetTarget==targetWrapper then native.GetTarget=oldTarget end
        if not ok then feature.lastReason='Native move action failed: '..tostring(err);return false end
        if not context.dispatched then feature.lastReason='Native move action did not dispatch';return false end
        feature.requests+=1;control.nativeRequests+=1
        feature.lastRequest=context
        feature.lastReason=if target then 'Native rebound requested at owned return arrival' else 'One native second use requested; hit acceptance remains game-owned'
        control.lastReason=feature.lastReason
        feature.release={character=record.character,tool=record.tool,slot=record.tool:GetAttribute('Key'),binding=record.binding,at=clock(),due=clock()+(if feature.timed then feature.pressTime else 0)}
        if feature.timed then feature.settlingUntil=feature.release.due+feature.settleTime end
        if not control.alive or not featureEnabled(feature) then release(feature) end
        return true
    end
    local function checkArrival(feature: any)
        local record=feature.pending
        if not record or not record.part then return end
        if not record.accepted or not record.part.Parent or not permitted(feature,record,true) then clearPending(feature,'Garuda return ended or move unavailable');return end
        local root=record.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then clearPending(feature,'Return owner has no root');return end
        local now=clock()
        if now-record.at>record.duration+0.15 then clearPending(feature,'Garuda return expired');return end
        local distance=(record.part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
        if not finite(distance) then clearPending(feature,'Invalid Garuda return position');return end
        local previous=record.lastPosition
        local segment=record.part.Position-previous
        local sweptDistance=distance
        if segment.Magnitude>0.01 then
            record.moved=true
            local fraction=math.clamp((root.Position-previous):Dot(segment)/segment:Dot(segment),0,1)
            sweptDistance=(previous+segment*fraction-root.Position).Magnitude
        end
        if distance<record.lastDistance-0.01 then record.approached=true end
        record.lastPosition=record.part.Position;record.lastDistance=distance
        -- The native arc can pass near the owner early. Wait for its reported
        -- terminal return sample, with observed approach and arrival geometry.
        local lead=if control.garudaPrediction then control.garudaLead else 0
        local progress=math.clamp((now-record.at+lead)/record.duration,0,1)
        local predicted=record.startPosition:Lerp(root.Position,progress)
        if record.duration~=0.1 then predicted+=host.Vector3.new(0,math.sin(progress*3.14)*15,0) end
        local arrived=distance<=control.returnRadius or (control.garudaPrediction and (predicted-root.Position).Magnitude<=control.returnRadius) or (now-record.at>=record.duration and sweptDistance<=control.returnRadius)
        if now-record.at+1e-9<record.duration*0.5 or not record.moved or not record.approached or not arrived then return end
        if held(savedBinding(record.tool:GetAttribute('Key'))) and (not record.initialHold or record.initialHoldReleased) then clearPending(feature,'New manual Garuda input took priority');return end
        local target=record.hit and record.hit.target or targetModel(menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget)
        if not validTarget(target) and type(control.nativeTool.GetTarget)=='function' then
            local ok,nativeTarget=pcall(control.nativeTool.GetTarget,control.nativeTool)
            target=if ok then targetModel(nativeTarget) else nil
        end
        if not validTarget(target) then clearPending(feature,'No valid native target for Garuda rebound');return end
        dispatch(feature,record,target)
    end
    local function onEffect(feature: any,kind: any,caster: any,...: any)
        if not control.alive or not featureEnabled(feature) or feature.suspended then return end
        if feature.name=='Garuda Rebound' and (kind=='Hit' or kind=='HeavyHit') then
            local cast=feature.garudaCast
            local victim=targetModel(select(1,...))
            -- Native Garuda hit effects identify the owner Player and victim Model.
            if (caster==player or caster==player.Character) and cast and cast.character==player.Character
                and cast.accepted and validTarget(victim) and permitted(feature,cast,true) then
                cast.hit={target=victim,at=clock()};feature.confirmed+=1
                feature.lastReason='Owned Garuda hit confirmed; waiting for its return'
            end
            return
        end
        if feature.name=='Garuda Rebound' and kind=='Recall' then
            local part,startPosition,duration=...
            if caster~=player.Character or not part or not part:IsA('BasePart') or not part.Parent or not finite(duration) or duration<=0 or duration>5 then return end
            local tool=toolFor(feature)
            local root=caster:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local humanoid=caster:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if not tool or not root or not humanoid then return end
            local cast=feature.garudaCast
            if not cast or not cast.accepted or cast.character~=caster or cast.tool~=tool then feature.lastReason='Garuda return has no accepted owned first use';return end
            clearPending(feature)
            local record={character=caster,tool=tool,health=cast.health,at=clock(),duration=duration,part=part,startPosition=startPosition,lastPosition=part.Position,lastDistance=(part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude,moved=false,approached=false,connections={},binding=cast.binding,hit=cast.hit,accepted=cast.accepted,initialHold=cast.initialHold,initialHoldReleased=cast.initialHoldReleased}
            if not record.accepted or not permitted(feature,record,true) or (held(record.binding) and (not record.initialHold or record.initialHoldReleased)) then feature.lastReason='New manual input or character state prevents Garuda rebound';return end
            feature.pending=record;feature.returns+=1;feature.lastReason='Tracking the owned Garuda return; waiting for arrival'
            connect(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Position'),function() checkArrival(feature) end,record.connections)
            connect(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal('CFrame'),function() checkArrival(feature) end,record.connections)
            connect(part.Destroying,function()
                if feature.pending==record then checkArrival(feature) end
                if feature.pending==record then clearPending(feature,'Garuda return was destroyed before an eligible arrival') end
            end,record.connections)
            return
        end
        if caster~=player.Character then return end
        if kind==feature.startEffect then
            feature.starts+=1
            local cast=feature.garudaCast
            if cast and cast.character==caster and clock()-cast.at<=0.45 then cast.accepted=true end
            local record=feature.pending
            if record and not record.part and record.character==caster and clock()-record.at<=0.45 then
                record.accepted=true
                if feature.name=='Focus Strike' then record.variant=select(1,...) end
            end
        elseif kind==feature.hitEffect then
            feature.confirmed+=1
            feature.lastReason='Native Blackflash hit confirmed'
        elseif (feature.name=='Brute Force' and kind=='Woosh') or (feature.name=='Cleave Rush' and kind=='Warn') then
            feature.lastBlackflashCast=select(1,...)==true
        end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(name: string,value: boolean)
        local feature=control.features[name]
        if not feature then return end
        feature.enabled=value==true
        clearPending(feature,if feature.enabled then (feature.suspendedReason or (if feature.ready then 'Waiting for an owned native move' else 'Native move service is unavailable')) else 'Disabled')
        if not featureEnabled(feature) then release(feature);releaseSpecial(feature) end
    end
    function control.setDelay(name: string,value: number)
        local feature=control.features[name]
        if not feature or not finite(value) or name=='Garuda Rebound' then return end
        feature.delay=math.clamp(value,0.05,0.4)
        clearPending(feature,'Second-use delay changed; waiting for the next move')
    end
    function control.setResoluteTeleportEnabled(value)control.resoluteTeleportEnabled=value==true;clearPending(control.features['Resolute Slash']) end
    function control.setResoluteFinisherDelay(value)
        if not finite(value) then return false end
        control.resoluteFinisherDelay=math.clamp(value,.7,.8)
        local feature=control.features['Resolute Slash']
        if feature.pending and feature.pending.finisher then clearPending(feature,'Finisher timing changed; waiting for the next move') end
        return true
    end
    function control.setGarudaPrediction(value) control.garudaPrediction=value==true end
    function control.setGarudaLead(value) if finite(value) then control.garudaLead=math.clamp(value,0,0.25) end end
    function control.step()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.refreshLegacyQTE()
        yukiStep()
        local now=clock()
        for _,feature in control.features do
            local special=feature.specialHeld
            if special then
                local info=special.character and special.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                local inSkill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil
                if inSkill then special.seenInSkill=true end
                if held(savedBinding(nil,'Special')) then feature.specialHeld=nil
                elseif not permitted(feature,special,true) or now-special.at>=1.5 or (special.seenInSkill and not inSkill) then releaseSpecial(feature) end
            end
            if feature.release and now+1e-9>=(feature.release.due or feature.release.at) then release(feature) end
            local record=feature.pending
            if record then
                if feature.suspended then clearPending(feature,feature.suspendedReason)
                elseif record.part then checkArrival(feature)
                elseif not permitted(feature,record,true) then clearPending(feature,'Move interrupted or manual input took priority')
                elseif now+1e-9>=record.deadline then
                    if not record.accepted then clearPending(feature,'No native cast-start confirmation; second use skipped')
                    elseif now-record.deadline>0.10 then clearPending(feature,'Second-use deadline passed; stale request skipped')
                    else dispatch(feature,record) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        cancelYuki('Paused by Failsafe')
        yuki.audioSession=nil
        if qte.effective and qte.callback then pcall(qte.callback,false) end
        qte.effective=false
        for _,feature in control.features do
            clearPending(feature,'Paused by Failsafe')
            release(feature)
            releaseSpecial(feature)
        end
    end
    function control.onFailsafeResume()
        control.refreshLegacyQTE()
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.setLegacyQTEEnabled(false)
        cancelYuki('Unloaded')
        if control.yukiSoundHook then
            local hook=control.yukiSoundHook;hook.active=false
            if hook.owner.PlaySound==hook.wrapper then hook.owner.PlaySound=hook.original end
        end
        yuki.audioSession=nil
        for _,hook in {control.specialHook,control.specialReleaseHook} do
            if hook then hook.active=false;if control.nativeTool[hook.key]==hook.wrapper then control.nativeTool[hook.key]=hook.original end end
        end
        for _,feature in control.features do
            clearPending(feature)
            release(feature)
            releaseSpecial(feature)
            for _,hook in feature.hooks do
                hook.active=false;if hook.signal.Fire==hook.wrapper then hook.signal.Fire=hook.original end
            end
            feature.enabled=false
        end
        control.alive=false
        if control.toolHook then
            control.toolHook.active=false
            if control.nativeTool.UseTool==control.toolHook.wrapper then control.nativeTool.UseTool=control.toolHook.original end
        end
        disconnect(control.connections)
    end
    local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
    local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
    local loaded,knit=false,nil
    if module then loaded,knit=pcall(host.require,module) end
    local serviceFolders=module and module:FindFirstChild('Services')
    if loaded and knit and type(knit.GetController)=='function' then
        local ok,native=pcall(knit.GetController,'ToolController')
        if ok and native and type(native.UseTool)=='function' and type(native.ReturnKey)=='function' then control.nativeTool=native end
    end
    if control.nativeTool and serviceFolders and type(knit.GetService)=='function' then
        for _,feature in control.features do
            for _,serviceName in feature.serviceNames do
                -- Never ask Knit for an absent name: GetService may wait indefinitely.
                if serviceFolders:FindFirstChild(serviceName) then
                    local ok,service=pcall(knit.GetService,serviceName)
                    if ok and service and service.Activated and type(service.Activated.Fire)=='function' and service.Effects and type(service.Effects.Connect)=='function' then
                        feature.services[serviceName]=service
                        if not feature.service then feature.service=service end
                        feature.ready=true;control.ready=true
                        local hook: any={active=true,signal=service.Activated,original=service.Activated.Fire}
                        hook.wrapper=function(self: any,...: any): ...any
                            local args=table.pack(...)
                            local created
                            if hook.active and control.alive and featureEnabled(feature) and not feature.suspended and args[1] and args[1]==toolFor(feature) and args[1]:GetAttribute('Service')==serviceName then
                                local ownDispatch=control.nativeDispatch
                                if ownDispatch and ownDispatch.name==feature.name and dispatchThread==coroutine.running() then ownDispatch.dispatched=true
                                elseif feature.special then
                                    -- Body Repel uses Special, never a timed second Body Repel.
                                elseif feature.pending then clearPending(feature,'A native manual second use took priority');feature.release=nil
                                elseif feature.timed and clock()<feature.settlingUntil then
                                    -- A finishing press cannot arm a third automatic activation.
                                elseif feature.name=='Garuda Rebound' and args.n==2 then
                                    local character=player.Character
                                    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                                    if humanoid then
                                        local binding=savedBinding(args[1]:GetAttribute('Key'))
                                        local cast={tool=args[1],character=character,health=humanoid.Health,at=clock(),accepted=false,binding=binding,initialHold=held(binding),initialHoldReleased=false}
                                        if permitted(feature,cast,true) then feature.garudaCast=cast;created=cast end
                                    end
                                elseif feature.name~='Garuda Rebound' and args.n==2 then
                                    local character=player.Character
                                    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                                    if humanoid then
                                        local record={tool=args[1],character=character,health=humanoid.Health,at=clock(),deadline=clock()+feature.delay+(if feature.timed then feature.pressTime else 0),context=args[2],args=args,accepted=feature.timed,binding=savedBinding(args[1]:GetAttribute('Key'))}
                                        if feature.name=='Resolute Slash' then
                                            local victim=resoluteTarget(record.context)
                                            local phase=menu.nativeCounter and menu.nativeCounter.directionalPhase
                                            if not validTarget(victim) and phase and phase.character==character and clock()-phase.at>=0 and clock()-phase.at<=0.5 then victim=targetModel(phase.target) end
                                            if not validTarget(victim) and type(control.nativeTool.GetTarget)=='function' then local ok,t=callNative(control.nativeTool.GetTarget,control.nativeTool);if ok then victim=targetModel(t) end end
                                            if validTarget(victim) then
                                                record.aimTarget=victim
                                                if control.resoluteTeleportEnabled and victim:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid').Health<15 then
                                                    record.teleportVictim,record.finisher=victim,true
                                                    record.deadline=record.at+control.resoluteFinisherDelay
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                        -- First request can be observed while native self-cast InSkill/Stun
                                        -- already exists; accepted startup must arrive before continuation.
                                        if permitted(feature,record,true) then feature.pending=record;created=record;feature.lastReason=if feature.timed then 'First press observed; waiting 10 ms release and second-use delay' else 'Waiting for native cast start and second-use deadline' end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,table.unpack(args,1,args.n)))
                            if not result[1] then
                                if feature.pending==created and created then clearPending(feature,'Native first move action failed') end
                                if feature.garudaCast==created and created then feature.garudaCast=nil end
                                error(result[2],0)
                            end
                            if created and feature.timed and feature.pending==created then
                                feature.release={character=created.character,tool=created.tool,slot=created.tool:GetAttribute('Key'),binding=created.binding,at=created.at,due=created.at+feature.pressTime,first=true}
                            end
                            if feature.special and (control.bodyDepth or 0)==0 and args[1]==toolFor(feature) then bodyRepelSpecial(args[1]) end
                            return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
                        end
                        table.insert(feature.hooks,hook)
                        if not feature.hook then feature.hook=hook end
                        service.Activated.Fire=hook.wrapper
                        connect(service.Effects,function(kind,caster,...) onEffect(feature,kind,caster,...) end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if control.nativeTool then
        local ok,fx=pcall(knit.GetController,'FXController')
        if ok and fx and type(fx.PlaySound)=='function' then
            local soundHook: any={active=true,owner=fx,original=fx.PlaySound}
            soundHook.wrapper=function(self: any,sound: any,parent: any,...: any): ...any
                local volume=if soundHook.active and control.alive then control.yukiSoundVolume(sound,parent) else nil
                if volume==nil then return soundHook.original(self,sound,parent,...) end
                -- Copy only this owned charge cue. Never change shared sound templates.
                local quiet=sound:Clone();quiet.Volume=volume
                local result=table.pack(pcall(soundHook.original,self,quiet,parent,...))
                quiet:Destroy()
                if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
            control.yukiSoundHook=soundHook;fx.PlaySound=soundHook.wrapper
        end
        local hook={active=true,original=control.nativeTool.UseTool}
        hook.wrapper=function(self,tool,action,...)
            local body=hook.active and control.alive and action=='Activated' and tool==toolFor(control.features['Body Repel'])
            if body then control.bodyDepth=(control.bodyDepth or 0)+1 end
            local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,tool,action,...))
            if body then control.bodyDepth-=1 end
            if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
            if body then bodyRepelSpecial(tool) end
            return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
        end
        control.toolHook=hook;control.nativeTool.UseTool=hook.wrapper
        if type(control.nativeTool.Special)=='function' and type(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial)=='function' then
            local special={active=true,key='Special',original=control.nativeTool.Special}
            special.wrapper=function(self,...)
                local begin=special.active and not yuki.dispatching and (yuki.instant or yuki.recharge) and yukiAllowed(nil)
                local busy=yuki.record~=nil
                if begin and busy then cancelYuki('A new native Special input took priority') end
                if begin then yuki.audioSession={character=player.Character,played=false,expires=clock()+8} end
                local result=table.pack(pcall(special.original,self,...))
                if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
                if begin and not busy then
                    local character=player.Character;local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                    yuki.record={character=character,health=humanoid.Health,at=clock(),cycles=0,maxCycles=if yuki.instant then 100 else 20,phase='Cycles'}
                end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
            control.specialHook=special;control.nativeTool.Special=special.wrapper
            local releaseHook={active=true,key='ReleaseSpecial',original=control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial}
            releaseHook.wrapper=function(self,...)
                if releaseHook.active and not yuki.dispatching then yuki.record=nil;yuki.lastReason='Your native Special release took priority' end
                return releaseHook.original(self,...)
            end
            control.specialReleaseHook=releaseHook;control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial=releaseHook.wrapper
        end
    end
    connect(run.Heartbeat,control.step)
    connect(input.InputBegan,function(event)
        for _,feature in control.features do
            local record=feature.pending
            local cast=feature.garudaCast
            if cast and (cast.initialHoldReleased or clock()-cast.at>0.02) and bindingEvent(cast.binding,event) then clearPending(feature,'Your new Garuda input took priority')
            elseif record and (record.initialHoldReleased or clock()-record.at>0.02) and bindingEvent(savedBinding(record.tool:GetAttribute('Key')),event) then clearPending(feature,'Your saved move input took priority') end
        end
    end)
    connect(input.InputEnded,function(event)
        local feature=control.features['Garuda Rebound']
        local record=feature and (feature.pending or feature.garudaCast)
        if record and bindingEvent(record.binding,event) then record.initialHoldReleased=true end
    end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()
        control.focused=false
        cancelYuki('Window focus was lost')
        for _,feature in control.features do clearPending(feature,'Window focus was lost');release(feature);releaseSpecial(feature) end
    end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function() control.focused=true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function()
        cancelYuki('Character removed')
        qte.removing=player.Character
        control.refreshLegacyQTE()
        for _,feature in control.features do clearPending(feature,'Character removed');release(feature) end
    end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,function()
        qte.removing=nil
        control.refreshLegacyQTE()
        for _,feature in control.features do clearPending(feature,'Character changed');release(feature) end
    end)
    return control
end
return NativeCombos
end)()

local ConfigStore = (function(): any
-- Persist settings only; live characters, camera ownership and physics are never saved.
local ConfigStore: {[string]: any} = {}
local kinds = {CreateToggle=true,CreateSlider=true,CreateInput=true,CreateDropdown=true,CreateColorPicker=true}
local function removedRedSpin(id)
    if type(id)=='string' then
        local key=id:gsub('^native/row/',''):gsub('^row/','')
        if key=='Player/Damage Numbers' or key=='Fun/Damage & Healing Numbers' or key=='Fun/Damage Numbers'
            or key=='Main/Damage & Healing Numbers' or key=='Main/Damage Numbers' or key=='Settings/Damage Number Font Size'
            or key:sub(1,#'Settings/Text Style [Settings/Damage Number Font Size] ')=='Settings/Text Style [Settings/Damage Number Font Size] ' then return true end
    end
    return id=='Main/Reversal Red 180 Spin' or id=='row/Main/Reversal Red 180 Spin'
        or id=='native/row/Main/Reversal Red 180 Spin'
        or id=='Main/Kill All / Bring' or id=='row/Main/Kill All / Bring'
        or id=='native/row/Main/Kill All / Bring'
end

function ConfigStore.migrateLockSpeeds(values: any): any
    if type(values)~="table" then return values end
    local result=table.clone(values)
    -- The old trail picker and enable toggle shared an ID. Only a typed color
    -- value moves to Tint; the existing boolean enable preference keeps its ID.
    for _,prefix in {'Skill/',''} do
        local oldKey,newKey=prefix..'Combat Trail Color',prefix..'Combat Trail Tint'
        local saved=values[oldKey]
        if type(saved)=='table' and (saved.Kind=='CreateColorPicker' or saved.Kind=='ColorPicker') then
            if values[newKey]==nil then result[newKey]=table.clone(saved) end
            result[oldKey]=nil
        end
    end
    local function settingValue(saved: any): any
        return if type(saved)=='table' then saved.Value else saved
    end
    local function migratedSetting(template: any,value: any,kind: string): any
        if type(template)~='table' then return value end
        local copy=table.clone(template)
        copy.Kind,copy.Value=kind,value
        return copy
    end
    for _,prefix in {'Main/',''} do
        -- These are full heights, not meters. The historical zero used a
        -- six-stud fallback; all assists now cover at least 45 studs each way.
        for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do
            local key=prefix..role..' Aim Box Height Y (m)'
            local saved=values[key]
            local structured=type(saved)=='table'
            local height=settingValue(saved)
            if (not structured or saved.Kind=='CreateSlider' or saved.Kind=='Slider')
                and type(height)=='number' and height==height and height>=0 and height<90 then
                result[key]=if structured then table.clone(saved) else 90
                if structured then result[key].Value=90 end
            end
        end
        local oldBox=values[prefix..'Block Aim Character Box']
        if type(settingValue(oldBox))=='boolean' then
            local key=prefix..'Block Aim Area'
            if values[key]==nil then
                local short=type(oldBox)=='table' and oldBox.Kind=='Toggle'
                result[key]=migratedSetting(oldBox,if settingValue(oldBox) then 'Facing Box' else '360°',if short then 'Dropdown' else 'CreateDropdown')
            end
            result[prefix..'Block Aim Character Box']=nil
        end
        local triggerKey,outgoingKey=prefix..'Auto Lock On Trigger',prefix..'Auto Lock On When You Hit'
        local savedTrigger,savedOutgoing=values[triggerKey],values[outgoingKey]
        local trigger,outgoing=settingValue(savedTrigger),settingValue(savedOutgoing)
        local incoming=trigger=='Incoming' or trigger=='BlockIncoming' or trigger=='HitIncoming' or trigger=='All'
        local validTrigger=trigger=='Block' or trigger=='Hit' or trigger=='Both' or trigger=='None' or incoming
        if validTrigger or type(outgoing)=='boolean' then
            local block=trigger=='Block' or trigger=='Both' or trigger=='BlockIncoming' or trigger=='All'
            -- Older builds saved an inert trigger separately from the working
            -- own-hit toggle. Merge both checked methods once, then save aliases
            -- in agreement so later restore order cannot change the selection.
            local hit=trigger=='Hit' or trigger=='Both' or trigger=='HitIncoming' or trigger=='All' or outgoing==true
            local combined=if block then (if hit then 'Both' else 'Block') else (if hit then 'Hit' else 'None')
            if incoming then combined=if block then (if hit then 'All' else 'BlockIncoming') else (if hit then 'HitIncoming' else 'Incoming') end
            local template=savedTrigger or savedOutgoing
            local shortKinds=type(template)=='table' and (template.Kind=='Dropdown' or template.Kind=='Toggle')
            result[triggerKey]=migratedSetting(template,combined,if shortKinds then 'Dropdown' else 'CreateDropdown')
            result[outgoingKey]=migratedSetting(savedOutgoing or template,hit,if shortKinds then 'Toggle' else 'CreateToggle')
        end
        local modeKey=prefix..'Lock On'
        if values[modeKey]==nil then
            local shift,camera=values[prefix..'Character Lock with Shift Lock'],values[prefix..'Camera Only']
            local legacy=values[if prefix=='Main/' then 'Player/Lock On Mode' else 'Lock On Mode']
            local legacyValue=settingValue(legacy)
            local mode,template
            if settingValue(shift)==true then mode,template='Character',shift
            elseif settingValue(camera)==true then mode,template='Camera',camera
            elseif legacyValue=='Camera' or legacyValue=='Character' or legacyValue=='Both' or legacyValue=='None' then mode,template=legacyValue,legacy end
            if mode then
                local shortKinds=type(template)=='table' and (template.Kind=='Dropdown' or template.Kind=='Toggle')
                result[modeKey]=migratedSetting(template,mode,if shortKinds then 'Dropdown' else 'CreateDropdown')
            end
        end
    end
    local icon=values['Main/Lock On Icon Size'] or values['Player/Lock On Icon Size']
    local iconValue=if type(icon)=='table' then icon.Value else icon
    if type(iconValue)=='number' and iconValue==iconValue and iconValue>=1 and iconValue<=15 then
        result['Main/Lock On Icon Size']=if type(icon)=='table' then table.clone(icon) else icon
        result['Player/Lock On Icon Size']=if type(icon)=='table' then table.clone(icon) else icon
    end
    for _,prefix in {"Main/",""} do
        local saved=values[prefix.."Lock On Transition (s)"]
        local structured=type(saved)=="table"
        if structured and saved.Kind~="CreateSlider" and saved.Kind~="Slider" then continue end
        local seconds=if structured then saved.Value else saved
        if type(seconds)~="number" or seconds~=seconds or seconds<0.01 or seconds>1 then continue end
        for _,item in {{name="Character Lock Speed",value=20},{name="Camera Lock Speed",value=1/seconds}} do
            local key=prefix..item.name
            if values[key]~=nil then continue end
            if structured then
                local migrated=table.clone(saved)
                migrated.Value=item.value
                result[key]=migrated
            else result[key]=item.value end
        end
    end
    return result
end

-- Before self/other sizes were split, these controls applied to both. Keep
-- that appearance for older saves without replacing explicitly saved self sizes.
function ConfigStore.migrateDisplaySizes(values: any): any
    if type(values)~="table" then return values end
    local result=table.clone(values)
    for _,pair in {
        {old="Resource Bar Height",self="Your Resource Bar Height",minimum=80,maximum=480},
        {old="Cooldown Viewer Size",self="Your Cooldown Viewer Size",minimum=0.25,maximum=30},
        {old="Resource Bar Offset X",self="Your Resource Bar Offset X",minimum=-15/0.28,maximum=15/0.28},
        {old="Resource Bar Offset Y",self="Your Resource Bar Offset Y",minimum=-15/0.28,maximum=15/0.28},
        {old="Resource Bar Offset Z",self="Your Resource Bar Offset Z",minimum=-15/0.28,maximum=15/0.28},
    } do
        for _,prefix in {"Settings/",""} do
            local oldKey,selfKey=prefix..pair.old,prefix..pair.self
            local saved=values[oldKey]
            if saved==nil or values[selfKey]~=nil then continue end
            local structured=type(saved)=="table"
            if structured and saved.Kind~="CreateSlider" and saved.Kind~="Slider" then continue end
            local value=if structured then saved.Value else saved
            if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge or value<pair.minimum or value>pair.maximum then continue end
            result[selfKey]=if structured then table.clone(saved) else value
        end
    end
    for _,prefix in {"Settings/",""} do
        local saved=values[prefix.."Resource Bar Side"]
        local key=prefix.."Your Resource Bar Side"
        local structured=type(saved)=="table"
        local value=if structured then saved.Value else saved
        local validKind=not structured or saved.Kind=="CreateDropdown" or saved.Kind=="Dropdown"
        if values[key]==nil and validKind and (value=="Automatic" or value=="Left" or value=="Right") then
            result[key]=if structured then table.clone(saved) else saved
        end
    end
    -- This entry point is shared by disk/profile restore, live reload, and
    -- the original name-based import route, so all get the same migration.
    return ConfigStore.migrateLockSpeeds(result)
end

function ConfigStore.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local shared = host._G or host
    local http = host.HttpService or host.game:GetService("HttpService")
    local clock = host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local valueType = host.typeof or typeof
    local control: any = {alive=true,started=false,ready=false,restored=0,writes=0,blocked=false,
        path="Shenaniganism.settings.json",backupPath="Shenaniganism.settings.backup.json",debounce=0.75,
        lastError=nil,lastValidText=nil,lastFingerprint=nil,pendingFingerprint=nil,changedAt=nil,
        libraryPath="Shenaniganism.configs.json",libraryBackupPath="Shenaniganism.configs.backup.json",
        libraryReady=false,libraryBlocked=false,profileWrites=0,selectedName="Current",lastProfileError=nil}

    -- The separate port starts with a copy of the user's saved preferences.
    -- Original settings are read only, and an existing port save is never replaced.
    if type(host.isfile)=='function' and type(host.readfile)=='function' and type(host.writefile)=='function' then
        local function forkPair(originalPrimary,originalBackup,newPrimary,newBackup)
            local existsOk,exists=pcall(host.isfile,newPrimary)
            if not existsOk or exists then return end
            for _,pair in {{originalPrimary,newPrimary},{originalBackup,newBackup}} do
                local targetOk,targetExists=pcall(host.isfile,pair[2])
                local sourceOk,sourceExists=pcall(host.isfile,pair[1])
                if targetOk and not targetExists and sourceOk and sourceExists then
                    local readOk,contents=pcall(host.readfile,pair[1])
                    if readOk and type(contents)=='string' then
                        local written=pcall(host.writefile,pair[2],contents)
                        local verified,actual=pcall(host.readfile,pair[2])
                        if not written or not verified or actual~=contents then
                            control.legacyForkError='Could not copy existing settings to the separate port store'
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        forkPair('Shenaniganism.Jujutsuer-port.settings.json','Shenaniganism.Jujutsuer-port.settings.backup.json',control.path,control.backupPath)
        forkPair('Shenaniganism.Jujutsuer-port.configs.json','Shenaniganism.Jujutsuer-port.configs.backup.json',control.libraryPath,control.libraryBackupPath)
    end

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function plain(value: any, seen: any, depth: number?): (boolean, any)
        local kind=valueType(value)
        if kind=="Color3" then return true,{R=value.R,G=value.G,B=value.B} end
        if kind=="EnumItem" then return true,{Enum=tostring(value.EnumType):gsub("^Enum%.",""),Name=value.Name} end
        if type(value)=="boolean" or type(value)=="string" then return true,value end
        if type(value)=="number" then return finite(value),value end
        if type(value)~="table" or (depth or 0)>20 then return false,nil end
        seen=seen or {}
        if seen[value] then return false,nil end
        seen[value]=true
        local result={}
        for key,nested in value do
            if type(key)~="string" and (not finite(key) or key<1 or key%1~=0) then seen[value]=nil;return false,nil end
            local ok,copy=plain(nested,seen,(depth or 0)+1)
            if not ok then seen[value]=nil;return false,nil end
            result[key]=copy
        end
        seen[value]=nil
        return true,result
    end
    local function fingerprint(value: any): string
        if type(value)=="string" then return "string:"..string.format("%q",value) end
        if type(value)~="table" then return type(value)..":"..tostring(value) end
        local keys={}
        for key in value do table.insert(keys,key) end
        table.sort(keys,function(a,b) return type(a)..tostring(a)<type(b)..tostring(b) end)
        local parts={"{"}
        for _,key in keys do table.insert(parts,fingerprint(key).."="..fingerprint(value[key])..";") end
        table.insert(parts,"}")
        return table.concat(parts)
    end
    local function valid(envelope: any): boolean
        if type(envelope)~="table" or envelope.Version~=1 or envelope.StoreVersion~=1 or type(envelope.Controls)~="table" then return false end
        for id,saved in envelope.Controls do
            if type(id)~="string" or not id:find("/",1,true) or type(saved)~="table" or not kinds[saved.Kind] then return false end
            if saved.Value==nil or not plain(saved.Value) then return false end
        end
        if envelope.Metadata~=nil and (type(envelope.Metadata)~="table" or type(envelope.Metadata.Controls)~="table"
            or (envelope.Metadata.Version~=nil and envelope.Metadata.Version~=1)) then return false end
        if envelope.Keybinds~=nil and type(envelope.Keybinds)~='table' then return false end
        if envelope.Layout~=nil and type(envelope.Layout)~='table' then return false end
        local ok=plain(envelope)
        return ok
    end
    local function keybinds(): any
        local result={}
        local store=shared.__CullingKeybindStore or {}
        for id,entry in menu.entries or {} do
            local list=store[id] or (entry.eligible and {})
            if entry and not (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig) and type(list)=="table" then
                local ok,copy=plain(list)
                if ok then result[id]=copy end
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    local function layout(): any
        local result={}
        for id,position in (menu.ui and menu.ui.appearance and menu.ui.appearance.order) or {} do
            if removedRedSpin(id) then continue end
            local entry=type(id)=="string" and menu.entries[id:match('^native/row/(.+)$') or id:match('^row/(.+)$') or id]
            if entry and entry.config and entry.config.ConfigManager then continue end
            if type(id)=="string" and type(position)=="table" and type(position.parent)=="string" and finite(position.order) then
                result[id]={parent=position.parent,order=position.order}
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    local function targetSelection(entry: any, value: any): (boolean, any, boolean)
        local methods,config=menu.targetMethods,entry.config or {}
        local multi=config.Multi==true or config.MultiSelect==true or config.Multiple==true
        local recognized=entry.kind=='CreateDropdown' and multi and methods
            and type(methods.isTargetControl)=='function' and methods.isTargetControl(entry.name or config.Name)
            and type(methods.normalize)=='function'
        if not recognized then return true,value,false end
        -- Saved dropdowns have always accepted strings or dense string arrays.
        -- Validate that original shape before alias expansion so a permissive
        -- runtime normalizer cannot repair a malformed import into valid data.
        if type(value)=='table' then
            local count,seen=0,{}
            for index,item in value do
                if type(index)~='number' or index<1 or index%1~=0 or type(item)~='string' or seen[item] then return false,nil,true end
                count+=1;seen[item]=true
            end
            if count~=#value then return false,nil,true end
        elseif type(value)~='string' then return false,nil,true end
        local normalized,accepted=methods.normalize(value,config.Default)
        if accepted~=true or type(normalized)~='table' then return false,nil,true end
        local options=entry.widget.CheckboxOptions or config.Options
        for _,item in normalized do
            if options and not table.find(options,item) then return false,nil,true end
        end
        return true,normalized,true
    end
    function control.snapshot(): any
        local envelope: any={Version=1,StoreVersion=1,Controls={},Metadata={Version=1,Controls={}},Keybinds=keybinds(),Layout=layout()}
        if control.retainedEnvelope then
            -- Dormant feature preferences survive the native-backend migration.
            -- Active widgets and managed appearance always supply current data.
            local retained=control.retainedEnvelope
            for id,value in retained.Controls or {} do
                if removedRedSpin(id) then continue end
                if id=='Main/Skill Aim Target Priority' and menu.entries['Main/Skill Aim Assist Targets'] then continue end
                if not menu.entries[id] then envelope.Controls[id]=value end
            end
            for id,value in retained.Keybinds or {} do
                if removedRedSpin(id) then continue end
                if not menu.entries[id] and envelope.Keybinds[id]==nil then envelope.Keybinds[id]=value end
            end
            for id,value in retained.Layout or {} do
                if not removedRedSpin(id) and envelope.Layout[id]==nil then envelope.Layout[id]=value end
            end
        end
        for id,entry in menu.entries or {} do
            local widget,config=entry.widget,entry.config or {}
            if type(id)~="string" or not kinds[entry.kind] or config.NoConfig or not widget or type(widget.Get)~="function" then continue end
            local ok,value=pcall(widget.Get)
            if entry.name=='Lock On Icon Size' and menu.lockMarker and finite(menu.lockMarker.size) then
                ok,value=true,menu.lockMarker.size
            end
            if ok then
                local accepted,normalized=targetSelection(entry,value)
                if not accepted then control.lastError='Cannot read target selection: '..id;return nil end
                value=normalized
            end
            local serializable,copy=plain(value)
            if not ok or not serializable then control.lastError="Cannot read setting: "..id;return nil end
            envelope.Controls[id]={Kind=entry.kind,Value=copy}
            if entry.name=="GUI Scale" or entry.name=="Blackflash Chain Timing (s)" then
                envelope.Metadata.Controls[entry.name]={Kind=entry.kind,Value=copy}
            end
        end
        for _,owner in {menu.distanceUnits,menu} do
            if owner and type(owner.stampExport)=="function" then
                local ok,stamped=pcall(owner.stampExport,envelope.Metadata)
                if not ok or type(stamped)~="table" then control.lastError="Cannot serialize managed settings";return nil end
                envelope.Metadata=stamped
            end
        end
        envelope.DistanceUnits=envelope.Metadata.DistanceUnits
        local ok,copy=plain(envelope)
        if not ok then control.lastError="Settings contain an unsupported value";return nil end
        return copy
    end
    local function settingValue(entry: any, saved: any): (boolean, any)
        if saved.Kind~=entry.kind then return false,nil end
        local value,config=saved.Value,entry.config or {}
        if entry.kind=="CreateToggle" then return type(value)=="boolean",value end
        if entry.kind=="CreateSlider" then
            if entry.id=='Player/Hit Outline Duration (s)' and finite(value) then value=math.clamp(value,1,600) end
            if entry.id=='Main/Block Range' and config.FixedRangeLimit and finite(value) then value=math.clamp(value,config.Min or 0,config.Max or 60) end
            return finite(value) and (not config.Min or value>=config.Min) and (not config.Max or value<=config.Max),value
        end
        if entry.kind=="CreateColorPicker" then
            if type(value)~="table" or not finite(value.R) or not finite(value.G) or not finite(value.B)
                or math.min(value.R,value.G,value.B)<0 or math.max(value.R,value.G,value.B)>1 then return false,nil end
            return true,host.Color3.new(value.R,value.G,value.B)
        end
        if entry.kind=="CreateInput" then return type(value)=="string" or finite(value),value end
        if entry.kind=="CreateDropdown" then
            local accepted,normalized=targetSelection(entry,value)
            if not accepted then return false,nil end
            value=normalized
            local options=entry.widget.CheckboxOptions or config.Options
            local multi=config.Multi==true or config.MultiSelect==true or config.Multiple==true
            if multi and type(value)=='table' then
                local result,seen={},{}
                for index,option in value do
                    if type(index)~='number' or index<1 or index%1~=0 or type(option)~='string'
                        or (options and not table.find(options,option)) or seen[option] then return false,nil end
                    seen[option]=true;table.insert(result,option)
                end
                if #result~=#value then return false,nil end
                return true,result
            end
            if type(value)~="string" then return false,nil end
            if entry.id=='Settings/UI Layout' and value=='Culling Hub' then value='JJS Modern' end
            local special=entry.widget.CheckboxOptions and (value=="Both" or value=="None")
            local playerChoice=config.DynamicOptions=='ServerPlayers' or entry.id=='Player/Target'
            return value=='' or playerChoice or not options or table.find(options,value)~=nil or special~=nil and special~=false,value
        end
        return false,nil
    end
    local function bindingCopy(binding: any, depth: number?): any
        if (depth or 0)>4 or type(binding)~="table" or (binding.kind~="Mouse" and binding.kind~="Keyboard") or type(binding.name)~="string" then return nil end
        -- Native port binding mode validation. Omitted mode keeps legacy Toggle.
        if binding.mode~=nil and binding.mode~='Toggle' and binding.mode~='Hold' then return nil end
        local enum=host.Enum and (if binding.kind=="Mouse" then host.Enum.UserInputType else host.Enum.KeyCode)
        if enum then
            local ok,key=pcall(function() return enum[binding.name] end)
            if not ok or not key then return nil end
        end
        local ok,copy=plain(binding)
        if not ok then return nil end
        if binding.modifier~=nil then
            copy.modifier=bindingCopy(binding.modifier,(depth or 0)+1)
            if not copy.modifier then return nil end
        end
        return copy
    end
    local function restoreBindings(saved: any)
        if type(saved)~="table" then return end
        if menu.cancelHeldBindings then menu.cancelHeldBindings() end
        local store=shared.__CullingKeybindStore
        if type(store)~="table" then store={};shared.__CullingKeybindStore=store end
        for id,entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if entry.eligible and not (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig) then store[id]={} end
        end
        for id,bindings in saved do
            if id=='Main/Sprint in Any Direction' then
                if saved['Main/Recovery in Any Direction'] then continue end
                id='Main/Recovery in Any Direction'
            end
            local entry=menu.entries[id]
            if not entry or not entry.eligible or type(bindings)~="table" then continue end
            local list=if bindings.kind then (if bindings.kind=="None" then {} else {bindings}) else bindings
            local accepted={}
            local good=true
            for _,binding in list do
                local copy=bindingCopy(binding)
                if not copy then good=false;break end
                table.insert(accepted,copy)
            end
            if good then store[id]=accepted end
        end
    end
    local function restoreLayout(saved: any)
        local ui=menu.ui
        if not ui or not ui.appearance or type(saved)~="table" then return end
        local order=ui.appearance.order or {}
        ui.appearance.order=order
        for id,position in saved do
            if id=='row/Main/Sprint in Any Direction' then
                if saved['row/Main/Recovery in Any Direction'] then continue end
                id='row/Main/Recovery in Any Direction'
            end
            if id=='row/Main/Dash Cooldown' or id=='row/Main/Dash Cooldown (s)' or id=='row/Main/Dash Cooldown (ms)' then
                if saved['row/Main/Dash Cooldown (100ms)'] then continue end
                if id~='row/Main/Dash Cooldown' and saved['row/Main/Dash Cooldown'] then continue end
                if id=='row/Main/Dash Cooldown (s)' and saved['row/Main/Dash Cooldown (ms)'] then continue end
                id='row/Main/Dash Cooldown (100ms)'
            end
            if type(id)=="string" and type(position)=="table" and type(position.parent)=="string" and finite(position.order) then order[id]={parent=position.parent,order=position.order} end
        end
        local function pageFor(object: any): any
            for _,page in (menu.panel and menu.panel.Pages) or {} do
                if object==page or object:IsDescendantOf(page) then return page end
            end
            return nil
        end
        for id,item in (ui.editor and ui.editor.items) or {} do
            local position=order[if ui.nativeMode and item.kind=='row' then 'native/'..id else id]
            if not position then continue end
            local parent
            if position.parent=="sidebar" and item.kind=="tab" then parent=menu.panel.Sidebar
            elseif position.parent:sub(1,8)=="section/" then
                local section=ui.groups[position.parent:sub(9)];parent=section and section.contents
            elseif position.parent:sub(1,5)=="page/" then
                local tab=menu.tabs[position.parent:sub(6)];parent=tab and tab.page
            end
            if parent and parent~=item.object and not parent:IsDescendantOf(item.object)
                and ((item.kind=="tab" and parent==menu.panel.Sidebar) or (item.kind~="tab" and pageFor(parent)==pageFor(item.object))) then
                item.object.Parent,item.object.LayoutOrder=parent,position.order
            end
        end
        if ui.editor then
            for _,group in ui.groups or {} do group.records={} end
            for _,record in menu.rows or {} do
                for _,group in ui.groups or {} do if record.row.Parent==group.contents then table.insert(group.records,record);break end end
            end
        end
    end
    local function prepare(envelope: any): (any, string?)
        if not valid(envelope) then return nil,'Configuration is malformed or has an unsupported version' end
        local controls=ConfigStore.migrateDisplaySizes(envelope.Controls)
        if type(menu.migrateTimes)=='function' then controls=menu.migrateTimes(controls,false) end
        if menu.nativeTojiAim and type(menu.nativeTojiAim.migrateSettings)=='function' then controls=menu.nativeTojiAim.migrateSettings(controls) end
        local distance=menu.distanceUnits
        if distance and type(distance.migrate)=='function' then
            local values={}
            for id,saved in controls do values[id]=saved.Value end
            local metadata=envelope.Metadata and envelope.Metadata.Controls
            local marker=metadata and metadata[distance.markerKey]
            if type(marker)=='table' then marker=marker.Value end
            if marker==nil and envelope.DistanceUnits=='m' then marker='meters-v1' end
            if marker~=nil then values[distance.markerKey]=marker end
            local migrated=distance.migrate(values,false)
            controls=table.clone(controls)
            for id,saved in controls do
                if migrated[id]~=nil then
                    local converted=table.clone(saved)
                    converted.Value=migrated[id]
                    controls[id]=converted
                end
            end
        end
        -- Migrate legacy target labels before options validation. Keep the
        -- caller's envelope untouched; rollback and future snapshots use the
        -- same canonical arrays as the current checkbox dropdowns.
        controls=table.clone(controls)
        local skillKey,legacySkillKey='Main/Skill Aim Assist Targets','Main/Skill Aim Target Priority'
        if menu.entries[skillKey] and controls[legacySkillKey]~=nil then
            if controls[skillKey]==nil then controls[skillKey]=table.clone(controls[legacySkillKey]) end
            -- Only the canonical selector may invoke the skill preference setter.
            controls[legacySkillKey]=nil
        end
        control.skippedValues={}
        for id,saved in controls do
            local entry=menu.entries[id]
            if entry and not (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig) then
                local accepted,normalized,recognized=targetSelection(entry,saved.Value)
                if not accepted then control.skippedValues[#control.skippedValues+1]=id;controls[id]=nil;continue end
                if recognized then
                    local converted=table.clone(saved);converted.Value=normalized;controls[id]=converted
                end
            end
        end
        for id,saved in controls do
            local entry=menu.entries[id]
            if entry and kinds[entry.kind] and not (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig) then
                local accepted=settingValue(entry,saved)
                if not accepted then control.skippedValues[#control.skippedValues+1]=id;controls[id]=nil end
            end
        end
        for id,bindings in envelope.Keybinds or {} do
            local entry=menu.entries[id]
            if not entry or not entry.eligible then continue end
            if type(bindings)~='table' then return nil,'Invalid keybind list: '..id end
            local list=if bindings.kind then (if bindings.kind=='None' then {} else {bindings}) else bindings
            for index,binding in list do
                if type(index)~='number' or index<1 or index%1~=0 or not bindingCopy(binding) then return nil,'Invalid keybind: '..id end
            end
        end
        for id,position in envelope.Layout or {} do
            if type(id)~='string' or type(position)~='table' or type(position.parent)~='string' or not finite(position.order) then
                return nil,'Invalid saved layout'
            end
        end
        local metadata=envelope.Metadata or {}
        local colors=metadata.ColorSettings
        if colors~=nil then
            if type(colors)~='table' or colors.version~=1 or type(colors.controls)~='table' then return nil,'Invalid saved color settings' end
            local function validColor(color)
                return type(color)=='table' and finite(color.R) and finite(color.G) and finite(color.B)
                    and math.min(color.R,color.G,color.B)>=0 and math.max(color.R,color.G,color.B)<=1
            end
            for id,saved in colors.controls do
                if type(id)~='string' or type(saved)~='table' or not validColor(saved.color)
                    or not finite(saved.transparency) or saved.transparency<0 or saved.transparency>1 then return nil,'Invalid saved color or transparency' end
            end
            if colors.miniMenu~=nil then
                local mini=colors.miniMenu
                if type(mini)~='table' or (mini.color~=nil and not validColor(mini.color)) then return nil,'Invalid mini menu color' end
                for _,key in {'transparency','depth'} do
                    if mini[key]~=nil and (not finite(mini[key]) or mini[key]<0 or mini[key]>1) then return nil,'Invalid mini menu appearance' end
                end
            end
        end
        local geometry=metadata.WindowGeometry
        if geometry~=nil then
            if type(geometry)~='table' or geometry.Version~=1 or (geometry.Popups~=nil and type(geometry.Popups)~='table') then return nil,'Invalid window geometry' end
            local function size(value)
                return type(value)=='table' and finite(value.Width) and finite(value.Height)
                    and value.Width>0 and value.Height>0 and value.Width<=65536 and value.Height<=65536
            end
            if geometry.Main~=nil and not size(geometry.Main) then return nil,'Invalid main window size' end
            for key,value in geometry.Popups or {} do
                if type(key)~='string' or #key==0 or #key>512 or not size(value) then return nil,'Invalid submenu size' end
            end
        end
        local timing=metadata.BlackflashTiming
        if timing~=nil and (type(timing)~='table' or timing.version~=1 or type(timing.profiles)~='table'
            or type(timing.manualOverride)~='boolean' or (timing.method~='Hop' and timing.method~='Side')
            or not finite(timing.manualWindow) or timing.manualWindow<.05 or timing.manualWindow>.4
            or (timing.requestDelay~=nil and (not finite(timing.requestDelay) or timing.requestDelay<.05 or timing.requestDelay>.4))) then
            return nil,'Invalid blackflash timing settings'
        end
        return controls
    end
    local function applyEnvelope(envelope: any,controls: any): (boolean, any)
        local failures={}
        local ids={}
        for id in controls do table.insert(ids,id) end
        table.sort(ids)
        local function apply(kind: string)
            for _,id in ids do
                local saved=controls[id]
                local entry=menu.entries[id]
                if not entry or entry.kind~=kind or (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig) then continue end
                -- The old window's own look settings are not restored: that window is gone and each one cost about half a second.
                if id=="Settings/UI Layout" or id:sub(1,14)=="Settings/Menu " then continue end
                local ok,value=settingValue(entry,saved)
                if ok and entry.widget and type(entry.widget.Set)=="function" then
                    -- Transform Into User is an action input: restoring its
                    -- text must never start a transform or resolve a user ID.
                    -- Its normal widget callback remains available to users.
                    local oldWindowLook=id=="Settings/UI Layout" or id:sub(1,14)=="Settings/Menu "
                    local silent=(entry.config and entry.config.NoRestoreCallback==true) or oldWindowLook
                        or (entry.kind=="CreateInput" and id=="Transform/Transform Into User")
                    local startedAt=os.clock()
                    local success,message=pcall(entry.widget.Set,value,not silent)
                    local took=os.clock()-startedAt
                    if took>.02 then local marks=SharedHooks.loadProfile.marks;marks[#marks+1]={'set '..id,took} end
                    if success then control.restored+=1 else table.insert(failures,id..": "..tostring(message)) end
                end
            end
        end
        local ok,message=pcall(function()
            local function span(label: string,fn: any)
                local startedAt=os.clock()
                fn()
                local marks=SharedHooks.loadProfile.marks;marks[#marks+1]={'restore '..label,os.clock()-startedAt}
            end
            span('keybinds',function() restoreBindings(envelope.Keybinds) end)
            span('layout',function() restoreLayout(envelope.Layout) end)
            if type(menu.prepareTurnRestore)=='function' then span('turn prepare',function() menu.prepareTurnRestore(controls) end) end
            for _,kind in {"CreateInput","CreateSlider","CreateDropdown","CreateColorPicker"} do span(kind,function() apply(kind) end) end
            if type(menu.applyManagedConfig)=="function" and envelope.Metadata then span('managed config',function() menu.applyManagedConfig(envelope.Metadata) end) end
            span('CreateToggle',function() apply("CreateToggle") end)
            if menu.ui and type(menu.ui.refresh)=="function" then span('ui refresh',function() menu.ui.refresh() end) end
        end)
        if not ok then table.insert(failures,tostring(message)) end
        return #failures==0,failures
    end
    function control.restore(envelope: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or menu.restoringControls then control.lastError='Settings are unavailable during another restore';return false end
        local prepareStarted=os.clock()
        local prepared,controls,problem=pcall(prepare,envelope)
        do local marks=SharedHooks.loadProfile.marks;marks[#marks+1]={'restore prepare',os.clock()-prepareStarted} end
        if not prepared or not controls then control.lastError=tostring(if prepared then problem else controls);return false end
        local snapshotStarted=os.clock()
        local before=control.snapshot()
        do local marks=SharedHooks.loadProfile.marks;marks[#marks+1]={'restore snapshot',os.clock()-snapshotStarted} end
        if not before then return false end
        local _,oldBindings=plain(shared.__CullingKeybindStore or {})
        local _,oldOrder=plain((menu.ui and menu.ui.appearance and menu.ui.appearance.order) or {})
        local previous,count=menu.restoringControls,control.restored
        menu.restoringControls=true
        local ok,failures=applyEnvelope(envelope,controls)
        if not ok then
            -- Restore all previous values and managed appearance after any
            -- callback failure; a failed setting never becomes an autosave.
            local rollbackControls=prepare(before)
            local rollbackOk,rollbackFailures=applyEnvelope(before,rollbackControls or before.Controls)
            local bindings=shared.__CullingKeybindStore or {};table.clear(bindings)
            for id,list in oldBindings do bindings[id]=list end
            shared.__CullingKeybindStore=bindings
            if menu.ui and menu.ui.appearance then
                local order=menu.ui.appearance.order or {};table.clear(order)
                for id,position in oldOrder do order[id]=position end
                menu.ui.appearance.order=order;pcall(restoreLayout,oldOrder)
            end
            control.restored=count
            control.lastError='Settings restore failed: '..table.concat(failures,'; ')
            if not rollbackOk then control.lastError..='; previous settings could not all be reapplied: '..table.concat(rollbackFailures,'; ') end
        else
            local _,retained=plain(envelope)
            control.retainedEnvelope=retained
            control.lastError=nil
        end
        if ok and type(menu.syncDashPreferences)=='function'then
            local synced,accepted=pcall(menu.syncDashPreferences)
            if not synced or accepted==false then control.lastError='Dash preferences could not be reconciled';ok=false end
        end
        menu.restoringControls=previous
        if ok and menu.generalESP and type(menu.generalESP.syncAppearanceAliases)=='function'then
            local synced,appearanceProblem=pcall(menu.generalESP.syncAppearanceAliases)
            if not synced then control.lastError='ESP appearance could not be reconciled: '..tostring(appearanceProblem);ok=false end
        end
        return ok
    end
    function control.normalizeImport(value: any): (any, string?)
        if type(value)~='table' then return nil,'The pasted configuration must contain a JSON object' end
        if value.Version~=nil and value.Version~=1 then return nil,'Unsupported configuration version' end
        if type(value.Metadata)=='table' and value.Metadata.Version~=nil and value.Metadata.Version~=1 then return nil,'Unsupported configuration metadata version' end
        local serializable,copy=plain(value)
        if not serializable then return nil,'Configuration contains an unsupported value' end
        if copy.StoreVersion~=nil then
            if not valid(copy) then return nil,'Configuration is malformed or has an unsupported store version' end
            copy.Metadata=copy.Metadata or {Version=1,Controls={}}
            copy.Metadata.Version=copy.Metadata.Version or 1
            local ok,controls,problem=pcall(prepare,copy)
            if not ok or not controls then return nil,tostring(if ok then problem else controls) end
            return copy
        end
        -- Original exports use names and short widget kinds. Convert those
        -- explicitly; never turn arbitrary JSON fields into menu callbacks.
        local source=if type(copy.Controls)=='table' then copy.Controls else copy
        local envelope={Version=1,StoreVersion=1,Controls={},Keybinds=copy.Keybinds,Layout=copy.Layout}
        local metadata=if type(copy.Metadata)=='table' then copy.Metadata else copy
