        envelope.Metadata={Version=1,Controls=if type(metadata.Controls)=='table' then metadata.Controls else {}}
        for _,key in {'DistanceUnits','BlackflashTiming','ColorSettings','WindowGeometry','MiniMenuOrder'} do
            if metadata[key]~=nil then envelope.Metadata[key]=metadata[key] end
        end
        envelope.DistanceUnits=copy.DistanceUnits or envelope.Metadata.DistanceUnits
        local count=0
        local canonicalSkillSource=source['Main/Skill Aim Assist Targets']~=nil or source['Skill Aim Assist Targets']~=nil
        for key,saved in source do
            if type(key)~='string' or type(saved)~='table' or saved.Value==nil then continue end
            local kind=saved.Kind
            if type(kind)=='string' and not kinds[kind] and kinds['Create'..kind] then kind='Create'..kind end
            for id,entry in menu.entries or {} do
                local legacySkill=(key=='Main/Skill Aim Target Priority' or key=='Skill Aim Target Priority')
                    and id=='Main/Skill Aim Assist Targets' and not canonicalSkillSource
                if kinds[entry.kind] and not (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig)
                    and (key==id or key==entry.name or (entry.config and key==entry.config.Name) or legacySkill) then
                    if not kinds[kind] then return nil,'Invalid widget kind: '..key end
                    envelope.Controls[id]={Kind=kind,Value=saved.Value};count+=1
                end
            end
        end
        if count==0 then return nil,'No recognized menu settings were found in the configuration' end
        if not valid(envelope) then return nil,'The legacy configuration is malformed' end
        local ok,controls,problem=pcall(prepare,envelope)
        if not ok or not controls then return nil,tostring(if ok then problem else controls) end
        return envelope
    end
    function control.exportJson(): (boolean, any)
        if not control.alive then return false,'Settings storage is unloaded' end
        local envelope=control.snapshot()
        if not envelope then return false,control.lastError end
        local ok,text=pcall(http.JSONEncode,http,envelope)
        if not ok or type(text)~='string' then control.lastError='Cannot encode exported configuration';return false,control.lastError end
        return true,text
    end
    local function read(path: string): (any, string?, string?, boolean)
        local ok,exists=pcall(host.isfile,path)
        if not ok then return nil,nil,"Cannot inspect saved settings",true end
        if not exists then return nil,nil,nil,false end
        local success,text=pcall(host.readfile,path)
        if not success or type(text)~="string" then return nil,nil,"Cannot read saved settings",true end
        local decoded,envelope=pcall(http.JSONDecode,http,text)
        if not decoded or not valid(envelope) then return nil,nil,"Saved settings are malformed or unsupported",true end
        return envelope,text,nil,true
    end
    function control.sanitizeName(value: any): string?
        if type(value)~="string" then return nil end
        local name=value:gsub("[%c<>:\"/\\|?*]","_"):gsub("%s+"," "):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if not name or name=="" or name=="." or name==".." or #name>64 then return nil end
        return name
    end
    local function validLibrary(library: any): boolean
        if type(library)~="table" or library.Version~=1 or library.ProfileStoreVersion~=1 or type(library.Profiles)~="table" then return false end
        for name,envelope in library.Profiles do
            if type(name)~="string" or control.sanitizeName(name)~=name or not valid(envelope) then return false end
        end
        if library.Selected~=nil and (type(library.Selected)~="string" or not library.Profiles[library.Selected]) then return false end
        return plain(library)
    end
    local function readLibrary(path: string): (any, string?, string?, boolean)
        local ok,exists=pcall(host.isfile,path)
        if not ok then return nil,nil,"Cannot inspect saved configurations",true end
        if not exists then return nil,nil,nil,false end
        local readOk,text=pcall(host.readfile,path)
        if not readOk or type(text)~="string" then return nil,nil,"Cannot read saved configurations",true end
        local decoded,library=pcall(http.JSONDecode,http,text)
        if not decoded or not validLibrary(library) then return nil,nil,"Saved configuration library is malformed or unsupported",true end
        return library,text,nil,true
    end
    local function refreshLibrary(): any
        local library,text,problem,exists=readLibrary(control.libraryPath)
        if not library then
            local backup,backupText,backupProblem,backupExists=readLibrary(control.libraryBackupPath)
            if backup then
                library,text=backup,backupText
                control.libraryRecoveredBackup=true
                -- Keep a corrupt or unreadable primary untouched. Its backup
                -- remains available for explicitly loading named profiles.
                if exists then control.libraryBlocked=true;control.lastProfileError=problem end
            elseif exists or backupExists then
                control.libraryBlocked=true;control.lastProfileError=problem or backupProblem
                return nil
            else library={Version=1,ProfileStoreVersion=1,Profiles={}} end
        end
        control.library,control.lastLibraryText=library,text
        control.libraryReady=true
        return library
    end
    local function notifyProfiles()
        if type(menu.refreshConfigProfiles)=="function" then pcall(menu.refreshConfigProfiles) end
    end
    local function writeLibrary(library: any): boolean
        if control.libraryBlocked or not validLibrary(library) then return false end
        local encoded,text=pcall(http.JSONEncode,http,library)
        if not encoded or type(text)~="string" then control.lastProfileError="Cannot encode saved configurations";return false end
        if text==control.lastLibraryText then
            control.library,control.pendingCurrent,control.lastProfileError=library,nil,nil
            return true
        end
        local backupText=control.lastLibraryText or text
        local backedUp=pcall(host.writefile,control.libraryBackupPath,backupText)
        if not backedUp then control.lastProfileError="Cannot preserve configuration backup";return false end
        local backupOk,verifiedBackup=pcall(host.readfile,control.libraryBackupPath)
        if not backupOk or verifiedBackup~=backupText then control.lastProfileError="Configuration backup could not be verified";return false end
        local written=pcall(host.writefile,control.libraryPath,text)
        if not written then control.lastProfileError="Cannot write configuration library";return false end
        local checked,contents=pcall(host.readfile,control.libraryPath)
        if not checked or contents~=text then control.lastProfileError="Configuration library could not be verified";return false end
        control.library,control.lastLibraryText=library,text
        control.lastProfileError,control.pendingCurrent=nil,nil
        control.profileWrites+=1
        notifyProfiles()
        return true
    end
    function control.listProfiles(): {string}
        local names={}
        for name in (control.library and control.library.Profiles) or {} do table.insert(names,name) end
        table.sort(names,function(a,b)
            if a=="Current" then return b~="Current" end
            if b=="Current" then return false end
            if a:lower()==b:lower() then return a<b end
            return a:lower()<b:lower()
        end)
        return names
    end
    function control.selectProfile(name: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or type(name)~="string" or not control.library or not control.library.Profiles[name] then return false end
        control.selectedName=name
        return true -- Choosing a row never applies settings or writes to disk.
    end
    local function syncCurrent(snapshot: any): boolean
        if control.libraryBlocked then return false end
        local library=refreshLibrary()
        if not library or control.libraryBlocked then return false end
        local _,copy=plain(library)
        copy.Profiles.Current=snapshot
        if copy.Profiles[control.selectedName] then copy.Selected=control.selectedName
        elseif copy.Selected==nil then copy.Selected="Current" end
        return writeLibrary(copy)
    end
    function control.saveProfile(value: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.ready or control.blocked or menu.restoringControls then return false end
        local name=control.sanitizeName(value)
        if not name then control.lastProfileError="Use a configuration name of 1-64 characters";return false end
        local library=refreshLibrary()
        if not library or control.libraryBlocked then return false end
        local snapshot=control.snapshot()
        if not snapshot then control.lastProfileError=control.lastError;return false end
        local _,copy=plain(library)
        copy.Profiles[name],copy.Profiles.Current=snapshot,snapshot
        copy.Selected=name
        if not writeLibrary(copy) then return false end
        control.selectedName=name
        notifyProfiles()
        return true
    end
    control.SaveNamed=control.saveProfile
    function control.deleteProfile(value: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.ready or control.blocked or menu.restoringControls then return false end
        local name=if type(value)=='string' then value else control.selectedName
        if name=='Current' then control.lastProfileError='Current is the automatic save and cannot be deleted';return false end
        local library=refreshLibrary()
        if not library or control.libraryBlocked then return false end
        if not library.Profiles[name] then control.lastProfileError='Choose a saved configuration to delete';return false end
        local _,copy=plain(library)
        copy.Profiles[name]=nil
        if copy.Selected==name then copy.Selected=if copy.Profiles.Current then 'Current' else next(copy.Profiles) end
        if not writeLibrary(copy) then return false end
        if control.selectedName==name then control.selectedName=copy.Selected or 'Current' end
        notifyProfiles()
        return true
    end
    function control.loadProfile(value: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.ready or control.blocked or menu.restoringControls then return false end
        local name=if type(value)=="string" then value else control.selectedName
        local library=refreshLibrary()
        local envelope=library and library.Profiles[name]
        if not envelope then control.lastProfileError="Choose a saved configuration";return false end
        -- The same guarded, ordered full restore used on startup restores
        -- binding/layout ownership before callbacks and enables toggles last.
        if not control.applyAndSave(envelope,name) then control.lastProfileError=control.lastError;return false end
        if not control.libraryBlocked then control.lastProfileError=nil end
        notifyProfiles()
        return true
    end
    function control.flush(): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.started or control.blocked or menu.restoringControls then return false end
        local snapshot=control.snapshot()
        if not snapshot then return false end
        local signature=fingerprint(snapshot)
        if signature==control.lastFingerprint then
            control.pendingFingerprint=nil
            control.pollPending,control.changedAt=nil,nil
            if control.pendingCurrent then syncCurrent(snapshot) end
            return true
        end
        local encoded,text=pcall(http.JSONEncode,http,snapshot)
        if not encoded then control.lastError="Cannot encode saved settings";return false end
        local backupText=control.lastValidText or text
        if control.lastBackupText~=backupText then
            local backedUp=pcall(host.writefile,control.backupPath,backupText)
            if not backedUp then control.lastError="Cannot preserve settings backup";return false end
            local checked,contents=pcall(host.readfile,control.backupPath)
            if not checked or contents~=backupText then control.lastError="Settings backup could not be verified";return false end
            control.lastBackupText=backupText
        end
        local written=pcall(host.writefile,control.path,text)
        if not written then control.lastError="Cannot write saved settings";return false end
        local verified,envelopeText=pcall(host.readfile,control.path)
        if not verified or envelopeText~=text then control.lastError="Saved settings could not be verified";return false end
        control.lastValidText,control.lastFingerprint=text,signature
        control.pendingFingerprint,control.changedAt,control.lastError,control.pollPending=nil,nil,nil,nil
        control.writes+=1
        syncCurrent(snapshot)
        return true
    end
    function control.applyAndSave(envelope: any,selectedName: string?): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.ready or control.blocked or menu.restoringControls then control.lastError='Local configuration storage is not ready';return false end
        local before=control.snapshot()
        if not before then return false end
        local previousName,previousPending=control.selectedName,control.pendingCurrent
        if not control.restore(envelope) then return false end
        if selectedName then control.selectedName=selectedName end
        control.pendingCurrent=clock()
        if control.flush() and (control.libraryBlocked or not control.pendingCurrent) then return true end
        local problem=control.lastError or control.lastProfileError or 'Loaded settings could not be saved locally'
        control.selectedName,control.pendingCurrent=previousName,previousPending
        local rolledBack=control.restore(before)
        -- The primary may have succeeded before the profile-library write
        -- failed. Persist the previous live settings again when storage allows.
        if rolledBack then control.pendingCurrent=clock();control.flush() end
        control.lastError=problem
        return false
    end
    function control.importJson(text: any): (boolean, string?)
        if type(text)~='string' or text:match('^%s*$') then control.lastError='Paste a configuration JSON object first';return false,control.lastError end
        local decoded,value=pcall(http.JSONDecode,http,text)
        if not decoded then control.lastError='The pasted configuration is invalid JSON';return false,control.lastError end
        local envelope,problem=control.normalizeImport(value)
        if not envelope then control.lastError=problem;return false,problem end
        local ok=control.applyAndSave(envelope)
        return ok,if ok then 'Imported configuration and saved it locally' else control.lastError
    end
    -- Poll cheap live values, not a copied and sorted 190 KB export. Full
    -- validation, backups and disk readback still run on the actual save.
    local function observedEqual(value, saved, depth)
        local kind=valueType(value)
        if kind=='Color3' then return type(saved)=='table' and value.R==saved.R and value.G==saved.G and value.B==saved.B end
        if kind=='EnumItem' then return type(saved)=='table' and saved.Name==value.Name and saved.Enum==tostring(value.EnumType):gsub('^Enum%.','') end
        if type(value)~='table' then return value==saved end
        if type(saved)~='table' or (depth or 0)>20 then return false end
        local count=0
        for key,item in value do
            count+=1
            if not observedEqual(item,saved[key],(depth or 0)+1) then return false end
        end
        for _ in saved do count-=1 end
        return count==0
    end
    function control.observeChanges()
        local previous=control.observation or {};local nextValues={};local changed=control.observation==nil
        local function observe(key,value)
            local saved=previous[key]
            if saved and observedEqual(value,saved.value) then nextValues[key]=saved;return true end
            local ok,copy=plain(value)
            if not ok then control.lastError='Cannot observe setting: '..key;return false end
            nextValues[key]={value=copy};changed=true;return true
        end
        for id,entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if not kinds[entry.kind] or (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig) or not entry.widget or type(entry.widget.Get)~='function' then continue end
            local ok,value=pcall(entry.widget.Get)
            if entry.name=='Lock On Icon Size' and menu.lockMarker and finite(menu.lockMarker.size) then ok,value=true,menu.lockMarker.size end
            if not ok then control.lastError='Cannot read setting: '..id;return nil end
            if not observe(id,value) then return nil end
        end
        local metadata={Version=1,Controls={}}
        for _,owner in {menu.distanceUnits,menu} do
            if owner and type(owner.stampExport)=='function' then
                local ok,value=pcall(owner.stampExport,metadata)
                if not ok or type(value)~='table' then control.lastError='Cannot observe managed settings';return nil end
                metadata=value
            end
        end
        if not observe('@Metadata',metadata) or not observe('@Keybinds',shared.__CullingKeybindStore or {})
            or not observe('@Layout',(menu.ui and menu.ui.appearance and menu.ui.appearance.order) or {}) then return nil end
        for id in previous do if not nextValues[id] then changed=true;break end end
        control.observation=nextValues
        return changed
    end
    function control.step(): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.started or not control.ready or control.blocked or menu.restoringControls or menu.alive==false then return false end
        local changed=control.observeChanges()
        if changed==nil then return false end
        if changed then control.pollPending=true;control.changedAt=clock();return false end
        if control.pollPending then
            if clock()-control.changedAt<control.debounce then return false end
            local saved=control.flush()
            if saved then control.pollPending=nil end
            return saved
        end
        if control.pendingCurrent and clock()-control.pendingCurrent>=control.debounce then return control.flush() end
        return true
    end
    function control.start(options: any?): boolean
        if not control.alive then return false end
        if control.started then return control.ready end
        if type(host.isfile)~="function" or type(host.readfile)~="function" or type(host.writefile)~="function" then
            control.lastError="Executor file storage is unavailable";return false
        end
        if not menu.entries or next(menu.entries)==nil or (menu.ui and menu.ui.ready==false) then control.lastError="Settings controls are not ready";return false end
        control.started=true
        local envelope,text,problem,existing=read(control.path)
        if not envelope then
            local backup,backupText,backupProblem=read(control.backupPath)
            if backup then envelope,text=backup,backupText;control.recoveredBackup=true;control.lastBackupText=backupText
            elseif existing or backupProblem then control.blocked=true;control.lastError=problem or backupProblem end
        end
        if envelope then
            control.lastValidText=text
            if not options or options.restore~=false then
                if not control.restore(envelope) then control.blocked=true end
            end
            control.lastFingerprint=fingerprint(envelope)
        end
        control.ready=true
        local library=refreshLibrary()
        local current=control.snapshot()
        if library and current and not control.libraryBlocked then
            library.Profiles.Current=current
            if library.Selected==nil then library.Selected="Current" end
            control.pendingCurrent=clock()
        end
        control.selectedName=if library and library.Selected and library.Profiles[library.Selected] then library.Selected else "Current"
        if type(menu.attachConfigStore)=="function" then pcall(menu.attachConfigStore,control) end
        control.step()
        if host.task and type(host.task.spawn)=="function" and type(host.task.wait)=="function" then
            control.thread=host.task.spawn(function()
                while control.alive do
                    host.task.wait(0.25)
                    if control.alive then
                        local stepped,stepProblem = pcall(control.step)
                        if not stepped then
                            control.lastError = 'Save step failed: ' .. tostring(stepProblem)
                            control.stepFailures = (control.stepFailures or 0) + 1
                            if control.stepFailures <= 3 then host.warn('[Shenaniganism] ' .. control.lastError) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        return not control.blocked
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.flush()
        control.alive,control.ready=false,false
        if control.thread and host.task and type(host.task.cancel)=="function" then pcall(host.task.cancel,control.thread) end
    end
    return control
end
return ConfigStore
end)()

local LockMarker = (function(): any
-- Embedded module type mode: strict
-- Native console artwork anchored to the target torso; 10 is 1x, 30 is 3x.
-- Distance adds glow without changing native hue/transparency; acquisition stays with its owner.
local LockMarker = {}

function LockMarker.new(host: {[string]: any}): any
    local control: any = {alive = true,glowPercent=40,images=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}),appearance=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}),targets=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}),markerOrder=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}),suppressed=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}),sequence=0,sizeHooks={},sizeConnections={}}
    local function finite(value,fallback)
        local number=tonumber(value) or fallback
        return if number==number and math.abs(number)<math.huge then number else fallback
    end
    function control.refresh(image)
        if not control.alive or not image or not image.Parent then return end
        local gui=image.Parent
        local target=control.targets[image]
        if target and target.Parent and control.menu and control.menu.autoLock then
            local torso=control.menu.autoLock.targetPart(target)
            if torso and gui.Adornee~=torso then gui.Adornee=torso end
        end
        -- No screen, height or aim offsets: the billboard center is the torso.
        if host.Vector3 then
            local zero=host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            for _,name in {'StudsOffset','StudsOffsetWorldSpace','ExtentsOffset','ExtentsOffsetWorldSpace'} do
                if gui[name]~=zero then gui[name]=zero end
            end
        end
        if host.Vector2 then
            local zero=host.Vector2.new(0,0)
            if gui.SizeOffset~=zero then gui.SizeOffset=zero end
        end
        local style=control.appearance[image]
        local camera=host.workspace and host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local part=gui.Adornee
        local distance=0
        if part and part.Position and camera and camera.CFrame then
            distance=(part.Position-camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
        end
        local strength=math.clamp(distance/200,0,1)*control.glowPercent/100
        image.ImageColor3=if style then style.color else host.Color3.fromRGB(0,251,255)
        if style then image.ImageTransparency=style.transparency end
        if control.size then
            local baseline=control.nativeSize or host.UDim2.fromScale(8,8)
            local desired=host.UDim2.new(baseline.X.Scale*control.size/10,baseline.X.Offset*control.size/10,
                baseline.Y.Scale*control.size/10,baseline.Y.Offset*control.size/10)
            if gui.Size~=desired then gui.Size=desired end
        end
        pcall(function() gui.Brightness=1+strength*2;gui.LightInfluence=0 end)
    end
    function control.reconcileMarkers()
        -- Both legacy lock paths may own a billboard for the same actor.
        -- Keep their tracking state intact, but draw only the newest image.
        local selected={}
        for image in control.images do
            local gui,target=image.Parent,control.targets[image]
            if gui and target and target.Parent and gui.Enabled~=false and (image.Visible~=false or control.suppressed[image]~=nil) then
                local previous=selected[target]
                if not previous or (control.markerOrder[image] or 0)>(control.markerOrder[previous] or 0) then selected[target]=image end
            end
        end
        for image in control.images do
            local target=control.targets[image]
            local duplicate=image.Parent and target and selected[target] and selected[target]~=image
            if duplicate then
                if control.suppressed[image]==nil then control.suppressed[image]=image.Visible~=false end
                image.Visible=false
            elseif control.suppressed[image]~=nil then
                if image.Parent and image.Visible==false then image.Visible=control.suppressed[image] end
                control.suppressed[image]=nil
            end
        end
    end
    function control.setSize(value)
        control.size=math.clamp(finite(value,10),1,30)
        local env=control.menu and control.menu.environment
        if env then
            env.LockIconSize=control.size
            if env._G then env._G.TargetIconSize=control.size end
        end
        if not control.syncingSize then
            control.syncingSize=true
            for widget in control.sizeHooks do
                if widget.Get()~=control.size then widget.Set(control.size,false) end
            end
            control.syncingSize=false
        end
        for image in control.images do control.refresh(image) end
    end
    function control.setGlow(value)
        control.glowPercent=math.clamp(finite(value,40),0,100)
        for image in control.images do control.refresh(image) end
    end
    function control.bindMenu(menu)
        control.menu=menu
        for _,id in {'Main/Lock On Icon Size','Player/Lock On Icon Size'} do
            local entry=menu.entries[id]
            if not entry or not entry.widget or control.sizeHooks[entry.widget] then continue end
            local widget=entry.widget;local hook={widget=widget,original=widget.Set}
            hook.wrapper=function(value,...)
                local results=table.pack(hook.original(value,...))
                if control.alive then control.setSize(widget.Get()) end
                return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
            end
            widget.Set=hook.wrapper;control.sizeHooks[widget]=hook
            if not control.sizeHook then control.sizeHook=hook;control.setSize(widget.Get()) end
        end
    end
    local properties = {
        "Image", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency", "ImageRectOffset", "ImageRectSize",
        "ScaleType", "ResampleMode", "Size", "Position", "AnchorPoint", "Rotation",
        "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderSizePixel",
    }
    local fallback: {[string]: any} = {
        Image = "rbxassetid://263401222",
        ImageColor3 = host.Color3.fromRGB(0, 251, 255),
        ImageTransparency = 0.6,
        ImageRectOffset = host.Vector2.new(0, 0),
        ImageRectSize = host.Vector2.new(0, 0),
        ScaleType = host.Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
        ResampleMode = host.Enum.ResamplerMode.Default,
        Size = host.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        Position = host.UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
        AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(0, 0),
        Rotation = 0,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }

    local function nativeTemplate(): any
        local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local controls = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Controls")
        local marker = controls and controls:FindFirstChild("LockTarget")
        local image = marker and marker:FindFirstChild("ImageLabel")
        return if image and image:IsA("ImageLabel") then image else nil
    end

    function control.create(target: any): any
        if not control.alive or not target or not target.Parent then return nil end
        local gui=host.Instance.new('BillboardGui')
        gui.Name,gui.AlwaysOnTop='LockOnGui',true
        gui.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(8,8)
        gui.Adornee=if control.menu and control.menu.autoLock then control.menu.autoLock.targetPart(target)
            else target:FindFirstChild('Torso') or target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local image=host.Instance.new('ImageLabel')
        image.Name,image.Parent='LockImage',gui
        control.apply(image,target)
        gui.Parent=host.game:GetService('CoreGui')
        return gui
    end

    function control.apply(image: any,target: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or not image or not image:IsA("ImageLabel") then return false end
        local template = nativeTemplate()
        -- Never alter the actual native marker if it is passed accidentally.
        if image == template then return false end
        control.nativeSize=if template and template.Parent then template.Parent.Size else host.UDim2.fromScale(8,8)
        if target then control.targets[image]=target end
        for _, property in properties do
            local value = if template then template[property] else fallback[property]
            image[property] = value
        end
        image.ImageColor3=if template then template.ImageColor3 else fallback.ImageColor3
        control.appearance[image]={transparency=image.ImageTransparency,color=image.ImageColor3}
        control.lastSource = 'Native console marker'
        if control.images[image]==nil then
            control.sequence+=1
            control.markerOrder[image]=control.sequence
            control.images[image]=false
        end
        control.refresh(image)
        control.reconcileMarkers()
        local gui=image.Parent
        if gui and type(gui.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function' and not control.sizeConnections[gui] then
            local record={}
            record.size=gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Size'):Connect(function()
                if control.alive and image.Parent==gui then control.refresh(image) end
            end)
            if gui.Destroying then record.destroy=gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
                record.size:Disconnect()
                if record.destroy then record.destroy:Disconnect() end
                control.sizeConnections[gui]=nil;control.images[image]=nil;control.appearance[image]=nil;control.targets[image]=nil
                control.markerOrder[image]=nil;control.suppressed[image]=nil
                if control.alive then control.reconcileMarkers() end
            end) end
            control.sizeConnections[gui]=record
        end
        return true
    end

    local ok,run=pcall(function() return host.game:GetService('RunService') end)
    if ok and run and run.RenderStepped then
        local elapsed=0
        control.glowConnection=run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
            elapsed+=delta
            if elapsed<.05 then return end
            elapsed=0
            for image in control.images do control.refresh(image) end
            control.reconcileMarkers()
        end)
    end

    function control.Destroy()
        control.alive = false
        if control.glowConnection then control.glowConnection:Disconnect() end
        for widget,hook in control.sizeHooks do if widget.Set==hook.wrapper then widget.Set=hook.original end end
        for _,record in control.sizeConnections do record.size:Disconnect();if record.destroy then record.destroy:Disconnect() end end
        table.clear(control.sizeHooks);table.clear(control.sizeConnections)
        for image,visible in control.suppressed do if image.Parent and image.Visible==false then image.Visible=visible end end
        table.clear(control.suppressed);table.clear(control.markerOrder)
        table.clear(control.images)
        table.clear(control.appearance)
        table.clear(control.targets)
    end
    return control
end

return LockMarker
end)()

local ParkourAssist = (function(): any
-- Uses the game's own Parkour action; no root, velocity, cooldown or remote rewrites.
local ParkourAssist: {[string]: any}={}
function ParkourAssist.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any): any
    local game,clock=host.game,host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local players,input,run=game:GetService('Players'),game:GetService('UserInputService'),game:GetService('RunService')
    local player,world=players.LocalPlayer,host.workspace
    local inspect=host.getupvalues or (host.debug and host.debug.getupvalues)
    local replace=host.setupvalue or (host.debug and host.debug.setupvalue)
    local valueType=host.typeof or typeof
    local shared=host._G or host
    local control: any={alive=true,ready=false,infiniteReady=false,infiniteEnabled=false,autoWallrunEnabled=false,
        focused=true,connections={},wallRequests=0,wallStarts=0,infiniteResets=0,countRestoreFailures=0,lastRequest=-math.huge,lastScan=-math.huge,lastReason='Disabled'}
    local function connect(signal: any,callback: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function number(value: any): boolean return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
    local function values(): any
        if type(inspect)~='function' or type(control.nativeParkour)~='function' then return nil end
        local ok,found=pcall(inspect,control.nativeParkour)
        return if ok and type(found)=='table' then found else nil
    end
    local function signature(found: any): boolean
        if not found or valueType(found[1])~='RaycastParams' or not number(found[2]) or found[2]<0 or found[2]%1~=0 then return false end
        local service,animations,animation=found[6],found[7],found[8]
        if type(service)~='table' or type(service.Parkour)~='table' or type(service.Parkour.Fire)~='function'
            or type(animations)~='table' or type(animations.BounceL)~='table' or type(animations.BounceR)~='table'
            or valueType(animation)~='Instance' or not animation:IsA('Animation') or animation.Name~='Parkour' then return false end
        local params=found[1]
        if params.FilterType~=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include then return false end
        local map=world:FindFirstChild('Map')
        return map~=nil and #params.FilterDescendantsInstances==1 and params.FilterDescendantsInstances[1]==map
    end
    local function nativeLimit(character: any,humanoid: any,info: any): number
        local limit=if info:FindFirstChild('DomainClash') then 1 elseif character:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Goku' then 4 else 3
        if humanoid.Health<humanoid.MaxHealth*.33 then limit-=2 elseif humanoid.Health<humanoid.MaxHealth*.66 then limit-=1 end
        return limit
    end
    local function eligible(character: any,root: any,humanoid: any,needsJump: boolean): (boolean,string,number?)
        if not control.alive or (menu and menu.alive==false) or not control.focused or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or (menu and menu.recording) then return false,'Input is unavailable' end
        if character~=player.Character or character==control.removingCharacter or not character or not character.Parent
            or not root or root.Parent~=character or not humanoid or humanoid.Parent~=character
            or root~=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or humanoid~=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then return false,'Character is unavailable' end
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or character:GetAttribute('Dead') then return false,'Character is unavailable' end
        for _,name in {'Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll'} do
            local state=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if state==true or (type(state)=='number' and state>0) then return false,'Character is ragdolled' end
        end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info or info:GetAttribute('Parkour') or character:GetAttribute('Movement') then return false,'Native parkour is busy' end
        for _,name in {'NoParkour','Stun','Block','NoJump','Knockback','InSkill','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false,'Native movement restriction: '..name end
        end
        if humanoid:GetState()~=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then return false,'Freefall is required' end
        if needsJump and humanoid.Jump~=true then return false,'Native jump is required' end
        local side=math.round(humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(root.CFrame.RightVector))
        if side==0 then return false,'Move sideways beside a wall' end
        local scale=character:GetScale()
        if not number(scale) or scale<=0 then return false,'Character scale is unavailable' end
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector*host.Vector3.new(1,0,1)
        if look.Magnitude<.001 then return false,'Character orientation is unavailable' end
        local basis=host.CFrame.lookAlong(root.Position,look)
        if world:Raycast(root.Position,basis.UpVector*scale*4,control.mapParams) then return false,'Native ceiling obstruction' end
        if not world:Raycast(root.Position,basis.RightVector*scale*(side*3),control.mapParams) then return false,'No native side wall' end
        local limit=nativeLimit(character,humanoid,info)
        if limit<=0 then return false,'Native health limit prevents a wall bounce' end
        return true,'Eligible',limit
    end
    local function restoreCount(lease: any)
        if not lease or not lease.changed then return end
        local found=values()
        -- A replacement character or another writer must retain its newer state.
        if player.Character~=lease.character or not signature(found) or (found[2]~=0 and found[2]~=1) then
            control.lastReason='Native counter changed during parkour';return
        end
        local ok,message=pcall(replace,control.nativeParkour,2,lease.previous)
        if not ok then
            control.countRestoreFailures+=1;control.infiniteReady=false
            control.lastReason='Cannot restore native wall counter: '..tostring(message)
        end
    end
    local module
    local ok,message=pcall(function()
        local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
        local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
        local folder=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('Character')
        module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('MovementController')
        assert(module,'Native MovementController is unavailable')
        control.controller=host.require(module)
        assert(type(control.controller)=='table' and type(control.controller.Parkour)=='function','Native Parkour action is unavailable')
        control.original=control.controller.Parkour
        control.nativeParkour=control.original
        local recorder=shared.__ShenaniganismParkourCapture
        if recorder and recorder.active and recorder.controller==control.controller and recorder.wrapper==control.original
            and type(recorder.nativeParkour)=='function' then control.nativeParkour=recorder.nativeParkour end
        local found=values()
        assert(signature(found),'Native Parkour signature did not match')
        control.mapParams,control.nativeService=found[1],found[6]
        control.ready=true;control.infiniteReady=type(replace)=='function'
        control.wrapper=function(self: any,character: any,root: any,humanoid: any,...: any)
            if not control.alive or not control.infiniteEnabled or not control.infiniteReady or self~=control.controller then
                return control.original(self,character,root,humanoid,...)
            end
            local allowed,_,limit=eligible(character,root,humanoid,true)
            local native=if allowed then values() else nil
            if not allowed or not signature(native) or native[2]<limit then return control.original(self,character,root,humanoid,...) end
            local lease={character=character,previous=native[2],changed=false}
            local reset,problem=pcall(replace,control.nativeParkour,2,0)
            local resetValues=if reset then values() else nil
            if not reset or not signature(resetValues) or resetValues[2]~=0 then
                control.infiniteReady=false;control.lastReason='Cannot scope native wall counter: '..tostring(problem)
                return control.original(self,character,root,humanoid,...)
            end
            lease.changed=true;control.infiniteResets+=1
            local results=table.pack(pcall(control.original,self,character,root,humanoid,...))
            restoreCount(lease)
            if not results[1] then error(results[2],0) end
            return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
        end
        control.controller.Parkour=control.wrapper
    end)
    if not ok then control.lastReason=tostring(message) end
    local function manualJump(): boolean
        local code=host.Enum.KeyCode and host.Enum.KeyCode.Space
        local down=code and input:IsKeyDown(code)
        if down then return true end
        local controls=menu and menu.m1Assist and menu.m1Assist.controls
        local active=controls and controls.activeController
        return active~=nil and active.isJumping==true
    end
    function control.step()
        if not control.alive or not control.ready or not control.autoWallrunEnabled then return end
        local now=clock()
        if now-control.lastScan<.1 then return end
        control.lastScan=now
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local allowed,reason,limit=eligible(character,root,humanoid,false)
        if not allowed then control.lastReason=reason;return end
        local found=values()
        if not signature(found) then control.ready=false;control.infiniteReady=false;control.lastReason='Native Parkour signature changed';return end
        if found[2]>=limit and not (control.infiniteEnabled and control.infiniteReady) then control.lastReason='Native wall-bounce count reached';return end
        if now-control.lastRequest<.1 then return end
        control.lastRequest=now
        local previous=humanoid.Jump
        local movement=character:GetAttribute('Movement')
        if not previous then humanoid.Jump=true end
        control.wallRequests+=1
        local dispatched,problem=pcall(control.controller.Parkour,control.controller,character,root,humanoid)
        if not previous and humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Jump==true and not manualJump() then humanoid.Jump=false end
        if not dispatched then control.lastReason='Native Parkour failed: '..tostring(problem);return end
        if not movement and character:GetAttribute('Movement') then control.wallStarts+=1;control.lastReason='Native wall movement started'
        else control.lastReason='Native parkour did not start' end
    end
    function control.setInfinite(value: any): boolean
        control.infiniteEnabled=value==true
        control.lastReason=if control.infiniteEnabled and not control.infiniteReady then 'Native wall counter is unavailable' elseif control.infiniteEnabled then 'Native wall counter assistance enabled' else 'Infinite Wall Run disabled'
        return not control.infiniteEnabled or control.infiniteReady
    end
    function control.setAutoWallrun(value: any): boolean
        control.autoWallrunEnabled=value==true;control.lastRequest=-math.huge;control.lastScan=-math.huge
        control.lastReason=if control.autoWallrunEnabled and not control.ready then 'Native Parkour is unavailable' elseif control.autoWallrunEnabled then 'Waiting for native wall conditions' else 'Auto Wallrun disabled'
        return not control.autoWallrunEnabled or control.ready
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false;control.infiniteEnabled=false;control.autoWallrunEnabled=false
        if control.controller and control.controller.Parkour==control.wrapper then control.controller.Parkour=control.original end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end
    connect(run.Heartbeat,control.step)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()control.focused=false end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function()control.focused=true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function(character)control.removingCharacter=character end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,function()control.removingCharacter=nil;control.lastRequest=-math.huge;control.lastScan=-math.huge end)
    return control
end
return ParkourAssist
end)()

local AutoRecovery = (function(): any
-- Automatically permit the verified native landing roll; the game owns its animation and movement.
local AutoRecovery: {[string]: any} = {}
function AutoRecovery.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local player = host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local input = host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local inspect = host.getupvalues or (host.debug and host.debug.getupvalues)
    local replace = host.setupvalue or (host.debug and host.debug.setupvalue)
    local readConstants = host.getconstants or (host.debug and host.debug.getconstants)
    local clock = host.tick
    local states = host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
    local control: any = {
        alive=true,enabled=false,active=false,ready=false,windowFocused=true,
        connections={},characterConnections={},loans={},rootLoans={},calls=0,recoveries=0,velocityReadSurrogates=0,
        directionEnabled=false,direction='Movement',directionReady=false,directionRedirects=0,
        directionRecords={},directionUsed=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}),
        directionOptions={'Movement','Camera','Forward','Backward','Left','Right','Forward Left','Forward Right','Backward Left','Backward Right'},
        minimumHeight=5,landingEvents=0,rawNativeCalls=0,recoveryRetryCalls=0,
        lastReason='Auto Recovery is disabled',
    }
    local function finite(value)
        return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function callbackOf(connection)
        local ok,value=pcall(function() return connection.Function end)
        return if ok then value else nil
    end
    local function upvalues(fn)
        if type(inspect)~='function' then return nil end
        local ok,values=pcall(inspect,fn)
        return if ok and type(values)=='table' then values else nil
    end
    local function stamp(fn)
        local values=upvalues(fn)
        return values and values[3]
    end
    local function nativeIdentity(fn,character,humanoid,root)
        local values=upvalues(fn)
        return values and values[1]==root and values[2]==character and finite(values[3]) and values[4]==humanoid
    end
    local function velocityReadIdentity(fn)
        local ok,values=pcall(readConstants,fn)
        -- The live Animate callback reads its captured root's Velocity.Y first;
        -- its later movement reads the character's actual HumanoidRootPart.
        -- These bounded constants identify that read layout independently of
        -- source lines. An unfamiliar layout retains ordinary native behavior.
        return ok and type(values)=='table' and values[5]=='Velocity' and values[6]=='Y'
            and values[34]==40000 and values[52]=='HumanoidRootPart'
            and values[53]=='CFrame' and values[54]=='LookVector'
    end
    local function disconnect(connection)
        if connection then pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
    end
    local function finiteVector(value)
        local kind=host.typeof or typeof
        return kind(value)=='Vector3' and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z)
    end
    local function releaseDirection(mover)
        local record=control.directionRecords[mover]
        if not record then return end
        control.directionRecords[mover]=nil
        for _,connection in record.connections do disconnect(connection) end
    end
    local function clearDirections()
        for mover in control.directionRecords do releaseDirection(mover) end
    end
    local function stopDirectionObserver()
        disconnect(control.directionObserver)
        control.directionObserver,control.directionCharacter=nil,nil
        control.directionReady=false
        clearDirections()
    end
    function control.directionEligible(character)
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not control.alive or not control.directionEnabled or not control.windowFocused
            or character~=player.Character or not character or not character.Parent
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root or root.Parent~=character
            or not states or humanoid.PlatformStand
            or player:GetAttribute('Spectate')==true then return false end
        if menu and menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if state~=states.Landed and state~=states.Running and state~=states.RunningNoPhysics then return false end
        if input and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        if menu and (menu.recording or (menu.keybinds and menu.keybinds.recording)) then return false end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info or not info:FindFirstChild('InRoll') or character:GetAttribute('Movement')~=true then return false end
        for _,name in {'InSkill','Block','Stun','TrueStun','NoParkour','NoMove','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Stun','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','TrueStun'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (finite(value) and value>0) then return false end
        end
        return nativeIdentity(control.nativeFunction,character,humanoid,root)
    end
    function control.rollDirection(character,native)
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local function flat(value)
            if not finiteVector(value) then return nil end
            local result=host.Vector3.new(value.X,0,value.Z)
            return if finite(result.Magnitude) and result.Magnitude>0.001 then result.Unit else nil
        end
        local camera=host.workspace and host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local frame=(camera and camera.CFrame) or root.CFrame
        local forward=flat(frame.LookVector)
        if not forward and finiteVector(frame.RightVector) then
            forward=flat(host.Vector3.new(frame.RightVector.Z,0,-frame.RightVector.X))
        end
        if not forward then return native.Unit end
        local right=host.Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
        if control.direction=='Camera' then return forward end
        if control.direction=='Movement' then
            -- The native roll can suppress Humanoid.MoveDirection. Read the
            -- player's current controls without submitting or changing input.
            -- A keyboard controller can retain its last vector while a native
            -- roll owns movement. Current physical keys take precedence.
            if input and type(input.IsKeyDown)=='function' then
                local function down(first,alternate)
                    local keys=host.Enum.KeyCode
                    return keys and ((keys[first] and input:IsKeyDown(keys[first]))
                        or (keys[alternate] and input:IsKeyDown(keys[alternate]))) or false
                end
                local x=(if down('D','Right') then 1 else 0)-(if down('A','Left') then 1 else 0)
                local z=(if down('S','Down') then 1 else 0)-(if down('W','Up') then 1 else 0)
                if x~=0 or z~=0 then return (right*x-forward*z).Unit end
            end
            if not control.controls then
                local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
                local module=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('PlayerModule')
                if module and type(host.require)=='function' then
                    local ok,result=pcall(host.require,module)
                    if ok and result and type(result.GetControls)=='function' then
                        local got,controls=pcall(result.GetControls,result)
                        if got then control.controls=controls end
                    end
                end
            end
            local active=control.controls and control.controls.activeController
            if active and type(active.GetMoveVector)=='function' then
                local reader=active.GetMoveVector
                for _=1,4 do
                    local previous=reader
                    for _,component in {menu and menu.m1Approach,menu and menu.blackflashChain,menu and menu.knockbackControl} do
                        local hook=component and component.movementHook
                        if hook and hook.controller==active and hook.wrapper==reader then reader=hook.original end
                    end
                    if reader==previous then break end
                end
                local ok,value=pcall(reader,active)
                if ok and finiteVector(value) and flat(value) then return (right*value.X-forward*value.Z).Unit end
            end
            return flat(humanoid.MoveDirection) or flat(root.CFrame.LookVector) or native.Unit
        end
        local choices={Forward={0,-1},Backward={0,1},Left={-1,0},Right={1,0},
            ['Forward Left']={-1,-1},['Forward Right']={1,-1},['Backward Left']={-1,1},['Backward Right']={1,1}}
        local choice=choices[control.direction]
        if not choice then return native.Unit end
        return (right*choice[1]-forward*choice[2]).Unit
    end
    -- A new native mover may be parented before its roll markers and fields.
    -- This gate permits observation only; directionEligible still owns writes.
    local function pendingRollEligible(character)
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not control.alive or not control.directionEnabled or not control.windowFocused
            or character~=player.Character or not character or not character.Parent
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root or root.Parent~=character
            or not states or humanoid.PlatformStand or player:GetAttribute('Spectate')==true then return false end
        if menu and menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if state~=states.Landed and state~=states.Running and state~=states.RunningNoPhysics then return false end
        if input and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        if menu and (menu.recording or (menu.keybinds and menu.keybinds.recording)) then return false end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info then return false end
        for _,name in {'InSkill','Block','Stun','TrueStun','NoParkour','NoMove','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Stun','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','TrueStun'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (finite(value) and value>0) then return false end
        end
        return nativeIdentity(control.nativeFunction,character,humanoid,root)
    end
    function control.observeRollMover(mover,character)
        if control.directionUsed[mover] or not pendingRollEligible(character)
            or not mover:IsA('BodyVelocity') or mover.Parent~=character:FindFirstChild('Torso') then return end
        control.directionUsed[mover]=true
        local record={character=character,created=clock(),connections={},writing=false,initialized=false}
        control.directionRecords[mover]=record
        local function attempt()
            if control.directionRecords[mover]~=record or record.writing then return end
            if not pendingRollEligible(character) or mover.Parent~=character:FindFirstChild('Torso')
                or not mover:IsDescendantOf(character) or (not record.initialized and clock()-record.created>.5) then releaseDirection(mover);return end
            -- The verified native handler parents the force before assigning its
            -- markers, signature and first Velocity. Only new candidates wait;
            -- existing, expired or unrelated movers can never be adopted.
            if mover.Name~='MovementForce' then
                if record.initialized or mover.Name~='BodyVelocity' then releaseDirection(mover) end
                return
            end
            if not control.directionEligible(character) then
                if record.initialized then releaseDirection(mover) end
                return
            end
            local force=mover.MaxForce
            if mover.P~=40000 or not finiteVector(force) or force.Y~=0
                or force.X<=0 or force.X>40000 or force.X~=force.Z then
                if record.initialized then releaseDirection(mover) end
                return
            end
            local base=mover.Velocity
            if not finiteVector(base) then releaseDirection(mover);return end
            local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(base.X,0,base.Z)
            if not finite(horizontal.Magnitude) then releaseDirection(mover);return end
            if horizontal.Magnitude==0 then return end
            record.initialized=true
            local direction=control.rollDirection(character,horizontal)
            local adjusted=direction*horizontal.Magnitude
            local applied=host.Vector3.new(adjusted.X,base.Y,adjusted.Z)
            if not finiteVector(applied) then releaseDirection(mover);return end
            -- Only rotate the currently supplied native vector. Never retain a
            -- speed to replay over native decay or extend the mover's lifetime.
            if (applied-base).Magnitude>0.0001 then
                record.writing=true
                mover.Velocity=applied
                record.writing=false
                control.directionRedirects+=1
            end
        end
        record.update=attempt
        for _,property in {'Name','P','MaxForce','Velocity'} do
            table.insert(record.connections,mover:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(attempt))
        end
        table.insert(record.connections,mover.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
            if mover.Parent~=character:FindFirstChild('Torso') or not mover:IsDescendantOf(character) then releaseDirection(mover) end
        end))
        attempt()
    end
    function control.refreshDirection()
        if not control.alive or not control.directionEnabled then stopDirectionObserver();return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root then stopDirectionObserver();return end
        if character~=control.character or not control.ready then
            if not control.discover() then stopDirectionObserver();return end
        end
        if not nativeIdentity(control.nativeFunction,character,humanoid,root) then stopDirectionObserver();return end
        if control.directionCharacter~=character then
            stopDirectionObserver()
            control.directionCharacter=character
            control.directionObserver=character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(mover) control.observeRollMover(mover,character) end)
        end
        control.directionReady=true
        for _,record in control.directionRecords do record.update() end
    end
    function control.updateDirections()
        for _,record in control.directionRecords do record.update() end
    end
    function control.setDirectionEnabled(value)
        control.directionEnabled=control.alive and value==true
        control.refreshDirection()
    end
    function control.setDirection(value)
        if table.find(control.directionOptions,value) then control.direction=value;return true end
        return false
    end
    function control.setMinimumHeight(value)
        if not finite(value) then return false end
        control.minimumHeight=math.clamp(value,0,100)
        return true
    end
    local function groundClearance(character,humanoid,root)
        local world=host.workspace
        if not world or type(world.Raycast)~='function' or not host.Vector3 or not finiteVector(root.Position) then return nil end
        if not control.groundParameters and host.RaycastParams and host.Enum.RaycastFilterType then
            control.groundParameters=host.RaycastParams.new()
            control.groundParameters.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            control.groundParameters.IgnoreWater=true
            control.groundParameters.RespectCanCollide=true
        end
        local parameters=control.groundParameters
        if parameters and control.groundCharacter~=character then
            parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
            control.groundCharacter=character
        end
        local ok,result=pcall(world.Raycast,world,root.Position,host.Vector3.new(0,-4096,0),parameters)
        if not ok or not result or not finiteVector(result.Position) then return nil end
        if result.Instance and type(result.Instance.IsDescendantOf)=='function' and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then return nil end
        local hip=if finite(humanoid.HipHeight) then humanoid.HipHeight else 0
        local half=if finiteVector(root.Size) then root.Size.Y/2 else 1
        -- R6 standing height includes both legs and HipHeight. R15 has no
        -- legacy leg part and already includes its standing offset in HipHeight.
        local leg=character:FindFirstChild('Left Leg') or character:FindFirstChild('Right Leg')
        if leg and finiteVector(leg.Size) then hip+=leg.Size.Y end
        return math.max(0,root.Position.Y-result.Position.Y-half-hip),result.Position.Y,root.Position.Y-half-hip
    end
    function control.cancelPendingLanding(reason)
        local pending=control.pendingLanding
        control.pendingLanding=nil
        if not pending then return end
        for _,connection in pending.connections do disconnect(connection) end
        control.lastPendingReason=reason
    end
    function control.sampleFall()
        if control.pendingLanding then return end
        if not control.enabled or not control.windowFocused or (menu and menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) then control.fall=nil;return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root then control.fall=nil;return end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        local clearance,_,feetY=groundClearance(character,humanoid,root)
        local velocity=root.Velocity
        if not finite(clearance) or not velocity or not finite(velocity.Y) then return end
        -- Wall-running can retain Running/Climbing instead of Freefall. The
        -- measured gap beneath the feet is still real airborne evidence; it
        -- never dispatches anything until the actual native Landed event.
        local airborne=state==states.Freefall or state==states.Jumping or state==states.Climbing or clearance>1
        if state==states.Dead or not airborne then
            if control.fall and clock()-control.fall.at>.5 then control.fall=nil end
            return
        end
        local record=control.fall
        if not record or record.character~=character then record={character=character,height=0,velocity=0};control.fall=record end
        record.height=math.max(record.height,clearance)
        record.peakFeetY=math.max(record.peakFeetY or feetY,feetY)
        record.velocity=math.min(record.velocity,velocity.Y)
        record.at=clock()
    end
    local function captureLanding(newState)
        if newState~=states.Landed or not control.humanoid then return nil end
        control.landingEvents+=1;control.lastLandingAt=clock()
        local state=control.humanoid:GetState()
        control.lastLandingState=tostring(state)
        local record=control.fall
        control.fall=nil
        local clearance,groundY
        if control.character and control.root then clearance,groundY=groundClearance(control.character,control.humanoid,control.root) end
        control.groundReady=finite(clearance)
        control.lastLandingClearance=clearance
        if not control.groundReady then control.lastReason='Landing ground could not be verified';return nil end
        if state~=states.Landed and state~=states.Running and state~=states.RunningNoPhysics then control.lastReason='The native landing state is no longer grounded';return nil end
        if not record or record.character~=control.character or not finite(record.at) then control.lastReason='No airborne height was recorded before landing';return nil end
        if clock()-record.at>.5 then control.lastReason='The airborne height record expired before landing';return nil end
        -- The live native Landed event can precede the final contact solver by
        -- slightly over one stud. Require actual floor contact for that small
        -- margin, and retain the strict gap bound when no floor is confirmed.
        local air=host.Enum.Material and host.Enum.Material.Air
        local onFloor=air~=nil and control.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=nil and control.humanoid.FloorMaterial~=air
        local tolerance=if onFloor and finiteVector(control.root.Size) then math.max(1,math.min(1.5,control.root.Size.Y*.75)) else 1
        record.height=math.min(record.height,math.max(0,record.peakFeetY-groundY))
        local velocity=control.root.Velocity
        if velocity and finite(velocity.Y) then record.velocity=math.min(record.velocity,velocity.Y) end
        control.lastLandingHeight,control.lastLandingVelocity=record.height,record.velocity
        if clearance>tolerance then control.lastReason='The landing has not reached actual ground';return nil,record end
        return record,record
    end
    local function restoreLoan(loan)
        if not loan or not loan.owned then return end
        if stamp(loan.fn)==loan.applied then
            local ok=pcall(replace,loan.fn,3,loan.previous)
            if not ok then control.lastReason='Native landing timestamp could not be restored';return end
        end
        loan.owned=false
        control.loans[loan]=nil
    end
    local function restoreRootLoan(loan)
        if not loan or not loan.owned then return false end
        local values=upvalues(loan.fn)
        if values and values[1]==loan.proxy then
            pcall(replace,loan.fn,1,loan.root)
            values=upvalues(loan.fn)
            if values and values[1]==loan.proxy then
                control.lastReason='Native landing root read could not be restored'
                return false
            end
        end
        loan.owned=false;control.rootLoans[loan]=nil
        return values and values[1]==loan.root
    end
    local function loanVelocityRead(fn,landing)
        local root=control.root
        local velocity=root and root.Velocity
        if not landing or not control.groundReady or not finiteVector(velocity)
            or velocity.Y<-50 or not velocityReadIdentity(fn) then return nil end
        local loan={fn=fn,root=root,owned=true}
        loan.proxy=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(_,key)
            if key=='Velocity' then
                -- Restore before returning the eligibility-only read, so the
                -- native animation, mover and nested state listeners all see
                -- the real root. No property on the character is written.
                if restoreRootLoan(loan) then
                    local current=root.Velocity
                    if finiteVector(current) then
                        control.velocityReadSurrogates+=1
                        return host.Vector3.new(current.X,math.clamp(landing.velocity,-4096,-51),current.Z)
                    end
                end
                return root.Velocity
            end
            local value=root[key]
            if type(value)=='function' then return function(_,...)return value(root,...)end end
            return value
        end})
        pcall(replace,fn,1,loan.proxy)
        local values=upvalues(fn)
        if values and values[1]==loan.proxy then control.rootLoans[loan]=true;return loan end
        loan.owned=false
        return nil
    end
    function control.release()
        control.cancelPendingLanding('Recovery released')
        control.fall=nil
        disconnect(control.wrapperConnection)
        control.wrapperConnection=nil
        for loan in control.loans do restoreLoan(loan) end
        for loan in control.rootLoans do restoreRootLoan(loan) end
        local native=control.nativeConnection
        if control.connectionOwned and native and callbackOf(native)==control.nativeFunction then
            local ok,connected=pcall(function() return native.Connected end)
            if (not ok or connected~=false) and native.Enabled==false then
                pcall(function() native:Enable() end)
            end
        end
        control.connectionOwned,control.active=false,false
    end
    function control.discover()
        if control.active then return control.ready end
        control.ready=false
        if type(host.getconnections)~='function' or type(inspect)~='function' or type(replace)~='function'
            or type(readConstants)~='function' or type(host.getfenv)~='function' or type(clock)~='function'
            or not host.debug or type(host.debug.info)~='function' or not states then
            control.lastReason='Verified native landing inspection APIs are unavailable';return false
        end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local animate=character and character:FindFirstChild('Animate')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root or not animate then
            control.lastReason='The native character landing handler is not ready';return false
        end
        local ok,list=pcall(host.getconnections,humanoid.StateChanged)
        if not ok or type(list)~='table' then control.lastReason='Native landing callbacks are unavailable';return false end
        local candidates={}
        for _,connection in list do
            local fn=callbackOf(connection)
            if type(fn)~='function' or connection==control.surrenderedConnection or connection.Enabled~=true or type(connection.Disable)~='function' or type(connection.Enable)~='function' then continue end
            local sourceOk,source,line=pcall(host.debug.info,fn,'sl')
            local envOk,environment=pcall(host.getfenv,fn)
            if not sourceOk or type(source)~='string' or not source:match('%.Animate$')
                or not envOk or type(environment)~='table' or environment.script~=animate
                or not nativeIdentity(fn,character,humanoid,root) then continue end
            local valuesOk,values=pcall(readConstants,fn)
            if not valuesOk or type(values)~='table' then continue end
            local found={}
            for _,value in values do if type(value)=='string' then found[value]=true end end
            if not (found.Landed and found.InRoll and found.MovementForce and found.Parkour and found.Roll) then continue end
            table.insert(candidates,{connection=connection,fn=fn,source=source..':'..tostring(line)})
        end
        if #candidates~=1 then
            control.lastReason=if #candidates>1 then 'Native landing handler is ambiguous' else 'Verified native landing handler is unavailable or already owned'
            return false
        end
        local selected=candidates[1]
        control.nativeConnection,control.nativeFunction,control.source=selected.connection,selected.fn,selected.source
        control.character,control.humanoid,control.root=character,humanoid,root
        control.velocityReadVerified=velocityReadIdentity(selected.fn)
        control.ready=true
        return true
    end
    function control.eligible(newState,landing)
        local character,humanoid,root=control.character,control.humanoid,control.root
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not control.windowFocused or newState~=states.Landed then return false end
        if player.Character~=character or not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0
            or not root or root.Parent~=character then control.lastReason='The landing character is unavailable or dead';return false end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if state~=states.Landed and not (landing and control.groundReady and (state==states.Running or state==states.RunningNoPhysics)) then return false end
        if input and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        if menu and (menu.recording or (menu.keybinds and menu.keybinds.recording) or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())) then return false end
        if control.groundReady then
            if not landing then return false end
            if landing.height<control.minimumHeight then control.lastReason='Grounded fall is below the recovery height';return false end
            if landing.velocity>=0 then control.lastReason='No descending motion was recorded before landing';return false end
        end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local velocity=root.Velocity
        if not info or not velocity or not finite(velocity.Y) or character:GetAttribute('Movement') then return false end
        if velocity.Y>=-50 and (not landing or not finiteVector(velocity) or not velocityReadIdentity(control.nativeFunction)) then
            control.lastReason='The native short-drop read layout is not verified'
            return false
        end
        for _,name in {'InSkill','Block','Stun','NoParkour','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','TrueStun','InRoll'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then control.lastReason='Native '..name..' prevents recovery';return false end
        end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','TrueStun'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (finite(value) and value>0) then return false end
        end
        if humanoid.PlatformStand or player:GetAttribute('Spectate')==true then return false end
        return nativeIdentity(control.nativeFunction,character,humanoid,root)
    end
    local function pendingLandingSafe(pending)
        local character,humanoid,root=pending.character,pending.humanoid,pending.root
        local now=clock()
        local readConnected,connected=pcall(function() return pending.native.Connected end)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not control.active or not control.windowFocused
            or now<pending.at or now-pending.at>.15 or player.Character~=character or not character.Parent
            or humanoid.Parent~=character or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or root.Parent~=character
            or control.character~=character or control.nativeFunction~=pending.fn or control.nativeConnection~=pending.native
            or control.wrapperConnection~=pending.wrapper or not pending.wrapper or pending.wrapper.Connected==false
            or readConnected and connected==false
            or callbackOf(pending.native)~=pending.fn or pending.native.Enabled~=false
            or not nativeIdentity(pending.fn,character,humanoid,root) or stamp(pending.fn)~=pending.stamp
            or player:GetAttribute('Spectate')==true or humanoid.Jump==true then return false end
        if input and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        if menu and (menu.recording or menu.menuKeyCapturing or (menu.keybinds and menu.keybinds.recording)
            or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())) then return false end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if state~=states.Landed and state~=states.Running and state~=states.RunningNoPhysics then return false end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info~=pending.info then return false end
        for _,name in {'InSkill','NoParkour'} do
            local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name)
            if marker and marker~=pending.markers[name] then return false end
        end
        for _,name in {'InRoll','InDash','Block','Stun','TrueStun','NoMove','Dead','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','Knockback'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) or value==true or finite(value) and value>0 then return false end
        end
        local moving=character:GetAttribute('Movement')
