        if moving and not pending.oldMovement then return false end
        if not moving then pending.oldMovement=false end
        return true
    end
    local function queuePendingLanding(arguments,landing,contactReady)
        if not landing or not finite(landing.height) or landing.height<control.minimumHeight
            or not finite(landing.velocity) or landing.velocity>=0 or not control.groundReady
            or not velocityReadIdentity(control.nativeFunction) then return nil end
        local info=control.character and control.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info then return nil end
        local markers={InSkill=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill'),NoParkour=info:FindFirstChild('NoParkour')}
        -- Only solver contact or an already-present parkour/skill guard may
        -- settle. New actions and every stun/roll/dash guard cancel instead.
        if contactReady and not markers.InSkill and not markers.NoParkour then return nil end
        local pending={character=control.character,humanoid=control.humanoid,root=control.root,info=info,
            fn=control.nativeFunction,native=control.nativeConnection,wrapper=control.wrapperConnection,stamp=stamp(control.nativeFunction),
            at=clock(),landing=landing,arguments=arguments,markers=markers,connections={},rawFinished=false,
            oldMovement=control.character:GetAttribute('Movement')}
        if not pendingLandingSafe(pending) then return nil end
        control.cancelPendingLanding('A newer genuine landing replaced the pending episode')
        control.pendingLanding=pending
        table.insert(pending.connections,info.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if control.pendingLanding~=pending then return end
            local name=child.Name
            if name=='InSkill' or name=='NoParkour' then
                if child~=pending.markers[name] then control.cancelPendingLanding('A new native action began') end
            elseif table.find({'InRoll','InDash','Block','Stun','TrueStun','NoMove','Dead','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','Knockback'},name) then
                control.cancelPendingLanding('Native '..name..' began before recovery')
            end
        end))
        if type(pending.character.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function' then
            for _,name in {'Movement','InDash','Stun','TrueStun','Dead','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','Knockback'} do
                table.insert(pending.connections,pending.character:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
                    if control.pendingLanding==pending and not pendingLandingSafe(pending) then control.cancelPendingLanding('Native action ownership changed') end
                end))
            end
        end
        control.lastPendingReason='Waiting briefly for the same landing contact and existing parkour guards'
        return pending
    end
    local function invokeNative(arguments,landing)
        local fn=control.nativeFunction
        local loan,rootLoan=nil,nil
        if control.eligible(arguments[2],landing) then
            local previous,now=stamp(fn),clock()
            -- A real recent jump already satisfies the native handler without an edit.
            if finite(previous) and finite(now) and now-previous>=0.25 then
                local candidate={fn=fn,previous=previous,applied=now,owned=true}
                local ok=pcall(replace,fn,3,now)
                if stamp(fn)==now then
                    loan=candidate;control.loans[candidate]=true;control.recoveries+=1
                    control.lastReason='The native landing roll was permitted'
                elseif ok then
                    control.lastReason='Native landing timestamp ownership changed'
                else
                    control.lastReason='Native landing timestamp cannot be supplied'
                end
            end
            rootLoan=loanVelocityRead(fn,landing)
        end
        -- This can yield for the native .4-second roll. Each loan belongs to this call.
        local ok,result=xpcall(function() return table.pack(fn(table.unpack(arguments,1,arguments.n))) end,function(err) return tostring(err) end)
        restoreRootLoan(rootLoan)
        restoreLoan(loan)
        control.calls+=1
        return ok,result
    end
    function control.stepPendingLanding()
        local pending=control.pendingLanding
        if not pending then return end
        if not pendingLandingSafe(pending) then control.cancelPendingLanding('Pending landing expired or native ownership changed');return end
        if not pending.rawFinished then return end
        local air=host.Enum.Material and host.Enum.Material.Air
        if not air or pending.humanoid.FloorMaterial==nil or pending.humanoid.FloorMaterial==air then return end
        local clearance,groundY=groundClearance(pending.character,pending.humanoid,pending.root)
        local tolerance=if finiteVector(pending.root.Size) then math.max(1,math.min(1.5,pending.root.Size.Y*.75)) else 1
        if not finite(clearance) or clearance>tolerance then return end
        -- Revalidate against the actual final floor without increasing the
        -- original airborne measurement or borrowing a later flight episode.
        local landing=pending.landing
        landing.height=math.min(landing.height,math.max(0,landing.peakFeetY-groundY))
        control.groundReady=true;control.lastLandingClearance=clearance
        if landing.height<control.minimumHeight then control.cancelPendingLanding('Final contact is below the recovery height');return end
        if not control.eligible(states.Landed,landing) then return end
        -- Consume before entering a yielding native roll. This is one bounded
        -- direct recovery retry, never a second StateChanged signal dispatch.
        control.cancelPendingLanding('The genuine landing received its single grounded retry')
        control.recoveryRetryCalls+=1
        local ok,result=invokeNative(pending.arguments,landing)
        if not ok then error(result,0) end
    end
    function control.runNative(...)
        local fn=control.nativeFunction
        local native=control.nativeConnection
        -- An external renderer/owner that re-enabled the original gets priority.
        if not fn or not control.active then return end
        if callbackOf(native)~=fn or native.Enabled~=false then
            control.surrenderedConnection=native
            control.release();control.ready=false;control.lastReason='Native landing handler ownership changed';return
        end
        local arguments=table.pack(...)
        if control.pendingLanding and (arguments[2]==states.Jumping or arguments[2]==states.Freefall or arguments[2]==states.Dead) then
            control.cancelPendingLanding('A new airborne or dead state began')
        end
        local landing,candidate=captureLanding(arguments[2])
        local pending
        if candidate and not control.eligible(arguments[2],landing) then pending=queuePendingLanding(arguments,candidate,landing~=nil) end
        control.rawNativeCalls+=1
        local ok,result=invokeNative(arguments,landing)
        if pending and control.pendingLanding==pending then
            if ok then pending.rawFinished=true else control.cancelPendingLanding('Native landing callback failed') end
        end
        if not ok then error(result,0) end
        return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
    end
    function control.install()
        if control.active then return true end
        if not control.discover() then return false end
        local native=control.nativeConnection
        local ok=pcall(function() native:Disable() end)
        if not ok or native.Enabled~=false then
            control.connectionOwned=native.Enabled==false;control.release()
            control.lastReason='The native landing handler cannot be temporarily owned';return false
        end
        control.connectionOwned=true
        local connected,wrapper=pcall(function() return control.humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(control.runNative) end)
        if not connected then control.release();control.lastReason='Native landing wrapper could not be connected';return false end
        control.wrapperConnection,control.active=wrapper,true
        control.lastReason='Auto Recovery is ready for a native landing'
        return true
    end
    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.refreshDirection()
        if not control.enabled then control.release();return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then
            control.release();control.ready=false;control.lastReason='The character is unavailable or dead';return
        end
        if control.active and (character~=control.character or humanoid~=control.humanoid
            or callbackOf(control.nativeConnection)~=control.nativeFunction or control.nativeConnection.Enabled~=false) then
            control.surrenderedConnection=control.nativeConnection
            control.release();control.ready=false
        end
        if not control.active then control.install() end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        control.enabled=control.alive and value==true
        if control.enabled then control.refresh()
        else control.release();control.surrenderedConnection=nil;control.lastReason='Auto Recovery is disabled' end
    end
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        if not signal then return end
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback);table.insert(control.connections,connection)
    end
    function control.track(character)
        stopDirectionObserver()
        control.release();control.ready=false;control.surrenderedConnection=nil
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do disconnect(connection) end
        table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        if character then
            local watched={}
            local function attach(object)
                if object:IsA('Humanoid') and not watched[object] then
                    watched[object]=true
                    table.insert(control.characterConnections,object.Died:Connect(function() control.release();control.ready=false;stopDirectionObserver() end))
                    if type(object.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function' then
                        table.insert(control.characterConnections,object:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Jump'):Connect(function()
                            if object.Jump~=true then return end
                            control.cancelPendingLanding('A real jump began')
                            -- A real jump owns the native timestamp, even if tick() has the same value.
                            for loan in control.loans do loan.owned=false;control.loans[loan]=nil end
                        end))
                    end
                end
            end
            table.insert(control.characterConnections,character.ChildAdded:Connect(attach))
            for _,object in character:GetChildren() do attach(object) end
            if control.enabled then control.refresh() else control.discover() end
            control.refreshDirection()
        end
    end
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,control.track)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function() control.track(nil) end)
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        -- Failsafe suppresses this controller's Heartbeat while paused, so
        -- release temporary ownership at the pause boundary itself. Keep the
        -- native callback wrapper alive to forward native movement normally.
        control.cancelPendingLanding('Paused by Failsafe')
        control.fall=nil
        clearDirections()
        for loan in control.loans do restoreLoan(loan) end
        for loan in control.rootLoans do restoreRootLoan(loan) end
    end
    connect(input and input.WindowFocusReleased,function()
        control.windowFocused=false
        control.cancelPendingLanding('Window focus was released')
        control.fall=nil
        clearDirections()
        for loan in control.loans do restoreLoan(loan) end
        for loan in control.rootLoans do restoreRootLoan(loan) end
    end)
    connect(input and input.WindowFocused,function() control.windowFocused=true end)
    local elapsed=0
    connect(run.Heartbeat,function(delta)
        if menu and menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then
            control.cancelPendingLanding('Paused by Failsafe')
            for loan in control.loans do restoreLoan(loan) end
            for loan in control.rootLoans do restoreRootLoan(loan) end
        end
        control.stepPendingLanding()
        control.sampleFall()
        control.updateDirections()
        elapsed+=delta
        if elapsed>=0.25 then elapsed=0;control.refresh() end
    end)
    if player.Character then control.track(player.Character) end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.directionEnabled=false;stopDirectionObserver()
        control.setEnabled(false);control.alive=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do disconnect(connection) end
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do disconnect(connection) end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.characterConnections)
    end
    return control
end
return AutoRecovery
end)()

local InfoVisibility = (function(): any
-- Cached information-display culling. Render callbacks only read isVisible().
local InfoVisibility: {[string]: any} = {}
local fieldChoices = {"Player Name", "Current Action / Emote", "State", "Stun Timer", "Dash Cooldown",
    "Health Bar", "Health Numbers", "Evasive Bar", "Special Bar", "Skill Cooldowns", "Distance"}
local allFields, noFields = {}, {}
for _, name in fieldChoices do allFields[name] = true end

function InfoVisibility.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local world = host.workspace
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, wallCheck = false, maxDistance = 5000/0.28, metersPerStud = 1,
        records = {}, order = {}, cursor = 1, elapsed = 0,
        interval = 0.05, rayInterval = 0.1, raysPerStep = 4,
        settleTime = 0.18, raycasts = 0, lastStepRays = 0,
        priorities = {}, prioritySet = {}, throughWalls = {},
    }
    local parameters = if host.RaycastParams then host.RaycastParams.new() else nil
    if parameters then
        parameters.FilterType = host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        parameters.IgnoreWater = true
    end

    local function body(model: any): any
        if not model or not model.Parent then return nil end
        local part = model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or model:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return if part and part.Parent and part:IsA("BasePart") then part else nil
    end

    local function context(): (any, any, any)
        local character, camera = player.Character, world.CurrentCamera
        local root = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or body(character))
        -- Range belongs to the local character. A detached/zoomed camera must
        -- never become the distance origin, including during respawn.
        local reference = if root and root.Parent then root.Position else nil
        return character, camera, reference
    end

    local function updateRange(record: any, reference: any)
        local part = body(record.model)
        record.part = part
        record.distanceMeters = if part and reference then (part.Position-reference).Magnitude*control.metersPerStud else math.huge
        record.inRange = record.distanceMeters <= control.maxDistance
    end

    function control.track(model: any): any
        if not control.alive or not model or not model.Parent or model == player.Character then return nil end
        local record = control.records[model]
        if record then return record end
        local _, _, reference = context()
        record = {
            model = model, wallVisible = nil, candidate = nil,
            nextRayAt = clock() + (#control.order % 5)*0.02,
        }
        updateRange(record, reference)
        control.records[model] = record
        table.insert(control.order, record)
        return record
    end

    function control.isVisible(model: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or not model or not model.Parent then return false end
        if model == player.Character then return true end
        local record = control.records[model] or control.track(model)
        return record ~= nil and record.inRange == true and (not control.wallCheck or record.wallVisible == true)
    end
    function control.fieldChoices(): {string}
        return table.clone(fieldChoices)
    end
    function control.setThroughWalls(values: any)
        local selected = {}
        if type(values) == "table" then
            for _, name in values do
                if type(name) == "string" and allFields[name] then selected[name] = true end
            end
        end
        control.throughWalls = selected
    end
    function control.fieldsFor(model: any): {[string]: boolean}
        if not control.alive or not model or not model.Parent then return noFields end
        if model == player.Character then return allFields end
        local record = control.records[model] or control.track(model)
        if not record or not record.inRange then return noFields end
        if not control.wallCheck or record.wallVisible == true then return allFields end
        -- Reuse the cached wall result. Selection never adds rays or bypasses range.
        return control.throughWalls
    end
    function control.prioritize(model: any): boolean
        local record=control.track(model)
        if not record or not record.inRange then return false end
        record.priorityUntil=clock()+0.3
        if record.wallVisible==nil then record.nextRayAt=math.min(record.nextRayAt,clock()) end
        if not control.prioritySet[record] then
            control.prioritySet[record]=true
            table.insert(control.priorities,record)
        end
        return true
    end

    local function rememberVisibility(record: any, visible: boolean, now: number)
        if record.wallVisible == nil then
            record.wallVisible, record.candidate = visible, nil
        elseif visible == record.wallVisible then
            record.candidate = nil
        elseif record.candidate ~= visible then
            record.candidate, record.candidateAt = visible, now
        elseif now-record.candidateAt >= control.settleTime then
            record.wallVisible, record.candidate = visible, nil
        end
    end

    function control.step()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local now = clock()
        local character, camera, reference = context()
        -- Range/ownership checks are cheap and keep removed or distant actors hidden.
        for index = #control.order, 1, -1 do
            local record = control.order[index]
            if not record.model.Parent or record.model == character then
                control.records[record.model] = nil
                table.remove(control.order,index)
            else
                updateRange(record,reference)
            end
        end
        control.lastStepRays = 0
        if not control.wallCheck or not camera or #control.order == 0 then return end
        if not parameters or not world.Raycast then
            for _, record in control.order do record.wallVisible = true end
            return
        end
        local function query(record)
            record.nextRayAt = now + control.rayInterval
            local excluded = {record.model,camera}
            if character then table.insert(excluded,character) end
            -- Other characters should not behave as walls or blink the hub on contact.
            local characters = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            if characters then table.insert(excluded,characters) end
            parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
            local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
            local direction = record.part.Position-origin
            if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                rememberVisibility(record,true,now)
                return
            end
            local remaining=control.raysPerStep-control.lastStepRays
            local ok,result,casts
            if menu and menu.visibilityRaycast then
                ok,result,casts=pcall(menu.visibilityRaycast,origin,direction,parameters,remaining)
                -- An error must not allow another query to exceed this step's budget.
                casts=if ok and type(casts)=='number' then math.clamp(casts,1,remaining) else remaining
            else
                ok,result=pcall(world.Raycast,world,origin,direction,parameters)
                casts=1
            end
            control.lastStepRays += casts
            control.raycasts += casts
            if ok then
                -- The excluded target is the endpoint; any earlier hit is scenery.
                rememberVisibility(record,result == nil,now)
                control.lastError = nil
            else
                -- Keep readable information if the host cannot provide a wall query.
                control.lastError = tostring(result)
                rememberVisibility(record,true,now)
            end
        end
        local priorityCount=#control.priorities
        for _=1,priorityCount do
            if control.lastStepRays>=control.raysPerStep then break end
            local record=table.remove(control.priorities,1)
            control.prioritySet[record]=nil
            if control.records[record.model]~=record or not record.inRange or not record.part or now>(record.priorityUntil or 0) then continue end
            if now<record.nextRayAt then
                control.prioritySet[record]=true;table.insert(control.priorities,record)
            else query(record) end
        end
        local checked,count=0,#control.order
        while checked<count and control.lastStepRays<control.raysPerStep do
            if control.cursor>count then control.cursor=1 end
            local record=control.order[control.cursor]
            control.cursor+=1;checked+=1
            if not record.inRange or not record.part or now<record.nextRayAt then continue end
            query(record)
        end
    end

    function control.setWallCheck(value: any): boolean
        if not control.alive then return false end
        local enabled = value == true
        if control.wallCheck == enabled then return false end
        control.wallCheck = enabled
        local now = clock()
        for _, record in control.order do
            record.candidate = nil
            record.nextRayAt = math.max(record.nextRayAt,now)
        end
        if menu and menu.visuals and type(menu.visuals.presentTargetNames)=="function" then menu.visuals.presentTargetNames() end
        return true
    end

    function control.setMaxDistance(value: any): boolean
        if not control.alive then return false end
        local amount = tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end
        amount = math.clamp(amount,0,5000/0.28)
        if amount == control.maxDistance then return false end
        control.maxDistance = amount
        for _, record in control.order do record.inRange = record.distanceMeters <= amount end
        return true
    end

    local connection = host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.elapsed += math.max(0,delta)
        if control.elapsed < control.interval then return end
        control.elapsed = 0
        control.step()
    end)
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        connection:Disconnect()
        table.clear(control.records)
        table.clear(control.order)
        table.clear(control.priorities)
        table.clear(control.prioritySet)
    end
    return control
end

return InfoVisibility
end)()

local LegacyDisplayBudget = (function(): any
-- Avoid interpreting disabled legacy ESP renderers. Managed overlays keep
-- their own subscriptions and are never affected by these two VM gates.
local LegacyDisplayBudget: {[string]: any}={}
function LegacyDisplayBudget.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any): any
    local valueType=host.typeof or typeof
    local clock=(host.os and host.os.clock) or os.clock
    local control: any={alive=true,ready=true,states={},calls=0,skipped=0,cleanupPasses=0,activePasses=0,overrideChecks=0}
    local function parentOf(key: any): any
        return if valueType(key)=='Instance' then key.Parent else false
    end
    local function snapshot(records: any): any
        local known={}
        if type(records)=='table' then
            for key,value in records do known[key]={value=value,parent=parentOf(key),name=if valueType(key)=='Instance' then key.Name else false} end
        end
        return known
    end
    local function changed(state: any,records: any): boolean
        if records~=state.records then return true end
        if type(records)~='table' then return false end
        for key,value in records do
            local previous=state.known[key]
            if not previous or previous.value~=value or previous.parent~=parentOf(key)
                or previous.name~=(if valueType(key)=='Instance' then key.Name else false) then return true end
        end
        for key in state.known do if records[key]==nil then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function getResolver(upvalues: any,environment: any): any
        local resolver=environment.GetPlayerSettings
        local slot=type(upvalues)=='table' and upvalues[0]
        if type(slot)=='table' and type(slot[3])=='table' and slot[2]~=nil then resolver=slot[3][slot[2]] end
        return resolver
    end
    local function overridesEnabled(records: any,resolver: any): any
        local checked={}
        for model in records do
            if valueType(model)~='Instance' then return nil end
            if not model.Parent then continue end
            local name=model.Name
            if type(name)~='string' or type(resolver)~='function' then return nil end
            if checked[name] then continue end
            checked[name]=true
            local ok,specific=pcall(resolver,name)
            if not ok or specific~=nil and type(specific)~='table' then return nil end
            if specific and (specific.NameESP or specific.OutlineESP) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.shouldSkip(sourceId: number,upvalues: any,environment: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or sourceId~=160 and sourceId~=171 then return false end
        if environment==nil then environment=menu and menu.environment end
        if type(environment)~='table' or type(environment._G)~='table' then return false end
        control.calls+=1
        local shared=environment._G
        -- Exact flags verified in work/updated/prototypes.json. Preserve Lua
        -- truthiness, including any legacy non-boolean enabled values.
        local enabled=if sourceId==160 then
            environment.NameESP or environment.OutlineESP or shared.ESP_Chams or shared.ESP_Info or shared.ESP_Tracers
            else shared.Item_Chams or shared.Item_Info or shared.Item_Tracers
        local records=if sourceId==160 then environment.ESPs else environment.ItemESPs
        local state=control.states[sourceId]
        if not state then state={};control.states[sourceId]=state end
        if sourceId==160 and not enabled and type(records)=='table' then
            local resolver=getResolver(upvalues,environment)
            local now=clock()
            local cache=state.overrides
            if not cache or cache.resolver~=resolver or now>=cache.nextCheck or changed(cache,records) then
                cache={resolver=resolver,nextCheck=now+.1,records=records,known=snapshot(records),value=overridesEnabled(records,resolver)}
                state.overrides=cache;control.overrideChecks+=1
            end
            local custom=cache.value
            if custom==nil then return false end
            enabled=custom
        end
        if enabled then
            state.enabled=true
            control.activePasses+=1
            return false
        end
        if state.enabled~=false or changed(state,records) then
            -- One normal VM pass hides stale visuals after disable or a new
            -- record/character lifecycle change; subsequent idle frames skip.
            state.enabled=false;state.records=records;state.known=snapshot(records)
            control.cleanupPasses+=1
            return false
        end
        control.skipped+=1
        return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        control.alive=false;control.ready=false;table.clear(control.states)
    end
    return control
end
return LegacyDisplayBudget
end)()

local Prediction = (function(): any
-- Read-only knockback direction for every accepted recent own-hit victim.
local Prediction: {[string]: any} = {}
local function finite(value: any): boolean
    return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
end
local function finitePoint(value: any): boolean
    return value~=nil and finite(value.X) and finite(value.Y) and finite(value.Z)
end
local CURVE_SEGMENTS=16
Prediction.horizon,Prediction.dynamicHorizon=.35,false
function Prediction.endpoint(origin: any,velocity: any,studs: number): any
    if not origin or not velocity or not finite(studs) or studs<=0 then return nil end
    if not finite(origin.X) or not finite(origin.Y) or not finite(origin.Z)
        or not finite(velocity.X) or not finite(velocity.Y) or not finite(velocity.Z) then return nil end
    local magnitude=velocity.Magnitude
    if not finite(magnitude) or magnitude<2 then return nil end
    -- Project a short, constant horizon so faster knockback makes a longer
    -- arrow. The saved length remains its maximum, not a forced fixed size.
    local distance=math.min(magnitude*.35,math.clamp(studs,0,30/0.28))
    return origin+velocity/magnitude*distance
end
-- Refill a retained world-space path. This is a short extrapolation of measured
-- motion, not a claim about future player input or a server collision response.
function Prediction.writeCurve(points: any,origin: any,velocity: any,acceleration: any,gravity: any,jerk: any,studs: number): (number,number)
    if type(points)~='table' or not finitePoint(origin) or not finitePoint(velocity)
        or not finitePoint(acceleration) or not finitePoint(gravity) or not finitePoint(jerk)
        or not finite(studs) or studs<=0 then return 0,0 end
    local speed=velocity.Magnitude
    if not finite(speed) or speed<2 then return 0,0 end
    local maximum=math.clamp(studs,0,30/.28)
    local horizon=math.min((Prediction.horizon or .35)*(if Prediction.dynamicHorizon then math.clamp(speed/40,.6,2.2) else 1),maximum/speed)
    local previous,length,count=origin,0,1
    points[1]=origin
    for index=1,CURVE_SEGMENTS do
        local time=horizon*index/CURVE_SEGMENTS
        local point=origin+velocity*time+(acceleration+gravity)*(.5*time*time)+jerk*(time*time*time/6)
        if not finitePoint(point) then return 0,0 end
        local offset=point-previous
        local distance=offset.Magnitude
        if not finite(distance) then return 0,0 end
        local remaining=maximum-length
        if distance>remaining then point=previous+offset*(remaining/distance);distance=remaining end
        count+=1;points[count]=point;length+=distance;previous=point
        if length>=maximum-.000001 then break end
    end
    return count,length
end
function Prediction.landing(origin,velocity,gravity,raycast,horizon,maxSegments)
    if not origin or not velocity or not gravity then return nil end
    for _,v in {origin,velocity,gravity} do
        if not finite(v.X) or not finite(v.Y) or not finite(v.Z) then return nil end
    end
    if horizon~=nil and (not finite(horizon) or horizon<=0) then return nil end
    if maxSegments~=nil and (not finite(maxSegments) or maxSegments<1) then return nil end
    local duration=if horizon~=nil then math.min(horizon,8) else 3.84
    local segments=if maxSegments~=nil then math.clamp(math.floor(maxSegments),1,64) else 64
    local adaptive=horizon~=nil
    local previous=origin
    for index=1,segments do
        local fraction=index/segments
        local time=duration*(if adaptive then fraction^1.25 else fraction)
        local point=origin+velocity*time+gravity*(.5*time*time)
        local hit=raycast(previous,point-previous)
        if hit then
            -- Stop at the first collision. Wall bounces are not predictable
            -- without the server's restitution and subsequent skill forces.
            if hit.Normal.Y>.35 then return hit.Position,time end
            return nil
        end
        previous=point
    end
    return nil
end
-- Ragdoll flight model: drag-damped ballistic steps, then per-surface bounce
-- (elasticity), friction on the tangent, and a Coulomb slide until it stops.
-- `surface(part)` returns the combined friction and elasticity for that contact.
function Prediction.simulate(origin,velocity,gravity,raycast,options)
    if not finitePoint(origin) or not finitePoint(velocity) or not finitePoint(gravity) or type(raycast)~='function' then return nil end
    options=options or {}
    local horizon=math.clamp(tonumber(options.horizon) or 6,.25,8)
    local budget=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(options.maxRays) or 64),4,96)
    local drag=math.clamp(tonumber(options.drag) or 0,0,.6)
    local restScale=math.clamp(tonumber(options.restitution) or .55,0,1)
    local restSpeed=tonumber(options.restSpeed) or 8
    local maxBounces=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(options.maxBounces) or 3),0,6)
    local slideCap=tonumber(options.slideCap) or 14
    local slideDrag=tonumber(options.slideDrag) or 1.5
    -- A ragdoll tumbles on impact, so it loses less sideways speed than one rigid block would.
    local tumble=tonumber(options.tumble) or .45
    local surface=options.surface
    local extraDrag,vector=tonumber(options.dashDrag) or 0,options.vector
    local pull=gravity.Magnitude
    if not finite(pull) or pull<=0 then return nil end
    local position,motion,time=origin,velocity,0
    local points,times={origin},{0}
    local rays,bounces,impact,impactTime,impactSpeed,rest,restTime,settled=0,0,nil,nil,0,nil,nil,false
    local function mark(point,at) points[#points+1]=point;times[#times+1]=at end
    while time<horizon and rays<budget do
        local step=math.min(math.clamp(.06+.04*time,.06,.2),horizon-time)
        local nextMotion=(motion+gravity*step)*math.exp(-drag*step)
        if extraDrag>0 and vector then
            local keep=math.exp(-extraDrag*step)
            nextMotion=vector(nextMotion.X*keep,nextMotion.Y,nextMotion.Z*keep)
        end
        local delta=(motion+nextMotion)*(.5*step)
        rays+=1
        local hit=raycast(position,delta)
        if not hit then
            position,motion,time=position+delta,nextMotion,time+step
            mark(position,time)
        else
            local length=delta.Magnitude
            local fraction=if length>1e-6 then math.clamp((hit.Position-position).Magnitude/length,0,1) else 1
            local hitTime=time+step*fraction
            local incoming=motion+(nextMotion-motion)*fraction
            local normal=hit.Normal
            local into=-incoming:Dot(normal)
            local ground=normal.Y>.35
            mark(hit.Position,hitTime)
            if ground and not impact then impact,impactTime,impactSpeed=hit.Position,hitTime,math.max(into,0) end
            position,time=hit.Position+normal*.05,hitTime
            if into<=0 then
                motion=incoming
            else
                local friction,elasticity=.5,.2
                if surface then
                    local f,e=surface(hit.Instance)
                    if finite(f) then friction=f end
                    if finite(e) then elasticity=e end
                end
                local bounce=math.clamp(elasticity*restScale,0,.7)
                local tangent=incoming+normal*into
                local tangentSpeed=tangent.Magnitude
                if tangentSpeed>1e-4 then
                    tangent=tangent*(math.max(0,tangentSpeed-friction*tumble*(1+bounce)*into)/tangentSpeed)
                end
                local outward=into*bounce
                bounces+=1
                if not ground and bounces>maxBounces and not impact then return nil end
                if ground and (outward<restSpeed or bounces>=maxBounces) then
                    local slideSpeed=tangent.Magnitude
                    local endPoint,distance=position,0
                    local carry=false
                    if slideSpeed>1 then
                        local mu=math.max(friction,.2)*slideDrag
                        distance=math.min(slideSpeed*slideSpeed/(2*mu*pull),slideCap)
                        local direction=tangent/slideSpeed
                        local lift=normal*.6
                        rays+=1
                        local wall=raycast(position+lift,direction*distance)
                        if wall and wall.Normal.Y<=.35 then
                            distance=math.max(0,(wall.Position-(position+lift)).Magnitude-.5)
                        else
                            endPoint=position+direction*distance
                            rays+=1
                            if not raycast(endPoint+lift,-normal*4) then
                                -- Slid off an edge: keep simulating the fall.
                                carry=true
                                motion=direction*math.max(slideSpeed*.6,2)
                                position=endPoint;time+=distance/math.max(slideSpeed*.7,1)
                                mark(position,time)
                            end
                        end
                        if not carry then endPoint=position+direction*distance end
                    end
                    if not carry then
                        rest,restTime,settled=endPoint,time+(if distance>0 and slideSpeed>1 then math.min(2*distance/slideSpeed,3) else 0),true
                        mark(rest,restTime)
                        break
                    end
                else
                    motion=tangent+normal*outward
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not impact then return nil end
    if not rest then rest,restTime=position,time end
    return {impact=impact,impactTime=impactTime,impactSpeed=impactSpeed,rest=rest,restTime=restTime,
        bounces=bounces,settled=settled,points=points,times=times,rays=rays}
end
function Prediction.pathAt(result,at)
    local times,points=result.times,result.points
    local count=#times
    if count==0 then return nil end
    if at<=times[1] then return points[1] end
    for index=2,count do
        if at<=times[index] then
            local span=times[index]-times[index-1]
            local fraction=if span>1e-6 then (at-times[index-1])/span else 1
            return points[index-1]+(points[index]-points[index-1])*fraction
        end
    end
    return points[count]
end
function Prediction.smoothPoint(current,goal,elapsed)
    if not goal then return nil end
    if not current then return goal end
    if not finite(elapsed) or elapsed<=0 then return current end
    -- Smooth in world space so camera movement is projected immediately.
    -- Large corrections respond faster; teleports must not drag an old marker.
    local distance=(goal-current).Magnitude
    if not finite(distance) or distance>50 then return goal end
    local response=if distance>8 then .025 else .055
    return current+(goal-current)*(1-math.exp(-math.min(elapsed,.25)/response))
end
function Prediction.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any): any
    local world=host.workspace
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local clock=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=false,length=5/0.28,visible=false,visibleCount=0,records={},currentTargets={},provisionalTargets={},provisionalWindow=0.25,initialForecastWindow=0.25,swingReach=6,swingFacingDot=0.2,nativeSwingCount=0,lastReason='Prediction is disabled'}
    control.curveSegmentLimit=CURVE_SEGMENTS
    control.arrowHoldSeconds,control.curveSmoothSeconds=1.5,.06
    control.arrowStyle,control.arrowWidth,control.arrowGrow='Classic',2,true
    local ARROW_STYLES={'Classic','Tapered','Glow Beam','Energy Flow','Dash Flow','Comet','Holo Ribbon','Neon Pulse'}
    function control.setArrowStyle(value)
        if not table.find(ARROW_STYLES,value) then return false end
        control.arrowStyle=value;return true
    end
    function control.setArrowWidth(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.arrowWidth=math.clamp(amount,1,8);return true
    end
    function control.setArrowGrow(value) control.arrowGrow=value==true;return true end
    function control.setArrowHorizon(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(amount) then return false end
        Prediction.horizon=math.clamp(amount,.15,1.5);return true
    end
    function control.setArrowDynamic(value) Prediction.dynamicHorizon=value==true;return true end
    function control.setArrowHoldSeconds(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.arrowHoldSeconds=math.clamp(amount,0,5)
        for _,record in control.records do
            if record.lastConfirmedMotionAt then record.holdUntil=record.lastConfirmedMotionAt+control.arrowHoldSeconds end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setCurveSmoothSeconds(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.curveSmoothSeconds=math.clamp(amount,0,.2);return true
    end
    local gui=host.Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name,gui.IgnoreGuiInset,gui.ResetOnSpawn,gui.Enabled='ShenaniganismPrediction',true,false,false
    gui.ZIndexBehavior=host.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    control.gui=gui
    control.landingEnabled=false
    control.landingHoldSeconds,control.landingHorizon,control.landingUpdateHz=1.5,6,12
    control.landingStates=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local function clearLanding(reason,forget)
        local parts=control.landingParts
        local shown=control.landingIcon and control.landingIcon.Visible
        if shown and not forget then
            -- Shrink out over a few frames (finished by updateLanding) instead of snapping off.
            if not control.landingExit then
                control.landingExit={at=clock(),position=control.landingIcon.Position,scale=parts.scale.Scale}
            end
        else
            if control.landingIcon then control.landingIcon.Visible=false end
            control.landingExit=nil
        end
        if parts then
            parts.rest.main.Visible,parts.rest.rim.Visible=false,false
            for _,bead in parts.beads do bead.Visible=false end
        end
        control.landingDrawPoint,control.landingDrawTarget,control.landingDrawAt,control.landingShownAt=nil,nil,nil,nil
        control.landingPoint,control.landingTime,control.landingSnapshot,control.landingKind,control.landingResult=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        control.landingHolding=false;control.landingHoldUntil=nil;control.landingReason=reason
        if forget then
            table.clear(control.landingStates)
            control.landingTrackedTarget,control.landingTrackedRoot,control.landingTrackedHumanoid,control.landingOwnerCharacter=nil,nil,nil,nil
        end
    end
    function control.setLandingEnabled(value)
        control.landingEnabled=control.alive and value==true
        gui.Enabled=control.enabled or control.landingEnabled
        if not control.landingEnabled then clearLanding('Disabled',true) end
        control.nextLandingAt=0
    end
    function control.setLandingHoldSeconds(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value);if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.landingHoldSeconds=math.clamp(amount,0,5)
        local target=control.landingTrackedTarget;local state=target and control.landingStates[target]
        if state and state.groundedAt then state.holdUntil=state.groundedAt+control.landingHoldSeconds;control.landingHoldUntil=state.holdUntil end
        return true
    end
    function control.setLandingHorizon(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value);if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.landingHorizon=math.clamp(amount,.5,8);control.nextLandingAt=0;return true
    end
    function control.setLandingUpdateRate(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value);if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.landingUpdateHz=math.clamp(amount,5,30);control.nextLandingAt=0;return true
    end
    local BEADS=18
    local DARK=host.Color3.fromRGB(8,10,14)
    local SHAPES={'Target','Box','Diamond','Arrow','Dynamic','Crosshair','Pulse Rings','Beacon','Chevrons','Brackets','Recharge Box','Recharge Bar','Hologram'}
    -- Hologram: a real 3D marker on the ground at the landing spot. A scan disc, a ring that closes onto the spot,
    -- an outward pulse, rising scan rings inside a light column, corner posts and a spinning crystal.
    local holo: any=nil
    local function hideHolo() if holo and holo.folder.Parent then holo.folder.Parent=nil end end
    local function drawHolo(point,color,left,holding,now)
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera or not point then return end
        local Enum,V3,CFrame=host.Enum,host.Vector3,host.CFrame
        if not holo or not holo.folder then
            local folder=host.Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='ShenaniganismLandingHologram'
            local function make(shape)
                local item=host.Instance.new('Part')
                item.Anchored,item.CanCollide,item.CanQuery,item.CanTouch,item.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
                item.Material,item.Transparency,item.Size=Enum.Material.Neon,1,V3.new(.2,.2,.2)
                if shape then item.Shape=shape end
                item.Parent=folder;return item
            end
            local cylinder=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            holo={folder=folder,disc=make(cylinder),ring=make(cylinder),pulse=make(cylinder),beam=make(cylinder),gem=make(),core=make(),
                rise={make(cylinder),make(cylinder),make(cylinder)},posts={make(),make(),make(),make()}}
        end
        if not holo.folder.Parent then holo.folder.Parent=camera end
        local scale=control.landingScale or 1
        local radius=3.2*scale
        local closing=if holding then 0 else math.clamp(left/2,0,1)
        local flat=CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi/2)
        local ground=point+V3.new(0,.1,0)
        local pale=color:Lerp(host.Color3.new(1,1,1),.55)
        local function set(item,size,frame,transparency,tint) item.Size=size;item.CFrame=frame;item.Color=tint or color;item.Transparency=transparency end
        set(holo.disc,V3.new(.05,radius*2,radius*2),CFrame.new(ground)*flat,.82)
        local closeD=radius*2*(.9+.8*closing)
        set(holo.ring,V3.new(.12,closeD,closeD),CFrame.new(ground)*flat,.12+.12*math.sin(now*6))
        local phase=(now*1.1)%1
        local pulseD=radius*2*(.25+.85*phase)
        set(holo.pulse,V3.new(.08,pulseD,pulseD),CFrame.new(ground)*flat,.3+.7*phase)
        local height=9
        set(holo.beam,V3.new(height,.5*scale,.5*scale),CFrame.new(ground+V3.new(0,height/2,0))*flat,.78+.08*math.sin(now*5))
        for index,item in holo.rise do
            local rise=(now*.8+index/3)%1
            local d=radius*(.7+.3*rise)
            set(item,V3.new(.08,d,d),CFrame.new(ground+V3.new(0,rise*height*.7,0))*flat,.25+.75*rise,pale)
        end
        local bob=3.4*scale+.4*math.sin(now*2.4)
        set(holo.gem,V3.new(1.1,1.1,1.1)*scale,CFrame.new(ground+V3.new(0,bob,0))*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/4,0,math.pi/4),.3)
        set(holo.core,V3.new(.6,.6,.6)*scale,CFrame.new(ground+V3.new(0,bob,0))*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/4,0,math.pi/4),.05,pale)
        local post=radius*.85
        local turn=CFrame.Angles(0,0,0)
        local index=0
        for x=-1,1,2 do for z=-1,1,2 do
            index+=1
            local item=holo.posts[index]
            set(item,V3.new(.16,1.1*scale,.16),CFrame.new(ground)*turn*CFrame.new(x*post,.55*scale,z*post),.2+.1*math.sin(now*4+index))
        end end
    end

    function control.setLandingShape(value)
        if value=='Orbit' then value='Brackets' end
        if not table.find(SHAPES,value) then return false end
        control.landingShape=value;control.landingView=nil;return true
    end
    function control.setLandingMarkerScale(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value);if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.landingScale=math.clamp(amount,50,200)/100;return true
    end
    local function landingIcon()
        if control.landingIcon then return end
        local Color3,UDim2,Vector2,UDim=host.Color3,host.UDim2,host.Vector2,host.UDim
        local function frame(parent,name,width,height,x,y,anchorX,anchorY)
            local item=host.Instance.new('Frame')
            item.Name,item.Size,item.AnchorPoint,item.Position=name,UDim2.fromOffset(width,height),Vector2.new(anchorX or .5,anchorY or .5),UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
            item.BorderSizePixel,item.Active,item.BackgroundTransparency=0,false,1
            item.Parent=parent
            return item
        end
        local function round(item,radius)
            local corner=host.Instance.new('UICorner');corner.CornerRadius=radius;corner.Parent=item
        end
        local function outline(item,thickness,alpha,color)
            local line=host.Instance.new('UIStroke');line.ApplyStrokeMode=host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            line.Thickness,line.Transparency=thickness,alpha
            if color then line.Color=color end
            line.Parent=item
            return line
        end
        local function solid(item,color,alpha)
            item.BackgroundTransparency=alpha or 0
            if color then item.BackgroundColor3=color end
        end
        -- A stroked shape with a dark rim drawn behind it so it reads on any floor.
        local function rimmed(parent,name,size,thickness,alpha,radius)
            local rim=frame(parent,name..'Rim',size,size,40,40)
            round(rim,radius);outline(rim,thickness+3,.3,DARK)
            local main=frame(parent,name,size,size,40,40)
            round(main,radius)
            return {main=main,rim=rim,stroke=outline(main,thickness,alpha)}
        end
        local icon=host.Instance.new('Frame')
        icon.Name,icon.Size,icon.AnchorPoint='PredictedLanding',UDim2.fromOffset(80,80),Vector2.new(.5,.5)
        icon.BackgroundTransparency,icon.BorderSizePixel,icon.Active,icon.ZIndex,icon.Visible=1,0,false,3,false
        icon.Parent=gui
        local scale=host.Instance.new('UIScale');scale.Parent=icon
        -- Depth: a flat contact shadow and a soft glow under the marker.
        local shadow=frame(icon,'ContactShadow',50,14,40,52)
        solid(shadow,DARK,.5);round(shadow,UDim.new(1,0))
        local glow=frame(icon,'Glow',48,48,40,40)
        solid(glow,nil,.82);round(glow,UDim.new(1,0))
        local ripples={}
        for index=1,2 do
            local ripple=frame(icon,'Ripple'..index,24,24,40,40)
            round(ripple,UDim.new(1,0))
            ripples[index]={main=ripple,stroke=outline(ripple,1.5,.5)}
        end
        local ringOuter=rimmed(icon,'Closing',60,1.5,.4,UDim.new(1,0))
        local ringInner=rimmed(icon,'Target',24,2,.1,UDim.new(1,0))
        local boxOuter=rimmed(icon,'BoxClosing',56,1.5,.4,UDim.new(0,6))
        local boxInner=rimmed(icon,'BoxTarget',24,2,.1,UDim.new(0,4))
        local coreRim=frame(icon,'CoreRim',11,11,40,40)
        solid(coreRim,DARK,.3);round(coreRim,UDim.new(1,0))
        local core=frame(icon,'Core',6,6,40,40)
        solid(core);round(core,UDim.new(1,0))
        local spinner=frame(icon,'Ticks',80,80,40,40)
        local ticks={}
        for _,spec in {{'TickN',2,8,40,21},{'TickS',2,8,40,59},{'TickW',8,2,21,40},{'TickE',8,2,59,40}} do
            local rim=frame(spinner,spec[1]..'Rim',spec[2]+2,spec[3]+2,spec[4],spec[5])
            solid(rim,DARK,.3)
            local tick=frame(spinner,spec[1],spec[2],spec[3],spec[4],spec[5])
            solid(tick)
            table.insert(ticks,tick)
        end
        -- Down arrow hovering above the spot: dark rim pieces first, accent pieces on top.
        local arrow=frame(icon,'Arrow',60,60,10,-20,0,0)
        local arrowFill={}
        local pieces={{'Stem',6,24,30,40,0},{'ArmR',6,18,36.4,45.6,45},{'ArmL',6,18,23.6,45.6,-45}}
        for _,piece in pieces do
            local rim=frame(arrow,piece[1]..'Rim',piece[2]+3,piece[3]+3,piece[4],piece[5])
            solid(rim,DARK,.3);rim.Rotation=piece[6];round(rim,UDim.new(0,3))
        end
        for _,piece in pieces do
            local fill=frame(arrow,piece[1],piece[2],piece[3],piece[4],piece[5])
            solid(fill);fill.Rotation=piece[6];round(fill,UDim.new(0,2))
            table.insert(arrowFill,fill)
        end
        -- Extra marker looks: crosshair, orbiting dots, a light beacon and falling chevrons.
        local extraFill={}
        local crossHolder=frame(icon,'CrossHolder',80,80,40,40)
        for _,spec in {{2,16,40,14},{2,16,40,66},{16,2,14,40},{16,2,66,40}} do
            local bar=frame(crossHolder,'CrossBar',spec[1],spec[2],spec[3],spec[4]);solid(bar);table.insert(extraFill,bar)
        end
        local orbit=frame(icon,'OrbitHolder',80,80,40,40)
        for index=1,3 do
            local angle=math.rad(120*(index-1))
            local dot=frame(orbit,'OrbitDot'..index,7,7,40+math.sin(angle)*24,40-math.cos(angle)*24)
            solid(dot);round(dot,UDim.new(1,0));table.insert(extraFill,dot)
        end
        local beacon=frame(icon,'Beacon',6,70,40,40,.5,1)
        solid(beacon,nil,.3);table.insert(extraFill,beacon)
        local beaconGradient=host.Instance.new('UIGradient');beaconGradient.Rotation=90
        beaconGradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new({host.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),host.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.05)})
        beaconGradient.Parent=beacon
        local chevrons={}
        for index=1,3 do
            local holder=frame(icon,'Chevron'..index,30,16,40,0)
            for _,side in {-1,1} do
                local arm=frame(holder,'Arm',16,4,15+side*6,8)
                arm.Rotation=-side*30;solid(arm);round(arm,UDim.new(0,2));table.insert(extraFill,arm)
            end
            chevrons[index]=holder
        end
        for _,item in {crossHolder,orbit,beacon} do item.Visible=false end
        for _,item in chevrons do item.Visible=false end
        -- Recharge Box: four dark edges with a bright fill that runs round the square like a timer.
        local chargeBoxItems,chargeBoxFill={},{}
        for index,spec in {{12,12,0,.5},{68,12,.5,0},{68,68,1,.5},{12,68,.5,1}} do
            local horizontal=index%2==1
            local trackEdge=frame(icon,'ChargeTrack'..index,if horizontal then 56 else 3,if horizontal then 3 else 56,spec[1],spec[2],spec[3],spec[4])
            solid(trackEdge,DARK,.45)
            local fillEdge=frame(icon,'ChargeFill'..index,if horizontal then 0 else 3,if horizontal then 3 else 0,spec[1],spec[2],spec[3],spec[4])
            solid(fillEdge);table.insert(extraFill,fillEdge)
            table.insert(chargeBoxItems,trackEdge);table.insert(chargeBoxItems,fillEdge)
            chargeBoxFill[index]=fillEdge
        end
        -- Recharge Bar: the same timer as a small bar under the spot.
        local chargeBarItems={}
        local barTrack=frame(icon,'ChargeBarTrack',56,5,12,64,0,.5)
        solid(barTrack,DARK,.4);round(barTrack,UDim.new(1,0))
        local barFill=frame(icon,'ChargeBarFill',0,5,12,64,0,.5)
        solid(barFill);round(barFill,UDim.new(1,0));table.insert(extraFill,barFill)
        table.insert(chargeBarItems,barTrack);table.insert(chargeBarItems,barFill)
        -- Brackets: four corner brackets that close onto the spot.
        local bracketItems,bracketPieces={},{}
        for _,sx in {-1,1} do
            for _,sy in {-1,1} do
                local across=frame(icon,'BracketAcross',14,3,40,40);solid(across);table.insert(extraFill,across)
                local down=frame(icon,'BracketDown',3,14,40,40);solid(down);table.insert(extraFill,down)
                table.insert(bracketItems,across);table.insert(bracketItems,down)
                table.insert(bracketPieces,{across=across,down=down,sx=sx,sy=sy})
            end
        end
        for _,item in chargeBoxItems do item.Visible=false end
        for _,item in chargeBarItems do item.Visible=false end
        for _,item in bracketItems do item.Visible=false end
        local pill=host.Instance.new('Frame')
        pill.Name,pill.Size,pill.AnchorPoint,pill.Position='ForecastPill',UDim2.fromOffset(150,20),Vector2.new(.5,0),UDim2.fromOffset(40,74)
        pill.BackgroundColor3,pill.BackgroundTransparency,pill.BorderSizePixel,pill.Active=Color3.fromRGB(16,18,24),.2,0,false
        round(pill,UDim.new(0,10))
        local pillStroke=outline(pill,1,.35)
        pill.Parent=icon
        local label=host.Instance.new('TextLabel')
        label.Name,label.Size,label.BackgroundTransparency='ForecastLabel',UDim2.fromScale(1,1),1
        label.Font,label.TextSize,label.TextColor3=host.Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,11,Color3.fromRGB(240,242,248)
        label.TextStrokeColor3,label.TextStrokeTransparency=DARK,.5
        label.Active,label.Parent=false,pill
        local rest=rimmed(gui,'PredictedRest',16,1.5,.35,UDim.new(1,0))
        rest.main.Position,rest.rim.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
        rest.main.ZIndex,rest.rim.ZIndex=2,1
        rest.main.Visible,rest.rim.Visible=false,false
        local beads={}
        for index=1,BEADS do
            local fraction=index/BEADS
            local size=math.floor(3+3*fraction)
            local bead=frame(gui,'PredictedTrail'..index,size,size,0,0)
            solid(bead,nil,.6-.5*fraction);round(bead,UDim.new(1,0))
            bead.ZIndex,bead.Visible=1,false
            beads[index]=bead
        end
        control.landingParts={ripples=ripples,scale=scale,glow=glow,shadow=shadow,ringOuter=ringOuter,ringInner=ringInner,boxOuter=boxOuter,boxInner=boxInner,
            core=core,coreRim=coreRim,spinner=spinner,ticks=ticks,arrow=arrow,arrowFill=arrowFill,pillStroke=pillStroke,rest=rest,beads=beads,
            crossHolder=crossHolder,orbit=orbit,beacon=beacon,chevrons=chevrons,extraFill=extraFill,
            chargeBoxItems=chargeBoxItems,chargeBoxFill=chargeBoxFill,chargeBarItems=chargeBarItems,chargeBarFill=barFill,bracketItems=bracketItems,bracketPieces=bracketPieces}
        control.landingLabel,control.landingRing,control.landingIcon=label,ringInner.stroke,icon
    end
    local function accentLanding(color)
        local parts=control.landingParts
        if not parts then return end
        local last=control.landingAccent
        if last and math.abs(last.R-color.R)+math.abs(last.G-color.G)+math.abs(last.B-color.B)<.004 then return end
        control.landingAccent=color
        for _,ripple in parts.ripples do ripple.stroke.Color=color end
        for _,set in {parts.ringOuter,parts.ringInner,parts.boxOuter,parts.boxInner,parts.rest} do set.stroke.Color=color end
        parts.pillStroke.Color=color
        parts.core.BackgroundColor3,parts.glow.BackgroundColor3=color,color
        for _,tick in parts.ticks do tick.BackgroundColor3=color end
        for _,piece in parts.arrowFill do piece.BackgroundColor3=color end
        for _,bead in parts.beads do bead.BackgroundColor3=color end
        for _,item in parts.extraFill or {} do item.BackgroundColor3=color end
    end
    local function publishLanding(target,state,locked,evidence,now,position,velocity,point,time,kind,action,holding,result)
        control.landingPoint,control.landingTime,control.landingKind,control.landingResult=point,time,kind,result
        control.landingHolding=holding==true;control.landingHoldUntil=if holding then state.holdUntil else nil
        control.landingSnapshot={target=target,lockedTarget=locked,hitEvidence=evidence,at=now,
            position=position,velocity=velocity,action=action,kind=kind,holding=holding==true,groundedAt=state.groundedAt,
            horizon=control.landingHorizon,rays=control.landingRaycasts,
            rest=result and result.rest,restTime=result and result.restTime,bounces=result and result.bounces,
            impactSpeed=result and result.impactSpeed,drag=state.dragK,gravityScale=state.gravScale}
        if not point or not time then return end
        landingIcon()
        local color=if holding then host.Color3.fromRGB(130,235,160)
            elseif kind=='Air' then host.Color3.fromRGB(110,220,255)
            elseif result and result.bounces>1 then host.Color3.fromRGB(255,130,170)
            else host.Color3.fromRGB(255,196,92)
        control.landingAccentTarget=color
        if not control.landingAccent then accentLanding(color) end
        local text
        if holding then text=if state.recoverRemaining and state.recoverSeenAt then string.format('GET UP %.1fs',math.max(0,state.recoverRemaining-(now-state.recoverSeenAt))) else 'LANDED'
        elseif kind=='Air' then text=string.format('AIR  %.1fs',time)
        else
            text=string.format('%.1fs',time)
            local own=player.Character
            local ownRoot=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if ownRoot then text..=string.format('  |  %dm',math.floor((point-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude+.5) :: any) end
            if result and result.bounces>1 then text..=string.format('  |  x%d bounce',(result.bounces-1) :: any) end
        end
        control.landingLabel.Text=text
    end
    local function sampleLanding(target,victims,locked,root,hum,now)
        if now<(control.nextLandingAt or 0) then return end
        control.nextLandingAt=now+1/control.landingUpdateHz
        control.landingSamples=(control.landingSamples or 0)+1
        control.landingRaycasts=0
        local own=player.Character
        local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local downed=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.characterRagdolled and menu.autoLock.characterRagdolled(target,hum)
        local state=control.landingStates[target] or {}
        control.landingStates[target]=state
        local dash=target:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash')~=nil)
        local evade=tonumber(target:GetAttribute('Evade'))
        local knockback=info and info:FindFirstChild('Knockback')
        local knocked=knockback~=nil or target:GetAttribute('Knockback')==true
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if not velocity or not finite(velocity.X) or not finite(velocity.Y) or not finite(velocity.Z) then clearLanding('Velocity unavailable');return end
        local position=root.Position
        if not position or not finite(position.X) or not finite(position.Y) or not finite(position.Z) then clearLanding('Position unavailable');return end
        local elapsed=if state.at then now-state.at else 0
        local teleported=state.position and (position-state.position).Magnitude>math.max(12,(state.velocity and state.velocity.Magnitude or 0)*math.max(elapsed,0)*2+4)
        local launchedAgain=state.groundedAt and (velocity.Y>2 or dash and not state.dash or knockback and knockback~=state.knockback)
        if teleported or launchedAgain then
            state.lastPoint,state.lastTime,state.groundedAt,state.holdUntil=nil,nil,nil,nil
            state.recoveredAirborne=false
            clearLanding(if teleported then 'Target moved discontinuously' else 'New launch')
        end
        local recentlyDowned=downed or state.downedAt and now-state.downedAt<=.5
        local spent=finite(evade) and finite(state.evade) and state.evade>=50 and evade<state.evade-1
        if recentlyDowned and (spent or dash and not state.dash) then state.evasiveUntil=now+.35;state.recoveredAirborne=true;if not (state.evadedAt and now-state.evadedAt<1) then state.evadedAt,state.evadeCleared=now,nil end end
        if state.tracking and dash and not state.dash then state.evasiveUntil=now+.35;state.recoveredAirborne=true;if not (state.evadedAt and now-state.evadedAt<1) then state.evadedAt,state.evadeCleared=now,nil end end
        if downed then state.downedAt=now end
        local prior={velocity=state.velocity,at=state.at,knockback=state.knockback,flying=state.flying}
        state.evade,state.dash,state.knockback,state.position,state.velocity,state.at=evade,dash,knockback,position,velocity,now
        if state.evadeCleared and state.evadedAt then
            if now-state.evadedAt<2.5 then return end
            state.evadeCleared=nil
        end
        local parent=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
        if not parent then clearLanding('Player GUI unavailable');return end
        if gui.Parent~=parent then gui.Parent=parent end
        local params=control.landingParams
        if not params then
            params=host.RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.RespectCanCollide=true;control.landingParams=params
        end
        local ignored={own,target}
        local effects=world:FindFirstChild('Effects');if effects then table.insert(ignored,effects) end
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored
        local function cast(origin,delta)
            control.landingRaycasts+=1
            return world:Raycast(origin,delta,params)
        end
        local halfHeight=if root.Size then root.Size.Y*.5 else 1
        local ground=if velocity.Y<=0 then cast(position,host.Vector3.new(0,-halfHeight-.3,0)) else nil
        if ground and ground.Normal.Y>.35 then
            state.recoveredAirborne,state.evasiveUntil,state.flying,state.tracking=false,nil,false,false
            if state.lastPoint and not state.groundedAt then
                state.groundedAt=now;state.holdUntil=now+control.landingHoldSeconds
                state.lastPoint=ground.Position
            end
            -- The marker follows the game's own recovery timer (the one the enemy stun viewer shows: ragdoll, stun, knockdown) instead of
            -- a fixed hold: it lasts as long as that timer says, and ends the moment the enemy is back on their feet.
            local vis=menu.visuals
            if state.groundedAt and vis and type(vis.statusPresentation)=='function' then
                local okay,stateName,text=pcall(vis.statusPresentation,target,hum)
                if okay and stateName and stateName~='Active' then
                    local remaining=tonumber(text)
                    if remaining and remaining>=0 then
                        state.recoverRemaining,state.recoverSeenAt=remaining,now
                        state.holdUntil=math.min(math.max(state.holdUntil or 0,now+remaining+.1),state.groundedAt+30)
                    end
                elseif okay and stateName=='Active' and now-state.groundedAt>.3 then
                    state.recoverRemaining,state.recoverSeenAt=nil,nil
                    state.holdUntil=math.min(state.holdUntil or now,now)
                end
            end
            if state.lastPoint and state.holdUntil and now<state.holdUntil then
                publishLanding(target,state,locked,victims[target],now,position,velocity,state.lastPoint,0,'Ground','Ground contact',true)
            else clearLanding('Grounded hold expired') end
            return
        end
        -- A held marker belongs to that touchdown, never to a later jump.
        if state.groundedAt then
            state.lastPoint,state.lastTime,state.groundedAt,state.holdUntil=nil,nil,nil,nil
            clearLanding('Left the previous landing')
        end
        -- Once a flight is being tracked it stays tracked, through air dashes and
        -- recoveries, until the target touches ground.
        if not downed and not state.recoveredAirborne and not knocked and not state.tracking then state.flying=false;clearLanding('No active displacement');return end
        state.tracking=true
        if not finite(world.Gravity) or world.Gravity<=0 then clearLanding('Gravity unavailable');return end
        -- Learn this target's real air drag and gravity from consecutive airborne samples.
        if prior.flying and prior.velocity and prior.at and prior.knockback==knockback and not dash then
            local gap=now-prior.at
            if gap>.04 and gap<.3 then
                local before,after=prior.velocity,velocity
                local h1=math.sqrt(before.X*before.X+before.Z*before.Z)
                local h2=math.sqrt(after.X*after.X+after.Z*after.Z)
                local drag=state.dragK or .02
                if h1>14 and h2>h1*.5 and h2<=h1*1.001 then
                    drag+=(math.clamp(math.log(h1/h2)/gap,0,.5)-drag)*.12
                    state.dragK=drag
                end
                if after.Y<=before.Y+.5 then
                    local ratio=((before.Y-after.Y)/gap-drag*(before.Y+after.Y)*.5)/world.Gravity
                    if ratio>.4 and ratio<2.2 then
                        local previous=state.gravScale or 1
                        state.gravScale=math.clamp(previous+(ratio-previous)*.12,.75,1.25)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        state.flying=true
        local evasive=dash or now<(state.evasiveUntil or 0)
        local point,time,kind,result
        kind=if evasive then 'Air' else 'Ground'
        local gravity=host.Vector3.new(0,-world.Gravity*(state.gravScale or 1),0)
        local function props(part)
            local ok,physical=pcall(function() return part.CurrentPhysicalProperties end)
            if ok and physical then return physical.Friction,physical.Elasticity,physical.FrictionWeight,physical.ElasticityWeight end
            return nil
        end
        local bodyFriction,bodyElasticity,bodyFrictionWeight,bodyElasticityWeight=props(root)
        local function surface(part)
            local friction,elasticity,frictionWeight,elasticityWeight=props(part)
            if not friction then friction,elasticity,frictionWeight,elasticityWeight=.5,.2,1,1 end
            if bodyFriction then
                friction=(friction*frictionWeight+bodyFriction*bodyFrictionWeight)/math.max(frictionWeight+bodyFrictionWeight,1e-3)
                elasticity=(elasticity*elasticityWeight+bodyElasticity*bodyElasticityWeight)/math.max(elasticityWeight+bodyElasticityWeight,1e-3)
            end
            return friction,elasticity
        end
        -- The whole flight to the final resting spot: arc, bounces and slide. An air
        -- dash adds fast horizontal decay so its burst is not projected forever.
        result=Prediction.simulate(position,velocity,gravity,cast,{horizon=control.landingHorizon,maxRays=64-control.landingRaycasts,
            drag=state.dragK or .02,dashDrag=if evasive then 3.2 else 0,vector=host.Vector3.new,surface=surface})
        if result then point,time=result.rest,result.restTime end
        control.landingForecasts=(control.landingForecasts or 0)+1
        if not point or not time or time<=0 then state.lastPoint,state.lastTime=nil,nil;clearLanding('No supported landing within horizon');return end
        state.lastPoint,state.lastTime=point,time
        publishLanding(target,state,locked,victims[target],now,position,velocity,point,time,kind,if evasive then 'Evasive velocity estimate' elseif downed then 'Downed' else 'Knockback',false,result)
    end
    function control.updateLanding(victims)
        if not control.landingEnabled then return end
        local now=clock();victims=victims or control.targets()
        local locked=menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget
        local target=if locked and victims[locked] then locked else control.target(victims)
        local own=player.Character
        local ownHum=own and own.Parent and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local hum=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        if not control.alive or not camera or not ownHum or ownHum.Health<=0 or own:GetAttribute('Dead')==true
            or not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or target:GetAttribute('Dead')==true or target==own or not victims[target]
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then
            clearLanding('Target or context unavailable',true);control.nextLandingAt=0;return
        end
        local livePosition,liveVelocity=root.Position,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if not livePosition or not liveVelocity or not finite(livePosition.X) or not finite(livePosition.Y) or not finite(livePosition.Z)
            or not finite(liveVelocity.X) or not finite(liveVelocity.Y) or not finite(liveVelocity.Z) then
            clearLanding('Physics unavailable',true);control.nextLandingAt=0;return
        end
        if control.landingOwnerCharacter~=own or control.landingTrackedTarget~=target
            or control.landingTrackedRoot~=root or control.landingTrackedHumanoid~=hum then
            clearLanding('Target or local character changed',true)
            control.landingOwnerCharacter=own;control.landingTrackedTarget=target
            control.landingTrackedRoot,control.landingTrackedHumanoid=root,hum;control.nextLandingAt=0
        end
        local state=control.landingStates[target]
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if state and state.groundedAt and velocity and finite(velocity.Y) then
            local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local dash=target:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash')~=nil)
            local knockback=info and info:FindFirstChild('Knockback')
            if velocity.Y>2 or dash and not state.dash or knockback and knockback~=state.knockback then control.nextLandingAt=0 end
        end
        sampleLanding(target,victims,locked,root,hum,now)
        if control.landingHolding and now>=(control.landingHoldUntil or now) then clearLanding('Grounded hold expired') end
        local icon,parts=control.landingIcon,control.landingParts
        local visual=control.landingVisual
        if not visual then visual={};control.landingVisual=visual end
        local dt=math.clamp(now-(visual.at or now),0,.1);visual.at=now
        if not control.landingPoint or (not control.landingHolding and (not control.landingTime or control.landingTime<=0)) then
            hideHolo()
            if parts then
                parts.rest.main.Visible,parts.rest.rim.Visible=false,false
                for _,bead in parts.beads do bead.Visible=false end
            end
            local exit=control.landingExit
            if icon and exit then
                local progress=(now-exit.at)/.16
                if progress>=1 then icon.Visible=false;control.landingExit=nil
                else icon.Position=exit.position;parts.scale.Scale=exit.scale*(1-progress)^2 end
            elseif icon then icon.Visible=false end
            control.landingDrawPoint,control.landingDrawTarget,control.landingDrawAt,control.landingShownAt=nil,nil,nil,nil
            visual.ring=nil
            return
        end
        control.landingExit=nil
        if control.landingDrawTarget~=target then control.landingDrawPoint=nil end
        control.landingDrawPoint=Prediction.smoothPoint(control.landingDrawPoint,control.landingPoint,now-(control.landingDrawAt or now))
        control.landingDrawTarget,control.landingDrawAt=target,now
        if not icon or not parts then return end
        local snapshot=control.landingSnapshot
        local age=if snapshot then math.max(now-snapshot.at,0) else 0
        local total=control.landingTime or 0
        local holding=control.landingHolding
        local left=math.max(total-age,0)
        -- Project against this ScreenGui's own origin so the marker lands on the pixel.
        local origin=gui.AbsolutePosition
        local function project(point)
            local screen,onScreen=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(point)
            return math.floor(screen.X-origin.X+.5),math.floor(screen.Y-origin.Y+.5),screen.Z>0 and onScreen and finite(screen.X) and finite(screen.Y)
        end
        local liftedLandingPoint=control.landingDrawPoint+host.Vector3.new(0,.5,0)
        local x,y,shown=project(liftedLandingPoint)
        if control.landingShape=='Hologram' then pcall(drawHolo,liftedLandingPoint,visual.color or control.landingAccentTarget or host.Color3.new(1,1,1),left,holding,now) else hideHolo() end
        icon.Visible=shown
        if shown then
            if not control.landingShownAt then control.landingShownAt=now end
            icon.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
            local shape=control.landingShape or 'Target'
            local view=shape
            if shape=='Dynamic' then view=if not holding and left>1.1 then 'Arrow' else 'Target' end
            if control.landingView~=view then
                control.landingView=view
                local isTarget,isBox,isArrow=view=='Target',view=='Box' or view=='Diamond',view=='Arrow'
                local ringy=isTarget or isArrow or view=='Pulse Rings' or view=='Orbit' or view=='Crosshair'
                for _,item in {parts.ringOuter.main,parts.ringOuter.rim,parts.spinner} do item.Visible=isTarget end
                for _,item in {parts.ringInner.main,parts.ringInner.rim} do item.Visible=ringy end
                for _,ripple in parts.ripples do ripple.main.Visible=ringy end
                parts.crossHolder.Visible=view=='Crosshair'
                parts.orbit.Visible=view=='Orbit'
