                parts.beacon.Visible=view=='Beacon'
                for _,chevron in parts.chevrons do chevron.Visible=view=='Chevrons' end
                for _,set in {parts.boxOuter,parts.boxInner} do
                    set.main.Visible,set.rim.Visible=isBox,isBox
                    local angle=if view=='Diamond' then 45 else 0
                    set.main.Rotation,set.rim.Rotation=angle,angle
                end
                parts.arrow.Visible=isArrow
                for _,item in parts.chargeBoxItems do item.Visible=view=='Recharge Box' end
                for _,item in parts.chargeBarItems do item.Visible=view=='Recharge Bar' end
                for _,item in parts.bracketItems do item.Visible=view=='Brackets' end
            end
            -- Eased accent colour and a springy entrance.
            local goal=control.landingAccentTarget
            if goal then
                visual.color=if visual.color then visual.color:Lerp(goal,1-math.exp(-dt*14)) else goal
                accentLanding(visual.color)
            end
            local appear=math.clamp((now-control.landingShownAt)/.3,0,1)
            local back=1+2.70158*(appear-1)^3+1.70158*(appear-1)^2
            parts.scale.Scale=(.35+.65*back)*(control.landingScale or 1)
            local landState=control.landingStates[target]
            local evadedAt=landState and landState.evadedAt
            if evadedAt and not landState.evadeCleared then
                local since=now-evadedAt
                if since<.55 then
                    accentLanding(if math.floor(since*16)%2==0 then host.Color3.new(1,1,1) else host.Color3.fromRGB(255,70,60))
                    parts.scale.Scale=parts.scale.Scale*(1+.3*since)
                else
                    landState.evadeCleared=true
                    clearLanding('Evasive used')
                    return
                end
            end
            local closing=if holding then 0 else math.clamp(left/2,0,1)
            local ringSize,ringAlpha
            if holding then
                local phase=((now-(if snapshot and snapshot.groundedAt then snapshot.groundedAt else now))%.9)/.9
                ringSize,ringAlpha=26+38*phase,.2+.8*phase
                visual.ring=nil
            else
                local goalSize=26+34*closing
                visual.ring=if visual.ring then visual.ring+(goalSize-visual.ring)*(1-math.exp(-dt*12)) else goalSize
                ringSize,ringAlpha=visual.ring,.15+.6*closing
            end
            parts.spinner.Rotation=0
            parts.crossHolder.Rotation=0
            parts.orbit.Rotation=0
            parts.beacon.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(6,60+26*closing+4*math.sin(now*6))
            for index,chevron in parts.chevrons do
                local cycle=(now*1.1+(index-1)/3)%1
                chevron.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(40,-24+cycle*(46+14*closing))
                for _,arm in chevron:GetChildren() do arm.BackgroundTransparency=.1+.85*cycle end
            end
            local function sizeSet(set,size)
                local udim=host.UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)
                set.main.Size,set.rim.Size=udim,udim
            end
            if view=='Target' then
                sizeSet(parts.ringOuter,ringSize);parts.ringOuter.stroke.Transparency=ringAlpha
            elseif view=='Box' or view=='Diamond' then
                sizeSet(parts.boxOuter,ringSize*.93);parts.boxOuter.stroke.Transparency=ringAlpha
            else
                -- The tip sits exactly on the spot when the landing is due.
                local gap=closing*(10+2.5*math.sin(now*7))
                parts.arrow.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(10,-12-gap)
            end
            if view~='Box' and view~='Diamond' then
                for index,ripple in parts.ripples do
                    local phase=(now*.9+(index-1)*.5)%1
                    local size=24+44*phase
                    ripple.main.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)
                    ripple.stroke.Transparency=if holding then 1 else .4+.6*phase
                end
            end
            if view=='Recharge Box' or view=='Recharge Bar' then
                -- Timer: time until the landing, then the time until the enemy gets up (the marker hold).
                local progress=0
                local timerState=control.landingStates[target]
                if holding and snapshot and snapshot.groundedAt then
                    local elapsed=now-snapshot.groundedAt
                    if timerState and timerState.recoverRemaining and timerState.recoverSeenAt then
                        local remaining=math.max(0,timerState.recoverRemaining-(now-timerState.recoverSeenAt))
                        progress=math.clamp(elapsed/math.max(elapsed+remaining,.05),0,1)
                    else progress=math.clamp(elapsed/math.max(control.landingHoldSeconds,.05),0,1) end
                elseif total>0 then progress=math.clamp(age/total,0,1) end
                if view=='Recharge Box' then
                    local travelled=progress*4
                    for index,edge in parts.chargeBoxFill do
                        local length=math.floor(56*math.clamp(travelled-(index-1),0,1)+.5)
                        edge.Size=if index%2==1 then host.UDim2.fromOffset(length,3) else host.UDim2.fromOffset(3,length)
                    end
                else
                    parts.chargeBarFill.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(56*progress+.5),5)
                end
            elseif view=='Brackets' then
                local reach=(ringSize or 40)*.5
                for _,piece in parts.bracketPieces do
                    piece.across.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(40+piece.sx*(reach-5),40+piece.sy*reach)
                    piece.down.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(40+piece.sx*reach,40+piece.sy*(reach-5))
                end
            end
            local pulse=9+10*(1-closing)
            local coreSize=if holding then 6 else 6+2*math.sin(now*pulse)
            parts.core.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(coreSize,coreSize)
            parts.coreRim.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(coreSize+5,coreSize+5)
            parts.glow.BackgroundTransparency=.8+.06*math.sin(now*5)
        end
        local result=control.landingResult
        local beads,rest=parts.beads,parts.rest
        if result and not holding and left>.05 then
            -- Beads stream along the flight path toward the final spot.
            local flow=(now*1.3)%1
            for index,bead in beads do
                local fraction=(index-1+flow)/#beads
                local point=Prediction.pathAt(result,age+left*fraction)
                local bx,by,beadShown=project(point)
                bead.Visible=beadShown
                if beadShown then
                    bead.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(bx,by)
                    bead.BackgroundTransparency=.3+.6*(1-math.sin(math.pi*fraction))
                end
            end
            -- The first ground touch, when the body then bounces or slides on.
            local impactPoint=result.impact
            if impactPoint and (impactPoint-result.rest).Magnitude>3 then
                local rx,ry,restShown=project(impactPoint+host.Vector3.new(0,.5,0))
                rest.main.Visible,rest.rim.Visible=restShown,restShown
                if restShown then
                    local at=host.UDim2.fromOffset(rx,ry)
                    rest.main.Position,rest.rim.Position=at,at
                end
            else rest.main.Visible,rest.rim.Visible=false,false end
        else
            rest.main.Visible,rest.rim.Visible=false,false
            for _,bead in beads do bead.Visible=false end
        end
    end
    local serial=0
    local function clearRecord(model)
        local record=control.records[model]
        if not record then return end
        for _,line in record.lines do line:Destroy() end
        control.records[model]=nil
    end
    local function recordFor(model)
        local record=control.records[model]
        if record then return record end
        serial+=1
        record={lines={},bodyLines={},curvePoints={},smoothCurvePoints={},visible=false}
        for index=1,CURVE_SEGMENTS+2 do
            local line=host.Instance.new('Frame')
            line.Name='KnockbackDirection'..tostring(serial)..'_'..tostring(index)
            line.BorderSizePixel,line.BackgroundTransparency,line.BackgroundColor3=0,0.1,host.Color3.fromRGB(255,190,70)
            line.AnchorPoint,line.Active,line.Visible=host.Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),false,false
            line.ZIndex,line.Parent=1,gui
            table.insert(record.lines,line)
            if index==1 or index>3 then table.insert(record.bodyLines,line) end
        end
        control.records[model]=record
        return record
    end
    local function hideRecord(record)
        record.visible=false
        record.motionAt,record.motionRoot,record.motionVelocity,record.motionPosition=nil,nil,nil,nil
        record.motionAcceleration,record.motionJerk,record.curvePointCount=nil,nil,0
        record.curveDrawAt,record.curveOrigin,record.curveDrawRoot,record.curveDrawEstimated,record.holdUntil,record.lastConfirmedMotionAt=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        record.holding=false
        for _,line in record.lines do if line.Visible then line.Visible=false end end
    end
    local function hide(reason)
        control.visible=false;control.visibleCount=0;control.provisionalCount=0;control.lastReason=reason
        control.currentTarget=nil
        table.clear(control.currentTargets)
        for _,record in control.records do hideRecord(record) end
    end
    local function living(model)
        if not model or not model.Parent or model==player.Character then return false end
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and model:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true
    end
    function control.targets()
        if type(menu.getRecentHitVictims)=='function' then return menu.getRecentHitVictims() end
        return menu.recentHitVictims or {}
    end
    function control.target(targets)
        targets=targets or control.targets()
        local latest,at=nil,-math.huge
        for model,evidence in targets do
            if living(model) and finite(evidence.at) and evidence.at>at then latest,at=model,evidence.at end
        end
        return latest
    end
    local function rememberContact(model,at,attacker)
        local own=player.Character
        local humanoid=own and own.Parent and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local age=if finite(at) then clock()-at else math.huge
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or attacker~=own or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0
            or own:GetAttribute('Dead')==true or not living(model) or age<0 or age>control.provisionalWindow then return false end
        local previous=control.provisionalTargets[model]
        if previous and previous.at>=at then return false end
        control.provisionalTargets[model]={at=at,character=own,source='Native own attack query contact',inferred=true}
        return true
    end
    function control.onContact(model,at,attacker)
        if rememberContact(model,at,attacker) then
            local visibility=menu.infoVisibility
            if visibility and type(visibility.prioritize)=='function' then pcall(visibility.prioritize,model) end
            control.update()
        end
    end
    function control.onHit(model)
        if control.enabled and control.targets()[model] then
            local visibility=menu.infoVisibility
            if visibility and type(visibility.prioritize)=='function' then pcall(visibility.prioritize,model) end
            control.update()
        end
    end
    function control.onSwing(caster,stage)
        local own=player.Character
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or caster~=own or not own or not own.Parent
            or not finite(stage) or stage<1 or stage>20 or stage~=math.floor(stage) then return end
        local humanoid=own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local look=root and root.CFrame and root.CFrame.LookVector
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or own:GetAttribute('Dead')==true or not look then return end
        local now=clock()
        if control.lastSwingCharacter==own and control.lastSwingStage==stage and now-(control.lastSwingAt or -math.huge)<0.025 then return end
        control.lastSwingCharacter,control.lastSwingStage,control.lastSwingAt=own,stage,now
        control.nativeSwingCount+=1
        local function eligible(model)
            if not living(model) then return false end
            local toward=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if not toward then return false end
            local offset=toward.Position-root.Position
            local flat=math.sqrt(offset.X*offset.X+offset.Z*offset.Z)
            local facing=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)
            return finite(offset.Magnitude) and offset.Magnitude<=control.swingReach and flat>0.05 and facing>0.05
                and (offset.X*look.X+offset.Z*look.Z)/(flat*facing)>=control.swingFacingDot
        end
        local selected
        if control.nativeTool and type(control.nativeTool.GetTarget)=='function' then
            local ok,value=pcall(control.nativeTool.GetTarget,control.nativeTool)
            if ok and value and type(value.FindFirstChild)=='function' and eligible(value) then selected=value end
        end
        local candidates=if selected then {[selected]=true} else (menu.autoCounterFilter and menu.autoCounterFilter.records or {})
        local count=0
        for model in candidates do
            if eligible(model) and rememberContact(model,now,own) then
                control.provisionalTargets[model].source='Inferred native Swing2 reach envelope'
                count+=1
                local visibility=menu.infoVisibility
                if visibility and type(visibility.prioritize)=='function' then pcall(visibility.prioritize,model) end
            end
        end
        control.lastSwingForecastCount=count
        if count>0 then control.update() end
    end
    function control.attachSwing()
        local own=player.Character
        local moveset=own and own:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        if control.swingCharacter==own and control.swingMoveset==moveset and control.swingConnection and control.swingConnection.Connected~=false then return end
        local changed=control.swingCharacter~=own or control.swingMoveset~=moveset
        if not changed and clock()<(control.nextSwingAttachAt or 0) then return end
        control.nextSwingAttachAt=clock()+0.25
        if control.swingConnection then control.swingConnection:Disconnect();control.swingConnection=nil end
        control.swingCharacter,control.swingMoveset,control.swingReady=own,moveset,false
        if type(moveset)~='string' or type(host.require)~='function' then return end
        if not control.nativeTool then
            local scripts=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerScripts') or (type(player.FindFirstChild)=='function' and player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts'))
            local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
            local character=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('Character')
            local module=character and character:FindFirstChild('ToolController')
            if module then
                local ok,value=pcall(host.require,module)
                if ok and type(value)=='table' then control.nativeTool=value end
            end
        end
        local tool=control.nativeTool
        if not tool or type(tool.GetToolService)~='function' then return end
        local ok,service=pcall(tool.GetToolService,tool,moveset..'Service')
        local effects=ok and service and service.Effects
        if not effects or type(effects.Connect)~='function' then return end
        control.swingConnection=effects:Connect(function(method,caster,stage)
            if method~='Swing2' or not control.alive then return end
            local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
            if tracker and type(tracker.onNativeSwing)=='function' then tracker.onNativeSwing(caster,stage) end
            control.onSwing(caster,stage)
        end)
        control.swingReady=control.swingConnection~=nil
    end
    local function attachContacts()
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if tracker~=control.contactTracker then
            if control.contactConnection then control.contactConnection:Disconnect();control.contactConnection=nil end
            table.clear(control.provisionalTargets)
            control.contactTracker=tracker
            control.contactBacklogRead=false
            control.nextContactPollAt=0
        end
        if control.contactConnection and control.contactConnection.Connected==false then control.contactConnection=nil end
        if tracker and not control.contactConnection and type(tracker.onNativeContact)=='function' then
            control.contactConnection=tracker.onNativeContact(control.onContact)
        end
        local subscribed=control.contactConnection~=nil
        local now=clock()
        if subscribed and control.contactBacklogRead then return end
        if not subscribed and now<(control.nextContactPollAt or 0) then return end
        control.contactBacklogRead=true
        control.nextContactPollAt=now+0.05
        for model,contact in tracker and tracker.recentNativeContacts or {} do
            if contact.owner==player.Character and contact.character==player.Character and not contact.ambiguous then
                rememberContact(model,contact.at,contact.owner)
            end
        end
    end
    local function displaced(model)
        local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info and (info:FindFirstChild('Knockback') or info:FindFirstChild('Ragdoll') or info:FindFirstChild('Stun') or info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun')) then return true end
        for _,name in {'Knockback','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Stun'} do
            local value=model:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or finite(value) and value>0 then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function segment(line,a,b)
        local dx,dy=b.X-a.X,b.Y-a.Y
        local length=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
        if length<0.5 then line.Visible=false;return end
        line.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset((a.X+b.X)*0.5,(a.Y+b.Y)*0.5)
        line.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(length,2)
        line.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(dy,dx))
        if not line.Visible then line.Visible=true end
    end
    local function boundedVector(value,maximum)
        local magnitude=value.Magnitude
        return if magnitude>maximum then value*(maximum/magnitude) else value
    end
    local function curveMotion(record,model,root,velocity,estimated,now)
        local zero=velocity*0
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local air=host.Enum.Material and humanoid and humanoid.FloorMaterial==host.Enum.Material.Air
        air=air or math.abs(velocity.Y)>2
        local gravity=if air and finite(world.Gravity) and world.Gravity>=0 then host.Vector3.new(0,-world.Gravity,0) else zero
        local elapsed=record.motionAt and now-record.motionAt or 0
        local previous=record.motionVelocity
        local discontinuity=record.motionPosition and (root.Position-record.motionPosition).Magnitude>math.max(12,velocity.Magnitude*math.max(elapsed,0)*3+4)
        if record.motionRoot~=root or record.motionEstimated~=estimated or not previous or elapsed<0 or elapsed>.25 or discontinuity then
            record.motionAcceleration,record.motionJerk=zero,zero
            record.motionAt,record.motionVelocity,record.motionPosition=now,velocity,root.Position
        elseif elapsed>=1/240 then
            local limit=math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude*8,40,320)
            local measured=(velocity-previous)/elapsed-gravity
            measured=boundedVector(measured,limit)
            local old=record.motionAcceleration or zero
            local acceleration=old+(measured-old)*(1-math.exp(-elapsed/.075))
            local jerk=boundedVector((acceleration-old)/elapsed,limit*4)
            record.motionAcceleration=acceleration
            record.motionJerk=(record.motionJerk or zero)+(jerk-(record.motionJerk or zero))*(1-math.exp(-elapsed/.1))
            record.motionAt,record.motionVelocity,record.motionPosition=now,velocity,root.Position
        end
        record.motionRoot,record.motionEstimated=root,estimated
        return record.motionAcceleration or zero,gravity,record.motionJerk or zero
    end
    local function drawCurve(record,camera,origin,velocity,acceleration,gravity,jerk,start,root,holding,estimated)
        local now=clock()
        local elapsed=record.curveDrawAt and now-record.curveDrawAt or 0
        local translation=record.curveOrigin and origin-record.curveOrigin
        local discontinuity=translation and translation.Magnitude>math.max(12,velocity.Magnitude*math.max(elapsed,0)*3+4)
        if holding and (record.curveDrawRoot~=root or discontinuity or elapsed<0 or record.curvePointCount<2) then return false end
        local points=record.smoothCurvePoints
        local count,length=record.curvePointCount,record.curveLength
        if holding then
            for index=1,count do points[index]=points[index]+translation end
        else
            count,length=Prediction.writeCurve(record.curvePoints,origin,velocity,acceleration,gravity,jerk,control.length*(record.grow or 1))
            local reset=record.curveDrawRoot~=root or record.curveDrawEstimated~=estimated or not record.curveOrigin or discontinuity or elapsed<0 or elapsed>.25
            local alpha=if reset or control.curveSmoothSeconds<=0 then 1 else 1-math.exp(-math.max(0,elapsed)/control.curveSmoothSeconds)
            for index=1,count do
                local previous=points[index]
                local goal=record.curvePoints[index]
                points[index]=if previous and not reset then previous+translation+(goal-previous-translation)*alpha else goal
            end
        end
        points[1]=origin
        record.curvePointCount,record.curveLength=count,length
        record.curveOrigin,record.curveDrawAt,record.curveDrawRoot=origin,now,root
        record.curveDrawEstimated=estimated
        if count<2 then return false end
        -- The additional shaft segments inherit the existing shaft style;
        -- keep its two independently styled endpoint-head frames intact.
        local shaft=record.lines[1]
        if record.bodyColor~=shaft.BackgroundColor3 or record.bodyTransparency~=shaft.BackgroundTransparency then
            record.bodyColor,record.bodyTransparency=shaft.BackgroundColor3,shaft.BackgroundTransparency
            for index=2,#record.bodyLines do
                record.bodyLines[index].BackgroundColor3=record.bodyColor
                record.bodyLines[index].BackgroundTransparency=record.bodyTransparency
            end
        end
        local previous=start
        local used,screenLength=0,0
        local finalX,finalY,tipX,tipY
        local viewport=gui.AbsoluteSize
        if viewport.X<=0 or viewport.Y<=0 then viewport=camera.ViewportSize end
        local guiOrigin=gui.AbsolutePosition
        for index=2,count do
            local projected=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(points[index])
            local point=host.Vector3.new(projected.X-guiOrigin.X,projected.Y-guiOrigin.Y,projected.Z)
            if not finitePoint(point) or point.Z<=0 then return false end
            local dx,dy=point.X-previous.X,point.Y-previous.Y
            local fraction=1
            if dx>0 then fraction=math.min(fraction,(viewport.X-previous.X)/dx) elseif dx<0 then fraction=math.min(fraction,-previous.X/dx) end
            if dy>0 then fraction=math.min(fraction,(viewport.Y-previous.Y)/dy) elseif dy<0 then fraction=math.min(fraction,-previous.Y/dy) end
            fraction=math.clamp(fraction,0,1)
            local clipped=fraction<1
            if clipped then point=host.Vector2.new(previous.X+dx*fraction,previous.Y+dy*fraction);dx,dy=point.X-previous.X,point.Y-previous.Y end
            local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
            -- Merge subpixel samples into the next visible string segment.
            if distance>=1.5 or index==count or clipped then
                if distance>=.5 then
                    used+=1
                    segment(record.bodyLines[used],previous,point)
                    screenLength+=distance
                    finalX,finalY,tipX,tipY=dx/distance,dy/distance,point.X,point.Y
                    previous=point
                end
            end
            if clipped then break end
        end
        for index=used+1,#record.bodyLines do record.bodyLines[index].Visible=false end
        if used==0 or screenLength<1 then return false end
        local tip=host.Vector2.new(tipX,tipY)
        local styled=control.arrowStyle~='Classic'
        local head=if styled then math.clamp(screenLength*.28,7,24)*(1+.12*math.sin(clock()*8)) else math.min(10,screenLength*.35)
        segment(record.lines[2],tip,host.Vector2.new(tipX-finalX*head-finalY*head*.5,tipY-finalY*head+finalX*head*.5))
        segment(record.lines[3],tip,host.Vector2.new(tipX-finalX*head+finalY*head*.5,tipY-finalY*head-finalX*head*.5))
        record.curveVisibleSegments,record.curveEndpoint=used,points[count]
        local style=control.arrowStyle
        if styled then
            record.styled=true
            local base,styleNow=control.arrowWidth,clock()
            local phase=(styleNow*1.2)%1
            for index=1,used do
                local line=record.bodyLines[index]
                local t=index/used
                local width,alpha=base,.1
                if style=='Tapered' then width,alpha=base*(2.2-1.7*t),.05+.55*t
                elseif style=='Glow Beam' then width,alpha=base*1.5,.05
                elseif style=='Energy Flow' then
                    local bump=math.max(0,1-math.abs(((t-phase+.5)%1)-.5)*6)
                    width,alpha=base*(1+.9*bump),.6-.55*bump
                elseif style=='Dash Flow' then
                    line.Visible=((t*8-phase*8)%2)<1
                    width,alpha=base*1.2,.1
                elseif style=='Comet' then width,alpha=base*(.6+2*t),.7-.65*t
                elseif style=='Holo Ribbon' then
                    width,alpha=base*(1.1+.9*t),.18+.3*math.abs(math.sin(t*22-styleNow*7))
                elseif style=='Neon Pulse' then
                    local bump=math.max(0,1-math.abs(((t-phase+.5)%1)-.5)*5)
                    width,alpha=base*(.7+1.4*bump),.0+.5*(1-bump) end
                line.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(line.Size.X.Offset,width)
                line.BackgroundTransparency=alpha
                local glow=line:FindFirstChild('FXGlow')
                if not glow then
                    glow=host.Instance.new('UIStroke');glow.Name='FXGlow';glow.Thickness=0;glow.Transparency=.72
                    glow.ApplyStrokeMode=host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border;glow.Parent=line
                end
                glow.Color=if style=='Holo Ribbon' then line.BackgroundColor3:Lerp(host.Color3.fromRGB(120,235,255),.7) else line.BackgroundColor3
                glow.Transparency=if style=='Holo Ribbon' then .45 elseif style=='Neon Pulse' then .5 else .72
                glow.Thickness=if style=='Glow Beam' then base*2.2 elseif style=='Energy Flow' then base*1.2 elseif style=='Holo Ribbon' then base*2.6 elseif style=='Neon Pulse' then base*3.2 else 0
            end
            for _,index in {2,3} do
                local arm=record.lines[index]
                arm.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(arm.Size.X.Offset,base*1.3)
                arm.BackgroundTransparency=.05
            end
        elseif record.styled then
            record.styled=false
            for _,line in record.lines do
                line.BackgroundTransparency=.1
                local glow=line:FindFirstChild('FXGlow')
                if glow then glow.Thickness=0 end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function drawTarget(model,camera,evidence,provisional)
        if menu.infoVisibility and not menu.infoVisibility.isVisible(model) then return false end
        local root=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then return false end
        local age=if finite(evidence.at) then clock()-evidence.at else math.huge
        local fresh=age>=0 and age<=control.initialForecastWindow
        local observed=not provisional and displaced(model)
        local velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if not finitePoint(root.Position) or not finitePoint(velocity) then return false end
        local record=control.records[model]
        local retainedWindow=record and not provisional and record.holdUntil and clock()<record.holdUntil and control.arrowHoldSeconds>0
        local ending=if observed or retainedWindow then Prediction.endpoint(root.Position,velocity,control.length) else nil
        local holding=retainedWindow and not ending
        local estimated=false
        if not ending and not observed and fresh then
            local attacker=evidence.character
            local ownRoot=attacker==player.Character and attacker and attacker.Parent and attacker:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if ownRoot then
                local direction=root.Position-ownRoot.Position
                if finite(direction.Magnitude) and direction.Magnitude>0.05 then
                    velocity=direction/direction.Magnitude*3
                    ending=Prediction.endpoint(root.Position,velocity,control.length)
                    estimated=ending~=nil
                end
            end
        end
        if not ending and not holding then return false end
        local a,onScreen=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
        if not onScreen or not finitePoint(a) or a.Z<=0 then return false end
        record=record or recordFor(model)
        -- The arrow reaches out from the target each time it appears.
        if not record.visible then record.shownAt=clock() end
        local growth=1
        if control.arrowGrow and record.shownAt then
            local progress=math.clamp((clock()-record.shownAt)/.22,0,1)
            growth=1-(1-progress)^3
        end
        record.grow=math.max(growth,.02)
        local acceleration,gravity,jerk=curveMotion(record,model,root,velocity,estimated,clock())
        if not drawCurve(record,camera,root.Position,velocity,acceleration,gravity,jerk,a,root,holding,estimated) then return false end
        if observed and not holding then record.lastConfirmedMotionAt=clock();record.holdUntil=record.lastConfirmedMotionAt+control.arrowHoldSeconds end
        record.visible=true
        record.provisional,record.inferred,record.directionSource=provisional==true,estimated,
            if holding then 'Recent confirmed motion path' elseif estimated then (if evidence.source=='Inferred native Swing2 reach envelope' then evidence.source else 'Initial attack geometry estimate') else 'Observed victim velocity'
        record.holding=holding==true
        return true
    end
    function control.update()
        local targets
        if control.alive and (control.enabled or control.landingEnabled) then targets=control.targets() end
        if control.alive then control.updateLanding(targets) end
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then return end
        control.attachSwing()
        attachContacts()
        local now,own=clock(),player.Character
        local humanoid=own and own.Parent and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local ownAlive=humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and own:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true
        for model,evidence in control.provisionalTargets do
            if targets[model] or not ownAlive or evidence.character~=own or not living(model)
                or now-evidence.at<0 or now-evidence.at>control.provisionalWindow then control.provisionalTargets[model]=nil end
        end
        for model in control.records do if (not targets[model] and not control.provisionalTargets[model]) or not living(model) then clearRecord(model) end end
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        local parent=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
        if not camera or not parent then hide('Camera or player GUI is unavailable');return end
        if gui.Parent~=parent then gui.Parent=parent end
        local menuRoot=menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        local main=menuRoot and (if menuRoot:IsA('ScreenGui') then menuRoot else menuRoot:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('ScreenGui'))
        local order=if main then main.DisplayOrder-1 else 0
        if gui.DisplayOrder~=order then gui.DisplayOrder=order end
        table.clear(control.currentTargets)
        local count,provisionalCount,latest,latestAt=0,0,nil,-math.huge
        for model,evidence in targets do
            if living(model) and drawTarget(model,camera,evidence,false) then
                count+=1
                table.insert(control.currentTargets,model)
                if finite(evidence.at) and evidence.at>latestAt then latest,latestAt=model,evidence.at end
            elseif control.records[model] then hideRecord(control.records[model]) end
        end
        for model,evidence in control.provisionalTargets do
            if drawTarget(model,camera,evidence,true) then
                count+=1
                provisionalCount+=1
                table.insert(control.currentTargets,model)
                if evidence.at>latestAt then latest,latestAt=model,evidence.at end
            elseif control.records[model] then hideRecord(control.records[model]) end
        end
        control.visibleCount,control.provisionalCount,control.visible,control.currentTarget=count,provisionalCount,count>0,latest
        control.lastReason=if count>0 then (if count==provisionalCount then 'Initial attack geometry estimate' else 'Observed knockback direction') else 'Waiting for native own-attack contacts or recent own-hit victims'
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        local wasEnabled=control.enabled
        control.enabled=control.alive and value==true
        gui.Enabled=control.enabled or control.landingEnabled
        if control.enabled and not wasEnabled then
            control.contactBacklogRead=false;control.nextContactPollAt=0
            attachContacts()
        end
        if not control.enabled then
            hide('Prediction is disabled');control.currentTarget=nil
            table.clear(control.provisionalTargets)
            for model in control.records do clearRecord(model) end
        end
    end
    function control.setLength(value)
        local number=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(number) then return false end
        local previous=control.length
        control.length=math.clamp(number,0,30/0.28)
        if control.length<previous then for _,record in control.records do hideRecord(record) end end
        if control.length==0 then hide('Prediction length is zero') end
        return true
    end
    -- Bind just after the camera so the marker is projected with this frame's final camera.
    local runService=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local bindName='ShenaniganismPrediction'
    local priority=(if host.Enum.RenderPriority then host.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value else 200)+1
    local bound=pcall(runService.BindToRenderStep,runService,bindName,priority,control.update)
    local connection=if bound then nil else runService.RenderStepped:Connect(control.update)
    attachContacts()
    control.attachSwing()
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.setLandingEnabled(false);control.setEnabled(false);control.alive=false
        if holo and holo.folder then holo.folder:Destroy();holo=nil end
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() else pcall(runService.UnbindFromRenderStep,runService,bindName) end
        if control.contactConnection then control.contactConnection:Disconnect();control.contactConnection=nil end
        if control.swingConnection then control.swingConnection:Disconnect();control.swingConnection=nil end
        gui:Destroy()
    end
    return control
end
return Prediction
end)()

local MoveNames = (function(): any
-- Animation metadata index for readable move labels. It observes no combat inputs.
local MoveNames: {[string]: any} = {}

-- These aliases match the game's exposed move-card names, not inferred attacks.
local aliases = {
    CursedStrike="Cursed Strikes", ExtendSwing="Extended Swings",
    EyeCatch="Eye Catching", JudgeReach="Judgement's Reach",
    Sacrilegious="Sacrilege", ShutUp="Shut Up!", DivineDog="Divine Dog: Totality",
    DivergentFist="Divergent Fist", RatioBreak="Ratio Breaker",
}
local excludedFolders = {Misc=true, Melee=true, MeleeUlt=true, Dodges=true, Dashes=true, Offloads=true, Kogane=true, TakadaJoint=true}
local generic = {
    Ultimate=true, UltimateAfter=true, Domain=true, Domain1=true, Domain2=true,
    Arm=true, Arms=true, Idle=true, Teleport=true, Grab=true, Throw=true, Launch=true,
    Recovery=true, Summon=true, Spawn=true, User=true, Up=true, Down=true,
    RunSlash=true, RunPierce=true, LaunchGround=true, LaunchGroundMelee=true,
    BoostOnStart=true, BoostOnEnd=true, GunShot=true, Kick=true, UltEnd=true,
}

local function normalized(value: string): string
    return value:gsub("<[^>]->", ""):gsub("[^%w]", ""):lower()
end
local function humanName(value: string): string
    return (value:gsub("_", " "):gsub("(%u)(%u%l)", "%1 %2"):gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"))
end
local function candidate(animation: any, root: any): any
    local names, node = {}, animation
    while node and node ~= root do
        table.insert(names,1,node.Name)
        if excludedFolders[node.Name] or node.Name:match("^Melee") then return nil end
        node=node.Parent
    end
    if node ~= root or #names < 2 then return nil end
    local raw = names[#names]
    local lower = raw:lower()
    -- Receiver clips and generic movement/awakening phases cannot name an attack.
    for _, word in {"victim","target","reaction","stun","warn","old","recovery","idle","landing","hit","ragdoll"} do
        if lower:find(word,1,true) then return nil end
    end
    if lower:match("^dash") or lower:match("^walk") or lower:match("^jump") or generic[raw] == true then return nil end
    local base = raw:gsub("%d+$", "")
    if generic[base] == true then return nil end
    if base == "RatioBreak" and not table.find(names,"RatioBreaker") then return nil end
    if base == "DivergentFist" and not table.find(names,"Variants") then return nil end
    -- A numbered clip inside a move folder uses that folder's metadata name.
    if raw:match("^%d+$") then
        base=names[#names-1]
        if base == names[1] or generic[base] or excludedFolders[base] then return nil end
    end
    local display = aliases[base] or humanName(base)
    if display == "" then return nil end
    return {name=display,key=normalized(display),assetKey=normalized(base),group=names[1]}
end

-- Shared, read-only emote catalog. The inventory supplies every exposed name;
-- equipped-wheel rows additionally supply verified animation IDs.
type EmoteCatalogState = {alive: boolean, busy: boolean?, signature: string?, [string]: any}
local function emoteResolver(host: any): any
    local clock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local result: EmoteCatalogState={alive=true,names={},byId={},knownIds={},stats={catalogNames=0,knownIds=0,resolvedIds=0,ambiguousIds=0,unresolvedNames=0,pending=0},connections={},assetNames={},assets={},metadata={},pending={},queue={}}
    local native,module,list,nextRead=nil,nil,nil,0
    local listConnections={}
    local function service(name)local ok,value=pcall(host.game.GetService,host.game,name);return ok and value or nil end
    local players=service('Players')
    local player=players and players.LocalPlayer
    local market=service('MarketplaceService')
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then local c=signal:Connect(callback);result.connections[#result.connections+1]=c;return c end
        return nil
    end
    local function idOf(value: any): string?
        if type(value)=='number' then return value>0 and value<math.huge and value%1==0 and string.format('%.0f',value) or nil end
        if type(value)~='string' then return nil end
        local id=value:match('^%s*(%d+)%s*$') or value:match('^rbxassetid://(%d+)') or value:match('[?&]id=(%d+)')
        if not id then return nil end
        id=id:gsub('^0+','')
        return id~='' and id or nil
    end
    result.normalizeId=idOf
    local function clean(value)
        if type(value)~='string' then return nil end
        value=value:gsub('<[^>]->',''):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','')
        return value~='' and value~='None' and #value<=160 and value or nil
    end
    local function at(parent,name)return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name) end
    local function findSources()
        local scripts=at(player,'PlayerScripts')
        local found=at(at(at(scripts,'Controllers'),'Character'),'EmoteController')
        if found and (found~=module or not native) and type(host.require)=='function' then
            local ok,value=pcall(host.require,found)
            if ok and type(value)=='table' then native,module=value,found end
        end
        local gui=player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
        local foundList=at(at(at(at(at(at(gui,'Menus'),'Group'),'Inventory'),'Items'),'Emotes'),'List')
        if foundList~=list then
            for _,c in listConnections do c:Disconnect();local at=table.find(result.connections,c);if at then table.remove(result.connections,at) end end
            table.clear(listConnections)
            list=foundList;result.dirty=true
            if list then
                table.insert(listConnections,connect(list.ChildAdded,function()result.dirty=true end))
                table.insert(listConnections,connect(list.ChildRemoved,function()result.dirty=true end))
                table.insert(listConnections,connect(list.Destroying,function()if list==foundList then list=nil;result.dirty=true end end))
            end
        end
        return native and native.EmoteCache,list
    end
    function result.refresh(force)
        if not result.alive then return false end
        local now=clock()
        if not force and now<nextRead and not result.dirty then return false end
        nextRead=now+2
        local cache,inventory=findSources()
        local names,ids,known,signature,evidence={},{},{},{},{}
        local function add(name,id,source)
            name=clean(name);if not name then return end
            names[name]=true
            id=idOf(id);if not id then return end
            known[id]=true
            evidence[id]=evidence[id]or {};evidence[id][name]=source
            local previous=ids[id]
            if previous==nil then ids[id]=name elseif previous~=name then ids[id]=false end
        end
        local rows=0
        if type(cache)=='table' then
            for key,row in cache do
                rows+=1;if rows>4096 then break end
                if type(row)=='table' then
                    add(row[1],row[2],'Native EmoteController.EmoteCache')
                    signature[#signature+1]=tostring(key)..'='..tostring(row[1])..':'..tostring(row[2])
                end
            end
        end
        local inventoryRows=0
        if inventory then for _,row in inventory:GetChildren() do
            if row:IsA('Frame') then
                inventoryRows+=1
                local name=clean(row.Name)
                if name then names[name]=true;signature[#signature+1]='n:'..name end
            end
        end end
        table.clear(result.assetNames)
        local assetRows=0
        for animation,record in result.assets do
            local node,emoteFolder=animation.Parent,false
            while node and node~=record.root do
                if node.Name=='Emotes'or node.Name=='Emote'then emoteFolder=true end
                node=node.Parent
            end
            local explicit=clean(animation:GetAttribute('EmoteName'))
            local name=explicit or clean(animation.Name)
            -- A folder named Emote or a generic Animation cannot supply a
            -- display name. Native catalog membership or an explicit emote
            -- attribute is required; character specials never qualify by name.
            if node==record.root and name and name~='Animation'and name~='AnimationTrack'and name~='Emote'and name~='Emotes'
                and (explicit or emoteFolder and names[name]) then
                local id=idOf(animation.AnimationId)
                if id then
                    add(name,id,'Native emote Animation metadata');assetRows+=1
                    local previous=result.assetNames[id]
                    result.assetNames[id]=if previous==nil or previous==name then name else false
                end
            end
        end
        for id,name in result.metadata do if type(name)=='string' and names[name] then add(name,id,'Animation product metadata: exact catalog name') end end
        table.sort(signature)
        local version=table.concat(signature,'|')
        if not force and not result.dirty and version==result.signature then return false end
        result.signature=version;result.dirty=false
        local count,idCount,resolved,ambiguous,covered=0,0,0,0,{}
        for name in names do count+=1 end
        for id in known do
            idCount+=1
            if type(ids[id])=='string' then resolved+=1;covered[ids[id]]=true else ambiguous+=1 end
        end
        local missing=0;for name in names do if not covered[name] then missing+=1 end end
        result.names,result.byId,result.knownIds,result.evidence=names,ids,known,evidence
        result.stats={catalogNames=count,inventoryNames=inventoryRows,wheelRows=rows,knownIds=idCount,resolvedIds=resolved,ambiguousIds=ambiguous,
            unresolvedNames=missing,pending=#result.queue+(result.busy and 1 or 0),metadataLookups=result.lookups or 0,observedAssetRows=assetRows}
        return true
    end
    function result.observeAnimation(animation,root)
        if not animation or not animation:IsA('Animation') then return end
        if result.assets[animation] then result.dirty=true;return end
        local node,eligible=animation.Parent,clean(animation:GetAttribute('EmoteName'))~=nil
        while node and node~=root do
            if node.Name=='Emotes' or node.Name=='Emote' then eligible=true end
            node=node.Parent
        end
        if not eligible or node~=root then return end
        local record={root=root,connections={}}
        result.assets[animation]=record;result.dirty=true
        local function dirty()result.dirty=true end
        local function observe(signal)
            local connection=connect(signal,dirty)
            if connection then table.insert(record.connections,connection)end
        end
        if type(animation.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then
            observe(animation:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AnimationId'));observe(animation:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'))
        end
        if type(animation.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function'then observe(animation:GetAttributeChangedSignal('EmoteName'))end
        observe(animation.AncestryChanged)
        local removed=connect(animation.Destroying,function()result.forgetAnimation(animation)end)
        if removed then table.insert(record.connections,removed)end
    end
    function result.forgetAnimation(animation)
        local record=result.assets[animation];if not record then return end
        result.assets[animation]=nil;result.dirty=true
        for _,connection in record.connections do
            connection:Disconnect()
            local index=table.find(result.connections,connection);if index then table.remove(result.connections,index)end
        end
    end
    function result.catalog()
        result.refresh()
        local entries,byName={},{}
        for name in result.names do local entry={name=name,animationIds={},ambiguousAnimationIds={},sources={}};byName[name]=entry;table.insert(entries,entry)end
        for id,names in result.evidence or {}do for name,source in names do
            local entry=byName[name]
            if entry then
                table.insert(if result.byId[id]==name then entry.animationIds else entry.ambiguousAnimationIds,id)
                entry.sources[id]=source
            end
        end end
        for _,entry in entries do table.sort(entry.animationIds);table.sort(entry.ambiguousAnimationIds)end
        table.sort(entries,function(a,b)return a.name<b.name end)
        return {version=1,stats=table.clone(result.stats),entries=entries,
            completeness='Currently exposed native inventory, cache and observed metadata only; unloaded and server-only animation IDs remain unknown'}
    end
    function result.named(model,info)
        result.refresh()
        local function known(value)return type(value)=='string' and result.names[value] and value or nil end
        if not model then return nil end
        for _,key in {'EmoteName','Emote','Emoting'} do local name=known(model:GetAttribute(key));if name then return name end end
        info=info or model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info then for _,key in {'Emote','Emoting'} do
            local marker=info:FindFirstChild(key)
            if marker then
                local name=marker:IsA('StringValue') and known(marker.Value) or nil
                name=name or known(marker:GetAttribute('EmoteName')) or known(marker:GetAttribute('Emote'))
                if name then return name end
            end
        end end
        return nil
    end
    local function emoteContext(model)
        if not model then return false end
        if model:GetAttribute('Emote') or model:GetAttribute('Emoting') or model:GetAttribute('EmoteName') then return true end
        local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return info and (info:FindFirstChild('Emote') or info:FindFirstChild('Emoting'))~=nil or false
    end
    local function assetDisplay(value)
        value=clean(value);if not value then return nil end
        -- Native animation product names commonly add this literal word. Never
        -- use fuzzy matching: some products (Air Drone) have a different name.
        local key=normalized(value:gsub('^[Ee][Mm][Oo][Tt][Ee]%s*',''):gsub('%s*[Ee][Mm][Oo][Tt][Ee]$',''))
        if key=='' then return nil end
        local name
        for candidateName in result.names do
            if normalized(candidateName)==key then if name and name~=candidateName then return nil end;name=candidateName end
        end
        return name
    end
    local pump
    pump=function()
        if result.busy or not result.alive or #result.queue==0 then return end
        local id=table.remove(result.queue,1)
        local lookup
        if market then local ok,value=pcall(function()return market.GetProductInfo end);if ok then lookup=value end end
        if type(lookup)~='function' or not host.task or type(host.task.spawn)~='function' then result.metadata[id]=false;result.pending[id]=nil;return end
        result.busy=true
        result.thread=host.task.spawn(function()
            result.lookups=(result.lookups or 0)+1
            local ok,data=pcall(lookup,market,tonumber(id),host.Enum and host.Enum.InfoType and host.Enum.InfoType.Asset)
            if result.alive then
                local name=ok and type(data)=='table' and data.AssetTypeId==24 and assetDisplay(data.Name) or nil
                result.metadata[id]=name or false
                result.pending[id]=nil;result.busy=false;result.thread=nil
                if name then result.dirty=true end
                result.stats.pending=#result.queue
                result.stats.metadataLookups=result.lookups
                pump()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function request(id)
        if not id or result.pending[id] or result.metadata[id]~=nil or #result.queue>=32 then return end
        result.pending[id]=true;result.queue[#result.queue+1]=id;result.stats.pending=#result.queue+(result.busy and 1 or 0)
        pump()
    end
    function result.nameForTrack(model,track)
        result.refresh()
        if not result.alive or not track or track.IsPlaying==false then return nil end
        local animation=track.Animation
        local id=animation and idOf(animation.AnimationId)
        local name=id and result.byId[id]
        if name~=nil then return result.named(model) or (type(name)=='string' and name or nil) end
        for _,value in {animation and animation.Name,track.Name} do
            if value and value~='Animation' and value~='AnimationTrack' and value~='Emote' and result.names[value] then return value end
        end
        if id and emoteContext(model) then request(id) end
        return nil
    end
    function result.isTrack(model,track)
        result.refresh()
        local animation=track and track.Animation
        local id=animation and idOf(animation.AnimationId)
        return id and result.knownIds[id]==true or result.nameForTrack(model,track)~=nil
    end
    function result.Destroy()
        result.alive=false
        if result.thread and host.task and type(host.task.cancel)=='function' then pcall(host.task.cancel,result.thread) end
        for _,c in result.connections do c:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(result.connections);table.clear(result.pending);table.clear(result.queue);table.clear(result.assets)
    end
    result.refresh(true)
    return result
end

function MoveNames.new(host: {[string]: any}, _menu: any): any
    local control: any = {alive=true,byId={},byAnimation=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}),folders=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}),connections={},animationCount=0,groupCount=0}
    control.emotes=emoteResolver(host)
    control.refreshEmotes=control.emotes.refresh
    control.emoteNameForTrack=control.emotes.nameForTrack
    control.isEmoteTrack=control.emotes.isTrack
    control.namedEmote=control.emotes.named
    control.emoteCatalogStats=function()control.emotes.refresh();return table.clone(control.emotes.stats)end
    control.exportEmoteCatalog=control.emotes.catalog
    local root = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Animations")
    local groups, rejected = {}, {}
    if root then
        -- One startup walk. Activity calls only query these maps and cached cards.
        for _, animation in root:GetDescendants() do
            if not animation:IsA("Animation") then continue end
            control.emotes.observeAnimation(animation,root)
            local id = animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
            if not id then continue end
            local entry = candidate(animation,root)
            if not entry then rejected[id]=true; continue end
            control.byAnimation[animation]=entry
            local prior=control.byId[id]
            if prior and (prior.key~=entry.key or prior.group~=entry.group) then
                control.byId[id]=false
            elseif prior==nil then control.byId[id]=entry end
            control.animationCount+=1
            groups[entry.group]=true
        end
        -- An ID shared with a receiver/unknown clip is unsafe when tracks contain
        -- a cloned Animation without the original replicated path.
        for id in rejected do control.byId[id]=false end
    end
    for _ in groups do control.groupCount+=1 end
    if root and root.DescendantAdded then
        local c=root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(animation)control.emotes.observeAnimation(animation,root)end)
        control.emotes.connections[#control.emotes.connections+1]=c
    end
    if root and root.DescendantRemoving then
        local c=root.DescendantRemoving:Connect(control.emotes.forgetAnimation)
        control.emotes.connections[#control.emotes.connections+1]=c
    end
    function control.cardNames(model: any): any
        local folder=model and model:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
        if not folder then return nil end
        local record=control.folders[folder]
        if not record then
            record={dirty=true,names={},cards={},connections={}}
            control.folders[folder]=record
            local function connect(signal,callback)
                if not signal then return end
                local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
                record.connections[connection],control.connections[connection]=true,true
            end
            -- Invalidation observes only that moveset; no recurring actor scans.
            for _, signal in {folder.ChildAdded,folder.ChildRemoved} do
                connect(signal,function() record.dirty=true end)
            end
            connect(folder.Destroying,function()
                for connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect(); control.connections[connection]=nil end
                table.clear(record.connections)
                table.clear(record.names)
                table.clear(record.cards)
            end)
        end
        if record.dirty then
            table.clear(record.names)
            table.clear(record.cards)
            for _, move in folder:GetChildren() do
                if move:IsA("NumberValue") or move:IsA("Tool") then
                    local key=normalized(move.Name)
                    record.names[key]=move.Name:gsub("<[^>]->", "")
                    record.cards[key]=record.cards[key] or {}
                    table.insert(record.cards[key],move)
                end
            end
            record.dirty=false
        end
        return record.names,record.cards
    end
    function control.nameForId(model: any, id: string, animation: any?): string?
        if not control.alive then return nil end
        local entry = animation and control.byAnimation[animation] or control.byId[id]
        if not entry then return nil end
        local cards=control.cardNames(model)
        return (cards and (cards[entry.key] or cards[entry.assetKey])) or entry.name
    end
    function control.nameForTrack(model: any, track: any): string?
        if not track or not track.IsPlaying or (track.WeightCurrent or 0)<=0.05 then return nil end
        local animation=track.Animation
        local id=animation and animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
        return if id then control.nameForId(model,id,animation) else nil
    end
    function control.skillNameForTrack(model: any, track: any): string?
        if not control.alive or not track or not track.IsPlaying or (track.WeightCurrent or 0)<=0.05 then return nil end
        local animation=track.Animation
        local id=animation and animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
        local entry=if id then control.byAnimation[animation] or control.byId[id] else nil
        if not entry then return nil end
        local _,cards=control.cardNames(model)
        local folder=model and model:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
        if not cards or not folder then return nil end
        for _,key in {entry.key,entry.assetKey} do
            for _,move in cards[key] or {} do
                local slot,service=move:GetAttribute("Key"),move:GetAttribute("Service")
                local currentKey=normalized(move.Name)
                local inUlt=model:GetAttribute("InUlt")==true
                -- Read current native card attributes: cooldown values and old
                -- M1 timestamps do not prove that a numbered skill is casting.
                if move.Parent==folder and (currentKey==entry.key or currentKey==entry.assetKey)
                    and type(slot)=="number" and slot%1==0 and slot>=1 and slot<=4
                    and type(service)=="string" and service~=""
                    and not (move:GetAttribute("AWK") and inUlt or move:GetAttribute("AWK2") and not inUlt) then
                    return move.Name:gsub("<[^>]->", "")
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        control.emotes.Destroy()
        for connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        table.clear(control.folders)
        table.clear(control.byAnimation)
        table.clear(control.byId)
    end
    return control
end
return MoveNames
end)()

local ProjectilePrediction = (function(): any
-- Optional evidence-based threat extension. All actual Block ownership and
-- native action dispatch remain in AutoBlock; this module never sends inputs.
local ProjectilePrediction: {[string]: any} = {}

function ProjectilePrediction.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, initialBlock: any?): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local world = host.workspace
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local control: any = {alive=true, projectileEnabled=false, allMovesEnabled=false, ready=false,
        predictionHorizon=0.35, maxRecords=300, records={}, count=0, actors={}, connections={},
        names={}, modelNames={}, seeded=false, lastSample=-math.huge, sampleInterval=1/120, lastAttach=-math.huge,
        projectileChecks=0, moveChecks=0, lastReason="Prediction options are disabled"}
    local zero = host.Vector3.new(0,0,0)
    -- Descendant bursts often belong to one already indexed attack model.
    -- These weak indexes never own another projectile or its lifetime.
    local sourceParts=setmetatable({},{__mode='kv'})
    local sourcePrimaryParts=setmetatable({},{__mode='kv'})
    local clear: any
    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function attribute(object: any, key: string): any
        return object and object:GetAttribute(key)
    end
    local function unblockable(object: any): boolean
        return object and (attribute(object,"Unblockable")==true or attribute(object,"Blockable")==false
            or attribute(object,"BlockBreak")==true or attribute(object,"BreakBlock")==true) or false
    end
    local function hostile(model: any): boolean
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(model)) then return false end
        if not model or model==player.Character or not model.Parent then return false end
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return false end
        local other=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        return not (other and player.Team and other.Team==player.Team and not player.Neutral and not other.Neutral)
    end
    local function ownerModel(value: any): any
        if type(value)=='string' then
            local found=type(players.FindFirstChild)=='function' and players:FindFirstChild(value)
            if found and found:IsA('Player') then return found.Character end
            local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters');return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(value)
        end
        if type(value)=="number" and type(players.GetPlayerByUserId)=="function" then
            local found=players:GetPlayerByUserId(value);return found and found.Character
        end
        if value and (type(value)=="table" or type(value)=="userdata") and type(value.IsA)=="function" then
            if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
            if value:IsA("Model") then return value end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function metadataOwner(source: any): any
        if not source then return nil end
        for _,name in {"OwnerUserId","Owner","Character","Caster"} do
            local found=ownerModel(attribute(source,name))
            if found then return found end
            local child=source:FindFirstChild(name)
            if child and child:IsA("ObjectValue") then
                found=ownerModel(child.Value);if found then return found end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function partOf(source: any): any
        if source:IsA("BasePart") then return source end
        if source:IsA("Model") then
            local hitbox=source:FindFirstChild("Hitbox",true)
            return (hitbox and hitbox:IsA("BasePart") and hitbox) or source.PrimaryPart or source:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function rootOf(): any
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
    end
    local function facing(root: any, point: any, threshold: number): boolean
        local d=point-root.Position
        local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(d.X,0,d.Z)
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
        look=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        return horizontal.Magnitude<=0.05 or (look.Magnitude>0.05 and look.Unit:Dot(horizontal.Unit)>=threshold)
    end
    local rayParams
    if host.RaycastParams and host.Enum and host.Enum.RaycastFilterType then
        rayParams=host.RaycastParams.new()
        rayParams.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rayParams.IgnoreWater=true
    end
    control.trajectoryReady=rayParams~=nil and type(world.Raycast)=="function"
    local function clearPath(start: any, finish: any, source: any, owner: any): boolean
        if not rayParams or type(world.Raycast)~="function" then return false end
        local exclusions={player.Character,source,owner}
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances=exclusions
        local direction=finish-start
        if direction.Magnitude<=0.01 then return true end
        local ok,hit=pcall(world.Raycast,world,start,direction,rayParams)
        return ok and not hit
    end
    local function add(source: any, native: any?)
        local part=source and partOf(source)
        if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        if source:IsA('Model') then sourceParts[source],sourcePrimaryParts[source]=part,source.PrimaryPart end
        local current=control.records[part]
        if current then
            if native then current.native=native;current.source=native.source or source end
            return
        end
        local owner=ownerModel(native and native.owner) or metadataOwner(source) or metadataOwner(part)
        if owner and not hostile(owner) then return end
        if control.count>=control.maxRecords then
            local victim,oldest
            for key,record in control.records do
                if not hostile(record.owner) or clock()-(record.lastMoved or record.born)>0.5 then
                    if not oldest or record.born<oldest then victim,oldest=key,record.born end
                end
            end
            if not victim then return end
            control.records[victim]=nil;control.count-=1
        end
        control.records[part]={part=part,source=source,native=native,position=part.Position,at=clock(),
            velocity=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or zero,predictionOwner=control,owner=owner,born=clock()}
        control.count+=1
    end
    local function candidate(object: any)
        if not control.alive or not (control.projectileEnabled or control.allMovesEnabled) then return end
        local known=control.names[object.Name] or attribute(object,"IsProjectile")==true or attribute(object,"Projectile")==true
            or attribute(object,'IsBomb')==true or attribute(object,'IsBullet')==true or attribute(object,'IsSwarm')==true or attribute(object,'IsExplosion')==true
        local source=object
        if object:IsA("Model") and control.modelNames[object.Name] then known=true end
        local ancestor=object.Parent
        while not known and ancestor and ancestor~=world do
            if ancestor:IsA("Model") and control.modelNames[ancestor.Name] then source=ancestor;known=true;break end
            if ancestor.Name=="Projectiles" then known=true;break end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
        if known then
            local cached=sourceParts[source]
            -- Only an event for an incidental descendant can reuse a resolved
            -- source. A direct source/Hitbox event, changed PrimaryPart or
            -- removed/reparented part must take the normal resolver path.
            if source~=object and object.Name~='Hitbox' and source:IsA('Model')
                and cached and cached.Parent and control.records[cached]
                and source.PrimaryPart==sourcePrimaryParts[source]
                and type(cached.IsDescendantOf)=='function' and cached:IsDescendantOf(source) then return end
            add(source)
        end
    end
    local function seed()
        if control.seeded then return end
        control.seeded=true
        local utils=host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Utils")
        if utils and not control.templatesIndexed then for _,object in utils:GetDescendants() do
            local name=object.Name:lower()
            if name:find("projectile",1,true) or name:find("bullet",1,true) or name:find('bomb',1,true)
                or name:find('grenade',1,true) or name:find('swarm',1,true) or name:find('explosion',1,true) then
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then control.names[object.Name]=true
                elseif object:IsA("Model") then control.modelNames[object.Name]=true end
            end
        end end
        control.templatesIndexed=true
        for _,name in {"Effects","Projectiles"} do
            local folder=world:FindFirstChild(name)
            if folder and not control.folders then control.folders={} end
            if folder then
                for _,object in folder:GetDescendants() do candidate(object) end
                if not control.folders[folder] then
                    control.folders[folder]=true
                    table.insert(control.connections,folder.DescendantAdded:Connect(candidate))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function borrow()
        local block=control.block
        if block then for _,native in block.projectileParts or {} do
            if native.part and native.part.Parent then add(native.source or native.part,native) end
        end end
    end
    function control.sample()
        if clock()-control.lastSample<control.sampleInterval then return end
        control.lastSample=clock()
        borrow()
        for part,record in control.records do
            if not part.Parent or not record.source.Parent then control.records[part]=nil;control.count-=1;continue end
            local native=record.native
            record.owner=ownerModel(native and native.owner) or metadataOwner(record.source) or metadataOwner(part)
            if (record.owner and not hostile(record.owner)) or (not record.owner and clock()-record.born>0.75) then
                control.records[part]=nil;control.count-=1;continue
            end
            local dt=clock()-record.at
            if dt>0 then
                local observed=(part.Position-record.position)/dt
                if observed.Magnitude>0.5 then record.velocity=observed;record.lastMoved=clock()
                elseif part.AssemblyLinearVelocity and part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude>0.5 then record.velocity=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                elseif clock()-(record.lastMoved or record.born)<=0.08 then
                    record.velocity=(native and native.predictedVelocity) or record.velocity or zero
                else record.velocity=zero end
                record.position,record.at=part.Position,clock()
            elseif native and native.predictedVelocity then record.velocity=native.predictedVelocity end
        end
    end
    function control.projectileThreat(record: any, root: any): (boolean, number?)
        local part,source=record.part,record.source
        local range=control.block and control.block.projectileRange
        if range and (range<=0 or (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>range) then return false end
        if not part.Parent or not hostile(record.owner) or unblockable(part) or unblockable(source) then return false end
        local block=control.block
        if block and block.allowsThreat and not block.allowsThreat({kind='Projectile',projectile=record}) then return false end
        local unresolved=part.Name=="PurpleProjectile" or part.Name=="WorldSlashProjectile"
            or source.Name=="PurpleProjectile" or source.Name=="WorldSlashProjectile"
        if unresolved and attribute(part,"Blockable")~=true and attribute(source,"Blockable")~=true then return false end
        if block and block.projectileThreat and block.referenceSettings then
            local incoming,time=block.projectileThreat(part,root,source,record.velocity,false,control.predictionHorizon)
            return incoming and clearPath(part.Position,root.Position,source,record.owner),time
        end
        if not facing(root,part.Position,0.05) then return false end
        local delta=root.Position-part.Position
        local velocity=record.velocity
        if not velocity or velocity.Magnitude<1 or delta:Dot(velocity)<=0 then return false end
        local relative=velocity-(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or zero)
        if relative.Magnitude<1 then return false end
        local time=delta:Dot(relative)/(relative.Magnitude^2)
        if not finite(time) or time<0 or time>control.predictionHorizon then return false end
        local size=part.Size
        local radius=2.5+(size and math.min(math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)*0.5,2) or 0)
        if (delta-relative*time).Magnitude>radius then return false end
        if not clearPath(part.Position,root.Position,source,record.owner) then return false end
        return true,time
    end
    local function contact(track: any): number?
        if type(track.GetTimeOfKeyframe)~="function" then return nil end
        local result
        for _,name in {"Hit","Impact","Attack","Damage","Contact"} do
            local ok,time=pcall(track.GetTimeOfKeyframe,track,name)
            if ok and finite(time) and time>0 then result=if result then math.min(result,time) else time end
        end
        return result
    end
    local function trackActor(model: any)
        if control.actors[model] then return end
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator=humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then return end
        local record={tracks={},connections={}}
        control.actors[model]=record
        local function playing(track: any)
            if not control.alive or not control.allMovesEnabled then return end
            local animation=track.Animation
            if not animation or unblockable(animation) then return end
            local id=tostring(animation.AnimationId):match("%d+") or ""
            local descriptor=control.block and control.block.animationIds and control.block.animationIds[id]
            if descriptor and descriptor.kind=="Ignore" then return end
            -- Contact keyframes are necessary. An unclassified animation also
            -- needs explicit native Blockable metadata; cast/windup alone is not evidence.
            if not (descriptor and descriptor.kind=="Move") and attribute(animation,"Blockable")~=true then return end
            local time=contact(track)
            if time then record.tracks[track]={contactTime=time,at=clock(),animation=animation} end
        end
        for _,track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do playing(track) end
        table.insert(record.connections,animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(playing))
    end
    function control.moveThreat(root: any): any
        local block=control.block
        if not block or block.range<=0 then return nil end
        for model in block.records or {} do if hostile(model) then trackActor(model) end end
        for model,record in control.actors do
            if not hostile(model) then
                for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
                control.actors[model]=nil;continue
            end
            for track,state in record.tracks do
                if track.IsPlaying~=true or clock()-state.at>(block.maxHold or 8) then record.tracks[track]=nil end
            end
            local other,info=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),model:FindFirstChild("Info")
            local skill=info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
            if not skill or unblockable(skill) or unblockable(info) or unblockable(model)
                or info:FindFirstChild("Stun") or info:FindFirstChild("TrueStun")
                or (tonumber(attribute(model,"Ragdoll")) or 0)>0 then continue end
            local reach=block.meleeReach or 6
            -- Only explicit blockable native range metadata can extend a move
            -- beyond ordinary M1 reach. No animation name implies extra reach.
            local range=attribute(skill,"AttackRange")
            if attribute(skill,"Blockable")==true and finite(range) and range>0 then reach=range end
            if (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>math.min(block.range,reach)
                or not facing(root,other.Position,0.05) or not facing(other,root.Position,0.15) then continue end
            for track,state in record.tracks do
                if track.IsPlaying~=true or clock()-state.at>(block.maxHold or 8) then record.tracks[track]=nil;continue end
                if unblockable(state.animation) then continue end
                if block.isEmoteTrack and block.isEmoteTrack(model,track) then continue end
                if block.allowsThreat and not block.allowsThreat({kind='Move',track=track,skill=skill}) then continue end
                local position,speed=track.TimePosition,track.Speed or 1
                if not finite(position) or not finite(speed) or speed<=0 then continue end
                local remaining=(state.contactTime-position)/speed
                if remaining>=-0.05 and remaining<=(block.reactionHorizon or 0.18)
