                    and clearPath(other.Position,root.Position,model,model) then return model,remaining,track,state end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.findSupplement(): (any, any, any)
        local root=rootOf()
        if not root then return nil end
        if control.projectileEnabled or control.allMovesEnabled then
            control.sample()
            local nearest,soonest
            for _,record in control.records do
                control.projectileChecks+=1
                local incoming,time=control.projectileThreat(record,root)
                if incoming and (not soonest or (time and time<soonest)) then nearest,soonest=record,time end
            end
            if nearest then
                control.lastReason="Predicted owned incoming projectile; native Block decides acceptance"
                local category=control.block.projectileCategory and control.block.projectileCategory(nearest.source,nearest.part,nearest) or 'Projectiles'
                return nearest.source,if category=='Projectiles' then 'Predicted incoming projectile' else 'Predicted incoming '..category,nearest,
                    {token=nearest,remaining=soonest,kind='Projectile'},
                    {token=nearest,kind='Projectile',category=category,single=true,projectile=nearest}
            end
        end
        if control.allMovesEnabled then
            control.moveChecks+=1
            local model,remaining,track,state=control.moveThreat(root)
            if model then
                control.lastReason="Native move contact evidence"
                local actor=control.actors[model];actor.model=model
                local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
                return model,control.moveReason,nil,{token=state,remaining=remaining,kind='Move'},
                    {token=state,kind='Move',track=track,record=actor,skill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')}
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    control.moveReason="Predicted native move contact"
    function control.attach(): boolean
        local block=initialBlock or menu.autoBlock
        if not block or block.alive==false or type(block.findThreat)~="function" or type(block.latchOngoing)~="function" then
            control.ready=false;control.lastReason="Waiting for native Auto Block";return false
        end
        if control.block==block then return true end
        if control.block then return false end
        control.block=block
        local originalFind,originalLatch=block.findThreat,block.latchOngoing
        control.originalFind,control.originalLatch=originalFind,originalLatch
        local wrapper=function(...)
            if not control.alive or not (control.projectileEnabled or control.allMovesEnabled) then return originalFind(...) end
            local result=table.pack(originalFind(...))
            if result[1] then return table.unpack(result,1,result.n) end
            return control.findSupplement()
        end
        local latchWrapper=function(...)
            local latch=block.latch
            if latch and latch.projectile and latch.projectile.predictionOwner==control then
                if not control.alive or not (control.projectileEnabled or control.allMovesEnabled)
                    or not hostile(latch.projectile.owner) or unblockable(latch.projectile.part)
                    or unblockable(latch.projectile.source) then block.latch=nil;return false end
                control.sample()
                local root=rootOf()
                if not root or not control.records[latch.projectile.part] or not control.projectileThreat(latch.projectile,root) then
                    block.latch=nil;return false
                end
            elseif latch and latch.source==control.moveReason and not (control.alive and control.allMovesEnabled) then
                block.latch=nil;return false
            end
            return originalLatch(...)
        end
        control.wrapper,control.latchWrapper=wrapper,latchWrapper
        block.findThreat,block.latchOngoing=wrapper,latchWrapper
        control.ready=true;control.lastReason="Prediction options are disabled"
        return true
    end
    local function update()
        if control.block and control.block.alive~=false and type(control.block.update)=="function" then control.block.update() end
    end
    local function setOption(key: string,value: any)
        local wasActive=control.projectileEnabled or control.allMovesEnabled
        control[key]=control.alive and value==true
        control.attach()
        if control.projectileEnabled or control.allMovesEnabled then
            if not wasActive then control.seeded=false end
            seed();control.sample()
        else clear() end
        update()
    end
    function control.setProjectileEnabled(value: any) setOption("projectileEnabled",value) end
    function control.setAllMovesEnabled(value: any) setOption("allMovesEnabled",value) end
    clear=function()
        table.clear(control.records);control.count=0;control.lastSample=-math.huge
        table.clear(sourceParts);table.clear(sourcePrimaryParts)
        for model,record in control.actors do
            for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
            control.actors[model]=nil
        end
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if not control.block and clock()-control.lastAttach>=0.25 then control.lastAttach=clock();control.attach() end
        if control.projectileEnabled or control.allMovesEnabled then control.sample() end
    end))
    if player.CharacterRemoving then table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(clear)) end
    if player.CharacterAdded then table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(clear)) end
    if world.ChildAdded then table.insert(control.connections,world.ChildAdded:Connect(function(object)
        if control.seeded and (object.Name=="Effects" or object.Name=="Projectiles") then
            control.seeded=false;seed()
        end
    end)) end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false;control.projectileEnabled=false;control.allMovesEnabled=false
        update()
        local block=control.block
        if block then
            if block.findThreat==control.wrapper then block.findThreat=control.originalFind end
            if block.latchOngoing==control.latchWrapper then block.latchOngoing=control.originalLatch end
        end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections);clear();control.ready=false
    end
    control.attach()
    return control
end

return ProjectilePrediction
end)()

local DashStatus = (function(): any
-- Passive dash information. Ordinary side/back cooldowns are estimates from
-- the native 2s client rule: other clients' private timer is not replicated.
-- Front Chase and Naoya/charge cooldowns are deliberately not invented.
local DashStatus: {[string]: any}={}

function DashStatus.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any): any
    local players=host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local replicated=host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local world=host.workspace
    local clock=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=false,ready=false,connections={},records={},animationIds={},nativeSignals={},
        observations=0,recordCount=0,motionDuration=0.4,ordinaryCooldown=2,lastReason="Dash Cooldown Info is disabled"}
    local function connect(list: any,signal: any,fn: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=="function" then table.insert(list,signal:Connect(fn)) end
    end
    local function disconnect(list: any)
        for _,connection in list do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(list)
    end
    local function live(model: any): boolean
        if not model or not model.Parent or not model:IsA("Model") or model:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return false end
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
    end
    local function allowed(model: any): boolean
        if model==player.Character then return true end
        local visual=menu.visuals
        if visual and type(visual.isInfoTarget)=="function" then
            local ok,value=pcall(visual.isInfoTarget,model);return ok and value==true
        end
        if menu.infoTargetOnly~=true then return true end
        if type(menu.isInfoTarget)~="function" then return false end
        local ok,value=pcall(menu.isInfoTarget,model);return ok and value==true
    end
    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function remainingAt(deadline: number,now: number): number
        local remaining=deadline-now
        -- Canonical positive zero also prevents a rendered "-0.00" at expiry.
        return if finite(remaining) and remaining>0 then remaining else 0
    end
    local function direction(value: any): string?
        return (value=="Front" or value=="Back" or value=="Left" or value=="Right") and value or nil
    end
    function control.untrack(model: any)
        local record=control.records[model]
        if not record then return end
        disconnect(record.connections)
        control.records[model]=nil;control.recordCount-=1
    end
    function control.noteDash(model: any,side: any,source: string,observedAt: number?)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not live(model) then return end
        control.track(model)
        local record=control.records[model]
        if not record then return end
        local now=clock()
        local at=if finite(observedAt) and observedAt<=now and now-observedAt<2.5 then observedAt else now
        local kind=direction(side)
        local duplicate=record.at and math.abs(at-record.at)<=0.25 and (record.direction==kind or not kind or not record.direction)
        if duplicate then
            record.at=math.min(at,record.at)
            record.direction=record.direction or kind
        else
            record.at,record.direction=at,kind
            control.observations+=1
        end
        record.activeUntil=record.at+control.motionDuration
        record.source=source
        record.moveset=model:GetAttribute("Moveset")
        local info=model:FindFirstChild("Info")
        record.special=(record.moveset=="Naoya") or (info and (info:FindFirstChild("DomainClash")~=nil or info:FindFirstChild("DisableChase")~=nil))
        control.lastReason="Observed native dash; remote cooldown deadline is not replicated"
    end
    function control.indexAnimation(animation: any)
        if not animation:IsA("Animation") then return end
        local side=direction(animation.Name:match("^Dash(.+)$"))
        if not side and animation.Name=="Chase" and animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name:find("Melee",1,true) then side="Front" end
        local id=animation.AnimationId and animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
        if side and id then control.animationIds[id]=side end
    end
    local function onAnimation(record: any,track: any)
        if not control.enabled then return end
        local animation=track.Animation
        local id=animation and animation.AnimationId and animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
        local side=id and control.animationIds[id]
        if not side then return end
        local position,speed=track.TimePosition,track.Speed or 1
        local at=if finite(position) and finite(speed) and speed>0 then clock()-math.max(0,position)/speed else clock()
        control.noteDash(record.model,side,"Native dash animation",at)
        record.tracks[track]={at=clock(),side=side}
    end
    function control.track(model: any)
        if control.records[model] or not live(model) then return end
        local record: any={model=model,connections={},attached={},tracks={}}
        control.records[model]=record;control.recordCount+=1
        local function attach(object: any)
            if record.attached[object] then return end
            if object:IsA("Animator") then
                record.attached[object]=true
                connect(record.connections,object.AnimationPlayed,function(track) onAnimation(record,track) end)
                for _,track in object:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do onAnimation(record,track) end
            elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
                record.attached[object]=true
                connect(record.connections,object.Died,function() control.untrack(model) end)
            end
        end
        connect(record.connections,model.DescendantAdded,attach)
        for _,object in model:GetDescendants() do attach(object) end
    end
    function control.getStatus(model: any): any
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not live(model) or not allowed(model) then return nil end
        local record=control.records[model]
        if not record then return nil end
        local now=clock()
        local info=model:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local active=model:GetAttribute("InDash")==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild("InDash")~=nil)
            or (record.activeUntil or -math.huge)>now
        for track,state in record.tracks do
            if track.IsPlaying~=true or now-state.at>2.5 then record.tracks[track]=nil
            elseif state.side=="Front" then active=true end
        end
        if not record.at and not active then return nil end
        local known,estimated,remaining=false,false,nil
        local source=record.source or "Native InDash marker"
        local localTimer=menu.dashControl
        if model==player.Character and record.at and localTimer and localTimer.enabled and finite(localTimer.nextAllowedAt) then
            remaining=remainingAt(localTimer.nextAllowedAt,now);known=true
            source="Configured local dash gate"
        elseif record.at and record.direction and record.direction~="Front" and not record.special then
            remaining=remainingAt(record.at+control.ordinaryCooldown,now);known=true;estimated=true
            source="Observed native 2s side/back rule; remote timer not replicated"
        end
        if not active and not known then return nil end
        return {label="Dash",text=if active then "Dash" else string.format("Dash %.2f",remaining or 0),
            active=active,remaining=remaining,direction=record.direction,source=source,estimated=estimated,known=known}
    end
    local animations=replicated:FindFirstChild("Animations")
    if animations then
        for _,animation in animations:GetDescendants() do control.indexAnimation(animation) end
        connect(control.connections,animations.DescendantAdded,control.indexAnimation)
        control.ready=next(control.animationIds)~=nil
    end
    local knitFolder=replicated:FindFirstChild("Knit")
    local knitModule=knitFolder and knitFolder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
    local services=knitModule and knitModule:FindFirstChild("Services")
    local knit
    if knitModule and host.require then local ok,value=pcall(host.require,knitModule);if ok then knit=value end end
    local function subscribe(folder: any)
        if not knit or control.nativeSignals[folder.Name] then return end
        local remotes=folder:FindFirstChild("RE")
        if not remotes or not remotes:FindFirstChild("Effects") then return end
        local movement=folder.Name=="MovementService"
        if not movement and not remotes:FindFirstChild("Chase") then return end
        -- GetService is called only for an existing advertised service folder.
        local ok,connection=pcall(function()
            local service=knit.GetService(folder.Name)
            return service.Effects:Connect(function(first,second,third,fourth)
                if movement then
                    if second=="Dash" then control.noteDash(third,fourth,"Native MovementService Dash") end
                elseif first=="Chase" then control.noteDash(second,"Front","Native moveset Chase effect") end
            end)
        end)
        if ok then table.insert(control.connections,connection);control.nativeSignals[folder.Name]=true;control.ready=true end
    end
    if services then
        for _,folder in services:GetChildren() do subscribe(folder) end
        connect(control.connections,services.ChildAdded,subscribe)
    end
    local characters=world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    local function clear()
        for model in control.records do control.untrack(model) end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: any)
        control.enabled=control.alive and value==true
        if control.enabled then
            if characters then for _,model in characters:GetChildren() do control.track(model) end end
            if player.Character then control.track(player.Character) end
            control.lastReason="Waiting for observed native dashes"
        else clear();control.lastReason="Dash Cooldown Info is disabled" end
    end
    if characters then
        connect(control.connections,characters.ChildAdded,function(model) if control.enabled then control.track(model) end end)
        connect(control.connections,characters.ChildRemoved,control.untrack)
    end
    connect(control.connections,player.CharacterRemoving,function(model) control.untrack(model) end)
    connect(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded,function(model) if control.enabled then control.track(model) end end)
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false;control.enabled=false;clear();disconnect(control.connections);control.ready=false
    end
    return control
end
return DashStatus
end)()

local NativeRed = (function(): any
-- Retain one native Red phase, click Special once, then face only its confirmed teleport.
local NativeRed: {[string]: any} = {}

function NativeRed.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, bindings: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=false,faceTargetEnabled=true,ready=false,focused=true,connections={},hooks={},requests=0,releases=0,accepted=0,confirmed=0,faceTurns=0,lastReason='Auto Reversal Red is disabled'}
    local function callNative(callback: any,...: any): ...any
        if menu.nativeCounter and type(menu.nativeCounter.callNative)=='function' then return menu.nativeCounter.callNative(callback,...) end
        return pcall(callback,...)
    end
    local function connect(signal: any,callback: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function keyHeld(role: string): boolean
        local binding=bindings and bindings.get and bindings.get(role)
        if not binding then return false end
        local enum=if binding.kind=='Mouse' then host.Enum.UserInputType else host.Enum.KeyCode
        local key=enum[binding.name]
        if not key then return false end
        return if binding.kind=='Mouse' then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(key) else input:IsKeyDown(key)
    end
    local function specialHeld(): boolean return keyHeld('Special') end
    local function dashActive(character): boolean
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and lock.dashFacingActive and lock.dashFacingActive() then return true end
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return character and (character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash')~=nil)) or false
    end
    local function retainedDashTarget()
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        local record=control.faceActive or control.facePending
        if not lock or type(lock.dashAssistTarget)~='function'or not record or record.phase~=control.held
            or record.character~=player.Character or record.phase.confirmed~=true then return nil end
        local target=lock.dashAssistTarget('Red')
        return if target==record.target then target else nil
    end
    local function currentRed(tool: any): boolean
        local character=player.Character
        local native=control.nativeTool
        local moveset=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not moveset or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Gojo' or not tool or tool.Parent~=moveset
            or (tool:GetAttribute('Service')~='ReversalRedService' and tool:GetAttribute('Service')~='ReversalRedMaxService') or tool:GetAttribute('Key')~=2 then return false end
        local ok,current=pcall(native.ReturnKey,native,2)
        return ok and current==tool
    end
    local function available(tool: any): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or specialHeld() or keyHeld('Block') or not currentRed(tool)
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        if dashActive(character)and not retainedDashTarget()then return false end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info then return false end
        for _,name in {'Dead','TrueStun','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Ragdoll'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0) or info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
        end
        for _,name in {'Block','Knockback','DomainClash','Throwable','Item'} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end end
        return true
    end
    local function releaseSpecial()
        local held=control.specialDown
        control.specialDown=nil
        if not held or held.character~=player.Character or specialHeld() or not currentRed(held.tool) then return false end
        local ok=callNative(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial,control.nativeTool)
        if ok then control.releases+=1 end
        return ok
    end
    local function releaseFacingRotation()
        local lease=control.rotationLease;control.rotationLease=nil
        if not lease then return end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        local root=lease.character==player.Character and lease.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if root and lock and lock.beginAssistReturn and lock.beginAssistReturn(root,root.CFrame,'Red',lease) then return end
        if menu.restoreRotationLease then menu.restoreRotationLease(lease)
        elseif lease.character==player.Character and lease.humanoid.Parent==lease.character and lease.humanoid.AutoRotate==false then lease.humanoid.AutoRotate=lease.previous end
    end
    local function releaseFacing()
        control.facePending=nil;control.faceActive=nil
        releaseFacingRotation()
    end
    local function lockOwnsFacing()
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput() then return true end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if aim and aim.dashFacingRole and lock and lock.dashAssistFacingReady and lock.dashAssistFacingReady(aim.dashFacingRole)then return true end
        return lock and lock.effectiveLockActive and lock.effectiveLockActive()==true or false
    end
    local function releaseRed(record)
        local deferred=record and record.releaseCall
        if not deferred or record.character~=player.Character or not currentRed(record.tool) then return end
        record.releaseCall=nil
        callNative(deferred.callback,table.unpack(deferred.args,1,deferred.args.n))
    end
    local function cancel(reason: string?)
        local pending,held=control.pending,control.held
        control.pending=nil;control.held=nil
        releaseSpecial();releaseFacing();releaseRed(held or pending)
        if reason then control.lastReason=reason end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: boolean)
        control.enabled=control.alive and control.ready and value==true
        if not control.enabled then cancel() end
        control.lastReason=if control.enabled then 'Waiting for your native Reversal Red activation' elseif not control.ready then 'Native Red unavailable: '..tostring(control.initError or 'native dependency missing') else 'Auto Reversal Red is disabled'
    end
    function control.setFaceTargetEnabled(value)
        control.faceTargetEnabled=value==true
        if not control.faceTargetEnabled then releaseFacing() end
    end
    function control.onRed(tool: any): boolean
        if control.dispatching or control.held or not available(tool) then return false end
        local pending=control.pending
        if pending and pending.tool==tool and pending.character==player.Character and clock()-pending.at<=0.65 then return true end
        control.pending={character=player.Character,tool=tool,at=clock()}
        control.lastReason='Waiting for native Red acceptance'
        return true
    end
    local function validTarget(target): boolean
        if not target or target==player.Character or (((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(target))) then return false end
        local ok,valid=pcall(function()
            local humanoid=target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            return target:IsA('Model') and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
        end)
        return ok and valid==true
    end
    function control.invalidateExcludedTargets()
        local record=control.held or control.faceActive or control.facePending
        if not record or not ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(record.target)) then return false end
        cancel('Target is protected by friend exclusions')
        return true
    end
    local function nativeTarget()
        local ok,target=pcall(control.nativeTool.GetTarget,control.nativeTool)
        return if ok and validTarget(target) then target else nil
    end
    function control.onTeleportSuccess(character): boolean
        local held=control.held
        if not held or held.confirmed or character~=player.Character or held.character~=character or clock()>held.deadline
            or not available(held.tool) then return false end
        held.confirmed=true
        control.confirmed+=1
        if control.faceTargetEnabled and validTarget(held.target) then
            -- The native teleport effect begins before its 0.1s arrival flash.
            -- Read both positions after that arrival, not at the departure point.
            control.facePending={character=character,tool=held.tool,target=held.target,phase=held,at=clock()+.12}
        end
        control.pending=nil
        control.lastReason='Native Reversal Red teleport confirmed'
        return true
    end
    function control.facingActive(): boolean
        if lockOwnsFacing() then return false end
        local record=control.faceActive or control.facePending
        return record~=nil and clock()>=record.at and record.phase==control.held and control.faceTargetEnabled
            and record.character==player.Character and available(record.tool) and validTarget(record.target)
    end
    function control.render(delta)
        local record=control.faceActive or control.facePending
        if not record then return end
        if clock()<record.at then return end
        if not control.faceTargetEnabled or record.character~=player.Character or not available(record.tool)
            or not validTarget(record.target) or record.phase~=control.held then releaseFacing();return end
        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if record.phase.seenInSkill and not (info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')) then releaseFacing();return end
        if dashActive(record.character)then
            local lock=menu.autoLock
            if not retainedDashTarget()or not lock or not lock.dashAssistFacingReady or not lock.dashAssistFacingReady('Red')then
                releaseFacingRotation()
                control.lastReason='Retaining confirmed Reversal Red target; waiting for native camera-relative dash movement'
                return
            end
        end
        if lockOwnsFacing() then
            -- Pause only facing; keep the accepted Red phase and its target.
            releaseFacingRotation()
            return
        end
        local root=record.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local targetRoot=record.target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root or not targetRoot or not host.CFrame or not host.Vector3 then releaseFacing();return end
        local position=root.Position
        local direction=host.Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X-position.X,0,targetRoot.Position.Z-position.Z)
        if direction.Magnitude<.01 then releaseFacing();return end
        local humanoid=record.character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if assist and assist.releaseShiftLockAim then assist.releaseShiftLockAim(false) end
        if not control.rotationLease and humanoid.AutoRotate==true then
            control.rotationLease={character=record.character,humanoid=humanoid,previous=true,owner=control}
        end
        if control.rotationLease then humanoid.AutoRotate=false end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        local desired=host.CFrame.lookAt(position,position+direction)
        root.CFrame=if lock and lock.humanizedFacingFrame then lock.humanizedFacingFrame(root,desired,'Red',delta,record.target,record.phase) else desired
        if lock and lock.noteAssistFacing then lock.noteAssistFacing(root,record.target,'Red Aim',root.CFrame) end
        if not control.faceActive then control.faceTurns+=1 end
        control.facePending=nil;control.faceActive=record
        control.lastReason='Faced the confirmed Reversal Red target'
    end
    function control.onRedEffect(event: any,character: any,serviceName: string?): boolean
        local source=serviceName or 'ReversalRedService'
        local acceptedEvent=if source=='ReversalRedMaxService' then event=='Swing' or event=='Aerial' else event=='Red'
        if not acceptedEvent or character~=player.Character then return false end
        local pending=control.pending
        if not pending or pending.character~=character or pending.tool:GetAttribute('Service')~=source or clock()-pending.at>0.65 then return false end
        control.pending=nil
        local target=nativeTarget()
        if not available(pending.tool) or not target then
            releaseRed(pending)
            control.lastReason='Native Red accepted; no eligible native target or manual input has priority'
            return false
        end
        -- Successful observed variants had ordinary M2 cooldown remaining.
        -- The accepted Red phase, not the idle teleport timer, gates this action.
        control.dispatching=true
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        -- Current native Red services have only Activated/Effects, so their
        -- accepted skill runs until InSkill ends. Do not synthesize more presses.
        control.held={character=character,tool=pending.tool,target=target,deadline=clock()+8,seenInSkill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil,releaseCall=pending.releaseCall}
        control.specialDown={character=character,tool=pending.tool}
        local ok,message=callNative(control.nativeTool.Special,control.nativeTool)
        local released=releaseSpecial()
        control.dispatching=false
        if not ok or not released then cancel('Native Special click unavailable: '..tostring(message));return false end
        control.requests+=1;control.accepted+=1
        control.lastReason='Red skill retained; native Special clicked once'
        return true
    end
    function control.step()
        local pending=control.pending
        if pending and (clock()-pending.at>0.65 or pending.character~=player.Character or not available(pending.tool)) then
            cancel('Red was not accepted in this activation')
        end
        local held=control.held
        if not held then return end
        if specialHeld() then cancel('Manual Special has priority');return end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local inSkill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil
        if inSkill then held.seenInSkill=true elseif held.seenInSkill then cancel('Native Red skill phase finished');return end
        if clock()>=held.deadline or not available(held.tool) then cancel('Native Red hold finished') end
        if not control.renderName then control.render() end
    end
    local function addHook(owner: any,key: string,factory: any): any
        if not owner or type(owner[key])~='function' then return nil end
        local hook: any={signal=owner,owner=owner,key=key,original=owner[key],active=true}
        hook.wrapper=factory(hook)
        owner[key]=hook.wrapper;table.insert(control.hooks,hook)
        return hook
    end
    local initOk,initMessage=pcall(function()
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knit=module and host.require(module)
        if not knit then error('Knit module unavailable') end
        local native=knit.GetController('ToolController')
        local service=knit.GetService('ReversalRedService')
        local gojo=knit.GetService('GojoService')
        local signal=service and service.Activated
        if not native or type(native.ReturnKey)~='function' or type(native.GetTarget)~='function' or type(native.Special)~='function' or type(native.ReleaseSpecial)~='function'
            or not signal or type(signal.Fire)~='function' or not service.Effects or type(service.Effects.Connect)~='function' then
            error('Native Red requires ToolController ReturnKey/GetTarget/Special/ReleaseSpecial and Red Activated/Effects')
        end
        control.nativeTool=native
        control.hook=addHook(signal,'Fire',function(hook: any)
            return function(self: any,...: any): ...any
                local tool=select(1,...)
                if hook.active and control.alive then control.onRed(tool) end
                local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,...))
                if not result[1] then
                    if (control.pending and control.pending.tool==tool) or (control.held and control.held.tool==tool) then cancel('Native Red request failed') end
                    error(result[2],0)
                end
                -- Returning from Fire only confirms the request was sent.
                -- The real Effects callback confirms Red entered its skill
                -- phase; sending Special before that can be rejected as an
                -- ordinary teleport (and consumes the pending activation).
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
        end)
        control.releaseHook=addHook(service.Deactivated,'Fire',function(hook: any)
            return function(self: any,...: any): ...any
                local tool=select(1,...)
                local phase=control.held or control.pending
                if hook.active and phase and phase.tool==tool and available(tool) then
                    phase.releaseCall=phase.releaseCall or {callback=hook.original,args=table.pack(self,...)}
                    return
                end
                local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,...))
                if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
        end)
        -- No UseTool release observer: native Red/Max have no Deactivated
        -- signal, so releasing the physical key must not cancel the skill phase.
        -- A later native/manual Special takes ownership of its own click.
        control.specialHook=addHook(native,'Special',function(hook: any)
            return function(self: any,...: any): ...any
                if hook.active and control.alive and not control.dispatching then
                    control.specialDown=nil
                    cancel('Manual or other native Special has priority')
                end
                return hook.original(self,...)
            end
        end)
        connect(service.Effects,function(event,character) control.onRedEffect(event,character,'ReversalRedService') end)
        local services=module:FindFirstChild('Services')
        if services and services:FindFirstChild('ReversalRedMaxService') then
            local max=knit.GetService('ReversalRedMaxService')
            addHook(max.Activated,'Fire',function(hook: any)
                return function(self: any,...: any): ...any
                    local tool=select(1,...)
                    if hook.active and control.alive then control.onRed(tool) end
                    local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,...))
                    if not result[1] then cancel('Native Max Red request failed');error(result[2],0) end
                    return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
                end
            end)
            addHook(max.Deactivated,'Fire',function(hook: any)
                return function(self: any,...: any): ...any
                    local phase=control.held or control.pending
                    if hook.active and phase and phase.tool==select(1,...) and available(phase.tool) then
                        phase.releaseCall=phase.releaseCall or {callback=hook.original,args=table.pack(self,...)}
                        return
                    end
                    return hook.original(self,...)
                end
            end)
            connect(max.Effects,function(event,character) control.onRedEffect(event,character,'ReversalRedMaxService') end)
        end
        connect(gojo and gojo.Effects,function(event: any,character: any)
            if event=='Teleport' then control.onTeleportSuccess(character) end
        end)
        control.ready=control.hook~=nil
    end)
    if not initOk then control.initError=tostring(initMessage);control.lastReason='Native Red unavailable: '..control.initError end
    if type(run.BindToRenderStep)=='function' and host.Enum.RenderPriority then
        control.renderName='Shenaniganism.RedFace.'..tostring(control)
        run:BindToRenderStep(control.renderName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+3,control.render)
    end
    connect(run.Heartbeat,control.step)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() control.focused=false;cancel('Game window lost focus') end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function() control.focused=true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function() cancel('Character removed') end)
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.enabled=false;cancel();control.alive=false
        if control.renderName then run:UnbindFromRenderStep(control.renderName);control.renderName=nil end
        for _,hook in control.hooks do hook.active=false;if hook.owner[hook.key]==hook.wrapper then hook.owner[hook.key]=hook.original end end
        table.clear(control.hooks)
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end
    return control
end

return NativeRed
end)()

local NativeCounter = (function(): any
-- Counter selection uses the equipped native tools, never hotbar text or keys.
local NativeCounter: {[string]: any} = {}
local services = {
    EyeCatchService='Tool', ManjiKickService='Tool', SupernovaService='Tool',
    AdaptationService='Tool', AnkleCutterService='M1',
}
local function finite(value: any): boolean
    return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
end
function NativeCounter.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any,bindings: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local clock=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=false,focused=true,ready=false,range=21,
        connections={},m1Connections={},kitConnections={},nativeServiceConnections={},requests=0,releases=0,failures=0,latches={},cooldowns=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'}),lastReason='Auto Counter is disabled'}
    local function resetTargetSwitch()
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and type(aim.resetAimTargetSwitch)=='function' then aim.resetAimTargetSwitch('Counter') end
    end
    control.projectileDelay,control.projectileWaits=0.05,{}
    control.impactLead,control.m1Reach,control.heartbeatStep=.075,8,1/60
    function control.setImpactLeadMs(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.impactLead=math.clamp(amount,0,150)/1000;return true
    end
    function control.setM1Reach(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(amount) then return false end
        control.m1Reach=math.clamp(amount,0,8);return true
    end
    control.adaptEnabled=false;control.yutaWindow=0.15
    function control.setAdaptEnabled(value)control.adaptEnabled=value==true end
    function control.setYutaWindow(value)if finite(value) then control.yutaWindow=math.clamp(value,0.01,0.15) end end
    local function connect(signal: any,callback: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function bindingHeld(binding: any): boolean
        if not binding then return false end
        local enum=if binding.kind=='Mouse' then host.Enum.UserInputType else host.Enum.KeyCode
        local key=enum[binding.name]
        if not key then return false end
        return if binding.kind=='Mouse' then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(key) else input:IsKeyDown(key)
    end
    local function savedBinding(slot: number,action: string?): any
        local role=if action=='Special' then 'Special' elseif action=='M1' then 'Melee' else 'Move'..tostring(slot)
        return bindings and bindings.get and bindings.get(role)
    end
    local function manualBlock(): boolean
        if bindings and type(bindings.manualBlockHeld)=='function' then
            local ok,value=pcall(bindings.manualBlockHeld)
            return not ok or value==true
        end
        return bindingHeld(bindings and bindings.get and bindings.get('Block'))
    end
    local rayParams: any=nil
    local nativeEnum: any=host.Enum
    if host.RaycastParams and nativeEnum and nativeEnum.RaycastFilterType then
        rayParams=host.RaycastParams.new()
        rayParams.FilterType=nativeEnum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rayParams.IgnoreWater=true
    end
    local function clearM1Path(target: any): boolean
        if not rayParams or type(host.workspace.Raycast)~='function' then return true end
        local own=player.Character
        local from=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local toward=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not from or not toward then return false end
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances={own,target}
        local ok,hit=pcall(host.workspace.Raycast,host.workspace,from.Position,toward.Position-from.Position,rayParams)
        return ok and hit==nil
    end
    function control.isCounterTool(tool: any): boolean
        return tool~=nil and (services[tool:GetAttribute('Service')]~=nil or player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Yuta' and player.Character:GetAttribute('InUlt')~=true and tool.Parent==player.Character:FindFirstChild('Moveset') and tool:GetAttribute('Key')==3)
    end
    function control.currentTool(): any
        local own=player.Character
        local moveset=own and own.Parent and own:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        local native=control.nativeTool
        if not moveset or not native then return nil end
        local kit=own:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        -- Hakari's counter is native Special, independent of skill-3 cooldown.
        if kit=='Hakari' and own:GetAttribute('InUlt')~=true then
            for slot=1,4 do
                local ok,anchor=pcall(native.ReturnKey,native,slot)
                if ok and anchor and anchor.Parent==moveset and anchor:GetAttribute('Key')==slot then return anchor,slot,'Special' end
            end
        elseif kit=='Yuta' and own:GetAttribute('InUlt')~=true then
            local ok,third=pcall(native.ReturnKey,native,3)
            if ok and third and third.Parent==moveset and third:GetAttribute('Key')==3 then return third,3,'Tool' end
        end
        for slot=1,4 do
            local ok,tool=pcall(native.ReturnKey,native,slot)
            if ok and tool and tool.Parent==moveset and tool:IsA('NumberValue')
                and tool:GetAttribute('Key')==slot and services[tool:GetAttribute('Service')] then
                return tool,slot,services[tool:GetAttribute('Service')]
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.bloodOrbCount(character: any?): number?
        local own=character or player.Character
        if not own or own:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Choso' then return nil end
        local assets=own:FindFirstChild('SetAssets')
        local convergence=assets and assets:FindFirstChild('Convergence')
        if not convergence then return 0 end
        -- Native Convergence.Spin/WingKing uses Charge for Blood1..Blood4.
        -- Consumed attachments can remain visible during their exit animation;
        -- the replicated charge, rather than particle count, is authoritative.
        local charge=convergence:GetAttribute('Charge')
        if not finite(charge) or charge<0 then return nil end
        return math.clamp(math.floor(charge),0,4)
    end
    function control.permitted(): (boolean,string?)
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput() then return false,'M1/Block input priority' end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then return false,'Emote menu is open' end
        if not control.alive then return false,'Auto Counter is unloaded' end
        if not control.enabled and not (control.adaptEnabled and player.Character and player.Character:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Mahoraga') then return false,'Auto Counter is disabled' end
        if not control.ready then return false,'Native counter actions are unavailable' end
        if not control.focused then return false,'The game window is not focused' end
        if menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false,'Typing or keybind recording takes priority' end
        if manualBlock() then return false,'Manual Block input takes priority' end
        local own=player.Character
        local humanoid=own and own.Parent and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info then return false,'Your character cannot counter now' end
        for _,name in {'Dead','TrueStun','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Ragdoll','Stun'} do
            local value=own:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (finite(value) and value>0) then return false,'Native '..name..' prevents a counter' end
        end
        for _,name in {'Stun','TrueStun','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Knockback','InSkill','Counter','NoMove','DomainClash','Throwable','Item'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false,'Native '..name..' prevents a counter' end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function actionService(tool: any,action: string,character: any): any
        local native=control.nativeTool
        if not native or type(native.GetToolService)~='function' then return nil end
        local name=if action=='Tool' then tool:GetAttribute('Service') else character:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        if action~='Tool' then name=if type(name)=='string' then name..'Service' else nil end
        if type(name)~='string' then return nil end
        local ok,service=pcall(native.GetToolService,native,name)
        return if ok then service else nil
    end
    local function hasAction(tool: any,action: string,character: any,event: string): boolean
        -- Minimal offline hosts may omit the native resolver. The actual game
        -- provides it; validate its signal before claiming a native request.
        if type(control.nativeTool.GetToolService)~='function' then return true end
        local service=actionService(tool,action,character)
        return service~=nil and service[event]~=nil and type(service[event].Fire)=='function'
    end
    function control.callNative(callback: any,...: any): ...any
        local environment=menu.environment or {}
        local read=host.getthreadidentity or host.getidentity or environment.getthreadidentity or environment.getidentity
        local write=host.setthreadidentity or host.setidentity or environment.setthreadidentity or environment.setidentity
        if type(read)~='function' or type(write)~='function' then return pcall(callback,...) end
        local readOk,identity=pcall(read)
        if not readOk or not finite(identity) then return false,'Native thread identity is unavailable' end
        local entered,message=pcall(write,2)
        if not entered then pcall(write,identity);return false,message end
        local result=table.pack(pcall(callback,...))
        local restored,restoreError=pcall(write,identity)
        if not restored then return false,'Native thread identity restoration failed: '..tostring(restoreError) end
        return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
    end
    local function release()
        local held=control.held
        if not held or held.character~=player.Character or not held.tool.Parent
            then control.held=nil;return end
        if held.tool:GetAttribute('Service')~=held.service or held.character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~=held.kit then
            control.held=nil;return
        end
        if bindingHeld(held.binding) or bindingHeld(savedBinding(held.slot,held.action)) then return end
        local ok,current=pcall(control.nativeTool.ReturnKey,control.nativeTool,held.slot)
        if not ok or current~=held.tool then control.held=nil;return end
        local event=if held.action=='Special' then 'RightDeactivated' else 'Deactivated'
        if not hasAction(held.tool,held.action,held.character,event) then control.held=nil;return end
        local released=if held.action=='Special' then control.callNative(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial,control.nativeTool)
            else control.callNative(control.nativeTool.UseTool,control.nativeTool,held.tool,'Deactivated')
        if released then control.held=nil;control.releases+=1 end
    end
    function control.toolReady(tool: any): boolean
        if tool:GetAttribute('Paused') then return false end
        local ready,skip=tool:GetAttribute('ReadyAt'),tool:GetAttribute('SkipTo')
        local lastUse=tool:GetAttribute('LastUse')
        if ready~=nil and not finite(ready) then return false end
        if skip~=nil and not finite(skip) then return false end
        local record=control.cooldowns[tool]
        if not record then
            record={ready=ready,skip=skip,lastUse=lastUse,effectiveSkip=skip};control.cooldowns[tool]=record
        else
            -- Native cooldown UI clears its prior SkipTo when ReadyAt changes.
            if record.lastUse~=lastUse then record.effectiveSkip=skip
            else
                if record.ready~=ready then record.effectiveSkip=nil end
                if record.skip~=skip then record.effectiveSkip=skip end
            end
            record.ready,record.skip,record.lastUse=ready,skip,lastUse
        end
        local ending=record.effectiveSkip or ready
        return ending==nil or ending<=host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: boolean)
        control.enabled=control.alive and value==true
        if not control.enabled then resetTargetSwitch();release();table.clear(control.latches);table.clear(control.projectileWaits) end
        control.lastReason=if control.enabled then 'Waiting for an eligible incoming attack' else 'Auto Counter is disabled'
    end
    -- Match the legacy Counter Range storage, which is measured in studs.
    function control.setRange(value: number)
        if finite(value) then control.range=math.clamp(value,0,45/0.28) end
    end
    function control.setProjectileDelay(value: any): boolean
        local seconds=tonumber(value)
        if not finite(seconds) then return false end
        control.projectileDelay=math.clamp(seconds,0,1)
        table.clear(control.projectileWaits)
        return true
    end
    local function token(target: any,filter: any): any
        local evidence=filter.lastCounterEvidence
        if evidence and evidence.target==target and clock()-evidence.at>=0 and clock()-evidence.at<=0.025 then
            local descriptor=type(evidence.token)=='table' and evidence.token.descriptor
            if not descriptor or (descriptor.counterKind or descriptor.kind)~='M1' then return evidence.token end
            local stamp=target:GetAttribute('LastM1')
            if finite(stamp) and host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp>=-0.05
                and host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp<=0.22 then return stamp end
            return evidence.token
        end
        local swing=filter.recentNativeSwings and filter.recentNativeSwings[target]
        if swing and clock()-swing.at>=0 and clock()-swing.at<=0.22 then return swing end
        local stamp=target:GetAttribute('LastM1')
        if finite(stamp) then
            local age=host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp
            if age>=-0.05 and age<=0.22 then return stamp end
        end
        local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info then
            for _,name in {'InSkill','Melee','Attacking'} do
                local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name)
                if marker then return marker end
            end
        end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local record=block and block.records and block.records[target]
        if record then for track,state in record.tracks or {} do
            if track.IsPlaying~=false and clock()-(state.at or -math.huge)<=1.5 then return state end
        end end
        return target
    end
    local function replicatedM1(target: any,filter: any,distance: number): boolean
        if distance>control.range or type(filter.allows)~='function' then return false end
        local stamp=target:GetAttribute('LastM1')
        local age=if finite(stamp) then host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-stamp else math.huge
        if age< -0.05 or age>0.22 then return false end
        local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info or info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun') or (tonumber(target:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')) or 0)>0 then return false end
        local stun=info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
        if stun and not (stun:IsA('BoolValue') and stun.Value==false and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')) then return false end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local record=block and block.records and block.records[target]
        for track,state in (record and record.tracks) or {} do
            local descriptor=state.descriptor or {}
            if track.IsPlaying and (descriptor.counterKind or descriptor.kind)=='M1' and finite(state.contactTime) then
                local phase,speed=tonumber(track.TimePosition),tonumber(track.Speed) or 1
                if not finite(phase) or not finite(speed) or speed<=0 then return false end
                local remaining=(state.contactTime-phase)/speed
                if remaining< -0.12 or remaining>0.18 then return false end
            end
        end
        -- All base movesets replicate accepted LastM1. An absent/late animation
        -- or a different moveset's Swing2 service must not make a present shared
        -- Block observer suppress this counter-only evidence beyond six studs.
        local ok,allowed=pcall(filter.allows,target)
        return ok and allowed==true and clearM1Path(target)
    end
    function control.update(): boolean
        if control.dispatching then return false end
        local allowed,reason=control.permitted()
        if not allowed then table.clear(control.projectileWaits);control.lastReason=reason;return false end
        local tool,slot,action=control.currentTool()
        if not control.enabled and tool and tool:GetAttribute('Service')~='AdaptationService' then return false end
        if not tool then table.clear(control.projectileWaits);control.lastReason='No equipped native counter tool';return false end
        if player.Character:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Choso' and tool:GetAttribute('Service')=='SupernovaService' then
            if bindingHeld(savedBinding(slot,'Special')) then
                table.clear(control.projectileWaits);control.lastReason='Manual Convergence input takes priority';return false
            end
            local orbs=control.bloodOrbCount()
            if orbs==nil or orbs>0 then
                table.clear(control.projectileWaits)
                control.lastReason=if orbs==nil then 'Waiting for native blood-orb state' else 'Blood orbs are available; Supernova counter skipped'
                return false
            end
        end
        if not hasAction(tool,action,player.Character,if action=='Special' then 'RightActivated' else 'Activated') then
            table.clear(control.projectileWaits);control.lastReason='The equipped native counter activation is unavailable';return false
        end
        if action=='Tool' and not control.toolReady(tool) then table.clear(control.projectileWaits);control.lastReason='Native counter cooldown is not ready';return false end
        if bindingHeld(savedBinding(slot,action)) then table.clear(control.projectileWaits);control.lastReason='Manual counter input takes priority';return false end
        local filter=menu.autoCounterFilter
        local own=player.Character
        local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not filter or not root or control.range<=0 then
            table.clear(control.projectileWaits)
            control.lastReason=if control.range<=0 then 'Counter Range is zero' else 'Incoming attack tracking is unavailable'
            return false
        end
        local candidates={}
        for target in filter.records or {} do candidates[target]=true end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        for target in (block and block.records) or {} do candidates[target]=true end
        for _,projectile in (block and block.projectileParts) or {} do
            if projectile.owner and projectile.owner~=own then candidates[projectile.owner]=true end
        end
        local predictor=menu.projectilePrediction
        for _,projectile in (predictor and predictor.records) or {} do
            if projectile.owner and projectile.owner~=own then candidates[projectile.owner]=true end
        end
        local incoming=filter.incomingAttacker and filter.incomingAttacker()
        local locked=filter.lockedTarget and filter.lockedTarget()
        if incoming then candidates[incoming]=true end
        if locked then candidates[locked]=true end
        if filter.lastHitTarget then candidates[filter.lastHitTarget]=true end
        local selected,selectedToken,nearest=nil,nil,math.huge
        local qualified,qualifiedTokens,normalScores={},{},{}
        local rejectedReason=nil
        local active={}
        local waiting={}
        for target in candidates do
            local other=target.Parent and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local distance=if other then (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude else math.huge
            if not finite(distance) then continue end
            local ok,triggered,triggerReason=pcall(filter.allowsTrigger,target,control.range)
            local observed=filter.lastCounterEvidence
            local waitingContact=observed and observed.target==target and (finite(observed.remaining) or observed.phaseKnown==true) and clock()-(observed.at or -math.huge)<=.025
            if ok and not triggered and not waitingContact and not (filter.isProjectileCast and filter.isProjectileCast(target,target:FindFirstChild('Info')))
              and replicatedM1(target,filter,distance) then
                triggered,triggerReason=true,'Fresh replicated incoming M1 inside Counter Range'
            end
            if not ok or not triggered then rejectedReason=if ok then triggerReason else 'Incoming attack detector failed: '..tostring(triggered);continue end
            local evidence=filter.lastCounterEvidence
            if evidence and evidence.target==target and finite(evidence.distance) then distance=evidence.distance end
            if own:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Yuta' and evidence and evidence.target==target and finite(evidence.remaining) and evidence.remaining>control.yutaWindow then rejectedReason='Waiting for the Yuta perfect counter window';continue end
            local phase=token(target,filter)
            local descriptor=type(phase)=='table' and phase.descriptor
            local m1=(evidence and evidence.target==target and evidence.kind=='M1') or type(phase)=='number' or (type(phase)=='table' and phase.character==target and finite(phase.at))
                or (descriptor and (descriptor.counterKind or descriptor.kind)=='M1')
            local projectile=evidence and evidence.target==target and evidence.kind=='Projectile'
            if m1 and not projectile and distance>math.min(control.range,control.m1Reach) then rejectedReason='Incoming M1 is outside the selected reach (maximum 8 studs)';continue end
            if m1 and filter.meleeAimedAtUs and not filter.meleeAimedAtUs(target) then rejectedReason='Incoming M1 is not on your character path';continue end
            if m1 and not clearM1Path(target) then rejectedReason='Incoming M1 is obstructed';continue end
            active[target]=true
            local prior=control.latches[target]
            local samePhase=prior and prior.token==phase
            if prior and not samePhase and type(prior.token)=='table' and type(phase)=='table'
                and prior.token.character==target and phase.character==target
                and finite(prior.token.at) and finite(phase.at) and prior.token.stage==phase.stage then
                -- Prediction may observe the same native event after this
                -- listener. Replaced receipt tables must not rearm one swing.
                samePhase=math.abs(prior.token.at-phase.at)<0.025
            end
            if prior and prior.character==own and prior.tool==tool and samePhase then continue end
            local remaining=evidence and evidence.target==target and evidence.remaining
            local lead=math.max(control.impactLead,math.min(.05,control.heartbeatStep))
            if finite(remaining) and (remaining>lead or remaining<-.03) then
                rejectedReason=if remaining>lead then 'Waiting for the selected counter impact lead' else 'The observed contact has already passed'
                -- Keep projectile receipt times while waiting for the impact gate.
                if projectile and not control.projectileWaits[phase] then
                    control.projectileWaits[phase]={character=own,tool=tool,target=target,at=clock(),service=tool:GetAttribute('Service'),kit=own:GetAttribute('Moveset')}
                end
                if projectile then waiting[phase]=true end
                continue
            end
            if projectile then
                local pending=control.projectileWaits[phase]
                if not pending or pending.character~=own or pending.tool~=tool or pending.target~=target
                    or pending.service~=tool:GetAttribute('Service') or pending.kit~=own:GetAttribute('Moveset') then
                    pending={character=own,tool=tool,target=target,at=clock(),service=tool:GetAttribute('Service'),kit=own:GetAttribute('Moveset')}
                    control.projectileWaits[phase]=pending
                end
                waiting[phase]=true
                if clock()-pending.at<control.projectileDelay and (not finite(remaining) or remaining>math.min(lead,math.max(control.heartbeatStep,.015))) then
                    rejectedReason='Waiting for the projectile counter beginning delay'
                    continue
                end
                -- Starting a projectile's timer must not consume the counter's
                -- active window while it is still travelling toward us.
                if not finite(evidence.remaining) then
                    rejectedReason='Waiting for a measurable projectile impact time'
                    continue
                end
            end
            -- Every candidate has passed attack evidence and impact gates.
            -- An old lock/last hit must not outweigh an earlier real contact.
            local priority=(if finite(remaining) then math.max(0,remaining) else 0)*10000+distance*.01
            table.insert(qualified,target);qualifiedTokens[target]=phase;normalScores[target]=priority
            if priority<nearest or priority==nearest and (not selected or target.Name<selected.Name) then nearest,selected,selectedToken=priority,target,phase end
        end
        -- Rank only proven incoming contacts. Cursor selection must not turn
        -- an idle actor near the pointer into a counter target or override the
        -- native evidence, impact, range, obstruction, or consumed-phase gates.
        if type(filter.selectThreat)=='function' then
            selected=filter.selectThreat(qualified,function(target) return normalScores[target] or math.huge end)
            selectedToken=selected and qualifiedTokens[selected]
        end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and type(aim.applyAimTargetSwitch)=='function' then
            selected=aim.applyAimTargetSwitch('Counter',selected,function(target)
                if not target or not target.Parent or target==own then return false end
                local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local other=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not other or target:GetAttribute('Dead')==true
                    or (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>control.range
                    or ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(target)) then return false end
                if type(filter.selectThreat)=='function' then return filter.selectThreat({target},function()return 0 end)==target end
                local okay,allowedTarget=pcall(filter.allows,target)
                return okay and allowedTarget==true
            end,own,root)
            -- A retained identity is not evidence of a new incoming attack.
            -- Never dispatch or turn an accepted counter toward an idle bystander.
            selectedToken=selected and qualifiedTokens[selected]
            if selectedToken==nil then selected=nil end
        end
        for target in control.latches do if not active[target] then control.latches[target]=nil end end
        for phase in control.projectileWaits do if not waiting[phase] then control.projectileWaits[phase]=nil end end
        if not selected then control.lastReason=rejectedReason or 'Waiting for an eligible incoming attack';return false end
        control.dispatching=true
        -- An attempted native phase is consumed even if its action fails. A
        -- failure must never release Auto Block again on every heartbeat.
        control.latches[selected]={character=own,tool=tool,token=selectedToken}
        control.projectileWaits[selectedToken]=nil
        -- Share only this counter's selected opponent with directional assist.
        -- The native action is still submitted immediately, with no input delay.
        control.directionalPhase={character=own,target=selected,kit=own:GetAttribute('Moveset'),at=clock()}
        local ok,message=control.callNative(function()
            -- Enter the normal game context before releasing our shared block.
            if block and block.held and type(block.release)=='function' then block.release() end
            if action=='Special' then
                control.nativeTool:Special()
            elseif action=='M1' then
                local humanoid=own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local air=host.Enum.Material and humanoid.FloorMaterial==host.Enum.Material.Air
                local variant=if air then 'Down' elseif humanoid.Jump==true then 'Up' else nil
                local nativeTarget=control.nativeTool:GetTarget()
                control.nativeTool:UseSetService('Activated',variant,nativeTarget)
            else
                control.nativeTool:UseTool(tool,'Activated')
            end
        end)
        control.dispatching=false
        if not ok then
            control.directionalPhase=nil
            control.failures+=1;control.lastDispatchError=tostring(message)
            control.lastReason='Native counter request failed: '..tostring(message);return false
        end
        control.requests+=1
        control.lastTarget,control.lastTool=selected,tool
        control.latches[selected]={character=own,tool=tool,token=selectedToken}
        if action~='M1' and hasAction(tool,action,own,if action=='Special' then 'RightDeactivated' else 'Deactivated') then
            control.held={character=own,tool=tool,slot=slot,action=action,binding=savedBinding(slot,action),
                service=tool:GetAttribute('Service'),kit=own:GetAttribute('Moveset')}
        end
        control.lastReason='Native '..tool.Name..' requested for an incoming attack'
        return true
    end
    pcall(function()
        local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knit=module and host.require(module)
        local native=knit and knit.GetController('ToolController')
        if not native or type(native.ReturnKey)~='function' or type(native.UseTool)~='function' then return end
        control.nativeTool=native;control.knit=knit;control.serviceFolder=module:FindFirstChild('Services');control.ready=true
        local service=knit.GetService('ItadoriService')
        local signal=service and service.Effects
        connect(signal,function(method: any,caster: any)
            if method=='Swing2' and caster~=player.Character then control.update() end
        end)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then control.nativeServiceConnections.ItadoriService=true end
    end)
    connect(run.Heartbeat,function(delta)
        if finite(delta) and delta>0 then control.heartbeatStep=math.clamp(delta,1/1000,.05) end
        release();control.update()
    end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() resetTargetSwitch();control.focused=false;table.clear(control.projectileWaits);release() end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function() control.focused=true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function() resetTargetSwitch();release();table.clear(control.latches);table.clear(control.projectileWaits) end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,function() resetTargetSwitch();table.clear(control.latches);table.clear(control.projectileWaits) end)
    local characterFolder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
    local function watchKit(target: any)
        local kit=target and target.Parent and target:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        if type(kit)~='string' or kit=='' or not control.knit then return end
        local name=kit..'Service'
        if control.nativeServiceConnections[name] or not control.serviceFolder or not control.serviceFolder:FindFirstChild(name) then return end
        local ok,service=pcall(control.knit.GetService,name)
        local signal=ok and service and service.Effects
        if not signal or type(signal.Connect)~='function' then return end
        control.nativeServiceConnections[name]=true
        connect(signal,function(method: any,caster: any,stage: any)
            if not control.alive or method~='Swing2' or not caster or not caster.Parent
                or type(caster.GetAttribute)~='function' or caster:GetAttribute('Moveset')~=kit then return end
            local filter=menu.autoCounterFilter
            if filter and type(filter.onNativeSwing)=='function' then filter.onNativeSwing(caster,stage) end
            -- Local swings are outgoing health-loss evidence across all kits.
            -- They must never dispatch an incoming counter against ourselves.
            if caster~=player.Character then control.update() end
        end)
    end
    local function watchM1(target: any)
        if not target or control.m1Connections[target] or type(target.GetAttributeChangedSignal)~='function' then return end
        control.m1Connections[target]=target:GetAttributeChangedSignal('LastM1'):Connect(function()
            if control.alive and control.enabled and target~=player.Character and target.Parent then control.update() end
        end)
        control.kitConnections[target]=target:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Moveset'):Connect(function() watchKit(target) end)
        watchKit(target)
    end
    if characterFolder then
        for _,target in characterFolder:GetChildren() do watchM1(target) end
        connect(characterFolder.ChildAdded,watchM1)
        connect(characterFolder.ChildRemoved,function(target: any)
            local connection=control.m1Connections[target]
            if connection then connection:Disconnect();control.m1Connections[target]=nil end
            local kitConnection=control.kitConnections[target]
            if kitConnection then kitConnection:Disconnect();control.kitConnections[target]=nil end
            control.latches[target]=nil
        end)
        control.replicatedM1Ready=true
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        resetTargetSwitch()
        release()
        control.held=nil
        control.directionalPhase=nil
        table.clear(control.latches)
        table.clear(control.projectileWaits)
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        resetTargetSwitch()
        release();control.held=nil;control.alive=false;control.enabled=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,connection in control.m1Connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,connection in control.kitConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.m1Connections)
        table.clear(control.kitConnections);table.clear(control.nativeServiceConnections)
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.latches)
        table.clear(control.cooldowns)
        table.clear(control.projectileWaits)
    end
    return control
end
return NativeCounter
end)()

local NativeWorldCutting = (function(): any
-- Continue only an actual Vessel-ultimate Dismantle activation through native
-- ToolController actions. One observed skill-1 press starts 3 -> 2 -> Special;
-- all input onsets must fit inside the user's 0.6-second sequence window.
local NativeWorldCutting: {[string]: any}={}
local SERVICES={'DismantleService','FlameArrowService','RushService'}
local STEPS={{slot=3,at=0.10},{slot=2,at=0.20},{special=true,at=0.30}}
function NativeWorldCutting.new(host: any,menu: any,bindings: any): any
 local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
 local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
 local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
 local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
 local clock=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
 local control: any={alive=true,enabled=false,ready=false,focused=true,connections={},pending=nil,held=nil,dispatching=false,requests=0,releases=0,lastReason='World Cutting Slash is disabled'}
 local function callNative(callback: any,...: any): ...any
  if menu.nativeCounter and type(menu.nativeCounter.callNative)=='function' then return menu.nativeCounter.callNative(callback,...) end
  return pcall(callback,...)
 end
 local function connect(signal: any,callback: any)
  if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
 end
 local function roleHeld(role: string): boolean
  local binding=bindings and bindings.get and bindings.get(role)
  if not binding then return false end
  local key=(if binding.kind=='Mouse' then host.Enum.UserInputType else host.Enum.KeyCode)[binding.name]
  return key~=nil and (if binding.kind=='Mouse' then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(key) else input:IsKeyDown(key))
 end
 local function currentKit(): any
  local character=player.Character
  local moves=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
  if not moves or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Itadori' or character:GetAttribute('InUlt')~=true or not control.nativeTool then return nil end
  local tools={}
  for slot,service in SERVICES do
   local ok,tool=pcall(control.nativeTool.ReturnKey,control.nativeTool,slot)
   if not ok or not tool or tool.Parent~=moves or tool:GetAttribute('Key')~=slot or tool:GetAttribute('Service')~=service then return nil end
   tools[slot]=tool
  end
  return {character=character,tools=tools}
 end
 control.currentKit=currentKit
 local function sameKit(record: any): boolean
  local kit=currentKit()
  if not kit or kit.character~=record.character then return false end
  for slot,tool in record.tools do if kit.tools[slot]~=tool then return false end end
  return true
 end
 local function available(record: any): boolean
