  if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or not sameKit(record) then return false end
  local character=record.character
  local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
  if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not info then return false end
  if bindings and bindings.manualBlockHeld and bindings.manualBlockHeld() then return false end
  for _,name in {'Dead','TrueStun','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Ragdoll'} do
   local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
   if value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0) or info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end
  end
  for _,name in {'Block','Knockback','DomainClash','Throwable','Item'} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return false end end
  return true
 end
 local function release()
  local held=control.held;control.held=nil
  -- Do not route a stale release into a replacement character or moveset.
  if not held or not sameKit(held.record) or roleHeld(held.role) then return end
  control.dispatching=true
  local ok
  if held.special then ok=callNative(control.nativeTool.ReleaseSpecial,control.nativeTool)
  else ok=callNative(control.nativeTool.UseTool,control.nativeTool,held.tool,'Deactivated') end
  control.dispatching=false
  if ok then control.releases+=1 end
 end
 local function cancel(reason: string)
  control.pending=nil;release();control.lastReason=reason
 end
 function control.setEnabled(value: boolean)
  control.enabled=value==true
  cancel(if control.enabled then 'Waiting for native Vessel ultimate Dismantle' else 'World Cutting Slash is disabled')
 end
 function control.onFirst(tool: any)
  if control.dispatching then return end
  if control.pending then cancel('Your new Dismantle activation took priority');return end
  local kit=currentKit()
  if not kit or kit.tools[1]~=tool or not available(kit) then return end
  if roleHeld('Move2') or roleHeld('Move3') or roleHeld('Special') then return end
  kit.index=1;kit.firstAt=clock();kit.due=kit.firstAt+STEPS[1].at
  control.pending=kit;control.lastReason='Native Vessel ultimate combo armed'
 end
 function control.step()
  local record=control.pending
  if not record then return end
  if not available(record) then cancel('Character, native moveset, or input state changed');return end
  local now=clock()
  if now-record.firstAt>=.6 then cancel('The 0.6-second input sequence expired');return end
  if control.held then
   if now+1e-9<control.held.due then return end
   release()
   record.index+=1
   if record.index>#STEPS then control.pending=nil;control.lastSequenceDuration=now-record.firstAt;control.lastReason='Native 1 -> 3 -> 2 -> Special requests finished';return end
   record.due=record.firstAt+STEPS[record.index].at
   return
  end
  if now+1e-9<record.due then return end
  if now-record.due>0.10 then cancel('Native combo deadline expired');return end
  local step=STEPS[record.index]
  local role=if step.special then 'Special' else 'Move'..step.slot
  if roleHeld(role) then cancel('Your held combat input took priority');return end
  control.dispatching=true
  local ok,message
  if step.special then ok,message=callNative(control.nativeTool.Special,control.nativeTool)
  else ok,message=callNative(control.nativeTool.UseTool,control.nativeTool,record.tools[step.slot],'Activated') end
  control.dispatching=false
  if not ok then control.lastDispatchError=tostring(message);cancel('Native combo action failed: '..control.lastDispatchError);return end
  control.requests+=1
  control.held={record=record,tool=step.slot and record.tools[step.slot],special=step.special,role=role,due=clock()+0.01}
 end
 pcall(function()
  local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
  local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
  local serviceFolders=module and module:FindFirstChild('Services')
  if not serviceFolders or not serviceFolders:FindFirstChild('DismantleService') then return end
  local knit=host.require(module)
  local native=knit.GetController('ToolController')
  if not native or type(native.UseTool)~='function' or type(native.ReturnKey)~='function' or type(native.Special)~='function' or type(native.ReleaseSpecial)~='function' then return end
  control.nativeTool=native
  local signal=knit.GetService('DismantleService').Activated
  if not signal or type(signal.Fire)~='function' then return end
  local hook: any={target=signal,key='Fire',original=signal.Fire,active=true}
  hook.wrapper=function(self: any,...: any): ...any
   local result=table.pack(hook.original(self,...))
   if hook.active and control.alive then control.onFirst(select(1,...)) end
   return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
  end
  signal.Fire=hook.wrapper;control.hook=hook;control.ready=true
 end)
 connect(run.Heartbeat,control.step)
 connect(input.InputBegan,function(event: any)
  if not control.pending or control.dispatching then return end
  for _,role in {'Move1','Move2','Move3','Move4','Special','Block'} do
   local binding=bindings and bindings.get and bindings.get(role)
   if binding and ((binding.kind=='Mouse' and event.UserInputType==host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name]) or (binding.kind~='Mouse' and event.KeyCode==host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name])) then
    if role=='Move1' and clock()-control.pending.firstAt<=0.02 then return end
    cancel('Your new combat input took priority');return
   end
  end
 end)
 connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() control.focused=false;cancel('Window focus was lost') end)
 connect(input.WindowFocused,function() control.focused=true end)
 connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function() control.pending=nil;control.held=nil end)
 function control.Destroy()
  if not control.alive then return end
  control.enabled=false;cancel('Unloaded');control.alive=false
  local hook=control.hook
  if hook then hook.active=false;if hook.target[hook.key]==hook.wrapper then hook.target[hook.key]=hook.original end end
  for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
  table.clear(control.connections)
 end
 return control
end
return NativeWorldCutting
end)()

local NativeVariants = (function(): any
-- Character-owned native continuations. No global key remaps or synthetic combat keys.
local NativeVariants: {[string]: any}={}
local SPECS={
    Ambush={kit='Haruta',service='AmbushService',slot=1},
    ShutUp={kit='Charles',service='ShutUpService',slot=2},
    Nue={kit='Megumi',service='NueService',slot=2},
    Toad={kit='Megumi',service='ToadService',slot=3},
    Reserve={kit='Hakari',service='ReserveBallService',slot=1},
}
function NativeVariants.new(host: any,menu: any,bindings: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control: any={alive=true,focused=true,ready=false,connections={},features={},dispatching=false,reservePrediction=false,lastReason='Character variants disabled'}
    for name,spec in SPECS do control.features[name]={enabled=false,spec=spec,requests=0,lastReason='Disabled'} end
    local function callNative(callback,...)
        if menu.nativeCounter and menu.nativeCounter.callNative then return menu.nativeCounter.callNative(callback,...) end
        return pcall(callback,...)
    end
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function held(role)
        local b=bindings and bindings.get and bindings.get(role)
        if not b then return false end
        local key=(if b.kind=='Mouse' then host.Enum.UserInputType else host.Enum.KeyCode)[b.name]
        return key and (if b.kind=='Mouse' then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(key) else input:IsKeyDown(key)) or false
    end
    local function toolFor(name)
        local f=control.features[name];local spec=f.spec
        local c=player.Character;local moves=c and c.Parent and c:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not moves or c:GetAttribute('Moveset')~=spec.kit or not control.native then return nil end
        local ok,tool=pcall(control.native.ReturnKey,control.native,spec.slot)
        return if ok and tool and tool.Parent==moves and tool:GetAttribute('Service')==spec.service and tool:GetAttribute('Key')==spec.slot then tool else nil
    end
    control.toolFor=toolFor
    local function available(name,character)
        local f=control.features[name];local c=character or player.Character
        local h=c and c.Parent and c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');local info=c and c:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or not f.enabled or c~=player.Character or not h or h.Health<=0 or h.PlatformStand or not info or not toolFor(name) or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        for _,n in {'Dead','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Knockback','Block','DomainClash','Throwable'} do
            local v=c:GetAttribute(n)
            if v==true or type(v)=='number' and v>0 or info:FindFirstChild(n) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function validTarget(t)
        if t and t:IsA('Player') then t=t.Character end
        if ((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(t)) then return nil end
        local h=t and t.Parent and t:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return if t~=player.Character and h and h.Health>0 and t:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then t else nil
    end
    local function lastHit()
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        return tracker and validTarget(tracker.lastHitTarget)
    end
    local function target()
        local locked=menu.environment and validTarget(menu.environment.LockedTarget)
        if locked then return locked end
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if assist and assist.selectSkillTarget then local ok,t=pcall(assist.selectSkillTarget);if ok and validTarget(t) then return validTarget(t) end end
        return lastHit()
    end
    local function face(point,backwards)
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput() then return end
        local c=player.Character;local root=c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then return end
        local direction=host.Vector3.new(point.X-root.Position.X,0,point.Z-root.Position.Z)
        if direction.Magnitude<0.01 then return end
        local frame=host.CFrame.lookAt(root.Position,root.Position+(if backwards then -direction else direction))
        root.CFrame=frame
        control.facing={character=c,root=root,frame=frame,untilAt=clock()+0.10}
    end
    function control.facingFrame(root)
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput() then return nil end
        local f=control.facing
        if not f or f.root~=root or f.character~=player.Character or clock()>f.untilAt then control.facing=nil;return nil end
        return f.frame+(root.Position-f.frame.Position)
    end
    function control.predictReservePoint(from,position,velocity,ping)
        -- Native ReserveBallController uses a 150-stud/sec straight flight.
        local time=math.clamp((position-from).Magnitude/150+math.clamp(ping or 0,0,.5),0,2)
        for _=1,3 do time=math.clamp((position+velocity*time-from).Magnitude/150+math.clamp(ping or 0,0,.5),0,2) end
        return position+velocity*time
    end
    local function releaseSpecial()
        local owned=control.special;control.special=nil
        if not owned or owned.character~=player.Character or held('Special') then return end
        callNative(control.native.ReleaseSpecial,control.native)
    end
    local function special(name)
        if control.special or held('Special') or not available(name) or type(control.native.Special)~='function' or type(control.native.ReleaseSpecial)~='function' then return end
        control.special={name=name,character=player.Character,at=clock(),seen=false}
        local ok,err=callNative(control.native.Special,control.native)
        if not ok then control.special=nil;control.features[name].lastReason=tostring(err) end
    end
    local function activate(tool,opponent)
        local native=control.native;local prior,wrapper
        if opponent and type(native.GetTarget)=='function' then
            prior=native.GetTarget;wrapper=function()return opponent end;native.GetTarget=wrapper
        end
        control.dispatching=true
        local ok,err=callNative(native.UseTool,native,tool,'Activated')
        control.dispatching=false
        if wrapper and native.GetTarget==wrapper then native.GetTarget=prior end
        return ok,err
    end
    function control.onReserveHit(caster,victim)
        local cast=control.reserveCast;local opponent=validTarget(victim)
        if not cast or cast.followed or clock()-cast.at>3 or cast.character~=player.Character or (caster~=player and caster~=player.Character) or not opponent or not available('Reserve',cast.character) then return false end
        local moves=cast.character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        local ok,doors=pcall(control.native.ReturnKey,control.native,2)
        if not ok or not doors or doors.Parent~=moves or doors:GetAttribute('Service')~='ShutterDoorService' then control.features.Reserve.lastReason='Native Shutter Doors is not equipped';return false end
        if menu.nativeCounter and not menu.nativeCounter.toolReady(doors) then control.features.Reserve.lastReason='Shutter Doors cooldown is not ready';return false end
        cast.followed=true
        local sent,err=activate(doors,opponent)
        if not sent then control.features.Reserve.lastReason=tostring(err);return false end
        control.features.Reserve.requests+=1;control.features.Reserve.lastReason='Owned Reserve Ball hit followed with native Shutter Doors'
        control.release={character=cast.character,tool=doors,due=clock()+.01}
        return true
    end
    function control.setEnabled(name,value)
        local f=control.features[name];if not f then return end
        f.enabled=value==true;f.lastReason=if f.enabled then 'Waiting for the current native '..name..' skill' else 'Disabled'
        if name=='Ambush' then control.ambush=nil end
        if name=='Reserve' then control.reserveCast=nil end
        if control.special and control.special.name==name and not f.enabled then releaseSpecial() end
    end
    function control.setReservePrediction(value)control.reservePrediction=value==true end
    function control.step()
        local now=clock();local pending=control.ambush
        if pending then
            if not available('Ambush',pending.character) or toolFor('Ambush')~=pending.tool then control.ambush=nil
            elseif now+1e-9>=pending.due then
                if now-pending.due>.1 then control.ambush=nil
                else
                    local ok,err=activate(pending.tool)
                    if not ok then control.ambush=nil;control.features.Ambush.lastReason=tostring(err)
                    else
                        pending.remaining-=1;control.features.Ambush.requests+=1;pending.due=now+.01
                        if pending.remaining==0 then control.ambush=nil;control.release={character=pending.character,tool=pending.tool,due=now+.01} end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local release=control.release
        if release and now+1e-9>=release.due then
            control.release=nil
            if release.character==player.Character and release.tool.Parent then callNative(control.native.UseTool,control.native,release.tool,'Deactivated') end
        end
        local own=control.special
        if own then
            local info=own.character and own.character:FindFirstChild('Info');local skill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            if skill then own.seen=true end
            if held('Special') then control.special=nil
            elseif not available(own.name,own.character) or now-own.at>1.5 or own.seen and not skill then releaseSpecial() end
        end
    end
    local initOk,err=pcall(function()
        local module=replicated.Knit.Knit;local knit=host.require(module)
        control.native=knit.GetController('ToolController')
        if not control.native or type(control.native.UseTool)~='function' then return end
        local hook: any={active=true,original=control.native.UseTool};control.hook=hook
        hook.wrapper=function(self,tool,action,...)
            local name
            if hook.active and control.alive and not control.dispatching and action=='Activated' then
                for n in SPECS do if tool==toolFor(n) and available(n) then name=n;break end end
            end
            if name=='ShutUp' then local victim=lastHit();if victim then face(victim.HumanoidRootPart.Position,true) end end
            if name=='Toad' then special(name) end
            if name=='Reserve' and control.reservePrediction then
                local opponent=target();local root=player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                if opponent and root then
                    local victimRoot=opponent.HumanoidRootPart;local ping=0
                    if type(player.GetNetworkPing)=='function' then local ok,v=pcall(player.GetNetworkPing,player);if ok then ping=v end end
                    face(control.predictReservePoint(root.Position,victimRoot.Position,victimRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity,ping),false)
                end
            end
            local priorTarget,targetWrapper
            if (name=='Nue' or name=='Toad') and type(self.GetTarget)=='function' then
                local opponent=target()
                if opponent then priorTarget=self.GetTarget;targetWrapper=function()return opponent end;self.GetTarget=targetWrapper end
            end
            local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,tool,action,...))
            if targetWrapper and self.GetTarget==targetWrapper then self.GetTarget=priorTarget end
            if not result[1] then if name=='Toad' then releaseSpecial() end;error(result[2],0) end
            if name=='Nue' then special(name)
            elseif name=='Ambush' then
                if control.ambush then control.ambush=nil else control.ambush={character=player.Character,tool=tool,remaining=6,due=clock()+.01} end
            elseif name=='Reserve' then control.reserveCast={character=player.Character,tool=tool,at=clock(),followed=false} end
            return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
        end
        control.native.UseTool=hook.wrapper;control.ready=true
        local services=module:FindFirstChild('Services')
        if services and services:FindFirstChild('ReserveBallService') then
            local service=knit.GetService('ReserveBallService')
            connect(service.Effects,function(kind,caster,victim)if kind=='Hit' then control.onReserveHit(caster,victim) end end)
        end
    end)
    if not initOk then control.initError=tostring(err) end
    connect(run.Heartbeat,control.step)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()control.focused=false;control.ambush=nil;control.reserveCast=nil;releaseSpecial() end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function()control.focused=true end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function()control.ambush=nil;control.reserveCast=nil;control.release=nil;control.facing=nil;releaseSpecial()end)
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        releaseSpecial();control.alive=false
        if control.hook then control.hook.active=false;if control.native.UseTool==control.hook.wrapper then control.native.UseTool=control.hook.original end end
        for _,c in control.connections do c:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end
    return control
end
return NativeVariants
end)()

local TrainControl = (function(): any
local TrainControl: {[string]: any} = {}
function TrainControl.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local control: any = {alive=true, enabled=false, buttonEnabled=false, interval=5,
        lastRequest=-math.huge, nextAttempt=0, requests=0, connections={}}
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local function connect(signal: any, callback: any)
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(control.connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    function control.findPrompt(): any
        local map=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Map')
        local station=map and map:FindFirstChild('StationControl',true)
        local train=station and station:FindFirstChild('ButtonTrain')
        local button=train and train:FindFirstChild('Button')
        return button and button:FindFirstChildOfClass('ProximityPrompt')
    end
    function control.spawn(): (boolean, string?)
        if not control.alive then return false,'Train control is unloaded' end
        local now=host.os.clock()
        local remaining=1-(now-control.lastRequest)
        if remaining>0 then
            control.status=string.format('Try again in %.2f seconds.',remaining)
            return false,control.status
        end
        local prompt=control.findPrompt()
        if not prompt then control.status='Train station unavailable';return false,control.status end
        if type(host.fireproximityprompt)~='function' then
            control.status='Prompt activation unavailable';return false,control.status
        end
        -- The loaded TBO button references this same station prompt. A submitted
        -- interaction is not proof that the server has spawned another train.
        control.lastRequest=now
        local ok,message=pcall(host.fireproximityprompt,prompt)
        control.lastError=if ok then nil else tostring(message)
        control.status=if ok then 'Train requested' else 'Request failed'
        if ok then control.requests+=1 end
        return ok,if ok then nil else control.status..': '..tostring(message)
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: boolean)
        control.enabled=value==true
        control.nextAttempt=host.os.clock()
    end
    function control.setInterval(value: number)
        if type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then
            control.interval=math.clamp(value,1,30)
        end
    end
    function control.step(now: number)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or now<control.nextAttempt then return end
        control.nextAttempt=now+control.interval
        control.spawn()
    end
    local function makeButton()
        if control.gui then return end
        local gui=host.Instance.new('ScreenGui')
        gui.Name='ShenaniganismSpawnTrain';gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
        gui.DisplayOrder=80;gui.Parent=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
        local frame=host.Instance.new('Frame')
        frame.Name='TrainPanel';frame.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(164,56)
        frame.Position=host.UDim2.new(1,-190,1,-160)
        frame.BackgroundColor3=host.Color3.fromRGB(32,36,44)
        frame.BorderColor3=host.Color3.fromRGB(88,94,104);frame.Active=true;frame.Parent=gui
        local drag=host.Instance.new('TextLabel')
        drag.Size=host.UDim2.new(1,0,0,17);drag.BackgroundTransparency=1
        drag.Text='Train';drag.TextSize=12;drag.TextColor3=host.Color3.fromRGB(210,215,220)
        drag.Active=true;drag.Parent=frame
        local button=host.Instance.new('TextButton')
        button.Name='SpawnTrain';button.Size=host.UDim2.new(1,-12,0,30)
        button.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(6,20)
        button.BackgroundColor3=host.Color3.fromRGB(52,60,70)
        button.BorderSizePixel=0;button.Text='Spawn Train';button.TextSize=14
        button.TextColor3=host.Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245);button.Parent=frame
        control.gui=gui;control.button=button
        connect(button.Activated,function() control.spawn() end)
        connect(drag.InputBegan,function(object)
            if object.UserInputType==host.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                control.drag={origin=object.Position,position=frame.Position}
            end
        end)
        connect(input.InputChanged,function(object)
            local dragging=control.drag
            if dragging and object.UserInputType==host.Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local delta=object.Position-dragging.origin
                frame.Position=host.UDim2.new(dragging.position.X.Scale,dragging.position.X.Offset+delta.X,
                    dragging.position.Y.Scale,dragging.position.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
            end
        end)
        connect(input.InputEnded,function(object)
            if object.UserInputType==host.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then control.drag=nil end
        end)
        connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() control.drag=nil end)
    end
    function control.setButtonEnabled(value: boolean)
        -- This is a presentation preference. Failsafe masks effective gameplay
        -- flags while the menu is open, but configuring this UI must still work.
        local requested=value==true
        control.buttonEnabled=requested
        if requested then makeButton() end
        if control.gui then control.gui.Enabled=requested end
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        control.alive=false;control.enabled=false;control.drag=nil
        for _,connection in ipairs(control.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        if control.gui then control.gui:Destroy();control.gui=nil end
    end
    connect(host.game:GetService('RunService').Heartbeat,function() control.step(host.os.clock()) end)
    return control
end
return TrainControl
end)()
