function LooksScripts.new(host,menu)
    local control={sessions={},alive=true}
    local task=host.task
    local function createSession(name)
        local s={alive=true,objects={},owned={},connections={},threads={},writes={},steps={},tweens={},tracks={},attributes={}}
        local originals,proxies={},setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
        local wrap,unwrap
        unwrap=function(value)
            if originals[value] then return originals[value] end
            if type(value)=='table' and not getmetatable(value) then local copy={};for k,v in value do copy[unwrap(k)]=unwrap(v) end;return copy end
            return value
        end
        local function write(object,key,value)
            if not s.alive then return end
            if not s.owned[object] then
                s.writes[object]=s.writes[object] or {}
                local record=s.writes[object][key]
                if not record then record={before=object[key]};s.writes[object][key]=record end
                record.last=value
            end
            object[key]=value
        end
        local function invoke(callback,...)
            if not s.alive then return end
            local thread=coroutine.running();s.threads[thread]=true
            local results=table.pack(pcall(callback,...));s.threads[thread]=nil
            if not results[1] and s.alive then
                s.lastError=tostring(results[2]);host.warn('Looks '..name..': '..s.lastError)
            end
            if results[1] then return table.unpack(results,2,results.n) end
            return
        end
        local function schedule(callback,args,delay)
            local thread=task.defer(function()
                if delay then task.wait(delay) end
                if s.alive then invoke(callback,table.unpack(args,1,args.n)) end
            end)
            s.threads[thread]=true;return thread
        end
        wrap=function(value)
            local kind=host.typeof(value)
            if kind~='Instance' and kind~='RBXScriptSignal' then
                if type(value)=='table' then local copy={};for k,v in value do copy[k]=wrap(v) end;return copy end
                return value
            end
            if proxies[value] then return proxies[value] end
            local proxy={};proxies[value]=proxy;originals[proxy]=value
            setmetatable(proxy,{__tostring=function()return tostring(value)end,__index=function(_,key)
                if kind=='RBXScriptSignal' then
                    if key=='Connect' or key=='Once' or key=='connect' then return function(_,callback)
                        local connection
                        connection=value:Connect(function(...)
                            if key=='Once' then connection:Disconnect() end
                            local args=table.pack(...);for i=1,args.n do args[i]=wrap(args[i]) end
                            invoke(callback,table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
                        end)
                        table.insert(s.connections,connection);return connection
                    end end
                    if key=='Wait' or key=='wait' then return function()
                        local args=table.pack(value:Wait());if not s.alive then error('Looks disabled',0) end
                        for i=1,args.n do args[i]=wrap(args[i]) end;return table.unpack(args,1,args.n)
                    end end
                end
                local member=value[key]
                if type(member)~='function' then return wrap(member) end
                return function(_,...)
                    if not s.alive then return end
                    local args=table.pack(...);for i=1,args.n do args[i]=unwrap(args[i]) end
                    if key=='Destroy' or key=='Remove' then
                        if s.owned[value] then value:Destroy() else write(value,'Parent',nil) end
                        return
                    elseif key=='ClearAllChildren' then
                        for _,child in value:GetChildren() do wrap(child):Destroy() end;return
                    elseif key=='BindToRenderStep' then
                        local id='JJSLooks/'..name..'/'..tostring(args[1]);s.steps[id]=true
                        return value:BindToRenderStep(id,args[2],function(...)invoke(args[3],...)end)
                    elseif key=='UnbindFromRenderStep' then
                        local id='JJSLooks/'..name..'/'..tostring(args[1]);s.steps[id]=nil;return value:UnbindFromRenderStep(id)
                    elseif key=='Create' and value:IsA('TweenService') then
                        local object=args[1]
                        if not s.owned[object] then
                            for property,goal in args[3] do
                                s.writes[object]=s.writes[object] or {}
                                local record=s.writes[object][property] or {before=object[property]}
                                record.last,record.tween=goal,true;s.writes[object][property]=record
                            end
                        end
                    elseif key=='HttpGet' or key=='HttpGetAsync' or key=='HttpPost' then
                        local url=tostring(args[1])
                        if name=='Vessel To Chara' and key~='HttpPost' and url:match('^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/damir512/sounds/main/[^?#]+%.mp3$') then
                            return member(value,table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
                        end
                        error('This managed moveset cannot load additional untracked scripts',0)
                    elseif key=='SetAttribute' then
                        s.attributes[value]=s.attributes[value] or {}
                        if not s.attributes[value][args[1]] then s.attributes[value][args[1]]={before=value:GetAttribute(args[1])} end
                        s.attributes[value][args[1]].last=args[2]
                    end
                    local results=table.pack(member(value,table.unpack(args,1,args.n)))
                    if key=='Clone' or key=='GetObjects' then
                        local objects=if key=='Clone' then {results[1]} else results[1]
                        for _,object in objects or {} do if object then table.insert(s.objects,object);s.owned[object]=true end end
                    elseif key=='Create' and value:IsA('TweenService') then table.insert(s.tweens,results[1])
                    elseif key=='LoadAnimation' then table.insert(s.tracks,results[1]) end
                    for i=1,results.n do results[i]=wrap(results[i]) end
                    return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
                end
            end,__newindex=function(_,key,nextValue)write(value,key,unwrap(nextValue))end})
            return proxy
        end
        local env={}
        local allowed={'assert','error','ipairs','pairs','next','pcall','xpcall','select','tonumber','tostring','type','unpack','setmetatable','getmetatable','rawget','rawset','rawequal','math','string','table','bit32','buffer','utf8','os','Enum','Vector2','Vector3','CFrame','Color3','UDim','UDim2','Rect','Ray','TweenInfo','NumberSequence','NumberSequenceKeypoint','ColorSequence','ColorSequenceKeypoint','NumberRange','PhysicalProperties','BrickColor','Font','DateTime','Random','Axes','Faces','Region3','Vector2int16','Vector3int16','warn','print','tick','time','typeof','version','elapsedTime','gcinfo'}
        for _,key in allowed do env[key]=host[key] end
        env.game,env.workspace,env.Game,env.Workspace=wrap(host.game),wrap(host.workspace),wrap(host.game),wrap(host.workspace)
        env._G,env.shared={},{}
        env.getgenv=function()return env end;env.getfenv=function()return env end
        env.typeof=function(value)return host.typeof(originals[value] or value)end
        env.cloneref=function(value)return value end
        if name=='Vessel To Chara' then
            local cache='Shenaniganism/LooksCache/chara/'
            local function assetPath(path)
                if type(path)~='string' or not path:match('^[%w_%-]+%.mp3$') then error('Unsupported moveset asset path',0) end
                return cache..path
            end
            env.isfile=function(path)return host.isfile and host.isfile(assetPath(path)) or false end
            env.writefile=function(path,data)
                local target=assetPath(path)
                if not s.alive then return end
                assert(type(data)=='string' and #data<=32*1024*1024,'Invalid moveset audio asset')
                for _,folder in {'Shenaniganism','Shenaniganism/LooksCache','Shenaniganism/LooksCache/chara'} do
                    if not host.isfolder(folder) then host.makefolder(folder) end
                end
                host.writefile(target,data)
            end
            env.readfile=function(path)return host.readfile(assetPath(path))end
            env.getcustomasset=function(path)return host.getcustomasset(assetPath(path))end
            env.getsynasset=env.getcustomasset
        end
        env.Instance={new=function(class,parent)
            local object=host.Instance.new(class);table.insert(s.objects,object);s.owned[object]=true
            if parent then object.Parent=unwrap(parent) end;return wrap(object)
        end}
        env.task={spawn=function(callback,...)return schedule(callback,table.pack(...))end,defer=function(callback,...)return schedule(callback,table.pack(...))end,delay=function(seconds,callback,...)return schedule(callback,table.pack(...),seconds)end,cancel=task.cancel,wait=function(seconds)
            if not s.alive then error('Looks disabled',0) end
            local result=task.wait(seconds);if not s.alive then error('Looks disabled',0) end;return result
        end}
        env.wait,env.spawn,env.delay=env.task.wait,env.task.spawn,env.task.delay
        env.coroutine=table.clone(coroutine)
        env.coroutine.create=function(callback)local thread=coroutine.create(function(...)return invoke(callback,...)end);s.threads[thread]=true;return thread end
        env.coroutine.wrap=function(callback)local thread=env.coroutine.create(callback);return function(...)local result=table.pack(coroutine.resume(thread,...));if not result[1] then error(result[2],0)end;return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)end end
        env.require=function(module)
            module=unwrap(module)
            if host.typeof(module)~='Instance' or not module:IsA('ModuleScript') then error('Unsupported external module',0) end
            return wrap(host.require(module))
        end
        env.loadstring=function(source,chunk)
            local fn,message=host.loadstring(source,chunk);if fn then host.setfenv(fn,env) end;return fn,message
        end
        env.setfenv=function(fn) return host.setfenv(fn,env) end
        s.environment=env
        function s.stop()
            if not s.alive then return end;s.alive=false
            for _,connection in s.connections do pcall(function()connection:Disconnect()end)end
            for id in s.steps do pcall(function()host.game:GetService('RunService'):UnbindFromRenderStep(id)end)end
            for thread in s.threads do if thread~=coroutine.running() then pcall(task.cancel,thread)end end
            for _,tween in s.tweens do pcall(function()tween:Cancel()end)end
            for _,track in s.tracks do pcall(function()track:Stop(0)end)end
            for object,properties in s.writes do for key,record in properties do pcall(function()
                if record.tween or object[key]==record.last then object[key]=record.before end
            end)end end
            for object,attributes in s.attributes do for key,record in attributes do pcall(function()if object:GetAttribute(key)==record.last then object:SetAttribute(key,record.before)end end)end end
            for i=#s.objects,1,-1 do pcall(function()s.objects[i]:Destroy()end)end
        end
        function s.start(source)
            local fn,message=host.loadstring(source,'=JJSLooks.'..name)
            if not fn then error(message,0) end;host.setfenv(fn,env)
            schedule(function()
                local ok,problem=pcall(fn)
                if not ok and s.alive then
                    s.lastError=tostring(problem);s.stop();control.sessions[name]=nil
                    local entry=menu.entries['Scripts/'..name];if entry then entry.widget.Set(false,false);entry.running=false end
                    host.warn('Looks '..name..' could not start: '..s.lastError)
                else s.ready=true end
            end,table.pack())
        end
        return s
    end
    function control.setEnabled(name,enabled)
        if not sourceNames[name] then return false end
        if not enabled then local old=control.sessions[name];if old then old.stop();control.sessions[name]=nil end;return true end
        if control.sessions[name] then return true end
        -- Moveset replacements share the same character. Switch, never stack them.
        if name~='Super Tze Fly' then for other,session in control.sessions do if other~='Super Tze Fly' then
            session.stop();control.sessions[other]=nil
            local entry=menu.entries['Scripts/'..other];if entry then entry.widget.Set(false,false);entry.running=false end
        end end end
        local session=createSession(name);control.sessions[name]=session;session.start(sources[sourceNames[name]])
        return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()for _,session in control.sessions do session.stop()end;table.clear(control.sessions);control.alive=false end
    return control
end
return LooksScripts
end)()

local WindowControls = (function(): any
-- Native window-controls component; embedded in Cullingotoole.updated.luau.
local WindowControls = {}
function WindowControls.clampPosition(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, viewportWidth: number, viewportHeight: number): (number, number)
  return math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(0, viewportWidth - width)), math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(0, viewportHeight - height))
end
function WindowControls.resizeBox(left: number, top: number, width: number, height: number, dx: number, dy: number, horizontal: number, vertical: number, viewportWidth: number, viewportHeight: number): (number, number, number, number)
  local right, bottom = left + width, top + height
  local minimumWidth, minimumHeight = math.min(300, viewportWidth), math.min(200, viewportHeight)
  if horizontal > 0 then
    right = math.clamp(right + dx, left + math.min(minimumWidth, viewportWidth - left), viewportWidth)
  elseif horizontal < 0 then
    left = math.clamp(left + dx, 0, right - math.min(minimumWidth, right))
  end
  if vertical > 0 then
    bottom = math.clamp(bottom + dy, top + math.min(minimumHeight, viewportHeight - top), viewportHeight)
  elseif vertical < 0 then
    top = math.clamp(top + dy, 0, bottom - math.min(minimumHeight, bottom))
  end
  return left, top, right - left, bottom - top
end
function WindowControls.new(environment: {[string]: any}): any
  local game, Instance, Enum = environment.game, environment.Instance, environment.Enum
  local Vector2, UDim2 = environment.Vector2, environment.UDim2
  local inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  local attached: {[any]: any} = {}
  local controller: any = {}
  local shared = environment._G or environment
  local function cleanSize(value: any): any
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local width, height = value.Width, value.Height
    if type(width) ~= "number" or type(height) ~= "number" or width ~= width or height ~= height
      or width <= 0 or height <= 0 or width > 65536 or height > 65536 then return nil end
    return {Width=width, Height=height}
  end
  local function cleanGeometry(value: any): any
    local result: any = {Version=1, Popups={}}
    if type(value) ~= "table" or value.Version ~= 1 then return result end
    result.Main = cleanSize(value.Main)
    if type(value.Popups) == "table" then
      for key, size in value.Popups do
        if type(key) == "string" and #key > 0 and #key <= 512 then result.Popups[key] = cleanSize(size) end
      end
    end
    return result
  end
  local geometry = cleanGeometry(shared.__CullingWindowGeometry)
  shared.__CullingWindowGeometry = geometry
  local mainBinding: any = nil
  local function changed()
    if type(controller.onGeometryChanged) == "function" then controller.onGeometryChanged() end
  end
  function controller.exportGeometry(): any
    return cleanGeometry(geometry)
  end
  function controller.importGeometry(value: any): boolean
    if type(value) ~= "table" or value.Version ~= 1 then return false end
    geometry = cleanGeometry(value)
    shared.__CullingWindowGeometry = geometry
    controller.restoreMainSize()
    return true
  end
  function controller.popupSize(key: string): any
    return cleanSize(geometry.Popups[key])
  end
  function controller.rememberPopupSize(key: string, width: number, height: number): boolean
    if type(key) ~= "string" or #key == 0 or #key > 512 then return false end
    local size = cleanSize({Width=width,Height=height})
    if not size then return false end
    local previous = geometry.Popups[key]
    if previous and previous.Width == width and previous.Height == height then return false end
    geometry.Popups[key] = size
    return true
  end
  function controller.geometryChanged()
    changed()
  end
  function controller.restoreMainSize()
    if mainBinding then mainBinding.restoreSize() end
  end
  function controller.attach(frame: any, titleBar: any, resizable: boolean, geometryKey: string?): any
    if attached[frame] then
      return attached[frame]
    end
    local screen = frame:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
    if not screen or (screen.Name ~= "Shenaniganism" and screen:GetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned") ~= true) then
      return nil
    end
    local guiContainer = screen:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePlayerGui")
    local connections: {any}, handles: {any} = {}, {}
    local alive, adjusting = true, false
    local gesture: any = nil
    local scale = frame:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
    local surfaces: {[any]: boolean} = {}
    local function connect(signal: any, callback: any)
      connections[#connections + 1] = signal:Connect(callback)
    end
    local function parentBounds(): (any, any)
      local parent = frame.Parent
      if parent:IsA("GuiBase2d") then
        return parent.AbsolutePosition, parent.AbsoluteSize
      end
      return screen.AbsolutePosition, screen.AbsoluteSize
    end
    local function setTopLeft(x: number, y: number)
      local origin, viewport = parentBounds()
      local size = frame.AbsoluteSize
      x, y = WindowControls.clampPosition(x - origin.X, y - origin.Y, size.X, size.Y, viewport.X, viewport.Y)
      local nextX, nextY = x + (size.X * frame.AnchorPoint.X), y + (size.Y * frame.AnchorPoint.Y)
      local current = frame.Position
      if current.X.Scale ~= 0 or current.Y.Scale ~= 0 or current.X.Offset ~= nextX or current.Y.Offset ~= nextY then
        frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(nextX, nextY)
      end
    end
    local function keepVisible()
      if (not alive or adjusting) or not frame.Parent then
        return
      end
      adjusting = true
      local position, size = frame.AbsolutePosition, frame.AbsoluteSize
      local _, viewport = parentBounds()
      if ((resizable and (size.X > 0)) and (size.Y > 0)) and ((size.X > viewport.X) or (size.Y > viewport.Y)) then
        local factor = if scale then math.max(0.01, scale.Scale) else 1
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(size.X, viewport.X) / factor, math.min(size.Y, viewport.Y) / factor)
      end
      setTopLeft(position.X, position.Y)
      adjusting = false
    end
    local function restoreSize()
      local saved = geometryKey == "Main" and geometry.Main
      if not saved or not alive or not frame.Parent then return end
      local _, viewport = parentBounds()
      local factor = if scale then math.max(0.01, scale.Scale) else 1
      local width = math.clamp(saved.Width * factor, math.min(300, viewport.X), viewport.X) / factor
      local height = math.clamp(saved.Height * factor, math.min(200, viewport.Y), viewport.Y) / factor
      if frame.Size.X.Scale ~= 0 or frame.Size.Y.Scale ~= 0 or frame.Size.X.Offset ~= width or frame.Size.Y.Offset ~= height then
        adjusting = true
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
        adjusting = false
      end
      keepVisible()
    end
    local function rememberSize(): boolean
      if geometryKey ~= "Main" then return false end
      local factor = if scale then math.max(0.01, scale.Scale) else 1
      local size = cleanSize({Width=frame.AbsoluteSize.X/factor,Height=frame.AbsoluteSize.Y/factor})
      if not size then return false end
      local previous = geometry.Main
      if previous and previous.Width == size.Width and previous.Height == size.Height then return false end
      geometry.Main = size
      return true
    end
    local function endGesture()
      local current = gesture
      if not current then return end
      gesture = nil
      if current.changedSize then changed() end
    end
    local function interactiveChildAt(input: any)
      if not guiContainer then
        return false
      end
      for _, object in guiContainer:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) do
        if object:IsDescendantOf(frame) and (object:IsA("GuiButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") or object:GetAttribute("WidgetType") == "SliderTrack") then
          return true
        end
      end
      return false
    end
    local function begin(input: any, horizontal: number?, vertical: number?)
      if gesture or not alive then
        return
      end
      local kind = input.UserInputType
      if (kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and (kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        return
      end
      if (horizontal == nil) and interactiveChildAt(input) then
        return
      end
      local origin = parentBounds()
      gesture = {input = input, kind = kind, pointer = input.Position, left = frame.AbsolutePosition.X - origin.X, top = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y - origin.Y, width = frame.AbsoluteSize.X, height = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y, horizontal = horizontal, vertical = vertical}
    end
    local function addDragSurface(surface: any)
      if surfaces[surface] ~= nil then return end
      surfaces[surface] = surface.Active
      surface.Active = true
      connect(surface.InputBegan, function(object) begin(object) end)
    end
    addDragSurface(titleBar)
    if resizable then
      local specifications: {any} = {{"N", 0, -1, 0.5, 0, 1, -28, 0, 14}, {"S", 0, 1, 0.5, 1, 1, -28, 0, 14}, {"W", -1, 0, 0, 0.5, 0, 14, 1, -28}, {"E", 1, 0, 1, 0.5, 0, 14, 1, -28}, {"NW", -1, -1, 0, 0, 0, 26, 0, 26}, {"NE", 1, -1, 1, 0, 0, 26, 0, 26}, {"SW", -1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 26, 0, 26}, {"SE", 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 26, 0, 26}}
      for _, spec in specifications do
        local handle = Instance.new("Frame")
        handle.Name = "ShenaniganismResize" .. spec[1]
        handle:SetAttribute("CullingWindowControl", true)
        handle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        handle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(spec[4], spec[5])
        handle.Size = UDim2.new(spec[6], spec[7], spec[8], spec[9])
        handle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        handle.BorderSizePixel = 0
        handle.ZIndex, handle.Active = 10000, true
        handle.Parent = frame
        handles[#handles + 1] = handle
        connect(handle.InputBegan, function(input)
          begin(input, spec[2], spec[3])
        end)
      end
    end
    connect(inputService.InputChanged, function(input)
      local current = gesture
      if not current or not alive then
        return
      end
      if current.kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if input ~= current.input then
          return
        end
      elseif input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        return
      end
      local dx, dy = input.Position.X - current.pointer.X, input.Position.Y - current.pointer.Y
      local origin, viewport = parentBounds()
      if current.horizontal ~= nil then
        local x, y, width, height = WindowControls.resizeBox(current.left, current.top, current.width, current.height, dx, dy, current.horizontal, current.vertical, viewport.X, viewport.Y)
        adjusting = true
        local factor = if scale then math.max(0.01, scale.Scale) else 1
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width / factor, height / factor)
        frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + (width * frame.AnchorPoint.X), y + (height * frame.AnchorPoint.Y))
        adjusting = false
        if rememberSize() then current.changedSize = true end
      else
        setTopLeft((origin.X + current.left) + dx, (origin.Y + current.top) + dy)
      end
    end)
    connect(inputService.InputEnded, function(input)
      if gesture and ((input == gesture.input) or ((gesture.kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1))) then
        endGesture()
      end
    end)
    connect(inputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
      endGesture()
    end)
    connect(frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
      if not frame.Visible then
        endGesture()
      else
        restoreSize()
      end
    end)
    connect(screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"), function()
      if not screen.Enabled then
        endGesture()
      else
        restoreSize()
      end
    end)
    connect(screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), keepVisible)
    connect(frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), keepVisible)
    local binding = {addDragSurface = addDragSurface, restoreSize = restoreSize}
    function binding.Destroy()
      if not alive then
        return
      end
      alive, gesture = false, nil
      attached[frame] = nil
      if mainBinding == binding then mainBinding = nil end
      for _, connection in connections do
        connection:Disconnect()
      end
      for _, handle in handles do
        handle:Destroy()
      end
      table.clear(connections)
      for surface, originalActive in surfaces do
        if surface.Parent then surface.Active = originalActive end
      end
    end
    attached[frame] = binding
    connect(frame.Destroying, binding.Destroy)
    connect(screen.Destroying, binding.Destroy)
    keepVisible()
    restoreSize()
    return binding
  end
  function controller.attachPanel(panel: any)
    if ((type(panel) ~= "table") or not panel.Main) or not panel.TopBar then
      return
    end
    local binding = controller.attach(panel.Main, panel.TopBar, true, "Main")
    if not binding then return end
    mainBinding = binding
    for _, child in panel.Main:GetChildren() do
      if child:IsA("Frame") and child ~= panel.TopBar then
        for _, descendant in child:GetDescendants() do
          if descendant:GetAttribute("WidgetType") == "SliderTrack" then
            binding.addDragSurface(child)
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local screen = panel.Main:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
    local openButton = screen:FindFirstChild("OpenBtn", true) or screen:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageButton")
    if openButton then
      controller.attach(openButton, openButton, false)
    end
  end
  function controller.Destroy()
    local bindings = {}
    for _, binding in attached do
      table.insert(bindings, binding)
    end
    for _, binding in bindings do
      binding.Destroy()
    end
  end
  return controller
end
return WindowControls
end)()

local GameBindings = (function(): any
-- Native game-bindings component; embedded in Cullingotoole.updated.luau.
local GameBindings = {}
function GameBindings.parse(value: any, enum: any): any
  local valueType = typeof(value)
  if valueType == "EnumItem" then
    local mouse = {MouseLeftButton="MouseButton1", MouseRightButton="MouseButton2", MouseMiddleButton="MouseButton3"}
    if mouse[value.Name] then return {kind="Mouse",name=mouse[value.Name]} end
    if value.Name == "None" then return nil end
    if (value.EnumType == enum.KeyCode) and (value ~= enum.KeyCode.Unknown) then
      return {kind = "Keyboard", name = value.Name}
    elseif (value.EnumType == enum.UserInputType) and value.Name:match("^MouseButton[123]$") then
      return {kind = "Mouse", name = value.Name}
    end
    return nil
  end
  if type(value) ~= "string" then
    return nil
  end
  value = value:gsub("^Enum%.KeyCode%.", ""):gsub("^Enum%.UserInputType%.", "")
  local compact = value:lower():gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
  local aliases = {lmb = "MouseButton1", rmb = "MouseButton2", mmb = "MouseButton3", leftmouse = "MouseButton1", rightmouse = "MouseButton2", middlemouse = "MouseButton3", leftmousebutton = "MouseButton1", rightmousebutton = "MouseButton2", middlemousebutton = "MouseButton3", mouse1 = "MouseButton1", mouse2 = "MouseButton2", mouse3 = "MouseButton3", mb1 = "MouseButton1", mb2 = "MouseButton2", mb3 = "MouseButton3", ["1"] = "One", ["2"] = "Two", ["3"] = "Three", ["4"] = "Four", ["5"] = "Five", ["6"] = "Six", ["7"] = "Seven", ["8"] = "Eight", ["9"] = "Nine", ["0"] = "Zero", ["`"] = "Backquote", caps = "CapsLock", capslock = "CapsLock", ctrl = "LeftControl", control = "LeftControl", shift = "LeftShift", alt = "LeftAlt", spacebar = "Space"}
  local name = aliases[compact] or value
  if name:match("^MouseButton[123]$") then
    return {kind = "Mouse", name = name}
  end
  for _, key in enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems() do
    if (key.Name:lower() == name:lower()) and (key ~= enum.KeyCode.Unknown) then
      return {kind = "Keyboard", name = key.Name}
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function GameBindings.role(value)
  if type(value) ~= "string" then
    return nil
  end
  local name = value:lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")
  if (name == "block") or (name == "blocking") then
    return "Block"
  end
  if (((name == "special") or (name == "specialability")) or (name == "variant")) or (name == "specialmove") then
    return "Special"
  end
  if (name == "dash") or (name == "dashing") then
    return "Dash"
  end
  local index = ((name:match("^move([1-4])$") or name:match("^skill([1-4])$")) or name:match("^ability([1-4])$")) or name:match("^moveslot([1-4])$")
  return if index then "Move" .. index else nil
end
function GameBindings.new(environment: {[string]: any}): any
  local game, enum = environment.game, environment.Enum
  local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
  local input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  local native = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
  local dashClock=(environment.os or os).clock
  local provider: any = {bindings = {}, sources = {}, held = {}, simulatedHeld = {}, lastRead = 0, warnings = {}, alive = true, dashDelay = 0, lastDash = -math.huge, connections = {}}
  local function dashSubmissionInterval(): number
    local shared=environment._G or environment
    local menu=shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
    local control=menu and menu.dashControl
    if control and control.alive~=false and type(control.getIntervalStatus)=='function' then
      local ok,status=pcall(control.getIntervalStatus)
      local maximum=ok and type(status)=='table' and status.maximum or nil
      if type(maximum)=='number' and maximum==maximum and math.abs(maximum)<math.huge then
        return if status.enabled==true then math.max(0,maximum)else 0
      end
    end
    return math.max(0,provider.dashDelay/1000)
  end
  provider.manualBlockVersion=0
  function provider.noteManualBlockPress()
    -- Invalidate only our queued helper inputs; native player input is untouched.
    provider.manualBlockVersion+=1
  end
  local logical = {[enum.KeyCode.F] = "Block", [enum.KeyCode.R] = "Special", [enum.KeyCode.One] = "Move1", [enum.KeyCode.Two] = "Move2", [enum.KeyCode.Three] = "Move3", [enum.KeyCode.Four] = "Move4", [enum.KeyCode.Q] = "Dash"}
  local function manualBlock(binding)
    if not provider.manualBlockHeld then return false end
    local ok,held=pcall(provider.manualBlockHeld,binding)
    return not ok or held==true
  end
  local function overlapAllows(action,context)
    if not action then return false end
    local shared=environment._G or environment
    local menu=shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
    local overlap=menu and menu.actionOverlap
    if not overlap or type(overlap.allows)~='function'then return false end
    local okay,allowed=pcall(overlap.allows,action,context)
    return okay and allowed==true
  end
  local function actionForRole(role)
    if role=='Dash'then return 'Dash' end
    if role=='M1'or role=='Melee'then return 'M1' end
    if role=='Special'or type(role)=='string'and role:match('^Move[1-4]$')then return 'Skill' end
    return nil
  end
  local function actionForBinding(binding)
    for role,saved in provider.bindings do
      if saved and saved.kind==binding.kind and saved.name==binding.name then
        local action=actionForRole(role)
        if action then return action end
      end
    end
    return if binding.kind=='Mouse'and binding.name=='MouseButton1'then 'M1'else nil
  end
  local function manualBlockSuppresses(action)
    return manualBlock()and not overlapAllows(action,'Block')
  end
  function provider.isNaoya()
    local character=player.Character
    return character~=nil and character:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Naoya'
  end
  local function bindingId(binding)
    return binding.kind..':'..binding.name
  end
  local function isBlockBinding(binding)
    local block=provider.bindings.Block
    return block and block.kind==binding.kind and block.name==binding.name
  end
  local function blockDashActive()
    local shared=environment._G or environment
    local menu=shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
    local dash=menu and menu.dashControl
    if not dash or type(dash.blockDashActive)~='function'then return false end
    local okay,active=pcall(dash.blockDashActive)
    return okay and active==true
  end
  local function helperBlockSuppressed()
    local shared=environment._G or environment
    local menu=shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
    local dash=menu and menu.dashControl
    if dash and type(dash.blockDashUnblocking)=='function'then
      local okay,active=pcall(dash.blockDashUnblocking)
      if not okay or active==true then return true end
    elseif blockDashActive()then return true end
    if provider.blockSuppressed then local okay,suppressed=pcall(provider.blockSuppressed);return not okay or suppressed==true end
    return false
  end
  local function isDashBinding(binding)
    local dash=provider.bindings.Dash
    return dash and dash.kind==binding.kind and dash.name==binding.name
  end
  function provider.simulationAllowed(down)
    if down and (not provider.alive or provider.isNaoya()) then return false end
    return true
  end
  local function releaseAllowed(binding)
    if not provider.isNaoya() then return true end
    if not provider.simulatedHeld[bindingId(binding)] then return false end
    if isBlockBinding(binding) and manualBlock(binding) then
      provider.simulatedHeld[bindingId(binding)]=nil
      return false
    end
    return true
  end
  function provider.setKnown(role, binding)
    provider.bindings[role] = binding
    provider.sources[role] = "User-confirmed setting"
  end
  function provider.refresh()
    if not provider.alive then
      return
    end
    provider.lastRead = os.clock()
    local folder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Keybind")
    local combat = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Combat")
    if combat then
      for _, action in combat:GetChildren() do
        local role = GameBindings.role(action.Name)
        if role and action:IsA("InputAction") then
          local saved = action:FindFirstChild("Keyboard")
          if saved and saved:IsA("InputBinding") then
            local binding = GameBindings.parse(saved.KeyCode, enum)
            if binding then binding.modifier = GameBindings.parse(saved.PrimaryModifier, enum) end
            provider.bindings[role] = binding
            provider.sources[role] = "In-game input action"
            provider.warnings[role] = nil
          end
        end
      end
      return
    end
    local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local menus = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Menus")
    local group = menus and menus:FindFirstChild("Group")
    local settings = group and group:FindFirstChild("Settings")
    local panel = settings and settings:FindFirstChild("Keybinds")
    if not panel then
      return
    end
    for _, row in panel:GetDescendants() do
      if row:IsA("GuiObject") then
        local role = GameBindings.role(row.Name)
        local label = nil
        for _, child in row:GetChildren() do
          if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") then
            local found = GameBindings.role(child.Text)
            if found then
              role, label = found, child
            end
          end
        end
        if role then
          local binding = GameBindings.parse((row:GetAttribute("KeyCode") or row:GetAttribute("Keybind")) or row:GetAttribute("Binding"), enum)
          for _, child in row:GetDescendants() do
            if (not binding and (child ~= label)) and (child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton")) then
              binding = GameBindings.parse(child.Text, enum)
            end
          end
          if binding then
            provider.bindings[role], provider.sources[role] = binding, "In-game keybind settings"
            provider.warnings[role] = nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  function provider.get(role)
    if (os.clock() - provider.lastRead) > 0.1 then
      provider.refresh()
    end
    return provider.bindings[role]
  end
  function provider.send(binding, down, repeated, layer)
    if not binding or not provider.simulationAllowed(down) or (not down and not releaseAllowed(binding)) then return false end
    if down and (isBlockBinding(binding)and helperBlockSuppressed()or isDashBinding(binding)and blockDashActive())then return false end
    if down and not isBlockBinding(binding)and manualBlockSuppresses(actionForBinding(binding))then return false end
    local id=bindingId(binding)
    if down then provider.simulatedHeld[id]=binding end
    if down and binding.modifier then provider.send(binding.modifier, true, false, layer) end
    if binding.kind == "Mouse" then
      local point = input:GetMouseLocation()
      native:SendMouseButtonEvent(point.X, point.Y, (tonumber(binding.name:sub(-1)) or 1) - 1, down, layer or game, 0)
    else
      native:SendKeyEvent(down, enum.KeyCode[binding.name], repeated or false, layer or game)
    end
    if not down then provider.simulatedHeld[id]=nil end
    if not down and binding.modifier then provider.send(binding.modifier, false, false, layer) end
    return true
  end
  local function specialBindingHeld(binding)
    if not binding then return false end
    local key=(if binding.kind=='Mouse' then enum.UserInputType else enum.KeyCode)[binding.name]
    if not key then return false end
    return if binding.kind=='Mouse' then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(key) else input:IsKeyDown(key)
  end
  provider.nativeSkillHeld={}
  function provider.currentSkill(slot: number): any
    if not provider.alive or type(slot)~='number' or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>4 then return nil end
    local character=player.Character
    local moveset=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
    if not moveset or not character:FindFirstChild('Info') then return nil end
    local toolController=provider.nativeSkillController
    if not toolController then
      local ok,value=pcall(function()
        local folder=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knit=module and environment.require(module)
        return knit and knit.GetController('ToolController')
      end)
      if ok then toolController=value end
    end
    if not toolController or type(toolController.ReturnKey)~='function' or type(toolController.UseKey)~='function' then return nil end
    local ok,tool=pcall(toolController.ReturnKey,toolController,slot)
    if not ok or not tool or tool.Parent~=moveset or not (tool:IsA('NumberValue') or tool:IsA('Tool'))
      or tool:GetAttribute('Key')~=slot or type(tool:GetAttribute('Service'))~='string' or tool:GetAttribute('Service')=='' then return nil end
    provider.nativeSkillController=toolController
    return {character=character,tool=tool,service=tool:GetAttribute('Service'),slot=slot,
      moveset=character:GetAttribute('Moveset'),binding=provider.get('Move'..tostring(slot)),controller=toolController}
  end
  function provider.sendNativeSkill(slot: number, down: boolean): boolean
    if not provider.alive then return false end
    if down and manualBlockSuppresses('Skill')then provider.lastSkillReason='Manual Block owns helper input; enable Skill overlap during Block to submit concurrently';return false end
    local owned=provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]
    if not down then
      if not owned then return false end
      owned.pendingRelease=true
      if owned.character~=player.Character then
        provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]=nil
        provider.lastSkillReason='The owned native character changed'
        return false
      end
    end
    local current=provider.currentSkill(slot)
    if not current then
      if owned and not down then
        local character=player.Character
        local set=character and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not set or not owned.tool or owned.tool.Parent~=set
          or owned.tool:GetAttribute('Key')~=slot or owned.tool:GetAttribute('Service')~=owned.service or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~=owned.moveset then provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]=nil end
      end
      provider.lastSkillReason='Current native skill is unavailable';return false
    end
    if not down and (current.tool~=owned.tool or current.service~=owned.service or current.moveset~=owned.moveset) then
      provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]=nil
      provider.lastSkillReason='The owned native skill or moveset changed';return false
    end
    if not down then
      if specialBindingHeld(owned.binding) or specialBindingHeld(provider.get('Move'..tostring(slot))) then
        provider.lastSkillReason='Owned native skill release deferred for manual input'
        return false
      end
      -- UseKey silently does nothing if this action is absent. Non-hold skills
      -- have no release request to send and must not inflate release counts.
      if type(current.controller.GetToolService)~='function' then
        provider.lastSkillReason='Native skill release capability is unavailable';return false
      end
      local found,service=pcall(current.controller.GetToolService,current.controller,owned.service)
      if not found or not service then
        provider.lastSkillReason='Native skill release service is unavailable';return false
      end
      if not service.Deactivated or type(service.Deactivated.Fire)~='function' then
        provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]=nil
        provider.lastSkillReason='This native skill has no Deactivated action';return false
      end
      if type(current.controller.UseTool)~='function' then
        provider.lastSkillReason='Native UseTool release is unavailable';return false
      end
    end
    -- Release the exact owned tool, never a newly resolved tool from this slot.
    local ok,message
    if down then ok,message=pcall(current.controller.UseKey,current.controller,slot,'Activated')
    else ok,message=pcall(current.controller.UseTool,current.controller,owned.tool,'Deactivated') end
    if not ok then provider.lastSkillReason='Native skill request failed: '..tostring(message);return false end
    if down then
      provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]=current
      provider.nativeSkillRequests=(provider.nativeSkillRequests or 0)+1
    else
      if provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]==owned then provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]=nil end
      provider.nativeSkillReleases=(provider.nativeSkillReleases or 0)+1
    end
    provider.lastSkillReason=if down then 'Current equipped native skill requested' else 'Owned native skill released'
    return true
  end
  function provider.flushNativeSkillReleases()
    if not provider.alive then return end
    for slot,owned in table.clone(provider.nativeSkillHeld) do
      if provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]==owned and owned.pendingRelease then provider.sendNativeSkill(slot,false) end
    end
  end
  local function connectOwned(signal,callback)
    if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(provider.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
  end
  connectOwned(input.InputEnded,provider.flushNativeSkillReleases)
  connectOwned(input.WindowFocused,provider.flushNativeSkillReleases)
  connectOwned(player.CharacterRemoving,function(character)
    character=character or player.Character
    for slot,owned in table.clone(provider.nativeSkillHeld) do
      if owned.character==character then provider.nativeSkillHeld[slot]=nil end
    end
  end)
  local runOk,runService=pcall(game.GetService,game,'RunService')
  local releaseClock=(environment.os or os).clock
  local lastReleaseCheck=releaseClock()
  if runOk and runService then
    connectOwned(runService.Heartbeat,function()
      if next(provider.nativeSkillHeld)==nil then return end
      local now=releaseClock()
      if now-lastReleaseCheck<0.1 then return end
      lastReleaseCheck=now
      provider.flushNativeSkillReleases()
    end)
  end
  local function nativeSpecialTool()
    local tool=provider.nativeSpecialController
    if not tool then
      local ok,value=pcall(function()
        local folder=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knit=module and environment.require(module)
        return knit and knit.GetController('ToolController')
      end)
      if ok and value and type(value.Special)=='function' and type(value.ReleaseSpecial)=='function' then
        tool=value;provider.nativeSpecialController=tool
      end
    end
    return tool
  end
  -- True when the native Special action can be requested at all. Callers use
  -- it to fall back to the move's own second use (double tap) when it cannot.
  function provider.nativeSpecialAvailable()
    return provider.alive==true and nativeSpecialTool()~=nil
  end
  function provider.sendNativeSpecial(down)
    if not provider.alive then return false end
    if down and manualBlockSuppresses('Skill')then provider.lastSpecialReason='Manual Block owns helper input; enable Skill overlap during Block to submit concurrently';return false end
    local character=player.Character
    if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
    local tool=nativeSpecialTool()
    if not tool then provider.lastSpecialReason='Native ToolController.Special is unavailable';return false end
    if not down then
      local owned=provider.nativeSpecialHeld
      provider.nativeSpecialHeld=nil
      if not owned or owned.character~=character or specialBindingHeld(owned.binding) or specialBindingHeld(provider.get('Special')) then return false end
    end
    local action=if down then tool.Special else tool.ReleaseSpecial
    local ok,message=pcall(action,tool)
    if not ok then provider.lastSpecialReason='Native Special request failed: '..tostring(message);return false end
    if down then
      provider.nativeSpecialHeld={character=character,binding=provider.get('Special')}
      provider.nativeSpecialRequests=(provider.nativeSpecialRequests or 0)+1
    else provider.nativeSpecialReleases=(provider.nativeSpecialReleases or 0)+1 end
    provider.lastSpecialReason=if down then 'Native current-character Special requested' else 'Owned native Special released'
    return true
  end
  function provider.sendLogical(down, key, repeated, layer)
    local role = logical[key]
    if role and role:match('^Move[1-4]$') then return provider.sendNativeSkill(tonumber(role:sub(5)),down) end
    -- Legacy R means the native Special action, regardless of its saved physical
    -- key. In particular, saved R can be Skill 2 while saved Z is Special.
    if logical[key]=='Special' then return provider.sendNativeSpecial(down) end
    if not provider.alive or not provider.simulationAllowed(down) then
      return
    end
    if not role then
      if key and key.Name then provider.send({kind='Keyboard',name=key.Name},down,repeated,layer)
      elseif not provider.isNaoya() then native:SendKeyEvent(down,key,repeated or false,layer or game) end
      return
    end
    if role=='Block' and down and helperBlockSuppressed()then return end
    if role=='Block' and not down and manualBlock(provider.held[role]) then
      local held=provider.held[role]
      if held then provider.simulatedHeld[bindingId(held)]=nil end
      provider.held[role]=nil;return
    end
    local binding = if down then provider.get(role) else provider.held[role]
    if not binding then
      if not provider.warnings[role] then
        provider.warnings[role] = true
        environment.warn("Culling Hub: " .. (role .. " binding is unavailable. Open the game's Settings > Keybinds."))
      end
      return
    end
    if (role == "Dash") and down then
      if manualBlockSuppresses('Dash')or blockDashActive()then return false end
      local blockVersion=provider.manualBlockVersion
      -- Query the effective duration again while waiting: changing a signed
      -- adjustment must shorten/extend this queued helper input as well.
      local remaining = dashSubmissionInterval() - (dashClock() - provider.lastDash)
      while remaining > .0000001 do
        environment.task.wait(math.min(remaining,.05))
        if not provider.alive or provider.manualBlockVersion~=blockVersion and not overlapAllows('Dash','Block')or manualBlockSuppresses('Dash')or blockDashActive()or not provider.simulationAllowed(true)then return false end
        remaining=dashSubmissionInterval()-(dashClock()-provider.lastDash)
      end
      if not provider.alive or provider.manualBlockVersion~=blockVersion and not overlapAllows('Dash','Block')or manualBlockSuppresses('Dash')or blockDashActive()then return false end
      provider.lastDash = dashClock()
    end
    local sent=provider.send(binding, down, repeated, layer)
    if down then if sent then provider.held[role]=binding end else provider.held[role]=nil end
    return nil
  end
  function provider.virtualInput()
    local proxy = {}
    function proxy:SendKeyEvent(down, key, repeated, layer)
      provider.sendLogical(down, key, repeated, if (type(layer) == "table") or (layer == environment.game) then game else layer)
    end
    function proxy:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,button,down,layer,rotation)
      if not provider.alive or not provider.simulationAllowed(down) then return false end
      local binding={kind='Mouse',name='MouseButton'..tostring((tonumber(button) or 0)+1)}
      if down and (isBlockBinding(binding)and helperBlockSuppressed()or isDashBinding(binding)and blockDashActive())then return false end
      if down and not isBlockBinding(binding)and manualBlockSuppresses(actionForBinding(binding))then return false end
      if not down and not releaseAllowed(binding) then return false end
      local id=bindingId(binding)
      if down then provider.simulatedHeld[id]=binding end
      local result=native:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,button,down,layer,rotation)
      if not down then provider.simulatedHeld[id]=nil end
      return result
    end
    setmetatable(proxy, {__index = function(_, key)
      local value = native[key]
      if type(value) == "function" then
        return function(_, ...)
          return value(native, ...)
        end
      end
      return value
    end})
    return proxy
  end
  function provider.counterLogical()
    local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local main = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Main")
    local controls = main and main:FindFirstChild("Controls")
    local moveset = controls and controls:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
    if not moveset then
      return nil, false, false
    end
    local counters = {["manji kick"] = true, ["supernova"] = true, ["eye catching"] = true, ["adaptation"] = true}
    for _, move in moveset:GetChildren() do
      local name = move:FindFirstChild("ItemName")
      local title = if name and name:IsA("TextButton") then name.Text else move.Name
      if title:lower() == "ankle cutter" then
        return nil, false, true
      end
      if title:lower() == "rough energy" then
        return enum.KeyCode.R, true, false
      end
      if counters[title:lower()] or title:lower():find("counter", 1, true) then
        local container = move:FindFirstChild("Key")
        local label = container and container:FindFirstChild("Key")
        local index = label and tonumber(label.Text)
        if not index then
          local order = move.LayoutOrder
          if (order >= 1) and (order <= 4) then
            index = order
          end
        end
        local names = {"One", "Two", "Three", "Four"}
        if index and names[index] then
          return enum.KeyCode[names[index]], false, false
        end
      end
    end
    return nil, false, false
  end
  function provider.Destroy()
    if not provider.alive then return end
    for slot in table.clone(provider.nativeSkillHeld) do provider.sendNativeSkill(slot,false) end
    table.clear(provider.nativeSkillHeld)
    if provider.nativeSpecialHeld then provider.sendNativeSpecial(false) end
    for role, binding in provider.held do
      if role~='Block' or not manualBlock(binding) then pcall(provider.send, binding, false, false, game) end
    end
    table.clear(provider.held)
    -- Naoya can inherit an owned fallback key from a previous character, but
    -- never receives an unowned release or a new simulated down.
    if provider.isNaoya() then
      for _,binding in table.clone(provider.simulatedHeld) do pcall(provider.send,binding,false,false,game) end
    end
    table.clear(provider.simulatedHeld)
    provider.alive = false
    for _,connection in provider.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(provider.connections)
  end
  provider.refresh()
  return provider
end
return GameBindings
end)()

local MenuEnhancements = (function(): any
-- Native menu-enhancements component; embedded in Cullingotoole.updated.luau.
local MenuEnhancements: {[string]: any} = {}
function MenuEnhancements.buttonCaption(config)
  config=config or {}
  if config.OptionsMenu then return utf8.char(9656) end
  local explicit=config.ButtonText
  if type(explicit)=='string' and explicit~='' and explicit:lower()~='run' and explicit:lower()~='execute' then return explicit end
  local name=tostring(config.DisplayName or config.Name or config.Title or 'Apply')
  local exact={['Original']='Reset',['Special Button']='Activate',['Server Hopper']='Hop Server',
    ['Force Reset']='Reset',['Instant Reset']='Reset',['Teleport Back']='Return',['Pick Up Item']='Pick Up'}
  if exact[name] then return exact[name] end
  local lower=name:lower()
  if lower:find('teleport',1,true) or lower:match('^tp ') then return 'Teleport' end
  if lower:find('rejoin',1,true) then return 'Rejoin' end
  if lower:find('pick up',1,true) or lower:find('pickup',1,true) then return 'Pick Up' end
  if lower:find('config',1,true) and (lower:find('import',1,true) or lower:find('load config',1,true)) then return 'Import' end
  local verbs={save='Save',load='Load',export='Export',import='Import',delete='Delete',clear='Clear',remove='Remove',
    apply='Apply',reset='Reset',refresh='Refresh',copy='Copy',paste='Paste',stop='Stop',play='Play',open='Open',
    close='Close',activate='Activate',deactivate='Deactivate',check='Check',call='Call',transform='Transform',morph='Morph',unload='Unload'}
  return verbs[lower:match('^(%a+)')] or name
end
function MenuEnhancements.new(environment: {[string]: any}, host: {[string]: any}, bindings: any, state: any, hotkeys: any, callbackIds: {[any]: number}, windowControls: any): any
  local game, Instance, Enum = host.game, host.Instance, host.Enum
  local UDim2, Vector3, Color3 = host.UDim2, host.Vector3, host.Color3
  local input = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  local players, workspace = game:GetService("Players"), host.workspace
  local shared = host._G or host
  local storage: any = shared.__CullingKeybindStore or {}
  shared.__CullingKeybindStore = storage
  local controller: any = {panel = nil, entries = {}, handlerEntries = {}, popup = nil, recording = nil, alive = true, enemySize = 40, npcSize = 40, pickupRange = 50000, dashDelay = 0, roots = {}, prompts = {}, connections = {}, instances = {}}
  controller.interactThroughWallsEnabled=false
  controller.buildId='2026-10-27-shenaniganism-native-v54-cursor-ray-esp'
  controller.buttonCaption=MenuEnhancements.buttonCaption
  -- Selected-player refreshes still update legacy per-player settings. The two
  -- replacement target ESP controls are global and must retain their own value.
  local targetRefreshThreads=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
  local targetRefreshCoroutine=host.coroutine or coroutine
  function controller.withLegacyTargetRefresh(callback,...)
    local thread=targetRefreshCoroutine.running()
    local previous=targetRefreshThreads[thread]
    targetRefreshThreads[thread]=true
    local result=table.pack(pcall(callback,...))
    targetRefreshThreads[thread]=previous
    if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
    return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
  end
  function controller.isLegacyTargetRefresh()
    return targetRefreshThreads[targetRefreshCoroutine.running()]==true
  end
  -- Begin scenery-aware visibility rays.
  -- Visibility ignores scenery only; projectile and landing collision rays stay physical.
  local visibilitySceneryNames={tree=true,trees=true,foliage=true,bush=true,bushes=true,
    lamppost=true,lampposts=true,lightpole=true,lightpoles=true,lightpost=true,lightposts=true,streetlight=true,streetlights=true,streetlamp=true,streetlamps=true,
    sodamachine=true,sodamachines=true,vendingmachine=true,vendingmachines=true,sodavendingmachine=true,
    throwable=true,throwables=true,grabbables=true,interactables=true,debris=true,rubble=true,destroyedparts=true}
  local visibilityPropCache=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
  local function interactionPart(object)
    return object:GetAttribute('Interactable')==true or object:GetAttribute('Grabbable')==true
      or object:GetAttribute('Pickupable')==true or object:GetAttribute('QuestItem')==true
      or object:FindFirstChildOfClass('ProximityPrompt')~=nil or object:FindFirstChildOfClass('ClickDetector')~=nil
      or object:FindFirstChildOfClass('DragDetector')~=nil
  end
  local function smallVisibilityProp(model)
    local now=os.clock()
    local cached=visibilityPropCache[model]
    if cached and now<cached.untilAt then return cached.ignore end
    local children=model:GetChildren()
    local interactive,light=false,false
    -- Inspect only small prop models, never recursively scan a building/map.
    if #children<=32 then
      interactive=interactionPart(model)
      for _,child in children do
        if child:IsA('BasePart') or child:IsA('Attachment') then
          interactive=interactive or interactionPart(child)
          light=light or child:FindFirstChildOfClass('PointLight')~=nil or child:FindFirstChildOfClass('SpotLight')~=nil or child:FindFirstChildOfClass('SurfaceLight')~=nil
          if not interactive then
            local attachment=child:FindFirstChildOfClass('Attachment')
            if attachment then interactive=interactionPart(attachment) end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local ignore=false
    if (interactive or light) and type(model.GetExtentsSize)=='function' then
      local size=model:GetExtentsSize()
      local low,high=math.min(size.X,size.Y,size.Z),math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
      local middle=size.X+size.Y+size.Z-low-high
      ignore=(interactive and high<=32 and middle<=16 and low<=12)
        or (light and #children<=12 and middle<=8 and low<=4)
    end
    visibilityPropCache[model]={untilAt=now+1,ignore=ignore}
    return ignore
  end
  local function visibilityActor(object)
    local characters=workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
    while object and object~=workspace do
      if object==characters or object:IsA('Accessory') then return true end
      if object:IsA('Model') and (object:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') or object:GetAttribute('HitboxNPC')) then return true end
      object=object.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  function controller.visibilitySceneryRoot(object)
    if not object or not object.Parent or visibilityActor(object) then return nil end
    local assembly=if object:IsA('BasePart') then object.AssemblyRootPart else nil
    if assembly and assembly~=object and visibilityActor(assembly) then return nil end
    local current=object
    while current and current~=workspace do
      local name=current.Name:lower():gsub('[%s_%-]','')
      local numbered=name:gsub('%d+$','')
      if visibilitySceneryNames[name] or visibilitySceneryNames[numbered]then return current end
      if current:GetAttribute('Destroyed')==true or current:GetAttribute('Broken')==true
        or current:GetAttribute('IsDebris')==true or current:GetAttribute('Debris')==true then return current end
      if current:IsA('Tool') then return current end
      if (current:IsA('BasePart') or current:IsA('Attachment')) and interactionPart(current) then return current end
      if current:IsA('Model') and smallVisibilityProp(current) then return current end
      current=current.Parent
    end
    if object:IsA('BasePart') and (object.Material==Enum.Material.Glass or object.CanCollide==false or object.Transparency>=.99) then return object end
    -- A loose prop is movable; an unanchored piece welded to a fixed wall is not.
    if object:IsA('BasePart') and object.Anchored==false and (not assembly or assembly.Anchored==false) then return object end
    return nil
  end
  function controller.visibilityRaycast(origin,direction,parameters,maxCasts)
    if not parameters or parameters.FilterType~=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude then
      return workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,parameters),1
    end
    local budget=tonumber(maxCasts) or 6
    if budget~=budget then budget=6 end
    budget=math.clamp(math.floor(budget),1,6)
    local original=parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances
    local excluded=table.clone(original)
    local function exclude(object)
      if object and not table.find(excluded,object) then table.insert(excluded,object);return true end
      return false
    end
    exclude(workspace:FindFirstChild('Effects'))
    exclude(workspace:FindFirstChild('Items'))
    local map=workspace:FindFirstChild('Map')
    local destructible=map and map:FindFirstChild('Destructible')
    exclude(destructible and destructible:FindFirstChild('Throwable'))
    local casts=0
    local ok,result=pcall(function()
      local hit
      for _=1,budget do
        parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances=excluded
        casts+=1
        hit=workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,parameters)
        if not hit then return nil end
        local scenery=controller.visibilitySceneryRoot(hit.Instance)
        if not scenery or not exclude(scenery) then return hit end
      end
      -- Exhaustion is not proof of visibility: retain the final obstruction.
      return hit
    end)
    parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances=original
    if not ok then error(result,0) end
    return result,casts
  end
  -- End scenery-aware visibility rays.
  -- Begin shared friend exclusions. Persist stable IDs, never display-name matches.
  controller.excludedUserIds={}
  local excludedPlayerCache=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
  function controller.excludedPlayer(candidate)
    if type(candidate)=='number' then return players:GetPlayerByUserId(candidate) end
    if not candidate or (type(candidate)~='table' and typeof(candidate)~='Instance') or type(candidate.IsA)~='function' then return nil end
    if candidate:IsA('Player') then return candidate end
    local model=if candidate:IsA('Model') then candidate else candidate:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
    if not model then return nil end
    local cached=excludedPlayerCache[model]
    -- Validate positive entries against the player's current character;
    -- respawns cannot leave an old model associated with a selected player.
    if cached and cached.Character==model then return cached end
    local actor=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
    excludedPlayerCache[model]=actor
    return actor
  end
  function controller.isOwnedSummon(candidate)
    if not candidate or (type(candidate)~='table' and typeof(candidate)~='Instance') or type(candidate.IsA)~='function' then return false end
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local character=player.Character
    local object=candidate
    -- Native summons publish a direct ObjectValue Owner, including robots
    -- without HitboxNPC. Read current ownership without scanning descendants
    -- or retaining a result across owner changes and character respawns.
    while object and type(object.IsA)=='function' do
      if (object==candidate or object:IsA('Model')) and type(object.FindFirstChild)=='function' then
        local owner=object:FindFirstChild('Owner')
        if owner and owner:IsA('ObjectValue') and (owner.Value==player or (character~=nil and owner.Value==character)) then return true end
      end
      object=object.Parent
    end
    return false
  end
  function controller.isExcluded(candidate)
    if controller.isOwnedSummon(candidate) then return true end
    if next(controller.excludedUserIds)==nil then return false end
    if type(candidate)=='number' then return controller.excludedUserIds[candidate]==true end
    local actor=controller.excludedPlayer(candidate)
    return actor~=nil and controller.excludedUserIds[actor.UserId]==true
  end
  function controller.setExcludedFriends(value)
    if type(value)~='string' then return false end
    local selected={}
    for token in value:gmatch('[^,]+') do
      local id=tonumber(token)
      if id and id==id and id>0 and id<9007199254740992 and id%1==0 and id~=players.LocalPlayer.UserId then selected[id]=true end
    end
    controller.excludedUserIds=selected
    if controller.refreshFriendsSelection then controller.refreshFriendsSelection() end
    local lock=controller.autoLock
    if lock and controller.isExcluded(environment.LockedTarget) and lock.releaseSelectedLock then lock.releaseSelectedLock('Target is on Friends Exclude') end
    local block=controller.autoBlock
    local proof=block and block.heldThreat
    local opponent=proof and (proof.record and proof.record.model or proof.projectile and proof.projectile.owner)
    if block and controller.isExcluded(opponent) and block.release then block.release() end
    if controller.friendExclusions and controller.friendExclusions.invalidateTargets then controller.friendExclusions.invalidateTargets() end
    return true
  end
  function controller.setFriendExcluded(id,enabled)
    id=tonumber(id)
    if not id or id%1~=0 or id<=0 or id>=9007199254740992 or id==players.LocalPlayer.UserId then return false end
    local selected=table.clone(controller.excludedUserIds)
    selected[id]=if enabled==true then true else nil
    local ids={};for key in selected do table.insert(ids,key) end;table.sort(ids)
    local values={};for _,key in ids do table.insert(values,string.format('%.0f',key)) end
    local csv=table.concat(values,',')
    local entry=controller.entries['Settings/Excluded Friends']
    if entry and entry.widget then entry.widget.Set(csv,true) else controller.setExcludedFriends(csv) end
    return true
  end
  function controller.openFriendsExclude()
    local records: {any} = {}
    local seen={}
    local actors=players:GetPlayers()
    table.sort(actors,function(a,b) return a.Name:lower()<b.Name:lower() end)
    local function add(id,label)
      local widget={}
      function widget.Get() return controller.isExcluded(id) end
      function widget.Set(value) return controller.setFriendExcluded(id,value) end
      table.insert(records,{id='Friend/'..tostring(id),name=label,displayName=label,kind='CreateToggle',config={},widget=widget})
      seen[id]=true
    end
    for _,actor in actors do
      if actor~=players.LocalPlayer then add(actor.UserId,actor.DisplayName..' (@'..actor.Name..')') end
    end
    local offline={};for id in controller.excludedUserIds do if not seen[id] then table.insert(offline,id) end end;table.sort(offline)
    for _,id in offline do add(id,'Saved player '..string.format('%.0f',id)..' (offline)') end
    if #records==0 then table.insert(records,{id='Friends/Empty',name='No other players in this server',kind='CreateParagraph',config={},widget={}}) end
    controller.openMiniPopup({id='Settings/Friends Exclude',name='Friends Exclude'},records)
  end
  -- End shared friend exclusions.

  -- Begin independent angular turn controls.
  controller.turnRoles={'Character Lock','Character Initial','Character Release','Skill Aim','M1 Aim','Block Aim','Counter Aim','Punish Aim'}
  controller.turnRates={}
  controller.aimSpeedNames={['M1']='M1 Aim Assist Speed',['Skill']='Skill Aim Assist Speed',
    ['Block']='Block Directional Assist Speed',['Counter']='Auto Counter Directional Assist Speed',['Punish']='Auto Punish Directional Assist Speed'}
  for _,role in controller.turnRoles do controller.turnRates[role]={degrees=if role=='Character Initial' or role=='Character Release' then 0 else 180,time=0,speed=0} end
  function controller.setTurnValue(role,field,value)
    local record=controller.turnRates[role];local number=tonumber(value)
    if not record or not number or number~=number or math.abs(number)==math.huge then return false end
    if field=='degrees' then record.degrees=math.clamp(number,0,if role=='Character Initial' or role=='Character Release' then 720 else 360)
    elseif field=='time' then record.time=math.clamp(number,0,10)
    elseif field=='speed' then
      record.speed=math.clamp(number,0,7200)
      if record.speed>0 then record.time=record.degrees/record.speed
      elseif not (controller.restoringControls and record.degrees==0) then record.time=0 end
    else return false end
    if field~='speed' then record.speed=if record.time>0 then record.degrees/record.time else 0 end
    if record.time>0 and record.speed>7200 then record.speed=7200;record.time=record.degrees/7200 end
    if record.time>10 then record.time=10;record.speed=record.degrees/10 end
    for _,item in {{'degrees','Turn Degrees (deg)'},{'time','Turn Time (s)'},{'speed','Turn Speed (deg/s)'}} do
      local entry=controller.entries['Main/'..role..' '..item[2]]
      if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Get()~=record[item[1]] then entry.widget.Set(record[item[1]],false) end
    end
    return true
  end
  function controller.prepareTurnRestore(values)
    if type(values)~='table' then return end
    -- Restore the independent angle before either linked time/speed callback.
    -- Reload maps may visit sliders in any order; their snapshots stay intact.
    for _,role in controller.turnRoles do
      local name=role..' Turn Degrees (deg)'
      local entry=controller.entries['Main/'..name]
      local saved=values['Main/'..name]
      if saved==nil then saved=values[name] end
      local structured=type(saved)=='table'
      if structured and saved.Kind~='CreateSlider' and saved.Kind~='Slider' then continue end
      local value=if structured then saved.Value else saved
      local maximum=if role=='Character Initial' or role=='Character Release' then 720 else 360
      if entry and entry.kind=='CreateSlider' and not (entry.config and entry.config.NoConfig)
        and type(value)=='number' and value==value and value>=0 and value<=maximum then
        controller.setTurnValue(role,'degrees',value)
      end
    end
  end
  function controller.turnRate(role)
    local record=controller.turnRates[role]
    return record and record.speed or 0
  end
  function controller.limitTurn(root,desired,delta,role)
    local speed=controller.turnRate(role)
    if speed<=0 or not root or not root.CFrame or not desired or not desired.Position then return desired end
    local from,to=root.CFrame.LookVector,desired.LookVector
    local elapsed=tonumber(delta) or (controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.renderDelta) or 1/60
    if not from or not to or not elapsed or elapsed~=elapsed or elapsed<=0 or math.abs(elapsed)==math.huge then return root.CFrame end
    if from.X*from.X+from.Z*from.Z<1e-6 or to.X*to.X+to.Z*to.Z<1e-6 then return desired end
    local yaw=math.atan2(to.X,to.Z)-math.atan2(from.X,from.Z)
    local angle=math.abs(math.atan2(math.sin(yaw),math.cos(yaw)))
    local alpha=if angle<1e-6 then 1 else math.min(1,math.rad(speed)*math.min(elapsed,.1)/angle)
    -- Match native translation and interpolate orientation only.
    local origin=root.CFrame+(desired.Position-root.CFrame.Position)
    return origin:Lerp(desired,alpha)
  end
  function controller.spinTurn(origin,desired,progress,role)
    local record=controller.turnRates[role]
    if not record or record.degrees<=0 or not origin.LookVector or not desired.LookVector then return origin:Lerp(desired,progress) end
    local from,to=origin.LookVector,desired.LookVector
    if from.X*from.X+from.Z*from.Z<1e-6 or to.X*to.X+to.Z*to.Z<1e-6 then return origin:Lerp(desired,progress) end
    local start=math.atan2(-from.X,-from.Z)
    local spin=math.rad(record.degrees)
    local goal=math.atan2(-to.X,-to.Z)
    local remaining=math.atan2(math.sin(goal-start-spin),math.cos(goal-start-spin))
    local travelled=progress*(spin+math.abs(remaining))
    local yaw=start+math.min(travelled,spin)+(if travelled>spin then (travelled-spin)*(if remaining<0 then -1 else 1) else 0)
    if progress>=1 then return desired end
    return host.CFrame.new(desired.Position,desired.Position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw),0,-math.cos(yaw)))
  end

  function controller.setMenuToggleKey(value)
    if type(value)~='string' or value=='Unknown' then return false end
    local valid=value=='MouseWheelUp' or value=='MouseWheelDown'
    if not valid then
      local ok,key=pcall(function()return if value:match('^MouseButton%d+$') then Enum.UserInputType[value] else Enum.KeyCode[value] end)
      valid=ok and key~=nil
    end
    if not valid then return false end
    controller.menuToggleKey=value
    if controller.refreshMenuKeyCaption then controller.refreshMenuKeyCaption() end
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.refreshHiddenLauncher then controller.ui.refreshHiddenLauncher() end
    return true
  end
  function controller.menuHiddenHintText()

  end
  function controller.menuInputName(object)
    if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and object.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return object.KeyCode.Name end
    local name=object.UserInputType.Name
    if name:match('^MouseButton%d+$') then return name end
    if name=='MouseWheel' and object.Position.Z~=0 then return if object.Position.Z>0 then 'MouseWheelUp' else 'MouseWheelDown' end
    return nil
  end

    controller.menuKeyCapturing=true
    if controller.refreshMenuKeyCaption then controller.refreshMenuKeyCaption() end
  end
  function controller.cancelMenuKeyCapture()
    controller.menuKeyCapturing=false
    if controller.refreshMenuKeyCaption then controller.refreshMenuKeyCaption() end
  end
  function controller.handleMenuToggle(object,processed)
    if not controller.alive or controller.menuKeyCapturing or controller.recording or processed or
      object==controller.menuKeyCapturedInput or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    if controller.menuInputName(object)==controller.menuToggleKey then
      if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and controller.isMenuInput(object) then return end
      if object.UserInputType.Name=='MouseWheel' then
        if os.clock()-(controller.lastMenuWheelAt or -math.huge)<.2 then return end
        controller.lastMenuWheelAt=os.clock()
      end
      if type(environment.ToggleHub)=='function' then environment.ToggleHub() end
    end
  end
