  end))
  function controller.syncBlackflashModes()
    local helper=controller.blackflashChain
    if not helper then return end
    local function requested(owner,key)
      if not owner then return false end
      if controller.getFailsafeRequested then return controller.getFailsafeRequested(owner,key)==true end
      return owner[key]==true
    end
    local chainEnabled=requested(helper,'enabled')
    if chainEnabled and controller.nativeCombos then controller.nativeCombos.setEnabled('Divergent Fist',false) end
    local feature=controller.nativeCombos and controller.nativeCombos.features and controller.nativeCombos.features['Divergent Fist']
    local divergent=if feature then requested(feature,'enabled') else requested(helper,'autoEnabled')
    for id,value in {['Automatic/Divergent Fist']=divergent,['Automatic/Auto Blackflash Chain']=chainEnabled} do
      local entry=controller.entries[id]
      if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Get()~=value then
        entry.running=value
        entry.widget.Set(value,false)
      end
    end
  end
  local getFrameRateLimit=if type(host.getfpscap)=='function' then host.getfpscap else environment.getfpscap
  local setFrameRateLimit=if type(host.setfpscap)=='function' then host.setfpscap else environment.setfpscap
  local currentFrameRateLimit=240
  if type(getFrameRateLimit)=='function' then
    local ok,value=pcall(getFrameRateLimit)
    if ok and type(value)=='number' and value==value and value>0 and value<math.huge then currentFrameRateLimit=value end
  end
  controller.frameRateLimit=math.clamp(math.round(currentFrameRateLimit),30,1000)
  controller.frameRateLimitAvailable=type(setFrameRateLimit)=='function'
  function controller.setFrameRateLimit(value)
    local number=tonumber(value)
    if not controller.alive or not number or number~=number or math.abs(number)==math.huge then return false end
    number=math.clamp(math.round(number),30,1000)
    if type(setFrameRateLimit)~='function' then controller.frameRateLimitError='Frame rate limit is unavailable';return false end
    local ok,message=pcall(setFrameRateLimit,number)
    if not ok then controller.frameRateLimitError=tostring(message);return false end
    controller.frameRateLimit,controller.frameRateLimitError=number,nil
    local entry=controller.entries['Settings/Frame Rate Limit']
    if entry and entry.widget.Get()~=number then entry.widget.Set(number,false) end
    return true
  end
  function controller.combatMenuOpen()
    local gui=players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
    local emotes=gui and gui:FindFirstChild('Emotes')
    if not emotes or emotes.Enabled==false then return false end
    local wheel=emotes:FindFirstChild('Emote')
    local picker=emotes:FindFirstChild('EmoteSelect')
    return (wheel and wheel.Visible==true) or (picker and picker.Visible==true) or false
  end
  -- Native emotes continue after their picker closes. Read their actual state,
  -- plus this menu's own playing emote tracks, without scanning animations.
  function controller.localCharacterEmoting(character)
    character=character or players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character or character~=players.LocalPlayer.Character or not character.Parent then return false end
    local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
    if info and (info:FindFirstChild('Emote') or info:FindFirstChild('Emoting')) then return true end
    for _,key in {'Emote','Emoting'} do
      local value=character:GetAttribute(key)
      if value==true or type(value)=='number' and value>0 or type(value)=='string' and value~='' then return true end
    end
    local appearance=controller.nativeAppearanceFeatures
    if appearance and appearance.alive~=false then
      local tracks=appearance.tracks
      for _,key in {'emote','specialEmote'} do
        local track=tracks and tracks[key]
        if track and track.IsPlaying==true then return true end
      end
    end
    return false
  end

  local function rotationRestricted(character,humanoid)
    if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand then return true end
    if controller.localCharacterEmoting(character) then return true end
    local lock=controller.autoLock
    if lock and lock.characterRagdolled and lock.characterRagdolled(character,humanoid) then return true end
    local retainedSkill=controller.characterShiftLockEnabled and environment._G.CharacterLockActive
      and lock and lock.ownsCharacter and lock.ownsCharacter(character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'))
      and lock.currentPendingSkill and lock.currentPendingSkill()~=nil
    for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','InSkill','NoRotate','NoRotation'} do
      local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
      if (value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0))
        and not (retainedSkill and (name=='InSkill' or name=='NoRotate' or name=='NoRotation')) then return true end
    end
    local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
    if info then
      for _,name in {'Ragdoll','CompleteRagdoll','TrueRagdoll','NoRotate','NoRotation','InSkill'} do
        if info:FindFirstChild(name) and not (retainedSkill and (name=='InSkill' or name=='NoRotate' or name=='NoRotation')) then return true end
      end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function rotationRecordValid(record)
    return record and players.LocalPlayer.Character==record.character and record.character.Parent
      and record.humanoid.Parent==record.character and record.humanoid.Health>0
  end
  local function clearPendingRotation(pending)
    if shared.__CullingPendingRotation~=pending then return end
    shared.__CullingPendingRotation=nil
    if pending.connection then pending.connection:Disconnect() end
  end
  local function retryPendingRotation(pending)
    if shared.__CullingPendingRotation~=pending then return end
    local record=pending.record
    if not rotationRecordValid(record) or record.humanoid.AutoRotate~=false then
      clearPendingRotation(pending)
    elseif not rotationRestricted(record.character,record.humanoid) then
      clearPendingRotation(pending)
      record.humanoid.AutoRotate=record.previous
    end
  end
  function controller.restoreRotationLease(record)
    if not rotationRecordValid(record) or record.humanoid.AutoRotate~=false then return end
    if not rotationRestricted(record.character,record.humanoid) then
      record.humanoid.AutoRotate=record.previous
      return
    end
    -- Keep the original value until the native move releases its rotation markers.
    -- A single shared lease survives reinjection and can be adopted by a new lock.
    local existing=shared.__CullingPendingRotation
    if existing then clearPendingRotation(existing) end
    local pending={record=record}
    shared.__CullingPendingRotation=pending
    pending.connection=game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped:Connect(function() retryPendingRotation(pending) end)
  end
  function controller.releaseCameraOnlyRotation()
    local record=controller.cameraOnlyRotation
    controller.cameraOnlyRotation=nil
    local release=controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.characterRelease
    if record and release and release.rotationLease and release.rotationLease.humanoid==record.humanoid then
      release.rotationLease.previous=record.previous
      return
    end
    controller.restoreRotationLease(record)
  end
  function controller.updateCameraOnlyRotation()
    if controller.localCharacterEmoting() then
      controller.releaseCameraOnlyRotation()
      controller.cameraOnlyRotationConflict=nil
      return
    end
    if controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.dashFacingActive and controller.autoLock.dashFacingActive() then
      controller.releaseCameraOnlyRotation()
      return
    end
    if controller.directionalLock and controller.directionalLock.enabled then
      controller.releaseCameraOnlyRotation()
      return
    end
    local character=players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    local target,connection=environment.LockedTarget,environment.LockConn
    local targetHumanoid=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    local mode=controller.effectiveLockMode
    local protectsFacing=mode=='Camera' or ((mode=='Character' or mode=='Both') and controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.ownsCharacter and controller.autoLock.ownsCharacter(character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')))
    local active=controller.alive and protectsFacing and targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Health>0 and connection and connection.Connected~=false and not rotationRestricted(character,humanoid)
        and not (controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.visibilityPaused and controller.autoLock.visibilityPaused(if mode=='Camera' then 'camera' else 'character'))
        and not (controller.m1AimAssist and controller.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive and controller.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive())
        and not (controller.m1AimAssist and controller.m1AimAssist.blockDirectionalActive and controller.m1AimAssist.blockDirectionalActive())
    local record=controller.cameraOnlyRotation
    if record and (not active or record.humanoid~=humanoid or record.target~=target or record.connection~=connection) then
      controller.releaseCameraOnlyRotation();record=nil
    end
    if not active then controller.cameraOnlyRotationConflict=nil;return end
    if record then
      if humanoid.AutoRotate~=false then
        if environment._G.CharacterLockActive then
          -- Native skill completion may restore AutoRotate. The retained lock
          -- still owns yaw, so resume it instead of latching a stale conflict.
          humanoid.AutoRotate=false
          controller.cameraOnlyRotationConflict=nil
        else
          controller.cameraOnlyRotation=nil
          controller.cameraOnlyRotationConflict={humanoid=humanoid,target=target,connection=connection}
          controller.cameraOnlyReason='Another controller changed character rotation'
        end
      end
      return
    end
    local conflict=controller.cameraOnlyRotationConflict
    if conflict and conflict.humanoid==humanoid and conflict.target==target and conflict.connection==connection then return end
    controller.cameraOnlyRotationConflict=nil
    local pending=shared.__CullingPendingRotation
    if pending and pending.record.humanoid==humanoid and rotationRecordValid(pending.record) and humanoid.AutoRotate==false then
      record=pending.record
      clearPendingRotation(pending)
      record.target,record.connection=target,connection
      controller.cameraOnlyRotation=record
      return
    end
    if humanoid.AutoRotate==true then
      controller.cameraOnlyRotation={humanoid=humanoid,character=character,target=target,connection=connection,previous=true}
      humanoid.AutoRotate=false
      controller.cameraOnlyReason=if mode=='Camera' then 'Camera tracking is independent of character rotation' else 'Character lock owns facing while shift lock is active'
    end
  end
  function controller.applyLockMode()
    -- The Camera/Character checkbox selector owns the mode. Legacy aliases
    -- mirror it and cannot silently override a saved Both selection.
    local value=controller.lockMode or 'Camera'
    controller.cameraOnlyEnabled=value=='Camera'
    controller.characterShiftLockEnabled=value=='Character'
    local activation=controller.entries['Main/Activate Lock On']
    local active=if activation and activation.widget and activation.widget.Get then activation.widget.Get()==true else controller.lockActivationEnabled~=false
    local characterActive=active and (value=='Character' or value=='Both') and not (controller.directionalLock and controller.directionalLock.enabled)
    if environment._G.CharacterLockActive and not characterActive and controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.captureCharacterRelease then
      controller.autoLock.captureCharacterRelease()
    end
    controller.effectiveLockMode=value
    environment._G.CameraLockActive=active and (value=='Camera' or value=='Both')
    environment._G.CharacterLockActive=characterActive
    local cameraOnly=controller.entries['Main/Camera Only']
    if cameraOnly then
      local enabled=controller.cameraOnlyEnabled
      cameraOnly.running=enabled
      if cameraOnly.widget.Get()~=enabled then cameraOnly.widget.Set(enabled,false) end
    end
    local characterShift=controller.entries['Main/Character Lock with Shift Lock']
    if characterShift then
      characterShift.running=controller.characterShiftLockEnabled
      if characterShift.widget.Get()~=controller.characterShiftLockEnabled then characterShift.widget.Set(controller.characterShiftLockEnabled,false) end
    end
    controller.updateCameraOnlyRotation()
  end
  function controller.setLockActivation(value)
    controller.lockActivationEnabled=value==true
    local lock=controller.autoLock
    if lock and lock.setActivationEnabled then
      lock.setActivationEnabled(controller.lockActivationEnabled)
    elseif not controller.lockActivationEnabled then
      local connection,gui=environment.LockConn,environment.LockGui
      if environment.CleanLock then pcall(environment.CleanLock) end
      if connection then pcall(function()connection:Disconnect()end) end
      if gui then pcall(function()gui:Destroy()end) end
      environment.LockedTarget,environment.LockConn,environment.LockGui=nil,nil,nil
    end
    controller.applyLockMode()
  end
  function controller.setLockMode(value)
    if value~='Camera' and value~='Character' and value~='Both' and value~='None' then return end
    controller.lockMode=value
    if value~='Camera' then
      controller.previousLockMode=value
      shared.__CullingNonCameraLockMode=value
    end
    local mode=controller.entries['Main/Lock On']
    if mode and mode.widget.Get()~=value then mode.widget.Set(value,false) end
    controller.applyLockMode()
  end
  function controller.setCameraOnly(enabled)
    if not controller.restoringControls then controller.setLockMode(if enabled==true then 'Camera' else 'Both')
    else controller.applyLockMode() end
  end
  function controller.setCharacterShiftLock(enabled)
    if enabled==true then
      if not controller.restoringControls and controller.directionalLock and controller.directionalLock.enabled then
        controller.directionalLock.setEnabled(false)
        local protection=controller.entries['Main/Anti Directional Lock']
        if protection then protection.running=false;protection.widget.Set(false,false) end
      end
    end
    if not controller.restoringControls then controller.setLockMode(if enabled==true then 'Character' else 'Both')
    else controller.applyLockMode() end
  end
  controller.timeAliases = {['Dash Cooldown']='Dash Cooldown (100ms)',['Dash Cooldown (s)']='Dash Cooldown (100ms)',['Dash Cooldown (ms)']='Dash Cooldown (100ms)',['Evasive Delay (ms)']='Evasive Delay (s)',
    ['Complete Ragdoll Delay (ms)']='Complete Ragdoll Delay (s)',['True Ragdoll Recovery (ms)']='True Ragdoll Recovery (s)',
    ['Hit Stun Recovery (ms)']='Hit Stun Recovery (s)',['Interaction Time (ms)']='Interaction Time (s)'}
  function controller.migrateTimes(values, imported)
    if type(values)~='table' then return values end
    local result=table.clone(values)
    local prefix=if imported then '' else 'Main/'
    local oldPriority,newPriority=prefix..'M1 First, Block Second',prefix..'M1 Input Override'
    if result[newPriority]==nil then result[newPriority]=result[oldPriority] end
    result[oldPriority]=nil
    for _,name in {'M1 Aim Target Priority','Skill Aim Target Priority','Block Aim Target Priority','Counter Aim Target Priority','Punish Aim Target Priority','Skill Aim Assist Targets','Robot Aim Target'} do
      local key=prefix..name
      local saved=result[key]
      if saved=='Closest to FOV center' then result[key]='Closest to cursor'
      elseif type(saved)=='table' and saved.Value=='Closest to FOV center' then
        local converted=table.clone(saved);converted.Value='Closest to cursor';result[key]=converted
      end
    end
    local postDashKey=prefix..'Block After My Dash Time (s)'
    local postDash=result[postDashKey]
    local postDashTime=tonumber(if type(postDash)=='table' then postDash.Value else postDash)
    if postDashTime and postDashTime==postDashTime and math.abs(postDashTime)<math.huge then
      if type(postDash)=='table' then local copy=table.clone(postDash);copy.Value=math.clamp(postDashTime,0,5);result[postDashKey]=copy
      else result[postDashKey]=math.clamp(postDashTime,0,5) end
    end
    local dashKey=prefix..'Dash Cooldown (100ms)' 
    local savedDash=result[dashKey]
    if savedDash==nil then
      for _,source in {{'Dash Cooldown',0.1},{'Dash Cooldown (ms)',0.01},{'Dash Cooldown (s)',10}} do
        local value=values[prefix..source[1]]
        local amount=tonumber(if type(value)=='table' then value.Value else value)
        if amount and amount==amount and math.abs(amount)<math.huge then
          amount=math.clamp(math.round(amount*source[2]*10000)/10000,0,100)
          if type(value)=='table' then local converted=table.clone(value);converted.Value=amount;savedDash=converted
          else savedDash=amount end
          break
        end
      end
    end
    local dashAmount=tonumber(if type(savedDash)=='table' then savedDash.Value else savedDash)
    if dashAmount and dashAmount==dashAmount and math.abs(dashAmount)<math.huge then
      dashAmount=math.clamp(math.round(dashAmount*10000)/10000,0,100)
      if type(savedDash)=='table' then local converted=table.clone(savedDash);converted.Value=dashAmount;result[dashKey]=converted
      else result[dashKey]=dashAmount end
    end
    for _,oldName in {'Dash Cooldown','Dash Cooldown (ms)','Dash Cooldown (s)'} do result[prefix..oldName]=nil end
    for _,names in {{'Enemy Hitbox Size','Enemy Hitbox Z'},{'NPC Hitbox Size','NPC Hitbox Z'}} do
      local oldKey,newKey=prefix..names[1],prefix..names[2]
      if result[newKey]==nil and values[oldKey]~=nil then
        result[newKey]=if type(values[oldKey])=='table' then table.clone(values[oldKey]) else values[oldKey]
      end
    end
    for key,value in values do
      if type(key)~='string' then continue end
      local name=if imported then key else key:match('^[^/]+/(.+)$')
      local replacement=controller.timeAliases[name]
      if replacement and replacement~='Dash Cooldown (100ms)' then
        local newKey=if imported then replacement else key:match('^[^/]+/')..replacement
        if result[newKey]==nil then
          local amount=tonumber(if type(value)=='table' then value.Value else value)
          if amount and amount==amount and math.abs(amount)<math.huge then
            amount=amount/1000
            if type(value)=='table' then
              local converted=table.clone(value);converted.Value=amount;result[newKey]=converted
            else result[newKey]=amount end
          end
        end
        result[key]=nil
      end
    end
    local oldRecoveryKey=if imported then 'Sprint in Any Direction' else 'Main/Sprint in Any Direction'
    local newRecoveryKey=if imported then 'Recovery in Any Direction' else 'Main/Recovery in Any Direction'
    if result[oldRecoveryKey]~=nil then
      if result[newRecoveryKey]==nil then result[newRecoveryKey]=result[oldRecoveryKey] end
      result[oldRecoveryKey]=nil
    end
    local oldDirectionKey=if imported then 'Reverse Knockback' else 'Main/Reverse Knockback'
    local newDirectionKey=if imported then 'Knockback Direction' else 'Main/Knockback Direction'
    local reverse=values[oldDirectionKey]
    if reverse~=nil then
      if result[newDirectionKey]==nil then
        local value=if imported and type(reverse)=='table' then reverse.Value else reverse
        result[newDirectionKey]=if imported then {Kind='CreateDropdown',Value=if value==true then 'Reverse' else 'Native'} else if value==true then 'Reverse' else 'Native'
      end
      result[oldDirectionKey]=nil
    end
    return result
  end
  -- Native sliders already participate in the original config registry. The
  -- scale adapter and timing mode are managed here because they live outside it.
  controller.miniOrders=shared.__CullingMiniMenuOrders or {}
  shared.__CullingMiniMenuOrders=controller.miniOrders
  function controller.stampExport(envelope: any): any
    if type(envelope)~='table' or type(envelope.Controls)~='table' then return envelope end
    local result=table.clone(envelope)
    result.Controls=table.clone(envelope.Controls)
    if windowControls and windowControls.exportGeometry then result.WindowGeometry=windowControls.exportGeometry() end
    result.MiniMenuOrder={}
    for key,order in controller.miniOrders do result.MiniMenuOrder[key]=table.clone(order) end
    local scale=controller.entries['Settings/GUI Scale']
    if scale and scale.widget and type(scale.widget.Get)=='function' then
      local ok,value=pcall(scale.widget.Get)
      if ok and type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then
        result.Controls['GUI Scale']={Kind='Slider',Value=value}
      end
    end
    local chain=controller.blackflashChain
    if chain and type(chain.exportProfiles)=='function' then
      local ok,timing=pcall(chain.exportProfiles)
      if ok and type(timing)=='table' then result.BlackflashTiming=timing end
    end
    if controller.ui and type(controller.ui.exportColors)=='function' then
      result.ColorSettings=controller.ui.exportColors()
    end
    return result
  end
  function controller.applyManagedConfig(envelope: any): number
    if type(envelope)~='table' or type(envelope.Controls)~='table' then return 0 end
    local applied=0
    if type(envelope.MiniMenuOrder)=='table' then
      for key,order in envelope.MiniMenuOrder do
        if type(key)=='string' and type(order)=='table' then
          local clean,seen={},{}
          for _,id in order do
            if type(id)=='string' and not seen[id] then table.insert(clean,id);seen[id]=true end
          end
          controller.miniOrders[key]=clean
        end
      end
    end
    if controller.ui and type(controller.ui.importColors)=='function' and envelope.ColorSettings~=nil then
      applied+=controller.ui.importColors(envelope.ColorSettings)
    end
    local scale=controller.entries['Settings/GUI Scale']
    local savedScale=envelope.Controls['GUI Scale']
    local value=tonumber(if type(savedScale)=='table' then savedScale.Value else savedScale)
    if scale and value and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge and controller.setExactValue(scale,tostring(value)) then
      applied+=1
    end
    if windowControls and windowControls.importGeometry and envelope.WindowGeometry then windowControls.importGeometry(envelope.WindowGeometry) end
    local chain,timing=controller.blackflashChain,envelope.BlackflashTiming
    if chain and timing==nil and type(chain.setWindow)=='function' then
      -- Older exports contain only a scalar. Preserve that explicit saved
      -- value as a manual override; they cannot encode recorded timing mode.
      local saved=envelope.Controls['Blackflash Chain Timing (s)']
      local seconds=tonumber(if type(saved)=='table' then saved.Value else saved)
      if seconds and seconds==seconds and seconds>=0.05 and seconds<=0.4 then
        local ok=pcall(function()
          chain.setWindow(seconds,'config')
          if controller.ui and type(controller.ui.syncBlackflashTiming)=='function' then controller.ui.syncBlackflashTiming() end
        end)
        if ok then applied+=1 end
      end
      return applied
    end
    if chain and type(timing)=='table' and timing.version==1 and type(timing.profiles)=='table'
      and type(timing.manualOverride)=='boolean' and type(chain.importProfiles)=='function'
      and type(chain.setWindow)=='function' and type(chain.useProfiles)=='function' then
      local manual=tonumber(timing.manualWindow)
      if timing.manualOverride and (not manual or manual~=manual or manual<0.05 or manual>0.4) then return applied end
      local ok=pcall(function()
        chain.importProfiles(timing)
        if timing.method=='Hop' or timing.method=='Side' then
          local method=controller.entries['Automatic/Blackflash Chain Method']
          if method and method.widget and type(method.widget.Set)=='function' then method.widget.Set(timing.method,true)
          elseif type(chain.setMethod)=='function' then chain.setMethod(timing.method) end
        end
        if timing.manualOverride then chain.setWindow(manual,'config') else chain.useProfiles() end
        local requestDelay=tonumber(timing.requestDelay)
        if requestDelay and requestDelay==requestDelay and requestDelay>=0.05 and requestDelay<=0.4 and type(chain.setRequestDelay)=='function' then chain.setRequestDelay(requestDelay) end
        if controller.ui and type(controller.ui.syncBlackflashTiming)=='function' then controller.ui.syncBlackflashTiming() end
      end)
      if ok then applied+=1 end
    end
    return applied
  end
  function controller.refreshConfigProfiles()
    local store,widgets=controller.configStore,controller.configProfileWidgets
    if not store or not widgets then return end
    local names=store.listProfiles()
    if #names==0 then names={"Current"} end
    controller.configProfileUpdating=true
    widgets.dropdownConfig.Options=names
    if type(widgets.dropdown.SetOptions)=='function' then
      local ok,message=pcall(widgets.dropdown.SetOptions,names)
      if not ok then controller.lastConfigMessage='Cannot refresh saved configurations: '..tostring(message) end
    end
    local selected=if table.find(names,store.selectedName) then store.selectedName else names[1]
    controller.selectedSavedConfig=selected
    if type(widgets.dropdown.Set)=='function' then pcall(widgets.dropdown.Set,selected,false) end
    controller.configProfileUpdating=false
  end
  function controller.createConfigProfiles(tab)
    if controller.configProfileWidgets then return end
    local widgets: any={}
    controller.configProfileWidgets=widgets
    controller.configNameDraft='Current'
    local function result(ok,action,buttonName,failureMessage)
      local store=controller.configStore
      controller.lastConfigMessage=if ok then action else failureMessage or (store and (store.lastProfileError or store.lastError)) or 'Local configuration storage is not ready'
      local entry=controller.entries['Settings/'..buttonName]
      if entry and entry.row then
        for _,label in entry.row:GetDescendants() do
          if label:IsA('TextLabel') and label:GetAttribute('WidgetType')=='TextMuted' then
            label.Text,label.Visible=tostring(controller.lastConfigMessage),true
          end
        end
      end
      if not ok and type(host.warn)=='function' then host.warn('Shenaniganism: '..tostring(controller.lastConfigMessage)) end
      return ok
    end
    controller.reportConfigResult=function(ok,message,buttonName)
      return result(ok,message,buttonName,if not ok then message else nil)
    end
    widgets.name=tab:CreateInput({Name='Config Name',Description='Name the complete setup to save locally. Executor files: Shenaniganism.settings.json and Shenaniganism.configs.json.',Default='Current',NoConfig=true,ConfigManager=true,Callback=function(value)
      controller.configNameDraft=tostring(value)
    end})
    widgets.dropdownConfig={Name='Saved Configs',Description='Choose a profile, then press Load Saved Config.',Options={'Current'},Default='Current',NoConfig=true,ConfigManager=true,Callback=function(value)
      if controller.configProfileUpdating then return end
      controller.selectedSavedConfig=value
      local store=controller.configStore
      if store then store.selectProfile(value) end
      if widgets.name and type(widgets.name.Set)=='function' then widgets.name.Set(value,false) end
      controller.configNameDraft=value
    end}
    widgets.dropdown=tab:CreateDropdown(widgets.dropdownConfig)
    widgets.save=tab:CreateButton({Name='Save Config',Description='Save all current settings under Config Name.',NoConfig=true,ConfigManager=true,Callback=function()
      local store=controller.configStore
      local name=if widgets.name and type(widgets.name.Get)=='function' then widgets.name.Get() else controller.configNameDraft
      local ok=store and store.saveProfile(name)
      if ok then
        controller.configNameDraft=store.selectedName
        if type(widgets.name.Set)=='function' then widgets.name.Set(store.selectedName,false) end
        controller.refreshConfigProfiles()
      end
      return result(ok==true,'Saved '..tostring(store and store.selectedName or name),'Save Config')
    end})
    widgets.load=tab:CreateButton({Name='Load Saved Config',Description='Apply every setting from the selected saved profile.',NoConfig=true,ConfigManager=true,Callback=function()
      local store=controller.configStore
      local name=controller.selectedSavedConfig
      if widgets.dropdown and type(widgets.dropdown.Get)=='function' then name=widgets.dropdown.Get() end
      return result(store and store.loadProfile(name)==true,'Loaded '..tostring(name),'Load Saved Config')
    end})
    widgets.delete=tab:CreateButton({Name='Delete Saved Config',Description='Delete the selected named profile. Current automatic settings are preserved.',NoConfig=true,ConfigManager=true,Callback=function()
      local store=controller.configStore
      local name=if widgets.dropdown and type(widgets.dropdown.Get)=='function' then widgets.dropdown.Get() else controller.selectedSavedConfig
      local ok=store and store.deleteProfile(name)
      if ok then
        controller.configNameDraft=store.selectedName
        if widgets.name and type(widgets.name.Set)=='function' then widgets.name.Set(store.selectedName,false) end
        controller.refreshConfigProfiles()
      end
      return result(ok==true,'Deleted '..tostring(name),'Delete Saved Config')
    end})
  end
  function controller.attachConfigStore(store)
    controller.configStore=store
    if not controller.configProfileWidgets and controller.tabs and controller.tabs.Settings then
      controller.createConfigProfiles(controller.tabs.Settings.tab)
      local group=controller.ui and controller.ui.groups and controller.ui.groups['Settings/Configuration']
      if group then
        for _,record in controller.rows or {} do
          if record.config and record.config.ConfigManager and record.row then
            group.count=(group.count or 0)+1
            record.row.Parent,record.row.LayoutOrder,record.destination=group.contents,group.count,'Settings'
            table.insert(group.records,record)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    controller.refreshConfigProfiles()
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.ready then controller.ui.refresh() end
  end
  local function connect(signal: any, callback: any): any
    local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
    controller.connections[#controller.connections + 1] = connection
    return connection
  end
  connect(game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped,controller.updateCameraOnlyRotation)
  connect(players.LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving,controller.releaseCameraOnlyRotation)
  local function owned(class)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    object:SetAttribute("CullingModern", true)
    controller.instances[#controller.instances + 1] = object
    return object
  end
  function controller.formatSlider(widget,precision)
    local frame=widget.Frame
    local label=widget.ValueLabel or (frame and frame:FindFirstChildOfClass('TextLabel'))
    if not label then return end
    local updating=false
    local function format()
      if updating or not controller.alive or not label.Parent then return end
      local value=tonumber(widget.Get())
      if value then
        local text=string.format('%.'..tostring(precision or 2)..'f',value)
        if label.Text~=text then updating=true;label.Text=text;updating=false end
      end
    end
    connect(label:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'),format)
    format()
  end
  function controller.setExactValue(entry,text)
    local value=tonumber(text)
    if not value or value~=value or value==math.huge or value==-math.huge then return false,'Enter a finite number.' end
    local config=entry.config or {}
    local minimum,maximum=tonumber(config.Min),tonumber(config.Max)
    if (minimum and value<minimum) or (maximum and value>maximum) then
      return false,'Range: '..(if minimum then string.format('%.2f',minimum) else '-inf')..' to '..(if maximum then string.format('%.2f',maximum) else 'inf')
    end
    local ok,message=pcall(entry.widget.Set,if entry.kind=='CreateInput' then tostring(value) else value,true)
    return ok,if ok then nil else tostring(message)
  end
  function controller.beginValueReset(entry,object,region,refresh)
    if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or not controller.alive or controller.recording
      or (controller.ui and controller.ui.editor and controller.ui.editor.enabled) then return false end
    local original=entry.defaultNumericValue
    if not original or original~=original or math.abs(original)==math.huge then return false end
    if controller.valueResetInput==object then return controller.valueResetSecond==true end
    local point=object.Position
    if region then
      local position,size=region.AbsolutePosition,region.AbsoluteSize
      if point.X<position.X or point.Y<position.Y or point.X>position.X+size.X or point.Y>position.Y+size.Y then return false end
    end
    local now=os.clock()
    local previous=controller.lastValueClick
    local second=previous and previous.entry==entry and now-previous.at<=0.35
      and math.abs(point.X-previous.x)<=6 and math.abs(point.Y-previous.y)<=6
    controller.valueResetInput,controller.valueResetSecond=object,second==true
    controller.valueResetPending={entry=entry,at=now,x=point.X,y=point.Y,second=second==true,refresh=refresh}
    return second==true
  end
  function controller.moveValueReset(object)
    local pending=controller.valueResetPending
    if pending and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
      if math.abs(object.Position.X-pending.x)>6 or math.abs(object.Position.Y-pending.y)>6 then pending.dragged=true end
    end
  end
  function controller.finishValueReset(object)
    if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
    local pending=controller.valueResetPending
    controller.valueResetPending=nil
    if not pending then return end
    local now=os.clock()
    if pending.dragged or now-pending.at>0.35 or not controller.alive or controller.recording
      or (controller.ui and controller.ui.editor and controller.ui.editor.enabled) then
      controller.lastValueClick=nil;return
    end
    if not pending.second then
      controller.lastValueClick={entry=pending.entry,at=now,x=pending.x,y=pending.y};return
    end
    controller.lastValueClick=nil
    -- Apply after the original slider's release handler so it cannot overwrite
    -- the reset with the pointer position. The normal setter persists the value.
    host.task.defer(function()
      if not controller.alive then return end
      local focused=input:GetFocusedTextBox()
      if pending.entry.kind=='CreateInput' and focused then focused:ReleaseFocus(false) end
      local ok=controller.setExactValue(pending.entry,tostring(pending.entry.defaultNumericValue))
      if ok and pending.refresh then pending.refresh() end
    end)
  end
  function controller.openValuePopup(entry,preserveMini)
    preserveMini=preserveMini==true and controller.popup and controller.popup.Name=='CullingQuickSettings'
    if controller.closeBindingPopup then controller.closeBindingPopup() end
    if preserveMini then controller.closeValuePopup() else controller.closePopup() end
    local initial=tonumber(entry.widget.Get())
    if not controller.panel or not controller.alive or not initial then return end
    local popup=owned('Frame')
    popup.Name,popup.Size,popup.BackgroundColor3,popup.BorderSizePixel='CullingExactValuePopup',UDim2.fromOffset(272,166),Color3.fromRGB(24,27,34),0
    local root=if controller.getPopupRoot then controller.getPopupRoot() else controller.panel.Root
    popup.ZIndex,popup.Active,popup.Parent=12020,true,root
    local point,origin,view=input:GetMouseLocation(),root.AbsolutePosition,root.AbsoluteSize
    popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(point.X-origin.X,0,math.max(0,view.X-272)),math.clamp(point.Y-origin.Y,0,math.max(0,view.Y-166)))
    local connections
    local function close() if preserveMini then controller.closeValuePopup() else controller.closePopup() end end
    if preserveMini then
      controller.valuePopup=popup;controller.valuePopupConnections={};connections=controller.valuePopupConnections
    else controller.popup=popup;connections=controller.popupConnections end
    local rounding=owned('UICorner');rounding.CornerRadius,rounding.Parent=host.UDim.new(0,8),popup
    local function make(class,name,text,x,y,width,height)
      local object=owned(class)
      object.Name,object.Text,object.Position,object.Size=name,text,UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
      object.Font,object.TextSize,object.TextColor3=Enum.Font.Gotham,12,Color3.fromRGB(230,237,246)
      object.BackgroundColor3,object.BackgroundTransparency,object.BorderSizePixel=Color3.fromRGB(42,48,60),if class=='TextLabel' then 1 else 0,0
      object.ZIndex,object.Parent=12022,popup
      return object
    end
    local title=make('TextLabel','Title',entry.displayName or entry.name,14,7,244,24)
    title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,24)
    title.TextXAlignment,title.TextTruncate=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    local initialText=string.format('%.'..tostring((entry.config or {}).Precision or 2)..'f',initial)
    local box=make('TextBox','ExactValue',initialText,14,38,244,30)
    box.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,30)
    box.ClearTextOnFocus,box.MultiLine,box.TextSize=false,false,14
    local config=entry.config or {}
    local range=if config.Min and config.Max then string.format('Range: %.2f to %.2f',config.Min,config.Max) else 'Enter an exact numeric value.'
    local status=make('TextLabel','Status',range,14,74,244,25)
    status.Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,1,-139)
    status.TextXAlignment,status.TextSize=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,11
    local function apply()
      local ok,message=controller.setExactValue(entry,if box.Text==initialText then tostring(initial) else box.Text)
      if ok then close()
      else status.Text,status.TextColor3=message,Color3.fromRGB(255,125,125) end
    end
    local cancel=make('TextButton','Cancel','Cancel',14,112,116,28)
    local accept=make('TextButton','Apply','Apply',142,112,116,28)
    cancel.Position,cancel.Size=UDim2.new(0,14,1,-50),UDim2.new(.5,-20,0,28)
    accept.Position,accept.Size=UDim2.new(.5,6,1,-50),UDim2.new(.5,-20,0,28)
    table.insert(connections,cancel.Activated:Connect(close))
    table.insert(connections,accept.Activated:Connect(apply))
    table.insert(connections,box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed) if enterPressed then apply() end end))
    table.insert(connections,box.InputBegan:Connect(function(object) if object.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then close() end end))
    controller.attachPopupResize(popup,272,166,connections)
    host.task.defer(function() if (controller.popup==popup or controller.valuePopup==popup) and box.Parent then box:CaptureFocus() end end)
  end
  function controller.bindValueEditor(entry)
    if entry.valueEditorBound or not entry.row then return end
    entry.valueEditorBound=true
    controller.valueEditorEntries=controller.valueEditorEntries or {}
    controller.valueEditorEntries[entry.row]=entry
    if entry.widget.ValueLabel then controller.valueEditorEntries[entry.widget.ValueLabel]=entry end
    local function begin(object)
      if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        controller.beginValueReset(entry,object,entry.widget.ValueLabel or entry.widget.Frame or entry.row)
        return
      end
      if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or controller.recording or controller.lastValueEditorInput==object then return end
      controller.lastValueEditorInput=object
      if controller.textStyle and controller.textStyle.openForEntry(entry) then
        -- Font controls open their own size and appearance settings together.
      elseif entry.name=='Block Range' and controller.projectilePrediction then controller.openMiniPopup(entry,controller.relatedSettings(entry))
      else controller.openValuePopup(entry) end
      host.task.defer(function()
        if controller.lastValueEditorInput==object then controller.lastValueEditorInput=nil end
      end)
    end
    entry.openExactValue=function() controller.openValuePopup(entry) end
    entry.exactValueInput=begin
    entry.row.Active=true
    connect(entry.row.InputBegan,begin)
    for _,object in entry.row:GetDescendants() do
      if object:IsA('GuiObject') then connect(object.InputBegan,begin) end
    end
  end
  function controller.numericAtPoint(point)
    local root=controller.panel and controller.panel.Root
    local container=root and root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('BasePlayerGui')
    if not container then return nil end
    for _,popup in {controller.popup,controller.bindingPopup,controller.valuePopup,controller.ui and controller.ui.colorPopup} do
      if popup and popup.Parent then
        local position,size=popup.AbsolutePosition,popup.AbsoluteSize
        if point.X>=position.X and point.X<=position.X+size.X and point.Y>=position.Y and point.Y<=position.Y+size.Y then return nil end
      end
    end
    for _,object in container:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(point.X,point.Y) do
      if controller.popupLayer and object:IsDescendantOf(controller.popupLayer) then return nil end
      if not object:IsDescendantOf(root) then continue end
      local node=object
      while node and node~=root do
        local entry=controller.valueEditorEntries and controller.valueEditorEntries[node]
        if entry then return entry end
        node=node.Parent
      end
      if object:IsA('GuiButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then return nil end
    end
    return nil
  end
  function controller.captureScale(source,cells)
    controller.scaleCells=controller.scaleCells or {}
    controller.scaleCells[source]=cells
  end
  function controller.attachScaleEditor()
    local cells=controller.scaleCells
    local drag,ending=cells and cells[23],cells and cells[24]
    if not drag or not ending or controller.scaleEntry then return end
    local function get(cell) return cell and cell[3][cell[2]] end
    local function put(cell,value) if cell then cell[3][cell[2]]=value end end
    local track,fill,label,scale=get(drag[1]),get(drag[2]),get(drag[4]),get(ending[2])
    if not track or not fill or not label or not scale then return end
    local widget={Frame=track,ValueLabel=label,Get=function() return get(drag[3]) end}
    widget.Set=function(value,_emit)
      value=math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 1,0.5,1.5)
      put(drag[0],false);put(ending[0],false)
      put(drag[3],value);put(ending[3],value)
      local interaction=get(ending[1])
      if type(interaction)=='table' then interaction.IsInteracting=false end
      fill.Size=UDim2.new(value-0.5,0,1,0)
      scale.Scale=value
      label.Text=string.format('GUI SCALE: %.2f',value)
    end
    label.Visible=true
    track.Position,track.Size=UDim2.new(.3,0,0.5,-3.5),UDim2.new(.7,-270,0,7)
    controller.register('GUI Scale','Settings','CreateSlider',{Min=0.5,Max=1.5,Default=1},widget,track)
    local entry=controller.entries['Settings/GUI Scale']
    controller.scaleEntry=entry
    connect(label.InputBegan,entry.exactValueInput)
  end
  local function same(a, b)
    return (((a ~= nil) and (b ~= nil)) and (a.kind == b.kind)) and (a.name == b.name)
  end
  function controller.inputBinding(object)
    if (object.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard) and (object.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) then
      return {kind = "Keyboard", name = object.KeyCode.Name}
    end
    if object.UserInputType.Name:match("^MouseButton[123]$") then
      return {kind = "Mouse", name = object.UserInputType.Name}
    end
    return nil
  end
  function controller.bindingsFor(entry: any): {any}
    local saved = storage[entry.id]
    if saved ~= nil then
      if saved.kind then
        saved = if saved.kind == "None" then {} else {saved}
        storage[entry.id] = saved
      end
      return saved
    end
    local value
    if entry.defaultRole then value = bindings.get(entry.defaultRole)
    elseif entry.defaultKey then value = {kind = "Keyboard", name = entry.defaultKey} end
    return if value then {value} else {}
  end
  -- Begin native feature keybind modes.
  controller.heldKeybinds={}
  controller.keybindDown={}
  local function keybindToken(value)
    return value and (value.kind..':'..value.name) or nil
  end
  function controller.supportsHold(entry)
    return entry and entry.kind=='CreateToggle' and entry.config and entry.config.AllowHoldKeybind==true
      and not entry.legacy and not entry.action
  end
  function controller.bindingMode(binding)
    return if binding and binding.mode=='Hold' then 'Hold' else 'Toggle'
  end
  function controller.hasHoldBinding(entry)
    if not controller.supportsHold(entry) then return false end
    for _,binding in controller.bindingsFor(entry) do
      if controller.bindingMode(binding)=='Hold' then return true end
    end
    return false
  end
  local function modifierHeld(binding,depth)
    if not binding then return true end
    if (depth or 0)>4 then return false end
    local ok,down=pcall(function()
      if binding.kind=='Keyboard' then return input:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[binding.name]) end
      if binding.kind=='Mouse' then return input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType[binding.name]) end
      return false
    end)
    return ok and down==true and modifierHeld(binding.modifier,(depth or 0)+1)
  end
  function controller.matchingBinding(entry,object)
    local value=controller.inputBinding(object)
    for _,binding in controller.bindingsFor(entry) do
      if same(value,binding) and modifierHeld(binding.modifier,0) then return binding end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function bindingUses(binding,value,depth)
    if not binding or (depth or 0)>4 then return false end
    return same(binding,value) or bindingUses(binding.modifier,value,(depth or 0)+1)
  end
  function controller.dispatchNativeBinding(entry,value)
    entry.running=value
    if not value then controller.stopEntry(entry) end
    local callback=entry.config and entry.config.SourceCallback or entry.callback
    local ok,message=pcall(function()if callback then callback(value) end end)
    if not ok then controller.lastKeybindError=tostring(message) end
    return ok
  end
  function controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,emit)
    local held=controller.heldKeybinds[entry]
    if not held then return false end
    controller.heldKeybinds[entry]=nil
    entry.running=false
    if emit~=false then controller.dispatchNativeBinding(entry,false) end
    return true
  end
  function controller.cancelHeldBindings()
    local entries={}
    for entry in controller.heldKeybinds do table.insert(entries,entry) end
    for _,entry in entries do controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,true) end
    table.clear(controller.keybindDown)
  end
  function controller.beginHeldBinding(entry,binding)
    if not controller.supportsHold(entry) then return false end
    local held=controller.heldKeybinds[entry]
    if not held then
      held={bindings={}}
      controller.heldKeybinds[entry]=held
      held.bindings[keybindToken(binding)]=binding
      if not controller.dispatchNativeBinding(entry,true) then
        if controller.heldKeybinds[entry]==held then controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,true) end
        return false
      end
      if controller.heldKeybinds[entry]~=held then
        -- A yielding native setter cannot replay activation after keyup/manual input.
        controller.dispatchNativeBinding(entry,entry.running==true)
        return false
      end
    end
    held.bindings[keybindToken(binding)]=binding
    return true
  end
  function controller.releaseHeldInput(object)
    local value=controller.inputBinding(object)
    if not value then return end
    controller.keybindDown[keybindToken(value)]=nil
    local finished={}
    for entry,held in controller.heldKeybinds do
      for token,binding in held.bindings do
        if bindingUses(binding,value,0) then held.bindings[token]=nil end
      end
      if next(held.bindings)==nil then table.insert(finished,entry) end
    end
    for _,entry in finished do controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,true) end
  end
  function controller.setBindingMode(entry: any,slot: number,mode: string): boolean
    if not controller.supportsHold(entry) or (mode~='Toggle' and mode~='Hold') then return false end
    local list=table.clone((controller.bindingsFor :: (any) -> {any})(entry))
    if not list[slot] then return false end
    controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,true)
    local value=table.clone(list[slot]);value.mode=mode;list[slot]=value
    storage[entry.id]=list
    local armed=entry.widget and entry.widget.Get and entry.widget.Get()==true
    if armed then controller.dispatchNativeBinding(entry,not controller.hasHoldBinding(entry)) end
    return true
  end
  -- End native feature keybind modes.
  function controller.bindingFor(entry)
    return controller.bindingsFor(entry)[1]
  end
  function controller.bindingLabel(value,depth)
    if not value or (depth or 0)>4 then return '' end
    local modifier=value.modifier and controller.bindingLabel(value.modifier,(depth or 0)+1)
    return (if modifier and modifier~='' then modifier..' + ' else '')..value.name
  end
  function controller.bindingText(entry)
    local names = {}
    for _, value in controller.bindingsFor(entry) do names[#names + 1] = controller.bindingLabel(value) end
    return if #names > 0 then table.concat(names, ", ") else "Unbound"
  end
  function controller.stopEntry(entry)
    controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,false)
    if entry.name == "Flight" and environment.SetFlight then environment.SetFlight(false)
    elseif entry.name == "Activate Lock On" then
      if controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.releaseSelectedLock then controller.autoLock.releaseSelectedLock('Lock key binding removed')
      elseif environment.CleanLock then environment.CleanLock() end
    end
    entry.running = false
  end
  function controller.getPopupRoot()
    if controller.popupLayer and controller.popupLayer.Parent then return controller.popupLayer end
    local original=controller.panel.Root
    local layer=owned('ScreenGui')
    layer.Name,layer.ResetOnSpawn,layer.Enabled='CullingMiniMenus',false,true
    layer.IgnoreGuiInset=original.IgnoreGuiInset
    layer.DisplayOrder=(original.DisplayOrder or 0)+10
    layer.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    layer.Parent=original.Parent
    controller.popupLayer=layer
    return layer
  end
  function controller.closeValuePopup()
    if controller.valuePopup then controller.valuePopup:Destroy();controller.valuePopup=nil end
    for _,connection in controller.valuePopupConnections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
    controller.valuePopupConnections={}
  end
  function controller.cancelBindingRecording()
    local recording=controller.recording
    controller.recording=nil
    if recording and recording.restore then recording.restore() end
  end
  function controller.closeBindingPopup()
    controller.cancelBindingRecording()
    local popup=controller.bindingPopup
    controller.bindingPopup,controller.bindingPopupEntry=nil,nil
    if popup then popup:Destroy() end
    for _,connection in controller.bindingPopupConnections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
    controller.bindingPopupConnections={}
  end
  function controller.closePopup()
    if controller.closeBindingPopup then controller.closeBindingPopup() end
    controller.closeValuePopup()
    controller.recording = nil
    if controller.popup then controller.popup:Destroy()
    controller.popup = nil end
    for _, connection in controller.popupConnections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
    controller.popupConnections = {}
    controller.popupEntry,controller.popupSearchRecord=nil,nil
  end
  function controller.keybindEntry(record)
    if not record or record.submenuRecords then return nil end
    local id=record.id or record.tab and (record.tab..'/'..record.name)
    local entry=id and controller.entries[id]
    if not entry or not entry.eligible or entry.widget~=record.widget
      or entry.config and (entry.config.ConfigManager or entry.config.CanonicalHidden) then return nil end
    return entry
  end
  function controller.popupContains(popup,point)
    if not popup or not popup.Parent or not point then return false end
    local position,size=popup.AbsolutePosition,popup.AbsoluteSize
    return point.X>=position.X and point.X<=position.X+size.X and point.Y>=position.Y and point.Y<=position.Y+size.Y
  end
  function controller.bindMiniKeybind(record,row,popup,connections,beforeOpen,parentMenu)
    local entry=controller.keybindEntry(record)
    if not entry then return false end
    row:SetAttribute('CullingKeybindEntryId',entry.id)
    local lastInput
    local function open(object)
      if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or controller.recording or lastInput==object
        or not controller.alive or controller.popup~=popup then return end
      lastInput=object
      if beforeOpen then beforeOpen() end
      controller.valueResetPending,controller.lastValueClick=nil,nil
      if entry.config and entry.config.GeneralESPOffscreenMenu and parentMenu and not parentMenu.entry.GeneralESPOffscreenRoot then
        controller.openMiniPopup({id=entry.id,name=entry.name,displayName=entry.displayName or entry.config.DisplayName,
          config=entry.config,parentMenu=parentMenu,GeneralESPOffscreenRoot=true},controller.relatedSettings(entry))
        return
      end
      controller.openPopup(entry,true)
      host.task.defer(function() if lastInput==object then lastInput=nil end end)
    end
    row.Active=true
    table.insert(connections,row.InputBegan:Connect(open))
    for _,object in row:GetDescendants() do
      if object:IsA('GuiObject') then object.Active=true;table.insert(connections,object.InputBegan:Connect(open)) end
    end
    return true
  end
  local bindingModifiers={LeftControl=true,RightControl=true,LeftShift=true,RightShift=true,LeftAlt=true,RightAlt=true,LeftSuper=true,RightSuper=true}
  function controller.beginBindingRecording(entry,slot,button,popup)
    controller.cancelBindingRecording()
    controller.cancelHeldBindings()
    local focused=input:GetFocusedTextBox()
    if focused then focused:ReleaseFocus() end
    local text,color=button.Text,button.BackgroundColor3
    local recording={entry=entry,slot=slot,popup=popup,modifiers={}}
    recording.restore=function()
      if button.Parent then button.Text,button.BackgroundColor3=text,color end
    end
    controller.recording=recording
    button.Text,button.BackgroundColor3='Press a key...',Color3.fromRGB(32,83,98)
  end
  function controller.commitBindingRecording(recording,value,object)
    if controller.recording~=recording then return end
    local previous,count=nil,0
    for _,name in {'LeftControl','RightControl','LeftShift','RightShift','LeftAlt','RightAlt','LeftSuper','RightSuper'} do
      if name~=value.name then
        local ok,held=pcall(function() return input:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[name]) end)
        if ok and held and count<4 then previous={kind='Keyboard',name=name,modifier=previous};count+=1 end
      end
    end
    value.modifier=previous
    controller.recordedInput=object
    if recording.entry then controller.setBinding(recording.entry,value,recording.slot)
    else controller.setBinding(recording,value) end
  end
  function controller.dismissPopupInput(object)
    if controller.recording then return false end
    if object.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
      if controller.bindingPopup then controller.closeBindingPopup()
      elseif controller.valuePopup then controller.closeValuePopup()
      elseif controller.popup then controller.closePopup() else return false end
      return true
    end
    if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return false end
    if controller.bindingPopup then
      if controller.popupContains(controller.bindingPopup,object.Position) then return false end
      controller.closeBindingPopup();return true
    end
    if controller.popup and not controller.popupContains(controller.popup,object.Position)
      and not controller.popupContains(controller.valuePopup,object.Position)
      and not (controller.generalESPPreview and controller.generalESPPreview.containsPoint and controller.generalESPPreview.containsPoint(object.Position)) then controller.closePopup();return true end
    return false
  end
  function controller.attachPopupResize(popup, minimumWidth, minimumHeight, connections, beforeResize, geometryKey)
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.isMiniSurface and controller.ui.isMiniSurface(popup) then
      popup:SetAttribute('CullingMiniMenuSurface',true)
    end
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.styleSurface then controller.ui.styleSurface(popup,true) end
    connections=connections or controller.popupConnections
    local root=popup.Parent
    if not root then return end
    controller.popupSizes=controller.popupSizes or {}
    controller.popupPositions=controller.popupPositions or {}
    geometryKey=geometryKey or popup.Name
    popup:SetAttribute('CullingPopupGeometryKey',geometryKey)
    minimumWidth,minimumHeight=math.floor(minimumWidth*.75),math.floor(minimumHeight*.75)
    local geometryDirty=false
    local function commitGeometry()
      if geometryDirty then
        geometryDirty=false
        if windowControls and windowControls.geometryChanged then windowControls.geometryChanged() end
      end
    end
    local open,gesture=true,nil
    local handle=owned('TextButton')
    handle.Name,handle.Text,handle.TextSize='ResizeHandle','\226\151\162',12
    handle.Font,handle.TextColor3=Enum.Font.Gotham,Color3.fromRGB(139,154,177)
    handle.BackgroundTransparency,handle.BorderSizePixel,handle.AutoButtonColor,handle.Active=1,0,false,true
    handle.Size,handle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(26,26),UDim2.new(1,-27,1,-27)
    handle.ZIndex,handle.Parent=popup.ZIndex+8,popup
    popup.Active=true
    local header=owned('TextButton')
    header.Name,header.Text,header.BackgroundTransparency,header.BorderSizePixel='MoveHandle','',1,0
    header.AutoButtonColor,header.Active,header.Size,header.Position=false,true,UDim2.new(1,-36,0,34),UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
    header.ZIndex,header.Parent=popup.ZIndex+1,popup
    local edgeE,edgeS=owned('Frame'),owned('Frame')
    for _,edge in {edgeE,edgeS} do
        edge.BackgroundTransparency,edge.BorderSizePixel,edge.Active=1,0,true
        edge.ZIndex,edge.Parent=popup.ZIndex+7,popup
    end
    edgeE.Name,edgeE.Size,edgeE.Position='ResizeEdgeE',UDim2.new(0,10,1,-64),UDim2.new(1,-10,0,40)
    edgeS.Name,edgeS.Size,edgeS.Position='ResizeEdgeS',UDim2.new(1,-64,0,10),UDim2.new(0,32,1,-10)
    local tracked={[popup]=true,[handle]=true,[edgeE]=true,[edgeS]=true}
    for _,object in popup:GetDescendants() do tracked[object]=true end
    local function connectPopup(signal,callback) table.insert(connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    local function scale()
      return math.max(.01,popup.AbsoluteSize.X/math.max(1,popup.Size.X.Offset)),math.max(.01,popup.AbsoluteSize.Y/math.max(1,popup.Size.Y.Offset))
    end
    local function fit(width,height,reposition)
      if not open or not popup.Parent then return end
      local sx,sy=scale()
      local origin,view=root.AbsolutePosition,root.AbsoluteSize
      local x,y=(popup.AbsolutePosition.X-origin.X)/sx,(popup.AbsolutePosition.Y-origin.Y)/sy
      local viewWidth,viewHeight=math.max(1,view.X/sx),math.max(1,view.Y/sy)
      if reposition then x=math.clamp(x,0,math.max(0,viewWidth-width));y=math.clamp(y,0,math.max(0,viewHeight-height)) end
      local availableWidth,availableHeight=math.max(1,viewWidth-x),math.max(1,viewHeight-y)
      width=math.clamp(width,math.min(minimumWidth,availableWidth),availableWidth)
      height=math.clamp(height,math.min(minimumHeight,availableHeight),availableHeight)
      popup.Position,popup.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
      return width,height
    end
    local savedPosition=controller.popupPositions[geometryKey]
    if savedPosition then popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(savedPosition.X,savedPosition.Y) end
    local saved=controller.popupSizes[geometryKey] or controller.popupSizes[popup.Name]
    local persisted=windowControls and windowControls.popupSize and (windowControls.popupSize(geometryKey) or windowControls.popupSize(popup.Name))
    fit(if persisted then persisted.Width elseif saved then saved.X else popup.Size.X.Offset,if persisted then persisted.Height elseif saved then saved.Y else popup.Size.Y.Offset,true)
    local function beginMove(object)
      if not open or not controller.alive or controller.recording then return end
      if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
      local point,position,size=object.Position,popup.AbsolutePosition,popup.AbsoluteSize
      if point.X<position.X or point.X>position.X+size.X-36 or point.Y<position.Y or point.Y>position.Y+34 then return end
      if beforeResize then beforeResize() end
      controller.valueResetPending,controller.lastValueClick=nil,nil
      local sx,sy=scale()
      gesture={moving=true,input=object,touch=object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch,x=point.X,y=point.Y,px=popup.Position.X.Offset,py=popup.Position.Y.Offset,sx=sx,sy=sy}
    end
    connectPopup(header.InputBegan,beginMove)
    -- Title labels sit above the header hit area; they share the same gesture.
    for _,object in popup:GetChildren() do
      if object:IsA('TextLabel') and object.Position.Y.Scale==0 and object.Position.Y.Offset<=10 then
        object.Active=true
        connectPopup(object.InputBegan,beginMove)
      end
    end
    local function beginResize(lockX,lockY)
      return function(object)
        if not open or not controller.alive or controller.recording then return end
        if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if beforeResize then beforeResize() end
        controller.valueResetPending,controller.lastValueClick=nil,nil
        local sx,sy=scale()
        gesture={input=object,touch=object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch,x=object.Position.X,y=object.Position.Y,width=popup.Size.X.Offset,height=popup.Size.Y.Offset,sx=sx,sy=sy,lockX=lockX,lockY=lockY}
      end
    end
    connectPopup(handle.InputBegan,beginResize(false,false))
    connectPopup(edgeE.InputBegan,beginResize(false,true))
    connectPopup(edgeS.InputBegan,beginResize(true,false))
    connectPopup(input.InputChanged,function(object)
      if not gesture or not open then return end
      if (gesture.touch and object~=gesture.input) or (not gesture.touch and object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then return end
      if gesture.moving then
        local width,height=popup.Size.X.Offset,popup.Size.Y.Offset
        local x=math.clamp(gesture.px+(object.Position.X-gesture.x)/gesture.sx,0,math.max(0,root.AbsoluteSize.X/gesture.sx-width))
        local y=math.clamp(gesture.py+(object.Position.Y-gesture.y)/gesture.sy,0,math.max(0,root.AbsoluteSize.Y/gesture.sy-height))
        popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
        controller.popupPositions[geometryKey]={X=x,Y=y}
        return
      end
      local width,height=fit(gesture.width+(if gesture.lockX then 0 else (object.Position.X-gesture.x)/gesture.sx),gesture.height+(if gesture.lockY then 0 else (object.Position.Y-gesture.y)/gesture.sy),false)
      if width then
        controller.popupSizes[geometryKey]={X=width,Y=height}
        if windowControls and windowControls.rememberPopupSize and windowControls.rememberPopupSize(geometryKey,width,height) then geometryDirty=true end
      end
    end)
    connectPopup(input.InputEnded,function(object)
      if gesture and ((gesture.touch and object==gesture.input) or (not gesture.touch and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then gesture=nil;commitGeometry() end
    end)
    connectPopup(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() gesture=nil;commitGeometry() end)
    connectPopup(root:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),function() fit(popup.Size.X.Offset,popup.Size.Y.Offset,true) end)
    connectPopup(popup.Destroying,function()
      commitGeometry()
      open,gesture=false,nil
      for index=#controller.instances,1,-1 do if tracked[controller.instances[index]] then table.remove(controller.instances,index) end end
      table.clear(tracked)
    end)
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.styleSurface then controller.ui.styleSurface(popup,true) end
  end
  function controller.setBinding(entry, value, slot)
    local current: {any} = controller.bindingsFor(entry)
    local hadHold=controller.hasHoldBinding(entry)
    controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,true)
    local list = table.clone(current)
    if value then
      value=table.clone(value)
      value.mode=value.mode or (slot and current[slot] and current[slot].mode) or 'Toggle'
    end
    if slot then
      if value then list[slot] = value elseif slot <= #list then table.remove(list, slot) end
    else list = if value then {value} else {} end
    storage[entry.id] = list
    controller.cancelBindingRecording()
    if controller.supportsHold(entry) and (hadHold or controller.hasHoldBinding(entry)) then
      -- Editing/removing a Hold binding changes who owns activation. Keep the
      -- saved checkbox, but immediately apply the resulting runtime mode.
      local armed=entry.widget and entry.widget.Get and entry.widget.Get()==true
      controller.dispatchNativeBinding(entry,armed and not controller.hasHoldBinding(entry))
    elseif #list == 0 and not controller.supportsHold(entry) then controller.stopEntry(entry) end
    if controller.bindingPopup then controller.openPopup(entry,true)
    elseif controller.popup and controller.popup.Name=='CullingKeybindPopup' then controller.openPopup(entry) end
  end
  function controller.openPopup(entry: any, preserveMini: boolean?)
    local nested=preserveMini==true and controller.popup and controller.popup.Name=='CullingQuickSettings'
    local oldPosition=if nested then controller.bindingPopup and controller.bindingPopup.Position else controller.popup and controller.popup.Position
    if nested then controller.closeBindingPopup();controller.closeValuePopup() else controller.closePopup() end
    if not controller.panel or not controller.alive then return end
    local screen = controller.getPopupRoot()
    local popup = owned("Frame")
    popup.Name = "CullingKeybindPopup"
    popup.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(248, 178)
    local point = input:GetMouseLocation()
    local origin, view = screen.AbsolutePosition, screen.AbsoluteSize
    popup.Position = oldPosition or UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(point.X-origin.X, 0, math.max(0, view.X-248)), math.clamp(point.Y-origin.Y, 0, math.max(0, view.Y-178)))
    popup.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 27, 34)
    popup.BorderSizePixel = 0
    popup.ZIndex, popup.Active = if nested then 12030 else 12000, true
    popup.Parent = screen
    popup:SetAttribute('CullingKeybindEntryId',entry.id)
    if nested then controller.bindingPopup,controller.bindingPopupEntry=popup,entry else controller.popup=popup end
    local connections=if nested then controller.bindingPopupConnections else controller.popupConnections
    local popupObjects={[popup]=true}
    local function popupOwned(class)
      local object=owned(class);popupObjects[object]=true;return object
    end
    local function refresh() controller.openPopup(entry,nested) end
    local corner = popupOwned("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 9)
    corner.Parent = popup
    local border = popupOwned("UIStroke")
    border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(66, 73, 86)
    border.Transparency = 0.3
    border.Parent = popup
    local function text(class, name, label, x, y, width, height)
      local object = popupOwned(class)
      object.Name, object.Text = name, label
      object.Size, object.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height), UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
      object.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 43, 54)
      object.BackgroundTransparency = if class == "TextLabel" then 1 else 0
      object.BorderSizePixel, object.TextSize = 0, 12
      object.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
      object.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(222, 229, 240)
      object.ZIndex, object.Parent = popup.ZIndex+2, popup
      if class == "TextButton" then
        local rounding = popupOwned("UICorner")
        rounding.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 5)
        rounding.Parent = object
      end
      return object
    end
    local function on(button, callback)
      local connection = button.Activated:Connect(callback)
      table.insert(connections, connection)
    end
    local title = text("TextLabel", "Title", entry.displayName or entry.name, 12, 5, 202, 27)
    title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-46,0,27)
    title.TextXAlignment, title.TextSize = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 13
    local close = text("TextButton", "Close", "x", 219, 7, 21, 21)
    close.Position=UDim2.new(1,-29,0,7)
    on(close, function() if nested then controller.closeBindingPopup() else controller.closePopup() end end)
    local list = controller.bindingsFor(entry)
    local scroll = popupOwned("ScrollingFrame")
    scroll.Name, scroll.Position, scroll.Size = "Bindings", UDim2.fromOffset(10, 37), UDim2.fromOffset(228, 83)
    scroll.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-95)
    scroll.BackgroundTransparency, scroll.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
    scroll.CanvasSize, scroll.ScrollBarThickness = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.max(1, #list)*31), 3
    scroll.ZIndex, scroll.Parent = popup.ZIndex+1, popup
    local slots = math.max(1, #list)
    local rowHeight=if controller.supportsHold(entry) then 56 else 31
    scroll.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,slots*rowHeight)
    local modeChoices
    for slot = 1, slots do
      local y = (slot-1)*rowHeight
      local label = text("TextLabel", "Slot"..slot, "Keybind "..slot, 0, y, 71, 27)
      label.TextXAlignment, label.Parent = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, scroll
      local record = text("TextButton", "Record"..slot, list[slot] and controller.bindingLabel(list[slot]) or "Record", 74, y, 121, 27)
      record.Size=UDim2.new(1,-107,0,27)
      record.Parent = scroll
      local clear = text("TextButton", "Clear"..slot, "x", 199, y, 25, 27)
      clear.Position=UDim2.new(1,-29,0,y)
      clear.Parent = scroll
      on(record, function()
        controller.beginBindingRecording(entry,slot,record,popup)
      end)
      on(clear, function() controller.setBinding(entry, nil, slot) end)
      if controller.supportsHold(entry) and list[slot] then
        local modeLabel=text('TextLabel','ModeLabel'..slot,'Mode',0,y+27,71,24)
        modeLabel.TextXAlignment,modeLabel.Parent=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,scroll
        local mode=text('TextButton','Mode'..slot,controller.bindingMode(list[slot])..'  \226\150\190',74,y+27,121,24)
        mode.Size,mode.Parent=UDim2.new(1,-107,0,24),scroll
        on(mode,function()
          if modeChoices then modeChoices:Destroy();modeChoices=nil;return end
          local position,size=mode.AbsolutePosition,mode.AbsoluteSize
          local sx=popup.AbsoluteSize.X/math.max(1,popup.Size.X.Offset)
          local sy=popup.AbsoluteSize.Y/math.max(1,popup.Size.Y.Offset)
          local x=(position.X-popup.AbsolutePosition.X)/sx
          local y=(position.Y-popup.AbsolutePosition.Y+size.Y)/sy
          if y+54>popup.Size.Y.Offset then y=(position.Y-popup.AbsolutePosition.Y)/sy-54 end
          modeChoices=popupOwned('Frame')
          modeChoices.Name,modeChoices.Position,modeChoices.Size='KeybindModes',UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),UDim2.fromOffset(size.X/sx,54)
          modeChoices.BackgroundColor3,modeChoices.BorderSizePixel,modeChoices.ZIndex,modeChoices.Parent=mode.BackgroundColor3,0,popup.ZIndex+5,popup
          for index,choice in {'Toggle','Hold'} do
            local button=text('TextButton','Choose'..choice,choice,0,(index-1)*27,size.X/sx,27)
            button.ZIndex,button.Parent=popup.ZIndex+6,modeChoices
            on(button,function()
              controller.setBindingMode(entry,slot,choice)
              refresh()
            end)
          end
          if controller.ui and controller.ui.styleSurface then controller.ui.styleSurface(modeChoices,true) end
        end)
      end
    end
    local add = text("TextButton", "Add", "+ Add keybind", 10, 130, 135, 26)
    add.Position,add.Size=UDim2.new(0,10,1,-46),UDim2.new(1,-113,0,26)
    on(add, function()
      controller.beginBindingRecording(entry,#controller.bindingsFor(entry)+1,add,popup)
    end)
    local clearAll = text("TextButton", "ClearAll", "Clear all", 151, 130, 87, 26)
    clearAll.Position=UDim2.new(1,-97,1,-46)
    on(clearAll, function() controller.setBinding(entry, nil) end)
    if entry.eligible then
      title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-118,0,27)
      title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
      local quick = text("TextButton", "QuickSettings", if nested then "Back" else "Settings", 149, 7, 64, 21)
      quick.Position=UDim2.new(1,-99,0,7)
      on(quick, function() if nested then controller.closeBindingPopup() else controller.openControlPopup(entry) end end)
    end
    local hint=text('TextLabel','CaptureHint','Hold modifiers + key / mouse; Esc cancels',10,158,228,14)
    hint.Position,hint.Size,hint.TextSize=UDim2.new(0,10,1,-18),UDim2.new(1,-20,0,14),9
    table.insert(connections,popup.Destroying:Connect(function()
      if controller.recording and controller.recording.popup==popup then controller.cancelBindingRecording() end
      for index=#controller.instances,1,-1 do if popupObjects[controller.instances[index]] then table.remove(controller.instances,index) end end
      table.clear(popupObjects)
    end))
    controller.attachPopupResize(popup,248,178,connections,nil,'Bindings/'..tostring(entry.id or entry.name))
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance then controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup) end
  end
  function controller.openControlPopup(entry)
    if (entry.name=='Character Lock Transition Curve' or entry.name=='Character Release Curve') and controller.ui and controller.ui.openCurveEditor then controller.ui.openCurveEditor(entry);return end
    if entry.config and entry.config.LiveFriends then controller.openFriendsExclude();return end
    local related=controller.relatedSettings(entry)
    if #related==0 then related={entry} end
    controller.openMiniPopup(entry,related)
  end
  -- Begin aim-assist menu grouping.
  local aimMenuRoles={['M1 Aim Assist']='M1',['Skill Aim Assist']='Skill',
    ['Block Directional Assist']='Block',['Auto Counter Directional Assist']='Counter',['Auto Punish Directional Assist']='Punish'}
  local function aimMenuGroup(entryName,name)
    if not aimMenuRoles[entryName] then return nil end
    if name:find(' Aim Prediction ',1,true) or name:find(' Aim Movement Prediction',1,true) then return 'Movement prediction' end
    if name:find(' Aim Offset ',1,true) then return 'Aim point offsets' end
    if name:match(' Aim Area$') or name:match(' Aim Box ') or name:match('^Show .+ Aim Box$') then return 'Facing box' end
    if name==entryName or name=='Aim Assist While Shift Locked' or name:match('^Block Assist ') then return 'Activation' end
    if name:match('^M1 Approach') or name=='Skill Aim Assist Facing' or name=='Skill Aim Assist Turn Time (s)'
      or name=='Manual Skill Steering' or name=='No Directional Lock During Skills' or name:match('^Skill Steering ')
      or name=='Yuji Chain Flash' or name=='Predicted Ragdoll Landing' or name=='Robot Aim Target'
      or name=='Auto Punish Punch Back Hits' or name=='Auto Punish Only While Blocking' or name=='Block Aim Direction'
      or name=='Block Aim Area' or name:match('^Block Aim Box ') or name=='Show Block Aim Box' then return 'Role settings' end
    if name:find('Range',1,true) or name:find('Targets',1,true) or name:find('Target Priority',1,true) or name:find('FOV',1,true)
      or name:match(' Aim Target Mode$') or name:match(' Aim Switch Delay %(ms%)$') or name=='Recent Hit Priority (s)' or name:match('^Block Aim Recent Hit') or name=='Block Aim Last Hit Sources' or name=='Block Aim Sticky Target' then return 'Target selection' end
    if name=='Aim Character Transition (ms)' or name=='Block Release Camera Guard (ms)' or name=='Aim Character Hold (s)' or name:find('Speed',1,true) or name:find('Smoothing',1,true) or name:find(' Aim Turn ',1,true) or name:find('Humanized Movement',1,true) or name:find('Ramp Into Laser Lock',1,true) then return 'Turning' end
    return 'Role settings'
  end
  -- End aim-assist menu grouping.

  local function humanizedRole(name)
    for role,label in humanizedNames do
      local prefix=label:gsub(' Humanized Movement$','')
      if label==name or name==prefix..' Ramp Into Laser Lock' or name==prefix..' Intro (ms)' or name==prefix..' Disengage Delay (ms)' or name==prefix..' Fade Out Duration (ms)' then return role end

    return humanizedMenus[name]
  end
  function controller.relatedSettings(entry)
    if entry.name=='Combat Trail Color' then
      for _,color in controller.rows or {} do
        if color.tab=='Skill' and color.name=='Combat Trail Tint' then return {color} end
      end
      return {}
    end
    if entry.name == "Anti-Ragdoll" then
      local related = {}
      for _, name in {"Anti-Ragdoll Method", "Evasive Delay (s)"} do
        for _, record in controller.rows do if record.name == name then table.insert(related, record) end end
      end
      return related
    end
    local names = {}
    local aimRole=aimMenuRoles[entry.name]
    local areaRole=entry.name:match('^(%w+) Aim Area$')
    if entry.name=='Allow Action Overlap' or entry.name:match('^Action Overlap ') then
