      names={'Reversal Red Auto Face Target'}

      for _,suffix in {'Width X (m)','Height Y (m)','Depth Z (m)','Offset X (studs)','Offset Y (studs)','Offset Z (studs)'} do table.insert(names,areaRole..' Aim Box '..suffix) end
    elseif aimRole then
      if aimRole=='M1' then names={'M1 Aim Assist','M1 Input Override','M1 Aim Range','M1 Aim Smoothing (ms)','M1 Approach','M1 Approach Range','M1 Approach Stop Distance'}

    end
    if entry.name=='Manual Skill Steering' or entry.name=='Skill Aim Assist' or entry.name=='No Directional Lock During Skills' then
      for _,name in {'Manual Skill Steering','No Directional Lock During Skills','Skill Steering Start','Skill Steering Direction','Yuji Chain Flash','Predicted Ragdoll Landing'} do table.insert(names,name) end
    end
    if table.find(names,'Skill Aim Assist') or entry.name=='Robot Aim Target' then
      table.insert(names,'Robot Aim Target')
      table.insert(names,'Recent Hit Priority (s)')
    end
    if entry.name=='Prediction' then
      for _,name in {'Predicted Ragdoll Landing','Prediction Line Length (m)','Prediction Arrow Hold (s)','Prediction String Smoothing (ms)'} do table.insert(names,name) end
    end
    if table.find(landingSettings,entry.name) or entry.name=='Landing Prediction' or entry.name=='Predicted Landing Position' or table.find(names,'Predicted Ragdoll Landing') then

    end
    local humanized=humanizedRole(entry.name)
    if humanized then
      table.insert(names,humanizedNames[humanized])
      local prefix=humanizedNames[humanized]:gsub(' Humanized Movement$','')
      table.insert(names,prefix..' Ramp Into Laser Lock')
      table.insert(names,prefix..' Intro (ms)')
      table.insert(names,prefix..' Disengage Delay (ms)');table.insert(names,prefix..' Fade Out Duration (ms)')
    end
    if entry.name=='Anti Endlag' then table.insert(names,'Endlag Recovery Delay (s)') end
    if entry.name=='Fourth M1 Recovery' then table.insert(names,'Fourth M1 Recovery Delay (s)') end
    if entry.name=='Aim Assist Speeds' then
      local menus={}
      for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do
        local settings={}
        for _,name in {controller.aimSpeedNames[role],role..' Aim Turn Degrees (deg)',role..' Aim Turn Time (s)',role..' Aim Turn Speed (deg/s)'} do
          for _,record in controller.rows do if record.name==name then table.insert(settings,record);break end end
        end
        table.insert(menus,{id='AimSpeeds/'..role,name=role..' Aim',kind='CreateButton',config={OptionsMenu=true},submenuRecords=settings})
      end
      return menus
    end
    if entry.name=='Auto Counter' then
      table.insert(names,'Auto Counter Impact Lead (ms)')
      table.insert(names,'Auto Counter M1 Reach (m)')
    end
    if entry.name=='Auto Block' or entry.name=='Block Range' then
      for _,name in {'Block Aim Area','Block Aim Box Width X (m)','Block Aim Box Height Y (m)','Block Aim Box Depth Z (m)','Show Block Aim Box','Block Aim Tracking Speed','Block Aim Sticky Target'} do table.insert(names,name) end
    end
    if table.find(names,'Offscreen FOV Margin X (px)') or entry.name=='Auto Block' then
      for _,name in {'Offscreen FOV Reference','Offscreen FOV Offset X (px)','Offscreen FOV Offset Y (px)'} do table.insert(names,name) end
    end
    local blockBoxX=table.find(names,'Block Aim Box Width X (m)')
    if table.find(names,'Block Directional Assist') or table.find(names,'Block Directional Assist Speed') then
      for _,name in {'Block Aim Direction','Keep Block Assist After Release','Block Assist Release Distance'} do table.insert(names,name) end
    end
    if blockBoxX then table.insert(names,blockBoxX+1,'Block Aim Box Height Y (m)') end
    local result = {}
    local included={}
    local turnPrefixes={}
    local label=entry.name or ''
    if label:lower():find('lock on',1,true) or label=='Character Lock with Shift Lock' or label:find('Character Lock',1,true)
        or label=='Character Releasing Speed' then turnPrefixes={'Character Lock','Character Initial','Character Release','Skill Aim'}
    elseif label=='Auto Block' or label:find('Block Directional',1,true) then turnPrefixes={'Block Aim'}
    elseif label=='Auto Counter' or label=='Auto Counter Targets' or label:find('Counter Directional',1,true) then turnPrefixes={'Counter Aim'}
    elseif label=='Auto Punish' or label=='Auto Punish Targets' or label:find('Punish Directional',1,true) then turnPrefixes={'Punish Aim'}
    elseif label=='Skill Aim Assist' or label=='Manual Skill Steering' then turnPrefixes={'Skill Aim'}
    elseif label=='M1 Aim Assist' or label=='M1 Assist' then turnPrefixes={'M1 Aim'} end
    for _,role in turnPrefixes do
      if role=='Block Aim' then
        for _,name in {'Block Aim Tracking Speed','Block Aim Sticky Target','Block Aim Prediction Dash Endpoint'} do table.insert(names,name) end
      end
      local speedName=controller.aimSpeedNames[role:gsub(' Aim$','')]
      if speedName then table.insert(names,speedName) end
      table.insert(names,role..' Target Priority')
      table.insert(names,role..' Target Mode');table.insert(names,role..' Switch Delay (ms)')

    end
    if #turnPrefixes>0 then table.insert(names,'Aim Assist While Shift Locked');table.insert(names,'Aim Character Transition (ms)');table.insert(names,'Block Release Camera Guard (ms)');table.insert(names,'Aim Character Hold (s)') end

        table.insert(names,'Show '..role..' Aim Box')

        end
      end
    end

      local preferred = if name=='Lock On Icon Size' then controller.entries['Player/'..name]
        elseif name=='Lock On' or name=='Camera Only' then controller.entries['Main/'..name] else nil
      for _, record in controller.rows or {} do if record.name == name and not (record.config and record.config.CanonicalHidden) and (not preferred or record.widget==preferred.widget) then
        local id=record.id or (record.tab or '')..'/'..record.name

        return if first~=second then first<second else ranks[a]<ranks[b]
      end)
    end
    return result
  end
  function controller.searchMainSettings(record)
    -- Resolve existing relationships only when a result is opened, then reuse
    -- the answer. Typing never builds menus or changes any feature setting.
    local cache=controller.searchSettingsOwners
    if not cache or cache.count~=#controller.rows then cache={count=#controller.rows,owners={}};controller.searchSettingsOwners=cache end
    local owner=cache.owners[record]
    if not owner then
      local name=record.name
      local preferred
      if record.config and record.config.InfoHubEditor then
        preferred=if record.config.InfoFieldEditor then 'Info Field ['..record.config.InfoFieldEditor..']'else 'Info Hub Layout'
      elseif infoMenuEntries[name] or table.find(infoVisibilitySettings,name) or table.find(infoDisplaySettings,name) then
        preferred=if name:find('Cooldown',1,true) or name:find('Resource',1,true) then 'Cooldown Viewer' else 'Info ESP'
      elseif table.find(landingSettings,name) then preferred='Predicted Ragdoll Landing'
      elseif name=='Prediction Arrow Hold (s)' or name=='Prediction String Smoothing (ms)' then preferred='Prediction'
      elseif name=='Front Dash Interval (s)' or name=='Front Dash Interval Adjustment (s)' then preferred='Custom Front Dash Interval'
      elseif name=='Target Not Required' then preferred='Custom Front Dash Interval'
      elseif name=='Auto Block What To Block' then preferred='Auto Block'
      elseif name=='Keep Block Assist After Release' or name=='Block Assist Release Distance' then preferred='Block Directional Assist'
      elseif name:match('^Failsafe ') then preferred='Failsafe'
      elseif name=='Dash Cooldown (100ms)' or name=='Dash Interval Adjustment (s)' then preferred='Modify Dash Cooldown'
      elseif humanizedRole(name) and (humanizedNames[humanizedRole(name)]==name or name:match(' Ramp Into Laser Lock$') or name:match(' Intro %(ms%)$') or name:match(' Disengage Delay %(ms%)$') or name:match(' Fade Out Duration %(ms%)$')) then preferred=humanizedMasters[humanizedRole(name)]
      elseif name:match('^Character ') or name:match('^Auto Lock On') or name:match('^Lock On')
        or name=='Initial Curve' or name=='Release Turning Curve' then preferred='Activate Lock On'
      else
        for master,role in aimMenuRoles do if name:match('^'..role..' Aim ') then preferred=master;break end end
      end
      local function contains(records)
        for _,other in records do
          if other==record or other.submenuRecords and contains(other.submenuRecords) then return true end
        end
        return false
      end
      local best=-math.huge
      for _,candidate in controller.rows do
        local config=candidate.config or {}
        if config.CanonicalHidden or not candidate.widget then continue end
        if candidate.name~=preferred and (config.QuickSettingsOnly or
          candidate.kind~='CreateToggle' and candidate.kind~='CreateButton' and candidate.kind~='CreateDropdown') then continue end
        local settings=controller.relatedSettings(candidate)
        if #settings==0 or not (candidate==record or contains(settings)) then continue end
        local score=if candidate.name==preferred then 10000 elseif candidate==record then 1000 else 0
        local prefix=0
        local words={};for word in candidate.name:lower():gmatch('%w+') do table.insert(words,word) end
        for word in name:lower():gmatch('%w+') do if words[prefix+1]~=word then break end;prefix+=1 end
        score+=prefix*20+(if candidate.tab==record.tab then 2 else 0)
        if score>best then owner,best=candidate,score end
        if candidate.name==preferred then break end
      end
      -- Standalone appearance controls open their full existing section.
      if not owner and controller.ui then
        for _,group in controller.ui.groups do
          if group.records and table.find(group.records,record) then
            owner={id='SearchSection/'..tostring(record.destination or record.tab)..'/'..tostring(group.name or group.header and group.header.Text or record.name),
              name=group.name or group.header and group.header.Text or record.tab,searchSection=group.records}
            break
          end
        end
      end
      owner=owner or record;cache.owners[record]=owner
    end
    local records,seen={},{}
    local function add(item)
      if not seen[item] and not (item.config and item.config.CanonicalHidden) then seen[item]=true;table.insert(records,item) end
    end
    if owner.widget then add(owner) end
    for _,item in owner.searchSection or controller.relatedSettings(owner) do add(item) end
    add(record)
    return owner,records
  end
  -- Visibility only: never reset a hidden widget or call its feature callback.
  function controller.controlApplicable(record)
    local name=record.name or ''
    local config=record.config or {}
    if config.CanonicalHidden then return false end
    if type(config.PortVisibleWhen)=='function' and config.PortVisibleWhen()==false then return false end
    local function value(label,default)
      local e=controller.entries['Main/'..label] or controller.entries['Automatic/'..label] or controller.entries['Settings/'..label]
      return if e and e.widget and e.widget.Get then e.widget.Get() else default
    end
    local parents={
      ['Endlag Recovery Delay (s)']='Anti Endlag', ['Block Stun Move Speed']='Anti Block Stun',
      ['Fourth M1 Recovery Delay (s)']='Fourth M1 Recovery',
      ['Anti-Stun Move Speed']='Anti-Stun', ['Hit Stun Recovery (s)']='Modify Hit Stun',
      ['Complete Ragdoll Delay (s)']='Complete Ragdoll Recovery', ['True Ragdoll Recovery (s)']='Disable True Ragdoll',
      ['Front Dash Speed Multiplier']='Front Dash Multiplier', ['Skill Cooldown (%)']='Skill Cooldown Modifier',
      ['Front Dash Interval (s)']='Custom Front Dash Interval',
      ['Hits Before Releasing Auto Block']='Auto Block Release After Hit Count',
      ['Block After My Dash Delay (ms)']='Block After My Dash', ['Block After My Dash Time (s)']='Block After My Dash',
      ['Block After My Front Dash']='Block After My Dash', ['Block After My Side Dash']='Block After My Dash',
      ['Enemy Side Dash Block Range (m)']='Predict Enemy Side Dash',
      ['Garuda Rebound Lead Time (s)']='Garuda Rebound Prediction',
      ['Resolute Slash Finisher Time (s)']='Resolute Slash TP Black Flash',
      ['Recovery Direction']='Recovery in Any Direction',
      ['Auto Counter Directional Assist Speed']='Auto Counter Directional Assist',
      ['Auto Counter Directional Assist Range (m)']='Auto Counter Directional Assist',
      ['Auto Punish Directional Assist Speed']='Auto Punish Directional Assist',
      ['Auto Punish Directional Assist Range (m)']='Auto Punish Directional Assist',
      ['Block Directional Assist Speed']='Block Directional Assist',
      ['Block Directional Assist Range (m)']='Block Directional Assist',
      ['Block Aim Recent Hit Window (s)']='Block Aim Recent Hits Only', ['Block Aim Last Hit Sources']='Block Aim Recent Hits Only',
      -- Facing-box dimensions remain editable before its detector is enabled.
      ['Prediction Line Length (m)']='Prediction',
    }
    local areaRole=name:match('^(%w+) Aim Box ') or name:match('^Show (%w+) Aim Box$')
    if areaRole and value(areaRole..' Aim Area','360°')=='360°' then return false end
    local parent=parents[name]
    if parent and value(parent,true)~=true then return false end
    if name=='Block Directional Assist Range (m)' and value('Block Aim Area','360°')~='360°' then return false end
    if value('Block Aim Direction','Enemy')=='Cursor' and value('Block Aim Area','360°')=='360°'
      and (name=='Block Aim Target Priority' or name=='Block Directional Assist Range (m)'
      or name=='Block Aim Recent Hits Only' or name=='Block Aim Last Hit Sources' or name=='Block Aim Recent Hit Window (s)') then return false end
    -- These are already QuickSettingsOnly. Keep framing and cursor-center
    -- adjusters reachable inside their feature menu before enabling it.
    if name:match('^Offscreen FOV') then
      return value('Pause Lock When Target Is Offscreen',false)==true
    end
    if name=='Auto Lock On Action Relock' then return value('Turn Off Auto Lock On After Dashing',false)==true or value('Turn Off Auto Lock On After Skill Connects',false)==true end
    local shape=value('Auto Lock On FOV Shape','Circle')
    if name=='Auto Lock On FOV (deg)' then return shape=='Circle' end
    if name=='Auto Lock On FOV Square Size (px)' then return shape=='Square' end
    if name=='Auto Lock On FOV Width (px)' or name=='Auto Lock On FOV Height (px)' then return shape=='Rectangle' end
    if name=='Perfect Block Timing (s)' then return value('Auto Block Perfect Block',false) or value('Auto Block Attack Timing','Current timing')=='Near impact' end
    if name=='Evasive Delay (s)' then local method=value('Anti-Ragdoll Method','Movement recovery');return method=='Evasive' or method=='Evasive or burst' end
    if name=='Skill Steering Direction' then return value('Manual Skill Steering',true)==true or value('No Directional Lock During Skills',false)==true end
    if name=='Skill Steering Start' then return value('Manual Skill Steering',true)==true and value('No Directional Lock During Skills',false)~=true end
    if name=='Own Collision Scale' then return value('Shrink Own Collision',false)==true end
    for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do
      if name:match('^'..role..' Aim Prediction ') then return value(role..' Aim Movement Prediction',true)==true end
      if name:match('^'..role..' Aim Turn ') then
        local master=({M1='M1 Aim Assist',Skill='Skill Aim Assist',Block='Block Directional Assist',Counter='Auto Counter Directional Assist',Punish='Auto Punish Directional Assist'})[role]
        if value(master,true)~=true then return false end
      end
    end
    return true
  end
  function controller.refreshControlVisibility()
    if controller.visibilityRefreshQueued then return end
    controller.visibilityRefreshQueued=true
    host.task.defer(function()
    controller.visibilityRefreshQueued=false
    if not controller.alive then return end
    local changed=false
    for _,record in controller.rows or {} do
      local applicable=controller.controlApplicable(record)
      if record.lastApplicable~=applicable then changed=true;record.lastApplicable=applicable end
      if record.row and record.row.Parent then
        local visible=applicable and not (record.config and record.config.QuickSettingsOnly)
        if record.row.Visible~=visible then record.row.Visible=visible end
      end
    end
    if changed and controller.refreshMiniVisibility then controller.refreshMiniVisibility() end
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.refreshEmptyGroups then controller.ui.refreshEmptyGroups() end
    end)
  end
  function controller.openMiniPopup(entry: any, records: {any}, searchFocus: any?)
    local previous = controller.popup and controller.popup.Position
    controller.closePopup()
    if not controller.alive or not controller.panel then return end
    local root=if controller.getPopupRoot then controller.getPopupRoot() else controller.panel.Root
    controller.miniOrders=controller.miniOrders or {}
    local orderKey=if entry.name:lower():find('lock on',1,true) or entry.name=='Camera Only' or entry.name=='Character Lock with Shift Lock' then 'Lock settings' else entry.id or entry.name
    local savedOrder=controller.miniOrders[orderKey] or {}
    local ranks={};for index,id in savedOrder do ranks[id]=index end
    local sorted=table.clone(records)
    local originalRanks={};for index,record in records do originalRanks[record]=index end
    local function recordId(record) return record.id or (record.tab or '')..'/'..record.name end
    table.sort(sorted,function(a,b) return (ranks[recordId(a)] or (#savedOrder+originalRanks[a]))<(ranks[recordId(b)] or (#savedOrder+originalRanks[b])) end)
    local popupObjects={}
    local function miniOwned(class)
      local object=owned(class)
      popupObjects[object]=true
      return object
    end
    local popup = miniOwned("Frame")
    popup.Name, popup.Size = "CullingQuickSettings", UDim2.fromOffset(260, math.clamp(76 + #records*35,150,250))
    local point = input:GetMouseLocation()

    popup.Position = previous or UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(point.X-origin.X, 0, math.max(0, view.X-260)), math.clamp(point.Y-origin.Y, 0, math.max(0, view.Y-popup.Size.Y.Offset)))
    popup.BackgroundColor3, popup.BorderSizePixel, popup.ZIndex, popup.Parent = Color3.fromRGB(24, 27, 34), 0, 12000, root
    controller.popup = popup
    controller.popupEntry=entry
    local focusRecord=searchFocus and searchFocus.record
    controller.popupSearchRecord=focusRecord
    local corner = miniOwned("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius, corner.Parent = host.UDim.new(0, 9), popup
    local function text(class, value, x, y, width, height, parent)
      local object = miniOwned(class)
      object.Text, object.Position, object.Size = value, UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
      object.Font, object.TextSize, object.TextColor3 = Enum.Font.Gotham, 12, Color3.fromRGB(224, 232, 244)
      object.BackgroundColor3, object.BackgroundTransparency, object.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(42, 48, 60), if class == "TextLabel" then 1 else 0, 0
      object.ZIndex, object.Parent = 12002, parent or popup
      return object
    end
    local title = text("TextLabel", entry.displayName or entry.name, 12, 5, 212, 26)

    list.CanvasSize, list.ZIndex, list.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #records*35), 12001, popup
    local function parentBlocked() return controller.recording~=nil or controller.bindingPopup~=nil end
    local popupOpen,drag,lastNumericInput=true,nil,nil
    local rows,handles,rowRecords,editing,rowDrag={}, {},{},false,nil
    local sectionHeaders,headerGroups={},{}
    controller.miniExpanded=controller.miniExpanded or {}
    controller.miniExpanded[orderKey]=controller.miniExpanded[orderKey] or {}
    local expanded=controller.miniExpanded[orderKey]
    local function miniGroup(record)
      local config=record.config
      if entry.GeneralESPOffscreenRoot and config and config.GeneralESPOffscreenMenu then return nil end
      if config and config.GeneralESPMiniOwned then return config.GeneralESPMiniGroup end
      if record.submenuRecords or entry.parentMenu or entry.name=='Block Aim Area' then return nil end
      if infoMenuEntries[entry.name] then
        local name=record.name
        if table.find(infoVisibilitySettings,name) then return 'Visibility & attacked players' end
        if name:match('^Your ') or name:match('^Front Dash ') or name:match('^Side Dash Bar ') or name:match('^Dash Bar ') or name=='Dash Overlay Order' or name=='Side Dash Overlay' then return 'Your display adjustments' end
        local barRole=name:match('^(%w+) Bar ')
        if barRole then return barRole..' appearance' end
        if name=='Cooldown Bar Color' or name=='Cooldown Ready Color' or name=='Cooldown Background Color'
          or name=='Cooldown Fill Transparency (%)' or name=='Cooldown Ready Transparency (%)' or name=='Cooldown Transparency (%)'
          or name=='Cooldown Vertical Offset (px)' or name=='Cooldown Outline Thickness (px)' then return 'Cooldown appearance' end
        return 'Shared display adjustments'
      end
      local aimGroup=aimMenuGroup(entry.name,record.name)
      if aimGroup then return aimGroup end
      if #records<4 and orderKey~='Lock settings' then return nil end
      local name=record.name:lower()
      if name:match(' aim area$') or name:match(' aim box ') or name:match('^show .+ aim box$') then return 'Facing box' end
      if entry.name=='Aim Assist Speeds' then return 'Aim assist speeds' end
      if name:find('shift lock',1,true) and (name:find('offset',1,true) or name=='shift lock visual offsets') then return 'Shift-lock visual offsets' end
      if name:find('turn off auto lock on after',1,true) or name=='auto lock on action relock' then return 'Lock activation' end
      if name=='predicted ragdoll landing' or name:match('^landing ') then return 'Landing prediction' end
      if name:find('humanized movement',1,true) then return 'Character movement' end
      if name=='block while being hit' or name=='auto block during recoverable stun' then return 'Block during hits' end
      if name:find('fov',1,true) then return 'Cursor FOV adjustments' end
      local characterLockAdjustment=name:find('character lock',1,true)~=nil and name~='character lock with shift lock'
      local characterTurnAdjustment=name:find('character initial',1,true)~=nil or name:find('character release',1,true)~=nil
      if characterLockAdjustment or characterTurnAdjustment or name=='character releasing speed'
        or name=='initial curve' or name=='release turning curve' then return 'Character lock adjustments' end
      if name:find('camera lock speed',1,true) or name:find('camera offset',1,true) then return 'Camera lock adjustments' end
      if name:find('offset',1,true) then return 'Position adjustments' end
      if name:find('icon',1,true) then return 'Target marker' end
      for _,role in {'Block','Counter','Punish','M1','Skill'} do
        local lower=role:lower()
        if name:find(lower..' aim',1,true) or name:find(lower..' directional',1,true) or name:find(lower..' assist when',1,true)
          or name:find(lower..' assist after',1,true) or role=='Skill' and name:find('steering',1,true) then return role..' aim adjustments' end
      end
      if name:find('after my',1,true) then return 'Block after my dash' end
      if name:find('enemy dash',1,true) or name:find('enemy front dash',1,true) or name:find('enemy side dash',1,true) or name:find('recent dashes',1,true) then return 'Enemy dash prediction' end
      if name:find('projectile',1,true) then return 'Projectile detection' end
      if name:find('perfect block',1,true) or name:find('hold down',1,true) or name:find('before releasing',1,true) or name:find('release after',1,true) or name:find('attack timing',1,true) then return 'Block timing' end
      if name:find('target',1,true) or name:find('recent hit',1,true) or name=='lock on range (studs)' then return 'Target selection' end
      if record.kind=='CreateSlider' then return (entry.displayName or entry.name)..' adjustments' end
      return if orderKey=='Lock settings' then 'Lock activation' else 'General'
    end
    -- Group related records once, retaining saved order within each submenu.
    local groupOrder,nextGroup={},0
    for _,record in sorted do local group=miniGroup(record) or '';if not groupOrder[group] then nextGroup+=1;groupOrder[group]=nextGroup end end
    table.sort(sorted,function(a,b)
      local ga,gb=groupOrder[miniGroup(a) or ''],groupOrder[miniGroup(b) or '']
      return if ga~=gb then ga<gb else (ranks[recordId(a)] or (#savedOrder+originalRanks[a]))<(ranks[recordId(b)] or (#savedOrder+originalRanks[b]))
    end)
    local function layoutRows()
      for _,header in sectionHeaders do header.Visible=false end
      local y,lastGroup,headerIndex=0,nil,0
      for index,row in rows do
        if rowRecords[row]~=focusRecord and not controller.controlApplicable(rowRecords[row]) then row.Visible=false;continue end
        local group=miniGroup(rowRecords[row])
        if group and group~=lastGroup then
          headerIndex+=1
          local header=sectionHeaders[headerIndex]
          if not header then
            header=text('TextButton','',0,0,240,28,list)
            header.Name,header.Size,header.TextSize,header.TextXAlignment='MiniSection'..headerIndex,UDim2.new(1,0,0,28),11,Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            local arrow=text('TextLabel','',0,0,20,28,header)
            arrow.Name,arrow.Position,arrow.TextXAlignment='Disclosure',UDim2.new(1,-22,0,0),Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            table.insert(controller.popupConnections,header.Activated:Connect(function()
              if editing or parentBlocked() then return end
              local name=headerGroups[header];expanded[name]=not expanded[name]
              drag,rowDrag=nil,nil;list.ScrollingEnabled=true;layoutRows()
            end))
            sectionHeaders[headerIndex]=header
          end
          if expanded[group]==nil then
            expanded[group]=group=='General' or group=='Target selection'
              or aimMenuRoles[entry.name]~=nil and group=='Facing box'
          end
          headerGroups[header]=group
          local focusGroup=focusRecord and miniGroup(focusRecord)==group
          header:SetAttribute('CullingMiniGroup',group);header:SetAttribute('Expanded',editing or expanded[group] or focusGroup)
          if controller.ui and controller.ui.applyMenuTextSize then controller.ui.applyMenuTextSize(header) end
          header.Text,header.Position,header.Visible='  '..group,UDim2.fromOffset(0,y),true
          header:FindFirstChild('Disclosure').Text=if editing or expanded[group] or focusGroup then '\226\150\190' else '\226\150\184'
          y+=30;lastGroup=group
        end
        row.Visible=not group or editing or expanded[group] or focusRecord~=nil and miniGroup(focusRecord)==group
        row:SetAttribute('CullingMiniGroup',group)
        row.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(if group then 8 else 0,y);row.LayoutOrder=index
        row.Size=UDim2.new(1,if group then -8 else 0,0,row.Size.Y.Offset)
        if row.Visible then y+=row.Size.Y.Offset end
      end
      list.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,y)
      if controller.ui and controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance then controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup) end
    end
    local function saveOrder()
      local order={};for _,row in rows do table.insert(order,recordId(rowRecords[row])) end
      controller.miniOrders[orderKey]=order
    end
    local function stopDrag()
      drag,rowDrag=nil,nil
      if popupOpen and list.Parent then list.ScrollingEnabled=true end
    end
    local childMenuContext={entry=entry,records=records}

    end))

      if controller.closeBindingPopup then controller.closeBindingPopup() end
      popupOpen=false
      drag,lastNumericInput=nil,nil
      -- Popup instances are transient; the global unload list need not retain
      -- every destroyed slider after repeatedly opening quick settings.
      for index=#controller.instances,1,-1 do
        if popupObjects[controller.instances[index]] then table.remove(controller.instances,index) end
      end
      table.clear(popupObjects)
    end))
    local function updateDrag(point)
      if not drag or not popupOpen or controller.popup~=popup then return end
      if parentBlocked() or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then stopDrag();return end
      local width=drag.track.AbsoluteSize.X
      if width<=0 then return end
      local alpha=math.clamp((point.X-drag.track.AbsolutePosition.X)/width,0,1)
      local value=drag.minimum+(drag.maximum-drag.minimum)*alpha
      if controller.ui and controller.ui.fineSliderValue then value=controller.ui.fineSliderValue(drag.startValue,drag.startX,point.X,width,drag.minimum,drag.maximum) end
      if math.abs((tonumber(drag.record.widget.Get()) or value)-value)>0.00000001 then drag.record.widget.Set(value,true) end
      if popupOpen and controller.popup==popup and drag then drag.refresh() end
    end
    table.insert(controller.popupConnections,input.InputChanged:Connect(function(object)
      if rowDrag and ((rowDrag.touch and object==rowDrag.touch) or (not rowDrag.touch and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
        local y=object.Position.Y-list.AbsolutePosition.Y+list.CanvasPosition.Y
        local from=table.find(rows,rowDrag.row)
        local destination=from
        local group=miniGroup(rowRecords[rowDrag.row])
        for index,row in rows do
          if miniGroup(rowRecords[row])==group then
            destination=index
            if y<row.Position.Y.Offset+row.Size.Y.Offset*.5 then break end
          end
        end
        if from and from~=destination then table.remove(rows,from);table.insert(rows,destination,rowDrag.row);layoutRows();saveOrder() end
      end
      if drag and ((drag.touch and object==drag.touch) or (not drag.touch and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then updateDrag(object.Position) end
    end))
    table.insert(controller.popupConnections,input.InputEnded:Connect(function(object)
      if rowDrag and ((rowDrag.touch and object==rowDrag.touch) or (not rowDrag.touch and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then saveOrder();stopDrag() end
      if drag and ((drag.touch and object==drag.touch) or (not drag.touch and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then stopDrag() end
    end))
    for index, record in sorted do
      local row=miniOwned('Frame')
      row.Name,row.Size,row.BackgroundTransparency,row.BorderSizePixel,row.Active,row.ZIndex,row.Parent='MiniRow'..index,UDim2.new(1,0,0,35),1,0,true,12002,list
      row:SetAttribute('CullingRecordId',recordId(record))
      local divider=miniOwned('Frame')
      divider.Name,divider.Size,divider.Position='MiniDivider',UDim2.new(1,-8,0,1),UDim2.new(0,4,1,-1)
      divider.BackgroundColor3,divider.BackgroundTransparency,divider.BorderSizePixel,divider.ZIndex,divider.Parent=Color3.fromRGB(135,135,135),.65,0,12003,row
      table.insert(rows,row);rowRecords[row]=record
      local grip=text('TextButton','\226\137\161',0,5,16,24,row)
      grip.Name,grip.Visible,grip.ZIndex='ReorderHandle',false,12010
      table.insert(handles,grip)
      table.insert(controller.popupConnections,grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
        if not editing or parentBlocked() or controller.valuePopup or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        stopDrag();rowDrag={row=row,touch=if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then object else nil};list.ScrollingEnabled=false
      end))
      local y=0

      caption=caption:gsub('^Character Lock Turn ','Tracking '):gsub('^Character Initial ','Initial '):gsub('^Character Release ','Release ')
        :gsub('^Character Releasing Speed$','Release Speed'):gsub('Spin Degrees','Spin'):gsub('Turn Degrees','Degrees')
      local label = text("TextLabel", caption, 0, y, 154, 29, row)
      label.Name,label.Position='Label',UDim2.fromOffset(18,0)
      label.Size=UDim2.new(.66,-22,0,29)
      label.TextXAlignment, label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
      local binary=controller.ui and controller.ui.binaryOptions and controller.ui.binaryOptions(record)
      if record.submenuRecords then
        local choose=text('TextButton','\226\150\184',209,2,24,25,row)
        choose.Name,choose.Position='OpenSubmenu',UDim2.new(1,-28,0,2)
        label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-52,0,29)
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,choose.Activated:Connect(function()
          if parentBlocked() then return end
          stopDrag()
          controller.openMiniPopup({id=record.id,name=record.name,parentMenu={entry=entry,records=records}},record.submenuRecords)
        end))
      elseif record.kind=='CreateToggle' or binary then
        local switch=text('TextButton','',209,3,24,24,row)
        switch.Name,switch.Position,switch.Size='MiniSquareSwitch'..index,UDim2.new(1,-48,0,3),UDim2.fromOffset(44,24)
        switch:SetAttribute('WidgetType','ToggleSwitch')
        local mark=text('TextLabel','\226\156\147',0,0,24,24,switch)
        mark.Name,mark.TextSize,mark.TextXAlignment,mark.ZIndex='Checkmark',16,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,12004
        local function isOn() return if binary then record.widget.Get()==binary.on else record.widget.Get()==true end
        local function refresh()
          if not popupOpen or not switch.Parent then return end
          controller.ui.styleSquareSwitch(switch,mark,isOn())
        end
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,switch.Activated:Connect(function()
          if parentBlocked() then return end
          stopDrag()
          record.widget.Set(if binary then (if isOn() then binary.off else binary.on) else not isOn(),true)
          refresh()
        end))
        local original=record.widget.Set
        local synced=function(...)
          local results=table.pack(original(...));refresh();return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
        end
        record.widget.Set=synced
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,popup.Destroying:Connect(function()
          if record.widget.Set==synced then record.widget.Set=original end
        end))
        refresh()
      elseif record.kind=='CreateDropdown' then
        local multi=record.widget.CheckboxOptions~=nil
        local options=if multi then record.widget.CheckboxOptions else (record.config.Options or {})
        local choose=text('TextButton','',165,2,68,25,row)
        label.Size=UDim2.new(.56,-22,0,29)
        choose.Name,choose.Position,choose.Size,choose.TextSize,choose.TextTruncate='MiniDropdown'..index,UDim2.new(.56,0,0,2),UDim2.new(.44,-4,0,25),11,Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        local arrow=text('TextLabel','\226\150\190',0,0,14,25,choose)
        arrow.Name,arrow.Position,arrow.ZIndex='Disclosure',UDim2.new(1,-14,0,0),12004
        local choices=miniOwned('ScrollingFrame')
        choices.Name,choices.Position,choices.Size='Choices',UDim2.new(.4,0,0,33),UDim2.new(.6,-4,0,math.min(180,#options*30))
        choices.BackgroundTransparency,choices.BorderSizePixel,choices.ScrollBarThickness,choices.ZIndex,choices.Visible,choices.Parent=1,0,3,12003,false,row
        choices.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#options*30)
        local buttons={}
        local function isChecked(value)
          if multi then return record.widget.IsChecked(value) end
          return record.widget.Get()==value
        end
        local function refreshChoices()
          local selected={}
          for _,value in options do
            local checked=isChecked(value)
            local choice=buttons[value]
            if choice.mark then choice.mark.Visible=checked end
            choice.option.BackgroundTransparency=if checked then .2 else .65
            if checked then table.insert(selected,(record.config.OptionLabels or {})[value] or tostring(value)) end
          end
          choose.Text=if #selected==0 then 'None' else table.concat(selected,', ')
          if controller.ui and controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance then controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup) end
        end
        local function setOpen(open)
          arrow.Text=if open then '\226\150\190' else '\226\150\184'
          choices.Visible=open;row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,if open then 35+choices.Size.Y.Offset else 35);layoutRows()
        end
        for optionIndex,value in options do
          local option=text('TextButton','',0,(optionIndex-1)*30,120,28,choices)
          option.Name,option.Size,option.ZIndex='Choice'..tostring(value),UDim2.new(1,-4,0,28),12004
          option.Text,option.TextXAlignment=(if multi then '      ' else '  ')..((record.config.OptionLabels or {})[value] or tostring(value)),Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
          local mark
          if multi then
            local square=miniOwned('Frame')
            square.Name,square.Size,square.Position,square.BackgroundColor3,square.BorderSizePixel,square.ZIndex,square.Parent='Checkbox',UDim2.fromOffset(14,14),UDim2.new(0,5,.5,-7),Color3.fromRGB(62,69,82),1,12005,option
            mark=text('TextLabel','\226\156\147',0,-1,14,15,square)
            mark.Name,mark.ZIndex='Checkmark',12006
          end
          buttons[value]={option=option,mark=mark}
          table.insert(controller.popupConnections,option.Activated:Connect(function()
            if parentBlocked() then return end
            if multi then record.widget.SetChecked(value,not record.widget.IsChecked(value),true)
            else record.widget.Set(value,true) end
            refreshChoices();if not multi then setOpen(false) end
          end))
        end
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,choose.Activated:Connect(function() if parentBlocked() then return end;stopDrag();setOpen(not choices.Visible);refreshChoices() end))
        local native=record.widget.DropdownButton or record.widget.ValueLabel or record.widget.Button
        if native and (native:IsA('TextLabel') or native:IsA('TextButton')) then
          table.insert(controller.popupConnections,native:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'):Connect(refreshChoices))
        end
        -- Original setters remain the sole source of truth for main and mini UI.
        local originalSet=record.widget.Set
        local syncedSet=function(...)
          local result=table.pack(originalSet(...))
          if popupOpen and choose.Parent then refreshChoices() end
          return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
        end
        record.widget.Set=syncedSet
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,popup.Destroying:Connect(function()
          if record.widget.Set==syncedSet then record.widget.Set=originalSet end
        end))
        refreshChoices()
      elseif record.kind == "CreateSlider" then
        label.Text,label.TextSize,label.Size=caption:gsub('^Lock On ',''),11,UDim2.new(.58,-21,0,29)
        local hit=text('TextButton','',142,y+2,91,29,row)
        hit.Position,hit.Size=UDim2.new(.6,-2,0,y+2),UDim2.new(.4,-5,0,29)
        hit.Name,hit.BackgroundTransparency,hit.AutoButtonColor,hit.Active='MiniSlider'..index,1,false,true
        hit:SetAttribute('CullingMiniSlider',true)
        local valueLabel=text('TextLabel','',0,0,91,13,hit)
        valueLabel.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,13)
        valueLabel.Name,valueLabel.TextSize,valueLabel.TextXAlignment,valueLabel.Active='Value',11,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,true

        local fill=miniOwned('Frame')
        fill.Name,fill.Size,fill.BackgroundColor3,fill.BorderSizePixel,fill.ZIndex,fill.Active,fill.Parent='Fill',UDim2.new(0,0,1,0),Color3.fromRGB(74,205,220),0,12004,true,track
        local fillCorner=miniOwned('UICorner');fillCorner.CornerRadius,fillCorner.Parent=host.UDim.new(0,3),fill
        local thumb=miniOwned('Frame')
        thumb.Name,thumb.Size,thumb.AnchorPoint='Thumb',UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),host.Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
        thumb.BackgroundColor3,thumb.BorderSizePixel,thumb.ZIndex,thumb.Active,thumb.Parent=Color3.fromRGB(225,245,248),0,12005,true,track
        local thumbCorner=miniOwned('UICorner');thumbCorner.CornerRadius,thumbCorner.Parent=host.UDim.new(0,4),thumb
        local config=record.config or {}
        local minimum,maximum=tonumber(config.Min),tonumber(config.Max)
        local validRange=minimum and maximum and minimum==minimum and maximum==maximum and math.abs(minimum)<math.huge and math.abs(maximum)<math.huge and maximum>minimum
        local function refresh()
          if not popupOpen or controller.popup~=popup or not hit.Parent then return end
          local value=tonumber(record.widget.Get()) or 0
          local alpha=if validRange then math.clamp((value-minimum)/(maximum-minimum),0,1) else 0
          local formatted=string.format('%.'..tostring(config.Precision or 2)..'f',value)
          if valueLabel.Text~=formatted then valueLabel.Text=formatted end
          local size,position=UDim2.new(alpha,0,1,0),UDim2.new(alpha,0,0.5,0)
          if fill.Size~=size then fill.Size=size end
          if thumb.Position~=position then thumb.Position=position end
        end
        local function begin(object)
          if not popupOpen or controller.popup~=popup or parentBlocked() or lastNumericInput==object then return end
          if input:GetFocusedTextBox() and not controller.valuePopup then return end
          if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
            lastNumericInput=object
            stopDrag()
            controller.openValuePopup(record,true)
          elseif not controller.valuePopup and validRange and (object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            lastNumericInput=object
            if controller.beginValueReset(record,object,hit,refresh) then stopDrag()
            else
              drag={record=record,track=track,minimum=minimum,maximum=maximum,refresh=refresh,startValue=tonumber(record.widget.Get()) or minimum,startX=object.Position.X,touch=if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then object else nil}
              list.ScrollingEnabled=false
              updateDrag(object.Position)
            end
          end
          host.task.defer(function() if lastNumericInput==object then lastNumericInput=nil end end)
        end
        for _,object in {hit,valueLabel,track,fill,thumb} do table.insert(controller.popupConnections,object.InputBegan:Connect(begin)) end
        for _,object in {label,row} do
          object.Active=true
          table.insert(controller.popupConnections,object.InputBegan:Connect(function(event)
            if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then begin(event) end
          end))
        end
        local nativeLabel=record.widget.ValueLabel or (record.widget.Frame and record.widget.Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass('TextLabel'))
        if nativeLabel then table.insert(controller.popupConnections,nativeLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'):Connect(refresh)) end
        refresh()
      elseif record.kind == "CreateButton" then
        local activate=text('TextButton',controller.buttonCaption(record.config or {Name=record.name}),165,y+2,68,25,row)
        activate.Position,activate.Size=UDim2.new(.7,-3,0,y+2),UDim2.new(.3,-4,0,25)
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,activate.Activated:Connect(function()
          if not popupOpen or controller.popup~=popup or parentBlocked() then return end
          local callback=record.callback or (record.config and record.config.Callback)
          if record.widget and type(record.widget.Activate)=='function'then
            local okay=record.widget.Activate()
            activate.Text=if okay==false then 'Retry'else controller.buttonCaption(record.config or{Name=record.name})
          elseif type(callback)=='function'then
            if controller.runManualMenuAction then controller.runManualMenuAction(callback)else callback()end
          end
        end))
      elseif record.kind == "CreateInput" then
        local function numericText() return tostring(record.widget.Get()) end
        local box = text("TextBox", numericText(), 165, y+2, 68, 25, row)
        box.Position,box.Size=UDim2.new(.7,-3,0,y+2),UDim2.new(.3,-4,0,25)
        box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,box.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
          controller.beginValueReset(record,object,box,function()
            if popupOpen and controller.popup==popup and box.Parent then box.Text=numericText() end
          end)
        end))
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections, box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
          if not popupOpen or controller.popup~=popup or parentBlocked() then return end
          if tonumber(record.widget.Get()) then
            local number = tonumber(box.Text)
            if number and number==number and math.abs(number)<math.huge then record.widget.Set(tostring(number), true) end
          else record.widget.Set(box.Text,true) end
          box.Text = numericText()
        end))
      elseif record.kind == "CreateColorPicker" then
        local choose = text("TextButton", "Color", 165, y+2, 68, 25, row)
        choose.Position,choose.Size=UDim2.new(.7,-3,0,y+2),UDim2.new(.3,-4,0,25)
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections, choose.Activated:Connect(function() if not parentBlocked() then controller.ui.openColor(record) end end))

      end
      if controller.bindMiniKeybind then controller.bindMiniKeybind(record,row,popup,controller.popupConnections,stopDrag,childMenuContext) end
    end
    controller.refreshMiniVisibility=layoutRows
    table.insert(controller.popupConnections,popup.Destroying:Connect(function()
      if controller.refreshMiniVisibility==layoutRows then controller.refreshMiniVisibility=nil end
    end))
    layoutRows()
    if entry.parentMenu then
      local back=text('TextButton','< Back',10,popup.Size.Y.Offset-32,240,24)
      back.Name,back.Position,back.Size='ParentMenu',UDim2.new(0,10,1,-40),UDim2.new(1,-20,0,24)
      table.insert(controller.popupConnections,back.Activated:Connect(function()
        controller.openMiniPopup(entry.parentMenu.entry,entry.parentMenu.records)
      end))
    end
    controller.attachPopupResize(popup,260,150,nil,stopDrag,'Mini/'..tostring(entry.id or entry.name))
    if controller.ui and controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance then controller.ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup) end
    if focusRecord then
      local focusRow
      for _,row in rows do if rowRecords[row]==focusRecord then focusRow=row;break end end
      if focusRow then
        local stroke=miniOwned('UIStroke')
        stroke.Name,stroke.ApplyStrokeMode='SearchResultHighlight',Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Color,stroke.Thickness,stroke.Transparency=Color3.fromRGB(0,190,255),2,.1
        stroke.Parent=focusRow
        focusRow:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismSearchMatch',true)
        local function clearHighlight()
          if not focusRecord then return end
          focusRecord=nil;controller.popupSearchRecord=nil
          if stroke.Parent then stroke:Destroy() end
          if focusRow.Parent then focusRow:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismSearchMatch',false) end
          if popupOpen then layoutRows() end
        end
        controller.clearMiniSearchHighlight=clearHighlight
        table.insert(controller.popupConnections,popup.Destroying:Connect(function()
          if controller.clearMiniSearchHighlight==clearHighlight then controller.clearMiniSearchHighlight=nil end
        end))
        host.task.defer(function()
          if not popupOpen or controller.popup~=popup or not focusRecord then return end
          local height=list.AbsoluteSize.Y
          list.CanvasPosition=host.Vector2.new(0,math.clamp(focusRow.Position.Y.Offset-height*.35,0,math.max(0,list.CanvasSize.Y.Offset-height)))
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  function controller.captureInput(object, _processed)
    if not controller.recording then return false end
    local value = controller.inputBinding(object)
    if not value then return true end
    if value.name=='Escape' then controller.cancelBindingRecording();controller.recordedInput=object;return true end
    if value.kind=='Mouse' and (controller.popupContains(controller.popup,object.Position)
      or controller.popupContains(controller.bindingPopup,object.Position)) then return true end
    if value.kind=='Keyboard' and bindingModifiers[value.name] then
      controller.recording.modifiers=controller.recording.modifiers or {}
      controller.recording.modifiers[value.name]=true
      return true
    end
    controller.commitBindingRecording(controller.recording,value,object)
    return true
  end
  function controller.matches(entry, object)
    return controller.matchingBinding(entry,object)~=nil
  end
  function controller.entryEnabled(entry)
    return entry.kind ~= "CreateToggle" or (entry.widget and entry.widget.Get()) == true
  end
  function controller.isMenuInput(object)
    if not object.UserInputType.Name:match("^MouseButton") or not controller.panel then return false end
    local container = controller.panel.Root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePlayerGui")
    if not container then return false end
    for _, gui in container:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(object.Position.X, object.Position.Y) do
      if gui:IsDescendantOf(controller.panel.Root) or (controller.popupLayer and gui:IsDescendantOf(controller.popupLayer)) then return true end
    end
    return false
  end
  function controller.matchLegacy(id, object, processed)
    if id == 135 or id == 151 or id == 243 then return nil end
    if not controller.alive or controller.menuKeyCapturing or object==controller.menuKeyCapturedInput or controller.recording or object == controller.recordedInput or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or controller.isMenuInput(object) then return nil end
    if id == 339 then
      -- The old Red helper finds its button anywhere in Main, including stale
      -- moveset UI, then presses Special. Require the current slot's native tool.
      local character=players.LocalPlayer.Character
      local moveset=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
      local ownsRed=false
      for _,tool in moveset and moveset:GetChildren() or {} do
        if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:GetAttribute("Service")=="ReversalRedService" and tool:GetAttribute("Key")==2 then ownsRed=true;break end
      end
      if not ownsRed then return nil end
    end
    local entries = controller.handlerEntries[id]
    -- An orphaned legacy handler must never fall back to its original key.
    if not entries then return nil end
    local matched = false
    for _, entry in entries do
      if controller.entryEnabled(entry) and controller.matches(entry, object) then matched = true
      break end
    end
    if not matched then return nil end
    local old = hotkeys.handlers[tostring(id)]
    return setmetatable({KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode[old]}, {__index = function(_, key) return object[key] end})
  end
  type MenuEntry = {id: string, name: string, kind: string, config: any, widget: any, callback: any, row: any,
    legacy: boolean, running: any, keybindDispatch: boolean?, [string]: any}
  function controller.register(name: string, tabName: string, kind: string, config: any, widget: any, row: any): ()
    local id = tabName .. ("/" .. name)
    if id=='Main/Recovery in Any Direction' and type(shared.__CullingKeybindStore)=='table' then
      local store=shared.__CullingKeybindStore
      if store[id]==nil then store[id]=store['Main/Sprint in Any Direction'] end
      store['Main/Sprint in Any Direction']=nil
    end
    local entry: MenuEntry = {id = id, name = name, displayName = config.DisplayName, kind = kind, config = config, widget = widget, callback = config.Callback, row = row, legacy = false, running = widget and widget.Get and widget.Get()}
    if kind=='CreateSlider' or kind=='CreateInput' then
      entry.defaultNumericValue=tonumber(config.Default)
    end
    controller.entries[id] = entry
    if widget and widget.Set and (kind=='CreateToggle' or kind=='CreateDropdown') then
      local originalSet=widget.Set
      widget.Set=function(...)
        local before=widget.Get and widget.Get()
        local results=table.pack(originalSet(...))
        if controller.heldKeybinds[entry] and not entry.keybindDispatch then controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,true) end
        if controller.refreshControlVisibility and (not widget.Get or widget.Get()~=before) then controller.refreshControlVisibility() end
        return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
      end
    end
    entry.eligible = not config.ConfigManager and (kind == "CreateButton" or kind == "CreateToggle")
    if not entry.eligible then
      if kind=='CreateSlider' or (kind=='CreateInput' and widget and widget.Get and tonumber(widget.Get())) then controller.bindValueEditor(entry) end
      if (kind=='CreateDropdown' or kind=='CreateInput' and not tonumber(widget and widget.Get and widget.Get())) and not config.ConfigManager and not config.MenuKeyRecorder and row then
        row.Active=true
        local lastInput
        local function openOptions(object)
          if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or controller.recording or lastInput==object then return end
          lastInput=object
          controller.openControlPopup(entry)
          host.task.defer(function() if lastInput==object then lastInput=nil end end)
        end
        connect(row.InputBegan,openOptions)
        for _,object in row:GetDescendants() do if object:IsA('GuiObject') then connect(object.InputBegan,openOptions) end end
      end
      return
    end
    local callbackId = callbackIds[config.SourceCallback or config.Callback]
    local handlers = callbackId and hotkeys.controls[tostring(callbackId)]
    if handlers then
      local roles = {One = "Move1", Two = "Move2", Three = "Move3", Four = "Move4", R = "Special"}
      for handler, key in handlers do
        local numeric = tonumber(handler)
        controller.handlerEntries[numeric] = controller.handlerEntries[numeric] or {}
        table.insert(controller.handlerEntries[numeric], entry)
        entry.defaultRole, entry.defaultKey, entry.legacy = roles[key], if roles[key] then nil else key, true
      end
    end
    if name == "Flight" then
      entry.defaultKey, entry.legacy = "X", false
      entry.action = function() environment.ToggleFly() end
    elseif name == "Activate Lock On" then
      entry.defaultKey, entry.legacy = "H", false
      entry.action = function(origin)
        if controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.toggleCursorLock then return controller.autoLock.toggleCursorLock(origin) end
        return environment.ToggleLock()
      end
    elseif name == 'Auto Lock On' then
      entry.action = function(origin)
        if controller.autoLock and controller.autoLock.toggleCursorLock then return controller.autoLock.toggleCursorLock(origin) end
        return environment.ToggleLock()
      end
    end
    controller.entries[id] = entry
    local lastOptionsInput
    local function openFeatureSettings(object)
      if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or controller.recording or lastOptionsInput==object then return end
      lastOptionsInput=object
      controller.openControlPopup(entry)
      host.task.defer(function() if lastOptionsInput==object then lastOptionsInput=nil end end)
    end
    local target = (widget and widget.Button) or row
    if target then
      target.Active = true
      connect(target.InputBegan,openFeatureSettings)
    end
    if row and (row ~= target) then
      row.Active = true
      connect(row.InputBegan,openFeatureSettings)
    end
    if row then
      for _,button in row:GetDescendants() do
        if button:IsA("GuiButton") and button ~= target then
          connect(button.InputBegan,openFeatureSettings)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function targetOptions(options)
    options=if type(options)=='table' then options else {}
    local names,seen={''},{['']=true}
    for _,name in options do
      if type(name)=='string' and not seen[name] then
        seen[name]=true
        table.insert(names,name)
      end
    end
    -- The legacy refresh also reads its first option after SetOptions returns.
    -- Keep that same list blank-first so it cannot silently pick a player.
    table.clear(options)
    for index,name in names do options[index]=name end
    return options
  end
  function controller.prepareTargetDropdown(config)
    config.Description,config.NoConfig='',true
    config.Options=targetOptions(config.Options)
    local saved=shared.__CullingManualTargetName
    config.Default=if type(saved)=='string' and table.find(config.Options,saved) then saved else ''
    local callback=config.Callback
    config.Callback=function(value,...)
      if controller.refreshingTargetOptions then return nil end
      if type(value)~='string' or not table.find(config.Options,value) then value='' end
      controller.selectedTarget=if value~='' then value else nil
      shared.__CullingManualTargetName=controller.selectedTarget
      if callback then return callback(value,...) end
      return nil
    end
  end
  function controller.attachTargetBox(row, widget, config)
    controller.targetWidget = widget
    if widget and config and type(widget.SetOptions)=='function' then
      local setOptions=widget.SetOptions
      widget.SetOptions=function(options,...)
        config.Options=targetOptions(options)
        local previous=controller.selectedTarget
        local selected=if previous and table.find(config.Options,previous) then previous else ''
        controller.refreshingTargetOptions=true
        local result=table.pack(pcall(setOptions,config.Options,...))
        local setOk,setError=true,nil
        if result[1] and type(widget.Set)=='function' then setOk,setError=pcall(widget.Set,selected,false) end
        controller.refreshingTargetOptions=false
        if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
        if not setOk then error(setError,0) end
        if selected~=(previous or '') then config.Callback(selected) end
        return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
      end
      if type(widget.Set)=='function' then widget.Set(config.Default,false) end
      config.Callback(config.Default)
    end
    if not row then return end
    local size = row.Size
    row.Size = UDim2.new(size.X.Scale,size.X.Offset,0,142)
    for _,child in row:GetChildren() do
      if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
        if child:GetAttribute("WidgetType") == "TextMuted" then child.Visible = false
        else
          child.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,10)
          child.Size = UDim2.new(0.5,-12,0,28)
        end
      elseif child:IsA("TextButton") then child.Position = UDim2.new(1,-190,0,8)
      elseif child:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then child.Position = UDim2.new(1,-190,0,48) end
    end
    local footer = owned("Frame")
    footer.Name = "TargetDetails"
    footer.Visible = false
    footer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    footer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8,62)
    footer.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,76)
    footer.Parent = row
    local bar = owned("Frame")
    bar.Name = "HealthBar"
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45,48,58)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,7)
    bar.Parent = footer
    local fill = owned("Frame")
    fill.Name = "Fill"
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65,230,115)
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
    fill.Parent = bar
    local details = owned("TextLabel")
    details.Name = "Summary"
    details.Text = ''
    details.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    details.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,12)
    details.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,62)
    details:SetAttribute("CullingInfoText", true)
    details.TextWrapped = true
    details.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215,225,235)
    details.TextSize = 13
    details.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    details.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    if environment.THEME_FONT then details.FontFace = environment.THEME_FONT end
    details.Parent = footer
    local statusText = owned("TextLabel")
    statusText.Name, statusText.BackgroundTransparency = "Status", 1
    statusText.Text = ''
    statusText.Position, statusText.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0,48),UDim2.new(1,0,0,20)
    statusText.TextSize, statusText.Font = 13,Enum.Font.Gotham
    statusText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    statusText.Parent = footer
    controller.targetDetails,controller.targetFill,controller.targetStatus = details,fill,statusText
    -- Begin cached target footer updates.
    local function footerShown()
      local object=row
      while object do
        if object:IsA('GuiObject') and not object.Visible then return false end
        if object:IsA('LayerCollector') and not object.Enabled then return false end
        object=object.Parent
      end
      return row.Parent~=nil
    end
    local function footerPut(object,key,value)
      if object[key]~=value then object[key]=value end
    end
    local function clearFooter()
      footerPut(footer,'Visible',false)
      footerPut(fill,'Size',UDim2.fromScale(0,1))
      footerPut(details,'Text','')
      footerPut(statusText,'Text','')
    end
    local elapsed = 0
    connect(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat,function(delta)
      elapsed += delta
      if elapsed<0.15 then return end
      elapsed = 0
      if not footerShown() then return end
      local name = controller.selectedTarget
      if type(name)~='string' or name=='' then
        clearFooter()
        return
      end
      local player = type(name)=="string" and players:FindFirstChild(name)
      local model = player and player.Character
      if not model and type(name)=="string" then model = workspace:FindFirstChild(name,true) end
      local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not humanoid then
        clearFooter()
        return
      end
      footerPut(footer,'Visible',true)
      local health,maximum = humanoid.Health,math.max(1,humanoid.MaxHealth)
      local fraction = math.clamp(health/maximum,0,1)
      footerPut(fill,'Size',UDim2.fromScale(fraction,1))
      footerPut(fill,'BackgroundColor3',Color3.fromRGB(math.round(255*(1-fraction)),math.round(70+160*fraction),70))
      local moveset = (player and player:GetAttribute("Moveset")) or model:GetAttribute("Moveset") or "Unknown"
      local activity = if controller.visuals then controller.visuals.activity(model,humanoid) else "Idle"
      local movesetText = if moveset == "Unknown" then "Activity: "..activity else "Moveset: "..tostring(moveset).." | "..activity
      footerPut(details,'Text',string.format("Health: %d / %d\n%s",math.round(health),math.round(maximum),movesetText))
      if controller.visuals then
        local state,text = controller.visuals.statusPresentation(model,humanoid)
        footerPut(statusText,'Text',if controller.visuals.stunEnabled then text else "Status: "..text)
        controller.visuals.paintStatus(statusText,state)
      else
        footerPut(statusText,'Text',"Status: "..(if health<=0 then "Down" else "Active"))
      end
    end)
    -- End cached target footer updates.
  end
  function controller.colorValue(value: any,fallback: any?): any
    local kind=host.typeof or typeof
    if kind(value)=='Color3' then return value end
    local red,green,blue
    if type(value)=='string' then
      local hex=value:match('^#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)$')
      if hex then return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(hex:sub(1,2),16),tonumber(hex:sub(3,4),16),tonumber(hex:sub(5,6),16)) end
      local channels={}
      for number in value:gsub('Color3',''):gmatch('[-+]?%d*%.?%d+') do table.insert(channels,tonumber(number)) end
      red,green,blue=channels[1],channels[2],channels[3]
    elseif type(value)=='table' then
      red,green,blue=value.R or value.r or value[1],value.G or value.g or value[2],value.B or value.b or value[3]
    end
    if type(red)=='number' and type(green)=='number' and type(blue)=='number' and red==red and green==green and blue==blue and math.abs(red)<math.huge and math.abs(green)<math.huge and math.abs(blue)<math.huge then
      local scale=if math.max(red,green,blue)>1 then 255 else 1
      return Color3.new(math.clamp(red/scale,0,1),math.clamp(green/scale,0,1),math.clamp(blue/scale,0,1))
    end
    return fallback
  end
  function controller.adaptColorWidget(widget: any,config: any): any
    local get=widget and widget.Get
    local set=widget and widget.Set
    local color=controller.colorValue(config.Default,Color3.new(1,1,1))
    if type(get)=='function' then local ok,value=pcall(get);if ok then color=controller.colorValue(value,color) end end
    local result=if type(widget)=='table' then widget else {}
    result.Get=function() return color end
    result.Set=function(value,emit)
      local parsed=controller.colorValue(value)
      if not parsed then return false end
      color=parsed
      if type(set)=='function' then set(parsed,emit)
      elseif emit and config.Callback then config.Callback(parsed) end
      return true
    end
    return result
  end
  function controller.wrapTab(tab: any, panel: any, name: string): ()
    local page = panel.Pages[#panel.Pages]
    local originals: {[string]: any} = {}
    controller.tabs = controller.tabs or {}
    controller.tabs[name] = {tab = tab, page = page}
    controller.rows = controller.rows or {}
    for _, kind in {"CreateButton", "CreateToggle", "CreateSlider", "CreateInput", "CreateDropdown", "CreateColorPicker", "CreateParagraph"} do
      originals[kind] = tab[kind]
    end
    local function addSlider(label: string, minimum: number, maximum: number, default: number, callback: any, step: number?): ()
      local before = {}
      for _, child in page:GetChildren() do before[child] = true end
      local config: any={Name = label, Min = minimum, Max = maximum, Default = default, Callback = callback, Step=step}
      if label=='Pickup Range (studs)' then
        config.DisplayName='Interaction Distance (studs)'
        config.Description='Maximum ProximityPrompt interaction distance. Interaction Time is controlled separately.'
      end
      if label=='Dash Cooldown (100ms)' then
        config.DisplayName='Dash Cooldown'
        config.Description='0-100. Each unit is 100 ms; 100 is 10 seconds. Right-click for four decimal places.'
        config.Precision=4
      end
      if label=='Enemy Hitbox Size' or label=='NPC Hitbox Size' then
        config.DisplayName=(if label=='Enemy Hitbox Size' then 'Player' else 'NPC')..' Hitbox X'
        config.Description='X dimension, 0-40 studs. Independent of Y and Z.'
      elseif label=='Enemy Hitbox Y' or label=='NPC Hitbox Y' then
        config.DisplayName=(if label=='Enemy Hitbox Y' then 'Player' else 'NPC')..' Hitbox Y'
        config.Description='Y height, 0-40 studs. Zero retains native body height.'
      elseif label=='Enemy Hitbox Z' or label=='NPC Hitbox Z' then
        config.DisplayName=(if label=='Enemy Hitbox Z' then 'Player' else 'NPC')..' Hitbox Z'
        config.Description='Z dimension, 0-40 studs. Independent of X and Y.'
      end
      if controller.distanceUnits then config=controller.distanceUnits.adaptConfig('CreateSlider',name,config) end
      minimum,maximum,default=config.Min,config.Max,config.Default
      local function normalize(value)
        local amount=math.clamp(tonumber(value) or default,minimum,maximum)
        if step and step>0 then amount=math.clamp(minimum+math.round((amount-minimum)/step)*step,minimum,maximum) end
        return amount
      end
      local widget
      if step then
        config.Callback=function(value,...)
          local amount=normalize(value)
          if widget and widget.Get and widget.Get()~=amount then widget.Set(amount,false) end
          return callback(amount,...)
        end
      end
      widget = originals.CreateSlider(tab, config)
      controller.formatSlider(widget,config.Precision)
      local set = widget.Set
      widget.Set = function(value, emit)
        set(normalize(value), emit)
      end
      local row
      for _, child in page:GetChildren() do
        if not before[child] and child:IsA("GuiObject") then

  function controller.setPanel(panel)
    controller.panel = panel
    -- Keep every close/key/click entry point on the same visibility transition.
    -- The legacy toggle's notification had a fixed LeftControl caption.
    controller.previousToggleHub=environment.ToggleHub
    function controller.toggleMenuVisibility(value)
      if not controller.alive or not panel.Main.Parent then return end
      local wasVisible=panel.Main.Visible
      panel.Main.Visible=if type(value)=='boolean' then value else not wasVisible
      local previous=environment.OpenBtn
      if previous and previous.Parent then previous.Visible=false end
      if controller.ui and controller.ui.refreshHiddenLauncher then controller.ui.refreshHiddenLauncher() end
      if wasVisible and not panel.Main.Visible then
        -- Mini menus use their own screen and keep their independent lifetime.
        pcall(function()
          game:GetService('StarterGui'):SetCore('SendNotification',{
            Title='Menu hidden',Text=controller.menuHiddenHintText(),Duration=4})
        end)
      end
    end
    environment.ToggleHub=controller.toggleMenuVisibility
    local original = panel.ApplyStyle
    panel.ApplyStyle = function(...)
      if controller.ui and controller.ui.applyingColor then return end
      local results = table.pack(original(...))
      if controller.ui and controller.ui.ready then controller.ui.refresh() end
      return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
  end
  function controller.setDashCooldown(enabled)
    controller.dashEnabled = enabled == true
    local slider = controller.entries["Main/Dash Cooldown (100ms)"]
    if slider then controller.dashDelay = math.clamp(math.round((tonumber(slider.widget.Get()) or 100)*10000)/10000, 0, 100)/10 end
    bindings.dashDelay = if controller.dashEnabled then controller.dashDelay*1000 else 0
    if controller.dashControl then
      controller.dashControl.setSeconds(controller.dashDelay)
      controller.dashControl.setEnabled(controller.dashEnabled)
    end
  end
  function controller.setBlockStunSpeed(value)
    controller.blockStunSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or game:GetService("StarterPlayer").CharacterWalkSpeed,0,100)
    if controller.refreshBlockStunSpeed then controller.refreshBlockStunSpeed() end
  end
  function controller.setAntiBlockStun(enabled)
    for _, connection in controller.blockStunConnections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
    controller.blockStunConnections = {}
    controller.refreshBlockStunSpeed = nil
    controller.antiBlockStun = enabled
    if not enabled then return end
    local function blockConnect(signal, callback)
      local connection = connect(signal, callback)
      table.insert(controller.blockStunConnections, connection)
    end
    local function purge(object)
      if not controller.antiBlockStun then return end
      local name = object.Name:lower():gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
      local specific = name == "blockstun" or name == "blockingstun" or name == "blockstunned"
      if name == "stun" then
        specific = (object.Parent and object.Parent:FindFirstChild("Block") ~= nil) or object:GetAttribute("BlockStun") == true or object:GetAttribute("BlockStunned") == true
        for _, attribute in {"Source", "Reason", "Type"} do
          local value = object:GetAttribute(attribute)
          if type(value) == "string" and value:lower():find("block", 1, true) then specific = true end
        end
      end
      if specific then object:Destroy() end
    end
    local function trackInfo(info)
      local function track(object)
        purge(object)
        if object.Parent and object.Name == "Stun" then
          for _, attribute in {"Source", "Reason", "Type", "BlockStun", "BlockStunned"} do blockConnect(object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute), function() purge(object) end) end
        end
      end
      for _, object in info:GetChildren() do track(object) end
      blockConnect(info.ChildAdded, track)
      blockConnect(info.ChildAdded, function(object)
        if object.Name == "Block" then
          for _, child in info:GetChildren() do purge(child) end
        end
      end)
    end
    local function trackCharacter(character)
      local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
      if info then trackInfo(info) end
      blockConnect(character.ChildAdded, function(object) if object.Name == "Info" then trackInfo(object) end end)
      -- On a respawn the Humanoid can arrive after CharacterAdded fires. Hook it
      -- whenever it appears, or the speed correction never attaches to the new
      -- character and the toggle has to be switched off and on again.
      local hooked
      local function hookHumanoid(humanoid)
        if hooked == humanoid then return end
        hooked = humanoid
        local correcting = false
        local function normalSpeed()
          local information = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
          if not controller.antiBlockStun or correcting or not humanoid.Parent or not information or not information:FindFirstChild("Block") then return end
          local base = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").CharacterWalkSpeed
          local penalty = math.clamp(1-humanoid.Health/math.max(1,humanoid.MaxHealth),0,1)*3
          local speed = base-penalty
          local settings = shared.Settings
          local forward = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
          local autoSprint = settings and settings.AutoRun and forward.Magnitude>0 and forward.Unit:Dot(humanoid.MoveDirection)>0.5
          if character:GetAttribute("Sprint") or autoSprint then speed = base*1.375-penalty end
          local custom = controller.entries["Main/WalkSpeed"]
          local amount = custom and tonumber(custom.widget.Get())
          if amount and amount>0 then speed = amount end
          speed *= humanoid:GetAttribute("Speed") or 1
          speed *= humanoid:GetAttribute("Speed2") or 1
          if controller.blockStunSpeed ~= nil then speed = controller.blockStunSpeed end
          if players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Spectate") == true then return end
          if math.abs(humanoid.WalkSpeed-speed)>0.01 then
            correcting = true
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
            correcting = false
          end
        end
        controller.refreshBlockStunSpeed = normalSpeed
        blockConnect(humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"),normalSpeed)
        blockConnect(game:GetService("RunService").Stepped,normalSpeed)
        normalSpeed()
      end
      local existing = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if existing then hookHumanoid(existing) end
      blockConnect(character.ChildAdded, function(object) if object:IsA("Humanoid") then hookHumanoid(object) end end)
    end
    controller.trackBlockStunInfo = trackInfo
    controller.trackBlockStunCharacter = trackCharacter
    if players.LocalPlayer.Character then trackCharacter(players.LocalPlayer.Character) end
    blockConnect(players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, trackCharacter)
  end
  local function restore(object, properties)
    if object and object.Parent then
      for key, value in properties do
        pcall(function()
          object[key] = value
        end)
      end
    end
  end
  function controller.getHitboxSize(model)
    if not controller.alive or model == players.LocalPlayer.Character or (controller.isCombatExcluded or controller.isExcluded)(model) then return 0 end
    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return 0 end
    local player = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
    local specific = environment.GetPlayerSettings and environment.GetPlayerSettings(model.Name)
    if not (environment._G.HitboxStatus or (specific and specific.HitboxExpander)) then return 0 end
    return if player then controller.enemySize else controller.npcSize
  end
  function controller.getHitboxDimensions(model)
    local x=controller.getHitboxSize(model)
    if not controller.alive or model==players.LocalPlayer.Character or (controller.isCombatExcluded or controller.isExcluded)(model) then return nil end
    local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    local specific=environment.GetPlayerSettings and environment.GetPlayerSettings(model.Name)
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not (environment._G.HitboxStatus or (specific and specific.HitboxExpander)) then return nil end
    local isPlayer=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)~=nil
    local z=if isPlayer then (controller.enemyDepth or controller.enemySize) else (controller.npcDepth or controller.npcSize)
    local y=if isPlayer then (controller.enemyHeight or 0) else (controller.npcHeight or 0)
    return if x>0 or y>0 or z>0 then host.Vector3.new(x,y,z) else nil
  end
  function controller.ApplyHitbox()
    if not controller.alive then return end
    local characters = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    if characters then
      for _, model in characters:GetChildren() do
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then controller.TrackHum(humanoid) end
      end
    end
    -- Restore any previous physical expansion before using query-only expansion.
    for root, properties in controller.roots do restore(root, properties) end
    table.clear(controller.roots)
    for humanoid, height in controller.hitboxHeights or {} do
      height.connection:Disconnect()
      if humanoid.Parent then humanoid.HipHeight = height.value end
    end
    controller.hitboxHeights = {}
    if controller.hitboxControl then controller.hitboxControl.updatePreview() end
  end
  local promptProperties={"MaxActivationDistance","RequiresLineOfSight","HoldDuration"}
  local function writePromptProperty(prompt,record,key,value)
    if prompt[key]==value then record.applied[key]=prompt[key];return end
    local previous=record.applied[key]
    record.applied[key]=value
    record.writing=true
