    local ok=pcall(function() prompt[key]=value end)
    record.writing=false
    record.applied[key]=if ok then prompt[key] else previous
    return ok
  end
  local function promptPropertyEnabled(key)
    return if key=="HoldDuration" then controller.interactionSpeedEnabled==true
      elseif key=='RequiresLineOfSight' then controller.interactThroughWallsEnabled==true
      else environment._G.InfinitePrompt_Toggle==true
  end
  local function updatePrompt(prompt,record)
    for _,key in promptProperties do
      if promptPropertyEnabled(key) then
        record.owned[key]=true
        local value=if key=="HoldDuration" then controller.interactionTime or 0.4
          elseif key=="MaxActivationDistance" then controller.pickupRange else false
        writePromptProperty(prompt,record,key,value)
      elseif record.owned[key] then
        record.owned[key]=nil
        writePromptProperty(prompt,record,key,record.original[key])
      end
    end
  end
  local function forgetPrompt(prompt,record)
    if controller.prompts[prompt]~=record then return end
    controller.prompts[prompt]=nil
    for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(record.connections)
  end
  function controller.applyPrompt(prompt)
    if not controller.alive or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return end
    if not controller.promptRegistryStarted and not environment._G.InfinitePrompt_Toggle and not controller.interactionSpeedEnabled and not controller.interactThroughWallsEnabled then return end
    local record=controller.prompts[prompt]
    if not record then
      record={original={},owned={},applied={},connections={},writing=false}
      for _,key in promptProperties do record.original[key]=prompt[key] end
      controller.prompts[prompt]=record
      if type(prompt.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=="function" then
        for _,key in promptProperties do
          table.insert(record.connections,prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal(key):Connect(function()
            if not controller.alive or record.writing or controller.prompts[prompt]~=record then return end
            if not record.owned[key] then record.original[key]=prompt[key];record.applied[key]=nil;return end
            if prompt[key]==record.applied[key] then return end
            record.original[key]=prompt[key]
            updatePrompt(prompt,record)
          end))
        end
      end
      if prompt.Destroying then table.insert(record.connections,prompt.Destroying:Connect(function() forgetPrompt(prompt,record) end)) end
    end
    updatePrompt(prompt,record)
  end
  function controller.ensurePromptRegistry()
    if controller.promptRegistryStarted or not controller.alive then return end
    controller.promptRegistryStarted=true
    controller.promptConnections={}
    if workspace.DescendantAdded then table.insert(controller.promptConnections,workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(controller.applyPrompt)) end
    local ok,service=pcall(game.GetService,game,"ProximityPromptService")
    if ok and service and service.PromptShown then
      table.insert(controller.promptConnections,service.PromptShown:Connect(function(prompt) controller.applyPrompt(prompt) end))
    end
    for _,object in workspace:GetDescendants() do controller.applyPrompt(object) end
  end
  local function refreshPrompts()
    if not controller.alive then return end
    if environment._G.InfinitePrompt_Toggle or controller.interactionSpeedEnabled or controller.interactThroughWallsEnabled then controller.ensurePromptRegistry() end
    for prompt,record in controller.prompts do updatePrompt(prompt,record) end
  end
  function controller.setPickup(enabled)
    environment._G.InfinitePrompt_Toggle=enabled==true
    refreshPrompts()
  end
  function controller.setInteractionSpeed(enabled)
    controller.interactionSpeedEnabled=enabled==true
    refreshPrompts()
  end
  function controller.setInteractThroughWalls(enabled)
    controller.interactThroughWallsEnabled=controller.alive and enabled==true
    refreshPrompts()
  end
  function controller.setInteractionTime(value)
    local number=tonumber(value)
    if not number or number~=number or math.abs(number)==math.huge then return false end
    controller.interactionTime=math.clamp(number,0,5)
    if controller.interactionSpeedEnabled then refreshPrompts() end
    return true
  end
  function controller.stopPromptRegistry()
    for _,connection in controller.promptConnections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
    controller.promptConnections=nil
    for prompt,record in controller.prompts do
      forgetPrompt(prompt,record)
      for _,key in promptProperties do
        if record.owned[key] then writePromptProperty(prompt,record,key,record.original[key]) end
      end
    end
    controller.promptRegistryStarted=false
  end
  local damageClock=if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
  local function validDamageCharacter(character: any): boolean
    local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return character~=nil and character==players.LocalPlayer.Character and character.Parent~=nil and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and character:GetAttribute("Dead")~=true
  end
  local function conflictingDamageOwner(tracker: any,model: any,at: number,character: any): boolean
    local native=tracker.recentNativeHits and tracker.recentNativeHits[model]
    if native and math.abs((native.at or -math.huge)-at)<=(tracker.damageEvidenceWindow or controller.damageMatchWindow) and native.owner~=character then return true end
    local observed=tracker.records and tracker.records[model]
    for _,source in observed and observed.damageSources or {} do
      if source.owner and source.owner~=character and math.abs((source.at or -math.huge)-at)<=(tracker.inferenceWindow or controller.damageMatchWindow) then return true end
    end
    return false
  end
  function controller.clearInfoTarget()
    controller.infoTarget,controller.infoTargetAt,controller.infoTargetCharacter=nil,nil,nil
    controller.infoTargetEvidence=nil
    table.clear(controller.recentHitVictims)
  end
  local function activeHitDisplacement(model: any): boolean
    local info=model:FindFirstChild("Info")
    for _,name in {"Knockback","Ragdoll","TrueRagdoll","CompleteRagdoll"} do
      if info and info:FindFirstChild(name) then return true end
      local value=model:GetAttribute(name)
      if value==true or (type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>0 and value<math.huge) then return true end
    end
    return false
  end
  function controller.updateInfoTarget()
    local character=players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if character~=controller.infoCurrentCharacter then
      controller.clearInfoTarget()
      table.clear(controller.infoDamageVersions);table.clear(controller.infoNativeProofs)
      controller.infoCurrentCharacter=character
      controller.infoCharacterRemoving=nil
    end
    if not controller.alive or not validDamageCharacter(character) or character==controller.infoCharacterRemoving then
      controller.clearInfoTarget()
      return
    end
    local now=damageClock()
    local latest,latestRecord=nil,nil
    for model,record in controller.recentHitVictims do
      local humanoid=model.Parent and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local age=now-record.at
      if record.character~=character or model==character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or model:GetAttribute("Dead")==true
        or age<0 or age>controller.recentHitActiveWindow
        or (age>controller.infoTargetWindow and not activeHitDisplacement(model)) then
        controller.recentHitVictims[model]=nil
      elseif not latestRecord or record.at>latestRecord.at or (record.at==latestRecord.at and model==controller.infoTarget) then
        latest,latestRecord=model,record
      end
    end
    controller.infoTarget=latest
    controller.infoTargetAt=latestRecord and latestRecord.at or nil
    controller.infoTargetCharacter=latestRecord and latestRecord.character or nil
    controller.infoTargetEvidence=latestRecord and {source=latestRecord.source,inferred=latestRecord.inferred,version=latestRecord.version} or nil
  end
  function controller.getRecentHitVictims(): any
    controller.updateInfoTarget()
    return controller.recentHitVictims
  end
  function controller.isDamageTarget(model: any): boolean
    controller.updateInfoTarget()
    if not controller.alive or not model or not model.Parent then return false end
    return controller.recentHitVictims[model]~=nil
  end
  function controller.isInfoTarget(model: any): boolean
    if not controller.alive or not model or not model.Parent then return false end
    local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or model:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return false end
    if model==players.LocalPlayer.Character then return true end
    if controller.infoTargetOnly~=true then return true end
    controller.updateInfoTarget()
    local record=controller.recentHitVictims[model]
    local age=record and damageClock()-record.at
    return age~=nil and age>=0 and age<=controller.infoDisplayWindow
  end
  function controller.setInfoTargetOnly(enabled: boolean): boolean
    enabled=enabled==true
    if not controller.alive or controller.infoTargetOnly==enabled then return false end
    controller.infoTargetOnly=enabled
    local visual=controller.visuals
    if visual and visual.alive~=false then
      local deferLayout=visual.deferLayout
      visual.deferLayout=true
      if type(visual.updateStuns)=="function" then visual.updateStuns() end
      if type(visual.updateInfo)=="function" then visual.updateInfo() end
      visual.deferLayout=deferLayout
      if not deferLayout and type(visual.layoutOverlays)=="function" then visual.layoutOverlays() end
    end
    if controller.sideDisplays and type(controller.sideDisplays.update)=="function" then controller.sideDisplays.update(0) end
    return true
  end
  local function rememberInfoHit(model: any,character: any,at: number,source: any,inferred: boolean,version: number?)
    controller.updateInfoTarget()
    local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if character==controller.infoCharacterRemoving or not humanoid then return end
    if humanoid.Health<=0 or model:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return end
    local previous=controller.recentHitVictims[model]
    if previous and at<previous.at then return end
    if version then
      if (controller.infoDamageVersions[model] or -1)>=version then return end
      controller.infoDamageVersions[model]=version
    else
      if controller.infoNativeProofs[model]==at then return end
      controller.infoNativeProofs[model]=at
    end
    controller.recentHitVictims[model]={character=character,at=at,source=source,inferred=inferred,version=version}
    if not controller.infoTargetAt or at>=controller.infoTargetAt then
      controller.infoTarget,controller.infoTargetAt,controller.infoTargetCharacter=model,at,character
      controller.infoTargetEvidence={source=source,inferred=inferred,version=version}
    end
    if controller.prediction and type(controller.prediction.onHit)=="function" then controller.prediction.onHit(model) end
  end
  function controller.onDamageHit(model: any,at: any,source: any,inferred: any,hit: any)
    local character=players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local now=damageClock()
    if not controller.alive or not model or not model.Parent or model==character or not validDamageCharacter(character) then return end
    if type(at)~="number" or at~=at or math.abs(at)==math.huge then return end
    local tracker=controller.damageTracker
    local observed=tracker and tracker.records and tracker.records[model]
    local exactHealth=type(hit)=="table" and hit.exactHealthLoss==true and hit.accepted==true and hit.target==model
      and hit.character==character and hit.at==at and hit.source==source and type(hit.delta)=="number" and hit.delta<0
      and observed and observed.lastDamageRecord==hit and type(hit.damageVersion)=="number" and hit.damageVersion>=1
    local matchWindow=if exactHealth then (tracker.damageEvidenceWindow or controller.damageMatchWindow) else controller.damageMatchWindow
    if now-at<0 or now-at>matchWindow then return end
    local perDamage=exactHealth or source=="Fresh replicated outgoing damage source" or (inferred==true and (source=="Unique recent M1 damage inference" or source=="Native local contact damage inference"))
    if inferred==true and not perDamage and source~="Unique native M1 hit inference" then return end
    local version
    if perDamage then
      if not observed or (not exactHealth and observed.damageAt~=at) or type(observed.damageVersion)~="number" or observed.damageVersion<1 then return end
      version=if exactHealth then hit.damageVersion else observed.damageVersion
    else
      -- A native caster/victim event is a one-use proof, not a standing grant
      -- to display every later health change on the same target.
      local native=tracker and tracker.recentNativeHits and tracker.recentNativeHits[model]
      -- Trust the tracker's exact per-victim native proof, rather than keeping
      -- a second move-name whitelist which silently drops new native skills.
      -- A plausible label alone never grants damage ownership.
      if type(hit)~="table" or hit.accepted~=true or hit.target~=model or hit.character~=character
        or hit.source~=source or hit.nativeProof~=native or not native or native.source~=source
        or native.character~=character or (native.evidence~="native-caster-victim" and native.evidence~="native-victim-hit") then return end
      local nativeAt=native and native.at
      -- The tracker records the native proof before rememberHit takes its own
      -- clock reading. Match that ordered pair within the existing 0.2-second window,
      -- and consume the original proof stamp so repeated notifications cannot
      -- authorize another health decrease.
      if not native or native.owner~=character or type(nativeAt)~='number' or nativeAt~=nativeAt
        or math.abs(nativeAt)==math.huge or nativeAt>at or at-nativeAt>controller.damageMatchWindow
        or now-nativeAt>controller.damageMatchWindow then return end
      at=nativeAt
    end
    if conflictingDamageOwner(tracker,model,at,character) then return end
    rememberInfoHit(model,character,at,source,inferred==true,version)
  end
  function controller.bindDamageTracker()
    local tracker=controller.autoCounterFilter
    if tracker==controller.damageTracker or not tracker or type(tracker.onLastHit)~="function" then return end
    if controller.damageTrackerConnection then controller.damageTrackerConnection:Disconnect() end
    if controller.damageTrackerHealthConnection then controller.damageTrackerHealthConnection:Disconnect() end
    controller.clearInfoTarget()
    table.clear(controller.infoDamageVersions);table.clear(controller.infoNativeProofs)
    controller.damageTracker=tracker
    controller.damageTrackerConnection=tracker.onLastHit(controller.onDamageHit)
    if controller.damageTrackerConnection then table.insert(controller.connections,controller.damageTrackerConnection) end
    if type(tracker.onDamageHit)=="function" then
      controller.damageTrackerHealthConnection=tracker.onDamageHit(controller.onDamageHit)
      if controller.damageTrackerHealthConnection then table.insert(controller.connections,controller.damageTrackerHealthConnection) end
    end
  end
  -- Shared hit attribution still feeds attacked-player Info ESP and prediction.
  -- Custom damage popups and their duplicate health observers were removed.
  function controller.stepInfoTargetTracking()
    if not controller.alive then return end
    controller.bindDamageTracker()
    controller.updateInfoTarget()
  end
  connect(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat,controller.stepInfoTargetTracking)
  connect(players.LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving,function(character)
    controller.infoCharacterRemoving=character
    controller.clearInfoTarget()
  end)
  function controller.TrackHum(humanoid)
    if not controller.alive or not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") then return end
    local tracker=controller.autoCounterFilter
    if tracker and type(tracker.adoptHumanoid)=="function" then tracker.adoptHumanoid(humanoid) end
  end
  function controller.Destroy()
    if environment.ToggleHub==controller.toggleMenuVisibility then environment.ToggleHub=controller.previousToggleHub end
    if not controller.alive then
      return
    end
    controller.cancelHeldBindings()
    if controller.configStore then controller.configStore.Destroy() end
    if controller.betaMenu then
      if controller.reinjecting then controller.betaMenu.detach() else controller.betaMenu.Destroy() end
    end
    controller.clearInfoTarget()
    controller.closePopup()
    controller.releaseCameraOnlyRotation()
    if controller.sideDisplays then controller.sideDisplays.Destroy() end
    if controller.ui then controller.ui.Destroy() end
    controller.setAntiBlockStun(false)
    if controller.visuals then controller.visuals.Destroy() end
    if controller.lockMarker then controller.lockMarker.Destroy() end
    if controller.parkourAssist then controller.parkourAssist.Destroy() end
    if controller.autoRecovery then controller.autoRecovery.Destroy() end
    if controller.infoVisibility then controller.infoVisibility.Destroy() end
    if controller.legacyDisplayBudget then controller.legacyDisplayBudget.Destroy() end
    if controller.prediction then controller.prediction.Destroy() end
    if controller.moveNames then controller.moveNames.Destroy() end
    if controller.dashStatus then controller.dashStatus.Destroy() end
    if controller.tracers then controller.tracers.Destroy() end
    if controller.autoLock then controller.autoLock.Destroy() end
    if controller.blackflashChain then controller.blackflashChain.Destroy() end
    if controller.nativeWorldCutting then controller.nativeWorldCutting.Destroy() end
    if controller.nativeRed then controller.nativeRed.Destroy() end
    if controller.nativeVariants then controller.nativeVariants.Destroy() end
    if controller.nativeCombos then controller.nativeCombos.Destroy() end
    if controller.zoomControl and controller.zoomControl.enabled then controller.setInfiniteZoom(false) end
    if controller.nativeCounter then controller.nativeCounter.Destroy() end
    if controller.directionalLock then controller.directionalLock.Destroy() end
    if controller.m1Approach then controller.m1Approach.Destroy() end
    if controller.m1AimAssist then controller.m1AimAssist.Destroy() end
    if controller.frontDash then controller.frontDash.Destroy() end
    if controller.m1Assist then controller.m1Assist.Destroy() end
    if controller.m1Hitbox then controller.m1Hitbox.Destroy() end
    if controller.floatingValues then controller.floatingValues.Destroy() end
    if controller.ragdollControl then controller.ragdollControl.Destroy() end
    if controller.stunRecovery then controller.stunRecovery.Destroy() end
        if controller.respawnControl then controller.respawnControl.Destroy() end
    if controller.trainControl then controller.trainControl.Destroy() end
    if controller.looksScripts then controller.looksScripts.Destroy() end
    if controller.knockbackControl then controller.knockbackControl.Destroy() end
    if controller.autoCounterFilter then controller.autoCounterFilter.Destroy() end
    if controller.sprintControl then controller.sprintControl.Destroy() end
    if controller.antiStunSpeed then controller.antiStunSpeed.Destroy() end
    if controller.distanceUnits then controller.distanceUnits.Destroy() end
    if controller.autoPunish then controller.autoPunish.Destroy() end
    if controller.hitboxControl then controller.hitboxControl.Destroy() end
    if controller.moderatorHop then controller.moderatorHop.Destroy() end
    if controller.dashControl then controller.dashControl.Destroy() end
    for _, entry in controller.entries do
      if ((entry.kind == "CreateToggle") and entry.widget) and entry.widget.Get() then
        pcall(entry.widget.Set, false, true)
      end
    end
    controller.alive = false
    for tween in controller.healthTweens or {} do pcall(tween.Cancel, tween) end
    for display in controller.healthDisplays or {} do display:Destroy() end
    state.unloaded = true
    for root, properties in controller.roots do
      restore(root, properties)
    end
    for humanoid, height in controller.hitboxHeights or {} do
      height.connection:Disconnect()
      if humanoid.Parent then humanoid.HipHeight = height.value end
    end
    controller.stopPromptRegistry()
    if controller.projectilePrediction then controller.projectilePrediction.Destroy() end
    bindings.Destroy()
    if controller.autoBlock then controller.autoBlock.Destroy() end
    windowControls.Destroy()
    for _, connection in controller.connections do
      pcall(function()
        connection:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    for connection in state.connections do
      pcall(function()
        connection:Disconnect()
      end)
    end
    for thread in state.threads do
      if thread ~= coroutine.running() then
        pcall(host.task.cancel, thread)
      end
    end
    for object in state.instances do
      pcall(function()
        object:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    for _, object in controller.instances do
      pcall(function()
        object:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    if controller.panel and controller.panel.Root then
      pcall(function()
        controller.panel.Root:Destroy()
      end)
    end
    if shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements == controller then
      shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements = nil
    end
    table.clear(state.connections)
    table.clear(state.threads)
    table.clear(state.instances)
    table.clear(controller.connections)
    table.clear(controller.instances)
  end
  function controller.handleInput(object, processed)
    if controller.menuKeyCapturing then
      local key=controller.menuInputName(object)
      if key then
        controller.menuKeyCapturedInput=object
        controller.cancelMenuKeyCapture()
        if key~='Escape' then
          local entry=controller.entries['Settings/Menu Toggle Key']
          if entry and entry.widget then entry.widget.Set(key,true) else controller.setMenuToggleKey(key) end
        end
      end
      return
    end
    if controller.alive and controller.dismissPopupInput(object) then return end
    if controller.alive and not controller.recording and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
      local entry=controller.numericAtPoint(object.Position)
      if entry then entry.exactValueInput(object);return end
    end
    if ((not controller.alive or controller.captureInput(object, processed)) or object == controller.recordedInput) or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or controller.isMenuInput(object) then
      return
    end
    local value = controller.inputBinding(object)
    if not value then
      return
    end
    local token=keybindToken(value)
    if controller.keybindDown[token] then return end
    controller.keybindDown[token]=true
    for _, entry in controller.entries do
      local binding=if entry.eligible and not entry.legacy and controller.entryEnabled(entry) then controller.matchingBinding(entry,object) else nil
      if binding then
        if controller.supportsHold(entry) and controller.bindingMode(binding)=='Hold' then
          controller.beginHeldBinding(entry,binding)
        elseif entry.action then
          entry.action(object)
        elseif entry.kind == "CreateToggle" then
          controller.cancelHeldEntry(entry,true)
          controller.dispatchNativeBinding(entry,not entry.running)
        elseif type(entry.callback) == "function" then
          entry.callback()
        end
      end
    end
  end
  connect(input.InputBegan, controller.handleInput)
  connect(input.InputChanged, controller.moveValueReset)
  connect(input.InputChanged,function(object,processed)
    if object.UserInputType.Name~='MouseWheel' then return end
    if controller.menuKeyCapturing then controller.handleInput(object,processed)
    else controller.handleMenuToggle(object,processed) end
  end)
  connect(input.InputEnded, controller.finishValueReset)
  function controller.finishInput(object)
    local recording=controller.recording
    local value=recording and controller.inputBinding(object)
    if value and value.kind=='Keyboard' and recording.modifiers and recording.modifiers[value.name] then
      controller.commitBindingRecording(recording,value,object)
    end
    controller.releaseHeldInput(object)
    if controller.menuKeyCapturedInput==object then controller.menuKeyCapturedInput=nil end
    if controller.recordedInput == object then controller.recordedInput = nil end
    if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then controller.lastValueEditorInput=nil end
  end
  connect(input.InputEnded,controller.finishInput)
  connect(input.TextBoxFocused,function() controller.cancelBindingRecording() end)
  connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() controller.cancelHeldBindings();controller.cancelBindingRecording();controller.lastValueEditorInput=nil;controller.cancelMenuKeyCapture() end)
  return controller
end
return MenuEnhancements
end)()

local ModernUI = (function(): any
-- Shenaniganism appearance, managed controls, and layout tools.
local ModernUI: {[string]: any} = {}
function ModernUI.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local Enum, Color3, UDim2, UDim = host.Enum, host.Color3, host.UDim2, host.UDim
    local appearance = host._G.__CullingAppearance or {infoFontSize = 13, transparency = {}}
    appearance.transparency=appearance.transparency or {}
    appearance.colors=appearance.colors or {}
    appearance.colorControls=appearance.colorControls or {}
    appearance.menuFontSizes=appearance.menuFontSizes or {title=24,subtitle=18,content=14,description=12}
    appearance.menuFontSizes.annotation=appearance.menuFontSizes.annotation or 8
    appearance.miniMenu=appearance.miniMenu or {transparency=0,depth=1}
    appearance.originalLook = true
    appearance.menuStyle='JJS Modern'
    host._G.__CullingAppearance = appearance
    local ui: any = {alive = true, ready = false, groups = {}, appearance = appearance, checkboxRecords = {}}
    ui.appearanceIndexDirty=true
    ui.searchMetadata=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    function ui.invalidateMenuObjects(appearanceChanged)
        ui.menuObjectCache,ui.mainSurfaceCache,ui.mainSurfaceCacheRoot=nil,nil,nil
        if appearanceChanged~=false then ui.appearanceIndexDirty=true end
    end
    function ui.menuObjects(): {any}
        local root=menu.panel.Root
        if not ui.menuObjectCache or ui.menuObjectCacheRoot~=root then
            ui.menuObjectCache=root:GetDescendants();ui.menuObjectCacheRoot=root
            ui.menuObjectCacheBuilds=(ui.menuObjectCacheBuilds or 0)+1
        end
        return ui.menuObjectCache
    end
    function ui.surfaceObjects(surface: any): {any}
        if surface==menu.panel.Root then return ui.menuObjects()end
        if surface==menu.panel.Main then
            if not ui.mainSurfaceCache or ui.mainSurfaceCacheRoot~=surface then
                ui.mainSurfaceCache=surface:GetDescendants();ui.mainSurfaceCacheRoot=surface
                ui.mainSurfaceCacheBuilds=(ui.mainSurfaceCacheBuilds or 0)+1
            end
            return ui.mainSurfaceCache
        end
        return surface:GetDescendants()
    end
    ui.nativeMode=false
    -- Capture factory surfaces before managed styling. Layout modes reuse the
    -- same controls and callbacks; Native only changes their presentation.
    local nativeColors={'BackgroundColor3','BackgroundTransparency','BorderColor3','BorderSizePixel'}
    local nativeText={'TextColor3','TextTransparency','TextStrokeColor3','TextStrokeTransparency','FontFace'}
    ui.nativeSurfaces=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    local function captureNativeObject(object,geometry)
        if not object:IsA('GuiObject') then return end
        local values=ui.nativeSurfaces[object]
        if not values then
            values={};ui.nativeSurfaces[object]=values
            for _,property in nativeColors do values[property]=object[property] end
            if object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then
                for _,property in nativeText do values[property]=object[property] end
            end
        end
        if geometry and not values.Position then values.Position,values.Size,values.AnchorPoint=object.Position,object.Size,object.AnchorPoint end
    end
    function ui.captureNativeRow(record)
        if record.nativePresentation or not record.row then return end
        local row=record.row
        local tab=menu.tabs and menu.tabs[record.tab]
        record.nativePresentation={parent=if tab then tab.page else row.Parent,order=row.LayoutOrder,objects={row},height=row.Size.Y.Offset}
        captureNativeObject(row,true)
        for _,object in row:GetDescendants() do
            if object:IsA('GuiObject') then
                captureNativeObject(object,true);table.insert(record.nativePresentation.objects,object)
                if not record.nativePresentation.control and (object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox')) and object.Parent==row then record.nativePresentation.control=object end
            end
        end
    end
    function ui.captureNativePresentation()
        if ui.nativeCaptured then return end
        ui.nativeCaptured=true;ui.nativeTabText={}
        for _,object in ui.menuObjects() do captureNativeObject(object,false) end
        for index,button in menu.panel.TabButtons do ui.nativeTabText[index]=button.Text end
        for _,record in menu.rows do ui.captureNativeRow(record) end
    end
    local function restoreNativeObject(object,values,keepGeometry)
        for property,value in values do
            if keepGeometry and (property=='Size' or property=='Position') then continue
            elseif property=='Size' and object:IsA('ScrollingFrame') then
                object.Size=UDim2.new(value.X.Scale,value.X.Offset,object.Size.Y.Scale,object.Size.Y.Offset)
            elseif object[property]~=value then object[property]=value end
        end
    end
    function ui.finishNativeRow(record)
        local native=record.nativePresentation
        if not native then return end
        for _,object in native.objects do
            if object.Parent then
                local values=ui.nativeSurfaces[object]
                local targetText=object==menu.targetDetails or object==menu.targetStatus
                if values then restoreNativeObject(object,values,object==record.row or targetText or menu.targetDetails and object==menu.targetDetails.Parent) end
                if targetText then object.TextSize=appearance.infoFontSize
                elseif object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then ui.applyMenuTextSize(object) end
            end
        end
        local row=record.row
        local size=ui.nativeSurfaces[row].Size
        local height=math.max(size.Y.Offset,appearance.menuFontSizes.content+appearance.menuFontSizes.description+20)
        local original=native.control and ui.nativeSurfaces[native.control]
        if original then
            for _,object in {record.checkboxContainer,record.binarySwitch,record.menuRecorder} do
                if object then object.Position,object.Size=original.Position,original.Size end
            end
        end
        if record.checkboxContainer then
            if record.checkboxDropdownOpen then height=math.max(height,record.checkboxContainer.Position.Y.Offset+record.checkboxContainer.Size.Y.Offset+record.checkboxList.Size.Y.Offset+8) end
        end
        for _,object in row:GetChildren() do
            if object:IsA('ScrollingFrame') and object.Visible and object.Size.Y.Offset>0 then height=math.max(height,object.Position.Y.Offset+object.Size.Y.Offset+8) end
            if object:IsA('ScrollingFrame') then record.layoutDropdownSize=object.Size end
            if object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')=='ToggleSwitch' then ui.styleSquareSwitch(object,record.squareMark,record.widget.Get()==true) end
        end
        if menu.targetDetails and row==menu.targetDetails.Parent.Parent then
            local footer=menu.targetDetails.Parent
            local originalFooter=ui.nativeSurfaces[footer]
            local y=if originalFooter and originalFooter.Position then originalFooter.Position.Y.Offset else 62
            for _,object in row:GetChildren() do if object:IsA('ScrollingFrame') and object.Visible and object.Size.Y.Offset>0 then y=math.max(y,object.Position.Y.Offset+object.Size.Y.Offset+10) end end
            local position=if originalFooter then originalFooter.Position else footer.Position
            local footerSize=if originalFooter then originalFooter.Size else footer.Size
            footer.Position=UDim2.new(position.X.Scale,position.X.Offset,position.Y.Scale,y)
            footer.Size=UDim2.new(footerSize.X.Scale,footerSize.X.Offset,footerSize.Y.Scale,math.max(footerSize.Y.Offset,(appearance.infoFontSize+5)*3+14))
            menu.targetDetails.Position,menu.targetDetails.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,13),UDim2.new(1,0,0,(appearance.infoFontSize+5)*2)
            if menu.targetStatus then menu.targetStatus.Position,menu.targetStatus.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,13+(appearance.infoFontSize+5)*2),UDim2.new(1,0,0,appearance.infoFontSize+5) end
            height=math.max(height,footer.Position.Y.Offset+footer.Size.Y.Offset+8)
        end
        if record.fineSlider and record.widget.Frame then
            local track=record.widget.Frame;local position,trackSize=track.Position,track.Size
            record.fineSlider.Position=UDim2.new(position.X.Scale,position.X.Offset,position.Y.Scale,position.Y.Offset-7)
            record.fineSlider.Size=UDim2.new(trackSize.X.Scale,trackSize.X.Offset,trackSize.Y.Scale,trackSize.Y.Offset+14)
        end
        if record.divider then record.divider.Visible=false end
        row.Size=UDim2.new(size.X.Scale,size.X.Offset,size.Y.Scale,height)
        record.layoutRowSize=row.Size
    end
    function ui.setPresentation(value)
        ui.nativeMode=value=='Native'
    end
    function ui.applyNativePresentation()
        local entering=not ui.presentedNative
        if entering then
            for object,values in ui.nativeSurfaces do if object.Parent then
                restoreNativeObject(object,values)
                if object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then ui.applyMenuTextSize(object) end
            end end
            for _,record in menu.rows do
                ui.captureNativeRow(record)
                record.groupedPresentation={parent=record.row.Parent,order=record.row.LayoutOrder,destination=record.destination}
            end
            ui.presentedNative=true
        end
        for _,record in menu.rows do
            local native=record.nativePresentation
            if native and native.parent and native.parent.Parent then
                record.row.Parent=native.parent
                local saved=appearance.order and appearance.order['native/row/'..record.tab..'/'..record.name]
                if entering then record.row.LayoutOrder=if saved and type(saved.order)=='number' then saved.order else record.nativeFlatOrder or native.order end
                record.destination=record.tab
            end
            ui.configureRow(record)
        end
        for _,group in ui.groups do group.frame.Visible=false end
        for _,object in ui.menuObjects() do
            if object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration') and (object:IsA('UIGradient') or object:IsA('UIStroke')) then object.Enabled=false end
        end
        ui.applyTabOrganization()
        if ui.updateSearch then ui.updateSearch() end
        ui.indexAppearance()
    end
    function ui.leaveNativePresentation()
        ui.presentedNative=false
        for _,record in menu.rows do
            record.nativeFlatOrder=record.row.LayoutOrder
            local grouped=record.groupedPresentation
            if grouped and grouped.parent and grouped.parent.Parent then record.row.Parent,record.row.LayoutOrder,record.destination=grouped.parent,grouped.order,grouped.destination end
        end
        for _,group in ui.groups do group.records={} end
        for _,record in menu.rows do
            for _,group in ui.groups do if record.row.Parent==group.contents then table.insert(group.records,record);break end end
        end
        for _,object in ui.menuObjects() do
            if object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration') and (object:IsA('UIGradient') or object:IsA('UIStroke')) then object.Enabled=true end
        end
    end
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local function owned(class)
        local object = host.Instance.new(class)
        ui.invalidateMenuObjects()
        object:SetAttribute("CullingModern", true)
        table.insert(menu.instances, object)
        return object
    end
    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(menu.connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function menuTreeChanged(object: any)
        if not ui.alive then return end
        local excluded=object and (object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration') or object:GetAttribute('CullingSurfaceAppearanceDecoration')
            or object:GetAttribute('CullingSwitchDecoration') or object:GetAttribute('CullingColorEditor')
            or ui.colorPopup and (object==ui.colorPopup or object:IsDescendantOf(ui.colorPopup)))
        ui.invalidateMenuObjects(not excluded)
    end
    local menuRoot=menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
    if menuRoot and menuRoot.DescendantAdded then connect(menuRoot.DescendantAdded,menuTreeChanged)end
    if menuRoot and menuRoot.DescendantRemoving then connect(menuRoot.DescendantRemoving,menuTreeChanged)end
    function ui.fineSliderValue(startValue,startX,currentX,width,minimum,maximum)
        if width<=0 then return startValue end
        return math.clamp(startValue+(currentX-startX)/width*(maximum-minimum)*.15,minimum,maximum)
    end
    function ui.attachFineSlider(record)
        if record.kind~='CreateSlider' or record.fineSlider or not record.widget.Frame then return end
        local track=record.widget.Frame;local config=record.config or {}
        if type(config.Min)~='number' or type(config.Max)~='number' then return end
        local pad=owned('TextButton');pad.Name='FineSliderInput';pad.Text=''
        pad.BackgroundTransparency,pad.BorderSizePixel,pad.AutoButtonColor,pad.Active=1,0,false,true
        pad.ZIndex, pad.Parent=math.max(track.ZIndex,record.row.ZIndex)+4,record.row
        record.fineSlider=pad
        connect(pad.InputBegan,function(event)
            if menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or ui.editor and ui.editor.enabled then return end
            if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then menu.openValuePopup(record);return end
            if event.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and event.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            if menu.beginValueReset and menu.beginValueReset(record,event,pad) then return end
            ui.sliderDrag={record=record,x=event.Position.X,value=record.widget.Get(),width=track.AbsoluteSize.X,
                touch=if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then event else nil}
        end)
        if not ui.sliderInputBound then
            ui.sliderInputBound=true
            connect(input.InputChanged,function(event)
                local drag=ui.sliderDrag
                if not drag or not ui.alive then return end
                if menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then ui.sliderDrag=nil;return end
                if (drag.touch and event==drag.touch) or (not drag.touch and event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
                    local c=drag.record.config
                    drag.record.widget.Set(ui.fineSliderValue(drag.value,drag.x,event.Position.X,drag.width,c.Min,c.Max),true)
                end
            end)
            connect(input.InputEnded,function(event)
                local drag=ui.sliderDrag
                if drag and ((drag.touch and event==drag.touch) or (not drag.touch and event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then ui.sliderDrag=nil end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function corner(object, radius)
        if appearance.originalLook then radius=0 end
        local existing = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if existing then existing.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
        return end
        local rounding = owned("UICorner")
        rounding.CornerRadius, rounding.Parent = UDim.new(0, radius), object
    end
    local function menuFont(object)
        if object==menu.targetDetails or object==menu.targetStatus then return end
        if appearance.originalLook and menu.environment and menu.environment.THEME_FONT then
            local font=menu.environment.THEME_FONT
            if object.FontFace~=font then object.FontFace=font end
        end
    end
    function ui.applyMenuTextSize(object)
        if object:IsA('TextButton') then object.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end
        if not (object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox')) then return end
        local role=object:GetAttribute('CullingFontRole')
        if not role then
            local kind=object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')
            if kind=='TextMuted' then role='description'
            elseif object.Name:match('^MiniSection') or object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniGroup') then role='subtitle'
            elseif object.Name=='Title' or (menu.panel and object.Parent==menu.panel.TopBar and object:IsA('TextLabel')) then role='title'
            else role='content' end
        end
        local size=if object==menu.targetDetails or object==menu.targetStatus then appearance.infoFontSize else appearance.menuFontSizes[role] or 14
        size=math.clamp(size,6,72)
        if object.TextScaled~=false then object.TextScaled=false end
        if object.TextSize~=size then object.TextSize=size end
    end
    -- Static surface lighting: no render loop, layout objects or input overlays.
    -- Parent ownership lets temporary popup decorations die with the popup.
    local depthProfiles={
        window={bottom=244,edge=.89,thickness=4},
        popup={bottom=244,edge=.88,thickness=3},
        header={bottom=222,edge=.78,thickness=1},
        control={bottom=233},
        row={bottom=248},
        list={bottom=237,edge=.83,thickness=1},
    }
    ui.depthProfiles=depthProfiles
    function ui.shadeSurface(object,profile,depth)
        depth=if type(depth)=='number'and depth==depth and math.abs(depth)<math.huge then math.clamp(depth,0,2) else 1
        local surfaces=menu.surfaceAppearance
        if surfaces and surfaces.alive then depth=surfaces.depthFor(object,profile,depth)end
        if not object or not object:IsA('GuiObject') or object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthProfile')==profile and object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength')==depth then return end
        local settings=depthProfiles[profile]
        if not settings then return end
        local gradient=object:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
        if gradient and gradient.Name~='CullingSurfaceShade' then return end
        local function decoration(class,name)
            local result=host.Instance.new(class)
            ui.invalidateMenuObjects(false)
            result.Name=name
            result:SetAttribute('CullingModern',true)
            result:SetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration',true)
            result.Parent=object
            return result
        end
        gradient=gradient or decoration('UIGradient','CullingSurfaceShade')
        gradient.Rotation=90
        gradient.Enabled=depth>0
        local bottom=math.clamp(255-(255-settings.bottom)*depth,0,255)
        gradient.Color=host.ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Color3.fromRGB(bottom,bottom,bottom))
        if settings.edge then
            local edge=object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceEdge') or decoration('UIStroke','CullingSurfaceEdge')
            edge.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            edge.Color,edge.Transparency,edge.Thickness=Color3.fromRGB(35,40,49),math.clamp(1-(1-settings.edge)*depth,0,1),settings.thickness
            edge.Enabled=depth>0
        end
        object:SetAttribute('CullingDepthProfile',profile)
        object:SetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength',depth)
        if surfaces and surfaces.alive then surfaces.afterShade(object)end
    end
    function ui.styleCompactHeader()
        local surface=menu.panel.TopBarSurface
        if not surface then return end
        surface.BackgroundTransparency=math.max(.85,appearance.transparency['Window Background COlor'] or .88)
        local edge=surface:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceEdge')
        if not edge then
            edge=owned('UIStroke')
            edge.Name='CullingSurfaceEdge';edge.Parent=surface
            edge:SetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration',true)
        end
        edge.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        if Enum.BorderStrokePosition then edge.BorderStrokePosition=Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Inner end
        edge.Color,edge.Transparency,edge.Thickness=Color3.fromRGB(35,40,49),.85,1
        edge.Enabled=true
    end
    local function miniPut(object,key,value)
        if object[key]~=value then object[key]=value end
    end
    local miniSurfaceNames={CullingQuickSettings=true,CullingKeybindPopup=true,CullingExactValuePopup=true,
        TurningCurveEditor=true,KeybindModes=true,CullingColorPicker=true}
    function ui.isMiniSurface(object)
        return object and object:IsA('GuiObject')
            and (miniSurfaceNames[object.Name]==true or object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniMenuSurface')==true)
    end
    function ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup)
        if not ui.alive or not popup or not popup.Parent or not ui.isMiniSurface(popup) then return false end
        popup:SetAttribute('CullingMiniMenuSurface',true)
        local style=appearance.miniMenu
        local palette=ui.palette or {}
        local background=style.color or palette['Window Background COlor'] or appearance.colors['Window Background COlor'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        local depth=style.depth or 1
        local function apply(object)
            if object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration') then return end
            local graphic=object
            while graphic and graphic~=popup do
                if graphic:GetAttribute('CullingColorGraphic') then return end
                graphic=graphic.Parent
            end
            if object:IsA('GuiObject') and not object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniAppearance') then object:SetAttribute('CullingMiniAppearance',true) end
            if object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then
                menuFont(object);ui.applyMenuTextSize(object)
                miniPut(object,'TextColor3',palette['Text Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0))
                miniPut(object,'TextTransparency',appearance.transparency['Text Color'] or 0)
            end
            local profile=object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthProfile')
            if object==popup or ui.isMiniSurface(object) then
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundColor3',background)
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundTransparency',style.transparency or 0)
                miniPut(object,'BorderColor3',palette['Border Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0))
                miniPut(object,'BorderSizePixel',1)
                profile='popup'
            elseif object:IsA('TextButton') and object.Name:match('^MiniSection%d+$') then
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundColor3',background)
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundTransparency',1-(1-(style.transparency or 0))*.82)
                profile='header'
            elseif (object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox')) and (object.BackgroundTransparency<1 or object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniPaletteControl'))
                and object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')~='ToggleSwitch' and not object:GetAttribute('CullingSwitchDecoration') then
                local key=if object:IsA('TextBox') then 'Input Background Color' else 'Button Background Color'
                if not object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniPaletteControl') then
                    object:SetAttribute('CullingMiniPaletteControl',true)
                    object:SetAttribute('CullingMiniBaseTransparency',object.BackgroundTransparency)
                end
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundColor3',palette[key] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundTransparency',appearance.transparency[key] or object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniBaseTransparency') or 0)
                profile='control'
            elseif object:IsA('UICorner') then miniPut(object,'CornerRadius',UDim.new(0,0))
            elseif object:IsA('Frame') and object.Name=='Checkbox' then
                if object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniBaseTransparency')==nil then object:SetAttribute('CullingMiniBaseTransparency',object.BackgroundTransparency) end
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundColor3',palette['Button Background Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
                miniPut(object,'BackgroundTransparency',appearance.transparency['Button Background Color'] or object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniBaseTransparency') or 0)
                miniPut(object,'BorderColor3',palette['Border Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0))
            end
            if profile then ui.shadeSurface(object,profile,depth) end
        end
        apply(popup)
        for _,object in popup:GetDescendants() do apply(object) end
        if menu.surfaceAppearance and type(menu.surfaceAppearance.bindTree)=='function'then menu.surfaceAppearance.bindTree(popup)end
        return true
    end
    function ui.refreshMiniAppearance()
        local seen={}
        local function apply(surface)
            if surface and not seen[surface] and ui.isMiniSurface(surface) then
                seen[surface]=true;ui.applyMiniAppearance(surface)
            end
        end
        apply(menu.popup);apply(menu.valuePopup);apply(ui.colorPopup)
        if menu.popupLayer and menu.popupLayer.Parent then
            for _,surface in menu.popupLayer:GetChildren() do apply(surface) end
        end
    end
    function ui.queueMiniAppearance()
        if not ui.ready or not ui.alive or ui.miniAppearanceQueued then return end
        ui.miniAppearanceQueued=true
        host.task.delay(1/60,function()
            ui.miniAppearanceQueued=false
            if menu.alive then ui.refreshMiniAppearance() end
        end)
    end
    function ui.setMiniMenuColor(value)
        if value==nil or (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' and type(value)~='table' then return false end
        for _,key in {'R','G','B'} do
            local channel=value[key]
            if type(channel)~='number' or channel~=channel or channel<0 or channel>1 then return false end
        end
        appearance.miniMenu.color=Color3.new(value.R,value.G,value.B)
        local entry=menu.entries['Settings/Mini Menu Background Color']
        if entry and entry.widget and not ui.syncingMiniMenuColor then
            local current=entry.widget.Get()
            if current.R~=value.R or current.G~=value.G or current.B~=value.B then
                ui.syncingMiniMenuColor=true
                local ok,message=pcall(entry.widget.Set,appearance.miniMenu.color,false)
                ui.syncingMiniMenuColor=false
                if not ok then error(message,0) end
            end
        end
        ui.queueMiniAppearance();return true
    end
    function ui.setMiniMenuTransparency(value)
        local number=tonumber(value)
        if not number or number~=number or math.abs(number)==math.huge then return false end
        local percent=math.clamp(number,0,100)
        appearance.miniMenu.transparency=percent/100
        appearance.transparency['Mini Menu Background Color']=percent/100
        local saved=appearance.colorControls['Settings/Mini Menu Background Color']
        if saved then saved.alpha=percent/100 end
        local entry=menu.entries['Settings/Mini Menu Transparency (%)']
        if entry and entry.widget.Get()~=percent then entry.widget.Set(percent,false) end
        if ui.miniColorRecord and ui.miniColorRecord.swatch then miniPut(ui.miniColorRecord.swatch,'BackgroundTransparency',percent/100) end
        ui.queueMiniAppearance();return true
    end
    function ui.setMiniMenuDepth(value)
        local number=tonumber(value)
        if not number or number~=number or math.abs(number)==math.huge then return false end
        local percent=math.clamp(number,0,100)
        appearance.miniMenu.depth=percent/100
        local entry=menu.entries['Settings/Mini Menu Depth (%)']
        if entry and entry.widget.Get()~=percent then entry.widget.Set(percent,false) end
        ui.queueMiniAppearance();return true
    end
    function ui.addMiniAppearanceSettings(tab)
        local color=appearance.miniMenu.color or appearance.colors['Window Background COlor']
        local default=if color then string.format('%d, %d, %d',math.round(color.R*255),math.round(color.G*255),math.round(color.B*255)) else '255, 255, 255'
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name='Mini Menu Background Color',Description='Background color for right-click mini pages only.',Default=default,MiniMenuAppearance=true,
            GetTransparency=function()return appearance.miniMenu.transparency or 0 end,SetTransparency=function(alpha)ui.setMiniMenuTransparency(alpha*100)end,Callback=ui.setMiniMenuColor})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='Mini Menu Transparency (%)',Description='Fade the background of right-click mini pages. Text and controls stay readable.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=(appearance.miniMenu.transparency or 0)*100,Step=1,Precision=0,MiniMenuAppearance=true,Callback=ui.setMiniMenuTransparency})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='Mini Menu Depth (%)',Description='Depth shading for right-click mini pages: 0 is flat; 100 preserves the faint raised surfaces.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=(appearance.miniMenu.depth or 1)*100,Step=1,Precision=0,MiniMenuAppearance=true,Callback=ui.setMiniMenuDepth})
    end
    function ui.styleSurface(surface,isPopup)
        if not appearance.originalLook or not surface then return end
        if isPopup and ui.isMiniSurface(surface) then ui.applyMiniAppearance(surface);return end
        if isPopup and surface.Name=='CullingColorPicker' then
            -- HSV gradients multiply their base colors. Theme tint/alpha must
            -- never recolor these controls or hide the editor used to recover it.
            local function editor(object)
                if not object:GetAttribute('CullingColorEditor') then object:SetAttribute('CullingColorEditor',true) end
                if object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then
                    menuFont(object);ui.applyMenuTextSize(object)
                end
            end
            editor(surface)
            for _,object in ui.surfaceObjects(surface) do editor(object) end
            ui.shadeSurface(surface,'popup')
            return
        end
        local palette=ui.palette or {}
        local function style(object)
            if object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration') then return end
            if object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then
                menuFont(object)
                ui.applyMenuTextSize(object)
                if isPopup then
                    object.TextColor3=palette['Text Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                    if object:IsA('TextButton') and object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')~='ToggleSwitch' then object.BackgroundColor3=palette['Button Background Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    elseif object:IsA('TextBox') then object.BackgroundColor3=palette['Input Background Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) end
                    if object.Name:match('^MiniSection%d+$') then
                        object.BackgroundColor3=palette['Row Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
                        object.BackgroundTransparency=.18
                        ui.shadeSurface(object,'header')
                    elseif (object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox')) and object.BackgroundTransparency<1
                        and object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')~='ToggleSwitch' and not object:GetAttribute('CullingColorEditor') then
                        ui.shadeSurface(object,'control')
                    end
                end
            elseif object:IsA('UICorner') then
                object.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,0)
            elseif isPopup and object:IsA('Frame') and object.Name=='Checkbox' then
                object.BackgroundColor3=palette['Button Background Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                object.BorderColor3=palette['Border Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            elseif isPopup and object:IsA('UIStroke') then object.Color=palette['Border Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0) end
        end
        style(surface)
        for _,object in ui.surfaceObjects(surface) do style(object) end
        if isPopup then
            surface.BackgroundColor3=palette['Window Background COlor'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            surface.BorderColor3=palette['Border Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            surface.BorderSizePixel=1
            ui.shadeSurface(surface,'popup')
        end
    end
    local function label(parent, text, position, size)
        local object = owned("TextLabel")
        object.Text, object.Position, object.Size = text, position, size
        object.Font, object.TextSize = Enum.Font.Gotham, 12
        menuFont(object)
        object.TextColor3, object.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(223, 231, 242), 1
        object.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        object.ZIndex, object.Parent = parent.ZIndex + 1, parent
        return object
    end
    local function button(parent, text, position, size, callback, connections)
        local object = owned("TextButton")
        object.Text, object.Position, object.Size = text, position, size
        object.Font, object.TextSize = Enum.Font.Gotham, 12
        menuFont(object)
        object.TextColor3, object.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 234, 245), Color3.fromRGB(42, 48, 59)
        object.BorderSizePixel, object.ZIndex, object.Parent = 0, parent.ZIndex + 2, parent
        corner(object, 5)
        if callback then
            if connections then table.insert(connections,object.Activated:Connect(callback)) else connect(object.Activated, callback) end
        end
        return object
    end
    function ui.binaryOptions(record)
        if record.kind~='CreateDropdown' then return nil end
        local options=record.config and record.config.Options
        if not options or #options~=2 then return nil end
        local pair={}
        for _,value in options do
            local name=tostring(value):lower()
            if name=='on' or name=='enabled' or name=='true' then pair.on=value
            elseif name=='off' or name=='disabled' or name=='false' then pair.off=value else return nil end
        end
        return if pair.on~=nil and pair.off~=nil then pair else nil
    end
    ui.switchStates=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    function ui.styleSquareSwitch(switch,mark,enabled)
        if mark then mark.Visible=false end
        local palette=ui.palette or {}
        local state=ui.switchStates[switch]
        if not state then
            local face=host.Instance.new('Frame')
            face.Name,face.Size,face.BorderSizePixel,face.ZIndex,face.Parent='SlidingSwitchFace',UDim2.fromScale(1,1),1,switch.ZIndex+1,switch
            face:SetAttribute('CullingSwitchDecoration',true)
            ui.shadeSurface(face,'control')
            local thumb=host.Instance.new('Frame')
            thumb.Name,thumb.Size,thumb.BorderSizePixel,thumb.ZIndex,thumb.Parent='SlidingSwitchThumb',UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),1,face.ZIndex+1,face
            thumb:SetAttribute('CullingSwitchDecoration',true)
            ui.shadeSurface(thumb,'control')
            state={face=face,thumb=thumb};ui.switchStates[switch]=state
        end
        switch.BackgroundTransparency=1
        switch.BorderSizePixel=0
        local key=if enabled then 'Toggle-On Color' else 'Toggle-Off Color'
        local color=palette[key] or (if enabled then Color3.fromRGB(100,220,135) else Color3.fromRGB(230,115,115))
        state.face.BackgroundColor3=color
        state.face.BackgroundTransparency=appearance.transparency[key] or .08
        state.face.BorderColor3=palette['Border Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(115,115,115)
        state.thumb.BackgroundColor3=palette['Knob Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(250,250,250)
        state.thumb.BackgroundTransparency=appearance.transparency['Knob Color'] or 0
        state.thumb.BorderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150)
        local position=UDim2.new(if enabled then 1 else 0,if enabled then -21 else 3,.5,-9)
        if state.enabled~=enabled then
            if state.tween then state.tween:Cancel() end
            if state.enabled==nil then state.thumb.Position=position
            else
                state.tween=host.game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(state.thumb,host.TweenInfo.new(.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=position})
                state.tween:Play()
            end
            state.enabled=enabled
        end
        if menu.surfaceAppearance and type(menu.surfaceAppearance.bindSwitch)=='function'then menu.surfaceAppearance.bindSwitch(state,enabled)end
    end
    function ui.attachBinarySwitch(record)
        if record.binarySwitch then return end
        local pair=ui.binaryOptions(record)
        if not pair or not record.widget or not record.widget.Set then return end
        local switch=button(record.row,'',UDim2.new(1,-58,0,8),UDim2.fromOffset(44,24),function()
            record.widget.Set(if record.widget.Get()==pair.on then pair.off else pair.on,true)
        end)
        switch.Name='BinarySquareSwitch';switch:SetAttribute('WidgetType','ToggleSwitch')
        local mark=label(switch,'\226\156\147',UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1))
        mark.Name,mark.TextSize,mark.TextXAlignment='Checkmark',16,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        record.binarySwitch,record.nativeDropdowns=switch,{}
        record.refreshBinary=function() ui.styleSquareSwitch(switch,mark,record.widget.Get()==pair.on) end
        local original=record.widget.Set;record.binaryOriginalSet=original
        local wrapper=function(...)
            local results=table.pack(original(...))
            if ui.alive and switch.Parent then record.refreshBinary() end
            return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
        end
        record.binarySetWrapper,record.widget.Set=wrapper,wrapper
        record.refreshBinary()
    end
    local function checkboxOptions(record)
        if record.config and record.config.CheckboxOptions then return record.config.CheckboxOptions end
        if record.kind ~= "CreateDropdown" then return nil end
        if record.name == "Lock On" then return {"Camera", "Character"} end
        if record.name == 'Auto Lock On Trigger' then return {'Block','Hit','Incoming'} end
        if record.name == 'Block Aim Last Hit Sources' then return {'By me','By enemy'} end
        if record.name == 'Auto Block What To Block' then return {"M1's",'Moves only'} end
        return nil
    end
    function ui.attachFriendsDropdown(record)
        if not (record.config and record.config.LiveFriends) or record.checkboxContainer then return end
        local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
        local container=owned('Frame')
        container.Name,container.BackgroundTransparency,container.BorderSizePixel='FriendsMultiSelect',1,0
        container.ZIndex,container.Parent=record.row.ZIndex+2,record.row
        local choices=owned('ScrollingFrame')
        choices.Name,choices.Position,choices.Size='ServerPlayers',UDim2.fromOffset(0,31),UDim2.fromOffset(260,0)
        choices.BackgroundColor3,choices.BorderSizePixel,choices.ScrollBarThickness=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235),1,4
        choices.ZIndex,choices.Parent,choices.Visible=container.ZIndex+2,container,false
        record.checkboxContainer,record.checkboxList,record.checkboxOptions,record.nativeDropdowns=container,choices,{},{}
        record.friendButtons={}
        local header=button(container,'Select players',UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),function()
            record.checkboxDropdownOpen=not record.checkboxDropdownOpen;ui.configureRow(record)
        end)
        header.Name='FriendsDropdownHeader';record.checkboxHeader=header
        record.refreshCheckboxes=function()
            local count=0
            for id,item in record.friendButtons do
                local selected=menu.isExcluded(id)
                if selected then count+=1 end
                item.button.Text=(if selected then '\226\156\147  ' else '    ')..item.label
                item.button.BackgroundColor3=if selected then (ui.palette and ui.palette['Theme Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(71,198,214)) else (ui.palette and ui.palette['Button Background Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
                item.button.TextColor3=ui.palette and ui.palette['Text Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
            end
            header.Text=(if #record.checkboxOptions==0 then 'No players' elseif count==0 then 'Select players' else tostring(count)..' excluded')..'  \226\150\190'
        end
        local function roster(leaving)
            if not ui.alive then return end
            local actors={}
            for _,actor in players:GetPlayers() do if actor~=players.LocalPlayer and actor~=leaving then table.insert(actors,actor) end end
            table.sort(actors,function(a,b)return a.Name:lower()<b.Name:lower()end)
            local present={};record.checkboxOptions={}
            for index,actor in actors do
                local id=actor.UserId;present[id]=true
                local item=record.friendButtons[id]
                if not item then
                    local hit=host.Instance.new('TextButton')
                    hit.Name,hit.Size,hit.BorderSizePixel,hit.AutoButtonColor='Player_'..id,UDim2.new(1,-4,0,28),0,false
                    hit.TextSize,hit.FontFace,hit.TextXAlignment=14,menu.environment.THEME_FONT,Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    hit.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    hit.ZIndex,hit.Parent=choices.ZIndex+1,choices
                    item={button=hit};record.friendButtons[id]=item
                    item.connection=hit.Activated:Connect(function()menu.setFriendExcluded(id,not menu.isExcluded(id))end)
                end
                item.label=actor.DisplayName..' (@'..actor.Name..')'
                item.button.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,(index-1)*30)
                table.insert(record.checkboxOptions,item.label)
            end
            for id,item in record.friendButtons do if not present[id] then item.connection:Disconnect();item.button:Destroy();record.friendButtons[id]=nil end end
            choices.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#actors*30)
            record.refreshCheckboxes()
            if ui.ready then ui.configureRow(record) end
        end
        menu.refreshFriendsSelection=record.refreshCheckboxes
        connect(players.PlayerAdded,function()roster()end)
        connect(players.PlayerRemoving,roster)
        roster()
    end
    function ui.attachMenuRecorder(record)
        if not (record.config and record.config.MenuKeyRecorder) or record.menuRecorder then return end
        record.nativeDropdowns={}
        local capture=button(record.row,'',UDim2.new(1,-234,0,6),UDim2.fromOffset(222,27),menu.beginMenuKeyCapture)
        capture.Name='MenuKeyRecorder';capture.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd;record.menuRecorder=capture
        menu.refreshMenuKeyCaption=function()
            if not capture.Parent then return end
            capture.Text=if menu.menuKeyCapturing then 'Press input (Esc cancels)' else 'Press to record: '..menu.menuToggleKey
        end
        menu.refreshMenuKeyCaption()
    end
    function ui.attachCheckboxes(record)
        if record.checkboxContainer then return end
        local options = checkboxOptions(record)
        if not options or not record.widget or type(record.widget.Set) ~= "function" then return end
        local widget, row = record.widget, record.row
        local container = owned("Frame")
        container.Name = "MultiSelectDropdown"
        container.BackgroundTransparency, container.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        container.Position, container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 6), UDim2.fromOffset(178, 27)
        container.ZIndex, container.Parent = row.ZIndex + 2, row
        record.checkboxContainer, record.checkboxButtons, record.nativeDropdowns = container, {}, {}
        container.ClipsDescendants=false
        local choices=owned('ScrollingFrame')
        choices.Name='MultiSelectChoices'
        choices.Position,choices.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,31),UDim2.fromOffset(178,0)
        choices.BackgroundColor3,choices.BackgroundTransparency,choices.BorderSizePixel=Color3.fromRGB(225,225,225),.15,1
        choices.AutomaticCanvasSize,choices.ScrollBarThickness=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,3
        choices.ZIndex,choices.Parent=container.ZIndex+2,container
        choices.Visible=false
        record.checkboxList=choices
        local header=button(container,'',UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),function()
            record.checkboxDropdownOpen=not record.checkboxDropdownOpen
            ui.configureRow(record)
        end)
        header.Name='MultiSelectHeader';header.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        record.checkboxHeader=header
        connect(header.InputBegan,function(object)
            if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and not menu.recording then
                local entry=menu.entries[record.tab..'/'..record.name]
                if entry then menu.openControlPopup(entry) end
            end
        end)
        record.checkboxPrevious = {Set = widget.Set, CheckboxOptions = widget.CheckboxOptions, IsChecked = widget.IsChecked, SetChecked = widget.SetChecked}
        widget.CheckboxOptions = options
        record.checkboxOptions = options
        local function isChecked(name)
            local value = widget.Get()
            if record.name=='Auto Lock On Trigger' then return menu.autoLock.activationHas(value,name) end
            if record.config.MultiSelect==true then return type(value)=='table' and table.find(value,name)~=nil end
            return table.find(options, name) ~= nil and (value == name or value == "Both")
        end
        local function setChecked(name, enabled, emit)
            if not table.find(options, name) or not ui.alive or not menu.alive then return false end
            if record.name=='Auto Lock On Trigger' then
                widget.Set(menu.autoLock.withActivation(widget.Get(),name,enabled),emit)
                return true
            end
            if record.config.MultiSelect==true then
                local selected={}
                for _,option in options do
                    if (if option==name then enabled==true else isChecked(option)) then table.insert(selected,option) end
                end
                widget.Set(selected,emit)
                return true
            end
            local first, second = isChecked(options[1]), isChecked(options[2])
            if name == options[1] then first = enabled == true else second = enabled == true end
            local value = if first and second then "Both" elseif first then options[1] elseif second then options[2] else "None"
            widget.Set(value, emit)
            return true
        end
        widget.IsChecked, widget.SetChecked = isChecked, setChecked
        record.checkboxIsChecked, record.checkboxSetChecked = isChecked, setChecked
        local function refresh()
            if not ui.alive or not menu.alive or not container.Parent then return end
            local selected={}
            for _, choice in record.checkboxButtons do
                local checked = isChecked(choice.name)
                if checked then table.insert(selected,(record.config.OptionLabels or {})[choice.name] or choice.name) end
                choice.mark.Visible = checked
                choice.square.BackgroundColor3 = if checked then (ui.palette and ui.palette["Theme Color"] or Color3.fromRGB(71, 198, 214))
                    else (ui.palette and ui.palette["Button Background Color"] or Color3.fromRGB(47, 54, 66))
                choice.square.BackgroundTransparency = if checked then 0.05 else 0.35
                choice.stroke.Color = ui.palette and ui.palette["Border Color"] or Color3.fromRGB(83, 93, 109)
                choice.text.TextColor3 = ui.palette and ui.palette["Text Color"] or Color3.fromRGB(223, 231, 242)
                choice.mark.TextColor3 = choice.text.TextColor3
                choice.hit.BackgroundColor3=ui.palette and ui.palette['Button Background Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            end
            header.Text=if #selected>0 then table.concat(selected,', ') else 'None'
            header.BackgroundColor3=ui.palette and ui.palette['Button Background Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            header.TextColor3=ui.palette and ui.palette['Text Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
        end
        record.refreshCheckboxes = refresh
        local nativeSet = widget.Set
        local wrapper = function(value, emit)
            local result = table.pack(nativeSet(value, emit))
            refresh()
            return table.unpack(result, 1, result.n)
        end
        widget.Set, record.checkboxSetWrapper = wrapper, wrapper
        for index, name in options do
            local hit = button(choices, "", UDim2.fromOffset(2,(index-1)*30), UDim2.new(1,-4,0,29), function()
                setChecked(name, not isChecked(name), true)
            end)
            hit.Name, hit.BackgroundTransparency, hit.AutoButtonColor = "Choice_" .. name, 0.15, false
            local square = owned("Frame")
            square.Name = "Checkbox"
            square.Position, square.Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -7), UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
            square.BorderSizePixel, square.ZIndex, square.Parent = 0, hit.ZIndex + 1, hit
            corner(square, 3)
            local stroke = owned("UIStroke")
            stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency, stroke.Parent = 1, 0.3, square
            local mark = label(square, "\226\156\147", UDim2.fromOffset(0, -1), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1))
            mark.Name, mark.TextSize, mark.Font = "Checkmark", 12, Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
            mark.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            local text = label(hit, (record.config.OptionLabels or {})[name] or name, UDim2.fromOffset(28, 0), UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0))
            text.Name, text.TextSize, text.TextTruncate = "ChoiceLabel", 11, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            table.insert(record.checkboxButtons, {name = name, hit = hit, square = square, stroke = stroke, mark = mark, text = text})
            connect(hit.InputBegan,function(object)
                if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and not menu.recording then
                    local entry=menu.entries[record.tab..'/'..record.name]
                    if entry then menu.openControlPopup(entry) end
                end
            end)
        end
        table.insert(ui.checkboxRecords, record)
        refresh()
    end
    function ui.hideNativeDropdown(record, child)
        local previous = record.nativeDropdowns[child]
        if not previous then
            previous = {visible = child.Visible}
            record.nativeDropdowns[child] = previous
            connect(child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
                if ui.alive and menu.alive and (record.checkboxContainer or record.binarySwitch or record.menuRecorder) and child.Visible then child.Visible = false end
            end)
            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                connect(child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
                    if record.refreshCheckboxes then record.refreshCheckboxes() end
                end)
            end
        end
        child.Visible = false
    end
    function ui.layoutTarget()
        if ui.targetResponsiveRecord and menu.panel and menu.panel.responsiveChrome then
            ui.layoutResponsiveRow(ui.targetResponsiveRecord)
            return
        end
        local details = menu.targetDetails
        if not details or not details.Parent then return end
        local footer, row = details.Parent, details.Parent.Parent
        local textHeight = (appearance.infoFontSize + 5) * 3
        local footerY = 60
        for _, child in row:GetChildren() do
            if child:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and child.Size.Y.Offset > 0 then footerY = math.max(60, 53 + child.Size.Y.Offset) end
        end
        local rowSize=UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, footerY + 18 + textHeight)
        if row.Size~=rowSize then row.Size=rowSize end
        footer.Position, footer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, footerY), UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, textHeight + 14)
        details.Position, details.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 13), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, (appearance.infoFontSize+5)*2)
        if details.TextSize~=appearance.infoFontSize then details.TextSize=appearance.infoFontSize end
        if details.Font~=Enum.Font.Gotham then details.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham end
        local status = menu.targetStatus
        if status then
            status.Position, status.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0,13+(appearance.infoFontSize+5)*2),UDim2.new(1,0,0,appearance.infoFontSize+5)
            if status.TextSize~=appearance.infoFontSize then status.TextSize=appearance.infoFontSize end
            if status.Font~=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold then status.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold end
        end
        if ui.palette then details.TextColor3 = ui.palette["Text Color"] end
