        for _, child in row:GetChildren() do
            if child:GetAttribute("CullingModern") then continue end
            if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                if child:GetAttribute("WidgetType") == "TextMuted" then child.Visible = false
                else child.Position, child.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(if ui.editor and ui.editor.enabled then 28 else 12, 10), UDim2.new(1, -204, 0, 30) end
            elseif child:IsA("TextButton") then child.Position, child.Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 9), UDim2.fromOffset(178, 30)
            elseif child:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then child.Position = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 45) end
        end
    end
    function ui.openCurveEditor(entry)
        menu.closePopup()
        if not menu.alive or not menu.autoLock then return end
        local phase=if entry.name=='Character Release Curve' then 'Release' else 'Initial'
        local root=menu.getPopupRoot()
        local popup=owned('Frame')
        popup.Name,popup.Size,popup.ZIndex='TurningCurveEditor',UDim2.fromOffset(350,312),12000
        popup.BackgroundColor3,popup.BorderSizePixel=Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245),1
        local point=input:GetMouseLocation()
        popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(point.X-root.AbsolutePosition.X,0,math.max(0,root.AbsoluteSize.X-350)),math.clamp(point.Y-root.AbsolutePosition.Y,0,math.max(0,root.AbsoluteSize.Y-312)))
        popup.Parent,menu.popup=root,popup
        local connections=menu.popupConnections
        local function listen(signal,callback) table.insert(connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
        local heading=label(popup,phase..' turn: drag the two points',UDim2.fromOffset(10,4),UDim2.new(1,-42,0,28))
        heading.TextColor3,heading.Active=Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30),true
        button(popup,'x',UDim2.new(1,-29,0,5),UDim2.fromOffset(22,22),menu.closePopup,connections)
        local graph=owned('Frame')
        graph.Name,graph.Position,graph.Size='CurveGraph',UDim2.fromOffset(16,42),UDim2.new(1,-32,1,-119)
        graph.BackgroundColor3,graph.BorderColor3,graph.BorderSizePixel,graph.ClipsDescendants=Color3.fromRGB(232,232,232),Color3.fromRGB(160,160,160),1,true
        graph.ZIndex,graph.Parent=12002,popup
        for index=1,3 do
            local x,y=owned('Frame'),owned('Frame')
            x.Position,x.Size=UDim2.fromScale(index/4,0),UDim2.new(0,1,1,0)
            y.Position,y.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,index/4),UDim2.new(1,0,0,1)
            for _,line in {x,y} do line.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150);line.BackgroundTransparency=.75;line.BorderSizePixel=0;line.ZIndex=12003;line.Parent=graph end
        end
        local lines,handles,fields={},{},{}
        for index=1,48 do
            local line=owned('Frame');line.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(0,.5)
            line.BackgroundColor3,line.BorderSizePixel,line.ZIndex,line.Parent=Color3.fromRGB(0,185,200),0,12004,graph
            lines[index]=line
        end
        local caption=label(popup,'Time ->    Turn amount ^',UDim2.new(0,16,1,-72),UDim2.new(1,-32,0,20))
        caption.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45)
        for index,axis in {'X1','Y1','X2','Y2'} do
            local field=owned('TextBox')
            field.Name,field.Position,field.Size=axis,UDim2.new((index-1)/4,9,1,-46),UDim2.new(.25,-14,0,24)
            field.BackgroundColor3,field.BorderSizePixel,field.TextSize=Color3.fromRGB(218,218,218),1,11
            field.TextColor3,field.ClearTextOnFocus,field.ZIndex,field.Parent=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20),false,12004,popup
            fields[index]=field
        end
        local function selectCustom() entry.widget.Set('Custom',true) end
        local function setPoint(index,value)
            local axis=({'X1','Y1','X2','Y2'})[index]
            local record=menu.entries['Main/'..phase..' Curve Control '..axis]
            if record then record.widget.Set(math.clamp(value,0,1),true) end
        end
        local function redraw()
            if not popup.Parent then return end
            local curve=menu.autoLock;local points=curve.curvePoints[phase]
            for index,line in lines do
                local ax,bx=(index-1)/48,index/48
                local ay,by=1-curve.evaluateCurve(ax,phase),1-curve.evaluateCurve(bx,phase)
                local dx,dy=(bx-ax)*graph.AbsoluteSize.X,(by-ay)*graph.AbsoluteSize.Y
                line.Position=UDim2.fromScale(ax,ay)
                line.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)+1,2)
                line.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(dy,dx))
            end
            for index,handle in handles do handle.Position=UDim2.fromScale(points[(index-1)*2+1],1-points[index*2]) end
            for index,field in fields do if not field:IsFocused() then field.Text=string.format('%.4f',points[index]) end end
        end
        local drag,windowDrag=nil,nil
        for index=1,2 do
            local handle=button(graph,tostring(index),UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),function() end,connections)
            handle.Name,handle.AnchorPoint,handle.ZIndex='CurvePoint'..index,host.Vector2.new(.5,.5),12005
            handles[index]=handle
            listen(handle.InputBegan,function(event)
                if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag=index;selectCustom() end
            end)
        end
        for index,field in fields do listen(field.FocusLost,function()
            local value=tonumber(field.Text)
            if value and value==value and math.abs(value)~=math.huge then selectCustom();setPoint(index,value) end
            redraw()
            if menu.configStore then menu.configStore.flush() end
        end) end
        listen(heading.InputBegan,function(event)
            if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then windowDrag={point=input:GetMouseLocation(),position=popup.Position} end
        end)
        listen(input.InputChanged,function(event)
            if event.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and event.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local mouse=input:GetMouseLocation()
            if drag then
                local size=graph.AbsoluteSize
                if size.X>0 and size.Y>0 then setPoint((drag-1)*2+1,(mouse.X-graph.AbsolutePosition.X)/size.X);setPoint(drag*2,1-(mouse.Y-graph.AbsolutePosition.Y)/size.Y);redraw() end
            elseif windowDrag then
                local sx=popup.AbsoluteSize.X/math.max(1,popup.Size.X.Offset);local sy=popup.AbsoluteSize.Y/math.max(1,popup.Size.Y.Offset)
                popup.Position=windowDrag.position+UDim2.fromOffset((mouse.X-windowDrag.point.X)/sx,(mouse.Y-windowDrag.point.Y)/sy)
            end
        end)
        listen(input.InputEnded,function(event)
            if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag,windowDrag=nil,nil;if menu.configStore then menu.configStore.flush() end end
        end)
        listen(graph:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),redraw)
        menu.attachPopupResize(popup,280,250,connections,function()drag,windowDrag=nil,nil end)
        redraw()
    end
    function ui.prepareNativeRow(record)
        local row=record.row
        if record.checkboxContainer then
            local height=if record.checkboxDropdownOpen then math.min(#record.checkboxOptions*30,if record.config.LiveFriends then 240 else math.huge) else 0
            record.checkboxList.Visible=record.checkboxDropdownOpen==true
            record.checkboxList.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,height)
            record.refreshCheckboxes()
        end
        for _,child in row:GetChildren() do
            local kind=child:GetAttribute('WidgetType')
            if (record.checkboxContainer or record.binarySwitch or record.menuRecorder) and (child:IsA('TextButton') or child:IsA('ScrollingFrame')) and not child:GetAttribute('CullingModern') then
                ui.hideNativeDropdown(record,child)
            elseif kind=='ToggleSwitch' then
                for _,native in child:GetChildren() do if native:IsA('Frame') and native.Name~='SlidingSwitchFace' then native.Visible=false end end
                if not record.switchSetWrapper and record.kind=='CreateToggle' then
                    local original=record.widget.Set
                    record.switchOriginalSet=original
                    local wrapper=function(...)
                        local result=table.pack(original(...))
                        if ui.alive and child.Parent then ui.styleSquareSwitch(child,nil,record.widget.Get()==true) end
                        return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
                    end
                    record.switchSetWrapper=wrapper;record.widget.Set=wrapper
                end
                if record.kind=='CreateToggle' and not record.switchStateConnection then
                    local function sync()
                        if ui.alive and child.Parent then ui.styleSquareSwitch(child,nil,record.widget.Get()==true) end
                    end
                    record.switchStateConnection=connect(child:GetPropertyChangedSignal('BackgroundColor3'),sync)
                    connect(child.InputEnded,function()host.task.defer(sync)end)
                end
            elseif child:IsA('ScrollingFrame') then
                if not record.dropdownWatch then
                    local list=child
                    local function queue()
                        if record.adjusting or record.responsiveWriting or record.layoutQueued or row.Size==record.layoutRowSize and list.Size==record.layoutDropdownSize then return end
                        record.layoutQueued=true
                        host.task.defer(function()record.layoutQueued=false;ui.configureRow(record)end)
                    end
                    record.dropdownWatch=connect(list:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Size'),queue)
                    connect(list.ChildAdded,function()record.layoutDropdownSize=nil;queue()end)
                    connect(list.ChildRemoved,function()record.layoutDropdownSize=nil;queue()end)
                    connect(row:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Size'),queue)
                end
            elseif child:IsA('TextLabel') and kind~='TextMuted' and record.displayName then child.Text=record.displayName
            elseif child:IsA('TextButton') and record.config and record.config.OptionsMenu then child.Text='\226\150\184' end
        end
        if record.kind=='CreateSlider' and record.widget.Frame then
            local value=record.widget.Frame:FindFirstChildOfClass('TextLabel')
            if value then value:SetAttribute('CullingFontRole','annotation');ui.applyMenuTextSize(value) end
        end
        if record.refreshBinary then record.refreshBinary() end
    end
    function ui.applyCanonicalLockVisibility(record)
        if record.tab=='Player' and record.name=='Lock On Mode' or record.tab=='Main' and (record.name=='Camera Only'
            or record.name=='Character Lock with Shift Lock' or record.name=='Auto Lock On When You Hit') then
            record.config.CanonicalHidden=true
            record.config.QuickSettingsOnly=true
        end
    end
    -- Geometry only: resizing must not restyle/rebuild every control or emit callbacks.
    local function responsivePut(object: any,property: string,value: any)
        if object[property]~=value then object[property]=value end
    end
    local function responsiveRowWidth(row,panel)
        local main=panel.Main
        local scale=main:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UIScale')
        local factor=if scale then math.max(.01,scale.Scale) else 1
        local width=if main.Size.X.Scale==0 then main.Size.X.Offset else main.AbsoluteSize.X/factor
        local chain,current={},row
        while current and current~=main do
            if not current:IsA('GuiObject') then return row.AbsoluteSize.X/factor end
            table.insert(chain,current);current=current.Parent
        end
        if not current then return row.AbsoluteSize.X/factor end
        -- Hidden pages can retain stale AbsoluteSize until rendered. Their UDim
        -- widths still resolve immediately from the shared window bounds.
        for i=#chain,1,-1 do local size=chain[i].Size;width=width*size.X.Scale+size.X.Offset end
        return math.max(1,width)
    end
    function ui.queueResponsiveRows()
        if ui.responsiveRowsQueued or not ui.alive or not menu.alive then return end
        ui.responsiveRowsQueued=true
        host.task.defer(function()
            ui.responsiveRowsQueued=false
            if not ui.alive or not menu.alive then return end
            for _,record in menu.rows do ui.layoutResponsiveRow(record) end
        end)
    end
    function ui.layoutResponsiveRow(record)
        local panel,row=menu.panel,record.row
        if not panel or not panel.responsiveChrome or not row or not row.Parent or record.responsiveWriting then return end
        if row==panel.ScaleWidget.Frame then return end
        record.responsiveWriting=true
        local config,widget=record.config or {},record.widget or {}
        local width=responsiveRowWidth(row,panel)
        record.responsiveWidth=width
        local heading,description=row:FindFirstChild('Name'),row:FindFirstChild('Description')
        local targetRow=menu.targetDetails and menu.targetDetails.Parent.Parent==row
        if targetRow then ui.targetResponsiveRecord=record end
        local control=record.checkboxContainer or record.binarySwitch or record.menuRecorder or record.colorButton or widget.Button
        if record.kind=='CreateSlider' then control=widget.Frame end
        local inset=if ui.editor and ui.editor.enabled then 28 else 12
        local usable=math.max(1,width-inset-12)
        local nameHeight=math.max(28,(if heading then heading.TextSize else 14)+8)
        local descHeight=math.max(18,(if description then description.TextSize else 12)+6)
        local toggle=control and control:GetAttribute('WidgetType')=='ToggleSwitch'
        local slider=record.kind=='CreateSlider'
        local desired=if toggle then 44 elseif record.menuRecorder then 222 elseif config.LiveFriends then 270 elseif record.colorButton then 132 else 178
        local stacked=control~=nil and not toggle and (width<440 or usable-desired<160)
        local controlWidth=if slider and not stacked then usable*.56 else math.min(desired,usable)
        if stacked then controlWidth=usable end
        local controlHeight=if toggle then 24 elseif slider then math.max(28,(appearance.menuFontSizes.annotation or 8)+8) else math.max(27,(appearance.menuFontSizes.content or 14)+10)
        local controlX=if stacked then inset else width-12-controlWidth
        local controlY=if stacked then 5+nameHeight+4 else 5
        local firstHeight=if stacked then nameHeight else math.max(nameHeight,if control then controlHeight else 0)
        if not stacked then controlY=5+(firstHeight-controlHeight)/2 end
        if heading then
            heading.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(inset,5)
            heading.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(if control and not stacked then math.max(1,controlX-inset-8) else usable,firstHeight)
            heading.TextWrapped,heading.TextTruncate,heading.ClipsDescendants=false,Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,true
        end
        local bottom=if stacked then controlY+controlHeight else 5+firstHeight
        if control then
            if slider then
                -- The track is always seven pixels high. Do not temporarily
                -- expand it to the input hitbox height before restoring it.
                responsivePut(control,'Position',UDim2.fromOffset(controlX,controlY+(controlHeight-7)/2))
                responsivePut(control,'Size',UDim2.fromOffset(controlWidth,7))
                if record.fineSlider then
                    responsivePut(record.fineSlider,'Position',UDim2.fromOffset(controlX,controlY))
                    responsivePut(record.fineSlider,'Size',UDim2.fromOffset(controlWidth,controlHeight))
                end
                local value=control:FindFirstChildOfClass('TextLabel')
                if value then
                    responsivePut(value,'Position',UDim2.new(0,0,.5,-controlHeight/2))
                    responsivePut(value,'Size',UDim2.new(1,0,0,controlHeight))
                    responsivePut(value,'TextTruncate',Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd)
                end
            else
                control.Position,control.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(controlX,controlY),UDim2.fromOffset(controlWidth,controlHeight)
                if control:IsA('TextButton') or control:IsA('TextBox') then
                    control.TextWrapped,control.TextTruncate,control.ClipsDescendants=false,Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,true
                end
            end
        end
        if description then
            description.Visible=not targetRow and description.Text~=''
            description.Position,description.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,bottom+4),UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1,width-24),descHeight)
            description.TextWrapped,description.TextTruncate,description.ClipsDescendants=false,Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,true
            if description.Visible then bottom+=4+descHeight end
        end
        local list=record.checkboxList or (if record.kind=='CreateDropdown' then widget.Frame else nil)
        if list and list:IsA('ScrollingFrame') then
            local open=if record.checkboxList then record.checkboxDropdownOpen==true else list.Visible and list.Size.Y.Offset>0
            local optionHeight=math.max(29,(appearance.menuFontSizes.content or 14)+8)
            local count=0
            local hasLayout=list:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIListLayout')~=nil
            for _,option in list:GetChildren() do if option:IsA('TextButton') then
                option.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,optionHeight)
                if not hasLayout then option.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,count*(optionHeight+5)) end
                option.TextTruncate,option.ClipsDescendants=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,true
                count+=1
            end end
            local listHeight=if open then math.min(if config.LiveFriends then 240 else 180,count*(optionHeight+5)) else 0
            local listY=bottom+6
            if record.checkboxList then
                list.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,listY-controlY)
                list.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,listHeight)
                list.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,count*(optionHeight+5))
            else
                list.Position,list.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(controlX,listY),UDim2.fromOffset(controlWidth,listHeight)
                record.layoutDropdownSize=list.Size
            end
            if open then bottom=listY+listHeight end
        end
        if record.colorButton then
            for _,caption in record.colorButton:GetChildren() do if caption:IsA('TextLabel') then
                caption.Size=UDim2.new(1,-46,1,0);caption.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd;caption.ClipsDescendants=true
            end end
        end
        if targetRow then
            local footer=menu.targetDetails.Parent
            local textHeight=math.max(18,appearance.infoFontSize+5)
            footer.Position,footer.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,bottom+8),UDim2.new(1,-24,0,textHeight*3+14)
            menu.targetDetails.Position,menu.targetDetails.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,13),UDim2.new(1,0,0,textHeight*2)
            menu.targetDetails.TextWrapped,menu.targetDetails.TextTruncate=true,Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            if menu.targetStatus then menu.targetStatus.Position,menu.targetStatus.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,13+textHeight*2),UDim2.new(1,0,0,textHeight);menu.targetStatus.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end
            bottom+=8+textHeight*3+14
        end
        row.ClipsDescendants=true
        local size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,math.max(54,bottom+8))
        if row.Size~=size then row.Size=size end
        record.layoutRowSize=row.Size
        record.responsiveWriting=false
        if not ui.responsiveWindowConnection then
            ui.responsiveWindowConnection=connect(panel.Main:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Size'),ui.queueResponsiveRows)
            connect(panel.ContentArea:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Size'),ui.queueResponsiveRows)
        end
        if not record.responsiveConnection then
            record.responsiveConnection=connect(row:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),function()
                if record.responsiveWriting or not ui.alive or not menu.alive or not row.Parent then return end
                local currentWidth=responsiveRowWidth(row,panel)
                if math.abs(currentWidth-(record.responsiveWidth or 0))<.1 or record.responsiveQueued then return end
                record.responsiveQueued=true
                host.task.defer(function()
                    record.responsiveQueued=false
                    if ui.alive and menu.alive and row.Parent then ui.layoutResponsiveRow(record) end
                end)
            end)
        end
    end
    function ui.configureRow(record)
        local row = record.row
        if not ui.alive or not row or not row.Parent or not menu.alive or record.adjusting then return end
        ui.applyCanonicalLockVisibility(record)
        record.adjusting = true
        ui.attachFineSlider(record)
        row.Visible=not (record.config and record.config.QuickSettingsOnly) and (not menu.controlApplicable or menu.controlApplicable(record))
        ui.attachFriendsDropdown(record)
        ui.attachMenuRecorder(record)
        ui.attachBinarySwitch(record)
        ui.attachCheckboxes(record)
        if ui.nativeMode then
            ui.prepareNativeRow(record)
            ui.finishNativeRow(record)
            ui.layoutResponsiveRow(record)
            record.adjusting=false
            return
        end
        local targetRow = menu.targetDetails and row == menu.targetDetails.Parent.Parent
        local height = math.max(if record.kind == "CreateParagraph" then 54 else 63, 45 + appearance.infoFontSize)
        -- Compute the final height first. Collapsing a live row before expanding
        -- it again clamps its scrolling page and re-triggers deferred Size signals.
        row.BorderSizePixel = 0
        if ui.palette then row.BackgroundColor3 = ui.palette["Row Color"] end
        if appearance.transparency["Row Color"] ~= nil then row.BackgroundTransparency = appearance.transparency["Row Color"] end
        ui.shadeSurface(row,'row')
        corner(row, 7)
        if not record.divider then
            local divider = owned("Frame")
            divider.Name, divider.Size = "CullingDivider", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1)
            divider.Position, divider.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -1), 0
            divider.BackgroundTransparency, divider.Parent = 0.78, row
            record.divider = divider
        end
        record.divider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(135,135,135)
        record.divider.BackgroundTransparency,record.divider.Visible=.65,true
        for _, child in row:GetChildren() do
            if child:GetAttribute("CullingModern") then continue end
            local kind = child:GetAttribute("WidgetType")
            if (record.checkboxContainer or record.binarySwitch or record.menuRecorder) and (child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("ScrollingFrame")) then
                ui.hideNativeDropdown(record, child)
                continue
            end
            if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                if not appearance.originalLook and child.Font~=Enum.Font.Gotham then child.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham end
                child.TextXAlignment, child.TextTruncate = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                menuFont(child)
                if kind == "TextMuted" then
                    child.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 35)
                    child.Size = UDim2.new(1, if record.kind == "CreateDropdown" then -204 else -24, 0, appearance.infoFontSize+5)
                    ui.applyMenuTextSize(child)
                else
                    if record.displayName then child.Text = record.displayName end
                    child.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(if ui.editor and ui.editor.enabled then 28 else 12, 5)
                    child.Size = if record.kind=='CreateSlider' then UDim2.new(0.42,if ui.editor and ui.editor.enabled then -40 else -24,0,28) else UDim2.new(1, if record.kind == "CreateParagraph" then -24 elseif record.kind=='CreateColorPicker' then -164 elseif record.kind == "CreateToggle" then -84 elseif record.menuRecorder then -248 else -204, 0, 28)
                    ui.applyMenuTextSize(child)
                end
            elseif kind == "ToggleSwitch" then
                child.Position,child.Size=UDim2.new(1,-58,0,8),UDim2.fromOffset(44,24)
                corner(child,0)
                for _,native in child:GetChildren() do
                    if native:IsA('Frame') and native.Name~='SlidingSwitchFace' then native.Visible=false end
                end
                if not record.switchSetWrapper and record.kind=='CreateToggle' then
                    local original=record.widget.Set
                    record.switchOriginalSet=original
                    local wrapper=function(...)
                        local results=table.pack(original(...))
                        if ui.alive and child.Parent then ui.styleSquareSwitch(child,nil,record.widget.Get()==true) end
                        return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
                    end
                    record.switchSetWrapper=wrapper;record.widget.Set=wrapper
                end
                ui.styleSquareSwitch(child,record.squareMark,record.widget.Get()==true)
                if record.kind=='CreateToggle' and not record.switchStateConnection then
                    local function syncState()
                        if not ui.alive or not child.Parent then return end
                        local state=ui.switchStates[child]
                        local enabled=record.widget.Get()==true
                        if state and state.enabled~=enabled then ui.styleSquareSwitch(child,nil,enabled) end
                    end
                    record.switchStateConnection=connect(child:GetPropertyChangedSignal('BackgroundColor3'),syncState)
                    connect(child.InputEnded,function() host.task.defer(syncState) end)
                end
            elseif child==record.fineSlider then
                child.Position,child.Size=UDim2.new(.42,0,0,2),UDim2.new(.58,-14,0,30)
            elseif child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("TextBox") then
                if record.config and record.config.OptionsMenu and child:IsA('TextButton') then
                    child.Text='\226\150\184'
                end
                child.Position, child.Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 6), UDim2.fromOffset(178, 27)
                if not appearance.originalLook and child.Font~=Enum.Font.Gotham then child.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham end
                ui.applyMenuTextSize(child)
                menuFont(child)
                corner(child, 5)
                if record.kind~='CreateColorPicker' then ui.shadeSurface(child,'control') end
            elseif record.kind=='CreateSlider' and child==record.widget.Frame then
                child.Position,child.Size=UDim2.new(0.42,0,0,14),UDim2.new(0.58,-14,0,7)
                if record.fineSlider then record.fineSlider.Position=UDim2.new(.42,0,0,2);record.fineSlider.Size=UDim2.new(.58,-14,0,30) end
                child.ClipsDescendants=false
                local value=child:FindFirstChildOfClass('TextLabel')
                if value then
                    value.Position,value.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,0.5,-8),UDim2.new(1,0,0,16)
                    value:SetAttribute('CullingFontRole','annotation')
                    value.TextSize,value.Font,value.TextScaled=appearance.menuFontSizes.annotation,Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,false
                    menuFont(value)
                end
            elseif kind == "SliderTrack" then
                child.Position, child.Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 13), UDim2.fromOffset(178, 7)
            elseif child:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                local list = child
                local opened, count = list.Size.Y.Offset > 0, 0
                list.BackgroundColor3, list.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 74), 0.35
                ui.shadeSurface(list,'list')
                for _, option in list:GetChildren() do
                    if option:IsA("TextButton") then
                        count += 1
                        local optionSize=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,29)
                        if option.Size~=optionSize then option.Size=optionSize end
                        if not appearance.originalLook and option.Font~=Enum.Font.Gotham then option.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham end
                        ui.applyMenuTextSize(option)
                        menuFont(option)
                        option.BorderSizePixel = 0
                        option.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
                        if ui.palette then option.BackgroundColor3, option.TextColor3 = ui.palette["Button Background Color"], ui.palette["Text Color"] end
                        corner(option, 4)
                        ui.shadeSurface(option,'control')
                    end
                end
                local listHeight = if opened then math.min(180, if count > 0 then count*30 else list.Size.Y.Offset) else 0
                list.Position = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, if targetRow then 45 else 37)
                local listSize=if ui.nativeMode then UDim2.new(list.Size.X.Scale,list.Size.X.Offset,0,listHeight) else UDim2.fromOffset(178,listHeight)
                if list.Size~=listSize then list.Size=listSize end
                list.AutomaticCanvasSize, list.ScrollBarThickness = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, 3
                if opened and not targetRow then height=math.max(height,44+listHeight) end
                if not record.dropdownWatch then
                    local function queue()
                        if record.adjusting or record.responsiveWriting or record.layoutQueued then return end
                        if row.Size==record.layoutRowSize and list.Size==record.layoutDropdownSize then return end
                        record.layoutQueued = true
                        host.task.defer(function()
                            record.layoutQueued = false
                            ui.configureRow(record)
                        end)
                    end
                    local function optionsChanged()
                        record.layoutDropdownSize=nil
                        queue()
                    end
                    record.dropdownWatch = connect(list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"), queue)
                    connect(list.ChildAdded, optionsChanged)
                    connect(list.ChildRemoved, optionsChanged)
                    connect(row:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"), queue)
                end
                record.layoutDropdownSize=list.Size
            end
        end
        if record.checkboxContainer then
            ui.shadeSurface(record.checkboxHeader,'control')
            ui.shadeSurface(record.checkboxList,'list')
            record.checkboxContainer.Position, record.checkboxContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -190, 0, 6), UDim2.fromOffset(178, 27)
            local listHeight=if record.checkboxDropdownOpen then math.min(#record.checkboxOptions*30,if record.config.LiveFriends then 240 else math.huge) else 0
            record.checkboxList.Visible=record.checkboxDropdownOpen==true
            local listSize=UDim2.fromOffset(178,listHeight)
            if record.checkboxList.Size~=listSize then record.checkboxList.Size=listSize end
            if record.checkboxDropdownOpen then height=math.max(height,44+listHeight) end
            if record.config.LiveFriends then
                record.checkboxContainer.Position,record.checkboxContainer.Size=UDim2.new(1,-282,0,6),UDim2.fromOffset(270,27)
                record.checkboxList.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(270,listHeight)
            end
            record.refreshCheckboxes()
        end
        if record.refreshBinary then record.refreshBinary() end
        if targetRow then ui.layoutTarget()
        else
            local rowSize=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,height)
            if not ui.nativeMode and row.Size~=rowSize then row.Size=rowSize end
        end
        record.layoutRowSize=row.Size
        if ui.nativeMode then ui.finishNativeRow(record) end
        ui.layoutResponsiveRow(record)
        record.adjusting = false
    end

    local SECTION_ALIASES = {
        ['Main/Camera'] = 'Main/Movement & camera', ['Main/Camera & view'] = 'Main/Movement & camera',
        ['Main/Movement'] = 'Main/Movement & camera', ['Main/Movement & view'] = 'Main/Movement & camera',
        ['Main/Blocking'] = 'Automatic/Blocking', ['Automatic/Blocking & counters'] = 'Automatic/Counters',
        ['Main/Anti-stun'] = 'Main/Stun & skill movement', ['Main/M1 hitbox'] = 'Main/Hitboxes',
    }
    local SECTION_ORDER = {
        Main = {'Movement & camera', 'Lock on', 'Lock-on curves & timing', 'Direction Freedom', 'Hitboxes', 'ESP', 'Information & damage', 'Info hub fields',
            'Enemy info card', 'Enemy status markers', 'Self HUD', 'Resource displays', 'Dashing', 'Stun & skill movement', 'Ragdoll & recovery', 'Knockback', 'Action controls', 'Interaction',
            'Parkour', 'Failsafe & debug', 'Game utilities'},
        Automatic = {'Blocking', 'Unblockable & skills', 'Dash out of trades', 'Block aim', 'Counters', 'Counter & punish aim', 'Punish', 'Aim & melee assists', 'Target filters', 'Prediction',
            'Skill movement', 'Skills', 'Character abilities', 'Skill interactions', 'Respawn'},
        Settings = {'Configuration', 'Theme colors', 'Text sizes', 'Appearance & layout', 'Menu look', 'Menu rows & controls', 'Menu transparency & effects', 'Menu text', 'Menu rail & tabs', 'Bar styling', 'Mini menus', 'Live data panel', 'Data editor', 'Performance'},
    }
    local function matchRule(rule, name)
        if rule.isSet[name] then return true end
        for _, prefix in rule.starts or {} do if name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then return true end end
        for _, part in rule.has or {} do if name:find(part, 1, true) then return true end end
        for _, pattern in rule.pat or {} do if name:find(pattern) then return true end end
        return false
    end
    function ui.groupOrderFor(key)
        local tab, group = tostring(key):match('^(.-)/(.+)$')
        local order = tab and SECTION_ORDER[tab]
        if not order then return nil end
        local index = table.find(order, group)
        return if index then index * 10 else nil
    end
    local function groupFor(record)
        local name = record.name:lower()
        local tab, group
        for _, rule in ruleIndex do
            if matchRule(rule, name) then tab, group = rule[1], rule[2];break end
        end
        if not tab then tab, group = groupForBase(record) end
        local alias = SECTION_ALIASES[tab .. '/' .. group]
        if alias then tab, group = alias:match('^(.-)/(.+)$') end
        return tab, group
    end
    ui.groupFor = groupFor
    function ui.refreshEmptyGroups()
        for _,group in ui.groups do
            if group.childGroups then continue end
            local visible=false
            for _,record in group.records do
                if record.row and record.row.Parent==group.contents and record.row.Visible then visible=true;break end
            end
            if group.frame.Visible~=visible then group.frame.Visible=visible end
        end
        for _,group in ui.groups do if group.childGroups then
            local visible=false
            for _,child in group.childGroups do if child.frame.Visible then visible=true;break end end
            group.frame.Visible=visible
        end end
    end
    function ui.applyTabOrganization()
        local panel=menu.panel
        if ui.nativeMode then
            for index,button in panel.TabButtons do
                button.Visible=true
                if ui.nativeTabText and ui.nativeTabText[index] then button.Text=ui.nativeTabText[index] end
            end
            return
        end
        local labels={Transform='Looks',Fun='Misc',Automatic='Game'}
        local merged={Scripts=true,Skill=true,Aura=true,Animation=true,Music=true,Game=true}
        ui.tabIdentities=ui.tabIdentities or {}
        for index,page in panel.Pages do
            local identity=ui.tabIdentities[page]
            if not identity then
                for name,tab in menu.tabs do if tab.page==page then identity=name;break end end
                ui.tabIdentities[page]=identity
            end
            local button=panel.TabButtons[index]
            if button and identity then
                button.Visible=not merged[identity]
                if labels[identity] then button.Text=labels[identity] end
                if merged[identity] then
                    local destination=if identity=='Skill' or identity=='Scripts' then 'Transform' else 'Fun'
                    if page.Visible then page.Visible=false;menu.tabs[destination].page.Visible=true end
                    local line=panel.TabLines[index];if line then line.Visible=false end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function ui.section(page, name, key)
        if ui.groups[key] then return ui.groups[key] end
        local section = owned("Frame")
        section.Name = "Section_"..name
        ui.groupCount = (ui.groupCount or 0) + 1
        section.LayoutOrder = (ui.groupOrderFor and ui.groupOrderFor(key)) or (1000 + ui.groupCount)
        section.BackgroundTransparency, section.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        section.Size, section.AutomaticSize = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 31), Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        section.Parent = page
        local header = button(section, "  -  "..name, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 29), nil)
        header.Name, header.TextXAlignment = "SectionHeader", Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        header.BackgroundColor3, header.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 54, 62), Color3.fromRGB(204, 211, 221)
        header.BackgroundTransparency = 0.30
        local separator=owned('Frame')
        separator.Name,separator.Position,separator.Size='SectionDivider',UDim2.new(0,4,1,-1),UDim2.new(1,-8,0,1)
        separator.BackgroundColor3,separator.BackgroundTransparency,separator.BorderSizePixel,separator.Parent=Color3.fromRGB(135,135,135),.65,0,header
        local contents = owned("Frame")
        contents.Name, contents.Position = "Contents", UDim2.fromOffset(5, 35)
        contents.Size, contents.AutomaticSize = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0), Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        contents.BackgroundTransparency, contents.BorderSizePixel, contents.Parent = 1, 0, section
        local layout = owned("UIListLayout")
        layout.Padding, layout.SortOrder, layout.Parent = UDim.new(0, 5), Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, contents
        local expanded = true
        local function setExpanded(value)
            expanded = value
            contents.Visible = expanded
            contents.AutomaticSize = if expanded then Enum.AutomaticSize.Y else Enum.AutomaticSize.None
            contents.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0)
            header.Text = "  "..(if expanded then "-" else "+").."  "..name
        end
        connect(header.Activated, function() setExpanded(not expanded) end)
        local result = {frame = section, header = header, contents = contents, records = {},setExpanded=setExpanded}
        connect(header.InputBegan, function(object)
            if object.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then menu.openMiniPopup({name = name}, result.records) end
        end)
        ui.groups[key] = result
        return result
    end
    function ui.nestCharacterSections()
        local tab=menu.tabs and menu.tabs.Automatic
        if not tab then return end
        local key='Automatic/Skills'
        local existing=ui.groups[key]
        local parent=ui.section(tab.page,'Skills',key)
        if not existing then parent.setExpanded(false) end
        parent.childGroups={};parent.records={}
        appearance.order=appearance.order or {}
        for _,name in {'Gojo','Hakari','Charles','Higuruma','Mahito','Megumi','Haruta','Nanami','Sukuna','Todo','Toji','Yuji','Yuki','Yuta'} do
            local childKey='Automatic/'..name
            local child=ui.groups[childKey]
            if child then
                child.frame.Parent=parent.contents
                table.insert(parent.childGroups,child)
                for _,record in child.records do table.insert(parent.records,record) end
                appearance.order['section/'..childKey]={parent='section/'..key,order=child.frame.LayoutOrder}
            end
        end
    end
    function ui.organizeGroups()
        local weights={['Lock on']=1,['Camera & view']=2,['Movement & view']=3,['Dashing']=4,['Parkour']=5,
            ['Stun & skill movement']=6,['Ragdoll & recovery']=7,['Knockback']=8,['Hitboxes']=9,
            ['Information & damage']=10,['Resource displays']=11,['Interaction']=12,
            ['Blocking']=1,['Counters']=2,['Punish']=3,['Aim & melee assists']=4,['Prediction']=5,['Skills']=6,['Skill movement']=7,
            ['Configuration']=1,['Appearance & layout']=2,['Performance']=3}
        local priority={['Auto Block']=1,['Auto Counter']=1,['Auto Punish']=1,['Activate Lock On']=1,['Lock On']=2,
            ['Auto Lock On']=3,['Auto Lock On Trigger']=4,['Block Range']=2,['Counter Range']=2,['Auto Punish Range']=2,
            ['M1 Assist']=1,['M1 Assist Method']=2,['M1 Aim Assist']=3,['Skill Aim Assist']=4,
            ['Cooldown Viewer']=1,['Info ESP']=1,
            ['Config Name']=1,['Saved Configs']=2,['Save Config']=3,['Load Saved Config']=4,['Export Config']=5,['Import Config']=6,['Unload GUI']=99}
        local groups={}
        for key,group in ui.groups do table.insert(groups,{key=key,group=group}) end
        table.sort(groups,function(a,b)
            local at,an=a.key:match('^([^/]+)/(.+)$');local bt,bn=b.key:match('^([^/]+)/(.+)$')
            if at~=bt then return at<bt end
            local aw,bw=weights[an] or 20,weights[bn] or 20
            return if aw~=bw then aw<bw else an<bn
        end)
        local migrate=appearance.organizationVersion~=2
        appearance.order=appearance.order or {}
        for index,item in groups do
            local group=item.group;group.frame.LayoutOrder=index
            table.sort(group.records,function(a,b)
                local ap,bp=priority[a.name] or 20,priority[b.name] or 20
                if ap~=bp then return ap<bp end
                if a.name~=b.name then return a.name<b.name end
                return a.tab<b.tab
            end)
            for order,record in group.records do
                record.row.LayoutOrder=order
                if migrate then appearance.order['row/'..record.tab..'/'..record.name]={parent='section/'..item.key,order=order} end
            end
            if migrate then
                local tab=item.key:match('^([^/]+)/')
                appearance.order['section/'..item.key]={parent='page/'..tab,order=index}
            end
        end
        appearance.organizationVersion=2
    end
    function ui.closeColor()
        if ui.colorPopup and menu.colorAppearancePanel and type(menu.colorAppearancePanel.detach)=='function'then menu.colorAppearancePanel.detach(ui.colorPopup)end
        ui.colorGesture = nil
        ui.colorPoint = nil
        ui.colorRecord = nil
        if ui.colorInstances then
            for index=#menu.instances,1,-1 do if ui.colorInstances[menu.instances[index]] then table.remove(menu.instances,index) end end
        end
        ui.colorInstances=nil
        if ui.colorPopup then ui.colorPopup:Destroy()
        ui.colorPopup = nil end
        for _, connection in ui.colorConnections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
        ui.colorConnections = {}
    end
    function ui.openColor(record)
        if not ui.alive or not record or not record.widget then return end
        if ui.colorPopup and ui.colorRecord==record then return end
        ui.closeColor()
        local W,H=388,584
        local Z=12101
        local HttpService=host.game:GetService('HttpService')
        local STORE_FILE='Shenaniganism/PickerColors.json'
        local function popupConnect(signal,callback) table.insert(ui.colorConnections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
        -- Saved colours: recents and favourites survive restarts.
        local store=appearance.pickerStore
        if not store then
            store={recent={},favorites={}}
            pcall(function()
                if isfile and isfile(STORE_FILE) then
                    local data=HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(STORE_FILE))
                    if type(data)=='table' then store.recent=data.recent or {};store.favorites=data.favorites or {} end
                end
            end)
            appearance.pickerStore=store
        end
        local function saveStore()
            pcall(function()
                if writefile then
                    if makefolder then pcall(makefolder,'Shenaniganism') end
                    writefile(STORE_FILE,HttpService:JSONEncode({recent=store.recent,favorites=store.favorites}))
                end
            end)
        end
        local function toHex(color,alpha)
            local base=string.format('#%02X%02X%02X',math.round(color.R*255),math.round(color.G*255),math.round(color.B*255))
            if alpha and alpha>0.002 then base..=string.format('%02X',math.round((1-alpha)*255)) end
            return base
        end
        local function fromHex(text)
            local digits=tostring(text):match('^%s*#?(%x+)%s*$')
            if digits and #digits==3 then digits=digits:gsub('.',function(c)return c..c end) end
            if digits and (#digits==6 or #digits==8) then
                local color=Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(digits:sub(1,2),16) or 0,tonumber(digits:sub(3,4),16) or 0,tonumber(digits:sub(5,6),16) or 0)
                local alpha=if #digits==8 then 1-(tonumber(digits:sub(7,8),16) or 0)/255 else nil
                return color,alpha
            end
            local r,g,b=tostring(text):match('rgb%a*%(%s*([%d%.]+)[%s,]+([%d%.]+)[%s,]+([%d%.]+)')
            if r then return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(tonumber(r) or 0,0,255),math.clamp(tonumber(g) or 0,0,255),math.clamp(tonumber(b) or 0,0,255)) end
            local h,s,l=tostring(text):match('hsl%a*%(%s*([%d%.]+)[%s,]+([%d%.]+)%%?[%s,]+([%d%.]+)')
            if h then
                local hh,ss,ll=(tonumber(h) or 0)/360,(tonumber(s) or 0)/100,(tonumber(l) or 0)/100
                local v=ll+ss*math.min(ll,1-ll)
                return Color3.fromHSV(hh%1,if v>0 then 2*(1-ll/v) else 0,v)
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function luminance(color)
            local function channel(x) return if x<=.03928 then x/12.92 else ((x+.055)/1.055)^2.4 end
            return .2126*channel(color.R)+.7152*channel(color.G)+.0722*channel(color.B)
        end
        -- ===== targets: the colour itself, plus any companion colours the setting offers (outline, shadow, background) =====
        local function primaryGet()
            local c=record.widget.Get()
            if menu.colorValue then c=menu.colorValue(c,Color3.new(1,1,1)) end
            return c
        end
        local function primarySet(color,alpha,emit)
            appearance.transparency[record.name]=alpha
            appearance.colorControls[record.tab..'/'..record.name]={color=color,alpha=alpha}
            if emit==true and record.config and record.config.SetTransparency then record.config.SetTransparency(alpha) end
            record.widget.Set(color,emit==true)
            if record.swatch then record.swatch.BackgroundColor3,record.swatch.BackgroundTransparency=color,alpha end
            if record.config and record.config.MiniMenuAppearance then ui.queueMiniAppearance()
            elseif record.tab=='Settings' then ui.queueAppearance(record.name) end
        end
        local targets={{name='Colour',get=primaryGet,set=primarySet,alpha=function()return ui.colorAlpha(record)end}}
        local extras=record.config and record.config.PickerExtras or {}
        for _,extra in extras do
            if extra.kind=='color' then
                table.insert(targets,{name=extra.label,get=extra.get,set=function(color,alpha,emit)extra.set(color,alpha,emit)end,alpha=extra.alpha or function()return 0 end})
            end
        end
        local targetIndex=1
        local original,originalAlpha=targets[1].get(),targets[1].alpha()
        local baseH,baseS,baseV=original:ToHSV()
        local alpha=originalAlpha
        local adjust={bright=0,contrast=0,sat=0,hue=0,temp=0,tint=0,gamma=0,invert=0,gray=0}
        local padMode,precisionIndex=1,1
        local PRECISION={{'Normal',1},{'Fine',.2},{'Ultra',.04}}
        local function resultColor()
            local color=Color3.fromHSV(baseH,baseS,baseV)
            local h,s,v=baseH,baseS,baseV
            if adjust.hue~=0 or adjust.sat~=0 or adjust.bright~=0 then
                h=(h+adjust.hue/360)%1
                s=math.clamp(s*(1+adjust.sat/100),0,1)
                v=math.clamp(v+adjust.bright/100,0,1)
                color=Color3.fromHSV(h,s,v)
            end
            local r,g,b=color.R,color.G,color.B
            if adjust.contrast~=0 then
                local k=1+adjust.contrast/100
                r,g,b=(r-.5)*k+.5,(g-.5)*k+.5,(b-.5)*k+.5
            end
            if adjust.temp~=0 then r,b=r+adjust.temp/100*.3,b-adjust.temp/100*.3 end
            if adjust.tint~=0 then g=g+adjust.tint/100*.3 end
            r,g,b=math.clamp(r,0,1),math.clamp(g,0,1),math.clamp(b,0,1)
            if adjust.gamma~=0 then
                local exponent=1/math.max(.2,1+adjust.gamma/100)
                r,g,b=r^exponent,g^exponent,b^exponent
            end
            if adjust.invert>0 then local m=adjust.invert/100;r,g,b=r*(1-m)+(1-r)*m,g*(1-m)+(1-g)*m,b*(1-m)+(1-b)*m end
            if adjust.gray>0 then
                local m=adjust.gray/100
                local lum=.299*r+.587*g+.114*b
                r,g,b=r*(1-m)+lum*m,g*(1-m)+lum*m,b*(1-m)+lum*m
            end
            return Color3.new(math.clamp(r,0,1),math.clamp(g,0,1),math.clamp(b,0,1))
        end
        -- ===== popup shell =====
        local popup=owned('Frame')
        popup.Name,popup.Size='CullingColorPicker',UDim2.fromOffset(W,H)
        local popupRoot=if menu.getPopupRoot then menu.getPopupRoot() else menu.panel.Root
        local origin,view=popupRoot.AbsolutePosition,popupRoot.AbsoluteSize
        local point=input:GetMouseLocation()
        popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(point.X-origin.X,0,math.max(0,view.X-W)),math.clamp(point.Y-origin.Y,0,math.max(0,view.Y-H)))
        popup.BackgroundColor3,popup.BorderSizePixel,popup.ZIndex=Color3.fromRGB(15,19,27),0,12100
        popup.Parent,ui.colorPopup,ui.colorRecord=popupRoot,popup,record
        corner(popup,14)

        local function make(class,name,parent,x,y,w,h,color)
            local object=owned(class)

            if object:IsA('GuiObject') then
                object.Position,object.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)

            return object
        end
        local function caption(parent,text,x,y,w,h,size,align,color)

        local title=caption(popup,record.name,14,8,W-80,22,13,nil,Color3.fromRGB(226,233,244))

        -- ===== tabs =====
        local TAB_NAMES={'Pick','Sliders','Adjust','Palette','Style'}

            pages[index]=page
        end
        -- target selector (colour / outline / shadow / background ...)
        local targetButtons={}
        local function buildTargets()
            if #targets<2 then return end
            local width=math.floor((W-28-(#targets-1)*4)/#targets)
            for index,target in targets do
                targetButtons[index]=clickable(popup,target.name,14+(index-1)*(width+4),H-30,width,22,function() end,10)
            end
        end
        -- ===== slider component =====
        local sliders={}
        local dragState: any=nil
        local function makeSlider(parent,spec)
            local row=make('Frame','SliderRow',parent,spec.x,spec.y,spec.w,24)
            caption(row,spec.label,0,4,58,16,10)
            local trackWidth=spec.w-58-64
            local track=make('Frame','Track',row,58,8,trackWidth,10,Color3.fromRGB(60,66,78))
            corner(track,5)
            local fill=make('Frame','Fill',track,0,0,trackWidth,10,Color3.new(1,1,1))
            corner(fill,5)
            local gradient=owned('UIGradient');gradient.Parent=fill
            local knob=make('Frame','Knob',track,0,-3,6,16,Color3.new(1,1,1))
            corner(knob,3)
            local ring=owned('UIStroke');ring.Color,ring.Thickness,ring.Transparency=Color3.fromRGB(15,19,27),1.5,0;ring.Parent=knob
            local number=box(row,spec.w-58,2,54,20,function(text)
                local value=tonumber((tostring(text):gsub('[^%d%.%-]','')))
                if value then spec.set(math.clamp(value,spec.min,spec.max),true) end
            end)
            number.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            local item={spec=spec,track=track,fill=fill,gradient=gradient,knob=knob,number=number}
            function item.refresh()
                local value=spec.get()
                local fraction=(value-spec.min)/(spec.max-spec.min)
                knob.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(fraction,0,1)*(trackWidth-6),-3)
                if spec.gradient then
                    local sequence,transparency=spec.gradient()
                    gradient.Color=sequence
                    gradient.Transparency=transparency or host.NumberSequence.new(0)
                end
                if not number:IsFocused() then number.Text=string.format('%.'..tostring(spec.decimals or 0)..'f',value) end
            end
            popupConnect(track.InputBegan,function(object)
                if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragState={item=item,object=object,startX=object.Position.X,startValue=spec.get(),precision=PRECISION[precisionIndex][2]}
                    if precisionIndex==1 then
                        local fraction=math.clamp((object.Position.X-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,track.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)
                        dragState.startValue=spec.min+(spec.max-spec.min)*fraction
                        dragState.startX=object.Position.X
                        spec.set(dragState.startValue,true)
                    end
                end
            end)
            table.insert(sliders,item)
            return item
        end
        table.insert(ui.colorConnections,input.InputChanged:Connect(function(object)
            if dragState and (object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or object==dragState.object) then
                local item=dragState.item
                local spec=item.spec
                local width=math.max(1,item.track.AbsoluteSize.X)
                local value=dragState.startValue+(object.Position.X-dragState.startX)/width*(spec.max-spec.min)*dragState.precision
                if dragState.precision==1 then value=spec.min+(spec.max-spec.min)*math.clamp((object.Position.X-item.track.AbsolutePosition.X)/width,0,1) end
                spec.set(math.clamp(value,spec.min,spec.max),true)
            end
        end))

            if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                if dragState or padDrag then
                    dragState,padDrag=nil,nil
                    local hex=toHex(resultColor())
                    for index=#store.recent,1,-1 do if store.recent[index]==hex then table.remove(store.recent,index) end end
                    table.insert(store.recent,1,hex)
                    while #store.recent>20 do table.remove(store.recent) end
                    saveStore()
                end
            end
        end))
        local update
        local function setRGB(r,g,b)
            local color=Color3.new(math.clamp(r/255,0,1),math.clamp(g/255,0,1),math.clamp(b/255,0,1))
            baseH,baseS,baseV=color:ToHSV()
            update(true)
        end
        local function hueSequence()
            local stops={}
            for index=0,6 do stops[#stops+1]=host.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(index/6,Color3.fromHSV(index/6,1,1)) end
            return host.ColorSequence.new(stops)
        end
        local function solid(a,b) return host.ColorSequence.new(a,b or a) end
        -- ===== Pick page =====
        local pick=pages[1]
        local PAD_W,PAD_H=W-28,168
        local padFrame=make('TextButton','Pad',pick,14,4,PAD_W,PAD_H,Color3.new(1,1,1))
        padFrame.Text='';padFrame.AutoButtonColor=false
        corner(padFrame,10)

        local whiteGradient=owned('UIGradient');whiteGradient.Parent=whiteLayer
        local blackLayer=make('Frame','Black',padFrame,0,0,PAD_W,PAD_H,Color3.new(0,0,0));corner(blackLayer,10)

        whiteLayer.ZIndex,blackLayer.ZIndex=Z+1,Z+2
        local marker=make('Frame','Marker',padFrame,0,0,14,14)
        marker.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5);marker.BackgroundTransparency=1;marker.ZIndex=Z+4
        corner(marker,7)

        local markerInner=owned('UIStroke');markerInner.Color,markerInner.Thickness,markerInner.Transparency=Color3.new(0,0,0),1,.4;markerInner.Parent=marker
        local MODES={{name='Saturation / Value  +  Hue',x='s',y='v',z='h'},{name='Hue / Saturation  +  Value',x='h',y='s',z='v'},{name='Hue / Value  +  Saturation',x='h',y='v',z='s'}}
        local function channelGet(channel) return if channel=='h' then baseH elseif channel=='s' then baseS else baseV end
        local function channelSet(channel,value) if channel=='h' then baseH=value elseif channel=='s' then baseS=value else baseV=value end end
        local function padPoint(position)
            local mode=MODES[padMode]
            local p,s=padFrame.AbsolutePosition,padFrame.AbsoluteSize
            local x,y=math.clamp((position.X-p.X)/math.max(1,s.X),0,1),math.clamp((position.Y-p.Y)/math.max(1,s.Y),0,1)
            if padDrag and padDrag.precision<1 then
                x=math.clamp(padDrag.startX+(x-padDrag.startX)*padDrag.precision,0,1)
                y=math.clamp(padDrag.startY+(y-padDrag.startY)*padDrag.precision,0,1)
            end
            channelSet(mode.x,x);channelSet(mode.y,1-y)
            update(true)
        end
        popupConnect(padFrame.InputBegan,function(object)
            if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local mode=MODES[padMode]
                local p,s=padFrame.AbsolutePosition,padFrame.AbsoluteSize
                local precision=PRECISION[precisionIndex][2]
                padDrag={object=object,precision=precision,startX=channelGet(mode.x),startY=1-channelGet(mode.y)}
                if precision==1 then padPoint(object.Position) else
                    padDrag.startX=channelGet(mode.x);padDrag.startY=1-channelGet(mode.y)
                    local fx,fy=math.clamp((object.Position.X-p.X)/math.max(1,s.X),0,1),math.clamp((object.Position.Y-p.Y)/math.max(1,s.Y),0,1)
                    padDrag.anchorX,padDrag.anchorY=fx,fy
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(ui.colorConnections,input.InputChanged:Connect(function(object)
            if padDrag and (object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or object==padDrag.object) then
                if padDrag.precision==1 then padPoint(object.Position) else
                    local mode=MODES[padMode]
                    local p,s=padFrame.AbsolutePosition,padFrame.AbsoluteSize
                    local fx,fy=(object.Position.X-p.X)/math.max(1,s.X),(object.Position.Y-p.Y)/math.max(1,s.Y)
                    channelSet(mode.x,math.clamp(padDrag.startX+(fx-padDrag.anchorX)*padDrag.precision,0,1))
                    channelSet(mode.y,math.clamp(1-(padDrag.startY+(fy-padDrag.anchorY)*padDrag.precision),0,1))
                    update(true)
                end
            end
        end))
        makeSlider(pick,{label='Third',x=14,y=PAD_H+10,w=W-28,min=0,max=1,decimals=3,
            get=function()return channelGet(MODES[padMode].z) end,set=function(value)channelSet(MODES[padMode].z,value);update(true) end,
            gradient=function()
                local z=MODES[padMode].z
                if z=='h' then return hueSequence() end
                if z=='s' then return solid(Color3.fromHSV(baseH,0,baseV),Color3.fromHSV(baseH,1,baseV)) end
                return solid(Color3.new(0,0,0),Color3.fromHSV(baseH,baseS,1))
            end})
        makeSlider(pick,{label='Opacity',x=14,y=PAD_H+38,w=W-28,min=0,max=100,decimals=1,
            get=function()return (1-alpha)*100 end,set=function(value)alpha=1-value/100;update(true) end,
            gradient=function()local c=resultColor();return solid(c),host.NumberSequence.new(1,0)end})
        local modeButton=clickable(pick,'Pad: '..MODES[1].name,14,PAD_H+70,W-28,22,function()
            padMode=padMode%#MODES+1
            update(false)
        end,10)
        local precisionButton=clickable(pick,'Precision: Normal  (drag speed)',14,PAD_H+96,W-28,22,function()
            precisionIndex=precisionIndex%#PRECISION+1

        local function nudgeRow(parent,y)
            local names={'-10','-1','-.1','+.1','+1','+10'}
            local deltas={-10,-1,-.1,.1,1,10}
            local width=math.floor((W-28-5*4)/6)

            {'Red',0,255,1,function()return resultColor().R*255 end,function(value)local c=resultColor();setRGB(value,c.G*255,c.B*255)end,function()local c=resultColor();return solid(Color3.new(0,c.G,c.B),Color3.new(1,c.G,c.B)) end},

            {'Lightness',0,100,1,function()local c=Color3.fromHSV(baseH,baseS,baseV);return (math.max(c.R,c.G,c.B)+math.min(c.R,c.G,c.B))*50 end,
                function(value)
                    local c=Color3.fromHSV(baseH,baseS,baseV)
                    local mx,mn=math.max(c.R,c.G,c.B),math.min(c.R,c.G,c.B)
                    local l=value/100
                    local s=if mx==mn then 0 else (mx-mn)/(1-math.abs(2*((mx+mn)/2)-1))
                    local v=l+s*math.min(l,1-l)
                    baseS=if v>0 then 2*(1-l/v) else 0;baseV=v;update(true)
                end,function()return solid(Color3.new(0,0,0),Color3.new(1,1,1)) end},
            {'Opacity',0,100,1,function()return (1-alpha)*100 end,function(value)alpha=1-value/100;update(true)end,function()return solid(resultColor()),host.NumberSequence.new(1,0) end},
        }

        end
        caption(sliderPage,'Numbers accept decimals (127.523): colours are stored as floating point, not 8-bit.',14,4+8*28+4,W-28,26,9).TextWrapped=true

        -- ===== Palette page =====
        local palettePage=pages[4]
        local swatchButtons={}
        local function swatchRow(parent,label,y,colors,columns,size)
            caption(parent,label,14,y,W-28,12,9)
            local gap=4
            local width=math.floor((W-28-(columns-1)*gap)/columns)
            for index,hex in colors do
                local color=fromHex(hex)
                if color then
                    local column,line=(index-1)%columns,math.floor((index-1)/columns)
                    local cell=clickable(parent,'',14+column*(width+gap),y+14+line*(size+gap),width,size,function()
                        local picked=Color3.new(color.R,color.G,color.B)
                        baseH,baseS,baseV=picked:ToHSV()
                        update(true)
                    end)
                    cell.BackgroundColor3=color
                    table.insert(swatchButtons,cell)
                end
            end
            return y+14+math.ceil(#colors/columns)*(size+gap)
        end
        local function hueShifted(delta) local c=Color3.fromHSV((baseH+delta/360)%1,baseS,baseV);return toHex(c) end
        local function buildPalette()
            for _,cell in swatchButtons do cell:Destroy() end
            table.clear(swatchButtons)
            for _,child in palettePage:GetChildren() do if child.Name=='Caption' then child:Destroy() end end
            local y=2
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Complementary',y,{hueShifted(0),hueShifted(180)},2,18)
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Analogous',y,{hueShifted(-30),hueShifted(0),hueShifted(30)},3,18)
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Triadic',y,{hueShifted(0),hueShifted(120),hueShifted(240)},3,18)
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Tetradic',y,{hueShifted(0),hueShifted(90),hueShifted(180),hueShifted(270)},4,18)
            local shades={}
            for index=0,8 do shades[#shades+1]=toHex(Color3.fromHSV(baseH,baseS,math.clamp(1-index/8*.92,.04,1))) end
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Shades',y,shades,9,16)
            local tints={}
            for index=0,8 do tints[#tints+1]=toHex(Color3.fromHSV(baseH,math.clamp(baseS*(1-index/8),0,1),baseV)) end
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Tints',y,tints,9,16)
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Presets',y,{'#FFFFFF','#E6E9EF','#A4ACBA','#5B6475','#262B36','#0B0E14','#FF5A5A','#FF9A3C','#FFD23C','#B6F04C','#4CE69A','#3CD7E6','#5A96FF','#9678FF','#DC6EFF','#FF6EB4','#FFB0A0','#7A4A28','#2E6B4F','#1F3A8A','#7A1F3D','#F5E6C8','#C0C0C0','#D4AF37'},12,16)
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Favourites  (star ☆ saves the current colour)',y,store.favorites,12,16)
            y=swatchRow(palettePage,'Recent',y,store.recent,12,16)
        end
        -- ===== Style page (extras the setting offers: sizes, fonts, effects, opacity) =====
        local stylePage=pages[5]
        local styleY=4
        local extraRefreshers={}
        local anyStyle=false
        for _,extra in extras do
            if extra.kind=='slider' then
                anyStyle=true
                local item=makeSlider(stylePage,{label=extra.label,x=14,y=styleY,w=W-28,min=extra.min,max=extra.max,decimals=extra.decimals or 0,
                    get=extra.get,set=function(value)extra.set(value);update(false) end})
                table.insert(extraRefreshers,item.refresh)
                styleY+=28
            elseif extra.kind=='choice' then
                anyStyle=true
                local button

                button=clickable(stylePage,describe(),14,styleY,W-28,22,function()
