                    extra.set(options[index%#options+1])
                    button.Text=describe()
                end,10)
                styleY+=28
            elseif extra.kind=='toggle' then
                anyStyle=true
                local button
                local function describe() return extra.label..':  '..(if extra.get() then 'On' else 'Off') end
                button=clickable(stylePage,describe(),14,styleY,W-28,22,function()
                    extra.set(not extra.get())
                    button.Text=describe()
                end,10)
                styleY+=28
            end
        end
        if #targets>1 then anyStyle=true;caption(stylePage,'Use the buttons at the bottom to edit '..tostring(#targets-1)..' companion colour(s): '..(function()local names={};for index=2,#targets do table.insert(names,targets[index].name) end;return table.concat(names,', ') end)(),14,styleY,W-28,28,10).TextWrapped=true;styleY+=34 end
        if not anyStyle then caption(stylePage,'This colour has no companion options. Its transparency, brightness, contrast and more are on the other tabs.',14,6,W-28,40,10).TextWrapped=true end
        -- ===== update =====
        local function refreshTargets()
            for index,button in targetButtons do
                button.BackgroundColor3=if index==targetIndex then Color3.fromRGB(52,70,108) else Color3.fromRGB(30,37,51)
            end
        end
        function update(emit)
            local color=resultColor()
            local mode=MODES[padMode]
            local hueColor=Color3.fromHSV(baseH,1,1)
            if mode.x=='s' then
                padBase.Color=solid(hueColor)
                whiteGradient.Rotation=0;whiteGradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new(0,1);whiteLayer.BackgroundTransparency=0
                blackGradient.Rotation=90;blackGradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new(1,0);blackLayer.BackgroundTransparency=0
            elseif mode.y=='s' then
                padBase.Color=hueSequence();padBase.Rotation=0
                whiteGradient.Rotation=90;whiteGradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new(1,0);whiteLayer.BackgroundTransparency=0
                blackGradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new(0);blackLayer.BackgroundTransparency=baseV
            else
                padBase.Color=hueSequence();padBase.Rotation=0
                whiteGradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new(0);whiteLayer.BackgroundTransparency=baseS
                blackGradient.Rotation=90;blackGradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new(1,0);blackLayer.BackgroundTransparency=0
            end
            if mode.x=='s' then padBase.Rotation=0 end
            marker.Position=UDim2.fromScale(channelGet(mode.x),1-channelGet(mode.y))
            modeButton.Text='Pad: '..mode.name
            precisionButton.Text='Precision: '..PRECISION[precisionIndex][1]..'  (drag speed)'
            newSwatch.BackgroundColor3,newSwatch.BackgroundTransparency=color,alpha
            if not hexBox:IsFocused() then hexBox.Text=toHex(color,alpha) end
            local backdrop=appearance.colors and appearance.colors['Window Background COlor'] or Color3.fromRGB(15,19,27)
            local la,lb=luminance(color),luminance(backdrop)
            local ratio=(math.max(la,lb)+.05)/(math.min(la,lb)+.05)
            contrastLabel.Text=string.format('Contrast vs window  %.1f:1  %s    |  %d, %d, %d',ratio,if ratio>=7 then 'AAA' elseif ratio>=4.5 then 'AA' elseif ratio>=3 then 'AA large' else 'low',math.round(color.R*255),math.round(color.G*255),math.round(color.B*255))
            local hex=toHex(color)
            local isFavorite=table.find(store.favorites,hex)~=nil
            starButton.Text=if isFavorite then '★' else '☆'
            for _,item in sliders do item.refresh() end
            srgbLabel.Text=string.format('Float RGB  %.4f  %.4f  %.4f',color.R,color.G,color.B)
            if emit~=nil then
                local target=targets[targetIndex]
                target.set(color,alpha,emit==true)
            end
            if activeTab==4 then buildPalette() end
        end
        popupConnect(hexBox.FocusLost,function()
            local color,hexAlpha=fromHex(hexBox.Text)
            if color then
                baseH,baseS,baseV=color:ToHSV()
                if hexAlpha then alpha=hexAlpha end
                for key in adjust do adjust[key]=0 end
                update(true)
            else update(false) end
        end)
        popupConnect(oldSwatch.Activated,function()
            baseH,baseS,baseV=original:ToHSV();alpha=originalAlpha
            for key in adjust do adjust[key]=0 end
            update(true)
        end)
        popupConnect(starButton.Activated,function()
            local hex=toHex(resultColor())
            local index=table.find(store.favorites,hex)
            if index then table.remove(store.favorites,index) else table.insert(store.favorites,1,hex) end
            while #store.favorites>24 do table.remove(store.favorites) end
            saveStore();update(false)
        end)
        for index,button in targetButtons do
            popupConnect(button.Activated,function()
                targetIndex=index
                local target=targets[index]
                original,originalAlpha=target.get(),target.alpha()
                baseH,baseS,baseV=original:ToHSV()
                alpha=originalAlpha
                for key in adjust do adjust[key]=0 end
                oldSwatch.BackgroundColor3,oldSwatch.BackgroundTransparency=original,originalAlpha
                refreshTargets();update(false)
            end)
        end
        for index,tabButton in tabButtons do
            popupConnect(tabButton.Activated,function()
                showTab(index)
                if index==4 then buildPalette() end
            end)
        end
        buildTargets()
        for index,button in targetButtons do
            popupConnect(button.Activated,function()
                targetIndex=index
                local target=targets[index]
                original,originalAlpha=target.get(),target.alpha()
                baseH,baseS,baseV=original:ToHSV()
                alpha=originalAlpha
                for key in adjust do adjust[key]=0 end
                oldSwatch.BackgroundColor3,oldSwatch.BackgroundTransparency=original,originalAlpha
                refreshTargets();update(false)
            end)
        end
        if menu.attachPopupResize and not(menu.colorAppearancePanel and type(menu.colorAppearancePanel.attach)=='function')then menu.attachPopupResize(popup,W,H,ui.colorConnections,function() dragState,padDrag=nil,nil end) end
        ui.colorInstances={[popup]=true}
        for _,object in popup:GetDescendants() do ui.colorInstances[object]=true end
        showTab(1)
        refreshTargets()
        update(nil)
        ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup)
        if menu.colorAppearancePanel and type(menu.colorAppearancePanel.attach)=='function'then
            local content={}
            for _,object in popup:GetChildren()do if object:IsA('GuiObject')and object~=title and object~=closeButton then table.insert(content,object)end end
            menu.colorAppearancePanel.attach(popup,record,{content=content,title=title,close=closeButton,
                getAlpha=function()return alpha end,updateAlpha=function(nextAlpha,emit)alpha=math.clamp(nextAlpha,0,1);update(emit~=false)end,
                getColor=function()return resultColor() end,setColor=function(nextColor,emit)baseH,baseS,baseV=nextColor:ToHSV();update(emit~=false)end,
                refresh=function()update(false)end})
        end
    end
    function ui.colorAlpha(record)
        if record.config and record.config.GetTransparency then
            local current=record.config.GetTransparency()
            if type(current)=='number' and current==current and math.abs(current)<math.huge then return math.clamp(current,0,1) end
        end
        local saved=appearance.colorControls[record.tab..'/'..record.name]
        local alpha=if saved then saved.alpha else appearance.transparency[record.name]
        return if type(alpha)=='number' and alpha==alpha and math.abs(alpha)<math.huge then math.clamp(alpha,0,1) else 0
    end
    function ui.setColorValue(record,color,alpha,emit)
        appearance.transparency[record.name]=alpha
        appearance.colorControls[record.tab..'/'..record.name]={color=color,alpha=alpha}
        if emit==true and record.config and record.config.SetTransparency then record.config.SetTransparency(alpha) end
        record.widget.Set(color,emit==true)
        if record.swatch then record.swatch.BackgroundColor3,record.swatch.BackgroundTransparency=color,alpha end
        if record.config and record.config.MiniMenuAppearance then ui.queueMiniAppearance()
        elseif record.tab=='Settings' then ui.queueAppearance(record.name) end
    end
    function ui.attachColor(record)
        if not record.row then return end
        if record.swatch and record.swatch.Parent then return end
        record.nativeColorSurfaces=record.nativeColorSurfaces or {}
        for _, object in record.row:GetDescendants() do
            local kind=object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')
            local original=not object:GetAttribute('CullingModern') and (object:IsA('TextBox') or object:IsA('GuiButton')
                or object:IsA('GuiObject') and (kind=='ColorBox' or kind=='ColorPicker' or kind=='ColorPickerPanel'))
            if original then
                if record.nativeColorSurfaces[object]==nil then
                    record.nativeColorSurfaces[object]=object.Visible
                    connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Visible'),function()
                        if ui.alive and menu.alive and record.colorButton and object.Parent and object.Visible then object.Visible=false end
                    end)
                end
                if object.Visible then object.Visible=false end
                if object:IsA('TextButton') and host.getconnections then
                    for _, signal in {object.Activated, object.MouseButton1Click} do
                        for _, connection in host.getconnections(signal) do
                            if menu.state.connections[connection] then connection:Disconnect() end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local checker = button(record.row, "", UDim2.new(1, -146, 0, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(132, 27), function() ui.openColor(record) end)
        checker.Name,checker.BackgroundColor3='EditColor',Color3.fromRGB(55,63,77)
        local backing=owned('Frame')
        backing.Name,backing.Position,backing.Size,backing.BackgroundColor3,backing.BorderSizePixel,backing.ZIndex,backing.Parent='ColorChecker',UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),UDim2.fromOffset(30,19),Color3.fromRGB(175,181,190),0,checker.ZIndex+1,checker
        corner(backing,3)
        local swatch=owned('Frame')
        swatch.Name,swatch.Size,swatch.BackgroundColor3,swatch.BackgroundTransparency,swatch.BorderSizePixel,swatch.ZIndex,swatch.Parent='ColorSwatch',UDim2.fromScale(1,1),record.widget.Get(),ui.colorAlpha(record),0,backing.ZIndex+1,backing
        corner(swatch,3)
        local caption=label(checker,'Edit color',UDim2.fromOffset(42,0),UDim2.fromOffset(88,27))
        caption:SetAttribute('CullingColorEditor',true)
        record.swatch,record.colorButton=swatch,checker
        record.row.Active=true
        local function rightClick(object)
            if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and not menu.recording then ui.openColor(record) end
        end
        connect(record.row.InputBegan,rightClick)
        connect(checker.InputBegan,rightClick)
    end
    function ui.registerColor(record)
        if record.config and record.config.MiniMenuAppearance then
            ui.miniColorRecord=record
            if appearance.miniMenu.color==nil then ui.setMiniMenuColor(record.widget.Get()) end
        end
        if not record.colorSetWrapper then
            local set=record.widget.Set
            record.colorSetOriginal=set
            record.colorSetWrapper=function(value,emit)
                ui.applyingColor=record.tab=='Settings' and ui.ready
                local ok,result=pcall(set,value,emit)
                ui.applyingColor=false
                if not ok then error(result,0) end
                if result==false then return false end
                local chosen=record.widget.Get()
                appearance.colors[record.name]=chosen
                local id=record.tab..'/'..record.name
                appearance.colorControls[id]={color=chosen,alpha=ui.colorAlpha(record)}
                if record.swatch then record.swatch.BackgroundColor3=chosen end
                if record.config and record.config.MiniMenuAppearance then ui.setMiniMenuColor(chosen)
                elseif ui.ready and record.tab=='Settings' then ui.queueAppearance(record.name) end
                return result
            end
            record.widget.Set=record.colorSetWrapper
            local saved=appearance.colorControls[record.tab..'/'..record.name]
            local chosen=if saved then saved.color else appearance.colors[record.name]
            if record.tab=='Skill' and record.name=='Combat Trail Tint' and not saved and chosen==nil then
                saved=appearance.colorControls['Skill/Combat Trail Color']
                chosen=if saved then saved.color else appearance.colors['Combat Trail Color']
                if saved then appearance.colorControls['Skill/Combat Trail Tint']=table.clone(saved) end
                if appearance.transparency['Combat Trail Tint']==nil then appearance.transparency['Combat Trail Tint']=appearance.transparency['Combat Trail Color'] end
            end
            if saved and record.config and record.config.SetTransparency then record.config.SetTransparency(saved.alpha) end
            if chosen then record.widget.Set(chosen,false) end
        end
        ui.attachColor(record)
    end
    function ui.exportColors()
        local style=appearance.miniMenu
        local color=style.color
        local result={version=1,controls={},miniMenu={transparency=style.transparency or 0,depth=style.depth or 1}}
        if color then result.miniMenu.color={R=color.R,G=color.G,B=color.B} end
        for _,record in menu.rows do if record.kind=='CreateColorPicker' then
            local controlColor=record.widget.Get()
            result.controls[record.tab..'/'..record.name]={color={R=controlColor.R,G=controlColor.G,B=controlColor.B},transparency=ui.colorAlpha(record)}
        end end
        return result
    end
    function ui.importColors(envelope)
        if type(envelope)~='table' or envelope.version~=1 or type(envelope.controls)~='table' then return 0 end
        ui.closeColor()
        local applied=0
        for _,record in menu.rows do if record.kind=='CreateColorPicker' then
            local saved=envelope.controls[record.tab..'/'..record.name]
            if saved==nil and record.tab=='Skill' and record.name=='Combat Trail Tint' then saved=envelope.controls['Skill/Combat Trail Color'] end
            local color=type(saved)=='table' and saved.color
            local alpha=type(saved)=='table' and saved.transparency
            local valid=type(color)=='table' and type(alpha)=='number' and alpha==alpha and alpha>=0 and alpha<=1
            if valid then for _,key in {'R','G','B'} do local channel=color[key];if type(channel)~='number' or channel~=channel or channel<0 or channel>1 then valid=false;break end end end
            if valid then
                appearance.transparency[record.name]=alpha
                appearance.colorControls[record.tab..'/'..record.name]={color=Color3.new(color.R,color.G,color.B),alpha=alpha}
                if record.config and record.config.SetTransparency then record.config.SetTransparency(alpha) end
                record.widget.Set(appearance.colorControls[record.tab..'/'..record.name].color,true)
                applied+=1
            end
        end end
        local mini=envelope.miniMenu
        if type(mini)=='table' then
            if mini.color then ui.setMiniMenuColor(mini.color) end
            if type(mini.transparency)=='number' then ui.setMiniMenuTransparency(mini.transparency*100) end
            if type(mini.depth)=='number' then ui.setMiniMenuDepth(mini.depth*100) end
        end
        if ui.ready then ui.refresh() end
        return applied
    end
    function ui.indexAppearance()
        if ui.appearanceTargets and not ui.appearanceIndexDirty and ui.appearanceIndexRoot==menu.panel.Root then return ui.appearanceTargets end
        local targets={}
        local function add(key,object,property,alphaProperty)
            targets[key]=targets[key] or {}
            table.insert(targets[key],{object=object,property=property,alpha=alphaProperty})
        end
        local mapping={Row='Row Color',SliderTrack='Slider Background Color',SliderFill='Theme Color',TabAccentLine='Theme Color',ActionButton='Button Background Color',InputBox='Input Background Color',ToggleKnob='Knob Color',Main='Window Background COlor',TopBar='Window Background COlor',Sidebar='Window Background COlor',TabStrip='Window Background COlor'}
        for _,object in ui.menuObjects() do
            if object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration') or object:GetAttribute('CullingSurfaceAppearanceDecoration') or object:GetAttribute('CullingSwitchDecoration') or object:GetAttribute('CullingColorEditor') or (ui.colorPopup and object:IsDescendantOf(ui.colorPopup)) then continue end
            local kind=object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')
            if object:IsA('GuiObject') then
                local key=mapping[kind]
                if not key and (object.Name=='SectionHeader' or object.Name:match('^MiniSection%d+$')) then key='Row Color' end
                if not key and object:IsA('Frame') and object.Name=='Checkbox' then key='Button Background Color' end
                if not key and object:IsA('TextBox') then key='Input Background Color' end
                if not key and object:IsA('TextButton') and kind~='ToggleSwitch' and kind~='CloseButton' and kind~='TabButton' and object.BackgroundTransparency<1 then key='Button Background Color' end
                if key then add(key,object,'BackgroundColor3','BackgroundTransparency') end
                if object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then add('Text Color',object,'TextColor3','TextTransparency') end
                if object.BorderSizePixel>0 then add('Border Color',object,'BorderColor3') end
            elseif object:IsA('UIStroke') then add('Border Color',object,'Color','Transparency') end
        end
        ui.appearanceTargets=targets;ui.appearanceIndexDirty=false;ui.appearanceIndexRoot=menu.panel.Root
        ui.appearanceIndexGeneration=(ui.appearanceIndexGeneration or 0)+1
        if menu.surfaceAppearance and type(menu.surfaceAppearance.bindIndex)=='function'then menu.surfaceAppearance.bindIndex(targets,ui.appearanceIndexGeneration)end
        return targets
    end
    function ui.queueAppearance(name)
        if not ui.alive or not ui.ready then return end
        ui.pendingAppearance=ui.pendingAppearance or {}
        ui.pendingAppearance[name]=true
        if ui.appearanceQueued then return end
        ui.appearanceQueued=true
        host.task.delay(1/60,function()
            ui.appearanceQueued=false
            if not ui.alive or not menu.alive then return end
            local pending=ui.pendingAppearance;ui.pendingAppearance={}
            if not ui.appearanceTargets or ui.appearanceIndexDirty then ui.indexAppearance() end
            ui.palette=ui.palette or {}
            for key in pending do
                local entry=menu.entries['Settings/'..key]
                local color=entry and entry.widget.Get()
                if color then ui.palette[key]=color end
                local alpha=appearance.transparency[key]
                for _,binding in ui.appearanceTargets[key] or {} do
                    local object=binding.object
                    if not object.Parent then continue end
                    if color and object[binding.property]~=color then object[binding.property]=color end
                    local surfaceAlpha=if object==menu.panel.TopBarSurface and key=='Window Background COlor' and alpha~=nil then math.max(.85,alpha) else alpha
                    if surfaceAlpha~=nil and binding.alpha and object[binding.alpha]~=surfaceAlpha then object[binding.alpha]=surfaceAlpha end
                    local native=ui.nativeMode and ui.nativeSurfaces[object]
                    if native then
                        if color then native[binding.property]=color end
                        if surfaceAlpha~=nil and binding.alpha then native[binding.alpha]=surfaceAlpha end
                    end
                end
            end
            if pending['Toggle-On Color'] or pending['Toggle-Off Color'] or pending['Knob Color'] or pending['Border Color'] then
                for switch,state in ui.switchStates do if switch.Parent then ui.styleSquareSwitch(switch,nil,state.enabled) end end
            end
            if pending['Button Background Color'] or pending['Input Background Color'] or pending['Text Color'] or pending['Border Color']
                or pending['Row Color'] or pending['Window Background COlor'] then ui.refreshMiniAppearance() end
            if pending['Row Color'] or pending['Text Color'] or pending['Theme Color'] then ui.applySearchAppearance() end
            if menu.surfaceAppearance and type(menu.surfaceAppearance.refreshPalette)=='function'then menu.surfaceAppearance.refreshPalette(pending,ui.appearanceIndexGeneration)end
        end)
    end
    function ui.refreshTransparency()
        local alpha = appearance.transparency
        for _, object in ui.menuObjects() do
            local kind = object:GetAttribute("WidgetType")
            -- A fully transparent text theme must not hide the controls needed to
            -- change it back; picker controls retain their own contrast.
            if (ui.colorPopup and object:IsDescendantOf(ui.colorPopup)) or object:GetAttribute('CullingColorEditor') then continue end
            if object:IsDescendantOf(menu.panel.Sidebar) or object:IsDescendantOf(menu.panel.TabStrip) then
                if object:IsA("TextButton") and object.Text == "Automatic" then object.Text = "Auto" end
                continue
            end
            if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if kind == "Row" and alpha["Row Color"] then object.BackgroundTransparency = alpha["Row Color"]
                elseif kind == "SliderTrack" and alpha["Slider Background Color"] then object.BackgroundTransparency = alpha["Slider Background Color"]
                elseif kind=='SliderFill' and alpha['Theme Color'] then object.BackgroundTransparency=alpha['Theme Color']
                elseif kind == "ActionButton" and alpha["Button Background Color"] then object.BackgroundTransparency = alpha["Button Background Color"]
                elseif kind == "InputBox" and alpha["Input Background Color"] then object.BackgroundTransparency = alpha["Input Background Color"] end
                if (object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox")) and alpha["Text Color"] then object.TextTransparency = alpha["Text Color"] end
            elseif object:IsA('UIStroke') and not object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration') and alpha['Border Color'] then
                object.Transparency=alpha['Border Color']
            end
        end
        if alpha["Window Background COlor"] then (menu.panel.WindowSurface or menu.panel.Main).BackgroundTransparency = alpha["Window Background COlor"] end
        for _, record in menu.rows do
            if record.swatch then record.swatch.BackgroundTransparency = ui.colorAlpha(record) end
            if record.kind == "CreateToggle" then
                local enabled = record.widget.Get()
                for _, object in record.row:GetDescendants() do
                    if object:GetAttribute("WidgetType") == "ToggleSwitch" then
                        object.BackgroundTransparency = alpha[if enabled then "Toggle-On Color" else "Toggle-Off Color"] or 0
                        local knob=object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Frame')
                        if knob then knob.BackgroundTransparency=alpha['Knob Color'] or 0 end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function searchMetadata(record: any): (any,boolean)
        local config=record.config or {}
        local cached=ui.searchMetadata[record]
        if not cached then cached={};ui.searchMetadata[record]=cached end
        local orderChanged=cached.name~=record.name or cached.tab~=record.tab
        if orderChanged or cached.display~=config.DisplayName or cached.description~=config.Description or not cached.text then
            cached.name,cached.tab,cached.display,cached.description=record.name,record.tab,config.DisplayName,config.Description
            cached.text=(record.name..' '..tostring(config.DisplayName or '')..' '..tostring(config.Description or '')..' '..record.tab):lower()
            cached.order=record.name..record.tab;cached.caption=record.name..'  ['..record.tab..']'
            ui.searchTextBuilds=(ui.searchTextBuilds or 0)+1
        end
        return cached,orderChanged
    end
    function ui.indexSearch(): {any}
        local rows=menu.rows or {}
        local rebuild=not ui.searchRows or ui.searchRowCount~=#rows
        for _,record in rows do
            local _,orderChanged=searchMetadata(record)
            if orderChanged or not ui.searchRowMembers or not ui.searchRowMembers[record]then rebuild=true end
        end
        if rebuild then
            ui.searchRows=table.clone(rows);ui.searchRowMembers={};ui.searchRowCount=#rows
            for _,record in ui.searchRows do ui.searchRowMembers[record]=true end
            table.sort(ui.searchRows,function(a,b)return ui.searchMetadata[a].order<ui.searchMetadata[b].order end)
            ui.searchIndexBuilds=(ui.searchIndexBuilds or 0)+1
        end
        return ui.searchRows
    end
    local function searchWords(query: any): {string}
        local words={};for word in tostring(query or ''):lower():gmatch('%S+')do table.insert(words,word)end
        return words
    end
    function ui.searchMatches(record: any,query: any,filter: any,words: {string}?): boolean
        if not record.widget or record.kind=='CreateParagraph' or record.config and record.config.CanonicalHidden then return false end
        if record.name=='Lock On Icon Size' and record.tab=='Main' or record.name=='Lock On' and record.tab=='Player' and record.kind=='CreateToggle' then return false end
        local cached=searchMetadata(record)
        for _,word in words or searchWords(query)do if not cached.text:find(word,1,true)then return false end end
        if filter and filter~='All' then
            if record.kind~='CreateToggle' then return false end
            local ok,value=pcall(record.widget.Get)
            return ok and value==(filter=='Enabled')
        end
        return true
    end
    function ui.applySearchAppearance()
        local results=ui.searchResults
        if not results or not results.Parent then return end
        local palette=ui.palette or {}
        local color=palette['Row Color'] or appearance.colors['Row Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(238,238,238)
        local alpha=appearance.transparency['Row Color'] or 0
        local text=palette['Text Color'] or appearance.colors['Text Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(15,15,15)
        local textAlpha=appearance.transparency['Text Color'] or 0
        results.BackgroundColor3,results.BackgroundTransparency=color,alpha
        for _,item in ui.searchItems or {}do
            item.BackgroundColor3,item.BackgroundTransparency=color,alpha
            item.TextColor3,item.TextTransparency=text,textAlpha
        end
        for _,header in ui.searchHeaders or {}do
            header.BackgroundColor3,header.BackgroundTransparency=color,math.min(1,alpha+.15)
            header.TextColor3,header.TextTransparency=palette['Theme Color'] or text,textAlpha
        end
        for name,item in ui.searchFilterButtons or {}do
            item.BackgroundColor3,item.BackgroundTransparency=color,alpha
            item.TextColor3=if name==ui.searchFilter then palette['Theme Color'] or text else text
            item.TextTransparency=textAlpha
        end
        if ui.searchCountLabel then ui.searchCountLabel.TextColor3,ui.searchCountLabel.TextTransparency=text,textAlpha end
        local surfaces=menu.surfaceAppearance
        if surfaces and type(surfaces.bindTree)=='function'and (ui.searchAppearanceOwner~=surfaces or ui.searchAppearanceVersion~=ui.searchItemsVersion)then
            surfaces.bindTree(results);ui.searchAppearanceOwner,ui.searchAppearanceVersion=surfaces,ui.searchItemsVersion
        end
    end
    function ui.setSearchUnderlayHidden(hidden)
        hidden=hidden==true
        local pages=menu.panel.Pages or {}
        ui.searchUnderlayPages=ui.searchUnderlayPages or setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
        ui.searchUnderlayHidden=hidden
        for _,page in pages do
            if not ui.searchUnderlayPages[page] then
                ui.searchUnderlayPages[page]={visible=page.Visible}
                connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Visible'),function()
                    if not ui.alive or ui.searchUnderlayUpdating or not ui.searchUnderlayHidden or not page.Visible then return end
                    ui.searchUnderlaySelected=page
                    ui.searchUnderlayUpdating=true;page.Visible=false;ui.searchUnderlayUpdating=false
                end)
            end
            if hidden and page.Visible then ui.searchUnderlaySelected=page end
        end
        if not hidden then
            -- Native tab buttons still select their accent during a search.
            -- Restore that most recent selection rather than the old tab.
            for index,line in menu.panel.TabLines or {} do
                if line.Visible then ui.searchUnderlaySelected=pages[index];break end
            end
        end
        ui.searchUnderlayUpdating=true
        for _,page in pages do
            if page.Parent then
                page.Visible=if hidden then false elseif ui.searchUnderlaySelected then page==ui.searchUnderlaySelected
                    else ui.searchUnderlayPages[page].visible
            end
        end
        ui.searchUnderlayUpdating=false
    end
    function ui.installSearch()
        if ui.searchBox or not menu.scaleEntry or not menu.panel.ContentArea then return end
        local track=menu.scaleEntry.widget.Frame
        local bar=menu.scaleEntry.widget.ValueLabel.Parent
        if not menu.panel.nativeHeaderless then track.Position,track.Size=UDim2.new(.3,0,0.5,-3.5),UDim2.new(.7,-270,0,7)end
        local search=owned('TextBox')
        search.Name,search.Position,search.Size='FeatureSearch',UDim2.new(1,-230,0.5,-12),UDim2.fromOffset(180,24)
        search.Text,search.PlaceholderText,search.ClearTextOnFocus='', 'Search features...',false
        search.BackgroundColor3,search.TextColor3,search.BorderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150)
        search.TextSize,search.TextXAlignment,search.Font,search.ZIndex,search.Parent=12,Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.Font.Gotham,bar.ZIndex+3,bar
        menuFont(search);ui.searchBox=search;ui.searchFilter='All'
        if menu.panel.nativeHeaderless and menu.panel.LayoutChrome then menu.panel:LayoutChrome()end
        local results=owned('ScrollingFrame')
        results.Name,results.Position,results.Size='FeatureSearchResults',UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        results.BorderSizePixel=0;results:SetAttribute('WidgetType','Row')
        results.CanvasSize,results.AutomaticCanvasSize,results.ScrollBarThickness=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,4
        results.ZIndex,results.Visible,results.Parent=500,false,menu.panel.ContentArea
        ui.searchResults=results;ui.searchItems={};ui.searchItemsVersion=0;ui.appearanceIndexDirty=true
        local layout=owned('UIListLayout');layout.Padding,layout.SortOrder,layout.Parent=UDim.new(0,4),Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,results
        local filters=owned('Frame');filters.Size,filters.BackgroundTransparency,filters.LayoutOrder,filters.Parent=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,28),1,-2,results
        filters.ZIndex=501
        local filterButtons={}
        for index,name in {'All','Enabled','Disabled'} do
            filterButtons[name]=button(filters,name,UDim2.new((index-1)/3,0,0,0),UDim2.new(1/3,-4,1,0),function()ui.searchFilter=name;ui.updateSearch()end)
            filterButtons[name]:SetAttribute('WidgetType','Row')
        end
        local count=label(results,'',UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.new(1,-8,0,24));count.LayoutOrder=-1
        ui.searchFilterButtons,ui.searchCountLabel=filterButtons,count
        ui.searchHeaders,ui.searchCollapsed={},{}
        local tabLabels={Transform='Looks',Fun='Misc',Automatic='Game'}
        local function pathOf(record: any): (string,string)
            local row=record.row
            local section=row and row.Parent and row.Parent.Parent
            local page=section and section.Parent
            local sectionName=section and tostring(section.Name):match('^Section_(.+)$')
            local pageName=page and tostring(page.Name):match('^Page_(.+)$') or record.tab
            return tabLabels[pageName] or pageName,sectionName or 'General'
        end
        local function escape(text: string): string
            return (tostring(text):gsub('&','&amp;'):gsub('<','&lt;'):gsub('>','&gt;'):gsub('"','&quot;'):gsub("'",'&apos;'))
        end
        local function highlight(name: string,words: {string},color: string): string
            local lower,marks=name:lower(),{}
            for _,word in words do
                local from=1
                while true do
                    local first,last=lower:find(word,from,true)
                    if not first then break end
                    for index=first,last do marks[index]=true end
                    from=last+1
                end
            end
            local out,open={},false
            for index=1,#name do
                if marks[index] and not open then table.insert(out,'<font color="#'..color..'"><b>');open=true
                elseif not marks[index] and open then table.insert(out,'</b></font>');open=false end
                table.insert(out,escape(name:sub(index,index)))
            end
            if open then table.insert(out,'</b></font>') end
            return table.concat(out)
        end
        -- Higher is better: exact name, name prefix, word prefix, name contains, then description-only.
        local function score(record: any,words: {string},query: string): number
            local meta=ui.searchMetadata[record]
            local display=tostring(meta.display or record.name):lower()
            local q=query:lower():match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
            if display==q or record.name:lower()==q then return 100 end
            if display:sub(1,#q)==q then return 80 end
            if display:find(' '..q,1,true) then return 60 end
            if display:find(q,1,true) then return 40 end
            local all=true
            for _,word in words do if not display:find(word,1,true) then all=false;break end end
            return if all then 20 else 10
        end
        local function chipFor(record: any): (string,any)
            local teal,muted=Color3.fromRGB(90,215,190),Color3.fromRGB(150,160,180)
            local ok,value=pcall(record.widget.Get)
            if record.kind=='CreateToggle' then return if ok and value==true then 'ON' else 'OFF',if ok and value==true then teal else muted end
            if record.kind=='CreateButton' then return 'RUN',muted end
            if record.kind=='CreateColorPicker' then return 'COLOR',muted end
            if not ok or value==nil then return '',muted end
            if type(value)=='number' then return string.format('%g',math.floor(value*100+.5)/100),muted end
            if type(value)=='table' then
                local parts={};for _,entry in value do table.insert(parts,tostring(entry)) end
                value=table.concat(parts,', ')
            end
            value=tostring(value)
            return if #value>12 then value:sub(1,11)..'...' else value,muted
        end
        local function headerFor(key: string): any
            local header=ui.searchHeaders[key]
            if header then return header end
            header=button(results,'',UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.new(1,-8,0,26),function()
                ui.searchCollapsed[key]=not ui.searchCollapsed[key];ui.updateSearch()
            end)
            header.Name='SearchHeader';header.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;header.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;header.TextSize=12
            header:SetAttribute('WidgetType','Row')
            local pad=owned('UIPadding');pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,10);pad.Parent=header
            -- Right-click a header: collapse every section, or expand them all if all are collapsed.
            connect(header.MouseButton2Click,function()
                local anyOpen=false
                for other in ui.searchHeaders do if not ui.searchCollapsed[other] then anyOpen=true;break end end
                for other in ui.searchHeaders do ui.searchCollapsed[other]=anyOpen end
                ui.updateSearch()
            end)
            ui.searchHeaders[key]=header;ui.searchItemsVersion+=1;ui.appearanceIndexDirty=true
            return header
        end
        local function itemFor(record: any): any
            local item=ui.searchItems[record]
            if item then return item end
            local function openEditor()
                search:ReleaseFocus()
                local owner,entries=menu.searchMainSettings(record)
                menu.openMiniPopup(owner,entries,{record=record,query=search.Text})
            end
            item=button(results,'',UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.new(1,-8,0,34),openEditor)
            item.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;item.RichText=true;item:SetAttribute('WidgetType','Row')
            local pad=owned('UIPadding');pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,14);pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,92);pad.Parent=item
            local chip=label(item,'',UDim2.new(1,-86,0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(78,34))
            chip.Name='State';chip.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right;chip.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;chip.TextSize=11;chip.ZIndex=item.ZIndex+1
            -- Right-click flips a toggle in place; other controls open their editor.
            connect(item.MouseButton2Click,function()
                if record.kind=='CreateToggle' then
                    local ok,value=pcall(record.widget.Get)
                    if ok then record.widget.Set(not value,true) end
                    ui.updateSearch()
                else openEditor() end
            end)
            ui.searchItems[record]=item;ui.appearanceIndexDirty=true
            ui.searchItemsVersion+=1;ui.searchButtonBuilds=(ui.searchButtonBuilds or 0)+1
            return item
        end
        function ui.updateSearch()
            if not ui.alive or menu.alive==false then return end
            ui.searchUpdates=(ui.searchUpdates or 0)+1
            local query=search.Text
            if ui.lastSearchQuery~=query then
                if menu.clearMiniSearchHighlight then menu.clearMiniSearchHighlight() end
                ui.lastSearchQuery=query
            end
            local active=query:find('%S')~=nil;results.Visible=active
            ui.setSearchUnderlayHidden(active)
            if not active then ui.applySearchAppearance();return end
            local words=searchWords(query)
            local groups,order={},{}
            local matchedCount=0
            for _,record in ui.indexSearch() do
                if ui.searchMatches(record,query,ui.searchFilter,words) then
                    matchedCount+=1
                    local tabName,sectionName=pathOf(record)
                    local key=tabName..' > '..sectionName
                    local group=groups[key]
                    if not group then group={key=key,title=tabName..'  >  '..sectionName,best=0,list={}};groups[key]=group;table.insert(order,group) end
                    local value=score(record,words,query)
                    group.best=math.max(group.best,value)
                    table.insert(group.list,{record=record,score=value})
                end
            end
            table.sort(order,function(a,b)
                if a.best~=b.best then return a.best>b.best end
                return a.key<b.key
            end)
            local theme=(ui.palette and ui.palette['Theme Color']) or Color3.fromRGB(90,215,190)
            local themeHex=theme:ToHex()
            local shownItems,shownHeaders={},{}
            for groupIndex,group in order do
                table.sort(group.list,function(a,b)
                    if a.score~=b.score then return a.score>b.score end
                    return tostring(ui.searchMetadata[a.record].display or a.record.name)<tostring(ui.searchMetadata[b.record].display or b.record.name)
                end)
                local collapsed=ui.searchCollapsed[group.key]==true
                local header=headerFor(group.key)
                header.Text=(if collapsed then '+  ' else '-  ')..group.title..'   ('..#group.list..')'
                header.Visible,header.LayoutOrder=true,groupIndex*1000;shownHeaders[group.key]=true
                for index,entry in group.list do
                    local record=entry.record
                    local item=itemFor(record)
                    if collapsed then item.Visible=false
                    else
                        local display=tostring(ui.searchMetadata[record].display or record.name)
                        local richText=highlight(display,words,themeHex)
                        if item.Text~=richText then item.Text=richText end
                        local chipText,chipColor=chipFor(record)
                        local chip=item:FindFirstChild('State')
                        if chip then
                            if chip.Text~=chipText then chip.Text=chipText end
                            chip.TextColor3=chipColor
                        end
                        item.Visible,item.LayoutOrder=true,groupIndex*1000+index;shownItems[record]=true
                    end
                end
            end
            for record,item in ui.searchItems do if not shownItems[record] then item.Visible=false end end
            for key,header in ui.searchHeaders do if not shownHeaders[key] then header.Visible=false end end
            count.Text=tostring(matchedCount)..' features in '..tostring(#order)..' sections  -  click to edit, right-click a toggle to flip it, right-click a header to fold all'
            ui.searchMatchCount=matchedCount
            results.CanvasPosition=host.Vector2.new(0,0)
            ui.applySearchAppearance()
        end
        connect(search:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'),ui.updateSearch)
        ui.indexSearch()
        ui.applySearchAppearance()
    end
    -- Hover and press feedback for menu buttons, using ONE shared overlay that moves
    -- to whichever button is hovered (a wash, a small accent bar and a press-in).
    -- Overlays only, so themes, colours, text and layout are never touched.
    function ui.installFeel()
        if ui.feelInstalled or not menu.panel or not menu.panel.Root then return end
        ui.feelInstalled=true
        local tweens=host.game:GetService('TweenService')
        local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
        local fast=host.TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local pressIn=host.TweenInfo.new(.06,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local pressOut=host.TweenInfo.new(.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local attached=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
        ui.feelConnections={}
        local list=ui.feelConnections
        local glow=owned('Frame')
        glow.Name,glow.BackgroundColor3,glow.BackgroundTransparency,glow.BorderSizePixel='FeelGlow',Color3.new(1,1,1),1,0
        glow.Size,glow.Active=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),false
        glow:SetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration',true)
        local glowCorner=owned('UICorner');glowCorner.Parent=glow
        local bar=owned('Frame')
        bar.Name,bar.AnchorPoint,bar.Position,bar.Size='FeelAccent',host.Vector2.new(0,.5),UDim2.new(0,0,.5,0),UDim2.new(0,3,0,0)
        bar.BorderSizePixel,bar.Active=0,false
        bar:SetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration',true)
        local scale=owned('UIScale');scale.Name='FeelScale'
        local hovered,down=nil,false
        local function accent(): any
            return (ui.palette and ui.palette['Theme Color']) or Color3.fromRGB(90,215,190)
        end
        local function play(object: any,info: any,goal: any)
            tweens:Create(object,info,goal):Play()
        end
        local function clear()
            glow.Parent,bar.Parent,scale.Parent=nil,nil,nil
            glow.BackgroundTransparency,scale.Scale=1,1
            bar.Size=UDim2.new(0,3,0,0)
            hovered,down=nil,false
        end
        local function enter(button: any)
            if hovered==button or not button.Parent then return end
            if hovered then clear() end
            hovered,down=button,false
            local existing=button:FindFirstChildOfClass('UICorner')
            glowCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,if existing then existing.CornerRadius.Offset else 0)
            glow.ZIndex,bar.ZIndex=button.ZIndex+1,button.ZIndex+2
            bar.BackgroundColor3=accent()
            glow.Parent,bar.Parent,scale.Parent=button,button,button
            play(glow,fast,{BackgroundTransparency=.9})
            play(bar,fast,{Size=UDim2.new(0,3,.62,0)})
        end
        local function attach(button: any)
            if attached[button] or not button.Parent or not button:IsA('TextButton') then return end
            if button:GetAttribute('WidgetType')=='ToggleSwitch' or button:GetAttribute('CullingNoFeel') then return end
            if button.BackgroundTransparency>=.99 then return end
            local size=button.AbsoluteSize
            if size.Y>90 or size.X>900 then return end
            attached[button]=true
            table.insert(list,button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() enter(button) end))
            table.insert(list,button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if hovered==button then clear() end end))
        end
        table.insert(list,input.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
            if hovered and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                down=true
                play(glow,pressIn,{BackgroundTransparency=.8});play(scale,pressIn,{Scale=.97})
            end
        end))
        table.insert(list,input.InputEnded:Connect(function(object)
            if hovered and down and object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                down=false
                play(glow,fast,{BackgroundTransparency=.9});play(scale,pressOut,{Scale=1})
            end
        end))
        local root=menu.panel.Root
        for _,object in root:GetDescendants() do if object:IsA('TextButton') then attach(object) end end
        table.insert(list,root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
            if object:IsA('TextButton') then host.task.defer(attach,object) end
        end))
    end
    function ui.queueTypography()
        if not ui.ready or ui.typographyQueued then return end
        ui.typographyQueued=true
        host.task.delay(1/60,function()
            ui.typographyQueued=false
            if not ui.alive or not menu.alive then return end
            for _,object in ui.menuObjects() do
                if object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox') then ui.applyMenuTextSize(object) end
            end
            if menu.panel.responsiveChrome then
                menu.panel:LayoutChrome()
                for _,record in menu.rows do ui.layoutResponsiveRow(record) end
            end
        end)
    end
    function ui.applyContentGap()
        local panel=menu.panel
        if panel.responsiveChrome then panel:LayoutChrome();return end
        local content=panel.ContentArea
        if not content then return end
        local previous=ui.contentGap
        local basePosition=if previous and content.Position==previous.position then previous.basePosition else content.Position
        local baseSize=if previous and content.Size==previous.size then previous.baseSize else content.Size
        local scale=panel.Main:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UIScale')
        local height=panel.Main.AbsoluteSize.Y/(if scale then scale.Scale else 1)
        local bottom=if panel.nativeHeaderless then -math.huge else 0
        for _,bar in {panel.TopBar,panel.TabStrip} do
            if bar and bar.Visible then bottom=math.max(bottom,(bar.Position.Y.Scale+bar.Size.Y.Scale)*height+bar.Position.Y.Offset+bar.Size.Y.Offset) end
        end
        local extra=math.max(0,bottom+14-(basePosition.Y.Scale*height+basePosition.Y.Offset))
        local position=UDim2.new(basePosition.X.Scale,basePosition.X.Offset,basePosition.Y.Scale,basePosition.Y.Offset+extra)
        local size=UDim2.new(baseSize.X.Scale,baseSize.X.Offset,baseSize.Y.Scale,baseSize.Y.Offset-extra)
        content.Position,content.Size,content.ClipsDescendants=position,size,true
        ui.contentGap={basePosition=basePosition,baseSize=baseSize,position=position,size=size}
    end
    function ui.refresh()
        if not ui.ready then return end
        ui.fullRefreshes=(ui.fullRefreshes or 0)+1
        -- Layout/presentation changes can alter a control's palette role even
        -- when its instance is reused. Palette-only edits use the keyed path.
        ui.appearanceIndexDirty=true
        if menu.panel.nativeHeaderless and menu.panel.LayoutChrome then menu.panel:LayoutChrome()end
        if ui.nativeMode then
            ui.applyNativePresentation()
            if menu.restoreWindowSize then menu.restoreWindowSize() end
            return
        end
        if ui.presentedNative then ui.leaveNativePresentation() end
        ui.nestCharacterSections()
        ui.palette = ui.palette or {}
        for _, record in menu.rows do
            if record.tab == "Settings" and record.kind == "CreateColorPicker" then ui.palette[record.name] = record.widget.Get() end
        end
        for _, record in menu.rows do ui.configureRow(record) end
        if appearance.originalLook then
            for _,group in ui.groups do
                group.header.BackgroundColor3=ui.palette['Row Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
                group.header.TextColor3=ui.palette['Text Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                group.header.BorderColor3=ui.palette['Border Color'] or Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                group.header.BorderSizePixel=0
                group.header.BackgroundTransparency=.18
                group.header:SetAttribute('CullingFontRole','subtitle')
                ui.shadeSurface(group.header,'header')
            end
        end
        for _, object in ui.menuObjects() do
            if object:IsDescendantOf(menu.panel.Sidebar) or object:IsDescendantOf(menu.panel.TabStrip) then continue end
            local kind = object:GetAttribute("WidgetType")
            if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
                if not appearance.originalLook and object.Font~=Enum.Font.Gotham then object.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham end
                menuFont(object)
                if not object:GetAttribute("CullingModern") then object.TextColor3 = ui.palette["Text Color"] end
            end
            if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if kind == "SliderTrack" then object.BackgroundColor3 = ui.palette["Slider Background Color"]
                elseif kind == "SliderFill" then object.BackgroundColor3 = ui.palette["Theme Color"]
                elseif kind == "ActionButton" then object.BackgroundColor3 = ui.palette["Button Background Color"]
                elseif object:IsA("TextBox") and not object:GetAttribute("CullingModern") then object.BackgroundColor3 = ui.palette["Input Background Color"] end
            end
        end
        local windowSurface=menu.panel.WindowSurface or menu.panel.Main
        windowSurface.BackgroundColor3 = ui.palette["Window Background COlor"]
        if appearance.transparency["Window Background COlor"] ~= nil then windowSurface.BackgroundTransparency = appearance.transparency["Window Background COlor"] end
        for _, child in menu.panel.Main:GetChildren() do
            if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Position.Y.Offset <= 0 then
                child.BackgroundColor3, child.BorderSizePixel = ui.palette["Window Background COlor"], 0
                corner(child, 10)
                for _, text in child:GetChildren() do
                    if text:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        ui.applyMenuTextSize(text)
                        menuFont(text)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        corner(windowSurface, 10)
        ui.shadeSurface(windowSurface,'window')
        if menu.panel.TopBar then
            local headerSurface=menu.panel.TopBarSurface or menu.panel.TopBar
            headerSurface.BackgroundTransparency=.12
            ui.shadeSurface(headerSurface,'row')
        end
        ui.styleCompactHeader()
        ui.styleSurface(menu.panel.Main,false)
        if menu.popup and menu.popup.Parent then ui.styleSurface(menu.popup,true) end
        if ui.colorPopup and ui.colorPopup.Parent then ui.styleSurface(ui.colorPopup,true) end
        ui.layoutTarget()
        ui.refreshTransparency()
        ui.applyContentGap()
        ui.applyTabOrganization()
        ui.refreshEmptyGroups()
        if ui.updateSearch then ui.updateSearch() end
        ui.indexAppearance()
        if menu.restoreWindowSize then menu.restoreWindowSize() end
    end
    function ui.installHiddenLauncher()
        if ui.hiddenLauncher then return end
        local playerGui=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
        if not playerGui then return end
        local guiService=host.game:GetService('GuiService')
        local screen=owned('ScreenGui')
        screen.Name='ShenaniganismMenuLauncher';screen.ResetOnSpawn=false
        screen.IgnoreGuiInset=true;screen.DisplayOrder=20;screen.Parent=playerGui
        local widget=owned('Frame')
        widget.Name='ShenaniganismLauncher';widget.BackgroundTransparency=1
        widget.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,44);widget.Parent=screen
        local launcher=owned('TextButton')
        launcher.Name='ReopenMenu';launcher.Text='S';launcher.TextSize=24
        launcher.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;launcher.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        launcher.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,22,24);launcher.BackgroundTransparency=.15
        launcher.BorderSizePixel=0;launcher.AutoButtonColor=false
        launcher.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);launcher.Parent=widget
        local rounded=owned('UICorner');rounded.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0);rounded.Parent=launcher
        local hint=owned('TextLabel')
        hint.Name='MenuKeyHint';hint.TextSize=13;hint.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        hint.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);hint.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,22,24)
        hint.BackgroundTransparency=.1;hint.BorderSizePixel=0
        hint.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(280,32)
        hint.Visible=false;hint.Parent=screen
        local hintCorner=owned('UICorner');hintCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8);hintCorner.Parent=hint
        ui.hiddenLauncher,ui.hiddenLauncherWidget,ui.hiddenLauncherTooltip=launcher,widget,hint
        local nativeRow=nil
        local rowConnections={}
        local function positionHint()
            if not hint.Visible then return end
            local origin,viewport=screen.AbsolutePosition,screen.AbsoluteSize
            local position,size=launcher.AbsolutePosition,launcher.AbsoluteSize
            hint.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(
                math.clamp(position.X-origin.X,0,math.max(0,viewport.X-280)),
                math.clamp(math.max(position.Y-origin.Y+size.Y+8,guiService.TopbarInset.Max.Y+8),0,math.max(0,viewport.Y-32)))
        end
        local function clearRowConnections()
            for _,connection in rowConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
            table.clear(rowConnections)
        end
        local function updateOrder()
            if not nativeRow then return end
            local order=0
            for _,sibling in nativeRow:GetChildren() do
                if sibling~=widget and sibling:IsA('GuiObject') then order=math.max(order,sibling.LayoutOrder) end
            end
            widget.LayoutOrder=order+1
        end
        local function positionFallback()
            if nativeRow or not ui.alive then return end
            local inset=guiService.TopbarInset
            local size=math.max(28,math.min(44,inset.Height-12))
            widget.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)
            widget.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(inset.Min.X+8,inset.Max.X-size-12),inset.Min.Y+math.max(0,(inset.Height-size)/2))
        end
        local function attachRow()
            if not ui.alive or not menu.alive then return end
            local topbar=playerGui:FindFirstChild('TopbarStandard')
            local holders=topbar and topbar:FindFirstChild('Holders')
            local row=holders and holders:FindFirstChild('Left')
            if row and not row:IsA('GuiObject') then row=nil end
            if row==nativeRow and widget.Parent then return end
            clearRowConnections();nativeRow=row
            widget.Parent=row or screen
            widget.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,44);widget.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,12)
            if row then
                updateOrder()
                table.insert(rowConnections,row.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) if child~=widget then updateOrder() end end))
                table.insert(rowConnections,row.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
                    if not row:IsDescendantOf(playerGui) then nativeRow=nil;widget.Parent=screen;positionFallback() end
                end))
            else positionFallback() end
        end
        function ui.refreshHiddenLauncher()
            if not ui.alive or not menu.alive or not widget.Parent then return end
            local legacy=menu.panel.Root:FindFirstChild('OpenBtn',true)
            if legacy then legacy.Visible=false end
            widget.Visible=not menu.panel.Main.Visible
            hint.Text=menu.menuHiddenHintText()
            ui.hiddenLauncherKey=menu.menuToggleKey
            if not widget.Visible then hint.Visible=false end
        end
        connect(launcher.Activated,function() menu.toggleMenuVisibility(true) end)
        connect(launcher.MouseEnter,function() launcher.BackgroundTransparency=0;hint.Visible=widget.Visible;positionHint() end)
        connect(launcher.MouseLeave,function() launcher.BackgroundTransparency=.15;hint.Visible=false end)
        connect(launcher.SelectionGained,function() hint.Visible=widget.Visible;positionHint() end)
        connect(launcher.SelectionLost,function() hint.Visible=false end)
        connect(launcher:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsolutePosition'),positionHint)
        connect(launcher:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),positionHint)
        connect(screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsolutePosition'),positionHint)
        connect(screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),positionHint)
        connect(menu.panel.Main:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Visible'),ui.refreshHiddenLauncher)
        connect(guiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal('TopbarInset'),positionFallback)
        connect(playerGui.DescendantAdded,function(object)
            if object.Name=='TopbarStandard' or object.Name=='Holders' or object.Name=='Left' then attachRow() end
        end)
        ui.clearLauncherRowConnections=clearRowConnections
        attachRow();ui.refreshHiddenLauncher()
    end
    function ui.installAimTargetSwitchControls()
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local main=menu.tabs.Main
        if not assist or not main or type(assist.setAimTargetSwitchMode)~='function' then return end
        local labels={Default='Current behavior',Delay='Switch with delay',Sticky='Stick to one enemy'}
        local modes={['Current behavior']='Default',['Switch with delay']='Delay',['Stick to one enemy']='Sticky'}
        for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do
            local prefix=role..' Aim '
            local modeName,delayName=prefix..'Target Mode',prefix..'Switch Delay (ms)'
            if not menu.entries['Main/'..modeName] then
                local current=assist.getAimTargetSwitchMode(role)
                main.tab:CreateDropdown({Name=modeName,DisplayName='Target Switching',Options={'Current behavior','Switch with delay','Stick to one enemy'},
                    Default=labels[current] or labels.Default,QuickSettingsOnly=true,
                    Description='Current behavior keeps your existing sticky and session settings. The other modes control free target selection; a confirmed native cast keeps its actual victim.',
                    Callback=function(value)local mode=modes[value];if mode then assist.setAimTargetSwitchMode(role,mode) end end})
            end
            if not menu.entries['Main/'..delayName] then
                main.tab:CreateSlider({Name=delayName,DisplayName='Switch Delay (ms)',Min=0,Max=5000,Default=assist.aimTargetSwitchDelayMs[role] or 250,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,
                    Description='Used only by Switch with delay. Wait this long before changing to another eligible enemy; zero switches immediately. Invalid targets are released immediately. Confirmed native casts keep their actual victim.',
                    Callback=function(value)assist.setAimTargetSwitchDelayMs(role,value)end})
            end
        end
    end
    function ui.installStickyAimControls()
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local main=menu.tabs.Main
        if not assist or not main then return end
        for _,spec in {
            {'M1 Aim Sticky Target','Stick to M1 Target','setM1AimSticky',{'M1 Assist','M1 Aim Assist'},
                'Remember the same valid M1 target between holds. Character facing still runs only during the ordinary M1 assist window; this does not hold M1 or keep turning after release.'},
            {'Skill Aim Sticky Target','Stick to Skill Target','setSkillAimSticky',{'Skill Aim Assist'},
                'Remember the same valid skill target between casts. Character facing still follows the ordinary skill assist window; this does not cast a skill or keep turning after it ends.'},
        } do
            local name,label,method,masters,description=spec[1],spec[2],spec[3],spec[4],spec[5]
            if type(assist[method])~='function' then continue end
            local related=table.clone(masters);table.insert(related,name)
            if not menu.entries['Main/'..name] then
                main.tab:CreateToggle({Name=name,DisplayName=label,Description=description,Default=false,QuickSettingsOnly=true,
                    PortRelatedNames=related,Callback=assist[method]})
            end
            for _,master in masters do
                local entry=menu.entries['Main/'..master]
                if entry and entry.config then
                    local names=entry.config.PortRelatedNames or {}
                    if not table.find(names,name) then names=table.clone(names);table.insert(names,name) end
                    entry.config.PortRelatedNames=names
                end
            end
        end
        if type(assist.setM1AssistRagdolled)=='function' and not menu.entries['Main/M1 Assist Ragdolled Targets'] then
            main.tab:CreateToggle({Name='M1 Assist Ragdolled Targets',DisplayName='Assist Ragdolled Targets',Description='Keep M1 assist following a target you are engaged with after they ragdoll, are downed or are getting up. Off drops them as soon as they go down, as before.',
                Default=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,PortRelatedNames={'M1 Assist','M1 Aim Assist','M1 Aim Sticky Target'},Callback=assist.setM1AssistRagdolled})
        end
    end
    function ui.finish()
        if menu.jujutsuerPort then menu.jujutsuerPort.createControls() end
        if menu.jujutsuerAutos then JujutsuerAutoControls.create(menu) end
        if menu.m1AimAssist then
            ui.installAimTargetSwitchControls()
            for _,role in {'M1','Block','Counter','Punish'} do
                menu.tabs.Main.tab:CreateDropdown({Name=role..' Aim Target Priority',DisplayName='Who to Aim At',Description='Select independent target methods within the cursor FOV. Selected histories use the newest eligible event; selected closest methods provide fallback ranking. Counter and punish keep their actual combat target.',Options=menu.targetMethods.choices(),Default={'Normal'},Multi=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=function(value)menu.m1AimAssist.setAimPriority(role,value)end})
            end
        end
        if menu.turnRoles then
            local main=menu.tabs.Main
            for _,role in {'M1','Skill'} do
                main.tab:CreateSlider({Name=menu.aimSpeedNames[role],DisplayName='Aim Assist Speed',Description='Shared with this feature right-click settings. Higher follows faster; zero pauses assistance.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=14,Step=.01,Precision=2,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=function(value)menu.m1AimAssist.setAimSpeed(role,value)end})
            end
            main.tab:CreateButton({Name='Aim Assist Speeds',OptionsMenu=true,Description='Open the same speed settings used by each assist, with separate degree and time limits.',Callback=function()
                local entry=menu.entries['Main/Aim Assist Speeds']
                if entry then menu.openMiniPopup(entry,menu.relatedSettings(entry)) end
            end})
            for _,role in menu.turnRoles do
                local spin=role=='Character Initial' or role=='Character Release'
                for _,item in {{'degrees','Turn Degrees (deg)',if spin then 720 else 360,if spin then 0 else 180},
                    {'time','Turn Time (s)',10,0},{'speed','Turn Speed (deg/s)',7200,0}} do
                    local field,label,maximum,default=item[1],item[2],item[3],item[4]
                    main.tab:CreateSlider({Name=role..' '..label,DisplayName=role..' '..(if spin and field=='degrees' then 'Spin Degrees (deg)' else label),
                        Description=if spin then 'Spin before settling: 360 degrees is one full turn; 720 is two. Time sets its duration. Zero time uses the existing transition speed.'
                            else 'Set degrees over time, or edit speed in degrees per second. Zero speed/time preserves the existing response.',
                        Min=0,Max=maximum,Default=default,Step=if field=='degrees' then 1 else .01,Precision=if field=='degrees' then 0 else 2,
                        QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=function(value)menu.setTurnValue(role,field,value)end})
                end
            end
        end
        if not menu.tabs.Beta then
            menu.panel:CreateTab('Beta','')
        end
        local root = menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        local screen = root and (if root:IsA("ScreenGui") then root else root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui"))
        if screen then screen.ResetOnSpawn = false end
        -- The old window's "S" icon and key hint are not created any more; Ctrl and this menu's own key open and hide the menu.
        menu.attachScaleEditor()
        local scale=menu.panel.Main:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UIScale')
        if scale then
            for _,object in root:GetDescendants() do
                if object:IsA('TextLabel') and object.Text:sub(1,10)=='GUI SCALE:' then
                    local updating=false
                    local function formatScale()
                        if updating or not object.Parent then return end
                        local text=string.format('GUI SCALE: %.2f',scale.Scale)
                        if object.Text~=text then updating=true;object.Text=text;updating=false end
                    end
                    connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'),formatScale)
                    connect(scale:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Scale'),formatScale)
                    formatScale()
                end
            end
        end
        local main = menu.tabs.Main
        if menu.visuals and menu.visuals.targetColor and menu.tabs.Player then
            local targetVisuals=menu.visuals
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateToggle({Name='Outline Players I Hit',DisplayName='Outline Recently Hit Enemies',Description='Every enemy you damage gets a separate outline starting at impact. Right-click to keep it until death or adjust duration, colors, body fill and transparency.',Default=false,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutline})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateToggle({Name='Keep Hit Outline Until Death',Description='Keep each confirmed hit enemy outlined until that character dies. Turning this off resumes the countdown from the last hit; turning Outline Recently Hit Enemies off clears all marks.',Default=false,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineUntilDeath})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateSlider({Name='Hit Outline Duration (s)',Description='Independent countdown from your last confirmed hit, up to 600 seconds. Used when Keep Hit Outline Until Death is off.',Min=1,Max=600,Default=300,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineDuration})
            if not targetVisuals.hitOutlineThicknessSupported and type(targetVisuals.probeHitOutlineThickness)=='function' then targetVisuals.probeHitOutlineThickness()end
            if true then
                menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateSlider({Name='Hit Outline Thickness (px)',DisplayName='Hit ESP Box Thickness (px)',Description='Actual wire thickness for recently hit enemies in the shared 3D box/rig renderer. Native mesh silhouette width remains engine controlled.',Min=.5,Max=8,Default=2,Step=.1,Precision=1,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineThickness})
            end
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateColorPicker({Name='Hit Outline Color',DisplayName='Recent Hit Outline Color',Description='Color for recently hit enemies only, rendered by the shared ESP.',Default='255, 55, 55',QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineColor,
                GetTransparency=function()return targetVisuals.hitOutlineTransparency end,
                SetTransparency=function(alpha)local entry=menu.entries['Player/Hit Outline Transparency (%)'];if entry then entry.widget.Set(alpha*100,true)end end})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateSlider({Name='Hit Outline Transparency (%)',DisplayName='Outline Transparency (%)',Description='Zero is solid; 100 is invisible.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=0,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineTransparency})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateToggle({Name='Hit Outline Fill Character',DisplayName='Fill Character / Chams',Description='Fill recently hit enemies with the selected body color.',Default=false,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineFill})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateColorPicker({Name='Hit Outline Fill Color',DisplayName='Character Fill Color',Description='Visual overlay color for recently hit enemies. Does not change the original body.',Default='255, 55, 55',QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineFillColor,
                GetTransparency=function()return targetVisuals.hitOutlineFillTransparency end,
                SetTransparency=function(alpha)local entry=menu.entries['Player/Hit Outline Fill Transparency (%)'];if entry then entry.widget.Set(alpha*100,true)end end})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateSlider({Name='Hit Outline Fill Transparency (%)',DisplayName='Fill Transparency (%)',Description='Zero is solid body fill; 100 is invisible fill.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=65,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setHitOutlineFillTransparency})
            local targetColor=targetVisuals.targetColor()
            local targetColorDefault=string.format('%d, %d, %d',math.round(targetColor.R*255),math.round(targetColor.G*255),math.round(targetColor.B*255))
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateColorPicker({Name='ESP Color',DisplayName='Target ESP Color',Description='Color for target outlines, glow and names. Right-click Target Outline ESP to adjust.',Default=targetColorDefault,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setTargetESPColor,
                GetTransparency=function()return targetVisuals.targetESPTransparency end,
                SetTransparency=function(alpha)
                    local entry=menu.entries['Player/ESP Transparency (%)']
                    if entry and entry.widget then entry.widget.Set(alpha*100,true) else targetVisuals.setTargetESPTransparency(alpha*100) end
                end})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateSlider({Name='ESP Glow (%)',DisplayName='Target ESP Glow (%)',Description='Native Highlight fill strength. Zero keeps a clean outline; larger values add a tinted body glow.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=0,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setTargetESPGlow})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateSlider({Name='ESP Transparency (%)',DisplayName='Target ESP Transparency (%)',Description='Fade target outlines and glow together: 0% is solid and 100% is hidden. Name visibility is independent.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=0,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=targetVisuals.setTargetESPTransparency})
        end
        if menu.prediction then
            menu.tabs.Automatic.tab:CreateToggle({Name='Predicted Ragdoll Landing',DisplayName='Predicted Landing Position',QuickSettingsOnly=true,Description='Show a small ground marker estimated from the locked or recently hit enemy velocity, gravity and the first terrain collision. Later forces can change the landing.',Default=false,Callback=menu.prediction.setLandingEnabled})
            menu.tabs.Automatic.tab:CreateDropdown({Name='Landing Marker Shape',Description='Target: closing rings. Box and Diamond: closing square. Arrow: a bobbing arrow that drops onto the spot.
