                    add('CreateToggle','visible','Show Field',{})
                    slider('size','Text Size',0,96);slider('offsetX','Offset X (px)',-500,500);slider('offsetY','Offset Y (px)',-500,500)
                    add('CreateToggle','customize','Customize Text Style',{})
                    color('textColor','Text Color','textTransparency',false);slider('textTransparency','Text Transparency (%)',0,100)
                    color('outlineColor','Outline Color','outlineOpacity',true);slider('outlineOpacity','Outline Opacity (%)',0,100);slider('outlineThickness','Outline Thickness',0,8,.1)
                    color('shadowColor','Shadow Color','shadowOpacity',true);slider('shadowOpacity','Shadow Opacity (%)',0,100);slider('shadowX','Shadow Offset X',-32,32);slider('shadowY','Shadow Offset Y',-32,32)
                    color('depthColor','Depth Color','depthOpacity',true);slider('depthOpacity','Depth Opacity (%)',0,100);slider('depthX','Depth Offset X',-32,32);slider('depthY','Depth Offset Y',-32,32)
                    tab:CreateButton({Name=prefix,DisplayName=field,ButtonText='Adjust',OptionsMenu=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,InfoHubEditor=true,InfoFieldEditor=field,PortRelatedNames=names,Callback=function()open(prefix)end})
                    for _,entry in entries do entry.config.PortRelatedNames=names end
                end
                do
                    local function box(kind: string, key: string, caption: string, config: any)
                        config.Name,config.DisplayName,config.QuickSettingsOnly = 'Stun Box '..caption,caption,true
                        config.Default = visual.stunBox[key]
                        config.Callback = function(value) if initializing then return nil end;return visual.setStunBox(key,value) end
                        config.Description = config.Description or 'Style the box behind the stun and status timer above an enemy\'s head.'
                        tab[kind](tab,config)
                    end
                    box('CreateToggle','enabled','Box',{Description='Draw a box behind the enemy stun / status timer.'})
                    box('CreateColorPicker','color','Box Color',{})
                    box('CreateSlider','opacity','Box Opacity (%)',{Min=0,Max=100,Step=1,Precision=0})
                    box('CreateSlider','corner','Box Corner Radius',{Min=0,Max=30,Step=1,Precision=0})
                    box('CreateSlider','border','Box Border Thickness',{Min=0,Max=8,Step=.5,Precision=1})
                    box('CreateColorPicker','borderColor','Box Border Color',{})
                    box('CreateDropdown','font','Font',{Options={'Gotham','GothamMedium','GothamBold','GothamSemibold','SourceSans','SourceSansBold','Arial','ArialBold','Code','Fantasy','Bangers','Michroma'}})
                    box('CreateSlider','lift','Height Offset (studs)',{Min=-10,Max=15,Step=.1,Precision=1})
                    box('CreateSlider','scale','Size (%)',{Min=10,Max=1000,Step=1,Precision=0,Description='Overall size of the stun / knock-down box and its text, like the info card Scale.'})
                    box('CreateSlider','width','Width (%)',{Min=10,Max=1000,Step=1,Precision=0,Description='Stretch the box wider or narrower on its own.'})
                    box('CreateSlider','height','Height (%)',{Min=10,Max=1000,Step=1,Precision=0,Description='Stretch the box taller or shorter on its own.'})
                    box('CreateSlider','spin','Spin (deg/s)',{Min=-720,Max=720,Step=1,Precision=0,Description='Spin the box around its centre. Negative spins the other way; 0 is still.'})
                end
                tab:CreateButton({Name='Info Hub Layout',DisplayName='Info Hub Layout & Fields',ButtonText='Adjust',OptionsMenu=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,InfoHubEditor=true,PortRelatedNames=layoutNames,Callback=function()open('Info Hub Layout')end})
                initializing=false
            end
            -- End info hub editor.
            settings.tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Info Font Size", Description = "Size of target information. Menu fonts use Menu Font Size instead.", Min = 10, Max = 100, Default = appearance.infoFontSize, Callback = function(size)
                appearance.infoFontSize = math.clamp(math.round(size), 10, 100)
                ui.refresh()
            end})
            settings.tab:CreateInput({Name='Excluded Friends',Default='',QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=menu.setExcludedFriends})
            menu.tabs.Player.tab:CreateDropdown({Name='Friends Exclude',Description='Select any number of server players to exclude. Updates automatically as players join or leave; selections are saved by UserId.',Options={},Default='None',NoConfig=true,LiveFriends=true})
            if menu.sideDisplays then
                settings.tab:CreateSlider({Name='HUD Update Rate (Hz)',Description='Refresh character information and bar placement up to this many rendered frames per second. Native body anchors follow the current rendered pose; data discovery and wall checks keep their existing budgets.',Min=30,Max=240,Default=90,Step=1,Precision=0,Callback=menu.sideDisplays.setUpdateRate})
            end
        end
        local consolidatedLockControls={['Auto Lock On']=true,['Auto Lock On Trigger']=true,['Auto Lock On When You Hit']=true,['Recent Hit Priority (s)']=true}
        ui.captureNativePresentation()
        local headingOnly={['Settings/Settings']=true,['Settings/UI Changer']=true,['Player/Player Tab']=true,
            ['Main/Main']=true,['Automatic/Automatic']=true,['Fun/Fun']=true,['Transform/Transform']=true,
            ['Transform/Clothing Editor']=true,['Transform/Avatar stuff']=true,['Transform/Server List']=true,
            ['Aura/Aura']=true,['Game/Game']=true,['Skill/Skill Tab']=true,['Skill/Combat Trails']=true,
            ['Skill/After-Images']=true,['Skill/Mesh Stuff']=true,['Skill/VFX Color Changers']=true,
            ['Animation/Fly animations']=true,['Animation/Animation Changer']=true,['Animation/Block Animations']=true,
            ['Emote/Emote Tab']=true,['Emote/Special Emotes']=true,['Music/Ultimate Music']=true,['Scripts/Script Tab']=true}
        for _, record in menu.rows do
            ui.applyCanonicalLockVisibility(record)
            if record.kind=='CreateParagraph' and headingOnly[record.tab..'/'..record.name] then
                record.config.CanonicalHidden=true;record.row.Visible=false
                continue
            end
            if record.tab=='Main' and record.name=='Lock On Icon Size' then record.config.QuickSettingsOnly=true;record.row.Visible=false end
            if consolidatedLockControls[record.name] then record.config.QuickSettingsOnly=true;record.row.Visible=false end
            if record.kind == "CreateColorPicker" then
                ui.registerColor(record)
            end
            if record.kind == "CreateParagraph" and ((record.tab == "Main" and record.name == "Main") or (record.tab == "Aura" and record.name == "Aura") or (record.tab == "Game" and record.name == "Game")) then
                record.row.Parent, record.row.LayoutOrder, record.destination = menu.tabs[record.tab].page, -1, record.tab
            else
                local destination, group = groupFor(record)
                local tab = menu.tabs[destination] or menu.tabs[record.tab]
                local section = ui.section(tab.page, group, destination.."/"..group)
                record.row.Parent = section.contents
                section.count = (section.count or 0) + 1
                record.row.LayoutOrder = section.count
                record.destination = destination
                table.insert(section.records, record)
            end
        end
        ui.nestCharacterSections()
        ui.organizeGroups()
        -- Move the requested blocking controls together once, preserving other edits.
        if appearance.blockingGroupingVersion ~= 1 then
            local saved = appearance.order
            if type(saved) == 'table' then
                local oldSection = saved['section/Automatic/Defense']
                if oldSection and not saved['section/Automatic/Blocking & counters'] then
                    saved['section/Automatic/Blocking & counters'] = table.clone(oldSection)
                end
                local blocking = ui.groups['Automatic/Blocking & counters']
                if blocking then
                    for _, record in blocking.records do
                        local key = 'row/'..record.tab..'/'..record.name
                        local previous = saved[key]
                        if previous and previous.parent ~= 'section/Automatic/Blocking & counters' then
                            saved[key] = {parent='section/Automatic/Blocking & counters',order=record.row.LayoutOrder}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            appearance.blockingGroupingVersion = 1
        end
        if appearance.looksMiscGroupingVersion~=1 then
            for _,record in menu.rows do
                if record.tab=='Scripts' or record.tab=='Skill' or record.tab=='Aura' or record.tab=='Animation' or record.tab=='Music' or record.tab=='Game' or (record.tab=='Player' and record.name:lower():find('morph',1,true)) then
                    local destination,group=groupFor(record)
                    appearance.order=appearance.order or {}
                    appearance.order['row/'..record.tab..'/'..record.name]={parent='section/'..destination..'/'..group,order=record.row.LayoutOrder}
                end
            end
            appearance.looksMiscGroupingVersion=1
        end
        if appearance.mainGameUtilitiesVersion~=1 then
            appearance.order=appearance.order or {}
            for _,record in menu.rows do
                local destination,group=groupFor(record)
                if record.tab=='Game' and destination=='Main' and group=='Game utilities' then
                    appearance.order['row/'..record.tab..'/'..record.name]={parent='section/Main/Game utilities',order=record.row.LayoutOrder}
                end
            end
            local section=ui.groups['Main/Game utilities']
            if section then appearance.order['section/Main/Game utilities']={parent='page/Main',order=section.frame.LayoutOrder} end
            appearance.order['section/Fun/Game utilities']=nil
            appearance.mainGameUtilitiesVersion=1
        end
        appearance.initialized, ui.ready = true, true
        menu.version = "Shenaniganism"
        for _, label in menu.panel.TopBar:GetChildren() do
            if label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Text:find("Culling Hub",1,true) then
                label.Text = "Shenaniganism"
            end
        end
        ui.refresh()
        for _, page in menu.panel.Pages do page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y end
        ui.installSearch()
        local feelOk,feelProblem=pcall(ui.installFeel)
        if not feelOk then menu.feelError=tostring(feelProblem) end
    end
    function ui.Destroy()
        if not ui.alive then return end
        if ui.searchResults then ui.searchResults.Visible=false end
        ui.setSearchUnderlayHidden(false)
        ui.alive, ui.ready = false, false
        for _,connection in ui.feelConnections or {} do connection:Disconnect() end
        if ui.clearLauncherRowConnections then ui.clearLauncherRowConnections() end
        for _,state in ui.switchStates do if state.tween then state.tween:Cancel() end end
        for _,record in menu.rows do
            for object,visible in record.nativeColorSurfaces or {} do if object.Parent then object.Visible=visible end end
            if record.friendButtons then for _,item in record.friendButtons do item.connection:Disconnect() end end
            if record.switchSetWrapper and record.widget.Set==record.switchSetWrapper then record.widget.Set=record.switchOriginalSet end
            if record.binarySwitch then
                if record.widget.Set==record.binarySetWrapper then record.widget.Set=record.binaryOriginalSet end
                for object,state in record.nativeDropdowns do if object.Parent then object.Visible=state.visible end end
                record.binarySwitch:Destroy();record.binarySwitch=nil
            end
        end
        for _, record in (ui.checkboxRecords :: {any}) do
            local widget, previous = record.widget, record.checkboxPrevious
            if widget.Set == record.checkboxSetWrapper then widget.Set = previous.Set end
            if widget.CheckboxOptions == record.checkboxOptions then widget.CheckboxOptions = previous.CheckboxOptions end
            if widget.IsChecked == record.checkboxIsChecked then widget.IsChecked = previous.IsChecked end
            if widget.SetChecked == record.checkboxSetChecked then widget.SetChecked = previous.SetChecked end
            for object, state in record.nativeDropdowns do
                if object.Parent and object.Visible == false then object.Visible = state.visible end
            end
            record.checkboxContainer:Destroy()
            record.checkboxContainer, record.refreshCheckboxes = nil, nil
        end
        table.clear(ui.checkboxRecords)
        if ui.editor then ui.editor.Destroy() end
        ui.closeColor()
        ui.menuObjectCache,ui.menuObjectCacheRoot,ui.mainSurfaceCache,ui.mainSurfaceCacheRoot,ui.appearanceTargets,ui.appearanceIndexRoot=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
        ui.searchRows,ui.searchMetadata,ui.searchRowMembers=nil,nil,nil
    end
    return ui
end
return ModernUI
end)()

local DashControl = (function(): any
-- Dash Cooldown values0-100 represent0-10 seconds (one unit is100 milliseconds).
local DashControl = {}
function DashControl.attach(movement: any, environment: {[string]: any}, player: any, directionOverride: any): any
    local originalRequest, originalDash = movement.DashRequest, movement.Dash
    local read, write = environment.getupvalues, environment.setupvalue or environment.debug.setupvalue
    local dashValues = read(originalDash)
    local timerFunction = originalRequest
    local timestampIndex
    -- Another menu can wrap DashRequest. Follow its captured values without
    -- removing that wrapper, locating the game's shared timer underneath it.
    local queue, seen, at, visited = {{originalRequest, 0}}, {}, 1, 0
    while at <= #queue and visited < 18000 and not timestampIndex do
        local value, depth = queue[at][1], queue[at][2]
        at += 1
        if seen[value] then continue end
        seen[value], visited = true, visited+1
        if type(value) == "function" then
            local ok, values = pcall(read, value)
            if not ok then continue end
            for index, captured in values do
                if type(captured) == "number" and captured > 10000000 then
                    for _, other in dashValues do
                        if captured == other then timestampIndex, timerFunction = index, value; break end
                    end
                end
            end
            if depth < 7 then
                for _, captured in values do
                    if type(captured) == "table" or type(captured) == "function" then table.insert(queue, {captured, depth+1}) end
                end
            end
        elseif type(value) == "table" and depth < 7 then
            local count = 0
            for _, captured in next, value do
                count += 1
                if count > 2048 then break end
                if type(captured) == "table" or type(captured) == "function" then table.insert(queue, {captured, depth+1}) end
            end
        end
    end
    assert(timestampIndex, "The dash timestamp could not be identified")
    local clock = if environment.os and type(environment.os.clock) == "function" then environment.os.clock else environment.tick
    local control: any = {seconds = 10, milliseconds = 10000, steps = 100, enabled = false, alive = true, lastRequest = nil, lastSide = nil, nextAllowedAt = nil, movement = movement,
        requests=0,rejections=0,frontDeniedCount=0,frontDeniedAt=nil,lastRequestReason='Modify Dash Cooldown is disabled',nativeTimerIndex=timestampIndex}
    control.frontIntervalEnabled,control.frontIntervalSeconds=false,0
    control.targetNotRequired,control.targetNotRequiredReady=false,false
    control.blockDashEnabled,control.blockDashReady=true,false
    control.blockDashRequests,control.blockDashReleases=0,0
    control.blockDashStarted,control.blockDashMoved=0,0
    control.lastBlockDashReason='Waiting for your Dash while blocking'
    control.targetlessRequests,control.targetlessLocalMoves=0,0
    control.lastTargetlessReason='Target Not Required is disabled'
    control.connections={}
    local nativeRecoveryDepth=0
    -- Keep saved minimum durations as bases; signed edits change only our
    -- submission waits and never rewrite a native/server cooldown duration.
    control.intervalAdjustmentSeconds,control.frontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds=0,0
    control.effectiveIntervalSeconds,control.effectiveFrontIntervalSeconds=10,0
    local function signedAdjustment(value: any,limit: number): number?
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return nil end
        return math.clamp(amount,-limit,limit)
    end
    local function frontIntervalMaximum(): number
        local maximum=math.max(0,control.frontIntervalSeconds+control.frontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds)
        control.effectiveFrontIntervalSeconds=maximum
        return maximum
    end
    local frontIntervalRecord
    local function moveset(character: any): any
        if not character or type(character.GetAttribute)~='function' then return nil end
        local ok,kit=pcall(character.GetAttribute,character,'Moveset')
        return if ok then kit else nil
    end
    local function currentFrontRecord(character: any): any
        if frontIntervalRecord and (frontIntervalRecord.character~=character or frontIntervalRecord.moveset~=moveset(character)) then
            frontIntervalRecord=nil
        end
        return frontIntervalRecord
    end
    function control.setFrontIntervalEnabled(value: any)
        control.frontIntervalEnabled=control.alive and value==true
    end
    function control.setFrontIntervalSeconds(value: any)
        local seconds=tonumber(value)or 0
        if seconds~=seconds or math.abs(seconds)==math.huge then seconds=0 end
        control.frontIntervalSeconds=math.clamp(seconds,0,15)
        frontIntervalMaximum()
    end
    function control.setFrontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds(value: any): boolean
        local amount=signedAdjustment(value,15)
        if not control.alive or amount==nil then return false end
        control.frontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds=amount
        frontIntervalMaximum()
        return true
    end
    function control.noteFrontDashStarted(character: any,observedAt: number?): boolean
        if not control.alive or not character or character~=player.Character then return false end
        local now=clock()
        local at=if type(observedAt)=='number' and observedAt==observedAt and math.abs(observedAt)<math.huge then math.min(observedAt,now) else now
        frontIntervalRecord={character=character,moveset=moveset(character),at=at}
        return true
    end
    function control.getFrontIntervalStatus(character: any): any
        if not control.alive or not character or character~=player.Character then return nil end
        local record=currentFrontRecord(character)
        local maximum=frontIntervalMaximum()
        local remaining=if control.frontIntervalEnabled and record then math.max(0,record.at+maximum-clock())else 0
        return {remaining=remaining,maximum=maximum,effective=maximum,
            base=control.frontIntervalSeconds,adjustment=control.frontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds,
            enabled=control.frontIntervalEnabled,ready=remaining<=0,
            fraction=if maximum>0 then math.clamp(1-remaining/maximum,0,1)else 1,
            source='Configured client minimum front-dash interval'}
    end
    -- Observe only remotes reached by this actual native request. Front Chase
    -- does not write the shared side-dash timer, so timer changes alone cannot
    -- distinguish its submission from a native state rejection.
    local function observeDispatch(): any
        local scope: any={alive=true,sent=false,hooks={}}
        local seenRemotes={}
        local function observe(remote: any)
            if type(remote)~='table' or type(remote.Fire)~='function' or seenRemotes[remote] then return end
            seenRemotes[remote]=true
            local original=remote.Fire
            local wrapper=function(self: any,...: any): ...any
                local result=table.pack(original(self,...))
                if scope.alive and control.alive then scope.sent=true end
                return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
            end
            remote.Fire=wrapper
            table.insert(scope.hooks,{remote=remote,original=original,wrapper=wrapper})
        end
        local values=read(timerFunction)
        for _,captured in values do
            if type(captured)~='table' then continue end
            observe(rawget(captured,'Dash'))
            if type(rawget(captured,'GetToolService'))=='function' then
                local character=player.Character
                local serviceName=character and character:GetAttribute('Moveset')
                serviceName=type(serviceName)=='string' and serviceName..'Service' or nil
                local replicated=environment.game and environment.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
                local knit=replicated and replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
                local module=knit and knit:FindFirstChild('Knit')
                local advertised=module and module:FindFirstChild('Services')
                -- Never query a guessed/missing Knit service (it can wait forever).
                if serviceName and advertised and advertised:FindFirstChild(serviceName) then
                    local ok,service=pcall(captured.GetToolService,captured,serviceName)
                    if ok and service then observe(service.Chase) end
                end
            end
        end
        function scope.stop()
            scope.alive=false
            for _,hook in scope.hooks do
                if hook.remote.Fire==hook.wrapper then hook.remote.Fire=hook.original end
            end
        end
        return scope
    end
    local readConstants = environment.getconstants or (environment.debug and environment.debug.getconstants)
    local writeConstant = environment.setconstant or (environment.debug and environment.debug.setconstant)
    local debugInfo = if environment.debug and environment.debug.info then environment.debug.info else debug.info
    -- Busy-action routing has its own capability contract. Charge/pursuit
    -- layouts remain independently versioned and are never inferred from it.
    local contract: any={readConstants=type(readConstants)=='function',writeConstant=type(writeConstant)=='function',
        identityReadable=false,sourceMatches=false,guardSignature=false,captureShape=false,scopedVerified=false,
        manualCallbacks=0,profileKnown=false,reason='Native dash action contract is unavailable'}
    control.nativeContractStatus=contract
    -- Read the native movement gate without advancing it or submitting a dash.
    -- Charge layouts are versioned: an unfamiliar controller may still expose
    -- its identified timestamp, but must not be presented as a known charge kit.
    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function validCharges(value: any): boolean
        return finite(value) and value>=0 and value<=2 and value%1==0
    end
    local nativeReadProfile
    if timestampIndex==4 and type(readConstants)=='function' then
        local identified,source,line,name=pcall(debugInfo,timerFunction,'sln')
        local readable,constants=pcall(readConstants,timerFunction)
        local captured,values=pcall(read,timerFunction)
        local domainRefill=if line==398 then .8 elseif line==343 then 1 else nil
        if identified and type(source)=='string' and source:match('Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$')
            and name=='DashRequest' and domainRefill and readable and type(constants)=='table'
            and captured and type(values)=='table' and finite(values[4]) and validCharges(values[6])
            and type(values[3])=='table' and type(rawget(values[3],'GetToolService'))=='function' then
            local signature={}
            for _,constant in constants do
                if type(constant)=='string' or finite(constant) then signature[constant]=true end
            end
            local matches=true
            -- Native literal 2 uses LOADN and is absent from getconstants.
            for _,constant in {'Front','Back','Dash','Chase','Naoya','DomainClash','DisableChase','CustomChase','NoDash','UseSetService',.4,.3,.45,domainRefill} do
                if not signature[constant] then matches=false;break end
            end
            if matches then nativeReadProfile={name='MovementController.DashRequest:'..line,domainRefill=domainRefill} end
        end
    end
    -- Identify the existing native Dash input callback and exact pursuit
    -- captures. This option never constructs a target or changes a marker.
    local manualDashCallbacks={}
    local inputService
    local focused=true
    local nativePursuit
    local restoreGuardTransactions
    local function refreshManualDashCallbacks()
        table.clear(manualDashCallbacks);contract.manualCallbacks=0
        contract.callbackRefreshes=(contract.callbackRefreshes or 0)+1
        if type(environment.getconnections)=='function' and environment.game then
            local replicated=environment.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
            local keybind=replicated and replicated:FindFirstChild('Keybind')
            local combat=keybind and keybind:FindFirstChild('Combat')
            local action=combat and combat:FindFirstChild('Dash')
            local connected,connections=pcall(function()return action and environment.getconnections(action.Pressed)end)
            if connected and type(connections)=='table' then
                local inspected=0
                for _,connection in connections do
                    inspected+=1;if inspected>128 then break end
                    local readable,callback=pcall(function()return connection.Function end)
                    if readable and type(callback)=='function' and not manualDashCallbacks[callback] then
                        local identified,source=pcall(debugInfo,callback,'s')
                        local captured,captures=pcall(read,callback)
                        local constantOk,constants=pcall(readConstants,callback)
                        local callbackNames={}
                        if constantOk and type(constants)=='table'then
                            for _,value in constants do if type(value)=='string'then callbackNames[value]=true end end
                        end
                        if identified and type(source)=='string' and source:match('Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$')
                            and captured and type(captures)=='table' and captures[1]==player and captures[2]==movement
                            and callbackNames.Character and callbackNames.DashRequest then
                            manualDashCallbacks[callback]=true;contract.manualCallbacks+=1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        control.targetNotRequiredReady=nativePursuit~=nil and contract.manualCallbacks>0
        control.blockDashReady=contract.manualCallbacks>0;control.blockingReady=control.blockDashReady
    end
    do
        local ok,values=pcall(read,timerFunction)
        -- Readiness supports the older charge layout too; pursuit routing is
        -- enabled only for the current branch whose non-target guards were
        -- inspected in full.
        if nativeReadProfile and nativeReadProfile.name=='MovementController.DashRequest:398'
            and ok and type(values)=='table' and values[1]==player and type(values[2])=='table'
            and type(values[2].Dash)=='table' and type(values[2].Dash.Fire)=='function' then
            nativePursuit=values[2]
        end
        -- The player's genuine Dash callback is useful even when optional
        -- pursuit/charge metadata is unfamiliar. Its exact captures still
        -- prove ownership; no synthetic input is recognized as a manual press.
        refreshManualDashCallbacks()
        local okInput,service=pcall(function()return environment.game and environment.game:GetService('UserInputService')end)
        if okInput then inputService=service end
        for _,event in {{inputService and inputService.WindowFocusReleased,false},{inputService and inputService.WindowFocused,true}} do
            if event[1] and type(event[1].Connect)=='function' then
                control.connections[#control.connections+1]=event[1]:Connect(function()focused=event[2]end)
            end
        end
        if player.CharacterAdded and type(player.CharacterAdded.Connect)=='function'then
            control.connections[#control.connections+1]=player.CharacterAdded:Connect(refreshManualDashCallbacks)
        end
        if player.CharacterRemoving and type(player.CharacterRemoving.Connect)=='function'then
            control.connections[#control.connections+1]=player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
                if restoreGuardTransactions then restoreGuardTransactions()end
                table.clear(manualDashCallbacks);contract.manualCallbacks=0
                control.blockDashReady,control.blockingReady,control.targetNotRequiredReady=false,false,false
            end)
        end
        if not control.targetNotRequiredReady then control.lastTargetlessReason='Verified native pursuit route or manual Dash input is unavailable' end
    end
    function control.setTargetNotRequired(value: boolean): boolean
        if not control.alive or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.targetNotRequired=value
        control.lastTargetlessReason=if not value then 'Target Not Required is disabled'
            elseif control.targetNotRequiredReady then 'Waiting for your native front/Chase dash press during DisableChase'
            else 'Verified native pursuit route or manual Dash input is unavailable'
        return true
    end
    function control.readNativeState(): any
        if not control.alive then return nil end
        local readable,values=pcall(read,timerFunction)
        local timed,wallNow=pcall(environment.tick)
        if not readable or type(values)~='table' or not finite(values[timestampIndex]) or not timed or not finite(wallNow) then return nil end
        local state: any={lastNativeAt=values[timestampIndex],wallNow=wallNow}
        if nativeReadProfile and validCharges(values[6]) and type(values[3])=='table'
            and type(rawget(values[3],'GetToolService'))=='function' then
            state.charges=values[6]
            state.profile=nativeReadProfile.name
            state.shortGate=.45;state.domainGate=.3
            state.refill=2;state.domainRefill=nativeReadProfile.domainRefill
        end
        return state
    end
    -- Retire only this script's exact historical Block-guard alias when an
    -- older runtime left it on the verified native controller. The verified
    -- per-request transaction below always restores its own temporary aliases.
    if nativeReadProfile and type(readConstants)=='function'and type(writeConstant)=='function'then
        local okay,constants=pcall(readConstants,timerFunction)
        if okay and type(constants)=='table'then
            local aliasIndex,count=nil,0
            for index,value in constants do if value=='__CullingDashWhileBlockingGuard'then aliasIndex=index;count+=1 end end
            if count==1 then pcall(writeConstant,timerFunction,aliasIndex,'Block')end
        end
    end
    local m1GuardIndices={}
    local naturalDashCall
    local nativeGuardTransaction
    local nativeGuardTransactions={}
    control.m1DashReady,control.m1DashEnabled=false,true
    local verifiedBlockGuard=false
    if type(readConstants)=="function" and type(writeConstant)=="function" then
        local ok, source, line = pcall(debugInfo, timerFunction, "sl")
        contract.identityReadable=ok;contract.definitionLine=if finite(line)then line else nil
        contract.sourceMatches=ok and type(source)=='string'and source:match('Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$')~=nil
        if contract.sourceMatches then
            local readable, constants = pcall(readConstants, timerFunction)
            if readable and type(constants)=="table" then
                local matches, names = 0, {}
                for index, value in constants do
                    if value=="Block" then matches+=1 end
                    if type(value)=='string'or finite(value)then names[value]=true end
                end
                verifiedBlockGuard = matches==1 and names.Dash and names.Chase and names.Stun
                    and names.Ragdoll and names.InSkill and names.NoDash and names.NoSprint or false
                local skillCount,sprintCount,stunCount=0,0,0
                for index,value in constants do
                    if value=='InSkill' then skillCount+=1;m1GuardIndices.InSkill=index end
                    if value=='NoSprint' then sprintCount+=1;m1GuardIndices.NoSprint=index end
                    if value=='Block'then m1GuardIndices.Block=index end
                    if value=='Stun'then stunCount+=1;m1GuardIndices.Stun=index end
                end
                local captured,values=pcall(read,timerFunction)
                local modernCaptures=captured and type(values)=='table'and values[1]==player and type(values[2])=='table'
                        and type(values[2].Dash)=='table'and type(values[2].Dash.Fire)=='function'
                        and type(values[3])=='table'and type(values[3].UseSetService)=='function'
                local modernSignature=true
                for _,value in {'Front','Back','Naoya','DomainClash','DisableChase','CustomChase','UseSetService','Toji','COATM',.4,.3,.45,.8}do
                    if not names[value]then modernSignature=false;break end
                end
                contract.guardSignature=verifiedBlockGuard and modernSignature
                contract.captureShape=modernCaptures==true
                -- Definition line numbers move when unrelated native code is
                -- edited. The complete known guard/route signature and actual
                -- controller captures are the current contract, not a line.
                verifiedBlockGuard=verifiedBlockGuard and (line==343 or modernSignature and modernCaptures)
                control.m1DashReady=verifiedBlockGuard and skillCount==1 and sprintCount==1 and stunCount==1
            end
        end
    end
    control.scopedDashReady=control.m1DashReady
    contract.scopedVerified=control.scopedDashReady==true;contract.profileKnown=nativeReadProfile~=nil
    contract.reason=if not contract.readConstants or not contract.writeConstant then 'Native dash guard access is unavailable'
        elseif not contract.sourceMatches then 'Native dash controller identity is unsupported'
        elseif not contract.scopedVerified then 'Native dash guard signature or controller captures are unsupported'
        elseif contract.manualCallbacks==0 then 'Native dash guards verified; manual Dash callback is unavailable'
        else 'Native busy-action guards and manual Dash callback are verified'
    control.blockingReady,control.blockingEnabled=control.blockDashReady,control.blockDashEnabled
    control.lastBlockReason='Dash While Blocking uses a real native Block release and acknowledgement'
    function control.setM1WhileDashing(value: boolean, provider: any): boolean
        if type(provider)=='function' then control.m1Provider=provider end
        control.m1DashEnabled=control.alive and value==true
        control.lastM1DashReason=if not control.m1DashEnabled then 'Dash While M1 is disabled'elseif control.m1DashReady then 'Verified native own-M1 dash request route is available'else 'Current native dash guard contract is unsupported'
        return value~=true or control.m1DashReady
    end
    local function dashMenu()

    local function scopedDashGuards()
        control.lastGuardReason='Native dash guard contract is unsupported or unloaded'
        if not control.alive or not control.scopedDashReady then return nil end
        local menu=dashMenu();local character=player.Character;local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        control.lastGuardReason='Dash overlap is paused by input focus, menu, or unavailable character'
        if not character or not character.Parent or not info or not focused or inputService and inputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu and(menu.recording or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen())then return nil end
        local overlap=menu and menu.actionOverlap
        local function allows(context)
            return not overlap or type(overlap.allows)=='function'and overlap.allows('Dash',context)==true
        end
        control.lastGuardReason='Native stun, death, or recovery restriction owns the dash request'
        for _,name in {'TrueStun','Knockback','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Dead'}do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or type(value)=='number'and value>0 or info:FindFirstChild(name)then return nil end
        end
        local incomingStun=character:GetAttribute('Stun')
        if incomingStun==true or type(incomingStun)=='number'and incomingStun>0 then return nil end
        if (tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll'))or 0)>0 then return nil end
        local manual=naturalDashCall and naturalDashCall()
        local block=manual and control.blockDashEnabled and info:FindFirstChild('Block')~=nil and allows('Block')
        local provider=control.m1Provider
        if type(provider)~='function'then
            local tracker=menu and menu.autoCounterFilter
            provider=tracker and tracker.m1EvidenceCurrent
        end
        local ownM1=false
        if control.m1DashEnabled and allows('M1')and type(provider)=='function'then
            local okay,active=pcall(provider);ownM1=okay and active==true
        end
        control.lastM1DashEvidence=if ownM1 then 'Recent native swing'else 'No confirmed current native M1 phase'
        if not ownM1 and control.m1DashEnabled and allows('M1')then
            local aim=menu and menu.m1AimAssist
            local session=aim and aim.m1HeldSession
            local marker=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            if session and session.character==character and session.nativeAt~=nil and marker and marker==session.nativeMarker
                and type(aim.userM1Held)=='function'and type(aim.ownM1Phase)=='function'then
                local held,down=pcall(aim.userM1Held)
                if held and down==true then
                    local okay,active=pcall(aim.ownM1Phase,character);ownM1=okay and active==true
                    if ownM1 then control.lastM1DashEvidence='Confirmed continuously held native M1 phase'end
                end
            end
        end
        if not block and not ownM1 then control.lastGuardReason='No verified permitted native Block or own-M1 overlap';return nil end
        local stun=info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
        -- Incoming Stun remains a real native restriction. Only the actual
        -- local action's false BoolValue can accompany this scoped request.
        if stun and(not stun:IsA('BoolValue')or stun.Value~=false)then control.lastGuardReason='Incoming native Stun cannot be bypassed';return nil end
        local guards={}
        if block then guards.Block=true end
        if stun then guards.Stun=true end
        if ownM1 then guards.InSkill,guards.NoSprint=true,true end
        control.lastGuardReason='Verified native own-action dash guards scoped to this request'
        return guards
    end
    function control.normalizeNativeDashConstant(caller,value)
        local transaction=nativeGuardTransaction
        while transaction do
            if not transaction.closed and transaction.caller==caller and transaction.thread==coroutine.running()
                and transaction.aliases[value]then return transaction.aliases[value]end
            transaction=transaction.previous
        end
        return value
    end
    local function restoreGuardTransaction(transaction)
        transaction.closed=true
        local restored=true
        for _,patch in transaction.patches do
            if patch.restored then continue end
            local checked,current=pcall(readConstants,timerFunction)
            if not checked or type(current)~='table'then restored=false;continue end
            if current[patch.index]~=patch.alias then patch.restored=true
            elseif pcall(writeConstant,timerFunction,patch.index,patch.original)then patch.restored=true
            else restored=false end
        end
        if restored then nativeGuardTransactions[transaction]=nil end
        if nativeGuardTransaction==transaction then nativeGuardTransaction=transaction.previous end
    end
    restoreGuardTransactions=function()
        for transaction in nativeGuardTransactions do restoreGuardTransaction(transaction)end
        nativeGuardTransaction=nil
    end
    local function nativeRequest(self,...)
        local guards=scopedDashGuards()
        if not guards then return originalRequest(self,...)end
        local readable,constants=pcall(readConstants,timerFunction)
        if not readable or type(constants)~='table' then return originalRequest(self,...) end
        local patches={};local transaction={caller=timerFunction,thread=coroutine.running(),aliases={},patches=patches,previous=nativeGuardTransaction}
        for name,index in m1GuardIndices do
            if not guards[name]or constants[index]~=name then continue end
            local alias='__ShenaniganismScopedDash_'..name
            local changed=pcall(writeConstant,timerFunction,index,alias)
            if changed then table.insert(patches,{index=index,original=name,alias=alias});transaction.aliases[alias]=name end
        end
        nativeGuardTransaction=transaction
        nativeGuardTransactions[transaction]=true
        local results=table.pack(pcall(originalRequest,self,...))
        restoreGuardTransaction(transaction)
        if not results[1] then error(results[2],0) end
        return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
    end
    function control.setDashWhileBlocking(value: boolean): boolean
        -- Keep the existing saved setting. Verified native requests retain
        -- Block; unsupported contracts use the release/acknowledgement path.
        return control.setBlockDashEnabled(value)
    end
    local function refreshDeadline()
        local last = control.lastRequest or control.lastSide
        control.effectiveIntervalSeconds=math.max(0,control.seconds+control.intervalAdjustmentSeconds)
        control.nextAllowedAt = if control.enabled and last then last+control.effectiveIntervalSeconds else nil
    end
    local function recordRequest(now: number)
        control.lastRequest, control.lastSide = now, now
        refreshDeadline()
    end
    local function direction()
        if directionOverride then return directionOverride() end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or not root then return nil end
        local look = environment.workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        local camera = environment.CFrame.new(root.Position, root.Position + environment.Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z))
        local forward = math.round(humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(camera.LookVector))
        local sideways = math.round(humanoid.MoveDirection:Dot(camera.RightVector))
        return if forward == 1 then "Front" elseif forward == -1 then "Back" elseif sideways == 1 then "Right" elseif sideways == -1 then "Left" else "Front"
    end
    local function frontIntervalInput(side: any): boolean
        if side=='Front' then return true end
        -- In the verified current controller, this exact back input invokes
        -- the moveset's Chase action rather than an ordinary movement dash.
        if side~='Back' or not nativeReadProfile or nativeReadProfile.name~='MovementController.DashRequest:398' then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        if moveset(character)~='Toji' or type(character.FindFirstChild)~='function' then return false end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        local ok,coatm=pcall(function()return stance and stance.Value=='COATM' or false end)
        return ok and coatm
    end
    local function noteFrontDenied(at: number)
        control.frontDeniedCount+=1
        control.frontDeniedAt=at
    end
    local function nativeFrontCooling(): boolean
        -- Reuse the read-only native readiness source. A stun/state restriction
        -- is separate from ready, so it cannot flash a fully recharged bar.
        local shared=environment._G or environment
        local menu=shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
        local readiness=menu and menu.frontDashReadiness
        if not readiness or type(readiness.getStatus)~='function' then return false end
        local ok,status=pcall(readiness.getStatus,player.Character)
        return ok and type(status)=='table' and status.ready==false
    end
    function control.canRequest(now: number, _side: string?): boolean
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then return true end
        refreshDeadline()
        return not control.nextAllowedAt or now+0.0000001 >= control.nextAllowedAt
    end
    function control.getIntervalStatus(observedAt: number?): any
        if not control.alive then return nil end
        -- Pure display observation uses the saved setting even while Failsafe
        -- masks gameplay's enabled flag. Never refresh its request deadline or
        -- write native timing just to draw a paused cooldown meter.
        local shared=environment._G or environment
        local menu=shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
        local configured=if menu and type(menu.getFailsafeRequested)=='function'then menu.getFailsafeRequested(control,'enabled')==true else control.enabled==true
        local now=if type(observedAt)=='number' and observedAt==observedAt and math.abs(observedAt)<math.huge then observedAt else clock()
        local maximum=math.max(0,control.seconds+control.intervalAdjustmentSeconds)
        local last=control.lastRequest or control.lastSide
        local remaining=if configured and last then math.max(0,last+maximum-now)else 0
        return {base=control.seconds,adjustment=control.intervalAdjustmentSeconds,
            maximum=maximum,effective=maximum,remaining=remaining,ready=remaining<=0,
            enabled=configured,
            fraction=if maximum>0 then math.clamp(1-remaining/maximum,0,1)else 1,
            source='Configured client dash submission interval'}
    end
    function control.setIntervalAdjustmentSeconds(value: any): boolean
        local amount=signedAdjustment(value,10)
        if not control.alive or amount==nil then return false end
        control.intervalAdjustmentSeconds=amount
        refreshDeadline()
        return true
    end
    function control.setSeconds(value)
        local seconds = tonumber(value) or 10
        if seconds ~= seconds or math.abs(seconds) == math.huge then seconds = 10 end
        control.seconds = math.clamp(seconds, 0, 10)
        control.milliseconds = control.seconds*1000
        control.steps = control.seconds*10
        refreshDeadline()
    end
    function control.setMilliseconds(value)
        control.setSeconds((tonumber(value) or 10000)/1000)
    end
    function control.setSteps(value)
        local steps=tonumber(value) or 100
        if steps~=steps or math.abs(steps)==math.huge then steps=100 end
        control.setSeconds((math.round(math.clamp(steps,0,100)*10000)/10000)/10)
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        control.enabled = control.alive and value == true
        refreshDeadline()
        control.lastRequestReason=if control.enabled then 'Waiting for a native dash request' else 'Modify Dash Cooldown is disabled'
    end
    local dashWrapper
    dashWrapper = function(self, targetPlayer, character, side, ...)
        if control.alive and targetPlayer == player then
            control.lastNativeDashAt,control.lastNativeDashCharacter=clock(),character
            if side=='Front' then control.noteFrontDashStarted(character) end
            if control.enabled and control.lastSubmission and control.submissionCharacter==character then
                -- A replicated/local dash effect is not a new input submission.
                -- Its delayed arrival must never restart the selected interval.
                control.lastSide=clock()
                refreshDeadline()
            else recordRequest(clock()) end
        end
        return originalDash(self, targetPlayer, character, side, ...)
    end
    local function tryTargetlessPursuit(self,side,now): boolean
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info or not info:FindFirstChild('DisableChase') then control.lastTargetlessReason='Ordinary Chase keeps its native route while ready';return false end
        local shared=environment._G or environment
        local menu=shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
        if not focused or (inputService and inputService:GetFocusedTextBox()) or (menu and (menu.recording
            or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen())) then
            control.lastTargetlessReason='Pursuit routing is paused; native Dash input is unchanged';return false
        end
        local root=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand then control.lastTargetlessReason='Native character is unavailable';return true end
        -- Let the original request keep its early evasive/escape dispatch.
        local force=info:FindFirstChild('ForceEsc')
        if info:FindFirstChild('Knockback') or character:GetAttribute('Burst') and not info:GetAttribute('Burst') or force and force.Value then return false end
        local custom=character:FindFirstChild('CustomChar')
        local customChase=custom and custom:GetAttribute('CustomChase')
        local guards=scopedDashGuards()or {}
        local m1Override=guards.InSkill==true
        if not customChase or side~='Front' then
            local inSkill=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            if info:FindFirstChild('Block')and not guards.Block or info:FindFirstChild('Stun')and not guards.Stun
                or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')) or 0)>0
                or inSkill and inSkill.Value==false and not info:FindFirstChild('AllowDashInSkill') and not m1Override then
                control.lastTargetlessReason='Native Block/Stun/Ragdoll/InSkill guard rejected pursuit';return true
            end
        end
        local noSprint=info:FindFirstChild('NoSprint')
        if info:FindFirstChild('NoDash') or noSprint and noSprint.Value==false and not noSprint:GetAttribute('AllowDash') and not m1Override then
            control.lastTargetlessReason='Native NoDash/NoSprint guard rejected pursuit';return true
        end
        if not control.canRequest(now,side) then noteFrontDenied(now);control.lastTargetlessReason='Waiting for the configured dash interval';return true end
        local readable,values=pcall(read,timerFunction)
        local timed,wallNow=pcall(environment.tick)
        if not readable or type(values)~='table' or not timed or not finite(wallNow) or not finite(values[4]) or not validCharges(values[6]) or values[2]~=nativePursuit then
            control.lastTargetlessReason='Native pursuit captures changed; input uses the original request';return false
        end
        local elapsed=wallNow-values[4]
        if elapsed<.3 then noteFrontDenied(now);control.lastTargetlessReason='Waiting for the native 0.3-second pursuit gate';return true end
        local domain=info:FindFirstChild('DomainClash')~=nil
        local refill=if domain then nativeReadProfile.domainRefill else 2
        local charges=if elapsed>refill then 2 else values[6]
        if charges<=0 then noteFrontDenied(now);control.lastTargetlessReason='Native dash charges are exhausted';return true end
        -- This is the verified native v62 pursuit branch. It lazily refills
        -- existing charges and does not consume one; no target is sent at all.
        if elapsed>refill then write(timerFunction,6,2) end
        nativePursuit.Dash:Fire(side)
        control.targetlessRequests+=1
        movement.Dash(self,player,character,side)
        control.targetlessLocalMoves+=1
        control.requests+=1;control.lastSubmission,control.submissionCharacter=now,character
        control.lastRequest=now;refreshDeadline()
        control.lastTargetlessAt=now
        control.lastTargetlessReason='Native pursuit movement submitted; server acceptance is observed separately'
        return true
    end
