    local continuingManualDash=false
    local function currentMenu()
        local shared=environment._G or environment
        return shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
    end
    local function blockDashPermitted(menu,character)
        if not control.alive or not control.blockDashEnabled or not character or character~=player.Character or not character.Parent
            or not focused or inputService and inputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu and (menu.recording or menu.menuKeyCapturing or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()
                or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then return false end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not humanoid.PlatformStand
            and character:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true and (tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll'))or 0)<=0
    end
    local function targetModel(value)
        local kind=type(value)
        if not value or kind~='table'and kind~='userdata'or type(value.IsA)~='function' then return nil end
        local model=if value:IsA('Player')then value.Character elseif value:IsA('Model')then value else value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        local humanoid=model and model~=player.Character and model.Parent and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then model else nil
    end
    function control.captureBlockDashTarget()
        local menu=currentMenu();local aim=menu and menu.m1AimAssist;local block=menu and menu.autoBlock
        local threat=block and block.heldThreat;local record=threat and threat.record
        local target
        for _,candidate in {aim and aim.blockAimTarget or false,aim and aim.blockAimSession and aim.blockAimSession.target or false,
            aim and aim.blockAimMemory and aim.blockAimMemory.target or false,record and (record.model or record.target)or false,
            block and block.lastTarget or false,block and block.referenceAimTarget or false,
            menu and menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget or false} do
            target=targetModel(candidate);if target then break end
        end
        control.blockDashAimCapture={character=player.Character,target=target,at=clock()}
        return target
    end
    function control.cancelBlockDash(reason)
        control.blockDashPending=nil
        control.lastBlockDashReason=reason or 'Block dash handoff ended'
    end
    function control.setBlockDashEnabled(value: boolean): boolean
        if not control.alive or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.blockDashEnabled=value
        control.blockingEnabled=value;control.blockingReady=control.blockDashReady
        control.lastBlockReason=if not value then 'Dash While Blocking is disabled'elseif control.scopedDashReady then 'Verified native dash requests retain actual Block state'else 'Dash While Blocking uses native release and acknowledgement'
        if not value then control.cancelBlockDash('Dash While Blocking is disabled')end
        return true
    end
    function control.blockDashActive(): boolean
        local record=control.blockDashPending
        return record~=nil and blockDashPermitted(currentMenu(),record.character)==true
    end
    function control.blockDashTarget()
        local record=control.blockDashPending
        return if record and control.blockDashActive()then targetModel(record.target)else nil
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        restoreGuardTransactions()
        control.cancelBlockDash('Block dash paused by Failsafe');control.blockDashAimCapture=nil
    end
    local lastCallbackMiss,lastCallbackMissAt
    naturalDashCall=function(): boolean
        if nativeRecoveryDepth>0 then return false end
        if continuingManualDash then return true end
        local callers={}
        local candidate
        for level=2,9 do
            local caller=debugInfo(level,'f')
            if not caller then break end
            if manualDashCallbacks[caller]then return true end
            callers[#callers+1]=caller
            if not candidate then
                local okay,source=pcall(debugInfo,caller,'s')
                if okay and type(source)=='string'and source:match('Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$')then candidate=caller end
            end
        end
        -- Rebound native inputs are discovered only at their actual request
        -- boundary. Retry failures at most10Hz per unchanged caller; a new
        -- native callback gets an immediate bounded verification attempt.
        local now=clock()
        if candidate and(candidate~=lastCallbackMiss or not lastCallbackMissAt or now-lastCallbackMissAt>=.1)then
            lastCallbackMiss,lastCallbackMissAt=candidate,now
            refreshManualDashCallbacks()
            for _,caller in callers do if manualDashCallbacks[caller]then return true end end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function dashEvidence(menu,character)
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash')then return true end
        local lock=menu and menu.autoLock
        if lock and type(lock.characterDashing)=='function'and lock.characterDashing()then return true end
        local front=menu and menu.frontDash;local dash=front and front.cameraDash
        return dash and dash.character==character and dash.mover and dash.mover.Parent
            and clock()-dash.started<=(dash.duration or .6)+.05 or false
    end
    local function actualDashEvidence(menu,character)
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if character and(character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash'))then return true end
        local front=menu and menu.frontDash;local dash=front and front.cameraDash
        return dash and dash.character==character and dash.mover and dash.mover.Parent
            and clock()-dash.started>=0 and clock()-dash.started<=(dash.duration or .6)+.05 or false
    end
    local function observeActualDashMovement(record,info,now)
        local character=record.character;local root=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local torso=character:FindFirstChild('Torso')
        local mover=root and type(root.FindFirstChild)=='function'and root:FindFirstChild('SwingForce')
            or torso and type(torso.FindFirstChild)=='function'and torso:FindFirstChild('MovementForce')
        if not root or not root.Position or not mover or type(mover.IsA)~='function'or not mover:IsA('BodyVelocity')or not mover.Parent then return end
        if not record.actualMover then
            record.actualMover=mover;record.actualOrigin=root.Position;control.blockDashStarted+=1
            control.lastBlockDashProof={at=now,character=character,mover=mover,side=record.side,distance=0,concurrentBlock=false}
        end
        local proof=control.lastBlockDashProof
        if not proof or proof.mover~=record.actualMover then return end
        proof.distance=math.max(proof.distance,(root.Position-record.actualOrigin).Magnitude)
        proof.concurrentBlock=proof.concurrentBlock or info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')~=nil or false
        if not record.actualMoved and proof.distance>=.5 then record.actualMoved=true;control.blockDashMoved+=1 end
    end
    function control.blockDashUnblocking(): boolean
        local record=control.blockDashPending
        return record~=nil and record.phase~='Dashing'and control.blockDashActive()
    end
    function control.blockDashConcurrent(): boolean
        local menu=currentMenu();local character=player.Character
        return blockDashPermitted(menu,character)==true and actualDashEvidence(menu,character)==true
    end
    function control.observeBlockDash(target): boolean
        if control.blockDashPending then return control.blockDashActive()end
        if not control.blockDashConcurrent()then return false end
        local menu=currentMenu();local block=menu and menu.autoBlock;local character=player.Character
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local manual=block and type(block.manualBlockHeld)=='function'and block.manualBlockHeld()==true
        if not manual and not(block and block.held)and not(info and info:FindFirstChild('Block'))then return false end
        local now=clock();local capture=control.blockDashAimCapture
        target=targetModel(target)or(capture and capture.character==character and now>=capture.at and now-capture.at<=1 and targetModel(capture.target))or control.captureBlockDashTarget()
        local bindings=menu and menu.bindings
        control.blockDashPending={character=character,target=target,at=now,lastDashAt=now,phase='Dashing',concurrentOnly=true,
            blockVersion=bindings and(bindings.manualBlockVersion or 0)or 0}
        control.lastBlockDashReason='Native dash is active; your Block intent can use the native guard'
        return true
    end
    function control.stepBlockDash()
        local record=control.blockDashPending
        if not record then control.observeBlockDash();return end
        local menu=currentMenu();local now=clock()
        if not blockDashPermitted(menu,record.character)then control.cancelBlockDash('Native Block dash context ended');return end
        local bindings=menu and menu.bindings
        if record.phase~='Dashing'and bindings and (bindings.manualBlockVersion or 0)~=record.blockVersion then
            control.cancelBlockDash('A new physical Block press superseded the pending dash');return
        end
        if now<record.at or now-record.at>2 then control.cancelBlockDash('Native Block dash handoff expired');return end
        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if record.phase=='Unblocking'then
            if not info then control.cancelBlockDash('Native Block state disappeared');return end
            if info:FindFirstChild('Block')then
                if now-record.at>=.35 then control.cancelBlockDash('Native Block did not acknowledge release')end
                return
            end
            record.phase,record.submittedAt='AwaitingDash',now
            continuingManualDash=true
            local okay,reason=pcall(requestWrapper,record.self,table.unpack(record.args,1,record.args.n))
            continuingManualDash=false
            if not okay then control.cancelBlockDash('Native Block dash request failed: '..tostring(reason));return end
            control.blockDashRequests+=1
            control.lastBlockDashReason='Native Block release acknowledged; your native dash was requested'
        end
        if control.blockDashPending~=record then return end
        observeActualDashMovement(record,info,now)
        if dashEvidence(menu,record.character)then
            record.phase,record.lastDashAt='Dashing',now
            control.lastBlockDashReason='Native dash is active; native Block can run concurrently'
        elseif record.phase=='Dashing'and now-(record.lastDashAt or now)>=.06 then control.cancelBlockDash('Native dash ended')
        elseif record.phase=='AwaitingDash'and now-(record.submittedAt or now)>=.45 then control.cancelBlockDash('Native dash did not start')end
    end
    local function beginBlockDash(self,args,side,now)
        if continuingManualDash or not control.blockDashReady or not control.blockDashEnabled or not naturalDashCall()then return false end
        local pending=control.blockDashPending
        if pending and pending.phase=='Unblocking'then return true end
        local menu=currentMenu();local character=player.Character
        if not blockDashPermitted(menu,character)or not control.canRequest(now,side)then return false end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info');local block=menu and menu.autoBlock
        local blocking=info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')or block and block.held
        if not blocking then return false end
        if control.scopedDashReady then
            local guards=scopedDashGuards()
            if not guards or not guards.Block then return false end
            if not pending or pending.phase~='AwaitingDash'then
                local capture=control.blockDashAimCapture
                control.blockDashPending={character=character,target=capture and capture.character==character and capture.target or control.captureBlockDashTarget(),
                    at=now,submittedAt=now,side=side,phase='AwaitingDash',direct=true,blockVersion=menu and menu.bindings and(menu.bindings.manualBlockVersion or 0)or 0}
                control.blockDashRequests+=1
                control.lastBlockDashReason='Native dash requested from actual Block; existing Block state retained'
            end
            return false
        end
        if not block or type(block.releaseForDash)~='function'then control.lastBlockDashReason='Native Block release handoff is unavailable';return false end
        local capture=control.blockDashAimCapture
        local target=if capture and capture.character==character and now>=capture.at and now-capture.at<=.3 then capture.target else control.captureBlockDashTarget()
        local bindings=menu and menu.bindings
        local record={character=character,target=target,self=self,args=args,at=now,side=side,phase='Unblocking',blockVersion=bindings and(bindings.manualBlockVersion or 0)or 0}
        control.blockDashPending=record
        local okay,released,reason=pcall(block.releaseForDash)
        if not okay or released~=true then control.cancelBlockDash('Native Block release failed: '..tostring(if okay then reason else released));return false end
        control.blockDashReleases+=1
        control.lastBlockDashReason='Waiting for the actual native Block release before your dash'
        control.stepBlockDash()
        return true
    end
    requestWrapper = function(self, ...)
        local frontSide=control.alive and direction() or nil
        local frontInput=frontIntervalInput(frontSide)
        local inputAt=clock()
        if control.alive and control.frontIntervalEnabled and frontIntervalMaximum()>0 then
            if frontInput then
                local interval=control.getFrontIntervalStatus(player.Character)
                if interval and not interval.ready then
                    noteFrontDenied(inputAt)
                    control.lastRequestReason='Waiting for the selected minimum front-dash interval'
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        if control.alive and beginBlockDash(self,table.pack(...),frontSide,inputAt)then return end
        if control.alive and control.targetNotRequired and control.targetNotRequiredReady and frontInput and nativeRecoveryDepth==0 then
            local manual=naturalDashCall()
            if manual and tryTargetlessPursuit(self,frontSide,inputAt) then return end
        end
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then
            local cooling=control.alive and frontInput and nativeFrontCooling()
            local result=table.pack(nativeRequest(self,...))
            if cooling then noteFrontDenied(inputAt) end
            return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
        end
        local side, now = frontSide, inputAt
        if not side then return nativeRequest(self, ...) end
        if not control.canRequest(now, side) then
            if frontInput then noteFrontDenied(inputAt) end
            control.lastRequestReason='Waiting for the selected dash interval';return
        end
        local frontCooling=frontInput and nativeFrontCooling()
        -- Record at the request boundary: other menus can call a captured Dash
        -- implementation and skip our animation wrapper entirely.
        local previousRequest, previousSide = control.lastRequest, control.lastSide
        recordRequest(now)
        local saved = read(timerFunction)[timestampIndex]
        -- Native u2 uses tick(); the local interval uses one monotonic clock.
        local temporary = environment.tick() - 2.01
        local dispatch=observeDispatch()
        control.activeDispatch=dispatch
        write(timerFunction, timestampIndex, temporary)
        local result = table.pack(pcall(nativeRequest, self, ...))
        dispatch.stop()
        if control.activeDispatch==dispatch then control.activeDispatch=nil end
        -- If the original request did not perform a dash, restore its timer.
        local timerChanged=read(timerFunction)[timestampIndex]~=temporary
        if not timerChanged then write(timerFunction, timestampIndex, saved) end
        if not result[1] then
            control.lastRequest, control.lastSide = previousRequest, previousSide
            refreshDeadline()
            control.lastRequestReason='Native dash request failed: '..tostring(result[2])
            error(result[2], 0)
        end
        if not timerChanged and not dispatch.sent then
            control.lastRequest,control.lastSide=previousRequest,previousSide
            refreshDeadline()
            control.rejections+=1
            if frontCooling then noteFrontDenied(inputAt) end
            control.lastRequestReason='Native state rejected the dash; selected interval was not advanced'
        else
            control.requests+=1
            control.lastSubmission,control.submissionCharacter=now,player.Character
            control.lastNativeDashAt,control.lastNativeDashCharacter=now,player.Character
            -- Synchronous Dash animation may begin slightly after entry too.
            -- Always retain the actual native request boundary as the interval.
            control.lastRequest=now
            refreshDeadline()
            control.lastRequestReason='Native dash submitted; server cooldown and state rules still apply'
        end
        return table.unpack(result, 2, result.n)
    end
    movement.Dash, movement.DashRequest = dashWrapper, requestWrapper
    local runOkay,run=pcall(function()return environment.game and environment.game:GetService('RunService')end)
    if runOkay and run and run.Heartbeat and type(run.Heartbeat.Connect)=='function'then
        control.connections[#control.connections+1]=run.Heartbeat:Connect(control.stepBlockDash)
    end
    function control.hooked(): boolean
        return control.alive and movement.Dash==dashWrapper and movement.DashRequest==requestWrapper
    end
    function control.requestNative(): boolean
        if not control.hooked() then return false end
        if control.enabled then
            local before=control.requests
            nativeRecoveryDepth+=1
            local ok,err=pcall(requestWrapper,movement)
            nativeRecoveryDepth-=1
            if not ok then control.lastRequestReason=tostring(err);return false end
            return control.requests>before
        end
        local saved=read(timerFunction)[timestampIndex]
        local dispatch=observeDispatch()
        nativeRecoveryDepth+=1
        local ok,err=pcall(requestWrapper,movement)
        nativeRecoveryDepth-=1
        local submitted=dispatch.sent or read(timerFunction)[timestampIndex]~=saved
        dispatch.stop()
        if not ok then control.lastRequestReason=tostring(err);return false end
        if submitted then control.lastNativeDashAt,control.lastNativeDashCharacter=clock(),player.Character end
        return submitted
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        restoreGuardTransactions()
        if control.blockingEnabled then control.setDashWhileBlocking(false) end
        control.alive, control.enabled = false, false
        control.cancelBlockDash('Dash control unloaded');control.blockDashAimCapture=nil
        control.frontIntervalEnabled=false;frontIntervalRecord=nil
        if control.activeDispatch then control.activeDispatch.stop();control.activeDispatch=nil end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        control.nextAllowedAt = nil
        if movement.Dash == dashWrapper then movement.Dash = originalDash end
        if movement.DashRequest == requestWrapper then movement.DashRequest = originalRequest end
    end
    return control
end
function DashControl.new(environment: {[string]: any}): any
    local player = environment.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local scripts = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local controllers = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
    local character = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("Character")
    local module = character and character:FindFirstChild("MovementController")
    local movement
    if module then movement=environment.require(module)
    else
        local folder=environment.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knitModule=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local knit=knitModule and environment.require(knitModule)
            return knit and type(knit.GetController)=='function' and knit.GetController('MovementController')
        end)
        if ok then movement=result end
    end
    assert(type(movement)=='table' and type(movement.Dash)=='function' and type(movement.DashRequest)=='function', 'MovementController is unavailable')
    return DashControl.attach(movement, environment, player, nil)
end
return DashControl
end)()

local LayoutEditor = (function(): any
-- Reorder sections and controls within their existing menu page.
local LayoutEditor: {[string]: any} = {}
function LayoutEditor.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, ui: any): any
    local Enum, UDim2, Color3 = host.Enum, host.UDim2, host.Color3
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local editor: any = {enabled = false, items = {}, drag = nil, alive = true}
    local saved = ui.appearance.order or {}
    ui.appearance.order = saved
    for _,alias in {
        {'row/Main/Dash Cooldown','row/Main/Dash Cooldown (100ms)'},
        {'row/Main/Dash Cooldown (ms)','row/Main/Dash Cooldown (100ms)'},
        {'row/Main/Dash Cooldown (s)','row/Main/Dash Cooldown (100ms)'},
        {'row/Main/Sprint in Any Direction','row/Main/Recovery in Any Direction'},
    } do
        if saved[alias[2]]==nil then saved[alias[2]]=saved[alias[1]] end
        saved[alias[1]]=nil
    end
    local function owned(class)
        local object = host.Instance.new(class)
        object:SetAttribute("CullingModern", true)
        table.insert(menu.instances, object)
        return object
    end
    local connections = {}
    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(menu.connections, connection)
        table.insert(connections, connection)
    end
    local function ownLayout(parent)
        local layout=parent and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIListLayout')
        if not layout then return end
        layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        connect(layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal('SortOrder'),function()
            if editor.alive and layout.SortOrder~=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder then layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder end
        end)
    end
    local function pageFor(object: any): any
        for _, page in menu.panel.Pages do if object == page or object:IsDescendantOf(page) then return page end end
        return nil
    end
    local function parentKey(parent)
        if parent == menu.panel.Sidebar then return "sidebar" end
        for name, tab in menu.tabs do if parent == tab.page then return "page/"..name end end
        for key, section in ui.groups do if parent == section.contents then return "section/"..key end end
        return nil
    end
    local function sorted(parent: any, except: any): {any}
        local list: {any} = {}
        for _, item in editor.items do
            if item.object.Parent == parent and item ~= except and item.object.Visible
                and not (item.record and item.record.config and item.record.config.QuickSettingsOnly) then
                table.insert(list, item)
            end
        end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.object.LayoutOrder < b.object.LayoutOrder end)
        return list
    end
    function editor.save()
        for key, item in editor.items do
            local storageKey=if ui.nativeMode and item.kind=='row' then 'native/'..key else key
            saved[storageKey] = {parent = parentKey(item.object.Parent), order = item.object.LayoutOrder}
        end
    end
    local function updateGroups()
        for _, section in ui.groups do section.records = {} end
        for _, record in menu.rows do
            for _, section in ui.groups do if record.row.Parent == section.contents then table.insert(section.records, record)
            break end end
        end
    end
    function editor.finishDrag()
        local drag = editor.drag
        if not drag then return end
        drag.item.object.Visible = drag.wasVisible
        drag.placeholder:Destroy()
        drag.ghost:Destroy()
        if drag.scroller and drag.scrollingEnabled~=nil then drag.scroller.ScrollingEnabled=drag.scrollingEnabled end
        editor.drag = nil
        updateGroups()
        editor.save()
        if menu.configStore and menu.configStore.flush then menu.configStore.flush() end
    end
    function editor.begin(item, object)
        if not editor.enabled or editor.drag or not editor.alive then return end
        if object.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and object.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local target = item.object
        if not target.Visible or (item.record and item.record.config and item.record.config.QuickSettingsOnly) then return end
        local placeholder = owned("Frame")
        placeholder.Name, placeholder.BackgroundTransparency, placeholder.BorderSizePixel = "ReorderPlaceholder", 0.85, 0
        placeholder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(92, 154, 178)
        placeholder.Size = UDim2.new(target.Size.X.Scale, target.Size.X.Offset, 0, target.AbsoluteSize.Y / math.max(0.01, menu.panel.Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale").Scale))
        placeholder.LayoutOrder, placeholder.Parent = target.LayoutOrder, target.Parent
        local ghost = owned("TextLabel")
        ghost.Name, ghost.Text, ghost.Size = "ReorderPreview", "  "..item.name, UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(340, target.AbsoluteSize.X), 30)
        ghost.Font, ghost.TextSize, ghost.TextXAlignment = Enum.Font.Gotham, 13, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        ghost.BackgroundColor3, ghost.BackgroundTransparency, ghost.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 51, 64), 0.15, Color3.fromRGB(235, 242, 250)
        ghost.BorderSizePixel, ghost.ZIndex, ghost.Parent = 0, 12500, menu.panel.Root
        local page=pageFor(target)
        local scroller=target.Parent
        while scroller and not scroller:IsA('ScrollingFrame') do scroller=scroller.Parent end
        local scrollingEnabled=scroller and scroller.ScrollingEnabled
        editor.drag = {item = item, input = object, placeholder = placeholder, ghost = ghost, page = page, scroller = scroller, wasVisible = target.Visible,scrollingEnabled=scrollingEnabled}
        if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            local mouse=input:GetMouseLocation()
            editor.drag.pointerOffset={X=object.Position.X-mouse.X,Y=object.Position.Y-mouse.Y}
        end
        if scrollingEnabled~=nil then scroller.ScrollingEnabled=false end
        target.Visible = false
        editor.move(object.Position)
    end
    function editor.move(point)
        local drag = editor.drag
        if not drag then return end
        if drag.lastPoint and drag.lastPoint.X==point.X and drag.lastPoint.Y==point.Y then return end
        drag.lastPoint={X=point.X,Y=point.Y}
        local origin = menu.panel.Root.AbsolutePosition
        drag.ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X-origin.X+10, point.Y-origin.Y+8)
        local parent = drag.item.object.Parent
        if drag.item.kind == "row" and not ui.nativeMode then
            for _, section in ui.groups do
                local contents = section.contents
                local p, s = contents.AbsolutePosition, contents.AbsoluteSize
                if contents.Visible and pageFor(contents) == drag.page and point.X >= p.X and point.X <= p.X+s.X and point.Y >= p.Y and point.Y <= p.Y+s.Y then parent = contents
                break end
            end
        end
        if drag.item.kind == "tab" then
            if parent ~= menu.panel.Sidebar then return end
        elseif pageFor(parent) ~= drag.page then return end
        local siblings = sorted(parent, drag.item)
        local index = #siblings+1
        for n, sibling in siblings do
            if point.Y < sibling.object.AbsolutePosition.Y+sibling.object.AbsoluteSize.Y*0.5 then index = n
            break end
        end
        drag.item.object.Parent, drag.placeholder.Parent = parent, parent
        drag.item.object.LayoutOrder, drag.placeholder.LayoutOrder = index, index
        for n, sibling in siblings do sibling.object.LayoutOrder = if n < index then n else n+1 end
    end
    function editor.setEnabled(value)
        editor.enabled = value == true
        if not editor.enabled then editor.finishDrag() end
        for _, item in editor.items do
            local visible=editor.enabled and not (item.record and item.record.config and item.record.config.QuickSettingsOnly)
            item.handle.Visible=visible
            if item.dragSurface then item.dragSurface.Visible=visible end
        end
        if editor.button then editor.button.Text = if editor.enabled then "Done" else "Edit" end
        if editor.button then editor.button.BackgroundColor3 = if editor.enabled then Color3.fromRGB(55, 164, 90) else Color3.fromRGB(190, 65, 70) end
        ui.refresh()
        -- Native dropdown layout can change child ZIndex while refreshing.
        for _,item in editor.items do if item.raiseSurface then item.raiseSurface() end end
    end
    local function add(key: string, name: string, object: any, kind: string, record: any, header: any?): ()
        local handle = owned("TextButton")
        handle.Name, handle.Text, handle.Size = "ReorderHandle", "=", UDim2.fromOffset(18, 24)
        handle.Position = if kind == "section" then UDim2.new(1, -23, 0, 3) elseif kind == "tab" then UDim2.new(1, -23, 0.5, -12) else UDim2.fromOffset(2, 7)
        handle.BackgroundTransparency, handle.BorderSizePixel, handle.Visible = 1, 0, false
        handle.TextColor3, handle.TextSize, handle.Font, handle.ZIndex, handle.Parent = Color3.fromRGB(135, 146, 162), 15, Enum.Font.Gotham, object.ZIndex+5, object
        local item = {key = key, name = name, object = object, kind = kind, handle = handle, record = record}
        editor.items[key] = item
        connect(handle.InputBegan, function(inputObject) editor.begin(item, inputObject) end)
        local dropdown=kind=='row' and record and record.kind=='CreateDropdown' and not (record.config and record.config.QuickSettingsOnly)
        if dropdown or kind=='tab' or (kind=='section' and header) then
            local surfaceParent=header or object
            local surface=owned('TextButton')
            surface.Name=if dropdown then 'DropdownReorderSurface' elseif kind=='tab' then 'TabReorderSurface' else 'SectionReorderSurface'
            surface.Text,surface.Size,surface.Position='',UDim2.new(1,0,1,0),UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
            surface.BackgroundTransparency,surface.BorderSizePixel,surface.AutoButtonColor=1,0,false
            surface.Active,surface.Visible,surface.Selectable,surface.Parent=true,false,false,surfaceParent
            item.dragSurface=surface
            connect(surface.InputBegan,function(inputObject) editor.begin(item,inputObject) end)
            local raising=false
            local function ownedOverlay(child)
                return child==surface or child==handle or child:IsDescendantOf(surface) or child:IsDescendantOf(handle)
            end
            local function raiseSurface()
                if raising or not editor.alive or not surface.Parent then return end
                raising=true
                local top=math.max(object.ZIndex,surfaceParent.ZIndex)
                for _,child in surfaceParent:GetDescendants() do
                    if not ownedOverlay(child) and child:IsA('GuiObject') then top=math.max(top,child.ZIndex) end
                end
                if surface.ZIndex~=top+1 then surface.ZIndex=top+1 end
                if handle.ZIndex~=top+2 then handle.ZIndex=top+2 end
                raising=false
            end
            item.raiseSurface=raiseSurface
            local watched=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
            local function watch(child)
                if ownedOverlay(child) or not child:IsA('GuiObject') or watched[child] then return end
                watched[child]=true
                connect(child:GetPropertyChangedSignal('ZIndex'),function()
                    if editor.enabled then raiseSurface() end
                end)
            end
            watch(object);watch(surfaceParent)
            for _,child in surfaceParent:GetDescendants() do watch(child) end
            connect(surfaceParent.DescendantAdded,function(child)
                watch(child)
                if editor.enabled then raiseSurface() end
            end)
            raiseSurface()
        end
    end
    function editor.finishSetup()
        ownLayout(menu.panel.Sidebar)
        for _,page in menu.panel.Pages do ownLayout(page) end
        for _,section in ui.groups do ownLayout(section.contents) end
        local tabIndex = 0
        for _, object in menu.panel.Sidebar:GetChildren() do
            if object:IsA("GuiButton") then
                tabIndex += 1
                local text = if object:IsA("TextButton") then object.Text else ""
                local title = object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
                if text == "" then text = title and title.Text or object.Name end
                object.LayoutOrder = tabIndex
                add("tab/"..tabIndex, text, object, "tab", nil)
            end
        end
        local sidebarLayout = menu.panel.Sidebar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
        if sidebarLayout then sidebarLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder end
        for key, section in ui.groups do add("section/"..key, section.header.Text, section.frame, "section", nil, section.header) end
        for _, record in menu.rows do add("row/"..record.tab.."/"..record.name, record.displayName or record.name, record.row, "row", record) end
        for key, item in editor.items do
            local position = saved[if ui.nativeMode and item.kind=='row' then 'native/'..key else key]
            if position then
                local parent
                if position.parent == "sidebar" and item.kind == "tab" then
                    parent = menu.panel.Sidebar
                elseif position.parent and position.parent:sub(1, 8) == "section/" then
                    local section = ui.groups[position.parent:sub(9)]
                    parent = section and section.contents
                elseif position.parent and position.parent:sub(1, 5) == "page/" then
                    local tab = menu.tabs[position.parent:sub(6)]
                    parent = tab and tab.page
                end
                if parent and ((item.kind == "tab" and parent == menu.panel.Sidebar) or (item.kind ~= "tab" and pageFor(parent) == pageFor(item.object))) then item.object.Parent, item.object.LayoutOrder = parent, position.order end
            end
        end
        updateGroups()
        local edit = owned("TextButton")
        edit.Name, edit.Text, edit.Size, edit.Position = "LayoutEdit", "Edit", UDim2.fromOffset(52, 26), UDim2.new(1, -66, 0.5, -13)
        edit.BackgroundColor3, edit.TextColor3, edit.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(190, 65, 70), Color3.fromRGB(239, 244, 250), 0
        edit.TextSize, edit.Font, edit.Parent = 12, Enum.Font.Gotham, menu.panel.TopBar
        local corner = owned("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius, corner.Parent = host.UDim.new(0, 5), edit
        if ui.styleSurface then ui.styleSurface(edit,false) end
        editor.button = edit
        connect(edit.Activated, function() editor.setEnabled(not editor.enabled) end)
        if menu.panel.nativeHeaderless and menu.panel.LayoutChrome then menu.panel:LayoutChrome()
        else for _, label in menu.panel.TopBar:GetChildren() do
            if label:IsA("TextLabel") then label.Size, label.TextTruncate = UDim2.new(1, -86, 1, 0), Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end
        end end
    end
    connect(input.InputChanged, function(object)
        if editor.drag and (object == editor.drag.input or object.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then editor.move(object.Position) end
    end)
    connect(input.InputEnded, function(object)
        if editor.drag and (object == editor.drag.input or object.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then editor.finishDrag() end
    end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased, editor.finishDrag)
    local runOk,run=pcall(host.game.GetService,host.game,'RunService')
    if runOk and run and run.RenderStepped then
        connect(run.RenderStepped,function()
            local drag=editor.drag
            if not drag or not drag.pointerOffset then return end
            local mouse=input:GetMouseLocation()
            editor.move({X=mouse.X+drag.pointerOffset.X,Y=mouse.Y+drag.pointerOffset.Y})
        end)
    end
    function editor.Destroy()
        editor.finishDrag()
        editor.alive,editor.enabled = false,false
        for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        for _,item in editor.items do
            item.handle.Visible=false
            if item.dragSurface then item.dragSurface.Visible=false end
        end
    end
    return editor
end
return LayoutEditor
end)()

local Visuals = (function(): any
-- Restartable world displays; each feature owns and clears its instances.
local Visuals: {[string]: any} = {}
function Visuals.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local world, players = host.workspace, host.game:GetService("Players")
    local visual: any = {alive = true, itemEnabled = false, infoEnabled = false, stunEnabled = false, items = {}, characters = {}, stuns = {}, defaultStunDuration = 0.8}
    local elapsed = 0
    local presentationElapsed,hitboxElapsed=0,0
    visual.layoutRecords=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    visual.nextLayoutOrder,visual.discoveryPasses,visual.presentationPasses=0,0,0
    visual.dashUntil = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    visual.shotUntil = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    visual.shotNames = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    visual.activityRecords = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    visual.actionConnections = {}
    visual.nativeNames = {}
    local infoFields={'Player Name','Current Action / Emote','State','Stun Timer','Dash Cooldown','Distance'}
    visual.infoLayout={offsetX=0,offsetY=0,offsetZ=0,width=0,height=0,scale=1,spacing=0}
    visual.infoFieldStyles,visual.infoFieldRecords={},setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    for _,field in infoFields do
        visual.infoFieldStyles[field]={visible=true,size=0,offsetX=0,offsetY=0,customize=false,
            textColor=host.Color3.new(1,1,1),textTransparency=0,outlineColor=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),outlineOpacity=75,outlineThickness=1,
            shadowColor=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),shadowOpacity=0,shadowX=1,shadowY=1,
            depthColor=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),depthOpacity=0,depthX=2,depthY=2}
    end
    local infoFieldBounds={size={0,96},offsetX={-500,500},offsetY={-500,500},textTransparency={0,100},outlineOpacity={0,100},outlineThickness={0,8},
        shadowOpacity={0,100},shadowX={-32,32},shadowY={-32,32},depthOpacity={0,100},depthX={-32,32},depthY={-32,32}}
    local infoLayoutBounds={offsetX={-30,30},offsetY={-30,30},offsetZ={-30,30},width={0,1000},height={0,600},scale={.25,5},spacing={0,60}}
    local function finiteInfo(value)
        return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function sameInfoDimension(a,b)
        return a and b and a.X.Scale==b.X.Scale and a.X.Offset==b.X.Offset and a.Y.Scale==b.Y.Scale and a.Y.Offset==b.Y.Offset
    end
    local function sameInfoValue(previous,value)
        return previous==value or type(previous)=='number'and type(value)=='number'and math.abs(previous-value)<=1e-6
    end
    local function putInfo(object,key,value)
        if not sameInfoValue(object[key],value)then object[key]=value end
    end
    function visual.infoFieldChoices()return table.clone(infoFields)end
    function visual.getInfoLayout()return table.clone(visual.infoLayout)end
    function visual.getInfoFieldStyle(field)
        local style=visual.infoFieldStyles[field];return if style then table.clone(style)else nil
    end
    function visual.infoFieldVisible(field)
        local style=visual.infoFieldStyles[field];return style~=nil and style.visible==true
    end
    local function infoStatusField(text)
        return if text:sub(1,4)=='Dash'then 'Dash Cooldown'elseif tonumber(text)then 'Stun Timer'else 'State'
    end
    local infoLayerProperties={'Text','Font','FontFace','TextSize','TextScaled','TextWrapped','TextXAlignment','TextYAlignment','RichText','LineHeight','TextTruncate','Visible'}
    local infoBaseProperties={'TextColor3','TextTransparency','TextStrokeTransparency'}
    local infoLayerSize=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    local function infoDecoration(label,record,key,name)
        local object=record[key]
        if not object or object.Parent~=label then object=label:FindFirstChild(name);record[key]=object end
        return object
    end
    local function applyDistanceInfoGeometry(label,style,record)
            if not record.externalSize or label.TextSize~=record.externalAppliedSize then record.externalSize=label.TextSize end
            local size=if style.size>0 then style.size else record.externalSize
            if label.TextSize~=size then label.TextSize=size end;record.externalAppliedSize=size
            local current=label.Position
            if current then
                if not record.externalPosition or not sameInfoDimension(current,record.externalAppliedPosition)then record.externalPosition=current end
                local base=record.externalPosition
                local position=record.distancePosition
                if not position or not sameInfoDimension(record.distancePositionBase,base)or record.distanceOffsetX~=style.offsetX or record.distanceOffsetY~=style.offsetY then
                    position=if style.offsetX==0 and style.offsetY==0 then base else host.UDim2.new(base.X.Scale,base.X.Offset+style.offsetX,base.Y.Scale,base.Y.Offset+style.offsetY)
                    record.distancePosition,record.distancePositionBase=position,base
                    record.distanceOffsetX,record.distanceOffsetY=style.offsetX,style.offsetY
                end
                if not sameInfoDimension(label.Position,position)then label.Position=position end;record.externalAppliedPosition=position
            end
            local length=#(label.Text or '')
            local bounds=record.distanceBounds
            if not bounds or record.distanceBoundsLength~=length or record.distanceBoundsSize~=size then
                local width,height=math.max(72,math.ceil(length*size*.65+4)),math.max(16,size+4)
                if not bounds or bounds.X.Offset~=width or bounds.Y.Offset~=height then bounds=host.UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)end
                record.distanceBounds,record.distanceBoundsLength,record.distanceBoundsSize=bounds,length,size
            end
            if not sameInfoDimension(label.Size,bounds)then label.Size=bounds end
    end
    function visual.applyInfoField(label,field,fade,geometryApplied)
        local style=visual.infoFieldStyles[field]
        if not label or not label.Parent or not style then return end
        local record=visual.infoFieldRecords[label]
        if not record then record={};visual.infoFieldRecords[label]=record end
        if field=='Distance'and not geometryApplied then applyDistanceInfoGeometry(label,style,record)end
        -- These ownership tags are written only here; each label has its own record.
        if record.field~=field then
            if label:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismInfoField')~=field then label:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismInfoField',field)end
            record.field=field
        end
        if record.customize~=style.customize then
            if label:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismInfoFieldCustom')~=style.customize then
                label:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismInfoFieldCustom',style.customize)
                if menu.textStyle and type(menu.textStyle.apply)=='function'then menu.textStyle.apply(label)end
            end
            record.customize=style.customize
        end
        if not style.customize then
            if record.applied then
                for key,value in record.base do if sameInfoValue(label[key],record.applied[key])then putInfo(label,key,value)end end
                record.applied,record.base=nil,nil
                for _,name in {'InfoFieldOutline','InfoFieldShadow','InfoFieldDepth'}do local layer=label:FindFirstChild(name);if layer then layer:Destroy()end end
                record.outline,record.shadow,record.depth=nil,nil,nil
                record.layerApplied=nil
                if menu.textStyle and type(menu.textStyle.apply)=='function'then menu.textStyle.apply(label)end
            end
            local gradient=label:FindFirstChild('StatusGradient');if gradient and gradient.Enabled==false then gradient.Enabled=true end
            return
        end
        if not record.base then
            record.base={TextColor3=label.TextColor3,TextTransparency=label.TextTransparency,TextStrokeTransparency=label.TextStrokeTransparency}
        elseif record.applied then
            for _,key in infoBaseProperties do
                if record.applied[key]~=nil and not sameInfoValue(label[key],record.applied[key])then record.base[key]=label[key]end
            end
        end
        local alpha=math.clamp(fade or 0,0,1)
        local applied=record.applied or {}
        applied.TextColor3,applied.TextTransparency,applied.TextStrokeTransparency=style.textColor,1-(1-style.textTransparency/100)*(1-alpha),1
        for _,key in infoBaseProperties do putInfo(label,key,applied[key])end
        record.applied=applied
        local gradient=label:FindFirstChild('StatusGradient')
        if gradient and gradient.Enabled~=false then gradient.Enabled=false end
        local outline=infoDecoration(label,record,'outline','InfoFieldOutline')
        if style.outlineOpacity>0 and style.outlineThickness>0 then
            if not outline then outline=host.Instance.new('UIStroke');outline.Name='InfoFieldOutline';outline:SetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer',true);outline.Parent=label;record.outline=outline end
            putInfo(outline,'ApplyStrokeMode',host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode and host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual or nil)
            putInfo(outline,'Color',style.outlineColor);putInfo(outline,'Thickness',style.outlineThickness)
            putInfo(outline,'Transparency',1-style.outlineOpacity/100*(1-alpha))
        elseif outline then outline:Destroy();record.outline=nil end
        -- Read the changing source once, shared by the two owned glyph layers.
        -- No property observers or per-frame tables are needed for unchanged text.
        local source=record.layerSource
        if style.shadowOpacity>0 or style.depthOpacity>0 then
            if not source then source={};record.layerSource=source end
            for _,key in infoLayerProperties do source[key]=label[key]end
        end
        local layerApplied=record.layerApplied
        if not layerApplied then layerApplied={};record.layerApplied=layerApplied end
        for _,kind in {'shadow','depth'}do
            local name=if kind=='shadow'then 'InfoFieldShadow'else 'InfoFieldDepth'
            local layer=infoDecoration(label,record,kind,name)
            if style[kind..'Opacity']>0 then
                if not layer then layer=host.Instance.new('TextLabel');layer.Name=name;layer:SetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer',true);layer.Parent=label;record[kind]=layer end
                local previous=layerApplied[kind]
                if not previous or previous.object~=layer then previous={object=layer};layerApplied[kind]=previous end
                for _,key in infoLayerProperties do
                    local value=source[key]
                    if value~=nil and previous[key]~=value then
                        if layer[key]~=value then layer[key]=value end
                        previous[key]=value
                    elseif value==nil then previous[key]=nil end
                end
                putInfo(layer,'BackgroundTransparency',1);putInfo(layer,'BorderSizePixel',0);putInfo(layer,'TextStrokeTransparency',1)
                local position=record[kind..'Position']
                if not position or position.X.Offset~=style[kind..'X']or position.Y.Offset~=style[kind..'Y']then
                    position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(style[kind..'X'],style[kind..'Y']);record[kind..'Position']=position
                end
                if not sameInfoDimension(layer.Position,position)then layer.Position=position end
                if not sameInfoDimension(layer.Size,infoLayerSize)then layer.Size=infoLayerSize end
                putInfo(layer,'TextColor3',style[kind..'Color']);putInfo(layer,'TextTransparency',1-style[kind..'Opacity']/100*(1-alpha))
                putInfo(layer,'ZIndex',math.max(0,(label.ZIndex or 1)-1))
            elseif layer then layer:Destroy();record[kind]=nil end
        end
    end
    -- applyInfoField restyles a label on every call, several times a frame per card. When nothing it depends on has changed (the style
    -- settings, the fade, and the label's own text, size, font, colour, alpha, position, size and visibility) the result would be the same,
    -- so the call is skipped.
    visual.infoStyleVersion = 0
    local applyInfoFieldFull = visual.applyInfoField
    function visual.applyInfoField(label, field, fade)
        local style=visual.infoFieldStyles[field]
        if style and not style.customize then
            -- Default labels need only their original geometry/ownership pass.
            -- Memoizing custom glyph properties here costs more native reads
            -- than that pass, and moving distance labels invalidate it anyway.
            return applyInfoFieldFull(label,field,fade)
        end
        if style and style.shadowOpacity<=0 and style.depthOpacity<=0 then
            -- Native strokes follow their label directly. With no copied glyph
            -- layers, font/text/visibility reads cannot change stroke output.
            -- Distance alone also owns label geometry, so retain those inputs.
            local record=if label then visual.infoFieldRecords[label]else nil
            if record and record.outlineMemoVersion==visual.infoStyleVersion and record.outlineMemoField==field
                and record.outlineMemoFade==fade and label.Parent~=nil
                and record.outlineMemoColor==label.TextColor3 and record.outlineMemoAlpha==label.TextTransparency
                and record.outlineMemoStroke==label.TextStrokeTransparency
                and(field~='Distance'or record.outlineMemoText==label.Text and record.outlineMemoTextSize==label.TextSize
                    and record.outlineMemoPosition==label.Position and record.outlineMemoSize==label.Size)then return end
            applyInfoFieldFull(label,field,fade)
            record=if label then visual.infoFieldRecords[label]else nil
            if record and label.Parent then
                record.outlineMemoVersion,record.outlineMemoField,record.outlineMemoFade=visual.infoStyleVersion,field,fade
                record.outlineMemoColor,record.outlineMemoAlpha,record.outlineMemoStroke=label.TextColor3,label.TextTransparency,label.TextStrokeTransparency
                if field=='Distance'then
                    record.outlineMemoText,record.outlineMemoTextSize=label.Text,label.TextSize
                    record.outlineMemoPosition,record.outlineMemoSize=label.Position,label.Size
                end
            end
            return
        end
        local record = if label then visual.infoFieldRecords[label] else nil
        local geometryApplied,geometryMatches=false,false
        if field=='Distance'and style and label and record then
            geometryMatches=record.memoPosition==label.Position and record.memoSize==label.Size
            -- World/screen movement changes the label's geometry, not the
            -- relative shadow/depth glyphs. Apply geometry every call before
            -- deciding whether the glyph style itself needs another pass.
            if not geometryMatches and record.memoVersion==visual.infoStyleVersion and record.memoField==field and label.Parent then
                applyDistanceInfoGeometry(label,style,record);geometryApplied=true
            end
        end
        if record and record.memoVersion == visual.infoStyleVersion and record.memoField == field and record.memoFade == fade and label.Parent ~= nil
            and record.memoText == label.Text and record.memoTextSize == label.TextSize and record.memoVisible == label.Visible and record.memoFont == label.Font
            and record.memoColor == label.TextColor3 and record.memoAlpha == label.TextTransparency and record.memoStroke == label.TextStrokeTransparency
            and (geometryApplied or geometryMatches or record.memoPosition == label.Position and record.memoSize == label.Size) then
            local unchanged=record.memoLayerProperties~=nil
            if unchanged then
                for _,key in infoLayerProperties do
                    if record.memoLayerProperties[key]~=label[key]then unchanged=false;break end
                end
            end
            if unchanged then return end
        end
        applyInfoFieldFull(label, field, fade, geometryApplied)
        record = if label then visual.infoFieldRecords[label] else nil
        if record and label.Parent then
            record.memoVersion, record.memoField, record.memoFade = visual.infoStyleVersion, field, fade
            -- The full renderer has just read these exact glyph properties
            -- after geometry and text-style changes. Its owned child writes do
            -- not change the source label, so do not cross the engine boundary
            -- again for the same values in this synchronous call.
            local captured=style and(style.shadowOpacity>0 or style.depthOpacity>0)and record.layerSource
            record.memoText=if captured then captured.Text else label.Text
            record.memoTextSize=if captured then captured.TextSize else label.TextSize
            record.memoVisible=if captured then captured.Visible else label.Visible
            record.memoFont=if captured then captured.Font else label.Font
            record.memoColor, record.memoAlpha, record.memoStroke = label.TextColor3, label.TextTransparency, label.TextStrokeTransparency
            record.memoPosition, record.memoSize = label.Position, label.Size
            local memo=record.memoLayerProperties or {};record.memoLayerProperties=memo
            for _,key in infoLayerProperties do memo[key]=if captured then captured[key]else label[key]end
        end
    end
    local function refreshInfoSettings()
        visual.infoStyleVersion += 1
        if visual.updateInfo then visual.updateInfo()end
        if visual.updateStuns then visual.updateStuns()end
        if visual.layoutOverlays then visual.layoutOverlays()end
    end
    function visual.setInfoLayoutProperty(key,value)
        local bounds=infoLayoutBounds[key]
        if not visual.alive or not bounds or not finiteInfo(value)then return false end
        visual.infoLayout[key]=math.clamp(value,bounds[1],bounds[2]);refreshInfoSettings();return true
    end
    function visual.setInfoFieldProperty(field,key,value)
        local style=visual.infoFieldStyles[field]
        if not visual.alive or not style or type(key)~='string'then return false end
        if key=='visible'or key=='customize'then
            if type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        elseif key:match('Color$')then
            local kind=type(value)
            if kind~='table'and kind~='userdata'and (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3'then return false end
            for _,channel in {'R','G','B'}do if not finiteInfo(value[channel])or value[channel]<0 or value[channel]>1 then return false end end
            if style[key]==nil then return false end
        else
            local bounds=infoFieldBounds[key]
            if not bounds or not finiteInfo(value)then return false end
            value=math.clamp(value,bounds[1],bounds[2])
        end
        style[key]=value
        if key~='visible'and key~='size'and key~='offsetX'and key~='offsetY'and key~='customize'and not menu.restoringControls then style.customize=true end
        refreshInfoSettings();return true
    end
    function visual.updateInfoWorldOffset(model,display,record)
        local layout=visual.infoLayout
        local current=display.StudsOffsetWorldSpace or host.Vector3.zero
        if not record.infoBaseWorldOffset or record.infoAppliedWorldOffset and current~=record.infoAppliedWorldOffset then record.infoBaseWorldOffset=current end
        if layout.offsetX==0 and layout.offsetY==0 and layout.offsetZ==0 then
            local offset=record.infoBaseWorldOffset
            if current~=offset then display.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=offset end
            record.infoAppliedWorldOffset=offset
            return
        end
        local offset=host.Vector3.new(layout.offsetX,layout.offsetY,layout.offsetZ)
        local root=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')or model:FindFirstChild('Torso')
        local frame=root and root.CFrame
        if root and type(root.GetRenderCFrame)=='function' then
            local okay,rendered=pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame,root)
            if okay and rendered then frame=rendered end
        end
        if offset.Magnitude>0 and frame then
            if type(frame.VectorToWorldSpace)=='function'then offset=frame:VectorToWorldSpace(offset)
            elseif frame.RightVector and frame.UpVector and frame.LookVector then offset=frame.RightVector*layout.offsetX+frame.UpVector*layout.offsetY-frame.LookVector*layout.offsetZ end
        end
        offset=record.infoBaseWorldOffset+offset
        if display.StudsOffsetWorldSpace~=offset then display.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=offset end
        record.infoAppliedWorldOffset=offset
    end
    function visual.layoutInfoDisplay(model,display,baseFont,baseWidth,deferWorldOffset)
        local record=visual.layoutRecords[display]
        if not record then return end
        baseFont,baseWidth=baseFont or record.infoBaseFont,baseWidth or record.infoBaseWidth
        if not baseFont or not baseWidth then return end
        record.infoBaseFont,record.infoBaseWidth=baseFont,baseWidth
        local layout=visual.infoLayout;local scale=layout.scale
        local statusField=infoStatusField(display.Status.Text or '')
        local geometry=record.infoGeometry
        if not geometry or geometry.entries[1].label~=display.Status or geometry.entries[2].label~=display.Information or geometry.entries[3].label~=display.Activity then
            geometry={entries={{label=display.Status,padding=8},{label=display.Information,field='Player Name',padding=5},{label=display.Activity,field='Current Action / Emote',padding=5}}}
            record.infoGeometry=geometry
        end
        local entries=geometry.entries
        local dirty=geometry.baseFont~=baseFont or geometry.baseWidth~=baseWidth or geometry.statusField~=statusField
            or geometry.scale~=scale or geometry.width~=layout.width or geometry.height~=layout.height or geometry.spacing~=layout.spacing
        entries[1].field=statusField
        for _,entry in entries do
            local style=visual.infoFieldStyles[entry.field]
            if entry.styleSize~=style.size or entry.styleX~=style.offsetX or entry.styleY~=style.offsetY then dirty=true end
        end
        if dirty then
            geometry.baseFont,geometry.baseWidth,geometry.statusField=baseFont,baseWidth,statusField
            geometry.scale,geometry.width,geometry.height,geometry.spacing=scale,layout.width,layout.height,layout.spacing
            local width=math.max(16,math.floor((if layout.width>0 then layout.width else baseWidth)*scale+.5))
            local required=layout.spacing*scale*2
            for index,entry in entries do
                local style=visual.infoFieldStyles[entry.field]
                entry.styleSize,entry.styleX,entry.styleY=style.size,style.offsetX,style.offsetY
                entry.font=math.max(1,math.floor((if style.size>0 then style.size else baseFont+(if index==1 then 2 else 0))*scale+.5))
                entry.height=entry.font+entry.padding*scale;required+=entry.height
            end
            local height=math.max(required,layout.height*scale)
            local gap=layout.spacing*scale+(height-required)/2;local y=0
            for _,entry in entries do
                entry.position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(entry.styleX*scale,y+entry.styleY*scale)
                entry.size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(width,entry.height)
                y+=entry.height+gap
            end
            geometry.size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
            visual.infoGeometryBuilds=(visual.infoGeometryBuilds or 0)+1
        end
        -- Geometry inputs stay static through countdown/text updates. Reuse the
        -- same values while still correcting a later external layout write.
        for _,entry in entries do
            local label=entry.label
            if not sameInfoDimension(label.Position,entry.position)then label.Position=entry.position end
            if not sameInfoDimension(label.Size,entry.size)then label.Size=entry.size end
            if label.TextSize~=entry.font then label.TextSize=entry.font end
            if host.Enum.TextTruncate and label.TextTruncate~=host.Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd then label.TextTruncate=host.Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end
        end
        if not sameInfoDimension(display.Size,geometry.size)then display.Size=geometry.size end
        -- layoutOverlays calls positionOverlay immediately after this layout;
        -- that call already updates the same world offset with the same state.
        if not deferWorldOffset then visual.updateInfoWorldOffset(model,display,record) end
    end
    -- Death is a lifetime boundary, not a temporary ragdoll. Some native corpse
    -- scripts restore Health or remove Dead while dismantling the old rig.
    -- Never let those writes recreate overlays for that same model.
    visual.deadModels=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    visual.retiredPlayerModels=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    visual.playerRoster,visual.rosterConnections={},{}
    visual.infoLives={}
    local function disconnectInfoLife(model)
        local record=visual.infoLives[model]
        if not record then return end
        visual.infoLives[model]=nil
        for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    function visual.releaseInfoActor(model,dead)
        if dead then visual.deadModels[model]=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or true end
        disconnectInfoLife(model)
        local display=visual.characters[model]
        if display then
            visual.characters[model]=nil
            visual.layoutRecords[display]=nil
            display:Destroy()
        end
        if visual.releaseStun then visual.releaseStun(model) end
        if dead and visual.releaseTargetESP then visual.releaseTargetESP(model) end
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local distance=humanoid and visual.nativeNames[humanoid]
        if distance~=nil then
            if humanoid.Parent and humanoid.NameDisplayDistance==0 then humanoid.NameDisplayDistance=distance end
            visual.nativeNames[humanoid]=nil
        end
        visual.activityRecords[model],visual.dashUntil[model],visual.shotUntil[model],visual.shotNames[model]=nil,nil,nil,nil
        if dead and visual.hitOutlineTimes then visual.hitOutlineTimes[model]=nil end
    end
    function visual.infoActorAlive(model,humanoid)
        if not model or not model.Parent then return false end
        humanoid=humanoid or model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Parent~=model then return false end
        local retiredHumanoid=visual.deadModels[model]
        if retiredHumanoid then
            if retiredHumanoid==humanoid or retiredHumanoid==true or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false end
            visual.deadModels[model]=nil
        end
        local nativeDead=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        local stateDead=nativeDead~=nil and type(humanoid.GetState)=="function" and humanoid:GetState()==nativeDead
        if humanoid.Health<=0 or model:GetAttribute("Dead")==true or stateDead then
            visual.releaseInfoActor(model,true)
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    function visual.observeInfoLife(model,humanoid)
        if not visual.infoActorAlive(model,humanoid) then return false end
        local previous=visual.infoLives[model]
        if previous and previous.humanoid==humanoid then return true end
        disconnectInfoLife(model)
        local record={humanoid=humanoid,connections={}}
        visual.infoLives[model]=record
        local function listen(signal,callback)
            if signal and type(signal.Connect)=="function" then table.insert(record.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
        end
        local function checkLife() visual.infoActorAlive(model,humanoid) end
        listen(humanoid.Died,function()
            if model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')==humanoid then visual.releaseInfoActor(model,true) end
        end)
        listen(humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"),checkLife)
        listen(humanoid.StateChanged,checkLife)
        listen(model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Dead"),checkLife)
        listen(model.AncestryChanged,function() if not model.Parent then visual.releaseInfoActor(model,false) end end)
        listen(humanoid.AncestryChanged,function() if humanoid.Parent~=model then visual.releaseInfoActor(model,false) end end)
        return true
    end
    function visual.pruneInfoLives()
        for model in visual.infoLives do
            if not visual.characters[model] and not visual.stuns[model] then disconnectInfoLife(model) end
        end
    end
    local function isDisplayActor(model)
        if not model or not model.Parent or not model:IsA("Model") or visual.retiredPlayerModels[model] then return false end
        if model==players.LocalPlayer.Character then return true end
        return not (type(menu.isOwnedSummon)=="function" and menu.isOwnedSummon(model))
    end
    function visual.isInfoTarget(model: any, humanoid: any?): boolean
        if not isDisplayActor(model) then return false end
        if not visual.infoActorAlive(model,humanoid) then return false end
        if model == players.LocalPlayer.Character then return true end
        if menu.infoTargetOnly ~= true then return true end
        if type(menu.isInfoTarget) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, allowed = pcall(menu.isInfoTarget, model)
        return ok and allowed == true
    end
    function visual.infoCandidates(): {any}
        if visual.discoveryCandidates then return visual.discoveryCandidates end
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        local models,seen={},{}
        local function add(model)
            if not seen[model] and isDisplayActor(model) then seen[model]=true;table.insert(models,model) end
        end
        if folder then for _,model in folder:GetChildren() do add(model) end end
        local victims=if type(menu.getRecentHitVictims)=="function" then menu.getRecentHitVictims() else menu.recentHitVictims or {}
        for model in victims do add(model) end
        for model in menu.autoCounterFilter and menu.autoCounterFilter.records or {} do add(model) end
        -- Player membership is seeded once and maintained by roster events.
        -- Read Character from each cached player so a just-replaced model can
        -- participate even before its deferred readiness callback runs.
        for currentPlayer in visual.playerRoster do add(currentPlayer.Character) end
        local target=menu.infoTarget
        -- Player characters and discovered NPCs may live outside Characters.
        -- Include them independently of lock-on and recent attack attribution.
        add(target)
        return models
    end
    function visual.syncLayer()
        local root = menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        local main = root and (if root:IsA("ScreenGui") then root else root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui"))
        local order = if main then main.DisplayOrder - 1 else 0
        if visual.gui.DisplayOrder ~= order then visual.gui.DisplayOrder = order end
    end
    local function restoreNames()
        for humanoid, distance in visual.nativeNames do
            if humanoid.Parent and humanoid.NameDisplayDistance == 0 then humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = distance end
        end
        table.clear(visual.nativeNames)
    end
    function visual.overlayFont(depth, base)
        return math.clamp(math.floor(base*math.clamp(35/math.max(depth,1),0.65,1)+0.5),11,base)
    end
    visual.dashAnimations, visual.m1Animations, visual.projectileAnimations = {}, {}, {}
    visual.sprintAnimations, visual.emoteAnimations = {}, {}
    -- The native wheel's EmoteCache is {display name, AnimationId, category}.
    -- Its preview creates an Animation from that same second field. Index this
    -- small catalog once per cache version; activity calls never scan the game.
    visual.emoteNames,visual.emoteDisplayNames={},{}
    visual.emoteCatalogCount,visual.emoteCatalogIndexed=0,0
    local nextEmoteCatalogRead=0
    function visual.refreshEmoteCatalog(force: boolean?): boolean
        if not visual.alive then return false end
        local shared=menu.moveNames and menu.moveNames.emotes
        if shared then
            local changed=shared.refresh(force)
            visual.emoteNames,visual.emoteDisplayNames=shared.byId,shared.names
            visual.emoteCatalogCount,visual.emoteCatalogIndexed=shared.stats.catalogNames,shared.stats.knownIds
            return changed
        end
        local now=host.os.clock()
        if force~=true and now<nextEmoteCatalogRead then return false end
        nextEmoteCatalogRead=now+5
        local scripts=players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
        local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
        local character=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('Character')
        local module=character and character:FindFirstChild('EmoteController')
        if not module or type(host.require)~='function' then return false end
        local ok,native=true,visual.emoteNative
        if module~=visual.emoteCatalogModule or not native then
            ok,native=pcall(host.require,module)
            if ok and type(native)=='table' then visual.emoteNative,visual.emoteCatalogModule=native,module end
        end
        local catalog=ok and type(native)=='table' and native.EmoteCache
        if type(catalog)~='table' then return false end
        if catalog==visual.emoteCatalogSource and #catalog==visual.emoteCatalogCount then return false end
        local names,displayNames,count,indexed={},{},0,0
        for _,entry in catalog do
            count+=1
            if count>4096 then break end
            if type(entry)~='table' or type(entry[1])~='string' or entry[1]=='' or #entry[1]>128 then continue end
            local name=entry[1]
            if name=='None' then continue end
            displayNames[name]=true
            local asset=entry[2]
            local id=if type(asset)=='string' then asset:match('%d+') elseif type(asset)=='number' and asset>0 then tostring(asset) else nil
            if not id or id=='0' then continue end
            local previous=names[id]
            if previous==nil then names[id]=name;indexed+=1
            elseif previous~=name then names[id]=false end
        end
        visual.emoteNames,visual.emoteDisplayNames=names,displayNames
        visual.emoteCatalogCount,visual.emoteCatalogIndexed=count,indexed
        visual.emoteCatalogSource=catalog
        return true
    end
    function visual.namedEmote(model: any,info: any): string?
        local names=menu.moveNames
        if names and names.namedEmote then local name=names.namedEmote(model,info);if name then return name end end
        local function known(value)
            return if type(value)=='string' and visual.emoteDisplayNames[value] then value else nil
        end
        for _,key in {'EmoteName','Emote','Emoting'} do
            local name=known(model:GetAttribute(key))
            if name then return name end
        end
        if info then
            for _,key in {'Emote','Emoting'} do
                local marker=info:FindFirstChild(key)
                if marker then
                    local name=if marker:IsA('StringValue') then known(marker.Value) else nil
                    name=name or known(marker:GetAttribute('EmoteName')) or known(marker:GetAttribute('Emote'))
                    if name then return name end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    visual.refreshEmoteCatalog(true)
    local animations = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Animations")
    if animations then
        for _, animation in animations:GetDescendants() do
            if animation:IsA("Animation") then
                local id = animation.AnimationId:match("%d+")
                if id then
                    if animation.Name:sub(1,4) == "Dash" or (animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name == "Dashes") then visual.dashAnimations[id] = true end
                    if animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name:match("^Melee") then visual.m1Animations[id] = true end
                    if animation.Name == "ReserveBalls" then visual.projectileAnimations[id] = true end
                    if animation.Name == "Sprint" and animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name == "Movement" then visual.sprintAnimations[id] = true end
                    local parent=animation.Parent
                    while parent and parent~=animations do
                        if parent.Name=="Emotes" or parent.Name=="Emote" then visual.emoteAnimations[id]=true;break end
                        parent=parent.Parent
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

            end
        end)
    end)

        if visual.alive and host.typeof(character) == "Instance" and character:IsA("Model") then
            visual.shotUntil[character] = host.os.clock()+0.45
            visual.shotNames[character] = name
        end
    end

        local knit = host.require(host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Knit.Knit)
        for service, action in {ReserveBallService="Fire",ReversalRedService="Red",FlameArrowService="Arrow",FurnaceArrowService="Arrow"} do
            pcall(function()
                local signal = knit.GetService(service).Effects
                table.insert(visual.actionConnections,signal:Connect(function(effect,character)
                    if effect == action then
                        local name = if service == "ReserveBallService" then "Reserve Balls" elseif service == "ReversalRedService" then "Reversal Red" else "Flame Arrow"
                        visual.noteShot(character,name)
                    end
                end))
            end)
        end
    end)
    local function make(class, parent)
        local object = host.Instance.new(class)
        object:SetAttribute("CullingOwnedVisual", true)
        if class == "BillboardGui" then
            pcall(function() object.ResetOnSpawn = false end)
            object.Enabled=false
            visual.nextLayoutOrder+=1
            visual.layoutRecords[object]={order=visual.nextLayoutOrder}
        end
        object.Parent = parent
        return object
    end

    visual.targetESPRecords={}
    visual.targetOutlineEnabled,visual.targetNameEnabled=false,false
    visual.hitOutlineEnabled,visual.hitOutlineDuration=false,300
    visual.hitOutlineUntilDeath=false
