        -- do not paint those hidden duplicates. setInfo(false) immediately
        -- refreshes standalone timers before enabling them again.
        if visual.infoEnabled and deferInformation then return end
        for model,record in visual.stuns do
            if not visual.infoActorAlive(model,record.humanoid) or not record.display.Parent then continue end
            local state,text,fade,visible=visual.displayStatusPresentation(model,record.humanoid)
            local fieldStyle=visual.infoFieldStyles[infoStatusField(text)]
            local font=math.max(1,math.floor((if fieldStyle.size>0 then fieldStyle.size else record.baseStatusFont or record.display.Timer.TextSize)*visual.infoLayout.scale+.5))
            if record.display.Timer.TextSize~=font then record.display.Timer.TextSize=font end
            if record.display.Timer.Visible~=visible then record.display.Timer.Visible=visible end
            local width=if text:sub(1,4)=="Dash" then math.max(120,math.ceil(#text*record.display.Timer.TextSize*0.65+12)) else 72
            local size=record.display.Size
            if not size or size.X.Offset~=width or size.Y.Offset~=font+12 then record.display.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(width,font+12) end
            if record.display.Timer.Text~=text then record.display.Timer.Text=text end
            local position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(fieldStyle.offsetX*visual.infoLayout.scale,fieldStyle.offsetY*visual.infoLayout.scale)
            if not sameInfoDimension(record.display.Timer.Position,position)then record.display.Timer.Position=position end
            visual.paintStatus(record.display.Timer,state,fade,0.2)
            visual.styleStunBox(record.display)
            local information=visual.characters[model]
            if information and information.Parent and not deferInformation then
                if information.Status.Visible~=visible then information.Status.Visible=visible end
                if information.Status.Text~=text then information.Status.Text=text end
                visual.paintStatus(information.Status,state,fade)
                visual.layoutInfoDisplay(model,information)
            end
        end
    end
    function visual.setStun(enabled)
        visual.stunEnabled = enabled == true
        visual.updateStuns()
    end
    -- CharacterAdded commonly fires before Humanoid, Info or the root exists.
    -- Keep one small observer per current player/character and retry only when
    -- those direct children become ready. The bounded discovery tick remains
    -- available for NPCs and damage-attribution sources outside player rosters.
    local function disconnectRosterConnections(connections)
        for _,current in connections do current:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    local function rosterListen(connections,signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=="function" then table.insert(connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    function visual.refreshRosterDisplays()
        if not visual.alive then return end
        local deferred=visual.deferLayout
        visual.deferLayout=true
        if visual.stunEnabled or visual.infoEnabled then visual.updateStuns() end
        if visual.infoEnabled then visual.updateInfo() end
        visual.updateTargetESP()
        visual.deferLayout=deferred
        if not deferred and (visual.stunEnabled or visual.infoEnabled) then visual.layoutOverlays() end
        if menu.sideDisplays and type(menu.sideDisplays.update)=="function" then menu.sideDisplays.update(0) end
    end
    local function queueRosterRefresh()
        if not visual.alive or visual.rosterRefreshQueued then return end
        visual.rosterRefreshQueued=true
        local function refresh()
            visual.rosterRefreshQueued=false
            visual.refreshRosterDisplays()
        end
        if host.task and type(host.task.defer)=="function" then host.task.defer(refresh) else refresh() end
    end
    local function retireRosterCharacter(record,model)
        if not model then return end
        visual.retiredPlayerModels[model]=true
        visual.releaseInfoActor(model,false)
        visual.releaseTargetESP(model)
        visual.hitOutlineTimes[model]=nil
        if record.character==model then
            disconnectRosterConnections(record.characterConnections)
            record.character=nil
        end
    end
    local function trackRosterCharacter(record,model)
        if record.character==model then return end
        retireRosterCharacter(record,record.character)
        record.character=model
        if model then
            visual.retiredPlayerModels[model]=nil
            local function changed(child)
                if child.Name=="HumanoidRootPart" or child.Name=="Head" or child.Name=="Info" or child:IsA("Humanoid") then queueRosterRefresh() end
            end
            rosterListen(record.characterConnections,model.ChildAdded,changed)
            rosterListen(record.characterConnections,model.ChildRemoved,changed)
            rosterListen(record.characterConnections,model.AncestryChanged,function()
                if not model.Parent then
                    visual.releaseInfoActor(model,false)
                    visual.releaseTargetESP(model)
                end
                queueRosterRefresh()
            end)
            rosterListen(record.characterConnections,model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Dead"),queueRosterRefresh)
        end
        queueRosterRefresh()
    end
    local function trackRosterPlayer(currentPlayer)
        if visual.playerRoster[currentPlayer] then return end
        local record={connections={},characterConnections={}}
        visual.playerRoster[currentPlayer]=record
        rosterListen(record.connections,currentPlayer.CharacterAdded,function(model) trackRosterCharacter(record,model) end)
        rosterListen(record.connections,currentPlayer.CharacterRemoving,function(model)
            retireRosterCharacter(record,model)
            queueRosterRefresh()
        end)
        trackRosterCharacter(record,currentPlayer.Character)
    end
    local function untrackRosterPlayer(currentPlayer)
        local record=visual.playerRoster[currentPlayer]
        if not record then return end
        visual.playerRoster[currentPlayer]=nil
        retireRosterCharacter(record,record.character or currentPlayer.Character)
        disconnectRosterConnections(record.connections)
        disconnectRosterConnections(record.characterConnections)
        queueRosterRefresh()
    end
    rosterListen(visual.rosterConnections,players.PlayerAdded,trackRosterPlayer)
    rosterListen(visual.rosterConnections,players.PlayerRemoving,untrackRosterPlayer)
    if type(players.GetPlayers)=="function" then
        for _,currentPlayer in players:GetPlayers() do trackRosterPlayer(currentPlayer) end
    else trackRosterPlayer(players.LocalPlayer) end
    local runService=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local connection = runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
        if not visual.alive then return end
        elapsed += delta
        presentationElapsed+=delta
        hitboxElapsed+=delta
        if elapsed>=0.1 or presentationElapsed>=1/30 then visual.statusBatch={now=host.os.clock()} end
        if elapsed>=0.1 then
            elapsed%=0.1
            visual.discoveryPasses+=1
            visual.deferLayout=true
            if visual.stunEnabled or visual.infoEnabled or visual.targetOutlineEnabled or visual.targetNameEnabled then visual.discoveryCandidates=visual.infoCandidates() end
            local coalescePresentation=presentationElapsed>=1/30
            if visual.stunEnabled or visual.infoEnabled then visual.updateStuns(coalescePresentation) end
            if visual.itemEnabled then visual.updateItems(true) end
            if visual.infoEnabled then visual.updateInfo(coalescePresentation) end
            visual.updateTargetESP()
            visual.bindHitOutlines()
            visual.discoveryCandidates=nil
            visual.deferLayout=false
        end
        if visual.itemEnabled then visual.renderItemEdges() end
        if presentationElapsed>=1/30 then
            presentationElapsed%=1/30
            -- layoutOverlays paints information.Status with current visibility
            -- and settings; presentStatuses owns the separate stun Timer. Each
            -- label needs one final paint, not both paints in this same pass.
            if visual.stunEnabled or visual.infoEnabled then visual.presentStatuses(true);visual.layoutOverlays() end
        end
        if hitboxElapsed>=0.15 then hitboxElapsed%=0.15;menu.ApplyHitbox() end
        visual.statusBatch=nil
    end)
    local positionConnection,positionRenderName
    local positionBudget=0
    local function renderPositions(delta)
        if not visual.alive or not (visual.infoEnabled or visual.stunEnabled) or type(delta)~='number'
            or delta~=delta or delta<=0 or math.abs(delta)==math.huge then return end
        local rate=menu.sideDisplays and menu.sideDisplays.updateRate or 240
        local interval=1/math.clamp(rate,30,240)
        positionBudget+=delta
        if positionBudget+1e-8<interval then return end
        positionBudget=math.max(0,positionBudget-interval*math.floor((positionBudget+1e-8)/interval))
        visual.presentOverlayPositions()
    end
    if type(runService.BindToRenderStep)=='function' and host.Enum.RenderPriority and host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last then
        positionRenderName='ShenaniganismInfoPositionPresentation'
        runService:BindToRenderStep(positionRenderName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+5,renderPositions)
    elseif runService.RenderStepped then positionConnection=runService.RenderStepped:Connect(renderPositions) end
    visual.positionRenderName=positionRenderName
    function visual.Destroy()
        visual.alive = false
        visual.setHitOutline(false)
        visual.setTargetOutline(false)
        visual.setTargetName(false)
        visual.setItems(false)
        visual.setInfo(false)
        visual.setStun(false)
        if visual.effectsConnection then visual.effectsConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _, actionConnection in visual.actionConnections do actionConnection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(visual.actionConnections)
        table.clear(visual.shotUntil)
        table.clear(visual.activityRecords)
        visual.emoteNames,visual.emoteDisplayNames={},{}
        for model in visual.infoLives do disconnectInfoLife(model) end
        for currentPlayer in visual.playerRoster do untrackRosterPlayer(currentPlayer) end
        disconnectRosterConnections(visual.rosterConnections)
        visual.emoteCatalogSource,visual.emoteCatalogModule,visual.emoteNative=nil,nil,nil
        connection:Disconnect()
        if positionConnection then positionConnection:Disconnect() end
        if positionRenderName then runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(positionRenderName) end
        visual.gui:Destroy()
    end
    return visual
end
return Visuals
end)()

local RagdollControl = (function(): any
-- Movement recovery and automatic use of game-provided evasives/bursts.
local RagdollControl: {[string]: any} = {}
function RagdollControl.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, bindings: any): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local types = host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
    local control: any = {alive = true, enabled = false, method = "Movement recovery", delay = 0, recoveryEnabled = false, recoveryDelay = 800, lastCompleteRecoveryAt = -math.huge, completeRecoveredThisEpisode = false, trueRagdollEnabled = false, trueRagdollDelay = 800, records = {}, skillGuards={}, ragdollSince = nil, lastAttempt = -math.huge}
    control.preservesNativeRig = true
    control.connections = {}
    control.focused = true
    control.getUpRepeatDelay,control.getUpGuardUntil=0.35,-math.huge
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local function ragdolled(character)
        return (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0) > 0
    end
    local function inSkill(character)
        local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local value=character:GetAttribute("InSkill")
        local guard=menu.antiStunSpeed
        local startup=guard and guard.skillStartupProtected and guard.skillStartupProtected(character)
        return startup==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")~=nil) or value==true or (type(value)=="number" and value>0)
    end
    local function skillProtected(character)
        local guard=control.skillGuards[character]
        return inSkill(character) or (guard and host.os.clock()<guard.untilAt)
    end
    local function releaseGuard(character)
        local guard=control.skillGuards[character]
        if not guard then return end
        control.skillGuards[character]=nil
        for _,connection in guard.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    local function ensureGuard(character)
        if control.skillGuards[character] then return end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return end
        local guard={untilAt=-math.huge,connections={}}
        control.skillGuards[character]=guard
        local function protect()
            guard.untilAt=host.os.clock()+0.2
            control.release(character,true)
            control.ragdollSince,control.completeSince,control.trueRagdollSince=nil,nil,nil
        end
        table.insert(guard.connections,info.ChildAdded:Connect(function(marker)
            if marker.Name=="InSkill" or inSkill(character) then protect() end
        end))
        if character.GetAttributeChangedSignal then
            table.insert(guard.connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InSkill"):Connect(function()
                if inSkill(character) then protect() end
            end))
        end
        guard.protect=protect
        if inSkill(character) then protect() end
    end
    function control.getRecoveryCooldownRemaining(now)
        if control.character ~= player.Character then return 0 end
        return math.max(0,control.recoveryDelay/1000-((now or host.os.clock())-control.lastCompleteRecoveryAt))
    end
    local function completeReady(character, now)
        -- With True Ragdoll recovery on, its own wait applies to a true ragdoll;
        -- the (immediate) first complete recovery must not bypass that wait.
        if control.trueRagdollEnabled and control.isTrueRagdoll(character) then return false end
        -- Keep correcting one successful episode without starting its cooldown again.
        return control.recoveryEnabled and ragdolled(character)
            and (control.completeRecoveredThisEpisode or control.getRecoveryCooldownRemaining(now)<=0.0000001)
    end
    function control.isTrueRagdoll(character)
        if not character or not ragdolled(character) then return false end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return false end
        for _, marker in info:GetChildren() do
            if marker:GetAttribute("Disable") == true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function trueRagdollReady(character, now)
        return control.trueRagdollEnabled and control.isTrueRagdoll(character) and control.trueRagdollSince ~= nil
            and now-control.trueRagdollSince+0.0000001 >= control.trueRagdollDelay/1000
    end
    function control.release(character,ownSkill)
        local record = control.records[character]
        if not record then return end
        control.records[character] = nil
        for _, connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    function control.capture(character)
        if control.records[character] then return control.records[character] end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then return nil end
        -- Observation only: the game's motors, sockets, state permissions and
        -- NoRagdoll attribute must keep their native ownership throughout a fall.
        local record: any = {humanoid = humanoid, connections = {}, recovering = false, sawRagdoll = ragdolled(character)}
        control.records[character] = record
        return record
    end
    function control.performAction(character,now,action)
        if character~=player.Character or not action or now-control.lastAttempt<0.2
            or not control.focused or (menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.focused==false)
            or player:GetAttribute("Spectate") or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or skillProtected(character) then return false end
        if ragdolled(character) and control.nativeEscapeSubmitted then return false end
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        if not dash or type(dash.requestNative)~="function" then
            control.lastReason="Native dash controller is unavailable"
            return false
        end
        control.lastAttempt=now
        local ok,submitted=pcall(dash.requestNative)
        control.lastAction=if ok and submitted==true then action else nil
        if ok and submitted==true then
            control.lastRecoveryDashAt=now
            if action=='Get-Up Dash' then control.getUpGuardUntil=now+control.getUpRepeatDelay end
        end
        control.lastReason=if ok and submitted==true then "Native recovery requested; game cooldowns and charges apply" elseif ok then "Native dash was not submitted" else tostring(submitted)
        if ok and submitted==true and ragdolled(character) then control.nativeEscapeSubmitted=true end
        return ok and submitted==true
    end
    function control.recover(character,now)
        if not ragdolled(character) or skillProtected(character) then control.release(character,inSkill(character));return false end
        now=now or host.os.clock()
        local action=control.readyAction(character,now,"Evasive or burst")
        if not control.performAction(character,now,action) then return false end
        local record = control.capture(character)
        if not record or record.humanoid.Health <= 0 or player:GetAttribute("Spectate") then return false end
        record.recovering = true
        return true
    end
    function control.readyAction(character, now, methodOverride)
        if skillProtected(character) then return nil end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not info or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or character:GetAttribute("Dead") then return nil end
        local timedRecovery = control.recoveryEnabled or (control.trueRagdollEnabled and control.isTrueRagdoll(character))
        if timedRecovery and ragdolled(character) and not (completeReady(character, now) or trueRagdollReady(character, now)) then return nil end
        local knocked = ragdolled(character) or info:FindFirstChild("Knockback") ~= nil
        local occupied = knocked or info:FindFirstChild("Stun") ~= nil or info:FindFirstChild("InSkill") ~= nil
        local burst = character:GetAttribute("Burst") and not info:GetAttribute("Burst")
        local method=methodOverride or control.method
        if (method == "Burst" or method == "Evasive or burst") and occupied and burst then return "Burst" end
        local allowed = method == "Evasive" or method == "Evasive or burst"
        local charge = (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Evade")) or 0) >= 50
        local forced = info:FindFirstChild("ForceEsc")
        charge = charge or (forced ~= nil and forced.Value == true)
        if not info:FindFirstChild("Knockback") and not (forced and forced.Value) then charge = false end
        if not allowed or not knocked or not charge or not control.ragdollSince or now-control.ragdollSince+0.0000001 < control.delay/1000 then return nil end
        -- Complete recovery cooldown and true-ragdoll delay retain the escape gate.
        -- The game must still provide an evasive charge or an available burst.
        if not (completeReady(character, now) or trueRagdollReady(character, now)) then
            for _, marker in info:GetChildren() do if marker:GetAttribute("Disable") then return nil end end
        end
        return "Evasive"
    end
    function control.stepGetUp(character,now)
        if not control.enabled or control.method~="Dash After Get-Up" or not control.focused
            or (menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.focused==false) then
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil
            return
        end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if now<control.getUpGuardUntil or (aim and aim.priorityInput and aim.priorityInput()) then
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil;return
        end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or player:GetAttribute("Spectate") then
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil;return
        end
        if skillProtected(character) then
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil;return
        end
        if ragdolled(character) then
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=true,nil;return
        end
        if control.getUpRagdolled then
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,{deadline=now+2}
        end
        if not control.getUpPending then return end
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        local last=control.lastRecoveryDashAt or -math.huge
        if dash and dash.lastNativeDashCharacter==character then last=math.max(last,dash.lastNativeDashAt or -math.huge) end
        if now-last<control.getUpRepeatDelay then
            -- An evasive/manual dash already used this recovery. Consume the
            -- automatic attempt instead of replaying it when the timer expires.
            control.getUpGuardUntil=last+control.getUpRepeatDelay
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil;return
        end
        if now>control.getUpPending.deadline then control.getUpPending=nil;return end
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if humanoid.PlatformStand or state==types.Physics or state==types.Ragdoll or state==types.FallingDown
            or state==types.PlatformStanding or state==types.GettingUp or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if not control.getUpPending.uprightAt then
            control.getUpPending.uprightAt,control.getUpPending.deadline=now,now+0.15
        end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return end
        for _,name in {"InSkill","Stun","TrueStun","Knockback","Block","NoDash","NoMove"} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return end end
        local keys=host.Enum.KeyCode
        if not keys or type(input.IsKeyDown)~="function" then return end
        local x=(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.D) or input:IsKeyDown(keys.Right) then 1 else 0)-(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.A) or input:IsKeyDown(keys.Left) then 1 else 0)
        local z=(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.S) or input:IsKeyDown(keys.Down) then 1 else 0)-(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.W) or input:IsKeyDown(keys.Up) then 1 else 0)
        if x==0 and z==0 then return end
        local dashBinding=bindings.get("Dash")
        local manualDash=false
        if type(dashBinding)=="table" then
            if dashBinding.kind=="Keyboard" and keys[dashBinding.name] then manualDash=input:IsKeyDown(keys[dashBinding.name])
            elseif dashBinding.kind=="Mouse" and host.Enum.UserInputType and input.IsMouseButtonPressed then
                local button=host.Enum.UserInputType[dashBinding.name]
                manualDash=button and input:IsMouseButtonPressed(button) or false
            end
        end
        if manualDash then control.getUpGuardUntil=now+control.getUpRepeatDelay;control.getUpPending=nil;return end
        -- Let native controls publish MoveDirection; otherwise DashRequest
        -- defaults to Front and would ignore an A/S/D key held during recovery.
        local movement=humanoid.MoveDirection
        if not movement or movement.Magnitude<0.01 then return end
        local camera=host.workspace and host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera and host.Vector3 then
            local expected=camera.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(host.Vector3.new(x,0,z))
            local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(expected.X,0,expected.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude<0.01 or horizontal.Unit:Dot(movement.Unit)<0.5 then return end
        end
        control.getUpPending=nil
        control.performAction(character,now,"Get-Up Dash")
    end
    function control.step(now)
        if not control.alive then return end
        local character = player.Character
        for tracked in control.records do if tracked ~= character then control.release(tracked) end end
        for tracked in control.skillGuards do if tracked~=character or not tracked.Parent then releaseGuard(tracked) end end
        if control.character ~= character then
            control.character = character
            control.ragdollSince, control.completeSince, control.trueRagdollSince, control.lastAttempt = nil, nil, nil, -math.huge
            control.lastCompleteRecoveryAt,control.completeRecoveredThisEpisode=-math.huge,false
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil
            control.getUpGuardUntil,control.lastRecoveryDashAt=-math.huge,nil
            control.nativeEscapeSubmitted=nil
        end
        if not character or not ragdolled(character) then
            if control.nativeEscapeSubmitted then control.lastAttempt=-math.huge end
            control.completeRecoveredThisEpisode=false;control.nativeEscapeSubmitted=nil
        end
        if not (control.enabled or control.recoveryEnabled or control.trueRagdollEnabled) then return end
        if not character or not character.Parent then
            control.ragdollSince, control.completeSince, control.trueRagdollSince = nil, nil, nil
            control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil
            return
        end
        ensureGuard(character)
        if control.method=="Dash After Get-Up" and control.enabled then control.stepGetUp(character,now) end
        if inSkill(character) then
            local guard=control.skillGuards[character]
            if guard then guard.protect() else control.release(character,true) end
            return
        end
        if skillProtected(character) then control.release(character,true);return end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local knocked = ragdolled(character) or (info and info:FindFirstChild("Knockback") ~= nil)
        local restricted = control.isTrueRagdoll(character)
        if knocked then control.ragdollSince = control.ragdollSince or now else control.ragdollSince = nil end
        if ragdolled(character) then control.completeSince = control.completeSince or now else control.completeSince = nil end
        if restricted then control.trueRagdollSince = control.trueRagdollSince or now else control.trueRagdollSince = nil end
        local record = control.records[character]
        if record and record.sawRagdoll and not ragdolled(character) then control.release(character) end
        if control.trueRagdollEnabled and not restricted and not control.recoveryEnabled
            and not (control.enabled and control.method == "Movement recovery") then control.release(character) end
        if control.recoveryEnabled or (control.trueRagdollEnabled and restricted) then
            local complete=completeReady(character,now)
            if complete or trueRagdollReady(character, now) then
                if control.recover(character,now) and complete and not control.completeRecoveredThisEpisode then
                    control.lastCompleteRecoveryAt,control.completeRecoveredThisEpisode=now,true
                end
            elseif not ragdolled(character) then control.release(character) end
            -- Complete recovery uses a cooldown between episodes, independently of charges.
            if not control.enabled or control.method == "Movement recovery" then return end
        elseif not control.enabled then control.release(character); return
        elseif control.method == "Movement recovery" then control.recover(character,now); return end
        if player:GetAttribute("Spectate") or host.game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local action = control.readyAction(character, now)
        if not action or now-control.lastAttempt < 0.2 then return end
        control.performAction(character,now,action)
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        control.enabled = value == true
        menu.environment._G.AntiRagdoll = false
        control.ragdollSince, control.lastAttempt = nil, -math.huge
        control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil
        if not control.enabled and not control.recoveryEnabled and not control.trueRagdollEnabled then
            for character in control.records do control.release(character) end
            for character in control.skillGuards do releaseGuard(character) end
        end
    end
    function control.setMethod(value)
        for character in control.records do control.release(character) end
        control.method, control.ragdollSince = value, nil
        control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil
    end
    function control.setDelay(value) control.delay = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 0, 0, 1000) end
    function control.setRecoveryDelay(value) control.recoveryDelay = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 800, 0, 3000) end
    function control.setRecoveryEnabled(value)
        for character in control.records do control.release(character) end
        control.recoveryEnabled, control.ragdollSince, control.completeSince = value == true, nil, nil
        if not control.enabled and not control.recoveryEnabled and not control.trueRagdollEnabled then for character in control.skillGuards do releaseGuard(character) end end
    end
    function control.setTrueRagdollDelay(value) control.trueRagdollDelay = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 800, 0, 3000) end
    function control.setTrueRagdollEnabled(value)
        for character in control.records do control.release(character) end
        control.trueRagdollEnabled, control.trueRagdollSince = value == true, nil
        if not control.enabled and not control.recoveryEnabled and not control.trueRagdollEnabled then for character in control.skillGuards do releaseGuard(character) end end
    end
    local connection = host.game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Connect(function() control.step(host.os.clock()) end)
    if input.WindowFocusReleased then table.insert(control.connections,input.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
        control.focused=false;control.getUpRagdolled,control.getUpPending=nil,nil
    end)) end
    if input.WindowFocused then table.insert(control.connections,input.WindowFocused:Connect(function()control.focused=true end)) end
    function control.Destroy()
        control.setTrueRagdollEnabled(false)
        control.setRecoveryEnabled(false)
        control.setEnabled(false)
        control.ragdollSince, control.completeSince, control.trueRagdollSince, control.character = nil, nil, nil, nil
        control.alive = false
        connection:Disconnect()
        for _,owned in control.connections do owned:Disconnect() end
    end
    return control
end
return RagdollControl
end)()

local ModeratorHop = (function(): any
-- Detect explicit staff flags or creator-group roles; names alone are not evidence.
local ModeratorHop: {[string]: any} = {}
function ModeratorHop.isStaffRole(role: any): boolean
    if type(role) ~= "string" then return false end
    local name = role:lower()
    for _, word in {"moderator", "moderation", "administrator", "admin", "developer", "owner", "staff"} do
        if name:find("%f[%a]"..word.."%f[%A]") then return true end
    end
    return false
end
function ModeratorHop.new(host: {[string]: any}, hop: any): any
    local game = host.game
    local players = game:GetService("Players")
    local monitor: any = {alive = true, enabled = false, generation = 0, pending = {}, connections = {}, lastHop = -math.huge, elapsed = 0}
    local function connect(signal, fn) table.insert(monitor.connections, signal:Connect(fn)) end
    function monitor.reason(player: any): string?
        for _, attribute in {"Moderator", "IsModerator", "Admin", "IsAdmin"} do
            if player:GetAttribute(attribute) == true then return "Game staff flag: "..attribute end
        end
        if game.CreatorType == host.Enum.CreatorType.User then
            return if player.UserId == game.CreatorId then "Experience creator" else nil
        end
        if game.CreatorType ~= host.Enum.CreatorType.Group then return nil end
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return game:GetService("GroupService"):GetRolesInGroupAsync(player.UserId, game.CreatorId) end)
        if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then monitor.lookupError = if ok then "Invalid role response" else tostring(result); return nil end
        for _, role in result.Roles or {} do
            if ModeratorHop.isStaffRole(role.Name) then return "Creator-group role: "..role.Name end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function monitor.scan(player: any): ()
        if not monitor.enabled or not monitor.alive or player == players.LocalPlayer or monitor.pending[player] then return end
        local generation = monitor.generation
        monitor.pending[player] = host.task.defer(function()
            local reason = monitor.reason(player)
            monitor.pending[player] = nil
            if not monitor.alive or not monitor.enabled or monitor.generation ~= generation or player.Parent ~= players then return end
            if reason and host.os.clock()-monitor.lastHop >= 15 then
                monitor.lastHop, monitor.lastReason = host.os.clock(), reason
                local ok, message = pcall(hop)
                if not ok then host.warn("Culling Hub server hop: "..tostring(message)) end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function observe(player)
        connect(player.AttributeChanged, function(attribute)
            if attribute == "Moderator" or attribute == "IsModerator" or attribute == "Admin" or attribute == "IsAdmin" then monitor.scan(player) end
        end)
        monitor.scan(player)
    end
    function monitor.setEnabled(value)
        monitor.enabled, monitor.generation = value == true, monitor.generation+1
        for _, thread in monitor.pending do pcall(host.task.cancel, thread) end
        table.clear(monitor.pending)
        if monitor.enabled then for _, player in players:GetPlayers() do monitor.scan(player) end end
    end
    for _, player in players:GetPlayers() do observe(player) end
    connect(players.PlayerAdded, observe)
    connect(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function(delta)
        if not monitor.enabled then return end
        monitor.elapsed += delta
        if monitor.elapsed >= 60 then monitor.elapsed = 0; for _, player in players:GetPlayers() do monitor.scan(player) end end
    end)
    function monitor.Destroy()
        monitor.alive = false
        monitor.setEnabled(false)
        for _, connection in monitor.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(monitor.connections)
    end
    return monitor
end
return ModeratorHop
end)()

local StunRecovery = (function(): any
-- Client movement recovery. Server-side escape and ability rules still apply.
local StunRecovery: {[string]: any} = {}
function StunRecovery.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any?): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local control: any = {alive = true, enabled = false, trueStun = false, milliseconds = 800, connections = {}, records = {}}
    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(control.connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function inSkill(character,info)
        local value=character:GetAttribute("InSkill")
        local guard=menu and menu.antiStunSpeed
        local startup=guard and guard.skillStartupProtected and guard.skillStartupProtected(character)
        return startup==true or info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")~=nil or value==true or (type(value)=="number" and value>0)
    end
    local function restoreOwned(record)
        record.restoring=true
        if record.hold then record.hold:Destroy();record.hold=nil end
        for marker in record.suspended do
            if marker.Parent==record.storage and record.info.Parent then marker.Parent=record.info end
            record.suspended[marker]=nil
        end
        record.restoring=false
        record.since,record.deadline=nil,nil
        table.clear(record.eligible)
    end
    function control.release(character)
        local record = control.records[character]
        if not record then return end
        control.records[character] = nil
        for _, connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        restoreOwned(record)
        record.storage:Destroy()
    end
    function control.track(character, now)
        if control.records[character] then return end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not info then return end
        local storage = host.Instance.new("Folder")
        storage.Name, storage.Parent = "CullingSuspendedHitStun", character
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local record: any = {info = info, storage = storage, suspended = {}, eligible={}, ignored=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}), connections = {}, since = nil, deadline = nil, health=humanoid and humanoid.Health, incomingUntil=-math.huge, skillUntil=-math.huge}
        control.records[character] = record
        local function protectSkill()
            restoreOwned(record)
            record.incomingUntil=-math.huge
            record.skillUntil=host.os.clock()+0.2
            -- These exact native instances belong to the skill's cleanup.
            -- Never reclaim them just because InSkill disappears first.
            for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do
                if marker.Name=="Stun" or marker.Name=="TrueStun" then record.ignored[marker]=true end
            end
        end
        record.protectSkill=protectSkill
        local function incoming(now)
            if inSkill(character,info) or now<record.skillUntil then return false end
            return now<=record.incomingUntil or info:FindFirstChild("Knockback")~=nil or (tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")) or 0)>0
        end
        record.incoming=incoming
        local function added(marker)
            if record.restoring then return end
            if marker.Name=="InSkill" or inSkill(character,info) then protectSkill();return end
            if (marker.Name ~= "Stun" and marker.Name ~= "TrueStun") or marker == record.hold or not (control.enabled or control.trueStun) then return end
            if host.os.clock()<record.skillUntil then record.ignored[marker]=true;return end
            if record.ignored[marker] or not incoming(host.os.clock()) then return end
            record.eligible[marker]=true
            record.since = host.os.clock()
            record.deadline = record.since+(if control.trueStun then 0 else control.milliseconds/1000)
        end
        table.insert(record.connections, info.ChildAdded:Connect(added))
        if character.GetAttributeChangedSignal then
            table.insert(record.connections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("InSkill"):Connect(function()
                if inSkill(character,info) then protectSkill() end
            end))
        end
        if humanoid then
            table.insert(record.connections,humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
                local health=humanoid.Health
                if record.health and health<record.health and not inSkill(character,info) and host.os.clock()>=record.skillUntil then record.incomingUntil=host.os.clock()+0.35 end
                record.health=health
            end))
        end
        if inSkill(character,info) then protectSkill() else for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do added(marker) end end
    end
    function control.step(now)
        if not control.alive or not (control.enabled or control.trueStun) then return end
        local character = player.Character
        for old in control.records do if old ~= character or not old.Parent then control.release(old) end end
        if not character or not character.Parent then return end
        control.track(character, now)
        local record = control.records[character]
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not record then return end
        -- Server deletion (or another native owner moving a marker away) ends
        -- our ownership. Do not retain every completed stun for this character.
        for marker in record.suspended do
            if marker.Parent ~= record.storage then record.suspended[marker] = nil end
        end
        for marker in record.eligible do
            if marker.Parent~=record.info and marker.Parent~=record.storage then record.eligible[marker]=nil end
        end
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then control.release(character);return end
        if inSkill(character,record.info) then record.protectSkill();return end
        if now<record.skillUntil then restoreOwned(record);return end
        -- A damage update may arrive just after the native marker. Adopt it
        -- only with incoming evidence; bare own-action stuns remain untouched.
        if not record.deadline and record.incoming(now) then
            for _,marker in record.info:GetChildren() do
                if (marker.Name=="Stun" or marker.Name=="TrueStun") and not record.ignored[marker] then
                    record.eligible[marker]=true
                    record.since=now;record.deadline=now+(if control.trueStun then 0 else control.milliseconds/1000)
                end
            end
        end
        if not record.deadline then return end
        if now+0.0000001 < record.deadline then
            -- Preserve a requested longer interval after a shorter native stun ends.
            if not record.hold then
                local marker = host.Instance.new("BoolValue")
                record.hold = marker
                marker.Name = "Stun"
                marker:SetAttribute("CullingRecoveryHold", true)
                marker.Parent = record.info
            end
            return
        end
        if record.hold then record.hold:Destroy(); record.hold = nil end
        -- Move live markers aside rather than destroying the game's instances.
        -- A subsequent server deletion can still remove these original markers.
        for _, marker in record.info:GetChildren() do
            if record.eligible[marker] and (marker.Name == "Stun" or (control.trueStun and marker.Name == "TrueStun")) then
                record.suspended[marker] = true
                marker.Parent = record.storage
            end
        end
        table.clear(record.eligible)
        record.deadline = nil
    end
    function control.setMilliseconds(value)
        control.milliseconds = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 800, 0, 3000)
        for _, record in control.records do
            if record.deadline and record.since then record.deadline = record.since+(if control.trueStun then 0 else control.milliseconds/1000) end
        end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        control.enabled = value == true
        if not control.enabled and not control.trueStun then for character in control.records do control.release(character) end
        else control.step(host.os.clock()) end
    end
    function control.setTrueStun(value)
        control.trueStun = value == true
        if not control.enabled and not control.trueStun then
            for character in control.records do control.release(character) end
        else
            for _, record in control.records do
                if record.deadline and record.since then record.deadline = record.since+(if control.trueStun then 0 else control.milliseconds/1000) end
            end
            control.step(host.os.clock())
        end
    end
    connect(host.game:GetService("RunService").Stepped, function() control.step(host.os.clock()) end)
    function control.Destroy()
        control.setTrueStun(false)
        control.setEnabled(false)
        control.alive = false
        for _, connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
    end
    return control
end
return StunRecovery
end)()

local RespawnControl = (function(): any
-- Use only the native reset request. Sent is not proof of server acceptance.
local RespawnControl: {[string]: any} = {}
function RespawnControl.attach(host: {[string]: any}, player: any, reset: any): any
    local control: any = {alive=true,enabled=false,connections={},characterConnections={},requested=nil,lastRequest=-math.huge,requestCharacter=nil,generation=0,deathAttempts=0,retryPending=false,status='Idle',sentCount=0,respawnCount=0,responseTimeout=2}
    local function dead(character: any): boolean
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return humanoid~=nil and (humanoid.Health<=0 or character:GetAttribute('Dead')==true)
    end
    local function notifyStatus(status: string)
        control.status=status
        control.statusAt=host.os.clock()
    end
    local function scheduleRetry(character: any,delay: number)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or control.deathAttempts>=2 or not host.task or not host.task.delay then return end
        local generation=control.generation
        control.retryPending=true
        host.task.delay(delay,function()
            if not control.alive or generation~=control.generation then return end
            control.retryPending=false
            control.onDeath(character)
        end)
    end
    local function watchResponse(pending: any)
        if not host.task or not host.task.delay then return end
        local generation=control.generation
        host.task.delay(control.responseTimeout,function()
            if not control.alive or generation~=control.generation or control.pending~=pending then return end
            control.pending=nil;control.requested=nil
            notifyStatus('Unconfirmed')
            -- No response or lifecycle progress is observable, not acceptance.
            -- Only an automatic dead-character request may get one retry.
            if (pending.source=='death' or pending.retryWhenDead) and not pending.receivedReply and control.enabled
                and player.Character==pending.character and dead(pending.character)
                and control.removingCharacter~=pending.character and control.deathAttempts<2 then
                control.onDeath(pending.character)
            end
        end)
    end
    function control.request(character: any,source: string?): (boolean, number?)
        if not control.alive or not character or character~=player.Character then return false,nil end
        local remaining=0.35-(host.os.clock()-control.lastRequest)
        if control.requestCharacter==character and remaining>0 then return false,remaining end
        local pending: any={character=character,source=source or 'manual',at=host.os.clock()}
        control.pending=pending;control.requested=character
        control.rejectedCharacter=nil;control.notifiedCharacter=nil
        notifyStatus('Sending')
        local ok,message=pcall(function() reset:Fire() end)
        control.lastError=if ok then nil else tostring(message)
        if not ok then
            if control.pending==pending then control.pending=nil;control.requested=nil;notifyStatus('SendFailed') end
            host.warn('Shenaniganism reset: '..tostring(message))
            return false,nil
        end
        control.lastRequest,control.requestCharacter=host.os.clock(),character
        control.sentCount+=1
        -- Compatibility: requested identifies the last outstanding SENT request.
        if control.pending==pending then
            if not pending.receivedReply then notifyStatus('Sent') end
            watchResponse(pending)
        end
        return true,nil
    end
    function control.onDeath(character: any)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or character~=player.Character
            or control.retryPending or control.deathAttempts>=2 or control.removingCharacter==character
            or control.rejectedCharacter==character or control.notifiedCharacter==character or not dead(character) then return end
        if control.pending and control.pending.character==character then
            if control.pending.source=='manual' and not control.pending.receivedReply then
                control.pending.retryWhenDead=true;control.deathAttempts=math.max(1,control.deathAttempts)
            end
            return
        end
        control.deathAttempts+=1
        local ok,remaining=control.request(character,'death')
        if not ok then scheduleRetry(character,if remaining then remaining+1/60 else 0.1) end
    end
    local function explicitRejection(value: any): boolean
        if type(value)~='string' then return false end
        local text=value:lower():gsub('\226\128\153',"'"):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','')
        return text=="you're currently using a skill / stunned!"
    end
    function control.onResetReply(title: any,body: any)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.lastReply={title=if type(title)=='string' then title else nil,body=if type(body)=='string' then body else nil,at=host.os.clock()}
        local pending=control.pending
        if not pending or pending.character~=player.Character then return end
        pending.receivedReply=true
        if explicitRejection(title) or explicitRejection(body) then
            control.rejectedCharacter=pending.character
            control.pending=nil;control.requested=nil
            control.generation+=1;control.retryPending=false
            notifyStatus('Rejected')
        else
            -- The native handler displays title/text, not an accepted boolean.
            control.notifiedCharacter=pending.character
            notifyStatus('Notified')
        end
    end
    function control.onRemoving(character: any)
        if not control.alive then return end
        character=character or player.Character
        if character~=control.trackedCharacter and character~=control.requestCharacter then return end
        control.removingCharacter=character
        control.generation+=1;control.retryPending=false
        control.pending=nil;control.requested=nil
        notifyStatus('Respawning')
    end
    function control.track(character: any)
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        local previous=control.trackedCharacter
        control.trackedCharacter=character
        control.generation+=1
        control.pending,control.requested,control.requestCharacter=nil,nil,nil
        control.rejectedCharacter,control.notifiedCharacter,control.removingCharacter=nil,nil,nil
        control.deathAttempts,control.retryPending,control.lastRequest=0,false,-math.huge
        if previous and previous~=character then control.respawnCount+=1;notifyStatus('Respawned') else notifyStatus('Idle') end
        local function humanoidAdded(humanoid: any)
            if not humanoid:IsA('Humanoid') then return end
            table.insert(control.characterConnections,humanoid.Died:Connect(function() control.onDeath(character) end))
            table.insert(control.characterConnections,humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function() control.onDeath(character) end))
        end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid then humanoidAdded(humanoid) end
        table.insert(control.characterConnections,character.ChildAdded:Connect(humanoidAdded))
        table.insert(control.characterConnections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Dead'):Connect(function() control.onDeath(character) end))
        control.onDeath(character)
    end
    function control.forceReset()
        local character=player.Character
        if not character then return false end
        return control.request(character,'manual')
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: boolean)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.enabled=value==true
        control.generation+=1
        control.deathAttempts,control.retryPending=0,false
        control.rejectedCharacter,control.notifiedCharacter=nil,nil
        if control.pending then
            -- Keep a sent request observable while canceling prior scheduled work.
            if control.pending.source=='death' or control.pending.retryWhenDead then control.deathAttempts=1 end
            watchResponse(control.pending)
        end
        if control.enabled and player.Character then control.onDeath(player.Character) end
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(control.track))
    if player.CharacterRemoving and type(player.CharacterRemoving.Connect)=='function' then
        table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(control.onRemoving))
    end
    if reset and type(reset.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(control.connections,reset:Connect(control.onResetReply)) end
    if player.Character then control.track(player.Character) end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive,control.enabled=false,false
        control.generation+=1
        control.retryPending=false;control.pending=nil;control.requested=nil
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.characterConnections)
        notifyStatus('Unloaded')
    end
    return control
end
function RespawnControl.new(host: {[string]: any}): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local knit=host.require(host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').Knit.Knit)
    return RespawnControl.attach(host,player,knit.GetService('JoinService').Reset)
end
return RespawnControl
end)()

local KnockbackControl = (function(): any
-- Change each incoming local knockback once; native decay and recovery keep control.
local KnockbackControl: {[string]: any} = {}

function KnockbackControl.new(host: {[string]: any}): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local typeOfValue: any = host.typeof or typeof
    local control: any = {
        alive = true, enabled = false, amount = 100, amountUnit = 'percent', direction = 'Native', reverseControls = false, target = "Self",
        windowFocused = true,
        records = {}, models = {}, connections = {},
        used = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
    }

    local function finiteNumber(value)
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end

    local function finiteVector(value)
        return typeOfValue(value) == "Vector3" and finiteNumber(value.X) and finiteNumber(value.Y) and finiteNumber(value.Z)
    end
    local inputOk,input=pcall(function() return host.game:GetService('UserInputService') end)
    control.input=if inputOk then input else nil
    control.directionOptions={'Native','Reverse','Forward','Backward','Left','Right','Forward Left','Forward Right','Backward Left','Backward Right','Keypress Direction'}

    local function activeEpisode(model)
        if model ~= player.Character or not model.Parent then return false end
        local info = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if info and (info:FindFirstChild("Knockback") or info:FindFirstChild("Stun") or info:FindFirstChild("TrueStun")) then
            return true
        end
        local ragdoll = model:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")
        return (finiteNumber(ragdoll) and ragdoll > 0) or model:GetAttribute("Stun") == true
    end

    local function disconnect(connections)
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end

    function control.inKnockback()
        local model=player.Character
        if not model or not activeEpisode(model) then return false end
        for mover,record in control.records do
            if record.model==model and mover.Parent and mover:IsDescendantOf(model) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.movementKeyHeld()
        local currentInput=control.input
        if not currentInput or not control.windowFocused or currentInput:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        if not host.Enum then return false end
        for _,name in {'W','A','S','D','Up','Down','Left','Right'} do
            if currentInput:IsKeyDown(host.Enum.KeyCode[name]) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.detachControls()
        local hook=control.movementHook
        if hook and hook.controller.GetMoveVector==hook.wrapper then hook.controller.GetMoveVector=hook.original end
        control.movementHook=nil
    end
    function control.shouldReverse()
        return control.alive and control.enabled and control.reverseControls and control.movementKeyHeld() and control.inKnockback()
    end
    function control.attachControls()
        if not control.enabled or not control.reverseControls then control.detachControls();return end
        if not control.controls and player.FindFirstChild then
            local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
            local module=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('PlayerModule')
            if module then
                local ok,result=pcall(function() return (host.require or require)(module):GetControls() end)
                if ok and type(result)=='table' then control.controls=result end
            end
        end
        local active=control.controls and control.controls.activeController
        if control.movementHook and control.movementHook.controller==active then return end
        control.detachControls()
        if not active or type(active.GetMoveVector)~='function' then return end
        local original=active.GetMoveVector
        local function wrapper(self,...)
            local vector=original(self,...)
            if control.shouldReverse() and finiteVector(vector) then return host.Vector3.new(-vector.X,vector.Y,-vector.Z) end
            return vector
        end
        control.movementHook={controller=active,original=original,wrapper=wrapper}
        active.GetMoveVector=wrapper
    end
    function control.rawMovement()
        if not control.movementKeyHeld() then return nil end
        local active=control.controls and control.controls.activeController
        if active and type(active.GetMoveVector)=='function' then
            local hook=control.movementHook
            local reader=if hook and hook.controller==active then hook.original else active.GetMoveVector
            local vector=reader(active)
            if finiteVector(vector) and (vector.X~=0 or vector.Z~=0) then return host.Vector3.new(vector.X,0,vector.Z) end
        end
        local currentInput,keys=control.input,host.Enum.KeyCode
        local function down(a,b) return currentInput:IsKeyDown(keys[a]) or currentInput:IsKeyDown(keys[b]) end
        local x=(if down('D','Right') then 1 else 0)-(if down('A','Left') then 1 else 0)
        local z=(if down('S','Down') then 1 else 0)-(if down('W','Up') then 1 else 0)
        return if x~=0 or z~=0 then host.Vector3.new(x,0,z) else nil
    end
    function control.resolveDirection(mode,model,native)
        if mode=='Native' then return native.Unit end
        if mode=='Reverse' then return native.Unit*-1 end
        local camera=host.workspace and host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local root=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local frame=(camera and camera.CFrame) or (root and root.CFrame)
        if not frame then return native.Unit end
        local look=frame.LookVector
        local forward=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        if forward.Magnitude<0.001 then
            local right=frame.RightVector
            forward=host.Vector3.new(right.Z,0,-right.X)
        end
        if forward.Magnitude<0.001 then return native.Unit end
        forward=forward.Unit
        local right=host.Vector3.new(-forward.Z,0,forward.X)
        local directions={Forward={0,-1},Backward={0,1},Left={-1,0},Right={1,0},['Forward Left']={-1,-1},['Forward Right']={1,-1},['Backward Left']={-1,1},['Backward Right']={1,1}}
        local choice=directions[mode]
        local x,z
        if mode=='Keypress Direction' then
            local movement=control.rawMovement()
            if not movement then return native.Unit end
            local sign=if control.reverseControls then -1 else 1
            x,z=movement.X*sign,movement.Z*sign
        elseif choice then x,z=choice[1],choice[2]
        else return native.Unit end
        local vector=host.Vector3.new(right.X*x-forward.X*z,0,right.Z*x-forward.Z*z)
        return if vector.Magnitude>0.001 then vector.Unit else native.Unit
    end

    function control.release(mover, restoreForce)
        local record = control.records[mover]
        if not record then return end
        control.records[mover] = nil
        disconnect(record.connections)
        if restoreForce==true and record.linearForce and record.forceOwned and activeEpisode(record.model) and mover.Parent and mover:IsDescendantOf(record.model) then
            for _,property in {'MaxAxesForce','ForceLimitMode','ForceLimitsEnabled'} do
                if mover[property]==record.linearForce.applied[property] then mover[property]=record.linearForce.base[property] end
            end
        end
        -- Never replay a captured velocity. Only undo an owned zero-force setting
        -- on a deliberate disable while the same native episode is still active.
        if restoreForce == true and record.forceProperty and record.forceOwned and activeEpisode(record.model)
            and mover.Parent and mover:IsDescendantOf(record.model) then
            pcall(function()
                if mover[record.forceProperty] == record.forceApplied then
                    mover[record.forceProperty] = record.forceBase
                end
            end)
        end
        if restoreForce == true and record.done and mover.Parent and mover:IsDescendantOf(record.model)
            and (if record.amount == 0 then record.forceOwned else mover[record.property] == record.applied) and not activeEpisode(record.model) then
            mover:Destroy()
        end
    end

    function control.apply(mover)
        local record = control.records[mover]
        if not record or record.done then return end
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not mover.Parent or not mover:IsDescendantOf(record.model)
            or not activeEpisode(record.model) then
            control.release(mover, false)
            return
        end
        local base = mover[record.property]
        if not finiteVector(base) then
            control.release(mover, false)
            return
        end
        -- A mover may be parented before its initial vector is assigned.
        -- Wait for that first nonzero vector; never watch subsequent native decay.
        if record.amount ~= 0 then
            if not finiteNumber(base.Magnitude) then
                control.release(mover, false)
                return
            end
            if base.Magnitude == 0 then return end
        end
        local horizontal = host.Vector3.new(base.X,0,base.Z)
        if horizontal.Magnitude == 0 then control.release(mover,false); return end
        -- Incoming force must never invert or amplify the native vertical lift.
        -- Percentage of this mover's original horizontal push, sampled once.
        -- Later native damping writes must never become a new scaling baseline.
        local horizontalMagnitude = horizontal.Magnitude
        local ratio = record.amount / 100
        local speed = horizontalMagnitude * ratio
        local adjusted = if record.direction == 'Native' then horizontal * ratio
            else control.resolveDirection(record.direction,record.model,horizontal) * speed
        local applied = if record.direction == 'Native' and record.amount == 100 then base
            else host.Vector3.new(adjusted.X,base.Y,adjusted.Z)
        if not finiteVector(applied) then
            control.release(mover, false)
            return
        end
        record.done, record.base, record.applied = true, base, applied
        record.nativeHorizontalMagnitude = horizontalMagnitude
        if record.vectorConnection then
            record.vectorConnection:Disconnect()
            record.vectorConnection = nil
        end
        if record.amount == 0 then
            local forceProperty = if mover:IsA("BodyVelocity") then "MaxForce" else "Enabled"
            record.forceProperty, record.forceBase = forceProperty, mover[forceProperty]
            -- Zero horizontal push must not leave a zero-velocity horizontal lock.
            if forceProperty ~= "MaxForce" then
                -- Cancel horizontal authority, rather than commanding a stationary
                -- horizontal velocity that would pin native walking after recovery.
                local original={ForceLimitsEnabled=mover.ForceLimitsEnabled,ForceLimitMode=mover.ForceLimitMode,MaxAxesForce=mover.MaxAxesForce}
                local y=if not original.ForceLimitsEnabled then math.huge elseif original.ForceLimitMode==host.Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis then original.MaxAxesForce.Y else mover.MaxForce
                local settings={ForceLimitsEnabled=true,ForceLimitMode=host.Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis,MaxAxesForce=host.Vector3.new(0,y,0)}
                record.linearForce={base=original,applied=settings}
                record.forceOwned=true
                mover.MaxAxesForce=settings.MaxAxesForce
                mover.ForceLimitMode=settings.ForceLimitMode
                mover.ForceLimitsEnabled=settings.ForceLimitsEnabled
                record.applied=base
                for _,property in {'ForceLimitsEnabled','ForceLimitMode','MaxAxesForce'} do
                    table.insert(record.connections,mover:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function()
                        if mover[property]~=settings[property] then record.forceOwned=false end
                    end))
                end
                return
            end
            record.forceApplied = host.Vector3.new(0,record.forceBase.Y,0)
            record.forceOwned = true
            mover[forceProperty] = record.forceApplied
            table.insert(record.connections, mover:GetPropertyChangedSignal(forceProperty):Connect(function()
                if mover[forceProperty] ~= record.forceApplied then record.forceOwned = false end
            end))
        elseif applied ~= base then
            mover[record.property] = applied
        end
    end

    function control.observe(mover, model)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or model ~= player.Character or mover.Name ~= "KnockbackForce"
            or control.used[mover] or not mover:IsDescendantOf(model) then return end
        local property = if mover:IsA("BodyVelocity") then "Velocity"
            elseif mover:IsA("LinearVelocity") then "VectorVelocity"
            else nil
        if not property then return end
        control.used[mover] = true
        -- A named force seen while idle is stale or outside a confirmed incoming
        -- episode. Never pick it up later just because a new stun begins.
        if not activeEpisode(model) then return end
        if not finiteVector(mover[property]) then return end
        local record: any = {
            model = model, property = property, amount = control.amount, direction = control.direction,
            done = false, connections = {},
        }
        control.records[mover] = record
        record.vectorConnection = mover:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function() control.apply(mover) end)
        table.insert(record.connections, record.vectorConnection)
        table.insert(record.connections, mover.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
            if not mover:IsDescendantOf(model) then control.release(mover, false) end
        end))
        control.apply(mover)
    end

    local function forgetModels()
        for _, connections in control.models do disconnect(connections) end
        table.clear(control.models)
    end

    local function observeModel(model)
        if not model or model ~= player.Character or control.models[model] then return end
        control.models[model] = {
            model.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(mover) control.observe(mover, model) end),
        }
    end

    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then return end
        control.attachControls()
        for mover, record in control.records do
            if not mover.Parent or not mover:IsDescendantOf(record.model) or not activeEpisode(record.model) then
                if mover.Parent and record.done and mover:IsDescendantOf(record.model) and not activeEpisode(record.model) then
                    -- An owned leftover knockback constraint must not pin walking
                    -- after its actual recovery episode has finished.
                    local owned = if record.amount == 0 then record.forceOwned else mover[record.property] == record.applied
                    if owned then mover:Destroy() end
                end
                control.release(mover, false)
            end
        end
        local model = player.Character
        observeModel(model)
        if not model then return end
        for _, mover in model:GetDescendants() do control.observe(mover, model) end
    end

    function control.setEnabled(value)
        local enabled = value == true and control.alive
        if control.enabled == enabled then return end
        control.enabled = enabled
        if not enabled then
            for mover in control.records do control.release(mover, true) end
            disconnect(control.connections)
            forgetModels()
            control.detachControls()
            return
        end
        control.windowFocused=true
        local currentInput=control.input
        if currentInput and currentInput.WindowFocusReleased then
            table.insert(control.connections,currentInput.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() control.windowFocused=false end))
            table.insert(control.connections,currentInput.WindowFocused:Connect(function() control.windowFocused=true end))
        end
        if player.CharacterAdded then
            table.insert(control.connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(model)
                for mover in control.records do control.release(mover, false) end
                forgetModels()
                control.detachControls()
                control.controls=nil
                observeModel(model)
                control.refresh()
            end))
        end
        if player.CharacterRemoving then
            table.insert(control.connections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
                for mover in control.records do control.release(mover, false) end
                forgetModels()
                control.detachControls()
            end))
        end
        local elapsed = 0
        table.insert(control.connections, host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
            elapsed += delta
            if elapsed < 0.05 then return end
            elapsed = 0
            control.refresh()
        end))
        control.refresh()
    end

    -- Changes affect the next native mover, not an impulse already in progress.
    function control.setAmount(value)
        local amount = tonumber(value)
        control.amount = if finiteNumber(amount) then math.clamp(amount, 0, 1000) else 100
    end
    function control.setDirection(value)
        if table.find(control.directionOptions,value) then control.direction=value end
    end
    function control.setReverse(value) control.setDirection(if value then 'Reverse' else 'Native') end
    function control.setReverseControls(value)
        control.reverseControls=value==true
        control.attachControls()
    end
    function control.setTarget(_value) control.target = "Self" end
    function control.Destroy()
        control.setEnabled(false)
        control.alive = false
        disconnect(control.connections)
        forgetModels()
    end
    return control
end

return KnockbackControl
end)()

local HitboxControl = (function(): any
-- Extend client hit queries. Own collision uses invisible welded colliders,
-- preserving native body appearance. Authoritative damage checks are unchanged.
local HitboxControl: {[string]: any} = {}
local ownBodyParts = {
    HumanoidRootPart=true, Head=true, Torso=true,
    ["Left Arm"]=true, ["Right Arm"]=true, ["Left Leg"]=true, ["Right Leg"]=true,
    UpperTorso=true, LowerTorso=true,
    LeftUpperArm=true, LeftLowerArm=true, LeftHand=true,
    RightUpperArm=true, RightLowerArm=true, RightHand=true,
    LeftUpperLeg=true, LeftLowerLeg=true, LeftFoot=true,
    RightUpperLeg=true, RightLowerLeg=true, RightFoot=true,
}
local function attachOwnCollision(host: any, control: any): any
    local ok, players = pcall(function() return host.game:GetService("Players") end)
    local player = if ok and players then players.LocalPlayer else nil
    control.ownCollisionAvailable = player ~= nil and player.CharacterAdded ~= nil
        and player.CharacterRemoving ~= nil and host.Instance ~= nil
    control.ownCollisionEnabled, control.ownCollisionScale = false, 0.5
    local records, characterConnections, playerConnections = {}, {}, {}
    local character, deathConnection, humanoid, proxyFolder = nil, nil, nil, nil
    local function disconnectAll(connections)
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    local function restore(record)
        if record.proxy then record.proxy:Destroy(); record.proxy = nil end
        local applied = record.appliedCollision
        record.appliedCollision = nil
        if applied ~= nil and record.part.CanCollide == applied then
            record.writing = true
            pcall(function() record.part.CanCollide = record.nativeCollision end)
            record.writing = false
        end
    end
    local function prepareProxy(record)
        if record.proxy then return true end
        local part, proxy = record.part, nil
        local created = pcall(function()
            proxy = part:Clone()
            assert(proxy, "Body collider could not be cloned")
            proxy:ClearAllChildren()
            proxy.Name = "CullingOwnCollider_" .. part.Name
            proxy.Transparency, proxy.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1, 0
            proxy.CanCollide, proxy.CanTouch, proxy.CanQuery = false, false, false
            proxy.Massless, proxy.Anchored, proxy.CastShadow, proxy.RootPriority = true, false, false, -127
            proxy.Size, proxy.CFrame = part.Size * control.ownCollisionScale, part.CFrame
            local weld = host.Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = "CullingOwnColliderWeld", part, proxy, proxy
        end)
        if not created then
            if proxy then proxy:Destroy() end
            return false
        end
        record.proxy = proxy
        return true
    end
    local function apply(record)
        local part = record.part
        if not control.alive or not control.ownCollisionEnabled or part.Parent ~= character
            or not ownBodyParts[part.Name] or not record.nativeCollision or control.ownCollisionScale >= 1 then
            restore(record)
            return
        end
        if not prepareProxy(record) then return end
        local proxy = record.proxy
        local target = part.Size * control.ownCollisionScale
        if proxy.Size ~= target then proxy.Size = target end
        if proxy.CollisionGroup ~= part.CollisionGroup then proxy.CollisionGroup = part.CollisionGroup end
        if proxy.CustomPhysicalProperties ~= part.CustomPhysicalProperties then proxy.CustomPhysicalProperties = part.CustomPhysicalProperties end
        if part:IsA("Part") and proxy.Shape ~= part.Shape then proxy.Shape = part.Shape end
        if part.CanCollide then
            record.appliedCollision, record.writing = false, true
            local wrote = pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
            record.writing = false
            if not wrote or part.CanCollide then
                -- A competing collision writer wins; never retry in a loop.
                record.appliedCollision = nil
                proxy:Destroy(); record.proxy = nil
                return
            end
        end
        if not proxyFolder then
            proxyFolder = host.Instance.new("Folder")
            proxyFolder.Name, proxyFolder.Parent = "CullingOwnCollision", character
        end
        if proxy.Parent ~= proxyFolder then proxy.Parent = proxyFolder end
        if not proxy.CanCollide then proxy.CanCollide = true end
    end
    local function forget(part)
        local record = records[part]
        if not record then return end
        records[part] = nil
        disconnectAll(record.connections)
        restore(record)
    end
    local function unbindCharacter()
        disconnectAll(characterConnections)
        if deathConnection then deathConnection:Disconnect(); deathConnection = nil end
        humanoid = nil
        for part in records do forget(part) end
        if proxyFolder then proxyFolder:Destroy(); proxyFolder = nil end
        character = nil
    end
    local function track(part)
        if records[part] or part.Parent ~= character or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not ownBodyParts[part.Name] then return end
        local record = {part=part, nativeCollision=part.CanCollide, appliedCollision=nil, writing=false, connections={}}
        records[part] = record
