        table.insert(record.connections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
            if record.writing or part.CanCollide == record.appliedCollision then return end
            record.nativeCollision, record.appliedCollision = part.CanCollide, nil
            apply(record)
        end))
        -- Render geometry and appearance stay native. Only proxy properties
        -- change when the body, its collision settings, or the slider changes.
        for _, property in {"Size", "CollisionGroup", "CustomPhysicalProperties"} do
            table.insert(record.connections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function() apply(record) end))
        end
        if part:IsA("Part") then
            table.insert(record.connections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Shape"):Connect(function() apply(record) end))
        end
        table.insert(record.connections, part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(function() apply(record) end))
        apply(record)
    end
    local function trackHumanoid(child)
        if humanoid or not child:IsA("Humanoid") then return end
        humanoid = child
        if child.Died then deathConnection = child.Died:Connect(unbindCharacter) end
    end
    local function bindCharacter(nextCharacter)
        if character == nextCharacter then return end
        unbindCharacter()
        if not control.alive or not control.ownCollisionEnabled or not nextCharacter then return end
        character = nextCharacter
        table.insert(characterConnections, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) track(child); trackHumanoid(child) end))
        table.insert(characterConnections, character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
            forget(child)
            if child == humanoid then
                if deathConnection then deathConnection:Disconnect(); deathConnection=nil end
                humanoid=nil
            end
        end))
        for _, child in character:GetChildren() do track(child); trackHumanoid(child) end
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause() unbindCharacter() end
    function control.onFailsafeResume() if control.ownCollisionEnabled then bindCharacter(player.Character) end end
    function control.setOwnCollisionEnabled(value)
        if not control.alive or not control.ownCollisionAvailable then return false end
        local enabled = value == true
        if enabled == control.ownCollisionEnabled then return true end
        control.ownCollisionEnabled = enabled
        if enabled then
            table.insert(playerConnections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter))
            table.insert(playerConnections, player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(oldCharacter)
                if oldCharacter == character then unbindCharacter() end
            end))
            bindCharacter(player.Character)
        else
            disconnectAll(playerConnections)
            unbindCharacter()
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setOwnCollisionScale(value)
        if not control.alive or not control.ownCollisionAvailable or type(value) ~= "number"
            or value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then return false end
        control.ownCollisionScale = math.clamp(value, 0.1, 1)
        for _, record in records do apply(record) end
        return true
    end
    return function()
        control.ownCollisionEnabled = false
        disconnectAll(playerConnections)
        unbindCharacter()
    end
end
function HitboxControl.attach(host: {[string]: any}, module: any, sizeFor: any): any
    local original = module.SphereHitbox
    local control: any = {alive = true, original = original, previewEnabled = false, previews = {}, queryCount = 0, expandedCount = 0, method='Box bounds'}
    local destroyOwnCollision = attachOwnCollision(host, control)
    control.sizeFor = sizeFor
    local deadHumanoids=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local function actorAlive(model,humanoid)
        if not model.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or deadHumanoids[humanoid] then return false end
        if type(model.GetAttribute)=='function' and model:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then return false end
        if type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' and host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType then
            local ok,state=pcall(humanoid.GetState,humanoid)
            if ok and state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function releasePreview(model,record)
        if record.died then record.died:Disconnect();record.died=nil end
        record.part:Destroy()
        if control.previews[model]==record then control.previews[model]=nil end
    end
    function control.setMethod(value)
        if value~='Box bounds' and value~='Ellipsoid bounds' and value~='Native' then return false end
        control.method=value;return true
    end
    function control.bounds(model,amount)
        local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not actorAlive(model,humanoid) then return nil end
        local ok,scale=pcall(function() return model:GetScale() end)
        scale=if ok then math.clamp(scale,0.25,5) else 1
        local height=6*scale
        local x,y,z
        if type(amount)=='number' then x,y,z=amount,0,amount
        elseif typeof(amount)=='Vector3' then x,y,z=amount.X,amount.Y,amount.Z
        else return nil end
        if x~=x or y~=y or z~=z or math.abs(x)==math.huge or math.abs(y)==math.huge or math.abs(z)==math.huge
            or (x<=0 and y<=0 and z<=0) then return nil end
        x,y,z=math.clamp(x,0,40),math.clamp(y,0,40),math.clamp(z,0,40)
        -- Zero Y retains native body height. All bounds follow the actual
        -- actor's position and orientation without changing physical parts.
        return root.CFrame,host.Vector3.new(if x>0 then x else root.Size.X,if y>0 then y else height,if z>0 then z else root.Size.Z)
    end
    function control.updatePreview()
        local wanted = {}
        local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if control.alive and control.previewEnabled and folder then
            for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
                local amount, root = sizeFor(model), model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not amount or not root then continue end
                local frame,size=control.bounds(model,amount)
                if not frame then continue end
                wanted[model] = true
                local record = control.previews[model]
                local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                if record and record.humanoid~=humanoid then releasePreview(model,record);record=nil end
                if not record then
                    local part = host.Instance.new("Part")
                    part.Name, part.Transparency, part.Anchored = "CullingQueryPreview", 1, true
                    part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = false, false, false
                    part.Parent = control.previewFolder
                    local box = host.Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                    box.Name, box.Adornee, box.SurfaceTransparency = "CullingHitboxWireframe", part, 0.92
                    box.Color3, box.SurfaceColor3, box.Transparency, box.LineThickness = host.Color3.fromRGB(255,65,65),host.Color3.fromRGB(255,65,65),0.15,0.02
                    box.Parent = part
                    record = {part = part, box = box,root=root,humanoid=humanoid}
                    control.previews[model] = record
                    if humanoid and humanoid.Died then record.died=humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                        deadHumanoids[humanoid]=true;releasePreview(model,record)
                    end)end
                end
                record.part.CFrame,record.part.Size=frame,size
                local own=host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                if model~=(own and own.Character) then
                    -- An enemy's box shows when they attack, holds a moment and fades out; it does not stay on screen. Yours stays.
                    local info=model:FindFirstChild("Info")
                    if info and (info:FindFirstChild("Attacking") or info:FindFirstChild("Melee") or info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")) then record.flashAt=os.clock() end
                    local age=os.clock()-(record.flashAt or -math.huge)
                    local fade=if age<.4 then 1 else math.clamp(1-(age-.4)/.6,0,1)
                    record.box.Transparency=1-.85*fade
                    record.box.SurfaceTransparency=1-.08*fade
                end
            end
        end
        for model, record in control.previews do if not wanted[model] then releasePreview(model,record) end end
    end
    function control.presentPreviews()
        for model,record in control.previews do
            if not actorAlive(model,record.humanoid) or not record.root.Parent then releasePreview(model,record);continue end
            local frame=record.root.CFrame
            if type(record.root.GetRenderCFrame)=='function' then
                local ok,rendered=pcall(record.root.GetRenderCFrame,record.root)
                if ok then frame=rendered end
            end
            record.part.CFrame=frame
        end
    end
    function control.setPreview(value)
        control.previewEnabled = value == true
        for model, record in control.previews do releasePreview(model,record) end
        table.clear(control.previews)
        if control.previewFolder then control.previewFolder:Destroy(); control.previewFolder = nil end
        if control.previewEnabled and control.alive then
            control.previewFolder = host.Instance.new("Folder")
            control.previewFolder.Name, control.previewFolder.Parent = "CullingHitboxPreviews", host.workspace
            control.updatePreview()
        end
    end
    -- Console trace of the first few hit queries, to see why nothing is expanded.
    control.hitboxTrace=true
    control.traceCount=0
    local function hitTrace(message: string)
        if control.hitboxTrace and control.traceCount<14 then
            control.traceCount+=1
            trace('[Shenaniganism] Hitbox query: '..message)
        end
    end
    function control.expand(targets: any, attacker: any, position: any, diameter: number): any
        local kind: string = typeof(position)
        hitTrace(string.format('method=%s position=%s diameter=%s targets=%d attacker=%s',control.method,kind,typeof(diameter)..':'..tostring(diameter),#targets,tostring(attacker and attacker.Name)))
        if not control.alive or control.method=='Native' or host.isGameplayPaused and host.isGameplayPaused()
            or kind ~= "Vector3" or type(diameter) ~= "number" then return targets end
        local folder = host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not folder then return targets end
        local found = {}
        for _, model in targets do found[model] = true end
        for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if model == attacker or found[model] then continue end
            local amount = sizeFor(model)
            local root, humanoid = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not amount or not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
            local frame,size=control.bounds(model,amount)
            if not frame then continue end
            local point: any = frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
            local half: any = size*0.5
            local closest = host.Vector3.new(math.clamp(point.X,-half.X,half.X),math.clamp(point.Y,-half.Y,half.Y),math.clamp(point.Z,-half.Z,half.Z))
            local radius=math.max(0,diameter)*0.5
            local intersects=(point-closest).Magnitude<=radius
            if control.method=='Ellipsoid bounds' then
                intersects=(point.X/(half.X+radius))^2+(point.Y/(half.Y+radius))^2+(point.Z/(half.Z+radius))^2<=1
            end
            hitTrace(string.format('  candidate %s: size=%s distanceToBox=%.1f radius=%.1f intersects=%s',model.Name,tostring(size),(point-closest).Magnitude,radius,tostring(intersects)))
            if intersects then table.insert(targets,model); found[model] = true; control.expandedCount += 1 end
        end
        return targets
    end
    local wrapper
    wrapper = function(self, attacker, offset, diameter, ...)
        control.queryCount += 1
        local targets = original(self, attacker, offset, diameter, ...)
        if control.hitboxTrace and (control.wrapperTrace or 0) < 10 then
            control.wrapperTrace = (control.wrapperTrace or 0) + 1
            trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] Hitbox hook call %d: self=%s attacker=%s offset=%s diameter=%s result=%s',
                control.queryCount, typeof(self), typeof(attacker), typeof(offset), typeof(diameter), typeof(targets)))
        end
        if not control.alive or type(targets) ~= "table" then return targets end
        local position = offset
        if attacker then
            local root = attacker:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return targets end
            position = (root.CFrame*offset).Position
        end
        local result = control.expand(targets, attacker, position, diameter)
        local extra = SharedHooks.extraHitTargets
        if extra then
            local okay, list = pcall(extra, result, attacker, position, diameter)
            if okay and type(list) == "table" then result = list end
        end
        local seen = SharedHooks.onHitQuery
        if seen then pcall(seen, attacker, position, diameter, result) end
        return result
    end
    module.SphereHitbox = wrapper
    local service=host.presentationRunService or host.game and host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local elapsed=0
    local presentation=service and (service.RenderStepped or service.Heartbeat)
    if presentation then
        control.previewConnection=presentation:Connect(function(dt)
            if not control.alive or not control.previewEnabled then return end
            elapsed+=dt
            if elapsed>=0.1 then elapsed=0;control.updatePreview() end
            control.presentPreviews()
        end)
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        destroyOwnCollision()
        control.alive = false
        if control.previewConnection then control.previewConnection:Disconnect();control.previewConnection=nil end
        control.setPreview(false)
        if module.SphereHitbox == wrapper then module.SphereHitbox = original end
    end
    return control
end
function HitboxControl.new(host: {[string]: any}, sizeFor: any): any
    local player = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
    local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
    local combat=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('Combat')
    local module=combat and combat:FindFirstChild('HitboxController')
    local native
    if module then native=host.require(module)
    else
        local folder=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knitModule=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local knit=knitModule and host.require(knitModule)
            return knit and type(knit.GetController)=='function' and knit.GetController('HitboxController')
        end)
        if ok then native=result end
    end
    assert(type(native)=='table' and type(native.SphereHitbox)=='function','HitboxController is unavailable')
    return HitboxControl.attach(host, native, sizeFor)
end
return HitboxControl
end)()

local AutoLock = (function(): any
local JujutsuerLockCore = (function()
    -- Pure candidate core extracted from recovered Jujutsuer lock mechanisms.
    -- Proven source: CharAdded:2 up32/up33 (nearest root and range), Heartbeat:6
    -- Look at, RenderStepped:5 Camera. No original runtime callback is invoked.
    -- Caller owns session lifecycle, all existing options, marker and final writes.
    local Core = {}

    local function finite(value)
        return type(value) == 'number' and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end

    local function distance(a, b)
        if not a or not b or not a.Position or not b.Position then return nil end
        local value = (a.Position - b.Position).Magnitude
        return if finite(value) and value >= 0 then value else nil
    end

    local function rootOf(model)
        return model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    end

    -- The reference selector chooses the first root with the strictly smallest 3D
    -- distance in Characters:GetChildren() order, excluding the local character.
    -- eligible is an explicit option-preservation extension, not reference code.
    function Core.nearestRoot(characters, ownCharacter, ownRoot, eligible)
        if not ownRoot then return nil end
        local selected, nearest = nil, math.huge
        for _, model in characters do
            if model == ownCharacter then continue end
            local root = rootOf(model)
            if not root or eligible and not eligible(root, model) then continue end
            local d = distance(root, ownRoot)
            if d and d < nearest then selected, nearest = root, d end
        end
        return selected
    end

    -- The recovered helper uses inclusive 3D range, with no extra FOV/wall policy.
    function Core.withinRange(ownRoot, targetRoot, range)
        if type(range) ~= 'number' or range ~= range or range < 0 then return false end
        local d = distance(ownRoot, targetRoot)
        return d ~= nil and d <= range
    end

    -- Integrates the recovered nearest/sticky selection with existing adjustable
    -- filters/priority. Current target must still belong to the supplied character
    -- set. preferredRoot/rank are the retained user's selection policies; default
    -- selection is the exact nearest helper above. Never discard FOV/blacklist/
    -- owned-summon/health/wall/ragdoll policy merely to mimic raw reference gaps.
    function Core.selectRoot(characters, ownCharacter, ownRoot, options)
        options = options or {}
        local range = options.range or math.huge
        local roots, models = {}, {}
        for _, model in characters do
            if model == ownCharacter then continue end
            local root = rootOf(model)
            if root then table.insert(roots, root); models[root] = model end
        end
        local function eligible(root)
            local model = models[root]
            return model ~= nil and Core.withinRange(ownRoot, root, range)
                and (not options.eligible or options.eligible(root, model) == true)
        end
        if options.sticky and options.currentRoot then
            if eligible(options.currentRoot) then return options.currentRoot, 'Sticky' end
            -- Reference clears an invalid sticky target and scans next frame.
            -- immediateRelock retains the existing menu's explicit fast-relock policy.
            if not options.immediateRelock then return nil, 'Invalid sticky target' end
        end
        if options.preferredRoot and eligible(options.preferredRoot) then
            return options.preferredRoot, 'Configured preferred target'
        end
        if options.rank then
            local selected, score = nil, math.huge
            for _, root in roots do
                if not eligible(root) then continue end
                local current = options.rank(root, models[root])
                if finite(current) and current < score then selected, score = root, current end
            end
            return selected, if selected then 'Configured priority' else 'No eligible target'
        end
        return Core.nearestRoot(characters, ownCharacter, ownRoot, function(root)
            return eligible(root)
        end), 'Reference nearest'
    end

    -- Reference Lerp alpha is 1-smoothness per frame. Normalization keeps that
    -- exact response at 60Hz and the same response over equal time at other rates.
    function Core.normalizedAlpha(smoothness, delta)
        if not finite(smoothness) or not finite(delta) then return 0 end
        local s, elapsed = math.clamp(smoothness, 0, 1), math.clamp(delta, 0, .1)
        if elapsed <= 0 then return 0 end
        if s == 0 then return 1 end
        return 1 - s ^ (elapsed * 60)
    end

    -- Exact bridge for retained characterSpeed/cameraSpeed slider units:
    -- 1-(exp(-speed/60))^(delta*60) == 1-exp(-speed*delta).
    function Core.smoothnessFromSpeed(speed)
        if not finite(speed) then return 1 end
        return math.exp(-math.max(speed, 0) / 60)
    end

    function Core.characterGoal(vectorNew, ownRoot, point, height)
        if not ownRoot or not point then return nil end
        local y = if height ~= nil then height else ownRoot.Position.Y
        if not finite(point.X) or not finite(point.Z) or not finite(y) then return nil end
        return vectorNew(point.X, y, point.Z)
    end

    function Core.characterDesired(lookAt, vectorNew, root, point, height)
        local goal = Core.characterGoal(vectorNew, root, point, height)
        if not goal or (goal - root.Position).Magnitude <= .001 then return nil end
        return lookAt(root.Position, goal)
    end

    function Core.cameraDesired(lookAt, camera, point)
        if not camera or not camera.CFrame or not point then return nil end
        local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
        if not finite(point.X) or not finite(point.Y) or not finite(point.Z)
            or (point - origin).Magnitude <= .001 then return nil end
        return lookAt(origin, point)
    end

    -- CURRENT object frame is deliberately the start for every tracking update.
    -- No retained blend.frame can replay a pre-assist heading or old shoulder pose.
    -- Translation is native-owned: even a stale desired frame cannot move it.
    -- Initial/release curves and spin are separate existing option layers applied
    -- by the caller. This function does not erase or own those states.
    function Core.trackingFrame(currentFrame, desiredFrame, smoothness, delta)
        if not currentFrame or not desiredFrame then return currentFrame end
        local nativePosition = currentFrame.Position
        local desired = desiredFrame + (nativePosition - desiredFrame.Position)
        return currentFrame:Lerp(desired, Core.normalizedAlpha(smoothness, delta))
    end

    return Core
end)()
-- Automatic acquisition follows checked own-block and accepted outgoing-hit methods.
-- Incoming attack metadata remains available to the defensive features.
local AutoLock: {[string]: any} = {}
function AutoLock.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player, input = players.LocalPlayer, host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local replicated = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local clock = if host.os and host.os.clock then host.os.clock else os.clock
    local kindOf = host.typeof or typeof
    local function nativeShiftLocked(): boolean
        local directional=menu.directionalLock
        if directional and type(directional.nativeShiftLocked)=='function' then return directional.nativeShiftLocked()==true end
        return host.Enum.MouseBehavior~=nil and input.MouseBehavior==host.Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    end
    local control: any = {alive=true,enabled=false,trigger="None",outgoingHitEnabled=false,focused=true,connections={},characterConnections={},metadata={},projectiles={},recentThreats={},recentHitWindow=2,recentHitAt=-math.huge,smoothSeconds=0.18,lastReason="Auto Lock On is disabled",inferenceWindow=0.3,inferenceRange=12,blockEvents=0,hitEvents=0,physicalReleaseVersion=0}
    local function characterEmoting(character: any?): boolean
        character=character or player.Character
        if not character or character~=player.Character then return false end
        if type(menu.localCharacterEmoting)=='function'then return menu.localCharacterEmoting(character)==true end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        for _,name in {'Emote','Emoting'}do
            if info and info:FindFirstChild(name)then return true end
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or type(value)=='number'and value==value and value>0 and value<math.huge
                or type(value)=='string'and value~=''and value~='None'then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local pauseEmoteFacing
    control.assistHumanized={Lock=true,M1=true,Block=true,Skill=true,Counter=true,Punish=true,Red=true}
    control.assistRampIntoLaser={Lock=false,M1=false,Block=false,Skill=false,Counter=false,Punish=false,Red=false}
    control.assistDisengageDelayMs={Lock=0,M1=0,Block=1000,Skill=0,Counter=0,Punish=0,Red=0}
    control.assistFadeOutMs={Lock=80,M1=80,Block=250,Skill=80,Counter=80,Punish=80,Red=80}
    control.assistFadeOverride={Block=true}
    control.assistIntroMs={Lock=80,M1=80,Block=80,Skill=80,Counter=80,Punish=80,Red=80}
    control.assistIntroOverride={}
    local function humanizedRole(role: any): string?
        return type(role)=='string' and role:gsub(' Aim$','') or nil
    end
    function control.isAssistHumanized(role: any): boolean
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        return key~=nil and control.assistHumanized[key]==true
    end
    function control.isAssistRampIntoLaser(role: any): boolean
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        return key~=nil and control.assistRampIntoLaser[key]==true
    end
    function control.setAssistRampIntoLaser(role: any,value: any): boolean
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        if not control.alive or not key or control.assistRampIntoLaser[key]==nil or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        if control.assistRampIntoLaser[key]==value then return true end
        control.assistRampIntoLaser[key]=value
        if control.rampOnset and control.rampOnset.role==key then control.rampOnset=nil end
        if key=='Lock'then control.characterAcquisition,control.characterBlend=nil,nil end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and aim.aimTransition and humanizedRole(aim.aimTransition.role)==key then aim.aimTransition=nil end
        return true
    end
    function control.setAssistHumanized(role: any,value: any): boolean
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        if not key or control.assistHumanized[key]==nil or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.assistHumanized[key]=value
        if control.humanizedOnset and control.humanizedOnset.role==key then control.humanizedOnset=nil end
        local release=control.characterRelease
        if release and release.assistRole==key then
            release.humanized=value
            release.assistReturnSeconds=control.assistReturnDuration(key)
        end
        return true
    end
    local function setReturnTiming(role,value,fade)
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        if not control.alive or not key or control.assistHumanized[key]==nil
            or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        if fade then control.assistFadeOutMs[key]=math.clamp(value,0,5000);control.assistFadeOverride[key]=true
        else control.assistDisengageDelayMs[key]=math.clamp(value,0,5000) end
        local release=control.characterRelease
        if release and release.assistRole==key then
            release.assistReturnSeconds=control.assistReturnDuration(key)
            release.fadeExplicit=control.assistFadeOverride[key]==true
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setAssistDisengageDelayMs(role,value)return setReturnTiming(role,value,false)end
    function control.setAssistFadeOutMs(role,value)return setReturnTiming(role,value,true)end
    function control.setAssistIntroMs(role,value)
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        if not control.alive or not key or control.assistHumanized[key]==nil
            or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.assistIntroMs[key]=math.clamp(value,0,5000);control.assistIntroOverride[key]=true
        if control.humanizedOnset and control.humanizedOnset.role==key then control.humanizedOnset=nil end
        if control.rampOnset and control.rampOnset.role==key then control.rampOnset=nil end
        return true
    end
    function control.assistOnsetDuration(role)
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local seconds=(assist and assist.characterTransitionMs or 80)*.001
        return if control.isAssistHumanized(role) then math.clamp(seconds,.06,.14) else seconds
    end
    function control.assistReturnDuration(role)
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        return if key and control.assistFadeOverride[key] then control.assistFadeOutMs[key]*.001 else control.assistOnsetDuration(role)
    end
    function control.getAssistIntroSeconds(role)
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        if key and control.assistIntroOverride[key] then return control.assistIntroMs[key]*.001 end
        local seconds=control.assistOnsetDuration(role)
        -- Block's continuously engaged response stays exact. Only the default
        -- handoff gets a little more room to accelerate and settle; explicitly
        -- saved Intro timings (including zero) retain their full meaning.
        return if key=='Block' and control.isAssistHumanized(role) then math.min(seconds*1.5,.21) else seconds
    end
    function control.getAssistRampSeconds(role)
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        return ((key and control.assistIntroMs[key])or 80)*.001
    end
    local function configuredReturn(role)
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        return key and ((control.assistDisengageDelayMs[key] or 0)>0 or control.assistFadeOverride[key]==true)
    end
    -- Recovered Jujutsuer selection/sticky tracking, adapted to the saved controls.
    -- One session token replaces the legacy VM's per-lock render connection.
    control.mechanism='Jujutsuer'
    control.stickyTarget=true
    control.lockRange=0 -- Existing profiles had no acquisition distance cap.
    function control.setStickyTarget(value) control.stickyTarget=value==true end
    function control.setLockRange(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.lockRange=math.clamp(amount,0,100)
        return true
    end
    function control.inLockRange(model)
        if control.lockRange<=0 then return true end
        local own=player.Character
        local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local target=model and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        return root~=nil and target~=nil and JujutsuerLockCore.withinRange(root,target,control.lockRange)
    end
    control.activationEnabled=true
    control.turnOffAfterDash,control.turnOffAfterSkillConnects=false,false
    control.actionRelockMode='Manual'
    function control.setTurnOffAfterDash(value)
        control.turnOffAfterDash=value==true
        if not control.turnOffAfterDash and control.actionRelock and control.actionRelock.kind=='Dash' then control.actionRelock=nil end
        if control.refreshDashAction then control.refreshDashAction() end
    end
    function control.setTurnOffAfterSkillConnects(value)
        control.turnOffAfterSkillConnects=value==true
        if not control.turnOffAfterSkillConnects and control.actionRelock and control.actionRelock.kind=='Skill' then control.actionRelock=nil end
    end
    function control.setActionRelockMode(value)
        if value~='Manual' and value~='Automatic' then return false end
        control.actionRelockMode=value;control.actionRelock=nil;return true
    end
    function control.activationAllowed()
        local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries['Main/Activate Lock On']
        if entry and entry.widget and type(entry.widget.Get)=='function' then
            local ok,value=pcall(entry.widget.Get)
            return ok and value==true
        end
        return control.activationEnabled~=false
    end
    control.cameraOffset={X=0,Y=0,Z=0}
    control.characterOffset={X=0,Y=0,Z=0}
    control.characterAimPart='Torso'
    control.characterSpeed,control.cameraSpeed=20,1/0.18
    control.characterTransitionSpeed,control.characterTransitionCurve=5,'Smooth'
    control.characterReleasingSpeed=5
    control.curvePoints={Initial={0.25,0.1,0.25,1},Release={0.25,0.1,0.25,1}}
    control.dashTracks=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.fovEnabled,control.showFov,control.fovDegrees=false,false,90
    control.fovOffsetX,control.fovOffsetY=0,0
    control.fovShape,control.fovBoxSize='Circle',400
    control.fovWidth,control.fovHeight=1920,1080
    function control.setFovShape(value)
        if not table.find({'Circle','Square','Rectangle'},value) then return false end
        control.fovShape=value;control.updateFovVisual();return true
    end
    function control.setFovDimension(field,value)
        local maximum=({fovBoxSize=1080,fovWidth=1920,fovHeight=1080})[field]
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not maximum or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control[field]=math.clamp(amount,1,maximum);control.updateFovVisual();return true
    end
    control.targetPriorities=menu.targetMethods.choices()
    control.targetPriority={'Last attacker'}
    control.lastKiller=host._G and host._G.__CullingLastKiller or nil
    function control.setTargetPriority(value)
        local selected,valid=menu.targetMethods.normalize(value)
        if not valid then return false end
        local changed=table.concat(menu.targetMethods.normalize(control.targetPriority),'|')~=table.concat(selected,'|')
        if changed and control.session then control.session.reselect=true end
        control.targetPriority=selected;return true
    end
    control.lockThroughWalls=false
    control.releaseOnTargetRagdoll=false
    control.allowDownedTargets=true
    function control.setAllowDownedTargets(value) control.allowDownedTargets=value==true end
    control.pauseOffscreen=false
    control.offscreenGrace=0.2
    control.offscreenMarginX,control.offscreenMarginY=80,80
    control.offscreenOffsetX,control.offscreenOffsetY=0,0
    control.offscreenReference='Cursor'
    function control.setOffscreenReference(value)
        if value~='Cursor' and value~='Screen' then return false end
        control.offscreenReference=value;control.offscreenState=nil;return true
    end
    function control.setOffscreenOffset(axis,value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if (axis~='X' and axis~='Y') or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control['offscreenOffset'..axis]=math.clamp(amount,-2000,2000);control.offscreenState=nil;return true
    end
    function control.offscreenBounds(camera)
        local view=camera.ViewportSize
        local center=if control.offscreenReference=='Cursor' then control.cursorPoint(camera) else view*.5
        local x,y=center.X+control.offscreenOffsetX,center.Y-control.offscreenOffsetY
        return x-view.X*.5-control.offscreenMarginX,y-view.Y*.5-control.offscreenMarginY,
            x+view.X*.5+control.offscreenMarginX,y+view.Y*.5+control.offscreenMarginY
    end
    function control.setOffscreenMargin(axis,value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if (axis~='X' and axis~='Y') or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control['offscreenMargin'..axis]=math.clamp(amount,0,500);control.offscreenState=nil;return true
    end
    function control.setPauseOffscreen(value)
        control.pauseOffscreen=control.alive and value==true;control.offscreenState=nil
    end
    function control.visibilityPaused(mode)
        if not control.pauseOffscreen then control.offscreenState=nil;return false end
        local target=menu.environment.LockedTarget;local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local part=control.targetPart(target)
        if not part or not camera then return false end
        -- Retain character aim through a native skill, including one begun during a dash.
        -- This exception does not acquire camera ownership or select another target.
        local cast=mode=='character' and control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
        if cast and (not cast.target or cast.target==target) then return false end
        local project=camera.WorldToViewportPoint or camera.WorldToScreenPoint
        if type(project)~='function' then return false end
        local now=clock();local state=control.offscreenState
        if not state or state.target~=target or state.camera~=camera then
            state={target=target,camera=camera,lastSeen=now,lastCheck=-math.huge,visible=true};control.offscreenState=state
        end
        if now-state.lastCheck>=0.03 then
            state.lastCheck=now
            local ok,point,visible=pcall(project,camera,part.Position)
            if not ok or not point then return false end
            local seen=visible==true and point.Z>0
            local viewport=camera.ViewportSize
            local left,top,right,bottom
            if viewport and viewport.X>0 and viewport.Y>0 then
                left,top,right,bottom=control.offscreenBounds(camera)
                seen=point.Z>0 and point.X>=left and point.X<=right and point.Y>=top and point.Y<=bottom
            end
            if not seen and viewport and viewport.X>0 and viewport.Y>0 and type(target.GetBoundingBox)=='function' then
                local boundsOk,frame,size=pcall(target.GetBoundingBox,target)
                if boundsOk and frame and size then
                    local minX,minY,maxX,maxY=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
                    local front,behind=false,false
                    for _,x in {-1,1} do for _,y in {-1,1} do for _,z in {-1,1} do
                        local projected,p=pcall(project,camera,frame:PointToWorldSpace(host.Vector3.new(size.X*x/2,size.Y*y/2,size.Z*z/2)))
                        if projected and p then
                            if p.Z>0 then front=true;minX=math.min(minX,p.X);maxX=math.max(maxX,p.X);minY=math.min(minY,p.Y);maxY=math.max(maxY,p.Y)
                            else behind=true end
                        end
                    end end end
                    -- Keep visible silhouettes at the viewport edge; near-plane crossing
                    -- waits for the whole body to leave rather than flipping yaw each frame.
                    seen=front and (behind or (maxX>=left and minX<=right and maxY>=top and minY<=bottom))
                end
            end
            state.visible=seen;if seen then state.lastSeen=now end
        end
        return not state.visible and now-state.lastSeen>=control.offscreenGrace
    end
    function control.setReleaseOnTargetRagdoll(value) control.releaseOnTargetRagdoll=control.alive and value==true end
    local sourceKeys={"LastAttacker","LastAttackerUserId","Attacker","AttackerUserId","DamageSource","HitBy","LastHitBy","creator","SourceUserId"}
    local function connect(signal,callback,list)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=="function" then local connection=signal:Connect(callback);table.insert(list or control.connections,connection);return connection end
        return nil
    end
    function control.targetPart(model)
        if not model then return nil end
        for _, name in {"Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "HumanoidRootPart"} do
            local part=model:FindFirstChild(name)
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then return part end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.setCharacterAimPart(value)
        if not control.alive or (value~='Torso' and value~='Head') then return false end
        control.characterAimPart=value
        return true
    end
    function control.characterTargetPart(model)
        if control.characterAimPart=='Head' and model then
            local head=model:FindFirstChild('Head')
            if head and head:IsA('BasePart') then return head end
        end
        return control.targetPart(model)
    end
    -- Character aim selects its own part; camera aim and the marker retain
    -- their torso anchor. Offsets follow the selected part's local axes.
    function control.targetPoint(model,mode)
        local part=if mode=='Character' then control.characterTargetPart(model) else control.targetPart(model)
        if not part then return nil end
        local offset=if mode=='Character' then control.characterOffset else control.cameraOffset
        local point=part.Position
        if offset.X~=0 or offset.Y~=0 or offset.Z~=0 then
            point=part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(host.Vector3.new(offset.X,offset.Y,offset.Z))
        end
        if mode=='Character' then
            local own=player.Character
            local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local targetRoot=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if root and targetRoot then
                local dx,dz=targetRoot.Position.X-root.Position.X,targetRoot.Position.Z-root.Position.Z
                local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
                -- Animated torso/head sway must not move horizontal lock aim.
                -- Keep the selected part's height and explicit local offsets;
                -- the character's root remains the continuous X/Z anchor.
                local x,z=point.X-part.Position.X,point.Z-part.Position.Z
                local length=math.sqrt(x*x+z*z)
                local scale=if length>0 then math.min(1,distance*.45/length) else 1
                point=host.Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X+x*scale,point.Y,targetRoot.Position.Z+z*scale)
            end
        end
        return point
    end
    function control.characterLookHeight(localRoot,model)
        if not localRoot then return nil end
        local y=control.characterOffset.Y
        -- Zero retains the game's upright yaw-only character lock. A chosen
        -- nonzero Y explicitly adds target-local vertical aim (and pitch).
        if y==0 then return localRoot.Position.Y end
        local part=control.characterTargetPart(model)
        if not part then return localRoot.Position.Y end
        local vertical=part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(host.Vector3.new(0,y,0))-part.Position
        return localRoot.Position.Y+vertical.Y
    end
    local function setOffset(offset,axis,value)
        if not control.alive or axis~='X' and axis~='Y' and axis~='Z' then return false end
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        offset[axis]=math.clamp(amount,-5/.28,5/.28)
        return true
    end
    function control.setCameraOffset(axis,value)
        return setOffset(control.cameraOffset,axis,value)
    end
    function control.setCharacterOffset(axis,value)
        return setOffset(control.characterOffset,axis,value)
    end
    function control.rawCursorPoint(camera)
        local framing=menu.directionalLock
        if framing and framing.cursorCenter then return framing.cursorCenter(camera) end
        return input:GetMouseLocation()
    end
    function control.cursorPoint(camera)
        local point=control.rawCursorPoint(camera)
        -- GetMouseLocation, WorldToViewportPoint and the inset-free FOV overlay
        -- share viewport coordinates. Subtracting the top bar only in free
        -- cursor mode shifted both the circle and selection on shift-lock changes.
        if control.fovOffsetX==0 and control.fovOffsetY==0 then return point end
        return point+host.Vector2.new(control.fovOffsetX,-control.fovOffsetY)
    end
    function control.fovGeometry(camera)
        camera=camera or host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera or not camera.ViewportSize or camera.ViewportSize.X<=0 or camera.ViewportSize.Y<=0 then return nil end
        local center=control.cursorPoint(camera)
        local farX=math.max(math.abs(center.X),math.abs(camera.ViewportSize.X-center.X))
        local farY=math.max(math.abs(center.Y),math.abs(camera.ViewportSize.Y-center.Y))
        local entireViewport=math.sqrt(farX*farX+farY*farY)+1
        local vertical=tonumber(camera.FieldOfView) or 70
        if vertical~=vertical or math.abs(vertical)==math.huge then vertical=70 end
        vertical=math.clamp(vertical,1,179)
        -- This screen circle approximates angular FOV off-center. Both visual
        -- and selection use this exact geometry; 180 degrees covers the view.
        local radius=if control.fovDegrees>=180 then entireViewport else math.min(entireViewport,
            camera.ViewportSize.Y*0.5*math.tan(math.rad(control.fovDegrees)*0.5)/math.tan(math.rad(vertical)*0.5))
        local width,height=radius*2,radius*2
        if control.fovShape=='Square' then
            width=control.fovBoxSize*math.min(camera.ViewportSize.X/1920,camera.ViewportSize.Y/1080);height=width
        elseif control.fovShape=='Rectangle' then
            width=control.fovWidth*camera.ViewportSize.X/1920;height=control.fovHeight*camera.ViewportSize.Y/1080
        end
        return {center=center,radius=radius,camera=camera,shape=control.fovShape,width=width,height=height}
    end
    function control.pointInFov(point,geometry)
        local dx,dy=point.X-geometry.center.X,point.Y-geometry.center.Y
        if geometry.shape=='Square' or geometry.shape=='Rectangle' then
            return math.abs(dx)<=geometry.width*.5 and math.abs(dy)<=geometry.height*.5
        end
        return dx*dx+dy*dy<=geometry.radius*geometry.radius
    end
    function control.inFov(model,camera,geometry)
        if not control.fovEnabled then return true end
        local part=control.targetPart(model)
        geometry=geometry or control.fovGeometry(camera)
        if not part or not geometry then return false end
        camera=geometry.camera
        local projected,visible
        if camera.WorldToViewportPoint then projected,visible=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        else projected,visible=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(part.Position) end
        return visible==true and projected.Z>0 and control.pointInFov(projected,geometry)
    end
    function control.updateFovVisual()
        -- Visibility previews the saved FOV independently of target filtering.
        local shown=control.alive and control.showFov
        local geometry=shown and control.fovGeometry()
        local parent=shown and player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
        shown=shown and geometry~=nil and parent~=nil
        if shown and not control.fovGui then
            if not host.Instance or not host.UDim2 or not host.UDim or not host.Color3 then control.fovVisualReady=false;return end
            local gui=host.Instance.new('ScreenGui')
            gui.Name,gui.ResetOnSpawn,gui.IgnoreGuiInset='ShenaniganismLockFov',false,true
            gui.ZIndexBehavior=host.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            local circle=host.Instance.new('Frame')
            circle.Name,circle.BackgroundTransparency,circle.BorderSizePixel='CursorFov',1,0
            circle.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5);circle.Parent=gui
            local corner=host.Instance.new('UICorner');corner.CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(1,0);corner.Parent=circle
            local stroke=host.Instance.new('UIStroke')
            stroke.Thickness,stroke.Transparency,stroke.Color=1.5,.2,host.Color3.fromRGB(65,220,235);stroke.Parent=circle
            control.fovGui,control.fovCircle,control.fovCorner,control.fovVisualReady=gui,circle,corner,true
        end
        local gui,circle=control.fovGui,control.fovCircle
        if not gui then return end
        if gui.Enabled~=shown then gui.Enabled=shown end
        if not shown then return end
        if gui.Parent~=parent then gui.Parent=parent end
        local root=menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        local main=root and (if root:IsA('ScreenGui') then root else root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('ScreenGui'))
        local order=if main then main.DisplayOrder-1 else 0
        if gui.DisplayOrder~=order then gui.DisplayOrder=order end
        local center,radius=geometry.center,geometry.radius
        if control.fovX~=center.X or control.fovY~=center.Y then
            circle.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(center.X,center.Y);control.fovX,control.fovY=center.X,center.Y
        end
        if control.fovVisualShape~=control.fovShape then
            control.fovCorner.CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(if control.fovShape=='Circle' then 1 else 0,0)
            control.fovVisualShape=control.fovShape
        end
        if control.fovVisualWidth~=geometry.width or control.fovVisualHeight~=geometry.height then
            circle.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(geometry.width,geometry.height)
            control.fovVisualWidth,control.fovVisualHeight=geometry.width,geometry.height
        end
        control.fovRadius=radius
    end
    function control.setFovEnabled(value)
        control.fovEnabled=value==true;control.updateFovVisual()
    end
    function control.setFovDegrees(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.fovDegrees=math.clamp(amount,1,180);control.updateFovVisual();return true
    end
    local function setFovOffset(axis,value)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not control.alive or not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control['fovOffset'..axis]=math.clamp(amount,-2000,2000)
        control.updateFovVisual();return true
    end

        return setFovOffset('X',value)
    end
    function control.setFovOffsetY(value)
        return setFovOffset('Y',value)
    end
    function control.setShowFov(value)
        control.showFov=value==true;control.updateFovVisual()
    end
    function control.setLockThroughWalls(value)
        control.lockThroughWalls=value==true
    end
    function control.retainsSkillTarget(model)
        local env=menu.environment
        local cast=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
        local info=cast and cast.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return cast and info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') and menu.characterShiftLockEnabled==true
            and env._G.CharacterLockActive==true and cast.target==model and env.LockedTarget==model
            and cast.connection==env.LockConn and cast.connection and cast.connection.Connected~=false
    end
    -- Track actual local bodies by identity, including a body retained after respawn.
    local ownCharacters=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    if player.Character then ownCharacters[player.Character]=true end
    function control.isOwnCharacter(candidate)
        if candidate==player then return true end
        if kindOf(candidate)~='Instance' then return false end
        local current=player.Character
        local object=candidate
        while object do
            if object==current or ownCharacters[object] then return true end
            object=object.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function valid(model)
        if control.isOwnCharacter(model) or (((menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded) and (menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded)(model))) then return false end
        if model and not control.allowDownedTargets and control.releaseOnTargetRagdoll and control.characterRagdolled and control.characterRagdolled(model)
            and not control.retainsSkillTarget(model)
            and not (control.teleportTargetRetained and control.teleportTargetRetained(model)) then return false end
        local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return model~=nil and model~=player.Character and model.Parent~=nil and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")~=nil
    end
    local function modelFrom(value)
        if kindOf(value)=="Instance" then
            if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
            if value:IsA("Model") then return value end
            return value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        elseif type(value)=="number" then
            local source=players:GetPlayerByUserId(value);return source and source.Character
        elseif type(value)=="string" then
            local source=players:FindFirstChild(value)
            if source and source:IsA("Player") then return source.Character end
            local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters");return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(value)
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function wallParameters()
        if not host.RaycastParams then return nil end
        local parameters=host.RaycastParams.new();parameters.FilterType=host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local excluded={player.Character}
        local effects=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Effects')
        if effects then table.insert(excluded,effects) end
        parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances=excluded
        return parameters
    end
    function control.hasLineOfSight(model,parameters)
        if control.lockThroughWalls then return true end
        local part,camera=control.targetPart(model),host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not part then return false end
        parameters=parameters or wallParameters()
        if not parameters or not host.workspace.Raycast or not camera or not camera.CFrame then return true end
        local origin,direction=camera.CFrame.Position,part.Position-camera.CFrame.Position
        local result=if menu.visibilityRaycast then menu.visibilityRaycast(origin,direction,parameters) else host.workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,parameters)
        return not result or modelFrom(result.Instance)==model
    end
    function control.closest(filter,preference)
        local camera,folder=host.workspace.CurrentCamera,host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        if not camera or not folder then return nil end
        local geometry=control.fovEnabled and control.fovGeometry(camera)
        if control.fovEnabled and not geometry then return nil end
        local point=control.rawCursorPoint(camera)
        local parameters=wallParameters()
        local ownRoot=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local projections,eligibility={},{}
        local function eligible(model)
            if eligibility[model]~=nil then return eligibility[model]end
            local okay=valid(model)and(not filter or filter(model))and control.inLockRange(model)
            local part=okay and control.targetPart(model)
            if part then
                local projection,shown
                if camera.WorldToViewportPoint then projection,shown=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                else projection,shown=camera:WorldToScreenPoint(part.Position)end
                okay=shown and projection.Z>0 and(not geometry or control.pointInFov(projection,geometry))
                    and control.hasLineOfSight(model,parameters)
                if okay then projections[model]=projection end
            else okay=false end
            eligibility[model]=okay==true;return okay==true
        end
        local function cursorRank(model)
            local projected=projections[model]
            return projected and math.sqrt((projected.X-point.X)^2+(projected.Y-point.Y)^2)or math.huge
        end
        local selection=preference or control.targetPriority
        local normalTarget
        if menu.targetMethods.has(selection,'Normal')and parameters and camera.ViewportPointToRay and host.workspace.Raycast then
            local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(point.X,point.Y)
            local hit=if menu.visibilityRaycast then menu.visibilityRaycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*1000,parameters)else host.workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*1000,parameters)
            local exact=hit and modelFrom(hit.Instance)
            if exact and eligible(exact)then normalTarget=exact end
        end
        local candidates=folder:GetChildren()
        local selected,reason=menu.targetMethods.choose(selection,menu.targetMethods.screenContext(candidates,{
            cursorHit=true,camera=camera,cursorPoint=point,
            candidates=candidates,eligible=eligible,cursorRank=cursorRank,normalRank=cursorRank,normalTarget=normalTarget,
            distanceRank=function(model)local root=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');return ownRoot and root and(root.Position-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude or math.huge end}))
        control.lastSelection=reason;return selected
    end
    local function permitted(cursorRequest)
        if characterEmoting()then return false end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then return false end
        if not control.alive or not control.activationAllowed() or (not cursorRequest and not control.enabled) or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return character~=nil and character.Parent~=nil and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
    end
    function control.release()
        local environment=menu.environment
        if control.lastAutoTarget and environment.LockedTarget==control.lastAutoTarget and environment.LockConn==control.ownedConnection then
            control.captureCharacterRelease()
            if environment.CleanLock then pcall(environment.CleanLock) end
            environment.LockedTarget=nil
            control.characterAcquisition,control.characterBlend=nil,nil
        end
        control.lastAutoTarget,control.ownedConnection=nil,nil
    end
    function control.ownsTarget()
        local environment=menu.environment
        return control.lastAutoTarget~=nil and environment.LockedTarget==control.lastAutoTarget and environment.LockConn==control.ownedConnection and environment.LockConn~=nil and environment.LockConn.Connected~=false
    end
    function control.updateBlockReleaseSuppression()
        local suppression=control.blockReleaseSuppression
        if not suppression or control.physicalBlockDown or clock()-suppression.at<0.12 then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info or not info:FindFirstChild('Block') then control.blockReleaseSuppression=nil end
    end
    local function acceptedOwnHit(target,record,at)
        at=at or (type(record)=='table' and record.at)
        if type(record)~='table' or record.accepted~=true or record.character~=player.Character
            or record.target~=target or record.at~=at or type(at)~='number' or at~=at
            or at>clock() or clock()-at>0.5 then return false end
        local proof=record.nativeProof
        if type(proof)=='table' and (proof.owner~=nil and proof.owner~=player.Character
            or proof.character~=nil and proof.character~=player.Character) then return false end
        return record.attackKind=='M1' or record.evidence=='health-delta'
            or record.evidence=='native-caster-victim' or record.evidence=='native-victim-hit'
            or record.evidence=='attributed-health-loss' and record.exactHealthLoss==true
                and type(record.delta)=='number' and record.delta<0
    end
    local activationMasks={None=0,Block=1,Hit=2,Both=3,Incoming=4,BlockIncoming=5,HitIncoming=6,All=7}
    local activationValues={'None','Block','Hit','Both','Incoming','BlockIncoming','HitIncoming','All'}
    local activationBits={Block=1,Hit=2,Incoming=4}
    function control.activationHas(value,method)
        local mask,bit=activationMasks[value],activationBits[method]
        return mask~=nil and bit~=nil and math.floor(mask/bit)%2==1
    end
    function control.withActivation(value,method,enabled)
        local mask,bit=activationMasks[value],activationBits[method]
        if mask==nil or bit==nil then return value end
        if control.activationHas(value,method)~=(enabled==true) then mask+=if enabled==true then bit else -bit end
        return activationValues[mask+1]
    end
    local blockProofToken,incomingProofToken={},{}
    local function blockMethodEnabled()
        return control.activationHas(control.trigger,'Block')
    end
    local function hitMethodEnabled()
        return control.outgoingHitEnabled and control.activationHas(control.trigger,'Hit')
    end
    local function ownBlockProof()
        local automatic=menu.autoBlock
        if automatic and automatic.heldThreat and automatic.heldThreat.kind=='OwnDash'
            and not (automatic.manualBlockHeld and automatic.manualBlockHeld()) then return nil end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')
        local native=control.nativeOwnBlock
        local fresh=native and native.character==character and clock()-native.at>=0 and clock()-native.at<=.2
        if not marker and not fresh then return nil end
        return {token=blockProofToken,character=character,marker=marker,native=if fresh then native else nil,at=clock()}
    end
    local function acceptedOwnBlock(proof)
        if type(proof)~='table' or proof.token~=blockProofToken or proof.character~=player.Character
            or type(proof.at)~='number' or proof.at>clock() or clock()-proof.at>.2 then return false end
        local info=proof.character and proof.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return proof.marker~=nil and info~=nil and proof.marker.Parent==info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')==proof.marker
            or proof.native~=nil and proof.native==control.nativeOwnBlock and proof.native.character==proof.character
                and clock()-proof.native.at>=0 and clock()-proof.native.at<=.2
    end
    local function acceptedIncomingHit(model,proof)
        return control.activationHas(control.trigger,'Incoming') and type(proof)=='table'
            and proof==control.incomingDamageProof and proof.token==incomingProofToken
            and proof.character==player.Character and proof.target==model
            and type(proof.at)=='number' and proof.at<=clock() and clock()-proof.at<=.3
    end
    function control.lock(model,cursorRequest,hitRecord,blockProof,incomingProof)
        if not permitted(cursorRequest==true) or not valid(model) or not control.inLockRange(model) then return false end
        if cursorRequest~=true then
            if control.dashAcquisitionSuppressed(hitRecord) then
                control.lastReason='Dashes do not activate automatic lock';return false
            end
            local blocked=blockMethodEnabled() and acceptedOwnBlock(blockProof)
            local hit=hitMethodEnabled() and acceptedOwnHit(model,hitRecord)
            local incoming=acceptedIncomingHit(model,incomingProof)
            if not blocked and not hit and not incoming then
                control.lastReason='Automatic lock requires an enabled block, outgoing hit or incoming hit method';return false
            end
            if blocked and not control.inFov(model) then control.lastReason='Blocked target is outside the cursor FOV';return false end
            if incoming and not control.inFov(model) then control.lastReason='Attacker is outside the cursor FOV';return false end
        end
        if cursorRequest~=true and clock()<(control.manualReleaseUntil or -math.huge) then control.lastReason='Manual unlock takes priority';return false end
        if cursorRequest==true then control.manualReleaseUntil=nil end
        local suppressed=control.manualUnlockSkill
        if suppressed then
            local active=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
            local own=player.Character;local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            local sameSkill=own==suppressed.character and (active==suppressed or marker~=nil)
            if sameSkill and cursorRequest~=true then
                control.lastReason='Manual unlock takes priority until this skill finishes';return false
            end
            control.manualUnlockSkill=nil
        end
        if not control.hasLineOfSight(model) then control.lastReason='Target is behind a wall';return false end
        local environment=menu.environment
        control.bindSafeLockCleanup()
        if environment.LockedTarget==model and environment.LockConn and environment.LockConn.Connected~=false then control.lastTarget=model;return true end
        control.startSession(model,cursorRequest~=true)
        control.downedAcquisition=if control.allowDownedTargets and control.characterRagdolled(model) then {target=model,connection=environment.LockConn} else nil
        control.lastTarget=model
        control.lastReason="Locked onto "..model.Name
        return true
    end
    function control.rejectOwnTarget()
        if not control.isOwnCharacter(menu.environment.LockedTarget) then return false end
        control.releaseSelectedLock('Local character excluded from lock targets')
        control.finishCharacterRelease()
        return true
    end
    function control.endSession(capture)
        local env=menu.environment
        if capture~=false then control.captureCharacterRelease() end
        control.teleportTargetLease=nil
        local connection,gui=env.LockConn,env.LockGui
        env.LockedTarget,env.LockConn,env.LockGui=nil,nil,nil
        control.session=nil
        control.lastAutoTarget,control.ownedConnection,control.lastTarget=nil,nil,nil
        control.characterAcquisition,control.characterBlend,control.cameraBlend=nil,nil,nil
        if connection and type(connection.Disconnect)=='function' then pcall(connection.Disconnect,connection) end
        if gui and type(gui.Destroy)=='function' then pcall(gui.Destroy,gui) end
        if menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation then menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation() end
    end
    function control.startSession(model,automatic)
        control.endSession(false)
        control.finishCharacterRelease()
        control.sessionGeneration=(control.sessionGeneration or 0)+1
        local token={Connected=true,generation=control.sessionGeneration}
        function token:Disconnect() self.Connected=false end
        local env=menu.environment
        env.LockedTarget,env.LockConn=model,token
        control.session={target=model,connection=token,automatic=automatic==true,refreshAt=clock()}
        control.downedAcquisition=if control.allowDownedTargets and control.characterRagdolled(model) then {target=model,connection=token} else nil
        control.lastAutoTarget=if automatic then model else nil
        control.ownedConnection=if automatic then token else nil
        control.lastTarget=model
        if menu.lockMarker and menu.lockMarker.create then
            local ok,gui=pcall(menu.lockMarker.create,model)
            if ok then env.LockGui=gui else control.lastMarkerError=tostring(gui) end
        end
        if menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation then menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation() end
        return token
    end
    function control.bindSafeLockCleanup()
        local env=menu.environment
        -- Capture originals only for teardown; active calls never execute the old
        -- selector, toggle or VM tracking callback. All entry points share this owner.
        if not control.targetSelectionHook or env.GetTarget~=control.targetSelectionHook.wrapper then
            local hook={original=env.GetTarget}
            hook.wrapper=function() return control.closest() end
            control.targetSelectionHook=hook;env.GetTarget=hook.wrapper
        end
        if not control.toggleReleaseHook or env.ToggleLock~=control.toggleReleaseHook.wrapper then
            local hook={original=env.ToggleLock}
            hook.wrapper=function() return control.toggleCursorLock() end
            control.toggleReleaseHook=hook;env.ToggleLock=hook.wrapper
        end
        if not control.cleanupHook or env.CleanLock~=control.cleanupHook.wrapper then
            local hook={original=env.CleanLock}
            hook.wrapper=function() return control.endSession(true) end
            control.cleanupHook=hook;env.CleanLock=hook.wrapper
        end
    end
    function control.refreshLockSession()
        local env=menu.environment
        local session=control.session
        if not session then return end
        if env.LockConn~=session.connection or env.LockedTarget~=session.target then
            if session.connection.Connected then session.connection:Disconnect() end
            control.session=nil;return
        end
        if not control.activationAllowed() or session.connection.Connected==false
            or not valid(session.target) or not control.inLockRange(session.target) then
            control.endSession(true);control.lastReason='Target lock ended';return
        end
        if (control.stickyTarget and not session.reselect) or not control.focused or clock()-session.refreshAt<.05 then return end
        session.refreshAt=clock()
        -- Contact/skill steering retains the actual victim until that move ends.
        if control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill() then return end
        session.reselect=nil
        local target=control.closest()
        if not target then
            control.endSession(true);control.lastReason='No eligible target for nonsticky lock'
        elseif target~=session.target then control.startSession(target,session.automatic) end
    end
    function control.releaseSelectedLock(reason)
        local environment=menu.environment
        if environment.LockedTarget or environment.LockConn or control.skillFacing then
            local cast=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
            if cast then cast.manualReleased=true;control.manualUnlockSkill=cast end
            if control.skillFacing then control.skillFacing.manualReleased=true end
            local own=player.Character;local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if not cast and info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then control.manualUnlockSkill={character=own,manualReleased=true} end
            control.skillFacing=nil;control.pendingHit=nil;control.teleportTargetLease=nil
            if not reason or reason=='Cursor lock released' or reason:find('physical Block',1,true) then
                control.manualReleaseUntil=clock()+.35
                if blockMethodEnabled() and ownBlockProof() then control.blockReleaseSuppression={at=clock()} end
            end
            local connection,gui=environment.LockConn,environment.LockGui
            local ok,message=true,nil
            if type(environment.CleanLock)=='function' then ok,message=pcall(environment.CleanLock) end
            -- Manual release must finish even if native GUI cleanup fails or
            -- a stale connection has lost its Connected flag.
            if connection then pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
            if gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
            environment.LockedTarget,environment.LockConn,environment.LockGui=nil,nil,nil
            control.characterAcquisition,control.characterBlend=nil,nil
            control.lastAutoTarget,control.ownedConnection,control.lastTarget=nil,nil,nil
            if not ok then control.cleanupFailure=tostring(message) end
            control.lastReason=reason or 'Cursor lock released'
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.setActivationEnabled(value)
        if value~=true then control.actionRelock=nil end
        local wasEnabled=control.activationEnabled
        local requested=control.alive and value==true
        control.activationEnabled=requested
        local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries['Main/Activate Lock On']
        if entry then
            entry.running=requested
            if entry.widget and type(entry.widget.Set)=='function' and entry.widget.Get()~=requested then
                entry.widget.Set(requested,false)
            end
        end
        if not control.activationEnabled or not wasEnabled then
            local own=player.Character;local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            control.activationAnimationSuppression=if marker then {character=own,marker=marker} else nil
        end
        if control.activationEnabled then
            if not wasEnabled then control.activationResumedAt=clock() end
            if type(menu.applyLockMode)=='function' then menu.applyLockMode() end
            return true
        end
        -- Keep the automatic feature preference, but end every current lock and
        -- discard old input/contact work before another activation is allowed.
        control.releaseSelectedLock('Lock activation is disabled')
        if control.pendingSkillCast then control.pendingSkillCast.manualReleased=true end
        control.pendingSkillCast,control.skillFacing,control.pendingHit=nil,nil,nil
        control.physicalBlockDown,control.physicalBlockKey,control.blockReleaseSuppression,control.nativeOwnBlock=nil,nil,nil,nil
        control.skillUnlockClick,control.teleportTargetLease,control.downedAcquisition=nil,nil,nil
        control.characterAcquisition,control.characterBlend,control.lastTarget=nil,nil,nil
        control.manualUnlockSkill,control.lastToggleObject=nil,nil
        control.lastReason='Lock activation is disabled'
        if type(menu.applyLockMode)=='function' then menu.applyLockMode() end
        return true
    end
    function control.toggleCursorLock(origin)
        if not control.alive or (origin and menu.isMenuInput and menu.isMenuInput(origin)) then return false end
        control.actionRelock=nil
        if origin and origin==control.lastToggleObject then return true end
        if origin then control.lastToggleObject=origin end
        local environment=menu.environment
        if environment.LockedTarget or environment.LockConn or control.skillFacing then
            return control.releaseSelectedLock('Cursor lock released')
        end
        if not permitted(true) then return false end
        local target=control.closest()
        if not target then
            control.lastReason=if control.fovEnabled then 'No visible target inside the cursor FOV' else 'No visible unobstructed target near the cursor'
            return false
        end
        control.lastSource='Bound cursor lock input'
        return control.lock(target,true)
    end
    function control.onBlock(origin,freshPress)
        if not blockMethodEnabled() or not permitted() or control.blockReleaseSuppression
            or (origin and menu.isMenuInput and menu.isMenuInput(origin)) then return false end
        local proof=ownBlockProof()
        if not proof then control.lastReason='Waiting for your native block to become active';return false end
        local env=menu.environment
        -- Repeated block acknowledgements never switch an already selected enemy.
        if valid(env.LockedTarget) and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected~=false then return true end
        if not freshPress and clock()-(control.lastBlockAt or -math.huge)<.05 then return false end
        control.lastBlockAt=clock()
        local target=control.closest()
        if not target then control.lastReason='No eligible target inside the block lock FOV';return false end
        local locked=control.lock(target,false,nil,proof)
        if locked then control.blockEvents+=1;control.lastSource='Your active native block' end
        return locked
    end
    function control.setRecentHitWindow(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value) or 2
        if amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then amount=2 end
        control.recentHitWindow=math.clamp(amount,0,30)
        if menu.autoCounterFilter and menu.autoCounterFilter.setHitWindow then menu.autoCounterFilter.setHitWindow(control.recentHitWindow) end
    end
    function control.setOutgoingHit(value)
        control.setTrigger(control.withActivation(control.trigger,'Hit',value))
    end
    control.skillHitEnabled=false
    control.skillUseEnabled=false
    function control.setSkillUseEnabled(value) control.skillUseEnabled=control.alive and value==true end
    function control.setSkillHitEnabled(value) control.skillHitEnabled=control.alive and value==true end
    control.skillHitTargets={'Normal'}
    function control.setSkillHitTargets(value)
        local selected,valid=menu.targetMethods.normalize(value)
        if not valid then return false end
        control.skillHitTargets=selected;return true
    end
    function control.skillTargetAllowed(target,previous)
        local context=menu.targetMethods.context()
        if previous~=nil then context.histories['Last target I hit']={model=previous,at=clock()}end
        return menu.targetMethods.allows(control.skillHitTargets,target,context)
    end
    local function setActionMaster(enabled)
        control.actionToggleWrite=true
        local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries['Main/Auto Lock On']
        if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Set then pcall(entry.widget.Set,enabled,true) end
        control.setEnabled(enabled)
        control.actionToggleWrite=nil
    end
    function control.turnOffForAction(kind,target,cast)
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or not control.activationAllowed() or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then return false end
        local env=menu.environment
        if not control.enabled and not env.LockedTarget and not env.LockConn and not control.skillFacing then return false end
        if kind=='Skill' and not control.enabled and not env.LockedTarget and not env.LockConn then return false end
        if control.actionRelock then return false end
        local own=player.Character
        local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not own or not own.Parent or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return false end
