        local selected=env.LockedTarget or target
        local info=own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local record={kind=kind,character=own,target=selected,at=clock(),marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')}
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if kind=='Dash' and (env.LockedTarget or env.LockConn or control.skillFacing)
            and assist and assist.retainShiftLockShoulder then assist.retainShiftLockShoulder() end
        local pending=cast or (control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill())
        local steering=if kind=='Skill' and pending and not pending.manualReleased
            and (control.manualSkillSteering or control.noSkillDirectionalLock) then table.clone(pending) else nil
        if pending then pending.manualReleased=true;control.manualUnlockSkill=pending end
        control.releaseSelectedLock(if kind=='Dash' then 'Released lock on dash input' else 'Released lock after your skill connected')
        control.skillFacing,control.pendingHit,control.teleportTargetLease=nil,nil,nil
        setActionMaster(false)
        if steering then
            steering.target,steering.connection,steering.assisted=nil,nil,nil
            steering.detached,steering.manualReleased,steering.contactTarget=true,nil,target
            steering.contactAt=steering.contactAt or clock()
            control.pendingSkillCast,control.skillFacing=steering,steering
        end
        if control.actionRelockMode=='Automatic' then control.actionRelock=record end
        control.lastReason=if kind=='Dash' then 'Auto Lock On switched off on dash input' else 'Auto Lock On switched off after your skill connected'
        return true
    end
    function control.onDashPress(origin)
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (origin and menu.isMenuInput and menu.isMenuInput(origin)) then return false end
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        if dash and dash.captureBlockDashTarget then dash.captureBlockDashTarget() end
        control.beginDashFacing()
        if not control.turnOffAfterDash then return false end
        local now=clock()
        if control.lastDashUnlockCharacter==player.Character and now-(control.lastDashUnlockAt or -math.huge)<.08 then return false end
        local changed=control.turnOffForAction('Dash')
        if changed then control.lastDashUnlockAt,control.lastDashUnlockCharacter=now,player.Character end
        return changed
    end
    function control.stepActionRelock()
        local record=control.actionRelock
        if not record then return end
        local own=player.Character
        local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if control.actionRelockMode~='Automatic' or not control.alive or not control.focused or not control.activationAllowed()
            or record.character~=own or not own or not own.Parent or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or hum.PlatformStand
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen())
            or clock()-record.at>30 or (record.kind=='Dash' and not control.turnOffAfterDash)
            or (record.kind=='Skill' and not control.turnOffAfterSkillConnects) then control.actionRelock=nil;return end
        if clock()-record.at<.15 then return end
        local info=own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if record.kind=='Dash' then
            if control.characterDashing() or (control.dashInputHeld and control.dashInputHeld()) then return end
            if info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then return end
        else
            local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            if marker and marker==record.marker then return end
            if marker then control.actionRelock=nil;return end
        end
        control.actionRelock=nil
        setActionMaster(true)
        control.manualUnlockSkill,control.manualReleaseUntil,control.blockReleaseSuppression=nil,nil,nil
        local target=record.target
        if not valid(target) or not control.inFov(target) or not control.hasLineOfSight(target) then target=control.closest() end
        if target and control.lock(target,true) then
            control.lastAutoTarget,control.ownedConnection=target,menu.environment.LockConn
            control.lastSource='Automatic relock after '..record.kind
        end
    end
    function control.onSkillUse(tool,action)
        return false
    end
    local function nativeDashDirection(track)
        local animation=track and track.Animation
        local id=animation and animation.AnimationId and animation.AnimationId:match('%d+')
        local status=menu.dashStatus
        if id and status and status.animationIds[id] then return status.animationIds[id] end
        local name=animation and animation.Name
        if not name then return nil end
        local side=name:match('^Dash(.+)$')
        if side~='Front' and side~='Back' and side~='Left' and side~='Right'
            and not (name=='Chase' and animation.Parent and animation.Parent.Name:find('Melee',1,true)) then return nil end
        local nativeAnimations=replicated:FindFirstChild('Animations')
        local ancestor=animation.Parent
        while ancestor do
            if ancestor==nativeAnimations then return if name=='Chase' then 'Front' else side end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function nativeDashTrack(track)
        return nativeDashDirection(track)~=nil
    end
    function control.characterDashing()
        local character=player.Character
        if not character then return false end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local active=character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true or (info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash')~=nil)
        for track in control.dashTracks do
            if track.IsPlaying~=true then control.dashTracks[track]=nil
            else active=true end
        end
        return active==true
    end
    function control.dashFacingActive()
        local character=player.Character
        if not character then return false end
        if control.dashFacingCharacter==character and clock()<(control.dashFacingUntil or 0) then return true end
        local front=menu.frontDash;local dash=front and front.cameraDash
        if dash and dash.character==character and dash.mover and dash.mover.Parent
            and clock()-dash.started<=(dash.duration or .6)+.05 then return true end
        return control.characterDashing()
    end
    local dashAssistRoles={'Lock','M1','Block','Skill','Counter','Punish','Red'}
    local function currentDashAssist()
        local record=control.dashAssistCapture
        if not record then return nil end
        local character=player.Character;local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info');local now=clock()
        local overlap=menu.actionOverlap
        local invalid=not control.alive or not control.focused or record.character~=character or not character or not character.Parent
            or not hum or not info or hum.Health<=0 or hum.PlatformStand or control.characterRagdolled(character,hum)
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()
            or characterEmoting(character)
            or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()
            or overlap and(overlap.alive==false or overlap.enabled==false or overlap.contexts and overlap.contexts.Dash==false)
            or now<record.at or now-record.at>2
        if not invalid and info then
            for _,name in {'Stun','TrueStun','Knockback','Dead'}do
                local value=character:GetAttribute(name);local marker=info:FindFirstChild(name)
                local selfLock=name=='Stun'and marker and marker:IsA('BoolValue')and marker.Value==false
                if value==true or type(value)=='number'and value>0 or marker and not selfLock then invalid=true;break end
            end
        end
        local front=menu.frontDash;local bridge=front and front.cameraDash
        local bridged=bridge and bridge.character==character and bridge.mover and bridge.mover.Parent
            and now>=bridge.started and now-bridge.started<=(bridge.duration or .6)+.05
        if bridged then record.moverAcknowledged=true end
        local actual=bridged or control.characterDashing()
        if actual then record.confirmed,record.lastNativeAt=true,now
        elseif record.confirmed and now-(record.lastNativeAt or now)>=.06 or not record.confirmed and now-record.at>.25 then invalid=true end
        if invalid then control.dashAssistCapture=nil;return nil end
        return record
    end
    local function dashRoleEnabled(role,record)
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if role=='Lock'then
            local env=menu.environment
            return control.activationAllowed() and env.LockedTarget==record.targets.Lock and env.LockConn==record.connection
                and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected~=false and(env._G.CharacterLockActive==true or env._G.CameraLockActive==true)
        elseif role=='Red'then
            local red=menu.nativeRed;local face=red and(red.faceActive or red.facePending)
            return red and red.alive~=false and red.enabled==true and red.faceTargetEnabled==true and face~=nil
                and face.character==record.character and face.phase==red.held and face.phase.confirmed==true and face.target==record.targets.Red
        elseif not assist or assist.alive==false then return false
        elseif role=='M1' then return assist.enabled==true
        elseif role=='Block'then return assist.blockAimEnabled==true or menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.referenceSettings and menu.autoBlock.referenceSettings.lookAt==true
        elseif role=='Skill'then return assist.skillAimEnabled==true
        elseif role=='Counter'then return assist.counterAimEnabled==true
        elseif role=='Punish'then return assist.punishAimEnabled==true end
        return false
    end
    function control.dashAssistTarget(role)
        role=(role or 'Lock'):gsub(' Aim$','')
        local record=currentDashAssist();local target=record and record.targets[role]
        local info=target and target:FindFirstChild('Info');local hum=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local dead=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        if target and dashRoleEnabled(role,record)and valid(target)and target:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true
            and not(info and info:FindFirstChild('Dead'))and not(dead and hum and hum:GetState()==dead)then return target end
        if record then record.targets[role]=nil end
        return nil
    end
    function control.dashAssistActive(role)
        if role then return control.dashAssistTarget(role)~=nil end
        for _,candidate in dashAssistRoles do if control.dashAssistTarget(candidate)then return true end end
        return false
    end
    function control.dashAssistFacingReady(role)
        if not control.dashAssistTarget(role)then return false end
        local bridge=menu.frontDash and menu.frontDash.cameraDash;local now=clock()
        return bridge~=nil and bridge.character==player.Character and bridge.mover~=nil and bridge.mover.Parent~=nil
            and now>=bridge.started and now-bridge.started<=(bridge.duration or .6)+.05
    end
    function control.captureDashAssists()
        local character=player.Character;local env=menu.environment;local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local existing=currentDashAssist();local now=clock()
        if existing and now-existing.at<.08 then return existing end
        local record={character=character,at=now,targets={},connection=env.LockConn}
        local function retain(role,target)
            if target and valid(target)and target:GetAttribute('Dead')~=true and dashRoleEnabled(role,record)then record.targets[role]=target end
        end
        -- Lock validity compares its selected identity, never a new selector.
        record.targets.Lock=env.LockedTarget
        if not dashRoleEnabled('Lock',record)or not valid(env.LockedTarget)then record.targets.Lock=nil end
        local red=menu.nativeRed;local face=red and(red.faceActive or red.facePending)
        if face then
            record.targets.Red=face.target
            if not dashRoleEnabled('Red',record)or not valid(face.target)then record.targets.Red=nil end
        end
        if assist then
            local held=type(assist.userM1Held)=='function'and assist.userM1Held()
            if held then retain('M1',assist.m1HeldSession and assist.m1HeldSession.character==character and assist.m1HeldSession.target or assist.lastTarget or assist.directionalTargets and assist.directionalTargets.M1)end
            local block=menu.autoBlock;local manual=block and type(block.manualBlockHeld)=='function'and block.manualBlockHeld()
            local retained=type(assist.getRetainedBlockTarget)=='function'and assist.getRetainedBlockTarget()
            if manual or block and block.held or retained then retain('Block',retained or assist.blockAimTarget or assist.blockAimSession and assist.blockAimSession.target)end
            local cast=control.skillFacing
            local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if cast and cast.character==character and not cast.manualReleased and(info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')or now-(cast.at or -math.huge)<=.8)then retain('Skill',cast.target)end
            local punish=menu.autoPunish;local pending=punish and punish.pending
            if punish and punish.enabled and pending and pending.character==character and pending.phase=='Executing'then retain('Punish',pending.target)end
            local counter=menu.nativeCounter;local phase=counter and counter.directionalPhase
            if counter and counter.enabled and phase and phase.character==character and now-(phase.at or -math.huge)<=3 then retain('Counter',phase.target)end
            local note=control.assistFacing or control.lastAssistFacing
            if note and note.character==character and now-(note.at or -math.huge)<=.15 then
                local role=note.role and note.role:gsub(' Aim$','')
                if table.find(dashAssistRoles,role)and not record.targets[role]then retain(role,note.target)end
            end
        end
        control.dashAssistCapture=if next(record.targets)then record else nil
        return control.dashAssistCapture
    end
    function control.beginDashFacing()
        local character=player.Character
        if not character then return end
        control.captureDashAssists()
        control.dashFacingCharacter,control.dashFacingUntil=character,clock()+.2
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if assist and assist.retainShiftLockShoulder then assist.retainShiftLockShoulder() end
        if assist and assist.yieldForDash then assist.yieldForDash() end
        control.finishCharacterRelease()
        if menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation then menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation() end
        control.hadCharacterControl=false
        control.characterBlend,control.cameraBlend=nil,nil
        -- Native dash selection is camera-relative. Start from that heading,
        -- never the last enemy-facing assist pose; preserve position and camera.
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local bridged=false
        for _,role in dashAssistRoles do if control.dashAssistFacingReady(role)then bridged=true;break end end
        local front=menu.frontDash
        local preservePending=control.dashAssistActive()and front and front.cameraRelativeReady==true
            and type(front.hooked)=='function'and front.hooked()==true
        if not bridged and not preservePending
            and nativeShiftLocked()
            and root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not humanoid.PlatformStand and camera then
            local look=camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local flat=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude>.001 then root.CFrame=host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+flat) end
        end
    end
    function control.dashAcquisitionSuppressed(hitRecord)
        local phase=control.noDashAcquisition
        if phase and phase.character~=player.Character then phase=nil;control.noDashAcquisition=nil end
        local active=control.characterDashing() or phase and clock()<(phase.confirmedUntil or -math.huge)
        if active then
            if not phase or phase.endedAt then
                phase={character=player.Character,startedAt=clock()};control.noDashAcquisition=phase
            end
            return true
        end
        if phase and not phase.endedAt then phase.endedAt=clock() end
        local at=hitRecord and hitRecord.at
        return hitRecord~=nil and (hitRecord.attackKind=='Dash' or phase~=nil
            and type(at)=='number' and at>=phase.startedAt and at<=phase.endedAt)
    end
    function control.observeDashAcquisition(character,origin,direction)
        if character~=player.Character then return false end
        if direction=='Front' or direction=='Back' or direction=='Left' or direction=='Right' then
            local phase=control.noDashAcquisition
            if not phase or phase.character~=character or phase.endedAt then
                phase={character=character,startedAt=clock()};control.noDashAcquisition=phase
            end
            phase.confirmedUntil=clock()+.1
        end
        control.dashAcquisitionSuppressed()
        return false
    end
    function control.onOutgoingHit(target,at,source,inferred,hitRecord)
        local prior=control.skillHitPrevious
        local accepted=acceptedOwnHit(target,hitRecord,at)
        if accepted then control.skillHitPrevious={target=target,at=at,character=player.Character} end
        if accepted and control.noteSkillContact then
            local cast=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
            local info=cast and cast.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            -- Confirmed damage during the native skill is contact even when
            -- the shared collector labelled that effect as an M1. Outside the
            -- actual skill phase, M1s never enter the steering path.
            if info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then control.noteSkillContact(target,at) end
        end
        if type(at)=='number' and control.activationResumedAt and at<control.activationResumedAt then return false end
        local observedCast=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
        local ownInfo=observedCast and observedCast.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local duringSkill=accepted and observedCast and at>=observedCast.at and ownInfo and ownInfo:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            and not (control.isCounterSkill and control.isCounterSkill(observedCast.tool))
        local isSkill=accepted and (hitRecord.attackKind=='Skill' or duringSkill~=nil and duringSkill~=false)
        if isSkill and hitRecord.attackKind~='Dash' and control.turnOffAfterSkillConnects then
            local history=control.actionSkillHits
            local previous=history and history[target]
            if previous and previous.character==player.Character and at<=previous.at then return false end
            if control.turnOffForAction('Skill',target,observedCast) then
                if not history then history=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'});control.actionSkillHits=history end
                history[target]={character=player.Character,at=at}
                return false
            end
        end
        if not hitMethodEnabled() then return false end
        local previous=prior and prior.character==player.Character and clock()-prior.at>=0
            and clock()-prior.at<=control.recentHitWindow and prior.target
        local skillAllowed=control.skillTargetAllowed(target,previous)
        if isSkill and skillAllowed and control.skillHitEnabled and control.outgoingHitEnabled and permitted() and valid(target)
            and type(at)=='number' and at==at and at<=clock() and clock()-at<=0.5 then
            local cast=control.skillFacing or (control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill())
            local locked=control.lock(target,false,hitRecord)
            if locked and cast and cast.character==player.Character and cast.kit==player.Character:GetAttribute('Moveset')
                and at>=cast.at then
                cast.target=target;cast.connection=menu.environment.LockConn;cast.assisted=nil
                control.skillFacing=cast
            end
            if locked then
                control.lastSource='Your connected native skill: '..tostring(source)
                if control.noteSkillContact then control.noteSkillContact(target,at) end
                return true
            end
        end
        if control.noteSkillContact and accepted and hitRecord.attackKind~='M1' then
            control.noteSkillContact(target,at)
        end
        if not control.outgoingHitEnabled or not accepted or not permitted() or not valid(target) then return false end
        local isM1=hitRecord.attackKind=='M1'
        -- Follow actual owned hits of every damage type. Mere nearby health loss
        -- or provisional contact is never evidence that this player dealt damage.
        local confirmed=accepted and (hitRecord.evidence=='health-delta' or hitRecord.evidence=='native-caster-victim'
            or hitRecord.evidence=='native-victim-hit' or hitRecord.evidence=='attributed-health-loss' and hitRecord.exactHealthLoss==true and type(hitRecord.delta)=='number' and hitRecord.delta<0)
        if not isM1 and not confirmed then return false end
        local now=clock()
        if type(at)~='number' or at~=at or at>now or now-at>0.5 then return false end
        control.lastOutgoingHit={target=target,at=at,source=source,inferred=inferred==true,attackKind=if isM1 then 'M1' else hitRecord.attackKind}
        control.lastSource='Your confirmed hit: '..tostring(source or 'Accepted native hit')
        local cast=control.skillFacing or (control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill())
        local locked=control.lock(target,false,hitRecord)
        if locked and cast and cast.character==player.Character and at>=cast.at then
            cast.target,cast.connection,cast.assisted=target,menu.environment.LockConn,nil;control.skillFacing=cast
            if not isM1 then control.noteSkillContact(target,at) end
        end
        return locked
    end
    function control.bindOutgoingHits()
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if tracker==control.outgoingTracker or not tracker or not tracker.onLastHit then return end
        if control.outgoingConnection then control.outgoingConnection:Disconnect() end
        if control.outgoingDamageConnection then control.outgoingDamageConnection:Disconnect();control.outgoingDamageConnection=nil end
        if control.contactConnection then control.contactConnection:Disconnect();control.contactConnection=nil end
        control.outgoingTracker=tracker
        control.outgoingConnection=tracker.onLastHit(control.onOutgoingHit)
        if tracker.onDamageHit then control.outgoingDamageConnection=tracker.onDamageHit(control.onOutgoingHit) end
        -- Native overlap queries can precede an actual hit. Steering is armed
        -- by the accepted outgoing hit stream above, never by query proximity.
        if tracker.setHitWindow then tracker.setHitWindow(control.recentHitWindow) end
    end
    function control.rememberHit(target,at)
        if valid(target) then control.recentAttacker,control.recentHitAt=target,at or clock() end
    end
    local function priorityInputActive()
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        return assist and assist.priorityInput and assist.priorityInput()~=nil or false
    end
    function control.ownsCamera(ignoreAssists)
        if characterEmoting()then return false end
        if priorityInputActive() then return false end
        if control.dashFacingActive() then return false end
        local environment=menu.environment
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local part=control.targetPart(environment.LockedTarget)
        local point=part and control.targetPoint(environment.LockedTarget,'Camera')
        return control.alive and control.activationAllowed() and control.focused and menu.characterShiftLockEnabled~=true and control.cameraSpeed>0 and environment._G.CameraLockActive==true
            and not control.visibilityPaused()
            and not (control.blockCameraFree and control.blockCameraFree())
            and not (control.skillCameraFree and control.skillCameraFree())
            and not (control.manualSkillSteeringActive and control.manualSkillSteeringActive())
            and (ignoreAssists or not (control.skillDirectionalActive and control.skillDirectionalActive()))
            and (ignoreAssists or not (menu.m1AimAssist and menu.m1AimAssist.blockDirectionalActive and menu.m1AimAssist.blockDirectionalActive()))
            and (ignoreAssists or not (menu.m1AimAssist and menu.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive and menu.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive()))
            and not (control.manualM1SteeringActive and control.manualM1SteeringActive())
            and valid(environment.LockedTarget) and environment.LockConn~=nil and environment.LockConn.Connected~=false
            and character~=nil and character.Parent~=nil and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
            and camera~=nil and camera.CFrame~=nil and type(camera.CFrame.Lerp)=='function'
            and host.CFrame~=nil and type(host.CFrame.new)=='function'
            and point~=nil
    end
    function control.characterRagdolled(character,humanoid)
        character=character or player.Character
        humanoid=humanoid or (character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'))
        if not character or not humanoid then return false end
        if humanoid.PlatformStand then return true end
        for _,name in {'Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Downed'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0) then return true end
        end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info then
            for _,name in {'Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Downed'} do if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return true end end
        end
        local states=host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
        if states and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' then
            local ok,current=pcall(humanoid.GetState,humanoid)
            if ok then
                for _,name in {'Ragdoll','FallingDown','Physics','PlatformStanding','GettingUp'} do
                    if states[name] and current==states[name] then return true end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.characterFacingPaused(root)
        if characterEmoting()then return true end
        if priorityInputActive() then return true end
        if control.dashFacingActive()and not control.dashAssistFacingReady('Lock')then return true end
        local character=player.Character
        if root and (not character or root.Parent~=character or root~=character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')) then return false end
        return not control.activationAllowed() or control.visibilityPaused('character') or control.characterRagdolled(character) or (control.manualSkillSteeringActive and control.manualSkillSteeringActive())==true
            or (control.skillDirectionalActive and control.skillDirectionalActive())==true
            or (menu.m1AimAssist and menu.m1AimAssist.blockDirectionalActive and menu.m1AimAssist.blockDirectionalActive())==true
            or (menu.m1AimAssist and menu.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive and menu.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive())==true
            or (control.manualM1SteeringActive and control.manualM1SteeringActive())==true
    end
    function control.manualM1SteeringActive()
        return false
    end
    function control.releaseRagdolledTarget()
        local env=menu.environment;local target=env.LockedTarget
        local downed=control.downedAcquisition
        if downed and downed.target==target and downed.connection==env.LockConn and control.allowDownedTargets then
            if control.characterRagdolled(target) then return false end
            control.downedAcquisition=nil
        end
        if not control.releaseOnTargetRagdoll or not target
            or not control.characterRagdolled(target) or type(env.CleanLock)~='function' then return false end
        if control.teleportTargetRetained and control.teleportTargetRetained(target) then return false end
        local cast=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
        local info=cast and cast.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if cast and control.characterSkillLocked and control.characterSkillLocked(cast)
            and info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then
            control.lastReason='Keeping the downed target through the active non-counter skill'
            return false
        end
        if control.chainFlashProtected and control.chainFlashProtected(cast) and (not cast.target or cast.target==target) then return false end
        control.bindSafeLockCleanup()
        local connection=env.LockConn
        local steering=control.detachSkillSteering and control.detachSkillSteering(target)
        local ok,message=pcall(env.CleanLock)
        if not ok then control.lastReason=tostring(message);return false end
        if env.LockedTarget==target and (env.LockConn==connection or not env.LockConn) then env.LockedTarget=nil end
        control.lastAutoTarget,control.ownedConnection,control.lastTarget=nil,nil,nil
        control.characterAcquisition,control.characterBlend=nil,nil
        if not steering then control.skillFacing=nil end
        control.lastReason='Target entered ragdoll; lock released'
        return true
    end
    function control.ownsCharacter(root)
        if control.universalSkillSteeringActive and control.universalSkillSteeringActive() then return false end
        if characterEmoting()then return false end
        if priorityInputActive() then return false end
        if control.dashFacingActive()and not control.dashAssistFacingReady('Lock')then return false end
        local environment=menu.environment
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local ownRoot=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        root=root or ownRoot
        return control.alive and control.activationAllowed() and control.focused and control.characterSpeed>0 and environment._G.CharacterLockActive==true
            and not control.visibilityPaused('character')
            and valid(environment.LockedTarget) and environment.LockConn~=nil and environment.LockConn.Connected~=false
            and character~=nil and character.Parent~=nil and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
            and not control.characterRagdolled(character,humanoid)
            and root~=nil and root==ownRoot and root.Parent==character and root.CFrame~=nil and type(root.CFrame.Lerp)=='function'
    end
    local function clearBlend(mode)
        control[mode..'Blend'],control[mode..'Target'],control[mode..'Source']=nil,nil,nil
        control[mode..'DirectionGuard']=nil
    end
    local function finiteNumber(value)
        return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function finitePoint(value)
        return value and finiteNumber(value.X) and finiteNumber(value.Y) and finiteNumber(value.Z)
    end
    function control.rotationPaused(mode,object)
        if control.visibilityPaused(mode) then return true end
        local environment=menu.environment
        local target,connection=environment.LockedTarget,environment.LockConn
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local part=control.targetPart(target)
        if not root or not part or not object or not object.CFrame then return true end
        local ownPosition=root.Position
        local targetRoot=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local targetPosition=if mode=='character' and targetRoot then targetRoot.Position else part.Position
        if not finitePoint(ownPosition) or not finitePoint(targetPosition) then return true end
        local shared=control.overlapGuard
        if not shared or shared.root~=root or shared.target~=target or shared.connection~=connection then
            shared={root=root,target=target,connection=connection,paused=false}
            control.overlapGuard=shared
        end
        local dx,dz=targetPosition.X-ownPosition.X,targetPosition.Z-ownPosition.Z
        -- Facing is undefined over the same horizontal point. Use real torso
        -- separation, independent of rotating local-axis aim offsets.
        -- Camera proximity protection must not freeze character yaw at melee
        -- distance. Only coincident centers lack a meaningful facing direction.
        local proximityKey=mode..'Paused'
        local radius=if mode=='character' then (if shared[proximityKey] then .04 else .02) else (if shared[proximityKey] then 2.25 else 1.5)
        shared[proximityKey]=dx*dx+dz*dz<=radius*radius
        local point=control.targetPoint(target,if mode=='camera' then 'Camera' else 'Character')
        local origin=object.CFrame.Position
        if not finitePoint(point) or not finitePoint(origin) then return true end
        local x,y,z=point.X-origin.X,point.Y-origin.Y,point.Z-origin.Z
        local horizontalSquared=x*x+z*z
        local guard=control[mode..'DirectionGuard']
        if not guard or guard.object~=object or guard.root~=root or guard.target~=target or guard.connection~=connection then
            guard={object=object,root=root,target=target,connection=connection,paused=false}
            control[mode..'DirectionGuard']=guard
        end
        if mode=='camera' then
            local totalSquared=horizontalSquared+y*y
            local ratio=if guard.paused then .12 else .08
            guard.paused=totalSquared<=.01 or horizontalSquared<=totalSquared*ratio*ratio
        else
            -- Character Y is deliberately flattened by the native callback.
            -- An offset can still put its separate aim point on the root.
            local minimum=if guard.paused then .02 else .01
            guard.paused=horizontalSquared<=minimum*minimum
        end
        return shared[proximityKey] or guard.paused
    end
    function control.effectiveLockActive(): boolean
        -- A selected target alone is retained state, not an active facing owner.
        -- Test the lock independently of assist predicates to avoid priority loops.
        if characterEmoting()or not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) or control.dashFacingActive()and not control.dashAssistFacingReady('Lock')
            or (control.manualSkillSteeringActive and control.manualSkillSteeringActive())
            or (control.manualM1SteeringActive and control.manualM1SteeringActive()) then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if control.ownsCharacter(root) and not control.rotationPaused('character',root) then return true end
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        return control.ownsCamera(true) and not control.rotationPaused('camera',camera) or false
    end
    function control.setSmoothSeconds(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value) or 0.18
        if amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then amount=0.18 end
        control.smoothSeconds=math.clamp(amount,0.01,1)
        -- Retain the old config field without letting its later restore
        -- replace either independent speed. New character facing is quicker.
        if not control.cameraSpeedExplicit then control.cameraSpeed=1/control.smoothSeconds end
    end
    local function setSpeed(mode,value)
        local fallback=if mode=='character' then 20 else 1/0.18
        local amount=tonumber(value) or fallback
        if amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then amount=fallback end
        control[mode..'Speed']=math.clamp(amount,1,100)
        control[mode..'SpeedExplicit']=true
    end
    function control.setCharacterSpeed(value) setSpeed('character',value) end
    function control.setCameraSpeed(value) setSpeed('camera',value) end
    function control.setCharacterTransitionSpeed(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value) or 5
        if amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then amount=5 end
        control.characterTransitionSpeed=math.clamp(amount,0,100)
    end
    function control.setCharacterTransitionCurve(value)
        if value=='Smooth' or value=='Linear' or value=='Exponential' or value=='Reverse Exponential' or value=='Bounce' or value=='Elastic' or value=='Custom' then control.characterTransitionCurve=value end
    end
    function control.setCharacterReleaseCurve(value)
        if table.find({'Smooth','Linear','Exponential','Reverse Exponential','Bounce','Elastic','Custom'},value) then control.characterReleaseCurve=value end
    end
    function control.setCurvePoint(phase,index,value)
        if not control.curvePoints[phase] or not finiteNumber(value) or index<1 or index>4 then return false end
        control.curvePoints[phase][index]=math.clamp(value,0,1);return true
    end
    local function bezier(t,a,b)
        return 3*(1-t)^2*t*a+3*(1-t)*t*t*b+t^3
    end
    function control.customCurve(progress,phase)
        local p=control.curvePoints[phase or 'Initial'];local low,high=0,1
        -- Invert x so nonuniform control-point spacing still measures real time.
        for _=1,24 do local t=(low+high)/2;if bezier(t,p[1],p[3])<progress then low=t else high=t end end
        return bezier((low+high)/2,p[2],p[4])
    end
    function control.setCharacterReleasingSpeed(value)
        local amount=tonumber(value) or 5
        if amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then amount=5 end
        control.characterReleasingSpeed=math.clamp(amount,0,100)
        if control.characterReleasingSpeed==0 then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
    end
    local function initialEase(progress,phase)
        local curve=if phase=='Release' then (control.characterReleaseCurve or control.characterTransitionCurve) else control.characterTransitionCurve
        if progress<=0 then return 0 end
        if progress>=1 then return 1 end
        if curve=='Custom' then return control.customCurve(progress,phase) end
        if curve=='Linear' then return progress end
        if curve=='Exponential' then return (math.exp(3*progress)-1)/(math.exp(3)-1) end
        if curve=='Reverse Exponential' then return 1-(math.exp(3*(1-progress))-1)/(math.exp(3)-1) end
        if curve=='Bounce' then
            if progress<1/2.75 then return 7.5625*progress*progress end
            if progress<2/2.75 then progress-=1.5/2.75;return 7.5625*progress*progress+.75 end
            if progress<2.5/2.75 then progress-=2.25/2.75;return 7.5625*progress*progress+.9375 end
            progress-=2.625/2.75;return 7.5625*progress*progress+.984375
        end
        if curve=='Elastic' then
            return 1+2^(-10*progress)*math.sin((10*progress-.75)*(2*math.pi/3))
        end
        return progress*progress*(3-2*progress)
    end
    control.evaluateCurve=initialEase
    local function returnContext(character)
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return {nativeActionMarker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill'),
            nativeSkill=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill(),
            manualM1=control.manualM1SteeringActive and control.manualM1SteeringActive(),
            nativeM1Marker=info and (info:FindFirstChild('Melee') or info:FindFirstChild('Attacking')),
            lockTarget=menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget}
    end
    local function newNativeFacingAction(character,proof)
        local current=returnContext(character)
        return (current.nativeActionMarker and (not proof or current.nativeActionMarker~=proof.nativeActionMarker))
            or (current.nativeSkill and (not proof or current.nativeSkill~=proof.nativeSkill))
            or (current.manualM1 and not (proof and proof.manualM1))
            or (current.nativeM1Marker and (not proof or current.nativeM1Marker~=proof.nativeM1Marker))
    end
    local function facingProof(root,role)
        for _,note in {control.assistFacing or false,control.lastAssistFacing or false} do
            if note and note.root==root and humanizedRole(note.role)==humanizedRole(role) then return note end
        end
        return if role=='Lock' then control.characterControlProof else nil
    end
    local function returnTargetValid(target)
        if not valid(target) then return false end
        local dead=target:GetAttribute('Dead')
        local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return dead~=true and not (type(dead)=='number' and dead>0)
            and not target:FindFirstChild('Dead') and not (info and info:FindFirstChild('Dead'))
    end
    local function configureAssistReturn(release,role,proof)
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        release.assistRole=key
        release.assistReturnSeconds=control.assistReturnDuration(role)
        release.fadeExplicit=key and control.assistFadeOverride[key]==true
        if release.yawVelocity==nil and proof and finiteNumber(proof.yawVelocity) then release.yawVelocity=proof.yawVelocity end
        release.nativeM1Marker=returnContext(player.Character).nativeM1Marker
        release.assistTarget=proof and (proof.target or key=='Lock' and proof.lockTarget) or release.assistTarget
        if not release.assistTarget and key=='Lock' then release.assistTarget=menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget end
        local targetHum=release.assistTarget and release.assistTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if targetHum and targetHum.Died and type(targetHum.Died.Connect)=='function' and not release.targetDeathConnection then
            release.targetDeathConnection=targetHum.Died:Connect(function()
                if control.characterRelease==release then control.cancelAssistReturn() end
            end)
        end
    end
    function control.finishCharacterRelease()
        local release=control.characterRelease
        control.characterRelease=nil
        if release and release.targetDeathConnection then release.targetDeathConnection:Disconnect();release.targetDeathConnection=nil end
        local lease=release and release.rotationLease
        if not lease then return end
        if menu.restoreRotationLease then menu.restoreRotationLease(lease)
        elseif lease.character==player.Character and lease.humanoid.Parent==lease.character and lease.humanoid.AutoRotate==false then
            lease.humanoid.AutoRotate=lease.previous
        end
    end
    function control.beginCharacterRelease(root,frame,role)
        if pauseEmoteFacing and pauseEmoteFacing()then return end
        role=role or 'Lock'
        local turn=menu.turnRates and menu.turnRates['Character Release']
        local humanized=control.isAssistHumanized(role)
        local timed=humanized or configuredReturn(role)
        if timed and newNativeFacingAction(player.Character,facingProof(root,role)) then control.finishCharacterRelease();return end
        if (not timed and control.characterReleasingSpeed<=0 and not (turn and turn.time>0)) or not root or not root.CFrame then control.finishCharacterRelease();return end
        if control.characterRelease and control.characterRelease.root==root then return end
        control.finishCharacterRelease()
        local character=player.Character
        local release={root=root,character=character,frame=frame or root.CFrame,progress=0}
        if timed then
            release.assistReturn,release.humanized=true,humanized
            configureAssistReturn(release,role,facingProof(root,role))
        end
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        release.nativeActionMarker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        release.nativeSkill=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
        release.manualM1=control.manualM1SteeringActive and control.manualM1SteeringActive()
        control.characterRelease=release
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local rotation=menu.cameraOnlyRotation
        local shiftLocked=menu.characterShiftLockEnabled==true or nativeShiftLocked()
        if (shiftLocked or timed) and humanoid and type(humanoid.AutoRotate)=='boolean' and (humanoid.AutoRotate or rotation and rotation.humanoid==humanoid) then
            release.rotationLease={character=character,humanoid=humanoid,previous=if rotation and rotation.humanoid==humanoid then rotation.previous else humanoid.AutoRotate}
            humanoid.AutoRotate=false
        end
    end
    -- Successful assist writes are observed by the existing final dispatcher.
    -- A sequence, rather than an age threshold, survives slow render frames.
    function control.noteAssistFacing(root,target,role,frame)
        if characterEmoting()then return end
        local own=player.Character
        if not own or root~=own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') then return end
        local previous=control.assistFacing
        local now=clock();local facing=frame or root.CFrame
        local velocity
        if previous and previous.root==root and previous.character==own and previous.role==role
            and previous.frame and finitePoint(previous.frame.LookVector) and finitePoint(facing.LookVector) then
            local dt=now-previous.at
            if finiteNumber(dt) and dt>0 and dt<=.25 then
                local before,after=previous.frame.LookVector,facing.LookVector
                local difference=math.atan2(-after.X,-after.Z)-math.atan2(-before.X,-before.Z)
                velocity=math.atan2(math.sin(difference),math.cos(difference))/dt
                if not finiteNumber(velocity) then velocity=nil end
            end
        end
        control.assistFacingSequence=(control.assistFacingSequence or 0)+1
        control.assistFacing={root=root,character=own,target=target,role=role,yawVelocity=velocity,
            frame=facing,sequence=control.assistFacingSequence,at=now}
        for key,value in returnContext(own) do control.assistFacing[key]=value end
    end
    function control.cancelAssistReturn()
        control.assistFacing,control.lastAssistFacing=nil,nil
        control.assistFacingRendered=control.assistFacingSequence
        local release=control.characterRelease
        if release and release.assistReturn then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
    end
    pauseEmoteFacing=function(): boolean
        if not characterEmoting()then return false end
        control.cancelAssistReturn();control.finishCharacterRelease()
        if menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation then menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation()end
        -- An emote is a new native owner. Retain selected targets/settings,
        -- never replay a pre-emote heading or delayed assist after it ends.
        control.hadCharacterControl=false;control.lastControlledRoot=nil;control.lastControlledFrame=nil
        control.characterControlProof=nil;control.skillFacingApplied=false
        control.humanizedOnset,control.rampOnset=nil,nil
        control.lastReason='Native emote owns character facing'
        return true
    end
    local function assistReturnBlocked(root)
        local own=player.Character
        local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if characterEmoting(own)or not control.alive or not control.focused or not own or not own.Parent or not hum or hum.Health<=0
            or root~=own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or not root or not root.CFrame
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or control.characterRagdolled(own,hum)
            or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())
            or control.dashFacingActive() or control.effectiveLockActive()
            or (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) then return true end
        local info=own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        for _,name in {'Stun','TrueStun','Knockback','NoRotate','NoRotation','InDash','Dead'} do
            local value=own:GetAttribute(name)
            local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild(name)
            -- Stun(false) is the native action's self-lock, also recognized by
            -- M1 aim. It must not convert normal action cleanup into a snap.
            local selfLock=name=='Stun' and marker and marker:IsA('BoolValue') and marker.Value==false
            if value==true or (type(value)=='number' and value>0) or (marker and not selfLock) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.beginAssistReturn(root,frame,role,lease)
        if pauseEmoteFacing()then return false end
        if (not control.isAssistHumanized(role) and not configuredReturn(role)) or assistReturnBlocked(root) then return false end
        local own=player.Character
        if newNativeFacingAction(own,facingProof(root,role)) then return false end
        local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not hum or (lease and (lease.character~=own or lease.humanoid~=hum)) then return false end
        local release=control.characterRelease
        if release and release.root==root and release.assistReturn and release.rotationLease==lease then return true end
        if not lease and hum.AutoRotate==false then return false end
        control.finishCharacterRelease()
        release={root=root,character=own,frame=frame or root.CFrame,progress=0,assistReturn=true,humanized=control.isAssistHumanized(role),
            assistRole=humanizedRole(role),assistReturnSeconds=control.assistReturnDuration(role),rotationLease=lease}
        configureAssistReturn(release,role,facingProof(root,role))
        if not lease then release.rotationLease={character=own,humanoid=hum,previous=hum.AutoRotate,owner=control} end
        control.characterRelease=release
        local info=own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        release.nativeActionMarker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        release.nativeSkill=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
        release.manualM1=control.manualM1SteeringActive and control.manualM1SteeringActive()
        hum.AutoRotate=false
        control.lastAssistFacing=nil;control.assistFacingRendered=control.assistFacingSequence
        control.humanizedOnset,control.rampOnset=nil,nil
        return true
    end
    -- A brief critically damped onset for direct native facing paths (Red).
    -- Established tracking returns to its existing exact live target response.
    function control.humanizedFacingFrame(root,desired,role,delta,target,session)
        if characterEmoting()then return root and root.CFrame or desired end
        if control.isAssistRampIntoLaser(role)and root and root.CFrame and desired then
            local key=humanizedRole(role)
            local seconds=control.getAssistRampSeconds(role)
            if seconds<=0 then return desired end
            local state=control.rampOnset
            if not state or state.root~=root or state.role~=key or state.target~=target or state.session~=session then
                state={root=root,role=key,target=target,session=session,yaw=math.atan2(-root.CFrame.LookVector.X,-root.CFrame.LookVector.Z),elapsed=0}
                control.rampOnset=state
            end
            local step=tonumber(delta)or control.renderDelta or 1/60
            if not finiteNumber(step)or step<=0 then return root.CFrame end
            local maximum=menu.turnRate and menu.turnRate(key..' Aim')or 0
            if state.elapsed>=seconds and maximum<=0 then return desired end
            local before=math.min(1,state.elapsed/seconds)
            state.elapsed=math.min(seconds,state.elapsed+step)
            local after=state.elapsed/seconds
            if after>=1-1e-12 then after=1;state.elapsed=seconds end
            local fractionBefore,fractionAfter=before^3,after^3
            local alpha=if after>=1 then 1 else math.clamp((fractionAfter-fractionBefore)/math.max(1-fractionBefore,1e-12),0,1)
            local goal=math.atan2(-desired.LookVector.X,-desired.LookVector.Z)
            local difference=math.atan2(math.sin(goal-state.yaw),math.cos(goal-state.yaw))
            local change=difference*alpha
            if maximum>0 then change=math.clamp(change,-math.rad(maximum)*step,math.rad(maximum)*step)end
            state.yaw+=change
            return host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(state.yaw),0,-math.cos(state.yaw)))
        end
        if not control.isAssistHumanized(role) or not root or not root.CFrame or not desired then return desired end
        local key=humanizedRole(role)
        local state=control.humanizedOnset
        local seconds=control.getAssistIntroSeconds(role)
        if seconds<=0 then return desired end
        if not state or state.root~=root or state.role~=key or state.target~=target then
            state={root=root,role=key,target=target,yaw=math.atan2(-root.CFrame.LookVector.X,-root.CFrame.LookVector.Z),velocity=0,elapsed=0}
            control.humanizedOnset=state
        end
        local step=tonumber(delta) or control.renderDelta or 1/60
        if not finiteNumber(step) or step<=0 then return root.CFrame end
        local goal=math.atan2(-desired.LookVector.X,-desired.LookVector.Z)
        local difference=math.atan2(math.sin(goal-state.yaw),math.cos(goal-state.yaw))
        if control.assistIntroOverride[key] then
            if state.elapsed>=seconds then return desired end
            local before=math.min(1,state.elapsed/seconds)
            state.elapsed+=step
            local after=math.min(1,state.elapsed/seconds)
            if after>=1-1e-12 then after=1;state.elapsed=seconds end
            local easedBefore=before*before*(3-2*before)
            local easedAfter=after*after*(3-2*after)
            local alpha=if after>=1 then 1 else math.clamp((easedAfter-easedBefore)/math.max(1-easedBefore,1e-12),0,1)
            state.yaw+=difference*alpha
            return host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(state.yaw),0,-math.cos(state.yaw)))
        end
        if state.elapsed>=seconds*2 then return desired end
        step=math.min(step,.1)
        local omega=8/seconds
        local spring=(state.velocity-omega*difference)*step
        local decay=math.exp(-omega*step)
        local change=difference+(-difference+spring)*decay
        state.velocity=(state.velocity-omega*spring)*decay
        if change*difference>0 and math.abs(change)>math.abs(difference) then change=difference;state.velocity=0 end
        state.yaw+=change;state.elapsed+=step
        return host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(state.yaw),0,-math.cos(state.yaw)))
    end
    function control.stepAssistReturn(delta)
        if pauseEmoteFacing()then return end
        local own=player.Character
        local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if control.dashFacingActive()and control.dashAssistActive()then
            local note=control.assistFacing
            if note and note.character==own and note.root==root then
                control.lastAssistFacing=note;control.assistFacingRendered=note.sequence
            end
            -- Retain only the last actually applied facing. Return movement
            -- starts after dash ownership ends, never against its native mover.
            return
        end
        if assistReturnBlocked(root) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
        local note=control.assistFacing
        if note and note.sequence~=control.assistFacingRendered then
            control.assistFacingRendered=note.sequence
            control.lastAssistFacing=note
            local release=control.characterRelease
            if release and release.assistReturn then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
            return
        end
        -- Red writes later in the same render pass; do not mistake its order
        -- for an assist ending, including at very low frame rates.
        local red=menu.nativeRed
        if red and red.facingActive and red.facingActive() then return end
        local last=control.lastAssistFacing
        if last then
            if last.character~=own or last.root~=root or (not control.isAssistHumanized(last.role) and last.target and not valid(last.target)) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
            if (control.isAssistHumanized(last.role) or configuredReturn(last.role)) and newNativeFacingAction(own,last) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
            local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
            local seconds=control.assistReturnDuration(last.role)
            if seconds<=0 and not configuredReturn(last.role) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
            local release=control.characterRelease
            if not release or not release.assistReturn then
                local hum=own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local lease=assist and assist.shiftLockAimLease
                -- Another native action may still be restoring its own lease.
                -- Keep the last applied heading for that cleanup, without writing.
                if not lease and hum.AutoRotate==false then
                    last.waitedFrames=(last.waitedFrames or 0)+1
                    if last.waitedFrames>2 then control.cancelAssistReturn() end
                    return
                end
                control.finishCharacterRelease()
                release={root=root,character=own,frame=last.frame,progress=0,assistReturn=true,assistReturnSeconds=seconds,
                    assistRole=humanizedRole(last.role),humanized=control.isAssistHumanized(last.role)}
                control.characterRelease=release
                if lease and lease.humanoid==hum then assist.shiftLockAimLease=nil
                else lease={character=own,humanoid=hum,previous=hum.AutoRotate,owner=assist} end
                release.rotationLease=lease
                local info=own:FindFirstChild('Info')
                release.nativeActionMarker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
                release.nativeSkill=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
                release.manualM1=control.manualM1SteeringActive and control.manualM1SteeringActive()
                hum.AutoRotate=false
            end
            release.assistReturn=true
            release.assistReturnSeconds=seconds
            release.assistRole=humanizedRole(last.role);release.humanized=control.isAssistHumanized(last.role)
            release.assistTarget=last.target
            configureAssistReturn(release,last.role,last)
            control.lastAssistFacing=nil
        end
        if control.characterRelease and control.characterRelease.assistReturn then control.stepCharacterRelease(delta) end
    end
    function control.captureCharacterRelease()
        if pauseEmoteFacing()then return false end
        local env=menu.environment
        local own=player.Character
        local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local active=(env._G.CharacterLockActive==true and env.LockedTarget~=nil
            and env.LockConn~=nil and env.LockConn.Connected~=false)
            or (control.hadCharacterControl and control.lastControlledRoot==root)
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or not own or not own.Parent
            or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or not root or not root.CFrame
            or control.characterRagdolled(own,hum)
            or not active
            or (menu.directionalLock and menu.directionalLock.enabled) then return false end
        control.beginCharacterRelease(root)
        -- The render fallback must not recapture a heading after cleanup snaps it.
        control.hadCharacterControl=false
        return control.characterRelease~=nil
    end
    function control.characterReleaseFrame(root,desired,delta)
        if pauseEmoteFacing()then return root and root.CFrame or desired end
        local release=control.characterRelease
        if not release or release.root~=root or release.character~=player.Character or not desired or not desired.Position then return desired end
        local elapsed=tonumber(delta) or control.renderDelta or 1/60
        if not finiteNumber(elapsed) then elapsed=0 end
        if release.assistReturn then
            local current=release.yaw
            if current==nil then
                local look=release.frame.LookVector
                if not finitePoint(look) then control.finishCharacterRelease();return desired end
                current=math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z)
            end
            local look=desired.LookVector
            if not finitePoint(look) then return root.CFrame end
            local goal=math.atan2(-look.X,-look.Z)
            local difference=math.atan2(math.sin(goal-current),math.cos(goal-current))
            local step=math.clamp(elapsed,0,.1)
            local previousGoal=release.returnGoalYaw
            local goalChange=if previousGoal then math.atan2(math.sin(goal-previousGoal),math.cos(goal-previousGoal)) else 0
            local goalVelocity=if step>0 and previousGoal then goalChange/math.max(elapsed,1e-12) else 0
            if not finiteNumber(goalVelocity) then goalVelocity=0 end
            if previousGoal and math.abs(goalChange)>1e-6 then release.followMovingGoal=true end
            release.returnGoalYaw=goal
            if release.fadeExplicit and (release.assistReturnSeconds or 0)<=0 then
                release.yaw,release.yawVelocity=goal,goalVelocity
                control.finishCharacterRelease()
                return desired
            end
            if release.fadeExplicit and not release.followMovingGoal then
                local seconds=math.max(1e-12,release.assistReturnSeconds or 0)
                if release.fadeOriginYaw==nil then
                    release.fadeOriginYaw=current;release.fadeDistance=difference
                    release.fadeInitialVelocity=release.yawVelocity or 0
                end
                release.fadeElapsed=(release.fadeElapsed or 0)+math.max(0,elapsed)
                local progress=math.min(1,release.fadeElapsed/seconds)
                if progress>=1-1e-12 then progress=1;release.fadeElapsed=seconds end
                local eased=if release.humanized then progress^3*(progress*(progress*6-15)+10) else progress*progress*(3-2*progress)
                local derivative=if release.humanized then 30*progress^2*(1-progress)^2 else 6*progress*(1-progress)
                -- Quintic endpoint constraints preserve incoming angular speed
                -- while reaching a stationary goal with zero final velocity.
                local carry=if release.humanized then (release.fadeInitialVelocity or 0) else 0
                local velocityShape=progress-6*progress^3+8*progress^4-3*progress^5
                local velocityDerivative=1-18*progress^2+32*progress^3-15*progress^4
                local yaw=release.fadeOriginYaw+release.fadeDistance*eased+carry*seconds*velocityShape
                release.yaw=yaw
                release.yawVelocity=release.fadeDistance*derivative/seconds+carry*velocityDerivative
                local result=host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw),0,-math.cos(yaw)))
                if progress>=1 then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
                return result
            end
            local seconds=math.clamp(release.assistReturnSeconds or .08,.016,5)
            local omega=(if release.humanized then 3 else 6)/seconds
            local velocity=release.yawVelocity or 0
            -- Solve the damped spring relative to the live moving goal. Its
            -- measured angular velocity feeds forward without moving camera.
            local goalStart=goal-goalVelocity*step
            local error=math.atan2(math.sin(current-goalStart),math.cos(current-goalStart))
            local relativeVelocity=velocity-goalVelocity
            local spring=(relativeVelocity+omega*error)*step
            local decay=math.exp(-omega*step)
            local remaining=(error+spring)*decay
            local nextRelativeVelocity=(relativeVelocity-omega*spring)*decay
            local yaw=goal+remaining
            release.yaw,release.yawVelocity=yaw,goalVelocity+nextRelativeVelocity
            release.elapsed=(release.elapsed or 0)+step
            local result=host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+host.Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw),0,-math.cos(yaw)))
            if math.abs(remaining)<math.rad(.15) and math.abs(nextRelativeVelocity)<math.rad(10) then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
            return result
        end
        local turn=menu.turnRates and menu.turnRates['Character Release']
        local speed=if release.assistReturn and release.assistReturnSeconds and release.assistReturnSeconds>0 then 1/release.assistReturnSeconds
            elseif turn and turn.time>0 then 1/turn.time else control.characterReleasingSpeed
        release.progress=math.min(1,release.progress+math.clamp(elapsed,0,.1)*speed)
        local origin=release.frame+(desired.Position-release.frame.Position)
        local progress=initialEase(release.progress,'Release')
        local result=if menu.spinTurn then menu.spinTurn(origin,desired,progress,'Character Release') else origin:Lerp(desired,progress)
        if release.progress>=1 or speed<=0 then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
        return result
    end
    local function currentCharacterAcquisition(acquisition)
        local environment=menu.environment
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return acquisition and control.alive and character and character.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
            and acquisition.object==character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') and acquisition.object.Parent==character
            and acquisition.target==environment.LockedTarget and valid(acquisition.target)
            and acquisition.connection==environment.LockConn and environment.LockConn and environment.LockConn.Connected~=false
    end
    function control.smoothAlpha(delta,mode)
        local elapsed=tonumber(delta) or 0
        if elapsed~=elapsed or math.abs(elapsed)==math.huge then elapsed=0 end
        local speed=if mode=='character' then control.characterSpeed else control.cameraSpeed
        return JujutsuerLockCore.normalizedAlpha(JujutsuerLockCore.smoothnessFromSpeed(speed),math.clamp(elapsed,0,0.1))
    end
    local function smoothFrame(mode,object,desired,delta)
        if mode=='character' and menu.nativeVariants then local facing=menu.nativeVariants.facingFrame(object);if facing then return facing end end
        local target=menu.environment.LockedTarget
        local connection=menu.environment.LockConn
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local current=object.CFrame
        local now=clock()
        local blend=control[mode..'Blend']
        local acquisition
        if mode=='character' then
            acquisition=control.characterAcquisition
            if not currentCharacterAcquisition(acquisition) then
                acquisition={object=object,target=target,connection=menu.environment.LockConn,progress=0,completed=false,frame=current}
                control.characterAcquisition=acquisition
                blend=nil
            end
        end
        if not blend or blend.object~=object or blend.target~=target or blend.connection~=connection or blend.characterRoot~=root then
            -- Begin at the real view/facing once. Movement and a moving aim
            -- point continue the same blend instead of restarting each frame.
            blend={object=object,target=target,connection=connection,characterRoot=root,frame=current,started=now,lastAt=now}
            if mode=='camera' then blend.camera=object else blend.root=object end
            control[mode..'Blend']=blend
            if delta==nil then delta=control.renderDelta or 1/60 end
        elseif delta==nil then
            delta=now-blend.lastAt
        end
        local from=current
        -- Preserve the exact native position, including movement/knockback.
        -- Only orientation is interpolated, never translation or velocity.
        local movement=desired.Position-from.Position
        if movement.Magnitude>0 then from=from+movement end
        if control.rotationPaused(mode,object) then
            -- Keep native camera/root translation while holding the last stable
            -- orientation. No velocity or movement input is owned here.
            blend.frame,blend.lastAt=from,now
            control[mode..'Target']=target
            control[mode..'Source']=if control.ownsTarget() then 'Automatic' else 'Manual'
            return from
        end
        -- The intro never changes tracking speed. Once acquired, native dashes
        -- keep exact target facing rather than adding another eased turn.
        local alpha=control.smoothAlpha(delta,mode)
        local ramp=mode=='character'and control.isAssistRampIntoLaser('Lock')
        local customIntro=ramp or mode=='character' and control.isAssistHumanized('Lock') and control.assistIntroOverride.Lock
        local initialStep=acquisition and not acquisition.completed
        if initialStep then
            local turn=menu.turnRates and menu.turnRates['Character Initial']
            local introSeconds=customIntro and(if ramp then control.getAssistRampSeconds('Lock')else control.getAssistIntroSeconds('Lock'))
            local speed=if customIntro then (if introSeconds>0 then 1/introSeconds else 0)
                elseif turn and turn.time>0 then 1/turn.time else control.characterTransitionSpeed
            if speed<=0 then
                acquisition.progress,acquisition.completed=1,true
                if customIntro then alpha=1 end
            else
                local elapsed=tonumber(delta) or 0
                if elapsed~=elapsed or math.abs(elapsed)==math.huge then elapsed=0 end
                local previous=acquisition.progress
                local progress=math.min(1,previous+(if customIntro then math.max(0,elapsed) else math.clamp(elapsed,0,0.1))*speed)
                if progress>=1-1e-9 then progress=1 end
                -- One finite onset from the original facing to the live goal.
                -- Its absolute curve can bounce/overshoot and settle exactly;
                -- incremental clamping would erase those selected motions.
                local start=acquisition.frame
                from=start+(desired.Position-start.Position)
                alpha=if ramp then progress^3 else initialEase(progress)
                acquisition.progress,acquisition.completed=progress,progress==1
            end
        end
        local introducing=acquisition and acquisition.progress<1
        local frame
        if initialStep then
            frame=if introducing and menu.spinTurn and not ramp then menu.spinTurn(from,desired,alpha,'Character Initial') else from:Lerp(desired,alpha)
        elseif customIntro then
            frame=desired
        else
            local speed=if mode=='character' then control.characterSpeed else control.cameraSpeed
            frame=JujutsuerLockCore.trackingFrame(current,desired,JujutsuerLockCore.smoothnessFromSpeed(speed),delta or control.renderDelta or 1/60)
        end
        if mode=='character' and (ramp or not introducing) and menu.limitTurn then
            frame=menu.limitTurn(object,frame,delta or control.renderDelta,'Character Lock')
        end
        blend.frame,blend.lastAt=frame,now
        control[mode..'Target']=target
        control[mode..'Source']=if control.ownsTarget() then 'Automatic' else 'Manual'
        return frame
    end
    function control.smoothCameraFrame(camera,desired,delta)
        if characterEmoting()then return camera and camera.CFrame or desired end
        if camera~=host.workspace.CurrentCamera or not control.ownsCamera() or not desired or not desired.Position then
            clearBlend('camera');return desired
        end
        return smoothFrame('camera',camera,desired,delta)
    end
    function control.smoothCharacterFrame(root,desired,delta)
        if root and control.characterFacingPaused(root) then
            clearBlend('character');return root.CFrame
        end
        if not control.ownsCharacter(root) or not desired or not desired.Position then
            clearBlend('character');return desired
        end
        control.nativeCharacterEpoch=control.manualInputFrame or 0
        local skillFrame=control.skillFacingFrame and control.skillFacingFrame(root)
        if skillFrame then
            -- Skill direction must not be pulled back to the locked target in
            -- Mouse mode. Keep normal camera tracking and movement position.
            if control.characterBlend then control.characterBlend.frame=skillFrame end
            return skillFrame
        end
        return smoothFrame('character',root,desired,delta)
    end
    control.skillAimMode='Locked target'
    control.manualSkillSteering=true
    control.noSkillDirectionalLock=false
    -- One yaw owner for all local action categories. No native state deletion,
    -- mover rewrites, camera transforms, or additional render connections.
    control.directionFreedomEnabled=false
    control.directionFreedomContexts={Skills=true,M1=true,Block=true,Dash=true,Recovery=true,Jump=true,Emotes=true,Movement=true}
    control.directionFreedomAssists={Lock=true,M1=true,Block=true,Skill=true,Counter=true,Punish=true,Red=true}
    function control.setDirectionFreedomEnabled(value)
        control.directionFreedomEnabled=control.alive and value==true
        if not control.directionFreedomEnabled and control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering then control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering()end
    end
    function control.setDirectionFreedomContext(kind,value)
        if control.directionFreedomContexts[kind]==nil or type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        control.directionFreedomContexts[kind]=value
        if kind=='Skills'then control.noSkillDirectionalLock=value;if value then control.skillSteeringDirection='Camera'end end
        if control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering then control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering()end
        return true
    end
    function control.setDirectionFreedomAssist(role,value)
        if control.directionFreedomAssists[role]==nil or type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        control.directionFreedomAssists[role]=value;return true
    end
    function control.assistDirectionFreedomAllowed(role)
        local key=type(role)=='string'and role:gsub(' Aim$','')or'M1'
        return control.directionFreedomAssists[key]~=false
    end
    function control.setNoSkillDirectionalLock(value)
        local enabled=control.alive and value==true
        control.noSkillDirectionalLock=enabled
        control.directionFreedomContexts.Skills=enabled
        if enabled then control.skillSteeringDirection='Camera'end
        if not control.noSkillDirectionalLock and control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering then control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering() end
    end
    control.skillSteeringStart='On contact'
    control.yujiChainFlash=false
    function control.setYujiChainFlash(value)control.yujiChainFlash=control.alive and value==true end
    function control.chainFlashProtected(context)
        return control.yujiChainFlash and context~=nil and context.kit=='Itadori' and context.service=='DivergentFistService'
    end
    function control.setSkillSteeringStart(value)
        if value~='On contact' and value~='Immediately' then return false end
        control.skillSteeringStart=value;return true
    end
    control.skillSteeringDirection='Mouse or camera'
    function control.setManualSkillSteering(value) control.manualSkillSteering=control.alive and value==true end
    function control.setSkillSteeringDirection(value)
        if not table.find({'Mouse or camera','Mouse','Camera','Keyboard','Both'},value) then return false end
        if control.noSkillDirectionalLock then value='Camera'end
        if control.skillSteeringDirection~=value then
            control.skillSteeringDirection=value
            control.skillSteeringRevision=(control.skillSteeringRevision or 0)+1
            control.lastSteeringMousePosition=nil;control.manualMouseDelta=nil
        end
        return true
    end
    control.skillAimHooks={}
    control.skillSignalHooks={}
    control.skillActionConnections={}
    control.skillAimScopes=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.skillLaunchScopes=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.summonAimScopes=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.summonSpecialScopes=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.summonAimSelections=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    control.summonAimTargetMode={'Closest to cursor'}
    function control.setSummonAimTargetMode(value)
        local selected,valid=menu.targetMethods.normalize(value)
        if not valid then return false end
        control.summonAimTargetMode=selected;table.clear(control.summonAimSelections);return true
    end
    local function ownsSummon(actor,own)
        if kindOf(actor)~='Instance' or not actor:IsA('Model') or actor==own then return false end
        local owner=actor:FindFirstChild('Owner')
        return actor.Parent~=nil and owner and owner:IsA('ObjectValue')
            and (owner.Value==own or owner.Value==player)
    end
