    local function summonAimAvailable()
        local own=player.Character
        local humanoid=own and own.Parent and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return control.alive and control.focused and not menu.recording and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            and not (menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()) and own and own:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Mechamaru'
            and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not (menu.nativeCounter and menu.nativeCounter.dispatching)
    end
    function control.selectSummonAimTarget(actor)
        if not summonAimAvailable() then return nil end
        local own=player.Character;local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local origin=(actor or own):FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local range=menu.m1AimAssist and menu.m1AimAssist.skillAimRange
        if not finiteNumber(range) then range=75 end
        if range<=0 or not origin then return nil end
        local parameters=wallParameters()
        local function eligible(target,fov,skipLine)
            if not valid(target) or ownsSummon(target,own) then return false end
            local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if target.Name=='HarutaSwordNPC' or (info and info:FindFirstChild('UroDistort')) then return false end
            local other=players.GetPlayerFromCharacter and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
            if other and not other.Neutral and not player.Neutral and player.Team~=nil and player.Team==other.Team then return false end
            local part=control.targetPart(target)
            if not part or (part.Position-origin.Position).Magnitude>range or (not skipLine and not control.hasLineOfSight(target,parameters)) then return false end
            return not fov or (camera and control.inFov(target,camera))
        end
        local geometry=camera and control.fovGeometry(camera)
        local cursor=camera and control.rawCursorPoint(camera)
        local folder=host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        local project=camera and(camera.WorldToViewportPoint or camera.WorldToScreenPoint)
        if not geometry or not cursor or not folder or type(project)~='function'then return nil end
        local projections={}
        local function allowed(target)
            if not eligible(target,false,true)then return false end
            local point,shown=project(camera,control.targetPart(target).Position)
            if not shown or point.Z<=0 or not control.pointInFov(point,geometry)or not control.hasLineOfSight(target,parameters)then return false end
            projections[target]=point;return true
        end
        local function cursorRank(target)
            local point=projections[target]
            return point and(point.X-cursor.X)^2+(point.Y-cursor.Y)^2 or math.huge
        end
        local now,key=clock(),actor or own
        local signature=table.concat(control.summonAimTargetMode,'|')
        local cached=control.summonAimSelections[key]
        if cached and cached.character==own and cached.camera==camera and cached.range==range and cached.signature==signature
            and cached.cursorX==cursor.X and cached.cursorY==cursor.Y and now>=cached.at and now-cached.at<.03
            and(not cached.target or allowed(cached.target))then return cached.target end
        local candidates=folder:GetChildren()
        local target=menu.targetMethods.choose(control.summonAimTargetMode,menu.targetMethods.screenContext(candidates,{
            cursorHit=true,camera=camera,cursorPoint=cursor,cursorRankSquared=true,
            candidates=candidates,eligible=allowed,cursorRank=cursorRank,normalRank=cursorRank,
            distanceRank=function(model)local part=control.targetPart(model);return part and(part.Position-origin.Position).Magnitude or math.huge end}))
        control.summonAimSelections[key]={character=own,camera=camera,range=range,signature=signature,cursorX=cursor.X,cursorY=cursor.Y,at=now,target=target}
        return target
    end
    local function summonScopeCurrent(scope)
        local own=player.Character
        return type(scope)=='table' and scope.character==own and summonAimAvailable() and ownsSummon(scope.actor,own)
            and kindOf(scope.marker)=='Instance' and scope.marker.Name=='InSkill' and scope.marker.Parent==scope.actor:FindFirstChild('Info')
            and kindOf(scope.request)=='Instance' and scope.request.Parent==scope.actor
            and (scope.request:IsA('RemoteEvent') or scope.request:IsA('UnreliableRemoteEvent'))
    end
    function control.bindSummonAim()
        if control.summonAimHook or not control.alive then return control.summonAimHook~=nil end
        local own=player.Character;local kit=own and own:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        if control.summonBindCharacter~=own or control.summonBindKit~=kit then
            control.summonBindCharacter,control.summonBindKit=own,kit
            control.summonBindAttempts,control.summonBindNext=0,-math.huge
        end
        if kit~='Mechamaru' then return false end
        local now=clock()
        if control.summonBindAttempts>=12 or now<control.summonBindNext then return false end
        local native=control.skillNativeTool
        local inspect=host.getupvalues or (host.debug and host.debug.getupvalues)
        if not native or type(native.GetToolService)~='function' or type(host.getconnections)~='function'
            or type(inspect)~='function' or not host.debug or type(host.debug.info)~='function' then return false end
        control.summonBindAttempts+=1;control.summonBindNext=now+1
        local ok,ready=pcall(function()
            local module=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
            for _,name in {'Controllers','Moveset','Mechamaru','Base','UltraCannonController'} do module=module and module:FindFirstChild(name) end
            if not module then return false end
            local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit');folder=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
            folder=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Services')
            if not folder or not folder:FindFirstChild('UltraCannonService') then return false end
            local service=native:GetToolService('UltraCannonService')
            local effects=service and service.Effects;local remote=effects and effects._re
            if not remote or not remote:IsA('RemoteEvent') or effects._directConnect~=true then return false end
            local source=module:GetFullName()
            for _,connection in host.getconnections(remote.OnClientEvent) do
                local callback=connection.Function
                if type(callback)~='function' or host.debug.info(callback,'s')~=source then continue end
                for _,dispatch in inspect(callback) do
                    if type(dispatch)~='table' or type(rawget(dispatch,'Start'))~='function'
                        or type(rawget(dispatch,'FireCannon'))~='function' or type(rawget(dispatch,'AlbatrosStart'))~='function' then continue end
                    local hook={dispatch=dispatch,original=dispatch.Start,active=true}
                    hook.wrapper=function(actor,marker,request,owner,...)
                        if not hook.active or not control.alive or actor==player.Character or owner~=player.Character then
                            return hook.original(actor,marker,request,owner,...)
                        end
                        local thread=coroutine.running();local previous=control.summonAimScopes[thread]
                        local scope={character=owner,actor=actor,marker=marker,request=request}
                        control.summonAimScopes[thread]=if summonScopeCurrent(scope) then scope else false
                        local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,actor,marker,request,owner,...))
                        control.summonAimScopes[thread]=if control.alive then previous else nil
                        if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
                        return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
                    end
                    dispatch.Start=hook.wrapper;control.summonAimHook=hook;control.summonAimReady=true
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end)
        control.summonAimReason=if ok and ready then 'Native owned robot aim is connected' else 'Waiting for the native Ultra Cannon aiming callback'
        return ok and ready==true
    end
    local function counterSkill(tool)
        local counters=menu.nativeCounter
        if counters and not counters.dispatching and tool and tool:GetAttribute('Service')=='SupernovaService'
            and counters.bloodOrbCount then
            local orbs=counters.bloodOrbCount()
            if type(orbs)=='number' and orbs>0 then return false end
        end
        return counters and ((counters.isCounterTool and counters.isCounterTool(tool)) or counters.dispatching)==true
    end
    control.isCounterSkill=counterSkill
    function control.characterSkillLocked(context)
        local env=menu.environment
        return context and control.activationAllowed() and not context.detached and menu.characterShiftLockEnabled==true
            and env._G.CharacterLockActive==true and valid(context.target)
            and env.LockedTarget==context.target and env.LockConn==context.connection
            and context.connection and context.connection.Connected~=false
    end
    function control.captureSkillLockAim(context)
        if not control.characterSkillLocked(context) or context.cameraAimYaw~=nil then return end
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local direction=camera and camera.CFrame and camera.CFrame.LookVector
        if direction and finitePoint(direction) and direction.X*direction.X+direction.Z*direction.Z>1e-6 then
            context.cameraAimYaw=math.atan2(direction.X,direction.Z)
        end
    end
    function control.setSkillAimMode(value)
        if value~='Locked target' and value~='Mouse' then return false end
        control.skillAimMode=value;control.skillFacing=nil;control.pendingSkillCast=nil
        return true
    end
    local function nativeCastCurrent(context)
        local own=player.Character
        local humanoid=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return context and not counterSkill(context.tool) and control.alive and control.focused and not menu.recording and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            and own==context.character and own.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
            and own:GetAttribute('Moveset')==context.kit and not control.characterRagdolled(own,humanoid)
            and context.tool.Parent==own:FindFirstChild('Moveset') and context.tool:GetAttribute('Service')==context.service
            and not (menu.nativeCounter and menu.nativeCounter.dispatching)
    end
    function control.currentPendingSkill()
        local cast=control.pendingSkillCast
        if not nativeCastCurrent(cast) or clock()-cast.at>8 then control.pendingSkillCast=nil;return nil end
        local info=cast.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then cast.seenSkill=true
        elseif cast.seenSkill or clock()-cast.at>(if cast.boundaryObserved then .65 else .2) then control.pendingSkillCast=nil;return nil end
        return cast
    end
    function control.observeNativeSkill(tool,action,boundary)
        local own=player.Character
        local slot=tool and tool:GetAttribute('Key')
        if action~='Activated' or not own or not tool or counterSkill(tool) or not (tool:IsA('NumberValue') or tool:IsA('Tool'))
            or tool.Parent~=own:FindFirstChild('Moveset') or not finiteNumber(slot) or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>4 then return nil end
        local native=control.skillNativeTool
        if native and type(native.ReturnKey)=='function' and native:ReturnKey(slot)~=tool then return nil end
        local existing=control.currentPendingSkill()
        if existing and existing.tool==tool then if boundary then existing.boundaryObserved=true end;return existing end
        local cast={character=own,kit=own:GetAttribute('Moveset'),tool=tool,service=tool:GetAttribute('Service'),at=clock(),mode=control.skillAimMode,boundaryObserved=boundary==true}
        if not nativeCastCurrent(cast) then return nil end
        control.pendingSkillCast=cast
        return cast
    end
    function control.observeOwnSkillAnimation(character,track)
        local names=menu.moveNames;local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if character~=player.Character or not track or track.IsPlaying~=true or not info or not info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            or info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun') or character:GetAttribute('Stun')==true
            or not names or type(names.skillNameForTrack)~='function' then return false end
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter;local incoming=tracker and tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        if incoming and incoming.character==character and clock()-incoming.at>=0 and clock()-incoming.at<.35 then return false end
        local ok,name=pcall(names.skillNameForTrack,character,track)
        if not ok or not name then return false end
        local moveset=character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        for _,tool in moveset and moveset:GetChildren() or {} do
            if tool.Name:gsub('<[^>]->','')~=name then continue end
            local observed,cast=pcall(control.observeNativeSkill,tool,'Activated',true)
            if not observed or not cast then return false end
            cast.animation=track;cast.seenSkill=true
            local suppressed=control.activationAnimationSuppression
            if not suppressed or suppressed.character~=character or suppressed.marker~=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then
                local acquired,reason=pcall(control.onSkillUse,tool,'Activated')
                if not acquired then control.lastReason='Animation steering acquisition skipped: '..tostring(reason) end
            end
            control.nativeSkillAnimations=(control.nativeSkillAnimations or 0)+1
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.observeCurrentSkillAnimations(character)
        local hum=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local animator=hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
        if not animator or type(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks)~='function' then return end
        local ok,tracks=pcall(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks,animator)
        if ok then for _,track in tracks do if control.observeOwnSkillAnimation(character,track) then break end end end
    end
    function control.refreshSkillAnimationFallback()
        if control.currentPendingSkill() then return end
        local character=player.Character;local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info or not info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then return end
        local now=clock()
        if now-(control.lastSkillAnimationCheck or -math.huge)<.05 then return end
        control.lastSkillAnimationCheck=now
        -- AnimationPlayed may precede blending and the native InSkill marker.
        -- Retry only this character's active tracks until a real skill maps.
        control.observeCurrentSkillAnimations(character)
    end
    local function skillContextCurrent(context)
        local own=player.Character
        local environment=menu.environment
        local humanoid=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        return context and not context.manualReleased and not counterSkill(context.tool) and control.alive and control.focused and not menu.recording and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            and own==context.character and own.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
            and own:GetAttribute('Moveset')==context.kit and not control.characterRagdolled(own,humanoid)
            and context.mode==control.skillAimMode
            and ((context.detached and (control.noSkillDirectionalLock or control.manualSkillSteering)
                    and not environment.LockedTarget and not environment.LockConn)
                or (valid(context.target) and ((context.assisted and menu.m1AimAssist and menu.m1AimAssist.skillAimEnabled
                    and not environment.LockedTarget and not environment.LockConn)
                or (environment.LockedTarget==context.target and environment.LockConn==context.connection
                    and context.connection and context.connection.Connected~=false))))
            and context.tool.Parent==own:FindFirstChild('Moveset') and context.tool:GetAttribute('Service')==context.service
            and not (menu.nativeCounter and menu.nativeCounter.dispatching)
    end
    local function activeSkillContext()
        local context=control.skillFacing
        if not context then
            local pending=control.currentPendingSkill()
            local env=menu.environment
            if pending and valid(env.LockedTarget) and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected~=false
                and (not pending.target or (pending.target==env.LockedTarget and pending.connection==env.LockConn)) then
                pending.target,pending.connection=env.LockedTarget,env.LockConn
                control.captureSkillLockAim(pending)
                context=pending;control.skillFacing=context
            elseif pending and not pending.manualReleased and (control.noSkillDirectionalLock or control.manualSkillSteering)
                and not pending.target and not env.LockedTarget and not env.LockConn then
                pending.detached=true
                context=pending;control.skillFacing=context
            end
        end
        if not skillContextCurrent(context) or clock()-context.at>8 then control.skillFacing=nil;return nil end
        local info=context.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local active=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        if active then context.seenSkill=true
        elseif context.seenSkill or clock()-context.at>(if context.boundaryObserved then .65 else .2) then control.skillFacing=nil;return nil end
        return context
    end
    local function manualSteeringFor(context)
        return context~=nil and not control.chainFlashProtected(context)
            and (control.noSkillDirectionalLock or (control.manualSkillSteering
                and (control.skillSteeringStart=='Immediately' or context.contactAt~=nil)))
    end
    local function directionalSkillFor(context)
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if not context or control.noSkillDirectionalLock or not assist or not assist.skillAimEnabled or type(assist.directionalFrame)~='function' then return false end
        return assist.skillAimFacing=='During skill' or clock()-(context.directionalAt or context.at)<assist.skillAimDuration
    end
    function control.skillDirectionalActive()
        if priorityInputActive() then return false end
        if control.effectiveLockActive() then return false end
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        return assist and assist.skillAimEnabled==true and type(assist.directionalFrame)=='function' and activeSkillContext()~=nil
    end
    function control.noteSkillTeleport(character)
        local context=activeSkillContext()
        if not context or character~=context.character then return false end
        if not ((context.kit=='Gojo' and context.service=='ReversalRedService')
            or (context.kit=='Yuta' and context.service=='ResoluteSlashService')) then return false end
        context.directionalAt=clock();context.directionalPosition=nil
        context.teleported=true
        control.teleportTargetLease=context
        return true
    end
    function control.teleportTargetRetained(target)
        local context=control.teleportTargetLease
        local env=menu.environment
        if not nativeCastCurrent(context) or clock()-context.at>8 or env.LockedTarget~=context.target
            or env.LockConn~=context.connection or not context.connection or context.connection.Connected==false then
            control.teleportTargetLease=nil;return false
        end
        return target==context.target and context.teleportVariant==true
    end
    function control.detachSkillSteering(target)
        local context=control.skillFacing or control.currentPendingSkill()
        local info=context and context.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not nativeCastCurrent(context) or context.target~=target or not manualSteeringFor(context)
            or not info or not info:FindFirstChild('InSkill') then return false end
        -- Releasing a downed victim ends target tracking, not the player's own
        -- verified skill. Its manual yaw continues until native completion.
        context.detached=true
        control.skillFacing=context
        return true
    end
    function control.noteSkillContact(target,at)
        local context=activeSkillContext()
        if not context or not finiteNumber(at) or at<context.at or at>clock() or clock()-at>0.5 then return false end
        if target~=context.target then
            if not context.detached or context.target or not control.manualSkillSteering or not valid(target) then return false end
            context.contactTarget=target
        end
        local info=context.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info then return false end
        context.contactAt=context.contactAt or at
        return true
    end
    function control.noteRapidPunchesDrag(character,target,marker)
        -- The native Gojo drag identifies its caster and grabbed victim. Rapid
        -- Punches' ordinary hit effects identify only the victim, so waiting
        -- for an attributed damage event can leave On-contact steering idle.
        local context=activeSkillContext()
        if not context or context.character~=character or context.kit~='Gojo'
            or context.service~='RapidPunchesService' or not valid(target)
            or kindOf(marker)~='Instance' or not marker.Parent then return false end
        return control.noteSkillContact(target,clock())
    end
    -- Camera mode follows every actual local skill episode, including native
    -- skills without a mapped service/contact context. This owns yaw only;
    -- neither native movement forces nor the camera/cursor are rewritten.
    function control.directionFreedomContext()
        if not control.alive or not control.directionFreedomEnabled or not control.focused
            or menu.recording or menu.menuKeyCapturing or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()then return nil end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand
            or not root or root.Parent~=character or not info or control.characterRagdolled(character,humanoid)then return nil end
        for _,name in {'Dead','TrueStun','Knockback','DomainClash'}do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or type(value)=='number'and value>0 or info:FindFirstChild(name)then return nil end
        end
        local stun=info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
        if character:GetAttribute('Stun')==true or stun and not(stun:IsA('BoolValue')and stun.Value==false)then return nil end
        -- Assistance keeps its selected enemy and its configured intro/return.
        -- Free camera direction takes over only when no target-facing owner exists.
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local skillMarker=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        local nativeM1=assist and assist.ownM1Phase and assist.ownM1Phase(character)==true
        -- A new native skill supersedes the preceding punch's lease/return.
        -- Test this before those former owners: waiting for their fade-out
        -- prevents universalSkillFacingFrame from ever releasing them.
        if skillMarker and not nativeM1 and control.directionFreedomContexts.Skills==true
            and not control.characterDashing()then return character,root,humanoid,skillMarker,'Skills'end
        if assist then
            if assist.enabled and assist.userM1Held and assist.userM1Held()then return nil end
            local turn=assist.aimTurnState;local now=clock()
            if assist.shiftLockAimLease or turn and turn.at and now>=turn.at and now-turn.at<=.1 then return nil end
            if assist.blockAimEnabled and (info:FindFirstChild('Block')or control.physicalBlockDown)then return nil end
            if assist.counterAimEnabled and menu.nativeCounter and menu.nativeCounter.directionalPhase then return nil end
            if assist.punishAimEnabled and menu.autoPunish and menu.autoPunish.pending then return nil end
        end
        local env=menu.environment
        if env and env.LockedTarget and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected~=false then return nil end
        if control.dashAssistCapture then return nil end
        if control.characterRelease and control.characterRelease.assistReturn then return nil end
        local kind,marker
        local function action(name)return info:FindFirstChild(name)end
        if control.characterDashing()then
            kind,marker='Dash',action('InDash')or action('Dash')
            local bridge=menu.frontDash and menu.frontDash.cameraDash;local now=clock()
            if not bridge or bridge.character~=character or not bridge.mover or not bridge.mover.Parent
                or now<bridge.started or now-bridge.started>(bridge.duration or .6)+.05 then return nil end
        elseif characterEmoting(character)then kind,marker='Emotes',action('Emote')or action('Emoting')
        elseif action('Melee')or action('Attacking')or assist and assist.ownM1Phase and assist.ownM1Phase(character)then
            kind,marker='M1',action('Melee')or action('Attacking')or action('InSkill')
        elseif action('Block')then kind,marker='Block',action('Block')
        elseif action('InSkill')then kind,marker='Skills',action('InSkill')
        elseif action('Rolling')or action('Roll')or action('Recovery')or action('Recovering')then
            kind,marker='Recovery',action('Rolling')or action('Roll')or action('Recovery')or action('Recovering')
        elseif action('Jumping')or action('Jump')or humanoid.Jump==true
            or host.Enum.Material and humanoid.FloorMaterial==host.Enum.Material.Air then kind,marker='Jump',action('Jumping')or action('Jump')
        else kind='Movement'end
        if control.directionFreedomContexts[kind]~=true then return nil end
        return character,root,humanoid,marker or info,kind
    end
    function control.universalSkillSteeringContext()
        local freeCharacter,freeRoot,freeHumanoid,freeMarker=control.directionFreedomContext()
        if freeCharacter then return freeCharacter,freeRoot,freeHumanoid,freeMarker end
        if control.directionFreedomEnabled then return nil end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        -- Native punches also use InSkill. Camera steering must not take yaw
        -- from an enabled, physically-held M1 assist during a confirmed combo.
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if assist and assist.enabled and assist.userM1Held and assist.userM1Held()
            and assist.ownM1Phase and assist.ownM1Phase(character)then return nil end
        if not control.alive or not control.noSkillDirectionalLock or control.skillSteeringDirection~='Camera'
            or not control.focused or menu.recording or menu.menuKeyCapturing or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()
            or not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Parent~=character
            or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand or not root or root.Parent~=character
            or not marker or marker.Parent~=info or characterEmoting(character)
            or control.characterRagdolled(character,humanoid) or control.dashFacingActive() then return nil end
        for _,name in {'Dead','TrueStun','Knockback','InDash','DomainClash'} do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if value==true or type(value)=='number' and value>0 or info:FindFirstChild(name) then return nil end
        end
        return character,root,humanoid,marker
    end
    function control.universalSkillSteeringActive()
        return control.universalSkillSteeringContext()~=nil
    end
    function control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering()
        -- No AutoRotate lease is borrowed: the existing late writer supplies
        -- only yaw. Never replay a completed skill's former AutoRotate=false.
        control.cameraSkillEpisode=nil
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause() control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering() end
    function control.universalSkillFacingFrame(root)
        local character,ownRoot,humanoid,marker=control.universalSkillSteeringContext()
        if not character then control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering();return nil end
        if root~=ownRoot then return nil end
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local heading=camera and camera.CFrame and camera.CFrame.LookVector
        if not finitePoint(heading) or not finitePoint(root.Position) then return nil end
        local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(heading.X,0,heading.Z)
        if horizontal.Magnitude<=.001 then return nil end
        local episode=control.cameraSkillEpisode
        if not episode or episode.character~=character or episode.marker~=marker then
            control.cancelAssistReturn();control.finishCharacterRelease()
            if menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation then menu.releaseCameraOnlyRotation() end
            local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
            if assist and assist.releaseShiftLockAim then assist.releaseShiftLockAim(false) end
            if assist and assist.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset then assist.restoreShiftLockCameraOffset() end
            control.hadCharacterControl=false;clearBlend('character')
            control.cameraSkillEpisode={character=character,marker=marker,humanoid=humanoid}
        end
        return host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+horizontal.Unit)
    end
    function control.manualSkillSteeringActive()
        return control.universalSkillSteeringActive() or manualSteeringFor(activeSkillContext())
    end
    function control.skillCameraFree()
        -- Contact timing gates character steering, never camera freedom.
        return control.universalSkillSteeringActive() or (control.manualSkillSteering or control.noSkillDirectionalLock) and activeSkillContext()~=nil
    end
    function control.blockCameraFree()
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return false end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local own=player.Character;local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return (block and block.manualBlockHeld and block.manualBlockHeld()==true)
            or (info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')~=nil) or false
    end
    function control.cameraRotationInputWanted()
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()then return false end
        local directional=menu.directionalLock;local lease=directional and directional.shiftCursorLease
        -- The real cursor lease uses LockCurrentPosition. Supply native camera
        -- rotation intent for that owned shift lock as well as LockCenter;
        -- keep the original native mouse delta and camera implementation.
        if lease and lease.active and directional.alive~=false and type(directional.shiftCursorActive)=='function'
            and directional.shiftCursorActive()==true then return true end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if block and block.manualBlockHeld and block.manualBlockHeld()==true then return true end
        local right=host.Enum.UserInputType and host.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
        local held=right and type(input.IsMouseButtonPressed)=='function' and input:IsMouseButtonPressed(right)
        return control.skillCameraFree() and (nativeShiftLocked() or held==true) or false
    end
    -- Game-consumed right-click Block presses may never reach CameraInput's
    -- rotation-activation counter. Supply that intent without changing its
    -- mouse deltas, camera position, enabled state, or Block binding.
    function control.bindCameraRotationInput()
        if control.cameraRotationHook then return end
        local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
        local module=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('PlayerModule')
        local cameras=module and module:FindFirstChild('CameraModule')
        local cameraInput=cameras and cameras:FindFirstChild('CameraInput')
        if not cameraInput then return end
        local ok,native=pcall(host.require,cameraInput)
        if not ok or type(native)~='table' or type(native.getRotationActivated)~='function' then return end
        local hook={owner=native,original=native.getRotationActivated,active=true}
        hook.wrapper=function(...)
            if hook.active and control.cameraRotationInputWanted() then return true end
            return hook.original(...)
        end
        native.getRotationActivated=hook.wrapper;control.cameraRotationHook=hook
    end
    local function aimingContext()
        local context=control.skillAimScopes[coroutine.running()]
        if context==false then return nil end
        if skillContextCurrent(context) then return context end
        return activeSkillContext()
    end
    -- Manual steering latches a world heading. Never add input repeatedly to
    -- the bearing of a grabbed victim, which rotates with the attacker.
    function control.sampleSteeringMouse()
        local delta
        if type(input.GetMouseDelta)=='function' then
            local ok,value=pcall(input.GetMouseDelta,input)
            if ok and value and finiteNumber(value.X) and finiteNumber(value.Y) then delta=value end
        end
        local locked=nativeShiftLocked()
        if not locked and type(input.GetMouseLocation)=='function' then
            local ok,point=pcall(input.GetMouseLocation,input)
            if ok and point and finiteNumber(point.X) and finiteNumber(point.Y) then
                local previous=control.lastSteeringMousePosition
                if previous then delta=host.Vector2.new(point.X-previous.X,point.Y-previous.Y) end
                control.lastSteeringMousePosition=point
            end
        else control.lastSteeringMousePosition=nil end
        return delta
    end
    function control.manualSkillPoint(context)
        local root=context.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not root or not camera then return nil end
        local point=context.target and control.targetPoint(context.target,'Character')
        local mode=control.skillSteeringDirection
        local revision=control.skillSteeringRevision or 0
        if context.manualSteeringMode~=mode or context.manualSteeringRevision~=revision or not context.manualYaw then
            local direction=if context.manualYaw then root.CFrame.LookVector
                elseif finitePoint(point) then point-root.Position else root.CFrame.LookVector
            if not finitePoint(direction) or direction.X*direction.X+direction.Z*direction.Z<.01 then direction=root.CFrame.LookVector end
            if finitePoint(direction) and direction.X*direction.X+direction.Z*direction.Z>=.01 then
                context.manualYaw=math.atan2(direction.X,direction.Z)
            end
            if not context.manualYaw then return nil end
            context.manualSteeringMode,context.manualSteeringRevision=mode,revision
            context.manualKeyboardChord=nil;context.manualInputFrame=nil
        end
        -- Input is consumed only by the late render writer, not by native aim
        -- queries or the early lock callback in the same frame.
        if context.manualInputFrame~=control.manualInputFrame then
            context.manualInputFrame=control.manualInputFrame
            local keyboard=mode=='Keyboard' or mode=='Both'
            local mouse=mode~='Keyboard' and mode~='Camera'
            local moved=false
            if mode=='Camera' then
                -- Read the actual camera heading, including shift-lock motion.
                -- Pixel deltas do not describe every native camera rotation.
                local heading=camera.CFrame.LookVector
                if finitePoint(heading) and heading.X*heading.X+heading.Z*heading.Z>.001 then
                    context.manualYaw=math.atan2(heading.X,heading.Z);moved=true
                end
            elseif keyboard and type(input.IsKeyDown)=='function' and host.Enum.KeyCode then
                local keys=host.Enum.KeyCode
                local x=(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.D) then 1 else 0)-(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.A) then 1 else 0)
                local z=(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.W) then 1 else 0)-(if input:IsKeyDown(keys.S) then 1 else 0)
                local chord=x+z*3
                if chord==0 then context.manualKeyboardChord=nil
                elseif context.manualKeyboardChord~=chord then
                    -- Latch each new chord in world space. A following camera
                    -- must not add another side-turn on every held-key frame.
                    local forward=camera.CFrame.LookVector;local right=camera.CFrame.RightVector
                    if finitePoint(forward) and finitePoint(right) then
                        local heading=forward*z+right*x
                        if heading.X*heading.X+heading.Z*heading.Z>.001 then
                            context.manualYaw=math.atan2(heading.X,heading.Z);moved=true
                            context.manualKeyboardChord=chord
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local delta=control.manualMouseDelta
            local mouseMoved=delta and finiteNumber(delta.X) and finiteNumber(delta.Y) and math.abs(delta.X)+math.abs(delta.Y)>.001
            local locked=nativeShiftLocked()
            if mouse and mouseMoved then
                if locked then
                    context.manualYaw-=math.clamp(delta.X,-250,250)*.002
                elseif control.skillNativeMouse then
                    local ok,aim=pcall(control.skillNativeMouse,control.skillNativeTool,75)
                    if ok and finitePoint(aim) then
                        local direction=aim-root.Position
                        if direction.X*direction.X+direction.Z*direction.Z>.01 then context.manualYaw=math.atan2(direction.X,direction.Z) end
                    end
                end
                moved=true
            end
            context.manualInputAt=if moved then clock() else context.manualInputAt
        end
        return root.Position+host.Vector3.new(math.sin(context.manualYaw)*75,0,math.cos(context.manualYaw)*75)
    end
    local function assistedSkillTargetPoint(context)
        local point=control.targetPoint(context.target,'Character')
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local root=context.character and context.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if point and assist and assist.skillAimEnabled and assist.predictAimPoint then
            return assist.predictAimPoint(root,context.target,'Skill',point)
        end
        return point
    end
    local function skillPoint(context)
        if not skillContextCurrent(context) then return nil end
        if manualSteeringFor(context) then return control.manualSkillPoint(context) end
        if control.characterSkillLocked(context) or context.mode=='Locked target' then
            return assistedSkillTargetPoint(context)
        end
        local ok,point=pcall(control.skillNativeMouse,control.skillNativeTool,75)
        return if ok and finitePoint(point) then point else nil
    end
    function control.skillFacingFrame(root)
        local cameraFacing=control.universalSkillFacingFrame(root)
        if cameraFacing then return cameraFacing end
        if characterEmoting()then return nil end
        if priorityInputActive() then return nil end
        if control.dashFacingActive() then return nil end
        if control.effectiveLockActive() then return nil end
        if menu.m1AimAssist and menu.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive and menu.m1AimAssist.automaticDirectionalActive() then return nil end
        local blockAssist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if blockAssist and blockAssist.blockDirectionalActive and blockAssist.blockDirectionalActive() then return nil end
        local context=activeSkillContext()
        if not context or root~=context.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or not root.CFrame then return nil end
        if control.noSkillDirectionalLock and manualSteeringFor(context) then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
        local info=context.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local retainedLock=control.characterSkillLocked(context)
        if context.target and assist and assist.skillAimEnabled and assist.aimAreaAllowsTarget
            and not manualSteeringFor(context) then
            if not assist.aimAreaAllowsTarget('Skill',context.target,root,assist.areaSkillContext==context and assist.areaTargets.Skill==context.target) then return nil end
            assist.areaTargets.Skill=context.target;assist.areaSkillContext=context
        end
        if not retainedLock and context.target and not control.noSkillDirectionalLock and not manualSteeringFor(context)
            and assist and assist.skillAimEnabled and type(assist.directionalFrame)=='function' then
            if info and (info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun') or info:FindFirstChild('Knockback')) then return nil end
            -- A native behind-target teleport changes the relative yaw. Start a
            -- fresh bounded correction rather than keeping a world-space heading.
            if context.teleportVariant and context.directionalPosition
                and (root.Position-context.directionalPosition).Magnitude>6 then
                context.directionalAt=clock();control.teleportTargetLease=context
            end
            context.directionalPosition=root.Position
            context.directionalAt=context.directionalAt or context.at
            local correcting=directionalSkillFor(context)
            if correcting then
                if assist.selectSkillTarget and assist.selectSkillTarget()~=context.target then return nil end
                local point=assistedSkillTargetPoint(context)
                return if point and assist.directionalFrame then assist.directionalFrame(root,point,control.renderDelta or 1/60,nil,'Skill Aim') else nil
            elseif not manualSteeringFor(context) then return nil end
        end
        if info and (info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun') or info:FindFirstChild('Knockback')
            or (not manualSteeringFor(context) and not (assist and assist.skillAimEnabled)
                and (info:FindFirstChild('NoRotate') or info:FindFirstChild('NoRotation')))) then return nil end
        local point=skillPoint(context)
        if not finitePoint(point) or not finitePoint(root.Position) or (not manualSteeringFor(context) and control.rotationPaused('character',root)) then return nil end
        local goal=host.Vector3.new(point.X,root.Position.Y,point.Z)
        local dx,dz=goal.X-root.Position.X,goal.Z-root.Position.Z
        if dx*dx+dz*dz<=.15*.15 then return nil end
        local desired=host.CFrame.new(root.Position,goal)
        local manual=manualSteeringFor(context) and not retainedLock
        if manual and not control.noSkillDirectionalLock and not context.steeringReleased then
            context.steeringReleased=true;control.beginCharacterRelease(root,nil,'Manual')
        end
        local facing=if manual and not control.noSkillDirectionalLock then control.characterReleaseFrame(root,desired,control.renderDelta) else desired
        if assist and assist.skillAimEnabled and not control.noSkillDirectionalLock and assist.directionalFrame then
            local assistedGoal=if manual then root.Position+facing.LookVector*75 else goal
            return assist.directionalFrame(root,assistedGoal,control.renderDelta or 1/60,nil,'Skill Aim') or root.CFrame
        end
        if assist and assist.refreshShiftLockAim then assist.refreshShiftLockAim(root) end
        return if menu.limitTurn then menu.limitTurn(root,facing,control.renderDelta,'Skill Aim') else facing
    end
    function control.bindSkillAim(native)
        if control.skillAimReady then return control.skillNativeTool==native end
        if not native or type(native.UseTool)~='function' or type(native.GetTarget)~='function' or type(native.GetMouseTarget)~='function' then return false end
        control.skillNativeTool=native;control.skillNativeMouse=native.GetMouseTarget
        local function hookMethod(key,factory)
            local hook={key=key,owner=native,original=native[key],active=true}
            hook.wrapper=factory(hook);native[key]=hook.wrapper;table.insert(control.skillAimHooks,hook)
        end
        hookMethod('GetTarget',function(hook)
            return function(self,...)
                local summon=hook.active and control.summonSpecialScopes[coroutine.running()]
                if summon then
                    if summon.character==player.Character then
                        local target=control.selectSummonAimTarget()
                        if target then return target end
                    end
                    return hook.original(self,...)
                end
                local context=hook.active and aimingContext()
                local launch=context and control.skillLaunchScopes[coroutine.running()]==context
                if context and context.target and (control.characterSkillLocked(context) or ((launch or directionalSkillFor(context) or not manualSteeringFor(context)) and context.mode=='Locked target')) then return context.target end
                return hook.original(self,...)
            end
        end)
        hookMethod('GetMouseTarget',function(hook)
            return function(self,limit,...)
                local summon=hook.active and control.summonAimScopes[coroutine.running()]
                if summon~=nil and hook.active then
                    local target=summonScopeCurrent(summon) and control.selectSummonAimTarget(summon.actor)
                    local point=target and control.targetPoint(target,'Character')
                    if point then
                        local root=summon.actor:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                        if root and finitePoint(root.Position) and finiteNumber(limit) and limit>0 then
                            local delta=point-root.Position
                            if delta.Magnitude>limit then point=root.Position+delta.Unit*limit end
                        end
                        return point
                    end
                    return hook.original(self,limit,...)
                end
                local context=hook.active and aimingContext()
                local launch=context and control.skillLaunchScopes[coroutine.running()]==context
                local point=context and
                    (if launch then assistedSkillTargetPoint(context) elseif control.characterSkillLocked(context) then skillPoint(context)
                    elseif context.mode=='Locked target' and (directionalSkillFor(context) or not manualSteeringFor(context)) then skillPoint(context) else nil)
                if point then
                    local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if camera and camera.CFrame and finiteNumber(limit) and limit>0 then
                        local delta=point-camera.CFrame.Position
                        if delta.Magnitude>limit then point=camera.CFrame.Position+delta.Unit*limit end
                    end
                    return point
                end
                return hook.original(self,limit,...)
            end
        end)
        hookMethod('UseTool',function(hook)
            return function(self,tool,action,...)
                if not hook.active or not control.alive then return hook.original(self,tool,action,...) end
                local own=player.Character;local env=menu.environment
                local slot=tool and tool:GetAttribute('Key')
                local context
                local thread=coroutine.running();local previous=control.skillAimScopes[thread]
                local previousLaunch=control.skillLaunchScopes[thread]
                local previousFacing=control.skillFacing
                local previousPending=control.pendingSkillCast
                local setupOk,setupFailure=pcall(function()
                control.observeNativeSkill(tool,action)
                local active=activeSkillContext()
                if not active or active.tool~=tool then control.onSkillUse(tool,action) end
                if own and tool and tool:IsA('NumberValue') and tool.Parent==own:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
                  and not counterSkill(tool) and finiteNumber(slot) and slot>=1 and slot<=4 and slot==math.floor(slot :: number)
                  and (action=='Activated' or action=='Deactivated') then
                    context={character=own,kit=own:GetAttribute('Moveset'),target=env.LockedTarget,connection=env.LockConn,
                        detached=control.noSkillDirectionalLock and not env.LockedTarget and not env.LockConn or nil,
                        mode=control.skillAimMode,tool=tool,service=tool:GetAttribute('Service'),at=clock()}
                    local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
                    if not control.noSkillDirectionalLock and not context.target and not context.connection and assist and assist.selectSkillTarget then
                        context.target=assist.selectSkillTarget();context.assisted=context.target~=nil
                    end
                    if not context.target and not context.connection and control.manualSkillSteering then context.detached=true end
                    local pending=control.currentPendingSkill()
                    if pending and pending.manualReleased and pending.tool==tool then context=nil end
                    if not skillContextCurrent(context) then context=nil end
                    -- A second use or button release belongs to the current
                    -- cast. Retain its observed native phase instead of opening
                    -- a fresh steering lease on each input.
                    local current=context and activeSkillContext()
                    if current and current.tool==tool and current.service==context.service then
                        if current~=previousPending and current.detached and not current.target and context.assisted then
                            current.target,current.connection,current.assisted,current.detached=context.target,context.connection,true,nil
                        end
                        context=current
                    end
                    if context and action=='Activated' and context.launchCommitted
                        and context.kit=='Yuta' and context.service=='ResoluteSlashService' then context.teleportVariant=true end
                end
                if context and action=='Activated' and context~=previousFacing then
                    control.captureSkillLockAim(context)
                    control.skillFacing=context
                    control.pendingSkillCast=context
                    local root=own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    local frame=root and control.skillFacingFrame(root)
                    if frame then root.CFrame=frame end
                end
                end)
                if not setupOk then
                    control.lastReason='Skill aim skipped; native input preserved: '..tostring(setupFailure)
                    control.skillFacing=nil;context=nil
                end
                control.skillAimScopes[thread]=if counterSkill(tool) then false else context
                local launch=context and action=='Activated' and not context.launchCommitted
                    and (context.mode=='Locked target' or control.characterSkillLocked(context)) and not context.detached
                control.skillLaunchScopes[thread]=if launch then context else nil
                local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,tool,action,...))
                control.skillAimScopes[thread]=previous
                control.skillLaunchScopes[thread]=previousLaunch
                if result[1] and launch then context.launchCommitted=true end
                if result[1] and context and context.teleportVariant then control.teleportTargetLease=context end
                if not result[1] then
                    control.pendingSkillCast=previousPending
                    if control.skillFacing==context then control.skillFacing=previousFacing end
                    error(result[2],0)
                end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
        end)
        if type(native.Special)=='function' then
            hookMethod('Special',function(hook)
                return function(self,...)
                    local context=hook.active and activeSkillContext()
                    local own=player.Character
                    local counter=own and own:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Hakari' and own:GetAttribute('InUlt')~=true
                    local thread=coroutine.running();local scope=control.skillAimScopes[thread]
                    local summonScope=control.summonSpecialScopes[thread]
                    if hook.active and own and own:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Mechamaru' then control.summonSpecialScopes[thread]={character=own} end
                    if counter then control.skillAimScopes[thread]=false end
                    local variant=context and context.kit=='Gojo' and context.service=='ReversalRedService'
                    local previous=variant and context.teleportVariant
                    if variant then context.teleportVariant=true end
                    local results=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,...))
                    control.skillAimScopes[thread]=scope
                    control.summonSpecialScopes[thread]=if control.alive then summonScope else nil
                    if not results[1] then
                        if variant then context.teleportVariant=previous end
                        error(results[2],0)
                    end
                    if variant then control.teleportTargetLease=context end
                    return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
                end
            end)
        end
        control.skillAimReady=true
        control.bindSummonAim()
        return true
    end
    function control.bindSkillSignalObservers()
        control.bindSummonAim()
        local native=control.skillNativeTool;local own=player.Character;local moveset=own and own:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not native or type(native.GetToolService)~='function' or not moveset then return end
        for _,tool in moveset:GetChildren() do
            local slot,serviceName=tool:GetAttribute('Key'),tool:GetAttribute('Service')
            if not (tool:IsA('NumberValue') or tool:IsA('Tool')) or not finiteNumber(slot) or slot%1~=0 or slot<1 or slot>4 or type(serviceName)~='string' then continue end
            local ok,service=pcall(native.GetToolService,native,serviceName)
            local signal=ok and service and service.Activated
            if not signal or type(signal.Fire)~='function' or control.skillSignalHooks[signal] then continue end
            local hook={signal=signal,original=signal.Fire,active=true}
            hook.wrapper=function(self,actualTool,...)
                local previousCast=control.pendingSkillCast
                if hook.active and control.alive then
                    local observed,reason=pcall(function()
                        local cast=control.observeNativeSkill(actualTool,'Activated',true)
                        if cast then
                            control.onSkillUse(actualTool,'Activated')
                            local env=menu.environment
                            if valid(env.LockedTarget) and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected~=false then
                                cast.target,cast.connection=env.LockedTarget,env.LockConn
                                if not control.skillFacing then control.skillFacing=cast end
                            end
                            control.nativeSkillObservations=(control.nativeSkillObservations or 0)+1
                        end
                    end)
                    if not observed then control.lastReason='Skill observer skipped; native input preserved: '..tostring(reason) end
                end
                local results=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,actualTool,...))
                if not results[1] then control.pendingSkillCast=previousCast;error(results[2],0) end
                return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
            end
            signal.Fire=hook.wrapper;control.skillSignalHooks[signal]=hook
        end
    end
    function control.bindSkillActions()
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Keybind')
        local combat=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Combat')
        if not combat then return end
        for slot=1,4 do
            local action=combat:FindFirstChild('Skill '..slot)
            if not action or control.skillActionConnections[action] or not action.Pressed then continue end
            -- Observe the game's action, including remapped keys. Never fire it.
            local connection=connect(action.Pressed,function()
                local native=control.skillNativeTool
                if not native or type(native.ReturnKey)~='function' then return end
                local ok,tool=pcall(native.ReturnKey,native,slot)
                if not ok or not tool or counterSkill(tool) then return end
                local observed,cast=pcall(control.observeNativeSkill,tool,'Activated',false)
                if observed and cast then control.nativeSkillActions=(control.nativeSkillActions or 0)+1 end
            end)
            control.skillActionConnections[action]=connection
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit');local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knit=module and host.require(module)
        if knit and type(knit.GetController)=='function' then control.bindSkillAim(knit.GetController('ToolController')) end
    end)

    -- The camera aim point follows animated torso/head parts and
    -- network-rate position steps, which shows up as camera shake. Filter it
    -- (alpha-beta, so steady motion has no lag). Zero disables the filter.
    control.cameraPointSmoothingMs=45
    function control.filterCameraPoint(target: any, point: any): any
        local tau=(tonumber(control.cameraPointSmoothingMs) or 0)/1000
        if tau<=0 or not point then control.cameraPointFilter=nil;return point end
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local now=clock()
            local state=control.cameraPointFilter
            if not state or state.target~=target or now<state.at or now-state.at>.25 or (point-state.position).Magnitude>20 then
                control.cameraPointFilter={target=target,position=point,velocity=host.Vector3.new(0,0,0),at=now}
                return point
            end
            local elapsed=now-state.at
            if elapsed<=.001 then return state.position end
            local alpha=1-math.exp(-elapsed/tau)
            local beta=alpha*alpha/(2-alpha)
            local predicted=state.position+state.velocity*elapsed
            local residual=point-predicted
            state.position=predicted+residual*alpha
            state.velocity=state.velocity+residual*(beta/elapsed)
            state.at=now
            return state.position
        end)
        if ok and result then return result end
        return point
    end
    function control.updateCamera(delta)
        if not control.ownsCamera() then control.cameraPointFilter=nil;clearBlend('camera');return end
        local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local target=menu.environment.LockedTarget
        local point=control.targetPoint(target,'Camera')
        if not camera or not point then control.cameraPointFilter=nil;clearBlend('camera');return end
        point=control.filterCameraPoint(target,point)
        camera.CFrame=control.smoothCameraFrame(camera,host.CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position,point),delta)
    end
    function control.updateTransitions(delta)
        local elapsed=tonumber(delta)
        if elapsed and elapsed==elapsed and math.abs(elapsed)~=math.huge and elapsed>0 then control.renderDelta=math.clamp(elapsed,0,0.1) end
        local own=player.Character;local ownRoot=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        -- An assist borrowing facing does not release the selected target.
        local controlling=control.ownsCharacter(ownRoot)
        if control.hadCharacterControl and not controlling and control.lastControlledRoot==ownRoot
            and not priorityInputActive() and not control.dashFacingActive() and not control.characterRagdolled(own) and control.focused then control.beginCharacterRelease(ownRoot,control.lastControlledFrame) end
        if controlling or (priorityInputActive() and not (control.characterRelease and control.characterRelease.assistReturn)) then control.finishCharacterRelease() end
        control.hadCharacterControl,control.lastControlledRoot=controlling,ownRoot
        if controlling then control.lastControlledFrame=ownRoot.CFrame;control.characterControlProof=returnContext(own) end
        if not control.ownsCamera() then clearBlend('camera') end
        if not control.ownsCharacter() then clearBlend('character') end
        -- Focus loss/ragdoll pause the writer without repeating a completed
        -- onset. Unlock, death and replacement end acquisition.
        if not currentCharacterAcquisition(control.characterAcquisition) then control.characterAcquisition=nil end
        local guard=control.overlapGuard
        local environment=menu.environment
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if guard and (guard.root~=root or guard.target~=environment.LockedTarget or guard.connection~=environment.LockConn
            or not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0
            or not valid(environment.LockedTarget) or not environment.LockConn or environment.LockConn.Connected==false) then
            control.overlapGuard=nil
        end
    end
    function control.stepCharacterRelease(delta)
        if pauseEmoteFacing()then return end
        local release=control.characterRelease
        if not release then return end
        if release.assistReturn then
            local own=player.Character
            local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if release.character~=own or release.root~=root or assistReturnBlocked(root)
                or (not release.humanized and release.assistTarget and not valid(release.assistTarget)) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
            local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            local nativeSkill=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
            if (marker and marker~=release.nativeActionMarker)
                or (control.manualSkillSteeringActive() and nativeSkill~=release.nativeSkill)
                or (info and (info:FindFirstChild('Melee') or info:FindFirstChild('Attacking')) and (info:FindFirstChild('Melee') or info:FindFirstChild('Attacking'))~=release.nativeM1Marker)
                or (not release.manualM1 and control.manualM1SteeringActive()) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
            local elapsed=tonumber(delta) or control.renderDelta or 1/60
            if not finiteNumber(elapsed) or elapsed<0 then elapsed=0 end
            local delay=(control.assistDisengageDelayMs[release.assistRole] or 0)*.001
            if release.assistTarget and (delay>0 or release.fadeExplicit) and not returnTargetValid(release.assistTarget) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
            local remaining=math.max(0,delay-(release.lingerElapsed or 0))
            if remaining>0 then
                local target=release.assistTarget
                if not returnTargetValid(target) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
                local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
                local point
                if release.assistRole=='Lock' then point=control.targetPoint(target,'Character')
                elseif assist and assist.directionalTargetPoint then point=assist.directionalTargetPoint(root,target,release.assistRole)
                else
                    local part=control.targetPart(target);point=part and part.Position
                    if point and assist and assist.predictAimPoint then point=assist.predictAimPoint(root,target,release.assistRole,point) end
                end
                if not finitePoint(point) then control.cancelAssistReturn();return end
                local flat=host.Vector3.new(point.X,root.Position.Y,point.Z)
                local before=root.CFrame.LookVector
                if (flat-root.Position).Magnitude>.001 then root.CFrame=host.CFrame.new(root.Position,flat) end
                if elapsed>0 and finitePoint(before) and finitePoint(root.CFrame.LookVector) then
                    local after=root.CFrame.LookVector
                    local change=math.atan2(-after.X,-after.Z)-math.atan2(-before.X,-before.Z)
                    release.yawVelocity=math.atan2(math.sin(change),math.cos(change))/elapsed
                end
                release.frame,release.yaw,release.fadeElapsed=root.CFrame,nil,0
                local consumed=math.min(remaining,elapsed)
                release.lingerElapsed=(release.lingerElapsed or 0)+consumed
                elapsed-=consumed
                if elapsed<=0 and not (release.fadeExplicit and release.assistReturnSeconds==0 and release.lingerElapsed>=delay) then return end
            end
            local direction
            if nativeShiftLocked() then
                local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
                direction=camera and camera.CFrame and camera.CFrame.LookVector
            elseif hum and finitePoint(hum.MoveDirection) and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude>.05 then direction=hum.MoveDirection
            else
                local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
                direction=camera and camera.CFrame and camera.CFrame.LookVector
            end
            if not finitePoint(direction) then control.finishCharacterRelease();return end
            direction=host.Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
            if direction.Magnitude<.001 then control.finishCharacterRelease();return end
            local desired=host.CFrame.new(root.Position,root.Position+direction)
            root.CFrame=control.characterReleaseFrame(root,desired,elapsed)
            return
        end
        if priorityInputActive() then control.finishCharacterRelease();return end
        -- A native dash owns facing. End this return lease rather than pausing
        -- with AutoRotate disabled or replaying its captured heading afterward.
        if control.dashFacingActive() then control.finishCharacterRelease();return end
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        local assistActive=assist and ((assist.automaticDirectionalActive and assist.automaticDirectionalActive())
            or (assist.blockDirectionalActive and assist.blockDirectionalActive()))
        if control.manualSkillSteeringActive() or control.manualM1SteeringActive() then return end
        local own=player.Character;local root=own and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local hum=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');local info=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or release.character~=own or release.root~=root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or control.characterRagdolled(own,hum)
            or control.ownsCharacter(root) or (menu.directionalLock and menu.directionalLock.enabled) then control.finishCharacterRelease();return end
        if info then for _,name in {'Stun','TrueStun','NoRotate','NoRotation','InSkill','InDash','Knockback'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return end
        end end
        local point
        if not assistActive and nativeShiftLocked() then
            local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
            if camera and finitePoint(camera.CFrame.LookVector) then point=root.Position+camera.CFrame.LookVector*75 end
        elseif not assistActive and control.skillNativeMouse and control.skillNativeTool then
            local ok,value=pcall(control.skillNativeMouse,control.skillNativeTool,75)
            if ok then point=value end
        end
        -- Native movement can supply its own facing when no mouse aim is ready.
        -- Blend that rotation too rather than abandoning the captured release.
        local desired=root.CFrame
        if finitePoint(point) then
            local goal=host.Vector3.new(point.X,root.Position.Y,point.Z)
            if (goal-root.Position).Magnitude>.15 then desired=host.CFrame.new(root.Position,goal) end
        end
        root.CFrame=control.characterReleaseFrame(root,desired,delta)
    end
    function control.projectileNear(position,velocity,root)
        if not velocity or velocity.Magnitude<0.05 then return false end
        local delta=root.Position-position
        local time=delta:Dot(velocity)/(velocity.Magnitude^2)
        return time>=-0.06 and time<=0.12 and (delta-velocity*time).Magnitude<=3
    end
    local function discardProjectile(part,record)
        if record.destroyConnection then record.destroyConnection:Disconnect();record.destroyConnection=nil end
        if control.projectiles[part]==record then control.projectiles[part]=nil end
    end
    local function observeProjectile(record,now,root)
        local part,owner=record.part,modelFrom(record.owner)
        if not part or not part.Parent or not valid(owner) then return end
        local velocity=record.predictedVelocity or record.velocity or part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if control.projectileNear(part.Position,velocity,root) then
            control.recentThreats[owner]={at=now,source="Native owned projectile trajectory before impact"}
        end
    end
    local function observeChangedProjectile(record)
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        local now=clock()
        if now-record.created<=8 then observeProjectile(record,now,root) end
    end
    function control.observeProjectiles()
        local character=player.Character
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        local now=clock()
        for part,record in control.projectiles do
            if not part.Parent or now-record.created>8 then discardProjectile(part,record) else observeProjectile(record,now,root) end
        end
        if menu.autoBlock then for _,record in menu.autoBlock.projectileParts or {} do observeProjectile(record,now,root) end end
        for owner,record in control.recentThreats do if now-record.at>0.25 or not valid(owner) then control.recentThreats[owner]=nil end end
    end
    function control.addProjectile(ownerValue,part,direction,speed)
        local owner=modelFrom(ownerValue)
        if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not valid(owner) then return end
        local velocity=direction and direction*speed or part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local record=control.projectiles[part]
        if record then
            record.owner,record.predictedVelocity,record.created=owner,velocity,clock()
        else
            record={owner=owner,part=part,predictedVelocity=velocity,created=clock()}
            control.projectiles[part]=record
            -- Keep this listener with its live projectile, rather than retaining
            -- every historical projectile connection in the controller bucket.
            record.destroyConnection=part.Destroying:Connect(function()
                -- Preserve this projectile's final impact evidence without
                -- rescanning an entire swarm for every individual removal.
                observeChangedProjectile(record)
                discardProjectile(part,record)
            end)
        end
        observeChangedProjectile(record)
    end
    local function faces(root,target)
        local delta=target.Position-root.Position
        local horizontal=host.Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector;look=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
        return horizontal.Magnitude<=0.05 or (look.Magnitude>0.05 and look.Unit:Dot(horizontal.Unit)>=0.45)
    end
    function control.attacker(character)
        local now,selected=clock(),nil
        for _,record in control.metadata do
            if now-record.at<=0.25 and valid(record.target) then
                if selected and selected~=record.target then return nil,"Ambiguous fresh damage-source metadata" end
                selected=record.target
            end
        end
        if selected then return selected,"Fresh replicated attacker metadata" end
        local root,folder=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),host.workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not root or not folder then return nil,"The local character or attacker is unavailable" end
        local serverNow=host.workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        for _,model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if not valid(model) then continue end
            local other=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local last=tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
            local age=last and serverNow-last
            if age and age>=-0.05 and age<=control.inferenceWindow and (other.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=control.inferenceRange and faces(other,root) then
                if selected and selected~=model then return nil,"Ambiguous recent facing M1 attackers" end
                selected=model
            end
        end
        control.observeProjectiles()
        for owner,record in control.recentThreats do
            if now-record.at<=0.25 and valid(owner) then
                if selected and selected~=owner then return nil,"Ambiguous M1 / projectile attackers" end
                selected=owner
            end
        end
        if selected then return selected,"Inferred: unique fresh native attack context at damage" end
        return nil,"No fresh identifiable damage source was replicated"
    end
    local function acquireIncomingHit(target,at,source)
        if not control.activationHas(control.trigger,'Incoming') or not permitted() or not valid(target) then return false end
        local proof={token=incomingProofToken,character=player.Character,target=target,at=at}
        control.incomingDamageProof=proof
        local locked=control.lock(target,false,nil,nil,proof)
        control.incomingDamageProof=nil
        if locked then control.lastSource='Hit by enemy: '..tostring(source) end
        return locked
    end
    function control.tryHit(character,hitAt,damageConfirmed)
        if character~=player.Character or not control.alive then return false,"The damage character is no longer current",false end
        local target,reason=control.attacker(character)
        control.lastSource,control.lastReason=reason,reason
        if target then
            control.rememberHit(target,hitAt)
            local locked=damageConfirmed==true and acquireIncomingHit(target,hitAt,reason) or false
            return locked,reason,true
        end
        return false,reason,false
    end
    function control.onHit(character,damageConfirmed)
        if character~=player.Character or not control.alive then return false end
        control.hitEvents+=1
        local at=clock()
        control.pendingHit=nil
        local ok=control.tryHit(character,at,damageConfirmed)
        return ok
    end
    function control.onConfirmedHit(attacker,defender,source)
        local target,victim=modelFrom(attacker),modelFrom(defender)
        if victim~=player.Character or not valid(target) then return false end
        control.metadata["native"]={target=target,at=clock()}
        control.rememberHit(target)
        control.lastSource=source or "Confirmed native hit source"
        control.pendingHit=nil
        return acquireIncomingHit(target,clock(),control.lastSource)
    end
    function control.rememberKiller(character)
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if character~=player.Character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health>0 or control.lastDeathCharacter==character then return end
        control.lastDeathCharacter=character
        local target,source=control.attacker(character)
        local incoming=menu.autoCounterFilter and menu.autoCounterFilter.lastIncomingRecord
        if not target and not source:find('Ambiguous',1,true) and incoming and incoming.character==character then
            local age=clock()-incoming.at
            if age>=0 and age<=control.inferenceWindow then target,source=incoming.target,incoming.source end
        end
