        control.lastKiller=nil
        if valid(target) then
            local owner=if players.GetPlayerFromCharacter then players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) else nil
            control.lastKiller={userId=owner and owner.UserId,model=target,source=source,at=clock()}
        end
        if host._G then host._G.__CullingLastKiller=control.lastKiller end
    end
    function control.track(character)
        control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering()
        control.cancelAssistReturn()
        if character then ownCharacters[character]=true end
        table.clear(control.dashTracks)
        control.characterAcquisition=nil
        control.overlapGuard=nil
        clearBlend('character')
        control.endSession(false);control.pendingHit=nil;control.recentAttacker=nil;control.recentHitAt=-math.huge;control.lastOutgoingHit=nil
        control.physicalBlockDown,control.physicalBlockKey,control.blockReleaseSuppression,control.nativeOwnBlock=nil,nil,nil,nil
        control.nativePressAt,control.nativePressHadOwned,control.nativePressVersion=nil,nil,nil
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.characterConnections);table.clear(control.metadata);table.clear(control.recentThreats)
        if not character then return end
        local attached={}
        local function detach(object)
            local node=attached[object]
            if not node then return end
            attached[object]=nil;node.alive=false
            for child in node.children do detach(child)end
            local parent=attached[node.parent]
            if parent then parent.children[object]=nil end
            for _,connection in node.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
            -- Keep the existing aggregate teardown list bounded by live nodes.
            -- No stale connection or marker survives a normal combo cleanup.
            for index=#control.characterConnections,1,-1 do
                if node.owned[control.characterConnections[index]]then
                    table.remove(control.characterConnections,index)
                end
            end
            table.clear(node.connections);table.clear(node.owned);table.clear(node.children)
        end
        local function attach(object,fresh)
            if attached[object] then return end
            local node={alive=true,parent=object.Parent,connections={},owned={},children={}}
            attached[object]=node
            local parent=attached[node.parent]
            if parent then parent.children[object]=true end
            local function watch(signal,callback)
                local connection=connect(signal,function(...)
                    if node.alive and attached[object]==node then callback(...)end
                end,control.characterConnections)
                if connection then node.connections[#node.connections+1]=connection;node.owned[connection]=true end
                return connection
            end
            local function remember(key,value)
                local target=modelFrom(value)
                control.metadata[tostring(object).."/"..key]=if valid(target) then {target=target,at=clock()} else nil
            end
            for _,key in sourceKeys do
                watch(object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key),function() remember(key,object:GetAttribute(key)) end)
                if fresh then remember(key,object:GetAttribute(key)) end
            end
            if object:IsA("ValueBase") and table.find(sourceKeys,object.Name) then
                watch(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"),function() remember(object.Name,object.Value) end)
                if fresh then remember(object.Name,object.Value) end
            end
            if object.Name=="Info" then
                watch(object.ChildAdded,function(marker)
                    attach(marker,true)
                    if marker.Name=="Block" then control.onBlock()
                    elseif marker.Name=='InSkill' then control.observeCurrentSkillAnimations(character)
                    elseif marker.Name=='InDash' then control.observeDashAcquisition(character) end
                end)
                watch(object.ChildRemoved,function(marker) if marker.Name=='Block' then control.updateBlockReleaseSuppression() end end)
                for _,marker in object:GetChildren() do attach(marker,false) end
            elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
                local previous=object.Health
                watch(object.HealthChanged,function(health) local damaged=health<previous;previous=health;if damaged then control.onHit(character,true);if health<=0 then control.rememberKiller(character) end end end)
                watch(object.Died,function() control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering();control.rememberKiller(character);control.pendingHit=nil;control.endSession(true) end)
            elseif object:IsA('Animator') then
                local function dashPlayed(track)
                    control.observeOwnSkillAnimation(character,track)
                    if nativeDashTrack(track) then
                        control.dashTracks[track]=true
                        control.observeDashAcquisition(character)
                    end
                end
                watch(object.AnimationPlayed,dashPlayed)
                if type(object.GetPlayingAnimationTracks)=='function' then
                    for _,track in object:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do if nativeDashTrack(track) then control.dashTracks[track]=true end end
                end
            end
        end
        connect(character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('InDash'),function()
            if character:GetAttribute('InDash')==true then control.observeDashAcquisition(character) end
        end,control.characterConnections)
        connect(character.ChildAdded,function(object) attach(object,true) end,control.characterConnections)
        connect(character.DescendantAdded,function(object) if object:IsA('Animator') then attach(object,true) end end,control.characterConnections)
        connect(character.DescendantRemoving,detach,control.characterConnections)
        attach(character,false)
        for _,object in character:GetChildren() do attach(object,false) end
        for _,object in character:GetDescendants() do if object:IsA('Animator') then attach(object,false) end end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        if not control.actionToggleWrite then control.actionRelock=nil end
        local requested=control.alive and value==true
        control.enabled=requested
        local entry=menu.entries["Main/Auto Lock On"]
        if entry then
            entry.running=requested
            if entry.widget.Get()~=requested then entry.widget.Set(requested,false) end
        end
        if not control.enabled then control.pendingHit=nil;control.physicalBlockDown=nil;control.blockReleaseSuppression=nil;control.nativeOwnBlock=nil;control.release();control.lastReason="Auto Lock On is disabled" end
    end
    function control.setTrigger(value)
        if activationMasks[value]==nil then return end
        control.trigger=value
        local requestedOutgoing=control.activationHas(value,'Hit')
        control.outgoingHitEnabled=requestedOutgoing
        for _,item in {{'Main/Auto Lock On Trigger',value},{'Main/Auto Lock On When You Hit',requestedOutgoing}} do
            local entry=menu.entries[item[1]]
            if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Get and entry.widget.Set and entry.widget.Get()~=item[2] then entry.widget.Set(item[2],false) end
        end
        if not blockMethodEnabled() then control.nativeOwnBlock=nil;control.lastBlockAt=nil end
        if value=='None' then control.pendingHit=nil;control.release() end
    end
    local blockAction,blockConnection
    function control.refreshBlockAction()
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild("Keybind")
        local combat=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Combat")
        local action=combat and combat:FindFirstChild("Block")
        if action==blockAction then return end
        if blockConnection then blockConnection:Disconnect() end
        blockAction=action
        blockConnection=if action then connect(action.Pressed,function()
            local binding=control.blockBinding()
            if binding and binding.kind=='Mouse' and menu.isMenuInput then
                local point=input:GetMouseLocation()
                local origin={UserInputType=host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name],Position=host.Vector3.new(point.X,point.Y,0)}
                if menu.isMenuInput(origin) then return end
            end
            local env=menu.environment
            control.nativePressAt,control.nativePressHadOwned,control.nativePressVersion=clock(),(env.LockedTarget~=nil or env.LockConn~=nil),control.physicalReleaseVersion
            local automatic=menu.autoBlock
            control.nativePressAutomatic=automatic and automatic.held~=nil and automatic.manualBlockHeld and not automatic.manualBlockHeld() or false
            if binding then
                local point=input:GetMouseLocation()
                local object={UserInputType=if binding.kind=='Mouse' then host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name] else host.Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard,
                    KeyCode=if binding.kind=='Keyboard' then host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name] else host.Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
                    Position=host.Vector3.new(point.X,point.Y,0)}
                control.tryBlockInput(object,binding)
            else control.onBlock() end
        end) else nil
        control.blockActionReady=blockConnection~=nil
    end
    local function parseKey(value)
        if kindOf(value)~="EnumItem" or value.Name=="Unknown" or value.Name=="None" then return nil end
        local aliases={MouseLeftButton="MouseButton1",MouseRightButton="MouseButton2",MouseMiddleButton="MouseButton3"}
        if aliases[value.Name] then return {kind="Mouse",name=aliases[value.Name]} end
        if value.EnumType==host.Enum.KeyCode then return {kind="Keyboard",name=value.Name} end
        return nil
    end
    function control.blockBinding()
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild("Keybind")
        local combat=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Combat")
        local action=combat and combat:FindFirstChild("Block")
        local binding=action and action:FindFirstChild("Keyboard")
        if not binding or not binding:IsA("InputBinding") then return nil end
        local result=parseKey(binding.KeyCode)
        if result then result.modifier=parseKey(binding.PrimaryModifier) end
        return result
    end
    function control.dashBinding()
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Keybind')
        local combat=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Combat')
        local action=combat and combat:FindFirstChild('Dash')
        local binding=action and action:FindFirstChild('Keyboard')
        if not binding or not binding:IsA('InputBinding') then return nil end
        local result=parseKey(binding.KeyCode)
        if result then result.modifier=parseKey(binding.PrimaryModifier) end
        return result
    end
    function control.dashInputHeld()
        local binding=control.dashBinding()
        if not binding then return false end
        if binding.kind=='Mouse' then return input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name]) end
        return input:IsKeyDown(host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name])
    end
    function control.refreshDashAction()
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Keybind')
        local combat=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Combat')
        local action=combat and combat:FindFirstChild('Dash') or nil
        if control.dashAction==action then return end
        if control.dashActionConnection then control.dashActionConnection:Disconnect() end
        control.dashAction=action
        control.dashActionConnection=if action then connect(action.Pressed,function()
            local binding=control.dashBinding()
            if binding and binding.kind=='Mouse' and menu.isMenuInput then
                local point=input:GetMouseLocation()
                local origin={UserInputType=host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name],Position=host.Vector3.new(point.X,point.Y,0)}
                if menu.isMenuInput(origin) then return end
            end
            control.onDashPress()
        end) else nil
    end
    function control.tryDashInput(object)
        local binding=control.dashBinding()
        if not binding then return false end
        local match=if binding.kind=='Mouse' then object.UserInputType==host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name] else object.KeyCode==host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name]
        if not match then return false end
        local modifier=binding.modifier
        if modifier then
            local held=if modifier.kind=='Mouse' then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[modifier.name]) else input:IsKeyDown(host.Enum.KeyCode[modifier.name])
            if not held then return false end
        end
        return control.onDashPress(object)
    end
    function control.syntheticBlockInput(object,binding,down)
        local automatic=menu.autoBlock
        if not automatic then return false end
        local key=binding.kind..':'..binding.name
        for _,expected in automatic.expectedInput or {} do
            if expected.key==key and expected.down==down and expected.expires>=clock() then return true end
        end
        local observed=automatic.lastObservedInput
        if observed and observed.object==object and observed.down==down then return observed.synthetic==true end
        if automatic.inputObservationReady then return false end
        if down and automatic.held and automatic.manualBlockHeld then
            local ok,held=pcall(automatic.manualBlockHeld,binding)
            if ok and not held then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.tryBlockInput(object,binding)
        if not permitted() then return false end
        if control.syntheticBlockInput(object,binding,true) then return control.onBlock(object) end
        if control.physicalBlockDown then return false end
        control.physicalBlockDown,control.physicalBlockKey=true,binding.kind..':'..binding.name
        control.blockReleaseSuppression=nil
        local firstNativeEvent=not control.nativePressAutomatic and control.nativePressVersion==control.physicalReleaseVersion and control.nativePressAt and clock()-control.nativePressAt<0.08 and control.nativePressHadOwned==false
        local cast=control.currentPendingSkill and control.currentPendingSkill()
        if cast and control.characterSkillLocked and control.characterSkillLocked(cast)
            and (menu.environment.LockedTarget or menu.environment.LockConn) then
            if (menu.environment.LockedTarget or menu.environment.LockConn) and not firstNativeEvent then
                control.skillUnlockClick={at=clock(),motion=0,cast=cast}
            end
            control.lastReason='Held camera drag keeps the target; a short Block tap can release it'
            return false
        end
        if (menu.environment.LockedTarget or menu.environment.LockConn) and not firstNativeEvent then
            control.releaseSelectedLock('Released target lock with the saved physical Block input');control.pendingHit=nil
            control.blockReleaseSuppression={at=clock()}
            control.lastReason='Released automatic lock with the saved physical Block input'
            return true
        end
        if control.ownsTarget() then return true end
        -- A new physical press is a new lock request, even during the unlock
        -- cooldown or the same skill. Background hit events remain suppressed.
        control.manualReleaseUntil,control.manualUnlockSkill=nil,nil
        control.lastBlockAt=nil
        return control.onBlock(object,true)
    end
    function control.onInput(object,processed)
        if processed or (menu.isMenuInput and menu.isMenuInput(object)) then return false end
        if control.tryDashInput(object) then return true end
        local binding=control.blockBinding()
        if not binding then return false end
        local match=if binding.kind=="Mouse" then object.UserInputType==host.Enum.UserInputType[binding.name] else object.KeyCode==host.Enum.KeyCode[binding.name]
        if not match then return false end
        if binding.modifier then
            local modifier=binding.modifier
            local held=if modifier.kind=="Mouse" then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType[modifier.name]) else input:IsKeyDown(host.Enum.KeyCode[modifier.name])
            if not held then return false end
        end
        return control.tryBlockInput(object,binding)
    end
    connect(input.InputBegan,control.onInput)
    connect(input.InputChanged,function(object)
        local click=control.skillUnlockClick
        if not click or not object.UserInputType or object.UserInputType.Name~='MouseMovement' then return end
        local delta=object.Delta
        if delta and finiteNumber(delta.X) and finiteNumber(delta.Y) then click.motion+=math.abs(delta.X)+math.abs(delta.Y) end
    end)
    connect(input.InputEnded,function(object)
        local toggle=control.lastToggleObject
        if toggle and (toggle==object or (toggle.UserInputType==object.UserInputType and toggle.KeyCode==object.KeyCode)) then
            control.lastToggleObject=nil
        end
        if not control.physicalBlockDown then return end
        local kind=object.UserInputType and object.UserInputType.Name or ''
        local key=if kind:match('^MouseButton[123]$') then 'Mouse:'..kind else object.KeyCode and 'Keyboard:'..object.KeyCode.Name
        if key~=control.physicalBlockKey then return end
        local binding=control.blockBinding()
        if binding and control.syntheticBlockInput(object,binding,false) then return end
        control.physicalBlockDown,control.physicalBlockKey=nil,nil
        control.physicalReleaseVersion+=1
        local click=control.skillUnlockClick;control.skillUnlockClick=nil
        if click and clock()-click.at<=.3 and click.motion<=5 then
            if control.releaseSelectedLock('Released skill target lock with a physical Block tap') then control.blockReleaseSuppression={at=clock()} end
        end
        control.updateBlockReleaseSuppression()
    end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function() control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering();control.actionRelock=nil;control.focused=false;control.pendingHit=nil;control.physicalBlockDown=nil;control.blockReleaseSuppression=nil;control.nativeOwnBlock=nil;control.skillUnlockClick=nil;control.lastToggleObject=nil end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function() control.focused=true end)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,control.track)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function() control.actionRelock=nil;control.track(nil) end)
    if player.Character then control.track(player.Character) end
    control.refreshBlockAction()
    local elapsed=0
    connect(host.game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat,function(delta)
        if control.cameraSkillEpisode and not control.universalSkillSteeringActive() then control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering() end
        if control.rejectOwnTarget() then return end
        control.refreshLockSession()
        local entry=menu.entries["Main/Auto Lock On"]
        if entry and entry.widget.Get()~=control.enabled then control.setEnabled(entry.widget.Get()) end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then
            control.actionRelock=nil
            control.releaseSelectedLock('Emote menu is open');control.finishCharacterRelease();return
        end
        elapsed+=delta
        if elapsed>=0.25 then elapsed=0;control.refreshBlockAction();control.refreshDashAction();control.bindOutgoingHits();control.bindSkillSignalObservers();control.bindSkillActions();control.bindSafeLockCleanup() end
        control.stepActionRelock()
        control.releaseRagdolledTarget()
        control.refreshSkillAnimationFallback()
        control.dashAcquisitionSuppressed()
        control.observeProjectiles()
        -- Skill yaw is written once by the late render callback. Heartbeat
        -- still observes native events without doubling the angular rate.
        control.updateBlockReleaseSuppression()
        -- Refresh only an unfulfilled held physical Block request, at 20 Hz.
        -- Unlock clicks retain their suppression until the next fresh press.
        local own=player.Character;local ownInfo=own and own:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if (control.physicalBlockDown or ownInfo and ownInfo:FindFirstChild('Block')) and not control.blockReleaseSuppression
            and not menu.environment.LockedTarget and not menu.environment.LockConn then control.onBlock() end
        control.pendingHit=nil
    end)
    -- One render owner performs the recovered camera/Look At tracking after
    -- native camera movement. The later assist dispatcher yields to active locks.
    -- No per-lock RenderStepped listener or legacy VM tracking loop is created.
    local runService=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    if host.presentationRunService and host.presentationRunService.RenderStepped then
        connect(host.presentationRunService.RenderStepped,function()
            if control.alive then control.updateFovVisual()end
        end)
    end
    local function renderFacing(delta)
        if pauseEmoteFacing()and not control.directionFreedomContext()then return end
        control.updateTransitions(delta)
        if not host.presentationRunService then control.updateFovVisual()end
        control.updateCamera(delta)
        if menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation then menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation() end
        control.manualInputFrame=(control.manualInputFrame or 0)+1
        control.manualMouseDelta=control.sampleSteeringMouse()
        local character=player.Character;local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local facing=root and control.skillFacingFrame(root)
        if facing then
            root.CFrame=facing
            if not control.universalSkillSteeringActive() and not control.ownsCharacter(root) then
                local context=control.skillFacing
                control.noteAssistFacing(root,context and (context.target or context.contactTarget),'Skill Aim',facing)
            end
        end
        control.skillFacingApplied=facing~=nil
        local assisted=facing~=nil
        local env=menu.environment
        if assisted and control.ownsCharacter(root) then
            -- Resume from the direction actually applied, never a pre-assist
            -- heading. A rejected assist must not finish the initial turn.
            control.characterAcquisition={object=root,target=env.LockedTarget,connection=env.LockConn,progress=1,completed=true,frame=root.CFrame}
            control.characterBlend=nil
        elseif control.ownsCharacter(root) and not control.characterFacingPaused(root) then
            -- Native lock keeps its selected target while it owns facing.
            local point=control.targetPoint(env.LockedTarget,'Character')
            if finitePoint(point) and finitePoint(root.Position) then
                local goal=host.Vector3.new(point.X,control.characterLookHeight(root,env.LockedTarget),point.Z)
                if (goal-root.Position).Magnitude>.001 then
                    root.CFrame=smoothFrame('character',root,host.CFrame.new(root.Position,goal),delta)
                    control.facingFallbackCount=(control.facingFallbackCount or 0)+1
                end
            end
        end
        -- Apply the release after native/assist facing, so it cannot be overwritten
        -- by a block rotation later in this render pass.
        if not control.assistReturnDispatcher or not control.characterRelease or not control.characterRelease.assistReturn then control.stepCharacterRelease(delta) end
    end
    if type(runService.BindToRenderStep)=='function' and host.Enum.RenderPriority then
        control.steeringRenderName='ShenaniganismSkillFacing'
        runService:BindToRenderStep(control.steeringRenderName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,renderFacing)
    else connect(runService.RenderStepped,renderFacing) end
    control.bindSkillActions()
    control.bindCameraRotationInput()
    control.bindSafeLockCleanup()
    control.bindOutgoingHits()
    local function nativeSignal(serviceName,signalName,callback)
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local services=module and module:FindFirstChild("Services")
        if not services or not services:FindFirstChild(serviceName) then return end
        local ok,signal=pcall(function() return host.require(module).GetService(serviceName)[signalName] end)
        if ok then connect(signal,callback) end
    end
    nativeSignal("BlockService","Effects",function(defender)
        if typeof(defender)=='Instance' then
            menu.blockConfirmedAt=menu.blockConfirmedAt or setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
            menu.blockConfirmedAt[defender]=clock()
        end
        if defender==player.Character then control.nativeOwnBlock={character=defender,at=clock()};control.onBlock() end
    end)
    nativeSignal('MovementService','Effects',function(_,method,character,direction)
        if method=='Dash' and character==player.Character then control.observeDashAcquisition(character,nil,direction) end
    end)
    nativeSignal("HandicapService","Hit",function(defender) if defender==player.Character then control.onHit(defender) end end)
    nativeSignal("HandicapService","Effects",function(attacker,method,defender)
        if method=="Grab" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker,defender,"Native grab source") end
    end)
    nativeSignal("GojoService","Effects",function(method,attacker,defender,marker)
        if method=='Teleport' then control.noteSkillTeleport(attacker) end
        if method=='DragStart' then control.noteRapidPunchesDrag(attacker,defender,marker) end
        if method=="ChaseHit" or method=="AerialHit" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker,defender,"Native Gojo "..method.." source") end
    end)
    nativeSignal("ReserveBallService","Effects",function(method,attacker,defender,part)
        if method=="Hit" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker,defender,"Native Reserve Ball hit caster")
        elseif method=="Fire" then
            local direction=defender and defender.LookVector
            control.addProjectile(attacker,part,direction,150)
        end
    end)
    nativeSignal("HakariService","Effects",function(method,attacker,defender)
        if method=="ChaseHit" or method=="CounterHit" then control.onConfirmedHit(attacker,defender,"Native Hakari "..method.." caster") end
    end)
    function control.Destroy()
        control.releaseUniversalSkillSteering()
        control.actionRelock=nil
        local cameraHook=control.cameraRotationHook
        if cameraHook then
            cameraHook.active=false
            if cameraHook.owner.getRotationActivated==cameraHook.wrapper then cameraHook.owner.getRotationActivated=cameraHook.original end
            control.cameraRotationHook=nil
        end
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.setEnabled(false);control.endSession(false);control.alive=false
        if control.steeringRenderName then runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(control.steeringRenderName) end
        table.clear(control.skillActionConnections)
        if control.cleanupHook and menu.environment.CleanLock==control.cleanupHook.wrapper then
            menu.environment.CleanLock=control.cleanupHook.original
        end
        if control.toggleReleaseHook and menu.environment.ToggleLock==control.toggleReleaseHook.wrapper then
            menu.environment.ToggleLock=control.toggleReleaseHook.original
        end
        if control.targetSelectionHook and menu.environment.GetTarget==control.targetSelectionHook.wrapper then
            menu.environment.GetTarget=control.targetSelectionHook.original
        end
        control.cancelAssistReturn();control.assistReturnDispatcher=nil
        control.finishCharacterRelease()
        control.skillFacing,control.pendingSkillCast,control.teleportTargetLease=nil,nil,nil;table.clear(control.skillAimScopes);table.clear(control.skillLaunchScopes)
        table.clear(control.summonAimScopes);table.clear(control.summonSpecialScopes);table.clear(control.summonAimSelections)
        local summonHook=control.summonAimHook
        if summonHook then
            summonHook.active=false
            if summonHook.dispatch.Start==summonHook.wrapper then summonHook.dispatch.Start=summonHook.original end
            control.summonAimHook=nil;control.summonAimReady=false
        end
        for signal,hook in control.skillSignalHooks do
            hook.active=false;if signal.Fire==hook.wrapper then signal.Fire=hook.original end
        end
        table.clear(control.skillSignalHooks)
        for _,hook in control.skillAimHooks do
            hook.active=false
            if hook.owner[hook.key]==hook.wrapper then hook.owner[hook.key]=hook.original end
        end
        table.clear(control.skillAimHooks)
        clearBlend('camera');clearBlend('character')
        control.characterAcquisition=nil
        table.clear(control.dashTracks)
        control.overlapGuard=nil
        if control.fovGui then control.fovGui:Destroy();control.fovGui,control.fovCircle=nil,nil end
        if control.outgoingConnection then control.outgoingConnection:Disconnect();control.outgoingConnection=nil end
        if control.outgoingDamageConnection then control.outgoingDamageConnection:Disconnect();control.outgoingDamageConnection=nil end
        if control.contactConnection then control.contactConnection:Disconnect();control.contactConnection=nil end
        for part,record in control.projectiles do discardProjectile(part,record) end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,connection in control.characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.characterConnections);table.clear(control.metadata);table.clear(control.projectiles);table.clear(control.recentThreats)
    end
    return control
end
return AutoLock
end)()

local FloatingValues = (function(): any
-- Upright world anchors keep labels clear of ragdoll body rotation.
local FloatingValues: {[string]: any} = {}
function FloatingValues.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any): any
    local control: any = {alive = true, anchors = {}, attached = {}, elapsed = 0}
    local folder = host.Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name, folder.Parent = "ShenaniganismFloatingValues", host.workspace
    local function makeAnchor(position: any): any
        local part = host.Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name, part.Size, part.Transparency, part.Anchored = "FloatingValueAnchor", host.Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1), 1, true
        part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = false, false, false
        part.CFrame, part.Parent = host.CFrame.new(position), folder
        return part
    end
    function control.position(model: any): any
        local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not root then return nil end
        -- Head/limb animation must not move the information anchor.
        local position=root.Position
        if type(root.GetRenderCFrame)=='function' then
            local okay,frame=pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame,root)
            local rendered=okay and frame and frame.Position
            if rendered and rendered.X==rendered.X and rendered.Y==rendered.Y and rendered.Z==rendered.Z
                and math.abs(rendered.X)<math.huge and math.abs(rendered.Y)<math.huge and math.abs(rendered.Z)<math.huge then position=rendered end
        end
        return position+host.Vector3.new(0,3.4,0)
    end
    -- The card hangs above the head, and the engine drops a billboard whose anchor is behind the camera or off screen even while the
    -- character's body is still in view. When the head anchor is out of view but any part of the body is on screen, hang the card on the
    -- highest visible body part instead; it only disappears once the whole character, arms and legs included, is off screen.
    control.keepWhileBodyVisible = true
    function control.setKeepWhileBodyVisible(value) control.keepWhileBodyVisible = value == true;return true end
    local function pointOnScreen(camera: any, position: any): boolean
        local projected, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
        return visible == true and projected.Z > 0
    end
    function control.visiblePoint(model: any, camera: any): any
        local best, bestY = nil, -math.huge
        for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency < 1 and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                local position = part.Position
                if position.Y > bestY and pointOnScreen(camera, position) then best, bestY = position, position.Y end
            end
        end
        if not best then
            local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root and pointOnScreen(camera, root.Position) then best = root.Position end
        end
        return if best then best + host.Vector3.new(0, .9, 0) else nil
    end
    function control.attach(display: any, model: any, offset: number)
        if not control.alive or not display.Parent then return end
        local record = control.attached[display]
        if not record or record.model ~= model then
            record = {model = model, offset = offset}
            control.attached[display] = record
            display.StudsOffset, display.ExtentsOffset, display.ExtentsOffsetWorldSpace = host.Vector3.zero, host.Vector3.zero, host.Vector3.zero
            if display.Name ~= "CullingInfoESP" and display.Name ~= "CullingEnemyStun" then
                for _, text in display:GetDescendants() do
                    if text:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        text.Font, text.TextStrokeColor3, text.TextStrokeTransparency = host.Enum.Font.GothamSemibold, host.Color3.new(0,0,0), 0.1
                        text.TextSize = math.max(16,text.TextSize)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        record.offset = offset
        local position = control.position(model)
        if position then
            local anchor = control.anchors[model]
            if not anchor then anchor = makeAnchor(position); control.anchors[model] = anchor end
            if display.Adornee ~= anchor then display.Adornee = anchor end
            if record.appliedOffset ~= offset then display.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = host.Vector3.new(0,offset,0); record.appliedOffset = offset end
        end
    end
    -- The VM registry owns historical instances until unload. Only bootstrap
    -- it once; new billboards arrive through lifecycle events, not a growing
    -- half-second scan of every destroyed menu/card instance.
    local pendingBillboards={}
    control.registryScans,control.registryVisits,control.discoveryVisits=0,0,0
    local function discover(object)
        control.discoveryVisits+=1
        if not menu.state.instances[object] or not object.Parent or not object:IsA('BillboardGui')
            or object.Name=='CDVIEW_AbilityMonitor' or object.Name=='LockOnGui'
            or object.Name:sub(1,16)=='PlayerLockOnGui_' or control.attached[object] then return end
        local part=object.Adornee
        local model=part and part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        if model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then control.attach(object,model,math.clamp(object.StudsOffset.Y,0,3)) end
    end
    function control.noteOwnedBillboard(object)
        if control.alive then pendingBillboards[object]=true end
    end
    local function discoverPending()
        if control.registryScans==0 then
            control.registryScans=1
            for object in menu.state.instances do
                control.registryVisits+=1
                if object:IsA('BillboardGui') then discover(object) end
            end
        end
        for object in pendingBillboards do pendingBillboards[object]=nil;discover(object) end
    end
    local wanted, updated, positions = {}, {}, {}
    local runService=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local function present(delta)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.elapsed += delta
        if control.elapsed >= 0.5 then
            control.elapsed = 0
            discoverPending()
        end
        table.clear(wanted);table.clear(updated);table.clear(positions)
        if next(control.attached)==nil and next(control.anchors)==nil then return end
        for display, record in control.attached do
            local position = positions[record.model]
            if position == nil then
                position = (record.model.Parent and control.position(record.model)) or false
                if position and control.keepWhileBodyVisible then
                    local camera = host.workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if camera and not pointOnScreen(camera, position) then
                        local alternative = control.visiblePoint(record.model, camera)
                        if alternative then position = alternative end
                    end
                end
                positions[record.model] = position
            end
            if not display.Parent or not position then control.attached[display] = nil
            else
                wanted[record.model] = true
                local anchor = control.anchors[record.model]
                if not anchor then anchor = makeAnchor(position); control.anchors[record.model] = anchor end
                if not updated[record.model] then
                    local current = anchor.Position
                    local humanoid = record.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= host.Enum.Material.Air and math.abs(position.Y-current.Y) < 0.18 then
                        position = host.Vector3.new(position.X,current.Y,position.Z)
                    end
                    local nextY = if math.abs(position.Y-current.Y)>20 then position.Y else current.Y+(position.Y-current.Y)*(1-math.exp(-18*delta))
                    local nextPosition = host.Vector3.new(position.X,nextY,position.Z)
                    if (nextPosition-current).Magnitude>0.001 then anchor.CFrame = host.CFrame.new(nextPosition) end
                    updated[record.model] = true
                end
                if display.Adornee ~= anchor then display.Adornee = anchor end
                if record.appliedOffset ~= record.offset then display.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = host.Vector3.new(0,record.offset,0); record.appliedOffset = record.offset end
            end
        end
        for model, anchor in control.anchors do if not wanted[model] then anchor:Destroy(); control.anchors[model] = nil end end
    end
    local connection,renderName
    if type(runService.BindToRenderStep)=='function' and host.Enum.RenderPriority and host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last then
        renderName='ShenaniganismFloatingValuePresentation'
        -- Follow the rendered body after native camera and character-facing
        -- writers; later info layout reads this frame's upright anchor.
        runService:BindToRenderStep(renderName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+3,present)
    else connection=runService.RenderStepped:Connect(present) end
    control.renderName=renderName
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        if renderName then runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderName) end
        table.clear(pendingBillboards)
        folder:Destroy()
        table.clear(control.anchors)
        table.clear(control.attached)
        table.clear(wanted);table.clear(updated);table.clear(positions)
    end
    return control
end
return FloatingValues
end)()

local ActionOverlap = (function(): any
-- Requested input routing. The game's native action handlers own acceptance.
local ActionOverlap={}
function ActionOverlap.new(host,menu)
    local control={alive=true,enabled=true,actions={Block=true,M1=true,Dash=true,Skill=true},
        contexts={Block=true,Dash=true,M1=true,Skill=true}}
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        if type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.enabled=value;return true
    end
    function control.setAction(action,value)
        if control.actions[action]==nil or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.actions[action]=value;return true
    end
    function control.setContext(context,value)
        if control.contexts[context]==nil or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.contexts[context]=value;return true
    end
    function control.allows(action,context)
        return control.alive and control.enabled and control.actions[action]==true and control.contexts[context]==true
            and not (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Allow Action Overlap',Description='Submit enabled native actions during other actions without script-owned waits or forced cancellation. Native game state, cooldown and acceptance still apply.',Default=true,Callback=control.setEnabled})
        for _,definition in {{'Block','Block'},{'M1','M1'},{'Dash','Dash'},{'Skill','Skills'}} do
            local action=definition[1]
            tab:CreateToggle({Name='Action Overlap Allow '..action,DisplayName='Allow '..definition[2],Description='Include this native action in action-overlap input routing.',Default=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=function(value)return control.setAction(action,value)end})
        end
        for _,definition in {{'Block','While Blocking'},{'Dash','While Dashing'},{'M1','While Attacking (M1)'},{'Skill','While Using Skills'}} do
            local context=definition[1]
            tab:CreateToggle({Name='Action Overlap During '..context,DisplayName=definition[2],Description='Allow the selected native action inputs during this context. The game decides which requests it accepts.',Default=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=function(value)return control.setContext(context,value)end})
        end
    end
    function control.Destroy()control.alive=false end
    return control
end
return ActionOverlap
end)()

local StunControls = (function(): any
-- Three separate, opt-in toggles: True Anti-Stun (remove stun markers), True
-- Anti-Ragdoll (refuse ragdoll) and Hit Ragdolled Targets (your hit query
-- reaches targets that are ragdolled). The server still has the final say.
    local function newActionTagFilters(player,paused)
        local control={alive=true,enabled={NoDash=false,NoBlock=false,NoM1=false},removed={NoDash=0,NoBlock=0,NoM1=0},pending=false}
        local lifetime,characterConnections,infoConnections={},{},{}
        local current,currentInfo=nil,nil
        local function disconnect(list)
            for _,connection in list do connection:Disconnect()end
            table.clear(list)
        end
        local function listen(list,signal,callback)
            if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function'then table.insert(list,signal:Connect(callback))end
        end
        local function active(object)
            return control.alive and object~=nil and current~=nil and player.Character==current and current.Parent~=nil
                and (object==current or object==currentInfo and currentInfo.Parent==current)
        end
        local function removeMarker(marker)
            local owner=marker.Parent
            if not active(owner)or control.enabled[marker.Name]~=true then return end
            if paused()then control.pending=true;return end
            local name=marker.Name
            -- These exact No* guards are tested by presence by native actions.
            -- Unlike Stun(false), a NoDash/NoBlock/NoM1 BoolValue(false) is
            -- still the requested guard instance and must be removed.
            marker:Destroy();control.removed[name]+=1
        end
        local function clearAttribute(object,name)
            if not active(object)or control.enabled[name]~=true then return end
            local value=object:GetAttribute(name)
            if value~=true and not(type(value)=='number'and value>0)then return end
            if paused()then control.pending=true;return end
            object:SetAttribute(name,nil)
            control.removed[name]+=1
        end
        local function scan(object)
            if not active(object)then return end
            for _,marker in object:GetChildren()do removeMarker(marker)end
            for name,enabled in control.enabled do if enabled then clearAttribute(object,name)end end
        end
        local function watchAttributes(object,list)
            for name,enabled in control.enabled do
                if enabled then listen(list,object:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name),function()clearAttribute(object,name)end)end
            end
        end
        local function watchInfo(info)
            disconnect(infoConnections);currentInfo=nil
            if not info or not current or info.Parent~=current or info.Name~='Info'then return end
            currentInfo=info
            listen(infoConnections,info.ChildAdded,removeMarker)
            watchAttributes(info,infoConnections)
            scan(info)
        end
        local function bind(character)
            disconnect(characterConnections);disconnect(infoConnections)
            current,currentInfo=character,nil;control.pending=false
            if not control.alive or not current or player.Character~=current then return end
            local owner=current
            listen(characterConnections,owner.ChildAdded,function(child)
                if current~=owner then return end
                if child.Name=='Info'then watchInfo(child)else removeMarker(child)end
            end)
            listen(characterConnections,owner.ChildRemoved,function(child)
                if current==owner and child==currentInfo then watchInfo(owner:FindFirstChild('Info'))end
            end)
            watchAttributes(owner,characterConnections)
            watchInfo(owner:FindFirstChild('Info'));scan(owner)
        end
        local function reconnect()
            disconnect(lifetime);disconnect(characterConnections);disconnect(infoConnections)
            current,currentInfo=nil,nil;control.pending=false
            if not control.alive then return end
            local enabled=false
            for _,value in control.enabled do if value then enabled=true;break end end
            if not enabled then return end
            listen(lifetime,player.CharacterAdded,bind)
            listen(lifetime,player.CharacterRemoving,function(character)if character==current then bind(nil)end end)
            bind(player.Character)
        end
        function control.set(name,value)
            if not control.alive or control.enabled[name]==nil or type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
            if control.enabled[name]==value then return true end
            control.enabled[name]=value;reconnect();return true
        end
        function control.flushPending()
            -- This is called by the existing local heartbeat only when an
            -- event arrived during Failsafe. There is no continuous scan.
            if not control.pending or not control.alive or paused()then return end
            control.pending=false;scan(current);scan(currentInfo)
        end
        function control.Destroy()
            if not control.alive then return end
            control.alive=false;reconnect()
        end
        return control
    end

local StunControls={}
function StunControls.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local world=host.workspace
    local Enum=host.Enum
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,trueAntiStun=false,trueAntiRagdoll=false,hitRagdolled=false,
        stunDelay=0,removedStun=0,clearedRagdoll=0,extraHits=0,lastReason='Stun controls are idle',unlockActions=false,lockDelay=0,removedLocks=0,antiDirectionLock=true,directionDelay=0,removedDirection=0,releasedFacing=0,inSkill=false,skillEndAt=-math.huge}
    local connections,characterConnections={}, {}
    local watched=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local scheduled=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local pendingAttributes={}
    local stunMarkers={Stun=true,TrueStun=true}
    -- The game's own action locks: no M1, no dash, no block, no sprint, no jump, no parkour. Opt-in, with its own wait.
    local lockMarkers={NoM1=true,NoDash=true,NoBlock=true,NoSprint=true,NoJump=true,NoParkour=true}
    -- The game's own direction lock: the Info marker that holds your character facing while a move plays.
    local directionMarkers={DirectionLock=true,NoRotate=true,NoRotation=true}
    local ragdollMarkers={Ragdoll=true,TrueRagdoll=true,CompleteRagdoll=true}
    local scrubbing=false
    local function positive(value: any): boolean
        return value==true or type(value)=='number' and value>0
    end
    local function paused(): boolean
        return menu.isFailsafePaused~=nil and menu.isFailsafePaused()==true
    end
    control.actionTagFilters=newActionTagFilters(player,paused)
    function control.setActionTagFilter(name,value)
        return control.actionTagFilters.set(name,value)
    end
    local function listen(list: any,signal: any,callback: any)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(list,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function disconnect(list: any)
        for _,connection in list do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(list)
    end
    local function cleared(value: any): any
        return if type(value)=='boolean' then false else 0
    end
    local function markerKind(name: string): string?
        if stunMarkers[name] and control.trueAntiStun then return "stun" end
        if lockMarkers[name] and control.unlockActions then return "lock" end
        if directionMarkers[name] and control.antiDirectionLock then return "direction" end
        return nil
    end
    local function scrubStun(marker: any)
        if not control.alive or not marker.Parent or paused() then return end
        local kind = markerKind(marker.Name)
        if not kind then return end
        if marker:IsA('ValueBase') and marker.Value==false then
            -- The game's own-cast marker stays; it is removed only if it becomes a real lock.
            if not watched[marker] then
                watched[marker]=true
                listen(characterConnections,marker.Changed,function()
                    if marker.Parent and marker.Value~=false then scrubStun(marker) end
                end)
            end
            return
        end
        local delay = if kind == "stun" then control.stunDelay elseif kind == "direction" then control.directionDelay else control.lockDelay
        local function remove()
            if control.alive and marker.Parent and markerKind(marker.Name) == kind then
                if kind == "stun" then control.removedStun+=1 elseif kind == "direction" then control.removedDirection+=1 else control.removedLocks+=1 end
                marker:Destroy()
            end
        end
        if delay>0 then
            -- Let it last this long, then remove it.
            if not scheduled[marker] then
                scheduled[marker]=true
                host.task.delay(delay,remove)
            end
            return
        end
        remove()
    end
    local function scrubAttributes(character: any)
        if not control.trueAntiStun or paused() then return end
        for name in stunMarkers do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if positive(value) then
                if control.stunDelay>0 then
                    if not pendingAttributes[name] then
                        pendingAttributes[name]=true
                        host.task.delay(control.stunDelay,function()
                            pendingAttributes[name]=nil
                            if control.alive and control.trueAntiStun and character.Parent and positive(character:GetAttribute(name)) then
                                control.removedStun+=1;character:SetAttribute(name,cleared(character:GetAttribute(name)))
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                else control.removedStun+=1;character:SetAttribute(name,cleared(value)) end
            end
        end
    end
    local function unragdoll(character: any)
        if scrubbing or not control.trueAntiRagdoll or paused() then return end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local flagged=false
        for name in ragdollMarkers do
            if positive(character:GetAttribute(name)) or info and info:FindFirstChild(name) then flagged=true;break end
        end
        if not flagged then return end
        scrubbing=true
        for name in ragdollMarkers do
            local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
            if positive(value) then character:SetAttribute(name,cleared(value)) end
            local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild(name)
            if marker then marker:Destroy() end
        end
        local constraints=character:FindFirstChild('RagdollConstraints')
        if constraints then
            for _,item in constraints:GetDescendants() do
                if item:IsA('BallSocketConstraint') and item.Enabled then item.Enabled=false end
            end
        end
        for _,item in character:GetDescendants() do
            if item:IsA('Motor6D') and item.Enabled==false then item.Enabled=true end
        end
        if humanoid.PlatformStand then humanoid.PlatformStand=false end
        local states=Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local state=humanoid:GetState()
        if state==states.Ragdoll or state==states.FallingDown or state==states.Physics then humanoid:ChangeState(states.Running) end
        control.clearedRagdoll+=1
        scrubbing=false
    end
    local function bind(character: any)
        disconnect(characterConnections)
        if not character then return end
        local function watchInfo(info: any)
            for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do scrubStun(marker) end
            listen(characterConnections,info.ChildAdded,function(marker: any)
                scrubStun(marker)
                if ragdollMarkers[marker.Name] then unragdoll(character) end
            end)
        end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info then watchInfo(info) end
        listen(characterConnections,character.ChildAdded,function(child: any)
            if child.Name=='Info' then watchInfo(child) end
        end)
        for name in stunMarkers do
            listen(characterConnections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name),function()scrubAttributes(character)end)
        end
        for name in ragdollMarkers do
            listen(characterConnections,character:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name),function()unragdoll(character)end)
        end
    end
    listen(connections,player.CharacterAdded,bind)
    bind(player.Character)
    listen(connections,run.Heartbeat,function()
        local character=player.Character
        if not character or not control.alive then return end
        if control.actionTagFilters.pending then control.actionTagFilters.flushPending()end
        if control.trueAntiRagdoll then unragdoll(character) end
        if control.trueAntiStun then scrubAttributes(character) end
        if control.antiDirectionLock and not paused() then
            for name in directionMarkers do
                local value=character:GetAttribute(name)
                if positive(value) then character:SetAttribute(name,cleared(value));control.removedDirection+=1 end
            end
            local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local skillNow=info~=nil and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')~=nil
            local now=host.os.clock()
            if control.inSkill and not skillNow then control.skillEndAt=now end
            control.inSkill=skillNow
            -- The moment a skill ends, give facing back: stop holding the character to the camera unless something else owns it
            -- (a lock-on target, an aim assist turn, a dash, a stun or an emote).
            if not skillNow and now-control.skillEndAt<=.6 then
                local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                if humanoid and humanoid.AutoRotate==false and humanoid.Health>0 and not humanoid.PlatformStand then
                    local environment=menu.environment or {}
                    local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
                    local turn=assist and assist.aimTurnState
                    local aiming=turn and turn.at and now>=turn.at and now-turn.at<=.15
                    local locked=environment.LockedTarget~=nil
                    local release=menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.characterRelease
                    local busy=info and (info:FindFirstChild('Stun') or info:FindFirstChild('TrueStun') or info:FindFirstChild('InDash') or info:FindFirstChild('Ragdoll'))
                    local emoting=menu.localCharacterEmoting and menu.localCharacterEmoting(character)
                    if not aiming and not locked and not release and not busy and not emoting then
                        humanoid.AutoRotate=true;control.releasedFacing+=1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Markers that arrived while the failsafe was paused (or before a toggle) are cleared as soon as it is safe.
        if (control.unlockActions or control.trueAntiStun or control.antiDirectionLock) and not paused() then
            local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if info then for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do if markerKind(marker.Name) then scrubStun(marker) end end end
        end
    end)
    local function refresh()
        local character=player.Character
        if not character then return end
        bind(character)
        scrubAttributes(character);unragdoll(character)
    end
    function control.setTrueAntiStun(value: any): boolean
        control.trueAntiStun=value==true;refresh()
        control.lastReason=if control.trueAntiStun then 'Removing stun markers as they appear' else 'True Anti-Stun is off'
        return true
    end
    function control.setStunDelay(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.stunDelay=math.clamp(amount,0,2000)/1000;return true
    end
    function control.setUnlockActions(value: any): boolean
        control.unlockActions=value==true
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info then for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do scrubStun(marker) end end
        control.lastReason=if control.unlockActions then 'Removing action locks as they appear' else 'Unlock Actions is off'
        return true
    end
    function control.setAntiDirectionLock(value: any): boolean
        control.antiDirectionLock=value==true
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info then for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do scrubStun(marker) end end
        control.lastReason=if control.antiDirectionLock then 'Removing the game direction lock as it appears' else 'Anti Direction Lock is off'
        return true
    end
    function control.setDirectionDelay(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.directionDelay=math.clamp(amount,0,1000)/1000;return true
    end
    function control.setLockDelay(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.lockDelay=math.clamp(amount,0,1000)/1000;return true
    end
    function control.setTrueAntiRagdoll(value: any): boolean
        control.trueAntiRagdoll=value==true;refresh()
        control.lastReason=if control.trueAntiRagdoll then 'Refusing ragdoll as it begins' else 'True Anti-Ragdoll is off'
        return true
    end
    function control.setHitRagdolled(value: any): boolean
        control.hitRagdolled=value==true
        return true
    end
    local function ragdolled(model: any): boolean
        local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
        for name in ragdollMarkers do
            if positive(model:GetAttribute(name)) or info and info:FindFirstChild(name) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Called from the game's hit query wrapper with the targets it found.
    function control.extraHitTargets(targets: any,attacker: any,position: any,diameter: any): any
        if not control.alive or not control.hitRagdolled or attacker~=player.Character
            or (host.typeof or typeof)(position)~='Vector3' or type(diameter)~='number' then return targets end
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        if not folder then return targets end
        local found={}
        for _,model in targets do found[model]=true end
        local radius=math.max(0,diameter)*.5
        for _,model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if model==attacker or found[model] or not ragdolled(model) then continue end
            local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            local root=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not root then continue end
            if menu.isCombatExcluded and menu.isCombatExcluded(model)==true then continue end
            local half=host.Vector3.new(math.max(root.Size.X,4)*.5,3,math.max(root.Size.Z,2.5)*.5)
            local point=root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
            local closest=host.Vector3.new(math.clamp(point.X,-half.X,half.X),math.clamp(point.Y,-half.Y,half.Y),math.clamp(point.Z,-half.Z,half.Z))
            if (point-closest).Magnitude<=radius then
                table.insert(targets,model);control.extraHits+=1
            end
        end
        return targets
    end
    SharedHooks.extraHitTargets=control.extraHitTargets
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated=true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='True Anti-Stun',DisplayName='True Anti-Stun',Description='Remove every stun marker the game places on your character the moment it appears, so stun does not block your movement or actions. Your own move markers are kept. The server decides what really lands, so some stuns may still hold.',Default=false,Callback=control.setTrueAntiStun})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='True Anti-Stun Stun Time (ms)',DisplayName='Stun Time (ms)',Description='How long a stun is allowed to last before True Anti-Stun removes it. 0 removes it the instant it appears; raise it to keep a short, fine-tuned stun.',Min=0,Max=2000,Default=0,Step=10,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=false,Callback=control.setStunDelay})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Unlock Actions',DisplayName='Unlock Actions (always M1, dash, block, sprint, jump)',Description='Remove the game action locks (NoM1, NoDash, NoBlock, NoSprint, NoJump, NoParkour) from your character the moment they appear, so you can punch, dash, block, sprint and jump even in recovery, stun or ragdoll. The server decides what really lands, and its own dash cooldown still applies.',Default=false,Callback=control.setUnlockActions})
        for _,name in {'NoDash','NoBlock','NoM1'}do
            tab:CreateToggle({Name='Remove '..name..' Tag',DisplayName='Remove '..name..' Tag',
                Description='Independently remove your own native '..name..' guard from Character/Info when it appears, including active matching attributes. Does not enable Unlock Actions or change dash physics, aim, cooldowns or the camera. Pauses with Failsafe; server restrictions still apply.',
                Default=false,Callback=function(value)return control.setActionTagFilter(name,value)end})
        end
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='Action Lock Time (ms)',DisplayName='Action Lock Time (ms)',Description='How long an action lock may last before Unlock Actions removes it. 0 removes it the instant it appears; up to 1000 ms keeps a short, fine-tuned recovery.',Min=0,Max=1000,Default=0,Step=10,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=false,Callback=control.setLockDelay})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Anti Direction Lock',DisplayName='Anti Direction Lock',Description='When a move tries to lock your facing (the game DirectionLock marker, NoRotate and NoRotation), remove it the moment it appears so you keep control of where your character faces during the skill. When the skill ends, facing is handed back at once unless a lock-on, aim assist, dash, stun or emote owns it. On by default.',Default=true,Callback=control.setAntiDirectionLock})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='Direction Lock Time (ms)',DisplayName='Direction Lock Time (ms)',Description='How long the game direction lock may last before Anti Direction Lock removes it. 0 removes it the instant it appears.',Min=0,Max=1000,Default=0,Step=10,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=false,Callback=control.setDirectionDelay})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='True Anti-Ragdoll',DisplayName='True Anti-Ragdoll',Description='Refuse ragdoll: clears the ragdoll flags, re-enables your joints and stands you back up as soon as the game ragdolls you. Separate from Ragdoll Cancel and from Anti-Ragdoll Physics.',Default=false,Callback=control.setTrueAntiRagdoll})
        tab:CreateButton({Name='Stun Control Stats',DisplayName='Stun Control Stats',ButtonText='Show',NoConfig=true,Description='Show how many stuns and ragdolls the toggles above have removed and how many extra ragdolled targets your hits reached this session.',
            Callback=function()
                return true,string.format('Stuns removed: %d | Action locks removed: %d | Direction locks removed: %d | Facing released after skills: %d | Ragdolls cleared: %d | Ragdolled hits added: %d',control.removedStun,control.removedLocks,control.removedDirection,control.releasedFacing,control.clearedRagdoll,control.extraHits)
            end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Hit Ragdolled Targets',DisplayName='Hit Ragdolled Targets',Description='Make your melee hit query include enemies that are ragdolled and inside the hit sphere, so you can hit them freely. Friends and excluded targets stay protected. The server may still reject a hit.',Default=false,Callback=control.setHitRagdolled})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        control.actionTagFilters.Destroy()
        disconnect(connections);disconnect(characterConnections)
        if SharedHooks.extraHitTargets==control.extraHitTargets then SharedHooks.extraHitTargets=nil end
        if menu.stunControls==control then menu.stunControls=nil end
    end
    return control
end
return StunControls
end)()

local nativeUltNames: any = nil
-- The character's own special colours from the game: UltNames[moveset] (main in slot 2, second in
-- slot 3), or the CustomUltC attribute when a kit sets one. Returns main, second (either may be nil).
local function nativeSpecColors(host: any, model: any): (any, any)
    if nativeUltNames == nil then
        local modules = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local source = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("UltNames")
        local okay, value = false, nil
        if source and type(host.require) == "function" then okay, value = pcall(host.require, source) end
        nativeUltNames = if okay and type(value) == "table" then value else false
    end
    local kindOf = host.typeof or typeof
    local main, second = nil, nil
    local custom = model:GetAttribute("CustomUltC")
    if type(custom) == "string" then
        for item in custom:gmatch("%S+") do
            local r, g, b = item:match("^([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)$")
            r, g, b = tonumber(r), tonumber(g), tonumber(b)
            if r and g and b and r == r and g == g and b == b then
                local color = host.Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(r, 0, 255), math.clamp(g, 0, 255), math.clamp(b, 0, 255))
                if not main then main = color elseif not second then second = color end
            end
        end
    end
    local entry = if nativeUltNames then nativeUltNames[model:GetAttribute("Moveset")] else nil
    if type(entry) == "table" then
        if not main and kindOf(entry[2]) == "Color3" then main = entry[2] end
        if not second and kindOf(entry[3]) == "Color3" then second = entry[3] end
    end
    return main, second
end

local ActivityState = (function(): any
-- Names exactly what a character is doing: IDLE, WALKING, RUNNING, JUMPING, FALLING, CLIMBING, WALL RUNNING,
-- SWIMMING, EMOTE: <name>, DASH, BLOCKING, M1 <n>, ACTION or the move's own name for a skill, SPECIAL: <name>,
-- ULTIMATE, STUNNED, RAGDOLL, and RECOVERING while the end lag after a move is still running. Emotes are
-- re-detected continuously. It reports how long the current action has run against what that move usually takes,
-- and how much end lag is left, so cards and the HUD can draw bars. Read-only.
local Activity = {}
local memory: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local learned: any = {}
local refreshedAt = -math.huge
local COLORS: any = {
    idle = Color3.fromRGB(150, 160, 175), walk = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 150), run = Color3.fromRGB(80, 225, 125), jump = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255),
    fall = Color3.fromRGB(110, 160, 255), climb = Color3.fromRGB(215, 175, 100), wallrun = Color3.fromRGB(70, 235, 210), swim = Color3.fromRGB(80, 190, 255),
    sit = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 190), emote = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 230), action = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 70), skill = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60),
    special = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 255), ult = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90), m1 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 80), dash = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 70),
    block = Color3.fromRGB(100, 170, 255), stun = Color3.fromRGB(160, 255, 70), ragdoll = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 50), dead = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120),
    recover = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
}
Activity.colors = COLORS
local function flag(model: any, info: any, name: string): boolean
    local value = model:GetAttribute(name)
    if value == true or (type(value) == "number" and value > 0) then return true end
    local child = info and info:FindFirstChild(name)
    if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") and child.Value == false then return false end
    return child ~= nil
end
function Activity.read(host: any, menu: any, model: any, now: number): any
    local info = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local mem = memory[model]
    if not mem then mem = {};memory[model] = mem end
    local names = menu.moveNames
    if names and names.refreshEmotes and now - refreshedAt > 4 then refreshedAt = now;pcall(names.refreshEmotes) end
    local animator = mem.animator
    if not animator or not animator.Parent then animator = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true);mem.animator = animator end
    local emote, climb, wallrun, skillName = nil, false, false, nil
    local actionRemaining = 0
    if animator then
        local levels = host.Enum.AnimationPriority
        for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            if track.IsPlaying and track.WeightCurrent > .05 then
                local trackName = if track.Name ~= "" and track.Name ~= "Animation" then track.Name else (track.Animation and track.Animation.Name or "")
                local lower = trackName:lower()
                local isEmote = false
                if names and names.isEmoteTrack then
                    local okay, value = pcall(names.isEmoteTrack, model, track)
                    isEmote = okay and value == true
                end
                if isEmote then
                    local okay, label = pcall(names.emoteNameForTrack, model, track)
                    emote = emote or (if okay and label then tostring(label) else trackName)
                elseif lower:find("wallrun", 1, true) or lower:find("wall run", 1, true) or (lower:find("wall", 1, true) and lower:find("run", 1, true)) then wallrun = true
                elseif lower:find("climb", 1, true) or lower:find("ladder", 1, true) or lower:find("rope", 1, true) then climb = true
                else
                    if names and names.skillNameForTrack then
                        local okay, label = pcall(names.skillNameForTrack, model, track)
                        if okay and label then skillName = skillName or label end
                    end
                    local priority = track.Priority
                    if (priority == levels.Action or priority == levels.Action2 or priority == levels.Action3 or priority == levels.Action4)
                        and track.Length > .05 and not track.Looped and track.Speed > 0 then
                        actionRemaining = math.max(actionRemaining, (track.Length - track.TimePosition) / math.max(.01, track.Speed))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local okayServer, server = pcall(host.workspace.GetServerTimeNow, host.workspace)
    local moveName = nil
    local moveset = model:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
    if moveset and okayServer then
        local bestAt = -math.huge
        for _, tool in moveset:GetChildren() do
            local last = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("LastUse"))
            if last and server - last >= 0 and server - last < 2.2 and last > bestAt then bestAt, moveName = last, (tool.Name:gsub("<[^>]->", "")) end
        end
    end
    local skillFlag = flag(model, info, "InSkill")
    local attacking = flag(model, info, "Attacking") or flag(model, info, "Melee")
    local ult = model:GetAttribute("InUlt") == true
    local last2 = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM2"))
    local special = last2 ~= nil and last2 > 0 and okayServer and server - last2 >= 0 and server - last2 < 1.4
    local last1 = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
    local m1Recent = last1 ~= nil and last1 > 0 and okayServer and server - last1 >= 0 and server - last1 < .6
    local acting = (skillFlag and not emote) or attacking or special
    local name = skillName or moveName
    -- Action bookkeeping: how long it has run, how long that move usually takes, end lag after it.
    if acting then
        mem.actingAt = mem.actingAt or now
        mem.lastActingAt = now
        mem.name = name or mem.name
        mem.peakLag = 0
    elseif mem.actingAt then
        local key = mem.name or "ACTION"
        local took = now - mem.actingAt
        if took > .05 and took < 15 then learned[key] = if learned[key] then learned[key] * .6 + took * .4 else took end
        mem.actingAt = nil
        mem.name = nil
    end
    local endlag = nil
    if not acting and mem.lastActingAt and now - mem.lastActingAt < 3 and actionRemaining > .05 then
        mem.peakLag = math.max(mem.peakLag or 0, actionRemaining)
        endlag = {left = actionRemaining, total = mem.peakLag}
    end
    local info2 = {text = "IDLE", color = COLORS.idle, kind = "idle", acting = false, endlag = endlag}
    local function set(kind: string, text: string, color: any?) info2.kind, info2.text, info2.color = kind, text, color or COLORS[kind] end
    local state = humanoid and humanoid:GetState().Name or "Running"
    local speed = 0
    if root then local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity;speed = math.sqrt(v.X * v.X + v.Z * v.Z) end
    local ragdoll = flag(model, info, "Ragdoll") or flag(model, info, "TrueRagdoll") or flag(model, info, "CompleteRagdoll")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 or model:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then set("dead", "DEAD")
    elseif ragdoll then set("ragdoll", "DOWNED")
    elseif flag(model, info, "Stun") or flag(model, info, "TrueStun") then set("stun", "STUNNED")
    elseif emote and not acting then
        if tostring(emote):lower():find("sprint", 1, true) then set("sprint", "SPRINTING") else set("emote", "EMOTE: " .. emote:upper()) end
    elseif acting then
        info2.acting = true
        local label = (name or mem.name or "ACTION")
        info2.name = label:upper()
        local expected = learned[label] or learned[mem.name or "ACTION"]
        info2.actionFraction = if expected then math.clamp((now - (mem.actingAt or now)) / expected, 0, 1) else nil
        info2.elapsed = now - (mem.actingAt or now)
        if ult then set("ult", "ULTIMATE: " .. info2.name)
        elseif special then set("special", "SPECIAL: " .. info2.name)
        elseif skillFlag or name then set("skill", info2.name)
        elseif m1Recent then set("m1", "M1 " .. tostring(math.max(1, (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("CurrentM1")) or 2) - 1)))
        else set("action", "ACTION") end
    elseif endlag then set("recover", "RECOVERING", COLORS.recover)
    elseif flag(model, info, "InDash") or flag(model, info, "DisableChase") then set("dash", "DASH")
    elseif flag(model, info, "Block") then set("block", "BLOCKING")
    elseif m1Recent then set("m1", "M1 " .. tostring(math.max(1, (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("CurrentM1")) or 2) - 1)))
    elseif climb or state == "Climbing" then set("climb", "CLIMBING")
    elseif wallrun then set("wallrun", "WALL RUNNING")
    elseif state == "Swimming" then set("swim", "SWIMMING")
    elseif state == "Seated" then set("sit", "SITTING")
    elseif state == "Jumping" then set("jump", "JUMPING")
    elseif state == "Freefall" or state == "FallingDown" then set("fall", "FALLING")
    elseif speed > .6 then
