        local sprint = flag(model, info, "Sprinting") or flag(model, info, "Sprint") or (humanoid ~= nil and speed > humanoid.WalkSpeed * 1.2)
        if sprint then set("run", "RUNNING") else set("walk", "WALKING") end
    end
    return info2
end
return Activity
end)()

local SelfHUD = (function(): any
-- A sleek readout of your own character: real hit area, M1 chain and combo
-- timer, attack speed, animation timing, cooldowns, status and session stats.
-- Reads game values only; it never changes your character or the game.
local SelfHUD = {}
function SelfHUD.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local world = host.workspace
    local C, U, E, Inst = host.Color3, host.UDim2, host.Enum, host.Instance
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local settings: any = {enabled = true, hitRing = true, reachMarker = false, chain = true, speed = true, timing = true,
        cooldowns = true, status = true, stats = true, hitTag = true, flash = true, scale = 1, posX = 50, posY = 88, comboWindow = 1.5, cooldownRing = true, ringLabels = true, ringRadius = 3.6, ringAttach = "Feet", ringHeight = 0, ringOffsetX = 0, ringOffsetZ = 0, ringState = true, ringDetail = "Detailed",
        ringM2 = true, ringEvade = true, ringSkills = true, ringHealth = true, ringUltimate = true, ringColorMode = "Per Stat",
        ringOpacity = .88, ringThickness = .3, ringLabelSize = 11, bgAlpha = .4, textScale = 1.15, boxWidth = 100, boxHeight = 100, boxFollowsText = false,
        ringSkillGrey = true, ringM1Invert = true, ringSwapUltSpecial = true, ringGeometry = "Circle", ringSides = {"Front", "Left", "Back", "Right"}, ringCornerGap = 8, ringTextMode = "Label", ringM1Stages = true, ringDashOverlay = true, ringRotation = 0,
        damagePopups = true, hitPopups = true, hitFallback = true, popupSize = 22,
        hudTheme = "Custom", hitRegister = true, ringShape = "Solid", ringSpin = 0,
        anchorMode = "Character", anchorMount = "Character", keepOnScreen = true, anchorPlacement = "Left", orbitAngle = 40, orbitDistance = 5, orbitHeight = 1.5, orbitSpin = 0, anchorPlacementOld = "Above", anchorFollow = "Character Facing", anchorLift = 4.5, anchorX = 0, anchorY = 0,
        nativeColors = true, ringGlow = .45, ringGlowSize = .5, ringBloom = false, ringBloomIntensity = .6, ringBloomSize = 24, ringBloomThreshold = .9,
        hpBar = true, details = true, layout = "Wide", ringLayout = "Dual Ring", ringInnerSkills = true, cooldownDrain = false, ringInnerScale = .62, ringDash = true, ringM1 = true, ringInnerLabels = true,
        overlayEnabled = false, overlaySkill = true, overlayEvade = true, overlayFront = true, overlaySide = true, overlayOpacity = .8, overlayHeight = 8, dragInMenu = true, alwaysOn = true, hitRingGround = true, hitRingSphere = false, ringGround = true, ringLockHeight = true, ringOverlay = true, ringColorT = .15, ringGreyT = .6, ringDarkBoost = .6, ringHealthWidth = 3, ringM1Width = .5, hitBoxShape = "Hexagon", hitBox3D = false, hitBoxSpin = 40}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, hits = 0, whiffs = 0, blocked = 0, perfect = 0}
    local glass, muted, track = C.fromRGB(16, 18, 26), C.fromRGB(150, 160, 180), C.fromRGB(34, 38, 50)
    local teal, orange, red, blue, white = C.fromRGB(90, 215, 190), C.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), C.fromRGB(255, 80, 70), C.fromRGB(110, 140, 255), C.new(1, 1, 1)
    local stateColors = {Counter = C.fromRGB(255, 80, 220), IFrame = C.fromRGB(235, 240, 255), Ragdoll = C.fromRGB(255, 205, 70), Stunned = C.fromRGB(255, 205, 70),
        Blocking = blue, Emote = muted, Attacking = red, Idle = teal}
    settings.ringColor = teal
    settings.ultColor = C.fromRGB(190, 120, 255)
    settings.popupColor, settings.hitPopupColor = C.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), C.fromRGB(255, 225, 110)
    settings.overlaySkillColor, settings.overlayEvadeColor, settings.overlayFrontColor, settings.overlaySideColor = orange, teal, C.fromRGB(255, 215, 90), blue
    local ui: any = nil
    local effects: {any} = {}
    local effectFolder: any = nil
    local reachPart: any = nil
    local reachInner: any = nil
    local reachHoldCenter: any, reachHoldFor: any = nil, nil
    local lastReach: any = nil
    local ring: any = nil
    local swings: {number} = {}
    local gaps: {number} = {}
    local lastM1: any = nil
    local lastQueryAt = -math.huge
    local streak, streakAt = 0, -math.huge
    local tag: any = {text = "", color = white, at = -math.huge}
    local flash: any = {color = white, at = -math.huge}
    local timingState: any = {alpha = 0}
    local cooldownMax: {[any]: number} = {}
    local evadeMax = 50
    local damageLog: {any} = {}
    local lastHealth: number? = nil
    local ping, pingAt = 0, -math.huge
    local stateName, stateSince = "Idle", 0
    local connections: {any} = {}
    local dragging: any = nil
    local pipShown: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local nativeAt, nativeModel, nativeMain = -math.huge, nil, nil
    local finisherStamp: any = nil
    local extras: any = {}
    local hpShown, hpGhost = 1, 1
    local m1Cooldown: {[string]: number} = {}
    local chainState: any = {key = "", n = 4}
    local bloomEffect: any = nil
    local overlayShown: {[string]: number} = {}
    local detailsAt, ultShown = -math.huge, 0
    local groundYMemory: number? = nil
    local graphH, graphBarW = 18, 7
    local stateAt, stateActive: any, actionWord = -math.huge, {}, "IDLE"
    local stretchMemory: any, stretched = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), false
    local cardLayoutFrame=0
    -- Box Text Size is resolution, not size: the box is laid out larger by this factor and drawn smaller by the same factor, so the text is
    -- sharper and the box never changes size on screen (1.15 is the size the layout was drawn for).
    local function boxFollow(): number
        -- Retired: it made Box Text Size change nothing visible (the box grew and was drawn back down). Text size is just text size.
        return 1
    end

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end
    local function stretchFactors(): (number, number)
        local follow = boxFollow()
        return settings.boxWidth / 100 * follow, settings.boxHeight / 100 * follow
    end
    local function stretchedValue(value: any, sx: number, sy: number): any
        if sx == 1 and sy == 1 then return value end
        return U.new(value.X.Scale, value.X.Offset * sx, value.Y.Scale, value.Y.Offset * sy)
    end
    local function cachedStretch(record: any, key: string, value: any, sx: number, sy: number): any
        local cache=record.stretchCache
        if not cache then cache={};record.stretchCache=cache end
        local entry=cache[key]
        if not entry then entry={};cache[key]=entry end
        if entry.value~=value or entry.sx~=sx or entry.sy~=sy then
            entry.value,entry.sx,entry.sy=value,sx,sy
            entry.result=stretchedValue(value,sx,sy)
        end
        return entry.result
    end
    local stretchTargets=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    local function stretchChildren(holder: any): {any}
        local entry=stretchTargets[holder]
        if not entry then
            entry={dirty=true,objects={}};stretchTargets[holder]=entry
            local function dirty()entry.dirty=true end
            table.insert(connections,holder.DescendantAdded:Connect(dirty))
            table.insert(connections,holder.DescendantRemoving:Connect(dirty))
        end
        if entry.dirty then
            table.clear(entry.objects)
            for _,object in holder:GetDescendants()do
                if object:IsA('GuiObject')then table.insert(entry.objects,object)end
            end
            entry.dirty=false
        end
        return entry.objects
    end
    -- The layout's own value for an object (what it asked for), not the stretched one on screen.
    local function naturalOf(object: any, key: string): any
        local record = stretchMemory[object]
        return if record and record[key] then record[key] else object[key]
    end
    -- A fixed text size: the size set is the size drawn (the auto-fit labels drew far smaller than they measured).
    local function putSize(label: any, size: number)
        size = math.clamp(size, 1, 100)
        if label.TextScaled then label.TextScaled = false end
        if label.TextSize ~= size then label.TextSize = size end
        local limit = label:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")
        if limit and limit.MaxTextSize ~= size then limit.MaxTextSize = size end
    end
    local function put(object: any, key: string, value: any)
        local record = stretchMemory[object]
        if record and (key == "Position" or key == "Size") then
            record[key] = value
            local sx, sy = stretchFactors()
            local wanted = cachedStretch(record, key, value, sx, sy)
            local current = object[key]
            if current ~= wanted then
                object[key] = wanted
                current = object[key]
            end
            record["applied" .. key] = current
            record["writtenFrame" .. key]=cardLayoutFrame
            return
        end
        if key == "TextSize" then
            if type(value) == "number" then value = math.clamp(value, 1, 100) end
            local limit = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")
            if limit then
                if limit.MaxTextSize ~= value then limit.MaxTextSize = value end
                return
            end
        end
        if object[key] ~= value then object[key] = value end
    end
    local function chainLength(character: any): number
        return m1ChainLength(character)
    end
    local function new(class: string, parent: any, props: any): any
        local object = Inst.new(class)
        for key, value in props do object[key] = value end
        object.Parent = parent
        return object
    end
    local function round(parent: any, radius: number): any
        return new("UICorner", parent, {CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, radius)})
    end
    local function textLabel(parent: any, name: string, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, font: any, size: number, align: any, color: any): any
        local label = new("TextLabel", parent, {Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = U.fromOffset(x, y),
            Size = U.fromOffset(w, h), Font = font, TextSize = size, TextXAlignment = align, TextColor3 = color or white, Text = "", ZIndex = 4,
            TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = false})
        new("UITextSizeConstraint", label, {MaxTextSize = size, MinTextSize = 5})
        return label
    end
    -- Text that reads on whatever it sits on: the colour of the bar under it (its fill where it is filled, its empty track where not), seen
    -- through the bar's transparency over the card glass. A light bar gets dark text and a dark bar gets light text, each with an outline of
    -- the opposite colour so it also reads where a bar edge runs through the word.
    -- The card glass takes a mild tint from whatever is behind the card in the world (see stepCard); text contrast is judged against it.
    local adaptedGlass: any = glass
    local backdrop: any, backdropAt, backdropParams = nil, -math.huge, nil
    local function contrastText(label: any, fill: any, fillAlpha: number, filled: boolean?)
        local under = if filled == false then track else fill
        local alpha = if filled == false then .5 else fillAlpha
        local seen = adaptedGlass:Lerp(under, math.clamp(1 - alpha, 0, 1))
        local luminance = .2126 * seen.R ^ 2.2 + .7152 * seen.G ^ 2.2 + .0722 * seen.B ^ 2.2
        local light = luminance > .19
        put(label, "TextColor3", if light then C.fromRGB(10, 12, 18) else white)
        put(label, "TextStrokeColor3", if light then C.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) else C.new(0, 0, 0))
        put(label, "TextStrokeTransparency", .55)
    end
    local function pip(parent: any, label: string, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): any
        local frame = new("Frame", parent, {Name = label .. "Pip", BackgroundColor3 = track, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = U.fromOffset(x, y),
            Size = U.fromOffset(w, h), ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 3})
        round(frame, 5)
        local bar = new("Frame", frame, {Name = "Bar", BackgroundColor3 = teal, BackgroundTransparency = .45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 4})
        local caption = new("TextLabel", frame, {Name = "Text", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = U.fromScale(1, 1),
            Font = E.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10, Text = label, TextColor3 = white, ZIndex = 5, TextScaled = true, TextWrapped = false})
        new("UITextSizeConstraint", caption, {MaxTextSize = 10, MinTextSize = 5})
        return {frame = frame, bar = bar, text = caption}
    end

    local function buildHitIcon(screen: any): (any, any, any, any)
        local group = new("CanvasGroup", screen, {Name = "HitTag", AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = U.fromScale(.5, .57), Size = U.fromOffset(38, 38), GroupTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 8, Visible = false})
        local scale = new("UIScale", group, {Scale = 1})
        local glyphs, ink = {}, {}
        local function glyph(name: string): any
            local holder = new("Frame", group, {Name = name, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 8, Visible = false})
            glyphs[name] = holder
            return holder
        end
        local function line(holder: any, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, width: number)
            local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
            local length, rotation = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
            local shadow = new("Frame", holder, {Name = "Shadow", AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Position = U.fromOffset((x1 + x2) * .5, (y1 + y2) * .5 + .6), Size = U.fromOffset(length + 1, width + 2), Rotation = rotation,
                BackgroundColor3 = C.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = .55, ZIndex = 8})
            round(shadow, 2)
            local mark = new("Frame", holder, {Name = "Mark", AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Position = U.fromOffset((x1 + x2) * .5, (y1 + y2) * .5), Size = U.fromOffset(length, width), Rotation = rotation,
                BackgroundColor3 = white, ZIndex = 9})
            round(mark, 2);table.insert(ink, {object = mark, property = "BackgroundColor3"})
        end
        local shield = glyph("shield")
        local points = {{19, 5}, {29, 9}, {28, 21}, {19, 31}, {10, 21}, {9, 9}}
        for index, from in points do local toward = points[index % #points + 1];line(shield, from[1], from[2], toward[1], toward[2], 2) end
        line(shield, 14, 17, 18, 21, 2);line(shield, 18, 21, 25, 13, 2)
        return group, scale, glyphs, ink
    end
    local function build(): any
        local gui=player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not gui then return nil end
        -- The status card, timing panel and 3D card mount were removed at the
        -- user's request. Keep only the independent block shield icon and
        -- plain Lua ring data; no invisible card hierarchy is constructed.
        local screen=new("ScreenGui",gui,{Name="ShenaniganismSelfHUD",ResetOnSpawn=false,IgnoreGuiInset=true,DisplayOrder=2})
        screen:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned",true)
        local tagLabel,tagScale,tagGlyphs,tagInk=buildHitIcon(screen)
        return {screen=screen,tagLabel=tagLabel,tagScale=tagScale,tagGlyphs=tagGlyphs,tagInk=tagInk,
            m2={},evade={},skills={{},{},{},{}}}
    end

    local function serverTime(): number?
        local okay, value = pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow, world)
        return if okay and finite(value) then value else nil
    end
    local function readState(character: any)
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local function marker(name: string): any
            local object = info and info:FindFirstChild(name)
            if object and object:IsA("ValueBase") and object.Value == false then return nil end
            return object
        end
        local skill = marker("InSkill")
        local ragdoll = character:GetAttribute("Ragdoll")
        if marker("Counter") then return "Counter"
        elseif marker("IFrame") then return "IFrame"
        elseif ragdoll == true or type(ragdoll) == "number" and ragdoll > 0 then return "Ragdoll"
        elseif marker("Stun") or character:GetAttribute("Stun") == true then return "Stunned"
        elseif marker("Block") then return "Blocking"
        elseif skill and skill:GetAttribute("Emote") == true then return "Emote"
        elseif skill then return "Attacking" end
        return "Idle"
    end
    local function pickTrack(character: any): any
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then return nil end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local skill = info and info:FindFirstChild("InSkill")
        if skill and skill:GetAttribute("Emote") == true then return nil end
        local levels = E.AnimationPriority
        local best: any = nil
        for _, candidate in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            local priority = candidate.Priority
            if (priority == levels.Action or priority == levels.Action2 or priority == levels.Action3 or priority == levels.Action4)
                and candidate.Length > .05 and not candidate.Looped and candidate.Speed > 0 then
                if not best or candidate.TimePosition < best.TimePosition then best = candidate end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function showTag(text: string, color: any)
        tag.text, tag.color, tag.at = text, color, clock()
        tag.kind = "shield"
        tag.version = (tag.version or 0) + 1
    end

    local hitWatch: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local trackAt = -math.huge
    local pendingOut: any = {}
    local pendingIn: any = nil
    -- Markers for hits the game's own hit query never reports (some skills): an enemy near you loses
    -- health shortly after you used M1, M2 or a skill.
    local function guessAttacker(character: any, myRoot: any, folder: any, server: number): any
        local feed = menu.threatFeed
        local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
        for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if model == character then continue end
            local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then continue end
            local distance = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if distance > 30 then continue end
            local age = math.huge
            local state = if feed and type(feed.stateOf) == "function" then feed.stateOf(model) else nil
            if state then
                if state.lastSwingAt then age = math.min(age, clock() - state.lastSwingAt) end
                if state.moveAt then age = math.min(age, clock() - state.moveAt) end
            end
            for _, name in {"LastM1", "LastM2"} do
                local stamp = tonumber(model:GetAttribute(name))
                if stamp and stamp > 0 then age = math.min(age, server - stamp) end
            end
            local moveset = model:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
            if moveset then
                for _, tool in moveset:GetChildren() do
                    local stamp = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("LastUse"))
                    if stamp and stamp > 0 then age = math.min(age, server - stamp) end
                end
            end
            if age >= -.1 and age < .9 then
                local score = age + distance * .01
                if score < bestScore then best, bestScore = model, score end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function stepHitWatch(character: any, now: number)
        if not (settings.hitFallback or settings.hitRegister) then return end
        local folder = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        local myRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not folder or not myRoot then return end
        local okay, server = pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow, world)
        if not okay then return end
        local lastAction = 0
        for _, name in {"LastM1", "LastM2"} do lastAction = math.max(lastAction, tonumber(character:GetAttribute(name)) or 0) end
        local moveset = character:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
        if moveset then for _, tool in moveset:GetChildren() do lastAction = math.max(lastAction, tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("LastUse")) or 0) end end
        local recent = server - lastAction < .9 and server - lastAction > -.25
        local tracker = if settings.hitRegister then menu.autoCounterFilter else nil
        -- Put every nearby character under the hit tracker's health watch before the first hit lands.
        if tracker and type(tracker.trackModel) == "function" and now - trackAt > 1 then
            trackAt = now
            for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
                if model ~= character then pcall(tracker.trackModel, model) end
            end
        end
        for _, model in folder:GetChildren() do
            if model == character then continue end
            local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not humanoid or not root then continue end
            local previous = hitWatch[humanoid]
            hitWatch[humanoid] = humanoid.Health
            if previous and recent and previous - humanoid.Health >= .5 and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude < 60 then
                if tracker then pendingOut[model] = {at = now} end
                if settings.hitFallback and now - lastQueryAt > .3 and now - tag.at > .35 then
                    control.hits += 1
                    if menu.cursorReticle and menu.cursorReticle.onHit then pcall(menu.cursorReticle.onHit,now)end
                end
            end
        end
        if tracker then
            for model, item in pendingOut do
                if now - item.at >= .12 then
                    pendingOut[model] = nil
                    local record = tracker.lastHitRecord
                    local registered = record and record.target == model and now - record.at < .5
                    if not registered and model.Parent and type(tracker.rememberHit) == "function" then
                        pcall(tracker.rememberHit, model, "Fresh replicated outgoing damage source", true, item.at)
                    end
                end
            end
            if pendingIn and now - pendingIn.at >= .12 then
                local queued = pendingIn
                pendingIn = nil
                local record = tracker.lastIncomingRecord
                if not (record and now - record.at < .6) then
                    local attacker = guessAttacker(character, myRoot, folder, server)
                    if attacker then
                        pcall(function()
                            tracker.lastIncomingRecord = {target = attacker, at = queued.at, character = character, source = "Attacker inferred from swing timing", inferred = true}
                            local visual = menu.visuals
                            if visual and visual.hitOutlineEnabled and visual.hitOutlineTimes and visual.infoActorAlive(attacker, attacker:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
                                visual.hitOutlineTimes[attacker] = queued.at
                                visual.updateTargetESP()
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Called by the game's hit query wrapper for every melee/skill hit query.
    function control.onHitQuery(attacker: any, position: any, diameter: any, targets: any)
        if not control.alive or not settings.enabled or attacker ~= player.Character then return end
        local now = clock()
        if now - lastQueryAt < .12 then return end
        lastQueryAt = now
        local hit, blocked = false, false
        local blockers: {any} = {}
        if type(targets) == "table" then
            for _, model in targets do
                if model ~= attacker then
                    local info = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
                    if info and info:FindFirstChild("Block") then table.insert(blockers, model) else hit = true end
                end
            end
        end
        local root = attacker:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local isVector = (host.typeof or typeof)(position) == "Vector3" and finite(diameter)
        if not hit and #blockers > 0 then
            -- Only a Block marker is not a landed hit. Wait for the game's own block confirmation; if the attack never lands, nothing pops up.
            local queryAt = clock()
            host.task.spawn(function()
                while control.alive and clock() - queryAt < .45 do
                    local confirmed = menu.blockConfirmedAt
                    if confirmed then
                        for _, model in blockers do
                            local at = confirmed[model]
                            if at and at >= queryAt - .1 then
                                if isVector and menu.blockFX then pcall(menu.blockFX.onEnemyBlock, position) end
                                control.blocked += 1;streak = 0;streakAt = clock()
                                if settings.hitTag then showTag("BLOCKED", blue) end
                                return
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    host.task.wait()
                end
            end)
            return
        end
        if hit then
            control.hits+=1
            if menu.cursorReticle and menu.cursorReticle.onHit then pcall(menu.cursorReticle.onHit,now)end
        else control.whiffs+=1 end
    end
    function control.onBlockedHit(perfect: boolean)
        if not control.alive or not settings.enabled then return end
        control.lastBlockAt = clock()
        if perfect then control.perfect += 1 end
        if menu.blockFX then pcall(menu.blockFX.onBlockedHit, perfect) end
        if settings.hitTag then showTag(if perfect then "PERFECT BLOCK" else "BLOCKED HIT", blue) end
    end

    -- Status, the state strip and the ring share one observation per HUD step.
    -- The cache is reset before every step and failed reads are never retained.
    local activityCharacter: any, activitySnapshot: any = nil, nil
    local function readActivity(character: any, now: number): any
        if activityCharacter==character and activitySnapshot~=nil then return activitySnapshot end
        local result=ActivityState.read(host,menu,character,now)
        if type(result)=='table' then activityCharacter,activitySnapshot=character,result end
        return result
    end
    -- Local card palette only: native ability/ring colors remain independent.
    local statusPalette = {
        idle = C.fromRGB(150, 160, 175), walk = C.fromRGB(120, 200, 150), run = C.fromRGB(80, 225, 125), sprint = C.fromRGB(35, 240, 175),
        jump = C.fromRGB(120, 200, 255), fall = C.fromRGB(110, 160, 255), climb = C.fromRGB(215, 175, 100), wallrun = C.fromRGB(70, 235, 210),
        swim = C.fromRGB(60, 155, 215), sit = C.fromRGB(170, 170, 190), emote = C.fromRGB(255, 140, 230), action = C.fromRGB(215, 200, 120),
        skill = C.fromRGB(255, 170, 60), special = C.fromRGB(225, 100, 255), ult = C.fromRGB(255, 215, 90), m1 = C.fromRGB(255, 130, 100),
        dash = C.fromRGB(90, 215, 255), block = C.fromRGB(100, 170, 255), stun = C.fromRGB(160, 255, 70), ragdoll = C.fromRGB(255, 140, 50),
        trueragdoll = C.fromRGB(230, 95, 50), down = C.fromRGB(180, 110, 140), dead = C.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), recover = C.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
    }
    local statusColorCharacter, statusColorShown, statusFallbackKey, statusFallbackColor
    local function statusTint(character: any, kind: string, text: string, dt: number): any
        local target = statusPalette[kind]
        if not target then
            local key = tostring(kind) .. ":" .. tostring(text)
            if key ~= statusFallbackKey then
                local hash = 0
                for index = 1, #key do hash = (hash * 31 + string.byte(key, index)) % 65521 end
                statusFallbackKey, statusFallbackColor = key, C.fromHSV((hash % 360) / 360, .6, .9)
            end
            target = statusFallbackColor
        end
        if statusColorCharacter ~= character or not statusColorShown then
            statusColorCharacter, statusColorShown = character, target
        elseif statusColorShown ~= target then
            local delta = if finite(dt) then math.max(0, dt) else 0
            statusColorShown = statusColorShown:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-delta * 12))
            if math.max(math.abs(statusColorShown.R - target.R), math.abs(statusColorShown.G - target.G), math.abs(statusColorShown.B - target.B)) < 1 / 255 then statusColorShown = target end
        end
        return statusColorShown
    end
    local function applyNativeUltimate(parts: any, character: any)
        local side = menu.sideDisplays
        local source = side and side.ultimateSource
        if source and not source.Parent then source = nil end
        local nativeGradient = source and side.ultimateSourceGradient
        if nativeGradient and nativeGradient.Parent ~= source then nativeGradient = nil end
        local style: any = nil
        if not source then
            local moveset, custom = character:GetAttribute("Moveset"), character:GetAttribute("CustomUltC")
            local palette = side and side.specialPalette
            local cached = parts.ultimatePalette
            if not cached or cached.character ~= character or cached.moveset ~= moveset or cached.custom ~= custom or cached.palette ~= palette then
                local record: any = {model = character}
                style = side and type(side.characterResourceStyle) == "function" and side.characterResourceStyle(record) or nil
                if not style then style = {base = (nativeSpecColors(host, character)) or settings.ultColor} end
                cached = {character = character, moveset = moveset, custom = custom, palette = palette, style = style}
                parts.ultimatePalette = cached
            end
            style = cached.style
        end
        put(parts.ultFill, "BackgroundColor3", if source then source.BackgroundColor3 else style.base)
        local gradient = parts.ultNativeGradient
        if (nativeGradient or style and style.gradient) and (not gradient or gradient.Parent ~= parts.ultFill) then
            gradient = Inst.new("UIGradient");gradient.Name = "NativeUltimate";gradient.Parent = parts.ultFill
            parts.ultNativeGradient = gradient
            parts.ultGradientDefaults = {Transparency = gradient.Transparency, Rotation = gradient.Rotation, Offset = gradient.Offset}
        end
        if gradient then
            put(gradient, "Enabled", if nativeGradient then nativeGradient.Enabled else style ~= nil and style.gradient ~= nil)
            if nativeGradient then
                put(gradient, "Color", nativeGradient.Color);put(gradient, "Transparency", nativeGradient.Transparency)
                put(gradient, "Rotation", nativeGradient.Rotation);put(gradient, "Offset", nativeGradient.Offset)
            elseif style and style.gradient then
                put(gradient, "Color", style.gradient)
                local defaults = parts.ultGradientDefaults
                put(gradient, "Transparency", defaults.Transparency);put(gradient, "Rotation", defaults.Rotation);put(gradient, "Offset", defaults.Offset)
            end
        end
        put(parts.ultText, "TextColor3", white)
        put(parts.ultText, "TextStrokeColor3", C.new(0, 0, 0));put(parts.ultText, "TextStrokeTransparency", 1)
    end
    local function stepRingData(character,humanoid,info,now,dt)
        local parts,server=ui,serverTime()
        local newState=readState(character)
        if newState~=stateName then stateName,stateSince=newState,now end
        local accent=stateColors[stateName]or teal
        if settings.status then
            local activity=readActivity(character,now)
            accent=if activity.endlag then ActivityState.colors.recover else activity.color or accent
        end
        local chainN = chainLength(character)
        local currentM1 = tonumber(character:GetAttribute("CurrentM1")) or 0
        local lastM1Value = tonumber(character:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
        if lastM1Value and lastM1Value > 0 and lastM1Value ~= lastM1 then
            -- The wait between a chain's last hit and the next accepted swing is the M1 cooldown. The
            -- game enforces it, so the shortest gap ever seen for this moveset is the real one.
            if lastM1 ~= nil and finisherStamp == lastM1 then
                local gap = lastM1Value - lastM1
                local kit = tostring(character:GetAttribute("Moveset"))
                if gap > .05 and gap < 4 then m1Cooldown[kit] = math.min(m1Cooldown[kit] or gap, gap) end
            end
            lastM1 = lastM1Value
        end
        if lastM1Value and currentM1 > chainN then finisherStamp = lastM1Value end
        local since = if lastM1Value and server then server - lastM1Value else math.huge
        local chainLive = settings.chain and since < settings.comboWindow and currentM1 > 1
        local stages = math.clamp(chainN, 1, 5)
        -- The game's CurrentM1 is the swing about to be thrown: after one hit it reads 2, after the last hit stages + 1.
        local done = math.clamp(currentM1 - 1, 0, stages)
        local cooldownLength = m1Cooldown[tostring(character:GetAttribute("Moveset"))] or 1
        local regaining = settings.chain and lastM1Value ~= nil and currentM1 > stages and since >= 0 and since < math.max(cooldownLength, settings.comboWindow)
        if regaining then
            local fraction = math.clamp(since / cooldownLength, 0, 1)
            extras.m1 = {fraction = fraction, text = if fraction >= 1 then "M1" else string.format("M1 %.1f", cooldownLength - since), color = if fraction >= 1 then teal else orange}
        elseif chainLive then
            extras.m1 = {fraction = math.clamp(done / stages, 0, 1), text = string.format("M1 %d/%d", done, stages), color = accent}
        else extras.m1 = {fraction = 1, text = "M1", color = teal} end
        extras.m1stages = {count = stages, done = done, live = chainLive, regaining = regaining, color = accent}
        local health=humanoid.Health
        if lastHealth and health<lastHealth-.01 and settings.hitRegister then pendingIn={at=now}end
        lastHealth=health

        local function setPip(item,text,fraction,color,ringText)
            local shown=pipShown[item]or fraction
            shown+=(fraction-shown)*(1-math.exp(-dt*12))
            if math.abs(fraction-shown)<.002 then shown=fraction end
            pipShown[item]=shown
            local view=if settings.cooldownDrain then 1-shown else shown
            item.live,item.ringText,item.ringFraction,item.ringColor=true,ringText or text,math.clamp(view,0,1),color
        end
        if settings.cooldowns or settings.cooldownRing then
            if settings.nativeColors and (now - nativeAt > .5 or nativeModel ~= character) then
                nativeAt, nativeModel = now, character
                nativeMain = (nativeSpecColors(host, character))
            end
            local dark = C.new(0, 0, 0)
            local specReady = if settings.nativeColors and nativeMain then nativeMain else teal
            local specBusy = if settings.nativeColors and nativeMain then nativeMain:Lerp(dark, .5) else orange
            -- Evasive keeps the game's plain blue whatever the character, and lights up when it is full.
            local evadeReady = C.fromRGB(32, 78, 200)
            local evadeBusy = evadeReady:Lerp(dark, .45)
            local cooldown, last = tonumber(character:GetAttribute("M2_CD")), tonumber(character:GetAttribute("LastM2"))
            local remaining = if cooldown and last and last > 0 and server then math.max(0, cooldown - (server - last)) else 0
            if remaining > .05 and cooldown and cooldown > 0 then setPip(parts.m2, string.format("%.1f", remaining), 1 - remaining / cooldown, specBusy, string.format("SPEC %.1f", remaining))
            else setPip(parts.m2, "SPEC", 1, specReady) end
            local evadeValue = tonumber(character:GetAttribute("Evade"))
            if evadeValue then
                evadeMax = math.max(evadeMax, evadeValue)
                setPip(parts.evade, "EVAD", evadeValue / evadeMax, if evadeValue / evadeMax >= .999 then evadeReady:Lerp(white, .45) elseif evadeValue / evadeMax < .5 then evadeBusy else evadeReady, string.format("EVAD %d%%", math.floor(evadeValue / evadeMax * 100 + .5)))
            else setPip(parts.evade, "EVAD", 0, track) end
            local moveset = character:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
            local index = 0
            if moveset then
                for _, tool in moveset:GetChildren() do
                    local readyAt = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("ReadyAt"))
                    if readyAt then
                        index += 1
                        if index > 4 then break end
                        local left = if server then math.max(0, readyAt - server) else 0
                        cooldownMax[tool] = math.max(cooldownMax[tool] or 0, left)
                        if left > .05 and cooldownMax[tool] > 0 then
                            setPip(parts.skills[index], string.format("%.0f", left), 1 - left / cooldownMax[tool], specBusy)
                        else setPip(parts.skills[index], tostring(index), 1, if settings.nativeColors and nativeMain then nativeMain:Lerp(white, .2) else teal) end
                    end
                end
            end
            for rest = index + 1, 4 do parts.skills[rest].live = false end
        else
            parts.m2.live, parts.evade.live = false, false
            for _, item in parts.skills do item.live = false end
        end
        -- Dash readiness for the ring (front and side), from the dash readiness provider.
        do
            local readiness = menu.frontDashReadiness
            local function dashExtra(getter: string, label: string): any
                if not readiness or type(readiness[getter]) ~= "function" then return nil end
                local okay, status = pcall(readiness[getter], character, server)
                if not okay or type(status) ~= "table" then return nil end
                local value = tonumber(if status.displayFraction ~= nil then status.displayFraction else status.fraction)
                if not finite(value) then return nil end
                local left = tonumber(if status.displayRemaining ~= nil then status.displayRemaining else status.remaining)
                local fraction = math.clamp(value :: number, 0, 1)
                return {fraction = fraction, text = if fraction >= 1 or not finite(left) then label else string.format("%s %.1f", label, left :: number)}
            end
            if settings.ringDash then extras.front, extras.side = dashExtra("getStatus", "DASH"), dashExtra("getSideStatus", "SIDE") end
        end
    end

    local function stepTag(now: number)
        local parts = ui
        if not parts then return end
        local age = now - tag.at
        local active = settings.hitTag and age >= 0 and age < .24
        put(parts.tagLabel, "Visible", active)
        if not active then return end
        if parts.tagVersion ~= tag.version then
            parts.tagVersion = tag.version
            for name, glyph in parts.tagGlyphs do put(glyph, "Visible", name == tag.kind) end
            for _, mark in parts.tagInk do put(mark.object, mark.property, tag.color) end
        end
        local fade = math.clamp((age - .055) / .185, 0, 1)
        put(parts.tagLabel, "GroupTransparency", fade)
        put(parts.tagScale, "Scale", 1 + .24 * math.exp(-age * 30) - .34 * math.exp(-age * 90))
    end

    -- Cooldown ring: arc ticks on the ground that turn with the character,
    -- plus billboard labels that always face the camera. Positions come from the
    -- rendered root frame each frame; nothing is welded or physical.
    local RING_TICKS = 10
    local ringGlowAlpha = 1
    local function slotAt(built: any, index: number): any
        local slot = built.slots[index]
        if slot then return slot end
        local folder = built.folder
        local ticks, halos = {}, {}
        for tickIndex = 1, RING_TICKS do
            ticks[tickIndex] = new("Part", folder, {Name = "Tick", Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false,
                Material = E.Material.Neon, Size = host.Vector3.new(.5, .12, .3), Transparency = 1, Color = track})
            halos[tickIndex] = new("Part", folder, {Name = "Halo", Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false,
                Material = E.Material.Neon, Size = host.Vector3.new(.5, .1, .3), Transparency = 1, Color = track})
        end
        local anchor = new("Part", folder, {Name = "LabelAnchor", Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanQuery = false, CanTouch = false, CastShadow = false,
            Transparency = 1, Size = host.Vector3.new(.2, .2, .2)})
        local board = new("BillboardGui", anchor, {Name = "Label", AlwaysOnTop = true, LightInfluence = 0, Size = U.fromOffset(54, 18),
            StudsOffset = host.Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), MaxDistance = 90, Enabled = false})
        local back = new("Frame", board, {BackgroundColor3 = glass, BackgroundTransparency = .2, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = U.fromScale(1, 1)})
        round(back, 6)
        local text = new("TextLabel", back, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), Font = E.Font.GothamBold,
            TextSize = 11, Text = "", TextColor3 = white, TextStrokeColor3 = C.new(0, 0, 0), TextStrokeTransparency = .6})
        local adorns = {}
        for tickIndex = 1, RING_TICKS do
            adorns[tickIndex] = new("BoxHandleAdornment", ticks[tickIndex], {Name = "Overlay", Adornee = ticks[tickIndex], AlwaysOnTop = true, ZIndex = 2,
                Size = ticks[tickIndex].Size, Transparency = 1, Color3 = track, Visible = false})
        end
        slot = {ticks = ticks, halos = halos, adorns = adorns, tickSizes = {}, anchor = anchor, board = board, back = back, text = text}
        built.slots[index] = slot
        return slot
    end
    local ringGroundParams: any, ringGroundY: number?, ringGroundAt: number? = nil, nil, nil
    local ringRootHeight: number? = nil
    local ringRootCharacter: any = nil
    local ringOverlayParams: any, ringCamPos: any = nil, nil
    local ringOverlayFilterCharacter,ringOverlayFilterCharacters,ringOverlayFilterEffects=nil,nil,nil
    local ringOccluded: any, ringFrame = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), 0
    local ringOccludedAt: any, ringClock = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), 0
    -- How see-through a ring box is allowed to be for its colour: greys, whites and blacks (no real colour) use Ring Grey Transparency,
    -- real colours use Ring Colour Transparency, and the darker the colour the more see-through it becomes (Ring Dark Boost).
    local function ringTone(color: any): number
        local _, saturation, value = color:ToHSV()
        local t = if saturation < .22 then settings.ringGreyT else settings.ringColorT
        return math.clamp(t + (1 - value) * (1 - t) * settings.ringDarkBoost, 0, .98)
    end
    local ringTrackTone = 0
    local function buildRing(): any
        if ring and ring.folder.Parent then return ring end
        ring = nil
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        ring = {folder = new("Model", camera, {Name = "ShenaniganismCooldownRing", WorldPivot = host.CFrame.new()}), slots = {}}
        return ring
    end
    -- Optional scene bloom while the ring is showing; it is removed as soon as the ring hides.
    local function stepBloom(show: boolean)
        if not (show and settings.ringBloom) then
            if bloomEffect then bloomEffect:Destroy();bloomEffect = nil end
            return
        end
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        if bloomEffect and not bloomEffect.Parent then bloomEffect = nil end
        if not bloomEffect then bloomEffect = new("BloomEffect", camera, {Name = "ShenaniganismRingBloom"}) end
        put(bloomEffect, "Intensity", settings.ringBloomIntensity);put(bloomEffect, "Size", settings.ringBloomSize);put(bloomEffect, "Threshold", settings.ringBloomThreshold)
    end
    local function hideSlot(slot: any)
        -- These parts are owned by this renderer. A slot already hidden needs
        -- no repeated instance-property traversal until drawRow uses it again.
        if slot.hidden then return end
        slot.paintFraction=nil
        put(slot.board, "Enabled", false)
        for _, tick in slot.ticks do put(tick, "Transparency", 1) end
        for _, halo in slot.halos do put(halo, "Transparency", 1) end
        for _, adorn in slot.adorns do if adorn.Visible then adorn.Visible = false end end
        slot.hidden=true
    end
    local function hideRing()
        stepBloom(false)
        if not ring then return end
        for _, slot in ring.slots do hideSlot(slot) end
    end
    -- Geometry: Circle, Square (the same ring squared off) or Straight (square sides only, with gaps at the
    -- corners and only the sides you picked). Straight packs the segments onto the picked sides.
    local SIDE_CENTRES = {Front = 0, Left = math.pi / 2, Back = math.pi, Right = math.pi * 1.5}
    local function pickedSides(): {string}
        local picked, set, list = settings.ringSides, {}, {}
        if type(picked) == "string" then set[picked] = true
        elseif type(picked) == "table" then for _, name in picked do set[name] = true end end
        for _, name in {"Front", "Left", "Back", "Right"} do if set[name] then table.insert(list, name) end end
        if #list == 0 then list = {"Front", "Left", "Back", "Right"} end
        return list
    end
    local function tickFrame(base: any, angle: number, radius: number): (any, number)
        if settings.ringGeometry == "Circle" then
            return base * host.CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0) * host.CFrame.new(0, 0, -radius), 1
        end
        local sin, cos = math.sin(angle), math.cos(angle)
        local scale = 1 / math.max(math.abs(sin), math.abs(cos), 1e-3)
        local alongX = math.abs(cos) >= math.abs(sin)
        return base * host.CFrame.new(-radius * sin * scale, 0, -radius * cos * scale) * host.CFrame.Angles(0, if alongX then 0 else math.pi / 2, 0), scale * scale
    end
    -- Draws one ring of segments. Every segment is a row of small ticks; the last lit tick fades in by
    -- its fractional coverage, so a segment fills smoothly instead of in steps.
    local function drawSet(built: any, data: {any}, firstSlot: number, base: any, radius: number, thickness: number, labelScale: number, labels: boolean, spanStart: number?, spanLength: number?): number
        local count = #data
        if count == 0 then return firstSlot end
        local first = spanStart or math.pi
        local span = spanLength or math.pi * 2
        local sector = span / count
        local shape = settings.ringShape
        local gap = if shape == "Solid" then 0 else math.min(.2, sector * .22)
        local arc = sector - gap
        local straight = settings.ringGeometry == "Straight"
        local sides = if straight then pickedSides() else {}
        local half = math.pi / 4 - math.rad(math.clamp(settings.ringCornerGap, 0, 30))
        half = math.max(half, .05)
        local angleScale = if straight then #sides * 2 * half / (math.pi * 2) else 1
        local turn0 = first / (math.pi * 2)
        local function angleOf(offset: number): number
            if not straight then return first + offset end
            local turn = (turn0 + offset / (math.pi * 2)) % 1
            local scaled = turn * #sides
            local index = math.min(math.floor(scaled), #sides - 1)
            return SIDE_CENTRES[sides[index + 1]] - half + (scaled - index) * 2 * half
        end
        local shownArc = arc * angleScale
        local baseLength = if shape == "Dotted" then thickness * 1.15 elseif shape == "Solid" then radius * shownArc / RING_TICKS * 1.08
            elseif shape == "Blocks" then radius * shownArc / RING_TICKS * .6 else radius * shownArc / RING_TICKS * .88
        thickness = if shape == "Thin Line" then thickness * .35 elseif shape == "Blocks" then thickness * 1.5 else thickness
        local lit = math.clamp(1 - settings.ringOpacity, 0, 1)
        local off = math.clamp(.7 + (1 - settings.ringOpacity) * .3, 0, 1)
        local mode = settings.ringTextMode
        local slotIndex = firstSlot
        local weights, totalWeight, cumulative = {}, 0, 0
        for index, item in data do
            local weight = math.max(.05, tonumber(item.weight) or 1)
            weights[index] = weight;totalWeight += weight
        end
        local function drawRow(slot: any, fraction: number, color: any, rowRadius: number, rowThickness: number, startOffset: number, rowArc: number)
            slot.hidden=false
            local filled = fraction * RING_TICKS
            local full = fraction >= 1
            local rowTone = ringTone(color)
            local rowLength = if shape == "Dotted" then rowThickness * 1.15
                else rowRadius * rowArc * angleScale / RING_TICKS * (if shape == "Solid" then 1.08 elseif shape == "Blocks" then .6 else .88)
            -- Geometry (where each segment sits and how big it is) only changes when the ring's shape settings do; it is laid out then, in the
            -- ring's own space, and the whole ring is moved by one pivot each frame.
            local inputs = slot.geometryInputs
            local geometryKey
            if inputs and inputs.count == count and inputs.first == first and inputs.startOffset == startOffset and inputs.rowArc == rowArc
                and inputs.rowRadius == rowRadius and inputs.rowThickness == rowThickness and inputs.rowLength == rowLength and inputs.angleScale == angleScale
                and inputs.geometry == settings.ringGeometry and inputs.shape == shape and inputs.glowSize == settings.ringGlowSize and inputs.half == half then
                geometryKey = inputs.key
            else
                geometryKey = string.format("%d|%.5f|%.5f|%.5f|%.5f|%.5f|%.5f|%.5f|%s|%s|%.4f|%.4f", count, first, startOffset, rowArc, rowRadius, rowThickness, rowLength, angleScale,
                    settings.ringGeometry, shape, settings.ringGlowSize, half)
                slot.geometryInputs = {count=count,first=first,startOffset=startOffset,rowArc=rowArc,rowRadius=rowRadius,rowThickness=rowThickness,
                    rowLength=rowLength,angleScale=angleScale,geometry=settings.ringGeometry,shape=shape,glowSize=settings.ringGlowSize,half=half,key=geometryKey}
            end
            local relayout = slot.geometryKey ~= geometryKey
            if relayout then slot.geometryKey = geometryKey end
            local repaint=slot.paintFraction~=fraction or slot.paintColor~=color or slot.paintLit~=lit
                or slot.paintOff~=off or slot.paintTrackTone~=ringTrackTone or slot.paintRowTone~=rowTone
            slot.coverage=slot.coverage or {}
            slot.paintFraction,slot.paintColor,slot.paintLit,slot.paintOff=fraction,color,lit,off
            slot.paintTrackTone,slot.paintRowTone=ringTrackTone,rowTone
            for tickIndex, tick in slot.ticks do
                local halo = slot.halos[tickIndex]
                if relayout then
                    local angle = angleOf(startOffset + (tickIndex - .5) * rowArc / RING_TICKS)
                    local frame, stretch = tickFrame(base, angle, rowRadius)
                    tick.CFrame = frame
                    slot.tickSizes[tickIndex] = host.Vector3.new(rowLength * stretch, .12, rowThickness)
                    tick.Size = slot.tickSizes[tickIndex]
                    halo.CFrame = frame
                    halo.Size = host.Vector3.new(rowLength * stretch + settings.ringGlowSize, .16, rowThickness + settings.ringGlowSize)
                end
                local tickSize = slot.tickSizes[tickIndex]
                if repaint then
                    local coverage=math.clamp(filled-(tickIndex-1),0,1)
                    slot.coverage[tickIndex]=coverage
                    if coverage>0 then
                        put(tick,"Color",track:Lerp(color,coverage))
                        local litAlpha=off+((if full then lit*.5 else lit)-off)*coverage
                        local tone=ringTrackTone+(rowTone-ringTrackTone)*coverage
                        put(tick,"Transparency",1-(1-litAlpha)*(1-tone))
                    else
                        put(tick,"Color",track);put(tick,"Transparency",1-(1-off)*(1-ringTrackTone))
                    end
                    put(halo,"Color",color)
                end
                local coverage=slot.coverage[tickIndex]
                if coverage>0 and settings.ringGlow>0 then
                    put(halo,"Transparency",1-(1-ringGlowAlpha)*coverage)
                else put(halo,"Transparency",1)end
                local adorn = slot.adorns[tickIndex]
                if settings.ringOverlay then
                    local shown = tick.Transparency < .99
                    -- A segment that is behind your own body stays an ordinary part, so you cover it; every other segment draws on top
                    -- of debris, items and the map.
                    local onTop = shown
                    if shown and ringCamPos and ringOverlayParams then
                        -- Each segment is tested at most every 50 ms (staggered so the tests spread across frames); between tests the last answer stands.
                        local cached = ringOccluded[tick]
                        local testedAt = ringOccludedAt[tick]
                        if cached == nil or testedAt == nil or ringClock - testedAt > .05 + (tickIndex % 5) * .004 then
                            cached = world:Raycast(ringCamPos, tick.Position - ringCamPos, ringOverlayParams) ~= nil
                            ringOccluded[tick], ringOccludedAt[tick] = cached, ringClock
                        end
                        if cached then onTop = false end
                    end
                    if adorn.Visible ~= onTop then adorn.Visible = onTop end
                    if onTop then
                        if adorn.Size ~= tickSize then adorn.Size = tickSize end
                        local tickColor, tickAlpha = tick.Color, tick.Transparency
                        if adorn.Color3 ~= tickColor then adorn.Color3 = tickColor end
                        if adorn.Transparency ~= tickAlpha then adorn.Transparency = tickAlpha end
                    end
                    local modifier = if onTop then 1 else 0
                    if tick.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= modifier then tick.LocalTransparencyModifier = modifier end
                else
                    if adorn.Visible then adorn.Visible = false end
                    if tick.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 0 then tick.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end
                end
            end
        end
        for index, item in data do
            local slot = slotAt(built, slotIndex)
            slotIndex += 1
            local itemSector = span * weights[index] / totalWeight
            local baseGap = if shape == "Solid" then 0 else math.min(.2, itemSector * .22)
            local itemGap = if item.joined then math.min(baseGap, .03) else baseGap
            local itemArc = itemSector - itemGap
            local startOffset = cumulative + itemGap * .5
            cumulative += itemSector
            local color = if settings.ringColorMode == "Custom" then settings.ringColor else item.ringColor
            local second = item.second
            if second then
                -- Two stats share one segment: the first on the outer lane, the second on the inner lane.
                local lane = thickness * .65
                drawRow(slot, item.ringDisplay or item.ringFraction, color, radius + lane, thickness * .85, startOffset, itemArc)
                local secondSlot = slotAt(built, slotIndex)
                slotIndex += 1
                drawRow(secondSlot, second.fraction, if settings.ringColorMode == "Custom" then settings.ringColor else second.color, radius - lane, thickness * .85, startOffset, itemArc)
                put(secondSlot.board, "Enabled", false)
            else
                drawRow(slot, item.ringDisplay or item.ringFraction, color, radius, thickness, startOffset, itemArc)
            end
            local anchorFrame = tickFrame(base, angleOf(startOffset + itemArc * .5), radius)
            if slot.anchor.CFrame ~= anchorFrame then slot.anchor.CFrame = anchorFrame end
            local size = math.floor(settings.ringLabelSize * labelScale + .5)
            local text = item.ringText
            local inBar = mode == "In Bar"
            local showText = labels and mode ~= "Off" and text ~= nil and text ~= ""
                and (mode ~= "On Use" or item.ringFraction < 1 or item.ringActive == true)
            put(slot.board, "Enabled", showText)
            put(slot.board, "StudsOffset", host.Vector3.new(0, if inBar then 0 else 1, 0))
            put(slot.back, "BackgroundTransparency", if inBar then 1 else .2)
            put(slot.text, "Text", text or "");put(slot.text, "TextColor3", white);put(slot.text, "TextSize", size)
            put(slot.back, "BackgroundColor3", color:Lerp(C.new(0, 0, 0), .55))
            put(slot.board, "Size", host.UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(54 * size / 11 + .5), math.floor(18 * size / 11 + .5)))
        end
        return slotIndex
    end
    local function stepRing(character: any, humanoid: any, now: number)
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (settings.enabled and settings.cooldownRing) or not root or not ui then hideRing();return end
        -- Outer ring: cooldowns. Inner ring: vitals, dashes and your M1.
        local outer: {any}, inner: {any} = {}, {}
        local function add(list: {any}, item: any, enabled: boolean) if enabled and item and item.live then table.insert(list, item) end end
        local ringGrey = host.Color3.fromRGB(110, 115, 128)
        local function addSkill(list: {any}, item: any, enabled: boolean)
            if not (enabled and item and item.live) then return end
            if not settings.ringSkillGrey then table.insert(list, item);return end
            local copy = table.clone(item)
            copy.ringDisplay = 1
            copy.ringColor = ringGrey:Lerp(item.ringColor or ringGrey, if item.ringFraction >= 1 then 1 else math.clamp(item.ringFraction, 0, 1) * .25)
            table.insert(list, copy)
        end
        add(outer, ui.m2, settings.ringM2)
        add(outer, ui.evade, settings.ringEvade)
        if settings.ringHealth then
            local ratio = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(1, humanoid.MaxHealth), 0, 1)
            local healthText = if settings.ringDetail == "Detailed" then string.format("HP %d/%d", math.floor(humanoid.Health + .5), math.floor(humanoid.MaxHealth + .5)) else string.format("HP %d%%", math.floor(ratio * 100 + .5))
            table.insert(inner, {live = true, weight = settings.ringHealthWidth, ringText = healthText, ringFraction = ratio,
                ringColor = host.Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70):Lerp(host.Color3.fromRGB(65, 235, 125), ratio)})
        end
        for index = 1, 4 do addSkill(if settings.ringInnerSkills then inner else outer, ui.skills[index], settings.ringSkills) end
        local ultimateValue = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Ultimate"))
        if settings.ringUltimate and ultimateValue then
            local ratio = math.clamp(ultimateValue / 100, 0, 1)
            table.insert(inner, {live = true, ringText = if settings.ringDetail == "Detailed" then string.format("ULT %d/100", math.floor(ultimateValue + .5)) else string.format("ULT %d%%", math.floor(ultimateValue + .5)), ringFraction = ratio,
                ringColor = if settings.nativeColors and nativeMain then nativeMain elseif ratio >= 1 then host.Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90) else settings.ultColor})
        end
        if settings.ringDash then
            local frontColor, sideColor = host.Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 70), host.Color3.fromRGB(170, 130, 255)
            if settings.ringDashOverlay and extras.front and extras.side then
                -- One segment, two lanes: front dash in orange on the outside, side dash in purple on the inside.
                table.insert(inner, {live = true, ringText = extras.front.text .. "  " .. extras.side.text, ringFraction = extras.front.fraction, ringColor = frontColor,
                    second = {fraction = extras.side.fraction, color = sideColor}})
            else
                if extras.front then table.insert(inner, {live = true, ringText = extras.front.text, ringFraction = extras.front.fraction, ringColor = frontColor}) end
                if extras.side then table.insert(inner, {live = true, ringText = extras.side.text, ringFraction = extras.side.fraction, ringColor = sideColor}) end
            end
        end
        if settings.ringM1 and extras.m1 then
            local info = extras.m1stages
            if settings.ringM1Stages and info and info.count > 1 then
                -- One small segment per M1 stage: stages light up as you chain, then refill in order as the cooldown returns.
                for stage = 1, info.count do
                    local fraction
                    if info.regaining then fraction = math.clamp(extras.m1.fraction * info.count - (stage - 1), 0, 1)
                    elseif info.live then fraction = if stage <= info.done then 1 else 0
                    else fraction = 1 end
                    local used = 1 - fraction
                    local stageColor, stageDisplay = extras.m1.color, nil
                    local label = ""
                    if info.regaining then label = if stage == info.count then extras.m1.text else ""
                    elseif info.live then label = if stage == math.max(info.done, 1) then extras.m1.text else ""
                    elseif stage == 1 then label = "M1" end
                    if settings.ringM1Invert then
                        stageDisplay = 1
                        stageColor = ringGrey:Lerp(extras.m1.color, used)
                        -- Keep the "recharging" meaning of the fraction for the text modes: below 1 means in use.
                        fraction = 1 - used
                    end
                    table.insert(inner, {live = true, joined = true, weight = math.min(settings.ringM1Width, settings.ringHealthWidth / 3 / info.count), ringText = label, ringFraction = fraction, ringDisplay = stageDisplay, ringColor = stageColor, ringActive = info.live and stage == info.done})
                end
            else
                table.insert(inner, {live = true, weight = math.min(settings.ringM1Width * 2, settings.ringHealthWidth / 3), ringText = extras.m1.text, ringFraction = extras.m1.fraction, ringColor = extras.m1.color})
            end
        end
        -- What you are doing right now: stun, downed, block, dash, M1, skill, special, ultimate or end lag, with its own time.
        if settings.ringState then
            local okay, activity = pcall(readActivity, character, now)
            if okay and type(activity) == "table" then
                local kind = activity.kind
                local shown = kind == "stun" or kind == "ragdoll" or kind == "block" or kind == "dash" or kind == "m1" or kind == "skill" or kind == "special" or kind == "ult"
                    or activity.acting == true or activity.endlag ~= nil
                if shown then
                    local text, fraction, color = tostring(activity.text), 1, activity.color or ActivityState.colors.action
                    if activity.endlag then
                        text = string.format("RECOVER %.1fs", activity.endlag.left)
                        fraction = math.clamp(1 - activity.endlag.left / math.max(.01, activity.endlag.total), 0, 1)
                        color = ActivityState.colors.recover
                    elseif activity.acting then fraction = math.clamp(activity.actionFraction or 1, 0, 1) end
                    table.insert(inner, {live = true, ringText = text, ringFraction = fraction, ringColor = color})
                end
            end
        end
        local layout = settings.ringLayout
        local leftHalf: {any}, rightHalf: {any} = {}, {}
        if layout == "Split Sides" then
            -- Outer ring: special and evasive share the left half, the ultimate has the right half.
            -- Inner ring: health, skills, dashes, M1 and what you are doing right now.
            outer = {}
            add(leftHalf, ui.m2, settings.ringM2)
            add(leftHalf, ui.evade, settings.ringEvade)
            local ultimate = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Ultimate")) or 0
            local ultRatio = math.clamp(ultimate / 100, 0, 1)
            table.insert(rightHalf, {live = true, ringText = if settings.ringDetail == "Detailed" then string.format("ULT %d/100", math.floor(ultimate + .5)) else string.format("ULT %d%%", math.floor(ultimate + .5)),
                ringFraction = if settings.cooldownDrain then 1 - ultRatio else ultRatio,
                ringColor = if settings.nativeColors and nativeMain then nativeMain elseif ultRatio >= 1 then host.Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90) else settings.ultColor})
            if not settings.ringInnerSkills then
                for index = 1, 4 do addSkill(inner, ui.skills[index], settings.ringSkills) end
            end
            -- The ultimate is on the outer ring here, so it is not repeated on the inner one.
            for position = #inner, 1, -1 do if inner[position].ringText and tostring(inner[position].ringText):sub(1, 3) == "ULT" then table.remove(inner, position) end end
        elseif layout == "Outer Only" or layout == "Inner Only" then
            for _, item in inner do table.insert(outer, item) end
            inner = {}
        end
        if settings.ringSwapUltSpecial then
            -- Switch the colours of the special and the ultimate: each shows the other's colour.
            local lists = {outer, inner, leftHalf, rightHalf}
            local specialColor, ultColor
            for _, list in lists do
                for _, item in list do
                    if item == ui.m2 then specialColor = item.ringColor
                    elseif type(item.ringText) == "string" and item.ringText:sub(1, 3) == "ULT" then ultColor = item.ringColor end
                end
            end
            if specialColor and ultColor then
                for _, list in lists do
                    for index, item in list do
                        if item == ui.m2 then local copy = table.clone(item);copy.ringColor = ultColor;list[index] = copy
                        elseif type(item.ringText) == "string" and item.ringText:sub(1, 3) == "ULT" then local copy = table.clone(item);copy.ringColor = specialColor;list[index] = copy end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if #outer + #inner + #leftHalf + #rightHalf == 0 then hideRing();return end
        local built = buildRing()
        if not built then hideRing();return end
        stepBloom(true)
        ringGlowAlpha = 1 - math.clamp(settings.ringGlow, 0, 1) * (.42 + .1 * math.sin(clock() * 3))
        local okay, frame = pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame, root)
        if not okay or not frame then frame = root.CFrame end
        local look = frame.LookVector
        local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
        local feetToRoot = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y * .5 - .1
        local feet = frame.Position - host.Vector3.new(0, feetToRoot, 0)
        if settings.ringGround and settings.ringAttach == "Feet" and settings.ringLockHeight then
            -- Locked: the ring is a fixed distance above your own feet at all times. Your standing height above the floor is measured once per
            -- character (on the floor, not moving vertically) and then kept, so the ring never adjusts to slopes, steps or the animation.
            if ringRootCharacter ~= character or not ringRootHeight then
                if not ringGroundParams then
                    ringGroundParams = host.RaycastParams.new()
                    ringGroundParams.FilterType = E.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                    ringGroundParams.RespectCanCollide = true
                end
                local ignore = {character}
                local charactersFolder = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
                if charactersFolder then table.insert(ignore, charactersFolder) end
                ringGroundParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
                if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= E.Material.Air and math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) < 1 then
                    local hit = world:Raycast(frame.Position, host.Vector3.new(0, -30, 0), ringGroundParams)
                    if hit then ringRootHeight, ringRootCharacter = frame.Position.Y - hit.Position.Y, character end
                end
            end
            feet = host.Vector3.new(frame.Position.X, frame.Position.Y - (ringRootHeight or feetToRoot), frame.Position.Z)
        elseif settings.ringGround and settings.ringAttach == "Feet" then
            -- Foot level for real: the floor (or debris) under you, found by a ray, not a guess from the rig's hip height.
            if not ringGroundParams then
                ringGroundParams = host.RaycastParams.new()
                ringGroundParams.FilterType = E.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                ringGroundParams.RespectCanCollide = true
            end
            local ignore = {character}
            local characters = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            if characters then table.insert(ignore, characters) end
            ringGroundParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
            local hit = world:Raycast(frame.Position, host.Vector3.new(0, -120, 0), ringGroundParams)
            if hit then
                local now = clock()
                local floorY = hit.Position.Y + .08
                local height = frame.Position.Y - hit.Position.Y
                -- Standing height (root above the floor) is learned while on the ground; above it by more than a little means airborne.
                local risingOrFalling = math.abs(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y) > 1.5
                if not ringRootHeight or (not risingOrFalling and height <= ringRootHeight + .35 and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= E.Material.Air) then ringRootHeight = height end
                if height > ringRootHeight + .35 then
                    ringGroundY = math.max(floorY, frame.Position.Y - ringRootHeight + .08)
                elseif ringGroundY and now - (ringGroundAt or 0) < .25 then
                    ringGroundY += (floorY - ringGroundY) * (1 - math.exp(-(now - (ringGroundAt or now)) * 20))
                else ringGroundY = floorY end
                ringGroundAt = now
                feet = host.Vector3.new(frame.Position.X, ringGroundY, frame.Position.Z)
            else
                -- No floor in reach (huge fall, over a gap): stay at your own feet using the standing height learned on the ground.
                ringGroundY = nil
                feet = host.Vector3.new(frame.Position.X, frame.Position.Y - (ringRootHeight or feetToRoot) + .08, frame.Position.Z)
            end
        end
        local attachLift = if settings.ringAttach == "Torso" then feetToRoot elseif settings.ringAttach == "Head" then feetToRoot + 1.6 else 0
        local anchorPoint = feet + host.Vector3.new(0, attachLift + settings.ringHeight + (if settings.ringAttach == "Feet" and settings.ringGround then .5 else 0), 0)
        local base = host.CFrame.new(anchorPoint) * host.CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * host.CFrame.new(settings.ringOffsetX, 0, settings.ringOffsetZ)
            * host.CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(settings.ringRotation) + math.rad(settings.ringSpin) * clock(), 0)
        local radius = settings.ringRadius
        do
            local camera = world.CurrentCamera
            ringCamPos = if camera then camera.CFrame.Position else nil
            if not ringOverlayParams then
                ringOverlayParams = host.RaycastParams.new()
                ringOverlayParams.FilterType = E.RaycastFilterType.Include
            end
            -- Only the world (ground, buildings, trees, debris, movable objects) is drawn over. Every character, yours and others', and
            -- the effects stay in front of the ring.
            local characters, effects = world:FindFirstChild("Characters"), world:FindFirstChild("Effects")
            if character~=ringOverlayFilterCharacter or characters~=ringOverlayFilterCharacters or effects~=ringOverlayFilterEffects then
                local front={character}
                if characters then table.insert(front,characters)end
                if effects then table.insert(front,effects)end
                ringOverlayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances=front
                ringOverlayFilterCharacter,ringOverlayFilterCharacters,ringOverlayFilterEffects=character,characters,effects
            end
            ringFrame += 1
        end
        -- No parts moved when the pivot already equals this frame's pose.
        -- GetPivot also notices an external pivot write; real motion still
        -- reaches PivotTo on the same frame as before.
        if built.folder:GetPivot()~=base then built.folder:PivotTo(base)end
        ringClock = clock()
        ringTrackTone = ringTone(track)
        -- drawSet owns label appearance; do not dirty every background first.
        local nextSlot = drawSet(built, outer, 1, base, radius, settings.ringThickness, 1, settings.ringLabels)
        if layout == "Split Sides" then
            -- Angles run from behind you through your right to the front (right half), and from the front through your left to behind (left half).
            nextSlot = drawSet(built, leftHalf, nextSlot, base, radius, settings.ringThickness, 1, settings.ringLabels, 0, math.pi)
            nextSlot = drawSet(built, rightHalf, nextSlot, base, radius, settings.ringThickness, 1, settings.ringLabels, math.pi, math.pi)
        end
        nextSlot = drawSet(built, inner, nextSlot, base, radius * settings.ringInnerScale, settings.ringThickness * .8, .85, settings.ringLabels and settings.ringInnerLabels)
        for index, slot in built.slots do if index >= nextSlot then hideSlot(slot) end end
    end

    -- A new character starts with a clean slate: swing history, cooldown maxima, timing track and
    -- eased bars from the previous one must not carry over.
    local lastCharacter: any = nil
    local function resetState()
        table.clear(swings);table.clear(gaps);lastM1 = nil;streak, streakAt = 0, -math.huge
        timingState.track, timingState.hitAt, timingState.summary, timingState.alpha = nil, nil, nil, 0
        table.clear(cooldownMax);evadeMax = 50;table.clear(damageLog);lastHealth = nil
        table.clear(pipShown);table.clear(overlayShown);table.clear(extras);hpShown, hpGhost = 1, 1;dragging = nil;finisherStamp = nil;chainState.key = ""
        nativeAt, nativeModel = -math.huge, nil
        stateName, stateSince = "Idle", clock()
    end
    -- Each part runs on its own, so one failing part cannot freeze the rest of the HUD.
    -- Cost per part in seconds (control.profile), so slow parts can be found from the game: time the card, ring, timing, tag, effects, reach,
    -- hits and popups separately.
    local profile: any = {}
    control.profile = profile
    local function guarded(name: string, callback: any, ...: any)
        local startedAt = clock()
        local okay, problem = pcall(callback, ...)
        profile[name] = (profile[name] or 0) + (clock() - startedAt)
        if not okay then
            control.partErrors = control.partErrors or {}
            if not control.partErrors[name] then
                control.partErrors[name] = tostring(problem)
                warn("[Shenaniganism] Self HUD " .. name .. " error: " .. tostring(problem))
            end
        end
    end
    function control.step(dt: number)
        if not control.alive then return end
        if not ui then ui=build()end
        if not ui then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local visible=settings.enabled and character~=nil and humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and info~=nil
            and(settings.alwaysOn or not(menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()))
        put(ui.screen,"Enabled",settings.enabled)
        if not visible then put(ui.tagLabel,"Visible",false);hideRing();return end
        if character~=lastCharacter then lastCharacter=character;resetState()end
        local now=clock()
        activityCharacter,activitySnapshot=nil,nil
        guarded("ringData",stepRingData,character,humanoid,info,now,dt)
        guarded("tag",stepTag,now)
        guarded("ring",stepRing,character,humanoid,now)
        guarded("hits",stepHitWatch,character,now)
    end

    table.insert(connections, run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
        local okay, problem = pcall(control.step, dt)
        if not okay then
            control.lastError = tostring(problem)
            control.errors = (control.errors or 0) + 1
