            if control.errors == 1 then warn("[Shenaniganism] Self HUD error: " .. control.lastError) end
        end
    end))
    SharedHooks.onHitQuery = control.onHitQuery
    SharedHooks.blockedHit = control.onBlockedHit

    local function setter(key: string)
        return function(value: any)
            if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
            settings[key] = value
            if key == "reachMarker" and not value and reachPart then reachPart:Destroy();reachPart = nil end
            return true
        end
    end
    local function numberSetter(key: string, low: number, high: number)
        return function(value: any)
            local amount = tonumber(value)
            if not finite(amount) then return false end
            settings[key] = math.clamp(amount :: number, low, high);return true
        end
    end

    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        if SharedHooks.onHitQuery == control.onHitQuery then SharedHooks.onHitQuery = nil end
        if SharedHooks.blockedHit == control.onBlockedHit then SharedHooks.blockedHit = nil end
        if ui then ui.screen:Destroy();ui = nil end
        if effectFolder then effectFolder:Destroy();effectFolder = nil end
        if reachPart then reachPart:Destroy();reachPart = nil end
        if ring then ring.folder:Destroy();ring = nil end
        if bloomEffect then bloomEffect:Destroy();bloomEffect = nil end
        if menu.selfHUD == control then menu.selfHUD = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return SelfHUD
end)()

local TargetJumpDash = (function(): any
-- When the enemy your Auto Block is guarding against jumps, dash in a chosen
-- direction. It presses your own saved movement and Dash keys, so the game
-- applies its normal rules (and your Block Dash setting) to the dash.
local TargetJumpDash = {}
function TargetJumpDash.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local world = host.workspace
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local settings: any = {enabled = false, direction = "Away From Target", range = 20, cooldown = 1, delayMs = 0, autoBlockOnly = true,
        unblockDodge = true, unblockRange = 14, unblockDelayMs = 120, tradeDodge = false, tradeDirection = "Strafe Right Of Target", tradeWindowMs = 160,
        dodgeEnabled = false, dodgeDirection = "Away From Target", dodgeRange = 16, dodgeCooldown = 1.5, dodgeDelayMs = 0,
        dodgeAbove = true, dodgeAboveHeight = 3, dodgeAboveRadius = 12, dodgeUnblockableOnly = true,
        lethalDodge = true, verifiedUnblockables = true,
        flipEnabled = false, flipShift = 25, flipWindowMs = 450, flipReach = 10, flipBehind = 60, flipMaxDashes = 3, flipCooldown = 2.5, flipM1 = true,
        bdEnabled = true, bdRange = 12, bdDirection = "Away From Their Facing", bdTurnTime = .7}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, dashes = 0, lastReason = "Dash On Target Jump is off"}
    local airborne: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local lastDashAt = -math.huge
    local busy = false
    local connection: any = nil
    local keyFor = {Front = "W", Back = "S", Left = "A", Right = "D"}

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end
    local function flat(vector: any): any
        return host.Vector3.new(vector.X, 0, vector.Z)
    end
    -- Which of Front / Back / Left / Right (relative to the camera, as the
    -- native dash reads it) points along the wanted world direction.
    local function sideFor(wanted: any): string?
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera or wanted.Magnitude < .001 then return nil end
        local look = flat(camera.CFrame.LookVector)
        if look.Magnitude < .001 then return nil end
        look = look.Unit
        local right = host.Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)
        local forward, sideways = wanted:Dot(look), wanted:Dot(right)
        if math.abs(forward) >= math.abs(sideways) then return if forward > 0 then "Front" else "Back" end
        return if sideways > 0 then "Right" else "Left"
    end
    local function chooseSide(root: any, targetRoot: any, modeOverride: string?): string?
        local mode = modeOverride or settings.direction
        if mode == "Camera Front" then return "Front" elseif mode == "Camera Back" then return "Back"
        elseif mode == "Camera Left" then return "Left" elseif mode == "Camera Right" then return "Right" end
        local away = flat(root.Position - targetRoot.Position)
        if away.Magnitude < .001 then return nil end
        away = away.Unit
        if mode == "Away From Target" then return sideFor(away)
        elseif mode == "Toward Target" then return sideFor(-away)
        end
        -- Strafes are perpendicular to the line between you and the target.
        local strafe = host.Vector3.new(-away.Z, 0, away.X)
        return sideFor(if mode == "Strafe Left Of Target" then -strafe else strafe)
    end
    local function wait(frames: number)
        for _ = 1, frames do run.Heartbeat:Wait() end
    end
    local function dash(side: string, verify: boolean?): boolean
        local bindings = menu.bindings
        local dashBinding = bindings and bindings.get and bindings.get("Dash")
        if not bindings or type(bindings.send) ~= "function" or not dashBinding then
            control.lastReason = "Dash key binding is unavailable"
            return false
        end
        local character=player.Character
        local before=menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.ownDashPhase
        local started=clock()
        local function observed()
            if not character or character~=player.Character then return false end
            local info=character:FindFirstChild("Info")
            local native=info and (info:FindFirstChild("InDash") or info:FindFirstChild("Dash"))
            local phase=menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.ownDashPhase
            local bridge=menu.frontDash and menu.frontDash.cameraDash
            return character:GetAttribute("InDash")==true or native~=nil
                or phase and phase~=before and phase.character==character
                or bridge and bridge.character==character and (bridge.started or -math.huge)>=started and bridge.mover and bridge.mover.Parent
        end
        local accepted=false
        local function awaitFrames(count)
            for _=1,count do run.Heartbeat:Wait();if verify and observed() then accepted=true end end
        end
        local keyName = keyFor[side]
        local code = host.Enum.KeyCode[keyName]
        local heldAlready = code ~= nil and input:IsKeyDown(code)
        local movement = {kind = "Keyboard", name = keyName}
        if not heldAlready then pcall(bindings.send, movement, true) end
        -- MoveDirection updates a frame or two after the key goes down.
        wait(2)
        pcall(bindings.send, dashBinding, true)
        awaitFrames(2)
        pcall(bindings.send, dashBinding, false)
        awaitFrames(6)
        if not heldAlready then pcall(bindings.send, movement, false) end
        -- Observe late native acceptance after releasing our keys; no extra
        -- movement hold or input delay is introduced.
        while verify and not accepted and control.alive and player.Character==character and clock()-started<.15 do awaitFrames(1) end
        return not verify or accepted
    end
    local function trigger(side: string, delayMs: number?, reason: string?, completed: any?, validate: any?)
        if busy then return end
        busy = true
        host.task.spawn(function()
            local pause = if delayMs ~= nil then delayMs else settings.delayMs
            if pause > 0 then host.task.wait(pause / 1000) end
            local accepted=false
            if control.alive and (settings.enabled or reason == "Dodge") and not input:GetFocusedTextBox()
                and not (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) and (not validate or validate()) then
                local ok = dash(side,reason=="Dodge")
                accepted=ok
                if ok then
                    control.dashes += 1
                    control.lastReason = (if reason == "Dodge" then "Skill incoming; dashed " else "Target jumped; dashed ") .. side
                end
            end
            busy = false
            if completed then completed(accepted) end
        end)
    end
    -- Skill Dodge: Threat Feed calls this when an enemy casts a skill. Dashes with your own keys, so the
    -- game's dash rules (cooldown, stun, Block Dash while guarding) still decide whether it happens.
    local lastDodgeAt = -math.huge
    local dodgeUntil = -math.huge
    local retryDodgeAt = -math.huge
    local function requestDodge(side,delayMs,seen,validate,acknowledged)
        if busy or clock()<retryDodgeAt then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        if not character or character:GetAttribute("InDash")==true or info and (info:FindFirstChild("InDash") or info:FindFirstChild("Dash")) then return end
        local function ready()
            local readiness=menu.frontDashReadiness
            local getter=readiness and (if side=="Front" then readiness.getStatus else readiness.getSideStatus)
            if getter then
                local okay,status=pcall(getter,character,world:GetServerTimeNow())
                if okay and type(status)=="table" and status.ready==false and (tonumber(status.fraction) or 0)<1 then return false end
            end
            return character==player.Character
        end
        if not ready() then return end
        retryDodgeAt=clock()+.2
        trigger(side,delayMs,"Dodge",function(accepted)
            if accepted then
                if seen then seen.handled=true end
                lastDodgeAt=clock();dodgeUntil=lastDodgeAt+.6
                control.dodges=(control.dodges or 0)+1
                if acknowledged then acknowledged() end
            else control.lastReason="Dodge input was not accepted; retaining incoming threat" end
        end,function()return ready() and (not validate or validate())end)
    end
    -- Overhead: the enemy is above your head (higher than the set height, and close enough over you).
    local function enemyAbove(root: any, targetRoot: any): boolean
        if not settings.dodgeAbove then return true end
        local lift = targetRoot.Position.Y - root.Position.Y
        local flatGap = host.Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, targetRoot.Position.Z - root.Position.Z).Magnitude
        return lift >= settings.dodgeAboveHeight and flatGap <= settings.dodgeAboveRadius
    end
    function control.dodgeActive(): boolean return clock() < dodgeUntil end
    function control.dodge(model: any)
        if not control.alive or not settings.dodgeEnabled or busy then return end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return end
        if input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetRoot = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not targetRoot then return end
        -- Only unblockable attacks are dodged: every M1 and normal skill can be blocked.
        local guard = menu.autoBlock
        local seen = guard and guard.unblockSeen and guard.unblockSeen[model]
        if settings.dodgeUnblockableOnly and (not seen or seen.handled or clock() - seen.at > 1.2) then return end
        if seen and settings.verifiedUnblockables and not seen.verified then return end
        if not enemyAbove(root, targetRoot) then return end
        if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > settings.dodgeRange then return end
        -- Only dodge a skill that can actually land: the caster must be facing you and you must be inside the
        -- skill reach Auto Block uses (its Facing Check and Physical Reach Gate switches apply here too).
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        if block then
            if type(block.enemyFacing) == "function" and not block.enemyFacing(targetRoot, root.Position) then return end
            if block.reachGate then
                local flat = host.Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, targetRoot.Position.Z - root.Position.Z).Magnitude
                if flat > (block.skillReach or 20) + (block.reachMargin or 1.5) then return end
            end
        end
        local now = clock()
        if now - lastDodgeAt < settings.dodgeCooldown then return end
        local side = chooseSide(root, targetRoot, settings.dodgeDirection)
        if not side then return end
        requestDodge(side,settings.dodgeDelayMs,seen,function()
            return model.Parent~=nil and (not seen or clock()-seen.at<=1.2 and (not seen.track or seen.track.IsPlaying~=false))
        end)
    end
    -- Dash Out Of Trades: an enemy M1 is about to land and your guard cannot come up in time (you are inside your
    -- own swing, or contact is nearly here), so a side dash takes you out of it. It waits for the side dash to be
    -- ready by the game's own cooldown and uses Auto Block's animation-timed contact estimate.
    -- Dash Out Of Unblockables: a grab, domain, ultimate or break move cannot be blocked, so side dash out of it.
    local function unblockStep()
        if not control.alive or not settings.unblockDodge or busy then return end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return end
        if input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        if not block or type(block.unblockableThreat) ~= "function" then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return end
        local target, seen = block.unblockableThreat(root, settings.unblockRange)
        if not target or seen.handled or settings.verifiedUnblockables and not seen.verified then return end
        -- It has to be able to reach you: inside the skill reach Auto Block uses (when its Physical Reach Gate is on).
        if block.reachGate then
            local unblockRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not unblockRoot then return end
            local flatGap = host.Vector3.new(unblockRoot.Position.X - root.Position.X, 0, unblockRoot.Position.Z - root.Position.Z).Magnitude
            if flatGap > (block.skillReach or 20) + (block.reachMargin or 1.5) then return end
        end
        do
            local overheadRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if overheadRoot and not enemyAbove(root, overheadRoot) then return end
        end
        local now = clock()
        if now - lastDodgeAt < settings.dodgeCooldown then return end
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local side = targetRoot and chooseSide(root, targetRoot, settings.dodgeDirection)
        if not side then return end
        requestDodge(side,settings.unblockDelayMs,seen,function()
            return target.Parent~=nil and clock()-seen.at<=1.0 and (not seen.track or seen.track.IsPlaying~=false)
        end)
    end
    local learnedDamage=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local damageTracker,damageConnection=nil,nil
    local lastLethalCheck=-math.huge
    local lethalTokens=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local function damageIdentity(target,track)
        local animation=track and track.Animation
        local id=animation and tostring(animation.AnimationId):match("%d+")
        if not id then return nil end
        return tostring(target:GetAttribute("Moveset")).."/"..id,animation
    end
    function control.recordLethalDamage(target,at,source,inferred,hit)
        local own=player.Character
        local observed=damageTracker and damageTracker.records and damageTracker.records[own]
        if not settings.lethalDodge or not hit or hit.accepted~=true or hit.exactHealthLoss~=true or inferred==true
            or hit.character~=own or hit.target~=target or not observed or observed.lastIncomingDamageRecord~=hit
            or hit.at~=at or hit.source~=source or not finite(hit.delta) or hit.delta>=0 then return end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local record=block and block.records and block.records[target]
        local selected=nil
        for track,state in record and record.tracks or {} do
            local kind=state.descriptor and state.descriptor.kind
            if track.IsPlaying and (kind=="M1" or kind=="Move" or kind=="Dash") then
                if selected then return end
                selected={track=track,state=state}
            end
        end
        if not selected or not finite(selected.state.contactTime) or not finite(selected.track.TimePosition)
            or math.abs(selected.track.TimePosition-selected.state.contactTime)>.2 then return end
        local key=damageIdentity(target,selected.track)
        if not key then return end
        local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local bucket=learnedDamage[target]
        if not bucket or bucket.humanoid~=humanoid then bucket={humanoid=humanoid,entries={}};learnedDamage[target]=bucket end
        local now=clock();local entry=bucket.entries[key]
        if entry and entry.version==hit.damageVersion and entry.character==own then return end
        if not entry or now-entry.at>120 then entry={count=0,minimum=-hit.delta};bucket.entries[key]=entry end
        entry.count+=1;entry.minimum=math.min(entry.minimum,-hit.delta);entry.at=now;entry.version=hit.damageVersion;entry.character=own
        local count=0
        for identity,item in bucket.entries do
            if now-item.at>120 then bucket.entries[identity]=nil else count+=1 end
        end
        if count>64 then bucket.entries={ [key]=entry } end
    end
    local function estimatedDamage(target,evidence)
        if not evidence then return nil end
        local key,animation=damageIdentity(target,evidence.track)
        for _,object in {animation,evidence.skill,evidence.projectile and evidence.projectile.source} do
            if object and type(object.GetAttribute)=="function" then
                local amount=object:GetAttribute("Damage")
                if finite(amount) and amount>0 and amount<=1000000 then return amount,"Native damage metadata" end
            end
        end
        local bucket=learnedDamage[target]
        local entry=key and bucket and bucket.entries[key]
        if entry and bucket.humanoid==target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and entry.count>=2 and clock()-entry.at<=120 then
            return entry.minimum,"Repeated observed damage"
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function lethalStep()
        local now=clock()
        if not control.alive or not settings.lethalDodge or now-lastLethalCheck<.05 then return end
        lastLethalCheck=now
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        if damageTracker~=tracker or not damageConnection or damageConnection.Connected==false then
            if damageConnection then damageConnection:Disconnect() end
            damageTracker=tracker;damageConnection=nil
            if tracker and tracker.onIncomingDamageHit then damageConnection=tracker.onIncomingDamageHit(control.recordLethalDamage) end
        end
        if busy or now<retryDodgeAt or now-lastDodgeAt<settings.dodgeCooldown or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        local threat=block and block.dodgeForecast
        local own=player.Character
        local root=own and own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid=own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not threat or threat.character~=own or now-threat.at<0 or now-threat.at>.1 or not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return end
        local target,evidence,timing=threat.target,threat.evidence,threat.timing
        if not target or not target.Parent or not evidence or not timing or not finite(timing.remaining)
            or timing.remaining<0 or timing.remaining>.25 or not evidence.token or lethalTokens[evidence.token] then return end
        local projectile=evidence.projectile
        local targetRoot=if projectile then projectile.part else target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not targetRoot or (targetRoot.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>settings.dodgeRange then return end
        local amount,why=estimatedDamage(target,evidence)
        if not amount or amount<humanoid.Health then return end
        local side=chooseSide(root,targetRoot,settings.dodgeDirection)
        if not side then return end
        local readiness=menu.frontDashReadiness
        local getter=readiness and (if side=="Front" then readiness.getStatus else readiness.getSideStatus)
        if getter then
            local okay,status=pcall(getter,own,world:GetServerTimeNow())
            if okay and type(status)=="table" and status.ready==false and (tonumber(status.fraction) or 0)<1 then return end
        end
        local token=evidence.token
        requestDodge(side,0,nil,function()
            return own==player.Character and humanoid.Health>0 and humanoid.Health<=amount and target.Parent~=nil
                and clock()-threat.at<=.15 and not lethalTokens[token]
        end,function()lethalTokens[token]=true end)
        -- The shared request marks a threat handled only after native acceptance.
        control.lastReason=why.." predicts "..tostring(amount).." damage at "..tostring(humanoid.Health).." HP"
    end

    local function tradeStep()
        if not control.alive or not settings.tradeDodge or busy then return end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return end
        if input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        if not block or type(block.emergencyActive) ~= "function" or not block.emergencyActive() then return end
        local threat = block.emergencyInfo
        local evidence, timing = threat and threat.evidence, threat and threat.timing
        if type(evidence) ~= "table" or evidence.kind ~= "M1" or type(timing) ~= "table" or type(timing.remaining) ~= "number" then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local own = character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local targetRoot = threat.target and threat.target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not targetRoot or not own or own:FindFirstChild("Block") then return end
        if timing.remaining < 0 or timing.remaining > settings.tradeWindowMs / 1000 then return end
        local swinging = own:FindFirstChild("Melee") ~= nil or own:FindFirstChild("Attacking") ~= nil
        local committed = swinging and not (type(block.m1CancelOpen) == "function" and block.m1CancelOpen())
        if not committed and timing.remaining > .07 then return end
        local now = clock()
        if now - lastDodgeAt < settings.dodgeCooldown then return end
        if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > settings.dodgeRange then return end
        local side = chooseSide(root, targetRoot, settings.tradeDirection)
        if not side then return end
        requestDodge(side,0,nil)
    end
    local function step()
        if not control.alive or not settings.enabled or busy then return end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return end
        if input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return end
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        local engaged = if settings.autoBlockOnly then block ~= nil and block.held ~= nil
            else (character:FindFirstChild("Info") ~= nil and character.Info:FindFirstChild("Block") ~= nil)
        local target = block and block.lastTarget
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(target) ~= "Instance" or not target:IsA("Model") then return end
        local targetHumanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 or not targetRoot then return end
        -- Edge-trigger: grounded last frame, airborne and rising now.
        local inAir = targetHumanoid.FloorMaterial == host.Enum.Material.Air
        local wasInAir = airborne[target] == true
        airborne[target] = inAir
        if not engaged or wasInAir or not inAir then return end
        if targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < 12 then return end
        if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > settings.range then return end
        local now = clock()
        if now - lastDashAt < settings.cooldown then return end
        local side = chooseSide(root, targetRoot)
        if not side then return end
        lastDashAt = now
        trigger(side, settings.delayMs, "Jump")
    end
    -- Flick Behind: Block Assist is on a target, you are both blocking, and you flick the camera by the set share of the
    -- screen width while close enough to hit. It side dashes round the target (your own keys, so the game's dash rules
    -- apply) until you are behind them, throws one M1 and hands back to your input: a held Block or a skill press
    -- simply carries on, and Block Assist re-engages on the held Block.
    local flip: any = {yaw = nil, samples = {}, busy = false, last = -math.huge}
    control.flips = 0
    function control.flipActive(): boolean return flip.busy end
    local function flatOf(vector: any): any return host.Vector3.new(vector.X, 0, vector.Z) end
    local function behindTarget(root: any, targetRoot: any): boolean
        local back = -flatOf(targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector)
        local toMe = flatOf(root.Position - targetRoot.Position)
        if back.Magnitude < .01 or toMe.Magnitude < .01 then return false end
        return back.Unit:Dot(toMe.Unit) >= math.cos(math.rad(settings.flipBehind))
    end
    local function flipTarget(): any
        local aim = menu.m1AimAssist
        if not aim then return nil end
        local okay, active = pcall(aim.blockDirectionalActive)
        if not okay or active ~= true then return nil end
        local model = aim.lastTarget
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(model) ~= "Instance" or not model:IsA("Model") or model == player.Character then return nil end
        return model
    end
    local function blocking(character: any): boolean
        local info = character and character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        return info ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild("Block") ~= nil
    end
    local function sideReady(character: any): boolean
        local readiness = menu.frontDashReadiness
        if not readiness or type(readiness.getSideStatus) ~= "function" then return true end
        local okay, status = pcall(readiness.getSideStatus, character, world:GetServerTimeNow())
        return not okay or type(status) ~= "table" or status.ready ~= false or (tonumber(status.fraction) or 0) >= 1
    end
    local function runFlip(target: any, left: boolean)
        flip.busy = true;flip.last = clock()
        host.task.spawn(function()
            local dashes = 0
            while control.alive and dashes < settings.flipMaxDashes do
                local character = player.Character
                local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local targetRoot = target.Parent and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local targetHumanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then break end
                if flatOf(targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > settings.flipReach * 2 then break end
                if behindTarget(root, targetRoot) then break end
                local waited = 0
                while not sideReady(character) and waited < .6 do waited += run.Heartbeat:Wait() end
                local toward = flatOf(targetRoot.Position - root.Position)
                if toward.Magnitude < .01 then break end
                toward = toward.Unit
                local right = host.Vector3.new(-toward.Z, 0, toward.X)
                local side = sideFor(if left then -right else right)
                if not side or not dash(side) then break end
                dashes += 1
                control.dashes += 1
                host.task.wait(.28)
            end
            local character = player.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local targetHumanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if settings.flipM1 and control.alive and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 then
                local bindings = menu.bindings
                if bindings and type(bindings.send) == "function" then
                    local swing = {kind = "Mouse", name = "MouseButton1"}
                    pcall(bindings.send, swing, true)
                    wait(2)
                    pcall(bindings.send, swing, false)
                end
            end
            control.flips += 1
            control.lastReason = string.format("Flick Behind: %d dash(es) then M1", dashes)
            flip.busy = false
        end)
    end
    local function flipStep()
        if not control.alive or not settings.flipEnabled or flip.busy then flip.yaw = nil;table.clear(flip.samples);return end
        if (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then flip.yaw = nil;table.clear(flip.samples);return end
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
        local now = clock()
        if flip.yaw then table.insert(flip.samples, {at = now, delta = math.atan2(math.sin(yaw - flip.yaw), math.cos(yaw - flip.yaw))}) end
        flip.yaw = yaw
        local window, total, kept = settings.flipWindowMs / 1000, 0, {}
        for _, sample in flip.samples do
            if now - sample.at <= window then table.insert(kept, sample);total += sample.delta end
        end
        flip.samples = kept
        local aspect = camera.ViewportSize.X / math.max(camera.ViewportSize.Y, 1)
        local horizontal = 2 * math.atan(math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) / 2) * aspect)
        if math.abs(total) / math.max(horizontal, .01) * 100 < settings.flipShift then return end
        if now - flip.last < settings.flipCooldown then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not blocking(character) then return end
        local target = flipTarget()
        local targetRoot = target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetHumanoid = target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 or not blocking(target) then return end
        if flatOf(targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > settings.flipReach then return end
        table.clear(flip.samples)
        runFlip(target, total > 0)
    end
    -- Block Assist side dash: the first moment Block Assist is engaged on a target while you block and are inside the set range, side dash
    -- once (your own movement and Dash keys, so the game's dash rules apply) and keep the character turned to face the enemy through the
    -- dash and a little after. It fires once per engagement; letting Block Assist go and engaging again arms it again.
    local engagedDash: any = {armed = true, busy = false}
    control.blockDashes = 0
    local function blockDashStep()
        local character = player.Character
        local target = if settings.bdEnabled then flipTarget() else nil
        if not target or not blocking(character) then engagedDash.armed = true;return end
        if not engagedDash.armed or engagedDash.busy or flip.busy or busy then return end
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetHumanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        local toward = flatOf(targetRoot.Position - root.Position)
        if toward.Magnitude < .01 or toward.Magnitude > settings.bdRange then return end
        if (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or not sideReady(character) then return end
        toward = toward.Unit
        local right = host.Vector3.new(-toward.Z, 0, toward.X)
        local sign = 1
        if settings.bdDirection == "Left Of Target" then sign = -1
        elseif settings.bdDirection == "Right Of Target" then sign = 1
        else
            local facing = flatOf(targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector)
            if facing.Magnitude > .01 and facing.Unit:Dot(right) > 0 then sign = -1 end
        end
        local side = sideFor(right * sign)
        if not side then return end
        engagedDash.armed = false;engagedDash.busy = true
        host.task.spawn(function()
            -- Turn to the enemy every frame for the dash and a moment after, whichever way it moved me.
            host.task.spawn(function()
                local started = clock()
                while control.alive and clock() - started < settings.bdTurnTime do
                    local nowRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local nowTarget = target.Parent and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if not nowRoot or not nowTarget then break end
                    local look = flatOf(nowTarget.Position - nowRoot.Position)
                    if look.Magnitude > .01 then
                        nowRoot.CFrame = host.CFrame.lookAt(nowRoot.Position, nowRoot.Position + look.Unit)
                    end
                    run.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
            end)
            if dash(side) then
                control.dashes += 1;control.blockDashes += 1
                control.lastReason = "Block Assist side dash (" .. side .. ")"
            end
            engagedDash.busy = false
        end)
    end
    connection = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        pcall(blockDashStep)
        pcall(flipStep)
        local okay, problem = pcall(step)
        if not okay then control.lastReason = "Error: " .. tostring(problem) end
        pcall(tradeStep)
        pcall(unblockStep)
        pcall(lethalStep)
    end)

    local function numberSetter(key: string, low: number, high: number)
        return function(value: any)
            local amount = tonumber(value)
            if not finite(amount) then return false end
            settings[key] = math.clamp(amount :: number, low, high);return true
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Auto Dodge Lethal Attacks", Description = "Dodge a fresh predicted contact whose native damage or repeated unambiguous observed damage reaches your current HP. Unknown attacks are not guessed. Uses Auto Block's existing threat forecast.", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.lethalDodge=value==true;return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Dodge Verified Unblockables Only", Description = "Require native unblockable flags or the game's known melee downslam identity. Off also permits your configured name heuristics.", Default = true, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.verifiedUnblockables=value==true;return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Dash Out Of Unblockables", DisplayName = "Dash Out Of Unblockables", Description = "When an enemy starts a grab, throw, domain, ultimate, down slam or break move (anything you cannot block), side dash out of it. It uses the Dodge Direction and Dodge Cooldown below and waits for your side dash to be ready.", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.unblockDodge = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Unblockable Dash Range (studs)", DisplayName = "Unblockable Range (studs)", Description = "Only dash out of unblockable attacks that start this close.", Min = 6, Max = 60, Default = 14, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end;settings.unblockRange = math.clamp(amount, 6, 60);return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Unblockable Dash Delay (ms)", DisplayName = "Unblockable Delay (ms)", Description = "Wait this long after the animation starts before dashing. Raise it if you dash too early.", Min = 0, Max = 500, Default = 120, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end;settings.unblockDelayMs = math.clamp(amount, 0, 500);return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Dash Out Of Trades", DisplayName = "Dash Out Of Trades", Description = "When an enemy M1 is about to land and your guard cannot come up in time (you are in your own swing, or contact is nearly here), side dash out of it. It waits for your side dash to be ready by the game's own cooldown. Pair with Dash While M1 on.", Default = false,
            Callback = function(value) settings.tradeDodge = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Trade Dash Direction", DisplayName = "Trade Dash Direction", Description = "Which way the trade dash goes around the enemy.", Options = {"Strafe Right Of Target", "Strafe Left Of Target", "Away From Target", "Camera Left", "Camera Right"}, Default = "Strafe Right Of Target", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.tradeDirection = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Trade Dash Window (ms)", DisplayName = "Trade Dash Window (ms)", Description = "How close to contact the enemy M1 must be before the trade dash fires. Smaller is later and tighter.", Min = 60, Max = 350, Default = 160, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end;settings.tradeWindowMs = math.clamp(amount, 60, 350);return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Skill Dodge", DisplayName = "Skill Dodge", Description = "When an enemy starts an UNBLOCKABLE attack that can reach you, dash out of the way once. Normal skills and M1s are never dodged.  Uses Threat Feed's skill detection and your own movement and Dash keys, so the game's dash rules still apply. Pair with Block Dash if you want to dodge while guarding.", Default = false,
            Callback = function(value) settings.dodgeEnabled = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Skill Dodge Above Only", DisplayName = "Dodge Only When Above Me", Description = "Only dodge when the enemy is detected on top of your head: higher than your root by the height below and within the radius below. Applies to Skill Dodge and Dash Out Of Unblockables.",
            Default = true, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = function(value) settings.dodgeAbove = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Skill Dodge Above Height (studs)", DisplayName = "Above Me: Height (studs)", Description = "How far higher than you the enemy must be to count as on top of your head.", Min = 0, Max = 30, Default = 3, Step = .5, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("dodgeAboveHeight", 0, 30)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Skill Dodge Above Radius (studs)", DisplayName = "Above Me: Radius (studs)", Description = "How far sideways the enemy can be and still count as on top of you.", Min = 1, Max = 40, Default = 12, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("dodgeAboveRadius", 1, 40)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Skill Dodge Unblockable Only", DisplayName = "Dodge Only Unblockables", Description = "Only dodge attacks flagged unblockable. Off: any enemy skill that meets the other conditions.",
            Default = true, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = function(value) settings.dodgeUnblockableOnly = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Skill Dodge Direction", DisplayName = "Dodge Direction", Description = "Away from the caster, a strafe across their line, or a fixed camera direction.",
            Options = {"Away From Target", "Strafe Left Of Target", "Strafe Right Of Target", "Toward Target", "Camera Back", "Camera Front", "Camera Left", "Camera Right"}, Default = "Away From Target", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.dodgeDirection = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Skill Dodge Range (studs)", DisplayName = "Dodge Range (studs)", Description = "Only dodge skills cast within this distance.", Min = 4, Max = 80, Default = 16, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("dodgeRange", 4, 80)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Skill Dodge Cooldown (s)", DisplayName = "Dodge Cooldown (s)", Description = "Minimum time between dodges: after one dodge it will not dodge again until this has passed. 0 to 30 s.", Min = 0, Max = 30, Default = 1.5, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("dodgeCooldown", 0, 30)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Skill Dodge Delay (ms)", DisplayName = "Dodge Delay (ms)", Description = "Wait this long after the cast before dashing. 0 dashes immediately.", Min = 0, Max = 500, Default = 0, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("dodgeDelayMs", 0, 500)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Block Assist Side Dash", DisplayName = "Block Assist Side Dash", Description = "The moment Block Assist is engaged on an enemy while you block and you are inside the range below, side dash once and keep your character turned to face the enemy through the dash. Fires once per engagement. Uses your own movement and Dash keys, so the game's dash rules apply.",
            Default = true, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = function(value) settings.bdEnabled = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block Assist Side Dash Range (studs)", DisplayName = "Side Dash Range (studs)", Description = "Dash only when the enemy is this close (melee range is about 12). Raise it to dash from further away.", Min = 3, Max = 180, Default = 12, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("bdRange", 3, 180)})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Block Assist Side Dash Direction", DisplayName = "Side Dash Direction", Description = "Away From Their Facing picks the side the enemy is not looking toward; or force left or right of the enemy.", Options = {"Away From Their Facing", "Left Of Target", "Right Of Target"}, Default = "Away From Their Facing", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.bdDirection = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block Assist Side Dash Turn Time (s)", DisplayName = "Side Dash Face Time (s)", Description = "How long after the dash starts your character is held facing the enemy.", Min = .2, Max = 2, Default = .7, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("bdTurnTime", .2, 2)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Flick Behind", DisplayName = "Flick Behind Combo", Description = "While Block Assist has a target and you are both blocking, flicking your camera by the set share of the screen while you are close enough to hit side dashes round the target (in the direction of the flick) until you are behind them, then throws one M1. After that it hands back to your input: a held Block or a skill press carries on, and Block Assist re-engages on the held Block. Uses your own movement, Dash and M1 keys, so the game's dash rules apply.",
            Default = false, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = function(value) settings.flipEnabled = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Flick Behind Camera Shift (%)", DisplayName = "Flick Size (% of screen)", Description = "How far the camera must turn within the flick window, as a share of the game window width at the current field of view.", Min = 5, Max = 100, Default = 25, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("flipShift", 5, 100)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Flick Behind Window (ms)", DisplayName = "Flick Window (ms)", Description = "The time the camera has to make the full flick.", Min = 100, Max = 1000, Default = 450, Step = 10, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("flipWindowMs", 100, 1000)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Flick Behind Reach (studs)", DisplayName = "Flick Reach (studs)", Description = "You must be this close to the target for the flick to count. Larger starts the dash from further away.", Min = 3, Max = 40, Default = 10, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("flipReach", 3, 40)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Flick Behind Angle (deg)", DisplayName = "Behind Angle (deg)", Description = "You count as behind the target when you are within this many degrees of straight behind them. Smaller needs a cleaner circle.", Min = 20, Max = 120, Default = 60, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("flipBehind", 20, 120)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Flick Behind Max Dashes", DisplayName = "Max Dashes", Description = "Most side dashes it will chain to get behind the target.", Min = 1, Max = 6, Default = 3, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("flipMaxDashes", 1, 6)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Flick Behind Cooldown (s)", DisplayName = "Flick Cooldown (s)", Description = "Minimum time between flick combos.", Min = 0, Max = 10, Default = 2.5, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("flipCooldown", 0, 10)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Flick Behind M1", DisplayName = "M1 After Flick", Description = "Throw one M1 once you are behind the target. Off: only the dashes.", Default = true, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = function(value) settings.flipM1 = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Dash On Target Jump", DisplayName = "Dash On Target Jump", Description = "While Auto Block is guarding against an enemy and that enemy jumps, dash in the chosen direction. Presses your own movement and Dash keys, so turn on Block Dash to dash while blocking. The game's own dash rules still apply.", Default = false,
            Callback = function(value) settings.enabled = value == true;control.lastReason = if settings.enabled then "Waiting for the target to jump" else "Dash On Target Jump is off";return true end})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Dash On Target Jump Direction", DisplayName = "Jump Dash Direction", Description = "Away or Toward the target, a strafe perpendicular to it, or a fixed camera direction.",
            Options = {"Away From Target", "Toward Target", "Strafe Left Of Target", "Strafe Right Of Target", "Camera Back", "Camera Front", "Camera Left", "Camera Right"}, Default = "Away From Target", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.direction = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Dash On Target Jump Auto Block Only", DisplayName = "Only While Auto Block Engaged", Description = "Only dash when Auto Block itself holds the guard. Off also dashes during a manually held Block.", Default = true, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.autoBlockOnly = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Dash On Target Jump Range (studs)", DisplayName = "Jump Dash Range (studs)", Description = "Only react to a jump from a target within this distance.", Min = 3, Max = 80, Default = 20, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("range", 3, 80)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Dash On Target Jump Cooldown (s)", DisplayName = "Jump Dash Cooldown (s)", Description = "Minimum time between jump dashes.", Min = 0, Max = 5, Default = 1, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("cooldown", 0, 5)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Dash On Target Jump Delay (ms)", DisplayName = "Jump Dash Delay (ms)", Description = "Wait this long after the jump before dashing. 0 dashes immediately.", Min = 0, Max = 500, Default = 0, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("delayMs", 0, 500)})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection = nil end
        if damageConnection then damageConnection:Disconnect();damageConnection=nil end
        table.clear(learnedDamage)
        if menu.targetJumpDash == control then menu.targetJumpDash = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return TargetJumpDash
end)()

local ThreatFeed = (function(): any
-- Reads the game's own combat announcements (the Effects remote of every move
-- service) and turns them into short-lived attack evidence for Auto Block:
-- M1 swing chains with a learned rhythm, and skill start-ups. Auto Block keeps
-- its normal animation evidence; this adds earlier and stickier evidence, so a
-- fast chain is one threat that keeps the guard up instead of one block per swing.
local ThreatFeed = {}
function ThreatFeed.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local replicated = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local kindOf = host.typeof or typeof
    local control: any = {alive = true, enabled = true, chainGap = 1.1, startup = .22, singleWindow = .3, castEnabled = true, castStartup = .28, castRange = 20, events = 0, swings = 0, moves = 0, dashes = 0,
        subscribed = 0, used = 0, lastKind = "", lastReason = "Waiting for combat events"}
    local states = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local connections: {any} = {}
    -- Per move, how long after the cast it really hit you and how far away the caster was. It starts from the
    -- fixed estimates and corrects itself from every skill that lands on you; it survives a script reload.
    local learned: any = shared.__ShenaniganismMoveTimings or {}
    shared.__ShenaniganismMoveTimings = learned
    local function learnKey(model: any, name: string): string return tostring(model:GetAttribute("Moveset")) .. "/" .. name end
    local lastHealth: any = nil
    -- Rough time from announcement to contact for skill start-ups (seconds).
    local MOVE_STARTUP = {Startup = .35, Chase = .28, Grab = .25, Throw = .3, Cast = .28}
    local function modelOf(value: any): any
        if kindOf(value) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        if value:IsA("Player") then return value.Character end
        if value:IsA("Model") then return value end
        return nil
    end
    local function stateFor(model: any): any
        local state = states[model]
        if not state then
            state = {intervals = {}, chainId = 0, token = {chain = 0}}
            states[model] = state
        end
        return state
    end
    local function noteSwing(state: any, kind: string, now: number)
        if kind == "Swing" then state.hasSwing = true
        elseif state.hasSwing and state.swingAt and now - state.swingAt < .5 then
            -- Swing2 follows Swing for the same swing; it only marks the active phase.
            state.activeAt = now
            return
        end
        local gap = now - (state.lastSwingAt or -math.huge)
        if gap > control.chainGap then
            state.chainId += 1
            state.token = {chain = state.chainId}
            state.intervals = {}
        end
        if state.lastSwingAt and gap < 1.6 and gap > .06 then
            table.insert(state.intervals, gap)
            if #state.intervals > 5 then table.remove(state.intervals, 1) end
        end
        state.lastSwingAt, state.swingAt = now, now
        if #state.intervals > 0 then
            local sorted = table.clone(state.intervals)
            table.sort(sorted)
            state.cadence = sorted[math.ceil(#sorted / 2)]
        end
    end
    local function noteMove(model: any, kind: string, at: number, name: string?)
        local state = stateFor(model)
        state.moveAt, state.moveKind, state.moveToken, state.moveName = at, kind, {move = kind, at = at}, name
        control.moves += 1
        local jump = menu.targetJumpDash
        if jump and type(jump.dodge) == "function" then pcall(jump.dodge, model) end
    end
    -- A skill the game just cast, read from the move's own LastUse stamp. This sees every kit's skills,
    -- including fast ones that never announce themselves on an effects channel.
    local seenUse: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local toolCache: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function scanCasts(root: any, now: number)
        if not control.castEnabled then return end
        local records = menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.records
        if not records then return end
        local okay, server = pcall(host.workspace.GetServerTimeNow, host.workspace)
        if not okay or type(server) ~= "number" then return end
        for model in records do
            if model == player.Character or not model.Parent then continue end
            local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not other then continue end
            local offset = root.Position - other.Position
            local flat = host.Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
            local distance = flat.Magnitude
            if distance > control.castRange then continue end
            if distance > 10 then
                local look = other.CFrame.LookVector
                if flat.Unit:Dot(host.Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)) < .2 then continue end
            end
            local cache = toolCache[model]
            if not cache or now - cache.at > 1 then
                local list = {}
                local moveset = model:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
                if moveset then for _, tool in moveset:GetChildren() do if tool:GetAttribute("ReadyAt") ~= nil then table.insert(list, tool) end end end
                cache = {at = now, list = list};toolCache[model] = cache
            end
            for _, tool in cache.list do
                local used = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("LastUse")) or false
                local previous = seenUse[tool]
                seenUse[tool] = used
                if previous ~= nil and used and used ~= previous and server - used >= -.05 and server - used < .5 then
                    noteMove(model, "Cast", now - math.max(0, server - used), tool.Name)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function handle(...: any)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then return end
        local args = table.pack(...)
        local strings, models = {}, {}
        for index = 1, math.min(args.n, 5) do
            local value = args[index]
            if type(value) == "string" then table.insert(strings, value)
            else
                local model = modelOf(value)
                if model then table.insert(models, model) end
            end
        end
        local kind = strings[1]
        if not kind then return end
        control.events += 1
        control.lastKind = kind
        local caster = models[1]
        if not caster or caster == player.Character then return end
        local now = clock()
        if kind == "Swing" or kind == "Swing2" then
            noteSwing(stateFor(caster), kind, now)
            control.swings += 1
        elseif MOVE_STARTUP[kind] then
            noteMove(caster, kind, now)
        elseif kind == "Dash" then
            local state = stateFor(caster)
            state.dashAt, state.dashSide = now, strings[2]
            control.dashes += 1
        end
    end
    local function subscribe()
        local folder = replicated:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local module = folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Knit")
        local services = module and module:FindFirstChild("Services")
        if not services or type(host.require) ~= "function" then control.lastReason = "Knit services are unavailable";return end
        local okay, knit = pcall(host.require, module)
        if not okay or type(knit) ~= "table" or type(knit.GetService) ~= "function" then control.lastReason = "Knit is unavailable";return end
        for _, item in services:GetChildren() do
            if not control.alive then return end
            local got, service = pcall(knit.GetService, item.Name)
            local signal = if got and type(service) == "table" then service.Effects else nil
            if signal and type(signal.Connect) == "function" then
                local connected, connection = pcall(signal.Connect, signal, handle)
                if connected and connection then
                    table.insert(connections, connection)
                    control.subscribed += 1
                end
            end
        end
        control.lastReason = "Listening to " .. tostring(control.subscribed) .. " combat channels"
    end
    host.task.defer(subscribe)
    -- Learning: when you lose health, the freshest skill cast near you is the likely cause.
    local function learnFromDamage()
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or not root then lastHealth = nil;return end
        local health = humanoid.Health
        local previous = lastHealth
        lastHealth = health
        if not previous or health >= previous - .5 then return end
        local now = clock()
        local best, bestAge = nil, math.huge
        for model, state in states do
            if state.moveAt and state.moveKind == "Cast" and state.moveName and model.Parent then
                local age = now - state.moveAt
                local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if age > .05 and age < 1.2 and other and (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < 60 and age < bestAge then best, bestAge = model, age end
            end
        end
        if not best then return end
        local state = states[best]
        -- A fresh M1 swing from the same enemy makes the cause ambiguous, so learn nothing from that hit.
        if state.lastSwingAt and now - state.lastSwingAt < 1 then return end
        local key = learnKey(best, state.moveName)
        local entry = learned[key] or {hits = 0}
        entry.startup = if entry.startup then entry.startup * .5 + bestAge * .5 else bestAge
        local distance = (best.HumanoidRootPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        entry.reach = if entry.reach then math.max(distance, entry.reach * .96) else distance
        entry.hits += 1
        learned[key] = entry
        control.learnedMoves = (control.learnedMoves or 0) + 1
        state.moveAt = nil
    end
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    table.insert(connections, run.Heartbeat:Connect(function() pcall(learnFromDamage) end))

    -- Best current attack against the character: an M1 chain (kept alive across
    -- the chain's rhythm) or a fresh skill start-up. Returns the same shape Auto
    -- Block's own threat search uses: model, source, timing, evidence.
    function control.activeThreat(root: any, range: number): (any, string?, any, any)
        if not control.enabled or not root then return nil end
        local now = clock()
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        local records = block and block.records
        if not records then return nil end
        local excluded = menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        local best, bestRemaining, bestSource, bestTiming, bestEvidence = nil, math.huge, nil, nil, nil
        scanCasts(root, now)
        for model, state in states do
            if not model.Parent or model == player.Character then continue end
            local record = records[model]
            local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not record or not other or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
            if excluded and excluded(model) then continue end
            if (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > range + 4 then continue end
            local cadence = state.cadence or .5
            -- One swing so far is a single punch until a second one proves a chain: do not hold the threat
            -- (and the guard, and your return punch) any longer than the single-punch window.
            local window = if #state.intervals > 0 then math.clamp(cadence * 1.7, .6, 1.5) else control.singleWindow
            if state.lastSwingAt and now - state.lastSwingAt <= window then
                -- Between swings, the next contact is one rhythm step after the last one.
                local sinceSwing = now - state.lastSwingAt
                local remaining = if sinceSwing < control.startup then state.lastSwingAt + control.startup - now
                    else math.max(0, state.lastSwingAt + cadence + control.startup - now)
                if remaining < bestRemaining then
                    best, bestRemaining = model, remaining
                    bestSource = "Announced M1 chain " .. tostring(state.chainId)
                    bestTiming = {token = state.token, remaining = remaining, kind = "M1"}
                    bestEvidence = {token = state.token, kind = "M1", single = false, record = record, feed = true}
                end
            end
            local startup = state.moveAt and MOVE_STARTUP[state.moveKind]
            local entry = if state.moveName then learned[learnKey(model, state.moveName)] else nil
            if startup and entry and entry.startup then startup = entry.startup end
            if startup and now - state.moveAt <= 1.0 then
                local remaining = math.max(0, state.moveAt + startup - now)
                if remaining < bestRemaining then
                    best, bestRemaining = model, remaining
                    bestSource = "Announced " .. tostring(state.moveKind)
                    bestTiming = {token = state.moveToken, remaining = remaining, kind = "Move"}
                    bestEvidence = {token = state.moveToken, kind = "Move", single = false, record = record, feed = true, reach = entry and entry.reach}
                end
            end
        end
        if best then control.used += 1;return best, bestSource, bestTiming, bestEvidence end
        return nil
    end
    function control.stateOf(model: any): any
        return states[model]
    end
    local function numberSetter(key: string, low: number, high: number, scale: number)
        return function(value: any)
            local amount = tonumber(value)
            if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end
            control[key] = math.clamp(amount, low, high) / scale
            return true
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Threat Feed", DisplayName = "Threat Feed", Description = "Auto Block also listens to the game's own combat announcements. An enemy M1 chain counts as one attack and keeps the guard up at its learned rhythm, and a skill start-up is caught the moment it is announced. Auto Block's normal animation checks still run.", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) control.enabled = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Threat Feed Chain Gap (s)", DisplayName = "Chain Gap (s)", Description = "A pause longer than this ends an M1 chain. Longer keeps the guard up through slower chains.", Min = .4, Max = 2, Default = 1.1, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("chainGap", .4, 2, 1)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Threat Feed Single Punch Window (ms)", DisplayName = "Single Punch Window (ms)", Description = "After one swing, how long Auto Block waits for a second swing before treating it as a single punch. A single punch ends the threat so your return M1 can fire at once; a second swing inside this time makes it a chain and keeps the guard up.", Min = 150, Max = 700, Default = 300, Step = 10, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("singleWindow", 150, 700, 1000)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Threat Feed Skill Casts", DisplayName = "Detect Skill Casts", Description = "Treat any enemy skill the game stamps as just used as an incoming attack, so fast skills that give no other warning are guarded too. Only enemies close to you and facing you count.", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) control.castEnabled = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Threat Feed Skill Startup (ms)", DisplayName = "Skill Startup (ms)", Description = "Estimated time from a skill cast to its contact. Auto Block presses early enough to cover it.", Min = 100, Max = 600, Default = 280, Step = 10, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end;control.castStartup = math.clamp(amount, 100, 600) / 1000;MOVE_STARTUP.Cast = control.castStartup;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Threat Feed Skill Range (studs)", DisplayName = "Skill Cast Range (studs)", Description = "Only skill casts from enemies this close count as incoming. Lower is stricter.", Min = 6, Max = 60, Default = 20, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end;control.castRange = math.clamp(amount, 6, 60);return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Threat Feed M1 Startup (ms)", DisplayName = "M1 Startup (ms)", Description = "Estimated time from an announced swing to its contact. Auto Block presses early enough to cover it, shortened by your ping.", Min = 80, Max = 400, Default = 220, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("startup", 80, 400, 1000)})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        for _, connection in connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(connections)
        if menu.threatFeed == control then menu.threatFeed = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return ThreatFeed
end)()

local EnemyRings = (function(): any
-- A glowing stat ring on the ground around each of the nearest enemies: four
-- arcs (health, evasive, special and ultimate) like your own ring, but in its
-- own colours and a more transparent look. Local anchored parts only.
local EnemyRings = {}
function EnemyRings.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local world = host.workspace
    local C, E, V, CF, Inst = host.Color3, host.Enum, host.Vector3, host.CFrame, host.Instance
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local ARCS, PER_ARC, MAX = 6, 9, 6
    local GAP = math.rad(14)
    local INNER, MODEL_COUNT = 32, 16
    local OUTLINES: any = {Circle = 0, Triangle = 3, Square = 4, Diamond = 4, Pentagon = 5, Hexagon = 6, Octagon = 8}
    -- A point on the ring at a given angle. A polygon outline keeps every segment lying flat along its edge.
    -- Local geometry is shared by every enemy using these exact settings.
    -- Bound history while sliders/section layouts change; no formatted keys or
    -- new CFrames are built on a warm lookup. World placement still runs each frame.
    local relativeFrames: any = {}
    local relativeCount = 0
    local function ringFrame(base: any, angle: number, radius: number, sides: number, offset: number): any
        local radii = relativeFrames[angle]
        local entry = radii and radii[radius]
        if not entry or entry.sides ~= sides or entry.offset ~= offset then
            local frame
            if sides == 0 then
                frame = CF.Angles(0, angle, 0) * CF.new(0, 0, -radius)
            else
                local sector = math.pi * 2 / sides
                local relative = (angle - offset) % sector
                local toEdge = relative - sector / 2
                local reach = radius * math.cos(math.pi / sides) / math.cos(toEdge)
                frame = CF.Angles(0, angle, 0) * CF.new(0, 0, -reach) * CF.Angles(0, -toEdge, 0)
            end
            if not entry then
                if relativeCount >= 256 then
                    table.clear(relativeFrames);relativeCount = 0;radii = nil
                end
                if not radii then radii = {};relativeFrames[angle] = radii end
                relativeCount += 1
            end
            entry = {sides = sides, offset = offset, frame = frame}
            radii[radius] = entry
        end
        return base * entry.frame
    end
    local dark = C.fromRGB(34, 38, 50)
    local teal, orange, gold, purple = C.fromRGB(90, 215, 190), C.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), C.fromRGB(255, 215, 90), C.fromRGB(190, 120, 255)
    local hostile = {C.fromRGB(255, 90, 90), C.fromRGB(255, 170, 70), C.fromRGB(255, 110, 200), C.fromRGB(255, 215, 90)}
    local settings: any = {enabled = true, count = 3, range = 60, radius = 2.7, opacity = 55, thickness = .22, palette = "Hostile",
        health = true, evade = true, special = true, ultimate = true, shape = "Segments", spin = 0, glow = .4, glowSize = .4, labels = true, labelSize = 11, lift = 0, offsetX = 0, offsetZ = 0, bloom = false, bloomIntensity = .6, bloomSize = 24, bloomThreshold = .9}
    settings.palette = "Native"
    settings.labelMode = "In Bar"
    settings.color = C.fromRGB(255, 110, 110)
    settings.outline, settings.orient, settings.facing = "Circle", "Camera", 0
    settings.sections = {"Health", "Evasive", "Special", "Ultimate", "Dash", "M1"}
    settings.innerStat, settings.innerScale = "Off", .62
    settings.model, settings.modelColorMode, settings.modelColor = "Off", "Custom", C.fromRGB(110, 220, 255)
    settings.modelSize, settings.modelHeight, settings.modelSpin, settings.modelAnim, settings.modelFacing, settings.modelOpacity = 100, 0, 0, 1, 0, 60
    local bloomEffect: any = nil
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, errors = 0}
    local folder: any = nil
    local rings: {any} = {}
    local selected: {any} = {}
    local pickedAt = -math.huge
    local rayParams: any = nil
    local connection: any = nil

    -- Only these locally owned, anchored visual parts enter this batch. No
    -- Position/Orientation listeners depend on their individual property writes.
    local moveParts: {any}, moveFrames: {any} = {}, {}
    local moveCount = 0
    local bulkOkay, bulkMethod, bulkMode = pcall(function()
        return world.BulkMoveTo, E.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged
    end)
    if not bulkOkay or type(bulkMethod) ~= "function" or not bulkMode then bulkMethod = nil end
    control.bulkMoveEnabled = bulkMethod ~= nil
    local function clearMoves()
        table.clear(moveParts);table.clear(moveFrames);moveCount = 0
    end
    local function movePart(part: any, frame: any)
        if bulkMethod then
            moveCount += 1
            moveParts[moveCount], moveFrames[moveCount] = part, frame
        else
            part.CFrame = frame
        end
    end
    local function flushMoves()
        if moveCount == 0 then return end
        local okay, problem = pcall(bulkMethod, world, moveParts, moveFrames, bulkMode)
        if not okay then
            -- An unavailable/rejected engine API must not hide or freeze rings.
            -- Fall back once, then use direct writes on subsequent frames.
            bulkMethod = nil
            control.bulkMoveEnabled, control.bulkMoveFallback = false, tostring(problem)
            for index = 1, moveCount do
                local part, frame = moveParts[index], moveFrames[index]
                pcall(function() part.CFrame = frame end)
            end
        end
        clearMoves()
    end

    local function finite(value: any): boolean
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
    end
    local function put(object: any, key: string, value: any)
        if object[key] ~= value then object[key] = value end
    end
    local function releaseRings()
        for _, item in rings do
            if item.destroying then item.destroying:Disconnect();item.destroying = nil end
            item.holder:Destroy()
        end
        table.clear(rings)
    end
    local function ensureFolder(): any
        if folder and folder.Parent then return folder end
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        releaseRings()
        folder = Inst.new("Folder")
        folder.Name = "ShenaniganismEnemyRings"
        folder.Parent = camera
        local ownedFolder = folder
        folder.Destroying:Connect(function() if folder == ownedFolder then folder = nil end end)
        return folder
    end
    local function ringAt(index: number): any
        local parent = ensureFolder()
        if not parent then return nil end
        local item = rings[index]
        -- hideFrom intentionally detaches reusable slots; nil Parent is not
        -- evidence that the holder was destroyed.
        if item and not item.destroyed then return item end
        if item and item.destroying then item.destroying:Disconnect();item.destroying = nil end
        local holder = Inst.new("Folder")
        holder.Name = "Ring" .. index
        local ticks = {}
        for tick = 1, ARCS * PER_ARC do
            local part = Inst.new("Part")
            part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            part.Material, part.Size, part.Transparency, part.Color = E.Material.Neon, V.new(.3, .1, .2), 1, dark
            part.Parent = holder
            ticks[tick] = part
        end
        local halos = {}
        for tick = 1, ARCS * PER_ARC do
            local part = Inst.new("Part")
            part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            part.Material, part.Size, part.Transparency, part.Color = E.Material.Neon, V.new(.3, .1, .2), 1, dark
            part.Parent = holder
            halos[tick] = part
        end
        local inner = {}
        for tick = 1, INNER do
            local part = Inst.new("Part")
            part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            part.Material, part.Size, part.Transparency, part.Color = E.Material.Neon, V.new(.3, .1, .2), 1, dark
            part.Parent = holder
            inner[tick] = part
        end
        local labels = {}
        for arc = 1, ARCS do
            local anchor = Inst.new("Part")
            anchor.Name = "LabelAnchor";anchor.Anchored, anchor.CanCollide, anchor.CanQuery, anchor.CanTouch, anchor.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            anchor.Transparency, anchor.Size = 1, V.new(.2, .2, .2)
            anchor.Parent = holder
            local board = Inst.new("BillboardGui")
            board.Name = "Label";board.AlwaysOnTop, board.LightInfluence, board.MaxDistance, board.Enabled = true, 0, 90, false
            board.Size, board.StudsOffset = host.UDim2.fromOffset(54, 18), V.new(0, 0, 0)
            board.Parent = anchor
            local back = Inst.new("Frame")
            back.BackgroundColor3, back.BackgroundTransparency, back.BorderSizePixel, back.Size = dark, 1, 0, host.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            back.Parent = board
            local corner = Inst.new("UICorner");corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 6);corner.Parent = back
