            local text = Inst.new("TextLabel")
            text.BackgroundTransparency, text.BorderSizePixel, text.Size, text.Font = 1, 0, host.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), E.Font.GothamBold
            text.TextSize, text.Text, text.TextColor3 = 11, "", C.new(1, 1, 1)
            text.Parent = back
            labels[arc] = {anchor = anchor, board = board, text = text, back = back}
        end
        item = {holder = holder, ticks = ticks, halos = halos, inner = inner, labels = labels, key = {}, groundY = nil, rayAt = -math.huge}
        item.destroying = holder.Destroying:Connect(function() item.destroyed = true end)
        holder.Parent = parent
        rings[index] = item
        return item
    end
    local function hideFrom(index: number)
        for position = index, #rings do
            local item = rings[position]
            if item and item.holder.Parent then item.holder.Parent = nil end
        end
    end
    local function server(): number?
        local okay, value = pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow, world)
        return if okay and finite(value) then value else nil
    end
    local function colorFor(arc: number, ratio: number, main: any, second: any, extra: any?): any
        if settings.palette == "Custom" then return settings.color end
        if arc == 7 then return C.fromRGB(255, 150, 60):Lerp(C.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), if ratio >= 1 then .35 else 0) end
        if arc == 5 then return C.fromRGB(255, 190, 70):Lerp(C.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), if ratio >= 1 then .35 else 0) end
        if arc == 6 then return extra or C.fromRGB(235, 70, 255) end
        if settings.palette == "Native" and main then
            if arc == 1 then return C.fromRGB(255, 70, 70):Lerp(C.fromRGB(65, 235, 125), ratio)
            elseif arc == 2 then return if ratio >= .999 then C.fromRGB(32, 78, 200):Lerp(C.new(1, 1, 1), .45) else C.fromRGB(32, 78, 200)
            elseif arc == 3 then return main end
            return if ratio >= 1 then gold else main:Lerp(dark, .35)
        end
        if settings.palette == "Match Mine" then
            if arc == 1 then return C.fromRGB(255, 70, 70):Lerp(C.fromRGB(65, 235, 125), ratio)
            elseif arc == 2 then return if ratio < .5 then orange else teal
            elseif arc == 3 then return teal end
            return if ratio >= 1 then gold else purple
        end
        local base = hostile[arc]
        return if arc == 1 then base:Lerp(C.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), math.clamp(1 - ratio, 0, 1) * .3) else base
    end
    local function pick(root: any)
        table.clear(selected)
        local characters = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not characters then return end
        local excluded = menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        for _, model in characters:GetChildren() do
            if model == player.Character then continue end
            local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not other or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then continue end
            local distance = (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
            if distance > settings.range then continue end
            if excluded and excluded(model) then continue end
            table.insert(selected, {model = model, root = other, humanoid = humanoid, distance = distance})
        end
        table.sort(selected, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)
        while #selected > settings.count do table.remove(selected) end
    end

    local MODELS = {"Off", "Orbit Orbs", "Gyro Rings", "Holo Column", "Crystal", "Cube Lattice", "Helix", "Dome", "Spikes"}
    local function modelParts(item: any): any
        if item.mparts then return item.mparts end
        local list = {}
        for index = 1, MODEL_COUNT do
            local part = Inst.new("Part")
            part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            part.Material, part.Size, part.Transparency = E.Material.Neon, V.new(.3, .3, .3), 1
            part.Parent = item.holder
            list[index] = part
        end
        item.mparts = list
        return list
    end
    local function drawModel(item: any, base: any, now: number, color: any)
        local list = modelParts(item)
        local kind = settings.model
        local scale = settings.modelSize / 100
        local anim = now * settings.modelAnim
        local alpha = math.clamp(1 - settings.modelOpacity / 100, 0, 1)
        local height = settings.modelHeight
        local radius = settings.radius
        local Ball, Block, Cyl = E.PartType.Ball, E.PartType.Block, E.PartType.Cylinder
        local flat = CF.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
        local used = 0
        local function use(shape: any, size: any, frame: any, transparency: number?, tint: any?)
            if used >= #list then return end
            used += 1
            local part = list[used]
            if part.Shape ~= shape then part.Shape = shape end
            part.Size = size
            movePart(part, frame)
            put(part, "Color", tint or color);put(part, "Transparency", transparency or alpha)
        end
        if kind == "Orbit Orbs" then
            for index = 1, 5 do
                local a = anim * 2 + index * math.pi * 2 / 5
                local reach = radius * .85 * scale
                use(Ball, V.new(.7, .7, .7) * scale, base * CF.new(math.sin(a) * reach, 3 * scale + height + math.sin(anim * 3 + index) * .3, math.cos(a) * reach))
            end
        elseif kind == "Gyro Rings" then
            local d = radius * 1.7 * scale
            for index = 1, 3 do
                use(Cyl, V.new(.12, d, d), base * CF.new(0, 3.2 * scale + height, 0) * CF.Angles(anim * (.9 + index * .4), anim * (.5 + index * .3) + index, index * 1.05) * flat)
            end
        elseif kind == "Holo Column" then
            local h = 7 * scale
            local d = radius * 1.5 * scale
            use(Cyl, V.new(h, d, d), base * CF.new(0, h / 2 + height, 0) * flat, math.clamp(alpha + .25, 0, 1))
            for index = 1, 3 do
                local phase = (anim * .5 + index / 3) % 1
                use(Cyl, V.new(.1, d * 1.05, d * 1.05), base * CF.new(0, phase * h + height, 0) * flat, math.clamp(.25 + .75 * phase, 0, 1))
            end
        elseif kind == "Crystal" then
            local y = 5.2 * scale + height + math.sin(anim * 2) * .4
            use(Block, V.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5) * scale, base * CF.new(0, y, 0) * CF.Angles(0, anim * 1.6, 0) * CF.Angles(math.pi / 4, 0, math.pi / 4))
            use(Block, V.new(.9, .9, .9) * scale, base * CF.new(0, y, 0) * CF.Angles(0, -anim * 2.4, 0) * CF.Angles(math.pi / 4, 0, math.pi / 4), math.clamp(alpha - .2, 0, 1), color:Lerp(C.new(1, 1, 1), .6))
            use(Cyl, V.new(.1, 2.6 * scale, 2.6 * scale), base * CF.new(0, y - 1.3 * scale, 0) * flat, math.clamp(alpha + .2, 0, 1))
        elseif kind == "Cube Lattice" then
            local reach = 1.7 * scale
            local spin = base * CF.new(0, 3.4 * scale + height, 0) * CF.Angles(anim * .6, anim, anim * .3)
            for x = -1, 1, 2 do for y = -1, 1, 2 do for z = -1, 1, 2 do
                use(Block, V.new(.38, .38, .38) * scale, spin * CF.new(x * reach, y * reach, z * reach))
            end end end
        elseif kind == "Helix" then
            for index = 1, 14 do
                local a = anim * 2 + index * .75
                local reach = radius * .8 * scale
                use(Ball, V.new(.38, .38, .38) * scale, base * CF.new(math.sin(a) * reach, (index / 14) * 6.5 * scale + height, math.cos(a) * reach))
            end
        elseif kind == "Dome" then
            local d = radius * 2.4 * scale
            use(Ball, V.new(d, d, d), base * CF.new(0, height + radius * .4, 0), math.clamp(alpha + .25, 0, 1))
        elseif kind == "Spikes" then
            for index = 1, 10 do
                local a = index * math.pi * 2 / 10
                local h = (1.2 + math.sin(anim * 3 + index * 1.3) * .8) * scale
                local reach = radius * scale
                use(Block, V.new(.22, h * 2, .22), base * CF.new(math.sin(a) * reach, h + height, math.cos(a) * reach))
            end
        end
        for index = used + 1, #list do put(list[index], "Transparency", 1) end
    end

    local function updateGround(item,model,frame,character,now)
        if item.groundModel~=model then
            item.groundModel,item.groundY,item.rayAt=model,nil,-math.huge
        end
        if now-item.rayAt>.12 then
            item.rayAt=now
            local excluded={model,folder,character}
            local characters=world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
            if characters then table.insert(excluded,characters)end
            rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances=excluded
            -- Probe terrain below the actor even through a high jump. A missed
            -- probe keeps the last real surface; it never substitutes root Y.
            local hit=world:Raycast(frame.Position,V.new(0,-2048,0),rayParams)
            if hit then item.groundY=hit.Position.Y+.06+.5 end
        end
        return item.groundY~=nil
    end

    local function step()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not settings.enabled or not myRoot or not camera or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) then
            if folder and folder.Parent then folder.Parent = nil end
            if bloomEffect then bloomEffect:Destroy();bloomEffect = nil end
            return
        end
        if folder and not folder.Parent then folder.Parent = camera end
        local now = clock()
        if now - pickedAt > .25 then pickedAt = now;pick(myRoot) end
        if not rayParams then
            rayParams = host.RaycastParams.new()
            rayParams.FilterType = E.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        end
        local serverNow = server()
        local litTransparency = math.clamp(1 - settings.opacity / 100, 0, 1)
        local glowAlpha = 1 - math.clamp(settings.glow, 0, 1) * (.42 + .1 * math.sin(now * 3))
        if settings.bloom and #selected > 0 then
            if bloomEffect and not bloomEffect.Parent then bloomEffect = nil end
            if not bloomEffect then bloomEffect = Inst.new("BloomEffect");bloomEffect.Name = "ShenaniganismEnemyRingBloom";bloomEffect.Parent = camera end
            put(bloomEffect, "Intensity", settings.bloomIntensity);put(bloomEffect, "Size", settings.bloomSize);put(bloomEffect, "Threshold", settings.bloomThreshold)
        elseif bloomEffect then bloomEffect:Destroy();bloomEffect = nil end
        local used = 0
        for index, entry in selected do
            local model, root, humanoid = entry.model, entry.root, entry.humanoid
            if not model.Parent or not root.Parent then continue end
            local item = ringAt(index)
            if not item then break end
            used = index
            local okay, frame = pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame, root)
            if not okay or not frame then frame = root.CFrame end
            if not updateGround(item,model,frame,character,now) then
                item.groundHidden=true
                if item.holder.Parent then item.holder.Parent=nil end
                continue
            end
            item.groundHidden=false
            if not item.holder.Parent then item.holder.Parent=folder end
            if item.nativeModel ~= model or now - (item.nativeAt or -math.huge) > 1 then
                item.nativeModel, item.nativeAt = model, now
                item.main, item.second = nativeSpecColors(host, model)
            end
            local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local flatLook = V.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            flatLook = if flatLook.Magnitude > .001 then flatLook.Unit else V.new(0, 0, -1)
            local flatRight = V.new(-flatLook.Z, 0, flatLook.X)
            local center = V.new(frame.Position.X + flatRight.X * settings.offsetX + flatLook.X * settings.offsetZ, item.groundY + settings.lift,
                frame.Position.Z + flatRight.Z * settings.offsetX + flatLook.Z * settings.offsetZ)
            local away = V.new(center.X - camera.CFrame.Position.X, 0, center.Z - camera.CFrame.Position.Z)
            local yaw = if away.Magnitude > .001 then math.atan2(-away.X, -away.Z) else 0
            local baseYaw = yaw
            if settings.orient == "Enemy Facing" then
                local lv = frame.LookVector
                baseYaw = math.atan2(-lv.X, -lv.Z)
            elseif settings.orient == "World" then baseYaw = 0 end
            local base = CF.new(center) * CF.Angles(0, baseYaw + math.rad(settings.facing) + math.rad(settings.spin) * now, 0)
            -- Stats for this enemy
            local healthRatio = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / math.max(1, humanoid.MaxHealth), 0, 1)
            local evadeValue = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Evade"))
            local actor = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            local ultimate = actor and tonumber(actor:GetAttribute("Ultimate"))
            local cooldown, last = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("M2_CD")), tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM2"))
            local special = 1
            if cooldown and cooldown > 0 and last and last > 0 and serverNow then
                special = math.clamp(1 - math.max(0, cooldown - (serverNow - last)) / cooldown, 0, 1)
            end
            local hitState = menu.hitStateFX
            local stateInfo = hitState and hitState.stateOf and hitState.stateOf(model)
            local dashFraction, dashLeft = 1, 0
            if hitState and hitState.dashOf then dashFraction, dashLeft = hitState.dashOf(model) end
            -- How many M1s they have landed in the current chain (resets once their combo window lapses).
            local m1Chain = m1ChainLength(model)
            local m1Stage = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("CurrentM1")) or 0
            local m1Last = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
            local m1Done = if serverNow and m1Last and serverNow - m1Last < 1.5 and m1Stage > 1 then math.clamp(m1Stage - 1, 0, m1Chain) else 0
            local stats: any = {
                M1 = {m1Done / math.max(1, m1Chain), string.format("M1 %d/%d", m1Done, m1Chain), 7},
                Health = if settings.health then {healthRatio, string.format("HP %d%%", math.floor(healthRatio * 100 + .5)), 1} else nil,
                Evasive = if settings.evade and evadeValue then {math.clamp(evadeValue / 50, 0, 1), string.format("EVAD %d%%", math.floor(math.clamp(evadeValue / 50, 0, 1) * 100 + .5)), 2} else nil,
                Special = if settings.special and cooldown then {special, if special < 1 then string.format("SPEC %.1f", cooldown * (1 - special)) else "SPEC", 3} else nil,
                Ultimate = if settings.ultimate and ultimate then {math.clamp(ultimate / 100, 0, 1), string.format("ULT %d%%", math.floor(ultimate + .5)), 4} else nil,
                Dash = {dashFraction, if dashLeft > .05 then string.format("DASH %.1f", dashLeft) else "DASH", 5},
                State = if stateInfo then {stateInfo.fraction or 1, stateInfo.short .. " " .. (if stateInfo.remaining then string.format("%.1f", stateInfo.remaining) else string.format("+%.1f", stateInfo.elapsed)), 6, stateInfo.color} else nil,
            }
            local armWeight, armTotal = {}, 0
            for arc = 1, ARCS do
                local sectionName = settings.sections[arc]
                local weight = if sectionName == "Health" then 3 elseif sectionName == "M1" then 1 else 2
                armWeight[arc] = weight;armTotal += weight
            end
            local armSpan, armStart, armCursor = {}, {}, 0
            for arc = 1, ARCS do
                armSpan[arc] = math.pi * 2 * armWeight[arc] / armTotal;armStart[arc] = armCursor;armCursor += armSpan[arc]
            end
            local span = math.pi * 2 / ARCS
            local radius = settings.radius
            local sides = OUTLINES[settings.outline] or 0
            local offset = if settings.outline == "Diamond" then math.pi / 4 else 0
            local gapAngle = if settings.shape == "Solid" then 0 else GAP
            local tickThickness = if settings.shape == "Thin Line" then settings.thickness * .35 elseif settings.shape == "Blocks" then settings.thickness * 1.5 else settings.thickness
            local tickLength = if settings.shape == "Dotted" then settings.thickness * 1.15 elseif settings.shape == "Solid" then radius * (span - gapAngle) / PER_ARC * 1.08
                elseif settings.shape == "Blocks" then radius * (span - gapAngle) / PER_ARC * .55 else radius * (span - gapAngle) / PER_ARC * .8
            for arc = 1, ARCS do
                local span = armSpan[arc]
                local tickLength = if settings.shape == "Dotted" then settings.thickness * 1.15 elseif settings.shape == "Solid" then radius * (span - gapAngle) / PER_ARC * 1.08
                    elseif settings.shape == "Blocks" then radius * (span - gapAngle) / PER_ARC * .55 else radius * (span - gapAngle) / PER_ARC * .8
                local stat = stats[settings.sections[arc]]
                local ratio = if stat then stat[1] else nil
                local statId = if stat then stat[3] else arc
                local filled = if ratio then math.floor(ratio * PER_ARC + .5) else -1
                local color = if ratio then colorFor(statId, ratio, item.main, item.second, if stat then stat[4] else nil) else dark
                local label = item.labels[arc]
                local labelMode = settings.labelMode
                local inBar = labelMode == "In Bar"
                if settings.labels and ratio ~= nil and labelMode ~= "Off" and (labelMode ~= "On Use" or ratio < 1) then
                    local labelAngle = math.pi + armStart[arc] + span / 2
                    movePart(label.anchor, if inBar then ringFrame(base, labelAngle, radius, sides, offset)
                        else base * CF.Angles(0, labelAngle, 0) * CF.new(0, 0, -radius))
                    put(label.board, "StudsOffset", V.new(0, if inBar then 0 else .9, 0))
                    put(label.back, "BackgroundTransparency", if inBar then 1 else .3)
                    put(label.board, "Enabled", true);put(label.text, "Text", stat[2]);put(label.text, "TextColor3", C.new(1, 1, 1));put(label.back, "BackgroundColor3", color:Lerp(C.new(0, 0, 0), .55))
                    put(label.text, "TextSize", settings.labelSize)
                    put(label.board, "Size", host.UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(54 * settings.labelSize / 11 + .5), math.floor(18 * settings.labelSize / 11 + .5)))
                else put(label.board, "Enabled", false) end
                local key = string.format("%.3f", span) .. "|" .. tostring(filled) .. "|" .. tostring(litTransparency) .. "|" .. tostring(settings.palette) .. "|" .. tostring(settings.thickness)
                    .. "|" .. tostring(model:GetAttribute("Moveset")) .. "|" .. tostring(settings.glow) .. "|" .. tostring(settings.glowSize) .. "|" .. settings.shape .. "|" .. tostring(statId) .. settings.outline .. tostring(if stat then stat[4] else nil)
                local changed = item.key[arc] ~= key or settings.palette == "Custom" and item.customColor ~= settings.color
                item.key[arc] = key
                for slot = 1, PER_ARC do
                    local part = item.ticks[(arc - 1) * PER_ARC + slot]
                    local angle = math.pi + armStart[arc] + gapAngle / 2 + (slot - .5) / PER_ARC * (span - gapAngle)
                    local tickFrame = ringFrame(base, angle, radius, sides, offset)
                    movePart(part, tickFrame)
                    local halo = item.halos[(arc - 1) * PER_ARC + slot]
                    local lit = ratio ~= nil and slot <= filled and settings.glow > 0
                    if changed then
                        part.Size = V.new(tickLength, .1, tickThickness)
                        if not ratio then put(part, "Transparency", 1)
                        elseif slot <= filled then put(part, "Color", color);put(part, "Transparency", litTransparency)
                        else put(part, "Color", dark);put(part, "Transparency", math.clamp(.8 + litTransparency * .2, 0, 1)) end
                        if lit then
                            halo.Size = V.new(tickLength + settings.glowSize, .14, tickThickness + settings.glowSize)
                            put(halo, "Color", color)
                        end
                    end
                    if lit then
                        movePart(halo, tickFrame)
                        put(halo, "Transparency", glowAlpha)
                    else put(halo, "Transparency", 1) end
                end
            end
            -- Inner ring: one more circle inside, showing any stat you choose.
            local innerStat = stats[settings.innerStat]
            local innerRadius = radius * settings.innerScale
            for slot = 1, INNER do
                local part = item.inner[slot]
                if innerStat then
                    local ratio = innerStat[1]
                    local on = slot <= math.floor(ratio * INNER + .5)
                    local angle = math.pi + (slot - .5) / INNER * math.pi * 2
                    movePart(part, ringFrame(base, angle, innerRadius, sides, offset))
                    part.Size = V.new(innerRadius * math.pi * 2 / INNER * .75, .1, settings.thickness * .7)
                    put(part, "Color", if on then colorFor(innerStat[3], ratio, item.main, item.second, innerStat[4]) else dark)
                    put(part, "Transparency", if on then litTransparency else math.clamp(.8 + litTransparency * .2, 0, 1))
                else put(part, "Transparency", 1) end
            end
            -- 3D model standing on the ring.
            if settings.model ~= "Off" then
                local mode = settings.modelColorMode
                local tint = if mode == "Health" then C.fromRGB(255, 70, 70):Lerp(C.fromRGB(65, 235, 125), healthRatio)
                    elseif mode == "Rainbow" then C.fromHSV((now * .3) % 1, .7, 1)
                    elseif mode == "State" and stateInfo then stateInfo.color else settings.modelColor
                local mbase = CF.new(center) * CF.Angles(0, baseYaw + math.rad(settings.modelFacing) + math.rad(settings.modelSpin) * now, 0)
                drawModel(item, mbase, now, tint)
            elseif item.mparts then
                for _, part in item.mparts do put(part, "Transparency", 1) end
            end
            item.customColor = settings.color
        end
        hideFrom(used + 1)
    end
    connection = run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        clearMoves()
        local okay, problem = pcall(step)
        -- Also apply work preceding a step error, matching the direct-write path.
        flushMoves()
        if not okay then
            control.errors += 1
            control.lastError = tostring(problem)
            if control.errors == 1 then warn("[Shenaniganism] Enemy ring error: " .. control.lastError) end
        end
    end)

    local function boolSetter(key: string)
        return function(value: any)
            if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
            settings[key] = value
            if key == "enabled" and not value and folder and folder.Parent then folder.Parent = nil end
            return true
        end
    end
    local function numberSetter(key: string, low: number, high: number)
        return function(value: any)
            local amount = tonumber(value)
            if not finite(amount) then return false end
            settings[key] = math.clamp(amount :: number, low, high);table.clear(selected);pickedAt = -math.huge
            for _, item in rings do table.clear(item.key) end
            return true
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        local function toggle(key: string, label: string, description: string, default: boolean)
            tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Enemy Ring " .. label, DisplayName = if key == "enabled" then "Enemy Rings" else label, Description = description, Default = default, Callback = boolSetter(key)})
        end
        toggle("enabled", "Master", "A glowing stat ring on the ground around the nearest enemies: health, evasive, special (M2) and ultimate arcs. A separate look from your own ring.", true)
        toggle("health", "Health", "Show an enemy health arc.", true)
        toggle("evade", "Evasive", "Show an enemy evasive (dash) arc.", true)
        toggle("special", "Special", "Show an enemy special (M2 cooldown) arc.", true)
        toggle("ultimate", "Ultimate", "Show an enemy ultimate arc (players only).", true)
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Enemy Ring Palette", DisplayName = "Enemy Ring Colors", Description = "Native: each enemy's own special colours from the game. Hostile: reds and oranges so enemy rings never look like yours. Match Mine: the same colours as your ring. Custom: one colour for everything.",
            Options = {"Native", "Hostile", "Match Mine", "Custom"}, Default = "Native", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.palette = value;for _, item in rings do table.clear(item.key) end;return true end})
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Enemy Ring Custom Color", DisplayName = "Enemy Ring Custom Color", Description = "Used when the colours are set to Custom.", Default = settings.color, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) ~= "Color3" then return false end;settings.color = value;for _, item in rings do table.clear(item.key) end;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Count", DisplayName = "Enemies Shown", Description = "How many of the nearest enemies get a ring.", Min = 1, Max = MAX, Default = 3, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("count", 1, MAX)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Range (studs)", DisplayName = "Ring Range (studs)", Description = "Only enemies within this distance get a ring.", Min = 10, Max = 150, Default = 60, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("range", 10, 150)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Radius (studs)", DisplayName = "Ring Radius (studs)", Description = "Radius of each enemy ring.", Min = 1.5, Max = 6, Default = 2.7, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("radius", 1.5, 6)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Opacity (%)", DisplayName = "Ring Opacity (%)", Description = "How solid the lit segments look. Lower is more transparent.", Min = 10, Max = 100, Default = 55, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("opacity", 10, 100)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Glow (%)", DisplayName = "Ring Glow (%)", Description = "A soft glowing halo behind each lit segment. Zero turns the halo off.", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = 40, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not finite(amount) then return false end;settings.glow = math.clamp(amount :: number, 0, 100) / 100;for _, item in rings do table.clear(item.key) end;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Glow Size", DisplayName = "Ring Glow Size", Description = "How far the halo spreads around each segment, in studs.", Min = .1, Max = 1.5, Default = .4, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("glowSize", .1, 1.5)})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Enemy Ring Shape", DisplayName = "Ring Shape", Description = "Segments, Solid band, Dotted trail, chunky Blocks or a Thin Line.",
            Options = {"Segments", "Solid", "Dotted", "Blocks", "Thin Line"}, Default = "Segments", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.shape = value;for _, item in rings do table.clear(item.key) end;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Spin (deg/s)", DisplayName = "Ring Spin (deg/s)", Description = "Slowly turn every enemy ring. Zero keeps them facing your camera.", Min = -180, Max = 180, Default = 0, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("spin", -180, 180)})
        toggle("labels", "Labels", "Show SPEC, EVAD, HP and ULT text on each enemy ring, in the same colours, the way your own ring shows yours.", true)
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Enemy Ring Text", DisplayName = "Ring Text", Description = "In Bar: text sits directly on its arc without a box. Label: a floating label above each arc. On Use: a label only while recharging. Off: no text.",
            Options = {"In Bar", "Label", "On Use", "Off"}, Default = "In Bar", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if value ~= "In Bar" and value ~= "Label" and value ~= "On Use" and value ~= "Off" then return false end;settings.labelMode = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Label Size", DisplayName = "Ring Label Size", Description = "Text size of the enemy ring labels.", Min = 8, Max = 24, Default = 11, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("labelSize", 8, 24)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Height Offset", DisplayName = "Ring Height Offset (studs)", Description = "Raise or lower every enemy ring from the ground.", Min = -2, Max = 6, Default = 0, Step = .01, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("lift", -2, 6)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Side Offset", DisplayName = "Ring Side Offset (studs)", Description = "Slide every enemy ring sideways, relative to your camera.", Min = -10, Max = 10, Default = 0, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("offsetX", -10, 10)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Depth Offset", DisplayName = "Ring Depth Offset (studs)", Description = "Slide every enemy ring away from (positive) or toward (negative) your camera.", Min = -10, Max = 10, Default = 0, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("offsetZ", -10, 10)})
        toggle("bloom", "Bloom", "Scene bloom while enemy rings are showing. It brightens other bright things too, and goes away when no ring shows.", false)
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Bloom Intensity", DisplayName = "Ring Bloom Intensity", Description = "Strength of the enemy ring bloom.", Min = 0, Max = 3, Default = .6, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("bloomIntensity", 0, 3)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Bloom Radius", DisplayName = "Ring Bloom Radius", Description = "Spread of the enemy ring bloom.", Min = 0, Max = 56, Default = 24, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("bloomSize", 0, 56)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Bloom Threshold", DisplayName = "Ring Bloom Threshold", Description = "How bright something must be to bloom. Lower blooms more of the scene.", Min = 0, Max = 3, Default = .9, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("bloomThreshold", 0, 3)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Enemy Ring Thickness", DisplayName = "Ring Thickness", Description = "Width of each ring segment.", Min = .1, Max = .8, Default = .22, Step = .02, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("thickness", .1, .8)})
        local function choice(key: string, name: string, display: string, description: string, options: {string}, default: string)
            tab:CreateDropdown({Name = name, DisplayName = display, Description = description, Options = options, Default = default, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
                Callback = function(value: any) if type(value) ~= "string" or not table.find(options, value) then return false end;settings[key] = value;for _, item in rings do table.clear(item.key) end;return true end})
        end
        local function number(key: string, name: string, display: string, description: string, low: number, high: number, default: number, step: number, precision: number)
            tab:CreateSlider({Name = name, DisplayName = display, Description = description, Min = low, Max = high, Default = default, Step = step, Precision = precision, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter(key, low, high)})
        end
        choice("outline", "Enemy Ring Outline", "Ring Outline", "The path the ring follows on the ground: a circle or a Triangle, Square, Diamond, Pentagon, Hexagon or Octagon.", {"Circle", "Triangle", "Square", "Diamond", "Pentagon", "Hexagon", "Octagon"}, "Circle")
        choice("orient", "Enemy Ring Orientation", "Ring Faces", "Camera: the ring stays square to your view. Enemy Facing: it turns with the enemy so one section is always at their front. World: it never turns.", {"Camera", "Enemy Facing", "World"}, "Camera")
        number("facing", "Enemy Ring Facing", "Ring Facing (deg)", "Turn the ring by a fixed angle so a chosen section points where you want it.", 0, 360, 0, 5, 0)
        local STATS = {"Health", "Evasive", "Special", "Ultimate", "Dash", "State", "M1", "Off"}
        for index, default in {"Health", "Evasive", "Special", "Ultimate", "Dash", "M1"} do
            tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Enemy Ring Section " .. index, DisplayName = "Ring Section " .. index, Description = "What this sixth of the ring shows. Health, Evasive, Special, Ultimate, Dash (their dash recovery), State (stun, ragdoll or knockdown time), M1 (how many M1s they have landed in their chain) or Off. Sections run clockwise from the back.", Options = STATS, Default = default, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
                Callback = function(value: any) if type(value) ~= "string" or not table.find(STATS, value) then return false end;settings.sections[index] = value;for _, item in rings do table.clear(item.key) end;return true end})
        end
        choice("innerStat", "Enemy Ring Inner Shows", "Inner Ring Shows", "A second, smaller circle inside the ring that shows any stat. Off hides it.", STATS, "Off")
        number("innerScale", "Enemy Ring Inner Size", "Inner Ring Size", "How big the inner circle is compared to the outer one.", .3, .9, .62, .02, 2)
        choice("model", "Enemy Ring Model", "Ring 3D Model", "A 3D hologram standing on each enemy ring: Orbit Orbs, Gyro Rings, Holo Column, Crystal, Cube Lattice, Helix, Dome or Spikes.", MODELS, "Off")
        choice("modelColorMode", "Enemy Ring Model Color Mode", "Model Color Mode", "Custom uses the colour below. Health goes red to green. Rainbow cycles. State takes the knockdown, stun or ragdoll colour while they have one.", {"Custom", "Health", "Rainbow", "State"}, "Custom")
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Enemy Ring Model Color", DisplayName = "Model Color", Description = "Colour of the 3D model in Custom mode.", Default = settings.modelColor, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value: any) if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) ~= "Color3" then return false end;settings.modelColor = value;return true end})
        number("modelSize", "Enemy Ring Model Size", "Model Size (%)", "Scale of the 3D model.", 40, 250, 100, 5, 0)
        number("modelHeight", "Enemy Ring Model Height", "Model Height Offset", "Raise or lower the model.", -2, 6, 0, .1, 1)
        number("modelOpacity", "Enemy Ring Model Opacity", "Model Opacity (%)", "How solid the model looks.", 10, 100, 60, 5, 0)
        number("modelSpin", "Enemy Ring Model Spin", "Model Spin (deg/s)", "Turn the whole model. Zero holds it still.", -360, 360, 0, 5, 0)
        number("modelAnim", "Enemy Ring Model Animation", "Model Animation Speed", "Speed of the model's own motion: orbiting, rising, tumbling. Zero freezes it.", 0, 4, 1, .1, 1)
        number("modelFacing", "Enemy Ring Model Facing", "Model Facing (deg)", "Turn the model by a fixed angle so it faces a chosen way.", 0, 360, 0, 5, 0)
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        clearMoves()
        table.clear(relativeFrames);relativeCount = 0
        if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection = nil end
        releaseRings()
        if folder then folder:Destroy();folder = nil end
        if bloomEffect then bloomEffect:Destroy();bloomEffect = nil end
        if menu.enemyRings == control then menu.enemyRings = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return EnemyRings
end)()

local HitStateFX = (function(): any
-- Data only: EnemyRings consumes state/dash progress. This service allocates
-- no visual instances and has no popup, burst, ring, shield or style controls.
local HitStateFX = {}
function HitStateFX.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local run=host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local world,C=host.workspace,host.Color3
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local settings: any={enabled=true,onlyMine=false,range=80,pollMs=200}
    local control: any={alive=true,settings=settings,errors=0}
    local KINDS: any = {
        ["UPPERCUT"] = {color = C.fromRGB(255, 205, 60), short = "UPPER"},
        ["KNOCKDOWN"] = {color = C.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), short = "DOWN"},
        ["TRUE RAGDOLL"] = {color = C.fromRGB(235, 70, 255), short = "T.RAG"},
        ["STUN"] = {color = C.fromRGB(160, 255, 70), short = "STUN"},
    }
    local learned: any = shared.__ShenaniganismStateTimes or {}
    shared.__ShenaniganismStateTimes = learned
    local dashLearn: any={}
    local episodes: any=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local dashes: any=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local connection: any=nil
    local pollAt=-math.huge
    local function finite(value: any): boolean return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
    local function flag(model: any, info: any, name: string): boolean
        local value = model:GetAttribute(name)
        return value == true or (type(value) == "number" and value > 0) or (info ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild(name) ~= nil)
    end
    local function detect(model: any, info: any): string?
        if flag(model, info, "TrueRagdoll") or flag(model, info, "CompleteRagdoll") then return "TRUE RAGDOLL" end
        if flag(model, info, "Ragdoll") or flag(model, info, "Knockback") then return "KNOCKDOWN" end
        if flag(model, info, "Stun") or flag(model, info, "TrueStun") then return "STUN" end
        return nil
    end
    local function swung(): boolean
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then return false end
        local okay, server = pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow, world)
        if okay and finite(server) then
            for _, name in {"LastM1", "LastM2"} do
                local at = tonumber(character:GetAttribute(name))
                if at and server - at < 1.2 and server - at > -.3 then return true end
            end
        end
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        return info ~= nil and (info:FindFirstChild("Melee") ~= nil or info:FindFirstChild("Attacking") ~= nil)
    end
    local function release(episode: any, now: number)
        local took = now - episode.startAt
        if took > .08 and took < 25 then
            local key = episode.kind
            learned[key] = if learned[key] then learned[key] * .6 + took * .4 else took
        end
    end
    local function resolve(episode: any, root: any, now: number): string
        if episode.base == "TRUE RAGDOLL" then return "TRUE RAGDOLL" end
        if episode.base == "STUN" then return "STUN" end
        if now - episode.startAt < .5 and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y > 20 then episode.up = true end
        return if episode.up then "UPPERCUT" else "KNOCKDOWN"
    end
    local function poll(now: number)
        local character = player.Character
        local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local characters = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not myRoot or not characters then return end
        local seen: any = {}
        for _, model in characters:GetChildren() do
            if model == character then continue end
            local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then continue end
            local distance = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if distance > 150 then continue end
            local info = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
            -- Dash recovery, the same way the info card reads it: the native DisableChase marker.
            local dash = dashes[model]
            if not dash then dash = {};dashes[model] = dash end
            local kit = tostring(model:GetAttribute("Moveset") or "?")
            local marker = info and info:FindFirstChild("DisableChase")
            if marker and not dash.at then dash.at = now
            elseif not marker and dash.at then
                local took = now - dash.at
                if took > .2 and took < 12 then dashLearn[kit] = if dashLearn[kit] then dashLearn[kit] * .6 + took * .4 else took end
                dash.at = nil
            end
            local base = detect(model, info)
            local episode = episodes[model]
            if base and distance <= settings.range then
                seen[model] = true
                if not episode then
                    local mine = distance < 32 and swung()
                    if mine or not settings.onlyMine then
                        episode = {model = model, root = root, base = base, startAt = now, mine = mine, kind = base}
                        episode.kind = resolve(episode, root, now)
                        episodes[model] = episode
                    end
                else
                    episode.base, episode.root = base, root
                    local kind = resolve(episode, root, now)
                    if kind ~= episode.kind then
                        episode.kind = kind
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for model, episode in episodes do
            if not seen[model] or not model.Parent then release(episode, now);episodes[model] = nil end
        end
    end
    connection=run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local okay,problem=pcall(function()
            if not control.alive or not settings.enabled or not player.Character or not world.CurrentCamera
                or(menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())then return end
            local now=clock()
            if now-pollAt>=settings.pollMs/1000 then pollAt=now;poll(now)end
        end)
        if not okay then
            control.errors+=1;control.lastError=tostring(problem)
            if control.errors==1 then warn("[Shenaniganism] Enemy state data error: "..control.lastError)end
        end
    end)
    -- For other modules: the enemy's current state, and how long until their dashes are back (fraction, seconds left).
    function control.stateOf(model: any): any
        local episode = episodes[model]
        if not episode or not episode.kind then return nil end
        local now = clock()
        local elapsed = now - episode.startAt
        local expected = learned[episode.kind]
        local kind = KINDS[episode.kind]
        return {kind = episode.kind, short = kind.short, color = kind.color, elapsed = elapsed,
            remaining = if expected then math.max(0, expected - elapsed) else nil,
            fraction = if expected then math.clamp(1 - elapsed / expected, 0, 1) else nil}
    end
    function control.dashOf(model: any): (number, number)
        local now = clock()
        local dash = dashes[model]
        local kit = tostring(model:GetAttribute("Moveset") or "?")
        local span = dashLearn[kit] or 2.2
        local left = 0
        if dash and dash.at then left = math.max(0, span - (now - dash.at)) end
        local feed = menu.threatFeed and menu.threatFeed.stateOf and menu.threatFeed.stateOf(model)
        if feed and feed.dashAt and feed.dashSide ~= "Front" then left = math.max(left, 2.2 - (now - feed.dashAt)) end
        return math.clamp(1 - left / span, 0, 1), math.max(left, 0)
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection=nil end
        table.clear(episodes);table.clear(dashes);table.clear(dashLearn)
        if menu.hitStateFX==control then menu.hitStateFX=nil end
    end
    return control
end
return HitStateFX
end)()

local DataEditor = (function(): any
-- Finds the game values you can change and edits them with a slider. Pick a source, press Scan, choose an entry,
-- then drag the slider or type an exact value. Hold keeps re-applying it, Reset puts it back. Only your own client
-- is changed, so anything the server decides (damage, cooldowns it checks) will not follow; use it to look
-- around, to test, and to find the value names that matter. Sources include your character, your markers, the
-- nearest enemy, your humanoid, your tools and the game's skill defaults.
local DataEditor = {}
DataEditor.sources = {"My Character Attributes", "My Info Markers", "My State Flags (no cancel/skill/dash, ragdoll)", "My Movement And Dash Data", "My Humanoid", "My Player Storage", "My Player Attributes", "My Tools", "Nearest Enemy Attributes", "Nearest Enemy Markers", "Nearest Enemy Movement And Dash", "Workspace Attributes", "Skill Defaults", "Game Items (ListData)", "Game Specials (ListData)", "Game Characters (ListData)", "Counter Data (me + nearest enemy)", "M1 And Block Data (me + nearest enemy)", "Downslam And Uppercut Data (me + nearest enemy)", "Ultimate And Cooldowns (all players)", "Dash Cooldowns (all players)", "All Data For All Players", "Search Everything"}
local STATE_FLAGS = {"Cancel", "Stun", "TrueStun", "IFrame", "NoM1", "NoSprint", "NoJump", "NoDash", "NoBlock", "NoParkour", "NoMass", "NoDeath", "DisableChase", "Block", "DirectionLock", "SpeedMultiplier", "JumpMultiplier", "DamageMultiplier", "HealthMultiplier", "KnockbackMultiplier", "Scale", "InSkill", "Wakeup", "Ragdoll", "TrueRagdoll", "Knockback", "InDash", "Dash", "Melee", "Attacking", "Stance"}
local NUMBER_FLAGS = {SpeedMultiplier = true, JumpMultiplier = true, DamageMultiplier = true, HealthMultiplier = true, KnockbackMultiplier = true, Scale = true, Ragdoll = true}
local MOVERS = {BodyVelocity = {"Velocity", "MaxForce", "P"}, BodyPosition = {"Position", "MaxForce", "P", "D"}, BodyGyro = {"MaxTorque", "P", "D"}, BodyForce = {"Force"},
    LinearVelocity = {"VectorVelocity", "MaxForce", "LineVelocity"}, VectorForce = {"Force"}, AlignPosition = {"MaxForce", "MaxVelocity", "Responsiveness"},
    AlignOrientation = {"MaxTorque", "Responsiveness"}, AngularVelocity = {"AngularVelocity", "MaxTorque"}, LinearVelocityConstraint = {}}
function DataEditor.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local world = host.workspace
    local settings: any = {source = "My Character Attributes", scale = "x1", hold = false}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, entries = {}}
    local entries: {any} = control.entries
    local selected: any = nil
    local connection: any = nil
    local HUMANOID = {"WalkSpeed", "JumpPower", "JumpHeight", "MaxHealth", "Health", "HipHeight", "MaxSlopeAngle", "AutoRotate"}
    local function widgetFor(name: string): any
        for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if entry.name == name or (entry.config and entry.config.Name == name) then
                local widget = entry.widget
                if widget then return widget end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function nearestEnemy(): any
        local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local characters = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if not root or not characters then return nil end
        local best, distance = nil, math.huge
        for _, model in characters:GetChildren() do
            local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if model ~= player.Character and other and (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < distance then best, distance = model, (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function describe(value: any): string
        if type(value) == "number" then return string.format("%.3f", value):gsub("%.?0+$", "") end
        return tostring(value)
    end
    local function add(label: string, get: any, set: any, kind: string)
        local okay, value = pcall(get)
        if not okay then return end
        table.insert(entries, {label = string.format("%s = %s", label, describe(value)), name = label, get = get, set = set, kind = kind, original = value})
    end
    local function attributes(container: any, prefix: string)
        if not container then return end
        local list = {}
        for key, value in container:GetAttributes() do
            if type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" or type(value) == "string" then table.insert(list, key) end
        end
        table.sort(list)
        for _, key in list do
            add(prefix .. key, function() return container:GetAttribute(key) end, function(value) container:SetAttribute(key, value) end, type(container:GetAttribute(key)))
        end
    end
    local function markers(folder: any, prefix: string)
        if not folder then return end
        local children = folder:GetChildren()
        table.sort(children, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
        for _, child in children do
            if child:IsA("ValueBase") then
                add(prefix .. child.Name, function() return child.Value end, function(value) child.Value = value end, type(child.Value))
            else
                add(prefix .. child.Name .. " (marker on)", function() return child.Parent == folder end, function(value)
                    if value == false and child.Parent then child.Parent = nil elseif value == true and not child.Parent then child.Parent = folder end
                end, "boolean")
            end
            attributes(child, prefix .. child.Name .. ".")
        end
    end
    -- A table from a game module, flattened to dotted names so every number, flag and text in it can be edited.
    local function tableEntries(data: any, prefix: string, depth: number)
        if type(data) ~= "table" or depth > 3 or #entries > 400 then return end
        local keys = {}
        for key in data do table.insert(keys, key) end
        table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
        for _, key in keys do
            local value = data[key]
            local name = prefix .. tostring(key)
            if type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" or type(value) == "string" then
                add(name, function() return data[key] end, function(newValue) data[key] = newValue end, type(value))
            elseif type(value) == "table" then tableEntries(value, name .. ".", depth + 1) end
            if #entries > 400 then return end
        end
    end
    local function moduleTable(name: string, field: string?): any
        local modules = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local module = modules and modules:FindFirstChild(name)
        local okay, data = pcall(function() return module and host.require(module) end)
        if not okay or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
        return if field then data[field] else data
    end
    local function movers(model: any, prefix: string)
        if not model then return end
        for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
            local props = MOVERS[object.ClassName]
            if props then
                for _, prop in props do
                    local okay, value = pcall(function() return (object :: any)[prop] end)
                    if okay and type(value) == "number" then
                        add(prefix .. object.Name .. "." .. prop, function() return (object :: any)[prop] end, function(newValue) (object :: any)[prop] = newValue end, "number")
                    elseif okay and (host.typeof or typeof)(value) == "Vector3" then
                        for _, axis in {"X", "Y", "Z"} do
                            add(prefix .. object.Name .. "." .. prop .. "." .. axis, function() return (object :: any)[prop][axis] end, function(newValue)
                                local current = (object :: any)[prop];
                                (object :: any)[prop] = host.Vector3.new(if axis == "X" then newValue else current.X, if axis == "Y" then newValue else current.Y, if axis == "Z" then newValue else current.Z)
                            end, "number")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            for _, axis in {"X", "Y", "Z"} do
                add(prefix .. "Root.Velocity." .. axis, function() return root.AssemblyLinearVelocity[axis] end, function(newValue)
                    local current = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = host.Vector3.new(if axis == "X" then newValue else current.X, if axis == "Y" then newValue else current.Y, if axis == "Z" then newValue else current.Z)
                end, "number")
            end
        end
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then for _, key in HUMANOID do add(prefix .. "Humanoid." .. key, function() return (humanoid :: any)[key] end, function(value) (humanoid :: any)[key] = value end, type((humanoid :: any)[key])) end end
    end
    -- Every state flag the game defines (no cancel / no skill / no dash / ragdoll and so on), on or off.
    local function stateFlags(model: any, prefix: string)
        if not model then return end
        local info = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
        for _, name in STATE_FLAGS do
            local numeric = NUMBER_FLAGS[name] == true
            add(prefix .. name, function()
                local child = info and info:FindFirstChild(name)
                if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then return child.Value end
                local attribute = model:GetAttribute(name)
                if attribute ~= nil then return attribute end
                if numeric then return 0 end
                return child ~= nil
            end, function(value)
                local child = info and info:FindFirstChild(name)
                if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then child.Value = value;return end
                if model:GetAttribute(name) ~= nil then model:SetAttribute(name, value);return end
                if numeric then
                    if child then child:Destroy() end
                    local created = Instance.new("NumberValue");created.Name, created.Value = name, tonumber(value) or 0;created.Parent = info
                elseif value == true and not child and info then
                    local created = Instance.new("BoolValue");created.Name, created.Value = name, true;created.Parent = info
                elseif value == false and child then child:Destroy() end
            end, if numeric then "number" else "boolean")
        end
    end
    local function storage(container: any, prefix: string)
        if not container then return end
        for _, object in container:GetDescendants() do
            if object:IsA("ValueBase") then
                add(prefix .. object:GetFullName():gsub("^.-%.", ""), function() return object.Value end, function(value) object.Value = value end, type(object.Value))
            end
            if #entries > 400 then return end
        end
        attributes(container, prefix)
    end
    function control.scan()
        table.clear(entries);selected = nil
        local source = settings.source
        local character = player.Character
        if source == "My State Flags (no cancel/skill/dash, ragdoll)" then stateFlags(character, "")
        elseif source == "My Movement And Dash Data" then movers(character, "")
        elseif source == "Nearest Enemy Movement And Dash" then
            local enemy = nearestEnemy()
            if enemy then movers(enemy, enemy.Name .. ".");stateFlags(enemy, enemy.Name .. ".") end
        elseif source == "My Player Storage" then
            storage(player, "")
            local pack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
            if pack then for _, tool in pack:GetChildren() do attributes(tool, "Backpack." .. tool.Name .. ".") end end
        elseif source == "Game Items (ListData)" then tableEntries(moduleTable("ListData", "Items"), "Items.", 0)
        elseif source == "Game Specials (ListData)" then tableEntries(moduleTable("ListData", "SpecialList"), "Special.", 0)
        elseif source == "Game Characters (ListData)" then tableEntries(moduleTable("ListData", "Characters"), "Characters.", 0)
        elseif source == "Counter Data (me + nearest enemy)" then
            for _, holder in {character, nearestEnemy()} do
                if holder then
                    local info = holder:FindFirstChild("Info")
                    local before = #entries
                    attributes(holder, holder.Name .. ".")
                    markers(info, holder.Name .. ".")
                    for index = #entries, before + 1, -1 do
                        local lower = entries[index].name:lower()
                        if not (lower:find("counter") or lower:find("adapt") or lower:find("iframe") or lower:find("cancel") or lower:find("block") or lower:find("perfect") or lower:find("parry") or lower:find("reversal")) then table.remove(entries, index) end
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif source == "M1 And Block Data (me + nearest enemy)" or source == "Downslam And Uppercut Data (me + nearest enemy)" then
            local words = if source:find("M1", 1, true) then {"m1", "melee", "block", "attack", "swing", "chase", "combo", "stance", "parry", "perfect", "m2", "sword"}
                else {"up", "down", "chase", "knock", "launch", "air", "slam", "ragdoll", "stun", "wakeup", "fall", "lift"}
            for _, holder in {character, nearestEnemy()} do
                if holder then
                    local before = #entries
                    attributes(holder, holder.Name .. ".")
                    markers(holder:FindFirstChild("Info"), holder.Name .. ".")
                    stateFlags(holder, holder.Name .. ".")
                    for index = #entries, before + 1, -1 do
                        local lower = entries[index].name:lower()
                        local keep = false
                        for _, word in words do if lower:find(word, 1, true) then keep = true;break end end
                        if not keep then table.remove(entries, index) end
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif source == "Ultimate And Cooldowns (all players)" or source == "Dash Cooldowns (all players)" then
            local dash = source:find("Dash", 1, true) ~= nil
            local words = if dash then {"evade", "chase", "dash", "disablechase", "movement", "swing"} else {"ult", "m2_cd", "lastm2", "cooldown", "readyat", "lastuse", "special", "energy", "meter"}
            for _, other in players:GetPlayers() do
                local prefix = other.Name .. "."
                local before = #entries
                attributes(other, prefix)
                if other.Character then
                    attributes(other.Character, prefix)
                    markers(other.Character:FindFirstChild("Info"), prefix)
                    for _, tool in other.Character:GetChildren() do if tool:IsA("Tool") or tool:IsA("ValueBase") then attributes(tool, prefix .. tool.Name .. ".") end end
                end
                local pack = other:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                if pack then for _, tool in pack:GetChildren() do attributes(tool, prefix .. "Bag." .. tool.Name .. ".") end end
                for index = #entries, before + 1, -1 do
                    local lower = entries[index].name:lower()
                    local keep = false
                    for _, word in words do if lower:find(word, 1, true) then keep = true;break end end
                    if not keep then table.remove(entries, index) end
                end
            end
        elseif source == "All Data For All Players" then
            local query = (settings.query or ""):lower()
            for _, other in players:GetPlayers() do
                local prefix = other.Name .. "."
                attributes(other, prefix);storage(other, prefix .. "Storage.")
                local pack = other:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                if pack then for _, tool in pack:GetChildren() do attributes(tool, prefix .. "Bag." .. tool.Name .. ".") end end
                if other.Character then
                    attributes(other.Character, prefix);markers(other.Character:FindFirstChild("Info"), prefix)
                    stateFlags(other.Character, prefix);movers(other.Character, prefix)
                    for _, tool in other.Character:GetChildren() do if tool:IsA("Tool") or tool:IsA("ValueBase") then attributes(tool, prefix .. tool.Name .. ".") end end
                end
            end
            if query ~= "" then for index = #entries, 1, -1 do if not entries[index].name:lower():find(query, 1, true) then table.remove(entries, index) end end end
            while #entries > 900 do table.remove(entries) end
        elseif source == "Search Everything" then
            local query = (settings.query or ""):lower()
            local enemy = nearestEnemy()
            attributes(character, "Me.");markers(character and character:FindFirstChild("Info"), "Me.");stateFlags(character, "Me.");movers(character, "Me.")
            attributes(player, "Player.");storage(player, "Storage.")
            if enemy then attributes(enemy, "Enemy.");markers(enemy:FindFirstChild("Info"), "Enemy.");movers(enemy, "Enemy.") end
            attributes(world, "Workspace.")
            tableEntries(moduleTable("SkillDefault", "defaultProp"), "SkillDefault.", 0)
            tableEntries(moduleTable("ListData", "SpecialList"), "Special.", 0)
            if query ~= "" then for index = #entries, 1, -1 do if not entries[index].name:lower():find(query, 1, true) then table.remove(entries, index) end end end
        elseif source == "My Character Attributes" then attributes(character, "")
        elseif source == "My Info Markers" then markers(character and character:FindFirstChild("Info"), "")
        elseif source == "My Humanoid" then
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then for _, key in HUMANOID do add(key, function() return (humanoid :: any)[key] end, function(value) (humanoid :: any)[key] = value end, type((humanoid :: any)[key])) end end
        elseif source == "My Player Attributes" then attributes(player, "")
        elseif source == "My Tools" then
            for _, holder in {character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")} do
                if holder then for _, tool in holder:GetChildren() do
                    if tool:IsA("Tool") or tool:IsA("ValueBase") then attributes(tool, tool.Name .. ".") end
                end end
            end
        elseif source == "Nearest Enemy Attributes" then
            local enemy = nearestEnemy()
            if enemy then attributes(enemy, enemy.Name .. ".") end
        elseif source == "Nearest Enemy Markers" then
            local enemy = nearestEnemy()
            if enemy then markers(enemy:FindFirstChild("Info"), enemy.Name .. ".") end
        elseif source == "Workspace Attributes" then attributes(world, "")
        elseif source == "Skill Defaults" then
            local modules = host.game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Modules")
            local module = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("SkillDefault")
            local okay, data = pcall(function() return module and host.require(module) end)
            local props = okay and type(data) == "table" and data.defaultProp
            if type(props) == "table" then
                local keys = {}
                for key in props do table.insert(keys, key) end
                table.sort(keys)
                for _, key in keys do add(tostring(key), function() return props[key] end, function(value) props[key] = value end, type(props[key])) end
            end
        end
        local labels = {}
        for _, entry in entries do table.insert(labels, entry.label) end
        if #labels == 0 then labels = {"(nothing found; press Scan again)"} end
        local dropdown = widgetFor("Data Entry")
        if dropdown and dropdown.SetOptions then pcall(dropdown.SetOptions, labels) end
        if dropdown and dropdown.Set then pcall(dropdown.Set, labels[1], false) end
        control.select(entries[1])
        return #entries
    end
    function control.select(entry: any)
        selected = entry
        local note = widgetFor("Data Editor Status")
        if note and note.Set then
            pcall(note.Set, if entry then string.format("%s   |   now %s   |   was %s", entry.name, describe(entry.get()), describe(entry.original)) else "Nothing selected")
        end
        if entry and type(entry.get()) == "number" then
            local slider = widgetFor("Data Editor Value")
            local scale = ({x1 = 1, x10 = 10, x100 = 100, x1000 = 1000})[settings.scale] or 1
            if slider and slider.Set then pcall(slider.Set, math.clamp(entry.get() / scale, -1000, 1000), false) end
        end
    end
    local function apply(value: any): boolean
        if not selected then return false end
        local kind = selected.kind
        local converted = value
        if kind == "number" then converted = tonumber(value)
        elseif kind == "boolean" then converted = (value == true) or (type(value) == "number" and value > 0) or tostring(value):lower() == "true"
        else converted = tostring(value) end
        if converted == nil then return false end
        local okay = pcall(selected.set, converted)
        if okay then
            selected.held = converted
            control.select(selected)
        end
        return okay
    end
    connection = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if settings.hold and selected and selected.held ~= nil then pcall(selected.set, selected.held) end
    end)
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Data Source", DisplayName = "Data Source", Description = "Where to look for editable values. Press Scan Data after changing it.", Options = DataEditor.sources, Default = DataEditor.sources[1], QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value: any) if type(value) ~= "string" or not table.find(DataEditor.sources, value) then return false end;settings.source = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateInput({Name = "Data Search Text", DisplayName = "Search Text", Description = "For the Search Everything source: only values whose name contains this text are listed. Try dash, ragdoll, cancel, counter, cooldown, speed.", Default = "",
            Callback = function(value: any) settings.query = tostring(value or "");return true end})
        tab:CreateButton({Name = "Scan Data", DisplayName = "Scan Data", Description = "Read every editable value in the chosen source into the Data Entry list.", ButtonText = "Scan",
            Callback = function() local count = control.scan();print("[Shenaniganism] Data Editor found " .. tostring(count) .. " values");return true end})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Data Entry", DisplayName = "Data Entry", Description = "The value to edit, with what it is right now.", Options = {"(press Scan Data)"}, Default = "(press Scan Data)", NoConfig = true,
            Callback = function(value: any)
                for _, entry in entries do if entry.label == value then control.select(entry);return true end end
                return false
            end})
        tab:CreateParagraph({Name = "Data Editor Status", DisplayName = "Selected Value", Content = "Nothing selected"})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Data Editor Value", DisplayName = "Value Slider", Description = "Drag to set the selected number. Booleans turn on above zero. Use Slider Scale for big numbers, or type an exact value below.", Min = -1000, Max = 1000, Default = 0, Step = .05, Precision = 2,
            Callback = function(value: any)
                local scale = ({x1 = 1, x10 = 10, x100 = 100, x1000 = 1000})[settings.scale] or 1
                local amount = tonumber(value)
                if not amount then return false end
                return apply(amount * scale)
            end})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Data Editor Scale", DisplayName = "Slider Scale", Description = "Multiplies the slider, so it can reach bigger numbers.", Options = {"x1", "x10", "x100", "x1000"}, Default = "x1", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value: any) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.scale = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateInput({Name = "Data Editor Exact", DisplayName = "Exact Value", Description = "Type a number, true/false or text and press Enter to set the selected value exactly.", Default = "",
            Callback = function(value: any) if value == nil or value == "" then return false end;return apply(value) end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Data Editor Hold", DisplayName = "Hold Value", Description = "Keep re-applying the value you set, so the game cannot change it back on your client.", Default = false,
            Callback = function(value: any) settings.hold = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateButton({Name = "Data Editor Reset", DisplayName = "Reset Selected Value", Description = "Put the selected value back to what it was when scanned.", ButtonText = "Reset",
            Callback = function()
                if not selected then return false end
                pcall(selected.set, selected.original);selected.held = nil;control.select(selected);return true
            end})
        tab:CreateButton({Name = "Data Editor Print", DisplayName = "Print All To Console", Description = "Print every scanned value to the console, so you can search for the one you want.", ButtonText = "Print",
            Callback = function()
                for _, entry in entries do print("[Shenaniganism] DATA " .. entry.label) end
                return true
            end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection = nil end
        if menu.dataEditor == control then menu.dataEditor = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return DataEditor
end)()

local MenuSkin = (function(): any
-- The menu's look, fully adjustable and presentation-only. Every value, key and saved setting stays as it was;
-- this adds corners, outlines, a drop shadow, a window glow, brightness, row icons, hover descriptions, slider
-- and checkbox styles, rail and content transparency, and accent presets. Classic removes all of it.
local MenuSkin = {}
MenuSkin.styles = {"Modern Glass", "Modern Flat", "Soft Round", "Classic"}
MenuSkin.fonts = {"Gotham", "Gotham Medium", "Builder Sans", "Montserrat", "Bloxy (Cartoon)"}
local FONT_NAMES: any = {["Gotham"] = "Gotham", ["Gotham Medium"] = "GothamMedium", ["Builder Sans"] = "BuilderSans", ["Montserrat"] = "Montserrat", ["Bloxy (Cartoon)"] = "Cartoon"}
local LOOKS: any = {
    ["Modern Glass"] = {radius = 12, outline = true, outlineAlpha = .72},
    ["Modern Flat"] = {radius = 8, outline = false, outlineAlpha = 1},
    ["Soft Round"] = {radius = 18, outline = true, outlineAlpha = .85},
}
local ACCENTS: any = {
    ["Ice"] = {150, 190, 255}, ["Mint"] = {110, 230, 190}, ["Amber"] = {255, 190, 90}, ["Rose"] = {255, 130, 170}, ["Violet"] = {180, 150, 255},
    ["Lime"] = {170, 235, 90}, ["Coral"] = {255, 130, 100}, ["Cyan"] = {80, 215, 235}, ["White"] = {240, 244, 250}, ["Gold"] = {255, 215, 90},
}
local FONT_CHOICES = {"Gotham", "Gotham Medium", "Gotham Semibold", "Gotham Bold", "Gotham Black", "Source Sans", "Source Sans Light", "Source Sans Bold",
    "Ubuntu", "Roboto", "Roboto Mono", "Code", "Nunito", "Michroma", "Oswald", "Highway", "Arcade", "Fredoka", "Sci-Fi", "Bloxy (Cartoon)"}
local FONT_ENUM: any = {["Gotham"] = "Gotham", ["Gotham Medium"] = "GothamMedium", ["Gotham Semibold"] = "GothamSemibold", ["Gotham Bold"] = "GothamBold", ["Gotham Black"] = "GothamBlack",
    ["Source Sans"] = "SourceSans", ["Source Sans Light"] = "SourceSansLight", ["Source Sans Bold"] = "SourceSansBold", ["Ubuntu"] = "Ubuntu", ["Roboto"] = "Roboto", ["Roboto Mono"] = "RobotoMono",
    ["Code"] = "Code", ["Nunito"] = "Nunito", ["Michroma"] = "Michroma", ["Oswald"] = "Oswald", ["Highway"] = "Highway", ["Arcade"] = "Arcade", ["Fredoka"] = "FredokaOne", ["Sci-Fi"] = "SciFi",
    ["Bloxy (Cartoon)"] = "Cartoon"}
local ROLES = {{"title", "Row Title"}, {"desc", "Row Description"}, {"tab", "Tab Name"}, {"button", "Button And Dropdown"}, {"value", "Slider Value"}, {"other", "Other Text"}}
local ACCENT_NAMES = {"Ice", "Mint", "Amber", "Rose", "Violet", "Lime", "Coral", "Cyan", "White", "Gold"}
local ICONS: any = {
    {{"block", "guard", "perfect"}, "🛡"}, {{"aim", "target", "lock", "fov", "cursor"}, "🎯"}, {{"dash", "dodge", "evad"}, "💨"}, {{"health", "hp"}, "❤"},
    {{"ult"}, "⚡"}, {{"special", "spec"}, "✦"}, {{"m1", "melee", "punch", "attack", "combo", "counter"}, "👊"}, {{"skill", "move", "variant"}, "✨"},
    {{"stun", "ragdoll", "knockback"}, "💫"}, {{"camera", "view", "zoom"}, "🎥"}, {{"cooldown", "timer", "delay", "speed", "timing"}, "⏱"},
    {{"esp", "card", "hud", "ring", "outline", "cham", "glow", "bloom", "box", "info", "enemy"}, "👁"}, {{"color", "transparency", "opacity", "theme", "accent", "shadow", "brightness"}, "🎨"},
    {{"sound", "audio", "volume", "music"}, "🔊"}, {{"config", "save", "load", "import", "export"}, "💾"}, {{"jump", "parkour", "movement", "sprint", "run", "walk"}, "🏃"},
    {{"toji", "sword", "weapon"}, "🗡"}, {{"menu", "gui", "layout", "font", "tab", "rail", "row"}, "🖥"}, {{"live", "data", "scan", "log"}, "📊"}, {{"auto"}, "⚙"},
}
local function iconFor(name: string): string
    local lower = name:lower()
    for _, entry in ICONS do
        for _, word in entry[1] do if lower:find(word, 1, true) then return entry[2] end end
    end
    return "•"
end
function MenuSkin.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local E, Inst, C, U = host.Enum, host.Instance, host.Color3, host.UDim2
    local settings: any = {style = "Classic", font = "Gotham Medium", radius = 12, outline = true, rowStyle = "Rounded", rowBar = false,
        rowIcons = true, descriptions = "Always", rowHeight = 63, toggleStyle = "Pill", sliderStyle = "Thin", shadow = 35, shadowSize = 18, glow = 0, brightness = 0,
        windowAlpha = nil, rowAlpha = nil, hover = true,
        roleStyle = {title = {}, desc = {}, tab = {}, button = {}, value = {}, other = {}},
        roleFont = {}, roleSize = {title = 100, desc = 100, tab = 100, button = 100, value = 100, other = 100}, roleColor = {}, roleAlpha = {}, useTextColors = false,
        fxMode = "Original", fxColor = nil, fxAlpha = .5, textAlpha = nil, boxAlpha = nil, outlineWidth = 1, outlineAlpha = nil, outlineColor = nil}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, applied = 0}
    local connections: {any} = {}
    local pending: any = {}
    local tipRow: any = nil
    local tipText = ""
    local function accent(root: any): any
        local line = root:FindFirstChild("TabAccentLine", true)
        return if line then line.BackgroundColor3 else C.fromRGB(110, 150, 200)
    end
    local function decor(object: any, className: string, name: string): any
        local item = object:FindFirstChild(name)
        if item and item.ClassName == className then return item end
        item = Inst.new(className)
        item.Name = name;item:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismSkin", true)
        item.Parent = object
        return item
    end
    local function gridIsList(): boolean
        local grid = menu.menuGrid
        return grid == nil or grid.settings == nil or grid.settings.mode == "List"
    end
    local function setY(object: any, y: number)
        local position = object.Position
        object.Position = U.new(position.X.Scale, position.X.Offset, 0, y)
    end
    -- Row geometry: only touched when you ask for a different height or hidden descriptions.
    local widgetByRow: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local widgetCount = -1
    local function widgetOf(row: any): any
        local panel = menu.panel
        local list = panel and panel.Controls
        if not list then return nil end
        if #list ~= widgetCount then
            widgetCount = #list
            for _, widget in list do if widget.Row then widgetByRow[widget.Row] = widget end end
        end
        return widgetByRow[row]
    end
    -- Each slider shows a small mark where the script's own default sits; right-click the bar to put it back.
    local function markDefault(row: any, track: any, root: any)
        local widget = widgetOf(row)
        local config = widget and widget.Config
        if not config or widget.Kind ~= "CreateSlider" or type(config.Default) ~= "number" then return end
        local minimum, maximum = tonumber(config.Min) or 0, tonumber(config.Max) or 100
        if maximum <= minimum then return end
        local mark = decor(track, "Frame", "SkinDefault")
        mark.BorderSizePixel = 0
        mark.AnchorPoint, mark.Size = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), U.fromOffset(2, 12)
