        mark.Position = U.new(math.clamp((config.Default - minimum) / (maximum - minimum), 0, 1), 0, .5, 0)
        mark.BackgroundColor3, mark.BackgroundTransparency, mark.ZIndex = accent(root), .35, track.ZIndex + 3
        if not track:GetAttribute("SkinResetHook") then
            track:SetAttribute("SkinResetHook", true)
            table.insert(connections, track.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject: any)
                if inputObject.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and widget.Set then pcall(widget.Set, config.Default, true) end
            end))
        end
    end
    local function styleRow(object: any, root: any)
        local heading = object:FindFirstChild("Name")
        local description = object:FindFirstChild("Description")
        local custom = gridIsList() and (settings.rowHeight ~= 63 or settings.descriptions ~= "Always")
        local height = if custom then settings.rowHeight else 63
        if gridIsList() then
            if object.Size.Y.Offset ~= height then object.Size = U.new(object.Size.X.Scale, object.Size.X.Offset, 0, height) end
            local hideText = settings.descriptions ~= "Always"
            if description then description.Visible = not hideText end
            if heading then
                setY(heading, if hideText then math.max(2, (height - heading.Size.Y.Offset) / 2) else 5)
            end
            for _, child in object:GetChildren() do
                local kind = child:GetAttribute("WidgetType")
                if kind == "ToggleSwitch" then setY(child, if custom then (height - child.Size.Y.Offset) / 2 else 8)
                elseif kind == "ActionButton" or kind == "InputBox" then setY(child, if custom then (height - 27) / 2 else 6)
                elseif kind == "SliderTrack" then
                    local thick = if settings.sliderStyle == "Thick" then 14 elseif settings.sliderStyle == "Segmented" then 11 else 7
                    markDefault(object, child, root)
                    child.Size = U.new(child.Size.X.Scale, child.Size.X.Offset, 0, thick)
                    setY(child, if custom then height / 2 - thick / 2 else 17.5 - thick / 2)
                    local knob = child:FindFirstChild("SkinKnob")
                    if knob then knob.Visible = settings.sliderStyle == "Knob" end
                elseif kind == "DropdownList" then setY(child, if custom then (height - 27) / 2 + 31 else 37) end
            end
        end
        -- Icon: kept inside its own holder, because the menu rewrites the text of any label placed straight in a row.
        local labelText = if heading then (heading:GetAttribute("SkinRaw") or heading.Text) else object.Name
        local holder = decor(object, "Frame", "SkinIconHolder")
        holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        holder.Position, holder.Size = U.fromOffset(8, (height - 24) / 2), U.fromOffset(26, 24)
        holder.ZIndex = object.ZIndex + 1
        holder.Visible = settings.rowIcons and gridIsList()
        local legacy = object:FindFirstChild("SkinIcon")
        if legacy then legacy:Destroy() end
        local icon = decor(holder, "TextLabel", "SkinIcon")
        icon.BackgroundTransparency, icon.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        icon.Font, icon.TextSize, icon.Text = E.Font.GothamMedium, 17, iconFor(labelText)
        icon.TextColor3 = accent(root)
        icon.Position, icon.Size, icon.ZIndex = U.fromOffset(0, 0), U.fromScale(1, 1), holder.ZIndex + 1
        -- Make room with padding, which the row layout never touches.
        for _, textLabel in {heading, description} do
            if textLabel then
                local pad = decor(textLabel, "UIPadding", "SkinPad")
                pad.PaddingLeft = host.UDim.new(0, if holder.Visible then 30 else 0)
            end
        end
        -- Hover description
        if not object:GetAttribute("SkinHover") then
            object:SetAttribute("SkinHover", true)
            table.insert(connections, object.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                tipRow = object
                local d = object:FindFirstChild("Description")
                tipText = if d then d.Text else ""
            end))
            table.insert(connections, object.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if tipRow == object then tipRow = nil end end))
        end
        if settings.rowAlpha ~= nil then object.BackgroundTransparency = settings.rowAlpha / 100 end
    end
    local function styleToggle(object: any, round: any)
        local knob = object:FindFirstChild("Knob")
        local mark = decor(object, "TextLabel", "SkinCheck")
        mark.BackgroundTransparency, mark.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        mark.Size, mark.Font, mark.TextSize, mark.Text = U.fromScale(1, 1), E.Font.GothamBold, 16, "✓"
        mark.TextColor3 = C.new(1, 1, 1)
        local style = settings.toggleStyle
        local position = object.Position
        if style == "Checkbox" then
            object.Size = U.fromOffset(24, 24)
            object.Position = U.new(position.X.Scale, -38, position.Y.Scale, position.Y.Offset)
            round(7)
            if knob then knob.Visible = false end
            mark.Visible = true
            local function refresh() if knob then mark.TextTransparency = if knob.Position.X.Offset > 10 then 0 else 1 end end
            refresh()
            if knob and not object:GetAttribute("SkinCheckHook") then
                object:SetAttribute("SkinCheckHook", true)
                table.insert(connections, knob:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(refresh))
            end
        elseif style == "Bracket" then
            object.Size = U.fromOffset(54, 24)
            object.Position = U.new(position.X.Scale, -68, position.Y.Scale, position.Y.Offset)
            round(0)
            if knob then knob.Visible = false end
            mark.Visible = false
            object.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            object.Font = E.Font.Code;object.TextSize = 13
            local function refresh()
                local on = knob ~= nil and knob.Position.X.Offset > 10
                object.Text = if on then "[ON]" else "[OFF]"
                object.TextColor3 = if on then accent(object.Parent or object) else C.fromRGB(120, 130, 150)
            end
            refresh()
            if knob and not object:GetAttribute("SkinBracketHook") then
                object:SetAttribute("SkinBracketHook", true)
                table.insert(connections, knob:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(refresh))
            end
        else
            if object.Text ~= "" then object.Text = "";object.BackgroundTransparency = 0 end
            object.Size = U.fromOffset(44, 24)
            object.Position = U.new(position.X.Scale, -58, position.Y.Scale, position.Y.Offset)
            round(if style == "Square Switch" then 5 else 999)
            if knob then
                knob.Visible = true
                local corner = decor(knob, "UICorner", "SkinCorner")
                corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, if style == "Square Switch" then 3 else 999)
            end
            mark.Visible = false
        end
    end
    local function styleSliderFill(object: any, root: any)
        local track = object.Parent
        if not track then return end
        local knob = decor(track, "Frame", "SkinKnob")
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.AnchorPoint, knob.Size = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), U.fromOffset(16, 16)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = C.new(1, 1, 1)
        knob.ZIndex = object.ZIndex + 2
        local corner = decor(knob, "UICorner", "SkinCorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 999)
        local stroke = decor(knob, "UIStroke", "SkinStroke")
        stroke.Color, stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency = accent(root), 2, 0
        knob.Visible = settings.sliderStyle == "Knob"
        local segmented = settings.sliderStyle == "Segmented"
        object.BackgroundTransparency = if segmented then 1 else 0
        track.BackgroundTransparency = if segmented then 1 else 0
        local segments = {}
        for index = 1, 10 do
            local segment = decor(track, "Frame", "SkinSeg" .. index)
            segment.BorderSizePixel = 0
            segment.Position, segment.Size = U.new((index - 1) / 10, 2, 0, 0), U.new(.1, -4, 1, 0)
            segment.ZIndex = object.ZIndex + 1;segment.Visible = segmented
            local segmentCorner = decor(segment, "UICorner", "SkinCorner")
            segmentCorner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 2)
            segments[index] = segment
        end
        local function place()
            local fraction = math.clamp(object.Size.X.Scale, 0, 1)
            knob.Position = U.new(fraction, 0, .5, 0)
            if segmented then
                for index, segment in segments do
                    segment.BackgroundColor3 = if (index - .5) / 10 <= fraction then accent(root) else C.fromRGB(44, 52, 70)
                end
            end
        end
        place()
        if not object:GetAttribute("SkinKnobHook") then
            object:SetAttribute("SkinKnobHook", true)
            table.insert(connections, object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(place))
        end
    end
    local function roleOf(object: any): string
        local name, kind = object.Name, object:GetAttribute("WidgetType")
        if name == "Name" then return "title" elseif name == "Description" then return "desc"
        elseif name == "RailName" or kind == "TabButton" then return "tab"
        elseif name == "Value" then return "value"
        elseif kind == "ActionButton" or kind == "InputBox" or kind == "DropdownOption" or name == "DropdownButton" or name == "Control" then return "button" end
        return "other"
    end
    local WEIGHTS = {"Default", "Thin", "ExtraLight", "Light", "Regular", "Medium", "SemiBold", "Bold", "ExtraBold", "Heavy"}
    local function escapeRich(text: string): string
        return (text:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
    end
    local function wrapText(raw: string, style: any): string
        local out = escapeRich(if style.upper then raw:upper() else raw)
        if style.underline then out = "<u>" .. out .. "</u>" end
        if style.strike then out = "<s>" .. out .. "</s>" end
        if style.highlight then
            local c = style.highlightColor or C.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
            out = string.format('<mark color="#%02X%02X%02X" transparency="%.2f">%s</mark>', math.round(c.R * 255), math.round(c.G * 255), math.round(c.B * 255), style.highlightAlpha or .55, out)
        end
        return out
    end
    local function styleDecorations(object: any, role: string)
        local style = settings.roleStyle[role]
        local wanted = style ~= nil and (style.underline or style.strike or style.highlight or style.upper)
        if wanted and object.Name ~= "SkinIcon" then
            if object:GetAttribute("SkinRaw") == nil then
                if object.RichText then return end
                object:SetAttribute("SkinRaw", object.Text)
            end
            object.RichText = true
            if not object:GetAttribute("SkinDecoHook") then
                object:SetAttribute("SkinDecoHook", true)
                table.insert(connections, object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                    if object:GetAttribute("SkinRaw") == nil or object.Text == object:GetAttribute("SkinWrapped") then return end
                    object:SetAttribute("SkinRaw", object.Text)
                    local current = settings.roleStyle[roleOf(object)]
                    if current then
                        local wrapped = wrapText(object.Text, current)
                        object:SetAttribute("SkinWrapped", wrapped);object.Text = wrapped
                    end
                end))
            end
            local wrapped = wrapText(object:GetAttribute("SkinRaw"), style)
            if object.Text ~= wrapped then object:SetAttribute("SkinWrapped", wrapped);object.Text = wrapped end
        elseif object:GetAttribute("SkinRaw") ~= nil then
            local raw = object:GetAttribute("SkinRaw")
            object:SetAttribute("SkinWrapped", raw);object.Text = raw;object.RichText = false
            object:SetAttribute("SkinRaw", nil)
        end
    end
    local function styleText(object: any, root: any, look: any)
        -- Text drawn with the game's own font files (icon fonts, drag handles) is left exactly as it is.
        if object.Name == "ReorderHandle" or object.Name == "SectionReorderSurface" then return end
        if look == nil then
            local original = object:GetAttribute("SkinFont")
            if original then pcall(function() object.Font = E.Font[original] end);object:SetAttribute("SkinFont", nil) end
            return
        end
        local role = roleOf(object)
        local want = FONT_ENUM[settings.roleFont[role] or ""] or FONT_NAMES[settings.font] or "GothamMedium"
        if not object:GetAttribute("SkinFont") then object:SetAttribute("SkinFont", object.Font.Name) end
        local fontStyle = settings.roleStyle[role]
        if fontStyle and (fontStyle.weight ~= nil or fontStyle.italic) then
            -- Weight and italic come from the font family's own faces.
            local key = want .. "|" .. tostring(fontStyle.weight) .. "|" .. tostring(fontStyle.italic)
            if object:GetAttribute("SkinFace") ~= key then
                pcall(function()
                    local FontClass = host.Font or Font
                    local base = FontClass.fromEnum(E.Font[want])
                    object.FontFace = FontClass.new(base.Family, if fontStyle.weight then E.FontWeight[fontStyle.weight] else base.Weight, if fontStyle.italic then E.FontStyle.Italic else E.FontStyle.Normal)
                end)
                object:SetAttribute("SkinFace", key)
            end
        else
            if object:GetAttribute("SkinFace") ~= nil then object:SetAttribute("SkinFace", nil);pcall(function() object.Font = E.Font[want] end) end
            if object.Font.Name ~= want then pcall(function() object.Font = E.Font[want] end) end
        end
        styleDecorations(object, role)
        -- Size per part of the menu.
        local scalePercent = settings.roleSize[role] or 100
        local applied = object:GetAttribute("SkinSize")
        if scalePercent ~= 100 or applied ~= nil then
            if applied == nil or object.TextSize ~= applied then object:SetAttribute("SkinBase", object.TextSize) end
            local base = object:GetAttribute("SkinBase") or object.TextSize
            local size = math.max(8, math.floor(base * scalePercent / 100 + .5))
            if object.TextSize ~= size then object.TextSize = size end
            object:SetAttribute("SkinSize", size)
        end
        -- Colour per part (only when custom text colours are on).
        if settings.useTextColors and settings.roleColor[role] then
            if object:GetAttribute("SkinColor") == nil then object:SetAttribute("SkinColor", object.TextColor3) end
            object.TextColor3 = settings.roleColor[role]
        elseif object:GetAttribute("SkinColor") ~= nil then
            object.TextColor3 = object:GetAttribute("SkinColor");object:SetAttribute("SkinColor", nil)
        end
        local alpha = settings.roleAlpha[role] or settings.textAlpha
        if alpha ~= nil then
            if object:GetAttribute("SkinAlpha") == nil then object:SetAttribute("SkinAlpha", object.TextTransparency) end
            object.TextTransparency = alpha
        elseif object:GetAttribute("SkinAlpha") ~= nil then
            object.TextTransparency = object:GetAttribute("SkinAlpha");object:SetAttribute("SkinAlpha", nil)
        end
        -- Depth: a shadow, an accent glow or an outline around the letters.
        local mode = settings.fxMode
        if mode ~= "Original" then
            if mode == "None" then object.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            else
                object.TextStrokeTransparency = settings.fxAlpha
                object.TextStrokeColor3 = if mode == "Shadow" then C.new(0, 0, 0) elseif mode == "Glow" then accent(root) else (settings.fxColor or C.new(0, 0, 0))
            end
        end
    end
    local function skin(object: any, root: any)
        local look = LOOKS[settings.style]
        if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
            if not object:GetAttribute("ShenaniganismSkin") or object.Name == "SkinIcon" then styleText(object, root, look) end
        end
        if not object:GetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned") then return end
        if look == nil then
            for _, child in object:GetChildren() do if child:GetAttribute("ShenaniganismSkin") then child:Destroy() end end
            return
        end
        local radius = settings.radius
        local kind = object:GetAttribute("WidgetType")
        local function round(amount: number)
            local corner = decor(object, "UICorner", "SkinCorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, amount)
        end
        local function outline(alpha: number, thickness: number)
            local stroke = decor(object, "UIStroke", "SkinStroke")
            stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = E.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            stroke.Color = settings.outlineColor or accent(root)
            stroke.Thickness = if thickness <= 1.2 then settings.outlineWidth else thickness
            stroke.Transparency = if thickness <= 1.2 and settings.outlineAlpha ~= nil then settings.outlineAlpha else alpha
            stroke.Enabled = settings.outline
        end
        if settings.boxAlpha ~= nil and (kind == "ActionButton" or kind == "InputBox" or kind == "DropdownList" or kind == "Row" or kind == "DropdownOption") then
            object.BackgroundTransparency = settings.boxAlpha / 100
        end
        local name = object.Name
        if name == "FeatureSearchResults" then
            round(radius);outline(look.outlineAlpha + .1, 1)
            local pad = decor(object, "UIPadding", "SkinPad")
            pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight, pad.PaddingTop, pad.PaddingBottom = host.UDim.new(0, 8), host.UDim.new(0, 8), host.UDim.new(0, 8), host.UDim.new(0, 8)
            return
        elseif name == "SearchHeader" then
            round(radius * .6)
            object.BackgroundTransparency = .55;object.TextColor3 = accent(root)
            return
        elseif name == "FeatureSearch" then
            round(999);outline(look.outlineAlpha, 1)
            local pad = decor(object, "UIPadding", "SkinPad")
            pad.PaddingLeft = host.UDim.new(0, 28)
            local glass = decor(object, "TextLabel", "SkinIcon")
            glass.BackgroundTransparency, glass.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
            glass.Text, glass.Font, glass.TextSize, glass.TextColor3 = "🔍", E.Font.GothamMedium, 13, accent(root)
            glass.Position, glass.Size = U.fromOffset(-24, 0), U.new(0, 22, 1, 0)
            return
        elseif object:IsA("TextButton") and object.Parent and object.Parent.Name == "FeatureSearchResults" then
            round(radius * .7);outline(look.outlineAlpha + .1, 1)
            object.BackgroundTransparency = settings.boxAlpha and settings.boxAlpha / 100 or .3
            local plain = object.Text:gsub("<[^>]->", "")
            local icon = decor(object, "TextLabel", "SkinIcon")
            icon.BackgroundTransparency, icon.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
            icon.Font, icon.TextSize, icon.Text, icon.TextColor3 = E.Font.GothamMedium, 16, iconFor(plain), accent(root)
            icon.Position, icon.Size, icon.ZIndex = U.fromOffset(8, 0), U.new(0, 24, 1, 0), object.ZIndex + 1
            local pad = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
            if pad and pad.PaddingLeft.Offset < 34 then pad.PaddingLeft = host.UDim.new(0, 36) end
            return
        elseif kind == "Row" and not (object:IsA("Frame") and name:sub(1, 4) == "Row_") then
            round(radius * .6);outline(look.outlineAlpha + .1, 1)
            return
        end
        if kind == "Row" then
            round(if settings.rowStyle == "Flat" then 0 elseif settings.rowStyle == "Angled" then 3 else radius * .8)
            outline(look.outlineAlpha, 1)
            local bar = decor(object, "Frame", "SkinBar")
            bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
            bar.AnchorPoint, bar.Position, bar.Size = host.Vector2.new(0, .5), U.new(0, 0, .5, 0), U.new(0, 3, .62, 0)
            bar.BackgroundColor3 = accent(root);bar.ZIndex = object.ZIndex + 1
            bar.Visible = settings.rowBar
            styleRow(object, root)
        elseif kind == "ToggleSwitch" then styleToggle(object, round)
        elseif kind == "CloseButton" then round(999)
        elseif object.Name == "Knob" then round(if settings.toggleStyle == "Square Switch" then 3 else 999)
        elseif kind == "SliderTrack" then round(999)
        elseif kind == "SliderFill" then round(999);styleSliderFill(object, root)
        elseif kind == "DropdownList" then round(radius * .6);outline(look.outlineAlpha, 1)
        elseif kind == "DropdownOption" then round(radius * .4)
        elseif kind == "ActionButton" or kind == "InputBox" then round(radius * .55)
        elseif kind == "TabButton" then round(radius * .8);outline(look.outlineAlpha + .1, 1)
        elseif kind == "TabAccentLine" then round(999)
        elseif kind == "Main" or object.Name == "BodyBackground" then round(radius + 4);outline(.45, 1.5)
        elseif kind == "TopBar" then round(radius * .8)
        elseif kind == "Sidebar" then round(radius);outline(look.outlineAlpha + .1, 1)
        end
    end
    local function roots(): {any}
        local list = {}
        local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if gui then for _, child in gui:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child:GetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned") then table.insert(list, child) end end end
        return list
    end
    -- Window-level effects: drop shadow, glow, brightness and transparencies.
    local function windowFx(root: any)
        local main = root:FindFirstChild("Main")
        local body = main and main:FindFirstChild("BodyBackground")
        if not main or not body then return end
        local classic = LOOKS[settings.style] == nil
        local function layer(name: string, grow: number, alpha: number)
            local frame = decor(body, "Frame", name)
            frame.BorderSizePixel = 0;frame.BackgroundColor3 = C.new(0, 0, 0)
            frame.Position, frame.Size = U.new(0, -grow, 0, -grow + 6), U.new(1, grow * 2, 1, grow * 2)
            frame.ZIndex = 0
            frame.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
            frame.Visible = not classic and alpha < .999
            local corner = decor(frame, "UICorner", "SkinCorner")
            corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, settings.radius + grow)
        end
        local opacity = settings.shadow / 100
        layer("SkinShadow", settings.shadowSize, 1 - opacity * .55)
        layer("SkinShadow2", settings.shadowSize * 1.8, 1 - opacity * .25)
        local glow = decor(body, "UIStroke", "SkinGlow")
        glow.ApplyStrokeMode = E.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        glow.Color, glow.Thickness, glow.Transparency = accent(root), 1.5 + settings.glow / 5, 1 - math.clamp(settings.glow / 110, 0, .9)
        glow.Enabled = not classic and settings.glow > 0
        local bright = decor(main, "Frame", "SkinBright")
        bright.BorderSizePixel, bright.Active = 0, false
        bright.Size, bright.ZIndex = U.fromScale(1, 1), 900
        bright.BackgroundColor3 = if settings.brightness >= 0 then C.new(1, 1, 1) else C.new(0, 0, 0)
        bright.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.abs(settings.brightness) / 100 * .3
        bright.Visible = not classic and settings.brightness ~= 0
        local brightCorner = decor(bright, "UICorner", "SkinCorner")
        brightCorner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, settings.radius + 4)
        if settings.windowAlpha ~= nil then body.BackgroundTransparency = settings.windowAlpha / 100 end
        local panel = menu.panel
        if panel and panel.ContentArea then
            if settings.contentAlpha ~= nil then
                panel.ContentArea.BackgroundTransparency = settings.contentAlpha / 100
                local corner = decor(panel.ContentArea, "UICorner", "SkinCorner")
                corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, settings.radius)
            end
        end
    end
    local tip: any = nil
    local function ensureTip(root: any)
        if tip and tip.Parent then return tip end
        tip = Inst.new("Frame")
        tip.Name = "SkinTip";tip:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismSkin", true)
        tip.AutomaticSize = E.AutomaticSize.XY;tip.BackgroundColor3 = C.fromRGB(12, 15, 21);tip.BackgroundTransparency = .05
        tip.BorderSizePixel, tip.ZIndex, tip.Visible, tip.Active = 0, 950, false, false
        local corner = Inst.new("UICorner");corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 8);corner.Parent = tip
        local stroke = Inst.new("UIStroke");stroke.Color, stroke.Transparency = accent(root), .5;stroke.Parent = tip
        local pad = Inst.new("UIPadding")
        pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight, pad.PaddingTop, pad.PaddingBottom = host.UDim.new(0, 10), host.UDim.new(0, 10), host.UDim.new(0, 7), host.UDim.new(0, 7)
        pad.Parent = tip
        local limit = Inst.new("UISizeConstraint");limit.MaxSize = host.Vector2.new(320, 400);limit.Parent = tip
        local label = Inst.new("TextLabel")
        label.Name = "Text";label.BackgroundTransparency, label.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        label.AutomaticSize = E.AutomaticSize.XY;label.Size = U.fromOffset(0, 0)
        label.TextWrapped, label.TextXAlignment, label.TextYAlignment = true, E.TextXAlignment.Left, E.TextYAlignment.Top
        label.Font, label.TextSize, label.TextColor3, label.ZIndex = E.Font.GothamMedium, 12, C.fromRGB(222, 229, 241), 951
        label.Parent = tip
        tip.Parent = root
        return tip
    end
    local watched: any = {}
    local function watch(root: any)
        if watched[root] then return end
        watched[root] = true
        table.insert(connections, root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object: any)
            if control.alive then pending[object] = root end
        end))
    end
    function control.apply()
        for _, root in roots() do
            watch(root)
            pcall(windowFx, root)
            for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do pcall(skin, object, root) end
        end
        local panel = menu.panel
        if panel then
            panel.RailAlpha = if settings.railAlpha ~= nil then settings.railAlpha / 100 else nil
            if panel.ApplyStyle then pcall(function() panel:ApplyStyle(panel.Style) end) end
        end
        control.applied = control.applied + 1
    end
    -- Restyling walks every element of the menu (about 0.6 s). Restoring a saved setup changes dozens of looks in one go,
    -- so changes made in the same frame share a single restyle instead of one each.
    local applyQueued = false
    function control.queueApply()
        if applyQueued then return end
        applyQueued = true
        host.task.defer(function()
            applyQueued = false
            if control.alive then control.apply() end
        end)
    end
    function control.set(key: string, value: any): boolean
        settings[key] = value
        if key == "style" and LOOKS[value] then settings.radius = LOOKS[value].radius;settings.outline = LOOKS[value].outline end
        control.queueApply();return true
    end
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local accumulator = 0
    table.insert(connections, run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
        -- Description tooltip follows the mouse while a row is hovered and descriptions are hidden.
        local root = roots()[1]
        if root and settings.descriptions == "On Hover" and tipRow and tipRow.Parent and tipText ~= "" then
            local frame = ensureTip(root)
            frame.Text.Text = tipText
            local location = input:GetMouseLocation()
            frame.Position = U.fromOffset(location.X + 16, location.Y + 18)
            frame.Visible = true
        elseif tip then tip.Visible = false end
        accumulator += dt
        if accumulator >= .5 then
            accumulator = 0
            for _, each in roots() do watch(each) end
        end
        local count = 0
        for object, owner in pending do
            pending[object] = nil
            if object.Parent then pcall(skin, object, owner) end
            count += 1
            if count > 60 then break end
        end
    end))
    host.task.defer(function() if control.alive then control.apply() end end)
    -- Everything that styles text, offered inside the colour picker's Style tab for that part of the menu.
    local function extrasFor(key: string): any
        local style = settings.roleStyle[key]
        local function field(label: string, name: string)
            return {kind = "toggle", label = label, get = function() return style[name] == true end, set = function(value: any) style[name] = value == true;control.queueApply() end}
        end
        return {
            {kind = "color", label = "Outline", get = function() return settings.fxColor or C.new(0, 0, 0) end, alpha = function() return settings.fxAlpha end,
                set = function(color: any, alpha: number, emit: boolean) settings.fxColor, settings.fxAlpha = color, alpha;if emit then control.queueApply() end end},
            {kind = "color", label = "Highlight", get = function() return style.highlightColor or C.fromRGB(255, 220, 80) end, alpha = function() return style.highlightAlpha or .55 end,
                set = function(color: any, alpha: number, emit: boolean) style.highlightColor, style.highlightAlpha = color, alpha;if emit and style.highlight then control.queueApply() end end},
            {kind = "slider", label = "Size %", min = 50, max = 240, get = function() return settings.roleSize[key] or 100 end, set = function(value: number) settings.roleSize[key] = math.floor(value + .5);control.queueApply() end},
            {kind = "slider", label = "Opacity %", min = 0, max = 100, get = function() return 100 - (settings.roleAlpha[key] or 0) * 100 end, set = function(value: number) settings.roleAlpha[key] = if value >= 100 then nil else 1 - value / 100;control.queueApply() end},
            {kind = "choice", label = "Font", options = FONT_CHOICES, get = function() return settings.roleFont[key] or "Gotham Medium" end, set = function(value: any) settings.roleFont[key] = value;control.queueApply() end},
            {kind = "choice", label = "Weight", options = WEIGHTS, get = function() return style.weight or "Default" end, set = function(value: any) style.weight = if value == "Default" then nil else value;control.queueApply() end},
            field("Italic", "italic"), field("Underline", "underline"), field("Strikethrough", "strike"), field("Highlight", "highlight"), field("Uppercase", "upper"),
            {kind = "choice", label = "Effect", options = {"Original", "None", "Shadow", "Glow", "Outline"}, get = function() return settings.fxMode end, set = function(value: any) settings.fxMode = value;control.queueApply() end},
        }
    end
    local PRESETS = {
        ["Rail Glass (A)"] = {layout = "Rail", theme = "Minimal Slate", railNames = false, values = {style = "Modern Glass", radius = 12, rowStyle = "Rounded", rowBar = false, rowIcons = false, toggleStyle = "Pill", sliderStyle = "Thin", outline = true, font = "Gotham Medium"}, tabUpper = false, mono = false},
        ["Command Deck (B)"] = {layout = "Top Deck", theme = "Minimal Slate", railNames = true, values = {style = "Modern Flat", radius = 4, rowStyle = "Angled", rowBar = true, rowIcons = false, toggleStyle = "Bracket", sliderStyle = "Segmented", outline = true, font = "Gotham Medium"}, tabUpper = true, mono = true},
        ["Rail + Deck (A+B)"] = {layout = "Rail", theme = "Minimal Slate", railNames = false, values = {style = "Modern Glass", radius = 6, rowStyle = "Angled", rowBar = true, rowIcons = false, toggleStyle = "Bracket", sliderStyle = "Segmented", outline = true, font = "Gotham Medium"}, tabUpper = true, mono = true},
        ["Classic"] = {layout = "Classic Tabs", theme = "Classic", railNames = true, values = {style = "Classic"}, tabUpper = false, mono = false},
    }
    local PRESET_NAMES = {"Rail Glass (A)", "Command Deck (B)", "Rail + Deck (A+B)", "Classic"}
    local function setEntry(name: string, value: any)
        for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if entry.name == name or (entry.config and entry.config.Name == name) then
                local widget = entry.widget
                if widget and type(widget.Set) == "function" then pcall(widget.Set, value, true);return end
            end
        end
    end
    function control.applyPreset(value: string): boolean
        local preset = PRESETS[value]
        if not preset then return false end
        for key, setting in preset.values do settings[key] = setting end
        local mono = if preset.mono then "Roboto Mono" else nil
        settings.roleFont.tab, settings.roleFont.desc, settings.roleFont.title, settings.roleFont.value = mono, mono, mono, mono
        settings.roleStyle.tab.upper = preset.tabUpper
        settings.roleStyle.title.upper = preset.tabUpper
        if menu.panel then menu.panel.RailNames = preset.railNames end
        setEntry("UI Layout", preset.layout)
        control.queueApply();return true
    end
    -- First run: the A look, unless you have already picked a preset.
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        local function dropdown(name: string, display: string, description: string, options: {string}, default: string, apply: any)
            tab:CreateDropdown({Name = name, DisplayName = display, Description = description, Options = options, Default = default, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
                Callback = function(value: any) if not table.find(options, value) then return false end;return apply(value) end})
        end
        local function slider(name: string, display: string, description: string, low: number, high: number, default: number, apply: any)
            tab:CreateSlider({Name = name, DisplayName = display, Description = description, Min = low, Max = high, Default = default, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
                Callback = function(value: any) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount then return false end;return apply(math.clamp(amount, low, high)) end})
        end
        local function toggle(name: string, display: string, description: string, default: boolean, apply: any)
            tab:CreateToggle({Name = name, DisplayName = display, Description = description, Default = default, Callback = function(value: any) return apply(value == true) end})
        end
        local function panelSetting(apply: any)
            return function(value: any)
                local panel = menu.panel
                if not panel then return false end
                if not apply(panel, value) then return false end
                if panel.ApplyStyle then panel:ApplyStyle(panel.Style) end
                return true
            end
        end
        dropdown("Menu Preset", "Menu Preset", "One click for a whole look: Rail Glass (A) is a slim icon rail with rounded glass rows; Command Deck (B) is top tabs with angular rows, [ON]/[OFF] toggles, block sliders and a technical font; Rail + Deck (A+B) puts the rail and the angular deck rows together; Classic puts the original menu back. You can still change every option afterwards.", PRESET_NAMES, "Classic", function(value: any)

        dropdown("Menu Text Effect", "Text Depth Effect", "Original keeps each piece of text as the menu draws it. None removes outlines.         slider("Menu Text Opacity", "Text Opacity (%)", "How solid every piece of menu text is. 100 is fully visible.", 20, 100, 100, function(value: any) return control.set("textAlpha", if value >= 100 then nil else 1 - value / 100) end)
        toggle("Menu Custom Text Colors", "Use Custom Text Colours", "Turn on to use the colours below for each part of the menu. Off keeps the theme's text colour.", false, function(value: any) return control.set("useTextColors", value) end)
        for _, role in ROLES do
            local key, label = role[1], role[2]
            dropdown("Menu Font " .. label, label .. " Font", "Font and weight for this part of the menu: Gotham goes from Medium to Black, plus Source Sans, Ubuntu, Roboto, Code and more.", FONT_CHOICES, "Gotham Medium", function(value: any) settings.roleFont[key] = value;control.queueApply();return true end)
            slider("Menu Size " .. label, label .. " Size (%)", "Text size for this part of the menu.", 60, 180, 100, function(value: any) settings.roleSize[key] = value;control.queueApply();return true end)
            tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Menu Color " .. label, DisplayName = label .. " Colour", Description = "Colour for this part of the menu text (needs Use Custom Text Colours). Open it for size, font, weight, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, outline and more.", Default = C.fromRGB(222, 229, 241), QuickSettingsOnly = true, PickerExtras = extrasFor(key),
                GetTransparency = function() return settings.roleAlpha[key] or 0 end,
                SetTransparency = function(value: any) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount then return false end;settings.roleAlpha[key] = if amount <= 0 then nil else math.clamp(amount, 0, .9);control.queueApply();return true end,
                Callback = function(value: any) if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) ~= "Color3" then return false end;settings.roleColor[key] = value;control.queueApply();return true end})
        end
        -- Text style for every part at once.
        for _, pair in {{"Menu Text Italic", "Italic", "italic"}, {"Menu Text Underline", "Underline", "underline"}, {"Menu Text Strike", "Strikethrough", "strike"}, {"Menu Text Highlight", "Highlight", "highlight"}, {"Menu Text Uppercase", "Uppercase", "upper"}} do
            toggle(pair[1], pair[2] .. " (all text)", pair[2] .. " for every part of the menu text. Each part can also be set on its own in its colour picker.", false, function(value: any)
                for _, role in ROLES do settings.roleStyle[role[1]][pair[3]] = value == true end
                control.queueApply();return true
            end)
        end
        dropdown("Menu Text Weight", "Text Weight (all text)", "Thin to Heavy weight for every part of the menu text. Default leaves each font as it is.", WEIGHTS, "Default", function(value: any)
            for _, role in ROLES do settings.roleStyle[role[1]].weight = if value == "Default" then nil else value end
            control.queueApply();return true
        end)
        -- Boxes: one look for rows, buttons, dropdowns, search results and tabs.
        slider("Menu Box Transparency", "Box Transparency (%)", "One transparency for rows, buttons, inputs, dropdown boxes and search results.", 0, 90, 12, function(value: any) return control.set("boxAlpha", value) end)
        slider("Menu Outline Width", "Outline Width", "Thickness of the outline around boxes and tabs.", 0, 4, 1, function(value: any) return control.set("outlineWidth", value) end)
        slider("Menu Outline Opacity", "Outline Opacity (%)", "How strong the outline is.", 0, 100, 28, function(value: any) return control.set("outlineAlpha", 1 - value / 100) end)
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Menu Outline Color", DisplayName = "Outline Colour", Description = "Colour of every outline. Leave on the accent to follow the theme.", Default = C.fromRGB(150, 190, 255), QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value: any) if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) ~= "Color3" then return false end;return control.set("outlineColor", value) end})
        toggle("Menu Match Tabs", "Match Boxes To Tabs", "Give rows, buttons and dropdowns the same transparency and outline as the tabs.", false, function(value: any)
            if value then settings.boxAlpha, settings.outlineAlpha, settings.outlineWidth = 18, .75, 1 else settings.boxAlpha, settings.outlineAlpha = nil, nil end
            control.queueApply();return true
        end)
        slider("Menu GUI Scale", "GUI Scale (%)", "Size of the whole menu. The same as the slider in the top bar.", 50, 150, 100, function(value: any)
            local entry = menu.scaleEntry
            if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Set then entry.widget.Set(value / 100, true);return true end
            return false
        end)
        dropdown("Menu Tab Tint", "Tab Picture Colour", "None keeps the pictures as they are. Accent tints them with the menu accent. Mono tints them with the text colour.", {"None", "Accent", "Mono"}, "None", panelSetting(function(panel: any, value: any) panel.TabTint = value;return true end))
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        settings.style = "Classic"
        for _, root in roots() do
            for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do pcall(skin, object, root) end
            for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do if object:GetAttribute("ShenaniganismSkin") then object:Destroy() end end
        end
        if menu.menuSkin == control then menu.menuSkin = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return MenuSkin
end)()

local LiveData = (function(): any
-- A live read-out of what is happening around you, on screen: every player's ping, health, evasive, ultimate,
-- special cooldown, dash state and stun/ragdoll; every move as it is used; the animations each character is playing,
-- frame by frame; and a hit and miss counter for every M1 swing. Pick what to show, move it, and print it to the
-- console. It only reads; nothing is sent to the game.
local LiveData = {}
LiveData.sources = {"Players", "Movement And Aim", "Cooldowns", "Profiles", "Auto Systems", "Animations (frame by frame)", "Moves Used", "Health", "Hits And Misses", "Everything"}
function LiveData.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local world = host.workspace
    local E, Inst, C = host.Enum, host.Instance, host.Color3
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local settings: any = {enabled = false, source = "Players", x = 1, y = 20, size = 12, range = 90, rows = 16, log = false, opacity = 25}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, errors = 0}
    local gui: any, back: any, label: any = nil, nil, nil
    local stats: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local seenUse: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local feed: {string} = {}
    local lines: {string} = {}
    local connection: any = nil
    local accumulator = 0
    local FPS = 30
    local function finite(value: any): boolean return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge end
    local function push(text: string)
        table.insert(feed, 1, string.format("%6.1f  %s", clock() % 1000, text))
        while #feed > 40 do table.remove(feed) end
        if settings.log then print("[Shenaniganism] LIVE " .. text) end
    end
    local function pingOf(model: any): string
        local owner = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        if owner == player then
            local okay, value = pcall(function() return player:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end)
            if okay and finite(value) then return string.format("%dms", math.floor(value + .5)) end
        end
        local attribute = owner and (owner:GetAttribute("Ping") or model:GetAttribute("Ping"))
        return if attribute then tostring(attribute) .. "ms" else "?"
    end
    local function ensureGui(): boolean
        if gui and gui.Parent then return true end
        local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui then return false end
        gui = Inst.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "ShenaniganismLiveData";gui.ResetOnSpawn = false;gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true;gui.DisplayOrder = 40
        gui.Parent = playerGui
        back = Inst.new("Frame")
        back.Name = "Back";back.BackgroundColor3 = C.fromRGB(10, 12, 18);back.BorderSizePixel = 0
        back.AutomaticSize = E.AutomaticSize.XY
        back.Parent = gui
        local corner = Inst.new("UICorner");corner.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 10);corner.Parent = back
        local stroke = Inst.new("UIStroke");stroke.Color, stroke.Transparency, stroke.Thickness = C.fromRGB(110, 180, 255), .6, 1;stroke.Parent = back
        local padding = Inst.new("UIPadding")
        padding.PaddingLeft, padding.PaddingRight, padding.PaddingTop, padding.PaddingBottom = host.UDim.new(0, 8), host.UDim.new(0, 8), host.UDim.new(0, 6), host.UDim.new(0, 6)
        padding.Parent = back
        label = Inst.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency, label.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        label.AutomaticSize = E.AutomaticSize.XY;label.Size = host.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        label.Font, label.TextXAlignment, label.TextYAlignment = E.Font.Code, E.TextXAlignment.Left, E.TextYAlignment.Top
        label.TextColor3, label.RichText = C.fromRGB(225, 236, 255), false
        label.Text = ""
        label.Parent = back
        return true
    end
    local function nearby(): {any}
        local list = {}
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local characters = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
        if character then table.insert(list, character) end
        if root and characters then
            local others = {}
            for _, model in characters:GetChildren() do
                local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if model ~= character and other and (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= settings.range then table.insert(others, {model = model, d = (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude}) end
            end
            table.sort(others, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
            for _, entry in others do table.insert(list, entry.model) end
        end
        return list
    end
    local function stateWord(model: any): string
        local info = model:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local function on(name: string): boolean
            local value = model:GetAttribute(name)
            return value == true or (type(value) == "number" and value > 0) or (info ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild(name) ~= nil)
        end
        local words = {}
        if on("Ragdoll") or on("TrueRagdoll") then table.insert(words, "RAG") end
        if on("Stun") or on("TrueStun") then table.insert(words, "STUN") end
        if on("Block") then table.insert(words, "BLK") end
        if on("InSkill") then table.insert(words, "SKILL") end
        if on("DisableChase") then table.insert(words, "DASH") end
        if on("InDash") then table.insert(words, "DASHING") end
        if on("NoM1") then table.insert(words, "NO-M1") end
        if on("NoDash") then table.insert(words, "NO-DASH") end
        if on("Cancel") then table.insert(words, "CANCEL") end
        return if #words > 0 then table.concat(words, ",") else "-"
    end
    -- Per-frame bookkeeping: health changes, M1 swings (hit or miss), and move uses.
    local function observe(model: any, now: number, server: number)
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not humanoid or not root then return end
        local entry = stats[model]
        if not entry then entry = {swings = 0, hits = 0, misses = 0, health = humanoid.Health, taken = 0, dealt = 0};stats[model] = entry end
        local drop = entry.health - humanoid.Health
        if drop > .5 then
            entry.taken += drop;entry.lastDrop = now
            push(string.format("%s HEALTH -%.0f (%.0f/%.0f)", model.Name, drop, humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth))
        end
        entry.health = humanoid.Health
        local last = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM1"))
        if last and entry.lastM1 and last ~= entry.lastM1 then
            entry.swings += 1
            entry.pending = {at = now, position = root.Position}
        end
        if last then entry.lastM1 = last end
        local pending = entry.pending
        if pending and now - pending.at >= .45 then
            entry.pending = nil
            local landed = nil
            for other, otherEntry in stats do
                if other ~= model and other.Parent and otherEntry.lastDrop and otherEntry.lastDrop >= pending.at - .05 and otherEntry.lastDrop <= now then
                    local otherRoot = other:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if otherRoot and (otherRoot.Position - pending.position).Magnitude < 14 then landed = other;break end
                end
            end
            if landed then entry.hits += 1;entry.dealt += 1;push(string.format("%s M1 HIT %s", model.Name, landed.Name))
            else entry.misses += 1;push(string.format("%s M1 MISS", model.Name)) end
        end
        local moveset = model:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
        if moveset then
            for _, tool in moveset:GetChildren() do
                local used = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("LastUse"))
                local previous = seenUse[tool]
                seenUse[tool] = used
                if used and previous ~= nil and used ~= previous and math.abs(server - used) < 1 then
                    push(string.format("%s USED %s [%s] cd %.1fs", model.Name, tool.Name, tostring(tool:GetAttribute("Key") or "?"), math.max(0, (tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("ReadyAt")) or used) - used)))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local lastReasons: any = {}
    local SYSTEMS = {"autoBlock", "autoPunish", "targetJumpDash", "m1AimAssist", "frontDash", "autoCounterFilter", "threatFeed"}
    local function watchSystems()
        for _, name in SYSTEMS do
            local system = menu[name]
            local reason = system and system.lastReason
            if type(reason) == "string" and reason ~= lastReasons[name] then
                lastReasons[name] = reason
                push(string.format("%s: %s", name, reason:sub(1, 90)))
            end
        end
    end
    local function movementLines(list: {any}, out: {string})
        local character = player.Character
        local mine = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        local aim = nil
        if camera then
            local location = host.game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetMouseLocation()
            aim = camera:ViewportPointToRay(location.X, location.Y).Direction
        end
        table.insert(out, "MOVEMENT     SPD  VEL(x,y,z)        DIST  FACE-AT-ME  MOUSE-OFF  GOING")
        for _, model in list do
            local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local speed = math.sqrt(v.X * v.X + v.Z * v.Z)
                local distance, face, mouse, going = 0, "-", "-", "-"
                if mine and model ~= character then
                    local toMe = mine.Position - root.Position
                    distance = toMe.Magnitude
                    local flat = host.Vector3.new(toMe.X, 0, toMe.Z)
                    local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
                    local lookFlat = host.Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                    if flat.Magnitude > .1 and lookFlat.Magnitude > .01 then face = string.format("%d", math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(lookFlat.Unit:Dot(flat.Unit), -1, 1)))) end
                    if speed > 1 and flat.Magnitude > .1 then
                        local approach = host.Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Unit:Dot(flat.Unit)
                        going = if approach > .4 then "closing" elseif approach < -.4 then "backing" else "strafing"
                    else going = "still" end
                    if aim then mouse = string.format("%d", math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(aim.Unit:Dot((root.Position - camera.CFrame.Position).Unit), -1, 1)))) end
                end
                table.insert(out, string.format("%-11s %-4d %-+4d,%-+4d,%-+4d %-5.1f %-11s %-10s %s", model.Name:sub(1, 11), math.floor(speed + .5), math.floor(v.X), math.floor(v.Y), math.floor(v.Z), distance, face, mouse, going))
            end
        end
    end
    local function cooldownLines(list: {any}, out: {string})
        local okay, server = pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow, world)
        if not okay then return end
        table.insert(out, "COOLDOWNS (seconds left)")
        for _, model in list do
            local moveset = model:FindFirstChild("Moveset")
            if moveset then
                local pieces = {}
                for _, tool in moveset:GetChildren() do
                    local ready = tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("ReadyAt"))
                    if ready then
                        local left = math.max(0, ready - server)
                        table.insert(pieces, string.format("%s[%s] %s", tool.Name:sub(1, 12), tostring(tool:GetAttribute("Key") or "?"), if left > .05 then string.format("%.1f", left) else "rdy"))
                    end
                end
                table.insert(out, model.Name:sub(1, 11) .. ": " .. table.concat(pieces, "  "))
            end
        end
    end
    local function profileLines(out: {string})
        table.insert(out, "PROFILE      DISPLAY      ID          AGE(d)  TEAM   PING")
        for _, other in players:GetPlayers() do
            local ping = if other == player then pingOf(other.Character or Inst.new("Folder")) else tostring(other:GetAttribute("Ping") or "?")
            table.insert(out, string.format("%-11s %-12s %-11d %-7d %-6s %s", other.Name:sub(1, 11), other.DisplayName:sub(1, 12), other.UserId, other.AccountAge, tostring(other.Team and other.Team.Name or "-"):sub(1, 6), ping))
        end
    end
    local function animationLines(model: any, out: {string})
        local animator = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
        if not animator then return end
        for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
            local length = track.Length
            local frame = math.floor(track.TimePosition * FPS + .5)
            local total = math.floor(length * FPS + .5)
            local keyframe = ""
            table.insert(out, string.format("%-10s %-18s f%03d/%03d  %.2fs/%.2fs  w%.2f p%d%s", model.Name:sub(1, 10), (track.Name ~= "" and track.Name or (track.Animation and track.Animation.Name) or "?"):sub(1, 18), frame, total, track.TimePosition, length, track.WeightCurrent, track.Priority.Value, keyframe))
        end
    end
    local function render(now: number)
        table.clear(lines)
        local source = settings.source
        local all = source == "Everything"
        local list = nearby()
        if source == "Players" or all then
            table.insert(lines, "PLAYER      PING  HP        EVD ULT SPEC  STATE")
            for _, model in list do
                local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local owner = players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                local cooldown, last = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("M2_CD")), tonumber(model:GetAttribute("LastM2"))
                local okay, server = pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow, world)
                local special = "rdy"
                if cooldown and last and cooldown > 0 and last > 0 and okay then special = string.format("%.1f", math.max(0, cooldown - (server - last))) end
                table.insert(lines, string.format("%-11s %-5s %-9s %-3s %-3s %-5s %s", model.Name:sub(1, 11), pingOf(model),
                    humanoid and string.format("%d/%d", humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth) or "?",
                    tostring(math.floor(tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Evade")) or 0)), tostring(owner and math.floor(tonumber(owner:GetAttribute("Ultimate")) or 0) or "-"), special, stateWord(model)))
                if #lines >= settings.rows then break end
            end
        end
        if source == "Movement And Aim" or all then
            if all then table.insert(lines, "") end
            movementLines(list, lines)
        end
        if source == "Cooldowns" or all then
            if all then table.insert(lines, "") end
            cooldownLines(list, lines)
        end
        if source == "Profiles" or all then
            if all then table.insert(lines, "") end
            profileLines(lines)
        end
        if source == "Auto Systems" or all then
            if all then table.insert(lines, "") end
            table.insert(lines, "AUTO SYSTEMS (latest reason each one gave)")
            for _, name in SYSTEMS do
                local system = menu[name]
                table.insert(lines, string.format("%-16s %s", name, tostring(system and system.lastReason or "(none)"):sub(1, 80)))
            end
        end
        if source == "Animations (frame by frame)" or all then
            if all then table.insert(lines, "") end
            table.insert(lines, "ANIMATIONS (30 fps frames)")
            for _, model in list do
                animationLines(model, lines)
                if #lines >= settings.rows + 10 then break end
            end
        end
        if source == "Health" then
            table.insert(lines, "HEALTH  now/max   taken   dealt-hits")
            for _, model in list do
                local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local entry = stats[model]
                if humanoid then table.insert(lines, string.format("%-11s %d/%d  taken %.0f  hits %d", model.Name:sub(1, 11), humanoid.Health, humanoid.MaxHealth, entry and entry.taken or 0, entry and entry.hits or 0)) end
            end
        end
        if source == "Hits And Misses" or all then
            if all then table.insert(lines, "") end
            table.insert(lines, "M1 SWINGS   hit  miss  accuracy")
            for _, model in list do
                local entry = stats[model]
                if entry and entry.swings > 0 then
                    table.insert(lines, string.format("%-11s %-4d %-5d %d%%", model.Name:sub(1, 11), entry.hits, entry.misses, math.floor(100 * entry.hits / math.max(1, entry.hits + entry.misses) + .5)))
                end
            end
        end
        if source == "Moves Used" or source == "Hits And Misses" or source == "Health" or source == "Auto Systems" or all then
            if all or source == "Moves Used" then
                if all then table.insert(lines, "") end
                table.insert(lines, "EVENTS")
            else table.insert(lines, "") ;table.insert(lines, "EVENTS") end
            for index = 1, math.min(#feed, 10) do table.insert(lines, feed[index]) end
        end
    end
    connection = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
        local okay, problem = pcall(function()
            if not control.alive then return end
            local now = clock()
            accumulator += dt
            local interval = if settings.source == "Animations (frame by frame)" or settings.source == "Everything" then 1 / 20 else 1 / 8
            -- Observation runs even while hidden so counters stay honest.
            local timeOkay, server = pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow, world)
            if accumulator >= 1 / 15 and timeOkay then
                for _, model in nearby() do observe(model, now, server) end
                watchSystems()
            end
            if accumulator < interval then return end
            accumulator = 0
            if not settings.enabled then
                if gui then gui.Enabled = false end
                return
            end
            if not ensureGui() then return end
            gui.Enabled = true
            back.Position = host.UDim2.fromScale(settings.x / 100, settings.y / 100)
            back.BackgroundTransparency = settings.opacity / 100
            label.TextSize = settings.size
            render(now)
            label.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
        end)
        if not okay then
            control.errors += 1;control.lastError = tostring(problem)
            if control.errors == 1 then warn("[Shenaniganism] Live data error: " .. control.lastError) end
        end
    end)
    local function boolSetter(key: string)
        return function(value: any) if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end;settings[key] = value;return true end
    end
    local function numberSetter(key: string, low: number, high: number)
        return function(value: any)
            local amount = tonumber(value)
            if not finite(amount) then return false end
            settings[key] = math.clamp(amount :: number, low, high);return true
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Live Data Enabled", DisplayName = "Live Data Panel", Description = "An on-screen read-out of what is happening around you right now: players with ping, health, evasive, ultimate, special cooldown, dash and stun/ragdoll; animations frame by frame; moves as they are used; health changes; and M1 hits and misses.", Default = false, Callback = boolSetter("enabled")})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Live Data Source", DisplayName = "Live Data Shows", Description = "Players, Animations (frame by frame), Moves Used, Health, Hits And Misses, or Everything.", Options = LiveData.sources, Default = "Players", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value: any) if not table.find(LiveData.sources, value) then return false end;settings.source = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Live Data X", DisplayName = "Panel X (%)", Description = "Horizontal position of the panel.", Min = 0, Max = 95, Default = 1, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("x", 0, 95)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Live Data Y", DisplayName = "Panel Y (%)", Description = "Vertical position of the panel.", Min = 0, Max = 95, Default = 20, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("y", 0, 95)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Live Data Size", DisplayName = "Panel Text Size", Description = "Text size of the panel.", Min = 8, Max = 20, Default = 12, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("size", 8, 20)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Live Data Range", DisplayName = "Panel Range (studs)", Description = "Only characters this close are listed.", Min = 20, Max = 300, Default = 90, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("range", 20, 300)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Live Data Rows", DisplayName = "Panel Rows", Description = "How many rows the Players list may use.", Min = 4, Max = 30, Default = 16, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("rows", 4, 30)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Live Data Opacity", DisplayName = "Panel Transparency (%)", Description = "How see-through the panel background is.", Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = 25, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("opacity", 0, 90)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Live Data Log", DisplayName = "Also Print Events To Console", Description = "Print each move, hit, miss and health change to the console as it happens.", Default = false, Callback = boolSetter("log")})
        tab:CreateButton({Name = "Live Data Snapshot", DisplayName = "Print Snapshot To Console", Description = "Print what the panel shows right now.", ButtonText = "Print",
            Callback = function() render(clock());for _, line in lines do print("[Shenaniganism] LIVE " .. line) end;return true end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection = nil end
        if gui then gui:Destroy();gui = nil end
        if menu.liveData == control then menu.liveData = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return LiveData
end)()

local MultiToggles = (function(): any
-- Related on/off options gathered into one drop-down of check boxes where several can be ticked at once. The single
-- toggles keep working, saving and loading exactly as before; they are only hidden from the page. Turn on
-- "Show Individual Check Boxes" in Settings to see them again.
local MultiToggles = {}
local function stripped(label: string, prefix: string): string
    return if label:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then label:sub(#prefix + 1) else label
end
MultiToggles.groups = {
    {title = "Select Self HUD Elements", tab = "Main", prefix = "Self HUD ", description = "Tick every part of your own HUD you want to see.",
        filter = function(l: string): boolean return not l:find("Ring", 1, true) and not l:find("Overlap", 1, true) and not l:find("Master", 1, true) and not l:find("Enabled", 1, true) and not l:find("Drag", 1, true) end},
    {title = "Select Self HUD Ring Parts", tab = "Main", prefix = "Self HUD ", description = "Tick every stat your own ring should show.",
        filter = function(l: string): boolean return l:find("Ring", 1, true) ~= nil end},
    {title = "Select Self HUD Overlap Bar Parts", tab = "Main", prefix = "Self HUD ", description = "Tick every cooldown the overlap bar should combine.",
        filter = function(l: string): boolean return l:find("Overlap", 1, true) ~= nil and l ~= "Overlap Bar" end},
    {title = "Select Enemy Ring Stats", tab = "Main", prefix = "Enemy Ring ", description = "Tick every stat the enemy rings should show.",
        names = {"Health", "Evasive", "Special", "Ultimate", "Labels"}},
    {title = "Select Dash FX Parts", tab = "Main", prefix = "Dash FX ", description = "Tick every part of the dash effects you want.",
        filter = function(l: string): boolean return l ~= "Enabled" end},
    {title = "Select Block FX Parts", tab = "Main", prefix = "Block FX ", description = "Tick every part of the block effects you want.",
        filter = function(l: string): boolean return l ~= "Enabled" end},
    {title = "Select Hit State Parts", tab = "Main", prefix = "Hit State FX ", description = "Tick every part of the knockdown, uppercut and stun markers you want.",
        filter = function(l: string): boolean return l ~= "Enabled" end},
}
function MultiToggles.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local control: any = {alive = true, groups = {}, showSingles = false, built = false}
    local function nameOf(entry: any): string?
        return entry.name or (entry.config and entry.config.Name)
    end
    local function entryNamed(name: string): any
        for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do if nameOf(entry) == name then return entry end end
        return nil
    end
    local function collect(group: any): {any}
        local members = {}
        if group.names then
            for _, label in group.names do
                local entry = entryNamed(group.prefix .. label)
                if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Kind == "CreateToggle" then table.insert(members, {entry = entry, label = label}) end
            end
        else
            for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do
                local name, widget = nameOf(entry), entry.widget
                if name and widget and widget.Kind == "CreateToggle" and name:sub(1, #group.prefix) == group.prefix then
                    local label = stripped((entry.config and entry.config.DisplayName) or name, group.prefix)
                    if group.filter(stripped(name, group.prefix)) then table.insert(members, {entry = entry, label = label}) end
                end
            end
            table.sort(members, function(a, b) return a.label < b.label end)
        end
        return members
    end
    local function selectedLabels(members: {any}): {string}
        local list = {}
        for _, member in members do
            local okay, value = pcall(member.entry.widget.Get)
            if okay and value == true then table.insert(list, member.label) end
        end
        return list
    end
    function control.build()
        if control.built or not control.alive then return end
        control.built = true
        for _, group in MultiToggles.groups do
            local members = collect(group)
            if #members >= 3 then
                local tabObject = menu.tabs and menu.tabs[group.tab]
                local tab = tabObject and (tabObject.tab or tabObject)
                if tab and tab.CreateDropdown then
                    local options, seen = {}, {}
                    for _, member in members do
                        local label = member.label
                        if seen[label] then label = label .. " (" .. tostring(nameOf(member.entry)) .. ")" end
                        seen[label] = true;member.label = label
                        table.insert(options, label)
                    end
                    local record = {group = group, members = members, options = options}
                    table.insert(control.groups, record)
                    tab:CreateDropdown({Name = group.title, DisplayName = group.title, Description = group.description, Options = options, Default = selectedLabels(members), Multi = true,
                        Callback = function(list: any)
                            if type(list) ~= "table" then return false end
                            local chosen = {}
                            for _, label in list do chosen[label] = true end
                            for _, member in record.members do
                                local widget = member.entry.widget
                                local okay, current = pcall(widget.Get)
                                local want = chosen[member.label] == true
                                if okay and current ~= want then pcall(widget.Set, want, true) end
                            end
                            return true
                        end})
                end
            end
        end
        local settingsTab = menu.tabs and menu.tabs.Settings
        settingsTab = settingsTab and (settingsTab.tab or settingsTab)
        if settingsTab and settingsTab.CreateToggle then
            settingsTab:CreateToggle({Name = "Show Individual Check Boxes", DisplayName = "Show Individual Check Boxes", Description = "The grouped check box drop-downs replace the long lists of single toggles. Turn this on to show the single toggles again.", Default = false,
                Callback = function(value: any) control.showSingles = value == true;return true end})
        end
    end
    local accumulator = 0
    local connection = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
        accumulator += dt
        if accumulator < 1 or not control.built then return end
        accumulator = 0
        for _, record in control.groups do
            local dropdown = entryNamed(record.group.title)
            local widget = dropdown and dropdown.widget
            if widget and widget.Get and widget.Set then
                local want = selectedLabels(record.members)
                local have = widget.Get()
                local differs = type(have) ~= "table" or #have ~= #want
                if not differs then
                    local set = {}
                    for _, label in have do set[label] = true end
                    for _, label in want do if not set[label] then differs = true;break end end
                end
                if differs then pcall(widget.Set, want, false) end
            end
            for _, member in record.members do
                local row = member.entry.widget.Row
                if row and row.Parent and row.Visible == control.showSingles then else if row and row.Parent then row.Visible = control.showSingles end end
            end
        end
    end)
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        connection:Disconnect()
        for _, record in control.groups do for _, member in record.members do
            local row = member.entry.widget.Row
            if row and row.Parent then row.Visible = true end
        end end
        if menu.multiToggles == control then menu.multiToggles = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return MultiToggles
end)()

local DeckMenu = (function(): any
-- The new menu. Style A: a slim icon rail, pill switches, rounded boxes. The only thing taken from B is the strip of
-- chips across the top, which jumps between the groups inside a tab. It uses the same eight tabs as the original
-- menu, shows every setting as a box in columns, and reads and writes the very same values, so nothing is copied
-- and nothing is lost. Right-click any box for its mini menu. Everything about how it looks is under Customize.
-- It replaces the original window: opening the old menu opens this one instead. Its own look settings are saved
-- to Shenaniganism/DeckUI2.json.
local DeckMenu = {}
local FILE = "Shenaniganism/DeckUI2.json"
local TAB_ORDER = {"Main", "Automatic", "Fun", "Transform", "Emote", "Player", "Settings", "Beta"}
local LABELS = {Main = "Main", Automatic = "Game", Fun = "Misc", Transform = "Looks", Emote = "Emote", Player = "Player", Settings = "Settings", Beta = "Beta"}
-- Tabs the original menu keeps hidden: their settings are shown inside the nearest of the eight.
local FOLDED = {Aura = "Transform", Game = "Main", Skill = "Automatic", Animation = "Transform", Music = "Fun", Scripts = "Fun"}
local FONT_LIST = {"Gotham", "Gotham Medium", "Gotham Semibold", "Gotham Bold", "Gotham Black", "Source Sans", "Source Sans Light", "Source Sans Bold", "Ubuntu", "Roboto", "Roboto Mono", "Code", "Nunito", "Michroma", "Oswald", "Highway", "Arcade", "Fredoka", "Sci-Fi", "Bloxy (Cartoon)"}
local FONT_ENUM: any = {["Gotham"] = "Gotham", ["Gotham Medium"] = "GothamMedium", ["Gotham Semibold"] = "GothamSemibold", ["Gotham Bold"] = "GothamBold", ["Gotham Black"] = "GothamBlack",
    ["Source Sans"] = "SourceSans", ["Source Sans Light"] = "SourceSansLight", ["Source Sans Bold"] = "SourceSansBold", ["Ubuntu"] = "Ubuntu", ["Roboto"] = "Roboto", ["Roboto Mono"] = "RobotoMono",
    ["Code"] = "Code", ["Nunito"] = "Nunito", ["Michroma"] = "Michroma", ["Oswald"] = "Oswald", ["Highway"] = "Highway", ["Arcade"] = "Arcade", ["Fredoka"] = "FredokaOne", ["Sci-Fi"] = "SciFi",
    ["Bloxy (Cartoon)"] = "Cartoon"}
local WEIGHTS = {"Default", "Thin", "ExtraLight", "Light", "Regular", "Medium", "SemiBold", "Bold", "ExtraBold", "Heavy"}
local ACCENTS = {Ice = {94, 224, 255}, Mint = {110, 230, 190}, Amber = {255, 190, 90}, Rose = {255, 130, 170}, Violet = {180, 150, 255}, Lime = {170, 235, 90}, Coral = {255, 130, 100}, White = {240, 244, 250}, Gold = {255, 215, 90}}
local ACCENT_NAMES = {"Ice", "Mint", "Amber", "Rose", "Violet", "Lime", "Coral", "White", "Gold"}
function DeckMenu.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local input = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local http = host.game:GetService("HttpService")
    local E, Inst, C, U = host.Enum, host.Instance, host.Color3, host.UDim2
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local control: any = {alive = true, errors = 0, open = false}
    local connections: {any} = {}
    local function rgb(r: number, g: number, b: number): any return C.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
    -- ===== settings (saved) =====
    local DEFAULTS: any = {
        key = "RightShift", theme = "Black", openOnLoad = false, px = -1, py = -1, replaceOld = true, decimals = 4, miniColumns = 2, scale = 100, width = 1020, height = 660, x = .5, y = .5,
        columns = 2, cardHeight = 112, gap = 10, railWidth = 92,
        accent = rgb(94, 224, 255), windowColor = rgb(10, 13, 19), windowAlpha = 4, panelColor = rgb(16, 21, 30), cardColor = rgb(20, 26, 37), cardAlpha = 6,
        textColor = rgb(228, 234, 244), mutedColor = rgb(150, 162, 184), outlineColor = nil, outlineWidth = 1, outlineAlpha = 72, radius = 12, shadow = 40, glow = 0,
        font = "Gotham Medium", titleSize = 100, descSize = 100, weight = "Default", italic = false, underline = false, strike = false, upper = false,
        fxMode = "None", fxColor = rgb(0, 0, 0), fxAlpha = 50, simple = true, descriptions = true,
        toggleStyle = "Pill", sliderStyle = "Thin", cardStyle = "Rounded", cardBar = false, edit = "",
    }
    local settings: any = {}
    for key, value in DEFAULTS do settings[key] = value end
    local function writeSettings()
        pcall(function()
            if not writefile then return end
            if makefolder then pcall(makefolder, "Shenaniganism") end
            local data = {}
            for key, value in settings do
                if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) == "Color3" then data[key] = {r = value.R, g = value.G, b = value.B}
                elseif type(value) ~= "table" then data[key] = value end
            end
            writefile(FILE, http:JSONEncode(data))
        end)
    end
    -- Many changes in one frame (restoring a saved setup) write the file once.
    local saveQueued = false
    local function saveSettings()
        if saveQueued then return end
        saveQueued = true
        host.task.defer(function() saveQueued = false;writeSettings() end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(FILE) then
            local data = http:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE))
            for key, value in data do
                if DEFAULTS[key] ~= nil or key == "outlineColor" then
                    if type(value) == "table" and value.r then settings[key] = C.new(value.r, value.g, value.b) else settings[key] = value end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    local function accent(): any return settings.accent end
    local function lineColor(): any return settings.outlineColor or settings.accent end
    -- ===== edit mode: hide boxes, move them, change columns per tab (saved) =====
    local layout: any = {hidden = {}, order = {}, cols = {}}
