    pcall(function()
        if type(settings.edit) == "string" and settings.edit ~= "" then
            local data = http:JSONDecode(settings.edit)
            layout.hidden, layout.order, layout.cols = data.hidden or {}, data.order or {}, data.cols or {}
            layout.tabs = data.tabs
            layout.recoveryMenuVersion = data.recoveryMenuVersion
        end
    end)
    local function saveLayout() settings.edit = http:JSONEncode(layout);saveSettings() end
    -- The tab rail order: the saved drag-and-drop order when it is a complete, valid list, otherwise the default.
    local function tabOrder(): {string}
        local saved = layout.tabs
        if type(saved) == "table" and #saved == #TAB_ORDER then
            local seen, okay = {}, true
            for _, name in saved do
                if not table.find(TAB_ORDER, name) or seen[name] then okay = false;break end
                seen[name] = true
            end
            if okay then return saved end
        end
        return TAB_ORDER
    end
    local editing = false
    -- ===== state =====
    local gui: any, window: any, content: any, overlay: any, tip: any = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
    local currentTab = "Main"
    local searchText = ""
    local searchBox: any = nil
    local collapsed: any = {}
    local sectionFilter: any = {}
    local updaters: {any} = {}
    local dragging: any = nil
    local openPopup: any = nil
    local miniLayer: any = nil
    local miniGui: any = nil
    local colorLayer: any = nil
    local openColorRef: any = function(_record: any): boolean return false end
    local rebuildAt: number? = nil
    local contentAt: number? = nil
    local build, renderContent
    local openMiniRef: any = function(_record: any) end
    local openKeyRef: any = function(_entry: any) end
    local keyRefresh: any = nil
    local function changed() rebuildAt = clock() + .3;saveSettings() end
    local function make(class: string, parent: any, props: any?): any
        local object = Inst.new(class)
        object.Name = (props and props.Name) or class
        if object:IsA("GuiObject") then object.BorderSizePixel = 0 end
        for key, value in props or {} do if key ~= "Name" then object[key] = value end end
        object.Parent = parent
        return object
    end
    local function corner(object: any, radius: number)
        local item = Inst.new("UICorner");item.CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, radius);item.Parent = object
    end
    local function stroke(object: any, color: any, thickness: number, alpha: number): any
        local item = Inst.new("UIStroke");item.ApplyStrokeMode = E.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        item.Color, item.Thickness, item.Transparency = color, thickness, alpha;item.Parent = object
        return item
    end
    local function escapeRich(text: string): string return (text:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")) end
    -- ===== text with every style option =====
    local function styled(parent: any, text: string, props: any?): any
        local clean: any = {}
        for key, value in props or {} do if key ~= "Role" and key ~= "FontName" and key ~= "Wrap" then clean[key] = value end end
        local label = make("TextLabel", parent, clean)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local role = (props and props.Role) or "title"
        local scale = if role == "desc" then settings.descSize else settings.titleSize
        label.TextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(((props and props.TextSize) or 14) * scale / 100 + .5))
        label.TextColor3 = (props and props.TextColor3) or (if role == "desc" then settings.mutedColor else settings.textColor)
        label.TextXAlignment = (props and props.TextXAlignment) or E.TextXAlignment.Left
        label.TextYAlignment = (props and props.TextYAlignment) or E.TextYAlignment.Center
        label.TextTruncate = if props and props.Wrap then E.TextTruncate.AtEnd else E.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        label.TextWrapped = props ~= nil and props.Wrap == true
        local fontName = FONT_ENUM[(props and props.FontName) or settings.font] or "GothamMedium"
        if settings.weight ~= "Default" or settings.italic then
            pcall(function()
                local FontClass = host.Font or Font
                local base = FontClass.fromEnum(E.Font[fontName])
                label.FontFace = FontClass.new(base.Family, if settings.weight ~= "Default" then E.FontWeight[settings.weight] else base.Weight, if settings.italic then E.FontStyle.Italic else E.FontStyle.Normal)
            end)
        else pcall(function() label.Font = E.Font[fontName] end) end
        local value = text
        if settings.underline or settings.strike or settings.upper then
            value = escapeRich(if settings.upper then text:upper() else text)
            if settings.underline then value = "<u>" .. value .. "</u>" end
            if settings.strike then value = "<s>" .. value .. "</s>" end
            label.RichText = true
        end
        label.Text = value
        if settings.fxMode ~= "None" then
            label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - settings.fxAlpha / 100
            label.TextStrokeColor3 = if settings.fxMode == "Shadow" then C.new(0, 0, 0) elseif settings.fxMode == "Glow" then accent() else settings.fxColor
        end
        return label
    end
    local function closePopup() if openPopup then openPopup.frame:Destroy();openPopup = nil end end
    local function simpler(text: string?): string
        if not text or text == "" then return "" end
        if not settings.simple then return text end
        local first = text:match("^(.-[%.!?])%s") or text
        if #first > 120 then first = first:sub(1, 117) .. "..." end
        return first
    end
    -- ===== simple drawn icons (no pictures, no emoji) =====
    local function drawIcon(parent: any, tab: string, color: any)
        local box = make("Frame", parent, {Name = "Icon", Size = U.fromOffset(24, 24), Position = U.new(.5, -12, 0, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        local function ring(size: number, thickness: number, x: number?, y: number?): any
            local frame = make("Frame", box, {Size = U.fromOffset(size, size), Position = U.fromOffset(x or (24 - size) / 2, y or (24 - size) / 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
            corner(frame, size / 2);stroke(frame, color, thickness, 0)
            return frame
        end
        local function dot(size: number, x: number, y: number)
            local frame = make("Frame", box, {Size = U.fromOffset(size, size), Position = U.fromOffset(x, y), BackgroundColor3 = color});corner(frame, size / 2)
        end
        local function outlined(w: number, h: number, x: number, y: number, radius: number): any
            local frame = make("Frame", box, {Size = U.fromOffset(w, h), Position = U.fromOffset(x, y), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
            corner(frame, radius);stroke(frame, color, 2, 0)
            return frame
        end
        if tab == "Main" then ring(22, 2);ring(12, 2);dot(4, 10, 10)
        elseif tab == "Automatic" then outlined(16, 21, 4, 1, 8)
        elseif tab == "Fun" then local d = outlined(13, 13, 5.5, 5.5, 2);d.Rotation = 45
        elseif tab == "Transform" then outlined(24, 13, 0, 5.5, 7);dot(6, 9, 9)
        elseif tab == "Emote" then ring(22, 2);dot(3, 7, 8);dot(3, 14, 8);make("Frame", box, {Size = U.fromOffset(8, 2), Position = U.fromOffset(8, 15), BackgroundColor3 = color})
        elseif tab == "Player" then ring(10, 2, 7, 0);outlined(18, 11, 3, 12, 6)
        elseif tab == "Settings" then ring(18, 3);dot(6, 9, 9);dot(3, 10.5, 0);dot(3, 10.5, 21);dot(3, 0, 10.5);dot(3, 21, 10.5)
        else outlined(8, 9, 8, 0, 2);outlined(18, 13, 3, 9, 6) end
    end
    -- ===== drag and drop =====
    -- Press on `source` in edit mode and drag over a sibling in `container` that carries the same attribute;
    -- releasing over it calls onDrop(draggedName, targetName). The target gets an accent outline while hovered.
    local suppressClick = false
    local function startReorder(source: any, container: any, nameAttr: string, onDrop: any)
        local startPoint = input:GetMouseLocation()
        local moved = false
        local hover: any = nil
        local function targetAt(point: any): any
            for _, other in container:GetChildren() do
                if other ~= source and other:IsA("GuiObject") and other:GetAttribute(nameAttr) ~= nil then
                    local a, b = other.AbsolutePosition, other.AbsoluteSize
                    if point.X >= a.X and point.X <= a.X + b.X and point.Y >= a.Y and point.Y <= a.Y + b.Y then return other end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end
        local function clearMark() if hover and hover.Parent then local mark = hover:FindFirstChild("DropMark");if mark then mark:Destroy() end end end
        dragging = {
            move = function(point: any)
                if not moved and (point - startPoint).Magnitude > 6 then moved = true;suppressClick = true end
                if not moved then return end
                local target = targetAt(point)
                if target ~= hover then
                    clearMark()
                    hover = target
                    if hover then stroke(hover, accent(), 3, 0).Name = "DropMark" end
                end
            end,
            drop = function(point: any)
                clearMark()
                if moved then
                    local target = targetAt(point)
                    if target then onDrop(source:GetAttribute(nameAttr), target:GetAttribute(nameAttr)) end
                end
                host.task.delay(.15, function() suppressClick = false end)
            end,
        }
    end
    -- ===== controls inside a box =====
    local function numberText(value: number, precision: number?): string
        local text = string.format("%." .. tostring(math.max(precision or 0, settings.decimals)) .. "f", value)
        if text:find("%.") then text = text:gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "") end
        return text
    end
    local function addControl(card: any, spec: any, width: number, height: number)
        local kind = spec.kind
        local bottom = height - 38
        local function add(update: any) table.insert(updaters, update) end
        local round = if settings.cardStyle == "Rounded" then 8 elseif settings.cardStyle == "Soft" then 12 else 3
        if kind == "toggle" then
            if settings.toggleStyle == "Checkbox" then
                local button = make("TextButton", card, {Name = "Toggle", Size = U.fromOffset(24, 24), Position = U.fromOffset(width - 36, 10), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
                corner(button, 6);stroke(button, lineColor(), 1.5, .2)
                local fill = make("Frame", button, {Name = "Fill", Size = U.fromOffset(12, 12), Position = U.fromOffset(6, 6), BackgroundColor3 = accent()});corner(fill, 3)
                local function refresh() fill.Visible = spec.get() == true end
                refresh();add(refresh)
                button.Activated:Connect(function() spec.set(not (spec.get() == true));refresh() end)
            else
                local button = make("TextButton", card, {Name = "Toggle", Size = U.fromOffset(44, 24), Position = U.fromOffset(width - 56, 10), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
                corner(button, if settings.toggleStyle == "Square" then 5 else 12)
                local knob = make("Frame", button, {Name = "Knob", Size = U.fromOffset(18, 18), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(10, 13, 19)})
                corner(knob, if settings.toggleStyle == "Square" then 4 else 9)
                local function refresh()
                    local on = spec.get() == true
                    button.BackgroundColor3 = if on then accent() else rgb(46, 55, 74)
                    knob.Position = if on then U.fromOffset(23, 3) else U.fromOffset(3, 3)
                    knob.BackgroundColor3 = if on then rgb(10, 13, 19) else settings.mutedColor
                end
                refresh();add(refresh)
                button.Activated:Connect(function() spec.set(not (spec.get() == true));refresh() end)
            end
        elseif kind == "slider" then
            local minimum, maximum = spec.min or 0, spec.max or 100
            local trackWidth = width - 24 - 70
            local track = make("TextButton", card, {Name = "Track", Size = U.fromOffset(trackWidth, 8), Position = U.fromOffset(12, bottom + 10), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(40, 49, 68), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
            if settings.sliderStyle == "Thick" then track.Size = U.fromOffset(trackWidth, 12);track.Position = U.fromOffset(12, bottom + 8) end
            corner(track, 6)
            local fill = make("Frame", track, {Name = "Fill", Size = U.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent()});corner(fill, 6)
            local knob = nil
            if settings.sliderStyle == "Knob" then
                knob = make("Frame", track, {Name = "Knob", Size = U.fromOffset(16, 16), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.new(0, 0, .5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(240, 244, 250)})
                corner(knob, 8);stroke(knob, accent(), 2, 0)
            end
            if type(spec.default) == "number" and maximum > minimum then
                make("Frame", track, {Name = "Default", Size = U.fromOffset(2, 12), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.new(math.clamp((spec.default - minimum) / (maximum - minimum), 0, 1), 0, .5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BackgroundTransparency = .5})
            end
            local number = make("TextBox", card, {Name = "Value", Size = U.fromOffset(58, 26), Position = U.fromOffset(width - 70, bottom + 1), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false})
            corner(number, 7);stroke(number, lineColor(), 1, .6)
            number.TextColor3, number.TextSize = settings.textColor, math.max(10, math.floor(13 * settings.titleSize / 100))
            pcall(function() number.Font = E.Font[FONT_ENUM[settings.font] or "GothamMedium"] end)
            local function refresh()
                local value = tonumber(spec.get()) or minimum
                local fraction = if maximum > minimum then math.clamp((value - minimum) / (maximum - minimum), 0, 1) else 0
                fill.Size = U.fromScale(fraction, 1)
                if knob then knob.Position = U.new(fraction, 0, .5, 0) end
                if not number:IsFocused() then number.Text = numberText(value, spec.precision) end
            end
            local function setFromX(x: number)
                local fraction = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
                local value = minimum + (maximum - minimum) * fraction
                if spec.step and spec.step > 0 then value = minimum + math.round((value - minimum) / spec.step) * spec.step end
                spec.set(math.clamp(value, minimum, maximum));refresh()
            end
            track.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
                if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = {set = setFromX};setFromX(object.Position.X)
                elseif object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and type(spec.default) == "number" then spec.set(spec.default);refresh() end
            end)
            number.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                local value = tonumber(number.Text)
                if value then (spec.exact or spec.set)(math.clamp(value, minimum, maximum)) end
                refresh()
            end)
            refresh();add(refresh)
        elseif kind == "dropdown" then
            local button = make("TextButton", card, {Name = "Dropdown", Size = U.fromOffset(width - 24, 28), Position = U.fromOffset(12, bottom), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
            corner(button, round);stroke(button, lineColor(), 1, .5)
            local text = styled(button, "", {Size = U.new(1, -34, 1, 0), Position = U.fromOffset(10, 0), TextColor3 = accent(), TextSize = 13})
            local chevron = make("Frame", button, {Name = "Chevron", Size = U.fromOffset(16, 10), Position = U.new(1, -26, .5, -5), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
            for side = -1, 1, 2 do
                local bar = make("Frame", chevron, {Name = "Bar", Size = U.fromOffset(10, 2), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromOffset(8 + side * 3.6, 5),
                    Rotation = -side * 40, BackgroundColor3 = accent()})
                corner(bar, 1)
            end
            local labels = spec.labels or {}
            local function current(): string
                local value = spec.get()
                if spec.multi then
                    local names = {}
                    for _, option in (type(value) == "table" and value or {}) do table.insert(names, tostring(labels[option] or option)) end
                    return if #names > 0 then table.concat(names, ", ") else "None selected"
                end
                return tostring(labels[value] or value or "None")
            end
            local function refresh() text.Text = current() end
            refresh();add(refresh)
            button.Activated:Connect(function()
                if openPopup and openPopup.owner == button then closePopup();return end
                closePopup()
                local options = spec.options or {}
                local rowHeight = 30
                local popupHeight = math.min(280, #options * (rowHeight + 2) + 8)
                local uiScale = math.max(.01, settings.scale / 100)
                -- A dropdown opened from a mini page opens inside the mini's own screen layer, so it is drawn above it and lines up with it.
                local inMini = miniLayer ~= nil and button:IsDescendantOf(miniLayer)
                local anchorFrame = if inMini then miniLayer else window
                local abs, windowAbs = button.AbsolutePosition, anchorFrame.AbsolutePosition
                local baseZ = if miniLayer then 110 else 60
                local frame = make("ScrollingFrame", if inMini then miniLayer else overlay, {Name = "Popup", Size = U.fromOffset(math.max(button.AbsoluteSize.X / uiScale, 180), popupHeight), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor,
                    ScrollBarThickness = 3, CanvasSize = U.fromOffset(0, #options * (rowHeight + 2) + 8), ZIndex = baseZ})
                local y = (abs.Y - windowAbs.Y) / uiScale + button.AbsoluteSize.Y / uiScale + 4
                if y + popupHeight > anchorFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y / uiScale then y = (abs.Y - windowAbs.Y) / uiScale - popupHeight - 4 end
                frame.Position = U.fromOffset((abs.X - windowAbs.X) / uiScale, y)
                corner(frame, round);stroke(frame, lineColor(), 1, .35)
                local layout = Inst.new("UIListLayout");layout.Padding = host.UDim.new(0, 2);layout.Parent = frame
                local pad = Inst.new("UIPadding");pad.PaddingTop, pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight = host.UDim.new(0, 4), host.UDim.new(0, 4), host.UDim.new(0, 4);pad.Parent = frame
                local chosen = {}
                if spec.multi then for _, option in (spec.get() or {}) do chosen[option] = true end end
                for _, option in options do
                    local entry = make("TextButton", frame, {Name = "Option", Size = U.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight), BackgroundColor3 = settings.cardColor, BackgroundTransparency = .3, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = baseZ + 1})
                    corner(entry, round)
                    local function caption(): string return tostring(labels[option] or option) end
                    local label = styled(entry, caption(), {Size = U.new(1, if spec.multi then -38 else -14, 1, 0), Position = U.fromOffset(if spec.multi then 32 else 10, 0), ZIndex = baseZ + 2, TextSize = 13,
                        TextColor3 = (if (not spec.multi and spec.get() == option) or chosen[option] then accent() else settings.textColor)})
                    local mark = nil
                    if spec.multi then
                        local box = make("Frame", entry, {Name = "Box", Size = U.fromOffset(16, 16), Position = U.new(0, 8, .5, -8), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, ZIndex = baseZ + 2})
                        corner(box, 4);stroke(box, lineColor(), 1.5, .2)
                        mark = make("Frame", box, {Name = "Mark", Size = U.fromOffset(8, 8), Position = U.fromOffset(4, 4), BackgroundColor3 = accent(), ZIndex = baseZ + 3, Visible = chosen[option] == true})
                        corner(mark, 2)
                    end
                    entry.Activated:Connect(function()
                        if spec.multi then
                            chosen[option] = not chosen[option]
                            local list = {}
                            for _, each in options do if chosen[each] then table.insert(list, each) end end
                            spec.set(list);label.Text = caption();if mark then mark.Visible = chosen[option] == true end;refresh()
                        else spec.set(option);refresh();closePopup() end
                    end)
                end
                openPopup = {frame = frame, owner = button}
            end)
        elseif kind == "button" then
            local button = make("TextButton", card, {Name = "Run", Size = U.fromOffset(math.min(150, width - 24), 28), Position = U.fromOffset(12, bottom), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
            corner(button, round);stroke(button, lineColor(), 1, .4)
            styled(button, spec.caption or "Run", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextColor3 = accent(), TextSize = 13})
            button.Activated:Connect(function() spec.press() end)
        elseif kind == "color" then
            local back = make("TextButton", card, {Name = "Color", Size = U.fromOffset(width - 24, 28), Position = U.fromOffset(12, bottom), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(175, 181, 190), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
            corner(back, round);stroke(back, lineColor(), 1, .4)
            local swatch = make("Frame", back, {Name = "Swatch", Size = U.fromScale(1, 1)});corner(swatch, round)
            local function refresh()
                local value = spec.get()
                swatch.BackgroundColor3 = if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) == "Color3" then value else rgb(255, 255, 255)
                swatch.BackgroundTransparency = if spec.alpha then spec.alpha() else 0
            end
            refresh();add(refresh)
            styled(back, "Change colour", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.new(1, 1, 1)}).TextStrokeTransparency = .3
            back.Activated:Connect(function() spec.open() end)
        elseif kind == "input" then
            local box = make("TextBox", card, {Name = "Input", Size = U.fromOffset(width - 24, 28), Position = U.fromOffset(12, bottom), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = tostring(spec.get() or ""), ClearTextOnFocus = false})
            corner(box, round);stroke(box, lineColor(), 1, .5)
            box.TextColor3, box.TextSize = settings.textColor, math.max(10, math.floor(13 * settings.titleSize / 100))
            pcall(function() box.Font = E.Font[FONT_ENUM[settings.font] or "GothamMedium"] end)
            box.FocusLost:Connect(function() spec.set(box.Text) end)
            add(function() if not box:IsFocused() then box.Text = tostring(spec.get() or "") end end)
        end
    end
    local MIN_CARD = 250
    local function renderCard(parent: any, spec: any, width: number, order: number, highlight: boolean?)
        local height = settings.cardHeight
        local card = make("Frame", parent, {Name = "Card", Size = U.fromOffset(width, height), BackgroundColor3 = settings.cardColor, BackgroundTransparency = settings.cardAlpha / 100, LayoutOrder = order})
        corner(card, if settings.cardStyle == "Rounded" then settings.radius elseif settings.cardStyle == "Soft" then settings.radius + 6 else 4)
        local border = stroke(card, lineColor(), settings.outlineWidth, settings.outlineAlpha / 100)
        -- A box found by a search keeps an accent outline until the search is cleared or the menu is closed.
        if highlight then border.Name = "SearchMark";border.Color, border.Thickness, border.Transparency = accent(), 3, 0 end
        if settings.cardBar then make("Frame", card, {Name = "Bar", Size = U.new(0, 3, .6, 0), Position = U.new(0, 0, .2, 0), BackgroundColor3 = accent()}) end
        local keyWidth = if spec.keyEntry then 104 else 0
        local nameWidth = (if spec.kind == "toggle" then width - 76 else width - 24) - keyWidth
        -- A name that does not fit on one line wraps onto a second line instead of being cut off.
        local twoLines = #tostring(spec.name) * 8.4 > nameWidth
        styled(card, spec.name, {Name = "Name", Size = U.fromOffset(nameWidth, if twoLines then 38 else 24), Position = U.fromOffset(12, 8), TextSize = 15, FontName = nil,
            Wrap = twoLines, TextYAlignment = if twoLines then E.TextYAlignment.Top else E.TextYAlignment.Center})
        if spec.keyEntry then
            local keyButton = make("TextButton", card, {Name = "Key", Size = U.fromOffset(96, 22), Position = U.fromOffset(width - (if spec.kind == "toggle" then 56 else 12) - 100, 9), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
            corner(keyButton, 7);stroke(keyButton, lineColor(), 1, .55)
            local keyText = styled(keyButton, "", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = settings.mutedColor})
            local function refreshKey()
                local okay, text = pcall(menu.bindingText, spec.keyEntry)
                keyText.Text = if okay and text and text ~= "Unbound" then tostring(text) else "Set key"
                keyText.TextColor3 = if okay and text and text ~= "Unbound" then accent() else settings.mutedColor
            end
            refreshKey();table.insert(updaters, refreshKey)
            keyButton.Activated:Connect(function() openKeyRef(spec.keyEntry) end)
        end
        if settings.descriptions then
            local text = simpler(spec.desc)
            if text ~= "" then
                local shift = if twoLines then 16 else 0
                styled(card, text, {Name = "Desc", Size = U.fromOffset(width - 24, math.max(16, height - 38 - 36 - shift)), Position = U.fromOffset(12, 34 + shift), TextSize = 12, Role = "desc", Wrap = true, TextYAlignment = E.TextYAlignment.Top})
            end
        end
        addControl(card, spec, width, height)
        if spec.mini then
            local lastOpen = 0
            local function onRight(object: any)
                if object.UserInputType ~= E.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return end
                local now = clock()
                if now - lastOpen < .25 then return end
                lastOpen = now
                spec.mini()
            end
            card.InputBegan:Connect(onRight)
            for _, child in card:GetDescendants() do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name ~= "Track" then child.InputBegan:Connect(onRight) end
            end
        end
        return card
    end
    -- ===== specs for every original setting =====
    local function specFromRecord(record: any): any?
        local widget, config = record.widget, record.config or {}
        if not widget or not widget.Get then return nil end
        local kind = record.kind
        local name = tostring(config.DisplayName or config.Name or record.name)
        if kind == "CreateParagraph" then return nil end
        local base = {name = name, desc = tostring(config.Description or config.Content or ""), record = record}
        if menu.keybindEntry then
            local okay, entry = pcall(menu.keybindEntry, record)
            if okay and entry then base.keyEntry = entry end
        end
        local function get() local okay, value = pcall(widget.Get);return if okay then value else nil end
        local function apply(value: any): boolean
            local okay, result, reason = pcall(widget.Set, value, true)
            if not okay then
                warn("[Shenaniganism] Menu: '" .. name .. "' errored when set to " .. tostring(value) .. ": " .. tostring(result))
                return false
            elseif result == false then
                warn("[Shenaniganism] Menu: '" .. name .. "' refused " .. tostring(value) .. ": " .. tostring(reason or "no reason given"))
                return false
            end
            if kind ~= "CreateSlider" and kind ~= "CreateInput" then print("[Shenaniganism] Menu: '" .. name .. "' set to " .. tostring(value)) end
            return true
        end
        if kind == "CreateToggle" then
            base.kind, base.get, base.set = "toggle", get, function(value: any) apply(value) end
        elseif kind == "CreateSlider" then
            base.kind, base.get, base.set = "slider", get, function(value: any) apply(value) end
            base.min, base.max, base.step, base.precision, base.default = config.Min, config.Max, config.Step, config.Precision, config.Default
            -- Typed values keep every decimal: the step is switched off for that one change.
            base.exact = function(value: any)
                local step = config.Step
                config.Step = nil
                pcall(widget.Set, value, true)
                config.Step = step
            end
        elseif kind == "CreateDropdown" then
            base.kind, base.get, base.set = "dropdown", get, function(value: any) apply(value) end
            base.options, base.multi, base.labels = config.Options or {}, config.Multi == true or config.MultiSelect == true or config.Multiple == true, config.OptionLabels
        elseif kind == "CreateButton" then
            base.kind, base.caption = "button", tostring(config.ButtonText or "Run")
            base.press = function()
                print("[Shenaniganism] Menu: pressed '" .. name .. "'")
                if widget.Activate then
                    local okay, problem = pcall(widget.Activate)
                    if not okay then warn("[Shenaniganism] Menu: '" .. name .. "' errored: " .. tostring(problem)) end
                else apply(true) end
            end
        elseif kind == "CreateColorPicker" then
            base.kind, base.get = "color", get
            base.alpha = function() return if menu.ui and menu.ui.colorAlpha then menu.ui.colorAlpha(record) else 0 end
            base.open = function()
                local okay, opened = pcall(openColorRef, record)
                if not okay then warn("[Shenaniganism] Menu: colour picker errored: " .. tostring(opened)) end
            end
        elseif kind == "CreateInput" then
            base.kind, base.get, base.set = "input", get, function(value: any) apply(value) end
        else return nil end
        -- Right-click opens the same mini menu the original menu has for this setting.
        if menu.searchMainSettings then base.mini = function() openMiniRef(record) end end
        return base
    end
    -- ===== mini menus, rebuilt =====
    local function closeMini() if miniGui then miniGui:Destroy();miniGui = nil end;if miniLayer then miniLayer:Destroy();miniLayer = nil end end
    function control.hasVisibleSurface()
        return control.open==true or miniGui~=nil and miniGui.Parent~=nil and miniGui.Enabled==true
    end
    -- Press on the handle and drag to move the panel; it stays inside the window. `remember` receives the offset.
    local function makeDraggable(panel: any, handle: any, remember: any?, free: boolean?)
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(object: any)
            if object.UserInputType ~= E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and object.UserInputType ~= E.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local start = input:GetMouseLocation()
            local scale = math.max(.01, settings.scale / 100)
            local ox, oy = panel.Position.X.Offset, panel.Position.Y.Offset
            dragging = {move = function(point: any)
                local x, y
                if free and gui then
                    -- Free over the whole game window, and past its edges: only a strip of the panel (80 px) has to stay on screen so its title bar can
                    -- always be grabbed back. The reference is the mini's own screen layer when there is one.
                    local layer = if miniLayer and miniLayer.Parent then miniLayer else overlay
                    local centre = layer.AbsolutePosition + layer.AbsoluteSize / 2
                    local screen, half = (if miniGui and miniGui.Parent then miniGui else gui).AbsoluteSize, panel.AbsoluteSize / 2
                    local keep = 80
                    x = math.clamp(ox + (point.X - start.X) / scale, (keep - half.X - centre.X) / scale, (screen.X - keep + half.X - centre.X) / scale)
                    y = math.clamp(oy + (point.Y - start.Y) / scale, (keep - half.Y - centre.Y) / scale, (screen.Y - keep + half.Y - centre.Y) / scale)
                else
                    -- Keep the panel inside the window (with a small overhang) so its title bar can always be grabbed again.
                    local limitX = math.max(0, (overlay.AbsoluteSize.X - panel.AbsoluteSize.X) / scale / 2) + 40
                    local limitY = math.max(0, (overlay.AbsoluteSize.Y - panel.AbsoluteSize.Y) / scale / 2) + 40
                    x = math.clamp(ox + (point.X - start.X) / scale, -limitX, limitX)
                    y = math.clamp(oy + (point.Y - start.Y) / scale, -limitY, limitY)
                end
                panel.Position = U.new(.5, x, .5, y)
                if remember then remember(x, y) end
            end}
        end)
    end
    local miniOffset = {x = 0, y = 0}
    local miniSize: any = nil
    local MINI_GROUPS = {"Main switch", "Info card", "Circle: what it shows", "Circle: layout, shape & position", "Circle: colours & glow", "Hit effects & popups", "Range & reach", "Timing & speed", "Aim & tracking", "Targets & filters", "Look & colour", "Other"}
    local MINI_WORDS = {
        {"Look & colour", {"color", "colour", "opacity", "transparency", "visual", "show ", "style", "thickness", "glow", "fx", "display", "outline", "marker"}},
        {"Range & reach", {"range", "reach", "margin", "distance", "radius", "area", "box", "offset", "size", "length", "height", "width", "depth"}},
        {"Timing & speed", {"delay", "time", "window", "cooldown", "interval", "lead", "duration", "speed", "smoothing", "intro", "fade", "(ms)", "(s)", "hold", "release", "recovery", "rate"}},
        {"Aim & tracking", {"aim", "lock", "track", "sticky", "target", "priority", "prediction", "turn", "direction", "latch", "cursor", "camera"}},
        {"Targets & filters", {"what to block", "facing", "angle", "chance", "typing", "look at", "check", "only", "ignore", "exclude", "require", "when", "while", "after", "before", "unblock", "reblock", "emergency", "assist"}},
    }
    local function miniGroupOf(name: string): string
        local lowered = name:lower()
        for _, group in MINI_WORDS do
            for _, word in group[2] do
                if lowered:find(word, 1, true) then return group[1] end
            end
        end
        return "Other"
    end
    -- Your own info card and circle get their own tidy sections instead of the generic keyword groups.
    local function selfGroupOf(name: string): string
        local l = name:lower()
        if l:find("^self hud ring") or l == "self hud cooldown ring" or l == "self hud cooldown bar mode" or l == "self hud ultimate color" then
            if l:find("color") or l:find("glow") or l:find("bloom") or l:find("opacity") or l:find("transparen") or l:find("dark boost") or l:find("thickness") or l:find("grey") or l:find("invert") or l:find("swap") then return "Circle: colours & glow" end
            if l:find("layout") or l:find("shape") or l:find("geometry") or l:find("sides") or l:find("corner gap") or l:find("rotation") or l:find("spin") or l:find("inner size")
                or l:find("radius") or l:find("height") or l:find("offset") or l:find("attach") or l:find("on the ground") or l:find("draws over") then return "Circle: layout, shape & position" end
            return "Circle: what it shows"
        end
        if l:find("hit ring") or l:find("reach marker") or l:find("popup") or l:find("hit tag") or l:find("flash") then return "Hit effects & popups" end
        return "Info card"
    end
    local function openMiniFrom(owner: any, entries: {any}, titleText: string, back: any?)
        closeMini()
        if not window then return end
        -- Not modal: the layer passes clicks through to the game and the main menu, so the mini panel stays until its X (or Escape) closes it.
        -- The mini page lives in its own screen layer, so it does not depend on the main menu: the main menu can close, hide with its key or
        -- be rebuilt and the mini page stays; only its own X (or Escape) closes it.
        miniGui = make("ScreenGui", gui.Parent, {Name = "ShenaniganismMini", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 61, Enabled = true})
        miniLayer = make("Frame", miniGui, {Name = "MiniLayer", Size = U.fromScale(100 / math.max(1, settings.scale), 100 / math.max(1, settings.scale)), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = false, ZIndex = 70})
        do local miniScale = Inst.new("UIScale");miniScale.Scale = settings.scale / 100;miniScale.Parent = miniLayer end
        local width = math.min(settings.width - 80, 400 * settings.miniColumns + 60)
        local height = math.min(settings.height - 80, 620)
        if miniSize then
            local area = (if miniGui and miniGui.Parent then miniGui else gui).AbsoluteSize
            local fit = math.max(.01, settings.scale / 100)
            width, height = math.clamp(miniSize.w, 300, math.max(300, area.X / fit * 2)), math.clamp(miniSize.h, 220, math.max(220, area.Y / fit * 2))
        end
        local panel = make("Frame", miniLayer, {Name = "Mini", Size = U.fromOffset(width, height), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromScale(.5, .5), BackgroundColor3 = settings.windowColor, BackgroundTransparency = (function() local ui = menu.ui;local look = ui and ui.appearance and ui.appearance.miniMenu;return math.clamp(if look and type(look.transparency) == "number" then look.transparency else .5, 0, 1) end)(), ZIndex = 71})
        corner(panel, settings.radius + 2);stroke(panel, lineColor(), 1.5, .35)
        panel.Position = U.new(.5, miniOffset.x, .5, miniOffset.y)
        local dragBar = make("TextButton", panel, {Name = "DragBar", Size = U.new(1, -300, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 71})
        makeDraggable(panel, dragBar, function(x: number, y: number) miniOffset.x, miniOffset.y = x, y end, true)
        for _, spec in {{"MiniGripR", U.new(1, -7, 0, 56), U.new(0, 14, 1, -90), {r = true}}, {"MiniGripB", U.new(0, 30, 1, -7), U.new(1, -90, 0, 14), {b = true}}, {"MiniGripBR", U.new(1, -22, 1, -22), U.fromOffset(26, 26), {r = true, b = true}}} do
            local handle = make("TextButton", panel, {Name = spec[1], Position = spec[2], Size = spec[3], BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 79})
            local edges = spec[4]
            handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
                if object.UserInputType ~= E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and object.UserInputType ~= E.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                local scale = math.max(.01, settings.scale / 100)
                local startPoint = input:GetMouseLocation()
                local startW, startH = panel.Size.X.Offset, panel.Size.Y.Offset
                local area = (if miniGui and miniGui.Parent then miniGui else gui).AbsoluteSize
                local pending = {w = startW, h = startH}
                local startX, startY = panel.Position.X.Offset, panel.Position.Y.Offset
                dragging = {resize = function(point: any)
                    if edges.r then pending.w = math.clamp(startW + (point.X - startPoint.X) / scale, 300, math.max(300, area.X / scale * 2)) end
                    if edges.b then pending.h = math.clamp(startH + (point.Y - startPoint.Y) / scale, 220, math.max(220, area.Y / scale * 2)) end
                    panel.Size = U.fromOffset(pending.w, pending.h)
                    -- The panel is centred on its anchor, so shift it by half the change to keep its top-left corner where it is.
                    panel.Position = U.new(.5, startX + (pending.w - startW) / 2, .5, startY + (pending.h - startH) / 2)
                    miniOffset.x, miniOffset.y = startX + (pending.w - startW) / 2, startY + (pending.h - startH) / 2
                end, drop = function()
                    miniSize = {w = pending.w, h = pending.h}
                    host.task.defer(function() openMiniFrom(owner, entries, titleText, back) end)
                end, mini = true}
            end)
        end
        styled(panel, titleText, {Size = U.new(1, -300, 0, 30), Position = U.fromOffset(16, 4), TextSize = 17, ZIndex = 72})
        local function headerButton(text: string, x: number, w: number, callback: any, hot: boolean?)
            local button = make("TextButton", panel, {Name = "Head", Size = U.fromOffset(w, 30), Position = U.new(1, x, 0, 10), BackgroundColor3 = if hot then rgb(255, 110, 120) else settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 72})
            corner(button, 15);stroke(button, lineColor(), 1, .5)
            styled(button, text, {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 73, TextColor3 = if hot then rgb(40, 10, 14) else accent()})
            button.Activated:Connect(callback)
        end
        do
            local xButton = make("TextButton", panel, {Name = "Close", Size = U.fromOffset(30, 30), Position = U.new(1, -44, 0, 10), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(255, 110, 120), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 72})
            corner(xButton, 15);stroke(xButton, lineColor(), 1, .5)
            for side = -1, 1, 2 do
                local bar = make("Frame", xButton, {Name = "Bar", Size = U.fromOffset(14, 2), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromScale(.5, .5), Rotation = side * 45, BackgroundColor3 = rgb(40, 10, 14), ZIndex = 73})
                corner(bar, 1)
            end
            xButton.Activated:Connect(closeMini)
        end
        if back then headerButton("Back", -124, 70, back) end
        local keyEntry = nil
        if owner and menu.keybindEntry then
            local okay, found = pcall(menu.keybindEntry, owner)
            if okay then keyEntry = found end
        end
        if keyEntry then
            local okay, label = pcall(menu.bindingText, keyEntry)
            headerButton("Key: " .. (if okay and label then tostring(label) else "none"), -274, 140, function() openKeyRef(keyEntry) end)
        end
        local items: {any} = {}
        local seenKey: {[string]: boolean} = {}
        for _, entry in entries do
            local spec
            if entry.submenuRecords then
                spec = {kind = "button", name = tostring(entry.displayName or (entry.config and entry.config.DisplayName) or entry.name), desc = "More options for this setting.", caption = "Open",
                    press = function() openMiniFrom(entry, entry.submenuRecords, tostring(entry.displayName or entry.name), function() openMiniFrom(owner, entries, titleText, back) end) end}
            else spec = specFromRecord(entry) end
            if spec then
                spec.mini = nil
                local key = spec.name .. "|" .. tostring(spec.kind)

                    seenKey[key] = true

" " .. tostring(spec.desc or "")):lower()})
                end

            {Size = U.new(1, -300, 0, 16), Position = U.fromOffset(16, 34), TextSize = 12, ZIndex = 72, Role = "desc"})
        local search = make("TextBox", panel, {Name = "Search", Size = U.new(1, -24, 0, 30), Position = U.fromOffset(12, 58), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Search these options",

        corner(search, 15);stroke(search, lineColor(), 1, .6)

        local body = make("ScrollingFrame", panel, {Name = "Body", Size = U.new(1, -24, 1, -102), Position = U.fromOffset(12, 94), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 4,
            CanvasSize = U.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = E.AutomaticSize.Y, ZIndex = 72})
        local columns = math.min(math.clamp(settings.miniColumns, 1, 3), math.max(1, math.floor((width - 38 + settings.gap) / (MIN_CARD + settings.gap))))
        local cardWidth = math.floor((width - 24 - 14 - settings.gap * (columns - 1)) / columns)

        local collapsedGroups: {[string]: boolean} = {}
        -- Options of one family (the first two words of their names) become a sub-menu of their group when there are three or more.
        local function familyOf(name: string): string
            local words = {}
            for word in name:gmatch("%S+") do
                table.insert(words, word)
                if #words == 2 then break end
            end
            return table.concat(words, " ")
        end
        local subWidth = math.floor((width - 24 - 14 - 16 - settings.gap * (columns - 1)) / columns)
        local function rebuild(filter: string)
            for _, child in body:GetChildren() do if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then child:Destroy() end end
            local lowered = filter:lower()
            local order, visibleIndex, shown = 0, 0, 0
            local function chevronIn(parent: any, isCollapsed: boolean, x: number, z: number)
                local chevron = make("Frame", parent, {Name = "Chevron", Size = U.fromOffset(16, 10), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromOffset(x, 15), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Rotation = if isCollapsed then -90 else 0, ZIndex = z})
                for side = -1, 1, 2 do
                    local bar = make("Frame", chevron, {Name = "Bar", Size = U.fromOffset(10, 2), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromOffset(8 + side * 3.6, 5), Rotation = -side * 40, BackgroundColor3 = accent(), ZIndex = z + 1})
                    corner(bar, 1)
                end
            end
            local function addGrid(members: {any}, cellWidth: number, indent: boolean)
                order += 1
                local grid = make("Frame", body, {Name = "Grid", Size = U.new(1, -6, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = E.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 72})
                if indent then local inset = Inst.new("UIPadding");inset.PaddingLeft = host.UDim.new(0, 16);inset.Parent = grid end
                local cells = Inst.new("UIGridLayout");cells.CellSize = U.fromOffset(cellWidth, settings.cardHeight);cells.CellPadding = U.fromOffset(settings.gap, settings.gap)
                cells.SortOrder = E.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;cells.Parent = grid
                for position, item in members do
                    local card = renderCard(grid, item.spec, cellWidth, position, lowered ~= "")
                    for _, child in card:GetDescendants() do if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child.ZIndex = 73 end end
                end
            end
            for _, groupName in MINI_GROUPS do
                local members = {}
                for _, item in items do
                    if item.group == groupName and (lowered == "" or item.haystack:find(lowered, 1, true)) then table.insert(members, item) end
                end
                if #members == 0 then continue end
                visibleIndex += 1
                shown += #members
                if collapsedGroups[groupName] == nil then collapsedGroups[groupName] = #items > 14 and visibleIndex > 2 end
                local isCollapsed = lowered == "" and collapsedGroups[groupName] == true
                order += 1
                local head = make("TextButton", body, {Name = "Group", Size = U.new(1, -6, 0, 32), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, BackgroundTransparency = .35, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 73})
                corner(head, 8)
                chevronIn(head, isCollapsed, 18, 74)
                styled(head, groupName .. "   (" .. tostring(#members) .. ")", {Size = U.new(1, -44, 1, 0), Position = U.fromOffset(38, 0), TextSize = 14, ZIndex = 74, TextColor3 = accent()})
                head.Activated:Connect(function()
                    collapsedGroups[groupName] = not collapsedGroups[groupName]
                    rebuild(search.Text)
                end)
                if isCollapsed then continue end
                local counts = {}
                for _, item in members do local family = familyOf(item.spec.name);counts[family] = (counts[family] or 0) + 1 end
                local loose, families, familyOrder = {}, {}, {}
                for _, item in members do
                    local family = familyOf(item.spec.name)
                    if #members > 5 and counts[family] >= 2 then
                        if not families[family] then families[family] = {};table.insert(familyOrder, family) end
                        table.insert(families[family], item)
                    else table.insert(loose, item) end
                end
                if #loose > 0 then addGrid(loose, cardWidth, false) end
                for _, family in familyOrder do
                    local list = families[family]
                    local key = groupName .. "/" .. family
                    if collapsedGroups[key] == nil then collapsedGroups[key] = #members > 10 end
                    local subCollapsed = lowered == "" and collapsedGroups[key] == true
                    order += 1
                    local wrap = make("Frame", body, {Name = "SubGroup", Size = U.new(1, -6, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 73})
                    local sub = make("TextButton", wrap, {Name = "SubHead", Size = U.new(1, -16, 1, 0), Position = U.fromOffset(16, 0), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, BackgroundTransparency = .6, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 73})
                    corner(sub, 8)
                    chevronIn(sub, subCollapsed, 16, 74)
                    styled(sub, family .. "   (" .. tostring(#list) .. ")", {Size = U.new(1, -44, 1, 0), Position = U.fromOffset(34, 0), TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 74, TextColor3 = settings.textColor})
                    sub.Activated:Connect(function()
                        collapsedGroups[key] = not collapsedGroups[key]
                        rebuild(search.Text)
                    end)
                    if not subCollapsed then addGrid(list, subWidth, true) end
                end
            end
            if shown == 0 then
                order += 1
                local empty = styled(body, if #items == 0 then "This setting has no extra options." else "Nothing matches that search.", {Size = U.new(1, -12, 0, 30), Position = U.fromOffset(4, 0), ZIndex = 73, Role = "desc"})
                empty.LayoutOrder = order
            end
        end
        local token = 0
        search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            token += 1
            local mine = token
            host.task.delay(.2, function() if mine == token and body.Parent then rebuild(search.Text) end end)
        end)
        rebuild("")
        panel.Active = true
    end
    local function openMini(record: any)
        local okay, owner, entries = pcall(menu.searchMainSettings, record)
        if not okay or not owner then return false end
        local config = (owner.config or record.config or {})
        print("[Shenaniganism] Menu: right-click menu for '" .. tostring(record.name) .. "' opened with " .. tostring(#(entries or {})) .. " options")
        openMiniFrom(owner, entries or {}, tostring(owner.displayName or config.DisplayName or owner.name or record.name))
        return true
    end
    openMiniRef = openMini

        settings.width, settings.height = width, height
        build()
    end
    function control.openMiniFor(name: string): boolean
        for _, record in menu.rows or {} do

        end
        return false
    end
    -- ===== colour picker: a colour panel, hue and opacity bars, and hex / RGB / HSV codes, in this menu's own look =====
    local function closeColorPanel() if colorLayer then colorLayer:Destroy();colorLayer = nil end end
    -- Reads a colour written as hex (#fff, #ffffff, #ffffff80), rgb(...), "r, g, b", hsl(...) or hsv(...).
    local function parseColorCode(text: string, forced: string?): (any, number?)
        local raw = tostring(text):lower()
        local mode = forced
        if not mode then
            if raw:find("hsl", 1, true) then mode = "hsl"
            elseif raw:find("hsv", 1, true) or raw:find("hsb", 1, true) then mode = "hsv"
            elseif raw:find("#", 1, true) or raw:match("^%s*%x+%s*$") and (#raw:gsub("%s", "") == 3 or #raw:gsub("%s", "") == 6 or #raw:gsub("%s", "") == 8) and raw:find("[a-f]") then mode = "hex"
            else mode = "rgb" end
        end
        if mode == "hex" then
            local digits = raw:match("#?(%x+)")
            if digits and #digits == 3 then digits = digits:gsub(".", function(c: string) return c .. c end) end
            if digits and (#digits == 6 or #digits == 8) then
                local color = C.fromRGB(tonumber(digits:sub(1, 2), 16) or 0, tonumber(digits:sub(3, 4), 16) or 0, tonumber(digits:sub(5, 6), 16) or 0)
                return color, if #digits == 8 then 1 - (tonumber(digits:sub(7, 8), 16) or 0) / 255 else nil
            end
            return nil, nil
        end
        local numbers = {}
        for token in raw:gmatch("[%+%-]?[%d%.]+%%?") do
            local percent=token:sub(-1)=='%'
            local number=tonumber(if percent then token:sub(1,-2) else token)
            if not number or number~=number or math.abs(number)==math.huge then return nil,nil end
            if percent and (#numbers==3 or mode=='rgb')then number*=if #numbers==3 then .01 else 2.55 end
            table.insert(numbers,number)
        end
        if #numbers < 3 or #numbers > 4 then return nil, nil end
        local x, y, z = numbers[1], numbers[2], numbers[3]
        if not x or not y or not z then return nil, nil end
        local opacity = nil
        local alpha: number?=tonumber(numbers[4])
        if alpha then opacity=1-math.clamp(if alpha>1 then alpha/255 else alpha,0,1) end
        if mode == "rgb" then
            return C.fromRGB(math.clamp(x, 0, 255), math.clamp(y, 0, 255), math.clamp(z, 0, 255)), opacity
        elseif mode == "hsv" then
            return C.fromHSV((x % 360) / 360, math.clamp(y, 0, 100) / 100, math.clamp(z, 0, 100) / 100), opacity
        else
            local h, sl, l = (x % 360) / 360, math.clamp(y, 0, 100) / 100, math.clamp(z, 0, 100) / 100
            local v = l + sl * math.min(l, 1 - l)
            return C.fromHSV(h, if v > 0 then 2 * (1 - l / v) else 0, v), opacity
        end
    end
    openColorRef = function(record: any): boolean
        closeColorPanel()
        local ui = menu.ui
        if not window or not record or not record.widget or not ui or type(ui.setColorValue) ~= "function" then return false end
        local targets: {any} = {{name = "Colour",

                local value = record.widget.Get()
                if menu.colorValue then value = menu.colorValue(value, C.new(1, 1, 1)) end
                return value
            end,
            alpha = function(): number return if type(ui.colorAlpha) == "function" then ui.colorAlpha(record) else 0 end,
            set = function(color: any, alpha: number, emit: boolean) ui.setColorValue(record, color, alpha, emit) end}}
        for _, extra in (record.config and record.config.PickerExtras) or {} do
            if extra.kind == "color" and type(extra.get) == "function" and type(extra.set) == "function" then
                table.insert(targets, {name = tostring(extra.label), get = extra.get, alpha = extra.alpha or function(): number return 0 end,
                    set = function(color: any, alpha: number, emit: boolean) extra.set(color, alpha, emit) end})
            end
        end
        local index = 1
        local original, originalAlpha = targets[1].get(), targets[1].alpha()
        local hue, sat, val = original:ToHSV()
        local alpha = originalAlpha
        local function hexText(color: any, opacity: number): string
            local text = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.round(color.R * 255), math.round(color.G * 255), math.round(color.B * 255))
            if opacity > .002 then text ..= string.format("%02X", math.round((1 - opacity) * 255)) end
            return text
        end

        colorLayer.Activated:Connect(closeColorPanel)
        local chipButtons: {any} = {}

            local caption = styled(row, label, {Size = U.new(1, 0, 0, 18), TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 133, TextColor3 = settings.mutedColor})

                if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = {set = setFromX};setFromX(object.Position.X)
                end
            end)
            table.insert(sliders, function()

        end
        sliderRow("Hue", function() return hue end, function(f: number) hue = f end, function(g: any)

        sliderRow("Brightness", function() return val end, function(f: number) val = f end, function(g: any)
            g.Color = host.ColorSequence.new(C.new(0, 0, 0), C.fromHSV(hue, sat, 1))
        end, function() return tostring(math.round(val * 100)) .. "%" end)
        sliderRow("Opacity", function() return 1 - alpha end, function(f: number) alpha = 1 - f end, function(g: any)
            g.Color = host.ColorSequence.new(C.new(.18, .2, .26), C.fromHSV(hue, sat, val))
        end, function() return tostring(math.round((1 - alpha) * 100)) .. "%" end)
        -- colour codes: hex, RGB and HSV; the hex box also understands rgb(...), hsl(...), hsv(...) and plain "r, g, b"
        local codeBoxes: {any} = {}
        local function codeBox(label: string, x: number, width: number, forced: string?, getText: any)
            styled(panel, label, {Size = U.fromOffset(width, 16), Position = U.fromOffset(x, top), TextSize = 12, ZIndex = 133, TextColor3 = settings.mutedColor})
            local box = make("TextBox", panel, {Name = label, Size = U.fromOffset(width, 30), Position = U.fromOffset(x, top + 18), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, ZIndex = 133})
            corner(box, 8);stroke(box, lineColor(), 1, .5)
            box.TextColor3, box.TextSize = settings.textColor, 13
            box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                local color, opacity = parseColorCode(box.Text, forced)
                if color then
                    hue, sat, val = color:ToHSV()
                    if opacity then alpha = opacity end
                    apply(true)
                elseif refreshAll then refreshAll() end
            end)
            table.insert(codeBoxes, {box = box, text = getText})
            return box
        end
        codeBox("Hex  (#ffffff, or rgb(), hsl(), hsv())", 16, 398, nil, function(): string return hexText(C.fromHSV(hue, sat, val), alpha) end)
        top += 56
        codeBox("RGB  (0 to 255)", 16, 190, "rgb", function(): string
            local color = C.fromHSV(hue, sat, val)
            return string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.round(color.R * 255), math.round(color.G * 255), math.round(color.B * 255))
        end)
        codeBox("HSV  (deg, %, %)", 224, 190, "hsv", function(): string
            return string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.round(hue * 360), math.round(sat * 100), math.round(val * 100))
        end)
        top += 58
        local reset = make("TextButton", panel, {Name = "Reset", Size = U.fromOffset(110, 30), Position = U.fromOffset(16, top), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 133})
        corner(reset, 15);stroke(reset, lineColor(), 1, .5)
        styled(reset, "Reset", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 134, TextColor3 = accent()})
        reset.Activated:Connect(function()
            hue, sat, val = original:ToHSV()
            alpha = originalAlpha
            apply(true)
        end)
        local done = make("TextButton", panel, {Name = "Done", Size = U.fromOffset(110, 30), Position = U.new(1, -126, 0, top), BackgroundColor3 = accent(), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 133})
        corner(done, 15)
        styled(done, "Done", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 134, TextColor3 = settings.windowColor})
        done.Activated:Connect(closeColorPanel)
        top += 46
        panel.Size = U.fromOffset(430, top)
        refreshAll = function()
            local color = C.fromHSV(hue, sat, val)
            newSwatch.BackgroundColor3, newSwatch.BackgroundTransparency = color, alpha
            oldSwatch.BackgroundColor3, oldSwatch.BackgroundTransparency = original, originalAlpha
            sv.BackgroundColor3 = C.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            pin.Position = U.new(sat, 0, 1 - val, 0)
            for _, update in sliders do update() end
            for _, code in codeBoxes do if not code.box:IsFocused() then code.box.Text = code.text() end end
            for position, parts in chipButtons do
                local selected = position == index
                parts.chip.BackgroundColor3 = if selected then accent() else settings.panelColor
                parts.chip.BackgroundTransparency = if selected then .75 else 0
                parts.mark.Transparency = if selected then .2 else .6
                parts.text.TextColor3 = if selected then accent() else settings.mutedColor
            end
        end
        refreshAll()
        return true
    end
    function control.openColorFor(name: string): boolean
        for _, record in menu.rows or {} do
            if record.kind == "CreateColorPicker" and record.widget and (record.name == name or (record.config and record.config.DisplayName == name)) then return openColorRef(record) end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- ===== keybind panel: the keybind editor in this menu's own look =====
    local keyLayer: any = nil
    local function closeKeyPanel()
        pcall(menu.cancelBindingRecording)
        if keyLayer then keyLayer:Destroy();keyLayer = nil end
        keyRefresh = nil
    end
    openKeyRef = function(entry: any)
        closeKeyPanel()
        if not window or not entry then return end
        keyLayer = make("TextButton", if miniLayer then miniLayer else overlay, {Name = "KeyLayer", Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 90})
        local canHold = false
        pcall(function() canHold = menu.supportsHold(entry) == true end)
        local panel = make("Frame", keyLayer, {Name = "Keys", Size = U.fromOffset(460, 340), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromScale(.5, .5), BackgroundColor3 = settings.windowColor, ZIndex = 91})
        corner(panel, settings.radius + 2);stroke(panel, lineColor(), 1.5, .35)
        local keyBar = make("TextButton", panel, {Name = "DragBar", Size = U.new(1, -100, 0, 44), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 91})
        makeDraggable(panel, keyBar)
        styled(panel, "Keybinds: " .. tostring(entry.displayName or entry.name), {Size = U.new(1, -120, 0, 40), Position = U.fromOffset(16, 4), TextSize = 17, ZIndex = 92})
        local function pill(parent: any, label: string, position: any, size: any, callback: any, hot: boolean?): any
            local button = make("TextButton", parent, {Name = "Pill", Size = size, Position = position, BackgroundColor3 = if hot then rgb(255, 110, 120) else settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 93})
            corner(button, 14);stroke(button, lineColor(), 1, .5)
            local text = styled(button, label, {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 94, TextColor3 = if hot then rgb(40, 10, 14) else accent()})
            button.Activated:Connect(callback)
            return button, text
        end
        pill(panel, "Close", U.new(1, -84, 0, 8), U.fromOffset(72, 28), closeKeyPanel, true)
        local body = make("ScrollingFrame", panel, {Name = "Body", Size = U.new(1, -24, 1, -112), Position = U.fromOffset(12, 50), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 4,
            CanvasSize = U.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = E.AutomaticSize.Y, ZIndex = 92})
        local listLayout = Inst.new("UIListLayout");listLayout.Padding = host.UDim.new(0, 6);listLayout.SortOrder = E.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;listLayout.Parent = body
        local function current(): {any}
            local okay, list = pcall(menu.bindingsFor, entry)
            return if okay and type(list) == "table" then list else {}
        end
        local function signature(): string
            local parts = {}
            for _, binding in current() do
                local okay, label = pcall(menu.bindingLabel, binding)
                local modeOkay, mode = pcall(menu.bindingMode, binding)
                table.insert(parts, tostring(if okay then label else "?") .. "/" .. tostring(if modeOkay then mode else ""))
            end
            return table.concat(parts, "|")
        end
        local lastSignature = ""
        local function rebuildRows()
            for _, child in body:GetChildren() do if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") then child:Destroy() end end
            local list = current()
            lastSignature = signature()
            local slots = math.max(1, #list)
            for slot = 1, slots do
                local binding = list[slot]
                local row = make("Frame", body, {Name = "Slot" .. slot, Size = U.new(1, -8, 0, 36), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = slot, ZIndex = 92})
                styled(row, "Key " .. slot, {Size = U.fromOffset(60, 36), TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 93, TextColor3 = settings.mutedColor})
                local recordWidth = if canHold and binding then 226 else 312
                local labelText = "Record"
                if binding then
                    local okay, label = pcall(menu.bindingLabel, binding)
                    if okay and label and label ~= "" then labelText = tostring(label) end
                end
                local recordButton
                recordButton = pill(row, labelText, U.fromOffset(64, 4), U.fromOffset(recordWidth, 28), function()
                    pcall(menu.beginBindingRecording, entry, slot, recordButton, panel)
                end)
                local x = 64 + recordWidth + 6
                if canHold and binding then
                    local okay, mode = pcall(menu.bindingMode, binding)
                    local modeName = if okay and mode then tostring(mode) else "Toggle"
                    pill(row, modeName, U.fromOffset(x, 4), U.fromOffset(86, 28), function()
                        pcall(menu.setBindingMode, entry, slot, if modeName == "Toggle" then "Hold" else "Toggle")
                        rebuildRows()
                    end)
                    x += 92
                end
                pill(row, "Clear", U.fromOffset(x, 4), U.fromOffset(52, 28), function()
                    pcall(menu.setBinding, entry, nil, slot)
                    rebuildRows()
                end)
            end
        end
        rebuildRows()
        local addButton
        addButton = pill(panel, "+ Add keybind", U.new(0, 12, 1, -52), U.fromOffset(150, 30), function()
            pcall(menu.beginBindingRecording, entry, #current() + 1, addButton, panel)
        end)
        pill(panel, "Clear all", U.new(0, 170, 1, -52), U.fromOffset(110, 30), function()
            pcall(menu.setBinding, entry, nil)
            rebuildRows()
        end)
        styled(panel, "Click Record, then press a key or mouse button. Hold modifiers for combos. Esc cancels.", {Size = U.new(1, -24, 0, 16), Position = U.new(0, 12, 1, -18), TextSize = 11, ZIndex = 93, Role = "desc"})
        keyRefresh = function()
            if menu.recording then return end
            if signature() ~= lastSignature then rebuildRows() end
        end
    end

    -- ===== the original menu's real structure: its tabs, groups and order =====
    local LEGACY_TWINS = {["Settings/Row Opacity (%)"] = true, ["Settings/Text Opacity (%)"] = true, ["Settings/UI Layout"] = true}
    local function listed(record: any): boolean
        local name = tostring(record.name)
        if record.tab == "Settings" and name:sub(1, 5) == "Menu " then return false end
        return not LEGACY_TWINS[tostring(record.tab) .. "/" .. name]
    end
    local RECOVERY_SECTIONS = {
        {name = "Movement Recovery", ids = {
            {"Game/Anti-Ragdoll", "Main/Anti-Ragdoll"}, {"Main/Anti-Ragdoll Method"}, {"Main/Evasive Delay (s)"},
            {"Main/Anti Endlag"}, {"Main/Endlag Recovery Delay (s)"}, {"Main/Fourth M1 Recovery"}, {"Main/Fourth M1 Recovery Delay (s)"},
        }},
        {name = "Landing & Roll Recovery", ids = {
            {"Automatic/Auto Recovery"}, {"Automatic/Auto Recovery Minimum Height (studs)"},
            {"Main/Recovery in Any Direction"}, {"Main/Recovery Direction"},
        }},
        {name = "Ragdoll Recovery", ids = {
            {"Main/Complete Ragdoll Recovery"}, {"Main/Complete Ragdoll Delay (s)"},
            {"Main/Disable True Ragdoll"}, {"Main/True Ragdoll Recovery (s)"},
        }},
    }
    local function recoverySections(result: any)
        local indexed, selected, groups = {}, {}, {}
        -- Quick-setting rows may live outside Page/Section containers. Their
        -- original records still own the real widget, callback, and keybind.
        for _, record in menu.rows or {} do
            if record.widget and record.widget.Get then indexed[tostring(record.tab) .. "/" .. tostring(record.name)] = record end
        end
        for id, record in menu.entries or {} do
            if not indexed[id] and record.widget and record.widget.Get then indexed[id] = record end
        end
        local restoring = layout.recoveryMenuVersion ~= 1
        for index, definition in RECOVERY_SECTIONS do
            local rows = {}
            for _, alternatives in definition.ids do
                local record
                for _, id in alternatives do if indexed[id] then record = indexed[id];break end end
                if record and not selected[record] then
                    selected[record] = true
                    table.insert(rows, {row = record.row, record = record})
                    if restoring then layout.hidden[record.name] = nil end
                end
            end
            if #rows > 0 then
                table.insert(groups, {name = definition.name, order = -100 + index, rows = rows})
                if restoring then collapsed["Main/" .. definition.name] = false end
            end
        end
        if #groups == 0 then return end
        -- One card per existing widget. Only its Deck grouping changes.
        for _, sections in result.tabs do
            for _, section in sections do
                for index = #section.rows, 1, -1 do
                    if selected[section.rows[index].record] then table.remove(section.rows, index) end
                end
            end
        end
        for index = #groups, 1, -1 do table.insert(result.tabs.Main, 1, groups[index]) end
        if restoring then
            layout.recoveryMenuVersion = 1
            sectionFilter.Main = nil
            saveLayout()
        end
    end
    local function structure(): any
        local result = {tabs = {}}
        for _, name in TAB_ORDER do result.tabs[name] = {} end
        local panel = menu.panel
        if not panel or not panel.Pages then return result end
        local byRow = {}
        for _, record in menu.rows or {} do if record.row then byRow[record.row] = record end end
        for index, page in panel.Pages do
            local tabName = tostring(page.Name):match("^Page_(.+)$") or tostring(index)
            local target = if result.tabs[tabName] then tabName else FOLDED[tabName]
            if target then
                local sections = result.tabs[target]
                for _, child in page:GetChildren() do
                    if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name:sub(1, 8) == "Section_" then
                        local contents = child:FindFirstChild("Contents")
                        local rows = {}
                        if contents then for _, row in contents:GetChildren() do if byRow[row] and listed(byRow[row]) then table.insert(rows, {row = row, record = byRow[row]}) end end end
                        table.sort(rows, function(a, b) return a.row.LayoutOrder < b.row.LayoutOrder end)
                        local name = child.Name:match("^Section_(.+)$") or "General"
                        local existing
                        for _, part in sections do if part.name == name then existing = part end end
                        if existing then for _, row in rows do table.insert(existing.rows, row) end
                        else table.insert(sections, {name = name, order = child.LayoutOrder, rows = rows}) end
                    elseif byRow[child] and listed(byRow[child]) then
                        local general
                        for _, part in sections do if part.name == "General" then general = part end end
                        if not general then general = {name = "General", order = -1, rows = {}};table.insert(sections, general) end
                        table.insert(general.rows, {row = child, record = byRow[child]})
                    end
                end
                table.sort(sections, function(a, b) return a.order < b.order end)
            end
        end
        recoverySections(result)
        return result
    end
    -- ===== building the window =====
    local function destroyGui()
        closePopup()
        keyLayer = nil
        colorLayer = nil
        keyRefresh = nil
        if gui then gui:Destroy();gui = nil end
        table.clear(updaters)
    end
    local function contentWidth(): number
        return settings.width - settings.railWidth - 16 - 8 - 8 - 14
    end
    function renderContent()
        table.clear(updaters)
        closePopup()
        for _, child in content:GetChildren() do if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then child:Destroy() end end
        local data = structure()
        local order = 0
        local function nextOrder() order += 1;return order end
        -- The chosen column count is a maximum: boxes never get narrower than MIN_CARD, they move to fewer columns instead.
        local fitColumns = math.max(1, math.floor((contentWidth() + settings.gap) / (MIN_CARD + settings.gap)))
        local columns = math.min(math.clamp(layout.cols[currentTab] or settings.columns, 1, 4), fitColumns)
        local cardWidth = math.floor((contentWidth() - settings.gap * (columns - 1)) / columns)
        local function grid(): any
            local frame = make("Frame", content, {Name = "Grid", Size = U.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = E.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder()})
            local layout = Inst.new("UIGridLayout")
            layout.CellSize = U.fromOffset(cardWidth, settings.cardHeight);layout.CellPadding = U.fromOffset(settings.gap, settings.gap)
            layout.SortOrder = E.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;layout.Parent = frame
            return frame
        end
        local function header(title: string, key: string?, count: number?): boolean
            local button = make("TextButton", content, {Name = "Header", Size = U.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), AutoButtonColor = false})
            local isCollapsed = key ~= nil and collapsed[key] == true
            if key then
                local chevron = make("Frame", button, {Name = "Chevron", Size = U.fromOffset(16, 10), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromOffset(14, 15), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Rotation = if isCollapsed then -90 else 0})
                for side = -1, 1, 2 do
                    local bar = make("Frame", chevron, {Name = "Bar", Size = U.fromOffset(10, 2), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = U.fromOffset(8 + side * 3.6, 5), Rotation = -side * 40, BackgroundColor3 = accent()})
                    corner(bar, 1)
                end
            end
            styled(button, title .. (if count and count > 0 then "   (" .. tostring(count) .. ")" else ""), {Size = U.new(1, if key then -30 else -4, 1, 0), Position = U.fromOffset(if key then 30 else 4, 0), TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = accent()})
            if key then button.Activated:Connect(function() collapsed[key] = not collapsed[key];renderContent() end) end
            return isCollapsed
        end
        local function addEditControls(card: any, spec: any, name: string, sectionKey: string, list: {any}, position: number, isHidden: boolean)
            local function names(): {string}
                local result = {}
                for _, item in list do table.insert(result, item.record and item.record.name or "") end
                return result
            end
            local function move(delta: number)
                local current = names()
                local target = position + delta
                if target < 1 or target > #current then return end
                current[position], current[target] = current[target], current[position]
                layout.order[sectionKey] = current
                saveLayout();renderContent()
            end
            local cover = make("Frame", card, {Name = "EditCover", Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = settings.windowColor, BackgroundTransparency = .12, ZIndex = 60})
            corner(cover, settings.radius)
