            styled(cover, (if isHidden then "HIDDEN  " else "") .. tostring(spec.name), {Size = U.new(1, -16, 0, 24), Position = U.fromOffset(8, 8), TextSize = 14, ZIndex = 61, TextColor3 = if isHidden then settings.mutedColor else settings.textColor})
            local buttonWidth = math.floor((cardWidth - 16 - 12) / 3)
            local function button(label: string, index: number, callback: any)
                local item = make("TextButton", cover, {Name = "EditButton", Size = U.fromOffset(buttonWidth, 30), Position = U.new(0, 8 + (index - 1) * (buttonWidth + 6), 1, -40), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 61})
                corner(item, 10);stroke(item, lineColor(), 1, .5)
                styled(item, label, {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 13, ZIndex = 62, TextColor3 = accent()})
                item.Activated:Connect(callback)
            end
            card:SetAttribute("EditName", name)
            cover.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
                if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.Touch then
                    startReorder(card, card.Parent, "EditName", function(fromName: any, toName: any)
                        local current = names()
                        local from, to = table.find(current, fromName), table.find(current, toName)
                        if from and to and from ~= to then
                            table.remove(current, from);table.insert(current, to, fromName)
                            layout.order[sectionKey] = current
                            saveLayout();renderContent()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            button("Earlier", 1, function() move(-1) end)
            button(if isHidden then "Show" else "Hide", 2, function() layout.hidden[name] = if isHidden then nil else true;saveLayout();renderContent() end)
            button("Later", 3, function() move(1) end)
        end
        local shown: {[string]: boolean} = {}
        local function fill(rows: {any}, sectionKey: string?, highlight: boolean?)
            local frame = grid()
            local list = rows
            if sectionKey and layout.order[sectionKey] then
                local rank = {}
                for position, name in layout.order[sectionKey] do rank[name] = position end
                list = table.clone(rows)
                local original = {}
                for position, entry in list do original[entry] = position end
                table.sort(list, function(left: any, right: any)
                    local leftRank = rank[left.record and left.record.name or ""] or (1000 + original[left])
                    local rightRank = rank[right.record and right.record.name or ""] or (1000 + original[right])
                    return leftRank < rightRank
                end)
            end
            local index = 0
            for position, entry in list do
                local name = entry.record and entry.record.name
                if entry.record and name then
                    local key = tostring(entry.record.tab) .. "/" .. tostring(name) .. "/" .. tostring(entry.record.kind)
                    if shown[key] then continue end
                    shown[key] = true
                end
                local isHidden = sectionKey ~= nil and name ~= nil and layout.hidden[name] == true
                if isHidden and not editing then continue end
                local spec = if entry.kind then entry else specFromRecord(entry.record)
                if spec then
                    index += 1
                    local card = renderCard(frame, spec, cardWidth, index, highlight)
                    if editing and sectionKey and name then addEditControls(card, spec, name, sectionKey, list, position, isHidden) end
                end
            end
        end
        if editing and currentTab ~= "__look" and searchText == "" then
            local bar = make("Frame", content, {Name = "EditBar", Size = U.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder()})
            styled(bar, "Drag boxes to move  |  columns", {Size = U.fromOffset(220, 34), Position = U.fromOffset(4, 3), TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = accent()})
            local function small(label: string, x: number, width: number, callback: any)
                local item = make("TextButton", bar, {Size = U.fromOffset(width, 30), Position = U.fromOffset(x, 5), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
                corner(item, 15);stroke(item, lineColor(), 1, .5)
                styled(item, label, {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = accent()})
                item.Activated:Connect(callback)
            end
            local current = math.clamp(layout.cols[currentTab] or settings.columns, 1, 4)
            small("-", 230, 34, function() layout.cols[currentTab] = math.max(1, current - 1);saveLayout();renderContent() end)
            styled(bar, tostring(current), {Size = U.fromOffset(30, 34), Position = U.fromOffset(268, 3), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 15})
            small("+", 302, 34, function() layout.cols[currentTab] = math.min(4, current + 1);saveLayout();renderContent() end)
            small("Reset this page", 350, 140, function()
                layout.cols[currentTab] = nil
                for key in layout.order do if key:sub(1, #currentTab + 1) == currentTab .. "/" then layout.order[key] = nil end end
                saveLayout();renderContent()
            end)
            small("Show all hidden", 498, 150, function() layout.hidden = {};saveLayout();renderContent() end)
        end
        if searchText ~= "" then
            local query = searchText:lower()
            for _, tabName in TAB_ORDER do
                local matches = {}
                for _, part in data.tabs[tabName] do
                    for _, entry in part.rows do
                        local config = entry.record.config or {}
                        local hay = (tostring(config.DisplayName or "") .. " " .. tostring(entry.record.name) .. " " .. tostring(config.Description or "") .. " " .. part.name):lower()
                        if hay:find(query, 1, true) then table.insert(matches, entry) end
                    end
                end
                if #matches > 0 then
                    if not header(LABELS[tabName], "search/" .. tabName, #matches) then fill(matches, nil, true) end
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if currentTab == "__look" then
            for _, part in lookSpecs() do
                if not header(part.name, "look/" .. part.name, #part.rows) then fill(part.rows) end
            end
            return
        end
        local parts = data.tabs[currentTab] or {}
        for index, part in parts do
            local key = currentTab .. "/" .. part.name
            if sectionFilter[currentTab] and sectionFilter[currentTab] ~= part.name then continue end
            if collapsed[key] == nil then collapsed[key] = index > 1 and sectionFilter[currentTab] == nil end
            if not header(part.name, key, #part.rows) then fill(part.rows, key) end
        end
    end
    function build()
        destroyGui()
        local camera = host.workspace.CurrentCamera
        local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui then return end
        gui = make("ScreenGui", playerGui, {Name = "ShenaniganismMenu", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 60, Enabled = control.open == true})
        if (settings.px or -1) < 0 then local v = camera.ViewportSize;settings.px = math.floor((v.X - settings.width) / 2);settings.py = math.floor((v.Y - settings.height) / 2) end
        window = make("Frame", gui, {Name = "Window", Size = U.fromOffset(settings.width, settings.height), AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(0, 0), Position = U.fromOffset(settings.px, settings.py),
            BackgroundColor3 = settings.windowColor, BackgroundTransparency = settings.windowAlpha / 100})
        local uiScale = Inst.new("UIScale");uiScale.Scale = settings.scale / 100;uiScale.Parent = window
        corner(window, settings.radius + 4)
        stroke(window, lineColor(), 1.5, .45)
        if settings.glow > 0 then stroke(window, accent(), 1.5 + settings.glow / 5, 1 - math.clamp(settings.glow / 110, 0, .9)) end
        if settings.shadow > 0 then
            for index = 1, 2 do
                local grow = 8 + index * 10
                local shade = make("Frame", window, {Name = "Shadow" .. index, Size = U.new(1, grow * 2, 1, grow * 2), Position = U.fromOffset(-grow, -grow + 8), BackgroundColor3 = C.new(0, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1 - settings.shadow / 100 * (if index == 1 then .5 else .22), ZIndex = 0})
                corner(shade, settings.radius + grow)
            end
        end
        -- top bar: title, search, customize, close
        local top = make("Frame", window, {Name = "Top", Size = U.new(1, -16, 0, 44), Position = U.fromOffset(8, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        local dragZone = make("TextButton", top, {Name = "Drag", Size = U.new(1, -540, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
        styled(top, currentTab == "__look" and "Customize" or "Menu", {Size = U.fromOffset(200, 44), Position = U.fromOffset(14, 0), TextSize = 17, TextColor3 = settings.textColor})
        local search = make("TextBox", top, {Name = "Search", Size = U.fromOffset(260, 34), Position = U.new(1, -(260 + 280), 0, 5), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Text = searchText, PlaceholderText = "Search settings", ClearTextOnFocus = false})
        corner(search, 17);stroke(search, lineColor(), 1, .6)
        search.TextColor3, search.PlaceholderColor3, search.TextSize = settings.textColor, settings.mutedColor, math.max(10, math.floor(14 * settings.titleSize / 100))
        pcall(function() search.Font = E.Font[FONT_ENUM[settings.font] or "GothamMedium"] end)
        local pad = Inst.new("UIPadding");pad.PaddingLeft = host.UDim.new(0, 16);pad.Parent = search
        local custom = make("TextButton", top, {Name = "Customize", Size = U.fromOffset(110, 34), Position = U.new(1, -(110 + 52), 0, 5), BackgroundColor3 = if currentTab == "__look" then accent() else settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
        corner(custom, 17);stroke(custom, lineColor(), 1, .6)
        styled(custom, if currentTab == "__look" then "Back" else "Customize", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = if currentTab == "__look" then settings.windowColor else accent()})
        local close = make("TextButton", top, {Name = "Close", Size = U.fromOffset(38, 34), Position = U.new(1, -42, 0, 5), BackgroundColor3 = rgb(255, 110, 120), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
        corner(close, 17)
        styled(close, "X", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = rgb(40, 10, 14)})
        close.Activated:Connect(function() control.setOpen(false) end)
        local editButton = make("TextButton", top, {Name = "Edit", Size = U.fromOffset(80, 34), Position = U.new(1, -(80 + 8 + 110 + 52), 0, 5), BackgroundColor3 = if editing then accent() else settings.panelColor, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
        corner(editButton, 17);stroke(editButton, lineColor(), 1, .6)
        styled(editButton, "Edit", {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = if editing then settings.windowColor else accent()})
        editButton.Activated:Connect(function() editing = not editing;build() end)
        custom.Activated:Connect(function() currentTab = if currentTab == "__look" then "Main" else "__look";searchText = "";build() end)
        searchBox = search
        search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() searchText = search.Text;contentAt = clock() + .35 end)
        -- tab rail (A): drawn icons with names
        local data = structure()
        local railWidth = settings.railWidth
        local rail = make("ScrollingFrame", window, {Name = "Rail", Size = U.new(0, railWidth, 1, -68), Position = U.fromOffset(8, 60), BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, ScrollBarThickness = 0,
            CanvasSize = U.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = E.AutomaticSize.Y})
        corner(rail, settings.radius);stroke(rail, lineColor(), 1, .7)
        local layout = Inst.new("UIListLayout");layout.Padding = host.UDim.new(0, 8);layout.HorizontalAlignment = E.HorizontalAlignment.Center;layout.Parent = rail
        local padding = Inst.new("UIPadding");padding.PaddingTop = host.UDim.new(0, 10);padding.Parent = rail
        for _, tabName in tabOrder() do
            local selected = currentTab == tabName and searchText == ""
            local button = make("TextButton", rail, {Name = "Tab", Size = U.fromOffset(railWidth - 18, 62), BackgroundColor3 = if selected then accent() else settings.cardColor, BackgroundTransparency = if selected then .82 else .65, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
            corner(button, math.max(6, settings.radius - 2))
            button:SetAttribute("TabName", tabName)
            if editing then
                button.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
                    if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.Touch then
                        startReorder(button, rail, "TabName", function(fromName: any, toName: any)
                            local order = table.clone(tabOrder())
                            local from, to = table.find(order, fromName), table.find(order, toName)
                            if from and to and from ~= to then
                                table.remove(order, from);table.insert(order, to, fromName)
                                layout.tabs = order
                                saveLayout();build()
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if selected then stroke(button, accent(), 1, .35);make("Frame", button, {Name = "Mark", Size = U.new(0, 3, .5, 0), Position = U.new(0, 0, .25, 0), BackgroundColor3 = accent()}) end
            drawIcon(button, tabName, if selected then accent() else settings.mutedColor)
            styled(button, LABELS[tabName], {Size = U.new(1, 0, 0, 18), Position = U.fromOffset(0, 38), TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextColor3 = if selected then accent() else settings.mutedColor})
            button.Activated:Connect(function() if suppressClick then return end;currentTab = tabName;searchText = "";build() end)
        end
        -- the deck strip from B, on top: jump between the groups of the current tab
        local stripHeight = 0
        local parts = if currentTab == "__look" or searchText ~= "" then {} else (data.tabs[currentTab] or {})
        if #parts > 1 then
            stripHeight = 40
            local strip = make("ScrollingFrame", window, {Name = "Deck", Size = U.new(1, -(railWidth + 16 + 8 + 8), 0, 34), Position = U.fromOffset(railWidth + 16, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScrollBarThickness = 0,
                CanvasSize = U.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = E.AutomaticSize.X, ScrollingDirection = E.ScrollingDirection.X})
            local chips = Inst.new("UIListLayout");chips.FillDirection = E.FillDirection.Horizontal;chips.Padding = host.UDim.new(0, 8);chips.VerticalAlignment = E.VerticalAlignment.Center;chips.Parent = strip
            local active = sectionFilter[currentTab]
            local function chip(label: string, value: string?)
                local selected = active == value
                local width = math.max(60, #label * 9 + 28)
                local button = make("TextButton", strip, {Name = "Chip", Size = U.fromOffset(width, 30), BackgroundColor3 = if selected then accent() else settings.cardColor, BackgroundTransparency = if selected then .8 else .35, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false})
                corner(button, 15);stroke(button, if selected then accent() else lineColor(), 1, if selected then .25 else .75)
                styled(button, label, {Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = E.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = if selected then accent() else settings.mutedColor})
                button.Activated:Connect(function() sectionFilter[currentTab] = value;rebuildAt = clock() end)
            end
            chip("All", nil)
            for _, part in parts do chip(part.name, part.name) end
        end
        local contentTop = 60 + stripHeight
        content = make("ScrollingFrame", window, {Name = "Content", Size = U.new(1, -(railWidth + 16 + 8), 1, -(contentTop + 8)), Position = U.fromOffset(railWidth + 16, contentTop), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ScrollBarThickness = 4, CanvasSize = U.fromOffset(0, 0), AutomaticCanvasSize = E.AutomaticSize.Y})
        local list = Inst.new("UIListLayout");list.Padding = host.UDim.new(0, 8);list.SortOrder = E.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;list.Parent = content
        local contentPad = Inst.new("UIPadding");contentPad.PaddingRight = host.UDim.new(0, 8);contentPad.PaddingBottom = host.UDim.new(0, 12);contentPad.Parent = content
        overlay = make("Frame", window, {Name = "Overlay", Size = U.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 50})
        tip = make("Frame", overlay, {Name = "Tip", AutomaticSize = E.AutomaticSize.XY, BackgroundColor3 = settings.panelColor, Visible = false, ZIndex = 80, Active = false})
        corner(tip, 8);stroke(tip, lineColor(), 1, .4)
        -- Pull the window back inside the game window whenever a move or resize pushes it out.
        local function keepWindowInside()
            if not window or not overlay then return end
            local scale = math.max(.01, settings.scale / 100)
            local origin, area = overlay.AbsolutePosition, overlay.AbsoluteSize
            local position, size = window.AbsolutePosition, window.AbsoluteSize
            if size.X > area.X or size.Y > area.Y then
                settings.width = math.floor(math.min(settings.width, area.X / scale))
                settings.height = math.floor(math.min(settings.height, area.Y / scale))
                window.Size = U.fromOffset(settings.width, settings.height)
                position, size = window.AbsolutePosition, window.AbsoluteSize
            end
            local shiftX = math.clamp(position.X, origin.X, origin.X + math.max(0, area.X - size.X)) - position.X
            local shiftY = math.clamp(position.Y, origin.Y, origin.Y + math.max(0, area.Y - size.Y)) - position.Y
            if shiftX ~= 0 or shiftY ~= 0 then
                settings.px, settings.py = math.floor(settings.px + shiftX / scale), math.floor(settings.py + shiftY / scale)
                window.Position = U.fromOffset(settings.px, settings.py)
            end
        end
        dragZone.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
            if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                local start = input:GetMouseLocation()
                local ox, oy = settings.px, settings.py
                dragging = {move = function(point: any)
                    settings.px = math.floor(ox + point.X - start.X)
                    settings.py = math.floor(oy + point.Y - start.Y)
                    window.Position = U.fromOffset(settings.px, settings.py)
                    keepWindowInside()
                end}
            end
        end)
        local function grip(name: string, position: any, size: any, edges: any)
            local g = make("TextButton", window, {Name = name, Position = position, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 120})
            g.InputBegan:Connect(function(object)
                if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    local scale = math.max(.01, settings.scale / 100)
                    local mouse = input:GetMouseLocation()
                    local start = {x = mouse.X, y = mouse.Y, w = settings.width, h = settings.height, px = settings.px, py = settings.py}
                    dragging = {resize = function(point: any)
                        local dx, dy = (point.X - start.x) / scale, (point.Y - start.y) / scale
                        local w2, h2, px2, py2 = start.w, start.h, start.px, start.py
                        if edges.r then w2 = math.max(360, start.w + dx) end
                        if edges.l then w2 = math.max(360, start.w - dx);px2 = start.px + (start.w - w2) end
                        if edges.b then h2 = math.max(260, start.h + dy) end
                        if edges.t then h2 = math.max(260, start.h - dy);py2 = start.py + (start.h - h2) end
                        settings.width, settings.height = math.floor(w2), math.floor(h2)
                        settings.px, settings.py = math.floor(px2), math.floor(py2)
                        window.Size = U.fromOffset(settings.width, settings.height)
                        window.Position = U.fromOffset(settings.px, settings.py)
                        keepWindowInside()
                    end}
                end
            end)
        end
        grip("GripL", U.new(0, -6, 0, 18), U.new(0, 14, 1, -36), {l = true})
        grip("GripR", U.new(1, -8, 0, 18), U.new(0, 14, 1, -36), {r = true})
        grip("GripT", U.new(0, 18, 0, -6), U.new(1, -36, 0, 14), {t = true})
        grip("GripB", U.new(0, 18, 1, -8), U.new(1, -36, 0, 14), {b = true})
        grip("GripTL", U.new(0, -8, 0, -8), U.fromOffset(24, 24), {t = true, l = true})
        grip("GripTR", U.new(1, -16, 0, -8), U.fromOffset(24, 24), {t = true, r = true})
        grip("GripBL", U.new(0, -8, 1, -16), U.fromOffset(24, 24), {b = true, l = true})
        grip("GripBR", U.new(1, -16, 1, -16), U.fromOffset(24, 24), {b = true, r = true})
        renderContent()
    end
    -- ===== input, refresh and opening =====
    table.insert(connections, input.InputChanged:Connect(function(object)
        if not dragging then return end
        if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            if dragging.set then dragging.set(object.Position.X) elseif dragging.move then dragging.move(input:GetMouseLocation()) elseif dragging.resize then dragging.resize(input:GetMouseLocation()) end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections, input.InputEnded:Connect(function(object)
        if object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.Touch then
            if dragging then
                local wasResize = dragging.resize ~= nil
                if dragging.drop then pcall(dragging.drop, input:GetMouseLocation()) end
                dragging = nil
                saveSettings()
                if wasResize then rebuildAt = clock() end
            end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections, input.InputBegan:Connect(function(object, processed)
        if openPopup and object.UserInputType == E.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            local point = object.Position
            local function inside(frame: any) local a, b = frame.AbsolutePosition, frame.AbsoluteSize;return point.X >= a.X and point.X <= a.X + b.X and point.Y >= a.Y and point.Y <= a.Y + b.Y end
            if not inside(openPopup.frame) and not inside(openPopup.owner) then closePopup() end
        end
        if object.KeyCode == E.KeyCode.Escape and (miniLayer or keyLayer or colorLayer) and not menu.recording then
            if colorLayer then closeColorPanel() elseif keyLayer then closeKeyPanel() else closeMini() end
            return
        end
        if processed or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or menu.recording then return end
        local code = E.KeyCode[settings.key]
        if code and object.KeyCode == code then control.setOpen(not control.open) end
    end))
    local accumulator = 0
    -- Takes the original window out of sight: parked in a folder that is never shown, its root off, its key (Ctrl) and S icon
    -- toggling this menu. It runs the moment the original window exists, so it is never drawn, even while the script loads.
    local function hookOldWindow()
        if control.hooked or not (menu.panel and menu.panel.Main) then return end
        control.hooked = true
        local main = menu.panel.Main
        main.Visible = false
        control.parked = Inst.new("Folder")
        main.Parent = control.parked
        menu.openMiniPopup = function(owner: any, entries: any, _options: any)
            pcall(openMiniFrom, owner, entries or {}, tostring(owner and (owner.displayName or owner.name) or "Options"))
        end
        menu.openPopup = function(entry: any) pcall(openKeyRef, entry) end
        local oldRoot = menu.panel.Root
        if oldRoot then
            oldRoot.Enabled = false
            table.insert(connections, oldRoot:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                if control.alive and oldRoot.Enabled then oldRoot.Enabled = false end
            end))
        end
        table.insert(connections, main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
            if main.Visible and control.alive then
                main.Visible = false
                -- The original menu key press arrives together with this menu's own key press; it must not undo a close.
                -- Outside that moment the original key (LeftControl) or the S icon toggles this menu: open it, or hide it.
                if clock() - (control.lastToggle or -1) > .35 then control.setOpen(not control.open) end
            end
        end))
    end
    control.hookOldWindow = hookOldWindow
    table.insert(connections, run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
        local okay, problem = pcall(function()
            if not control.alive then return end
            if contentAt and clock() >= contentAt and not dragging then
                contentAt = nil
                if control.open and content and content.Parent then renderContent() end
            end
            if rebuildAt and clock() >= rebuildAt and not dragging then
                rebuildAt = nil
                if control.open and gui then build() end
            end
            -- The original window is replaced: opening it opens this menu instead.
            hookOldWindow()
            if not control.colorRedirected and menu.ui and menu.ui.openColor then
                control.colorRedirected = true
                menu.ui.openColor = function(record: any) pcall(openColorRef, record) end
            end
            accumulator += dt
            if accumulator >= .25 and control.open then
                accumulator = 0
                for _, update in updaters do pcall(update) end
                if keyRefresh then pcall(keyRefresh) end
            end
        end)
        if not okay then
            control.errors += 1;control.lastError = tostring(problem)
            if control.errors == 1 then warn("[Shenaniganism] Menu error: " .. control.lastError) end
        end
    end))
    host.task.delay(3, function() if control.alive and settings.openOnLoad ~= false then control.setOpen(true) end end)
    function control.setOpen(value: boolean)
        control.open = value == true
        control.lastToggle = clock()
        if control.open then
            local okay, problem = pcall(build)
            if not okay then control.errors += 1;warn("[Shenaniganism] Menu build error: " .. tostring(problem));control.open = false;return end
            if gui then gui.Enabled = true end
        elseif gui then
            closePopup();gui.Enabled = false
            searchText = ""
            if searchBox and searchBox.Parent and searchBox.Text ~= "" then searchBox.Text = "" end
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateButton({Name = "Open New Menu", DisplayName = "Open New Menu", ButtonText = "Open", Description = "Open the new menu: icon rail, boxes in columns, a strip of groups on top and a Customize page for the whole look. Default key: Right Shift.",
            Callback = function() control.setOpen(not control.open);return true end})
        tab:CreateInput({Name = "New Menu Key", DisplayName = "New Menu Key", Description = "Key that opens and closes the new menu, for example RightShift, Insert, F4 or K.", Default = settings.key,
            Callback = function(value: any) if type(value) == "string" and E.KeyCode[value] then settings.key = value;saveSettings();return true end;return false end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        destroyGui()
        if miniGui then miniGui:Destroy();miniGui = nil;miniLayer = nil end
        if menu.deckMenu == control then menu.deckMenu = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return DeckMenu
end)()






local MenuGrid = (function(): any
-- Presentation only: lays the menu's on/off rows out as a grid of compact tiles with icons, in 2 or 3
-- columns, and puts everything back when set to List. Values, keys, callbacks and saved configs are
-- untouched; only each row's size, label text and description visibility change.
local MenuGrid = {}
-- First matching keyword wins.
local ICONS = {
    {{"block", "guard", "perfect"}, "🛡"}, {{"aim", "target", "lock", "cursor", "fov"}, "🎯"},
    {{"dash", "dodge", "evasive", "evad"}, "💨"}, {{"health", " hp"}, "❤"}, {{"ultimate", " ult"}, "⚡"},
    {{"special", "spec "}, "✦"}, {{"m1", "melee", "punch", "attack", "counter", "combo"}, "👊"},
    {{"skill", "move", "variant", "flourish", "rupture", "whiplash", "transcend", "lasso"}, "✨"},
    {{"stun", "ragdoll", "knockback", "recover"}, "💫"}, {{"camera", "view", "zoom"}, "🎥"},
    {{"cooldown", "timer", "delay", "speed", "timing"}, "⏱"}, {{"esp", "info", "card", "hud", "box", "ring", "outline", "cham", "glow", "bloom"}, "👁"},
    {{"color", "transparency", "opacity", "theme"}, "🎨"}, {{"sound", "audio", "volume"}, "🔊"},
    {{"config", "save", "load", "import", "export"}, "💾"}, {{"jump", "parkour", "movement", "sprint", "run"}, "🏃"},
    {{"toji", "sword", "weapon"}, "🗡"}, {{"menu", "gui", "ui "}, "🖥"}, {{"auto"}, "⚙"},
}
function MenuGrid.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local settings: any = {mode = "List", icons = true, compact = true}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, applied = 0}
    local accumulator = 0
    local connection: any = nil
    local function iconFor(name: string): string
        local lowered = " " .. string.lower(name) .. " "
        for _, entry in ICONS do
            for _, word in entry[1] do
                if string.find(lowered, word, 1, true) then return entry[2] end
            end
        end
        return "▪"
    end
    local function columnsOf(mode: string): number
        return if mode == "3 Columns" then 3 elseif mode == "2 Columns" then 2 else 1
    end
    local function modeKey(): string
        return settings.mode .. "|" .. tostring(settings.icons) .. "|" .. tostring(settings.compact)
    end
    local function isToggleRow(row: any): boolean
        if not row:IsA("Frame") or row:GetAttribute("WidgetType") ~= "Row" then return false end
        local switch = row:FindFirstChild("Control")
        return switch ~= nil and switch:GetAttribute("WidgetType") == "ToggleSwitch"
    end
    local function restyle(row: any, columns: number)
        local heading = row:FindFirstChild("Name")
        local description = row:FindFirstChild("Description")
        local switch = row:FindFirstChild("Control")
        if row:GetAttribute("GridOrigSize") == nil then
            row:SetAttribute("GridOrigSize", row.Size)
            if heading then
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigText", heading.Text)
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigHeadPos", heading.Position)
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigHeadSize", heading.Size)
            end
            if switch then row:SetAttribute("GridOrigSwitchPos", switch.Position) end
            if description then
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigDescPos", description.Position)
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigDescSize", description.Size)
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigDescText", description.TextSize)
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigDescWrap", description.TextWrapped)
                row:SetAttribute("GridOrigDescAlign", description.TextYAlignment.Name)
            end
        end
        local original = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigSize")
        if columns <= 1 then
            row.Size = original
            if heading then
                heading.Text = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigText")
                heading.Position, heading.Size = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigHeadPos"), row:GetAttribute("GridOrigHeadSize")
            end
            if description then
                description.Visible = true
                description.Position, description.Size = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescPos"), row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescSize")
                description.TextSize, description.TextWrapped = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescText"), row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescWrap")
                description.TextYAlignment = host.Enum.TextYAlignment[row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescAlign")]
            end
            if switch then switch.Position = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigSwitchPos") end
            return
        end
        -- Compact keeps all the information, rearranged: icon and name on the top line beside the switch,
        -- the description underneath in small wrapped text. Off keeps the original row height and text.
        local compact = settings.compact
        row.Size = host.UDim2.new(1 / columns, -6, 0, if compact then 54 else original.Y.Offset)
        if heading then
            local base = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigText")
            heading.Text = if settings.icons then iconFor(base) .. "  " .. base else base
            heading.Position = host.UDim2.fromOffset(10, if compact then 4 else 5)
            heading.Size = host.UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, if compact then 22 else 28)
        end
        if description then
            description.Visible = true
            if compact then
                description.Position, description.Size = host.UDim2.fromOffset(10, 27), host.UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 25)
                description.TextSize, description.TextWrapped = 10, true
                description.TextYAlignment = host.Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
            else
                description.Position, description.Size = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescPos"), row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescSize")
                description.TextSize, description.TextWrapped = row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescText"), row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescWrap")
                description.TextYAlignment = host.Enum.TextYAlignment[row:GetAttribute("GridOrigDescAlign")]
            end
        end
        if switch then switch.Position = host.UDim2.new(1, -54, 0, if compact then 4 else 8) end
    end
    local function applyAll()
        local ui = menu.ui
        if not ui or not ui.groups then return end
        local key = modeKey()
        local columns = columnsOf(settings.mode)
        for _, group in ui.groups do
            local contents = group.contents
            if not contents or not contents.Parent then continue end
            local layout = contents:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
            if layout then
                local wanted = if columns > 1 then host.Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal else host.Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
                if layout.FillDirection ~= wanted then layout.FillDirection = wanted end
                if layout.Wraps ~= (columns > 1) then layout.Wraps = columns > 1 end
            end
            for _, row in contents:GetChildren() do
                if row:GetAttribute("GridMode") ~= key and isToggleRow(row) then
                    row:SetAttribute("GridMode", key)
                    restyle(row, columns)
                    control.applied += 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function control.refresh() applyAll() end
    -- New rows appear as sections are built, so check twice a second, and only while the menu is open.
    connection = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
        accumulator += dt
        if accumulator < .5 or not control.alive then return end
        accumulator = 0
        local panel = menu.panel
        if not (panel and panel.Main and panel.Main.Visible) and settings.mode == "List" then return end
        pcall(applyAll)
    end)
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Menu Grid Layout", DisplayName = "Menu Layout", Description = "List is the normal menu. 2 Columns or 3 Columns lay the on/off rows out as a grid of compact tiles. Only the look changes: every setting, key and saved value is the same.",
            Options = {"List", "2 Columns", "3 Columns"}, Default = "List",
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;settings.mode = value;pcall(applyAll);return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Menu Grid Icons", DisplayName = "Menu Tile Icons", Description = "Put a small icon in front of each tile's name in the grid, picked from its keywords (block, aim, dash, health and so on).", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.icons = value == true;pcall(applyAll);return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Menu Grid Compact", DisplayName = "Compact Tiles", Description = "Shorter tiles that keep the full information: icon, name and switch on the top line, the description underneath in small text. Off keeps the original row height and text size.", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.compact = value == true;pcall(applyAll);return true end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if connection then connection:Disconnect();connection = nil end
        settings.mode = "List"
        pcall(applyAll)
        if menu.menuGrid == control then menu.menuGrid = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return MenuGrid
end)()

local BarFX = (function(): any
-- One effect engine for bars and controls: sweeps, stripes, pulses and glows driven by a UIGradient and a
-- UIStroke that sit on top of a fill. It never changes a value, only how the fill looks while it is live.
local BarFX = {}
BarFX.choices = {"Shimmer", "Pulse", "Stripes", "Scanner", "Wave", "Breathe", "Heartbeat", "Sparkle", "Flicker", "Spectrum", "Flow", "Edge Glow", "None"}
function BarFX.sequences(host: any): any
    local K = host.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
    local white = host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local function grey(value: number): any return host.Color3.new(value, value, value) end
    return {
        band = host.ColorSequence.new({K(0, grey(.78)), K(.38, grey(.78)), K(.5, white), K(.62, grey(.78)), K(1, grey(.78))}),
        stripes = host.ColorSequence.new({K(0, grey(.7)), K(.24, grey(.7)), K(.26, white), K(.5, white), K(.52, grey(.7)), K(.74, grey(.7)), K(.76, white), K(1, white)}),
        scanner = host.ColorSequence.new({K(0, grey(.55)), K(.46, grey(.55)), K(.5, white), K(.54, grey(.55)), K(1, grey(.55))}),
    }
end
local function put(object: any, key: string, value: any)
    if object[key] ~= value then object[key] = value end
end
-- entry = {gradient, stroke, fill, pulse}. tint lets Spectrum and Flow recolour the fill (cards only: other
-- owners repaint their own colours, so those two fall back to Shimmer and Breathe).
function BarFX.apply(host: any, sequences: any, entry: any, effect: string, now: number, speed: number, index: number, live: boolean, rotation: number, tint: boolean)
    local gradient, stroke, fill = entry.gradient, entry.stroke, entry.fill
    local mode = effect
    if not tint then
        if mode == "Spectrum" then mode = "Shimmer" elseif mode == "Flow" then mode = "Breathe" end
    end
    local sweeping = mode == "Shimmer" or mode == "Stripes" or mode == "Scanner"
    if gradient then
        put(gradient, "Rotation", if mode == "Stripes" then rotation + 45 else rotation)
        if sweeping and live then
            put(gradient, "Color", if mode == "Stripes" then sequences.stripes elseif mode == "Scanner" then sequences.scanner else sequences.band)
            put(gradient, "Enabled", true)
            local x = if mode == "Scanner" then math.sin(now * speed * 2 + index) elseif mode == "Stripes" then ((now * speed * .5) % 2) - 1 else ((now * speed * .8 + index * .37) % 2) - 1
            put(gradient, "Offset", host.Vector2.new(x, 0))
        else put(gradient, "Enabled", false) end
    end
    local alpha = 0
    if live then
        if mode == "Pulse" then alpha = .04 + .18 * (.5 + .5 * math.sin(now * speed * 3 + index))
        elseif mode == "Breathe" then alpha = .3 * (.5 + .5 * math.sin(now * speed * 1.2 + index * .6))
        elseif mode == "Wave" then alpha = .32 * (.5 + .5 * math.sin(now * speed * 4 - index * 1.1))
        elseif mode == "Heartbeat" then
            local t = (now * speed * .9 + index * .05) % 1
            local beat = math.max(math.exp(-t * 12), if t >= .22 then .8 * math.exp(-(t - .22) * 12) else 0)
            alpha = .36 * (1 - beat)
        elseif mode == "Sparkle" then
            local bucket = math.floor(now * speed * 7)
            alpha = if (math.sin(bucket * 12.9898 + index * 78.233) * 43758.5453) % 1 > .8 then 0 else .22
        elseif mode == "Flicker" then alpha = .14 * ((math.sin(now * speed * 37 + index * 5) * 43758.5453) % 1)
        end
        if tint and fill then
            if mode == "Spectrum" then fill.BackgroundColor3 = fill.BackgroundColor3:Lerp(host.Color3.fromHSV((now * speed * .15 + index * .13) % 1, .7, 1), .38)
            elseif mode == "Flow" then fill.BackgroundColor3 = fill.BackgroundColor3:Lerp(host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), .28 * (.5 + .5 * math.sin(now * speed * 2 + index))) end
        end
    end
    if entry.pulse ~= false and fill then put(fill, "BackgroundTransparency", alpha) end
    if stroke then
        if mode == "Edge Glow" and live and fill then
            put(stroke, "Thickness", 1.5);put(stroke, "Color", fill.BackgroundColor3:Lerp(host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), .35))
            put(stroke, "Transparency", .2 + .5 * (.5 + .5 * math.sin(now * speed * 3 + index)))
        else put(stroke, "Thickness", 0) end
    end
end
return BarFX
end)()

local MenuEffects = (function(): any
-- The same effects on the menu itself: ON toggle switches, slider fills and action buttons can shimmer,
-- pulse or glow while the menu is open. Presentation only; it never touches a value or a callback.
local MenuEffects = {}
function MenuEffects.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local settings: any = {toggle = "None", slider = "None", button = "None", speed = 1, click = true, knobHover = true}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings}
    local sequences = BarFX.sequences(host)
    local tweens = host.game:GetService("TweenService")
    local userInput = host.game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local guiService = host.game:GetService("GuiService")
    local playerGui = host.game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local feelConnections: {any} = {}
    local function inMenu(object: any): boolean
        local gui = object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
        return gui ~= nil and gui.Name:sub(1, 13) == "Shenaniganism"
    end
    local function objectsAtMouse(): {any}
        local position = userInput:GetMouseLocation() - guiService:GetGuiInset()
        local okay, list = pcall(playerGui.GetGuiObjectsAtPosition, playerGui, position.X, position.Y)
        return if okay then list else {}
    end
    -- A short flash over the pressed button plus a quick press-in, so every click is felt.
    local function clickFlash(button: any)
        local flash = host.Instance.new("Frame")
        flash.Name = "FeelFlash";flash:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned", true)
        flash.BorderSizePixel, flash.BackgroundColor3, flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0, host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), .5
        flash.Size, flash.Position, flash.ZIndex = host.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), host.UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), button.ZIndex + 6
        flash.Active = false
        local corner = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if corner then host.Instance.new("UICorner", flash).CornerRadius = corner.CornerRadius end
        flash.Parent = button
        local fade = tweens:Create(flash, host.TweenInfo.new(.3, host.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, host.Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
        fade.Completed:Connect(function() flash:Destroy() end)
        fade:Play()
        if not button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") then
            local press = host.Instance.new("UIScale");press.Name = "FeelPress";press:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned", true);press.Parent = button
            local back = tweens:Create(press, host.TweenInfo.new(.2, host.Enum.EasingStyle.Back, host.Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1})
            press.Scale = .92
            back.Completed:Connect(function() press:Destroy() end)
            back:Play()
        end
    end
    table.insert(feelConnections, userInput.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject: any)
        if not control.alive or not settings.click or inputObject.UserInputType ~= host.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
        for _, object in objectsAtMouse() do
            if inMenu(object) and object:IsA("GuiButton") and object.Name ~= "ReorderHandle" and object.Name ~= "FineSliderInput" then
                pcall(clickFlash, object);return
            end
        end
    end))
    -- Slider knob: appears and shades toward the slider colour while the pointer is on the slider or dragging it.
    local hoverState: any = nil
    local function releaseHover()
        local state = hoverState
        hoverState = nil
        if not state then return end
        for _, knob in {state.feel, state.skin} do
            if knob and knob.Parent then
                tweens:Create(knob, host.TweenInfo.new(.15), {BackgroundColor3 = host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Size = knob.Name == "FeelKnob" and host.UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14) or knob.Size}):Play()
            end
        end
        if state.feel and state.feel.Parent then
            tweens:Create(state.feel, host.TweenInfo.new(.15), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
            local stroke = state.feel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if stroke then tweens:Create(stroke, host.TweenInfo.new(.15), {Transparency = 1}):Play() end
        end
    end
    local function hoverKnob(track: any, fill: any)
        local feel = track:FindFirstChild("FeelKnob")
        if not feel then
            feel = host.Instance.new("Frame")
            feel.Name = "FeelKnob";feel:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned", true)
            feel.AnchorPoint, feel.Size, feel.BorderSizePixel = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5), host.UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), 0
            feel.BackgroundTransparency, feel.BackgroundColor3 = 1, host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            feel.Active = false
            host.Instance.new("UICorner", feel).CornerRadius = host.UDim.new(0, 999)
            local stroke = host.Instance.new("UIStroke", feel);stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency, stroke.Color = 2, 1, fill.BackgroundColor3
            feel.Parent = track
        end
        feel.ZIndex = fill.ZIndex + 3
        local skin = track:FindFirstChild("SkinKnob")
        if skin and not skin.Visible then skin = nil end
        hoverState = {track = track, fill = fill, feel = feel, skin = skin}
        local shade = fill.BackgroundColor3
        local info = host.TweenInfo.new(.12, host.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, host.Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        tweens:Create(feel, info, {BackgroundTransparency = 0, BackgroundColor3 = shade:Lerp(host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), .35), Size = host.UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)}):Play()
        local stroke = feel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if stroke then stroke.Color = shade;tweens:Create(stroke, info, {Transparency = 0}):Play() end
        if skin then tweens:Create(skin, info, {BackgroundColor3 = shade:Lerp(host.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), .35)}):Play() end
    end
    local hoverAt = -math.huge
    table.insert(feelConnections, run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not control.alive or not settings.knobHover then
            if hoverState then releaseHover() end
            return
        end
        local gate,deck=menu.menuRenderGate,menu.deckMenu
        local deckHidden=not deck or deck.open~=true and type(deck.hasVisibleSurface)=='function'and not deck.hasVisibleSurface()
        if gate and gate.alive==true and gate.sleeping==true and deckHidden then
            if hoverState then releaseHover() end
            return
        end
        local now = (host.os or os).clock()
        if now - hoverAt < 1 / 40 then return end
        hoverAt = now
        local dragging = userInput:IsMouseButtonPressed(host.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
        local target: any = nil
        if not (dragging and hoverState) then
            for _, object in objectsAtMouse() do
                if object.Name == "FineSliderInput" and inMenu(object) then target = object.Parent;break end
            end
            local track = target and target:FindFirstChild("SliderTrack")
            local fill = track and track:FindFirstChild("Fill")
            if track and fill then
                if not hoverState or hoverState.track ~= track then
                    releaseHover();hoverKnob(track, fill)
                end
            elseif hoverState then releaseHover() end
        end
        local state = hoverState
        if state then
            if not state.fill.Parent or not state.track.Parent then hoverState = nil;return end
            local fraction = math.clamp(state.fill.Size.X.Scale + state.fill.Size.X.Offset / math.max(1, state.track.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
            state.feel.Position = host.UDim2.fromScale(fraction, .5)
        end
    end))
    local tracked: {any} = {}
    local entries: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local rebuildAt, stepAt = -math.huge, -math.huge
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local function shown(object: any): boolean
        local current = object
        while current and current ~= host.game do
            if current:IsA("GuiObject") and not current.Visible then return false end
            if current:IsA("ScreenGui") then return current.Enabled end
            current = current.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function entryFor(fill: any): any
        local entry = entries[fill]
        if entry and entry.gradient.Parent == fill then return entry end
        local gradient = host.Instance.new("UIGradient")
        gradient.Name = "FXGradient";gradient.Enabled = false;gradient.Color = sequences.band
        gradient:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned", true);gradient.Parent = fill
        local stroke = host.Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Name = "FXStroke";stroke.Thickness = 0;stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke:SetAttribute("ShenaniganismOwned", true);stroke.Parent = fill
        entry = {gradient = gradient, stroke = stroke, fill = fill, pulse = true}
        entries[fill] = entry
        return entry
    end
    local function rebuild()
        table.clear(tracked)
        local ui = menu.ui
        if not ui or not ui.groups then return end
        for _, group in ui.groups do
            local contents = group.contents
            if not contents or not contents.Parent or not shown(contents) then continue end
            for _, row in contents:GetChildren() do
                if not row:IsA("Frame") or row:GetAttribute("WidgetType") ~= "Row" then continue end
                local widget = row:FindFirstChild("Control")
                local kind = widget and widget:GetAttribute("WidgetType")
                if kind == "ToggleSwitch" then
                    table.insert(tracked, {kind = "toggle", entry = entryFor(widget), knob = widget:FindFirstChild("Knob")})
                elseif kind == "ActionButton" then
                    table.insert(tracked, {kind = "button", entry = entryFor(widget)})
                else
                    local trackFrame = row:FindFirstChild("SliderTrack")
                    local fill = trackFrame and trackFrame:FindFirstChild("Fill")
                    if fill then table.insert(tracked, {kind = "slider", entry = entryFor(fill)}) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function idleAll()
        for _, item in tracked do BarFX.apply(host, sequences, item.entry, "None", 0, 1, 1, false, 0, false) end
    end
    local connection = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local now = clock()
        if now - stepAt < 1 / 30 then return end
        stepAt = now
        local anyEffect = settings.toggle ~= "None" or settings.slider ~= "None" or settings.button ~= "None"
        local panel = menu.panel
        local open = panel and panel.Main and panel.Main.Visible
        if not anyEffect or not open then
            if control.active then idleAll();control.active = false end
            return
        end
        control.active = true
        if now - rebuildAt > .5 then rebuildAt = now;pcall(rebuild) end
        for index, item in tracked do
            local effect = settings[item.kind]
            local live = true
            if item.kind == "toggle" then live = item.knob ~= nil and item.knob.Position.X.Offset > 10 end
            if item.entry.fill.Parent then
                BarFX.apply(host, sequences, item.entry, effect, now, settings.speed, index, live and effect ~= "None", 0, false)
            end
        end
    end)
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        -- Info Card / Stun Card / Info Circle, for players and enemies, each with its own settings door in Main.
        do
            local main = menu.tabs and menu.tabs.Main and menu.tabs.Main.tab
            local function door(name: string, display: string, description: string, matches: (string) -> boolean)
                if not main then return end
                main:CreateButton({Name = name, DisplayName = display, ButtonText = "Open", Description = description, OptionsMenu = true,
                    Callback = function()
                        local entry = menu.entries["Main/" .. name]
                        local list = {}
                        for _, record in menu.rows or {} do
                            if type(record.name) == "string" and record.name ~= name and matches(record.name) then table.insert(list, record) end
                        end
                        if entry and menu.openMiniPopup then menu.openMiniPopup(entry, list) end
                    end})
            end
            door("Stun Card Customize", "Stun Card: Enemy", "Every setting for the stun / knock-down box above an enemy: colour, opacity, corners, border, font, height, size, width and spin.",
                function(n) return n:find("^Stun Box") ~= nil or n == "Enemy Stun Viewer" end)
            door("Enemy Circle Customize", "Info Circle: Enemy", "Every setting for the circle around enemies: sections, weights, size, colours and height.",
                function(n) return n:find("^Enemy Ring") ~= nil end)
        end
        local function effectDropdown(key: string, name: string, display: string, description: string)
            tab:CreateDropdown({Name = name, DisplayName = display, Description = description, Options = BarFX.choices, Default = "None",
                Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" or not table.find(BarFX.choices, value) then return false end;settings[key] = value;return true end})
        end
        effectDropdown("toggle", "Menu Toggle Effect", "Toggle Effect", "Animation on every switch that is turned ON: a light sweep, pulse, heartbeat, edge glow and more. Only while the menu is open.")
        effectDropdown("slider", "Menu Slider Effect", "Slider Fill Effect", "Animation on slider fills.")
        effectDropdown("button", "Menu Button Effect", "Button Effect", "Animation on action buttons.")
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Menu Click Effect", DisplayName = "Button Click Effect", Description = "A quick flash and press-in on any menu button or switch you click.", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.click = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Menu Slider Knob Hover", DisplayName = "Slider Knob Hover Shade", Description = "A knob appears on a slider and shades toward the slider colour while your pointer is on it or you drag it.", Default = true,
            Callback = function(value) settings.knobHover = value == true;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Menu Effect Speed", DisplayName = "Menu Effect Speed", Description = "Speed of the menu effects.", Min = .2, Max = 4, Default = 1, Step = .05, Precision = 2,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end;settings.speed = math.clamp(amount, .2, 4);return true end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        connection:Disconnect()
        for _, feelConnection in feelConnections do feelConnection:Disconnect() end
        if hoverState then pcall(releaseHover) end
        idleAll()
        for _, entry in entries do
            if entry.gradient then entry.gradient:Destroy() end
            if entry.stroke then entry.stroke:Destroy() end
        end
        if menu.menuEffects == control then menu.menuEffects = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return MenuEffects
end)()

local FovStyle = (function(): any
-- Gives the cursor FOV circle (Auto Lock "Show FOV Circle") extra looks: spinning dashes, rainbow, a scanner
-- sweep, pulse, a second ring, compass ticks and a glow. It only decorates the existing circle.
local FovStyle = {}
FovStyle.choices = {"Plain", "Spin Dashes", "Rainbow", "Scanner", "Pulse", "Double Ring", "Ticks", "Glow"}
function FovStyle.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local N, K = host.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new, host.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
    local settings: any = {style = "Plain", speed = 1, color = host.Color3.fromRGB(65, 220, 235)}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings}
    local dashPattern, scanPattern, rainbow = nil, nil, nil
    local function sequences()
        if dashPattern then return end
        local points, time = {}, 0
        for index = 0, 7 do
            table.insert(points, N(math.min(time, 1), if index % 2 == 0 then 0 else 1))
            table.insert(points, N(math.min(time + .06, 1), if index % 2 == 0 then 0 else 1))
            time += .125
        end
        local cleaned, last = {}, -1
        for _, point in points do
            if point.Time > last then table.insert(cleaned, point);last = point.Time end
        end
        if last < 1 then table.insert(cleaned, N(1, 1)) end
        dashPattern = host.NumberSequence.new(cleaned)
        scanPattern = host.NumberSequence.new({N(0, 0), N(.16, .55), N(.18, 1), N(1, 1)})
        local colors = {}
        for index = 0, 6 do table.insert(colors, K(index / 6, host.Color3.fromHSV(index / 6, .8, 1))) end
        rainbow = host.ColorSequence.new(colors)
    end
    local built = ""
    local function clearExtras(circle: any)
        for _, name in {"FXInner", "FXGlow", "FXTicks"} do
            local item = circle:FindFirstChild(name)
            if item then item:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    local function ring(parent: any, name: string, scale: number, corner: any, thickness: number, transparency: number): any
        local frame = host.Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Name = name;frame.AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5);frame.Position = host.UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5)
        frame.Size = host.UDim2.fromScale(scale, scale);frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1;frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local round = host.Instance.new("UICorner");round.CornerRadius = corner;round.Parent = frame
        local stroke = host.Instance.new("UIStroke");stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency, stroke.Color = thickness, transparency, settings.color;stroke.Parent = frame
        frame.Parent = parent
        return frame
    end
    local function restore(circle: any, stroke: any)
        clearExtras(circle)
        local gradient = stroke:FindFirstChild("FXGradient")
        if gradient then gradient:Destroy() end
        stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency = 1.5, .2
        stroke.Color = host.Color3.fromRGB(65, 220, 235)
        built = ""
    end
    local function step()
        local lock = menu.autoLock
        local circle, gui = lock and lock.fovCircle, lock and lock.fovGui
        if not circle or not circle.Parent or not gui or not gui.Enabled then return end
        local stroke = circle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if not stroke then return end
        local style = settings.style
        if style == "Plain" then
            if control.styled then restore(circle, stroke);control.styled = false end
            return
        end
        control.styled = true
        sequences()
        local now, speed = clock(), settings.speed
        local cornerObject = circle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        local corner = if cornerObject then cornerObject.CornerRadius else host.UDim.new(1, 0)
        if built ~= style then
            clearExtras(circle)
            local old = stroke:FindFirstChild("FXGradient")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            built = style
            if style == "Spin Dashes" or style == "Rainbow" or style == "Scanner" then
                local gradient = host.Instance.new("UIGradient")
                gradient.Name = "FXGradient"
                if style == "Spin Dashes" then gradient.Transparency = dashPattern
                elseif style == "Scanner" then gradient.Transparency = scanPattern
                else gradient.Color = rainbow end
                gradient.Parent = stroke
            elseif style == "Double Ring" then ring(circle, "FXInner", .84, corner, 1, .35)
            elseif style == "Glow" then ring(circle, "FXGlow", 1.02, corner, 7, .78)
            elseif style == "Ticks" then
                local holder = host.Instance.new("Frame")
                holder.Name = "FXTicks";holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1;holder.Size = host.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1);holder.Parent = circle
                for index = 1, 4 do
                    local tick = host.Instance.new("Frame")
                    tick.BorderSizePixel = 0;tick.BackgroundColor3 = settings.color;tick.AnchorPoint = host.Vector2.new(.5, .5)
                    local horizontal = index % 2 == 0
                    tick.Size = if horizontal then host.UDim2.fromOffset(14, 2) else host.UDim2.fromOffset(2, 14)
                    tick.Position = if index == 1 then host.UDim2.fromScale(.5, 0) elseif index == 2 then host.UDim2.fromScale(1, .5) elseif index == 3 then host.UDim2.fromScale(.5, 1) else host.UDim2.fromScale(0, .5)
                    tick.Parent = holder
                end
            end
        end
        if stroke.Color ~= settings.color then stroke.Color = settings.color end
        local gradient = stroke:FindFirstChild("FXGradient")
        if gradient then
            gradient.Rotation = (now * speed * 90) % 360
            if style == "Scanner" then gradient.Rotation = (now * speed * 180) % 360 end
        end
        if style == "Pulse" then
            local wave = .5 + .5 * math.sin(now * speed * 3)
            stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency = 1.5 + 2 * wave, .5 - .4 * wave
        elseif style == "Glow" or style == "Double Ring" then
            stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency = 1.8, .15
        else stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency = 2, .1 end
        for _, name in {"FXInner", "FXGlow"} do
            local extra = circle:FindFirstChild(name)
            local extraStroke = extra and extra:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if extraStroke then
                extraStroke.Color = settings.color
                if name == "FXGlow" then extraStroke.Transparency = .65 + .2 * math.sin(now * speed * 2) end
            end
        end
        local ticks = circle:FindFirstChild("FXTicks")
        if ticks then for _, tick in ticks:GetChildren() do tick.BackgroundColor3 = settings.color end end
    end
    local connection = run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if control.alive then pcall(step) end
    end)
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "FOV Style Mode", DisplayName = "FOV Circle Look", Description = "Extra looks for the cursor FOV circle: spinning dashes, rainbow, a scanner sweep, pulse, a second ring, compass ticks or a glow. Needs Show FOV Circle on. Plain leaves it as it was.",
            Options = FovStyle.choices, Default = "Plain", Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" or not table.find(FovStyle.choices, value) then return false end;settings.style = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "FOV Style Color", DisplayName = "FOV Circle Color", Description = "Colour used by the FOV circle looks.", Default = settings.color, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) ~= "Color3" then return false end;settings.color = value;return true end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "FOV Style Speed", DisplayName = "FOV Look Speed", Description = "Speed of the spin, sweep and pulse.", Min = .2, Max = 4, Default = 1, Step = .05, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) local amount = tonumber(value);if not amount or amount ~= amount or math.abs(amount) == math.huge then return false end;settings.speed = math.clamp(amount, .2, 4);return true end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        connection:Disconnect()
        local lock = menu.autoLock
        local circle = lock and lock.fovCircle
        local stroke = circle and circle.Parent and circle:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
        if circle and stroke then restore(circle, stroke) end
        if menu.fovStyle == control then menu.fovStyle = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return FovStyle
end)()

local CursorReticle = (function(): any
local CursorReticle = {}
function CursorReticle.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control: any={alive=true,settings={enabled=true},hitmarkerOnly=true}
    local gui,root,renderConnection=nil,nil,nil
    local lines,strokes={},{}
    local untilTime=0
    local lifetime=.16
    local function stop()
        if renderConnection then renderConnection:Disconnect();renderConnection=nil end
        if gui then gui.Enabled=false end
    end
    local function ensure()
        if gui and gui.Parent and root and root.Parent then return true end
        local parent=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
        if not parent then return false end
        if gui then gui:Destroy()end
        table.clear(lines);table.clear(strokes)
        gui=host.Instance.new('ScreenGui')
        gui.Name='ShenaniganismCrosshairHitmarker';gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true;gui.DisplayOrder=3;gui.Enabled=false
        gui:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true);gui.Parent=parent
        root=host.Instance.new('Frame');root.Name='Hitmarker';root.BackgroundTransparency=1;root.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(24,24)
        root.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5);root.Parent=gui
        for _,point in {{-1,-1},{1,-1},{-1,1},{1,1}}do
            local line=host.Instance.new('Frame');line.BorderSizePixel=0;line.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5)
            line.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(7,2);line.Position=host.UDim2.new(.5,point[1]*6,.5,point[2]*6)
            line.Rotation=if point[1]==point[2]then 45 else -45
            line.BackgroundColor3=host.Color3.new(1,1,1);line.Parent=root;lines[#lines+1]=line
            local stroke=host.Instance.new('UIStroke');stroke.Color=host.Color3.new(0,0,0);stroke.Thickness=1;stroke.Parent=line
            strokes[#strokes+1]=stroke
        end
        return true
    end
    local function step()
        local remaining=untilTime-clock()
        if not control.alive or not control.settings.enabled or remaining<=0 or not gui or not gui.Parent
            or(menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())then stop();return end
        local mouse=input:GetMouseLocation()
        root.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(mouse.X,mouse.Y)
        local transparency=1-math.clamp(remaining/lifetime,0,1)
        for index,line in lines do line.BackgroundTransparency=transparency;strokes[index].Transparency=transparency end
        gui.Enabled=true
    end
    function control.onHit()
        if not control.alive or not control.settings.enabled or(menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused())then return end
        if not ensure()then return end
        untilTime=clock()+lifetime
        step()
        if not renderConnection then renderConnection=run.RenderStepped:Connect(step)end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated=true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Crosshair Hitmarker',Description='A short hitmarker at the game cursor when your hit is detected. No animated cursor or character popup effects.',Default=true,
            Callback=function(value)control.settings.enabled=value==true;if not control.settings.enabled then stop()end;return true end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false;stop()
        if gui then gui:Destroy();gui=nil;root=nil end
        table.clear(lines);table.clear(strokes)
        if menu.cursorReticle==control then menu.cursorReticle=nil end
    end
    return control
end
return CursorReticle
end)()

local DashFX=nil -- Character popup effects removed at the user's request.

local BlockFX = (function(): any
-- Shows your block. While you guard, a shield (bubble, orbiting rings or a front plate) pops in around you
-- and a marker floats over your head. A blocked hit flashes the shield at once and sends a ripple from the
-- point of contact, then everything fades out. A force field can also show your Auto Block range: a dome, a
-- wall, a hex ring or pulsing ground rings, instead of the flat disc.
local BlockFX = {}
BlockFX.shieldStyles = {"Bubble", "Orbit Rings", "Front Plate", "Curved Panel", "Twin Wings", "Wide Wall", "Aegis Disc"}
BlockFX.panelMaterials = {"Glass", "ForceField", "Neon", "Ice", "Foil", "SmoothPlastic"}
BlockFX.panelFollows = {"Attacker", "Facing", "Camera"}
BlockFX.rangeStyles = {"Off", "Dome", "Wall Ring", "Hex Ring", "Ground Pulse"}
BlockFX.rangeModes = {"While Blocking", "Always", "Enemy In Range"}
BlockFX.iconStyles = {"Shield", "Square", "Diamond"}
function BlockFX.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local players = host.game:GetService("Players")
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local run = host.game:GetService("RunService")
    local world = host.workspace
    local C, V, CF, E = host.Color3, host.Vector3, host.CFrame, host.Enum
    local clock = (host.os or os).clock
    local white = C.new(1, 1, 1)
    local settings: any = {enabled = false, shield = true, shieldStyle = "Bubble", shieldOpacity = 70, shieldSize = 4.5,
        panelWidth = 3.2, panelHeight = 4.4, panelCurve = 70, panelDistance = 2.2, panelThickness = .15, panelSegments = 12, panelMaterial = "Glass", panelEdges = true, panelFollow = "Attacker", panelLift = .2,
        icon = true, iconStyle = "Diamond", impact = true, rangeStyle = "Off", rangeMode = "While Blocking", rangeOpacity = 80, rangeSpin = 40}
    settings.shieldColor, settings.rangeColor = C.fromRGB(110, 160, 255), C.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, errors = 0}
    local folder: any = nil
    local parts: any = {rings = {}, pulses = {}, hexBars = {}, ripples = {}, panelSegs = {}, panelEdges = {}}
    local blocking, blockStart, amount = false, 0, 0
    local impactAt, impactDirection = -math.huge, nil
    local enemyNearAt, enemyNear = -math.huge, false
    local function part(shape: any?): any
        local item = host.Instance.new("Part")
        item.Anchored, item.CanCollide, item.CanQuery, item.CanTouch, item.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        item.Material, item.Transparency, item.Size, item.Color = E.Material.ForceField, 1, V.new(1, 1, 1), white
        if shape then item.Shape = shape end
        item.Parent = folder
        return item
    end
    local function ensure(): boolean
        if folder and folder.Parent then return true end
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return false end
        folder = host.Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name = "ShenaniganismBlockFX";folder.Parent = camera
        parts = {rings = {}, pulses = {}, hexBars = {}, ripples = {}, panelSegs = {}, panelEdges = {}}
        return true
    end
    local function hide(item: any) if item then item.Transparency = 1 end end
    local function hidePanel()
        for _, segment in parts.panelSegs do hide(segment) end
        for _, edge in parts.panelEdges do hide(edge) end
    end
    local function hideShield()
        hidePanel();hide(parts.disc)
        hide(parts.bubble);hide(parts.plate)
        for _, ring in parts.rings do hide(ring) end
        if parts.icon then parts.icon.board.Enabled = false end
    end
    local function hideRange()
        hide(parts.dome);hide(parts.wall)
        for _, bar in parts.hexBars do hide(bar) end
        for _, pulse in parts.pulses do hide(pulse) end
    end
    local function rangeRadius(): number
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        local reference = block and block.referenceSettings
        if not reference then return 8 end
        local minimum, range = tonumber(reference.minimumRange) or 0, tonumber(block.range) or 0
        if reference.rangeType == "Static" then return math.max(minimum, range) end
        return tonumber(block.effectiveBlockRange) or math.max(minimum, range)
    end
    local function ripple(position: any, direction: any, radius: number)
        if not ensure() then return end
        local item = part(E.PartType.Cylinder)
        item.Material = E.Material.Neon
        table.insert(parts.ripples, {part = item, at = clock(), position = position, direction = direction, radius = radius})
        if #parts.ripples > 8 then table.remove(parts.ripples, 1).part:Destroy() end
    end
    local function attackerDirection(root: any): any
        local block = menu.autoBlock
        local target = block and block.lastTarget
        local other = if (host.typeof or typeof)(target) == "Instance" then target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
        local offset = if other then other.Position - root.Position else root.CFrame.LookVector
        offset = V.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
        return if offset.Magnitude > .01 then offset.Unit else V.new(0, 0, -1)
    end
    -- A blocked hit: flash the shield at once, then let it fade.
    function control.onBlockedHit(perfect: boolean?)
        if not control.alive or not settings.enabled or not settings.impact then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        impactAt, impactDirection = clock(), attackerDirection(root)
        ripple(root.Position + impactDirection * settings.shieldSize * .9, impactDirection, settings.shieldSize * (if perfect then 2.2 else 1.6))
    end
    -- Your own hit was blocked by the enemy.
    function control.onEnemyBlock(position: any)
        if not control.alive or not settings.enabled or not settings.impact or (host.typeof or typeof)(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local direction = if root then (position - root.Position) * V.new(1, 0, 1) else V.new(0, 0, -1)
        direction = if direction.Magnitude > .01 then direction.Unit else V.new(0, 0, -1)
        ripple(position, -direction, 2.6)
    end
    -- The enemy you are fighting right now: Block Assist's own target, then the one you last hit, then your M1 assist target, then your lock.
    local panelAim: any = nil
    local function engagedTarget(root: any): any
        local assist, tracker = menu.m1AimAssist, menu.autoCounterFilter
        local candidates: {any} = {}
        if assist then
            table.insert(candidates, assist.blockAimTarget)
            table.insert(candidates, assist.automaticAimTarget)
        end
        if tracker and tracker.lastHitTarget and clock() - (tonumber(tracker.lastHitAt) or -math.huge) < 4 then table.insert(candidates, tracker.lastHitTarget) end
        if assist then
            table.insert(candidates, assist.lastTarget)
            table.insert(candidates, assist.m1LastTarget)
        end
        local lock = menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget
