        if lock then table.insert(candidates, lock) end
        for _, candidate in candidates do
            local model = candidate
            if (host.typeof or typeof)(model) == "Instance" and model:IsA("Player") then model = model.Character end
            if (host.typeof or typeof)(model) == "Instance" and model ~= player.Character and model.Parent then
                local other = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if other and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= 45 then return model end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function panelDirection(root: any): any
        local mode = settings.panelFollow
        if mode == "Camera" then
            local camera = world.CurrentCamera
            local look = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or root.CFrame.LookVector
            local flat = V.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            return if flat.Magnitude > .01 then flat.Unit else V.new(0, 0, -1)
        elseif mode == "Facing" then
            local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
            local flat = V.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            return if flat.Magnitude > .01 then flat.Unit else V.new(0, 0, -1)
        end
        local engaged = engagedTarget(root)
        local direction
        if engaged then
            local offset = engaged.HumanoidRootPart.Position - root.Position
            offset = V.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
            if offset.Magnitude > .01 then direction = offset.Unit end
        end
        direction = direction or attackerDirection(root)
        -- Ease toward the new heading so the panel swings round instead of flickering between enemies.
        local now = clock()
        if panelAim and now - panelAim.at < .3 then
            local blended = panelAim.direction:Lerp(direction, 1 - math.exp(-(now - panelAim.at) / .04))
            if blended.Magnitude > .05 then direction = blended.Unit end
        end
        panelAim = {direction = direction, at = now}
        return direction
    end
    -- A curved glass panel standing in front of you from shoulder to shoulder, built from slim slats along an arc.
    local function drawPanel(center: any, root: any, color: any, transparency: number, flash: number, scale: number, count: number, curveDegrees: number, width: number, height: number)
        local direction = panelDirection(root)
        local curve = math.rad(math.clamp(curveDegrees, 0, 175))
        local half = curve / 2
        local flat = curve < .05
        local radius = if flat then 1e4 else width / (2 * math.sin(half))
        local apex = center + V.new(0, settings.panelLift, 0) + direction * settings.panelDistance
        local circle = apex - direction * radius
        local right = V.new(-direction.Z, 0, direction.X)
        local segmentWidth = (if flat then width / count else 2 * radius * math.sin(curve / count / 2)) * 1.06 * scale
        local material = E.Material.Glass
        pcall(function() material = E.Material[settings.panelMaterial] end)
        local edgeColor = color:Lerp(white, .45)
        for index = 1, count do
            local theta = -half + (index - .5) * curve / count
            local normal, position
            if flat then
                normal = direction
                position = apex + right * (-width / 2 + (index - .5) * width / count) * scale
            else
                normal = CF.Angles(0, theta, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(direction)
                position = circle + normal * radius
                position = center + (position - center) * 1 + V.new(0, settings.panelLift, 0)
                position = V.new(position.X, center.Y + settings.panelLift, position.Z)
            end
            local segment = parts.panelSegs[index]
            if not segment then segment = part();parts.panelSegs[index] = segment end
            segment.Material = material
            segment.Size = V.new(segmentWidth, height * scale, settings.panelThickness)
            segment.CFrame = CF.lookAt(position, position + normal)
            segment.Color, segment.Transparency = color, math.clamp(transparency, 0, .95)
            for edgeIndex = 1, 2 do
                local slot = (index - 1) * 2 + edgeIndex
                local edge = parts.panelEdges[slot]
                if not edge then edge = part();edge.Material = E.Material.Neon;parts.panelEdges[slot] = edge end
                if settings.panelEdges then
                    local side = if edgeIndex == 1 then 1 else -1
                    edge.Size = V.new(segmentWidth, .09, settings.panelThickness + .05)
                    edge.CFrame = CF.lookAt(position + V.new(0, side * height * scale / 2, 0), position + V.new(0, side * height * scale / 2, 0) + normal)
                    edge.Color, edge.Transparency = edgeColor, math.clamp(transparency - .3 - .3 * flash, 0, 1)
                else hide(edge) end
            end
        end
        for index = count + 1, #parts.panelSegs do hide(parts.panelSegs[index]) end
        for slot = count * 2 + 1, #parts.panelEdges do hide(parts.panelEdges[slot]) end
    end
    local function hexRing(center: any, radius: number, spin: number, color: any, transparency: number, offset: number, sides: number)
        for index = 1, sides do
            local angleA = spin + (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / sides
            local angleB = spin + index * math.pi * 2 / sides
            local first = V.new(math.sin(angleA) * radius, 0, math.cos(angleA) * radius)
            local second = V.new(math.sin(angleB) * radius, 0, math.cos(angleB) * radius)
            local bar = parts.hexBars[offset + index]
            if not bar then bar = part();bar.Material = E.Material.Neon;parts.hexBars[offset + index] = bar end
            local delta = second - first
            bar.Size = V.new(.2, .12, delta.Magnitude + .1)
            bar.CFrame = CF.new(center) * CF.lookAt((first + second) * .5, (first + second) * .5 + delta)
            bar.Color, bar.Transparency = color, transparency
        end
    end
    local function step(dt: number)
        if not control.alive then return end
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not settings.enabled or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) then
            if folder then hideShield();hideRange() end
            return
        end
        if not ensure() then return end
        local now = clock()
        local info = character:FindFirstChild("Info")
        local isBlocking = info ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild("Block") ~= nil
        if isBlocking and not blocking then blockStart = now end
        blocking = isBlocking
        local goal = if blocking then 1 else 0
        amount += (goal - amount) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * (if goal > amount then 40 else 12)))
        if amount < .01 then amount = 0 end
        local okay, frame = pcall(root.GetRenderCFrame, root)
        if not okay or not frame then frame = root.CFrame end
        local center = frame.Position
        local feet = center - V.new(0, humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y * .5 - .1, 0)
        do
            -- The range shapes lie on the floor (or debris) under you, so they stay at ground level when you jump.
            if not control.floorParams then control.floorParams = host.RaycastParams.new();control.floorParams.FilterType = E.RaycastFilterType.Exclude end
            control.floorParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character, world.CurrentCamera}
            local hit = world:Raycast(center, V.new(0, -300, 0), control.floorParams)
            if hit and hit.Normal.Y > .2 then feet = V.new(center.X, hit.Position.Y + .5, center.Z) end
        end
        local flash = math.max(0, 1 - (now - impactAt) / .4) ^ 2
        -- Shield around you
        if settings.shield and amount > 0 then
            local popAge = now - blockStart
            local overshoot = if popAge < .18 then 1 + .25 * math.sin(popAge / .18 * math.pi) else 1
            local radius = settings.shieldSize * overshoot * (1 + .18 * flash) * (.5 + .5 * amount)
            local base = 1 - settings.shieldOpacity / 100 * amount
            local transparency = base * (1 - flash) + .05 * flash
            local color = settings.shieldColor:Lerp(white, flash * .7)
            local style = settings.shieldStyle
            local panelStyle = style == "Curved Panel" or style == "Twin Wings" or style == "Wide Wall"
            if not panelStyle then hidePanel() end
            if style ~= "Aegis Disc" then hide(parts.disc) end
            if style == "Bubble" then
                hide(parts.plate);for _, ring in parts.rings do hide(ring) end
                if not parts.bubble then parts.bubble = part(E.PartType.Ball) end
                parts.bubble.Size = V.new(radius * 2, radius * 2, radius * 2)
                parts.bubble.CFrame = CF.new(center)
                parts.bubble.Color, parts.bubble.Transparency = color, transparency
            elseif style == "Orbit Rings" then
                hide(parts.bubble);hide(parts.plate)
                for index = 1, 3 do
                    local ring = parts.rings[index]
                    if not ring then ring = part(E.PartType.Cylinder);ring.Material = E.Material.Neon;parts.rings[index] = ring end
                    ring.Size = V.new(.08, radius * 2, radius * 2)
                    ring.CFrame = CF.new(center) * CF.Angles(now * 1.2 + index * 2.1, now * .8, index * 1.05) * CF.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                    ring.Color, ring.Transparency = color, math.clamp(transparency - .1, 0, 1)
                end
            elseif panelStyle then
                hide(parts.bubble);hide(parts.plate);for _, ring in parts.rings do hide(ring) end
                local scale = (.6 + .4 * amount) * overshoot * (1 + .12 * flash)
                if style == "Twin Wings" then drawPanel(center, root, color, transparency, flash, scale, 2, math.clamp(settings.panelCurve * 1.3, 20, 170), settings.panelWidth, settings.panelHeight)
                elseif style == "Wide Wall" then drawPanel(center, root, color, transparency, flash, scale, math.clamp(settings.panelSegments + 4, 6, 28), 140, settings.panelWidth * 1.9, settings.panelHeight * 1.2)
                else drawPanel(center, root, color, transparency, flash, scale, math.clamp(settings.panelSegments, 4, 24), settings.panelCurve, settings.panelWidth, settings.panelHeight) end
            elseif style == "Aegis Disc" then
                hide(parts.bubble);hide(parts.plate);for _, ring in parts.rings do hide(ring) end
                if not parts.disc then parts.disc = part(E.PartType.Cylinder) end
                local direction = panelDirection(root)
                local diameter = settings.panelWidth * (.6 + .4 * amount) * overshoot * (1 + .12 * flash)
                local at = center + V.new(0, settings.panelLift, 0) + direction * settings.panelDistance
                parts.disc.Size = V.new(settings.panelThickness, diameter, diameter)
                parts.disc.CFrame = CF.lookAt(at, at + direction) * CF.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
                pcall(function() parts.disc.Material = E.Material[settings.panelMaterial] end)
                parts.disc.Color, parts.disc.Transparency = color, math.clamp(transparency, 0, .95)
            else
                hide(parts.bubble);for _, ring in parts.rings do hide(ring) end
                if not parts.plate then parts.plate = part() end
                local direction = attackerDirection(root)
                parts.plate.Size = V.new(radius * 1.7, radius * 1.9, .2)
                parts.plate.CFrame = CF.lookAt(center + direction * (radius * .55 + 1), center + direction * 10)
                parts.plate.Color, parts.plate.Transparency = color, transparency
            end
        else hideShield() end
        -- Marker over your head
        if settings.icon and amount > .05 then
            if not parts.icon then
                local anchor = part();anchor.Size = V.new(.2, .2, .2)
                local board = host.Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                board.Name = "BlockMarker";board.AlwaysOnTop, board.LightInfluence, board.Size = true, 0, host.UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60)
                board.StudsOffset = V.new(0, 0, 0);board.Parent = anchor
                local label = host.Instance.new("TextLabel")
                label.BackgroundTransparency, label.Size, label.Font = 1, host.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), E.Font.GothamBlack
                label.TextStrokeColor3, label.TextStrokeTransparency = C.new(0, 0, 0), .4
                label.Parent = board
                parts.icon = {anchor = anchor, board = board, label = label}
            end
            local icon = parts.icon
            icon.anchor.CFrame = CF.new(center + V.new(0, 3.9, 0))
            icon.board.Enabled = true
            icon.label.Text = if settings.iconStyle == "Square" then "■" elseif settings.iconStyle == "Diamond" then "◆" else "🛡"
            icon.label.TextColor3 = settings.shieldColor:Lerp(white, flash * .8)
            icon.label.TextSize = math.floor((28 + 14 * flash) * (.7 + .3 * amount) + .5)
            icon.label.TextTransparency = 1 - amount
        elseif parts.icon then parts.icon.board.Enabled = false end
        -- Range force field
        local style = settings.rangeStyle
        local show = style ~= "Off"
        if show and settings.rangeMode == "While Blocking" then show = blocking
        elseif show and settings.rangeMode == "Enemy In Range" then
            if now - enemyNearAt > .15 then
                enemyNearAt, enemyNear = now, false
                local characters = world:FindFirstChild("Characters")
                local radiusNow = rangeRadius() * 1.1
                if characters then
                    for _, model in characters:GetChildren() do
                        local other = model ~= character and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local otherHumanoid = other and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if other and otherHumanoid and otherHumanoid.Health > 0 and (other.Position - center).Magnitude <= radiusNow then enemyNear = true;break end
                    end
                end
            end
            show = enemyNear
        end
        if show then
            local radius = rangeRadius()
            local transparency = 1 - settings.rangeOpacity / 100 * .35
            local color = settings.rangeColor
            local spin = math.rad(settings.rangeSpin) * now
            if style ~= "Dome" then hide(parts.dome) end
            if style ~= "Wall Ring" then hide(parts.wall) end
            if style ~= "Hex Ring" then for _, bar in parts.hexBars do hide(bar) end end
            if style ~= "Ground Pulse" then for _, pulse in parts.pulses do hide(pulse) end end
            if style == "Dome" then
                if not parts.dome then parts.dome = part(E.PartType.Ball) end
                parts.dome.Size = V.new(radius * 2, radius * 2, radius * 2)
                parts.dome.CFrame = CF.new(feet)
                parts.dome.Color, parts.dome.Transparency = color, transparency
            elseif style == "Wall Ring" then
                if not parts.wall then parts.wall = part(E.PartType.Cylinder) end
                parts.wall.Size = V.new(6, radius * 2, radius * 2)
                parts.wall.CFrame = CF.new(feet + V.new(0, 3, 0)) * CF.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                parts.wall.Color, parts.wall.Transparency = color, transparency
            elseif style == "Hex Ring" then
                local solid = 1 - settings.rangeOpacity / 100
                hexRing(feet + V.new(0, .15, 0), radius, spin, color, solid, 0, 6)
                hexRing(feet + V.new(0, .15, 0), radius * .66, -spin * 1.4, color, math.clamp(solid + .25, 0, 1), 6, 6)
            else
                for index = 1, 3 do
                    local pulse = parts.pulses[index]
                    if not pulse then pulse = part(E.PartType.Cylinder);parts.pulses[index] = pulse end
                    local phase = (now * .5 + (index - 1) / 3) % 1
                    pulse.Size = V.new(.1, radius * 2 * phase, radius * 2 * phase)
                    pulse.CFrame = CF.new(feet + V.new(0, .12, 0)) * CF.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                    pulse.Color = color
                    pulse.Transparency = math.clamp(1 - settings.rangeOpacity / 100 * (1 - phase), 0, 1)
                end
            end
        else hideRange() end
        -- Impact ripples
        for index = #parts.ripples, 1, -1 do
            local item = parts.ripples[index]
            local progress = (now - item.at) / .35
            if progress >= 1 then
                item.part:Destroy();table.remove(parts.ripples, index)
            else
                local ease = 1 - (1 - progress) ^ 3
                local size = 1 + item.radius * ease
                item.part.Size = V.new(.1, size, size)
                item.part.CFrame = CF.lookAt(item.position, item.position + item.direction) * CF.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
                item.part.Color = settings.shieldColor:Lerp(white, .5 * (1 - progress))
                item.part.Transparency = .05 + .95 * progress
            end
        end
    end
    local connection = run.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
        local okay, problem = pcall(step, dt)
        if not okay then
            control.errors += 1
            control.lastError = tostring(problem)
            if control.errors == 1 then warn("[Shenaniganism] Block FX error: " .. control.lastError) end
        end
    end)
    local function boolSetter(key: string)
        return function(value: any)
            if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
            settings[key] = value;return true
        end
    end
    local function choiceSetter(key: string, list: {string})
        return function(value: any)
            if type(value) ~= "string" or not table.find(list, value) then return false end
            settings[key] = value;return true
        end
    end
    local function numberSetter(key: string, low: number, high: number)
        if key ~= "shieldOpacity" and key ~= "rangeOpacity" then
            low = if low < 0 then math.min(low, -500) else math.min(low, 0)
            if key == "panelSegments" then low = 1 end
            high = math.max(high, 500)
        end
        return function(value: any)
            local amount2 = tonumber(value)
            if not amount2 or amount2 ~= amount2 or math.abs(amount2) == math.huge then return false end
            settings[key] = math.clamp(amount2, low, high);return true
        end
    end
    local function colorSetter(key: string)
        return function(value: any)
            if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) ~= "Color3" then return false end
            settings[key] = value;return true
        end
    end
    -- Special effects as hollow outlines. Every effect the game spawns (workspace.Effects) is hidden on this client only (local transparency,
    -- emitters off) and drawn instead as one mostly transparent outline: a box for blocky effects, three crossed rings for round ones. Nothing is
    -- filled and nothing is drawn in the middle. Turning it off puts every effect back exactly as it was.
    local fxSettings: any = {enabled = false, opacity = 25, circles = true}
    local fxHidden: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local fxShapes: any, fxPending: any = {}, {}
    local fxStatic: any = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local fxFolder: any, fxEffects: any, fxAdded: any, fxFrame = nil, nil, nil, 0
    local function fxHide(item: any)
        if fxHidden[item] ~= nil then return end
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
            fxHidden[item] = {"part", item.LocalTransparencyModifier};item.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
        elseif item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            fxHidden[item] = {"emitter", item.Transparency, item.Enabled};item.Transparency = host.NumberSequence.new(1);item.Enabled = false
        elseif item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam") then
            fxHidden[item] = {"line", item.Transparency};item.Transparency = host.NumberSequence.new(1)
        elseif item:IsA("Decal") or item:IsA("Texture") then
            fxHidden[item] = {"decal", item.Transparency};item.Transparency = 1
        end
    end
    local function fxTop(item: any): any
        local current = item
        while current.Parent and current.Parent ~= fxEffects do
            if current.Parent:IsA("Folder") and current.Parent.Parent == fxEffects then break end
            current = current.Parent
        end
        return current
    end
    local function fxTake(item: any, existing: boolean?)
        fxHide(item)
        if item:IsA("BasePart") then
            local top = fxTop(item)
            if existing then fxStatic[top] = true
            elseif not fxStatic[top] then fxPending[top] = true end
        end
    end
    local function fxDrop(record: any)
        if record.proxy then record.proxy:Destroy() end
    end
    local function fxClear()
        for _, record in fxShapes do fxDrop(record) end
        table.clear(fxShapes);table.clear(fxPending)
        if fxAdded then fxAdded:Disconnect();fxAdded = nil end
        fxEffects = nil
        for item, data in fxHidden do
            if item.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    local kind = data[1]
                    if kind == "part" then item.LocalTransparencyModifier = data[2]
                    elseif kind == "emitter" then item.Transparency = data[2];item.Enabled = data[3]
                    else item.Transparency = data[2] end
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(fxHidden)
    end
    local function fxBuild(record: any, round: boolean)
        local proxy = host.Instance.new("Part")
        proxy.Anchored, proxy.CanCollide, proxy.CanQuery, proxy.CanTouch, proxy.CastShadow, proxy.Transparency = true, false, false, false, false, 1
        proxy.Size = V.new(1, 1, 1);proxy.Parent = fxFolder
        record.proxy, record.round = proxy, round
        local transparency = 1 - fxSettings.opacity / 100
        if round then
            record.rings = {}
            for index, frame in {CF.new(), CF.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0), CF.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)} do
                local ring = host.Instance.new("CylinderHandleAdornment")
                ring.Adornee, ring.Height, ring.Angle, ring.CFrame = proxy, .06, 360, frame
                ring.AlwaysOnTop, ring.ZIndex, ring.Color3, ring.Transparency = true, 1, record.color, transparency
                ring.Radius = 1;ring.InnerRadius = .9
                ring.Parent = proxy
                record.rings[index] = ring
            end
        else
            local box = host.Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            box.Adornee, box.LineThickness, box.SurfaceTransparency, box.Color3, box.Transparency = proxy, .03, 1, record.color, transparency
            box.Parent = proxy
            record.box = box
        end
    end
    local function fxLook(top: any): (any, boolean)
        local color, round, seen = white, false, 0
        local items = if top:IsA("BasePart") then {top} else top:GetDescendants()
        for _, item in items do
            if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                seen += 1
                if seen == 1 then color = item.Color end
                local lower = item.Name:lower()
                if (item:IsA("Part") and item.Shape == E.PartType.Ball) or lower:find("sphere", 1, true) or lower:find("orb", 1, true) or lower:find("ring", 1, true) or lower:find("circle", 1, true) then round = true end
                local mesh = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                if mesh and mesh.MeshType == E.MeshType.Sphere then round = true end
                if seen >= 12 then break end
            end
        end
        return color, round
    end
    local function fxStep()
        if not fxSettings.enabled then return end
        local effects = world:FindFirstChild("Effects")
        if effects ~= fxEffects then
            if fxAdded then fxAdded:Disconnect();fxAdded = nil end
            fxEffects = effects
            if effects then
                fxAdded = effects.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item: any) pcall(fxTake, item) end)
                for _, item in effects:GetDescendants() do pcall(fxTake, item, true) end
            end
        end
        if not effects then return end
        if not fxFolder or not fxFolder.Parent then
            local camera = world.CurrentCamera
            if not camera then return end
            fxFolder = host.Instance.new("Folder");fxFolder.Name = "ShenaniganismEffectOutlines";fxFolder.Parent = camera
            for _, record in fxShapes do record.proxy = nil end
            table.clear(fxShapes)
        end
        local count = 0
        for _ in fxShapes do count += 1 end
        for top in fxPending do
            if top.Parent and not fxShapes[top] and not fxStatic[top] and count < 30 then
                local size, frame
                if top:IsA("Model") then frame, size = top:GetBoundingBox() else frame, size = top.CFrame, top.Size end
                local mine = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local near = not mine or (frame.Position - mine.Position).Magnitude <= 120
                local biggest = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
                if biggest >= .6 and biggest <= 40 and near then
                    local record: any = {top = top, born = clock()}
                    local color, round = fxLook(top)
                    record.color = color
                    fxBuild(record, round and fxSettings.circles)
                    fxShapes[top] = record;count += 1
                end
            end
        end
        table.clear(fxPending)
        fxFrame += 1
        local transparency = 1 - fxSettings.opacity / 100
        for top, record in fxShapes do
            if not top.Parent or not top:IsDescendantOf(effects) or clock() - record.born > 4 then
                if top.Parent then fxStatic[top] = true end
                fxDrop(record);fxShapes[top] = nil
            else
                if record.alpha ~= transparency then
                    record.alpha = transparency
                    if record.box then record.box.Transparency = transparency end
                    if record.rings then for _, ring in record.rings do ring.Transparency = transparency end end
                end
                if fxFrame % 2 == 0 then
                    local frame, size
                    if top:IsA("Model") then frame, size = top:GetBoundingBox() else frame, size = top.CFrame, top.Size end
                    if record.round then
                        local dimension = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z, .2)
                        record.proxy.Size = V.new(dimension, dimension, dimension)
                        local radius = dimension / 2
                        if not record.radius or math.abs(radius - record.radius) > radius * .02 then
                            record.radius = radius
                            for _, ring in record.rings do ring.Radius = radius;ring.InnerRadius = math.max(0, radius - math.clamp(radius * .04, .04, .25)) end
                        end
                    else record.proxy.Size = V.new(math.max(size.X, .1), math.max(size.Y, .1), math.max(size.Z, .1)) end
                    record.proxy.CFrame = frame
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local fxConnection = run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local okay, problem = pcall(fxStep)
        if not okay then
            control.errors += 1
            control.lastError = tostring(problem)
            if control.errors == 1 then warn("[Shenaniganism] Effect outlines error: " .. control.lastError) end
        end
    end)
    function control.setEffectOutlines(value: any)
        if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        fxSettings.enabled = value
        if not value then fxClear() end
        return true
    end
    function control.setEffectOpacity(value: any)
        local amount2 = tonumber(value)
        if not amount2 or amount2 ~= amount2 or math.abs(amount2) == math.huge then return false end
        fxSettings.opacity = math.clamp(amount2, 5, 100);return true
    end
    function control.setEffectCircles(value: any)
        if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false end
        fxSettings.circles = value
        for _, record in fxShapes do fxDrop(record) end
        table.clear(fxShapes)
        for item in fxHidden do if item.Parent and item:IsA("BasePart") then fxPending[fxTop(item)] = true end end
        return true
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        -- Block FX sliders open up to 0..500 (-500..500 when they can go negative); the two opacity percents stay 0..100.
        local realTab = tab
        tab = setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, name)
            local member = realTab[name]
            if name == "CreateSlider" then
                return function(_, config)
                    if not tostring(config.Name):find("Opacity (%)", 1, true) then
                        config.Min = if config.Min < 0 then math.min(config.Min, -500) else math.min(config.Min, 0)
                        if config.Name == "Block FX Panel Segments" then config.Min = 1 end
                        config.Max = math.max(config.Max, 500)
                    end
                    return realTab:CreateSlider(config)
                end
            end
            if type(member) == "function" then return function(_, ...) return member(realTab, ...) end end
            return member
        end})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Special Effect Outlines", DisplayName = "Special Effects As Outlines", Description = "Every special and attack effect the game spawns is hidden on your screen and drawn as a hollow outline instead: a box for blocky effects, crossed rings for round ones. Nothing is filled and nothing is drawn in the middle. Off by default: the normal effects are shown and no outline shapes are created.", Default = false, Callback = control.setEffectOutlines})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Special Effect Outline Opacity (%)", DisplayName = "Effect Outline Opacity (%)", Description = "How solid the effect outlines are. Low is mostly transparent.", Min = 5, Max = 100, Default = 25, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = control.setEffectOpacity})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Special Effect Outline Circles", DisplayName = "Round Effects Use Rings", Description = "Round effects (spheres, rings, orbs) are drawn as three crossed rings. Off draws every effect as a box.", Default = true, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = control.setEffectCircles})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Block FX Enabled", DisplayName = "Block Effects", Description = "Show your block: a shield around you and a marker over your head while you guard, an instant flash and ripple when a hit is blocked, and an optional force field for your Auto Block range.", Default = false, Callback = boolSetter("enabled")})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Block FX Shield", DisplayName = "Block Shield", Description = "A shield that pops in around you when your guard comes up.", Default = true, Callback = boolSetter("shield")})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Block FX Shield Style", DisplayName = "Shield Style", Description = "Bubble: a force field around you. Orbit Rings: three rings circling you. Front Plate: a flat plate toward the enemy. Curved Panel: a glass panel curving from shoulder to shoulder. Twin Wings: two angled panels. Wide Wall: a broad curved wall. Aegis Disc: a round shield disc.", Options = BlockFX.shieldStyles, Default = "Bubble", QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = choiceSetter("shieldStyle", BlockFX.shieldStyles)})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Block FX Panel Follow", DisplayName = "Panel Faces", Description = "Which way the panel, wings, wall and disc face: toward the Attacker (the enemy you are fighting: your assist target, the one you last hit, your lock, else whoever last attacked), the way your character Faces, or where the Camera looks.", Options = BlockFX.panelFollows, Default = "Attacker", QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = choiceSetter("panelFollow", BlockFX.panelFollows)})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Block FX Panel Material", DisplayName = "Panel Material", Description = "Glass, ForceField, Neon, Ice, Foil or Smooth Plastic for the panel styles.", Options = BlockFX.panelMaterials, Default = "Glass", QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = choiceSetter("panelMaterial", BlockFX.panelMaterials)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Panel Width", DisplayName = "Panel Width (studs)", Description = "How wide the panel is. Around 3 reaches shoulder to shoulder.", Min = 1.5, Max = 9, Default = 3.2, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("panelWidth", 1.5, 9)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Panel Height", DisplayName = "Panel Height (studs)", Description = "How tall the panel is.", Min = 1.5, Max = 9, Default = 4.4, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("panelHeight", 1.5, 9)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Panel Curve", DisplayName = "Panel Curve (degrees)", Description = "How much the panel wraps around you. Zero is flat, larger bends it round your shoulders.", Min = 0, Max = 170, Default = 70, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("panelCurve", 0, 170)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Panel Distance", DisplayName = "Panel Distance (studs)", Description = "How far in front of your middle the panel stands.", Min = .5, Max = 6, Default = 2.2, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("panelDistance", .5, 6)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Panel Thickness", DisplayName = "Panel Thickness", Description = "Thickness of the glass.", Min = .05, Max = .8, Default = .15, Step = .01, Precision = 2, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("panelThickness", .05, .8)})

        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Block FX Panel Edges", DisplayName = "Panel Edge Glow", Description = "A bright glowing rim along the top and bottom of the panel.", Default = true, Callback = boolSetter("panelEdges")})
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Block FX Shield Color", DisplayName = "Shield Color", Description = "Colour of the shield, marker and ripples.", Default = settings.shieldColor, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = colorSetter("shieldColor")})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Shield Opacity (%)", DisplayName = "Shield Opacity (%)", Description = "How solid the shield looks.", Min = 10, Max = 100, Default = 70, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("shieldOpacity", 10, 100)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Shield Size", DisplayName = "Shield Size", Description = "Radius of the shield in studs.", Min = 2, Max = 10, Default = 4.5, Step = .1, Precision = 1, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("shieldSize", 2, 10)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Block FX Marker", DisplayName = "Block Marker", Description = "A marker floating over your head while you block.", Default = true, Callback = boolSetter("icon")})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Block FX Marker Style", DisplayName = "Marker Style", Description = "Diamond (default), Square or Shield.", Options = BlockFX.iconStyles, Default = "Diamond", QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = choiceSetter("iconStyle", BlockFX.iconStyles)})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Block FX Impact", DisplayName = "Block Hit Flash", Description = "When a hit is blocked the shield flashes at once and a ripple spreads from the contact point, then both fade out. Also ripples where the enemy blocks your hit.", Default = true, Callback = boolSetter("impact")})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Block FX Range Style", DisplayName = "Range Force Field", Description = "Show your Auto Block range as a force field: Dome, Wall Ring, Hex Ring or Ground Pulse rings. Off hides it.", Options = BlockFX.rangeStyles, Default = "Off", QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = choiceSetter("rangeStyle", BlockFX.rangeStyles)})
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Block FX Range Mode", DisplayName = "Range Shows", Description = "While Blocking, Always, or only when an enemy is inside the range.", Options = BlockFX.rangeModes, Default = "While Blocking", QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = choiceSetter("rangeMode", BlockFX.rangeModes)})
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Block FX Range Color", DisplayName = "Range Color", Description = "Colour of the range force field.", Default = settings.rangeColor, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = colorSetter("rangeColor")})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Range Opacity (%)", DisplayName = "Range Opacity (%)", Description = "How solid the range force field looks.", Min = 10, Max = 100, Default = 80, Step = 1, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("rangeOpacity", 10, 100)})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name = "Block FX Range Spin (deg/s)", DisplayName = "Range Spin (deg/s)", Description = "How fast the Hex Ring turns.", Min = -180, Max = 180, Default = 40, Step = 5, Precision = 0, QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = numberSetter("rangeSpin", -180, 180)})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        connection:Disconnect()
        fxConnection:Disconnect()
        fxClear()
        if fxFolder then fxFolder:Destroy();fxFolder = nil end
        if folder then folder:Destroy();folder = nil end
        if menu.blockFX == control then menu.blockFX = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return BlockFX
end)()

local MenuTheme = (function(): any
-- Ready-made looks for the menu itself. Each theme sets the menu's own colour pickers (window, rows, buttons,

        ["Knob Color"] = rgb(255, 255, 255), ["Border Color"] = rgb(160, 100, 170), ["Text Color"] = rgb(255, 240, 252)},
