function MenuTheme.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local settings: any = {theme = "Default"}
    local control: any = {alive = true, settings = settings, defaults = {}}
    local function widgetFor(name: string): any
        for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if entry.name == name or (entry.config and entry.config.Name == name) then
                local widget = entry.widget
                if widget and type(widget.Set) == "function" and type(widget.Get) == "function" then return widget end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function capture(name: string, widget: any)
        if control.defaults[name] == nil then
            local okay, value = pcall(widget.Get)
            if okay and (host.typeof or typeof)(value) == "Color3" then control.defaults[name] = value end
        end
    end
    local function paint(colors: any)
        for name, color in colors do
            local widget = widgetFor(name)
            if widget then
                capture(name, widget)
                pcall(widget.Set, color, true)
            end
        end
    end
    function control.apply(theme: string)
        if theme == "Default" or theme == "Classic" then
            local colors = {}
            for name, value in control.defaults do colors[name] = value end
            paint(colors)
        elseif PRESETS[theme] then
            -- Remember the original colours before the first change, so Default can restore them.
            for name in PRESETS[theme] do
                local widget = widgetFor(name)
                if widget then capture(name, widget) end
            end
            paint(PRESETS[theme])
        else return false end
        settings.theme = theme
        if menu.menuSkin and menu.menuSkin.apply then pcall(menu.menuSkin.apply) end
        if menu.panel and menu.panel.ApplyStyle then pcall(function() menu.panel:ApplyStyle(menu.panel.Style) end) end
        return true
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Menu Theme", DisplayName = "Menu Theme", Description = "Ready-made looks for the whole menu: Midnight, Neon Cyber, Sunset, Forest, Royal, Mono and Candy set the window, rows, buttons, accent, toggles, border and text together. Default puts back the colours the menu started with. You can still fine-tune any colour afterwards.",
            Options = MenuTheme.names, Default = "Classic", QuickSettingsOnly = true, Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;if value == "Default" then value = "Classic" end;control.userChose = true;return control.apply(value) end})
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Menu Accent Quick", DisplayName = "Menu Accent", Description = "One colour for the menu's accent: sliders, tab lines and toggles that are on.", Default = rgb(0, 205, 215), QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value)
                if (host.typeof or typeof)(value) ~= "Color3" then return false end
                paint({["Theme Color"] = value, ["Toggle-On Color"] = value})
                return true
            end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if menu.menuTheme == control then menu.menuTheme = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return MenuTheme
end)()

local CombatPriority = (function(): any
-- One switch for how your actions rank against each other. "Dash > M1 > Block" sets every related option at
-- once: the dash outranks both your M1 and your block, your M1 outranks your block, and your block key and M1
-- key can stay held through a dash. The values are the normal menu options, so you can still change any of them.
local CombatPriority = {}
CombatPriority.modes = {"Custom", "Dash > M1 > Block", "Block > M1 > Dash"}
local PRESETS: any = {
    ["Dash > M1 > Block"] = {{"Block Priority Over M1", false}, {"Manual M1 Overrides Everything", true}, {"Allow Action Overlap", true},
        {"Dash While Blocking", true}, {"Dash While M1", true}, {"Assist Guided Dashes", true}, {"Dash Circling Mode", "Always Arc"},
        {"Dash Ignores Block", false}, {"Dash Circling Overpowers", true}, {"Block Aim Pause On Dash", false}, {"Auto Block Emergency Guard", true}},
    ["Block > M1 > Dash"] = {{"Block Priority Over M1", true}, {"Dash Ignores Block", true}, {"Block Aim Pause On Dash", true}, {"Dash Circling Overpowers", false}},
}
function CombatPriority.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local control: any = {alive = true, mode = "Custom"}
    local function widgetFor(name: string): any
        for _, entry in menu.entries or {} do
            if entry.name == name or (entry.config and entry.config.Name == name) then
                local widget = entry.widget
                if widget and type(widget.Set) == "function" then return widget end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.apply(mode: string): boolean
        local preset = PRESETS[mode]
        if mode ~= "Custom" and not preset then return false end
        control.mode = mode
        for _, pair in preset or {} do
            local widget = widgetFor(pair[1])
            if widget then pcall(widget.Set, pair[2], true) end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated = true
        tab:CreateDropdown({Name = "Combat Priority", DisplayName = "Combat Priority", Description = "Dash > M1 > Block: your dash outranks everything, M1 outranks block, and block and M1 can stay held while you dash. Dash circling works while you block. Picking a mode sets all the related options for you. Custom changes nothing.",
            Options = CombatPriority.modes, Default = "Custom", QuickSettingsOnly = true,
            Callback = function(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return false end;return control.apply(value) end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive = false
        if menu.combatPriority == control then menu.combatPriority = nil end
    end
    return control
end
return CombatPriority
end)()

local TargetFilters = (function(): any
-- One place for "who may be targeted". It wraps the shared combat-exclusion
-- predicate, so every assist (aim, Auto Block, Counter, Punish) honours it.
local TargetFilters={}
function TargetFilters.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,previous=menu.isCombatExcluded,cache=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),
        targetPlayers=true,targetNpcs=true,ignoreSummons=true,hideSummonsInESP=true,ignoreEmoting=false,ignoreRagdolled=false,maxDistance=0,
        lastReason='Target filters are idle'}
    local function modelOf(candidate: any): any
        if candidate==nil or (type(candidate)~='table' and type(candidate)~='userdata') or type(candidate.IsA)~='function' then return nil end
        if candidate:IsA('Player') then return candidate.Character end
        if candidate:IsA('Model') then return candidate end
        return candidate:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
    end
    -- A summon, clone or puppet: a living model no player owns that is tied to
    -- an owner (Owner value or attribute) or is named after a player.
    function control.isSummon(model: any): boolean
        if not model or players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return false end
        local owner=model:FindFirstChild('Owner')
        if owner and (not owner:IsA('ObjectValue') or owner.Value~=nil) and (not owner:IsA('StringValue') or owner.Value~='') then return true end
        for _,name in {'Owner','OwnerId','OwnerName','Summoner','Summon','Clone','IsClone','IsSummon'} do
            local value=model:GetAttribute(name)
            if value~=nil and value~=false and value~='' and value~=0 then return true end
        end
        local name=model.Name
        for _,actor in players:GetPlayers() do
            if actor.Name==name or actor.DisplayName==name then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function evaluate(model: any): boolean
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid then return false end
        local actor=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        if actor then
            if not control.targetPlayers then return true end
        else
            if not control.targetNpcs then return true end
            if control.ignoreSummons and control.isSummon(model) then return true end
        end
        if control.ignoreEmoting then
            local info=model:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local skill=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
            if skill and skill:GetAttribute('Emote')==true then return true end
        end
        if control.ignoreRagdolled then
            local ragdoll=model:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')
            if ragdoll==true or type(ragdoll)=='number' and ragdoll>0 then return true end
        end
        if control.maxDistance>0 then
            local own=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local root=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            if own and root and (own.Position-root.Position).Magnitude>control.maxDistance then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.excludes(candidate: any): boolean
        if not control.alive then return false end
        local model=modelOf(candidate)
        if not model or model==player.Character then return false end
        local now=clock()
        local cached=control.cache[model]
        if cached and now-cached.at<.2 then return cached.excluded end
        local ok,excluded=pcall(evaluate,model)
        excluded=ok and excluded==true
        control.cache[model]={at=now,excluded=excluded}
        return excluded
    end
    -- Passive ESP uses this instead of the combat predicate.
    function control.hidesInESP(model: any): boolean
        return control.alive and control.hideSummonsInESP and control.isSummon(model)
    end
    local previous=control.previous
    local predicate=function(candidate: any)
        return (previous and previous(candidate)==true) or control.excludes(candidate)
    end
    control.predicate=predicate
    menu.isCombatExcluded=predicate
    menu.targetFilters=control
    local function setter(key: string)
        return function(value: any)
            if type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
            control[key]=value;table.clear(control.cache);return true
        end
    end
    function control.setMaxDistance(value: any): boolean
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        control.maxDistance=math.clamp(amount,0,1000);table.clear(control.cache);return true
    end
    function control.createControls(tab: any)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated=true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Target Players',DisplayName='Target Players',Description='Let assists (aim, Auto Block, Counter, Punish) target other players. Off excludes every player.',Default=true,Callback=setter('targetPlayers')})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Target NPCs',DisplayName='Target NPCs',Description='Let assists target NPCs such as training dummies. Off excludes every non-player.',Default=true,Callback=setter('targetNpcs')})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Ignore Summons And Clones',DisplayName='Ignore Summons And Clones',Description='Assists skip puppets, clones and player-controlled NPCs (models tied to an owner, or named after a player) so they target the real player instead.',Default=true,Callback=setter('ignoreSummons')})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Hide Summons And Clones In ESP',DisplayName='Hide Summons And Clones In ESP',Description='General ESP skips the same puppets and clones, so only the real player is outlined.',Default=true,Callback=setter('hideSummonsInESP')})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Ignore Emoting Targets',DisplayName='Ignore Emoting Targets',Description='Assists skip players who are currently emoting.',Default=false,Callback=setter('ignoreEmoting')})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Ignore Ragdolled Targets',DisplayName='Ignore Ragdolled Targets',Description='Assists skip targets that are ragdolled.',Default=false,Callback=setter('ignoreRagdolled')})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='Max Target Distance (studs)',DisplayName='Max Target Distance (studs)',Description='Assists ignore targets farther than this. 0 turns the limit off.',Min=0,Max=1000,Default=0,Step=5,Precision=0,Callback=control.setMaxDistance})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        if menu.isCombatExcluded==predicate then menu.isCombatExcluded=previous end
        if menu.targetFilters==control then menu.targetFilters=nil end
    end
    return control
end
return TargetFilters
end)()

local FriendExclusions = (function(): any
-- Passive friendship checks. Combat predicates only read this cache; no request
-- or yielding work occurs while an assist chooses or follows a target.
local FriendExclusions={}
function FriendExclusions.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,enabled=true,records={},connections={},queue={},running=0,
        maximumConcurrent=2,maximumAttempts=3,requests=0,completed=0,failures=0,lastError=nil}
    local previousPredicate=menu.isCombatExcluded
    local pumping=false
    local function actorFor(candidate)
        if candidate==nil then return nil end
        if type(candidate)=='number' then return players:GetPlayerByUserId(candidate) end
        if menu.excludedPlayer then
            local actor=menu.excludedPlayer(candidate)
            if actor then return actor end
        end
        if type(candidate)~='table' and type(candidate)~='userdata' then return nil end
        if type(candidate.IsA)~='function' then return nil end
        if candidate:IsA('Player') then return candidate end
        local model=if candidate:IsA('Model') then candidate else candidate:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        if model then
            local actor=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if actor then return actor end
        end
        -- Summons/projectiles can carry the native player's direct Owner.
        -- Walk only this candidate's parents, never scan the map or roster.
        local ancestor=candidate
        for _=1,16 do
            if not ancestor or (type(ancestor)~='table' and type(ancestor)~='userdata')
                or type(ancestor.FindFirstChild)~='function' then break end
            local owner=ancestor:FindFirstChild('Owner')
            if owner and owner:IsA('ObjectValue') and owner.Value then
                local value=owner.Value
                if value:IsA('Player') then return value end
                if value:IsA('Model') then return players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(value) end
            end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.isExcluded(candidate)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then return false end
        local actor=actorFor(candidate)
        if not actor or actor==player then return false end
        local record=control.records[actor.UserId]
        -- Unknown and failed checks are protected rather than assuming that a
        -- friend is hostile while the asynchronous Roblox request is pending.
        return not record or record.player~=actor or record.state~='not-friend'
    end
    local predicate=function(candidate)
        return (menu.isExcluded and menu.isExcluded(candidate)==true)
            or (previousPredicate and previousPredicate(candidate)==true) or control.isExcluded(candidate)
    end
    menu.friendExclusions=control
    menu.isCombatExcluded=predicate
    local function excluded(candidate)return candidate~=nil and predicate(candidate)==true end
    function control.invalidateTargets()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        local environment=menu.environment or {}
        if lock then
            if (excluded(environment.LockedTarget) or excluded(lock.skillFacing and lock.skillFacing.target))
                and lock.releaseSelectedLock then lock.releaseSelectedLock('Target is protected by friend exclusions') end
            local release=lock.characterRelease
            if release and excluded(release.target) and lock.cancelAssistReturn then lock.cancelAssistReturn() end
            local capture=lock.dashAssistCapture
            if capture and capture.targets then
                for role,target in capture.targets do if excluded(target) then capture.targets[role]=nil end end
            end
        end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim then
            for role,target in aim.directionalTargets or {} do
                if excluded(target) then
                    if aim.resetDirectionalAim then aim.resetDirectionalAim(role..' Aim',true) end
                    aim.directionalTargets[role]=nil
                end
            end
            for _,key in {'lastTarget','automaticAimTarget','blockAimTarget'} do if excluded(aim[key]) then aim[key]=nil end end
            for _,key in {'m1HeldSession','blockAimMemory','blockAimSession'} do
                if aim[key] and excluded(aim[key].target) then aim[key]=nil end
            end
        end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if block then
            local proof=block.heldThreat
            local target=proof and (proof.record and proof.record.model or proof.projectile and proof.projectile.owner)
                or block.latch and block.latch.target
            if excluded(target) then
                if block.referencePolicy and block.referencePolicy.cancel then block.referencePolicy.cancel('Target is protected by friend exclusions') end
                if block.release then block.release() end
            end
            for _,key in {'referenceAimTarget','referenceStickyTarget','lastTarget'} do if excluded(block[key]) then block[key]=nil end end
            local pending=block.punchBackPending
            if pending and excluded(pending.target) and block.cancelPunchBack then block.cancelPunchBack('Target is protected by friend exclusions') end
        end
        for _,name in {'autoPunish','nativeRed'} do
            local owner=menu[name]
            if owner and owner.invalidateExcludedTargets then owner.invalidateExcludedTargets() end
        end
        -- A native cleanup can itself hand its rotation lease back through the
        -- shared return helper. It must not linger on the now-protected actor.
        if lock and lock.characterRelease and excluded(lock.characterRelease.target) and lock.cancelAssistReturn then lock.cancelAssistReturn() end
    end
    local function current(record)
        return control.alive and record.present and control.records[record.id]==record
    end
    local function request(id)
        -- IsFriendsWithAsync is the current public API. Older supported clients
        -- can still expose its deprecated yielding predecessor.
        local ok,method=pcall(function()return player.IsFriendsWithAsync end)
        if not ok or type(method)~='function' then
            ok,method=pcall(function()return player.IsFriendsWith end)
        end
        if not ok or type(method)~='function' then error('Roblox friendship API is unavailable') end
        local result=method(player,id)
        if type(result)~='boolean' then error('Roblox friendship API returned no boolean result') end
        return result
    end
    local pump
    local function enqueue(record)
        if not current(record) or (record.state~='pending' and record.state~='failed')
            or record.queued or record.inFlight or record.attempts>=control.maximumAttempts then return end
        record.queued=true;table.insert(control.queue,record)
        if not pumping then
            pumping=true
            host.task.defer(function()pumping=false;if control.alive then pump() end end)
        end
    end
    pump=function()
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled then return end
        while control.running<control.maximumConcurrent and #control.queue>0 do
            local record=table.remove(control.queue,1);record.queued=false
            if not current(record) or (record.state~='pending' and record.state~='failed')
                or record.inFlight or record.attempts>=control.maximumAttempts then continue end
            record.inFlight=true;record.attempts+=1;control.running+=1;control.requests+=1
            host.task.spawn(function()
                local ok,result=pcall(request,record.id)
                control.running-=1;record.inFlight=false
                if current(record) then
                    record.checkedAt=clock()
                    if ok then
                        record.state=if result then 'friend' else 'not-friend'
                        record.error=nil;control.completed+=1
                        if result then control.invalidateTargets() end
                    else
                        record.state='failed';record.error=tostring(result)
                        control.failures+=1;control.lastError=record.error
                        if record.attempts<control.maximumAttempts then
                            host.task.delay(if record.attempts==1 then 2 else 8,function()
                                if current(record) then enqueue(record) end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
                pump()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function watch(actor)
        if not control.alive or actor==player or type(actor.UserId)~='number' or actor.UserId<=0 then return end
        local old=control.records[actor.UserId]
        if old and old.player==actor then return end
        if old then old.present=false end
        local record={id=actor.UserId,player=actor,present=true,state='pending',attempts=0}
        control.records[record.id]=record
        -- Install pending protection synchronously, before a deferred request.
        if control.enabled then control.invalidateTargets() end
        enqueue(record)
    end
    local function forget(actor)
        local record=control.records[actor.UserId]
        if record and record.player==actor then record.present=false;control.records[actor.UserId]=nil end
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        if not control.alive or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        if control.enabled==value then return true end
        control.enabled=value
        if value then
            control.invalidateTargets()
            for _,record in control.records do if record.state=='pending' or record.state=='failed' then enqueue(record) end end
            pump()
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive then return false end
        for _,record in control.records do
            if not record.inFlight then record.state='pending';record.attempts=0;enqueue(record) end
        end
        if control.enabled then control.invalidateTargets();pump() end
        return true
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if not tab or control.controlCreated then return end
        control.controlCreated=true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Auto Exclude Friends',Description='Automatically exclude your Roblox friends from all combat assists. Checks current and joining players; unverified friendship checks stay protected. Manual exclusions remain separate, and ESP stays visible.',
            Default=true,PortRelatedNames={'Auto Exclude Friends','Friends Exclude'},Callback=control.setEnabled})
    end
    function control.onDestroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _,record in control.records do record.present=false end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.queue);table.clear(control.records)
        if menu.isCombatExcluded==predicate then menu.isCombatExcluded=previousPredicate end
        if menu.friendExclusions==control then menu.friendExclusions=nil end
    end
    control.Destroy=control.onDestroy
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(control.connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    connect(players.PlayerAdded,watch);connect(players.PlayerRemoving,forget)
    for _,actor in players:GetPlayers() do watch(actor) end
    return control
end
return FriendExclusions
end)()

local TargetMethods = (function(): any
-- Embedded module type mode: nocheck
-- Shared, data-only target preferences and a deterministic candidate selector.
-- Callers retain their range/FOV/wall/team filters and own every action.
local TargetMethods={}
local anatomical={Head=true,Torso=true,UpperTorso=true,LowerTorso=true,
    ['Left Arm']=true,['Right Arm']=true,['Left Leg']=true,['Right Leg']=true,
    LeftUpperArm=true,LeftLowerArm=true,LeftHand=true,RightUpperArm=true,RightLowerArm=true,RightHand=true,
    LeftUpperLeg=true,LeftLowerLeg=true,LeftFoot=true,RightUpperLeg=true,RightLowerLeg=true,RightFoot=true}
function TargetMethods.new(host,menu)
    local methods={}
    local canonical={'Normal','Closest to cursor','Closest to character','Last target I hit','Last attacker','Last killer','Locked target'}
    local known={};for _,name in canonical do known[name]=true end;known.Mouse=true
    local aliases={['All targets']={'Normal'},['All threats']={'Normal'},['Recent attacker']={'Last attacker'},
        ['Last hit target']={'Last target I hit'},['Last hit by you']={'Last target I hit'},
        ['Last hit']={'Last target I hit'},['Recent hit']={'Last target I hit'},['Recent hit priority']={'Last target I hit'},
        ['Nearest to cursor']={'Closest to cursor'},['Closest to FOV center']={'Closest to cursor'},
        ['Nearest to my character']={'Closest to character'},['Locked or last hit']={'Locked target','Last target I hit'},
        ['Locked target or last hit']={'Locked target','Last target I hit'},
        ['Last hit or attacker']={'Last target I hit','Last attacker'},Both={'Last target I hit','Last attacker'},None={}}
    local clock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    function methods.choices(includeMouse)
        local result=table.clone(canonical);if includeMouse then table.insert(result,'Mouse')end;return result
    end
    function methods.normalize(value,default)
        if type(value)=='table'and value.Value~=nil then value=value.Value end
        if value==nil then value=default end
        local selected,valid={},true
        local function add(item)
            if known[item]then selected[item]=true
            elseif aliases[item]then for _,name in aliases[item]do selected[name]=true end
            else valid=false end
        end
        if type(value)=='string'then add(value)
        elseif type(value)=='table'then
            local count,maximum,hasMap=0,0,false
            for key,item in value do
                if type(key)=='number'then
                    if key<1 or key%1~=0 then valid=false end
                    count+=1;maximum=math.max(maximum,key)
                    if type(item)=='string'then add(item)else valid=false end
                elseif type(item)~='boolean'or not(known[key]or aliases[key])then valid=false
                else hasMap=true;if item==true then add(key)end end
            end
            if count>0 and(hasMap or maximum~=count)then valid=false end
        elseif value~=nil then valid=false end
        local result={};for _,name in canonical do if selected[name]then table.insert(result,name)end end
        if selected.Mouse then table.insert(result,'Mouse')end
        return result,valid
    end
    function methods.has(value,name)
        return table.find(methods.normalize(value),name)~=nil
    end
    function methods.isNormal(value)
        local list=methods.normalize(value,'Normal');return #list==1 and list[1]=='Normal'
    end
    function methods.isTargetControl(name)
        return name=='Lock On Target Priority'or name=='Auto Lock On Skill Targets'or name=='Skill Aim Assist Targets'
            or name=='Robot Aim Target'or name=='Auto Counter Targets'or name=='Auto Punish Targets'
            or type(name)=='string'and name:match(' Aim Target Priority$')~=nil
    end
    local function modelFrom(value)
        if (type(value)=='table'or type(value)=='userdata')and type(value.IsA)=='function'then
            if value:IsA('Player')then return value.Character end
            if value:IsA('Model')then return value end
            return value:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        end
        if type(value)=='string'then local actor=players:FindFirstChild(value);return actor and actor.Character end
        return nil
    end
    function methods.context(extra)
        local context=table.clone(extra or {})
        local now=context.now or clock()
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        local tracker=menu.autoCounterFilter
        local window=lock and lock.recentHitWindow or tracker and tracker.hitWindow or 2
        local function recent(model,at)
            local age=type(at)=='number'and now-at or math.huge
            if window>0 and age>=0 and age<=window then return modelFrom(model),at end
            return nil
        end
        local lastTarget,lastAt=tracker and tracker.lastHitTarget,tracker and tracker.lastHitAt
        if tracker and type(tracker.getLastHitRecord)=='function'then
            local record=tracker.getLastHitRecord()
            lastTarget=record and record.character==player.Character and record.target or nil
            lastAt=record and record.character==player.Character and record.at or nil
        end
        local hit,hitAt=recent(lastTarget,lastAt)
        local incoming=tracker and tracker.lastIncomingRecord
        local attacker,attackerAt
        if incoming and incoming.character==player.Character then attacker,attackerAt=recent(incoming.target,incoming.at)end
        if lock and type(lock.recentHitAt)=='number'and lock.recentHitAt>(attackerAt or -math.huge)then
            local candidate,candidateAt=recent(lock.recentAttacker,lock.recentHitAt)
            if candidate then attacker,attackerAt=candidate,candidateAt end
        end
        local killerRecord=lock and lock.lastKiller
        local killer=killerRecord and killerRecord.model
        if killerRecord and killerRecord.userId then
            local owner=players:GetPlayerByUserId(killerRecord.userId);killer=owner and owner.Character
        end
        context.histories=context.histories or {
            ['Last target I hit']={model=hit,at=hitAt},['Last attacker']={model=attacker,at=attackerAt},
            ['Last killer']={model=modelFrom(killer),at=killerRecord and killerRecord.at or 0}}
        context.locked=context.locked or modelFrom(menu.environment and menu.environment.LockedTarget)
        return context
    end
    local function allowed(context,target)
        local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        return target~=nil and not (excluded and excluded(target)) and (not context.eligible or context.eligible(target)==true)
    end
    -- Take one actual cursor snapshot per selection. Callers can supply their
    -- proven candidate pool so ranking never invents an unrelated combat target.
    function methods.screenContext(candidates,extra)
        local context=table.clone(extra or {})
        -- Existing callers use either pixel distance or squared distance.
        -- Keep their ranks unchanged; normalize only the optional close-tie band.
        if context.cursorRankSquared==nil then context.cursorRankSquared=context.cursorRank==nil end
        local world=host.workspace
        local camera=context.camera or world and world.CurrentCamera
        local cursor=context.cursorPoint
        if not cursor and (not context.cursorRank or context.cursorHit~=false) then
            local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
            if input and type(input.GetMouseLocation)=='function' then cursor=input:GetMouseLocation() end
        end
        if candidates==nil then
            local folder=world and world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
            candidates=folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}
        end
        context.candidates=candidates
        local own=player.Character
        local ownRoot=own and type(own.FindFirstChild)=='function' and own:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local projections,distances={},{}
        local function partFor(target)
            if context.targetPart then return context.targetPart(target) end
            local lock=menu.autoLock
            if lock and lock.targetPart then
                local part=lock.targetPart(target)
                if part then return part end
            end
            if not target or type(target.FindFirstChild)~='function' then return nil end
            return target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or target:FindFirstChild('Torso')
                or target:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso') or target:FindFirstChild('Head')
        end
        if not context.cursorRank then
            context.cursorRank=function(target)
                if projections[target]~=nil then return projections[target] end
                local score=math.huge
                local part=partFor(target)
                if camera and cursor and part and camera.WorldToViewportPoint then
                    -- A cursor over any part of the body counts: take the nearest
                    -- of the chosen part, the head and the root, not one point.
                    local points={part}
                    if type(target.FindFirstChild)=='function' then
                        local head=target:FindFirstChild('Head')
                        if head and head~=part then table.insert(points,head) end
                        local root=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                        if root and root~=part then table.insert(points,root) end
                    end
                    for _,candidatePart in points do
                        local point,visible=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(candidatePart.Position)
                        if visible==true and point.Z>0 then
                            local dx,dy=point.X-cursor.X,point.Y-cursor.Y
                            score=math.min(score,dx*dx+dy*dy)
                        end
                    end
                    if score==math.huge then
                        -- Off-screen or behind the camera used to rank as "no target".
                        -- Rank it after every on-screen target, nearest to the aim
                        -- direction first, so a target is still found.
                        local toward=part.Position-camera.CFrame.Position
                        if toward.Magnitude>.001 then
                            local angle=math.acos(math.clamp(camera.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(toward.Unit),-1,1))
                            score=1e9*(1+angle)
                        end
                    end
                end
                projections[target]=score;return score
            end
        end
        if not context.distanceRank then
            context.distanceRank=function(target)
                if distances[target]~=nil then return distances[target] end
                local part=partFor(target)
                local score=ownRoot and part and (part.Position-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                distances[target]=score;return score
            end
        end
        if context.cursorHit~=false and type(context.cursorHitTarget)~='function' then
            local queried,hitTarget=false,nil
            local pixelRank=context.cursorRank
            context.cursorHitTarget=function()
                if queried then return hitTarget end
                queried=true
                if not camera or not cursor or not world or type(world.Raycast)~='function'
                    or type(camera.ViewportPointToRay)~='function' or not host.RaycastParams
                    or type(host.RaycastParams.new)~='function' then return nil end
                local pool,included,roots={},{},{}
                for _,target in candidates do
                    if (type(target)=='table' or type(target)=='userdata') and target~=own and not included[target]
                        and type(target.IsA)=='function' and target:IsA('Model') and allowed(context,target) then
                        included[target]=true;table.insert(pool,target)
                        local root=type(target.FindFirstChild)=='function' and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                        if root then table.insert(roots,root) end
                    end
                end
                if #pool==0 then return nil end
                local ok,result=pcall(function()
                    local params=host.RaycastParams.new()
                    -- Current native filters permit excluding invisible roots
                    -- while including only caller-proven eligible characters.
                    local mixed=pcall(function()params.IncludeInstances=pool;params.ExcludeInstances=roots end)
                    if not mixed then
                        local include=host.Enum and host.Enum.RaycastFilterType and host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                        if include==nil then return nil end
                        params.FilterType=include;params.FilterDescendantsInstances=pool
                    end
                    local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(cursor.X,cursor.Y,0)
                    if not ray or not ray.Origin or not ray.Direction then return nil end
                    return world:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*(if type(context.cursorRayRange)=='number' and context.cursorRayRange==context.cursorRayRange then math.clamp(context.cursorRayRange,1,50000)else 15000),params)
                end)
                local part=ok and result and result.Instance
                -- Accessories, tools, invisible roots and expanded custom
                -- hitboxes do not count as an anatomical cursor hit.
                if part and anatomical[part.Name] and included[part.Parent]
                    and type(part.IsA)=='function' and part:IsA('BasePart') and allowed(context,part.Parent) then hitTarget=part.Parent end
                return hitTarget
            end
            context.cursorRank=function(target)
                if queried and target==hitTarget then return 0 end
                return pixelRank and pixelRank(target) or math.huge
            end
        end
        return methods.context(context)
    end
    function methods.allowsScope(value,target,context)
        context=context or methods.context()
        local selected=methods.normalize(value,'Normal')
        for _,name in selected do
            if name=='Normal'or name=='Closest to cursor'or name=='Closest to character'then return allowed(context,target)end
            if name=='Locked target'and target==context.locked then return allowed(context,target)end
            local history=context.histories and context.histories[name]
            if history and target==history.model then return allowed(context,target)end
        end
        return false
    end
    function methods.allows(value,target,context)
        context=context or methods.context()
        local selected=methods.normalize(value,'Normal')
        if table.find(selected,'Closest to cursor') or table.find(selected,'Closest to character') then
            return methods.choose(selected,methods.screenContext(context.candidates,context))==target
        end
        return methods.allowsScope(selected,target,context)
    end
    function methods.choose(value,context)
        context=context or methods.context()
        local selected=methods.normalize(value,'Normal')
        local enabled={};for _,name in selected do enabled[name]=true end
        -- Explicit cursor proximity is the primary ranking. Saved lock/history
        -- checkboxes must not silently turn this into a remembered/world target.
        local cursorFirst=enabled['Closest to cursor']==true
        if cursorFirst and type(context.cursorHitTarget)=='function' then
            local target=context.cursorHitTarget()
            if allowed(context,target) then return target,'Closest to cursor' end
        end
        if not cursorFirst and enabled['Locked target']and allowed(context,context.locked)then return context.locked,'Locked target'end
        local best,stamp,reason
        for _,name in canonical do
            local history=not cursorFirst and enabled[name]and context.histories and context.histories[name]
            if history and allowed(context,history.model)then
                local at=history.at or 0
                if not best or at>(stamp or -math.huge)then best,stamp,reason=history.model,at,name end
            end
        end
        if best then return best,reason end
        local ranks={}
        if enabled['Closest to cursor']then table.insert(ranks,{'Closest to cursor',context.cursorRank})end
        if enabled['Closest to character']then table.insert(ranks,{'Closest to character',context.distanceRank})end
        if #ranks==0 and enabled.Normal then
            if allowed(context,context.normalTarget)then return context.normalTarget,'Normal'end
            if context.normalPrefersLock and allowed(context,context.locked)then return context.locked,'Normal'end
            table.insert(ranks,{'Normal',context.normalRank or context.cursorRank or context.distanceRank})
        end
        if #ranks==0 then return nil,if enabled.Mouse then 'Mouse'else 'No eligible selected target method'end
        local bestRanks,bestTie
        local threat=cursorFirst and menu.threatAssessment
        local useThreat=threat and threat.enabled and type(threat.tieRadius)=='number' and threat.tieRadius>0
            and type(threat.strength)=='number' and threat.strength>0
            and type(threat.context)=='function' and type(threat.assess)=='function'
            and type(threat.adjustCursorRank)=='function'
        local cursorCandidates=useThreat and {} or nil
        local valids={}
        for index,target in context.candidates or {}do
            if not allowed(context,target)then continue end
            local values,valid={},true
            for _,rank in ranks do
                local score=rank[2]and rank[2](target)
                if type(score)~='number'or score~=score or score==math.huge then valid=false;break end
                table.insert(values,score)
            end
            if not valid then continue end
            local tie=tostring(target.Name or '')..'\0'..tostring(index)
            table.insert(valids,{target=target,values=values,tie=tie})
            if cursorCandidates and values[1]>=0 then
                table.insert(cursorCandidates,{target=target,values=values,tie=tie})
            end
            local better=best==nil
            if best then
                for i,score in values do
                    if score~=bestRanks[i]then better=score<bestRanks[i];break end
                    if i==#values then better=tie<bestTie end
                end
            end
            if better then best,bestRanks,bestTie=target,values,tie end
        end
        -- With several ranking methods on (cursor and character distance), the old
        -- rule compared them one after another, so the first always won and the
        -- second never mattered. Combine them: each method orders the candidates
        -- and the target with the best total position wins; ties fall back to the
        -- first method.
        if #ranks>1 and #valids>1 and not cursorCandidates then
            local totals={}
            for index=1,#ranks do
                local ordered=table.clone(valids)
                table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)return a.values[index]<b.values[index] end)
                local position=0
                local previousScore
                for place,candidate in ordered do
                    if candidate.values[index]~=previousScore then position=place;previousScore=candidate.values[index] end
                    totals[candidate]=(totals[candidate] or 0)+position
                end
            end
            local winner
            for _,candidate in valids do
                if not winner or totals[candidate]<totals[winner]
                    or totals[candidate]==totals[winner] and (candidate.values[1]<winner.values[1]
                        or candidate.values[1]==winner.values[1] and candidate.tie<winner.tie) then winner=candidate end
            end
            if winner then best,bestRanks,bestTie=winner.target,winner.values,winner.tie end
        end
        if best and cursorCandidates and #cursorCandidates>1 and bestRanks[1]>=0 then
            local minimum=if context.cursorRankSquared then math.sqrt(bestRanks[1]) else bestRanks[1]
            local snapshot,adjustedBest,selectedPixels
            for _,candidate in cursorCandidates do
                local pixels=if context.cursorRankSquared then math.sqrt(candidate.values[1]) else candidate.values[1]
                if pixels>minimum+threat.tieRadius then continue end
                snapshot=snapshot or threat.context(context)
                local assessment=threat.assess(candidate.target,snapshot)
                local adjusted=threat.adjustCursorRank(pixels,minimum,assessment)
                if type(adjusted)~='number' or adjusted~=adjusted or math.abs(adjusted)==math.huge then continue end
                local better=adjustedBest==nil or adjusted<adjustedBest
                if adjusted==adjustedBest then
                    better=pixels<selectedPixels
                    if pixels==selectedPixels then
                        for i,score in candidate.values do
                            if score~=bestRanks[i] then better=score<bestRanks[i];break end
                            if i==#candidate.values then better=candidate.tie<bestTie end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if better then
                    best,bestRanks,bestTie=candidate.target,candidate.values,candidate.tie
                    adjustedBest,selectedPixels=adjusted,pixels
                end
            end
        end
        return best,ranks[1][1]
    end
    return methods
end
return TargetMethods
end)()

local ThreatAssessment = (function(): any
-- Read-only threat estimates for an already eligible cursor-distance shortlist.
-- Selection eligibility, exact cursor hits and accepted victim ownership stay
-- with TargetMethods/cast owners. This component sends no inputs and owns no loop.
local ThreatAssessment={}
local TRACK_LIMIT,PROJECTILE_LIMIT=16,128
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function clamp(value,a,b)return math.max(a,math.min(b,value))end
local function xyz(value)
    if value and finite(value.X)and finite(value.Y)and finite(value.Z)then return value.X,value.Y,value.Z end
    return nil
end
local function attribute(object,name)
    return object and type(object.GetAttribute)=='function'and object:GetAttribute(name)or nil
end
local function child(object,name)
    return object and type(object.FindFirstChild)=='function'and object:FindFirstChild(name)or nil
end
local function rootOf(model)return child(model,'HumanoidRootPart')end
local function active(value)return value==true or finite(value)and value>0 end
local function modelOwner(value)
    if value and(type(value)=='table'or type(value)=='userdata')and type(value.IsA)=='function'then
        if value:IsA('Player')then return value.Character end
        if value:IsA('Model')then return value end
    end
    return nil
end
local function trajectory(snapshot,part,velocity,radius,horizon)
    local x,y,z=xyz(part and part.Position)
    local vx,vy,vz=xyz(velocity)
    if not x or not vx or not snapshot.x then return nil end
    local rx,ry,rz=x-snapshot.x,y-snapshot.y,z-snapshot.z
    vx,vy,vz=vx-snapshot.vx,vy-snapshot.vy,vz-snapshot.vz
    local speed2=vx*vx+vy*vy+vz*vz
    if speed2<1 then return nil end
    local at=-(rx*vx+ry*vy+rz*vz)/speed2
    if not finite(at)or at<0 or at>horizon then return nil end
    local dx,dy,dz=rx+vx*at,ry+vy*at,rz+vz*at
    if dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz>radius*radius then return nil end
    return at
end
function ThreatAssessment.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local clock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,enabled=true,tieRadius=12,strength=1,mode='Cursor close ties',contexts=0,assessments=0}
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        if type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        control.enabled=value;return true
    end
    function control.setTieRadius(value)
        if not finite(value)then return false end
        control.tieRadius=clamp(value,0,100);return true
    end
    function control.setStrength(value)
        if not finite(value)then return false end
        control.strength=clamp(value,0,1);return true
    end
    function control.context(base)
        base=base or {}
        local own=player.Character
        local root=rootOf(own)
        local x,y,z=xyz(root and root.Position)
        local vx,vy,vz=xyz(root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
        local block,tracker=menu.autoBlock,menu.autoCounterFilter
        local now=if finite(base.now)then base.now else clock()
        local snapshot={now=now,own=own,root=root,x=x,y=y,z=z,vx=vx or 0,vy=vy or 0,vz=vz or 0,
            player=player,cache={},attackRecords=block and block.records or {},completed=block and block.completedContacts or {},
            incoming=tracker and tracker.lastIncomingRecord,projectiles={},projectileVisits=0,trackVisits=0,
            meleeReach=if block and finite(block.meleeReach)then clamp(block.meleeReach,1,30)else 6}
        local world=host.workspace
        if finite(base.serverNow)then snapshot.serverNow=base.serverNow
        elseif world and type(world.GetServerTimeNow)=='function'then
            local ok,value=pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow,world)
            if ok and finite(value)then snapshot.serverNow=value end
        end
        -- Iterate existing telemetry once per selection, never once per target.
        -- Overflow is ignored as a whole, avoiding order-dependent first-N bias.
        local projectiles=block and block.projectileParts or {}
        if #projectiles>PROJECTILE_LIMIT then snapshot.projectileBudgetExceeded=true
        elseif x then
            for _,record in projectiles do
                snapshot.projectileVisits+=1
                local part=record.part
                local owner=modelOwner(record.owner)
                if not owner or owner==own or not part or not part.Parent or snapshot.completed[record]then continue end
                local category=record.category
                if not table.find({'Projectiles','Bullets','Bombs','Explosions','Swarms'},category)then continue end
                local source=record.source
                local remaining,risk
                if category=='Bombs'or category=='Explosions'then
                    local radius=attribute(source,'BlastRadius')or attribute(source,'ExplosionRadius')or attribute(part,'BlastRadius')or attribute(part,'ExplosionRadius')
                    remaining=attribute(source,'FuseRemaining')or attribute(source,'TimeToImpact')or attribute(part,'FuseRemaining')or attribute(part,'TimeToImpact')
                    local deadline=attribute(source,'DetonateAt')or attribute(source,'ImpactAt')or attribute(part,'DetonateAt')or attribute(part,'ImpactAt')
                    if finite(deadline)and snapshot.serverNow then remaining=deadline-snapshot.serverNow end
                    if attribute(source,'DamageActive')==true or attribute(part,'DamageActive')==true then remaining=0 end
                    local px,py,pz=xyz(part.Position)
                    if not finite(radius)or radius<=0 or radius>200 or not finite(remaining)or remaining<0 or remaining>.75 or not px then continue end
                    local dx,dy,dz=px-(x+snapshot.vx*remaining),py-(y+snapshot.vy*remaining),pz-(z+snapshot.vz*remaining)
                    if dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz>(radius+2.5)^2 then continue end
                    risk=.8+.2*(1-remaining/.75)
                else
                    local velocity=record.velocity
                    local rvx,rvy,rvz=xyz(velocity)
                    if not rvx or rvx*rvx+rvy*rvy+rvz*rvz<1 then velocity=record.predictedVelocity or part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end
                    local sx,sy,sz=xyz(part.Size)
                    local radius=2.5+(if sx then math.min(math.max(sx::number,sy::number,sz::number)*.5,3)else 0)
                    remaining=trajectory(snapshot,part,velocity,radius,.75)
                    if remaining==nil then continue end
                    risk=.75+.25*(1-remaining/.75)
                end
                local previous=snapshot.projectiles[owner]
                if not previous or risk>previous.risk or risk==previous.risk and(remaining<previous.remaining
                    or remaining==previous.remaining and category<previous.category)then
                    snapshot.projectiles[owner]={risk=risk,remaining=remaining,category=category}
                end
            end
        end
        control.contexts+=1
        return snapshot
    end
    local function explicitOtherTarget(target,info,snapshot)
        for _,key in {'AttackTarget','AbilityTarget','TargetCharacter','TargetUserId'}do
            local value=attribute(target,key)
            if value==nil then
                value=attribute(info,key)
                local marker=child(info,key)
                if value==nil and marker and type(marker.IsA)=='function'and marker:IsA('ValueBase')then value=marker.Value end
            end
            if value~=nil and value~=snapshot.own and value~=snapshot.player then
                if type(value)=='number'and value~=snapshot.player.UserId then return true end
                if type(value)=='string'and value~=''and value~=snapshot.player.Name and value~=snapshot.own.Name and value~=tostring(snapshot.player.UserId)then return true end
                local model=modelOwner(value)
                if model and model~=snapshot.own then return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    function control.assess(target,snapshot)
        snapshot=snapshot or control.context()
        if snapshot.cache[target]then return snapshot.cache[target]end
        local result={score=0,level='None',reasons={},components={},estimated=true}
        if target~=nil then snapshot.cache[target]=result end
        control.assessments+=1
        local root=rootOf(target)
        local humanoid=target and type(target.FindFirstChildOfClass)=='function'and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local x,y,z=xyz(root and root.Position)
        if not control.alive or not x or not snapshot.x or target==snapshot.own or not target.Parent
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or active(attribute(target,'Dead'))then return result end
        local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        if excluded and excluded(target)then return result end
        local info=child(target,'Info')
        if child(info,'Dead')then return result end
        local dx,dy,dz=snapshot.x-x,snapshot.y-y,snapshot.z-z
        local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz)
        result.distance=distance
        local vx,vy,vz=xyz(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
        vx,vy,vz=(vx or 0)-snapshot.vx,(vy or 0)-snapshot.vy,(vz or 0)-snapshot.vz
        local closing=if distance>.001 then (vx*dx+vy*dy+vz*dz)/distance else 0
        result.closingSpeed=closing
        local look=root.CFrame and root.CFrame.LookVector
        local lx,_ly,lz=xyz(look)
        local flat=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz)
        local facing=0
        if lx then
            local length=math.sqrt(lx*lx+lz*lz)
            if length>.001 and flat>.001 then facing=clamp((lx*dx+lz*dz)/(length*flat),-1,1)elseif flat<=.001 then facing=1 end
        end
        result.facingDot=facing
        local proximity=1/(1+(distance/18)^2)
        local directionFactor=clamp((facing+.2)/1.2,0,1)
        local stun=child(info,'Stun')
        local disabled=humanoid.PlatformStand==true or active(attribute(target,'Ragdoll'))or active(attribute(target,'TrueStun'))
            or active(attribute(target,'Stun'))or stun and type(stun.IsA)=='function'and stun:IsA('BoolValue')and stun.Value==true or child(info,'Ragdoll')
            or child(info,'TrueRagdoll')or child(info,'CompleteRagdoll')or child(info,'TrueStun')or child(info,'Knockback')
        local recent=snapshot.incoming
        if recent and recent.character==snapshot.own and recent.target==target and finite(recent.at)then
            local age=snapshot.now-recent.at
            if age>=0 and age<=3 then
                result.components.recentAttacker=(if recent.inferred then .12 else .24)*(1-age/3)*(if disabled then .25 else 1)
                table.insert(result.reasons,'Recent observed attacker')
            end
        end
        local record=snapshot.attackRecords[target]
        local attack,contact,kind=0,nil,nil
        local phased,trackCount=false,0
        if record and not disabled and not explicitOtherTarget(target,info,snapshot)then
            for _ in record.tracks or {}do trackCount+=1;if trackCount>TRACK_LIMIT then break end end
            if trackCount>TRACK_LIMIT then result.trackBudgetExceeded=true
            else
                for track,state in record.tracks or {}do
                    snapshot.trackVisits+=1
                    local descriptor=state.descriptor or {}
                    local nativeKind=descriptor.kind
                    if nativeKind~='M1'and nativeKind~='Move'then continue end
                    if snapshot.completed[state]or nativeKind=='Move'and snapshot.completed[child(info,'InSkill')]then phased=true;continue end
                    if track.IsPlaying==false or not finite(state.at)or snapshot.now<state.at
                        or snapshot.now-state.at>(if nativeKind=='M1'then 1.5 else 8)
                        or track.IsPlaying==nil and finite(state.expires)and snapshot.now>state.expires then continue end
                    if nativeKind=='Move'and not child(info,'InSkill')then continue end
                    local remaining
                    if finite(state.contactTime)then
                        phased=true
                        local position,speed=track.TimePosition,track.Speed
                        if not finite(position)or not finite(speed)or speed<=0 then continue end
                        remaining=(state.contactTime-position)/speed
                        if remaining<-.12 then continue end
                    end
                    local reach=if nativeKind=='M1'then 1/(1+(distance/snapshot.meleeReach)^4)else proximity
                    local risk=(if nativeKind=='M1'then .52 else .56)*reach*directionFactor
                    if closing>0 then risk+=.08*reach*clamp(closing/35,0,1)end
                    if remaining and remaining>=0 and remaining<=.6 then
                        risk+=.34*(1-remaining/.6)*reach*directionFactor
                    end
                    if risk>attack or risk==attack and((remaining or math.huge)<(contact or math.huge)
                        or remaining==contact and kind and nativeKind<kind)then attack,contact,kind=risk,remaining,nativeKind end
                end
            end
            -- These native state markers are evidence; animation names/priorities
            -- and InSkill alone never make an emote or unknown action a threat.
            if not phased and not result.trackBudgetExceeded then
                local swing=record.nativeSwing
                local fresh=swing and finite(swing.at)and snapshot.now>=swing.at and snapshot.now-swing.at<=.22 and not snapshot.completed[swing]
                local stamp=attribute(target,'LastM1')
                local age=finite(stamp)and snapshot.serverNow and snapshot.serverNow-stamp
                local lastM1=age and age>=-.05 and age<=.22 and stamp~=record.blockedLastM1
                local marker=child(info,'Melee')or child(info,'Attacking')
                if marker and snapshot.completed[marker]then marker=nil end
                if swing and snapshot.completed[swing]then fresh,lastM1,marker=false,false,nil end
                if fresh or lastM1 or marker then
                    local risk=.42/(1+(distance/snapshot.meleeReach)^4)*directionFactor
                    if risk>attack then attack,kind=risk,'M1'end
                end
            end
            local dash=record.dashPhase
            if dash and not dash.endedAt and dash.character==snapshot.own and dash.side=='Front'
                and not snapshot.completed[dash]and finite(dash.at)and snapshot.now>=dash.at and snapshot.now-dash.at<=.65 then
                local eta=trajectory(snapshot,root,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity,4,.65)
                if eta then result.components.frontDash=.38*(1-eta/.65);result.timeToImpact=eta;table.insert(result.reasons,'Observed front dash closing on your position')end
            end
        end
        if attack>0 then
            result.components.attack=attack;result.timeToImpact=contact or result.timeToImpact
            result.attackKind=kind;table.insert(result.reasons,if kind=='M1' then 'Active native M1 evidence'else 'Active native move evidence')
            if contact and contact>=0 then table.insert(result.reasons,'Native animation contact timing')end
        end
        local projectile=snapshot.projectiles[target]
        if projectile then
            result.components.projectile=projectile.risk;result.timeToImpact=projectile.remaining
            table.insert(result.reasons,'Observed incoming '..projectile.category:lower()..' trajectory or active fuse')
        end
        -- Independent signals combine without double-counting repeated tracks.
        local complement=1
        for _,name in {'recentAttacker','attack','frontDash','projectile'}do complement*=1-clamp(result.components[name]or 0,0,1)end
        result.score=clamp(1-complement,0,1)
        result.level=if result.score>=.7 then 'High'elseif result.score>=.35 then 'Medium'elseif result.score>0 then 'Low'else 'None'
        return result
    end
    function control.adjustCursorRank(pixels,nearestPixels,assessment)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or control.strength<=0 or control.tieRadius<=0 then return pixels end
        if not finite(pixels)or not finite(nearestPixels)or pixels<nearestPixels or pixels-nearestPixels>control.tieRadius then return math.huge end
        local score=type(assessment)=='table'and assessment.score or assessment
        score=if finite(score)then clamp(score,0,1)else 0
        return pixels-control.strength*control.tieRadius*score
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if not tab or control.controlsCreated then return end
        control.controlsCreated=true
        local related={'Threat Aware Cursor Targeting','Cursor Threat Tie Radius (px)','Cursor Threat Strength (%)'}
        local function add(kind,name,config)
            config.Name=name;config.PortRelatedNames=related;config.JujutsuerPortTab='Main';config.JujutsuerPortGroup='Lock on'
            config.QuickSettingsOnly=name~=related[1]
            return tab[kind](tab,config)
        end
        add('CreateToggle',related[1],{Description='Keep exact cursor hits first. Within the selected close-cursor band only, use observed attacks, approach and incoming projectile timing to help choose a threat. This is an estimate and never changes a committed skill victim.',Default=true,Callback=control.setEnabled})
        add('CreateSlider',related[2],{Description='Only targets this many pixels from the closest eligible cursor distance may receive a threat preference. Zero restores strict closest-cursor ranking.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=12,Step=1,Precision=0,Callback=control.setTieRadius})
        add('CreateSlider',related[3],{Description='Threat influence inside the close-cursor band. Zero preserves pure cursor distance; targets outside the band are never promoted.',Min=0,Max=100,Default=100,Step=1,Precision=0,Callback=function(value)return control.setStrength(value/100)end})
    end
    function control.Destroy()control.alive=false end
    return control
end
return ThreatAssessment
end)()

local NativeMenuFactory = (function(): any
-- Embedded module type mode: nocheck
-- Owned Shenaniganism controls. This module creates no legacy GUI or VM closures.
local NativeMenuFactory = {}
-- Exact tab artwork recovered from the original root's static CreateTab calls.
local originalTabImages={
    Main='rbxassetid://18319797565',Automatic='rbxassetid://83223446527332',
    Fun='rbxassetid://136900398387437',Transform='rbxassetid://17688911545',
