function NativeMenuFactory.new(host: {[string]: any}, menu: any, options: any): any
    options = options or {}
    local Instance, Enum = host.Instance, host.Enum
    local UDim2, UDim, Color3 = host.UDim2, host.UDim, host.Color3
    local input = host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local players = host.game:GetService('Players')
    local shared = host._G or host
    local appearance = shared.__CullingAppearance or {}
    local fontSizes = appearance.menuFontSizes or {title=24,subtitle=18,content=14,description=12,annotation=8}
    local colors = appearance.colors or {}
    local connections, controls, dropdownCleanups = {}, {}, {}
    local floating: any = {}
    local alive, drag = true, nil
    local panel = {Pages={},TabButtons={},TabLines={},Refreshers={},Controls=controls,NativeOwned=true,nativeHeaderless=true,Style='JJS Modern',RailWidth=84,RailIconSize=30,RailNames=true,TabTint='None'}
    local function connect(signal, callback, bucket)
        local connection = signal:Connect(function(...) if alive then return callback(...) end;return nil end)
        table.insert(bucket or connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function color(key, fallback) return colors[key] or fallback end
    local function own(className, name, parent, kind)
        local object = Instance.new(className)
        object.Name = name
        object:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true)
        if kind then object:SetAttribute('WidgetType',kind) end
        if object:IsA('GuiObject') then
            object.BorderSizePixel=0
            object.BackgroundColor3=color('Row Color',Color3.fromRGB(238,238,238))
        end
        object.Parent=parent
        return object
    end
    local function text(className, name, caption, parent, size, kind)
        local object=own(className,name,parent,kind or 'Text')
        object.Text=tostring(caption or '')
        object.TextColor3=color('Text Color',Color3.fromRGB(15,15,15))
        object.TextSize=size or fontSizes.content or 14
        object.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        object.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        object.ClipsDescendants=true
        if options.FontFace then object.FontFace=options.FontFace else object.Font=Enum.Font.Cartoon end
        object.BackgroundTransparency=1
        if object:IsA('TextButton') then object.AutoButtonColor=false end
        return object
    end
    local function layout(parent, horizontal)
        local list=own('UIListLayout','Layout',parent)
        list.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        list.Padding=UDim.new(0,5)
        if horizontal then list.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal end
        return list
    end
    local playerGui=players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
    assert(playerGui,'Shenaniganism needs LocalPlayer.PlayerGui')
    local root=own('ScreenGui','Shenaniganism',playerGui)
    root.ResetOnSpawn=false
    root.IgnoreGuiInset=true
    root.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
    root.DisplayOrder=50
    root.Enabled=false
    panel.Root=root
    local main=own('Frame','Main',root,'WindowRoot')
    main.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-480,.5,-300)
    main.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(960,600)
    main.BackgroundColor3=color('Window Background COlor',Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245))
    -- The shared resize/drag root stays transparent between its two surfaces.
    main.BackgroundTransparency=1
    panel.Main=main
    if options.Version then
        local version=text('TextLabel','BuildVersion','v'..tostring(options.Version),main,11)
        version.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(0,1)
        version.Position,version.Size=UDim2.new(0,8,1,-3),UDim2.fromOffset(180,16)
        version.BackgroundTransparency,version.TextTransparency=1,.15
        version.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        version.ZIndex=30
        version:SetAttribute('CullingFontRole','description')
        panel.VersionLabel=version
    end
    local scale=own('UIScale','MenuScale',main)
    scale.Scale=tonumber(options.Scale) or 1
    local body=own('Frame','BodyBackground',main,'Main')
    body.BackgroundColor3=main.BackgroundColor3
    body.BackgroundTransparency=(appearance.transparency or {})['Window Background COlor'] or .08
    panel.WindowSurface=body
    local tools=own('Frame','ScaleBar',main,'ChromeRoot')
    tools.Position,tools.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),UDim2.new(1,-16,0,30)
    tools.ClipsDescendants=true
    tools.BackgroundTransparency=1
    panel.TopBar,panel.ScaleBar=tools,tools
    local scaleSurface=own('Frame','ScaleSurface',tools,'TopBar')
    scaleSurface.BackgroundColor3=main.BackgroundColor3
    scaleSurface.BackgroundTransparency=.88
    panel.TopBarSurface=scaleSurface
    local close=text('TextButton','CloseButton','x',tools,18,'CloseButton')
    close.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    close.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,125,132)
    close.BackgroundTransparency=0
    panel.CloseButton=close
    local scaleLabel=text('TextLabel','ScaleValue','',tools,12)
    scaleLabel.Position,scaleLabel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,0),UDim2.new(.3,-16,0,30)
    scaleLabel:SetAttribute('CullingFontRole','description')
    scaleLabel.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    local scaleTrack=own('Frame','ScaleTrack',tools,'SliderTrack')
    scaleTrack.Position,scaleTrack.Size=UDim2.new(.3,0,.5,-3.5),UDim2.new(.7,-270,0,7)
    scaleTrack.BackgroundColor3=color('Slider Background Color',Color3.fromRGB(63,68,80))
    local scaleFill=own('Frame','Fill',scaleTrack,'SliderFill')
    scaleFill.BackgroundColor3=color('Theme Color',Color3.fromRGB(0,205,215))
    function panel:LayoutChrome(availableWidth)
        local width=availableWidth or (if main.Size.X.Scale==0 and main.Size.X.Offset>0 then main.Size.X.Offset else main.AbsoluteSize.X/math.max(.01,scale.Scale))
        local inner=math.max(80,width-16)
        local line=math.max(30,(fontSizes.content or 14)+12,(fontSizes.description or 12)+10)
        local compact=inner<560
        local height=if compact then line*2+4 else line
        local actionY=if compact then line+4 else 0
        tools.Position,tools.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),UDim2.new(1,-16,0,height)
        local editWidth=math.min(72,math.max(46,(fontSizes.content or 14)*2.4+12))
        local closeWidth=math.max(26,math.min(44,line-4))
        local closeLeft=inner-4-closeWidth
        local editLeft=closeLeft-6-editWidth
        local searchWidth=if compact then math.max(1,editLeft-12) else math.min(200,inner*.24)
        local searchLeft=if compact then 4 else editLeft-8-searchWidth
        local trackRight=if compact then inner-8 else searchLeft-14
        local captionWidth=math.min(112,math.max(88,(fontSizes.description or 12)*7.5),math.max(40,trackRight-44))
        local trackLeft=captionWidth+12
        scaleLabel.Position,scaleLabel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(4,0),UDim2.fromOffset(captionWidth,line)
        scaleTrack.Position,scaleTrack.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(trackLeft,(line-7)/2),UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(112,math.max(1,trackRight-trackLeft)),7)
        scaleSurface.Position,scaleSurface.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),UDim2.fromOffset(trackLeft+scaleTrack.Size.X.Offset+8,line)
        close.Position,close.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(closeLeft,actionY+2),UDim2.fromOffset(closeWidth,line-4)
        local edit=tools:FindFirstChild('LayoutEdit')
        if edit then edit.Position,edit.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(editLeft,actionY+2),UDim2.fromOffset(editWidth,line-4);edit.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end
        local search=tools:FindFirstChild('FeatureSearch')
        if search then search.Position,search.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(searchLeft,actionY+3),UDim2.fromOffset(searchWidth,line-6);search.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd;search.ClipsDescendants=true end
        -- Toolbar, navigation and pages share the same resized window bounds.
        local bodyTop=8+height+8
        body.Position,body.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,bodyTop),UDim2.new(1,0,1,-bodyTop)
        local rail=self.Style=='Rail' or self.Style=='Rail Right'
        local vertical=self.Style=='Vertical' or rail
        local right=self.Style=='Rail Right'
        local deck=self.Style=='Top Deck'
        if self.Sidebar then
            local sidebarWidth=if rail then self.RailWidth else math.floor(math.clamp(width*.22,80,172))
            self.Sidebar.Position=if right then UDim2.new(1,-sidebarWidth-8,0,bodyTop) else UDim2.fromOffset(8,bodyTop)
            self.Sidebar.Size=UDim2.new(0,sidebarWidth,1,-bodyTop-8)
            local stripHeight=if deck then 46 else 36
            self.TabStrip.Position,self.TabStrip.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,bodyTop),UDim2.new(1,-16,0,stripHeight)
            self.ContentArea.Position=if vertical then (if right then UDim2.fromOffset(8,bodyTop) else UDim2.fromOffset(sidebarWidth+18,bodyTop)) else UDim2.fromOffset(8,bodyTop+stripHeight+8)
            self.ContentArea.Size=if vertical then UDim2.new(1,-sidebarWidth-26,1,-bodyTop-8) else UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-bodyTop-stripHeight-16)
        end
    end
    panel.responsiveChrome=true
    if main.GetPropertyChangedSignal then connect(main:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Size'),function()panel:LayoutChrome()end)end
    if tools.ChildAdded then connect(tools.ChildAdded,function(child)
        if child.Name=='LayoutEdit'or child.Name=='FeatureSearch'then
            if host.task and host.task.defer then host.task.defer(function()if alive then panel:LayoutChrome()end end)else panel:LayoutChrome()end
        end
    end)end
    panel:LayoutChrome()
    local sidebar=own('ScrollingFrame','Sidebar',main,'Sidebar')
    sidebar.BackgroundTransparency=1
    sidebar.ScrollBarThickness=3
    sidebar.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    sidebar.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
    layout(sidebar,false)
    panel.Sidebar=sidebar
    local strip=own('ScrollingFrame','TabStrip',main,'TabStrip')
    strip.BackgroundTransparency=1
    strip.ScrollBarThickness=3
    strip.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    strip.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
    layout(strip,true)
    panel.TabStrip=strip
    local content=own('Frame','ContentArea',main,'Page')
    content.BackgroundTransparency=1
    content.ClipsDescendants=true
    panel.ContentArea=content
    local STYLES={Rail=true,['Rail Right']=true,['Top Deck']=true,JJS=true,Vertical=true,['JJS Modern']=true}
    function panel:RefreshTabs()
        local pictured=self.Style=='Rail' or self.Style=='Rail Right' or self.Style=='Top Deck'
        for index,button in self.TabButtons do
            local line=self.TabLines[index]
            local selected=line~=nil and line.Visible
            button.BackgroundTransparency=if pictured then (if selected then .1 else .85) else .5
            local label=button:FindFirstChild('RailName')
            if label then label.TextTransparency=if selected then 0 else .4 end
            local icon=button:FindFirstChild('RailIcon')
            if icon then icon.ImageTransparency=if selected then 0 else .4 end
        end
    end
    function panel:ApplyStyle(value)
        if value=='Classic Tabs' or value=='Culling Hub' or value=='Native' then value='JJS Modern' end
        self.Style=if STYLES[value] then value else 'JJS Modern'
        local rail=self.Style=='Rail' or self.Style=='Rail Right'
        local deck=self.Style=='Top Deck'
        local vertical=self.Style=='Vertical' or rail
        local pictured=rail or deck
        sidebar.Visible,strip.Visible=vertical,not vertical
        sidebar.BackgroundTransparency=if rail then (self.RailAlpha or .55) else 1
        self:LayoutChrome()
        local iconSize=self.RailIconSize
        local tint=if self.TabTint=='Accent' then color('Theme Color',Color3.fromRGB(150,190,255)) elseif self.TabTint=='Mono' then color('Text Color',Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)) else Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        for index,button in self.TabButtons do
            button.Parent=if vertical then sidebar else strip
            button.Size=if rail then UDim2.new(1,-6,0,iconSize+(if self.RailNames then 28 else 16)) elseif deck then UDim2.fromOffset(132,40) elseif vertical then UDim2.new(1,-6,0,44) else UDim2.fromOffset(112,31)
            button.Text=if pictured then '' else tostring(button:GetAttribute('TabCaption') or button.Text)
            local art=button:FindFirstChild('TabArtwork')
            if art then art.Visible=not pictured end
            local icon=button:FindFirstChild('RailIcon')
            if icon then
                icon.Visible=pictured and icon.Image~=''
                icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize,iconSize)
                icon.ImageColor3=tint
                if rail then icon.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,0);icon.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,6)
                else icon.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(0,.5);icon.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,.5,0) end
            end
            local label=button:FindFirstChild('RailName')
            if label then
                label.Visible=pictured and (self.RailNames or deck)
                if rail then
                    label.Position,label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,iconSize+10),UDim2.new(1,0,0,14)
                    label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                else
                    label.Position,label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(iconSize+18,0),UDim2.new(1,-(iconSize+24),1,0)
                    label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                end
            end
            local line=self.TabLines[index]
            if line then
                if rail then
                    line.Position=UDim2.new(if self.Style=='Rail' then 0 else 1,if self.Style=='Rail' then 0 else -3,.2,0)
                    line.Size=UDim2.new(0,3,.6,0)
                else line.Position,line.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-2),UDim2.new(1,0,0,2) end
            end
        end
        self:RefreshTabs()
    end
    function panel:SetVisible(value)
        main.Visible=if type(value)=='boolean' then value else not main.Visible
    end
    connect(close.Activated,function()
        if menu and menu.toggleMenuVisibility then menu.toggleMenuVisibility(false) else panel:SetVisible(false) end
    end)
    connect(host.game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped,function()
        for choices,info in floating do
            local button=info.button
            if choices.Parent and button.Parent then
                local uiScale=math.max(.01,scale.Scale)
                local origin=button.AbsolutePosition-main.AbsolutePosition
                local y=origin.Y/uiScale+button.AbsoluteSize.Y/uiScale+4
                local limit=main.AbsoluteSize.Y/uiScale
                if y+choices.AbsoluteSize.Y/uiScale>limit and origin.Y/uiScale>choices.AbsoluteSize.Y/uiScale+8 then y=origin.Y/uiScale-choices.AbsoluteSize.Y/uiScale-4 end
                choices.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(origin.X/uiScale,y)
            else floating[choices]=nil end
        end
    end)
    connect(input.InputBegan,function(object)
        if object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and object.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local point=object.Position
        for choices,info in floating do
            local function inside(frame)
                local a,b=frame.AbsolutePosition,frame.AbsoluteSize
                return point.X>=a.X and point.X<=a.X+b.X and point.Y>=a.Y and point.Y<=a.Y+b.Y
            end
            if not inside(choices) and not inside(info.button) then info.close() end
        end
    end)
    local function callback(config,value,emit)
        if not alive then return false end
        if emit and type(config.Callback)=='function' then return config.Callback(value) end
        return nil
    end
    local function finite(value,fallback)
        value=tonumber(value)
        return if value and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then value else fallback
    end
    local function parseColor(value)
        if menu and type(menu.colorValue)=='function' then
            local parsed=menu.colorValue(value)
            if parsed then return parsed end
        end
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)=='Color3' then return value end
        if type(value)=='string' then
            local hex=value:match('^#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)$')
            if hex then return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(hex:sub(1,2),16),tonumber(hex:sub(3,4),16),tonumber(hex:sub(5,6),16)) end
            local channels={}
            for number in value:gsub('Color3',''):gmatch('[-+]?%d*%.?%d+') do table.insert(channels,tonumber(number)) end
            if #channels~=3 then return nil end
            for _,number in channels do if number~=number or math.abs(number)==math.huge then return nil end end
            -- The count check and finite-value pass above validate all channels.
            return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(channels[1] :: number,0,255),math.clamp(channels[2] :: number,0,255),math.clamp(channels[3] :: number,0,255))
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function createRow(page,config,kind)
        local row=own('Frame','Row_'..tostring(config.Name or config.Title or kind),page,'Row')
        row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,63)
        row.LayoutOrder=#page:GetChildren()
        row.BackgroundTransparency=.12
        local heading=text('TextLabel','Name',config.DisplayName or config.Name or config.Title,row,fontSizes.content or 14)
        heading.Position,heading.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,5),UDim2.new(1,if kind=='Paragraph'then -24 elseif kind=='Toggle'then -84 elseif kind=='ColorPicker'then -164 else -204,0,28)
        heading.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        local description=text('TextLabel','Description',config.Description or config.Content or '',row,fontSizes.description or 12,'TextMuted')
        description.Position,description.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,35),UDim2.new(1,if kind=='Dropdown'then -204 else -24,0,24)
        description.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        return row
    end
    local function action(row,caption,kind)
        local button=text('TextButton','Control',caption,row,fontSizes.content or 14,kind or 'ActionButton')
        button.Position,button.Size=UDim2.new(1,-190,0,6),UDim2.fromOffset(178,27)
        button.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        button.BackgroundColor3=color('Button Background Color',Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
        button.BackgroundTransparency=0
        return button
    end
    local function addControl(kind,config,widget,row)
        widget.Row,widget.Config,widget.Kind=row,config,kind
        table.insert(controls,widget)
        return widget
    end
    function panel:CreateTab(name,image)
        local index=#self.Pages+1
        local button=text('TextButton','Tab_'..name,name,strip,14,'TabButton')
        button.LayoutOrder=index
        button.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(112,31)
        button.BackgroundTransparency=.5
        button.ZIndex=2
        local asset=if type(image)=='string'and image~=''then image else (options.TabImages or originalTabImages)[name]
        if type(asset)=='string'and asset~=''then
            local backdrop=own('ImageLabel','TabArtwork',button,'TabArtwork')
            backdrop.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1
            backdrop.Image=asset
            backdrop.ImageTransparency=.5
            backdrop.ZIndex=1
        end
        button:SetAttribute('TabCaption',name)
        local railIcon=own('ImageLabel','RailIcon',button,'RailIcon')
        railIcon.BackgroundTransparency=1;railIcon.Image=if type(asset)=='string' then asset else ''
        railIcon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit;railIcon.ZIndex=3;railIcon.Visible=false
        railIcon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30)
        local railName=text('TextLabel','RailName',name,button,10,'RailName')
        railName.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;railName.ZIndex=3;railName.Visible=false
        local accent=own('Frame','TabAccentLine',button,'TabAccentLine')
        accent.Position,accent.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-2),UDim2.new(1,0,0,2)
        accent.BackgroundColor3=color('Theme Color',Color3.fromRGB(0,205,215))
        accent.ZIndex=4
        accent.Visible=index==1
        local page=own('ScrollingFrame','Page_'..name,content,'Page')
        page.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        page.BackgroundTransparency=1
        page.BorderSizePixel=0
        page.ScrollBarThickness=3
        page.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        page.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
        page.Visible=index==1
        layout(page,false)
        table.insert(self.Pages,page)
        table.insert(self.TabButtons,button)
        table.insert(self.TabLines,accent)
        connect(button.Activated,function()
            for i,target in self.Pages do target.Visible=i==index;self.TabLines[i].Visible=i==index end
            self:RefreshTabs()
        end)
        local tab={Page=page,Name=name}
        function tab:CreateParagraph(config)
            local row=createRow(page,config,'Paragraph')
            return addControl('CreateParagraph',config,{Get=function() return config.Content end,Set=function(value) config.Content=value;row.Description.Text=tostring(value or '') end},row)
        end
        function tab:CreateButton(config)
            local row=createRow(page,config,'Button')
            local caption=if menu and menu.buttonCaption then menu.buttonCaption(config) else config.ButtonText or config.DisplayName or config.Name or 'Apply'
            local button=action(row,caption)
            local widget={Button=button,Get=function() return false end}
            widget.Set=function(value,emit) return callback(config,value,emit) end
            -- A deliberate button click is distinct from automation or saved
            -- configuration replay. Only this path borrows menu-pause permission.
            widget.Activate=function()
                if not alive or type(config.Callback)~='function' then return false,'Action is unavailable' end
                local result=table.pack(pcall(function()
                    if name~='Settings' and not config.ConfigManager and menu and menu.runManualMenuAction then
                        return menu.runManualMenuAction(config.Callback)
                    end
                    return config.Callback()
                end))
                local failure=if not result[1]then result[2]elseif result[2]==false then result[3]or'Action is unavailable'else nil
                if failure~=nil then
                    local message=if type(failure)=='number'then string.format('Try again in %.2f seconds.',math.max(0,failure))else tostring(failure)
                    widget.LastActionError=message
                    if row.Parent and row.Description then row.Description.Text=message end
                    return false,message
                end
                widget.LastActionError=nil
                if row.Parent and row.Description then row.Description.Text=tostring(config.Description or'')end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end
            connect(button.Activated,widget.Activate)
            return addControl('CreateButton',config,widget,row)
        end
        function tab:CreateToggle(config)
            local row=createRow(page,config,'Toggle')
            local button=action(row,'','ToggleSwitch')
            button.Position,button.Size=UDim2.new(1,-58,0,8),UDim2.fromOffset(44,24)
            local knob=own('Frame','Knob',button)
            knob.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(18,18)
            knob.BackgroundColor3=color('Knob Color',Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
            local value=config.Default==true
            local widget={Button=button,Get=function()return value end}
            local function paint()
                button.BackgroundColor3=color(if value then 'Toggle-On Color' else 'Toggle-Off Color',if value then Color3.fromRGB(127,244,144) else Color3.fromRGB(255,128,135))
                knob.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(if value then 23 else 3,3)
            end
            widget.Set=function(nextValue,emit) value=nextValue==true;paint();return callback(config,value,emit) end
            connect(button.Activated,function() widget.Set(not value,true) end)
            paint()
            return addControl('CreateToggle',config,widget,row)
        end
        function tab:CreateSlider(config)
            local row=createRow(page,config,'Slider')
            local minimum,maximum=finite(config.Min,0),finite(config.Max,100)
            if maximum<minimum then minimum,maximum=maximum,minimum end
            local value=math.clamp(finite(config.Default,minimum),minimum,maximum)
            local track=own('Frame','SliderTrack',row,'SliderTrack')
            row:FindFirstChild('Name').Size=UDim2.new(.42,-24,0,28)
            track.Position,track.Size=UDim2.new(.42,0,0,14),UDim2.new(.58,-14,0,7)
            track.BackgroundColor3=color('Slider Background Color',Color3.fromRGB(63,68,80))
            local fill=own('Frame','Fill',track,'SliderFill')
            fill.BackgroundColor3=color('Theme Color',Color3.fromRGB(0,205,215))
            local label=text('TextLabel','Value','',track,fontSizes.annotation or 8)
            label.Position,label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,-2),UDim2.new(1,0,0,11)
            label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            label:SetAttribute('CullingFontRole','annotation')
            local widget={Frame=track,ValueLabel=label,Get=function() return value end}
            local function paint()
                fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(if maximum>minimum then (value-minimum)/(maximum-minimum) else 0,1)
                label.Text=string.format('%.'..tostring(config.Precision or 2)..'f',value)
            end
            widget.Set=function(nextValue,emit)
                local amount=finite(nextValue,value)
                if config.Step and config.Step>0 then amount=minimum+math.round((amount-minimum)/config.Step)*config.Step end
                value=math.clamp(amount,minimum,maximum)
                paint();return callback(config,value,emit)
            end
            local function at(point)
                local alpha=math.clamp((point.X-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,track.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)
                widget.Set(minimum+(maximum-minimum)*alpha,true)
            end
            track.Active=true
            connect(track.InputBegan,function(object)
                if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    drag={object=object,at=at};at(object.Position)
                end
            end)
            paint()
            return addControl('CreateSlider',config,widget,row)
        end
        function tab:CreateInput(config)
            local row=createRow(page,config,'Input')
            local box=text('TextBox','Input',config.Default or '',row,fontSizes.content or 14,'InputBox')
            box.Position,box.Size=UDim2.new(1,-190,0,6),UDim2.fromOffset(178,27)
            box.BackgroundTransparency=0
            box.BackgroundColor3=color('Input Background Color',Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255))
            box.ClearTextOnFocus=false
            local value=tostring(config.Default or '')
            local widget={Button=box,ValueLabel=box,Get=function() return value end}
            widget.Set=function(nextValue,emit) value=tostring(nextValue or '');box.Text=value;return callback(config,value,emit) end
            connect(box.FocusLost,function()widget.Set(box.Text,true)end)
            return addControl('CreateInput',config,widget,row)
        end
        function tab:CreateDropdown(config)
            local row=createRow(page,config,'Dropdown')
            local button=action(row,'')
            button.Name='DropdownButton'
            local choices=own('ScrollingFrame','Choices',row,'DropdownList')
            choices.Position,choices.Size=UDim2.new(1,-190,0,37),UDim2.fromOffset(178,0)
            choices.BackgroundTransparency=.1
            choices.Visible=false
            choices.ScrollBarThickness=3
            choices.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
            layout(choices,false)
            local options=table.clone(config.Options or {})
            local multi=config.Multi==true or config.MultiSelect==true or config.Multiple==true
            local selected={}
            local value=config.Default
            if value==nil then value=options[1] or '' end
            local function selectMany(values)
                table.clear(selected)
                if type(values)~='table' then return end
                for k,v in values do
                    local option=if type(k)=='number' then v else k
                    if table.find(options,option) then selected[option]=if type(k)=='number' then true else v==true end
                end
            end
            if multi then selectMany(config.Default) end
            local widget={Button=button,DropdownButton=button,ValueLabel=button,Frame=choices}
            local choiceRecords={}
            local dropdownAlive=true
            local function paint()
                local optionLabels=config.OptionLabels or {}
                local caption
                if multi then
                    local labels={}
                    for _,option in options do if selected[option] then table.insert(labels,tostring(optionLabels[option] or option)) end end
                    caption=if #labels>0 then table.concat(labels,', ') else 'None'
                else caption=tostring(optionLabels[value] or value or 'None') end
                caption..='  ▾'
                if button.Text~=caption then button.Text=caption end
                for _,record in choiceRecords do
                    local option,choice=record.option,record.button
                    local label=(if multi then (if selected[option] then '☑  ' else '☐  ') else '')..tostring(optionLabels[option] or option)
                    if choice.Text~=label then choice.Text=label end
                end
            end
            widget.Get=function() if not multi then return value end;local result={};for _,option in options do if selected[option] then table.insert(result,option) end end;return result end
            widget.Set=function(nextValue,emit)
                if multi then
                    selectMany(nextValue)
                elseif table.find(options,nextValue) or nextValue=='' then value=nextValue else return false end
                paint();callback(config,widget.Get(),emit);return true
            end
            if multi then
                widget.CheckboxOptions=options
                widget.IsChecked=function(option) return selected[option]==true end
                widget.SetChecked=function(option,on,emit)
                    if not table.find(options,option) then return false end
                    selected[option]=on==true;paint();callback(config,widget.Get(),emit);return true
                end
            end
            local function setOpen(open)
                -- A real dropdown box: it floats over the menu at the button instead of pushing the rows down.
                if choices.Visible~=open then choices.Visible=open end
                local height=if open then math.min(240,#options*30) else 0
                local uiScale=math.max(.01,scale.Scale)
                local width=math.max(120,button.AbsoluteSize.X/uiScale)
                choices.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
                if open then
                    choices.ZIndex=960
                    for _,child in choices:GetChildren() do if child:IsA('GuiObject') then child.ZIndex=961 end end
                    if choices.Parent~=main then choices.Parent=main end
                    floating[choices]={button=button,close=function() setOpen(false) end}
                else
                    floating[choices]=nil
                    if choices.Parent~=row then choices.Parent=row end
                end
            end
            local function releaseChoice(record)
                if record.connection then record.connection:Disconnect();record.connection=nil end
                record.button:Destroy()
            end
            local function populate()
                local available={}
                for _,record in choiceRecords do
                    local bucket=available[record.option]
                    if not bucket then bucket={};available[record.option]=bucket end
                    table.insert(bucket,record)
                end
                table.clear(choiceRecords)
                for index,option in options do
                    local bucket=available[option]
                    local record=bucket and table.remove(bucket)
                    if record and record.button.Parent~=choices then releaseChoice(record);record=nil end
                    if not record then
                        local choice=text('TextButton','Choice_'..tostring(index),'',choices,12,'DropdownOption')
                        choice.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,24)
                        record={option=option,button=choice}
                        -- The record and callback survive player-list refreshes;
                        -- only genuinely added options allocate or bind inputs.
                        record.connection=connect(choice.Activated,function()
                            if multi then widget.SetChecked(option,not selected[option],true) else widget.Set(option,true);setOpen(false) end
                        end,{})
                    end
                    local choice=record.button
                    local name='Choice_'..tostring(index)
                    if choice.Name~=name then choice.Name=name end
                    if choice.LayoutOrder~=index then choice.LayoutOrder=index end
                    if choice.Visible~=true then choice.Visible=true end
                    table.insert(choiceRecords,record)
                end
                for _,bucket in available do for _,record in bucket do releaseChoice(record)end end
                if choices.CanvasSize.X.Scale~=0 or choices.CanvasSize.X.Offset~=0 or choices.CanvasSize.Y.Scale~=0 or choices.CanvasSize.Y.Offset~=#options*29 then choices.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,#options*29)end
                paint()
            end
            widget.SetOptions=function(nextOptions)
                if not alive or not dropdownAlive then return false end
                nextOptions=nextOptions or {}
                local unchanged=#options==#nextOptions
                if unchanged then for index,option in options do if nextOptions[index]~=option then unchanged=false;break end end end
                if unchanged then for _,record in choiceRecords do if record.button.Parent~=choices then unchanged=false;break end end end
                if unchanged then config.Options=options;paint();setOpen(choices.Visible);return nil end
                options=table.clone(nextOptions or {});config.Options=options
                if multi then
                    widget.CheckboxOptions=options
                    for option in selected do if not table.find(options,option) then selected[option]=nil end end
                else if not table.find(options,value) then value=options[1] or '' end end
                populate();setOpen(choices.Visible)
                return nil
            end
            connect(button.Activated,function()setOpen(not choices.Visible)end)
            local function cleanupChoices()
                dropdownAlive=false
                floating[choices]=nil
                if choices.Parent~=row then choices:Destroy() end
                for _,record in choiceRecords do if record.connection then record.connection:Disconnect();record.connection=nil end end
                table.clear(choiceRecords)
                dropdownCleanups[row]=nil
            end
            dropdownCleanups[row]=cleanupChoices
            connect(row.Destroying,cleanupChoices)
            populate()
            return addControl('CreateDropdown',config,widget,row)
        end
        function tab:CreateColorPicker(config)
            local row=createRow(page,config,'ColorPicker')
            local value=parseColor(config.Default) or Color3.new(1,1,1)
            local widget={Get=function() return value end}
            widget.Set=function(nextValue,emit)
                local parsed=parseColor(nextValue)
                if not parsed then return false end
                value=parsed;callback(config,value,emit);return true
            end
            -- ModernUI.attachColor supplies the existing managed HSV/alpha editor.
            -- No duplicate native color panel is built beneath it.
            return addControl('CreateColorPicker',config,widget,row)
        end
        tab.CreateSection=function(_,title) return tab:CreateParagraph({Title=title,Content=''}) end
        tab.CreateDivider=function() return tab:CreateParagraph({Title='',Content=''}) end
        if menu and type(menu.wrapTab)=='function' and options.WrapTabs~=false then menu.wrapTab(tab,self,name) end
        self:ApplyStyle(self.Style)
        return tab
    end
    local scaleValue=scale.Scale
    local scaleWidget={Frame=scaleTrack,ValueLabel=scaleLabel,Get=function()return scaleValue end}
    scaleWidget.Set=function(value,emit)
        scaleValue=math.clamp(finite(value,scaleValue),.5,1.5)
        scale.Scale=scaleValue
        scaleFill.Size=UDim2.new(scaleValue-.5,0,1,0)
        scaleLabel.Text=string.format('GUI SCALE: %.2f',scaleValue)
        if emit and menu and menu.scheduleSave then menu.scheduleSave() end
    end
    scaleWidget.Set(scaleValue,false)
    local function scaleAt(point)
        local alpha=math.clamp((point.X-scaleTrack.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,scaleTrack.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)
        scaleWidget.Set(.5+alpha,true)
    end
    scaleTrack.Active=true
    connect(scaleTrack.InputBegan,function(object)
        if object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag={object=object,at=scaleAt};scaleAt(object.Position) end
    end)
    connect(input.InputChanged,function(object)
        if drag and (object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or object==drag.object) then drag.at(object.Position) end
    end)
    connect(input.InputEnded,function(object)
        if drag and (object==drag.object or object.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then drag=nil end
    end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()drag=nil end)
    -- The legacy VM's menu-key listener is retired. Keep exactly one owned
    -- keyboard/mouse-button entry point; wheel input stays in MenuEnhancements.
    connect(input.InputBegan,function(object,processed)
        if menu and type(menu.handleMenuToggle)=='function' then menu.handleMenuToggle(object,processed) end
    end)
    panel.ScaleWidget=scaleWidget
    function panel:RegisterScale()
        if not menu or not menu.register or menu.scaleEntry then return end
        menu.register('GUI Scale','Settings','CreateSlider',{Min=.5,Max=1.5,Default=1},scaleWidget,scaleTrack)
        menu.scaleEntry=menu.entries['Settings/GUI Scale']
        local entry=menu.scaleEntry
        if entry and type(entry.exactValueInput)=='function' then connect(scaleLabel.InputBegan,entry.exactValueInput) end
    end
    function panel:Present()
        if not alive then return false end
        self:RegisterScale()
        root.Enabled=true
        return true
    end
    function panel:Destroy()
        if not alive then return end
        alive=false;drag=nil
        for _,cleanup in dropdownCleanups do cleanup()end
        for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        root:Destroy()
    end
    connect(root.Destroying,function()
        if not alive then return end
        alive=false;drag=nil
        for _,cleanup in dropdownCleanups do cleanup()end
        for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end)
    local startStyle=options.Style or appearance.presentation
    if startStyle==nil or startStyle=='Culling Hub' or startStyle=='JJS Modern' or startStyle=='Native' then startStyle='JJS Modern' end
    panel:ApplyStyle(startStyle)
    if menu then
        if menu.setPanel then menu.setPanel(panel) else menu.panel=panel end
        panel:RegisterScale()
    end
    return panel
end

return NativeMenuFactory
end)()

local RetiredMovementCleanup = (function(): any
local Cleanup={}
function Cleanup.new(host,menu)
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local world=host.workspace
    local readConnections,readUpvalues=host.getconnections,host.getupvalues
    local debugInfo=host.debug and host.debug.info or debug.info
    local kind=host.typeof or typeof
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control={alive=true,scans=0,disconnected=0,skipped=0,errors=0}
    local connections,playerConnections={},{}
    local queued,running,rescan=false,false,false
    local function currentCharacters()
        local current={}
        for _,actor in players:GetPlayers()do if actor.Character then current[actor.Character]=true end end
        return current
    end
    local function inspect(fn,current)
        local okay,record=pcall(function()
            if type(fn)~='function'then return nil end
            local source,line=debugInfo(fn,'sl')
            -- Verified native callback: its third upvalue is the same u46
            -- connection the callback disconnects in its own cleanup branch.
            -- A different native version fails closed instead of being guessed.
            if type(source)~='string'or not source:match('Controllers%.Character%.MovementController$')or line~=296 then return nil end
            local values=readUpvalues(fn)
            local root,joint,connection,model=values[1],values[2],values[3],values[4]
            if kind(root)~='Instance'or not root:IsA('BasePart')or root.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'
                or kind(joint)~='Instance'or not joint:IsA('Motor6D')or joint.Name~='RootJoint'
                or kind(connection)~='RBXScriptConnection'or connection.Connected~=true
                or kind(model)~='Instance'or not model:IsA('Model')or current[model]then return nil end
            if root.Parent~=nil or joint.Parent~=nil or model.Parent~=nil then return nil end
            return setmetatable({fn=fn,root=root,joint=joint,connection=connection,model=model,at=clock()},{__mode='v'})
        end)
        if not okay then control.errors+=1;return nil end
        return record
    end
    local function collect()
        local found={};local current=currentCharacters()
        for _,item in readConnections(run.Stepped)do
            local okay,fn=pcall(function()return item.Function end)
            if okay then local record=inspect(fn,current);if record then found[#found+1]=record end end
        end
        return found
    end
    local schedule
    local function scan()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if running then rescan=true;return end
        running=true;control.scans+=1
        local okay,pending=pcall(collect)
        if not okay then control.errors+=1;control.lastError=tostring(pending);running=false;return end
        control.lastCandidates=#pending
        if #pending==0 then running=false;return end
        host.task.delay(2.1,function()
            if not control.alive then running=false;table.clear(pending);return end
            local current=currentCharacters()
            local removed=0
            for _,first in pending do
                local record=first.fn and inspect(first.fn,current)
                if record and clock()-(first.at or clock())>=2
                    and record.root==first.root and record.joint==first.joint
                    and record.model==first.model and record.connection==first.connection then
                    local disconnected=pcall(function()record.connection:Disconnect()end)
                    if disconnected and record.connection.Connected==false then removed+=1 else control.errors+=1 end
                else control.skipped+=1 end
            end
            table.clear(pending);running=false
            control.disconnected+=removed
            if removed>0 then print('[Shenaniganism] retired movement callbacks removed',removed,'total',control.disconnected)end
            if rescan then rescan=false;schedule()end
        end)
    end
    schedule=function()
        if not control.alive or queued then return end
        queued=true
        host.task.delay(.1,function()queued=false;if control.alive then scan()end end)
    end
    local function watch(actor)
        if playerConnections[actor]then return end
        playerConnections[actor]=actor.CharacterRemoving:Connect(schedule)
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        for _,connection in playerConnections do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(connections);table.clear(playerConnections)
    end
    if type(readConnections)~='function'or type(readUpvalues)~='function'then control.unavailable=true;return control end
    for _,actor in players:GetPlayers()do watch(actor)end
    connections[#connections+1]=players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(actor)watch(actor);schedule()end)
    connections[#connections+1]=players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(actor)
        local connection=playerConnections[actor];if connection then connection:Disconnect();playerConnections[actor]=nil end
        schedule()
    end)
    local characters=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
    if characters then connections[#connections+1]=characters.ChildRemoved:Connect(schedule)end
    schedule()
    return control
end
return Cleanup
end)()

local NativeFeatureHost = (function(): any
-- Compose the existing native controllers without executing the legacy VM.
local NativeFeatureHost = {}

-- A UI may retain a callback while its native game controller is unavailable.
-- Only configuration writes are retained; actions are never replayed later.
function NativeFeatureHost.deferred(label, construct, available, methods, defaults, attach, accept, retryOptions)
    local pending, latest, wrappers, values = {}, {}, {}, table.clone(defaults or {})
    local record: any = {alive=true, pendingNative=true, name=label, attempts=0, errors={}, target=nil}
    local proxy
    local function status()
        return record.lastError or ('Waiting for native '..label)
    end
    local function invoke(name: string, ...)
        if not record.alive then return false, 'Controller is unloaded' end
        local target = record.target
        if target and type(target[name])=='function' then return target[name](...) end
        local readers=values.__readers
        if readers and type(readers[name])=='function' then return readers[name](values,...) end
        -- Other already-ready helpers use this only as their exception-safe
        -- native call wrapper; withholding that wrapper would block them too.
        if name=='callNative' and type(select(1,...))=='function' then return pcall(...) end
        if name:sub(1,3)=='set' or name=='importProfiles' or name=='useProfiles' or name=='bindLegacyQTE' then
            local args=table.pack(...)
            if label=='M1AimAssist' and ((name :: string)=='setAimTargetSwitchMode' or (name :: string)=='setAimTargetSwitchDelayMs') then
                if not values.aimTargetSwitchModes or values.aimTargetSwitchModes[args[1]]==nil then return false,'Unknown aim role' end
                if (name :: string)=='setAimTargetSwitchMode' then
                    if not table.find({'Default','Delay','Sticky'},args[2]) then return false,'Unknown target switching mode' end
                elseif type(args[2])~='number' or args[2]~=args[2] or math.abs(args[2])==math.huge then return false,'Switch delay must be finite' end
            elseif label=='DashControl' and ((name :: string)=='setIntervalAdjustmentSeconds' or (name :: string)=='setFrontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds') then
                local value=tonumber(args[1])
                if not value or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false,'Interval adjustment must be finite' end
            elseif label=='AutoBlock' and (name :: string)=='setPunchBackHits' then
                local value=tonumber(args[1])
                if not value or value%1~=0 or value<1 or value>10 then return false,'Punch Back hits must be an integer from 1 to 10' end
            elseif label=='AutoBlock' and (name :: string)=='setPunchBackAfterAttack' then
                if type(args[1])~='boolean' then return false,'Punch Back attack-end preference must be boolean' end
            elseif label=='AutoBlock'and((name :: string)=='setEnemyAttackAngle'or(name :: string)=='setEnemyShoulderMargin')then
                local value=args[1]
                if type(value)~='number'or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false,'Enemy attack geometry must be finite' end
            elseif label=='M1AimAssist' and (name :: string)=='setBlockAimKeepAfterRelease' then
                if type(args[1])~='boolean' then return false,'Block Assist retention must be boolean' end
            elseif label=='M1AimAssist' and (name :: string)=='setBlockAimReleaseDistance' then
                if type(args[1])~='number' or args[1]~=args[1] or math.abs(args[1])==math.huge then return false,'Block Assist release distance must be finite' end
            elseif label=='AutoLock' and ((name :: string)=='setAssistHumanized'or (name :: string)=='setAssistRampIntoLaser') then
                local role=type(args[1])=='string' and args[1]:gsub(' Aim$','')
                local flags=values[if (name :: string)=='setAssistHumanized'then 'assistHumanized'else 'assistRampIntoLaser']
                if not role or not flags or flags[role]==nil or type(args[2])~='boolean' then return false,'Unknown assist or invalid movement preference' end
            elseif label=='AutoLock' and ((name :: string)=='setAssistDisengageDelayMs' or (name :: string)=='setAssistFadeOutMs' or (name :: string)=='setAssistIntroMs') then
                local role=type(args[1])=='string' and args[1]:gsub(' Aim$','')
                local value=args[2]
                if not role or not values.assistHumanized or values.assistHumanized[role]==nil or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false,'Unknown assist or invalid return timing' end
            end
            local key=if name=='importProfiles' then nil else name
            if key then
                for index=1,args.n-1 do
                    if type(args[index])=='string' or type(args[index])=='number' then key..='/'..tostring(args[index]) else break end
                end
            end
            if #pending>=256 then
                local compact={}
                for _,call in pending do if not call.cancelled then compact[#compact+1]=call end end
                pending=compact
            end
            if #pending>=1024 then return false, 'Too many pending settings' end
            NativeFeatureHost.updatePendingMetadata(label,values,name,args)
            if type(values.__configure)=='function' then values.__configure(values,name,args) end
            local call={name=name,args=args}
            if key then
                if latest[key] then latest[key].cancelled=true end
                latest[key]=call
            end
            pending[#pending+1]=call
            return true, status()
        end
        return false, status()
    end
    local known={}
    for _,name in methods or {} do known[name]=true end
    function record.Destroy()
        if not record.alive then return end
        record.alive=false;table.clear(pending);table.clear(latest)
        if record.target and type(record.target.Destroy)=='function' then record.target.Destroy() end
    end
    proxy=setmetatable({}, {
        __index=function(_,key)
            if key=='Destroy' then return record.Destroy end
            if key=='pendingNative' then return record.target==nil end
            if key=='alive' then return record.alive end
            if key=='lastReason' and not record.target then return status() end
            if key=='ready' or key=='nativeReady' then
                return record.target and record.target[key] or false
            end
            local target=record.target
            if target and type(target[key])~='function' then return target[key] end
            if known[key] or target and type(target[key])=='function' or values.__readers and type(values.__readers[key])=='function' then
                if not wrappers[key] then wrappers[key]=function(...) return invoke(key,...) end end
                return wrappers[key]
            end
            return values[key]
        end,
        __newindex=function(_,key,value)
            if record.target then record.target[key]=value else values[key]=value end
        end,
    })
    record.proxy=proxy
    record.defaults=values
    function record.step()
        if not record.alive or record.target then return record.target~=nil end
        local now=retryOptions and retryOptions.clock and retryOptions.clock() or 0
        if record.nextRetryAt and now<record.nextRetryAt then return false end
        local gateOk,allowed,reason=pcall(available)
        if not gateOk or not allowed then
            record.lastError=if gateOk then reason else tostring(allowed)
            return false
        end
        record.attempts+=1
        local ok,target=pcall(construct)
        if not ok or type(target)~='table' then
            record.lastError=tostring(target)
            record.nextRetryAt=now+(retryOptions and retryOptions.retrySeconds or 0)
            return false
        end
        if accept then
            local accepted,ready,acceptReason=pcall(accept,target)
            if not accepted or not ready then
                record.lastError=if accepted then acceptReason or target.initError or target.lastReason or 'Native dependency is not ready' else tostring(ready)
                if type(target.Destroy)=='function' then pcall(target.Destroy) end
                record.nextRetryAt=now+(retryOptions and retryOptions.retrySeconds or 0)
                return false
            end
        end
        record.target=target;record.pendingNative=false;record.lastError=nil
        -- Replace the menu reference so facing/input ownership comparisons use
        -- the real controller. Existing callback wrappers remain valid.
        local attached,message=pcall(attach,target)
        if not attached then record.errors[#record.errors+1]='Attach: '..tostring(message) end
        for _,call in pending do
            if call.cancelled then continue end
            local method=target[call.name]
            if type(method)=='function' then
                local success,callMessage=pcall(method,table.unpack(call.args,1,call.args.n))
                if not success then record.errors[#record.errors+1]=call.name..': '..tostring(callMessage) end
            end
        end
        table.clear(pending);table.clear(latest)
        return true
    end
    return record
end

-- Mirror configuration data only. The pending object still reports ready=false
-- and every action remains unavailable; enabled here is the requested setting.
function NativeFeatureHost.updatePendingMetadata(label: string,values: any,method: string,args: any)
    local function number(value,low,high)
        local result=tonumber(value)
        if not result or result~=result or math.abs(result)==math.huge then return nil end
        return math.clamp(result,low or -math.huge,high or math.huge)
    end
    if (label=='NativeCombos' or label=='NativeVariants') and method=='setEnabled' then
        local feature=values.features and values.features[args[1]]
        if feature then feature.enabled=args[2]==true end
        return
    end
    if label=='NativeCombos' then
        if method=='setDelay' then
            local feature=values.features and values.features[args[1]]
            local delay=number(args[2],.05,.4)
            if feature and delay and args[1]~='Garuda Rebound' then feature.delay=delay end
            return
        elseif method=='setLegacyQTEEnabled' then
            values.legacyQTE.enabled=args[1]==true;return
        elseif method=='setYukiInstantEnabled' or method=='setYukiRechargeEnabled' then
            values.yukiCharge=values.yukiCharge or {instant=false,recharge=false}
            values.yukiCharge[if method=='setYukiInstantEnabled' then 'instant' else 'recharge']=args[1]==true
            return
        end
    end
    if label=='M1AimAssist' then
        if method=='setAimTargetSwitchMode' then
            if values.aimTargetSwitchModes and values.aimTargetSwitchModes[args[1]]~=nil and table.find({'Default','Delay','Sticky'},args[2]) then values.aimTargetSwitchModes[args[1]]=args[2] end
            return
        elseif method=='setAimTargetSwitchDelayMs' then
            local value=number(args[2],0,5000)
            if value and values.aimTargetSwitchDelayMs and values.aimTargetSwitchDelayMs[args[1]]~=nil then values.aimTargetSwitchDelayMs[args[1]]=value end
            return
        elseif method=='setAimAreaMode' or method=='setAimAreaDimension' or method=='setAimAreaVisible' then
            local area=values.aimAreas and values.aimAreas[args[1]]
            if not area then return end
            if method=='setAimAreaMode' and (args[2]=='Facing Box' or args[2]=='360°' or args[2]=='Half Dome') then
                area.mode=args[2]
                if args[1]=='Block' then values.blockAimBoxEnabled=args[2]~='360°' end
            elseif method=='setAimAreaVisible' then
                area.visible=args[2]==true
                if args[1]=='Block' then values.blockAimBoxVisible=area.visible end
            elseif method=='setAimAreaDimension' and table.find({'x','y','z','ox','oy','oz'},args[2]) then
                local value=number(args[3],if args[2]=='y' then 90 elseif #args[2]==2 then -100 else 0,if args[2]=='y' then 200 else 100)
                if value then area[args[2]]=value;if args[1]=='Block' and #args[2]==1 then values['blockAimBox'..args[2]:upper()]=value end end
            end
            return
        elseif method=='setAimPriority' then
            if values.__targetMethods then
                local normalized,valid=values.__targetMethods.normalize(args[2])
                if valid~=false then values.aimPriorities[args[1]]=normalized end
            elseif table.find(values.aimPriorityChoices,args[2]) then values.aimPriorities[args[1]]=args[2] end
            return
        elseif method=='setAimPrediction' then
            local prediction=values.aimPrediction[args[1]]
            if prediction then
                local limits={leadMs={0,250},maxLead={0,10},strength={0,3},x={-10,10},y={-10,10},z={-10,10}}
                local bounds=limits[args[2]]
                if args[2]=='enabled' or args[2]=='dashEndpoint' then prediction[args[2]]=args[3]==true
                elseif bounds then local value=number(args[3],bounds[1],bounds[2]);if value then prediction[args[2]]=value end end
            end
            return
        elseif method=='setAimSpeed' then
            local field=({M1='turnResponse',Skill='skillAimSpeed'})[args[1]]
            local value=number(args[2],0,100)
            if field and value then values[field]=value end
            return
        elseif method=='setSkillAimTargets' then
            if values.__targetMethods then
                local normalized,valid=values.__targetMethods.normalize(args[1])
                if valid~=false then values.skillAimTargets=normalized;values.aimPriorities.Skill=normalized end
                return
            end
            local value=if args[1]=='Closest to FOV center' then 'Closest to cursor' else args[1]
            if value=='Closest to cursor' or value=='Closest to character' then
                values.aimPriorities.Skill=value;values.skillAimTargets='All targets'
            else values.aimPriorities.Skill='Normal';values.skillAimTargets=value end
            return
        end
    end
    if label=='AutoLock' then
        if method=='setAssistHumanized'or method=='setAssistRampIntoLaser' then
            local role=type(args[1])=='string' and args[1]:gsub(' Aim$','')
            local flags=values[if method=='setAssistHumanized'then 'assistHumanized'else 'assistRampIntoLaser']
            if role and flags and flags[role]~=nil and type(args[2])=='boolean' then flags[role]=args[2] end
            return
        elseif method=='setAssistDisengageDelayMs' or method=='setAssistFadeOutMs' or method=='setAssistIntroMs' then
            local role=type(args[1])=='string' and args[1]:gsub(' Aim$','')
            local value=number(args[2],0,5000)
            if role and values.assistHumanized[role]~=nil and value then
                values[if method=='setAssistDisengageDelayMs' then 'assistDisengageDelayMs' elseif method=='setAssistIntroMs' then 'assistIntroMs' else 'assistFadeOutMs'][role]=value
                if method=='setAssistFadeOutMs' then values.assistFadeOverride[role]=true end
                if method=='setAssistIntroMs' then values.assistIntroOverride[role]=true end
            end
            return
        elseif method=='setFovDimension' then
            local maximum=({fovBoxSize=1080,fovWidth=1920,fovHeight=1080})[args[1]]
            local value=maximum and number(args[2],1,maximum)
            if value then values[args[1]]=value end
            return
        elseif method=='setOffscreenMargin' or method=='setOffscreenOffset' then
            local prefix=if method=='setOffscreenMargin' then 'offscreenMargin' else 'offscreenOffset'
            local value=number(args[2],if method=='setOffscreenMargin' then 0 else -2000,if method=='setOffscreenMargin' then 500 else 2000)
            if (args[1]=='X' or args[1]=='Y') and value then values[prefix..args[1]]=value end
            return
        elseif method=='setCameraOffset' or method=='setCharacterOffset' then
            local key=if method=='setCameraOffset' then 'cameraOffset' else 'characterOffset'
            local value=number(args[2],-5/.28,5/.28)
            if table.find({'X','Y','Z'},args[1]) and value then values[key][args[1]]=value end
            return
        elseif method=='setTrigger' then
            if values.__readers.activationHas(values,args[1],'Block') or table.find({'None','Hit','Both','Incoming','BlockIncoming','HitIncoming','All'},args[1]) then
                values.trigger=args[1];values.outgoingHitEnabled=values.__readers.activationHas(values,args[1],'Hit')
            end
            return
        elseif method=='setOutgoingHit' then
            values.outgoingHitEnabled=args[1]==true
            values.trigger=values.__readers.withActivation(values,values.trigger or 'None','Hit',args[1])
            return
        elseif method=='setCameraSpeed' then values.cameraSpeedExplicit=true
        end
    end
    if label=='AutoBlock'and(method=='setEnemyAttackAngle'or method=='setEnemyShoulderMargin')then
        local angle=method=='setEnemyAttackAngle'
        local value=number(args[1],if angle then 60 else 0,if angle then 360 else 4)
        if value then values[if angle then 'enemyAttackAngle'else 'enemyShoulderMargin']=value end
        return
    elseif label=='AutoBlock' and method=='setPunchBackHits' then
        local value=tonumber(args[1])
        if value and value%1==0 and value>=1 and value<=10 then values.punchBackHits=value end
        return
    elseif label=='AutoBlock' and method=='setPunchBackAfterAttack' then
        if type(args[1])=='boolean' then values.punchBackAfterAttack=args[1] end
        return
    elseif label=='AutoBlock' and method=='setReferenceOption' then
        local settings=values.referenceSettings
        if settings and settings[args[1]]~=nil then
            local bounds=({chance={0,100},sensitivity={0,1},blockDelay={0,1},unblockDelay={0,1}})[args[1]]
            if bounds then local value=number(args[2],bounds[1],bounds[2]);if value then settings[args[1]]=value end
            elseif type(settings[args[1]])=='boolean' then settings[args[1]]=args[2]==true
            elseif args[1]=='rangeType' and (args[2]=='Static' or args[2]=='Dynamic') then settings.rangeType=args[2] end
        end
        return
    elseif label=='AutoBlock' and method=='setReferenceVisualizerColor' then
        values.referenceSettings.visualizerColor=args[1];return
    elseif label=='DashControl' and table.find({'setSeconds','setMilliseconds','setSteps'},method) then
        local value=number(args[1],0,if method=='setSeconds' then 10 elseif method=='setMilliseconds' then 10000 else 100)
        if value then
            values.seconds=if method=='setMilliseconds' then value/1000 elseif method=='setSteps' then math.round(value*10000)/100000 else value
            values.milliseconds,values.steps=values.seconds*1000,values.seconds*10
            values.effectiveIntervalSeconds=math.max(0,values.seconds+(values.intervalAdjustmentSeconds or 0))
        end
        return
    elseif label=='DashControl' and table.find({'setIntervalAdjustmentSeconds','setFrontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds','setFrontIntervalSeconds'},method) then
        local front=method~='setIntervalAdjustmentSeconds'
        local adjustment=method~='setFrontIntervalSeconds'
        local limit=if front then 15 else 10
        local value=number(args[1],if adjustment then -limit else 0,limit)
        if value then
            values[if not front then 'intervalAdjustmentSeconds' elseif adjustment then 'frontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds' else 'frontIntervalSeconds']=value
            values.effectiveIntervalSeconds=math.max(0,(values.seconds or 10)+(values.intervalAdjustmentSeconds or 0))
            values.effectiveFrontIntervalSeconds=math.max(0,(values.frontIntervalSeconds or 0)+(values.frontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds or 0))
        end
        return
    elseif label=='DashControl' and (method=='setM1WhileDashing' or method=='setDashWhileBlocking' or method=='setBlockDashEnabled') then
        values[if method=='setM1WhileDashing' then 'm1DashEnabled' else 'blockingEnabled']=args[1]==true
        if method~='setM1WhileDashing' then values.blockDashEnabled=args[1]==true end
        return
    end
    if method:sub(1,3)~='set' or args.n~=1 then return end
    local aliases={setHitCount='requestedM1s',setPreview='previewEnabled',setInfinite='infiniteEnabled',setAutoWallrun='autoWallrunEnabled',
        setM1AimSmoothing='m1AimSmoothingMs',setBlockAimSmoothing='blockAimSmoothingMs',setSkillAimSmoothing='skillAimSmoothingMs',
        setCounterAimSmoothing='counterAimSmoothingMs',setPunishAimSmoothing='punishAimSmoothingMs',setPostOwnDashDelay='postOwnDashDelayMs',
        setDashPrediction='dashPredictionEnabled',setImpactLeadMs='impactLead',setReferenceM1Ids='referenceM1Ids'}
    local field=aliases[method] or (method:sub(4,4):lower()..method:sub(5))
    local value=args[1]
    if type(value)=='number' and (value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge) then return end
    if method=='setEnabled' and label=='BlackflashChain' then value=false end -- Retired rear-movement feature.
    if type(values[field])=='boolean' or type(value)=='boolean' then value=value==true end
    local limits={impactLead={0,150},m1Reach={0,8},projectileDelay={0,1},yutaWindow={.01,.15},
        ownCollisionScale={.1,1},multiplier={.25,3},assistDashRadius={1,30},resoluteFinisherDelay={.7,.8},garudaLead={0,.25},
        fovDegrees={1,180},fovOffsetX={-2000,2000},fovOffsetY={-2000,2000},lockRange={0,100},
        recentHitWindow={0,30},smoothSeconds={.01,1},characterSpeed={0,100},cameraSpeed={0,100},
        characterTransitionSpeed={0,100},characterReleasingSpeed={0,100},
        blockAimRange={0,100},blockAimReleaseDistance={0,100},punishAimRange={0,100},counterAimRange={0,100/.28},
        skillAimRange={0,200},skillAimDuration={0,2},blockAimHitWindow={0,30},
        blockAimBoxX={0,100},blockAimBoxY={90,200},blockAimBoxZ={0,100},
        turnResponse={0,100},blockAimSpeed={0,100},blockAimTrackingSpeed={1,100},counterAimSpeed={0,100},punishAimSpeed={0,100},
        m1AimSmoothingMs={0,1000},blockAimSmoothingMs={0,1000},skillAimSmoothingMs={0,1000},counterAimSmoothingMs={0,1000},punishAimSmoothingMs={0,1000},characterTransitionMs={0,500},blockReleaseCameraGuardMs={0,500},aimHoldSeconds={0,10},aimMoveLead={-10,10},assistHandoffMs={0,800},dashCameraDelay={0,5},
        postOwnDashDelayMs={0,2000},postOwnDashTime={0,5},holdTime={0,5},perfectBlockLead={0,3},projectileRange={0,80},dashSideRange={0,80},
        releaseTimeout={-0.3,1},nativeRecoveryTimeout={0,2},acceptanceTimeout={.1,2},hitsBeforePunish={1,5}}
    local bounds=limits[field]
    if field=='range' then bounds={0,({AutoBlock=60,AutoPunish=30/.28,NativeCounter=45/.28,BlackflashChain=5/.28,M1AimAssist=80})[label] or 80} end
    if bounds then value=number(value,bounds[1],bounds[2]);if value==nil then return end end
    if method=='setImpactLeadMs' then value/=1000 end
    if method=='setHitCount' then value=number(value,1,5);if not value or value%1~=0 then return end end
    values[field]=value
    if label=='AutoLock' and method=='setSmoothSeconds' and not values.cameraSpeedExplicit then values.cameraSpeed=1/value end
end

-- Read-only UI metadata and pure configuration helpers remain available in
-- lobbies. None of these helpers creates a target, sends input, or moves a rig.
function NativeFeatureHost.pendingDefaults(name,targetMethods)
    if name=='M1AimAssist' then
        local areas={}
        for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do areas[role]={mode='360°',x=16,y=90,z=8,ox=0,oy=0,oz=0,visible=false} end
        local switchModes,switchDelays={},{}
        for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do switchModes[role]='Default';switchDelays[role]=250 end
        return {aimTargetSwitchModes=switchModes,aimTargetSwitchDelayMs=switchDelays,m1AimSticky=false,skillAimSticky=false,blockAimTrackingSpeed=100,blockAimSticky=true,blockAimKeepAfterRelease=true,blockAimReleaseDistance=20,blockAimBoxY=90,aimAreas=areas,
            __readers={getAimTargetSwitchMode=function(values,role)return values.aimTargetSwitchModes[role] end,getRetainedBlockTarget=function()return nil end,getRetainedM1Target=function()return nil end,getRetainedSkillTarget=function()return nil end},__targetMethods=targetMethods,aimPriorityChoices=if targetMethods then targetMethods.choices() else {'Normal','Closest to cursor','Closest to character','Last target I hit',
            'Last attacker','Last hit or attacker','Locked target'}}
    elseif name=='AutoPunish' then
        return {__targetMethods=targetMethods,targetModes=if targetMethods then targetMethods.choices() else {'All threats','Locked target','Last hit target','Locked or last hit'},
            __readers={getTargetMode=function(values)return values.targetMode or 'All threats'end},
            __configure=function(values,method,args)
                if method=='setTargetMode' then
                    if targetMethods then
                        local normalized,valid=targetMethods.normalize(args[1])
                        if valid~=false then values.targetMode=normalized end
                    elseif table.find(values.targetModes,args[1]) then values.targetMode=args[1] end
                end
            end}
    elseif name=='AutoLock' then
        local masks={None=0,Block=1,Hit=2,Both=3,Incoming=4,BlockIncoming=5,HitIncoming=6,All=7}
        local choices={'None','Block','Hit','Both','Incoming','BlockIncoming','HitIncoming','All'}
        local bits={Block=1,Hit=2,Incoming=4}
        local function activationHas(_,value,method)
            local mask,bit=masks[value],bits[method]
            return mask~=nil and bit~=nil and math.floor(mask/bit)%2==1
        end
        local function bezier(t,a,b)return 3*(1-t)^2*t*a+3*(1-t)*t*t*b+t^3 end
        local function custom(values,progress,phase)
            local p=values.curvePoints[phase or 'Initial'];local low,high=0,1
            for _=1,24 do local t=(low+high)/2;if bezier(t,p[1],p[3])<progress then low=t else high=t end end
            return bezier((low+high)/2,p[2],p[4])
        end
        local function evaluate(values,progress,phase)
            local curve=if phase=='Release' then values.characterReleaseCurve or values.characterTransitionCurve else values.characterTransitionCurve
            if progress<=0 then return 0 end
            if progress>=1 then return 1 end
            if curve=='Custom' then return custom(values,progress,phase) end
            if curve=='Linear' then return progress end
            if curve=='Exponential' then return (math.exp(3*progress)-1)/(math.exp(3)-1) end
            if curve=='Reverse Exponential' then return 1-(math.exp(3*(1-progress))-1)/(math.exp(3)-1) end
            if curve=='Bounce' then
                if progress<1/2.75 then return 7.5625*progress*progress end
                if progress<2/2.75 then progress-=1.5/2.75;return 7.5625*progress*progress+.75 end
                if progress<2.5/2.75 then progress-=2.25/2.75;return 7.5625*progress*progress+.9375 end
                progress-=2.625/2.75;return 7.5625*progress*progress+.984375
            end
            if curve=='Elastic' then return 1+2^(-10*progress)*math.sin((10*progress-.75)*(2*math.pi/3)) end
            return progress*progress*(3-2*progress)
        end
        return {characterTransitionCurve='Smooth',characterReleaseCurve='Smooth',fovBoxSize=400,
            assistHumanized={Lock=true,M1=true,Block=true,Skill=true,Counter=true,Punish=true,Red=true},
            assistRampIntoLaser={Lock=false,M1=false,Block=false,Skill=false,Counter=false,Punish=false,Red=false},
            assistDisengageDelayMs={Lock=0,M1=0,Block=0,Skill=0,Counter=0,Punish=0,Red=0},
            assistFadeOutMs={Lock=80,M1=80,Block=80,Skill=80,Counter=80,Punish=80,Red=80},assistFadeOverride={},
            assistIntroMs={Lock=80,M1=80,Block=80,Skill=80,Counter=80,Punish=80,Red=80},assistIntroOverride={},
            __targetMethods=targetMethods,targetPriorities=if targetMethods then targetMethods.choices() else {'Recent attacker','Last target I hit','Last killer','Nearest to my character','Nearest to cursor'},
            targetPriority=if targetMethods then targetMethods.normalize('Recent attacker') else 'Recent attacker',characterAimPart='Torso',
            cameraOffset={X=0,Y=0,Z=0},characterOffset={X=0,Y=0,Z=0},
            curvePoints={Initial={.25,.1,.25,1},Release={.25,.1,.25,1}},
            __readers={activationHas=activationHas,customCurve=custom,evaluateCurve=evaluate,
                getAssistRampSeconds=function(values,role)local key=type(role)=='string'and role:gsub(' Aim$','');return ((key and values.assistIntroMs[key])or 80)*.001 end,
                isAssistRampIntoLaser=function(values,role)local key=type(role)=='string'and role:gsub(' Aim$','');return key~=nil and values.assistRampIntoLaser[key]==true end,
                getAssistIntroSeconds=function(values,role)local key=type(role)=='string' and role:gsub(' Aim$','');return ((key and values.assistIntroMs[key]) or 80)*.001 end,
                isAssistHumanized=function(values,role)
                    local key=type(role)=='string' and role:gsub(' Aim$','')
                    return key~=nil and values.assistHumanized[key]==true
                end,
                withActivation=function(values,value,method,enabled)
                    local mask,bit=masks[value],bits[method]
                    if mask==nil or bit==nil then return value end
                    if activationHas(values,value,method)~=(enabled==true) then mask+=if enabled==true then bit else -bit end
                    return choices[mask+1]
                end},
            __configure=function(values,method,args)
                if method=='setCurvePoint' then
                    local phase,index,value=args[1],args[2],args[3]
                    if values.curvePoints[phase] and type(index)=='number' and index>=1 and index<=4 and type(value)=='number' then
                        values.curvePoints[phase][index]=math.clamp(value :: number,0,1)
                    end
                elseif method=='setCharacterTransitionCurve' then values.characterTransitionCurve=args[1]
                elseif method=='setCharacterReleaseCurve' then values.characterReleaseCurve=args[1]
                elseif method=='setTargetPriority' then
                    if targetMethods then
                        local normalized,valid=targetMethods.normalize(args[1])
                        if valid~=false then values.targetPriority=normalized end
                    elseif table.find(values.targetPriorities,args[1]) then values.targetPriority=args[1] end
                end
            end}
    elseif name=='BlackflashChain' then
        return {__readers={
            exportProfiles=function(values)
                return {version=1,profiles=values.profiles or {Hop={},Side={}},method=values.method or 'Hop',
                    manualOverride=false,manualWindow=values.manualWindow or .19,requestDelay=values.requestDelay or .3}
            end,
            getWindow=function(values)return values.requestDelay or .3,false,'Waiting for native Black Flash controller'end,
        },__configure=function(values,method,args)
            if method=='setRequestDelay' and type(args[1])=='number' then values.requestDelay=math.clamp(args[1],.05,.4)
            elseif method=='setMethod' and table.find({'Hop','Side'},args[1]) then values.method=args[1]
            elseif method=='importProfiles' and type(args[1])=='table' and type(args[1].profiles)=='table' then
                for _,mode in {'Hop','Side'} do
                    for id,profile in args[1].profiles[mode] or {} do values.profiles[mode][id]=profile end
                end
            end
        end}
    end
    return {}
end

function NativeFeatureHost.new(host, environment, factories, options)
    options=options or {}
    assert(host and host.game and host.Instance and host.task,'Native host is incomplete')
    -- Some original adapters call Knit.GetService inside pcall. GetService can
    -- yield forever for an absent service; pcall does not bound that wait.
    -- Refuse only names absent from this exact Knit module's native registry.
