    local originalHost,knitViews=host,setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    host=setmetatable({require=function(module)
        local value=originalHost.require(module)
        local replicated=originalHost.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knitModule=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        if module~=knitModule or type(value)~='table' or type(value.GetService)~='function' then return value end
        if knitViews[module] then return knitViews[module] end
        local view=setmetatable({}, {__index=value})
        function view.GetService(name,...)
            if name==view then name=select(1,...) end
            local services=module:FindFirstChild('Services')
            if type(name)~='string' or not services or not services:FindFirstChild(name) then
                error('Native service is unavailable: '..tostring(name),0)
            end
            return value.GetService(name)
        end
        knitViews[module]=view
        return view
    end},{__index=originalHost})
    local shared=host._G or host
    local previousNative=shared.__ShenaniganismNativeFeatureHost
    assert(not previousNative or not previousNative.alive,'Unload the previous native feature host before starting another')
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    assert(player,'LocalPlayer is unavailable')
    local state={unloaded=false,connections={},instances={},threads={},newInstance=host.Instance.new,
        spawners={[host.task.spawn]=true,[host.task.defer]=true,[host.task.delay]=true}}
    local manager={alive=true,pending={},errors={},controllers={},state=state}
    local function report(name,message)
        manager.errors[name]=tostring(message)
        if options.onStatus then options.onStatus(name,tostring(message)) end
    end
    local windows=assert(factories.WindowControls,'WindowControls is not bundled').new(host)
    local bindings=assert(factories.GameBindings,'GameBindings is not bundled').new(host)
    for role,binding in options.knownBindings or {} do bindings.setKnown(role,binding) end
    manager.windowControls,manager.bindings=windows,bindings
    shared.__CullingWindowControls=windows
    local hotkeys={handlers={},controls={}}
    local callbackIds={}
    manager.legacyHotkeys,manager.callbackIds=hotkeys,callbackIds
    local menu=assert(factories.MenuEnhancements,'MenuEnhancements is not bundled').new(
        environment,host,bindings,state,hotkeys,callbackIds,windows)
    manager.menu=menu;menu.nativeFeatureHost=manager
    local failsafe=options.failsafe and options.failsafe.new(host,menu)
    manager.failsafe=failsafe
    if failsafe then failsafe.bindInputs(bindings) end
    local function componentArgs(name,...)
        local args=table.pack(...)
        -- This broker calls an owned native movement callback every Stepped.
        -- Pause its optional edits through controller/eligibility guards, never
        -- suppress the game's original movement update along with automation.
        if failsafe and name~='SprintControl' then for index=1,args.n do if args[index]==host then args[index]=failsafe.hostFor(host,name) end end end
        return args
    end
    local function timedNew(label,fn,...)
        local startedAt=os.clock()
        local value=fn(...)
        local marks=SharedHooks.loadProfile.marks
        marks[#marks+1]={'host.'..label,os.clock()-startedAt}
        return value
    end
    if options.friendExclusions then menu.friendExclusions=timedNew('friendExclusions',options.friendExclusions.new,host,menu) end
    if options.targetFilters then menu.targetFilters=timedNew('targetFilters',options.targetFilters.new,host,menu) end
    if options.stunControls then menu.stunControls=timedNew('stunControls',options.stunControls.new,host,menu) end
    if options.selfHUD then menu.selfHUD=timedNew('selfHUD',options.selfHUD.new,host,menu) end
    if options.targetJumpDash then menu.targetJumpDash=timedNew('targetJumpDash',options.targetJumpDash.new,host,menu) end
    if options.threatFeed then menu.threatFeed=timedNew('threatFeed',options.threatFeed.new,host,menu) end
    if options.enemyRings then menu.enemyRings=timedNew('enemyRings',options.enemyRings.new,host,menu) end
    if options.menuGrid then menu.menuGrid=timedNew('menuGrid',options.menuGrid.new,host,menu) end
    if options.menuEffects then menu.menuEffects=timedNew('menuEffects',options.menuEffects.new,host,menu) end
    if options.fovStyle then menu.fovStyle=timedNew('fovStyle',options.fovStyle.new,host,menu) end
    if options.dashFX then menu.dashFX=timedNew('dashFX',options.dashFX.new,host,menu) end
    if options.menuTheme then menu.menuTheme=timedNew('menuTheme',options.menuTheme.new,host,menu) end
    if options.combatPriority then menu.combatPriority=timedNew('combatPriority',options.combatPriority.new,host,menu) end
    if options.blockFX then menu.blockFX=timedNew('blockFX',options.blockFX.new,host,menu) end
    if options.hitStateFX then menu.hitStateFX=timedNew('hitStateFX',options.hitStateFX.new,host,menu) end
    if options.deckMenu then menu.deckMenu=timedNew('deckMenu',options.deckMenu.new,host,menu) end
    if options.multiToggles then menu.multiToggles=timedNew('multiToggles',options.multiToggles.new,host,menu) end
    if options.liveData then menu.liveData=timedNew('liveData',options.liveData.new,host,menu) end
    if options.menuSkin then menu.menuSkin=timedNew('menuSkin',options.menuSkin.new,host,menu) end
    if options.dataEditor then menu.dataEditor=timedNew('dataEditor',options.dataEditor.new,host,menu) end
    if options.cursorReticle then menu.cursorReticle=timedNew('cursorReticle',options.cursorReticle.new,host,menu) end
    menu.retiredMovementCleanup=timedNew('retiredMovementCleanup',RetiredMovementCleanup.new,host,menu)
    if options.targetMethods then menu.targetMethods=timedNew('targetMethods',options.targetMethods.new,host,menu) end
    if options.actionOverlap then menu.actionOverlap=timedNew('actionOverlap',options.actionOverlap.new,host,menu) end
    menu.rows=menu.rows or {};menu.tabs=menu.tabs or {}
    menu.buildId=options.buildId or '2026-10-18-native-v54'

    local function create(field,name,...)
        local module=factories[name]
        if not module or type(module.new)~='function' then report(name,'Component is not bundled');return nil end
        local args=componentArgs(name,...)
        local startedAt=os.clock()
        local ok,value=pcall(module.new,table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
        do local marks=SharedHooks.loadProfile.marks;marks[#marks+1]={'component.'..tostring(name),os.clock()-startedAt} end
        if not ok or type(value)~='table' then report(name,value);return nil end
        if failsafe then failsafe.guardController(value,name) end
        menu[field]=value;manager.controllers[field]=value
        return value
    end
    local controllerCache={}
    local function knitRuntime()
        local folder=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        if not module then return nil,nil,nil end
        local services=module:FindFirstChild('Services')
        if not services then return nil,module,nil end
        local ok,value=pcall(host.require,module)
        return if ok and type(value)=='table' then value else nil,module,services
    end
    local function nativeController(name,category)
        if controllerCache[name] then return controllerCache[name] end
        local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
        local root=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
        local folder=root and root:FindFirstChild(category or 'Character')
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
        if module then
            local ok,value=pcall(host.require,module)
            if ok and type(value)=='table' then controllerCache[name]=value;return value end
        end
        local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
        local knitFolder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local knitModule=knitFolder and knitFolder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        if not knitModule then return nil end
        local ok,knit=pcall(host.require,knitModule)
        if not ok or type(knit)~='table' or type(knit.GetController)~='function' then return nil end
        local resolved,value=pcall(knit.GetController,name)
        if resolved and type(value)=='table' then controllerCache[name]=value;return value end
        return nil
    end
    local function nativeGate(name)
        if options.nativeAvailable then return options.nativeAvailable(name,menu) end
        local function hasMethods(object,names)
            if type(object)~='table' then return false end
            for _,method in names do if type(object[method])~='function' then return false end end
            return true
        end
        local function serviceReady(serviceName,signals)
            local knit,_,services=knitRuntime()
            if not knit or not services or not services:FindFirstChild(serviceName) then return false end
            local ok,service=pcall(knit.GetService,serviceName)
            if not ok or not service then return false end
            for signalName,method in signals or {} do
                if not service[signalName] or type(service[signalName][method])~='function' then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        if name=='M1Assist' or name=='M1AimAssist' then
            local tool=nativeController('ToolController')
            if name=='M1AimAssist' and menu.m1Assist and menu.m1Assist.pendingNative then return false,'Waiting for native M1 input bridge' end
            return tool and type(tool.Melee)=='function' and type(tool.UseSetService)=='function', 'Waiting for native ToolController'
        elseif name=='HitboxControl' then
            local control=nativeController('HitboxController','Combat')
            return control and type(control.SphereHitbox)=='function','Waiting for native HitboxController'
        elseif name=='DashControl' then
            local control=nativeController('MovementController')
            local read=host.getupvalues or host.debug and host.debug.getupvalues
            local write=host.setupvalue or host.debug and host.debug.setupvalue
            return control and type(control.Dash)=='function' and type(control.DashRequest)=='function'
                and type(read)=='function' and type(write)=='function','Waiting for native MovementController and timer inspection'
        elseif name=='RespawnControl' then
            return serviceReady('JoinService',{Reset='Fire'}),'Waiting for native JoinService reset signal'
        elseif name=='FrontDash' then
            local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
            local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
            local combat=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('Combat')
            local module=combat and combat:FindFirstChild('HandicapController')
            local bridge=menu.m1Assist
            return module~=nil and bridge and bridge.pendingNative~=true and bridge.nativeChaseBridge==true
                and type(bridge.hasRequestHook)=='function' and bridge.hasRequestHook(), 'Waiting for native Chase bridge and HandicapController'
        elseif name=='ParkourAssist' then
            local scripts=player:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
            local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
            local character=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('Character')
            local module=character and character:FindFirstChild('MovementController')
            local read=host.getupvalues or host.debug and host.debug.getupvalues
            return module~=nil and host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Map')~=nil and type(read)=='function', 'Waiting for native Parkour controller and map'
        elseif name=='ProjectilePrediction' then
            return menu.autoBlock and menu.autoBlock.pendingNative~=true and menu.autoBlock.nativeReady==true,'Waiting for native Auto Block'
        elseif name=='AutoBlock' or name=='AutoPunish' then
            local tool=nativeController('ToolController')
            return host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')~=nil and hasMethods(tool,{'Block'})
                and serviceReady('BlockService',{Effects='Connect',Deactivated='Fire'}),'Waiting for native Block service and characters'
        elseif name=='NativeVariants' then
            return hasMethods(nativeController('ToolController'),{'UseTool','ReturnKey'}), 'Waiting for native skill controller'
        elseif name=='NativeCombos' then
            local tool=nativeController('ToolController')
            if not hasMethods(tool,{'UseTool','ReturnKey'}) then return false,'Waiting for native skill controller' end
            for _,service in {'DivergentFistService','FocusStrikeService','BruteForceService','CleaveRushService',
                'GarudaReboundService','BodyRepelService','ResoluteSwingService','ResoluteSlashService'} do
                if serviceReady(service,{Activated='Fire',Effects='Connect'}) then return true end
            end
            return false,'Waiting for native skill continuation signals'
        elseif name=='NativeRed' then
            return hasMethods(nativeController('ToolController'),{'ReturnKey','GetTarget','Special','ReleaseSpecial'})
                and serviceReady('ReversalRedService',{Activated='Fire',Effects='Connect'})
                and serviceReady('GojoService'), 'Waiting for native Red and Gojo services'
        elseif name=='NativeCounter' then
            return host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')~=nil
                and hasMethods(nativeController('ToolController'),{'UseTool','ReturnKey'})
                and serviceReady('ItadoriService',{Effects='Connect'}), 'Waiting for native counter tool and attack signals'
        elseif name=='NativeWorldCutting' then
            return hasMethods(nativeController('ToolController'),{'UseTool','ReturnKey','Special','ReleaseSpecial'})
                and serviceReady('DismantleService',{Activated='Fire'}), 'Waiting for native Dismantle service'
        elseif name=='BlackflashChain' then
            local animations=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Animations')
            local itadori=animations and animations:FindFirstChild('Itadori')
            local variants=itadori and itadori:FindFirstChild('Variants')
            return variants~=nil and hasMethods(nativeController('ToolController'),{'UseKey','ReturnKey'})
                and serviceReady('DivergentFistService',{Effects='Connect'}), 'Waiting for native Black Flash animations and continuation service'
        elseif name=='AutoLock' then
            return host.workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')~=nil
                and hasMethods(nativeController('ToolController'),{'UseTool','GetTarget','GetMouseTarget'}), 'Waiting for native character lock and skill target controller'
        end
        return true
    end
    local function accept(name,target)
        if name=='M1Assist' then return target.nativeChaseBridge==true and target.hasRequestHook and target.hasRequestHook() end
        if name=='HitboxControl' then return type(target.original)=='function' end
        if name=='RespawnControl' then return type(target.forceReset)=='function' end
        if name=='DashControl' then return target.hooked and target.hooked() end
        if name=='AutoBlock' then return target.nativeReady==true and target.ready==true end
        if name=='AutoLock' then return target.skillAimReady==true end
        return target.ready==true
    end
    local function deferred(field,name,defaults,...)
        local args=componentArgs(name,...)
        defaults=table.clone(defaults or {})
        for key,value in NativeFeatureHost.pendingDefaults(name,menu.targetMethods) do if defaults[key]==nil then defaults[key]=value end end
        if name=='NativeCounter' then defaults.profiles=factories.NativeCounter and factories.NativeCounter.profiles or {} end
        if name=='M1AimAssist' then
            defaults.aimPrediction=defaults.aimPrediction or {}
            defaults.aimAreas,defaults.areaTargets={},{}
            defaults.characterTransitionMs=80
            defaults.blockReleaseCameraGuardMs=120
            defaults.aimHoldSeconds=0
            defaults.aimMoveLead=0
            defaults.assistHandoffMs=160
            defaults.dashFreeEnabled,defaults.dashCameraDelay=true,.3
            for _,role in {'M1','Skill','Block','Counter','Punish'} do
                defaults.aimAreas[role]={mode='360°',x=16,y=90,z=8,ox=0,oy=0,oz=0,visible=false}
                defaults.aimPrediction[role]=defaults.aimPrediction[role] or {enabled=true,dashEndpoint=true,leadMs=if role=='Block' then 120 else 80,maxLead=if role=='Block' then 8 else 2,strength=1,x=0,y=0,z=0}
            end
        end
        local module=factories[name]
        if not module or type(module.new)~='function' then report(name,'Component is not bundled');return end
        local record=NativeFeatureHost.deferred(name,function()
            return module.new(table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
        end,function() return nativeGate(name) end,deferredMethods[name],defaults,function(target)
            if failsafe then failsafe.guardController(target,name) end
            menu[field]=target;manager.controllers[field]=target
            if field=='autoPunish' then bindings.blockSuppressed=target.pauseAutomaticBlock end
            if field=='blackflashChain' and options.blackflashProfiles then target.importProfiles(options.blackflashProfiles) end
            if options.onControllerReady then options.onControllerReady(field,target,menu) end
        end,function(target)return accept(name,target)end,{clock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock,retrySeconds=5})
        menu[field]=record.proxy;manager.controllers[field]=record.proxy
        manager.pending[#manager.pending+1]=record
        record.step()
    end

    create('ui','ModernUI',host,menu)
    assert(menu.ui,'Native menu styling could not initialize')
    create('floatingValues','FloatingValues',host,menu)
    create('visuals','Visuals',host,menu)
    create('tracers','Tracers',host,menu)
    deferred('m1Assist','M1Assist',{enabled=false,focused=true,connections={}},host,menu)
    create('sideDisplays','SideDisplays',host,menu)
    deferred('autoPunish','AutoPunish',{enabled=false,range=6,onlyWhileBlocking=false,targetMode='All threats',
        requestedM1s=1,blockPauseUntil=0,metadata={},projectiles={},recentThreats={}},host,menu,bindings)
    if menu.autoPunish then bindings.blockSuppressed=menu.autoPunish.pauseAutomaticBlock end
    create('m1Hitbox','M1Hitbox',host,menu)
    deferred('autoBlock','AutoBlock',{enabled=false,range=13,held=nil,records={},projectileParts={},punchBackHits=1,punchBackAfterAttack=false,enemyAttackAngle=220,enemyShoulderMargin=1.5,
        projectileIndex={},projectileNames={},projectileModelNames={},nativeSignals={},
        referenceSettings={punchBack=false,afkCheck=false,typingCheck=true,lookAt=true,sticky=false,
            facingCheck=true,sensitivity=0,blockDelay=.2,unblockDelay=.2,chance=100,rangeType='Static',minimumRange=6,
            visualizer=false,blockM1s=true,blockMoves=true,blockProjectiles=true,blockBombs=true,blockBullets=true,
            blockMoveVariants=true,blockExplosions=true,blockSwarms=true,visualizerColor=host.Color3 and host.Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255)},instantBlockEnabled=true},host,menu,bindings)
    deferred('hitboxControl','HitboxControl',{method='Native',ownCollisionEnabled=false,ownCollisionScale=.5,ownCollisionAvailable=true},host,menu.getHitboxDimensions)
    create('autoCounterFilter','AutoCounterFilter',host,menu)
    create('sprintControl','SprintControl',host,menu)
    create('antiStunSpeed','AntiStunSpeed',host,menu)
    create('distanceUnits','DistanceUnits',host,menu)
    deferred('m1AimAssist','M1AimAssist',{enabled=false,skillAimEnabled=false,blockAimEnabled=false,focused=true,range=6,maximumRange=80,
        skillAimRange=30,blockAimRange=8,punishAimRange=8,counterAimRange=100/.28,connections={},aimPriorities={},aimPrediction={}},host,menu)
    create('m1Approach','M1Approach',host,menu)
    create('directionalLock','DirectionalLock',host,menu)
    deferred('frontDash','FrontDash',{enabled=false,multiplier=1,focused=true,assistGuidedEnabled=true,assistDashRadius=3.5},host,menu)
    local comboFeatures={}
    for _,name in {'Divergent Fist','Focus Strike','Brute Force','Cleave Rush','Garuda Rebound','Body Repel','Resolute Slash'} do
        comboFeatures[name]={enabled=false,ready=false,delay=if name=='Divergent Fist' or name=='Focus Strike' or name=='Resolute Slash' then .33 else .3,
            services={},hooks={},requests=0,confirmed=0,lastReason='Waiting for native skill service'}
    end
    deferred('nativeCombos','NativeCombos',{features=comboFeatures,resoluteTeleportEnabled=false,resoluteFinisherDelay=.75,
        garudaPrediction=true,garudaLead=.03,returnRadius=2,legacyQTE={enabled=false,effective=false}},host,menu,bindings)
    local variantFeatures={}
    for _,name in {'Ambush','ShutUp','Nue','Toad','Reserve'} do variantFeatures[name]={enabled=false,requests=0} end
    deferred('nativeVariants','NativeVariants',{features=variantFeatures,reservePrediction=false},host,menu,bindings)
    create('lockMarker','LockMarker',host)
    deferred('parkourAssist','ParkourAssist',{infiniteEnabled=false,autoWallrunEnabled=false,infiniteReady=false},host,menu)
    create('prediction','Prediction',host,menu)
    create('legacyDisplayBudget','LegacyDisplayBudget',host,menu)
    create('infoVisibility','InfoVisibility',host,menu)
    create('autoRecovery','AutoRecovery',host,menu)
    create('moveNames','MoveNames',host,menu)
    -- Never hand ProjectilePrediction a pending proxy: it replaces Block methods
    -- and retains the initial object. Wait for the real Block owner instead.
    deferred('projectilePrediction','ProjectilePrediction',{projectileEnabled=false,allMovesEnabled=false,
        records={},actors={},count=0,predictionHorizon=.35},host,menu)
    create('dashStatus','DashStatus',host,menu)
    deferred('nativeRed','NativeRed',{enabled=false,faceTargetEnabled=true,requests=0,releases=0,confirmed=0,faceTurns=0},host,menu,bindings)
    deferred('nativeCounter','NativeCounter',{enabled=false,range=21,projectileDelay=.05,impactLead=.075,m1Reach=8,
        latches={},cooldowns={},projectileWaits={},nativeServiceConnections={}},host,menu,bindings)
    deferred('nativeWorldCutting','NativeWorldCutting',{enabled=false,requests=0,releases=0},host,menu,bindings)
    create('trainControl','TrainControl',host,menu)
    create('looksScripts','LooksScripts',host,menu)
    deferred('blackflashChain','BlackflashChain',{enabled=false,autoEnabled=false,method='Hop',window=.19,
        range=6,requestDelay=.3,profiles={Hop={},Side={}},connections={},characterConnections={}},host,menu,bindings)
    if menu.blackflashChain and menu.blackflashChain.pendingNative and options.blackflashProfiles then
        menu.blackflashChain.importProfiles(options.blackflashProfiles)
    end
    create('ragdollControl','RagdollControl',host,menu,bindings)
    create('stunRecovery','StunRecovery',host,menu)
    create('knockbackControl','KnockbackControl',host)
    deferred('autoLock','AutoLock',{enabled=false,activationEnabled=true,trigger='None',mechanism='Jujutsuer',
        stickyTarget=true,lockRange=0,connections={},characterConnections={},metadata={},projectiles={},recentThreats={},
        fovDegrees=90,fovShape='Circle',fovWidth=1920,fovHeight=1080,fovOffsetX=0,fovOffsetY=0,
        characterSpeed=20,cameraSpeed=1/.18,smoothSeconds=.18,recentHitWindow=2},host,menu)
    deferred('respawnControl','RespawnControl',{enabled=false,status='Waiting for native JoinService',sentCount=0,respawnCount=0},host)
    create('moderatorHop','ModeratorHop',host,function()
        local entry=menu.entries['Game/Server Hopper']
        if entry and entry.callback then return entry.callback() end
        return nil
    end)
    deferred('dashControl','DashControl',{enabled=false,seconds=10,milliseconds=10000,steps=100,requests=0,rejections=0,frontDeniedCount=0,
        blockDashEnabled=true,blockingEnabled=true,blockDashReady=false,blockDashRequests=0,blockDashReleases=0,m1DashEnabled=true,m1DashReady=false,
        frontIntervalEnabled=false,frontIntervalSeconds=0,intervalAdjustmentSeconds=0,frontIntervalAdjustmentSeconds=0,effectiveIntervalSeconds=10,effectiveFrontIntervalSeconds=0,
        targetNotRequired=false,targetNotRequiredReady=false,targetlessRequests=0,targetlessLocalMoves=0,lastTargetlessReason='Native pursuit route has not attached'},host)
    if factories.JujutsuerAutos then create('jujutsuerAutos','JujutsuerAutos',host,menu) end
    if factories.JujutsuerOPIntegration and factories.JujutsuerOP then
        create('jujutsuerPort','JujutsuerOPIntegration',host,menu,factories.JujutsuerOP)
    end

    function manager.step()
        if not manager.alive or not menu.alive then return end
        for _,record in manager.pending do record.step() end
    end
    local lastRetry=0
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    manager.retryConnection=run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
        lastRetry+=delta
        if lastRetry>=.5 then lastRetry=0;manager.step() end
    end)
    state.connections[manager.retryConnection]=true
    local previousDestroy=menu.Destroy
    function manager.Destroy()
        if not manager.alive then return end
        manager.alive=false
        if manager.retryConnection then
            manager.retryConnection:Disconnect();state.connections[manager.retryConnection]=nil
        end
        local function destroy(name,object)
            if object and type(object.Destroy)=='function' then
                local ok,message=pcall(object.Destroy)
                if not ok then report(name..'.Destroy',message) end
            end
        end
        destroy('JujutsuerAutos',menu.jujutsuerAutos)
        destroy('JujutsuerOP',menu.jujutsuerPort)
        destroy('ActionOverlap',menu.actionOverlap)
        destroy('CombatPriority',menu.combatPriority)
        destroy('MenuTheme',menu.menuTheme)
        destroy('BlockFX',menu.blockFX)
        destroy('HitStateFX',menu.hitStateFX)
        destroy('DeckMenu',menu.deckMenu)
        destroy('MultiToggles',menu.multiToggles)
        destroy('LiveData',menu.liveData)
        destroy('MenuSkin',menu.menuSkin)
        destroy('DataEditor',menu.dataEditor)
        destroy('DashFX',menu.dashFX)
        destroy('CursorReticle',menu.cursorReticle)
        destroy('RetiredMovementCleanup',menu.retiredMovementCleanup)
        destroy('FovStyle',menu.fovStyle)
        destroy('MenuEffects',menu.menuEffects)
        destroy('MenuGrid',menu.menuGrid)
        destroy('EnemyRings',menu.enemyRings)
        destroy('ThreatFeed',menu.threatFeed)
        destroy('TargetJumpDash',menu.targetJumpDash)
        destroy('SelfHUD',menu.selfHUD)
        destroy('StunControls',menu.stunControls)
        destroy('TargetFilters',menu.targetFilters)
        destroy('FriendExclusions',menu.friendExclusions)
        if failsafe then destroy('Failsafe',failsafe) end
        for _,record in manager.pending do destroy(record.name,record) end
        local ok,result=pcall(previousDestroy)
        if not ok then
            report('Menu.Destroy',result)
            -- A component teardown failure must not leave other native owners
            -- alive after reinjection. Every component's Destroy is idempotent.
            for name,object in manager.controllers do destroy(name,object) end
            for connection in state.connections do pcall(function()connection:Disconnect()end) end
            for object in state.instances do pcall(function()object:Destroy()end) end
            for thread in state.threads do if thread~=coroutine.running() then pcall(host.task.cancel,thread) end end
            pcall(bindings.Destroy);pcall(windows.Destroy);menu.alive=false
        end
        state.unloaded=true
        if shared.__ShenaniganismNativeFeatureHost==manager then shared.__ShenaniganismNativeFeatureHost=nil end
        if shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements==menu then shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements=nil end
        if shared.__CullingWindowControls==windows then shared.__CullingWindowControls=nil end
        return ok,result
    end
    menu.Destroy=manager.Destroy
    shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements=menu
    shared.__ShenaniganismNativeFeatureHost=manager
    return manager
end

return NativeFeatureHost
end)()

local Failsafe = (function(): any
-- One pause boundary for script-owned automation; menu/configuration remain usable.
local Failsafe={}
local readable={ModernUI=true,FloatingValues=true,Visuals=true,Tracers=true,SideDisplays=true,AutoCounterFilter=true,M1Hitbox=true,
    DistanceUnits=true,LockMarker=true,Prediction=true,InfoVisibility=true,LegacyDisplayBudget=true,MoveNames=true,
    DashStatus=true,NativeAppearanceFeatures=true,HalloweenDoors=true,FrontDashReadiness=true}
function Failsafe.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local game=host.game
    local input=game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=game:GetService('RunService')
    local gui=game:GetService('GuiService')
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,enabled=true,paused=false,pauseReasons={},connections={},controllers={},hosts={},threads={},errors={},coverage={},physicalAtStart={},
        conditions={menu=true,typing=true,robloxMenu=true,emoteMenu=true,windowFocus=true,cursorOutside=true,afk=true},
        idleTimeoutSeconds=60,physicalHeld={},syntheticUntil={},syntheticDepth=0}
    local clock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    control.lastPhysicalActivity=clock()
    local registry=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local sentinel={Name='ShenaniganismFailsafePause'}
    local focused=true
    local initialFocus=host.isrbxactive or host.iswindowactive
    if type(initialFocus)=='function' then local ok,value=pcall(initialFocus);if ok and type(value)=='boolean' then focused=value end end
    local cleanupDepth=0
    local cleanupScopes=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local manualScopes=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then local c=signal:Connect(callback);control.connections[#control.connections+1]=c;return c end
        return nil
    end
    local function call(owner,name,...)
        if owner and type(owner[name])=='function' then local ok,message=pcall(owner[name],...);if not ok then control.errors[name]=tostring(message) end end
    end
    local function bindingsNow()
        return menu.bindings or menu.nativeFeatureHost and menu.nativeFeatureHost.bindings
    end
    local function inputId(object)
        if not object then return nil end
        local kind=object.UserInputType
        local name=kind and kind.Name
        if name=='Keyboard' then
            local key=object.KeyCode
            local keyName=key and key.Name
            if keyName and keyName~='Unknown' then return 'Keyboard:'..keyName,key,false end
        elseif name and name:match('^MouseButton') then return 'Mouse:'..name,kind,true end
        return nil
    end
    local function syntheticInput(id)
        if control.syntheticDepth>0 then return true end
        if not id then return false end
        local bindings=bindingsNow()
        if bindings and bindings.simulatedHeld and bindings.simulatedHeld[id] and not control.physicalAtStart[id] then return true end
        return not control.physicalHeld[id] and (control.syntheticUntil[id] or -math.huge)>clock()
    end
    local function activity()
        control.lastPhysicalActivity=clock()
    end
    local function seedPhysicalHolds()
        for _,method in {'GetKeysPressed','GetMouseButtonsPressed'} do
            if type(input[method])=='function' then
                local ok,pressed=pcall(input[method],input)
                if ok and type(pressed)=='table' then for _,object in pressed do
                    local id,key,mouse=inputId(object)
                    if id and not syntheticInput(id) then control.physicalHeld[id]={key=key,mouse=mouse} end
                end end
            end
        end
    end
    local function heldActivity()
        for id,record in control.physicalHeld do
            local ok,down=pcall(function()
                return if record.mouse then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(record.key) else input:IsKeyDown(record.key)
            end)
            if ok and down==true and not syntheticInput(id) then activity()
            else control.physicalHeld[id]=nil end
        end
    end
    local function ourMenuOpen()
        local panel=menu.panel
        local main=panel and panel.Main
        if main and main.Parent and main.Visible==true then return true end
        for _,popup in {menu.popup,menu.valuePopup,menu.ui and menu.ui.colorPopup} do
            if popup and popup.Parent and popup.Visible~=false then return true end
        end
        return menu.recording~=nil and menu.recording~=false or menu.menuKeyCapturing==true
    end
    function control.requested(owner,key)
        local record=registry[owner]
        if record and record.values[key]~=nil then return record.values[key] end
        return owner and owner[key]
    end
    local function preserveRequested(callback)
        local saved={}
        for owner,record in registry do saved[owner]={values=table.clone(record.values),revisions=table.clone(record.revisions)} end
        local thread=coroutine.running()
        local previousScope=cleanupScopes[thread]
        cleanupScopes[thread]=true
        cleanupDepth+=1
        local ok,message=pcall(callback)
        cleanupDepth-=1
        cleanupScopes[thread]=previousScope
        for owner,snapshot in saved do
            local record=registry[owner]
            if record then
                -- Native releases can yield. Restore cleanup-owned changes,
                -- without replaying old preferences over newer input/UI writes.
                for key,value in snapshot.values do
                    if record.revisions[key]==snapshot.revisions[key] then record.values[key]=value end
                end
                for key in record.values do
                    if snapshot.values[key]==nil and record.revisions[key]==snapshot.revisions[key] then record.values[key]=nil end
                end
            end
        end
        if not ok then control.errors.cleanup=tostring(message) end
    end
    local function pauseOwned()
        preserveRequested(function()
            for thread in control.threads do
                if thread~=coroutine.running() and host.task and host.task.cancel then pcall(host.task.cancel,thread) end
                control.threads[thread]=nil
            end
            call(menu.autoPunish,'cancelForManualBlock')
            call(menu.m1Approach,'cancelForManualBlock')
            call(menu.directionalLock,'setShiftCursorEnabled',false)
            call(menu.directionalLock,'clearShiftOffset')
            call(menu.antiStunSpeed,'releaseSpeed')
            for _,name in {'stunRecovery','ragdollControl'} do
                local owner=menu[name]
                if owner and owner.records then for character in table.clone(owner.records) do call(owner,'release',character) end end
            end
            local knockback=menu.knockbackControl
            if knockback and knockback.records then for mover in table.clone(knockback.records) do call(knockback,'release',mover,true) end end
            call(menu.autoBlock,'release')
            call(menu.m1Assist,'pauseForFailsafe')
            call(menu.m1AimAssist,'restoreShiftLockCameraOffset')
            call(menu.m1AimAssist,'resetDirectionalAim',nil,true)
            call(menu.m1AimAssist,'releaseShiftLockAim',false)
            call(menu.autoLock,'cancelAssistReturn')
            call(menu.autoLock,'finishCharacterRelease')
            call(menu.autoLock,'endSession',false)
            if menu.autoLock then menu.autoLock.skillFacing=nil;menu.autoLock.pendingSkillCast=nil;menu.autoLock.teleportTargetLease=nil;menu.autoLock.actionRelock=nil end
            call(menu,'releaseCameraOnlyRotation')
            for _,name in {'nativeRed','nativeWorldCutting'} do call(menu[name],'setEnabled',false) end
            for name,owner in control.controllers do
                if owner.onFailsafePause then call(owner,'onFailsafePause') end
                if type(owner.features)=='table' and type(owner.setEnabled)=='function' then
                    for feature in owner.features do call(owner,'setEnabled',feature,false) end
                end
                if name=='NativeAutomaticFeatures' and type(owner.enabled)=='table' then
                    for key in owner.generation do owner.generation[key]=(owner.generation[key] or 0)+1 end
                    table.clear(owner.busy)
                end
            end
            local bindings=menu.bindings or menu.nativeFeatureHost and menu.nativeFeatureHost.bindings
            if bindings then
                for slot in table.clone(bindings.nativeSkillHeld or {}) do call(bindings,'sendNativeSkill',slot,false) end
                if bindings.nativeSpecialHeld then call(bindings,'sendNativeSpecial',false) end
                for _,binding in table.clone(bindings.simulatedHeld or {}) do
                    local id=binding.kind..':'..binding.name
                    -- UIS down can be our own simulated down. Only a hold
                    -- observed before this lease is evidence of manual priority.
                    if not control.physicalAtStart[id] then call(bindings,'send',binding,false,false) end
                end
                table.clear(bindings.held or {})
            end
        end)
    end
    local function collectReasons()
        local reasons={}
        local idleSeconds=math.max(0,clock()-control.lastPhysicalActivity)
        if control.enabled then
            local conditions=control.conditions
            if conditions.menu and ourMenuOpen() then reasons[#reasons+1]='Our menu is open' end
            if conditions.windowFocus and not focused then reasons[#reasons+1]='Roblox is not focused' end
            if conditions.typing and input:GetFocusedTextBox() then reasons[#reasons+1]='Typing in a text box' end
            local ok,open=pcall(function()return gui.MenuIsOpen end)
            if conditions.robloxMenu and ok and open==true then reasons[#reasons+1]='Roblox menu is open' end
            if conditions.emoteMenu and menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen() then reasons[#reasons+1]='Emote menu is open' end
            if conditions.cursorOutside then
                local camera=host.workspace.CurrentCamera
                local position=input:GetMouseLocation()
                local inset=host.Vector2.new(0,0)
                local read,value=pcall(gui.GetGuiInset,gui)
                if read and value then inset=value end
                local size=camera and camera.ViewportSize
                if size and size.X>0 and size.Y>0 and position then
                    local x,y=position.X-inset.X,position.Y-inset.Y
                    if x<0 or y<0 or x>=size.X or y>=size.Y then reasons[#reasons+1]='Cursor is outside the game viewport' end
                else reasons[#reasons+1]='Game viewport is unavailable' end
            end
            if conditions.afk and idleSeconds>=control.idleTimeoutSeconds then reasons[#reasons+1]='AFK / no physical activity' end
        end
        return reasons,idleSeconds
    end
    local function manualActionAllowed()
        local reasons=collectReasons()
        for _,reason in reasons do if reason~='Our menu is open' then return false,reason end end
        return true
    end
    local function actionPaused()
        if not control.alive then return control.paused end
        if manualScopes[coroutine.running()] then return not manualActionAllowed() end
        return control.paused
    end
    function control.runManualMenuAction(callback,...)
        if not control.alive or type(callback)~='function' then return false,'Manual menu action is unavailable' end
        local allowed,reason=manualActionAllowed()
        if not allowed then control.lastManualActionReason=reason;return false,'Failsafe: '..reason end
        local thread=coroutine.running()
        local previous=manualScopes[thread]
        manualScopes[thread]=true
        local result=table.pack(pcall(callback,...))
        manualScopes[thread]=previous
        if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
        control.lastManualActionReason=nil
        return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
    end
    local function foreignCallback(callback,...)
        local thread=coroutine.running()
        local previous=manualScopes[thread]
        if not previous then return callback(...) end
        manualScopes[thread]=nil
        local result=table.pack(pcall(callback,...))
        manualScopes[thread]=previous
        if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
        return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
    end
    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive then return control.paused end
        if focused then heldActivity() end
        local reasons,idleSeconds=collectReasons()
        control.idleSeconds=idleSeconds
        control.pauseReasons=reasons
        local paused=#reasons>0
        if paused~=control.paused then
            control.paused=paused
            control.transitions=(control.transitions or 0)+1
            if paused then pauseOwned()
            else
                for _,owner in control.controllers do call(owner,'onFailsafeResume') end
                if menu.directionalLock then call(menu.directionalLock,'updateShiftCursorVisual') end
            end
        end
        return paused
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        control.enabled=value==true
        control.refresh()
        return true
    end
    function control.setCondition(key,value)
        if not control.alive or control.conditions[key]==nil or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
        control.conditions[key]=value;control.refresh();return true
    end
    function control.setIdleTimeoutSeconds(value)
        if not control.alive or type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control.idleTimeoutSeconds=math.clamp(value,1,3600);control.refresh();return true
    end
    function control.guardController(owner,name)
        if type(owner)~='table' or registry[owner] then return owner end
        if readable[name] then control.coverage[name]='Read-only display/UI remains available';return owner end
        local old=getmetatable(owner)
        if old and type(old)~='table' then control.coverage[name]='Frame/input gates only; locked controller metatable';return owner end
        local record={values={},revisions={},name=name,previousMeta=old}
        local function guarded(key,value)
            if type(key)~='string' or type(value)~='boolean' then return false end
            if name=='HitboxControl' and key=='previewEnabled' then return false end
            local lower=key:lower()
            return lower=='enabled' or lower:match('enabled$')~=nil or key=='focused' or key=='windowFocused'
                or (name=='NativeBaseFeatures' and table.find({'noclip','infJump','infRange','spinner','flyActive'},key)~=nil)
                or name=='EnabledFlags'
        end
        for key,value in owner do if guarded(key,value) then record.values[key]=value;rawset(owner,key,nil) end end
        registry[owner]=record
        local meta=table.clone(old or {})
        local originalIndex,originalNewIndex=meta.__index,meta.__newindex
        meta.__index=function(object,key)
            local value=record.values[key]
            if value~=nil then return if control.paused then false else value end
            if type(originalIndex)=='function' then return originalIndex(object,key) end
            return type(originalIndex)=='table' and originalIndex[key] or nil
        end
        meta.__newindex=function(object,key,value)
            if record.values[key]~=nil or guarded(key,value) then
                if not cleanupScopes[coroutine.running()] then record.revisions[key]=(record.revisions[key] or 0)+1 end
                record.values[key]=value;return
            end
            if type(originalNewIndex)=='function' then return originalNewIndex(object,key,value) end
            if type(originalNewIndex)=='table' then originalNewIndex[key]=value else rawset(object,key,value) end
            return nil
        end
        meta.__iter=function(object)
            local all=table.clone(object)
            -- A snapshot must not inherit the write-through state proxy.
            setmetatable(all,nil)
            for key,value in record.values do all[key]=if control.paused then false else value end
            return next,all
        end
        setmetatable(owner,meta)
        control.controllers[name]=owner
        control.coverage[name]='Frame/input gates and requested enable/focus flags'
        if type(owner.enabled)=='table' then control.guardController(owner.enabled,'EnabledFlags') end
        if type(owner.features)=='table' then for key,value in owner.features do control.guardController(value,name..'/'..tostring(key)) end end
        if type(owner.legacyQTE)=='table' then control.guardController(owner.legacyQTE,name..'/LegacyQTE') end
        if control.paused then preserveRequested(function()call(owner,'onFailsafePause')end) end
        return owner
    end
    function control.hostFor(original,name)
        if readable[name] then return original end
        if control.hosts[name] then return control.hosts[name] end
        local signals,rawSignals=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
        local function allowed()return not actionPaused() or cleanupDepth>0 end
        local function automaticAllowed()return not control.paused or cleanupDepth>0 end
        local function signalView(signal)
            if not signal or type(signal.Connect)~='function' then return signal end
            if signals[signal] then return signals[signal] end
            local view=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(_,key)
                if key=='Connect' or key=='Once' then return function(_,callback)
                    local wrapped=function(...)if automaticAllowed() then return foreignCallback(callback,...)end;return nil end
                    return signal[key](signal,wrapped)
                end end
                local value=signal[key]
                return if type(value)=='function' then function(_,...)return value(signal,...)end else value
            end})
            signals[signal]=view;rawSignals[view]=signal;return view
        end
        local runView=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(_,key)
            if key=='BindToRenderStep' then return function(_,id,priority,callback)
                return run:BindToRenderStep(id,priority,function(...)if automaticAllowed() then return foreignCallback(callback,...)end;return nil end)
            end end
            local value=run[key]
            if type(value)=='function' then return function(_,...)return value(run,...)end end
            return signalView(value)
        end})
        local inputView=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(_,key)
            if key=='GetFocusedTextBox' then return function()return input:GetFocusedTextBox() or (not allowed() and sentinel or nil)end end
            local value=input[key]
            -- Input end/focus signals stay live so owned input/lifecycle can clean up.
            if key=='InputBegan' or key=='JumpRequest' then return signalView(value) end
            return if type(value)=='function' then function(_,...)return value(input,...)end else value
        end})
        local gameView=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(_,key)
            if key=='GetService' then return function(_,service)
                if service=='RunService' then return runView end
                if service=='UserInputService' then return inputView end
                return original.game:GetService(service)
            end end
            local value=original.game[key]
            return if type(value)=='function' then function(_,...)return value(original.game,...)end else value
        end})
        local taskView=setmetatable({}, {__index=original.task})
        for _,method in {'spawn','defer','delay'} do
            taskView[method]=function(...)
                local args=table.pack(...)
                local index=if method=='delay' then 2 else 1
                local callback=args[index]
                if type(callback)~='function' then return original.task[method](...) end
                local thread
                args[index]=function(...)
                    -- This backend's sole deferred task refreshes roster UI.
                    if not automaticAllowed() and not (name=='NativeBaseFeatures' and method=='defer') then
                        if thread then control.threads[thread]=nil end
                        return
                    end
                    local result=table.pack(pcall(foreignCallback,callback,...))
                    if thread then control.threads[thread]=nil end
                    if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
                    return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
                end
                thread=original.task[method](table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
                if thread and coroutine.status(thread)~='dead' then control.threads[thread]=true end
                return thread
            end
        end
        -- Pure presentation callbacks may stay live while their controller's
        -- gameplay callbacks/enable flags remain paused. Never use this service
        -- for input, hit queries, character facing or physics changes.
        local view=setmetatable({game=gameView,task=taskView,presentationRunService=run,
            isGameplayPaused=actionPaused},{__index=original})
        -- Native movement discovery requires an actual RBXScriptSignal rather
        -- than this host's guarded subscription view.
        if type(original.getconnections)=='function' then
            view.getconnections=function(signal,...)return original.getconnections(rawSignals[signal] or signal,...)end
        end
        control.hosts[name]=view
        return view
    end
    function control.bindInputs(bindings)
        if not bindings then return end
        for _,name in {'send','sendLogical','sendNativeSkill','sendNativeSpecial','simulationAllowed'} do
            local original=bindings[name]
            if type(original)=='function' then bindings[name]=function(...)
                local down=if name=='send' or name=='sendNativeSkill' then select(2,...) else select(1,...)
                if (down==true or name=='simulationAllowed') and actionPaused() then return false end
                local binding=name=='send' and select(1,...)
                local id=type(binding)=='table' and binding.kind and binding.name and binding.kind..':'..binding.name
                if id and down==true and not (bindings.simulatedHeld and bindings.simulatedHeld[id]) then
                    local key=(if binding.kind=='Mouse' then host.Enum.UserInputType else host.Enum.KeyCode)[binding.name]
                    local ok,held=pcall(function()return key and (if binding.kind=='Mouse' then input:IsMouseButtonPressed(key) else input:IsKeyDown(key)) end)
                    control.physicalAtStart[id]=ok and held==true
                end
                if id then control.syntheticUntil[id]=clock()+.2 end
                control.syntheticDepth+=1
                local result=table.pack(pcall(original,...))
                control.syntheticDepth-=1
                if id and down==false then control.physicalAtStart[id]=nil end
                if not result[1] then error(result[2],0) end
                return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
            end end
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if not tab or control.controlCreated then return end
        control.controlCreated=true
        local options={
            {'menu','Failsafe While Using Menu','While Using Our Menu','Pause gameplay automation while the main menu, right-click settings, color picker or keybind recorder is open. Menu and visual controls remain usable.'},
            {'typing','Failsafe While Typing','While Typing / Chatting','Pause gameplay automation while a text box has focus, including Roblox chat and search or value inputs.'},
            {'robloxMenu','Failsafe Roblox Menu','While Roblox Menu Is Open','Pause gameplay automation while the Roblox system menu is open.'},
            {'emoteMenu','Failsafe Emote Menu','While Emote Menu Is Open','Pause gameplay automation while the native emote wheel or picker is open.'},
            {'windowFocus','Failsafe Window Unfocused','When Window Is Not Focused','Pause gameplay automation when Roblox loses focus or you switch to another window.'},
            {'cursorOutside','Failsafe Cursor Outside Game','When Cursor Leaves Game','Pause gameplay automation when the cursor is outside the usable game viewport or the viewport is unavailable.'},
            {'afk','Failsafe AFK','When AFK / Inactive','Pause after the selected time without physical activity. Your own held keys/buttons or mouse movement keep you active; this script\'s automatic inputs do not.'},
        }
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Debug Console Traces',DisplayName='Debug Console Traces',Description='Print diagnostic lines (enemy animations, hits taken, punch steps, unblock reblock, hitbox queries) to the console. Off keeps the console quiet.',Default=false,QuickSettingsOnly=true,
            Callback=function(value)DebugTrace.enabled=value==true end})
        local related={'Failsafe'}
        for _,spec in options do table.insert(related,spec[2]) end
        table.insert(related,'Failsafe AFK Timeout (s)')
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Failsafe',DisplayName='Failsafe',Description='Temporarily pause gameplay automation for every enabled condition below. Feature preferences stay saved and resume when all enabled conditions clear.',Default=true,PortRelatedNames=related,Callback=control.setEnabled})
        for _,spec in options do
            local key=spec[1]
            tab:CreateToggle({Name=spec[2],DisplayName=spec[3],Description=spec[4],Default=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,PortRelatedNames=related,
                Callback=function(value)return control.setCondition(key,value)end})
        end
        if type(tab.CreateSlider)=='function' then
            tab:CreateSlider({Name='Failsafe AFK Timeout (s)',DisplayName='AFK Timeout (s)',Description='Physical inactivity before the AFK condition pauses gameplay automation. Mouse movement and held physical controls count; automatic requests do not.',
                Min=1,Max=3600,Default=60,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,PortRelatedNames=related,Callback=control.setIdleTimeoutSeconds})
        end
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.paused=true;pauseOwned();control.alive=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        if control.renderName then run:UnbindFromRenderStep(control.renderName) end
        for owner,record in registry do
            setmetatable(owner,record.previousMeta)
            for key,value in record.values do rawset(owner,key,value) end
        end
        table.clear(control.connections)
    end
    menu.failsafe=control
    menu.setFailsafeEnabled=control.setEnabled
    menu.isFailsafePaused=function()
        if not control.alive and not manualScopes[coroutine.running()] then return false end
        return actionPaused()
    end
    menu.runManualMenuAction=control.runManualMenuAction
    menu.getFailsafeRequested=control.requested
    if menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation then
        local original=menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation
        menu.updateCameraOnlyRotation=function(...)if not control.paused then return original(...)end;return nil end
    end
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()focused=false;table.clear(control.physicalHeld);control.refresh()end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function()focused=true;activity();seedPhysicalHolds();control.refresh()end)
    connect(input.InputBegan,function(object)
        local id,key,mouse=inputId(object)
        if focused and id and not syntheticInput(id) then
            control.physicalHeld[id]={key=key,mouse=mouse};activity();control.refresh()
        end
    end)
    connect(input.InputEnded,function(object)
        local id=inputId(object)
        if id and not syntheticInput(id) then control.physicalHeld[id]=nil end
    end)
    connect(input.InputChanged,function(object)
        if not focused or control.syntheticDepth>0 or not object then return end
        local kind=object.UserInputType and object.UserInputType.Name
        if kind~='MouseMovement' and kind~='MouseWheel' and kind~='Touch' then return end
        local lease=menu.directionalLock and menu.directionalLock.shiftCursorLease
        if lease and lease.active and lease.warping then return end
        local delta=object.Delta
        if delta and ((delta.X or 0)~=0 or (delta.Y or 0)~=0 or (delta.Z or 0)~=0) then activity();control.refresh() end
    end)
    connect(input.TextBoxFocused,control.refresh);connect(input.TextBoxFocusReleased,control.refresh)
    connect(gui.MenuOpened,control.refresh);connect(gui.MenuClosed,control.refresh)
    local elapsed=0
    connect(run.Heartbeat,function(delta)elapsed+=delta;if elapsed>=.05 then elapsed=0;control.refresh()end end)
    if type(run.BindToRenderStep)=='function' and host.Enum.RenderPriority and host.Enum.RenderPriority.First then
        control.renderName='ShenaniganismFailsafe'
        run:BindToRenderStep(control.renderName,host.Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value-1,control.refresh)
    end
    if focused then seedPhysicalHolds() end
    control.refresh()
    return control
end
return Failsafe
end)()

local NativeBaseFeatures = (function(): any
-- Embedded module type mode: nonstrict
-- Direct native implementations for the original menu's basic callbacks.
-- This component never executes a legacy prototype, decoder, or GUI library.
local NativeBaseFeatures={}

function NativeBaseFeatures.new(host,environment,menu)
    local game,Instance,Enum=host.game,host.Instance,host.Enum
    local world=host.workspace or game:GetService('Workspace')
    local players=game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local run=game:GetService('RunService')
    local input=game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local shared=host._G or host
    local flags=environment._G or environment
    local clock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local control: any={alive=true,unsupported={},errors={},callbacks={},targetSettings={},connections={},characterConnections={},
        noclip=false,infJump=false,walkSpeed=0,hipHeight=nil,dashMultiplier=1,flyActive=false,infRange=false,
        collision=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),written=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),owned=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),fly={},importBuffer='',spinner=false,
        itemNames=false,itemLabels={},nextItemScan=0,cooldowns=false,cooldownRecords={},cooldownAbilityCaches={},cooldownActors={},cooldownCursor=1,nextCooldownDiscovery=0}
    control.cooldownBarColor=host.Color3.new(.35,.22,.04)
    control.cooldownReadyColor=host.Color3.new(.77,.53,0)
    control.cooldownBackgroundColor=host.Color3.new(.12,.12,.12)
    control.cooldownFillTransparency,control.cooldownReadyTransparency,control.cooldownCardSpacing=.75,0,2
    control.cooldownDeadModels=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    control.cooldownViewerStates=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    control.cooldownViewersRetired,control.cooldownViewerRangeSkips=0,0
    control.mainMotion={mode=nil,phase=nil,wiggle=.1,nextTeleport=0,forward=0,right=0,jump=false,focused=true}
    menu.nativeBaseFeatures=control
    local function connect(signal,callback,bucket)
        if not signal or not signal.Connect then return nil end
        local connection=signal:Connect(function(...)if control.alive then return callback(...)end;return nil end)
        table.insert(bucket or control.connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function disconnect(bucket)
        for _,connection in bucket do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(bucket)
    end
    local function finite(value,fallback)
        local amount=tonumber(value)
        return if amount and amount==amount and math.abs(amount)<math.huge then amount else fallback
    end
    local function own(class,name,parent)
        local object=Instance.new(class)
        object.Name=name;object:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true);object.Parent=parent
        control.owned[object]=true
        return object
    end
    local function write(object,property,value)
        if not object then return end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() and (table.find({'WalkSpeed','HipHeight','PlatformStand','AutoRotate','Velocity'},property)
            or property=='Value' and object.Name=='DashMultiplier') then return end
        local record=control.written[object]
        if not record then record={};control.written[object]=record end
        if not record[property] then record[property]={before=object[property]}end
        record[property].value=value
        if object[property]~=value then object[property]=value end
    end
    local function restore(object,property)
        local record=control.written[object]
        local saved=record and record[property]
        if not saved then return end
        if object.Parent and object[property]==saved.value then object[property]=saved.before end
        record[property]=nil
        if next(record)==nil then control.written[object]=nil end
    end
    local function body()
        local character=player.Character
        return character,character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid'),character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    end
    local function selected()
        local name=menu.selectedTarget
        if type(name)~='string' or name=='' then return nil end
        local actor=players:FindFirstChild(name)
        if actor then return actor.Character end
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
    end
    local previousGetSettings=environment.GetPlayerSettings
    environment.GetPlayerSettings=function(name)
        name=if type(name)=='string' then name else name and name.Name
        if not name then return nil end
        if not control.targetSettings[name] then control.targetSettings[name]={LockMode='Camera',LockIcon=true,LockIconSize=10,
            NameESP=false,OutlineESP=false,HitboxExpander=false,HitKill=false,MorphId=''}end
        return control.targetSettings[name]
    end
    local getSettings=environment.GetPlayerSettings
    function control.refreshTargets(exceptPlayer)
        local widget=menu.targetWidget
        if not widget or type(widget.SetOptions)~='function'or type(players.GetPlayers)~='function'then return false end
        local names={}
        for _,actor in players:GetPlayers()do
            if actor~=player and actor~=exceptPlayer then table.insert(names,actor.Name)end
        end
        table.sort(names)
        local signature=table.concat(names,'\0')
        if signature==control.lastRoster then return true end
        -- The existing managed adapter supplies its blank choice, preserves a
        -- valid current selection, and clears a player who has left.
        widget.SetOptions(names)
        control.lastRoster=signature
        return true
    end
    connect(players.PlayerAdded,function()control.refreshTargets()end)
    connect(players.PlayerRemoving,function(actor)control.refreshTargets(actor)end)
    if host.task and host.task.defer then host.task.defer(function()if control.alive then control.refreshTargets()end end)end
    local function targetState()
        local model=selected()
        if not model then return nil end
        return getSettings(model.Name),model
    end
    local marker=menu.lockMarker
    if marker and type(marker.create)=='function'then
        local original=marker.create
        local wrapper=function(target,...)
            local gui=original(target,...)
            if gui and target and getSettings(target.Name).LockIcon==false then gui.Enabled=false end
            return gui
        end
        marker.create=wrapper
        control.markerCreateHook={owner=marker,original=original,wrapper=wrapper}
    end
    local function setTargetIcon(value)
        local settings,target=targetState()
        if not settings then return false,'Choose a target first'end
        settings.LockIcon=value==true
        if marker then
            for image in marker.images or {}do
                local model=marker.targets and marker.targets[image]
                if model and model.Name==target.Name and image.Parent then image.Parent.Enabled=settings.LockIcon end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function method(object,name,...)
        if not object or type(object[name])~='function' then return false,'Native '..name..' is unavailable' end
        return object[name](...)
    end
    local previousFlight,previousToggle=environment.SetFlight,environment.ToggleFly
    local function stopFlight()
        for _,object in {control.fly.velocity,control.fly.gyro}do if object then object:Destroy();control.owned[object]=nil end end
        if control.fly.humanoid then restore(control.fly.humanoid,'PlatformStand')end
        control.fly={};control.flyActive=false;environment.FlyActive=false
    end
    function control.setFlight(value)
        if value~=true then stopFlight();return true end
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then control.flyActive=true;return true end
        if control.flyActive then return true end
        local character,humanoid,root=body()
        if not character or not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health<=0 then return false,'Character is not ready for flight' end
        local velocity=own('BodyVelocity','LookFly',root)
        velocity.MaxForce=host.Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        velocity.Velocity=host.Vector3.zero
        local gyro=own('BodyGyro','LookGyro',root)
        gyro.MaxTorque=host.Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9);gyro.P=15000;gyro.CFrame=root.CFrame
        control.fly={character=character,humanoid=humanoid,root=root,velocity=velocity,gyro=gyro}
        control.flyActive=true;environment.FlyActive=true
        write(humanoid,'PlatformStand',true)
        return true
    end
    environment.SetFlight=control.setFlight
    local nativeToggle=function()return control.setFlight(not control.flyActive)end
    environment.ToggleFly=nativeToggle
    local function trackCollision(part)
        if not part:IsA('BasePart') then return end
        if control.collision[part]==nil then control.collision[part]=part.CanCollide end
        if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide=false end
    end
    local function restoreCollision()
        for part,was in control.collision do if part.Parent and part.CanCollide==false then part.CanCollide=was end end
        table.clear(control.collision)
    end
    -- Noclip is on when requested directly, or while the invisible character is on and its noclip option is set.
    function control.applyNoclip()
        control.noclip=control.noclipRequested==true or(control.invisible==true and control.invisibleNoclip~=false)
        flags.NoclipEnabled=control.noclip
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return true end
        if not control.noclip and not control.mainMotion.collision then restoreCollision();return true end
        local character=player.Character
        if character then for _,part in character:GetDescendants()do trackCollision(part)end end
        return true
    end
    function control.setNoclip(value)
        control.noclipRequested=value==true
        return control.applyNoclip()
    end
    -- Invisible character: local only. Parts, decals and textures of your own character are drawn fully transparent
    -- on this client; the server and other players still see you. Everything is restored when it is turned off.
    control.invisible,control.invisibleNoclip=false,true
    control.hidden=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local nextHide=0
    local function restoreInvisible()
        for object,record in control.hidden do if object.Parent and object.Transparency==1 then object.Transparency=record.before end end
        table.clear(control.hidden)
    end
    local function hideOwn(object)
        if not(object:IsA('BasePart')or object:IsA('Decal')or object:IsA('Texture'))or object.Name=='HumanoidRootPart'then return end
        if not control.hidden[object]then control.hidden[object]={before=object.Transparency}end
        if object.Transparency~=1 then object.Transparency=1 end
    end
    function control.setInvisible(value)
        control.invisible=value==true
        if not control.invisible then restoreInvisible()end
        nextHide=0
        return control.applyNoclip()
    end
    function control.setInvisibleNoclip(value)
        control.invisibleNoclip=value==true
        return control.applyNoclip()
    end
    connect(run.RenderStepped,function()
        if not control.invisible or menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()then return end
        local now=clock()
        local character=player.Character
        if character and now>=nextHide then
            nextHide=now+.25
            for _,object in character:GetDescendants()do hideOwn(object)end
        end
        for object in control.hidden do if object.Parent and object.Transparency~=1 then object.Transparency=1 end end
    end)
    -- These three old controls move only the local character. They never send
    -- a damage/bring request, and share one opt-in motion owner instead of
    -- starting competing RenderStepped or waiting coroutine loops.
    local motion=control.mainMotion
    local function mainMotionBlocked(character,humanoid)
        if menu.alive==false or not motion.focused or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()then return true end
        if menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()then return true end
        if not character or not character.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return true end
        local block=menu.autoBlock
        if block and ((block.manualBlockHeld and block.manualBlockHeld()==true)or block.held~=nil)then return true end
        local env=menu.environment or environment
        if env.LockedTarget and env.LockConn and env.LockConn.Connected~=false then return true end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and (lock.skillFacing or (lock.currentPendingSkill and lock.currentPendingSkill()))then return true end
        local aim=menu.m1AimAssist
        if aim and (aim.blockAimTarget or aim.automaticAimTarget or (aim.enabled and aim.userM1Held and aim.userM1Held()))then return true end
        local port=menu.jujutsuerPort
        local state=port and port.runtime and port.runtime.state
        if state and (state.orbit or state.loopTp or state.tpWalking)then return true end
        if control.flyActive or control.infRange or control.spinner then return true end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        for _,name in {'InDash','InSkill','Block','Melee','Attacking','DomainClash','Knockback','Stun','TrueStun'}do
            if character:GetAttribute(name)==true or info and info:FindFirstChild(name)then return true end
        end
        if (tonumber(character:GetAttribute('Ragdoll'))or 0)>0 or (humanoid.PlatformStand and motion.humanoid~=humanoid)then return true end
        return false
    end
    local function releaseMotionWrites()
        if motion.velocityRoot then restore(motion.velocityRoot,'Velocity')end
        motion.velocityRoot,motion.baseVelocity,motion.phase=nil,nil,nil
        if motion.humanoid then restore(motion.humanoid,'PlatformStand');restore(motion.humanoid,'AutoRotate')end
        motion.humanoid=nil
        motion.collision=false
        if not control.noclip then restoreCollision()end
    end
    local function releaseMotionCamera()
        if motion.camera and motion.camera.Parent and motion.camera.CameraSubject==motion.anchor then
            local _,humanoid=body()
            motion.camera.CameraSubject=if motion.cameraSubject and motion.cameraSubject.Parent then motion.cameraSubject else humanoid
        end
        motion.camera,motion.cameraSubject=nil,nil
    end
    local function retireMotionAnchor()
        releaseMotionCamera()
        if motion.anchor then control.owned[motion.anchor]=nil;motion.anchor:Destroy();motion.anchor=nil end
        motion.character=nil
    end
    local motionIds={walkfling=192,ultra=208}
    function control.setMainMotion(mode,value)
        if motionIds[mode]==nil then return false,'Unknown movement mode' end
        if value~=true then
            if motion.mode~=mode then return true end
            releaseMotionWrites();retireMotionAnchor();motion.mode=nil
        elseif motion.mode~=mode then
            local old=motion.mode
            releaseMotionWrites();retireMotionAnchor()
            motion.mode=mode;motion.nextTeleport=0;motion.wiggle=.1
            if old then
                for _,entry in menu.entries or {}do
                    if entry.config and entry.config.CallbackSourceId==motionIds[old]and entry.widget and entry.widget.Set then entry.widget.Set(false,false)end
                end
            end
        end
        motion.forward,motion.right,motion.jump=0,0,false
        return true
    end
    local function teleportAnchor(character,root)
        if motion.character~=character or motion.anchor and not motion.anchor.Parent then retireMotionAnchor()end
        if not motion.anchor then
            local anchor=own('Part','TeleportAnchor',world)
            anchor.Size=host.Vector3.new(1,1,1);anchor.Transparency=1;anchor.CanCollide=false;anchor.Anchored=true
            anchor.CFrame=root.CFrame;motion.anchor=anchor;motion.character=character
        end
        return motion.anchor
    end
    local function motionActors(character)
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')or world:FindFirstChild('Character')
        local targets={}
        if folder then
            for _,model in folder:GetChildren()do
                local humanoid=model:IsA('Model')and model~=character and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local root=humanoid and model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                if root and humanoid.Health>0 then table.insert(targets,{model=model,root=root})end
            end
        end
        return targets
    end
    local function teleportAroundAnchor(character,humanoid,root,anchor)
        local chosen
        if math.random()<.3 then
            local nearby={}
            for _,target in motionActors(character)do if(target.root.Position-anchor.Position).Magnitude<=40 then table.insert(nearby,target)end end
            if #nearby>0 then chosen=nearby[math.random(1,#nearby)].root end
        end
        if chosen then
            local point=chosen.Position-chosen.CFrame.LookVector*4
            point=host.Vector3.new(point.X,chosen.Position.Y+2,point.Z)
            root.CFrame=host.CFrame.lookAt(point,chosen.Position)
        else
            local angle,distance=math.random()*2*math.pi,math.random()*20
            local position=anchor.Position
            local x,z=position.X+math.cos(angle)*distance,position.Z+math.sin(angle)*distance
            local params=host.RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances={character};params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            local hit=world:Raycast(host.Vector3.new(x,position.Y+100,z),host.Vector3.new(0,-200,0),params)
            local y=if hit then hit.Position.Y+3 else position.Y
            root.CFrame=host.CFrame.new(x,y,z)*(root.CFrame-root.CFrame.Position)
        end
        local velocity=if motion.jump then host.Vector3.new(0,50,0)else host.Vector3.zero
        root.Velocity=velocity;root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=velocity
        if motion.jump then humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping);motion.jump=false end
    end
    function control.stepMainMotion(phase,delta,now)
        if not motion.mode then return end
        local character,humanoid,root=body()
        if not root and character and motion.mode=='walkfling'then root=character:FindFirstChild('Torso')or character:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso')end
        if not root or mainMotionBlocked(character,humanoid)then
            releaseMotionWrites();releaseMotionCamera();motion.paused=true;motion.forward,motion.right,motion.jump=0,0,false
            return
        end
        motion.paused=false
        if motion.mode=='walkfling'then
            if not motion.collision then
                motion.collision=true
                for _,part in character:GetDescendants()do trackCollision(part)end
            end
            if phase=='heartbeat'then
                if motion.velocityRoot then restore(motion.velocityRoot,'Velocity')end
                motion.velocityRoot=root;motion.baseVelocity=root.Velocity;motion.phase='spike'
                write(root,'Velocity',motion.baseVelocity*10000+host.Vector3.new(0,10000,0))
            elseif phase=='render'and motion.phase=='spike'then
                restore(motion.velocityRoot,'Velocity');motion.phase='restore'
            elseif phase=='stepped'and motion.phase=='restore'then
                write(root,'Velocity',motion.baseVelocity+host.Vector3.new(0,motion.wiggle,0))
                motion.wiggle=-motion.wiggle;motion.phase='wiggle'
            end
        elseif motion.mode=='ultra'then
            local anchor=teleportAnchor(character,root)
            if phase=='render'then
                local camera=world.CurrentCamera
                if camera then
                    if motion.camera~=camera then releaseMotionCamera();motion.camera=camera;motion.cameraSubject=camera.CameraSubject end
