                    camera.CameraSubject=anchor
                    local look,right=camera.CFrame.LookVector,camera.CFrame.RightVector
                    anchor.Position+=(host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)*motion.forward+host.Vector3.new(right.X,0,right.Z)*motion.right)*30*delta
                end
            elseif phase=='heartbeat'and now>=motion.nextTeleport then
                motion.nextTeleport=now+.01
                teleportAroundAnchor(character,humanoid,root,anchor)
            end
        end
    end
    connect(input.InputBegan,function(object,processed)
        if motion.mode~='ultra'or processed or motion.paused or input:GetFocusedTextBox()or menu.recording then return end
        local key=object.KeyCode
        if key==Enum.KeyCode.W then motion.forward=1 elseif key==Enum.KeyCode.S then motion.forward=-1
        elseif key==Enum.KeyCode.D then motion.right=1 elseif key==Enum.KeyCode.A then motion.right=-1
        elseif key==Enum.KeyCode.Space then motion.jump=true end
    end)
    connect(input.InputEnded,function(object)
        local key=object.KeyCode
        if key==Enum.KeyCode.W and motion.forward==1 or key==Enum.KeyCode.S and motion.forward==-1 then motion.forward=0 end
        if key==Enum.KeyCode.D and motion.right==1 or key==Enum.KeyCode.A and motion.right==-1 then motion.right=0 end
    end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()motion.focused=false;releaseMotionWrites();releaseMotionCamera();motion.forward,motion.right,motion.jump=0,0,false end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function()motion.focused=true end)
    function control.setWalkSpeed(value)
        local speed=finite(value,nil)
        if not speed then return false,'WalkSpeed must be a finite number'end
        control.walkSpeed=math.clamp(speed,0,500)
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return true end
        local _,humanoid=body()
        if humanoid then if control.walkSpeed>0 then write(humanoid,'WalkSpeed',control.walkSpeed)else restore(humanoid,'WalkSpeed')end end
        return true
    end
    function control.setHipHeight(value)
        local height=finite(value,nil)
        if not height then return false,'Hip Height must be a finite number'end
        control.hipHeight=math.clamp(height,0,250)
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return true end
        local _,humanoid=body()
        if humanoid then write(humanoid,'HipHeight',control.hipHeight)end
        return true
    end
    local function applyDashMultiplier()
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not info then return false end
        local amount=math.clamp(finite(control.dashMultiplier,1),1,5)
        local multiplier=info:FindFirstChild('DashMultiplier')
        if not multiplier then
            -- Native ChildAdded readers must never observe NumberValue's zero
            -- default. Its owned restore baseline is the normal multiplier.
            multiplier=Instance.new('NumberValue')
            multiplier.Name='DashMultiplier';multiplier:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true)
            multiplier.Value=1;control.owned[multiplier]=true
            write(multiplier,'Value',amount)
            multiplier.Parent=info
        elseif multiplier:IsA('NumberValue')then
            if control.owned[multiplier]then
                local record=control.written[multiplier]or{};control.written[multiplier]=record
                record.Value=record.Value or{before=1};record.Value.before=1
            end
            write(multiplier,'Value',amount)
        else return false end
        return true
    end
    function control.setDashMultiplier(value)
        local amount=finite(value,nil)
        if not amount then return false,'Dash Multiplier must be a finite number'end
        control.dashMultiplier=math.clamp(amount,1,5);flags.DashMultiplierValue=control.dashMultiplier
        if not (menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()) then applyDashMultiplier() end;return true
    end
    local function nativeText(parent,name,caption,size)
        local label=own('TextLabel',name,parent)
        label.Text=tostring(caption or '')
        label.BackgroundTransparency=1
        label.TextColor3=host.Color3.new(1,1,1)
        label.TextSize=size or 12
        if environment.THEME_FONT then label.FontFace=environment.THEME_FONT end
        return label
    end
    local function clearBillboard(record)
        if record and record.nativeHandle and record.gui and menu.sideDisplays and type(menu.sideDisplays.detachOwnedViewer)=='function'then
            menu.sideDisplays.detachOwnedViewer(record.gui)
        end
        if record and record.cooldownConnections then disconnect(record.cooldownConnections) end
        if record and record.gui then
            if menu.state and menu.state.instances then menu.state.instances[record.gui]=nil end
            control.owned[record.gui]=nil
            record.gui:Destroy()
        end
    end
    function control.refreshItemNames()
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Items')
        local wanted={}
        if control.itemNames and folder then
            for _,item in folder:GetChildren()do
                local part=if item:IsA('BasePart')then item else item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart',true)
                if not part then continue end
                wanted[item]=true
                local record=control.itemLabels[item]
                if record and (record.part~=part or not record.gui.Parent)then clearBillboard(record);record=nil end
                if not record then
                    local gui=own('BillboardGui','ShenaniganismItemName',part)
                    gui.Adornee=part;gui.AlwaysOnTop=true;gui.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(200,50)
                    gui.StudsOffset=host.Vector3.new(0,2,0)
                    local label=nativeText(gui,'ItemName',item.Name,20)
                    label.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    label.TextColor3=host.Color3.new(0,1,0);label.TextStrokeTransparency=.5
                    record={gui=gui,label=label,part=part};control.itemLabels[item]=record
                end
                if record.label.Text~=item.Name then record.label.Text=item.Name end
            end
        end
        for item,record in control.itemLabels do if not wanted[item]then clearBillboard(record);control.itemLabels[item]=nil end end
    end
    function control.setItemNames(value)
        control.itemNames=value==true;flags.Item_Info=control.itemNames
        control.nextItemScan=0;control.refreshItemNames();return true
    end
    local function serverTime()
        if type(world.GetServerTimeNow)=='function'then local ok,time=pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow,world);if ok and type(time)=='number'then return time end end
        return (host.os and host.os.time or os.time)()
    end
    local function clearCooldownAbilityCache(model)
        local cache=control.cooldownAbilityCaches[model]
        if not cache then return end
        disconnect(cache.connections)
        control.cooldownAbilityCaches[model]=nil
    end
    -- Labels read the replicated native input registry, never our logical input
    -- aliases. Keep this small registry event-driven and local-player-only.
    local cooldownKeyWatch={connections={},labels={},initialized=false,storage=nil}
    local function readableCooldownKey(value)
        if value==nil then return nil end
        local name=if type(value)=='string'then value else tostring(value)
        name=name:match('([^%.]+)$')or name
        if name=='None'or name=='Unknown'then return nil end
        local compact={One='1',Two='2',Three='3',Four='4',Five='5',Six='6',Seven='7',Eight='8',Nine='9',Zero='0',
            MouseLeftButton='M1',MouseRightButton='M2',MouseMiddleButton='M3',MouseButton1='M1',MouseButton2='M2',MouseButton3='M3',
            LeftControl='LCtrl',RightControl='RCtrl',LeftShift='LShift',RightShift='RShift',LeftAlt='LAlt',RightAlt='RAlt'}
        return compact[name]or name
    end
    local function cooldownSlot(name)
        local compact=tostring(name):lower():gsub('[^%w]','')
        local index=compact:match('^skill(%d+)$')or compact:match('^move(%d+)$')or compact:match('^ability(%d+)$')or compact:match('^moveslot(%d+)$')
        return index and tostring(tonumber(index))or nil
    end
    local function localCooldownKey(key)
        return cooldownKeyWatch.labels[tostring(key)]or tostring(key)
    end
    local function refreshLocalCooldownKeyText()
        local record=control.cooldownRecords[player.Character]
        if not record then return end
        for _,card in record.cards do
            local ability=card.reference and card.reference.Value
            local key=ability and ability:GetAttribute('Key')
            if key~=nil and card.key and card.key.Parent then
                local label=localCooldownKey(key)
                if card.key.Text~=label then card.key.Text=label end
            end
        end
    end
    local refreshCooldownKeyBindings
    refreshCooldownKeyBindings=function()
        disconnect(cooldownKeyWatch.connections)
        table.clear(cooldownKeyWatch.labels)
        local storage=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
        cooldownKeyWatch.storage,cooldownKeyWatch.initialized=storage,storage~=nil
        if not storage then return end
        local function watch(signal,callback)connect(signal,callback,cooldownKeyWatch.connections)end
        local function named(name)return function(child)if child.Name==name then refreshCooldownKeyBindings()end end end
        watch(storage.ChildAdded,named('Keybind'));watch(storage.ChildRemoved,named('Keybind'))
        local keybind=storage:FindFirstChild('Keybind')
        if keybind then
            watch(keybind.ChildAdded,named('Combat'));watch(keybind.ChildRemoved,named('Combat'))
            local combat=keybind:FindFirstChild('Combat')
            if combat then
                watch(combat.ChildAdded,refreshCooldownKeyBindings);watch(combat.ChildRemoved,refreshCooldownKeyBindings)
                for _,action in combat:GetChildren()do
                    if not action:IsA('InputAction')then continue end
                    if type(action.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then watch(action:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),refreshCooldownKeyBindings)end
                    local slot=cooldownSlot(action.Name)
                    if not slot then continue end
                    watch(action.ChildAdded,refreshCooldownKeyBindings);watch(action.ChildRemoved,refreshCooldownKeyBindings)
                    for _,candidate in action:GetChildren()do
                        if candidate:IsA('InputBinding')and type(candidate.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then
                            watch(candidate:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),refreshCooldownKeyBindings)
                        end
                    end
                    local binding=action:FindFirstChild('Keyboard')
                    if binding and binding:IsA('InputBinding')then
                        local key=readableCooldownKey(binding.KeyCode)
                        local modifier=readableCooldownKey(binding.PrimaryModifier)
                        cooldownKeyWatch.labels[slot]=if key then (if modifier then modifier..'+'else '')..key else '—'
                        if type(binding.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then
                            watch(binding:GetPropertyChangedSignal('KeyCode'),refreshCooldownKeyBindings)
                            watch(binding:GetPropertyChangedSignal('PrimaryModifier'),refreshCooldownKeyBindings)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        refreshLocalCooldownKeyText()
    end
    local function cooldownKeyLabel(model,key)
        if model~=player.Character then return tostring(key)end
        if not cooldownKeyWatch.initialized then refreshCooldownKeyBindings()end
        return localCooldownKey(key)
    end
    function control.getCooldownKeyLabel(model,key)return cooldownKeyLabel(model,key)end
    function control.getCooldownBindingLabels()return table.clone(cooldownKeyWatch.labels)end
    local function sortCooldownAbilities(a,b)
            local ak,bk=tonumber(a.key),tonumber(b.key)
            if ak and bk and ak~=bk then return ak<bk end
            if ak and not bk then return true end
            if bk and not ak then return false end
            return if a.key~=b.key then a.key<b.key else a.name<b.name
    end
    local function cooldownEntries(model,moveset)
        local cache=control.cooldownAbilityCaches[model]
        if cache and cache.moveset~=moveset then clearCooldownAbilityCache(model);cache=nil end
        if not moveset then return nil end
        if not cache then
            cache={moveset=moveset,entries={},connections={},dirty=true,eventDriven=false}
            cache.invalidate=function()cache.dirty=true end
            control.cooldownAbilityCaches[model]=cache
        end
        if cache.dirty or not cache.eventDriven then
            disconnect(cache.connections)
            local entries={}
            local eventDriven=connect(moveset.ChildAdded,cache.invalidate,cache.connections)~=nil
            eventDriven=connect(moveset.ChildRemoved,cache.invalidate,cache.connections)~=nil and eventDriven
            for _,object in moveset:GetChildren()do
                if not object:IsA('NumberValue')then continue end
                if type(object.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function' and type(object.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function' then
                    eventDriven=connect(object:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Key'),cache.invalidate,cache.connections)~=nil and eventDriven
                    eventDriven=connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),cache.invalidate,cache.connections)~=nil and eventDriven
                else eventDriven=false end
                local key=object:GetAttribute('Key')
                if key~=nil then table.insert(entries,{object=object,name=object.Name,key=tostring(key)})end
            end
            table.sort(entries,sortCooldownAbilities)
            cache.entries,cache.eventDriven,cache.dirty=entries,eventDriven,false
        end
        return cache.entries
    end
    local function readCooldownAbilities(model,now,reuse)
        local moveset=model:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        local entries=cooldownEntries(model,moveset)
        local cache=control.cooldownAbilityCaches[model]
        local abilities
        if reuse and cache then
            abilities=cache.renderAbilities
            if not abilities then abilities={};cache.renderAbilities=abilities else table.clear(abilities)end
        else abilities={}end
        -- Only membership/order is cached. Native duration/use/deadline values
        -- and the current time still drive every existing recharge update.
        if entries then for _,entry in entries do
            local object=entry.object
            if object.Parent~=moveset then continue end
            local maximum=finite(object.Value,nil)
            if not maximum then continue end
            local lastUse=finite(object:GetAttribute('LastUse'),nil)
            local readyAt=finite(object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt'),nil)
            local remaining=if readyAt then math.max(readyAt-now,0) elseif lastUse then math.max(maximum-(now-lastUse),0)else 0
            local ability=if reuse then entry.renderSample else nil
            if not ability then
                ability={}
                if reuse then entry.renderSample=ability;control.cooldownRenderSampleBuilds=(control.cooldownRenderSampleBuilds or 0)+1 end
            end
            ability.object,ability.name,ability.key,ability.remaining=object,entry.name,entry.key,remaining
            ability.maximum,ability.ready,ability.readyAt,ability.lastUse=maximum,remaining<=0,readyAt,lastUse
            table.insert(abilities,ability)
        end end
        return abilities
    end
    function control.cooldownAbilities(model,now)
        -- External consumers retain independent snapshots. Only the synchronous
        -- renderer borrows the per-kit sample array and records.
        return readCooldownAbilities(model,now,false)
    end
    local function cooldownCard(card,ability)
        -- Use the game's MoveReveal card and its running Handle script.
        -- Only labels/style are added here; native LastUse/ReadyAt drives the fill.
        local fill=card:FindFirstChild('Cooldown')
        local keyFrame=card:FindFirstChild('Key')
        local key=keyFrame and keyFrame:FindFirstChild('Key')
        if not fill then return nil end
        if not key then
            keyFrame=card:FindFirstChild('ShenaniganismKey')or own('Frame','ShenaniganismKey',card)
            keyFrame.BackgroundTransparency=1;keyFrame.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,0)
            key=keyFrame:FindFirstChild('Key')or nativeText(keyFrame,'Key',ability.key,18)
            key.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1);key.TextScaled=true;key.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        end
        card.BackgroundColor3=control.cooldownBackgroundColor
        -- Native Handle creates/reparents cards on moveset switches. The side
        -- display may already have styled them before this decorator runs;
        -- never replace that saved transparency with an opaque default.
        card.BackgroundTransparency=if menu.sideDisplays then menu.sideDisplays.cooldownTransparency else .75
        card.BorderSizePixel=1;card.BorderColor3=host.Color3.new(0,0,0)
        local aspect=card:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIAspectRatioConstraint')or own('UIAspectRatioConstraint','Aspect',card)
        aspect.AspectRatio=1;aspect.DominantAxis=Enum.DominantAxis.Width
        fill.BorderSizePixel=0;fill.BackgroundColor3=control.cooldownBarColor
        fill.BackgroundTransparency=control.cooldownFillTransparency
        fill:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismCooldownFill',true)
        local gradient=fill:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGradient')
        if gradient then gradient.Enabled=false end
        keyFrame.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,0)
        keyFrame.Position,keyFrame.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(.5,0),host.UDim2.fromScale(1,.53)
        local title=card:FindFirstChild('ItemName')or nativeText(card,'ItemName',ability.name,12)
        title.Position,title.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(0,.53),host.UDim2.fromScale(1,.43)
        title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;title.TextScaled=true;title.TextWrapped=true
        local reference=card:FindFirstChild('Item')or own('ObjectValue','Item',card);reference.Value=ability.object
        local outline=card:FindFirstChild('Outline')or own('UIStroke','Outline',card)
        outline.Color=control.cooldownReadyColor;outline.Thickness=2
        outline.Transparency=control.cooldownReadyTransparency
        -- Native Handle subscribes to future casts. Seed an already-running
        -- cooldown once on adoption without changing any game attributes.
        return {frame=card,fill=fill,key=key,title=title,reference=reference,outline=outline,
            seedReadyAt=if ability.remaining>0 then ability.readyAt else nil,seedLastUse=ability.lastUse}
    end
    function control.setCooldownBarColor(color)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(color)~='Color3' then return false end
        control.cooldownBarColor=color
        for _,record in control.cooldownRecords do
            for _,card in record.cards do
                if card.fill.Parent and card.fill.BackgroundColor3~=color then card.fill.BackgroundColor3=color end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setCooldownReadyColor(color)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(color)~='Color3' then return false end
        control.cooldownReadyColor=color
        for _,record in control.cooldownRecords do
            for _,card in record.cards do
                if card.outline.Parent and card.outline.Color~=color then card.outline.Color=color end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setCooldownBackgroundColor(color)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(color)~='Color3' then return false end
        control.cooldownBackgroundColor=color
        for _,record in control.cooldownRecords do
            for _,card in record.cards do
                if card.frame.Parent and card.frame.BackgroundColor3~=color then card.frame.BackgroundColor3=color end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function cooldownAlpha(field,part,property,percent)
        local amount=tonumber(percent)
        if not amount or amount~=amount or math.abs(amount)==math.huge then return false end
        local alpha=math.clamp(amount,0,100)/100
        control[field]=alpha
        for _,record in control.cooldownRecords do
            for _,card in record.cards do
                local object=card[part]
                if object.Parent and object[property]~=alpha then object[property]=alpha end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.setCooldownFillTransparency(percent)
        return cooldownAlpha('cooldownFillTransparency','fill','BackgroundTransparency',percent)
    end
    function control.setCooldownReadyTransparency(percent)
        return cooldownAlpha('cooldownReadyTransparency','outline','Transparency',percent)
    end
    function control.setCooldownCardSpacing(value)
        local spacing=tonumber(value)
        if not spacing or spacing~=spacing or math.abs(spacing)==math.huge then return false end
        control.cooldownCardSpacing=math.clamp(math.round(spacing),0,40)
        for _,record in control.cooldownRecords do
            if record.layout and record.layout.Parent then record.layout.Padding=host.UDim.new(control.cooldownCardSpacing/320,0) end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function clearViewerState(model)
        local state=control.cooldownViewerStates[model]
        if state then disconnect(state.connections);state.humanoid=nil;control.cooldownViewerStates[model]=nil end
    end
    local function viewerInRange(model,part,now,record)
        local state=control.cooldownViewerStates[model]
        local side=menu.sideDisplays
        local localCharacter=player.Character
        local localRoot=localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local root=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local limit=side and finite(side.maxViewDistance,nil)
        -- Missing host/range/rig data preserves the previous viewer lifecycle.
        -- The camera is never a distance origin, even during respawn.
        if model==localCharacter or not limit or limit<0 or not side or type(side.studsToMeters)~='function'
            or not localRoot or not root or not part or not localRoot.Position or not root.Position then
            if state then state.outsideAt,state.nextAt=nil,nil;state.reason='retained unknown/local'end
            return true,state
        end
        local a,b=localRoot.Position,root.Position
        local ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz=finite(a.X,nil),finite(a.Y,nil),finite(a.Z,nil),finite(b.X,nil),finite(b.Y,nil),finite(b.Z,nil)
        if not ax or not ay or not az or not bx or not by or not bz then return true,state end
        local dx,dy,dz=ax-bx,ay-by,az-bz
        local okay,distance=pcall(side.studsToMeters,math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz))
        distance=if okay then finite(distance,nil)else nil
        if not distance then return true,state end
        if not state then state={connections={}};control.cooldownViewerStates[model]=state end
        state.distance,state.limit,state.nextAt=distance,limit,now+.05
        if distance<=limit+10 then state.outsideAt=nil;state.reason=if distance<=limit then 'in range'else 'prewarming';return true,state end
        if record then
            if distance<=limit+15 then state.outsideAt=nil;state.reason='boundary cache';return true,state end
            state.outsideAt=state.outsideAt or now
            if now-state.outsideAt<.75 then state.reason='retirement grace';return true,state end
            local owned=side.records and side.records[model]
            if owned and owned.source==record.gui and type(side.detachOwnedViewer)~='function'then
                state.reason='waiting for safe detach';return true,state
            end
        end
        state.reason='out of range'
        return false,state
    end
    local function observeFarViewerLife(model,humanoid,state)
        if state.humanoid==humanoid then return end
        disconnect(state.connections);state.humanoid=humanoid
        local function retire()
            if control.cooldownViewerStates[model]~=state or state.humanoid~=humanoid then return end
            control.cooldownDeadModels[model]=true
            clearCooldownAbilityCache(model)
            clearViewerState(model)
        end
        connect(humanoid.Died,retire,state.connections)
        connect(humanoid.HealthChanged,function(health)if health<=0 then retire()end end,state.connections)
        connect(humanoid.StateChanged,function(_previous,current)if current==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then retire()end end,state.connections)
        if type(model.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function'then
            connect(model:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Dead'),function()if model:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then retire()end end,state.connections)
        end
    end
    function control.updateCooldownModel(model,now)
        local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local dead=control.cooldownDeadModels[model] or model:GetAttribute('Dead')==true
            or humanoid and humanoid.Health<=0
        if not dead and humanoid and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function' then
            dead=humanoid:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        end
        if dead then control.cooldownDeadModels[model]=true end
        if dead or not humanoid then
            clearViewerState(model)
            clearCooldownAbilityCache(model)
            local old=control.cooldownRecords[model]
            if old then control.cooldownRecords[model]=nil;clearBillboard(old) end
            return
        end
        local part=model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')or model:FindFirstChild('Head')or model.PrimaryPart
        local record=control.cooldownRecords[model]
        local keepViewer,viewerState=viewerInRange(model,part,now,record)
        if not keepViewer then
            -- Keep membership observers and current native timestamps available
            -- without an invisible running Reveal.Handle for every distant actor.
            cooldownEntries(model,model:FindFirstChild('Moveset'))
            if record then
                clearBillboard(record);control.cooldownRecords[model]=nil
                table.clear(record.cards)
                record.gui,record.holder,record.layout,record.nativeHandle,record.ultimate=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
                record.cardSize,record.wantedCards=nil,nil
                control.cooldownViewersRetired+=1
            end
            observeFarViewerLife(model,humanoid,viewerState)
            control.cooldownViewerRangeSkips+=1
            return
        end
        local sampledAt=serverTime()
        local abilities=readCooldownAbilities(model,sampledAt,true)
        if #abilities==0 or not part then
            if record then clearBillboard(record);control.cooldownRecords[model]=nil end
            return
        end
        if record and (not record.gui.Parent or record.humanoid~=humanoid) then clearBillboard(record);record=nil end
        if not record then
            local utils=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Utils')
            local actor=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            local template=utils and utils:FindFirstChild(if actor then 'Reveal' else 'MoveReveal')
            if not template or not template:IsA('BillboardGui') or not template:FindFirstChild('Handle') then
                control.cooldownNativeStatus='Waiting for the game cooldown viewer'
                return
            end
            -- Clone the actual game display including its original client
            -- Handle script. Keep its hierarchy intact for native updates.
            local gui=template:Clone()
            gui.Name='CDVIEW_AbilityMonitor';gui:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true)
            gui:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismNativeViewer',template.Name)
            gui:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismNativeHeightStuds',template.Size.Y.Scale)
            control.owned[gui]=true
            local handle=gui:FindFirstChild('Handle')
            handle.Enabled=false
            -- SideDisplays owns visibility, including recent-hit and wall filters.
            -- New cards stay hidden until that shared visibility pass adopts them.
            gui.Enabled=false
            gui:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismDisplayManaged',true)
            -- SideDisplays applies the character-distance limit; Roblox's
            -- camera-distance cutoff must not hide a zoomed-out eligible actor.
            gui.Adornee=part;gui.AlwaysOnTop=true;gui.LightInfluence=0;gui.MaxDistance=math.huge
            local holder=gui:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
            if not holder then gui:Destroy();control.owned[gui]=nil;return end
            holder.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1);holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
            local layout=holder:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIListLayout')
            if not layout then gui:Destroy();control.owned[gui]=nil;return end
            layout.FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Vertical;layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            layout.Padding=host.UDim.new(control.cooldownCardSpacing/320,0)
            local evasive=gui:FindFirstChild('Evasive')
            if evasive then evasive.Visible=false end -- existing combined Special/Evasive gauge stays in place
            record={gui=gui,holder=holder,layout=layout,cards={},nativeHandle=handle,nativeTemplate=template.Name,ultimate=gui:FindFirstChild('Ult'),
                humanoid=humanoid,cooldownConnections={}}
            control.cooldownRecords[model]=record
            local function retire()
                if control.cooldownRecords[model]~=record then return end
                control.cooldownDeadModels[model]=true
                control.cooldownRecords[model]=nil
                clearViewerState(model)
                clearCooldownAbilityCache(model)
                clearBillboard(record)
            end
            connect(humanoid.Died,retire,record.cooldownConnections)
            connect(humanoid.HealthChanged,function(health)if health<=0 then retire() end end,record.cooldownConnections)
            connect(humanoid.StateChanged,function(_previous,current)if current==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then retire() end end,record.cooldownConnections)
            if type(model.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function' then
                connect(model:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Dead'),function()if model:GetAttribute('Dead')==true then retire() end end,record.cooldownConnections)
            end
            if menu.state and menu.state.instances then menu.state.instances[gui]=true end
            gui.Parent=part
            handle.Enabled=true
            control.cooldownNativeStatus='Game '..template.Name..' Handle active'
            if menu.sideDisplays and menu.sideDisplays.noteOwnedBillboard then menu.sideDisplays.noteOwnedBillboard(gui)end
            if menu.floatingValues and menu.floatingValues.noteOwnedBillboard then menu.floatingValues.noteOwnedBillboard(gui)end
            if menu.sideDisplays and type(menu.sideDisplays.refreshOwnedViewer)=='function'then menu.sideDisplays.refreshOwnedViewer(gui)end
        end
        if viewerState and viewerState.humanoid then disconnect(viewerState.connections);viewerState.humanoid=nil end
        record.nextAt=now+.05
        local wanted=record.wantedCards
        if not wanted then wanted={};record.wantedCards=wanted else table.clear(wanted)end
        local cardSize=record.cardSize
        if not cardSize or record.cardCount~=#abilities then
            cardSize=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1/#abilities)
            record.cardSize,record.cardCount=cardSize,#abilities
        end
        for index,ability in abilities do
            wanted[ability.name]=true
            local card=record.cards[ability.name]
            local nativeCard=record.holder:FindFirstChild(ability.name)
            if not nativeCard or not nativeCard:IsA('Frame')then continue end
            if not card or card.frame~=nativeCard then card=cooldownCard(nativeCard,ability);record.cards[ability.name]=card end
            if not card then continue end
            if card.frame.LayoutOrder~=index then card.frame.LayoutOrder=index end
            if card.frame.Size~=cardSize then card.frame.Size=cardSize end
            if card.reference.Value~=ability.object then card.reference.Value=ability.object end
            local keyLabel=cooldownKeyLabel(model,ability.key)
            if card.key.Text~=keyLabel then card.key.Text=keyLabel end
            if card.title.Text~=ability.name then card.title.Text=ability.name end
            if card.seedReadyAt then
                if ability.lastUse~=card.seedLastUse then card.seedReadyAt=nil
                else
                    local duration=math.max(card.seedReadyAt-(card.seedLastUse or sampledAt),.001)
                    local fillSize=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,math.clamp(ability.remaining/duration,0,1))
                    if card.fill.Size~=fillSize then card.fill.Size=fillSize end
                    if ability.remaining<=0 then card.seedReadyAt=nil end
                end
            end
            if card.outline.Enabled~=ability.ready then card.outline.Enabled=ability.ready end
            -- Keep the game's ready flash, then restore the selected card
            -- color once its one-second native tween has finished.
            if ability.ready and (not ability.readyAt or sampledAt>=ability.readyAt+1.1)
                and card.backgroundRestoredFor~=(ability.lastUse or false) then
                card.frame.BackgroundColor3=control.cooldownBackgroundColor
                card.backgroundRestoredFor=ability.lastUse or false
            end
        end
        -- Handle owns card lifetime, including temporary moveset reparenting.
        for name,card in record.cards do if not wanted[name]or not card.frame.Parent then record.cards[name]=nil end end
    end
    function control.stepCooldowns(now)
        if not control.cooldowns then return end
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        if now>=control.nextCooldownDiscovery then
            local models={}
            for _,model in folder and folder:GetChildren()or{}do if model:IsA('Model')then table.insert(models,model)end end
            control.cooldownActors=models;control.nextCooldownDiscovery=now+.5
            if control.cooldownCursor>#models then control.cooldownCursor=1 end
            local wanted={};for _,model in models do wanted[model]=true end
            for model,record in control.cooldownRecords do if not wanted[model]or not model.Parent then clearBillboard(record);control.cooldownRecords[model]=nil end end
            for model in control.cooldownAbilityCaches do if not wanted[model]or not model.Parent then clearCooldownAbilityCache(model)end end
            for model in control.cooldownViewerStates do if not wanted[model]or not model.Parent then clearViewerState(model)end end
        end
        local models=control.cooldownActors
        local checked,updated,start=0,0,clock()
        while checked<#models and updated<8 do
            if control.cooldownCursor>#models then control.cooldownCursor=1 end
            local model=models[control.cooldownCursor]
            control.cooldownCursor+=1;checked+=1
            local record=control.cooldownRecords[model]
            local rangeState=control.cooldownViewerStates[model]
            if not model.Parent or record and now<(record.nextAt or 0)or not record and rangeState and now<(rangeState.nextAt or 0)then continue end
            control.updateCooldownModel(model,now);updated+=1
            if clock()-start>=.00075 then break end
        end
    end
    function control.setCooldowns(value)
        control.cooldowns=value==true
        if not control.cooldowns then
            disconnect(cooldownKeyWatch.connections);table.clear(cooldownKeyWatch.labels);cooldownKeyWatch.initialized=false
            for model,record in control.cooldownRecords do clearBillboard(record);control.cooldownRecords[model]=nil end
            for model in control.cooldownAbilityCaches do clearCooldownAbilityCache(model)end
            for model in control.cooldownViewerStates do clearViewerState(model)end
            table.clear(control.cooldownActors)
        else
            local now=clock()
            local character=player.Character
            -- Settings restoration may run while heartbeat work is paused.
            -- The local HUD cannot depend on its position in the enemy batch.
            if character and character.Parent and character:IsA('Model')then control.updateCooldownModel(character,now)end
            control.nextCooldownDiscovery=0;control.stepCooldowns(now)
        end
        return true
    end
    local stateNames={Stun='AntiStun',NoJump='AntiNoJump',NoSprint='AntiNoSprint'}
    local function clearNativeState(marker)
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return end
        local key=stateNames[marker.Name]
        if not key or flags[key]~=true or not marker.Parent then return end
        local guard=menu.antiStunSpeed
        if guard and guard.shouldPreserveNativeMarker and guard.shouldPreserveNativeMarker(marker) then return end
        marker:Destroy()
    end
    local function observeInfo(info)
        for _,marker in info:GetChildren()do clearNativeState(marker)end
        connect(info.ChildAdded,clearNativeState,control.characterConnections)
    end
    local function attachCharacter(character)
        disconnect(control.characterConnections)
        releaseMotionWrites();retireMotionAnchor()
        restoreCollision()
        if not character then return end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if info then observeInfo(info)end
        connect(character.ChildAdded,function(child)
            if child.Name=='Info'then observeInfo(child);applyDashMultiplier()end
            if child:IsA('Humanoid')then
                if control.walkSpeed>0 then write(child,'WalkSpeed',control.walkSpeed)end
                if control.hipHeight~=nil then write(child,'HipHeight',control.hipHeight)end
            end
        end,control.characterConnections)
        connect(character.DescendantAdded,function(part)if control.noclip or motion.collision then trackCollision(part)end end,control.characterConnections)
        if control.noclip or motion.collision then for _,part in character:GetDescendants()do trackCollision(part)end end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid then
            if control.walkSpeed>0 then write(humanoid,'WalkSpeed',control.walkSpeed)end
            if control.hipHeight~=nil then write(humanoid,'HipHeight',control.hipHeight)end
        end
        if control.dashMultiplier~=1 then applyDashMultiplier()end
    end
    local function setState(name,value)
        flags[name]=value==true
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if value and info then for _,marker in info:GetChildren()do clearNativeState(marker)end end
        if menu.antiStunSpeed and menu.antiStunSpeed.refresh then menu.antiStunSpeed.refresh()end
        return true
    end
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,attachCharacter)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function()stopFlight();releaseMotionWrites();retireMotionAnchor();restoreCollision();disconnect(control.characterConnections)end)
    attachCharacter(player.Character)
    connect(input.JumpRequest,function()
        if not control.infJump then return end
        local _,humanoid=body()
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)end
    end)
    connect(run.Stepped,function()
        control.stepMainMotion('stepped',0,clock())
        if not control.noclip and not motion.collision then return end
        for part in control.collision do if part.Parent and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide=false end end
    end)
    connect(run.RenderStepped,function(delta)control.stepMainMotion('render',delta,clock())end)
    connect(run.Heartbeat,function(delta)
        local now=clock()
        control.stepMainMotion('heartbeat',delta,now)
        if control.itemNames and now>=control.nextItemScan then control.nextItemScan=now+.5;control.refreshItemNames()end
        control.stepCooldowns(now)
        if control.walkSpeed>0 then local _,humanoid=body();if humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then write(humanoid,'WalkSpeed',control.walkSpeed)end end
        if control.flyActive then
            local fly=control.fly
            local camera=world.CurrentCamera
            if player.Character~=fly.character or not fly.root.Parent or not fly.velocity.Parent or fly.humanoid.Health<=0 then stopFlight()
            elseif camera then
                local direction=fly.humanoid.MoveDirection
                if direction.Magnitude>0 then
                    local look=camera.CFrame.LookVector
                    local flat=host.Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
                    local travel=direction
                    if flat.Magnitude>1e-4 then
                        local relative=host.CFrame.lookAt(host.Vector3.zero,flat.Unit):VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
                        travel=camera.CFrame.LookVector*(-relative.Z)+camera.CFrame.RightVector*relative.X
                    end
                    fly.velocity.Velocity=if travel.Magnitude>1e-4 then travel.Unit*fly.humanoid.WalkSpeed*5 else host.Vector3.zero
                else fly.velocity.Velocity=host.Vector3.zero end
                fly.gyro.CFrame=camera.CFrame
            end
        end
        if control.infRange then
            local target=selected()
            local _,_,root=body()
            local targetRoot=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
            local health=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if root and targetRoot and target~=player.Character and health and health.Health>0 then
                root.CFrame=host.CFrame.lookAt((targetRoot.CFrame*host.CFrame.new(0,.5,2.8)).Position,targetRoot.Position)
            end
        end
        if control.spinner then
            local _,_,root=body()
            if root then root.CFrame=root.CFrame*host.CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(50)*math.clamp(delta*60,0,6),0)end
        end
    end)
    local function applyClothing(character,shirt,pants)
        if not character then return false,'Character is unavailable'end
        for _,pair in {{'Shirt','ShirtTemplate',shirt},{'Pants','PantsTemplate',pants}}do
            local id=tostring(pair[3]or''):match('%d+')
            if id then
                local object=character:FindFirstChildOfClass(pair[1])
                if not object then object=own(pair[1],pair[1],character)end
                write(object,pair[2],'rbxassetid://'..id)
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function morphId(character,value)
        if not character then return false,'Character is unavailable'end
        local id=finite(value,nil)
        if not id and type(value)=='string'then
            local ok,result=pcall(players.GetUserIdFromNameAsync,players,value)
            if ok then id=result end
        end
        if not id or id<=0 or id%1~=0 then return false,'Use a Roblox user ID or username'end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid then return false,'Humanoid is unavailable'end
        local ok,description=pcall(players.GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId,players,id)
        if not ok then return false,tostring(description)end
        local applied,message=pcall(humanoid.ApplyDescription,humanoid,description)
        description:Destroy()
        return applied,if not applied then tostring(message)else nil
    end
    local paletteKeys={['Theme Color']='ThemeColor',['Toggle-On Color']='ToggleOnColor',['Toggle-Off Color']='ToggleOffColor',
        ['Row Color']='RowBg',['Border Color']='BorderColor',['Text Color']='TextColor',['Slider Background Color']='SliderTrackBg',
        ['Button Background Color']='ButtonBg',['Input Background Color']='InputBg',['Window Background COlor']='WindowBg',['Knob Color']='KnobColor'}
    local function setColor(name,value)
        local parsed=menu.colorValue and menu.colorValue(value)
        if not parsed then return false,'Use a valid color'end
        shared.__CullingAppearance=shared.__CullingAppearance or {}
        local appearance=shared.__CullingAppearance
        appearance.colors=appearance.colors or {};appearance.colors[name]=parsed
        local ui=menu.ui
        if ui then
            ui.palette=ui.palette or {};ui.palette[name]=parsed
            if ui.queueAppearance then ui.queueAppearance(name)elseif ui.refresh then ui.refresh()end
        end
        environment[paletteKeys[name]]=parsed
        return true
    end
    local function exportConfig()
        local store=menu.configStore
        local function result(ok,message)
            if store and not ok then store.lastError=message end
            if menu.reportConfigResult then menu.reportConfigResult(ok,message,'Export Config')end
            return ok,message
        end
        if not store or not store.exportJson then return result(false,'Settings storage is still initializing')end
        local ok,encoded=store.exportJson()
        if not ok then return result(false,encoded)end
        if type(host.setclipboard)~='function'then return result(false,'Clipboard access is unavailable')end
        local copied,message=pcall(host.setclipboard,encoded)
        if not copied then return result(false,'Cannot copy configuration: '..tostring(message))end
        result(true,'Copied complete configuration JSON to the clipboard')
        return true,encoded
    end
    local function loadConfig()
        local store=menu.configStore
        if not store or not store.importJson then
            local message='Settings storage is still initializing'
            if menu.reportConfigResult then menu.reportConfigResult(false,message,'Load Config')end
            return false,message
        end
        local ok,message=store.importJson(control.importBuffer)
        if menu.reportConfigResult then menu.reportConfigResult(ok,message or 'Imported configuration','Load Config')end
        return ok,message
    end
    local function hop()
        local http=game:GetService('HttpService')
        local url='https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/'..tostring(game.PlaceId)..'/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100'
        local get=host.request or host.http_request
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local text=if type(get)=='function'then get({Url=url,Method='GET'}).Body else game:HttpGet(url)
            return http:JSONDecode(text)
        end)
        if not ok or type(result)~='table'then return false,'Cannot read the current server list'end
        -- HTTP can yield. A later focus/chat pause must still stop a pending
        -- deliberate menu action before it changes servers.
        if menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()then return false,'Server hop paused; return to the game and try again'end
        for _,server in result.data or {}do
            if type(server.id)=='string'and server.id~=game.JobId and (server.playing or 0)<(server.maxPlayers or 0)then
                game:GetService('TeleportService'):TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId,server.id,player)
                return true
            end
        end
        return false,'No other available server was returned'
    end

    function control.callback(tab,name,config,callbackSourceId)
        local handler=handlers[tonumber(callbackSourceId)]
        if not handler then control.unsupported[tostring(tab)..'/'..tostring(name)]=tonumber(callbackSourceId)or true;return nil end
        local key=tostring(tab)..'/'..tostring(name)
        if callbackSourceId==192 then
            config.Description='Legacy local velocity pulses and temporary noclip for contact testing. Server results vary. Pauses during block, dash, skills or active aim; turning off restores owned state.'
            config.Default=false
        elseif callbackSourceId==208 then
            config.Description='Move an invisible camera anchor with WASD at 30 studs/s while locally teleporting nearby, with a 30% chance to move behind a character within 40 studs. Block and aim take priority.'
            config.Default=false
        end
        if control.callbacks[key]then return control.callbacks[key]end
        local fn=function(...)
            if not control.alive then return false,'Native features are unloaded'end
            if config.FailsafeGameplayAction and menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused() then return false,'Failsafe has paused game actions'end
            local result=table.pack(pcall(handler,...))
            if not result[1]then control.errors[key]=tostring(result[2]);return false,control.errors[key]end
            if result[2]==false then control.errors[key]=tostring(result[3]or'Native request was not accepted')else control.errors[key]=nil end
            return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
        end
        control.callbacks[key]=fn
        return fn
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()
        local allowed={WalkSpeed=true,HipHeight=true,PlatformStand=true,AutoRotate=true,Velocity=true}
        for object,properties in control.written do
            for property in properties do
                if allowed[property] or (property=='Value' and object.Name=='DashMultiplier') then
                    restore(object,property)
                    if property=='Value' and object.Name=='DashMultiplier' and control.owned[object] then object:Destroy();control.owned[object]=nil end
                end
            end
        end
        stopFlight();restoreCollision();releaseMotionWrites();releaseMotionCamera()
        motion.forward,motion.right,motion.jump=0,0,false
    end
    function control.onFailsafeResume()
        control.refreshTargets()
        local character,humanoid=body()
        if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return end
        if control.walkSpeed>0 then write(humanoid,'WalkSpeed',control.walkSpeed) end
        if control.hipHeight~=nil then write(humanoid,'HipHeight',control.hipHeight) end
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local multiplier=info and info:FindFirstChild('DashMultiplier')
        local current=multiplier and multiplier:IsA('NumberValue')and finite(multiplier.Value,nil)
        local repairOwned=multiplier and control.owned[multiplier]and(not current or current<1 or current>5)
        if control.dashMultiplier~=1 or repairOwned then applyDashMultiplier() end
        if control.noclip then control.applyNoclip() end
        if control.flyActive then control.flyActive=false;control.setFlight(true) end
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if motion.mode then control.setMainMotion(motion.mode,false)end
        stopFlight();restoreCollision();disconnect(control.characterConnections);disconnect(control.connections);restoreInvisible()
        control.setItemNames(false);control.setCooldowns(false)
        for object,record in control.written do for property in record do restore(object,property)end end
        for object in control.owned do if object.Parent then object:Destroy()end end
        table.clear(control.owned)
        flags.NoclipEnabled=false;flags.InfJumpEnabled=false;flags.AntiStun=false;flags.AntiNoJump=false;flags.AntiNoSprint=false
        control.infRange=false;control.spinner=false;control.alive=false
        if environment.SetFlight==control.setFlight then environment.SetFlight=previousFlight end
        if environment.ToggleFly==nativeToggle then environment.ToggleFly=previousToggle end
        if environment.GetPlayerSettings==getSettings then environment.GetPlayerSettings=previousGetSettings end
        local hook=control.markerCreateHook
        if hook and hook.owner.create==hook.wrapper then hook.owner.create=hook.original end
    end
    return control
end

return NativeBaseFeatures
end)()

local Appearance = {}

function Appearance.new(host, env, menu)
    local game=host.game
    local players=game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local lighting=game:GetService('Lighting')
    local runService=game:GetService('RunService')
    local world=host.workspace or game:GetService('Workspace')
    local Instance,Enum,CFrame,Vector3=host.Instance,host.Enum,host.CFrame,host.Vector3
    local Color3=host.Color3
    local taskLibrary=host.task or env.task
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled={},objects={},errors={},connections={},meshSlots={},meshObjects={},tracks={}}
    local shared=env._G or env
    local state={daySpeed=1,afterLife=.5,afterStart=Color3.new(1,1,1),afterEnd=Color3.new(0,0,0),trailColor=Color3.new(1,1,1),
        vfxColor=Color3.new(1,0,0),shirt='',pants='',selectedEmote='Objection',loop=false,freeze=false,
        specialName='Cooking',selectedMusic='Infinite Void',customMusic='0',musicEnabled=false,meshEnabled=false,
        debrisDistance=5,debrisRate=5,debrisDelay=.1,killSound='',
        meshEditor={SlotName='Slot 1',BodyPart='Torso',MeshId='',TextureId='',Offset='0, 0, 0',Rotation='0, 0, 0'}}
    local activePreset,activeStyle,activeBlockStyle
    local originalLighting,originalSkies={},{}
    local lightKeys={'Ambient','OutdoorAmbient','Brightness','EnvironmentDiffuseScale','EnvironmentSpecularScale','ShadowSoftness','ExposureCompensation','ColorShift_Bottom','ColorShift_Top','GlobalShadows','ClockTime','FogColor','FogStart','FogEnd'}
    for _,key in lightKeys do pcall(function()originalLighting[key]=lighting[key]end)end
    local function character()return player and player.Character end
    local aliases={Torso={'Torso','UpperTorso','LowerTorso'},['Left Arm']={'Left Arm','LeftUpperArm','LeftHand'},['Right Arm']={'Right Arm','RightUpperArm','RightHand'},['Left Leg']={'Left Leg','LeftUpperLeg','LeftFoot'},['Right Leg']={'Right Leg','RightUpperLeg','RightFoot'}}
    local function part(name)
        local model=character();if not model then return nil end
        for _,candidate in aliases[name]or{name}do local item=model:FindFirstChild(candidate);if item then return item end end
        return nil
    end
    local function anchor(name)
        if name=='Lighting'then return lighting elseif name=='Workspace'then return world elseif name=='Character'then return character()
        elseif name=='CoreGui'or name=='PlayerGui'then return player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')or player:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')end
        return part(name)
    end
    local function note(name,message)control.errors[name]=tostring(message);return false end
    local function own(name,object)
        local list=control.objects[name];if not list then list={};control.objects[name]=list end
        table.insert(list,object);return object
    end
    local function clear(name)
        for _,object in control.objects[name]or{}do pcall(object.Destroy,object)end
        control.objects[name]=nil
    end
    local function value(data,objects)
        if type(data)~='table'then return data end
        if data.Ref then return objects[data.Ref]end
        if data.Anchor then return anchor(data.Anchor)end
        if data.Enum then
            local result=Enum;for segment in data.Enum:gmatch('[^.]+')do if segment~='Enum'then result=result[segment]end end
            return result
        end
        local kind=data.Kind or data.Type
        if kind=='AnchorProperty'then local item=part(data.Args[1]);return item and item[data.Method]end
        if kind=='Property'then local object=value(data.Args[1],objects);return object and object[data.Method]end
        if kind=='Operation'then
            local first,second=value(data.Args[1],objects),value(data.Args[2],objects)
            if data.Method=='mul'then return first*second elseif data.Method=='add'then return first+second
            elseif data.Method=='sub'then return first-second elseif data.Method=='neg'then return -first end
        end
        if kind then
            if kind=='Color3'and not data.Args then return Color3.new(data.R,data.G,data.B)end
            local constructor=host[kind]
            if not constructor then error('Native constructor unavailable: '..tostring(kind))end
            local args={};for index,item in data.Args or{}do args[index]=value(item,objects)end
            return constructor[data.Method or'new'](table.unpack(args))
        end
        local result={};for key,item in data do result[key]=value(item,objects)end;return result
    end
    local function restoreLighting()
        if activePreset then clear(activePreset);control.enabled[activePreset]=false;activePreset=nil end
        for key,item in originalLighting do pcall(function()lighting[key]=item end)end
        for object,parent in originalSkies do if object then pcall(function()object.Parent=parent end)end end
        table.clear(originalSkies)
    end
    local function applyBlueprint(name,enabled)
        clear(name);control.enabled[name]=enabled==true
        if not enabled then if activePreset==name then restoreLighting()end;return true end
        local blueprint=recovered.blueprints[name]
        if not blueprint then return note(name,'Original appearance properties unavailable')end
        if blueprint.Tab=='Fun'and name~='Four Arms'then
            restoreLighting();activePreset=name;control.enabled[name]=true
            for _,object in lighting:GetChildren()do if object:IsA('Sky')then originalSkies[object]=object.Parent;object.Parent=nil end end
        elseif(blueprint.Tab=='Aura'or name=='Four Arms')and not character()then return true end
        local objects={}
        local ok,message=pcall(function()
            for _,record in blueprint.Objects do objects[record.Id]=own(name,Instance.new(record.Class))end
            for _,record in blueprint.Objects do
                local object=objects[record.Id]
                for key,item in record.Properties do
                    if key~='Parent'then
                        local success,errorMessage=pcall(function()object[key]=value(item,objects)end)
                        if not success then control.errors[name..'/'..key]=tostring(errorMessage)end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _,record in blueprint.Objects do
                if record.Properties.Parent then objects[record.Id].Parent=value(record.Properties.Parent,objects)end
            end
            for key,item in blueprint.Lighting do lighting[key]=value(item,objects)end
        end)
        if not ok then clear(name);return note(name,message)end
        return true
    end
    local function stopTrack(key)
        local track=control.tracks[key]
        if track then pcall(track.Stop,track,.1);pcall(track.Destroy,track);control.tracks[key]=nil end
    end
    local function stopStyle()
        stopTrack('styleIdle');stopTrack('styleRun');control.styleCharacter=nil
    end
    local function animator()
        local model=character();local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid then return nil,nil end
        local result=humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
        if not result then result=Instance.new('Animator');result.Parent=humanoid end
        return result,humanoid
    end
    local function animationId(input)
        local digits=tostring(input or''):match('(%d+)');return digits and'rbxassetid://'..digits
    end
    local function loadTrack(key,id,priority,looped)
        stopTrack(key)
        local controller=animator();if not controller then return nil end
        local animation=Instance.new('Animation');animation.AnimationId=animationId(id)
        local ok,track=pcall(controller.LoadAnimation,controller,animation);animation:Destroy()
        if not ok then note(key,track);return nil end
        track.Priority=priority or Enum.AnimationPriority.Action;track.Looped=looped==true
        control.tracks[key]=track;return track
    end
    local ids=recovered.animationIds
    local profiles={
        ['Mokou Animations']={idle=ids.MokouIdle,run=ids.MokouRun,start=1.7,finish=1.9,idleSpeed=.2},
        ['Super Tze Animations']={idle=ids.SuperTzeIdle,run=ids.SuperTzeRun,start=0,finish=.1,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Tuff Animations']={idle=ids.SuperSigmaIdle,run=ids.SuperSigmaRun,start=1.6,finish=1.7,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Wally West Animations']={idle=ids.WaollyIdle,run=ids.WaollyWestRun,start=1.5,finish=1.6,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Mahoraga Animations']={idle=ids.MahoIdle,run=ids.MahoRun,start=1.6,finish=1.7,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Choppy Anims']={idle=ids.Knj8BitAnimsIdle,run=ids.Knj8BitAnimsRun,start=.6,finish=1.6,idleSpeed=.3,choppy=true},
        ['Jevil']={idle=ids.evilJIdle,run=ids.evilJRun,start=0,finish=1.6,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Tenna']={idle=ids.AnttennaAnimsIdle,run=ids.AnttennaAnimsRun,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Yuji Jump']={idle=ids.YujiJumpAnimsIdle,run=ids.YujiJumpAnimsRun,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Jojo Stand']={idle=ids.JojoStandAnimsIdle,run=ids.JojoStandAnimsRun,idleSpeed=.3},
        ['Flicker']={idle=ids.FlickerAnimsIdle,run=ids.FlickerAnimsRun,start=.2,finish=.3,idleSpeed=3},
        ['Chara']={idle=ids.KnjTufferTwooIdle,run=ids.KnjTufferTwooRun,freeze=4.82,idleSpeed=0},
        ['Ryu Larp']={idle=ids.KnjLarpryuIdle,run=ids.KnjLarpryuRun,freeze=2,idleSpeed=0},
    }
    local blockStyles={['Invisible Block']=ids.InvBlockID,['Chara Block']=ids.CharaBlockID,['Charles Block']=ids.CharlesBlockID,
        ['Gojo Block']=ids.GojoBlockID,['Haruta Block']=ids.HarutaBlockID,['Higuruma Sword']=ids.HiguSwordID,
        ['Yuji Block']=ids.YujiID,['Mahito Super Ult']=ids.MahitoID,['Mechamaru']=ids.MechID,

    local function setStyle(name,enabled)
        if activeStyle and activeStyle~=name then control.enabled[activeStyle]=false end
        stopStyle();activeStyle=if enabled then name else nil;control.enabled[name]=enabled==true
        return true
    end
    local function blocking()
        local model=character();local info=model and model:FindFirstChild('Info');local block=info and info:FindFirstChild('Block')
        if block then local ok,result=pcall(function()return block.Value end);return ok and(result==true or result==1)end
        return model and model:GetAttribute('Blocking')==true
    end
    local function setBlockStyle(name,enabled)
        if activeBlockStyle and activeBlockStyle~=name then control.enabled[activeBlockStyle]=false end
        stopTrack('blockStyle');activeBlockStyle=if enabled then name else nil;control.enabled[name]=enabled==true
        return true
    end
    local function parseColor(input,fallback)
        if menu.colorValue then return menu.colorValue(input,fallback)end
        return if (host.typeof or typeof)(input)=='Color3'then input else fallback
    end
    local clothingOriginal=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    local function applyClothing()
        local model=character();if not model then return false end
        for _,entry in {{'Shirt','ShirtTemplate',state.shirt},{'Pants','PantsTemplate',state.pants}}do
            if entry[3]~=''then
                local object=model:FindFirstChildOfClass(entry[1]);if not object then object=own('clothing',Instance.new(entry[1]));object.Parent=model end
                if clothingOriginal[object]==nil then clothingOriginal[object]=object[entry[2]]end
                object[entry[2]]=animationId(entry[3])or''
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function morph(userId)
        userId=tonumber(userId);if not userId or userId<=0 then return note('morph','Enter a numeric Roblox UserId')end
        taskLibrary.spawn(function()
            local model=character();local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');if not humanoid then return end
            local ok,description=pcall(players.GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId,players,userId)
            if not ok then note('morph',description);return end
            if not control.alive or model~=character()then description:Destroy();return end
            if not control.originalDescription then pcall(function()control.originalDescription=humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()end)end
            local applied,message=pcall(humanoid.ApplyDescription,humanoid,description)
            if not applied then note('morph',message)end
            if applied then
                local head=model:FindFirstChild('Head')
                if head and not head:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal')then
                    local face=Instance.new('Decal');face.Name='face';face.Face=Enum.NormalId.Front
                    face.Texture='rbxasset://textures/face.png';face.Parent=head
                end
            end
            description:Destroy()
        end)
        return true
    end
    local function setSelfFling(enabled)
        clear('Self Fling');control.enabled['Self Fling']=enabled==true
        local root=part('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then return true end
        if enabled then
            control.flingVelocity=root.AssemblyAngularVelocity
            local force=own('Self Fling',Instance.new('BodyAngularVelocity'));force.Name='FlingBAV'
            force.AngularVelocity=Vector3.new(0,99999,0);force.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge);force.P=math.huge;force.Parent=root
        elseif control.flingVelocity then root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=control.flingVelocity;control.flingVelocity=nil end
        return true
    end
    local function triples(input)
        local result={};for token in tostring(input or''):gmatch('[-+]?%d*%.?%d+')do table.insert(result,tonumber(token))end
        return result[1]or 0,result[2]or 0,result[3]or 0
    end
    local function rebuildMeshes()
        clear('meshes');if not state.meshEnabled or not character()then return end
        for name,slot in control.meshSlots do
            local target=part(slot.BodyPart);local meshId=animationId(slot.MeshId)
            if target and meshId then
                local body=own('meshes',Instance.new('Part'));body.Name='ShenaniganismMesh_'..name
                body.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1);body.CanCollide=false;body.CanTouch=false;body.CanQuery=false;body.Massless=true
                local x,y,z=triples(slot.Offset);local rx,ry,rz=triples(slot.Rotation)
                local offset=CFrame.new(x,y,z)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx),math.rad(ry),math.rad(rz))
                body.CFrame=target.CFrame*offset;body.Parent=character()
                local mesh=own('meshes',Instance.new('SpecialMesh'));mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh;mesh.MeshId=meshId
                mesh.TextureId=animationId(slot.TextureId)or'';mesh.Parent=body
                local weld=own('meshes',Instance.new('Weld'));weld.Part0=target;weld.Part1=body;weld.C0=offset;weld.Parent=body
            end
        end
    end
    local recolorOriginal=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    local function paint(object,trailOnly)
        local ok,class=pcall(function()return object.ClassName end);if not ok then return end
        local eligible=if trailOnly then class=='Trail'and object.Name=='CombatTrail'else class=='ParticleEmitter'or class=='Trail'or class=='Beam'or class=='PointLight'or class=='SpotLight'or class=='SurfaceLight'
        if not eligible then return end
        if not trailOnly then
            local model=character();if not model or not object:IsDescendantOf(model)then return end
        end
        if recolorOriginal[object]==nil then pcall(function()recolorOriginal[object]=object.Color end)end
        local color=if trailOnly then state.trailColor else state.vfxColor
        pcall(function()object.Color=if class=='ParticleEmitter'or class=='Trail'or class=='Beam'then host.ColorSequence.new(color)else color end)
    end
    local function restoreColors()
        for object,color in recolorOriginal do pcall(function()object.Color=color end)end
        table.clear(recolorOriginal)
    end
    local function refreshPaint()
        if control.enabled['Combat Trail Color']then for _,object in world:GetDescendants()do paint(object,true)end end
        if control.enabled['VFX Recolor']and character()then for _,object in character():GetDescendants()do paint(object,false)end end
    end
    local function stopEmote()stopTrack('emote');stopTrack('specialEmote');control.specialMode=nil end
    local function playEmote()
        stopEmote()
        local id=recovered.emotes[state.selectedEmote];if not id then return note('emote','Choose a recovered animation')end
        local track=loadTrack('emote',id,Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,state.loop)
        if track then track:Play(.1,1,1);return true end;return false
    end
    local function playSpecial(mode)
        stopEmote();local specification=recovered.specialEmotes[state.specialName]
        if not specification then return note('specialEmote','Choose a recovered special animation')end
        local track=loadTrack('specialEmote',specification.Id,Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,false)
        if not track then return false end
        control.specialMode=mode;track:Play(.1,1,1)
        track.TimePosition=specification[if mode=='toggle'then'ToggleStart'else'ButtonStart']or 0
        return true
    end
    local function stopMusic()
        if control.sound then pcall(control.sound.Stop,control.sound);pcall(control.sound.Destroy,control.sound);control.sound=nil end
        control.playingMusic=nil
    end
    local function inUltimate()
        local gui=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui');local main=gui and gui:FindFirstChild('Main');local holder=main and main:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not holder then return false end
        for _,frame in holder:GetChildren()do
            local label=frame:FindFirstChild('ItemName');local name=label and label.Text
            if name and recovered.UltMoves[name]then return true elseif name and recovered.BaseMoves[name]then return false end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function updateMusic()
        if not state.musicEnabled or not inUltimate()then stopMusic();return end
        local id=if state.customMusic~=''and state.customMusic~='0'then animationId(state.customMusic)else animationId(recovered.music[state.selectedMusic])
        if not id then return end
        if control.sound and control.playingMusic==id then return end
        stopMusic();local sound=Instance.new('Sound');sound.Name='ShenaniganismUltMusic';sound.SoundId=id
        sound.Volume=.4;sound.Looped=true;sound.RollOffMaxDistance=150;sound.RollOffMinDistance=15
        sound.Parent=part('HumanoidRootPart')or game:GetService('SoundService');sound:Play();control.sound=sound;control.playingMusic=id
    end
    local deathNames={'Death Ultrakill','Death Hotline','Death Undertale','Death Dissapear','Death Wasted','Death DarkSouls','Death Skull'}
    local function clearDeath()
        control.deathToken=(control.deathToken or 0)+1
        for _,name in deathNames do clear(name)end
        if control.deathCamera and world.CurrentCamera then world.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView=control.deathCamera end
        control.deathCamera=nil
    end
    local function soundOnce(id,parent,volume)
        local sound=Instance.new('Sound');sound.SoundId=animationId(id);sound.Volume=volume or 1
        sound.RollOffMaxDistance=75;sound.RollOffMinDistance=10;sound.RollOffMode=Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
        sound.Parent=parent or game:GetService('SoundService');sound.PlayOnRemove=true;sound:Play();sound:Destroy()
    end
    local function showDeath()
        if not control.enabled['Death Screens']then return end
        clearDeath();local token=control.deathToken
        local choice=deathNames[math.random(1,6)]
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera;control.deathCamera=camera and camera.FieldOfView
        applyBlueprint(choice,true)
        local function later(seconds,callback)
            taskLibrary.delay(seconds,function()if control.alive and control.enabled['Death Screens']and control.deathToken==token then callback()end end)
        end
        if choice=='Death Ultrakill'then
            soundOnce('72065177541762')
            later(2,function()
                clear(choice);applyBlueprint('Death Skull',true)
                local image
                for _,object in control.objects['Death Skull']or{}do if object:IsA('ImageLabel')then image=object;break end end
                if image then
                    image.Image='rbxassetid://139953963425773'
                    for index=0,2 do
                        later(index+.7,function()if image.Parent then image.Image='rbxassetid://87428252808810'end end)
                        later(index+1,function()if image.Parent then image.Image='rbxassetid://139953963425773'end end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        elseif choice=='Death Undertale'then
            local image
            for _,object in control.objects[choice]or{}do if object:IsA('ImageLabel')then image=object;break end end
            if image then
                image.Image='rbxassetid://134218178924310'
                later(.5,function()if image.Parent then image.Image='rbxassetid://12104764025';soundOnce('114355233102700')end end)
                later(2.5,function()if image.Parent then image.Visible=false end end)
            end
        elseif choice=='Death Dissapear'then
            soundOnce('9114221327')
            for _,body in character()and character():GetChildren()or{}do
                if body:IsA('BasePart')then
                    body.Material=Enum.Material.Neon;body.Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255)
                    game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(body,host.TweenInfo.new(2,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Transparency=1,Size=body.Size*1.2}):Play()
                end
            end
        end
        later(6,clearDeath)
    end
    local function bindDeath()
        if control.deathConnection then control.deathConnection:Disconnect();control.deathConnection=nil end
        if not control.enabled['Death Screens']then return end
        local model=character();local humanoid=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid and humanoid.Died then control.deathConnection=humanoid.Died:Connect(showDeath)end
    end
    local killConnections={}
    local function hookKillSound(humanoid)
        if state.killSound==''or killConnections[humanoid]or not humanoid:IsA('Humanoid')then return end
        killConnections[humanoid]=humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            if control.alive and state.killSound~=''then
                local model=humanoid.Parent;local root=model and(model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')or model:FindFirstChild('Head'))
                soundOnce(state.killSound,root,1)
            end
        end)
    end
    local ghostAt,stepAt,musicAt,debrisAt=0,0,0,0
    local function spawnDebris(now)
        if not control.enabled.Debris or now-debrisAt<state.debrisDelay then return end;debrisAt=now
        local root=part('HumanoidRootPart');if not root then return end
        local parameters=host.RaycastParams.new();parameters.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances={character()}
        local hit=world:Raycast(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,0),Vector3.new(0,-10,0),parameters)
        local surface=hit and hit.Instance;if not surface or not surface:IsA('BasePart')then return end
        local distance=math.max(0,math.floor(state.debrisDistance))
        for _=1,state.debrisRate do
            local scale=math.random(2,5)/10;local body=Instance.new('Part');body.Name='DebrisPiece'
            body.Color=surface.Color;body.Material=surface.Material;body.Size=Vector3.new(scale,scale,scale)
            body.Anchored=false;body.CanCollide=false;body.CanTouch=false;body.CanQuery=false
            body.CFrame=CFrame.new(root.Position+Vector3.new(math.random(-distance,distance),-1,math.random(-distance,distance)));body.Parent=world
            body:ApplyImpulse(Vector3.new(math.random(-20,20),math.random(40,80),math.random(-20,20))*body:GetMass())
            local life=math.random(15,30)/10
            game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(body,host.TweenInfo.new(life,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{Transparency=1,Size=Vector3.new(0,0,0)}):Play()
            game:GetService('Debris'):AddItem(body,life)
        end
    end
    local function afterImage(now)
        if not control.enabled['After-Images']or now-ghostAt<.1 then return end;ghostAt=now
        local model=character();if not model then return end
        local duration=math.max(.05,state.afterLife)
        for _,sourcePart in model:GetChildren()do
            if sourcePart:IsA('BasePart')and sourcePart.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'then
                local ghost=Instance.new('Part');ghost.Name='ShenaniganismAfterImage';ghost.Size=sourcePart.Size;ghost.CFrame=sourcePart.CFrame
                ghost.Anchored=true;ghost.CanCollide=false;ghost.CanTouch=false;ghost.CanQuery=false;ghost.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
                ghost.Color=state.afterStart;ghost.Transparency=.45;ghost.Parent=world
                local tween=game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(ghost,host.TweenInfo.new(duration),{Transparency=1,Color=state.afterEnd});tween:Play()
                game:GetService('Debris'):AddItem(ghost,duration+.05)
            end
        end
    end
    local function step(dt)
        if not control.alive then return end
        local now=os.clock();afterImage(now);spawnDebris(now)
        if control.enabled.Spinner then local root=part('HumanoidRootPart');if root then root.CFrame=root.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(50),0)end end
        if control.enabled['Day Night Cycle']then lighting.ClockTime=(lighting.ClockTime+dt*state.daySpeed)%24 end
        if now-stepAt<.05 then return end;stepAt=now
        local model=character()
