        if control.enabled['Super Tze Flying']then
            local flying=env.FlyActive or shared.FlyActive
            if flying then
                local track=control.tracks.flyStyle or loadTrack('flyStyle','91428863336534',Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,true)
                if track then if not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(.1)end;if track.TimePosition>=.1 then track.TimePosition=0 end end
            else stopTrack('flyStyle')end
        end
        if activeStyle then
            local profile=profiles[activeStyle];local controller,humanoid=animator()
            if controller and profile then
                if control.styleCharacter~=model then
                    stopStyle();control.styleCharacter=model
                    loadTrack('styleIdle',profile.idle,Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,true)
                    loadTrack('styleRun',profile.run,Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,true)
                end
                local running=humanoid.WalkSpeed>=20 and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude>0
                local key=if running then'styleRun'else'styleIdle';local other=control.tracks[if running then'styleIdle'else'styleRun'];local track=control.tracks[key]
                if other and other.IsPlaying then other:Stop(.1)end
                if track then
                    if not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(.1,1,if running then 1 else profile.idleSpeed or.3);track.TimePosition=if running then 0 else profile.start or profile.freeze or 0 end
                    if not running and profile.freeze then track.TimePosition=profile.freeze;track:AdjustSpeed(0)
                    elseif profile.finish and track.TimePosition>=profile.finish then track.TimePosition=if running then 0 else profile.start or 0 end
                end
            end
        end
        if activeBlockStyle then
            if blocking()then
                local track=control.tracks.blockStyle
                if not track then
                    local id=blockStyles[activeBlockStyle]
                    if activeBlockStyle=='Dodge Block'then local choices={ids.GojoBlockID,ids.HarutaBlockID,ids.HiguSwordID};id=choices[math.random(1,#choices)]end
                    track=loadTrack('blockStyle',id,Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4,true)
                end
                if track and not track.IsPlaying then track:Play(0,1,1)end
            else stopTrack('blockStyle')end
        end
        local emote=control.tracks.emote
        if emote and state.freeze and emote.Length>0 and emote.TimePosition>=math.max(0,emote.Length-.05)then emote:AdjustSpeed(0)end
        local special=control.tracks.specialEmote
        if special and control.specialMode then
            local specification=recovered.specialEmotes[state.specialName];local toggle=control.specialMode=='toggle'
            local finish=specification[if toggle then'ToggleEnd'else'ButtonEnd']
            if finish and special.TimePosition>=finish then
                if toggle and specification.ToggleLoop then special.TimePosition=specification.ToggleStart or 0
                else special.TimePosition=specification[if toggle then'ToggleFreeze'else'ButtonFreeze']or finish;special:AdjustSpeed(0)end
            end
        end
        if now-musicAt>=.5 then musicAt=now;updateMusic()end
    end
    function control.callback(tab,name,config,sourceId)
        if recovered.blueprints[name]then return function(value)return applyBlueprint(name,value)end end
        if tab=='Animation'then
            if profiles[name]then return function(value)return setStyle(name,value)end end
            if blockStyles[name]or name=='Dodge Block'then return function(value)return setBlockStyle(name,value)end end
            if name=='Super Tze Flying'then return function(value)
                control.enabled[name]=value==true;stopTrack('flyStyle')
                if value and(env.FlyActive or shared.FlyActive)then local track=loadTrack('flyStyle','91428863336534',Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,true);if track then track:Play(.1)end end
            end end
        elseif tab=='Transform'then
            if name=='Shirt ID'then return function(value)state.shirt=tostring(value);return applyClothing()end
            elseif name=='Pants ID'then return function(value)state.pants=tostring(value);return applyClothing()end
            elseif name=='Apply Clothing'then return applyClothing
            elseif name=='Transform Into User'then return function(value)if menu.restoringControls then return end;return morph(value)end
            elseif name=='Transform Into Roblox'then return function()return morph(1)end end
            if name=='Transform Into Tze'then return function()return morph(1241352401)end end
        elseif tab=='Fun'then
            if name=='Original'then return function()restoreLighting();local camera=world.CurrentCamera;if camera then camera.FieldOfView=70 end;return true end
            elseif name=='Day Night Speed'then return function(value)state.daySpeed=math.clamp(tonumber(value)or 1,0,100)end
            elseif name=='Day Night Cycle'then return function(value)control.enabled[name]=value==true;if not value then lighting.ClockTime=originalLighting.ClockTime end end end
            if name=='Spinner'then return function(value)control.enabled[name]=value==true end
            elseif name=='Self Fling'then return setSelfFling
            elseif name=='Death Screens'then return function(value)control.enabled[name]=value==true;bindDeath();if not value then clearDeath()end end
            elseif name=='Kill Sound'then return function(value)
                state.killSound=animationId(value)or''
                for humanoid,connection in killConnections do connection:Disconnect();killConnections[humanoid]=nil end
                if state.killSound~=''then for _,object in world:GetDescendants()do if object:IsA('Humanoid')then hookKillSound(object)end end end
            end end
        elseif tab=='Aura'then
            if name=='Debris'then return function(value)control.enabled.Debris=value==true end
            elseif name=='Debris Spawn Distance'then return function(value)state.debrisDistance=math.max(0,tonumber(value)or 5)end
            elseif name=='Debris Amount'then return function(value)state.debrisRate=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(value)or 5))end
            elseif name=='Spawn Delay'then return function(value)state.debrisDelay=math.max(.01,tonumber(value)or.1)end end
        elseif tab=='Skill'then
            if name=='Combat Trail Color'then
                if config and config.kind=='CreateColorPicker'or sourceId==536 then return function(value)state.trailColor=parseColor(value,state.trailColor);refreshPaint()end end
                return function(value)control.enabled[name]=value==true;if not value then restoreColors()end;refreshPaint()end
            elseif name=='After-Images'then return function(value)control.enabled[name]=value==true end
            elseif name=='After-Image Lifetime'then return function(value)state.afterLife=math.clamp(tonumber(value)or.5,.05,10)end
            elseif name=='After-Image Start Color'then return function(value)state.afterStart=parseColor(value,state.afterStart)end
            elseif name=='After-Image End Color'then return function(value)state.afterEnd=parseColor(value,state.afterEnd)end
            elseif name=='VFX Recolor'then return function(value)control.enabled[name]=value==true;if not value then restoreColors()end;refreshPaint()end
            elseif name=='VFX Color'then return function(value)state.vfxColor=parseColor(value,state.vfxColor);refreshPaint()end
            elseif name=='Mesh'then return function(value)state.meshEnabled=value==true;rebuildMeshes()end
            elseif name=='Save / Update Mesh'then return function()local key=state.meshEditor.SlotName;if key==''then return false end;control.meshSlots[key]=table.clone(state.meshEditor);rebuildMeshes();return true end
            elseif name=='Remove Mesh'then return function()control.meshSlots[state.meshEditor.SlotName]=nil;rebuildMeshes();return true end
            elseif name=='Clear All Meshes'then return function()table.clear(control.meshSlots);rebuildMeshes();return true end end
            local field=({['Mesh Slot Name']='SlotName',['Mesh Body Part']='BodyPart',['Mesh Id']='MeshId',['Mesh Texture']='TextureId',['Mesh Position']='Offset',['Mesh Rotation']='Rotation'})[name]
            if field then return function(value)state.meshEditor[field]=tostring(value)end end
        elseif tab=='Emote'then
            if name=='Animation'then return function(value)state.selectedEmote=value;if control.enabled.Play then playEmote()end end
            elseif name=='Play'then return function(value)control.enabled.Play=value==true;if value then return playEmote()else stopEmote()end;return nil end
            elseif name=='Loop'then return function(value)state.loop=value==true;if value then state.freeze=false end;local track=control.tracks.emote;if track then track.Looped=state.loop end end
            elseif name=='End Freeze'then return function(value)state.freeze=value==true;if value then state.loop=false end;local track=control.tracks.emote;if track then track.Looped=state.loop;track:AdjustSpeed(1)end end
            elseif name=='Special Animation'then return function(value)state.specialName=value;if control.enabled['Special Toggle']then playSpecial('toggle')end end
            elseif name=='Special Toggle'then return function(value)control.enabled[name]=value==true;if value then return playSpecial('toggle')else stopEmote()end;return nil end
            elseif name=='Special Button'then return function()return playSpecial('button')end end
        elseif tab=='Music'then
            if name=='Ultimate Musics'then return function(value)state.selectedMusic=value;updateMusic()end
            elseif name=='Custom Music'then return function(value)state.customMusic=tostring(value);updateMusic()end
            elseif name=='Enable Ult Music'then return function(value)state.musicEnabled=value==true;updateMusic()end
            elseif name=='Stop Music'then return stopMusic end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end;control.alive=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        if control.deathConnection then control.deathConnection:Disconnect()end
        for _,connection in killConnections do connection:Disconnect()end
        clearDeath();setSelfFling(false)
        stopStyle();stopTrack('blockStyle');stopTrack('flyStyle');stopEmote();stopMusic();restoreLighting();restoreColors()
        for name in table.clone(control.objects)do clear(name)end
        for object,template in clothingOriginal do pcall(function()object[if object:IsA('Shirt')then'ShirtTemplate'else'PantsTemplate']=template end)end
        if control.originalDescription then
            local _,humanoid=animator();if humanoid then pcall(humanoid.ApplyDescription,humanoid,control.originalDescription)end
            control.originalDescription:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.insert(control.connections,runService.Heartbeat:Connect(step))
    table.insert(control.connections,world.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
        if state.killSound~=''and object:IsA('Humanoid')then hookKillSound(object)end
        if control.enabled['Combat Trail Color']then paint(object,true)end
        if control.enabled['VFX Recolor']then paint(object,false)end
    end))
    table.insert(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        stopStyle();stopTrack('blockStyle');stopTrack('flyStyle');stopEmote()
        taskLibrary.defer(function()
            if not control.alive then return end
            for name,enabled in control.enabled do if enabled and recovered.blueprints[name]and recovered.blueprints[name].Tab=='Aura'then applyBlueprint(name,true)end end
            rebuildMeshes();applyClothing();refreshPaint()
            bindDeath();clearDeath()
        end)
    end))
    control.data=recovered;control.state=state;control.profiles=profiles;control.blockStyles=blockStyles
    return control
end
return Appearance
end)()

local NativeAutomaticFeatures = (function(): any
-- Direct native replacements for the remaining original automatic callbacks.
-- Timings and remote names are recovered from original callbacks 244, 313,
-- 365, 372, 376 and 385. No bytecode interpreter is included here.
local NativeAutomaticFeatures={}
function NativeAutomaticFeatures.new(host,environment,menu)
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local bindings=menu.bindings or menu.nativeFeatureHost.bindings
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled={},generation={},connections={},busy={},timers={},nativeMissing={}}
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback);table.insert(control.connections,connection);return connection
    end
    local function moveset()
        local character=player.Character
        return character and character.Parent and character:GetAttribute('Moveset')
    end
    local function keyMatches(object,role)
        local binding=bindings.get(role)
        return binding and (if binding.kind=='Mouse' then object.UserInputType.Name==binding.name else object.KeyCode.Name==binding.name)
    end
    local function invalidate(name)
        control.generation[name]=(control.generation[name] or 0)+1
        control.busy[name]=nil
    end
    local function setEnabled(name,value)
        invalidate(name);control.enabled[name]=value==true
    end
    local function execute(name,delay,callback)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled[name] or control.busy[name] then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local token=control.generation[name]
        control.busy[name]=true
        host.task.spawn(function()
            local function valid()
                return control.alive and control.enabled[name] and control.generation[name]==token and player.Character==character and character and character.Parent
            end
            host.task.wait(delay)
            if valid() then
                local ok,message=pcall(callback,valid)
                if not ok then control.lastError=name..': '..tostring(message) end
            end
            if control.generation[name]==token then control.busy[name]=nil end
        end)
    end
    local function tap(binding,valid,duration)
        if not binding or not valid() then return false end
        if not bindings.send(binding,true,false) then return false end
        host.task.wait(duration or .01)
        bindings.send(binding,false,false)
        return valid()
    end
    local function melee(valid)
        return tap({kind='Mouse',name='MouseButton1'},valid,.05)
    end
    local function fever()
        if moveset()~='Hakari' then return end
        execute('Fever Breaker',.1,function(valid) tap(bindings.get('Move2'),valid,.05);host.task.wait(.05) end)
    end
    local function shadow()
        if moveset()~='Megumi' then return end
        execute('Item Shadow Void',.1,function(valid) melee(valid);host.task.wait(1.5) end)
    end
    local function todo(name,delay)
        if moveset()~='Todo' then return end
        execute(name,delay,function(valid) melee(valid);host.task.wait(.1) end)
    end
    connect(input.InputBegan,function(object,processed)
        if not control.alive or processed or input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if keyMatches(object,'Move4') then fever() end
        if keyMatches(object,'Special') then
            shadow();todo('Todo Fake Swap',.4);todo('Todo Perfect Swap',.5)
        end
    end)
    local elapsed=0
    local ratioConnection,ratioRemote,ratioEffects
    local function detachRatio()
        if ratioConnection then ratioConnection:Disconnect();ratioConnection=nil end
        ratioRemote,ratioEffects=nil,nil
        invalidate('Auto Ratio')
    end
    local function finiteNumber(value)
        return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function ratioStep()
        if not control.enabled['Auto Ratio'] then
            if ratioConnection then detachRatio() end
            control.nativeMissing['Auto Ratio']=nil
            return
        end
        local storage=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
        local knit=storage:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        knit=knit and knit:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local services=knit and knit:FindFirstChild('Services')
        local service=services and services:FindFirstChild('NanamiService')
        local remotes=service and service:FindFirstChild('RE')
        local effects=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('Effects')
        local activated=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('RightActivated')
        if not effects or not effects.OnClientEvent or not activated or type(activated.FireServer)~='function' then
            if ratioConnection then detachRatio() end
            control.nativeMissing['Auto Ratio']='Waiting for NanamiService Effects and RightActivated'
            return
        end
        if ratioConnection and ratioEffects==effects and ratioRemote==activated and ratioConnection.Connected~=false then return end
        if ratioConnection then detachRatio() end
        ratioRemote,ratioEffects=activated,effects
        control.nativeMissing['Auto Ratio']=nil
        ratioConnection=effects.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
            local args={...}
            if not control.alive or args[1]~='SpawnRatio' or args[2]~=player or not control.enabled['Auto Ratio'] then return end
            -- Original opcode 67 indexes args[6]. It does not divide args by 6.
            -- The original follows with multiply .6, then subtract network ping.
            local duration=args[6]
            if not finiteNumber(duration) or duration<=0 then control.lastError='Auto Ratio: SpawnRatio has no valid sixth timing field';return end
            local ok,ping=pcall(player.GetNetworkPing,player)
            if not ok or not finiteNumber(ping) or ping<0 then control.lastError='Auto Ratio: network ping is unavailable';return end
            local delay=math.max(0,duration*.6-ping)
            invalidate('Auto Ratio')
            control.lastRatioTiming={duration=duration,ping=ping,delay=delay}
            execute('Auto Ratio',delay,function(valid)
                if valid() and ratioRemote==activated and ratioEffects==effects and effects.Parent==remotes and activated.Parent==remotes then
                    activated:FireServer()
                    control.ratioRequests=(control.ratioRequests or 0)+1
                    control.lastError=nil
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
    local qteElapsed=0
    connect(run.Heartbeat,function(delta)
        if not control.alive then return end
        if control.enabled['Higuruma QTE'] and moveset()=='Hiromi' then
            qteElapsed+=delta
            local delay=math.max(0,tonumber(environment._G.HigurumaDelay) or 0)
            if qteElapsed>=delay then
                qteElapsed=0
                local character=player.Character
                local remote=character and character:FindFirstChild('RemoteEvent')
                if remote and remote:IsA('RemoteEvent') then remote:FireServer(true) end
            end
        else qteElapsed=0 end
        elapsed+=delta
        if elapsed>=.5 then elapsed=0;ratioStep() end
    end)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function()
        for name in control.enabled do invalidate(name) end
    end)
    local callbacks={
        ['Auto Ratio']=function(value)setEnabled('Auto Ratio',value);ratioStep()end,
        ['Higuruma QTE']=function(value)setEnabled('Higuruma QTE',value)end,
        ['Fever Breaker']=function(value)setEnabled('Fever Breaker',value)end,
        ['Item Shadow Void']=function(value)setEnabled('Item Shadow Void',value)end,
        ['Todo Fake Swap']=function(value)
            if value then setEnabled('Todo Perfect Swap',false) end
            setEnabled('Todo Fake Swap',value)
        end,
        ['Todo Perfect Swap']=function(value)
            if value then setEnabled('Todo Fake Swap',false) end
            setEnabled('Todo Perfect Swap',value)
        end,
    }
    function control.callback(tab,name,config,sourceId)
        if tab=='Automatic' then return callbacks[name] end
        return nil
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        for name in control.enabled do invalidate(name) end
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        detachRatio()
    end
    return control
end
return NativeAutomaticFeatures
end)()

local UniversalTextStyle = (function(): any
-- Per-font styling belongs to the native menu and its explicitly owned displays.
-- Defaults leave existing text alone. Decorations are event-driven, never polled.
local UniversalTextStyle = {}
function UniversalTextStyle.new(host: any, menu: any): any
    local ui, Color3, Enum = menu.ui, host.Color3, host.Enum
    local control: {[string]: any} = {alive=true, groups={}, candidates=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}), candidateGroups=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}), records={}, roots={}, connections={}, created=false}
    local roles={['Title Font Size']='title',['Subtitle Font Size']='subtitle',['Content Font Size']='content',
        ['Description Font Size']='description',['Annotation Font Size']='annotation', ['Info Font Size']='info'}
    local syncProperties={'Text','FontFace','TextSize','TextScaled','TextWrapped','TextXAlignment','TextYAlignment','RichText',
        'LineHeight','TextTruncate','MaxVisibleGraphemes','Visible','ZIndex'}
    local baseProperties={'TextColor3','TextTransparency','TextStrokeTransparency'}
    local function connect(signal, callback, collection)
        if not signal then return end
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(collection or control.connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function text(object)
        return object and (object:IsA('TextLabel') or object:IsA('TextButton') or object:IsA('TextBox'))
            and not object:GetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer')
    end
    local function assign(object, key, value)
        if value~=nil and object[key]~=value then object[key]=value end
    end
    local function disconnect(record)
        for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        record.connections={}
    end
    local function deleteDecorations(record)
        for _,key in {'outline','shadow','depth'} do
            if record[key] then record[key]:Destroy();record[key]=nil end
        end
    end
    local function restore(object, record)
        record.writing=true
        for _,key in baseProperties do
            if record.applied[key]~=nil and object[key]==record.applied[key] then assign(object,key,record.base[key]) end
        end
        record.writing=false
        deleteDecorations(record);disconnect(record)
        control.records[object]=nil
    end
    function control.groupFor(object)
        if not text(object) then return nil end
        if object:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismInfoFieldCustom')==true then return nil end
        local named=object:GetAttribute('CullingFontGroup')
        if named then
            for _,group in control.groups do
                if named==group.entry.id or named==group.entry.name or named==group.role then return group end
            end
        end
        local role=object:GetAttribute('CullingFontRole')
        if object==menu.targetDetails or object==menu.targetStatus then role='info' end
        local ancestor=object
        while ancestor do
            if ancestor:GetAttribute('CullingColorGraphic') then return nil end
            if ancestor.Name=='CullingInfoESP' or ancestor.Name=='CullingEnemyStun' or ancestor.Name=='CullingInformationESP' then role='info';break end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
        if not role then
            -- This fallback is limited to menu roots; other world overlays need
            -- an explicit font group or one of the owned information displays.
            local inMenu=false
            for root,kind in control.roots do
                if kind=='menu' and (object==root or object:IsDescendantOf(root)) then inMenu=true;break end
            end
            if not inMenu then return nil end
            local kind=object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')
            if kind=='TextMuted' then role='description'
            elseif object.Name:match('^MiniSection') or object:GetAttribute('CullingMiniGroup') then role='subtitle'
            elseif object.Name=='Title' or (menu.panel and object.Parent==menu.panel.TopBar and object:IsA('TextLabel')) then role='title'
            else role='content' end
        end
        for _,group in control.groups do if group.role==role then return group end end
        return nil
    end
    local function syncLayer(object, layer, style, kind)
        for _,property in syncProperties do
            if property~='ZIndex' then pcall(function() assign(layer,property,object[property]) end) end
        end
        layer.BackgroundTransparency,layer.BorderSizePixel,layer.Active=1,0,false
        layer.TextStrokeTransparency=1
        layer.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        layer.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(style[kind..'X'],style[kind..'Y'])
        layer.TextColor3,layer.TextTransparency=style[kind..'Color'],1-style[kind..'Opacity']/100
        -- Roblox permits zero here. The child stays behind its parent's glyphs
        -- without introducing a wrapper or changing any layout geometry.
        pcall(function() layer.ZIndex=math.max(0,object.ZIndex-1) end)
    end
    local function makeDecoration(object, class, kind)
        local decoration=host.Instance.new(class)
        decoration.Name='CullingTextStyle'..kind
        decoration:SetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer',true)
        decoration.Parent=object
        return decoration
    end
    local function applyRecord(object, record, group)
        if not control.alive or record.writing then return end
        local style=group.style
        if not style.enabled then restore(object,record);return end
        -- Palette owners can update a whole surface synchronously before their
        -- property signals run. Retain that latest unstyled value for disable.
        for _,key in baseProperties do
            if record.applied[key]~=nil and object[key]~=record.applied[key] then record.base[key]=object[key] end
        end
        record.writing=true;record.group=group
        local values={TextColor3=style.textColor,TextTransparency=style.textTransparency/100,
            TextStrokeTransparency=if style.outlineOpacity>0 and style.outlineThickness>0 then 1 else record.base.TextStrokeTransparency}
        for _,key in baseProperties do record.applied[key]=values[key];assign(object,key,values[key]) end
        if style.outlineOpacity>0 and style.outlineThickness>0 then
            local outline=record.outline or makeDecoration(object,'UIStroke','Outline');record.outline=outline
            outline.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
            outline.Color,outline.Thickness,outline.Transparency=style.outlineColor,style.outlineThickness,1-style.outlineOpacity/100
            outline.Enabled=true
        elseif record.outline then record.outline:Destroy();record.outline=nil end
        for _,kind in {'shadow','depth'} do
            if style[kind..'Opacity']>0 then
                local layer=record[kind] or makeDecoration(object,'TextLabel',if kind=='shadow' then 'Shadow' else 'Depth');record[kind]=layer
                syncLayer(object,layer,style,kind)
            elseif record[kind] then record[kind]:Destroy();record[kind]=nil end
        end
        record.writing=false
    end
    function control.apply(object)
        if not control.alive or not control.candidates[object] or not object.Parent or not text(object) then return end
        local group=control.groupFor(object)
        local previous=control.candidateGroups[object]
        if previous~=group then
            if previous then previous.members[object]=nil end
            control.candidateGroups[object]=group
            if group then group.members[object]=true end
        end
        local record=control.records[object]
        if not group or not group.style.enabled then if record then restore(object,record) end;return end
        if not record then
            record={base={},applied={},connections={}}
            for _,key in baseProperties do record.base[key]=object[key] end
            control.records[object]=record
            local function changed(property)
                if not control.alive or record.writing or control.records[object]~=record then return end
                if table.find(baseProperties,property) and object[property]~=record.applied[property] then record.base[property]=object[property] end
                if not record.queued then
                    record.queued=true
                    host.task.defer(function()
                        record.queued=false
                        if control.alive and control.records[object]==record then control.apply(object) end
                    end)
                end
            end
            for _,property in baseProperties do connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property),function() changed(property) end,record.connections) end
            for _,property in syncProperties do connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property),function() changed(property) end,record.connections) end
            connect(object.Destroying,function() deleteDecorations(record);disconnect(record);control.records[object]=nil;control.candidates[object]=nil end,record.connections)
        end
        applyRecord(object,record,group)
    end
    function control.applyAll()
        for object in control.candidates do if object.Parent then control.apply(object) end end
    end
    function control.applyGroup(group)
        for object in group.members do if object.Parent then control.apply(object) end end
    end
    local function note(object)
        if text(object) then control.candidates[object]=true;control.apply(object) end
    end
    local pendingDiscovery={}
    local discoveryQueued=false
    local function queueDiscovery(object)
        if not control.alive or not text(object) then return end
        pendingDiscovery[object]=true
        if discoveryQueued then return end
        discoveryQueued=true
        host.task.defer(function()
            discoveryQueued=false
            local batch=pendingDiscovery;pendingDiscovery={}
            if not control.alive then table.clear(batch);return end
            -- DescendantAdded already reports every node of a parented tree.
            -- One set also deduplicates overlapping menu and popup roots.
            for candidate in batch do
                if candidate.Parent then
                    for root in control.roots do
                        if candidate==root or candidate:IsDescendantOf(root) then note(candidate);break end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    function control.addRoot(root, kind)
        if not root or control.roots[root] then return end
        control.roots[root]=kind or 'menu';note(root)
        for _,object in root:GetDescendants() do note(object) end
        connect(root.DescendantAdded,queueDiscovery)
    end
    local function discoverRoots()
        if menu.panel then control.addRoot(menu.panel.Root,'menu') end
        control.addRoot(menu.popupLayer,'menu')
        if menu.visuals then control.addRoot(menu.visuals.gui,'overlay') end
        if menu.floatingValues then
            for _,record in menu.floatingValues.displays or {} do
                if record.anchor then control.addRoot(record.anchor.Parent,'overlay') end
            end
        end
    end
    local originalSize=ui.applyMenuTextSize
    local sizeHook=function(object,...)
        if object and object:GetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer') then return end
        local result=table.pack(originalSize(object,...))
        if control.alive and text(object) then
            -- applyMenuTextSize is only called for UI owned by this menu.
            control.candidates[object]=true;control.apply(object)
        end
        return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
    end
    ui.applyMenuTextSize=sizeHook
    local originalSurface=ui.styleSurface
    local surfaceHook
    if originalSurface then
        surfaceHook=function(object,...)
            if object and object:GetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer') then return end
            local result=table.pack(originalSurface(object,...))
            if text(object) then control.apply(object) end
            return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
        end
        ui.styleSurface=surfaceHook
    end
    local originalMini=ui.applyMiniAppearance
    local miniHook=function(popup,...)
        local result=table.pack(originalMini(popup,...))
        if popup then
            control.apply(popup)
            for _,object in popup:GetDescendants() do if text(object) then control.apply(object) end end
        end
        return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
    end
    ui.applyMiniAppearance=miniHook
    local originalRelated=menu.relatedSettings
    local relatedHook=function(entry,...)
        local group=entry and control.groups[entry.id]
        if group then
            local result={entry}
            for _,record in group.rows do table.insert(result,record) end
            return result
        end
        return originalRelated(entry,...)
    end
    menu.relatedSettings=relatedHook
    local originalPopupRoot=menu.getPopupRoot
    local popupRootHook
    if originalPopupRoot then
        popupRootHook=function(...)
            local root=originalPopupRoot(...);control.addRoot(root,'menu');return root
        end
        menu.getPopupRoot=popupRootHook
    end
    function control.openForEntry(entry)
        if not control.alive or not entry or not control.groups[entry.id] then return false end
        menu.openMiniPopup(entry,menu.relatedSettings(entry));return true
    end
    local function defaultColor()
        return ui.palette and ui.palette['Text Color'] or ui.appearance.colors['Text Color'] or Color3.new(0,0,0)
    end
    function control.createControls()
        if control.created then return end
        control.created=true
        local fontEntries,seen={},{}
        for _,entry in menu.rows do
            if entry.kind=='CreateSlider' and entry.name:lower():match('font size') and not (entry.config and entry.config.TextStyleOwner) then
                local font=table.clone(entry)
                font.id=font.id or (font.tab..'/'..font.name)
                if not seen[font.id] then seen[font.id]=true;table.insert(fontEntries,font) end
            end
        end
        for _,entry in fontEntries do
            local group: {[string]: any}={entry=entry,role=entry.config and entry.config.FontRole or roles[entry.name] or entry.id,rows={},fields={},members=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})}
            group.style={enabled=false,textColor=defaultColor(),textTransparency=0,outlineColor=Color3.new(0,0,0),outlineOpacity=0,outlineThickness=1,
                shadowColor=Color3.new(0,0,0),shadowOpacity=0,shadowX=1,shadowY=1,depthColor=Color3.new(0,0,0),depthOpacity=0,depthX=2,depthY=2}
            control.groups[entry.id]=group
            local target=menu.tabs[entry.tab] or menu.tabs.Settings
            local tab=target.tab
            local function set(field: string,value: any,enable: boolean?)
                if not control.alive then return end
                if field:match('Color$') then
                    if value==nil then return end
                    for _,channel in {'R','G','B'} do
                        if type(value[channel])~='number' or value[channel]~=value[channel] or value[channel]<0 or value[channel]>1 then return end
                    end
                elseif field~='enabled' and (type(value)~='number' or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge) then return end
                group.style[field]=value
                local row=group.fields[field]
                if row and row.widget.Get()~=value then row.widget.Set(value,false) end
                if enable~=false and field~='enabled' and not menu.restoringControls then
                    group.style.enabled=true
                    local enabled=group.fields.enabled
                    if enabled and enabled.widget.Get()~=true then enabled.widget.Set(true,false) end
                end
                control.applyGroup(group)
            end
            local function add(kind,field,caption,config)
                config.Name='Text Style ['..entry.id..'] '..caption
                config.DisplayName=caption;config.QuickSettingsOnly=true
                config.TextStyleOwner,config.TextStyleProperty=entry.id,field
                config.Description='Applies to '..entry.name:gsub(' Font Size','')..' text only. Saved with your local menu configuration.'
                config.Default=group.style[field]
                config.Callback=function(value) set(field,value) end
                tab[kind](tab,config)
                local registered=menu.entries[entry.tab..'/'..config.Name] or menu.entries['Settings/'..config.Name]
                assert(registered,'Font style control was not registered: '..config.Name)
                local record=table.clone(registered);record.tab=entry.tab
                group.fields[field]=record;table.insert(group.rows,record)
                if ui.configureRow then ui.configureRow(record) end
                return record
            end
            local function slider(field,caption,min,max,step)
                return add('CreateSlider',field,caption,{Min=min,Max=max,Step=step or 1,Precision=if step==.1 then 1 else 0})
            end
            local function color(field,caption,alphaField,invert)
                local alpha=function() local value=group.style[alphaField]/100;return if invert then 1-value else value end
                return add('CreateColorPicker',field,caption,{GetTransparency=alpha,SetTransparency=function(value)
                    if type(value)=='number' and value==value then set(alphaField,math.clamp(if invert then (1-value)*100 else value*100,0,100)) end
                end})
            end
            add('CreateToggle','enabled','Customize Text Style',{})
            color('textColor','Text Color','textTransparency',false)
            slider('textTransparency','Text Transparency (%)',0,100)
            color('outlineColor','Outline Color','outlineOpacity',true)
            slider('outlineOpacity','Outline Opacity (%)',0,100)
            slider('outlineThickness','Outline Thickness',0,6,.1)
            color('shadowColor','Shadow Color','shadowOpacity',true)
            slider('shadowOpacity','Shadow Opacity (%)',0,100)
            slider('shadowX','Shadow Offset X',-16,16)
            slider('shadowY','Shadow Offset Y',-16,16)
            color('depthColor','Depth Color','depthOpacity',true)
            slider('depthOpacity','Depth Opacity (%)',0,100)
            slider('depthX','Depth Offset X',-16,16)
            slider('depthY','Depth Offset Y',-16,16)
        end
        discoverRoots()
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        table.clear(pendingDiscovery)
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        for object,record in control.records do restore(object,record) end
        if ui.applyMenuTextSize==sizeHook then ui.applyMenuTextSize=originalSize end
        if surfaceHook and ui.styleSurface==surfaceHook then ui.styleSurface=originalSurface end
        if ui.applyMiniAppearance==miniHook then ui.applyMiniAppearance=originalMini end
        if menu.relatedSettings==relatedHook then menu.relatedSettings=originalRelated end
        if popupRootHook and menu.getPopupRoot==popupRootHook then menu.getPopupRoot=originalPopupRoot end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.candidates);table.clear(control.candidateGroups);table.clear(control.roots)
    end
    return control
end
return UniversalTextStyle
end)()

local SurfaceAppearance = (function(): any
-- Menu-only surface effects. All decorations are non-layout UI modifiers;
-- defaults are neutral, transient popups are discovered on styling events.
local SurfaceAppearance={}
local SPECS={
    {'Window Background COlor','Window Background','window'}, {'Row Color','Content Block','row'},
    {'Button Background Color','Button Background','control'}, {'Input Background Color','Input Background','control'},
    {'Slider Background Color','Slider Background','control'}, {'Theme Color','Accent','control'},
    {'Toggle-On Color','Toggle On','control'}, {'Toggle-Off Color','Toggle Off','control'}, {'Knob Color','Knob','control'},
    {'Border Color','Border','control'}, {'Mini Menu Background Color','Mini Menu','popup'},
}
local WIDGET_KEYS={Row='Row Color',SliderTrack='Slider Background Color',SliderFill='Theme Color',TabAccentLine='Theme Color',
    ActionButton='Button Background Color',InputBox='Input Background Color',ToggleKnob='Knob Color',Main='Window Background COlor',
    TopBar='Window Background COlor',Sidebar='Window Background COlor',TabStrip='Window Background COlor'}
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
function SurfaceAppearance.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any): any
    local ui=menu.ui
    local control: any={alive=true,groups={},records=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),depthOwners=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),connections={}}
    for _,spec in SPECS do control.groups[spec[1]]={key=spec[1],label=spec[2],profile=spec[3],depthAdjustment=0,
        shadowOpacity=0,shadowColor=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),shadowSize=3,rows={},members=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})}end
    local function put(object,key,value)if value~=nil and object[key]~=value then object[key]=value end end
    local function connect(signal,callback,list)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function'then local connection=signal:Connect(callback);table.insert(list or control.connections,connection);return connection end
        return nil
    end
    local function disconnect(list)for _,connection in list do connection:Disconnect()end;table.clear(list)end
    local function excluded(object)
        local cursor=object
        while cursor do
            if cursor:GetAttribute('CullingSurfaceAppearanceDecoration')or cursor:GetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer')
                or cursor:GetAttribute('CullingColorGraphic')or cursor:GetAttribute('CullingColorEditor')or cursor:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismBarChrome')then return true end
            if cursor==menu.panel.Root or cursor==menu.popupLayer then return false end
            cursor=cursor.Parent
        end
        return true
    end
    local function roleFor(object)
        if not object or type(object.IsA)~='function'then return nil end
        if object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration')then return nil end
        if object:IsA('UIStroke')then return 'Border Color'end
        if not object:IsA('GuiObject')then return nil end
        if ui.isMiniSurface and ui.isMiniSurface(object)or object.Name:match('^MiniSection%d+$')then return 'Mini Menu Background Color'end
        local kind=object:GetAttribute('WidgetType')
        local key=WIDGET_KEYS[kind]
        if key then return key end
        if object.Name=='SectionHeader'then return 'Row Color'end
        if object:IsA('TextBox')then return 'Input Background Color'end
        if object:IsA('Frame')and object.Name=='Checkbox'then return 'Button Background Color'end
        if object:IsA('TextButton')and kind~='ToggleSwitch'and kind~='CloseButton'and kind~='TabButton'and object.BackgroundTransparency<1 then return 'Button Background Color'end
        return nil
    end
    local function remember(object,names)
        local result={};if object then for _,key in names do result[key]=object[key]end end;return result
    end
    local gradientProperties={'Color','Rotation','Enabled'}
    local edgeProperties={'Color','Transparency','Thickness','Enabled','ApplyStrokeMode'}
    local function nativeChrome(record,profile,depth)
        local settings=ui.depthProfiles and ui.depthProfiles[profile]
        if not settings then return end
        if record.chromeProfile==profile and record.chromeDepth==depth and record.chromeBottom==settings.bottom
            and record.chromeEdge==settings.edge and record.chromeThickness==settings.thickness then return end
        record.chromeProfile,record.chromeDepth,record.chromeBottom=profile,depth,settings.bottom
        record.chromeEdge,record.chromeThickness=settings.edge,settings.thickness
        local bottom=math.clamp(255-(255-settings.bottom)*depth,0,255)
        record.nativeGradient={Color=host.ColorSequence.new(host.Color3.new(1,1,1),host.Color3.fromRGB(bottom,bottom,bottom)),Rotation=90,Enabled=depth>0}
        record.nativeEdge=if settings.edge then {Color=host.Color3.fromRGB(35,40,49),Transparency=math.clamp(1-(1-settings.edge)*depth,0,1),Thickness=settings.thickness,Enabled=depth>0,ApplyStrokeMode=host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}else nil
    end
    local function restoreProperties(object,base,applied)
        if not object or not object.Parent then return end
        for key,value in base or{}do if applied and applied[key]~=nil and object[key]==applied[key]then put(object,key,value)end end
    end
    local function removeRecord(record)
        if record.dead then return end;record.dead=true
        disconnect(record.connections)
        if record.shadow then record.shadow:Destroy();record.shadow=nil end
        if record.borderGradient then record.borderGradient:Destroy();record.borderGradient=nil end
        if record.borderAdapter then
            if record.object.Parent and record.object.BorderSizePixel==record.appliedBorderSize then put(record.object,'BorderSizePixel',record.borderWidth)end
            record.borderAdapter:Destroy();record.borderAdapter=nil
        end
        local gradient=record.object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceShade')
        local edge=record.object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceEdge')
        if record.nativeProfile then
            restoreProperties(gradient,record.nativeGradient,record.appliedGradient)
            restoreProperties(edge,record.nativeEdge,record.appliedEdge)
            if record.object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength')==record.appliedDepth then record.object:SetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength',record.nativeDepth)end
        else
            if gradient and record.createdGradient==gradient then gradient:Destroy()end
            if edge and record.createdEdge==edge then edge:Destroy()end
            if record.appliedDepth~=nil and record.object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength')==record.appliedDepth then
                record.object:SetAttribute('CullingDepthProfile',nil);record.object:SetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength',nil)
            end
        end
        record.group.members[record.object]=nil
        local bucket=control.records[record.object];if bucket then bucket[record.group.key]=nil end
    end
    local applyRecord
    function control.register(key,object,alphaProperty)
        local group=control.groups[key]
        if not control.alive or not group or not object or not object.Parent or excluded(object)
            or not(object:IsA('GuiObject')or object:IsA('UIStroke'))then return nil end
        local bucket=control.records[object]
        if not bucket then bucket={};control.records[object]=bucket end
        local record=bucket[key]
        if record then return record end
        record={object=object,group=group,alpha=alphaProperty or(if object:IsA('UIStroke')then 'Transparency'else 'BackgroundTransparency'),connections={}}
        if key=='Border Color'then
            if object:IsA('GuiObject')then record.borderWidth=object.BorderSizePixel
            end
        else
            local profile=object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthProfile')
            if profile then
                local strength=object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength')
                record.nativeProfile,record.nativeDepth=profile,if finite(strength)then math.clamp(strength,0,2)else 1
                nativeChrome(record,record.nativeProfile,record.nativeDepth)
            end
        end
        bucket[key]=record;group.members[object]=record
        local function changed()
            if not control.alive or record.dead or record.writing or record.queued then return end
            record.queued=true;host.task.defer(function()
                record.queued=false
                if control.alive and not record.dead and object.Parent then applyRecord(record)end
            end)
        end
        connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(record.alpha),changed,record.connections)
        if key=='Border Color'and object:IsA('GuiObject')then
            connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal('BorderColor3'),changed,record.connections)
            connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal('BorderSizePixel'),function()
                if not record.writing and object.BorderSizePixel~=record.appliedBorderSize then record.borderWidth=object.BorderSizePixel;changed()end
            end,record.connections)
        end
        connect(object.Destroying,function()removeRecord(record)end,record.connections)
        return record
    end
    local function own(class,parent,name)
        local object=host.Instance.new(class);object.Name=name
        object:SetAttribute('CullingSurfaceAppearanceDecoration',true);object:SetAttribute('CullingDepthDecoration',true)
        object.Parent=parent;return object
    end
    local function borderStroke(record)
        local object=record.object
        if object:IsA('UIStroke')then return object end
        if (record.borderWidth or 0)<=0 then return nil end
        local stroke=record.borderAdapter
        if not stroke then
            stroke=own('UIStroke',object,'CullingNativeBorderAlpha');stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            if host.Enum.BorderStrokePosition then pcall(function()stroke.BorderStrokePosition=host.Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Outer end)end
            record.borderAdapter=stroke
        end
        put(stroke,'Thickness',record.borderWidth);put(stroke,'Color',object.BorderColor3)
        put(object,'BorderSizePixel',0);record.appliedBorderSize=0
        return stroke
    end
    applyRecord=function(record)
        if record.dead or record.writing or not record.object.Parent then return end
        record.writing=true
        local object,group=record.object,record.group
        local alpha=object[record.alpha]or 0
        local shadowParent=object
        if group.key=='Border Color'then
            local requested=ui.appearance.transparency['Border Color']
            local needs=finite(requested)or group.depthAdjustment~=0 or group.shadowOpacity>0
            local stroke=if needs then borderStroke(record)else nil
            if stroke then
                alpha=if object:IsA('UIStroke')then object.Transparency elseif finite(requested)then math.clamp(requested,0,1)else 0
                -- Existing native strokes already have a real palette-alpha
                -- binding. Only our pixel-border adapter needs an alpha write.
                if record.borderAdapter==stroke then put(stroke,'Transparency',alpha)end
                shadowParent=stroke.Parent
                if group.depthAdjustment~=0 then
                    local gradient=record.borderGradient or own('UIGradient',stroke,'CullingBorderDepth');record.borderGradient=gradient
                    local strength=math.abs(group.depthAdjustment)/100
                    gradient.Color=host.ColorSequence.new(host.Color3.new(1,1,1),host.Color3.fromRGB(255-100*strength,255-100*strength,255-100*strength))
                    gradient.Rotation=if group.depthAdjustment>0 then 90 else -90
                elseif record.borderGradient then record.borderGradient:Destroy();record.borderGradient=nil end
            end
        end
        if group.shadowOpacity>0 and group.shadowSize>0 and shadowParent and shadowParent:IsA('GuiObject')then
            local shadow=record.shadow
            if not shadow then
                shadow=own('UIStroke',shadowParent,'CullingSurfaceShadow_'..group.key:gsub('%W',''))
                shadow.ApplyStrokeMode=host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                local gradient=own('UIGradient',shadow,'CullingSurfaceShadowFalloff');gradient.Rotation=90
                gradient.Transparency=host.NumberSequence.new(.9,0)
                record.shadow=shadow
            end
            shadow.Color,shadow.Thickness=group.shadowColor,group.shadowSize
            shadow.Transparency=1-(1-math.clamp(alpha,0,1))*group.shadowOpacity/100
            shadow.Enabled=shadow.Transparency<1
        elseif record.shadow then record.shadow:Destroy();record.shadow=nil end
        record.writing=false
    end
    function control.depthFor(object,profile,depth)
        if not control.alive or control.applyingDepth then return depth end
        local key=roleFor(object)
        if not key or key=='Border Color'then return depth end
        local record=control.register(key,object)
        if not record then return depth end
        record.nativeProfile,record.nativeDepth=profile,depth;nativeChrome(record,profile,depth)
        control.depthOwners[object]=record
        return math.clamp(depth+record.group.depthAdjustment/100,0,2)
    end
    function control.afterShade(object)
        local record=control.depthOwners[object]
        if not control.alive or not record then return end
        local gradient=object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceShade');local edge=object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceEdge')
        record.appliedGradient=remember(gradient,gradientProperties);record.appliedEdge=remember(edge,edgeProperties)
        record.appliedDepth=object:GetAttribute('CullingDepthStrength')
        applyRecord(record)
    end
    local function applyDepth(record)
        if record.group.key=='Border Color'then applyRecord(record);return end
        local object=record.object
        if not object:IsA('GuiObject')then return end
        local base=record.nativeDepth or 0
        local profile=record.nativeProfile or record.group.profile
        local value=math.clamp(base+record.group.depthAdjustment/100,0,2)
        if not record.nativeProfile and value==0 then return end
        local gradient=object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceShade');local edge=object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceEdge')
        control.depthOwners[object]=record;control.applyingDepth=true
        ui.shadeSurface(object,profile,value)
        control.applyingDepth=false
        if not gradient and not record.nativeProfile then record.createdGradient=object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceShade')end
        if not edge and not record.nativeProfile then record.createdEdge=object:FindFirstChild('CullingSurfaceEdge')end
        control.afterShade(object)
    end
    function control.bindIndex(targets,generation)
        if not control.alive then return end
        if control.indexTargets==targets and control.indexGeneration==generation then return end
        control.indexTargets,control.indexGeneration=targets,generation
        for key,list in targets or{}do if control.groups[key]then for _,binding in list do
            local bucket=control.records[binding.object]
            local existing=bucket and bucket[key]
            if not existing then
                local record=control.register(key,binding.object,binding.alpha)
                if record then
                    if record.group.depthAdjustment~=0 then applyDepth(record)end
                    applyRecord(record)
                end
            end
        end end end
    end
    function control.bindTree(root)
        if not control.alive or not root then return end
        local function add(object)
            local key=roleFor(object)
            local record=key and control.register(key,object)
            if record then if record.group.depthAdjustment~=0 then applyDepth(record)end;applyRecord(record)end
            if object:IsA('GuiObject')and object.BorderSizePixel>0 then local border=control.register('Border Color',object);if border then applyRecord(border)end end
        end
        add(root);for _,object in root:GetDescendants()do add(object)end
    end
    function control.bindSwitch(state,enabled)
        if not state then return end
        local key=if enabled then 'Toggle-On Color'else 'Toggle-Off Color'
        local other=if enabled then 'Toggle-Off Color'else 'Toggle-On Color'
        local bucket=state.face and control.records[state.face]
        if bucket and bucket[other]then removeRecord(bucket[other])end
        for _,pair in {{key,state.face},{'Knob Color',state.thumb}}do
            local record=pair[2]and control.register(pair[1],pair[2])
            if record then record.nativeProfile,record.nativeDepth='control',1;nativeChrome(record,'control',1);applyDepth(record);applyRecord(record)end
        end
    end
    function control.refreshPalette(pending,generation)
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.bindIndex(ui.appearanceTargets,generation or ui.appearanceIndexGeneration)
        if pending then
            for key in pending do
                local group=control.groups[key]
                if group then for _,record in group.members do applyRecord(record)end end
            end
        else
            for _,group in control.groups do for _,record in group.members do applyRecord(record)end end
        end
    end
    function control.setOption(key,field,value)
        local group=control.groups[key]
        if not control.alive or not group then return false end
        if field=='depthAdjustment'and key=='Mini Menu Background Color'then return false end
        if field=='shadowColor'then
            if not value or not finite(value.R)or not finite(value.G)or not finite(value.B)or value.R<0 or value.R>1 or value.G<0 or value.G>1 or value.B<0 or value.B>1 then return false end
            value=host.Color3.new(value.R,value.G,value.B)
        else
            if not finite(value)then return false end
            if field=='depthAdjustment'then value=math.clamp(value,-100,100)
            elseif field=='shadowOpacity'then value=math.clamp(value,0,100)
            elseif field=='shadowSize'then value=math.clamp(value,0,16)else return false end
        end
        group[field]=value
        local entry=group.fields and group.fields[field]
        if entry and entry.widget and entry.widget.Get()~=value then entry.widget.Set(value,false)end
        for _,record in group.members do if field=='depthAdjustment'then applyDepth(record)end;applyRecord(record)end
        return true
    end
    function control.relatedFor(entry)
        if not entry then return{}end
        local key=entry.config and entry.config.SurfaceAppearanceRole or entry.name
        if entry.config and entry.config.AppearanceAlphaOwner then local original=menu.entries[entry.config.AppearanceAlphaOwner];if original then key=original.name end end
        if key=='Mini Menu Transparency (%)'or key=='Mini Menu Depth (%)'then key='Mini Menu Background Color'end
        local group=control.groups[key]
        if not group then return{}end
        local result={}
        if key=='Mini Menu Background Color'and menu.entries['Settings/Mini Menu Depth (%)']then table.insert(result,menu.entries['Settings/Mini Menu Depth (%)'])end
        for _,record in group.rows do table.insert(result,record)end
        return result
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if control.created or not tab then return end;control.created=true
        for _,spec in SPECS do local group=control.groups[spec[1]];group.fields={}
            local function add(kind,field,suffix,config)
                config.Name=group.label..' '..suffix;config.Default=group[field];config.QuickSettingsOnly=true
                config.AppearanceSettingsOwned,config.SurfaceAppearanceRole=true,group.key
                config.Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(group.key,field,value)end
                tab[kind](tab,config)
                local entry=menu.entries['Settings/'..config.Name]
                if entry then group.fields[field]=entry;table.insert(group.rows,entry)end
            end
            if group.key~='Mini Menu Background Color'then add('CreateSlider','depthAdjustment','Depth Adjustment (%)',{Min=-100,Max=100,Step=1,Precision=0,Description='Reduce or strengthen this surface finish. Zero preserves its current depth; sizes and layout stay unchanged.'})end
            add('CreateSlider','shadowOpacity','Shadow Opacity (%)',{Min=0,Max=100,Step=1,Precision=0,Description='Opacity of this surface’s shaded edge shadow. Zero preserves the current appearance.'})
            add('CreateColorPicker','shadowColor','Shadow Color',{GetTransparency=function()return 1-group.shadowOpacity/100 end,SetTransparency=function(alpha)if finite(alpha)then return control.setOption(group.key,'shadowOpacity',(1-math.clamp(alpha,0,1))*100)end;return false end})
            add('CreateSlider','shadowSize','Shadow Size (px)',{Min=0,Max=16,Step=.1,Precision=1,Description='Width of the non-layout edge shadow. It does not change the surface dimensions.'})
        end
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end;control.alive=false
        disconnect(control.connections)
        for _,bucket in control.records do for _,record in bucket do removeRecord(record)end end
        table.clear(control.records);table.clear(control.depthOwners)
    end
    control.bindIndex(ui.appearanceTargets,ui.appearanceIndexGeneration)
    if menu.panel and menu.panel.Root then control.bindTree(menu.panel.Root)end
    if menu.popupLayer then control.bindTree(menu.popupLayer)end
    for _,state in ui.switchStates or{}do control.bindSwitch(state,state.enabled)end
    return control
end
return SurfaceAppearance
end)()

local BarAppearance = (function(): any
-- Optional local bar effects. The producer retains every size, anchor and value.
local BarAppearance={}
function BarAppearance.new(host: {[string]: any},menu: any): any
    local roles={'Health','Evasive','Special','Ultimate','Cooldown','FrontDash','SideDash'}
    local captions={Health='Health',Evasive='Evasive',Special='Special',Ultimate='Ultimate',Cooldown='Cooldown',FrontDash='Front Dash',SideDash='Side Dash'}
    local control: any={alive=true,created=false,styles={},groups={},bindings={}}
    local bounds={depth={0,100},shadowOpacity={0,100},shadowX={-32,32},shadowY={-32,32},shadowSize={0,24}}
    local side=menu.sideDisplays
    local function finite(value: any): boolean return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
    local function put(object,key,value)if object[key]~=value then object[key]=value end end
    local function clearEffects(binding)
        for _,connection in binding.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(binding.connections)
        if binding.shadow then binding.shadow:Destroy();binding.shadow=nil end
        if binding.depth then binding.depth:Destroy();binding.depth=nil end
        binding.shadowStroke,binding.shadowCorner=nil,nil
    end
    local function own(class,parent,name)
        local object=host.Instance.new(class);object.Name=name
        object:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismBarChrome',true)
        object:SetAttribute('AppearanceSettingsOwned',true)
        object.Parent=parent
        return object
    end
    for _,role in roles do
        control.styles[role]={customDepth=false,depth=100,shadowOpacity=0,shadowColor=host.Color3.new(0,0,0),shadowX=2,shadowY=2,shadowSize=4}
    end
    function control.depthFor(role,global)
        local style=control.styles[role]
        return if style and style.customDepth then global*style.depth/100 else global
    end
    local function sync(binding)
        local chrome,target,style=binding.chrome,binding.chrome.target,control.styles[binding.role]
        if not control.alive or not target.Parent then return end
        if chrome.syncAlpha then chrome.syncAlpha()end
        local depth=binding.depth
        if depth then
            local alpha=1-(1-(tonumber(target.BackgroundTransparency)or 0))*control.depthFor(binding.role,side and side.barDepth or 1)
            put(depth,'BackgroundTransparency',alpha);put(depth,'Visible',target.Visible~=false and alpha<1)
            put(depth,'ZIndex',target.ZIndex or 1)
        end
        local shadow=binding.shadow
        if shadow then
            local stroke=binding.shadowStroke
            local visible=target.Visible~=false
            local alpha=1-(tonumber(target.BackgroundTransparency)or 0)
            local outline=chrome.outline or target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIStroke')
            if outline then alpha=math.max(alpha,1-(tonumber(outline.Transparency)or 0))end
            local opacity=math.clamp(alpha,0,1)*style.shadowOpacity/100
            put(shadow,'Visible',visible and opacity>0)
            put(shadow,'Position',host.UDim2.fromOffset(style.shadowX,style.shadowY))
            put(shadow,'ZIndex',math.max(0,(target.ZIndex or 1)-1))
            put(stroke,'Color',style.shadowColor);put(stroke,'Transparency',1-opacity)
            put(stroke,'Thickness',style.shadowSize)
            local original=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UICorner')
            if original and binding.shadowCorner then put(binding.shadowCorner,'CornerRadius',original.CornerRadius)end
        end
    end
    local function apply(binding)
        clearEffects(binding)
        local chrome,target,style=binding.chrome,binding.chrome.target,control.styles[binding.role]
        if not control.alive or not target.Parent then return end
        if chrome.syncAlpha then chrome.syncAlpha()end
        local fill=chrome.kind=='Fill'or chrome.kind=='Appearance'
        local needsDepth=fill and style.customDepth and not chrome.shade
        local needsShadow=style.shadowOpacity>0 and (chrome.kind=='Track'or chrome.kind=='Outline'or binding.role=='FrontDash'or binding.role=='SideDash')
        -- Never introduce a GuiObject into a layout-managed container.
        if target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIListLayout')or target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIGridLayout')then
            needsDepth,needsShadow=false,false
            binding.reason='This native frame contains a layout; decorations are not inserted into it'
        else binding.reason=nil end
        if needsDepth and host.NumberSequence and host.ColorSequence then
            local depth=own('Frame',target,'ShenaniganismBarLocalDepth')
            depth.Size,depth.Position=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1),host.UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
            depth.BorderSizePixel,depth.BackgroundColor3,depth.Active=0,host.Color3.new(0,0,0),false
            local gradient=own('UIGradient',depth,'DepthGradient')
            gradient.Color=host.ColorSequence.new(host.Color3.new(1,1,1),host.Color3.new(1,1,1))
            gradient.Transparency,gradient.Rotation=host.NumberSequence.new(0,1),-90
            binding.depth=depth
        end
        if needsShadow then
            -- A separate border silhouette adds no layout rectangle or opaque
            -- panel over the meter. Its source frame keeps its exact geometry.
            local shadow=own('Frame',target,'ShenaniganismBarLocalShadow')
            shadow.Size=host.UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            shadow.BackgroundTransparency,shadow.BorderSizePixel,shadow.Active=1,0,false
            local stroke=own('UIStroke',shadow,'ShadowStroke')
            if host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode then stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=host.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border end
            local corner=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UICorner')
            if corner then binding.shadowCorner=own('UICorner',shadow,'ShadowCorner')end
            binding.shadow,binding.shadowStroke=shadow,stroke
        end
        if binding.shadow or binding.depth then
            local function observe(object,property)
                if type(object.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then
                    table.insert(binding.connections,object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function()sync(binding)end))
                end
            end
            for _,property in {'BackgroundTransparency','Visible','ZIndex'}do observe(target,property)end
            if binding.shadow then
                local outline=chrome.outline or target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIStroke')
                if outline then observe(outline,'Transparency')end
                local corner=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('UICorner')
                if corner then observe(corner,'CornerRadius')end
            end
            sync(binding)
        end
    end
    function control.bind(chrome,role)
        if not control.alive or not control.styles[role]then return false end
        local previous=control.bindings[chrome]
        if previous and previous.role==role then return true end
        if previous then clearEffects(previous)end
        local binding={chrome=chrome,role=role,connections={}}
        control.bindings[chrome]=binding
        local style=control.styles[role]
        if style.customDepth or style.shadowOpacity>0 then apply(binding)end
        return true
    end
    function control.unbind(chrome)
        local binding=control.bindings[chrome]
        if not binding then return end
        clearEffects(binding);control.bindings[chrome]=nil
    end
    function control.refreshDepth()
        for _,binding in control.bindings do sync(binding)end
    end
    local function mirror(role,field,value)
        local group=control.groups[role];local entry=group and group.fields[field]
        if entry and entry.widget.Get()~=value then entry.widget.Set(value,false)end
    end
    function control.set(role: string,field: string,value: any): boolean
        local style=control.styles[role]
        if not control.alive or not style then return false end
        if field=='customDepth'then if type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        elseif field=='shadowColor'then
            if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3'then return false end
            if not finite(value.R)or not finite(value.G)or not finite(value.B)or math.min(value.R,value.G,value.B)<0 or math.max(value.R,value.G,value.B)>1 then return false end
        else
            local range=bounds[field]
            if not range or not finite(value)then return false end
            value=math.clamp(value,range[1],range[2])
        end
        local changed=style[field]~=value
        style[field]=value;mirror(role,field,value)
        if changed and field=='depth'and not menu.restoringControls and not style.customDepth then
            style.customDepth=true;mirror(role,'customDepth',true);changed=true
        end
        if changed then for _,binding in control.bindings do if binding.role==role then apply(binding)end end end
        return true
    end
    function control.getStyle(role)local style=control.styles[role];return if style then table.clone(style)else nil end
    local function matches(entry,role)
        local config=entry.config or {}
        if config.BarAppearanceRole then return config.BarAppearanceRole==role end
        local name=entry.name or config.Name or ''
        local caption=captions[role]
        if role=='FrontDash'then return name:find('Front Dash Bar',1,true)~=nil or name=='Front Dash Readiness Bar'or name=='Front Dash Bar Placement'end
        if role=='SideDash'then return name:find('Side Dash Bar',1,true)~=nil or name=='Side Dash Overlay'end
        return name:find(caption..' Bar',1,true)~=nil or (role=='Cooldown'and(name:match('^Cooldown ')~=nil or name:match('^Self Cooldown ')~=nil))
    end
    function control.relatedFor(entry)
        if not entry then return {}end
        local result={}
        for _,role in roles do
            local group=control.groups[role]
            if group and (matches(entry,role)or entry.name=='Info ESP'or entry.name=='Cooldown Viewer'or entry.name=='Bar Depth/Shading (%)')then
                for _,row in group.rows do table.insert(result,row)end
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if control.created or not control.alive then return end
        control.created=true;tab=tab and (tab.tab or tab)or menu.tabs.Settings.tab
        for _,role in roles do
            local group={fields={},rows={}};control.groups[role]=group
            local prefix=captions[role]..' Bar '
            local function add(kind,field,caption,options)
                options=options or {};options.Name=prefix..caption;options.DisplayName=caption
                options.Default=control.styles[role][field];options.QuickSettingsOnly=true
                options.AppearanceSettingsOwned,options.BarAppearanceRole,options.BarAppearanceProperty=true,role,field
                options.Description='Local '..captions[role]..' bar appearance. Preserves bar dimensions, position and gameplay.'
                if field=='depth'then options.Description='Multiplier of the shared bar shading. Editing enables Customize Depth; the original look is retained while disabled.'end
                options.Callback=function(value)return control.set(role,field,value)end
                local widget=tab[kind](tab,options)
                local entry
                for _,row in menu.rows or {}do if row.config==options then entry=row;break end end
                if not entry then for _,row in menu.entries or {}do if row.config==options then entry=row;break end end end
                entry=entry or {id='Settings/'..options.Name,tab='Settings',name=options.Name,config=options,kind=kind,widget=widget}
                group.fields[field]=entry;table.insert(group.rows,entry)
            end
            local function slider(field,caption,min,max)add('CreateSlider',field,caption,{Min=min,Max=max,Step=1,Precision=0})end
            add('CreateToggle','customDepth','Customize Depth')
            slider('depth','Depth (%)',0,100)
            slider('shadowOpacity','Shadow Opacity (%)',0,100)
            add('CreateColorPicker','shadowColor','Shadow Color',{GetTransparency=function()return 1-control.styles[role].shadowOpacity/100 end,
                SetTransparency=function(alpha)if finite(alpha)then return control.set(role,'shadowOpacity',(1-math.clamp(alpha,0,1))*100)end;return false end})
            slider('shadowX','Shadow Offset X (px)',-32,32);slider('shadowY','Shadow Offset Y (px)',-32,32)
            slider('shadowSize','Shadow Size (px)',0,24)
        end
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if side and side.appearanceAdapter==control then side.setAppearanceAdapter(nil)end
        for chrome in control.bindings do control.unbind(chrome)end
        control.alive=false
    end
    if side and type(side.setAppearanceAdapter)=='function'then side.setAppearanceAdapter(control)end
    return control
end
return BarAppearance
end)()

local HitOutlineStyle = (function(): any
-- Compatibility settings for hit tint. GeneralESP owns the only renderer.
-- Neither color nor alpha edits ever modify the original actor's body.
local HitOutlineStyle={}
function HitOutlineStyle.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local visual=menu.visuals
    local control: any={alive=true,created=false,records={},fields={},rows={},
        chamMaterial='Native Highlight',depthMode='Follow ESP',outlineStyle='3D Box'}
    local function refresh()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if visual and type(visual.refreshHitOutlineStyle)=='function'then visual.refreshHitOutlineStyle()end
    end
    local function mirror(field,value)
        local entry=control.fields[field]
        if entry and entry.widget.Get()~=value then entry.widget.Set(value,false)end
    end
    function control.release(_model)end -- The shared renderer owns actor cleanup.
    function control.apply(outline)
        -- Standalone Visuals compatibility; the full menu uses GeneralESP.
        if not control.alive or not outline or not outline.Parent or not visual then return end
        outline.FillTransparency=if visual.hitOutlineFillEnabled then visual.hitOutlineFillTransparency else 1
    end
    function control.setChamMaterial(value)
        if not control.alive then return false end
        local materials=host.Enum.Material or {}
        if value~='Native Highlight'and(not CHAM_MATERIALS[value]or materials[CHAM_MATERIALS[value]]==nil)then return false end
        control.chamMaterial=value;mirror('chamMaterial',value)
        if menu.generalESP and menu.generalESP.setHitAppearance then menu.generalESP.setHitAppearance('fillMaterial',value)end
        refresh();return true
    end
    function control.setDepthMode(value)
        if not control.alive or(value~='Follow ESP'and value~='Always On Top'and value~='Occluded')then return false end
        control.depthMode=value;mirror('depthMode',value)
        if menu.generalESP and menu.generalESP.setHitAppearance then menu.generalESP.setHitAppearance('depthMode',if value=='Follow ESP'then 'Follow Wall Setting'else value)end
        refresh();return true
    end
    function control.setOutlineStyle(value)
        if not control.alive or(value~='3D Box'and value~='Native Mesh'and value~='Rig Boxes'and value~='Mesh + 3D Box')then return false end
        control.outlineStyle=value;mirror('outlineStyle',value)
        if menu.generalESP and menu.generalESP.setHitAppearance then menu.generalESP.setHitAppearance('outlineStyle',value)end
        refresh();return true
    end
    function control.relatedFor(entry)
        if not entry then return {}end
        local name=entry.name or(entry.config and entry.config.Name)or''
        if entry.id~='Player/Outline Players I Hit'and not name:find('Hit Outline',1,true)and name~='Keep Hit Outline Until Death'and not(entry.config and entry.config.GeneralESPOwned)then return {}end
        local rows=table.clone(control.rows)
