        for _,row in menu.generalESPSettings and menu.generalESPSettings.rows or {}do rows[#rows+1]=row end
        return rows
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if control.created or not control.alive then return end
        control.created=true;tab=tab and(tab.tab or tab)or menu.tabs.Player.tab
        local function add(field,options)
            options.AppearanceSettingsOwned=true;options.HitOutlineStyleOwned=true;options.QuickSettingsOnly=true
            local widget=tab:CreateDropdown(options)
            local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries['Player/'..options.Name]
            entry=entry or{id='Player/'..options.Name,name=options.Name,tab='Player',kind='CreateDropdown',config=options,widget=widget}
            control.fields[field]=entry;table.insert(control.rows,entry)
        end
        local choices={'Native Highlight'}
        for _,name in CHAM_ORDER do if host.Enum.Material and host.Enum.Material[CHAM_MATERIALS[name]]then choices[#choices+1]=name end end
        add('chamMaterial',{Name='Hit Outline Cham Material',DisplayName='Hit ESP Fill Material',Options=choices,Default='Native Highlight',
            Description='Optional visual overlay material for a hit enemy. Fill is off by default. Transparency affects only the overlay, never the character body.',Callback=control.setChamMaterial})
        add('depthMode',{Name='Hit Outline Depth Mode',DisplayName='Hit ESP Depth Mode',Options={'Follow ESP','Always On Top','Occluded'},Default='Follow ESP',
            Description='Use the shared ESP wall setting, render above scene geometry, or respect scene depth. Only the ESP presentation changes.',Callback=control.setDepthMode})
        add('outlineStyle',{Name='Hit Outline Render Style',DisplayName='Hit ESP Outline Style',Options={'3D Box','Native Mesh','Rig Boxes','Mesh + 3D Box'},Default='3D Box',
            Description='The shared ESP renders a 3D bounds box, the native mesh silhouette, animated body-part boxes, or both mesh and bounds. Box thickness is adjustable; native silhouette width follows engine support.',Callback=control.setOutlineStyle})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        if visual and visual.hitOutlineStyle==control then visual.hitOutlineStyle=nil end
    end
    if visual then visual.hitOutlineStyle=control end
    return control
end
return HitOutlineStyle
end)()

local AppearanceSettings = (function(): any
-- Opacity is another view of an existing alpha channel, never a second value.
-- All discovery and method composition happen once; this module owns no loop.
local AppearanceSettings={}
local palette={['Theme Color']=true,['Toggle-On Color']=true,['Toggle-Off Color']=true,['Row Color']=true,
    ['Border Color']=true,['Text Color']=true,['Slider Background Color']=true,['Button Background Color']=true,
    ['Input Background Color']=true,['Window Background COlor']=true,['Knob Color']=true}
local specialCanonical={
    ['Settings/Mini Menu Background Color']='Settings/Mini Menu Transparency (%)',
    ['Main/Cooldown Bar Color']='Main/Cooldown Fill Transparency (%)',
    ['Main/Cooldown Background Color']='Settings/Cooldown Transparency (%)',
    ['Main/Halloween Door ESP Color']='Main/Halloween Door ESP Outline Transparency (%)',
}
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function clamp(value)return math.clamp(value,0,1)end
local function nameOf(entry)return entry.name or entry.config and entry.config.Name or entry.id:match('/(.+)$')end
local function tabOf(entry)return entry.tab or entry.id:match('^([^/]+)/')end
local function idOf(entry)
    if not entry then return nil end
    return entry.id or entry.tab and(entry.name or entry.config and entry.config.Name)and entry.tab..'/'..(entry.name or entry.config.Name)
end
function AppearanceSettings.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,channels={},byEntry={},aliases={},pending={},hooks={},snapshots={},relatedProviders={},created=false}
    local hooked=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local originals,rows,nativeRows={},{},{}
    for _,entry in menu.rows or {}do local id=idOf(entry);if id then nativeRows[id]=entry end end
    local function addOriginal(entry)
        local id=type(entry)=='table'and idOf(entry)
        if type(id)~='string'or not entry.widget or originals[id]
            or entry.config and entry.config.AppearanceSettingsOwned then return end
        entry=menu.entries and menu.entries[id]or entry
        if not entry.id then entry=table.clone(entry);entry.id=id end
        originals[id]=entry;table.insert(rows,entry)
    end
    for _,entry in menu.rows or {}do addOriginal(entry)end
    for _,entry in menu.entries or {}do addOriginal(entry)end
    table.sort(rows,function(a,b)return a.id<b.id end)
    control.originalEntries=originals
    local function pickerRecord(entry)
        local native=nativeRows[entry.id]
        if native then return native end
        local view=table.clone(entry);view.tab=tabOf(entry);return view
    end
    local function read(channel)
        local ok,value=pcall(channel.get)
        if ok and finite(value)then return clamp(value)end
        control.lastFailure='Cannot read appearance alpha: '..channel.id
        return nil
    end
    function control.sync(channel)
        if not control.alive or not channel or channel.syncing then return end
        local alpha=read(channel)
        local alias=channel.alias
        if alpha==nil or not alias then return end
        local value=(1-alpha)*100
        channel.syncing=true
        local ok,reason=pcall(function()
            if not alias.widget.Get or math.abs(alias.widget.Get()-value)>1e-7 then alias.widget.Set(value,false)end
        end)
        channel.syncing=false
        if not ok then control.lastFailure=tostring(reason)end
    end
    local function after(owner,key,channel)
        if not owner or type(owner[key])~='function'then return end
        local keys=hooked[owner]
        if not keys then keys={};hooked[owner]=keys end
        local hook=keys[key]
        if hook then hook.channels[channel]=true;return end
        hook={owner=owner,key=key,original=owner[key],channels={[channel]=true}}
        hook.wrapper=function(...)
            local result=table.pack(hook.original(...))
            if control.alive then for watched in hook.channels do control.sync(watched)end end
            return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
        end
        owner[key]=hook.wrapper;keys[key]=hook;table.insert(control.hooks,hook)
    end
    local function link(channel,entry)
        if not entry then return end
        control.byEntry[entry.id]=channel;channel.entries[entry.id]=entry
        after(entry.widget,'Set',channel)
        if entry.config then after(entry.config,'SetTransparency',channel)end
    end
    local function createChannel(id,entry,get,set,alreadyOpacity)
        local channel=control.channels[id]
        if channel then link(channel,entry);return channel end
        channel={id=id,canonical=entry,get=get,set=set,entries={},alreadyOpacity=alreadyOpacity==true,effects={}}
        if read(channel)==nil then control.pending[entry.id]='The alpha adapter did not return a finite number';return nil end
        control.channels[id]=channel;link(channel,entry)
        return channel
    end
    local function sliderChannel(entry,inverse)
        local maximum=entry.config and entry.config.Max
        local unit=if finite(maximum)and maximum<=1 then 1 else 100
        return createChannel(entry.id,entry,function()
            local value=entry.widget.Get()
            return if inverse then 1-value/unit else value/unit
        end,function(alpha)
            return entry.widget.Set((if inverse then 1-alpha else alpha)*unit,true)
        end,inverse)
    end
    local function canonicalFor(entry)
        local explicit=entry.config and entry.config.AppearanceAlphaControlId
        if explicit and originals[explicit]then return originals[explicit]end
        local special=specialCanonical[entry.id]
        if special and originals[special]then return originals[special]end
        local name,tab=nameOf(entry),tabOf(entry)
        local base=name:gsub(' Color$','')
        for _,suffix in {' Transparency (%)',' Opacity (%)'}do
            local candidate=originals[tab..'/'..base..suffix]
            if candidate and candidate.kind=='CreateSlider'then return candidate end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function realPicker(entry)
        local config=entry.config or {}
        if type(config.SetTransparency)=='function'then
            return {get=function()
                if type(config.GetTransparency)=='function'then return config.GetTransparency()end
                return menu.ui and menu.ui.colorAlpha and menu.ui.colorAlpha(pickerRecord(entry))
            end,set=function(alpha)return config.SetTransparency(alpha)end}
        end
        if tabOf(entry)=='Settings'and palette[nameOf(entry)]and menu.ui and type(menu.ui.colorAlpha)=='function'
            and type(menu.ui.queueAppearance)=='function'then
            local appearance=host._G and host._G.__CullingAppearance
            if not appearance or type(appearance.transparency)~='table'then return nil end
            return {get=function()return menu.ui.colorAlpha(pickerRecord(entry))end,set=function(alpha)
                appearance.transparency[nameOf(entry)]=alpha
                local saved=appearance.colorControls and appearance.colorControls[entry.id]
                if saved then saved.alpha=alpha end
                local view=pickerRecord(entry)
                if view.swatch and view.swatch.Parent then view.swatch.BackgroundTransparency=alpha end
                menu.ui.queueAppearance(nameOf(entry));return true
            end}
        end
        return nil
    end
    function control.registerAlpha(id,adapter)
        local entry=type(id)=='table'and originals[idOf(id)]or originals[id]
        if not control.alive or not entry or not originals[entry.id]or type(adapter)~='table'
            or type(adapter.get)~='function'or type(adapter.set)~='function'then return nil end
        local canonical=adapter.canonicalId and control.channels[adapter.canonicalId]
        if canonical then link(canonical,entry);control.pending[entry.id]=nil;return canonical end
        if control.byEntry[entry.id]then return control.byEntry[entry.id]end
        local channel=createChannel(adapter.canonicalId or entry.id,entry,adapter.get,adapter.set,false)
        if channel then
            control.pending[entry.id]=nil
            if control.created then control.addAlias(channel);control.sync(channel)end
        end
        return channel
    end
    -- Explicit alpha sliders are the persistent owner, even if their paired
    -- color picker has another name or lives on another tab.
    for _,entry in rows do
        if entry.kind=='CreateSlider'and nameOf(entry):find('Transparency',1,true)then sliderChannel(entry,false)end
    end
    for _,entry in rows do
        if entry.kind~='CreateColorPicker'then continue end
        local canonical=canonicalFor(entry)
        if canonical then
            local channel=control.byEntry[canonical.id]or sliderChannel(canonical,nameOf(canonical):find('Opacity',1,true)~=nil)
            if channel then link(channel,entry)end
        else
            local adapter=realPicker(entry)
            if adapter then control.registerAlpha(entry,adapter)
            else control.pending[entry.id]='Picker alpha has no verified renderer adapter'end
        end
    end
    local function effectRows(channel)
        local name=nameOf(channel.canonical)
        local prefix=name:match('^(Info Field %b[]) ')or name:match('^(Text Style %b[]) ')
        if not prefix then return end
        for _,entry in rows do
            if tabOf(entry)==tabOf(channel.canonical)and nameOf(entry):sub(1,#prefix+1)==prefix..' 'then
                table.insert(channel.effects,entry)
            end
        end
    end
    for _,channel in control.channels do effectRows(channel)end
    local function push(result,seen,entry)
        local id=idOf(entry)
        if id and not seen[id]then seen[id]=true;table.insert(result,entry)end
    end
    function control.relatedFor(entry)
        local channel=entry and control.byEntry[idOf(entry)]
        if not channel then return {}end
        local result,seen={},{}
        push(result,seen,channel.canonical);push(result,seen,channel.alias)
        for _,member in channel.entries do push(result,seen,member)end
        for _,member in channel.effects do push(result,seen,member)end
        return result
    end
    function control.groupFor(entry)
        local channel=entry and control.byEntry[idOf(entry)]
        if not channel then return nil end
        return {id=channel.id,canonical=channel.canonical,alias=channel.alias,entries=channel.entries,
            effects=channel.effects,alreadyOpacity=channel.alreadyOpacity,opacity=function()
                local alpha=read(channel);return if alpha then (1-alpha)*100 else nil
            end}
    end
    function control.addRelatedProvider(provider)
        if not control.alive or not provider or type(provider.relatedFor)~='function'then return false end
        for _,existing in control.relatedProviders do if existing==provider then return true end end
        table.insert(control.relatedProviders,provider);return true
    end
    local function tabControl(name)
        local tab=control.tabs and control.tabs[name]or menu.tabs and menu.tabs[name]
        return tab and(tab.tab or tab)
    end
    local function extendRelated(entry,channel)
        local config=entry.config
        if not config then return end
        local original=config.PortRelatedNames
        local related,seen={},{}
        for _,name in original or {}do if not seen[name]then table.insert(related,name);seen[name]=true end end
        for _,member in control.relatedFor(channel.canonical)do
            local name=nameOf(member)
            if not seen[name]then table.insert(related,name);seen[name]=true end
        end
        config.PortRelatedNames=related
        table.insert(control.snapshots,{owner=config,key='PortRelatedNames',original=original,value=related})
    end
    function control.addAlias(channel)
        if channel.alias or channel.alreadyOpacity then return end
        local entry=channel.canonical
        local originalName=nameOf(entry)
        local name=if originalName:find('Transparency',1,true)then originalName:gsub('Transparency','Opacity')
            else originalName:gsub(' [Cc][Oo][Ll][Oo][Rr]$','')..' Opacity (%)'
        local tabName=tabOf(entry);local tab=tabControl(tabName)
        local id=tabName..'/'..name
        if menu.entries[id]then control.pending[id]='An existing control already owns this opacity name';return end
        if not tab or type(tab.CreateSlider)~='function'then control.pending[id]='The original appearance tab is unavailable';return end
        local alpha=read(channel)
        if alpha==nil then return end
        local colorIds={}
        for _,member in channel.entries do if member.kind=='CreateColorPicker'then table.insert(colorIds,member.id)end end
        table.sort(colorIds)
        local initializing=true
        local config={Name=name,DisplayName=(entry.config and entry.config.DisplayName or name):gsub('Transparency','Opacity'),
            Description='Opacity for the same saved appearance channel: 0 is invisible, 100 is solid. Transparency stays synchronized.',
            Min=0,Max=100,Default=(1-alpha)*100,Step=1,Precision=0,NoConfig=true,QuickSettingsOnly=true,
            AppearanceSettingsOwned=true,AppearanceSettingsOwner=control,AppearanceAlphaOwner=entry.id,AppearanceAlphaColorIds=colorIds,
            Callback=function(value)
                if not control.alive or channel.syncing or control.creating or initializing then return true end
                if not finite(value)then return false end
                local result=channel.set(1-math.clamp(value,0,100)/100)
                control.sync(channel);return result
            end}
        for _,key in {'JujutsuerPortTab','JujutsuerPortGroup','TextStyleOwner','InfoHubEditor','InfoFieldEditor','MiniMenuAppearance',
            'GeneralESPMiniOwned','GeneralESPMiniGroup','GeneralESPOffscreenMenu','PortVisibleWhen','PortRelatedNames'}do
            if entry.config then config[key]=entry.config[key]end
        end
        tab:CreateSlider(config)
        initializing=false
        local alias=menu.entries[id]
        if not alias or not alias.widget then control.pending[id]='Opacity control did not register on the original menu';return end
        channel.alias=alias;control.byEntry[id]=channel;control.aliases[id]=alias
        for _,member in channel.entries do extendRelated(member,channel)end
        extendRelated(alias,channel)
    end
    function control.createControls(tabs)
        if not control.alive or control.created then return end
        control.tabs=tabs;control.created=true;control.creating=true
        local ordered={};for _,channel in control.channels do table.insert(ordered,channel)end
        table.sort(ordered,function(a,b)return a.id<b.id end)
        for _,channel in ordered do control.addAlias(channel)end
        control.creating=false
        for _,channel in ordered do control.sync(channel)end
    end
    local originalRelated=menu.relatedSettings
    local relatedHook
    relatedHook=function(entry,...)
        local base=if originalRelated then originalRelated(entry,...)else {}
        if not control.alive then return base end
        local result,seen={},{}
        for _,member in base or {}do push(result,seen,member)end
        local inspect={entry};for _,member in base or {}do table.insert(inspect,member)end
        for _,member in inspect do
            local related=control.relatedFor(member)
            for _,linked in related do push(result,seen,linked)end
            local providers={menu.surfaceAppearance,menu.barAppearance,table.unpack(control.relatedProviders)}
            for _,provider in providers do
                if provider and type(provider.relatedFor)=='function'then
                    for _,owner in {member,table.unpack(related)}do
                        for _,effect in provider.relatedFor(owner)or {}do push(result,seen,effect)end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    menu.relatedSettings=relatedHook
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        if menu.relatedSettings==relatedHook then menu.relatedSettings=originalRelated end
        for index=#control.hooks,1,-1 do
            local hook=control.hooks[index]
            if hook.owner[hook.key]==hook.wrapper then hook.owner[hook.key]=hook.original end
        end
        for index=#control.snapshots,1,-1 do
            local snapshot=control.snapshots[index]
            if snapshot.owner[snapshot.key]==snapshot.value then snapshot.owner[snapshot.key]=snapshot.original end
        end
        for id,entry in control.aliases do
            if menu.entries[id]==entry then menu.entries[id]=nil end
            if entry.row and entry.row.Parent then entry.row:Destroy()end
        end
        for index=#(menu.rows or {}),1,-1 do
            local entry=menu.rows[index]
            if entry.config and entry.config.AppearanceSettingsOwner==control then table.remove(menu.rows,index)end
        end
    end
    return control
end
return AppearanceSettings
end)()

local ColorAppearancePanel = (function(): any
-- One color editor, with existing saved appearance controls shown in place.
-- It decorates the owned picker only and never copies setting values to storage.
local ColorAppearancePanel={}
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function nameOf(entry)return entry.config and entry.config.DisplayName or entry.name or entry.id end
local function idOf(entry)
    return entry and(entry.id or entry.tab and(entry.name or entry.config and entry.config.Name)and entry.tab..'/'..(entry.name or entry.config.Name))
end
function ColorAppearancePanel.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local Enum,UDim2,Color3=host.Enum,host.UDim2,host.Color3
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,states={},attachCount=0,detachCount=0}
    local function make(state,class,parent,name)
        local object=host.Instance.new(class)
        object.Name=name or class;object.Parent=parent
        if object.SetAttribute then object:SetAttribute('AppearanceSettingsOwned',true)end
        table.insert(state.owned,object)
        return object
    end
    local function connect(state,signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function'then table.insert(state.connections,signal:Connect(callback))end
    end
    local function text(state,class,parent,name)
        local object=make(state,class,parent,name)
        object.BackgroundTransparency=1;object.BorderSizePixel=0;object.TextSize=13
        object.TextColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0);object.ZIndex=12112
        local font=menu.environment and menu.environment.THEME_FONT
        if font then object.FontFace=font end
        if Enum.TextTruncate then object.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end
        if Enum.TextXAlignment then object.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left end
        return object
    end
    local function button(state,parent,caption)
        local object=text(state,'TextButton',parent,'AppearanceButton')
        object.Text=caption;object.BackgroundTransparency=.1
        object.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
        return object
    end
    local function get(entry)
        local ok,value=pcall(entry.widget.Get)
        return if ok then value else nil
    end
    local function appearanceEntry(entry,current)
        if not entry or idOf(entry)==idOf(current)or not entry.widget or type(entry.widget.Set)~='function'then return false end
        if not table.find({'CreateSlider','CreateToggle','CreateDropdown','CreateColorPicker','CreateInput'},entry.kind)then return false end
        local name=(entry.name or entry.id):lower()
        return name:find('opacity',1,true)or name:find('transparency',1,true)or name:find('shadow',1,true)
            or name:find('outline',1,true)or name:find('glow',1,true)or name:find('cham',1,true)
            or name:find('mesh',1,true)or name:find('depth',1,true)and not name:find('depth z',1,true)
            or entry.config and(entry.config.TextStyleOwner or entry.config.InfoFieldEditor)
    end
    local function focused(box)return input.GetFocusedTextBox and input:GetFocusedTextBox()==box end
    local function commit(state,callback,...)
        state.commitDepth=(state.commitDepth or 0)+1
        local result=table.pack(pcall(callback,...))
        state.commitDepth-=1
        if state.commitDepth==0 then control.refresh(state)end
        if not result[1]then error(result[2],0)end
        return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
    end
    local function invoke(state,entry,value)
        local ok,result=pcall(commit,state,entry.widget.Set,value,true)
        if not ok then control.lastFailure=tostring(result);return false end
        return result~=false
    end
    local function layoutRows(state)
        local y=8
        for _,row in state.rows do
            row.frame.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,y);row.frame.Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,row.height)
            y+=row.height+6
        end
        state.appearance.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,y+4)
    end
    function control.refresh(state)
        if not control.alive or not state or state.closed or state.refreshing or (state.commitDepth or 0)>0 then return end
        state.refreshing=true
        for _,refresh in state.refreshers do refresh()end
        local color=state.refs.getColor and state.refs.getColor()or get(state.entry)
        local alpha=menu.ui and menu.ui.colorAlpha and menu.ui.colorAlpha(state.entry)
        if finite(alpha)and state.refs.updateAlpha and(not state.refs.getAlpha or math.abs(state.refs.getAlpha()-alpha)>1e-7)then
            state.refs.updateAlpha(alpha,false)
        end
        if color then
            for index,key in {'R','G','B'}do
                local box=state.rgba[index]
                if box and not focused(box)and finite(color[key])then box.Text=tostring(math.floor(color[key]*255+.5))end
            end
        end
        local opacity=state.rgba[4]
        if opacity and not focused(opacity)and finite(alpha)then opacity.Text=string.format('%.1f',(1-alpha)*100)end
        state.refreshing=false
    end
    local function watchMethod(state,owner,key)
        if not owner or type(owner[key])~='function'then return end
        local keys=state.watched[owner]
        if not keys then keys={};state.watched[owner]=keys end
        if keys[key]then return end
        keys[key]=true
        local original=owner[key]
        local hook={owner=owner,key=key,original=original}
        hook.wrapper=function(...)
            return commit(state,original,...)
        end
        owner[key]=hook.wrapper;table.insert(state.hooks,hook)
    end
    local function watch(state,entry)
        watchMethod(state,entry.widget,'Set')
        watchMethod(state,entry.config,'SetTransparency')
    end
    local function navigate(state,entry,back)
        if not menu.ui or type(menu.ui.openColor)~='function'or entry and idOf(entry)==idOf(state.entry)then return end
        local history=table.clone(state.history)
        local page='Color'
        if back then
            local previous=table.remove(history);if not previous then return end
            entry,page=previous.entry,previous.page
        else table.insert(history,{entry=state.entry,page=state.page})end
        -- The native editor consumes a menu.rows record (tab/name), while
        -- saved controls and relatedFor commonly return menu.entries (id).
        local id=idOf(entry)
        for _,row in menu.rows or {}do if idOf(row)==id then entry=row;break end end
        if not entry.tab and id then entry=table.clone(entry);entry.tab=id:match('^([^/]+)/')end
        control.navigation={history=history,page=page,size=state.popup.Size,position=state.popup.Position}
        menu.ui.openColor(entry)
        control.navigation=nil
    end
    local function makeRow(state,entry)
        local frame=make(state,'Frame',state.appearance,'AppearanceSettingRow')
        frame.BackgroundTransparency=.18;frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235);frame.BorderSizePixel=0;frame.ZIndex=12111
        local title=text(state,'TextLabel',frame,'SettingName');title.Text=nameOf(entry)
        title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,5);title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,22)
        local row={frame=frame,height=60,entry=entry};table.insert(state.rows,row)
        watch(state,entry)
        local config=entry.config or {}
        if entry.kind=='CreateSlider'or entry.kind=='CreateInput'then
            local box=text(state,'TextBox',frame,'SettingValue');box.ClearTextOnFocus=false
            box.BackgroundTransparency=.05;box.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            box.Position=UDim2.new(1,-110,0,31);box.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(102,24)
            local minimum,maximum=config.Min or 0,config.Max or 100
            local track,fill
            if entry.kind=='CreateSlider'then
                track=button(state,frame,'');track.Name='SettingTrack';track.Position=UDim2.new(0,8,0,40);track.Size=UDim2.new(1,-130,0,7)
                track.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150)
                fill=make(state,'Frame',track,'SettingFill');fill.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255);fill.BorderSizePixel=0;fill.ZIndex=12113
                connect(state,track.InputBegan,function(event)
                    if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        state.drag={entry=entry,track=track,event=event,min=minimum,max=maximum};control.drag(state,event.Position)
                    end
                end)
            end
            connect(state,box.FocusLost,function()
                local value=if entry.kind=='CreateSlider'then tonumber(box.Text)else box.Text
                if entry.kind=='CreateInput'or finite(value)then invoke(state,entry,if entry.kind=='CreateSlider'then math.clamp(value,minimum,maximum)else value)
                else control.refresh(state)end
            end)
            table.insert(state.refreshers,function()
                local value=get(entry)
                if not focused(box)then box.Text=if finite(value)then string.format('%.'..math.clamp(config.Precision or 3,0,4)..'f',value)else tostring(value or '')end
                if fill and finite(value)then fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp((value-minimum)/math.max(maximum-minimum,1e-12),0,1),1)end
            end)
        elseif entry.kind=='CreateToggle'then
            row.height=42;title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-100,0,28)
            local toggle=button(state,frame,'');toggle.Name='SettingToggle';toggle.Position=UDim2.new(1,-82,0,8);toggle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(74,26)
            connect(state,toggle.Activated,function()invoke(state,entry,get(entry)~=true)end)
            table.insert(state.refreshers,function()toggle.Text=if get(entry)==true then 'On'else 'Off'end)
        elseif entry.kind=='CreateColorPicker'then
            row.height=42;title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-100,0,28)
            local edit=button(state,frame,'Edit color');edit.Name='SettingColor';edit.Position=UDim2.new(1,-90,0,8);edit.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(82,26)
            connect(state,edit.Activated,function()navigate(state,entry,false)end)
        elseif entry.kind=='CreateDropdown'then
            local choose=button(state,frame,'');choose.Name='SettingDropdown';choose.Position=UDim2.new(0,8,0,30);choose.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,25)
            local choices={};local expanded=false
            local function values()
                local value=get(entry);if type(value)=='table'then return value end
                return {value}
            end
            local function collapse()
                expanded=false;for _,option in choices do option.Visible=false end
                row.height=60;layoutRows(state)
            end
            for index,option in config.Options or {}do
                local item=button(state,frame,tostring(option));item.Name='SettingOption';item.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,59+(index-1)*25);item.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,24);item.Visible=false
                table.insert(choices,item)
                connect(state,item.Activated,function()
                    if config.Multi then
                        local selected=table.clone(values());local at=table.find(selected,option)
                        if at then table.remove(selected,at)else table.insert(selected,option)end
                        invoke(state,entry,selected)
                    else invoke(state,entry,option);collapse()end
                end)
            end
            connect(state,choose.Activated,function()
                if expanded then collapse()else
                    expanded=true;for _,option in choices do option.Visible=true end
                    row.height=62+#choices*25;layoutRows(state)
                end
            end)
            table.insert(state.refreshers,function()local value=get(entry);choose.Text=if type(value)=='table'then table.concat(value,', ')else tostring(value or 'Select')end)
        end
    end
    function control.drag(state,point)
        local drag=state.drag
        if not drag or not point then return end
        local width=math.max(1,drag.track.AbsoluteSize.X)
        local fraction=math.clamp((point.X-drag.track.AbsolutePosition.X)/width,0,1)
        local value=drag.min+(drag.max-drag.min)*fraction
        local step=drag.entry.config and drag.entry.config.Step
        if finite(step)and step>0 then value=drag.min+math.floor((value-drag.min)/step+.5)*step end
        invoke(state,drag.entry,math.clamp(value,drag.min,drag.max))
    end
    function control.selectPage(state,page)
        state.page=page
        state.color.Visible=page=='Color';state.appearance.Visible=page=='Appearance'
        state.colorTab.BackgroundTransparency=if page=='Color'then .05 else .5
        state.appearanceTab.BackgroundTransparency=if page=='Appearance'then .05 else .5
        control.refresh(state)
    end
    function control.attach(popup,entry,refs)
        if not control.alive or not popup or not popup.Parent or not entry or not entry.widget or control.states[popup]then return false end
        refs=refs or {}
        local navigation=control.navigation
        local state={popup=popup,entry=entry,refs=refs,owned={},connections={},hooks={},watched={},refreshers={},rows={},rgba={},content={},history=navigation and navigation.history or {}}
        control.states[popup]=state;control.current=state;control.attachCount+=1
        popup.Size=navigation and navigation.size or UDim2.fromOffset(560,540)
        if navigation then popup.Position=navigation.position end
        local tabs=make(state,'Frame',popup,'ColorAppearanceTabs');tabs.BackgroundTransparency=1;tabs.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,42);tabs.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,30);tabs.ZIndex=12110
        state.colorTab=button(state,tabs,'Color');state.colorTab.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0);state.colorTab.Size=UDim2.new(.5,-3,1,0)
        state.appearanceTab=button(state,tabs,'Appearance');state.appearanceTab.Position=UDim2.new(.5,3,0,0);state.appearanceTab.Size=UDim2.new(.5,-3,1,0)
        for _,name in {'color','appearance'}do
            local scroll=make(state,'ScrollingFrame',popup,name=='color'and 'ColorPage'or 'AppearancePage')
            scroll.BackgroundTransparency=1;scroll.BorderSizePixel=0;scroll.ScrollBarThickness=5;scroll.ZIndex=12110
            scroll.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,80);scroll.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-90);state[name]=scroll
        end
        state.native=make(state,'Frame',state.color,'NativeColorCanvas');state.native.BackgroundTransparency=1;state.native.BorderSizePixel=0;state.native.ZIndex=12110
        for _,object in refs.content or {}do
            if object.Parent==popup then
                local original={object=object,position=object.Position,parent=object.Parent,layers={}}
                table.insert(state.content,original)
                local position=object.Position;object.Position=UDim2.new(position.X.Scale,position.X.Offset,position.Y.Scale,position.Y.Offset-30)
                object.Parent=state.native
                for _,layer in {object,table.unpack(object:GetDescendants())}do
                    if layer:IsA('GuiObject')then table.insert(original.layers,{object=layer,z=layer.ZIndex});layer.ZIndex+=20 end
                end
            end
        end
        local rgba=make(state,'Frame',state.color,'RgbaInputs');rgba.BackgroundTransparency=1;rgba.ZIndex=12111
        state.rgbaFrame=rgba
        for index,caption in {'R','G','B','Opacity %'}do
            local holder=make(state,'Frame',rgba,'Rgba'..index);holder.BackgroundTransparency=1;holder.Position=UDim2.new((index-1)/4,2,0,0);holder.Size=UDim2.new(.25,-4,1,0)
            local label=text(state,'TextLabel',holder,'ChannelName');label.Text=caption;label.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,18)
            local box=text(state,'TextBox',holder,'ChannelValue');box.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,20);box.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26);box.ClearTextOnFocus=false;box.BackgroundTransparency=.08;box.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
            state.rgba[index]=box
            connect(state,box.FocusLost,function()
                commit(state,function()
                local number=tonumber(box.Text)
                if finite(number)then
                    if index==4 and refs.updateAlpha then refs.updateAlpha(1-math.clamp(number,0,100)/100,true)
                    elseif index<4 and refs.setColor then
                        local current=refs.getColor and refs.getColor()or get(entry)
                        if current then
                            local values={current.R,current.G,current.B};values[index]=math.clamp(number,0,255)/255
                            refs.setColor(Color3.new(values[1],values[2],values[3]),true)
                        end
                    end
                end
                end)
            end)
        end
        local back=button(state,popup,'Back');back.Name='ColorAppearanceBack';back.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,8);back.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(56,24);back.Visible=#state.history>0
        connect(state,back.Activated,function()navigate(state,nil,true)end)
        if refs.title then refs.title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(if back.Visible then 76 else 12,7);refs.title.Size=UDim2.new(1,if back.Visible then -120 else -56,0,26)end
        local seen={}
        for _,related in menu.relatedSettings and menu.relatedSettings(entry)or {}do
            local id=idOf(related)
            if id and not seen[id]and appearanceEntry(related,entry)then seen[id]=true;makeRow(state,related)end
        end
        if #state.rows==0 then
            local empty=text(state,'TextLabel',state.appearance,'NoAdditionalAppearance');empty.Text='This color has no additional rendered appearance settings.'
            empty.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,10);empty.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,44);empty.TextWrapped=true
        end
        watch(state,entry)
        local function resize()
            if state.closed then return end
            local height=math.max(360,(popup.AbsoluteSize and popup.AbsoluteSize.Y or 540)-170)
            state.native.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,height)
            rgba.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,height-30);rgba.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,50)
            state.color.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,height+28);layoutRows(state)
        end
        state.resize=resize
        local function fitRestoredBounds()
            if state.closed or not popup.Parent then return end
            local parent=popup.Parent
            local view,origin=parent.AbsoluteSize,parent.AbsolutePosition
            local size,absolute=popup.Size,popup.AbsoluteSize
            if not view or not origin or not absolute or not finite(view.X)or not finite(view.Y)or view.X<=0 or view.Y<=0 then return end
            local sx=if size.X.Offset>0 and finite(absolute.X)and absolute.X>0 then absolute.X/size.X.Offset else 1
            local sy=if size.Y.Offset>0 and finite(absolute.Y)and absolute.Y>0 then absolute.Y/size.Y.Offset else 1
            sx,sy=math.max(.01,sx),math.max(.01,sy)
            local widthLimit,heightLimit=math.max(1,view.X/sx),math.max(1,view.Y/sy)
            -- Restore first, then enlarge and relocate using the enlarged size.
            -- The legacy picker could otherwise leave less than the new minimum
            -- available at the right/bottom edge before the shared resize clamps.
            local width=math.clamp(size.X.Offset,math.min(440,widthLimit),widthLimit)
            local height=math.clamp(size.Y.Offset,math.min(380,heightLimit),heightLimit)
            local position=popup.AbsolutePosition
            local x=math.clamp((position.X-origin.X)/sx,0,math.max(0,widthLimit-width))
            local y=math.clamp((position.Y-origin.Y)/sy,0,math.max(0,heightLimit-height))
            local anchor=popup.AnchorPoint
            popup.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
            popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x+(anchor and anchor.X or 0)*width,y+(anchor and anchor.Y or 0)*height)
        end
        if popup.GetPropertyChangedSignal then connect(state,popup:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),resize)end
        connect(state,state.colorTab.Activated,function()control.selectPage(state,'Color')end)
        connect(state,state.appearanceTab.Activated,function()control.selectPage(state,'Appearance')end)
        connect(state,input.InputChanged,function(event)
            if state.drag and(event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or event==state.drag.event)then control.drag(state,event.Position)end
        end)
        connect(state,input.InputEnded,function(event)
            if state.drag and(event==state.drag.event or event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)then state.drag=nil end
        end)
        if menu.attachPopupResize then menu.attachPopupResize(popup,440,380,state.connections,function()state.drag=nil;resize()end)end
        fitRestoredBounds()
        if popup.Parent.GetPropertyChangedSignal then connect(state,popup.Parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),function()fitRestoredBounds();resize()end)end
        if popup.Destroying then connect(state,popup.Destroying,function()control.detach(popup)end)end
        resize();control.selectPage(state,navigation and navigation.page or 'Color')
        if menu.ui and menu.ui.applyMiniAppearance then menu.ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup)end
        return state
    end
    function control.detach(popup)
        local state=control.states[popup]
        if not state or state.closed then return false end
        state.closed=true;state.drag=nil
        for _,connection in state.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        for index=#state.hooks,1,-1 do local hook=state.hooks[index];if hook.owner[hook.key]==hook.wrapper then hook.owner[hook.key]=hook.original end end
        for _,record in state.content do
            if record.object.Parent==state.native then record.object.Parent=record.parent;record.object.Position=record.position end
            for _,layer in record.layers do layer.object.ZIndex=layer.z end
        end
        for index=#state.owned,1,-1 do local object=state.owned[index];if object.Parent then object:Destroy()end end
        control.states[popup]=nil;if control.current==state then control.current=nil end
        control.detachCount+=1
        return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        for popup in control.states do control.detach(popup)end
        control.navigation=nil
    end
    return control
end
return ColorAppearancePanel
end)()

local MenuWarmup = (function(): any
-- Resolve only owned menu artwork and fonts in bounded background batches.
-- Existing rows remain hidden until selected; no gameplay/render loop is added.
local MenuWarmup={}
function MenuWarmup.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local control: any={alive=true,started=false,ready=false,complete=false,queued={},pending={},loaded={},failed={},connections={},scans=0,batches=0,requested=0,completed=0}
    local tasks=assert(host.task,'Menu asset preload requires the task scheduler')
    local provider
    local ok,value=pcall(function()return host.game:GetService('ContentProvider')end)
    if ok and value and type(value.PreloadAsync)=='function'then provider=value end
    local function content(value)
        return type(value)=='string'and value~=''and(value:match('^rbxasset')or value:match('^https://www%.roblox%.com/asset'))
    end
    local function keyOf(value)
        local id=value:match('^rbxassetid://(%d+)$')or value:match('[?&]id=(%d+)')
        return if id then 'asset:'..id else value
    end
    local function enqueue(value,source)
        if not control.alive or not content(value)or value=='rbxassetid://0'then return false end
        local key=keyOf(value)
        if control.queued[key]then return false end
        control.queued[key]=true;table.insert(control.pending,{id=value,input=source or value});control.requested+=1
        return true
    end
    local function inspect(object)
        if object:IsA('ImageLabel')or object:IsA('ImageButton')then enqueue(object.Image)
        elseif object:IsA('TextLabel')or object:IsA('TextButton')or object:IsA('TextBox')then
            local face=object.FontFace
            -- Loading the label resolves bundled font-family aliases and their
            -- actual face files; treating the family JSON as an image can fail.
            if face then enqueue(face.Family,object)end
        end
    end
    local function drain()
        if not control.alive or control.running or not control.started then return end
        if not provider then control.complete=true;control.unavailable=true;return end
        control.running=true;control.ready=false;control.complete=false
        tasks.spawn(function()
            while control.alive and #control.pending>0 do
                local batch,records={},{}
                for _=1,math.min(8,#control.pending)do
                    local record=table.remove(control.pending,1)
                    table.insert(records,record);table.insert(batch,record.input)
                end
                control.batches+=1
                local resolved={}
                local success,message=pcall(function()
                    provider:PreloadAsync(batch,function(id,status)
                        if not control.alive then return end
                        -- Text objects also report their unset ancillary content
                        -- slots. Those empty IDs are not requested menu assets.
                        if type(id)~='string'or id==''or id=='rbxassetid://0'then return end
                        local name=if type(status)=='string'then status else status and status.Name
                        local key=keyOf(id)
                        resolved[key]=true
                        if name=='Success'then control.loaded[key]=true;control.failed[key]=nil else control.failed[key]=tostring(name or status)end
                    end)
                end)
                if not control.alive then break end
                for _,record in records do
                    local id=record.id
                    local key=keyOf(id)
                    control.completed+=1
                    if not success then control.failed[key]=tostring(message)
                    elseif not resolved[key]and not control.loaded[key]then
                        local fetched,status=pcall(function()return provider:GetAssetFetchStatus(id)end)
                        if fetched and status and status.Name=='Success'then control.loaded[key]=true
                        else control.failed[key]='No successful asset status returned'end
                    end
                end
                if #control.pending>0 then tasks.wait()end
            end
            control.running=false
            if control.alive then control.complete=#control.pending==0;control.ready=control.complete and next(control.failed)==nil end
        end)
    end
    function control.note(object)
        if not control.alive then return end
        local before=control.requested;inspect(object)
        if control.started and control.requested~=before then drain()end
    end
    function control.start()
        if not control.alive or control.started then return false end
        control.started=true
        local root=menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        if not root then control.complete=true;return false end
        control.scans+=1;inspect(root)
        for _,object in root:GetDescendants()do inspect(object)end
        if root.DescendantAdded then table.insert(control.connections,root.DescendantAdded:Connect(control.note))end
        -- Palette changes reuse all existing objects; a chosen replacement font
        -- can be noted explicitly without a periodic tree walk.
        drain();return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(control.connections);table.clear(control.pending)
    end
    return control
end
return MenuWarmup
end)()

local MenuRenderGate = (function(): any
-- Embedded module type mode: nonstrict
-- Sleep only the owned menu screen; global input and its separate launcher stay live.
local MenuRenderGate = {}

function MenuRenderGate.new(_host: any, menu: any): any
    local control: any = {alive=true,sleeping=false,writes=0,connections={},surfaces={}}
    local panel=menu and menu.panel
    local root=panel and panel.Root
    if not panel or panel.NativeOwned~=true or not root or not root:IsA('ScreenGui')
        or root:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned')~=true then
        control.lastReason='No owned menu screen'
        function control.Destroy() control.alive=false end
        return control
    end
    local originalEnabled=root.Enabled
    local appliedEnabled: boolean?=nil
    local originalPopupRoot=menu.getPopupRoot
    local popupRootHook: any=nil
    local function connect(signal: any, callback: any, bucket: any)
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(bucket or control.connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function disconnect(bucket: any)
        for _,connection in bucket do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(bucket)
    end
    function control.refresh()
        if not control.alive or not root.Parent then return end
        local visible=false
        for surface,record in control.surfaces do
            if surface.Parent then
                for child in record.children do
                    if child.Parent==surface and child.Visible then visible=true;break end
                end
            end
            if visible then break end
        end
        if root.Enabled~=visible then
            root.Enabled=visible
            appliedEnabled=visible
            control.writes+=1
        end
        control.sleeping=not visible
        control.lastReason=if visible then 'Menu surface visible' else 'All menu surfaces hidden'
    end
    local function watchSurface(surface: any)
        if not control.alive or not surface or control.surfaces[surface] then return end
        local record: any={connections={},children={}}
        control.surfaces[surface]=record
        local function remove(child: any)
            local childConnections=record.children[child]
            if childConnections then
                record.children[child]=nil
                disconnect(childConnections)
                control.refresh()
            end
        end
        local function add(child: any)
            if not control.alive or record.children[child] or not child:IsA('GuiObject') then return end
            local childConnections={}
            record.children[child]=childConnections
            connect(child:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Visible'),control.refresh,childConnections)
            connect(child.Destroying,function() remove(child) end,childConnections)
            control.refresh()
        end
        connect(surface.ChildAdded,add,record.connections)
        connect(surface.ChildRemoved,remove,record.connections)
        connect(surface.AncestryChanged,control.refresh,record.connections)
        connect(surface.Destroying,function()
            control.surfaces[surface]=nil
            disconnect(record.connections)
            for _,childConnections in record.children do disconnect(childConnections) end
            table.clear(record.children)
            control.refresh()
        end,record.connections)
        for _,child in surface:GetChildren() do add(child) end
        control.refresh()
    end
    -- Popup screens are siblings of Root, and may be created long after startup.
    watchSurface(root)
    if menu.popupLayer then watchSurface(menu.popupLayer) end
    if type(originalPopupRoot)=='function' then
        popupRootHook=function(...)
            local results=table.pack(originalPopupRoot(...))
            if results[1] then watchSurface(results[1]) end
            return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
        end
        menu.getPopupRoot=popupRootHook
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        if popupRootHook and menu.getPopupRoot==popupRootHook then menu.getPopupRoot=originalPopupRoot end
        for _,record in control.surfaces do
            disconnect(record.connections)
            for _,childConnections in record.children do disconnect(childConnections) end
        end
        table.clear(control.surfaces)
        disconnect(control.connections)
        -- Preserve a later owner's explicit Enabled change.
        if appliedEnabled~=nil and root.Parent and root.Enabled==appliedEnabled then root.Enabled=originalEnabled end
        control.sleeping=false
    end
    control.refresh()
    return control
end

return MenuRenderGate
end)()

local NativeScoreboardKills = (function(): any
-- Reveal the game's existing replicated Hidden.Kills stat locally.
-- Only an owned Parent lease changes; numeric values and other stats are untouched.
local NativeScoreboardKills={}
function NativeScoreboardKills.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=false,records={},connections={},revealedCount=0,parentWrites=0,lastReason='Disabled'}
    local function connect(signal,callback,bucket)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function'then local connection=signal:Connect(callback);table.insert(bucket,connection);return connection end
        return nil
    end
    local function disconnect(bucket)
        for _,connection in bucket do connection:Disconnect()end;table.clear(bucket)
    end
    local function numericKills(object: any): boolean
        if not object or object.Name~='Kills'or not(object:IsA('NumberValue')or object:IsA('IntValue'))then return false end
        local value=object.Value
        return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function release(record,restore)
        local lease=record.lease
        if not lease then return end
        record.lease=nil;disconnect(record.killConnections)
        if lease.counted then control.revealedCount-=1 end
        if restore and lease.value.Parent==lease.stats then
            local ok,message=pcall(function()lease.value.Parent=lease.originalParent end)
            if ok then control.parentWrites+=1 else control.lastError=tostring(message)end
        end
    end
    local refresh
    local function bindHidden(record,hidden)
        if record.hidden==hidden then return end
        release(record,true);disconnect(record.hiddenConnections);record.hidden=hidden
        if not hidden then return end
        connect(hidden.ChildAdded,function()refresh(record)end,record.hiddenConnections)
        connect(hidden.ChildRemoved,function()refresh(record)end,record.hiddenConnections)
        connect(hidden.Destroying,function()
            local refreshing=record.refreshing
            record.hiddenDestroying=hidden;record.refreshing=true
            release(record,true)
            record.refreshing=refreshing
        end,record.hiddenConnections)
        if type(hidden.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then connect(hidden:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),function()refresh(record)end,record.hiddenConnections)end
    end
    local function bindStats(record,stats)
        if record.stats==stats then return end
        bindHidden(record,nil);disconnect(record.statsConnections);record.stats=stats
        if not stats then return end
        connect(stats.ChildAdded,function()refresh(record)end,record.statsConnections)
        connect(stats.ChildRemoved,function()refresh(record)end,record.statsConnections)
        if type(stats.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then connect(stats:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),function()refresh(record)end,record.statsConnections)end
    end
    refresh=function(record)
        if not control.alive or record.dead or record.refreshing then return end
        record.refreshing=true
        local actor=record.player
        local stats=actor.Parent and actor:FindFirstChild('leaderstats')
        if stats and not stats:IsA('Folder')then stats=nil end
        bindStats(record,stats)
        local hidden=stats and stats:FindFirstChild('Hidden')
        if hidden and not hidden:IsA('Folder')then hidden=nil end
        if hidden==record.hiddenDestroying then hidden=nil end
        bindHidden(record,hidden)
        local lease=record.lease
        if lease and(not control.enabled or lease.value.Parent~=stats or not numericKills(lease.value))then
            release(record,lease.value.Parent==stats);lease=nil
        end
        if control.enabled and stats and hidden and not record.lease then
            local kills=hidden:FindFirstChild('Kills')
            -- A genuinely visible stat already owns its native scoreboard row.
            if numericKills(kills)and not stats:FindFirstChild('Kills')then
                local nextLease={value=kills,stats=stats,originalParent=hidden}
                record.lease=nextLease
                local ok,message=pcall(function()kills.Parent=stats end)
                if ok then control.parentWrites+=1 else control.lastError=tostring(message)end
                if ok and record.lease==nextLease and kills.Parent==stats then
                    nextLease.counted=true;control.revealedCount+=1
                    if type(kills.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then
                        for _,property in {'Parent','Name'}do connect(kills:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property),function()refresh(record)end,record.killConnections)end
                    end
                    connect(kills.Destroying,function()release(record,false)end,record.killConnections)
                elseif record.lease==nextLease then record.lease=nil end
            end
        end
        record.refreshing=false
    end
    local function remove(actor)
        local record=control.records[actor]
        if not record then return end
        record.dead,record.refreshing=true,true
        release(record,true);disconnect(record.connections);disconnect(record.statsConnections);disconnect(record.hiddenConnections)
        control.records[actor]=nil
    end
    local function add(actor)
        if not control.alive or control.records[actor]then return end
        local record={player=actor,connections={},statsConnections={},hiddenConnections={},killConnections={}}
        control.records[actor]=record
        connect(actor.ChildAdded,function()refresh(record)end,record.connections)
        connect(actor.ChildRemoved,function()refresh(record)end,record.connections)
        refresh(record)
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        if not control.alive or type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        control.enabled=value
        for _,record in control.records do refresh(record)end
        control.lastReason=if value then 'Showing actual replicated hidden kill stats'else 'Disabled'
        return true
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if not control.alive or control.controlsCreated or not tab then return end
        tab=tab.tab or tab
        if type(tab.CreateToggle)~='function'then return end
        control.controlsCreated=true
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Reveal Hidden Scoreboard Kills',Description='Show the real replicated Kills value stored in each player’s Hidden folder. Turning this off restores the native hidden location; counts are never copied or modified.',Default=false,Callback=control.setEnabled})
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.enabled=false
        for actor in control.records do remove(actor)end
        disconnect(control.connections);control.alive=false;control.lastReason='Unloaded'
    end
    connect(players.PlayerAdded,add,control.connections)
    connect(players.PlayerRemoving,remove,control.connections)
    for _,actor in players:GetPlayers()do add(actor)end
    return control
end
return NativeScoreboardKills
end)()

local NativeGlyphs = (function(): any
-- Embedded module type mode: nocheck
-- Font-independent icons for the owned menu. Captions keep the selected font.
-- Only known disclosure/checkmark strings are replaced; no render/input loop.
local NativeGlyphs={}
function NativeGlyphs.new(host,menu)
    local control={alive=true,roots={},records={},connections={}}
    local DOWN,RIGHT,CHECK,BOX_ON,BOX_OFF='\226\150\190','\226\150\184','\226\156\147','\226\152\145','\226\152\144'
    local function connect(signal,callback,bucket)
        if not signal then return end
        local connection=signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(bucket or control.connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function own(class,name,parent)
        local object=host.Instance.new(class)
        object.Name=name
        object:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true)
        object:SetAttribute('CullingModern',true)
        object:SetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer',true)
        object:SetAttribute('CullingGlyphLayer',true)
        if object:IsA('GuiObject')then
            object.BackgroundTransparency=1;object.BorderSizePixel=0;object.Active=false
        end
        object.Parent=parent
        return object
    end
    local function text(object)
        return object and (object:IsA('TextLabel')or object:IsA('TextButton'))
            and not object:GetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer')and not object:GetAttribute('CullingGlyphLayer')
    end
    local function classify(object,raw:string,previous)
        local suffix=raw:sub(-#DOWN)
        if suffix==DOWN or suffix==RIGHT then
            local caption=raw:sub(1,#raw-#suffix):gsub('%s+$','')
            return 'arrow',caption,suffix==DOWN,if caption==''then 'center'else 'trailing'
        end
        if raw==CHECK and (object.Name=='Checkmark'or object.Name=='Check'or object.Parent and object.Parent.Name=='Checkbox')then
            return 'tick','',true,'center'
        end
        if object.Name:match('^Choice_')then
            local prefix=raw:sub(1,#BOX_ON)
            if prefix==BOX_ON or prefix==BOX_OFF then
                local caption=raw:sub(#prefix+1):gsub('^%s+','')
                return 'box',caption,prefix==BOX_ON,if caption==''then 'center'else 'leading'
            end
        end
        if object.Name:match('^Player_')then
            if raw:sub(1,#CHECK)==CHECK then return 'tick',raw:sub(#CHECK+1):gsub('^%s+',''),true,'leading'end
            if previous and previous.position=='leading'and previous.kind=='tick'and raw:sub(1,4)=='    'then
                return 'tick',raw:sub(5),false,'leading'
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function segment(parent,name,x1,y1,x2,y2)
        local frame=own('Frame',name,parent)
        frame.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5)
        frame.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset((x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2)
        frame.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt((x2-x1)^2+(y2-y1)^2),2)
        frame.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1))
        frame.BackgroundTransparency=0
        return frame
    end
    local function deleteFigure(record)
        if record.figure then record.figure:Destroy();record.figure=nil end
        if record.padding then record.padding:Destroy();record.padding=nil end
        record.parts,record.tickParts=nil,nil
    end
    local function makeFigure(object,record,kind)
        deleteFigure(record)
        local holder=own('Frame','NativeMenuGlyph',object)
        holder.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(12,12)
        holder.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5)
        holder.ClipsDescendants=false
        record.figure,record.parts,record.tickParts=holder,{},{}
        if kind=='arrow'then
            table.insert(record.parts,segment(holder,'Upper',3,2,8,6))
            table.insert(record.parts,segment(holder,'Lower',8,6,3,10))
        else
            if kind=='box'then
                for index,points in {{1,1,11,1},{11,1,11,11},{11,11,1,11},{1,11,1,1}}do
                    table.insert(record.parts,segment(holder,'Edge'..index,table.unpack(points)))
                end
            end
            table.insert(record.tickParts,segment(holder,'TickShort',2.5,6,5,8.5))
            table.insert(record.tickParts,segment(holder,'TickLong',5,8.5,10,2.5))
            for _,part in record.tickParts do table.insert(record.parts,part)end
        end
        return holder
    end
    local function sync(object,record)
        local figure=record.figure
        if not figure or not figure.Parent then return end
        -- UIPadding reserves caption space, and also shrinks the coordinate
        -- space used by child icons. Compensate so the arrow stays at the
        -- actual edge of its button rather than drifting into the caption.
        if record.position~='center'and not object:FindFirstChildOfClass('UIPadding')then
            record.padding=own('UIPadding','NativeGlyphPadding',object)
        end
        if record.padding then
            record.padding.PaddingLeft=host.UDim.new(0,if record.position=='leading'and record.active then 18 else 0)
            record.padding.PaddingRight=host.UDim.new(0,if record.position=='trailing'and record.active then 18 else 0)
        end
        figure.Visible=record.active and object.Visible~=false
        figure.Position=if record.position=='trailing'then host.UDim2.new(1,if record.padding then 7 else -11,.5,0)
            elseif record.position=='leading'then host.UDim2.new(0,if record.padding then -9 else 9,.5,0)else host.UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
        figure.Rotation=if record.kind=='arrow'and record.checked then 90 else 0
        figure.ZIndex=object.ZIndex+1
        for _,part in record.parts do
            part.BackgroundColor3=object.TextColor3
            part.BackgroundTransparency=object.TextTransparency
            part.ZIndex=figure.ZIndex
        end
        for _,part in record.tickParts do part.Visible=record.checked end
    end
    function control.refresh(object)
        local record=control.records[object]
        if not control.alive or not record or record.writing or not object.Parent then return end
        local raw=object.Text
        -- A palette/visibility update sees our cleaned caption. It must retain
        -- the icon state until the actual caption owner publishes new text.
        if raw==record.cleaned then sync(object,record);return end
        local kind,caption,checked,position=classify(object,raw,record)
        record.raw=raw
        if not kind then record.active=false;record.cleaned=raw;sync(object,record);return end
        if not record.figure or record.kind~=kind then makeFigure(object,record,kind)end
        if not record.styleConnected then
            record.styleConnected=true
            for _,property in {'TextColor3','TextTransparency','Visible','ZIndex','Rotation'}do
                connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property),function()if control.alive and not record.writing then sync(object,record)end end,record.connections)
            end
        end
        record.kind,record.position,record.checked,record.active=kind,position,checked,true
        record.cleaned=caption
        record.writing=true;object.Text=caption;record.writing=false
        sync(object,record)
    end
    local function forget(object,restore)
        local record=control.records[object]
        if not record then return end
        for _,connection in record.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        if restore and object.Parent and object.Text==record.cleaned and record.raw then object.Text=record.raw end
        deleteFigure(record);control.records[object]=nil
    end
    local function note(object)
        if not text(object)or control.records[object]then return end
        if not object:IsA('TextButton')and object.Name~='Disclosure'and object.Name~='Checkmark'and object.Text~=CHECK and object.Text~=DOWN and object.Text~=RIGHT then return end
        local record={connections={},active=false}
        control.records[object]=record
        connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'),function()control.refresh(object)end,record.connections)
        connect(object.Destroying,function()forget(object,false)end,record.connections)
        control.refresh(object)
    end
    function control.addRoot(root)
        if not root or control.roots[root]then return end
        control.roots[root]=true
        for _,object in root:GetDescendants()do note(object)end
        connect(root.DescendantAdded,function(object)
            if object:GetAttribute('CullingTextStyleLayer')or object:GetAttribute('CullingGlyphLayer')then return end
            local function added()
                if not control.alive or not object.Parent then return end
                note(object)
                for _,child in object:GetDescendants()do note(child)end
            end
            if host.task and host.task.defer then host.task.defer(added)else added()end
        end)
    end
    if menu.panel then control.addRoot(menu.panel.Root)end
    control.addRoot(menu.popupLayer)
    local originalPopupRoot=menu.getPopupRoot
    local popupRootHook
    if originalPopupRoot then
        popupRootHook=function(...)
            local root=originalPopupRoot(...)
            if control.alive then control.addRoot(root)end
            return root
        end
        menu.getPopupRoot=popupRootHook
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        for _,connection in control.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(control.connections)
        for object in control.records do forget(object,true)end
        table.clear(control.roots)
        if popupRootHook and menu.getPopupRoot==popupRootHook then menu.getPopupRoot=originalPopupRoot end
    end
    return control
end
return NativeGlyphs
end)()

local HalloweenDoors = (function(): any
-- Local, event-driven highlights for spawned Halloween interaction doors.
local HalloweenDoors={}
type DoorState = {alive: boolean, enabled: boolean, folder: any?, records: {[any]: any}, connections: {any},
    generation: number, scans: number, color: any, fillTransparency: number, outlineTransparency: number, [string]: any}
function HalloweenDoors.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local world=host.workspace
    local control: DoorState={alive=true,enabled=false,records={},connections={},generation=0,scans=0,
        color=host.Color3.fromRGB(255,170,40),fillTransparency=.9,outlineTransparency=0}
    local function disconnect(connections)
        for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    local function own(class,name,parent)
        local object=host.Instance.new(class)
        object.Name=name;object:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true);object.Parent=parent
        return object
    end
    local function clearHighlight(record)
        if record.highlight then record.highlight:Destroy();record.highlight=nil end
    end
    local function forget(model)
        local record=control.records[model]
        if not record then return end
        control.records[model]=nil
        disconnect(record.connections);clearHighlight(record)
    end
    local function style(highlight)
        highlight.FillColor=control.color;highlight.OutlineColor=control.color
        highlight.FillTransparency=control.fillTransparency
        highlight.OutlineTransparency=control.outlineTransparency
    end
    local function refresh(record)
        local model=record.model
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or control.records[model]~=record then return end
        if model.Name~='HalloweenDoor' or not model:IsDescendantOf(world) then forget(model);return end
        -- A HalloweenDoor inside the combat NPC named Door is a spent/mimic
        -- actor, not an interaction door. Decorative portals have no prompt.
        local ancestor=model
        while ancestor and ancestor~=world do
            if ancestor.Name=='Characters' or ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then
                record.prompt=nil;clearHighlight(record);return
            end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
        local door=model:FindFirstChild('Door')
        local prompt=door and door:IsA('BasePart') and door:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt',true)
        record.prompt=prompt or nil
        if not prompt then clearHighlight(record);return end
        -- The native prompt is disabled during its countdown. The spawned
        -- door is still worth locating; never change or trigger that prompt.
        if not record.highlight or not record.highlight.Parent then
            local highlight=own('Highlight','HalloweenDoorHighlight',control.folder)
            highlight.Adornee=model
            highlight.DepthMode=host.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            highlight.Enabled=true;style(highlight)
            record.highlight=highlight
        end
    end
    local function queue(record)
        if record.pending then return end
        record.pending=true
        host.task.defer(function()record.pending=false;refresh(record)end)
    end
    local function watch(model)
        if not control.alive or not control.enabled or not model:IsA('Model') or model.Name~='HalloweenDoor'
            or control.records[model] or not model:IsDescendantOf(world) then return end
        local record={model=model,connections={}}
        control.records[model]=record
        local function connect(signal,callback)table.insert(record.connections,signal:Connect(callback))end
        connect(model.DescendantAdded,function()queue(record)end)
        connect(model.DescendantRemoving,function()queue(record)end)
        connect(model.AncestryChanged,function()queue(record)end)
        connect(model:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),function()queue(record)end)
        connect(model.Destroying,function()forget(model)end)
        refresh(record)
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value)
        local enabled=value==true and control.alive
        if control.enabled==enabled then return true end
        control.enabled=enabled;control.generation+=1
        disconnect(control.connections)
        for model in control.records do forget(model)end
        if control.folder then control.folder:Destroy();control.folder=nil end
        if not enabled then return true end
        control.folder=own('Folder','ShenaniganismHalloweenDoors',world)
        table.insert(control.connections,world.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch))
        local generation=control.generation
        host.task.spawn(function()
            control.scans+=1
            local objects=world:GetDescendants()
            for index,object in objects do
                if not control.alive or not control.enabled or control.generation~=generation then return end
                watch(object)
                if index%2000==0 then host.task.wait()end
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    local function restyle()
        for _,record in control.records do if record.highlight then style(record.highlight)end end
    end
    function control.setColor(value)
        if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3' then return false end
        control.color=value;restyle();return true
    end
    local function alpha(field,percent)
        local value=tonumber(percent)
        if not value or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return false end
        control[field]=math.clamp(value,0,100)/100;restyle();return true
    end
    function control.setFillTransparency(value)return alpha('fillTransparency',value)end
    function control.setOutlineTransparency(value)return alpha('outlineTransparency',value)end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Halloween Door ESP',Description='Highlight spawned Halloween doors through walls, including doors counting down. Updates automatically as doors appear and disappear.',Default=true,Callback=control.setEnabled})
        tab:CreateColorPicker({Name='Halloween Door ESP Color',DisplayName='Door Highlight Color',Default='255, 170, 40',QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=control.setColor,
            GetTransparency=function()return control.outlineTransparency end,
            SetTransparency=function(value)
                local entry=menu.entries['Main/Halloween Door ESP Outline Transparency (%)']
                if entry then entry.widget.Set(value*100,true)end
            end})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='Halloween Door ESP Fill Transparency (%)',DisplayName='Door Fill Transparency (%)',Min=0,Max=100,Default=90,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=control.setFillTransparency})
        tab:CreateSlider({Name='Halloween Door ESP Outline Transparency (%)',DisplayName='Door Outline Transparency (%)',Min=0,Max=100,Default=0,Step=1,Precision=0,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=control.setOutlineTransparency})
        control.setEnabled(true)
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false;control.setEnabled(false)
    end
    return control
end
return HalloweenDoors
end)()

local AntiAFK = (function(): any
-- One owned idle listener. No frame timer, foreign connection edits or held input.
local AntiAFK={}
function AntiAFK.new(host,menu)
    menu=menu or {}
    local function service(name)
        local ok,value=pcall(function()return host.game:GetService(name)end)
        return if ok then value else nil
    end
    local players=service('Players')
    local player=players and players.LocalPlayer
    local input=service('UserInputService')
    local gui=service('GuiService')
    local virtualUser=service('VirtualUser')
    local world=host.workspace or service('Workspace')
    local control={alive=true,enabled=true,created=false,ready=false,connection=nil,pulses=0,skipped=0,
        disconnectPreventionVerified=false,lastReason='Not connected'}
    local function disconnect()
        if control.connection then
            pcall(function()control.connection:Disconnect()end)
            control.connection=nil
        end
        control.ready=false
    end
    local function available()
        local ok,value=pcall(function()
            return player~=nil and player.Idled~=nil and input~=nil and virtualUser~=nil
                and type(virtualUser.CaptureController)=='function' and type(virtualUser.ClickButton2)=='function'
                and type(input.GetFocusedTextBox)=='function' and type(input.GetKeysPressed)=='function'
