            local materials=E.Material
            local materialKey=CHAM_MATERIALS[value]
            if not materials or not materialKey or materials[materialKey]==nil then return false end
        end
        local current=settings[key]
        if type(current)=='boolean'then
            if type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        elseif key:match('Color$')then
            if (host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3'then return false end
            if not finite(value.R)or not finite(value.G)or not finite(value.B)then return false end
        elseif choices[key]then
            if type(value)~='string'or not choices[key][value]then return false end
        else
            if not finite(value)then return false end
            local range=bounds[key]or(key:match('Transparency$')and{0,1})
            if not range then return false end
            value=math.clamp(value,range[1],range[2])
            if key=='maxActors'then value=math.floor(value)end
        end
        local selectingCustom=not menu.restoringControls and key~='cursorColor'and key~='wallColor'and key:sub(1,4)~='card'and key:match('Color$')and settings.colorMode~='Custom'
        if current==value and not selectingCustom then control.syncAppearanceAliases(key);return true end
        settings[key]=value;control.version+=1
        if key=='scanIntervalMs'then discoveryElapsed=0 end
        if not menu.restoringControls then
            if key=='outlineStyle'then
                settings.boxStyle=if value=='3D Box'or value=='Mesh + 3D Box'then '3D'else 'None'
                local field=menu.generalESPSettings and menu.generalESPSettings.fields.boxStyle
                if field then field.widget.Set(settings.boxStyle,false)end
            end
            if key~='cursorColor'and key~='wallColor'and key:sub(1,4)~='card'and key:match('Color$')and settings.colorMode~='Custom'then
                settings.colorMode='Custom'
                local field=menu.generalESPSettings and menu.generalESPSettings.fields.colorMode
                if field then field.widget.Set('Custom',false)end
            end
            control.syncAppearanceAliases(key)
        end
        if key=='enabled'or key=='cursorEnabled'then
            if not settings.cursorEnabled then control.cursorTarget=nil end
            if active()then if not running then start()else control.refresh()end;control.present(1)else stop()end
        elseif active()then
            if key=='throughWalls'then for _,record in control.records do record.wallVisible=false end end
            control.refresh();control.present(1)
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        settings.enabled=false;control.alive=false;stop()
    end
    return control
end

return GeneralESP
end)()

local GeneralESPPreview = (function(): any
-- On-demand, script-free mannequin preview. Never reads or clones a game actor.
local GeneralESPPreview={}
function GeneralESPPreview.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,state=nil,opens=0}
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.presentationRunService or host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local UDim2,Vector3,CFrame,Color3,Enum=host.UDim2,host.Vector3,host.CFrame,host.Color3,host.Enum
    local function connect(state,signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function'then state.connections[#state.connections+1]=signal:Connect(callback)end
    end
    local function make(state,class,name,parent)
        local object=host.Instance.new(class);object.Name=name
        object:SetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned',true)
        object.Parent=parent;return object
    end
    local function text(state,class,name,caption,parent)
        local object=make(state,class,name,parent)
        object.Text=caption;object.BackgroundTransparency=1;object.BorderSizePixel=0;object.TextSize=13
        object.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,240);object.ZIndex=12202
        local font=menu.environment and menu.environment.THEME_FONT;if font then object.FontFace=font end
        if Enum.TextTruncate then object.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end
        return object
    end
    local function cleanup(state,alreadyDestroying)
        if not state or state.closed then return end
        state.closed=true
        for _,connection in state.connections do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(state.connections)
        if control.state==state then control.state=nil end
        if menu.popup==state.popup then menu.popup=nil end
        if not alreadyDestroying then state.popup:Destroy()end
    end
    function control.close()cleanup(control.state,false)end
    function control.refresh()
        if control.state then control.state.dirty=true end
    end
    local function settings()
        local renderer=menu.generalESP
        return if renderer and renderer.getSettings then renderer.getSettings()else nil
    end
    local function part(state,name,size,position)
        local object=make(state,'Part',name,state.world)
        object.Size=size;object.CFrame=CFrame.new(position)
        object.Anchored=true;object.CanCollide=false;object.CanTouch=false;object.CanQuery=false
        object.CastShadow=false;object.Color=Color3.fromRGB(160,165,175)
        if Enum.Material then object.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end
        return object
    end
    local function paintLine(line,a,b,width,color,alpha)
        local dx,dy=b.X-a.X,b.Y-a.Y
        line.Position=UDim2.fromOffset((a.X+b.X)*.5,(a.Y+b.Y)*.5)
        line.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy),width)
        line.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5);line.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(dy,dx))
        line.BackgroundColor3=color;line.BackgroundTransparency=alpha;line.Visible=true
    end
    function control.present()
        local state=control.state
        if not control.alive or not state or state.closed or not state.dirty then return end
        local config=settings();if not config then return end
        local size=state.viewport.AbsoluteSize
        if not size or size.X<1 or size.Y<1 then return end
        state.dirty=false
        local center=Vector3.new(0,.5,0)
        local cp=math.cos(state.pitch)
        local position=center+Vector3.new(math.sin(state.yaw)*cp,math.sin(state.pitch),math.cos(state.yaw)*cp)*state.distance
        state.camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(position,center)
        state.camera.FieldOfView=45
        local scale=config.boxScale or 1
        local padding=(config.boxPadding or 0)*2
        local extent=Vector3.new((config.boxWidth or 4)*scale+padding,(config.boxHeight or 6)*scale+padding,(config.boxDepth or 2.5)*scale+padding)*.5
        local origin=center+Vector3.new(config.offsetX or 0,config.offsetY or 0,config.offsetZ or 0)
        local corners={}
        local left,top,right,bottom=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge
        local pixels=size.Y/(2*math.tan(math.rad(45)*.5))
        for _,x in {-1,1}do for _,y in {-1,1}do for _,z in {-1,1}do
            local point=origin+Vector3.new(extent.X*x,extent.Y*y,extent.Z*z)
            corners[#corners+1]=point
            local localPoint=state.camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
            local depth=math.max(.05,-localPoint.Z)
            local px,py=size.X*.5+localPoint.X*pixels/depth,size.Y*.5-localPoint.Y*pixels/depth
            left,top,right,bottom=math.min(left,px),math.min(top,py),math.max(right,px),math.max(bottom,py)
        end end end
        for _,object in state.lines do object.Visible=false end
        for _,object in state.shadows do object.Visible=false end
        for _,object in state.edges do object.Transparency=1 end
        local style=config.boxStyle or 'Corners'
        local color=config.boxColor or Color3.fromRGB(80,200,255)
        local alpha=config.boxTransparency or 0
        local width=config.lineThickness or 1.5
        local function segment(index,x1,y1,x2,y2)
            local a,b={X=x1,Y=y1},{X=x2,Y=y2}
            if config.shadowEnabled then paintLine(state.shadows[index],a,b,width+2*(config.shadowThickness or 1),config.shadowColor or Color3.new(0,0,0),config.shadowTransparency or .4)end
            paintLine(state.lines[index],a,b,width,color,alpha)
        end
        if style=='3D'then
            local index=0
            for a,point in corners do for b=a+1,#corners do
                local other=corners[b]
                local differences=(if point.X~=other.X then 1 else 0)+(if point.Y~=other.Y then 1 else 0)+(if point.Z~=other.Z then 1 else 0)
                if differences==1 then
                    index+=1;local edge=state.edges[index];local length=(other-point).Magnitude
                    local thickness=math.max(.008,width*state.distance/pixels)
                    edge.Size=Vector3.new(thickness,thickness,length)
                    edge.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((point+other)*.5,other)
                    edge.Color=color;edge.Transparency=alpha
                end
            end end
        elseif style=='2D'then
            segment(1,left,top,right,top);segment(2,right,top,right,bottom)
            segment(3,right,bottom,left,bottom);segment(4,left,bottom,left,top)
        elseif style=='Corners'then
            local length=math.min(right-left,bottom-top)*.23
            segment(1,left,top,left+length,top);segment(2,left,top,left,top+length)
            segment(3,right,top,right-length,top);segment(4,right,top,right,top+length)
            segment(5,left,bottom,left+length,bottom);segment(6,left,bottom,left,bottom-length)
            segment(7,right,bottom,right-length,bottom);segment(8,right,bottom,right,bottom-length)
        end
        for _,body in state.body do
            local material=Enum.Material and Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            local materialKey=if config.fillEnabled then CHAM_MATERIALS[config.fillMaterial]else nil
            if materialKey and Enum.Material and Enum.Material[materialKey]then material=Enum.Material[materialKey]end
            if material then body.Material=material end
            body.Color=if config.fillEnabled then config.fillColor or color else Color3.fromRGB(160,165,175)
            body.Transparency=if config.fillEnabled then config.fillTransparency or .8 else 0
        end
        local labels={}
        if config.showName then labels[#labels+1]='Preview Player'end
        if config.showDistance then labels[#labels+1]='20 studs'end
        if config.showHealth then labels[#labels+1]='100/100'end
        state.label.Visible=config.labelsEnabled==true;state.label.Text=table.concat(labels,'  ')
        state.label.TextColor3=config.labelColor or Color3.new(1,1,1);state.label.TextTransparency=config.labelTransparency or 0
        state.label.TextSize=config.labelSize or 13
        state.label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(left,math.max(0,top-(config.labelOffset or 8)-24))
        state.label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(80,right-left),24)
        state.note.Text='Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom\nChanges use your normal ESP settings and save with them.'
    end
    function control.open()
        if not control.alive then return false,'Preview is unloaded' end
        if control.state and not control.state.closed then control.refresh();return true end
        if not settings()then return false,'General ESP renderer is unavailable' end
        local parent=if menu.getPopupRoot then menu.getPopupRoot()else menu.panel and menu.panel.Root
        if not parent then return false,'Preview surface is unavailable' end
        local entry=menu.popupEntry
        local owner=menu.popup
        local docked=owner and owner.Parent and owner.Name=='CullingQuickSettings'
            and entry and entry.config and entry.config.GeneralESPOwned==true
        if not docked and menu.closePopup then menu.closePopup()end
        local state: any={connections={},body={},edges={},lines={},shadows={},yaw=.45,pitch=.12,distance=12,dirty=true,
            owner=if docked then owner else nil}
        control.state=state
        local okay,failure=pcall(function()
            local popup=make(state,'Frame','GeneralESPPreview',parent);state.popup=popup
            popup:SetAttribute('CullingMiniMenuSurface',true)
            popup.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(460,470);popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(40,60)
            popup.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(28,31,38);popup.BorderSizePixel=1;popup.ZIndex=12200
            popup.Active=true;popup.ClipsDescendants=true
            if not docked then menu.popup=popup end
            if docked then
                local function placeBeside()
                    if state.closed or not owner.Parent then return end
                    local origin,view=parent.AbsolutePosition,parent.AbsoluteSize
                    local at,size=owner.AbsolutePosition,owner.AbsoluteSize
                    local width,height=math.min(460,math.max(180,view.X-16)),math.min(470,math.max(180,view.Y-16))
                    local x,y=at.X-origin.X+size.X+8,at.Y-origin.Y
                    if x+width>view.X-8 then x=at.X-origin.X-width-8 end
                    popup.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
                    popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x,0,math.max(0,view.X-width)),math.clamp(y,0,math.max(0,view.Y-height)))
                    state.dirty=true
                end
                placeBeside()
                connect(state,owner:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsolutePosition'),placeBeside)
                connect(state,owner:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),placeBeside)
                connect(state,parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),placeBeside)
                connect(state,owner.Destroying,control.close)
            end
            local title=text(state,'TextLabel','Title','Advanced ESP Preview',popup)
            title.Position,title.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,6),UDim2.new(1,-128,0,28);title.Active=true
            local reset=text(state,'TextButton','Reset','Reset',popup)
            reset.Position,reset.Size=UDim2.new(1,-110,0,6),UDim2.fromOffset(64,28)
            local close=text(state,'TextButton','Close','×',popup)
            close.Position,close.Size=UDim2.new(1,-38,0,6),UDim2.fromOffset(28,28)
            local viewport=make(state,'ViewportFrame','PreviewViewport',popup);state.viewport=viewport
            viewport:SetAttribute('CullingColorGraphic',true)
            viewport.Position,viewport.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,42),UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-170)
            viewport.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,23,29);viewport.BackgroundTransparency=.12
            viewport.BorderSizePixel=0;viewport.ZIndex=12201;viewport.Active=true;viewport.ClipsDescendants=true
            viewport.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(200,200,210);viewport.LightColor=Color3.new(1,1,1);viewport.LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-1,-1)
            state.world=make(state,'WorldModel','PreviewWorld',viewport)
            state.camera=make(state,'Camera','PreviewCamera',viewport);viewport.CurrentCamera=state.camera
            local overlay=make(state,'Frame','PreviewOverlay',popup);state.overlay=overlay
            overlay.Position,overlay.Size=viewport.Position,viewport.Size
            overlay.BackgroundTransparency=1;overlay.BorderSizePixel=0;overlay.ZIndex=12202;overlay.ClipsDescendants=true;overlay.Active=true
            overlay:SetAttribute('CullingColorGraphic',true)
            for _,spec in {{'Torso',Vector3.new(2,2,1),Vector3.new(0,1,0)},
                {'Head',Vector3.new(2,1,1),Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)},
                {'LeftArm',Vector3.new(1,2,1),Vector3.new(-1.5,1,0)},
                {'RightArm',Vector3.new(1,2,1),Vector3.new(1.5,1,0)},
                {'LeftLeg',Vector3.new(1,2,1),Vector3.new(-.5,-1,0)},
                {'RightLeg',Vector3.new(1,2,1),Vector3.new(.5,-1,0)}}do
                state.body[#state.body+1]=part(state,spec[1],spec[2],spec[3])
            end
            for index=1,12 do state.edges[index]=part(state,'BoxEdge'..index,Vector3.new(.01,.01,.01),Vector3.new(0,0,0));state.edges[index].Transparency=1 end
            for index=1,8 do
                for _,pair in {{state.shadows,'BoxShadow',12203},{state.lines,'BoxLine',12204}}do
                    local line=make(state,'Frame',pair[2]..index,overlay);line.BorderSizePixel=0;line.ZIndex=pair[3];pair[1][index]=line
                end
            end
            state.label=text(state,'TextLabel','ActorLabel','',overlay);state.label.ZIndex=12205
            state.note=text(state,'TextLabel','PreviewNote','',popup);state.note.TextWrapped=true
            state.note.Position,state.note.Size=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-54),UDim2.new(1,-24,0,46)
            local drag,move
            local function dragStart(event)
                if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag=event.Position end
            end
            connect(state,viewport.InputBegan,dragStart)
            connect(state,overlay.InputBegan,dragStart)
            connect(state,title.InputBegan,function(event)
                if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then move={at=event.Position,position=popup.Position}end
            end)
            local function wheel(event)
                if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and state.lastWheel~=event then
                    state.lastWheel=event;state.distance=math.clamp(state.distance-event.Position.Z,5,35);state.dirty=true
                end
            end
            connect(state,viewport.InputChanged,wheel)
            connect(state,overlay.InputChanged,wheel)
            connect(state,input.InputChanged,function(event)
                if event.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and event.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                if drag then
                    local dx,dy=event.Position.X-drag.X,event.Position.Y-drag.Y;drag=event.Position
                    state.yaw+=dx*.012;state.pitch=math.clamp(state.pitch+dy*.008,-1.1,1.1);state.dirty=true
                elseif move then
                    local x=move.position.X.Offset+event.Position.X-move.at.X
                    local y=move.position.Y.Offset+event.Position.Y-move.at.Y
                    popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x,0,math.max(0,parent.AbsoluteSize.X-popup.AbsoluteSize.X)),math.clamp(y,0,math.max(0,parent.AbsoluteSize.Y-popup.AbsoluteSize.Y)))
                end
            end)
            connect(state,input.InputEnded,function(event)
                if event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or event.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag,move=nil,nil end
            end)
            connect(state,input.WindowFocusReleased,function()drag,move=nil,nil end)
            connect(state,reset.Activated,function()state.yaw,state.pitch,state.distance=.45,.12,12;state.dirty=true end)
            connect(state,close.Activated,control.close)
            connect(state,viewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'),function()state.dirty=true end)
            connect(state,popup.Destroying,function()cleanup(state,true)end)
            if menu.attachPopupResize then menu.attachPopupResize(popup,320,340,state.connections,function()drag,move=nil,nil;state.dirty=true end)end
            if menu.ui and menu.ui.applyMiniAppearance then menu.ui.applyMiniAppearance(popup)end
            connect(state,run.RenderStepped,control.present)
            control.opens+=1;control.present()
        end)
        if not okay then
            control.lastError=tostring(failure)
            if state.popup then cleanup(state,false)else control.state=nil end
            return false,control.lastError
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.close();control.alive=false
        if menu.generalESPPreview==control then menu.generalESPPreview=nil end
    end
    return control
end
return GeneralESPPreview
end)()

local GeneralESPSettings = (function(): any
-- Saved controls for the independent General ESP renderer.
local GeneralESPSettings={}
local miniGroups={}
for _,key in {'players','npcs','showSelf','revealInvisible','excludeFriends','throughWalls','onlyAttacked','maxDistance','maxActors','colorMode','distanceFade','fadeStart','updateRate','scanIntervalMs'}do miniGroups[key]='Visibility & filters'end
for _,key in {'boxStyle','boxColor','boxTransparency','lineThickness','boxPadding','boxScale','boxWidth','boxHeight','boxDepth','offsetX','offsetY','offsetZ'}do miniGroups[key]='Boxes, dimensions & position'end
for _,key in {'fillEnabled','fillColor','fillTransparency','fillMaterial','outlineEnabled','outlineColor','outlineTransparency','outlineThickness','outlineStyle','depthMode'}do miniGroups[key]='Mesh outline & chams'end
for _,key in {'outlineEffect','glowStrength','glowRadius','bloomEnabled','bloomIntensity','bloomSize','bloomThreshold','shadowEnabled','shadowColor','shadowTransparency','shadowThickness'}do miniGroups[key]='Glow & bloom'end
for _,key in {'labelsEnabled','labelColor','labelTransparency','labelSize','labelOffset','showName','showDistance','showHealth'}do miniGroups[key]='Labels'end
for _,key in {'skeletonEnabled','skeletonColor','skeletonTransparency','skeletonThickness','tracerEnabled','tracerColor','tracerTransparency','tracerThickness','tracerOrigin','headEnabled','headColor','headTransparency','headSize','facingEnabled','facingColor','facingTransparency','facingLength','facingThickness','offscreenEnabled','offscreenOnlyMarked','offscreenColor','offscreenTransparency','offscreenSize','offscreenRadius','offscreenDistance'}do miniGroups[key]='Markers, skeleton & tracers'end
local legacyMiniGroups={
    ['Outline Players I Hit']='Hit duration',['Keep Hit Outline Until Death']='Hit duration',['Hit Outline Duration (s)']='Hit duration',
    ['Hit Outline Color']='Mesh outline & chams',['Hit Outline Transparency (%)']='Mesh outline & chams',['Hit Outline Thickness (px)']='Mesh outline & chams',
    ['Hit Outline Fill Character']='Mesh outline & chams',['Hit Outline Fill Color']='Mesh outline & chams',['Hit Outline Fill Transparency (%)']='Mesh outline & chams',
    ['Hit Outline Cham Material']='Mesh outline & chams',['Hit Outline Depth Mode']='Mesh outline & chams',['Hit Outline Render Style']='Mesh outline & chams',
}
function GeneralESPSettings.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    for _,key in {'cursorEnabled','cursorMethod','cursorRadius','cursorRayDistance','cursorColor','cursorUpdateRate'}do miniGroups[key]='Cursor ray ESP'end
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,created=false,rows={},fields={},rowCount=0}
    local function renderer()
        local owner=menu.generalESP
        return if owner and owner.alive~=false and type(owner.set)=='function'and type(owner.getSettings)=='function'then owner else nil
    end
    local function read(key,fallback)
        local owner=renderer()
        if owner then local settings=owner.getSettings();if settings[key]~=nil then return settings[key]end end
        return fallback
    end
    local function wireMode()
        local style=read('outlineStyle','Native Mesh')
        return read('boxStyle','Corners')=='3D'or style=='3D Box'or style=='Rig Boxes'or style=='Mesh + 3D Box'
    end
    local function boundsMode()
        local style=read('outlineStyle','Native Mesh')
        return read('boxStyle','Corners')~='None'or style=='3D Box'or style=='Mesh + 3D Box'
    end
    local function set(key,value)
        if not control.alive then return false end
        local owner=renderer();if not owner then return false end
        local accepted=owner.set(key,value)
        if accepted~=false then
            local preview=menu.generalESPPreview
            if preview and type(preview.refresh)=='function'then preview.refresh()end
        end
        return accepted
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if not control.alive or control.created then return false end
        tab=tab and(tab.tab or tab)or menu.tabs and menu.tabs.Main and menu.tabs.Main.tab
        if not tab or not renderer()then return false end
        control.created=true
        local related={'Outline Players I Hit','Keep Hit Outline Until Death','Hit Outline Duration (s)',
            'Hit Outline Color','Hit Outline Transparency (%)','Hit Outline Thickness (px)',
            'Hit Outline Fill Character','Hit Outline Fill Color','Hit Outline Fill Transparency (%)',
            'Hit Outline Cham Material','Hit Outline Depth Mode','Hit Outline Render Style'}
        local function add(kind,key,label,options)
            options=options or {}
            options.Name=if key=='enabled'then 'General ESP'else 'General ESP '..label
            options.DisplayName=if key=='enabled'then 'Advanced ESP'else label
            options.GeneralESPOwned=true;options.GeneralESPField=key
            options.GeneralESPMiniOwned=true
            options.GeneralESPMiniGroup=miniGroups[key]or(if label=='Native Outline Width'then 'Mesh outline & chams'elseif label=='3D Preview'then 'Boxes, dimensions & position'else nil)
            if key=='outlineThickness'then options.PortVisibleWhen=function()local style=read('outlineStyle','Native Mesh');return style=='Rig Boxes'or style=='Mesh + 3D Box'end
            elseif key=='outlineEffect'then options.PortVisibleWhen=wireMode
            elseif key=='glowStrength'or key=='glowRadius'then options.PortVisibleWhen=function()return wireMode()and read('outlineEffect','Solid')~='Solid'end
            elseif key=='fillColor'or key=='fillMaterial'then options.PortVisibleWhen=function()return read('fillEnabled',false)end
            elseif key=='bloomIntensity'or key=='bloomSize'or key=='bloomThreshold'then options.PortVisibleWhen=function()return read('bloomEnabled',false)end
            elseif key=='boxColor'or key=='lineThickness'or key=='boxWidth'or key=='boxHeight'or key=='boxDepth'or key=='boxPadding'or key=='boxScale'or key=='offsetX'or key=='offsetY'or key=='offsetZ'then options.PortVisibleWhen=boundsMode end
            if key=='shadowEnabled'then options.DisplayName='Outline Shadows'end
            options.JujutsuerPortTab,options.JujutsuerPortGroup='Main','ESP'
            options.PortRelatedNames=related;options.QuickSettingsOnly=key~='enabled'
            if key=='cursorEnabled'then options.Name='Cursor Ray ESP';options.DisplayName='Cursor Ray ESP';options.QuickSettingsOnly=false end
            if key then options.Default=read(key,options.Default);options.Callback=function(value)return set(key,value)end end
            related[#related+1]=options.Name
            local widget=tab[kind](tab,options)
            local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries['Main/'..options.Name]
            entry=entry or {id='Main/'..options.Name,name=options.Name,tab='Main',kind=kind,config=options,widget=widget,row=widget.Row}
            control.rows[#control.rows+1]=entry;control.rowCount+=1
            if key then control.fields[key]=entry end
            return entry
        end
        local function toggle(key,label,default,description)
            return add('CreateToggle',key,label,{Default=default,Description=description})
        end
        local function slider(key,label,low,high,default,step,description)
            if key~='fadeStart' and key~='offscreenRadius' then
                low=if low<0 then math.min(low,-500) else math.min(low,0)
                if key=='cardReference' or key=='cardWidth' or key=='cardMaxDistance' or key=='cardEffectRate' or key=='cursorRayDistance' then low=1 end
                high=if key=='cardEffectRate' then 240 else math.max(high,500)
            end
            return add('CreateSlider',key,label,{Min=low,Max=high,Default=default,Step=step,Precision=if step<1 then 2 else 0,Description=description})
        end
        local function dropdown(key,label,options,default,description)
            return add('CreateDropdown',key,label,{Options=options,Default=default,Description=description})
        end
        local cyan=host.Color3.fromRGB(80,200,255)
        local function color(key,label,alphaKey,default,alpha)
            return add('CreateColorPicker',key,label,{Default=default,ColorPickerAlpha=true,Description='Color and transparency for this General ESP element.',
                GetTransparency=function()return read(alphaKey,alpha)end,
                SetTransparency=function(value)return set(alphaKey,value)end})
        end
        toggle('enabled','General ESP',false,'Advanced third-person actor ESP with animated-mesh materials, 3D bounds, skeletons, facing arrows and independent labels. Right-click to customize; existing information bars keep their own settings.')
        toggle('cursorEnabled','Cursor Ray ESP',false,'Outline the living enemy under your cursor through walls. This is visual ESP only: it does not aim, rotate your character or change the camera. Fill stays off when used alone.')
        dropdown('cursorMethod','Cursor Detection Method',{'Raycast','Cursor Radius','Raycast + Radius'},'Raycast + Radius','Raycast checks the actual body under the cursor. Cursor Radius selects nearby on-screen enemies. Combined tries the ray first.')
        slider('cursorRadius','Cursor Radius (px)',0,250,20,1,'Maximum screen distance for cursor-radius fallback. Zero requires exact screen alignment.')
        color('cursorColor','Cursor Outline Color','cursorTransparency',cyan,0)
        slider('cursorRayDistance','Cursor Ray Distance (studs)',1,50000,15000,1,'How far the cursor ray reaches into the world when it looks for the enemy under your cursor. Lower it to ignore far-away enemies behind your target.')
        slider('cursorUpdateRate','Cursor Scan Rate (Hz)',0,240,60,1,'Cursor queries per second. The outline follows the animated character through the engine. Zero queries every rendered frame.')
        toggle('players','Show Players',true,'Include other living player characters.')
        toggle('showSelf','Show My Character',false,'Include your own character in this visual ESP, useful in third person. Targeting and friend filters are unchanged.')
        toggle('revealInvisible','Reveal Invisible Players',true,'Scan every player, including ones whose body is fully transparent. Their body parts are drawn again as a visible chams overlay (a material is chosen automatically if Native Highlight is selected), and rig boxes include them. Boxes, labels, tracers and the info card never depended on body transparency.')
        toggle('npcs','Show NPCs',true,'Include eligible living NPCs, including Naoya frames. Owned summons and invalid actors retain their exclusions.')
        toggle('excludeFriends','Exclude Friends',true,'Apply the current friend exclusions to this independent ESP.')
        toggle('throughWalls','Show Through Walls',true,'Show this ESP through walls. Disable to use its actual visibility checks.')
        toggle('onlyAttacked','Only Attacked Targets',false,'Limit this ESP to eligible targets recorded as attacked by you.')
        slider('maxDistance','Maximum Distance (studs)',1,20000,1000,1,'Maximum distance from your character. Camera zoom does not change this range.')
        slider('maxActors','Maximum Actors',1,100,32,1,'Bound the number of simultaneously drawn General ESP actors.')
        slider('scanIntervalMs','Player Scan Interval (ms)',0,5000,200,1,'Scan all current players at this interval. Zero scans every rendered frame. Maximum Actors still limits how many eligible actors are drawn.')
        dropdown('boxStyle','Box Style',{'None','2D','Corners','3D'},'Corners','Choose a projected rectangle, corner marks, or a three-dimensional box.')
        color('boxColor','Box Color','boxTransparency',cyan,.1)
        slider('lineThickness','Box Thickness (px)',.5,8,1.5,.1,'Line thickness of General ESP boxes.')
        slider('boxWidth','Box Width (studs)',.5,20,4,.1,'Width of the General ESP bounds.')
        slider('boxHeight','Box Height (studs)',.5,20,6,.1,'Height of the General ESP bounds.')
        slider('boxDepth','Box Depth (studs)',.5,20,2.5,.1,'Depth of the General ESP bounds.')
        slider('boxPadding','Box Padding (studs)',0,5,.2,.05,'Extra space around the character bounds.')
        slider('boxScale','Box Scale',.1,5,1,.05,'Scale the box around the character bounds.')
        for _,axis in {'X','Y','Z'}do slider('offset'..axis,'Offset '..axis..' (studs)',-20,20,0,.1,'Move the General ESP bounds relative to the character.')end
        toggle('fillEnabled','Character Fill / Chams',false,'Tint the character silhouette with its separate color and transparency.')
        color('fillColor','Character Fill Color','fillTransparency',cyan,.8)
        local style=menu.advancedESPStyle
        local meshChoices=if style and type(style.materialChoices)=='function'then style.materialChoices()else {'Native Highlight'}
        dropdown('fillMaterial','Mesh Material',meshChoices,'Native Highlight','Native Highlight tints the silhouette. Holographic and Neon use separate visual overlays following the animated body; the original actor remains unchanged. Material overlays use scene depth, with native Highlight fill for see-through visibility.')
        toggle('outlineEnabled','Character Outline',false,'Show a native character-mesh outline in the live game.')
        dropdown('outlineStyle','Outline Style',{'Native Mesh','3D Box','Rig Boxes','Mesh + 3D Box'},'Native Mesh','Native Mesh follows the animated character silhouette. 3D Box surrounds its bounds. Rig Boxes outline each animated body part with adjustable thickness. Native mesh silhouette width remains engine controlled on restricted clients.')
        dropdown('depthMode','Depth Mode',{'Follow Wall Setting','Always On Top','Occluded'},'Follow Wall Setting','Follow the shared wall option, draw outlines above scene geometry, or respect scene depth. Does not change the character.')
        dropdown('outlineEffect','Outline Effect',{'Solid','Neon','Holographic'},'Solid','Solid lines, layered neon-style glow, or a translucent holographic wire effect. These styles apply to 3D bounds and animated rig boxes; native mesh contours retain the engine silhouette.')
        slider('glowStrength','Outline Glow Strength',0,1,.45,.01,'Opacity of the soft glow around 3D outline lines. Body filling is independent and off by default.')
        slider('glowRadius','Outline Glow Radius (px)',0,16,4,.1,'Soft glow width around 3D bounds and rig boxes. Zero disables the glow layers.')
        toggle('wallSplit','Separate Wall Colors',false,'Draw one colour where the character is behind a wall and your normal colours where it is in front of the wall. Uses two highlight layers per character, so very large lobbies use more of the engine highlight budget.')
        color('wallColor','Behind Wall Color','wallTransparency',host.Color3.fromRGB(255,120,60),.35)
        dropdown('outlineAnimation','Outline Animation',{'None','Pulse','Breathe','Heartbeat','Strobe','Flicker','Sparkle','Spectrum','Flow','Threat Flash'},'None','Animate the character outline and fill. Pulse, Breathe and Heartbeat change how solid it looks; Strobe, Flicker and Sparkle flash it; Spectrum and Flow shift its colour; Threat Flash turns it red and strobes while that enemy is attacking. Each enemy runs on its own phase.')
        slider('outlineAnimationSpeed','Outline Animation Speed',.2,4,1,.05,'Speed of the outline animation.')
        toggle('glowPulse','Pulsing Glow',false,'Breathe the outline and fill in and out so the character reads as glowing.')
        slider('glowPulseSpeed','Glow Pulse Speed',.1,6,1.2,.05,'Pulses per second.')
        slider('glowPulseDepth','Glow Pulse Depth',0,1,.35,.01,'How much the glow fades at the dim end of the pulse.')
        toggle('bloomEnabled','Scene Bloom',false,'Optional scene-wide bloom for bright/neon effects. Also affects other bright game objects. Off by default; outline glow has its own controls.')
        slider('bloomIntensity','Bloom Intensity',0,3,.4,.01,'Strength of the optional scene bloom effect.')
        slider('bloomSize','Bloom Radius',0,56,24,1,'Radius of the optional scene bloom.')
        slider('bloomThreshold','Bloom Threshold',0,3,1.1,.01,'Brightness threshold for the optional scene bloom. Higher limits bloom to brighter areas.')
        color('outlineColor','Outline Color','outlineTransparency',cyan,0)
        slider('outlineThickness','Rig Outline Thickness (px)',.5,8,2,.1,'Adjust animated body-part box outlines. Native mesh silhouette width changes only if the engine supports it; use Box Thickness for the full 3D bounds.')
        if style and style.outlineThicknessSupported then
            -- The shared rig-width control also reaches the supported native silhouette.
        else
            add('CreateButton',nil,'Native Outline Width',{DisplayName='Outline Width: Unavailable',ButtonText='Unavailable',NoConfig=true,
                Description='This client restricts native silhouette width. Box, skeleton, tracer and facing-marker widths remain adjustable. '..tostring(style and style.outlineThicknessReason or 'Native width is unavailable.'),
                Callback=function()return false,style and style.outlineThicknessReason or 'Native outline width is unavailable on this client'end})
        end
        toggle('skeletonEnabled','Skeleton',false,'Draw available character joints without changing the rig.')
        color('skeletonColor','Skeleton Color','skeletonTransparency',host.Color3.new(1,1,1),.2)
        slider('skeletonThickness','Skeleton Thickness (px)',.5,8,1,.1,'Thickness of projected skeleton lines.')
        toggle('tracerEnabled','Tracer',false,'Draw a line from the selected screen origin to the actor.')
        color('tracerColor','Tracer Color','tracerTransparency',cyan,.45)
        slider('tracerThickness','Tracer Thickness (px)',.5,8,1,.1,'Thickness of General ESP tracer lines.')
        dropdown('tracerOrigin','Tracer Origin',{'Bottom','Center','Cursor'},'Bottom','Use the screen bottom, screen center, or actual cursor position.')
        toggle('headEnabled','Head Marker',false,'Draw a marker at the actor’s actual head.')
        color('headColor','Head Color','headTransparency',host.Color3.new(1,1,1),.15)
        slider('headSize','Head Marker Size (px)',1,30,5,.5,'Screen size of the head marker.')
        toggle('facingEnabled','Facing Direction',false,'Show the direction the character is facing.')
        color('facingColor','Facing Color','facingTransparency',host.Color3.fromRGB(255,220,70),.2)
        slider('facingLength','Facing Length (studs)',.5,50,6,.1,'World length of the facing direction marker.')
        slider('facingThickness','Facing Thickness (px)',.5,8,1.5,.1,'Pixel thickness of the 3D character-facing shaft and arrowhead. Its length follows your studs setting.')
        toggle('offscreenEnabled','Offscreen Indicators',false,'Show eligible actors outside the screen with edge indicators.')
        toggle('offscreenOnlyMarked','Offscreen Only Marked Enemies',false,'Limit offscreen indicators to enemies with a currently active confirmed hit mark. Right-click Offscreen Indicators for its own settings.')
        color('offscreenColor','Offscreen Color','offscreenTransparency',cyan,.2)
        slider('offscreenSize','Offscreen Size (px)',4,40,12,.5,'Size of offscreen actor indicators.')
        slider('offscreenRadius','Offscreen Radius',.1,.48,.42,.01,'Fraction of the screen used for the indicator ring.')
        toggle('labelsEnabled','Labels',false,'Show the selected actor details next to this ESP box.')
        color('labelColor','Label Color','labelTransparency',host.Color3.new(1,1,1),0)
        slider('labelSize','Label Size (px)',8,32,13,1,'Text size of General ESP labels.')
        slider('labelOffset','Label Offset (px)',-100,100,8,1,'Space between the box and its label.')
        toggle('showName','Label Name',true,'Include the player or NPC name when Labels is enabled.')
        toggle('showDistance','Label Distance',true,'Include distance from your character when Labels is enabled.')
        toggle('showHealth','Label Health',false,'Include available health when Labels is enabled.')
        toggle('offscreenDistance','Offscreen Distance Text',true,'Show the distance beside each offscreen indicator.')
        dropdown('colorMode','Color Mode',{'Custom','Team','Health','Distance','Threat','Native'},'Custom','Choose custom colors or colors derived from the actor team, health, distance, current threat state (attacking, blocking, counter, stunned), or Native: each character\'s own resource colour from the game.')
        toggle('distanceFade','Distance Fade',false,'Fade this ESP near the configured distance limit.')
        slider('fadeStart','Fade Starts At',0,.99,.7,.01,'Fraction of Maximum Distance where fading begins.')
        toggle('shadowEnabled','Line Shadows',true,'Add a contrasting shadow behind supported projected lines and labels.')
        color('shadowColor','Shadow Color','shadowTransparency',host.Color3.new(0,0,0),.4)
        slider('shadowThickness','Shadow Thickness (px)',0,6,1,.1,'Extra shadow width around projected lines.')
        slider('updateRate','Refresh Rate (Hz)',0,240,0,1,'Zero updates every rendered frame. A positive limit caps this independent ESP only.')
        add('CreateButton',nil,'3D Preview',{Description='Open the Advanced ESP neutral mannequin to preview box, actual mesh materials and body colors. Drag to rotate; scroll to zoom. Native character outlines are viewed in the live game.',NoConfig=true,
            Callback=function()
                local preview=menu.generalESPPreview
                if not control.alive or not preview or type(preview.open)~='function'then return false,'Preview is unavailable' end
                return preview.open()
            end})
        -- These retain their existing Player IDs, callbacks and saved values;
        -- only their placement inside the shared ESP mini menu is annotated.
        for name,group in legacyMiniGroups do
            local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries['Player/'..name]
            if entry and entry.config then
                entry.config.GeneralESPMiniOwned=true;entry.config.GeneralESPMiniGroup=group
                if name=='Hit Outline Fill Color'or name=='Hit Outline Fill Transparency (%)'or name=='Hit Outline Cham Material'then
                    entry.config.PortVisibleWhen=function()return menu.visuals and menu.visuals.hitOutlineFillEnabled==true end
                end
            end
        end
        for _,record in menu.rows or {}do
            local group=record.tab=='Player'and legacyMiniGroups[record.name]
            if group and record.config then record.config.GeneralESPMiniOwned=true;record.config.GeneralESPMiniGroup=group end
        end
        local offscreen={}
        for _,key in {'offscreenEnabled','offscreenOnlyMarked','offscreenColor','offscreenSize','offscreenRadius'}do
            local entry=control.fields[key];if entry then offscreen[#offscreen+1]=entry.name end
        end
        for _,key in {'offscreenEnabled','offscreenOnlyMarked','offscreenColor','offscreenSize','offscreenRadius'}do
            local entry=control.fields[key]
            if entry then entry.config.PortRelatedNames=offscreen;entry.config.GeneralESPOffscreenMenu=true end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end;control.alive=false
        if menu.generalESPSettings==control then menu.generalESPSettings=nil end
    end
    control.createControls()
    return control
end
return GeneralESPSettings
end)()

local TojiSettingsTab = (function(): any
-- Presentation only: canonical Automatic/Transform IDs still own every value,
-- callback and keybind. The dedicated page never registers replacement controls.
local TojiSettingsTab={}
local groups={
    ['Automatic/Brute Force']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Perfect Rupture']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Auto Flourish']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Auto Flourish ISOH']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Auto Whiplash']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Auto Transcend']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Auto Rupture Variant']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Special Fallback To Double Press']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Special Cooldown Counts As Unavailable']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Rupture Variant']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Rupture Use-Twice Delay (ms)']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Rupture Hold Special Delay (ms)']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Rupture Timing Adjustment (ms)']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Whiplash Timing Adjustment (ms)']='Timing',
    ['Automatic/Rupture End Aim Assist']='Aim assists',
    ['Transform/Hide Toji inventory curse']='Character',
}
for _,name in {'Toji Aim Targets','Toji Aim Range (studs)','Toji Aim Height Y (studs)',
    'Toji Aim FOV Radius (px)','Toji Aim Cursor Ray Range (studs)','Toji Aim Actor Types'}do
    groups['Automatic/'..name]='Targeting'
end
for _,skill in {'Whiplash','Rupture','Flourish','Transcend','Lasso'}do
    local prefix=skill..' Aim '
    groups['Automatic/'..(if skill=='Lasso'then'Lasso Auto Target'else prefix..'Assist')]='Aim assists'
    for _,suffix in {'Targets','Range (studs)','Height Y (studs)','FOV Radius (px)','Show FOV','FOV Color','FOV Transparency (%)'}do
        groups['Automatic/'..prefix..suffix]='Aim assists'
    end
end
TojiSettingsTab.canonicalGroups=groups
local function idOf(record)
    return record.id or record.tab and record.name and record.tab..'/'..record.name
end
local function groupOf(record)
    local config=record.config or {}
    -- Opacity adapters retain an explicit canonical owner; no substring match.
    return groups[idOf(record)]or config.AppearanceSettingsOwned and groups[config.AppearanceAlphaOwner]
end
function TojiSettingsTab.new(menu)
    local control={alive=true,hooks={}}
    local ui=assert(menu.ui,'Toji settings require the existing menu UI')
    local tab=assert(menu.tabs.Main,'The native menu must register the Main page')
    local sectionRank={Timing=1,['Aim assists']=2,Targeting=3,Character=4}
    local function owned(record)
        local group=groupOf(record)
        if group and record.config then
            record.config.JujutsuerPortTab='Main'
            record.config.JujutsuerPortGroup=group
        end
        return group
    end
    local function hook(key,after)
        if type(ui[key])~='function'then return end
        local original=ui[key]
        local wrapper=function(...)
            local results=table.pack(original(...))
            if control.alive then after(...)end
            return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
        end
        ui[key]=wrapper;table.insert(control.hooks,{key=key,original=original,wrapper=wrapper})
    end
    hook('captureNativeRow',function(record)
        if owned(record)and record.nativePresentation then record.nativePresentation.parent=tab.page end
    end)
    hook('applyNativePresentation',function()
        for _,record in menu.rows or {}do if owned(record)then record.destination='Main'end end
    end)
    function control.apply()
        if not control.alive then return end
        local order=ui.appearance.order or {};ui.appearance.order=order
        local counts={}
        local nativeCount=0
        for _,record in menu.rows or {}do
            local group=owned(record)
            if not group then continue end
            local id=idOf(record)
            counts[group]=(counts[group]or 0)+1
            nativeCount+=1
            local rowKey='row/'..id
            local sectionKey='Toji/'..group
            local previous=order[rowKey]
            local rowOrder=if previous and previous.parent=='section/'..sectionKey then previous.order else counts[group]
            order[rowKey]={parent='section/'..sectionKey,order=rowOrder}
            local nativeKey='native/'..rowKey
            local native=order[nativeKey]
            order[nativeKey]={parent='page/Main',order=if native and native.parent=='page/Main'then native.order else 5000+nativeCount}
            if not ui.ready then continue end
            local section=ui.section(tab.page,'Toji '..group,sectionKey)
            local savedSection=order['section/'..sectionKey]
            -- First time here: park the section after everything else on Main.
            if not(savedSection and savedSection.parent=='page/Main')then section.frame.LayoutOrder=5000+(sectionRank[group]or 9)end
            order['section/'..sectionKey]={parent='page/Main',order=section.frame.LayoutOrder}
            section.frame.Parent=tab.page
            for _,existing in ui.groups do
                local index=table.find(existing.records or {},record)
                if index then table.remove(existing.records,index)end
            end
            table.insert(section.records,record)
            if ui.captureNativeRow then ui.captureNativeRow(record)end
            if record.nativePresentation then record.nativePresentation.parent=tab.page end
            if record.groupedPresentation then
                record.groupedPresentation.parent=section.contents
                record.groupedPresentation.destination='Main'
                record.groupedPresentation.order=rowOrder
            end
            record.row.Parent=if ui.nativeMode then tab.page else section.contents
            record.row.LayoutOrder=if ui.nativeMode then order[nativeKey].order else rowOrder
            record.destination='Main'
        end
        if ui.ready and ui.refreshEmptyGroups then ui.refreshEmptyGroups()end
        ui.searchRows=nil
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        for _,item in control.hooks do if ui[item.key]==item.wrapper then ui[item.key]=item.original end end
    end
    control.apply()
    return control
end
return TojiSettingsTab
end)()

local TojiInventoryCurse = (function(): any
-- Local cosmetic visibility for the owner's actual Toji inventory curse.
local TojiInventoryCurse = {}

function TojiInventoryCurse.new(host: any, _menu: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local control: any={alive=true,enabled=true,character=nil,worm=nil,assets=nil,hiddenCount=0,
        appliedWrites=0,restoredWrites=0,lastReason='Waiting for your Toji inventory curse'}
    local connections,characterConnections,wormConnections,assetConnections={},{},{},{}
    local owned={}
    local function disconnect(list)
        for _,connection in list do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(list)
    end
    local function connect(signal,callback,list)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function'then table.insert(list,signal:Connect(callback))end
    end
    local function visualProperty(object)
        -- Roblox's character TransparencyController may reset LTM when the
        -- camera changes. Local base transparency keeps the asset hidden too.
        if object:IsA('BasePart')then return 'Transparency',1,'LocalTransparencyModifier',1 end
        if object:IsA('Decal')or object:IsA('Texture')then return 'Transparency',1 end
        if object:IsA('ParticleEmitter')or object:IsA('Trail')or object:IsA('Beam')
            or object:IsA('Fire')or object:IsA('Smoke')or object:IsA('Sparkles')
            or object:IsA('Light')or object:IsA('Highlight')or object:IsA('SurfaceGui')or object:IsA('BillboardGui')then
            return 'Enabled',false
        end
        return nil,nil
    end
    local function restore(object)
        local lease=owned[object]
        if not lease then return end
        owned[object]=nil;control.hiddenCount-=1
        -- A later visual owner may have changed this property. Restore only
        -- the exact value this feature still owns, including detached assets.
        for _,property in lease do
            local ok,current=pcall(function()return object[property.name]end)
            if ok and current==property.applied then
                local restored=pcall(function()object[property.name]=property.previous end)
                if restored then control.restoredWrites+=1 end
            end
        end
    end
    local function clearWorm()
        disconnect(wormConnections)
        for object in owned do restore(object)end
        control.worm=nil
    end
    local function hide(object)
        if owned[object]or not control.enabled or not control.worm then return end
        local property,value,otherProperty,otherValue=visualProperty(object)
        if not property then return end
        local lease={}
        local function apply(name,applied)
            if not name then return end
            local readable,previous=pcall(function()return object[name]end)
            if not readable or previous==applied then return end
            local ok=pcall(function()object[name]=applied end)
            if ok then
                table.insert(lease,{name=name,previous=previous,applied=applied})
                control.appliedWrites+=1
            end
        end
        apply(property,value);apply(otherProperty,otherValue)
        if #lease>0 then
            owned[object]=lease;control.hiddenCount+=1
        end
    end
    local refresh
    refresh=function(force)
        if not control.alive then return end
        local character=control.character
        local assets=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChild('SetAssets')
        if assets~=control.assets then
            disconnect(assetConnections);control.assets=assets
            if assets and type(assets.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then
                connect(assets:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),function()refresh()end,assetConnections)
            end
        end
        local toji=character and character:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Toji'
        local worm=control.enabled and toji and assets and assets:FindFirstChild('Worm')or nil
        if worm~=control.worm then
            clearWorm();control.worm=worm
            if worm then
                if type(worm.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then
                    connect(worm:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Name'),function()refresh()end,wormConnections)
                end
                force=true
            end
        end
        if worm and force then
            hide(worm)
            for _,object in worm:GetDescendants()do hide(object)end
        end
        control.lastReason=if not control.enabled then 'Toji inventory curse is visible'
            elseif not character or not character.Parent then 'Waiting for your character'
            elseif not toji then 'Waiting for your Toji moveset'
            elseif not worm then 'Waiting for your Toji inventory curse'
            else 'Your Toji inventory curse is hidden locally'
    end
    local function track(character)
        disconnect(characterConnections);disconnect(assetConnections);clearWorm()
        control.assets=nil;control.character=character
        if character then
            connect(character.DescendantAdded,function(object)
                refresh()
                local worm=control.worm
                if worm and object:IsDescendantOf(worm)then hide(object)end
            end,characterConnections)
            connect(character.DescendantRemoving,function(object)
                if object==control.worm or object==control.assets then
                    clearWorm()
                    if object==control.assets then disconnect(assetConnections);control.assets=nil end
                    return
                end
                for hidden in owned do
                    if hidden==object or hidden:IsDescendantOf(object)then restore(hidden)end
                end
            end,characterConnections)
            connect(character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Moveset'),function()refresh()end,characterConnections)
            connect(character.AncestryChanged,function()refresh()end,characterConnections)
        end
        refresh(true)
    end
    function control.setEnabled(value: boolean): boolean
        if not control.alive or type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        control.enabled=value;refresh(true);return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.enabled=false;control.alive=false
        disconnect(connections);disconnect(characterConnections);disconnect(assetConnections);clearWorm()
        control.character,control.assets=nil,nil
        control.lastReason='Toji inventory curse visibility unloaded'
    end
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,track,connections)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function(character)if character==control.character then track(nil)end end,connections)
    track(player.Character)
    return control
end

return TojiInventoryCurse
end)()

local TojiTargetMethods = (function(): any
-- Toji-only acquisition preferences. Native cast owners retain eligibility,
-- accepted victims and timing. No observer, input, or presentation loop lives here.
local TojiTargetMethods={}
local ADVANCED={
    'Lowest HP','Highest HP','Lowest HP %','Highest HP %','Highest threat',
    'Farthest horizontal distance','Nearest 3D distance','Smallest vertical gap',
    'Highest relative height','Lowest relative height','Fastest motion','Slowest motion',
    'Approaching fastest','Receding fastest','Facing me','Facing away',
    'Actively attacking','Blocking','Not blocking','Airborne','Grounded','Ragdolled','Standing',
    'Prefer Players','Prefer NPCs',
}
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function xyz(value)
    if value and finite(value.X)and finite(value.Y)and finite(value.Z)then return value.X,value.Y,value.Z end
    return nil
end
local function child(object,name)return object and type(object.FindFirstChild)=='function'and object:FindFirstChild(name)end
local function attribute(object,name)return object and type(object.GetAttribute)=='function'and object:GetAttribute(name)end
local function active(value)return value==true or finite(value)and value>0 end
local anatomical={Head=true,Torso=true,UpperTorso=true,LowerTorso=true,
    ['Left Arm']=true,['Right Arm']=true,['Left Leg']=true,['Right Leg']=true,
    LeftUpperArm=true,LeftLowerArm=true,LeftHand=true,RightUpperArm=true,RightLowerArm=true,RightHand=true,
    LeftUpperLeg=true,LeftLowerLeg=true,LeftFoot=true,RightUpperLeg=true,RightLowerLeg=true,RightFoot=true}
local function marker(model,info,names)
    for _,name in names do
        if active(attribute(model,name))then return true end
        local value=child(info,name)
        if value and (type(value.IsA)~='function'or not value:IsA('BoolValue')or value.Value==true)then return true end
    end
    return false
end
function TojiTargetMethods.new(host,menu)
    local base=menu.targetMethods
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local clock=host.os and host.os.clock or os.clock
    local methods={}
    local canonical=base.choices()
    local advanced={}
    for _,name in ADVANCED do advanced[name]=true;table.insert(canonical,name)end
    local aliases={['Last Hit Enemy']='Last target I hit',['Last hit enemy']='Last target I hit',
        ['Closest To Cursor']='Closest to cursor',['Highest Threat']='Highest threat'}
    function methods.choices()return table.clone(canonical)end
    function methods.normalize(value,default)
        if type(value)=='table'and value.Value~=nil then value=value.Value end
        if value==nil then value=default end
        local selected,valid={},true
        local function add(item)
            item=aliases[item]or item
            if advanced[item]then selected[item]=true;return end
            local normalized,ok=base.normalize(item)
            if not ok or table.find(normalized,'Mouse')then valid=false;return end
            for _,name in normalized do selected[name]=true end
        end
        if type(value)=='string'then add(value)
        elseif type(value)=='table'then
            local count,maximum,mapped=0,0,false
            for key,item in value do
                if type(key)=='number'then
                    count+=1;maximum=math.max(maximum,key)
                    if key<1 or key%1~=0 or type(item)~='string'then valid=false else add(item)end
                elseif type(key)~='string'or type(item)~='boolean'then valid=false
                else mapped=true;if item then add(key)else local _,ok=methods.normalize(key);if not ok then valid=false end end end
            end
            if count>0 and(mapped or maximum~=count)then valid=false end
        elseif value~=nil then valid=false end
        local result={};for _,name in canonical do if selected[name]then table.insert(result,name)end end
        return result,valid
    end
    methods.screenContext=base.screenContext
    methods.context=base.context
    function methods.usesCursorWorld(value)
        return table.find(methods.normalize(value),'Closest to cursor')~=nil
    end
    function methods.chooseCursorWorld(context)
        context=context or base.screenContext(nil,{cursorHit=false})
        local world=host.workspace
        local camera=context.camera or world and world.CurrentCamera
        local cursor=context.cursorPoint
        if not cursor then
            local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
            cursor=input and type(input.GetMouseLocation)=='function'and input:GetMouseLocation()
        end
        if not camera or not cursor or not finite(cursor.X)or not finite(cursor.Y)or not world
            or type(world.Raycast)~='function'or not host.RaycastParams or type(host.RaycastParams.new)~='function'then
            return nil,'Cursor world ray is unavailable'
        end
        local range=if finite(context.cursorRayRange)then math.clamp(context.cursorRayRange,1,50000)else 15000
        local candidates=context.candidates or {}
        if #candidates>1024 then return nil,'Cursor world candidate budget exceeded'end
        local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        local function allowed(target)
            return target~=nil and not(excluded and excluded(target))and(not context.eligible or context.eligible(target)==true)
        end
        local eligible,roots={},{}
        local own=player.Character
        if own then table.insert(roots,own)end
        for _,target in candidates do
            if target~=own and allowed(target)then
                eligible[target]=true
                local root=child(target,'HumanoidRootPart')
                if root then table.insert(roots,root)end
            end
        end
        -- GetMouseLocation is in screen coordinates. ScreenPointToRay accounts
        -- for the native GUI inset. The viewport fallback requires its actual
        -- inset, never an assumed top-bar size or a forced cursor position.
        local ok,result=pcall(function()
            local ray
            if type(camera.ScreenPointToRay)=='function'then ray=camera:ScreenPointToRay(cursor.X,cursor.Y,0)
            elseif type(camera.ViewportPointToRay)=='function'then
                local got,gui=pcall(host.game.GetService,host.game,'GuiService')
                if not got or not gui or type(gui.GetGuiInset)~='function'then return nil end
                local inset=gui:GetGuiInset()
                if not inset or not finite(inset.X)or not finite(inset.Y)then return nil end
                ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(cursor.X-inset.X,cursor.Y-inset.Y,0)
            end
            local ox=xyz(ray and ray.Origin)
            local dx,dy,dz=xyz(ray and ray.Direction)
            if not ox or not dx then return nil end
            local length=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz)
            if length<=.00001 then return nil end
            local params=host.RaycastParams.new()
            local exclude=host.Enum and host.Enum.RaycastFilterType and host.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            if exclude==nil then return nil end
            params.FilterType=exclude;params.FilterDescendantsInstances=roots
            return world:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*(range/length),params)
        end)
        local point=ok and result and result.Position
        local px,py,pz=xyz(point)
        if not px then return nil,'The cursor ray has no world hit point'end
        local part=result.Instance
        if part and anatomical[part.Name]and eligible[part.Parent]and type(part.IsA)=='function'and part:IsA('BasePart')then
            return part.Parent,'Closest to cursor: exact native body ray hit',point
        end
        local best,bestDistance,bestTie
        for index,target in candidates do
            if not eligible[target]then continue end
            local targetPart=context.targetPart and context.targetPart(target)or child(target,'HumanoidRootPart')
            local x,y,z=xyz(targetPart and targetPart.Position)
            if not x then continue end
            local dx,dy,dz=x-px,y-py,z-pz
            local distance=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz
            local tie=tostring(target.Name or '')..'\0'..tostring(index)
            if not best or distance<bestDistance or distance==bestDistance and tie<bestTie then
                best,bestDistance,bestTie=target,distance,tie
            end
        end
        return best,'Closest to cursor: nearest character to world hit point',point
    end
    function methods.choose(value,context)
        local selected,valid=methods.normalize(value,'Closest to cursor')
        if not valid then return nil,'Invalid Toji target preference'end
        local ordinary,preferences={},{}
        for _,name in selected do table.insert(if advanced[name]then preferences else ordinary,name)end
        -- The user's cursor preference is a point in the actual 3D world.
        -- Other established selectors retain their original shared owner.
        if table.find(ordinary,'Closest to cursor')then return methods.chooseCursorWorld(context)end
        if #preferences==0 then return base.choose(ordinary,context)end
        context=context or base.context()
        local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        local own=player.Character;local ownRoot=child(own,'HumanoidRootPart')
        local ox,oy,oz=xyz(ownRoot and ownRoot.Position)
        local ovx,ovy,ovz=xyz(ownRoot and ownRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
        local now=context.now or clock()
        local cache,threatSnapshot={},nil
        local function metadata(target)
            if cache[target]then return cache[target]end
            local root=child(target,'HumanoidRootPart')
            local humanoid=target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            local info=child(target,'Info')
            local x,y,z=xyz(root and root.Position)
            local vx,vy,vz=xyz(root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
            local row={}
            cache[target]=row
            if humanoid and finite(humanoid.Health)then
                row['Lowest HP']=humanoid.Health;row['Highest HP']=-humanoid.Health
                if finite(humanoid.MaxHealth)and humanoid.MaxHealth>0 then
                    row['Lowest HP %']=humanoid.Health/humanoid.MaxHealth;row['Highest HP %']=-row['Lowest HP %']
                end
            end
            if x and ox then
                local dx,dy,dz=x-ox,y-oy,z-oz
                local flat=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz);local distance=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz)
                row['Farthest horizontal distance']=-flat;row['Nearest 3D distance']=distance
                row['Smallest vertical gap']=math.abs(dy);row['Highest relative height']=-dy;row['Lowest relative height']=dy
                if vx then
                    local speed=math.sqrt(vx*vx+vy*vy+vz*vz)
                    row['Fastest motion']=-speed;row['Slowest motion']=speed
                    if distance>.001 and ovx then
                        local closing=-((vx-ovx)*dx+(vy-ovy)*dy+(vz-ovz)*dz)/distance
                        row['Approaching fastest']=-closing;row['Receding fastest']=closing
                    end
                end
                local look=root.CFrame and root.CFrame.LookVector
                local lx,_,lz=xyz(look)
                local length=lx and math.sqrt(lx*lx+lz*lz)
                if length and length>.001 and flat>.001 then
                    local facing=math.clamp(-(lx*dx+lz*dz)/(length*flat),-1,1)
                    row['Facing me']=-facing;row['Facing away']=facing
                end
            end
            if info then
                local blocked=marker(target,info,{'Block','Blocking'})
                local ragdolled=marker(target,info,{'Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll'})or humanoid and humanoid.PlatformStand==true
                row.Blocking=if blocked then 0 else 1;row['Not blocking']=1-row.Blocking
                row.Ragdolled=if ragdolled then 0 else 1;row.Standing=1-row.Ragdolled
                local attacking=marker(target,info,{'Melee','Attacking'})
                local observer=menu.autoBlock
                local record=observer and observer.records and observer.records[target]
                local swing=record and record.nativeSwing
                local completed=observer and observer.completedContacts or {}
                if swing and finite(swing.at)and now>=swing.at and now-swing.at<=.22 and not completed[swing]then attacking=true end
                row['Actively attacking']=if attacking then 0 else 1
            end
            if humanoid then
                local state
                if type(humanoid.GetState)=='function'then local ok,result=pcall(humanoid.GetState,humanoid);if ok then state=result end end
                local states=host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType
                local air=host.Enum and host.Enum.Material and host.Enum.Material.Air
                local airborne=state and states and(state==states.Freefall or state==states.Jumping)
                if humanoid.FloorMaterial~=nil and air~=nil then airborne=humanoid.FloorMaterial==air
                elseif not airborne and state and states and(state==states.Running or state==states.RunningNoPhysics or state==states.Landed)then airborne=false
                else if not airborne then airborne=nil end end
                if airborne~=nil then row.Airborne=if airborne then 0 else 1;row.Grounded=1-row.Airborne end
            end
            if type(players.GetPlayerFromCharacter)=='function'then
                local owner=players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
                row['Prefer Players']=if owner then 0 else 1;row['Prefer NPCs']=1-row['Prefer Players']
            end
            if table.find(preferences,'Highest threat')then
                local threat=menu.threatAssessment
                if threat and threat.alive~=false and type(threat.context)=='function'and type(threat.assess)=='function'then
                    threatSnapshot=threatSnapshot or threat.context(context)
                    local assessment=threat.assess(target,threatSnapshot)
                    if assessment and finite(assessment.score)then row['Highest threat']=-assessment.score end
                end
            end
            return row
        end
        local ordinaryTarget=if #ordinary>0 then base.choose(ordinary,context)else nil
        local best,bestRanks,bestTie
        for index,target in context.candidates or {}do
            if not target or excluded and excluded(target)or context.eligible and context.eligible(target)~=true then continue end
            local row=metadata(target);local ranks={}
            -- Missing metadata sorts after observed values, then uses the same
            -- cursor snapshot. Preferences never become hidden hard filters.
            for _,name in preferences do
                local score=row[name];table.insert(ranks,if finite(score)then 0 else 1);table.insert(ranks,if finite(score)then score else 0)
            end
            table.insert(ranks,if ordinaryTarget==target then 0 else 1)
            local cursor=context.cursorRank and context.cursorRank(target)
            table.insert(ranks,if finite(cursor)then cursor else math.huge)
            local tie=tostring(target.Name or '')..'\0'..tostring(index)
            local better=best==nil
            if best then
                for i,score in ranks do
                    if score~=bestRanks[i]then better=score<bestRanks[i];break end
                    if i==#ranks then better=tie<bestTie end
                end
            end
            if better then best,bestRanks,bestTie=target,ranks,tie end
        end
        return best,preferences[1]or 'No eligible selected target method'
    end
    return methods
end
return TojiTargetMethods
end)()

local NativeTojiAim = (function(): any
-- Shared Toji target selection. Existing M1 directional-assist owns all yaw.
-- Native UseTool is wrapped before it builds its real target/aim payload.
local NativeTojiAim={}
local SPECS={
    Whiplash={service='WhiplashService',label='Whiplash',timing='Auto Whiplash',followup='WhiplashAgain'},
    Rupture={service='RuptureService',label='Rupture',timing='Perfect Rupture',followup='RuptureCheck'},
    Flourish={service='FlourishService',label='Flourish',timing='Auto Flourish',aliases={'Auto Flourish ISOH'}},
    Transcend={service='TranscendService',label='Transcend',timing='Auto Transcend'},
    -- Direct replicated Toji.COATM.Lasso metadata: native Service=LassoService,
    -- Key=2. This assists a manual cast; it never fires an extra activation.
    Lasso={service='LassoService',label='Lasso',toggle='Lasso Auto Target'},
}
local function finite(value)return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function active(value)return value==true or finite(value)and value>0 end
function NativeTojiAim.new(host,menu)
    local players=host.game:GetService('Players')
    local player=players.LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local world=host.workspace
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control: any={alive=true,features={},connections={},hooks={},scopes=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),generation=0}
    local methods=if host.TojiTargetMethods then host.TojiTargetMethods.new(host,menu)else menu.targetMethods
    control.targetMethods=methods
    control.shared={targets={'Closest to cursor'},range=80,height=90,radius=150,cursorRayRange=15000,actors={'Players','NPCs'}}
    control.ruptureEndEnabled=false
    control.optionWidgets={}
    local sharedKeys={targets=true,range=true,height=true,radius=true,cursorRayRange=true,actors=true}
    local sharedNames={targets='Toji Aim Targets',range='Toji Aim Range (studs)',height='Toji Aim Height Y (studs)',radius='Toji Aim FOV Radius (px)',cursorRayRange='Toji Aim Cursor Ray Range (studs)',actors='Toji Aim Actor Types'}
    local function keyFor(value)
        if type(value)=='string'then
            for key,spec in SPECS do
                if value==key or value==spec.timing or value==spec.service or value==spec.toggle or spec.aliases and table.find(spec.aliases,value)then return key end
            end
        elseif(type(value)=='table'or type(value)=='userdata')and type(value.GetAttribute)=='function'then return keyFor(value:GetAttribute('Service'))end
        return nil
    end
    for key,spec in SPECS do
        control.features[key]={spec=spec,enabled=false,range=control.shared.range,height=control.shared.height,radius=control.shared.radius,actors=control.shared.actors,showFov=false,
            color=host.Color3.fromRGB(100,215,255),transparency=0,targets={'Closest to cursor'},lastReason='Disabled'}
    end
    local function connect(signal,callback)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function'then local c=signal:Connect(callback);table.insert(control.connections,c);return c end
        return nil
    end
    local function paused()
        return menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()==true
    end
    local function primaryLock()
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if lock and type(lock.effectiveLockActive)=='function'then return lock.effectiveLockActive()==true end
        local env=menu.environment or {}
        return env.LockedTarget~=nil and env.LockConn~=nil and env.LockConn.Connected~=false
    end
    local function ownReady()
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local root=humanoid and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not control.alive or paused()or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()
            or menu.combatMenuOpen and menu.combatMenuOpen()or not root or humanoid.Health<=0
            or humanoid.PlatformStand or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Toji'then return nil end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Knockback','TrueStun'}do
            if active(character:GetAttribute(name))or info and info:FindFirstChild(name)then return nil end
        end
        return character,root,info
    end
    function control.cursorGeometry(key)
        local feature=control.features[keyFor(key)]
        local camera=world.CurrentCamera
        if not feature or not camera or type(input.GetMouseLocation)~='function'then return nil end
        local point=input:GetMouseLocation()
        if not point or not finite(point.X)or not finite(point.Y)then return nil end
        return {center=point,radius=feature.radius,camera=camera}
    end
    local function targetPart(target)
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        return lock and lock.targetPart and lock.targetPart(target)or target:FindFirstChild('Torso')
            or target:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso')or target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    end
    function control.eligible(key,target,acquiring)
        local feature=control.features[keyFor(key)]
        local own,root=ownReady()
        if not feature or not own or not target or target==own or not target.Parent
            or type(target.IsA)~='function'or not target:IsA('Model')then return false end
        local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        if excluded and excluded(target)then return false end
        local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local other=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not other or active(target:GetAttribute('Dead'))
            or info and info:FindFirstChild('Dead')or target.Name=='HarutaSwordNPC'
