            or target:FindFirstChild('Owner')or target:GetAttribute('Summon')==true or target:GetAttribute('IsSummon')==true then return false end
        if type(humanoid.GetState)=='function'and host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType then
            local ok,state=pcall(humanoid.GetState,humanoid)
            if ok and state==host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then return false end
        end
        local otherPlayer=players.GetPlayerFromCharacter and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
        if otherPlayer and player.Team~=nil and player.Team==otherPlayer.Team and not player.Neutral and not otherPlayer.Neutral then return false end
        if not table.find(control.shared.actors,if otherPlayer then 'Players'else 'NPCs')then return false end
        local delta=other.Position-root.Position
        local cursorWorld=methods.usesCursorWorld and(acquiring=='Cursor World'or acquiring==true and methods.usesCursorWorld(control.shared.targets))
        local range=if cursorWorld then control.shared.cursorRayRange else feature.range
        if not finite(delta.X)or not finite(delta.Y)or not finite(delta.Z)or math.abs(delta.Y)>feature.height*.5
            or math.sqrt(delta.X*delta.X+delta.Z*delta.Z)>range then return false end
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if not(lock and lock.lockThroughWalls)then
            if not lock or type(lock.hasLineOfSight)~='function'or not lock.hasLineOfSight(target)then return false end
        end
        if acquiring==true and not cursorWorld then
            local geometry=control.cursorGeometry(key)
            local part=targetPart(target)
            if not geometry or not part or type(geometry.camera.WorldToViewportPoint)~='function'then return false end
            local point,visible=geometry.camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if visible~=true or not point or point.Z<=0 then return false end
            local x,y=point.X-geometry.center.X,point.Y-geometry.center.Y
            if x*x+y*y>geometry.radius*geometry.radius then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.selectTarget(key)
        key=keyFor(key)
        local feature=key and control.features[key]
        local character,root=ownReady()
        if not feature or not feature.enabled or primaryLock()or not character then return nil end
        if not methods or not methods.screenContext or not methods.choose then return nil end
        local candidates,seen={},{}
        local function add(target)
            if target and not seen[target]then seen[target]=true;table.insert(candidates,target)end
        end
        local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Characters')
        if folder then for _,target in folder:GetChildren()do add(target)end end
        if type(players.GetPlayers)=='function'then for _,other in players:GetPlayers()do add(other.Character)end end
        local geometry=control.cursorGeometry(key)
        if not geometry then return nil end
        local context=methods.screenContext(candidates,{camera=geometry.camera,cursorPoint=geometry.center,cursorHit=false,cursorRayRange=control.shared.cursorRayRange,
            targetPart=targetPart,eligible=function(target)return control.eligible(key,target,true)end})
        local target,reason=methods.choose(control.shared.targets,context)
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if assist and not assist.pendingNative and type(assist.applyAimTargetSwitch)=='function'then
            local retainedScope=if methods.usesCursorWorld and methods.usesCursorWorld(control.shared.targets)then 'Cursor World'else false
            target=assist.applyAimTargetSwitch('Skill',target,function(model)
                return control.eligible(key,model,retainedScope)
            end,character,root)
        end
        feature.lastSelection=reason
        return target
    end
    function control.finish(name,reason)
        local record=control.current
        if not record or name and keyFor(name)~=record.key then return false end
        control.current=nil
        control.features[record.key].lastReason=reason or 'Native skill ended'
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if assist and assist.automaticAimKind=='Skill'and assist.automaticAimTarget==record.target and assist.resetDirectionalAim then assist.resetDirectionalAim('Skill Aim')end
        return true
    end
    local function ownsTool(character,tool,key)
        local moves=character and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not moves or not tool or not tool.Parent then return false end
        if key=='Lasso'then
            -- The current native COATM skill is nested under its weapon bin.
            -- Accept that exact owned bin or the active root tool only, never
            -- another character's Lasso or an arbitrary descendant folder.
            return tool.Name=='Lasso' and type(tool.IsA)=='function'and(tool:IsA('NumberValue')or tool:IsA('Tool'))
                and(tool.Parent==moves or tool.Parent==moves:FindFirstChild('COATM'))
        end
        return tool.Parent==moves
    end
    -- A native request retains its cast identity even when another owner has
    -- character facing. Primary lock and native dash only gate yaw below.
    local function whiplashFollowupLive(record)
        local timings=menu.nativeTojiTimings
        local feature=timings and timings.alive~=false and timings.features and timings.features['Auto Whiplash']
        local cast=record and record.whiplashCast
        if not feature or not cast or cast.character~=record.character or cast.tool~=record.tool or cast.target~=record.target then return false end
        return feature.pending==cast or feature.followup and feature.followup.sourceCast==cast
            or timings.dispatching and timings.dispatching.feature==feature and timings.dispatching.cast==cast
    end
    local function requestRecord(record)
        if not record or record~=control.current then return nil end
        local feature=control.features[record.key]
        local character,root,info=ownReady()
        if not feature or not(feature.enabled or record.endPhase and control.ruptureEndEnabled)or character~=record.character or not ownsTool(character,record.tool,record.key)
            or record.tool:GetAttribute('Service')~=feature.spec.service or not control.eligible(record.key,record.target,if record.cursorWorld then 'Cursor World'else false)
            or clock()<record.at or clock()-record.at>(if record.endPhase and record.endTrack and record.endTrack.IsPlaying then 30 else 8)then control.finish(record.key,'Native target or skill context ended');return nil end
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        local followup=info and feature.spec.followup and info:FindFirstChild(feature.spec.followup)
        if record.whiplashCast then
            local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if not whiplashFollowupLive(record)or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<record.whiplashCast.health
                or record.target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')~=record.whiplashCast.targetRoot then
                control.finish(record.key,'Confirmed Whiplash follow-up ended or was interrupted');return nil
            end
        end
        if record.endPhase then
            local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            local stun=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
            if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<record.endHealth or active(character:GetAttribute('Stun'))
                or stun and type(stun.IsA)=='function'and stun:IsA('BoolValue')and stun.Value==true then
                control.finish(record.key,'Native Rupture end phase was interrupted');return nil
            end
        end
        if (record.key=='Lasso'or record.endPhase) and marker and record.nativeMarker and marker~=record.nativeMarker then
            control.finish(record.key,'A different native skill phase began');return nil
        end
        if marker then record.seenSkill=true;record.nativeMarker=marker end
        if not record.whiplashCast and not record.requestDepth and not marker and not followup and (record.seenSkill or clock()-record.at>.25)then
            control.finish(record.key,'Native skill markers ended');return nil
        end
        return record,root,info
    end
    function control.activeContext()
        local cameraOwner=menu.autoLock
        if cameraOwner and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive and cameraOwner.universalSkillSteeringActive() then return nil end
        local record,root,info=requestRecord(control.current)
        if not record then return nil end
        local feature=control.features[record.key]
        local lock=menu.autoLock
        if primaryLock()or not record.whiplashCast and(lock and lock.dashFacingActive and lock.dashFacingActive()or info and info:FindFirstChild('InDash'))then return nil end
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if not assist or assist.alive==false or assist.pendingNative or not assist.directionalFrame
            or assist.priorityAllows and not assist.priorityAllows('Skill')then return nil end
        assist.areaTargets.Skill=record.target
        return {target=record.target,root=root,range=feature.range,speed=assist.skillAimSpeed or 14,kind='Skill',toji=record}
    end
    function control.facingActive()return control.activeContext()~=nil end
    function control.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget()
        if not control.current or control.current.key~='Whiplash'or not control.current.whiplashCast then return nil end
        local record=requestRecord(control.current)
        return if record and record.key=='Whiplash'and record.whiplashCast and record.accepted then record.target else nil
    end
    function control.beginWhiplashFollowup(character,tool,target,cast)
        if not control.features.Whiplash.enabled then return nil end
        local timings=menu.nativeTojiTimings;local feature=timings and timings.features and timings.features['Auto Whiplash']
        if not feature or feature.pending~=cast or cast.character~=character or cast.tool~=tool or cast.target~=target or not cast.whiplashStarted
            or character~=player.Character or not ownsTool(character,tool,'Whiplash')or not control.eligible('Whiplash',target,false)then return false end
        local record=control.current
        if record and(record.key~='Whiplash'or record.character~=character or record.tool~=tool or record.accepted and record.target~=target)then return false end
        if not record then
            control.generation+=1
            record={key='Whiplash',character=character,tool=tool,generation=control.generation};control.current=record
        end
        record.target,record.accepted,record.whiplashCast,record.at=target,true,cast,clock()
        control.features.Whiplash.lastReason='Assisting the exact confirmed native Whiplash second-hit phase'
        return true
    end
    -- Timings invokes this only after the exact owned native second use was
    -- submitted. Its actual authored End/Stopped cue releases the same lease.
    function control.beginFollowup(character,name,target,tool,track)
        local key=keyFor(name)
        if key~='Rupture'or not control.ruptureEndEnabled or character~=player.Character then return false end
        local own,_,info=ownReady()
        if own~=character then return false end
        local record=control.current
        if record and(record.key~=key or record.character~=character)then return false end
        if record and record.accepted and target and target~=record.target then return false end
        if not record then
            -- An end-only toggle can borrow a proven native victim; it must
            -- never acquire an unrelated enemy after the first skill landed.
            if not target or not tool or not ownsTool(character,tool,key)or tool:GetAttribute('Service')~=SPECS[key].service
                or not control.eligible(key,target,false)then return false end
            control.generation+=1
            record={key=key,character=character,tool=tool,target=target,accepted=true,generation=control.generation,at=clock()}
            control.current=record
        elseif target then
            if not control.eligible(key,target,false)then return false end
            record.target,record.accepted=target,true
        end
        if not control.eligible(key,record.target,false)then return false end
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        record.endPhase,record.endHealth,record.at,record.endTrack=true,humanoid.Health,clock(),track
        record.nativeMarker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')or record.nativeMarker
        control.features[key].lastReason='Assisting the exact native Rupture end phase'
        return true
    end
    function control.setRuptureEndEnabled(value)
        if type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        control.ruptureEndEnabled=value
        if not value and control.current and control.current.endPhase then control.finish('Rupture','Rupture End Aim Assist disabled')end
        return true
    end
    function control.beginSkill(character,tool,phase)
        if not tool or(type(tool)~='table'and type(tool)~='userdata')or type(tool.GetAttribute)~='function'then return nil end
        local key=keyFor(tool)
        local feature=key and control.features[key]
        if not feature or not(feature.enabled or key=='Rupture'and control.ruptureEndEnabled and control.current and control.current.endPhase)or character~=player.Character then return nil end
        local own=ownReady()
        if own~=character or not ownsTool(character,tool,key)then return nil end
        local current=requestRecord(control.current)
        if current and current.character==character and current.tool==tool then
            current.requestDepth=(current.requestDepth or 0)+1;return current
        end
        if primaryLock()then return nil end
        local target=control.selectTarget(key)
        if not target then feature.lastReason='No eligible target inside the shared Toji cursor FOV';return nil end
        control.finish(nil,'A new owned Toji skill began')
        control.generation+=1
        local record={key=key,tool=tool,character=character,target=target,at=clock(),generation=control.generation,requestDepth=1,phase=phase,
            cursorWorld=methods.usesCursorWorld and methods.usesCursorWorld(control.shared.targets)or false}
        control.current=record;feature.lastReason='Assisting this native cast only'
        return record
    end
    function control.endRequest(record,succeeded)
        if not record or control.current~=record then return end
        local depth=(record.requestDepth or 1)-1
        record.requestDepth=if depth>0 then depth else nil
        if succeeded==false then control.finish(record.key,'Native request failed')end
    end
    function control.acceptedVictim(name,target)
        local record=control.current
        if not record or keyFor(name)~=record.key or record.accepted then return false end
        if not control.eligible(record.key,target,false)then return false end
        record.target,record.accepted=target,true
        control.features[record.key].lastReason='Retaining the exact native first-hit victim'
        return true
    end
    function control.beforeFollowup(character,name,target)
        local record=control.current
        if not record or keyFor(name)~=record.key then return nil end
        if record.character~=character or record.target~=target or not control.eligible(record.key,target,false)then return false end
        -- A primary lock may pause this assist without cancelling an otherwise
        -- legitimate native second use on its already confirmed victim.
        return true
    end
    function control.attachFaceOwner()
        local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
        if not assist or assist.pendingNative or type(assist.automaticAimContext)~='function'then return false end
        if control.faceHook and control.faceHook.owner==assist then return true end
        local hook={owner=assist,original=assist.automaticAimContext,active=true}
        hook.wrapper=function(...)
            if hook.active and control.confirmedWhiplashFollowupTarget()then
                local context=control.activeContext();if context then return context end
            end
            local context=hook.original(...)
            if context or not hook.active then return context end
            return control.activeContext()
        end
        assist.automaticAimContext=hook.wrapper
        control.faceHook=hook;table.insert(control.hooks,hook)
        return true
    end
    function control.bindNative(native)
        if not native or type(native.UseTool)~='function'then return false end
        control.attachFaceOwner()
        if control.native==native then return true end
        control.native=native
        local function hookMethod(key,factory)
            if type(native[key])~='function'then return end
            local hook={owner=native,key=key,original=native[key],active=true}
            hook.wrapper=factory(hook);native[key]=hook.wrapper;table.insert(control.hooks,hook)
        end
        local function scoped()
            local record=control.scopes[coroutine.running()]
            return requestRecord(record)
        end
        hookMethod('GetTarget',function(hook)return function(self,...)
            local record=hook.active and self==native and scoped()
            if record then return record.target end
            return hook.original(self,...)
        end end)
        hookMethod('GetMouseTarget',function(hook)return function(self,limit,...)
            local record=hook.active and self==native and scoped()
            if record then
                local part=targetPart(record.target)
                local root=record.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                local point=part and part.Position
                local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
                if point and assist and assist.predictAimPoint then
                    local ok,predicted=pcall(assist.predictAimPoint,root,record.target,'Skill',point)
                    if ok and predicted and finite(predicted.X)and finite(predicted.Y)and finite(predicted.Z)then point=predicted end
                end
                if point and root and finite(limit)and limit>0 then
                    local delta=point-root.Position
                    if delta.Magnitude>limit then point=root.Position+delta.Unit*limit end
                end
                if point then return point end
            end
            return hook.original(self,limit,...)
        end end)
        hookMethod('UseTool',function(hook)return function(self,tool,action,...)
            if not hook.active or self~=native or action~='Activated'then return hook.original(self,tool,action,...)end
            local current=control.current
            local character=player.Character
            local timings=menu.nativeTojiTimings
            if character and(type(tool)=='table'or type(tool)=='userdata')and type(tool.GetAttribute)=='function'and ownsTool(character,tool,keyFor(tool))
                and timings and type(timings.cancelWhiplashForNewAction)=='function'then timings.cancelWhiplashForNewAction(character,tool)end
            if current and current.tool~=tool and(type(tool)=='table'or type(tool)=='userdata')
                and character and type(tool.GetAttribute)=='function'and ownsTool(character,tool,keyFor(tool))then
                control.finish(nil,'A different owned native skill began')
            end
            if not keyFor(tool)then return hook.original(self,tool,action,...)end
            local setup,record=pcall(control.beginSkill,player.Character,tool,action)
            if not setup then control.lastFailure='Native input kept; aim setup failed: '..tostring(record);record=nil end
            local thread=coroutine.running();local previous=control.scopes[thread]
            control.scopes[thread]=record
            if record and control.activeContext()then
                local assist=menu.m1AimAssist
                local ok,reason=pcall(function()
                    if assist and assist.applyExternalSkillAim then assist.applyExternalSkillAim(true)
                    elseif assist and assist.stepAutomaticAim then assist.stepAutomaticAim(1/60)end
                end)
                if not ok then control.lastFailure='Native input kept; facing skipped: '..tostring(reason)end
            end
            local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,tool,action,...))
            control.scopes[thread]=previous;control.endRequest(record,result[1])
            if not result[1]then error(result[2],0)end
            return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
        end end)
        return true
    end
    function control.setOption(name,key,value)
        local feature=control.features[keyFor(name)]
        if not feature and not(name=='Toji'and sharedKeys[key])then return false end
        if key=='enabled'or key=='showFov'then
            if type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
            feature[key]=value
            if key=='showFov'and not value and feature.circle then feature.circle.Visible=false end
            if key=='enabled'and not value and not(control.current and control.current.key==keyFor(name)and control.current.endPhase and control.ruptureEndEnabled)then control.finish(name,'Disabled')end
        elseif key=='targets'then
            local normalized,valid=methods.normalize(value)
            if not valid or table.find(normalized,'Mouse')then return false end
            value=normalized
        elseif key=='actors'then
            if type(value)~='table'then return false end
            local selected,maximum={},0
            for index,item in value do
                if type(index)~='number'or index<1 or index%1~=0 or(item~='Players'and item~='NPCs')or table.find(selected,item)then return false end
                maximum=math.max(maximum,index)
                table.insert(selected,item)
            end
            if #selected~=#value or maximum~=#selected then return false end
            value={};for _,item in {'Players','NPCs'}do if table.find(selected,item)then table.insert(value,item)end end
        elseif key=='color'then
            if(host.typeof or typeof)(value)~='Color3'then return false end
            feature.color=value
        else
            local bounds=({range={0,200},height={90,200},radius={10,1000},cursorRayRange={1,20000},transparency={0,1}})[key]
            if not bounds or not finite(value)then return false end
            value=math.clamp(value,bounds[1],bounds[2])
            if not sharedKeys[key]then feature[key]=value end
        end
        if sharedKeys[key]then
            control.shared[key]=value
            for _,other in control.features do other[key]=value end
            for _,widget in control.optionWidgets[key]or {}do
                if widget and type(widget.Set)=='function'then widget.Set(if type(value)=='table'then table.clone(value)else value,false)end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function control.migrateSettings(values)
        if type(values)~='table'then return values end
        local migrated=table.clone(values)
        local suffix={targets='Targets',range='Range (studs)',height='Height Y (studs)',radius='FOV Radius (px)'}
        for _,prefix in {'Main/',''}do
            for key,name in sharedNames do
                local saved=values[prefix..name]
                if not saved and suffix[key]then
                    -- Older independent selectors can disagree. Prefer the
                    -- established first skill deterministically, then save all
                    -- aliases together so restore order cannot choose a skill.
                    for _,skill in {'Whiplash','Rupture','Lasso','Flourish','Transcend'}do
                        saved=values[prefix..skill..' Aim '..suffix[key]]
                        if saved~=nil then break end
                    end
                end
                if saved~=nil then
                    migrated[prefix..name]=if type(saved)=='table'then table.clone(saved)else saved
                    if suffix[key]then
                        for _,skill in {'Whiplash','Rupture','Lasso','Flourish','Transcend'}do
                            migrated[prefix..skill..' Aim '..suffix[key]]=if type(saved)=='table'then table.clone(saved)else saved
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return migrated
    end
    function control.presentFov()
        if not control.alive then return end
        for key,feature in control.features do
            local geometry=if feature.showFov then control.cursorGeometry(key)else nil
            if geometry and not feature.circle then
                if not control.fovGui then
                    local parent=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
                    if not parent then continue end
                    local gui=host.Instance.new('ScreenGui');gui.Name='ShenaniganismTojiAimFov'
                    gui.IgnoreGuiInset,gui.ResetOnSpawn,gui.DisplayOrder=true,false,9;gui.Parent=parent;control.fovGui=gui
                end
                local circle=host.Instance.new('Frame');circle.Name=key..'CursorFov'
                circle.AnchorPoint=host.Vector2.new(.5,.5);circle.BackgroundTransparency,circle.BorderSizePixel=1,0
                local corner=host.Instance.new('UICorner');corner.CornerRadius=host.UDim.new(1,0);corner.Parent=circle
                local stroke=host.Instance.new('UIStroke');stroke.Thickness=1;stroke.Parent=circle
                circle.Parent=control.fovGui;feature.circle,feature.stroke=circle,stroke
            end
            local circle=feature.circle
            if circle then
                circle.Visible=geometry~=nil
                if geometry then
                    circle.Position=host.UDim2.fromOffset(geometry.center.X,geometry.center.Y)
                    circle.Size=host.UDim2.fromOffset(geometry.radius*2,geometry.radius*2)
                    feature.stroke.Color,feature.stroke.Transparency=feature.color,feature.transparency
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        if control.controlsCreated or not tab then return end
        control.controlsCreated=true
        local sharedRelated={}
        for _,key in {'targets','range','height','radius','cursorRayRange','actors'}do table.insert(sharedRelated,sharedNames[key])end
        for _,name in {'Skill Aim Target Mode','Skill Aim Switch Delay (ms)'}do table.insert(sharedRelated,name)end
        control.relatedNames=sharedRelated
        local function remember(key,widget)
            if not widget then return end
            control.optionWidgets[key]=control.optionWidgets[key]or {};table.insert(control.optionWidgets[key],widget)
        end
        local function shared(kind,key,config)
            config.Name=sharedNames[key];config.JujutsuerPortTab='Automatic';config.JujutsuerPortGroup='Toji'
            config.PortRelatedNames=sharedRelated;config.QuickSettingsOnly=key~='targets'
            config.Default=control.shared[key];config.Callback=function(value)return control.setOption('Toji',key,value)end
            remember(key,tab[kind](tab,config))
        end
        shared('CreateDropdown','targets',{DisplayName='Toji: Who To Aim At',Description='One selection for all enabled Toji skills. Closest to cursor uses the exact character under your actual world ray, otherwise the eligible character closest to its 3D map hit point. Uncheck it to rank other checked preferences in displayed order. Native skill reach, exclusions and first-hit requirements still apply.',Options=methods.choices(),Multi=true})
        shared('CreateSlider','range',{DisplayName='Toji Range (studs)',Min=0,Max=200,Step=.1,Precision=1})
        shared('CreateSlider','height',{DisplayName='Toji Height Y (studs)',Description='Shared full height. 90 includes 45 studs above and below.',Min=90,Max=200,Step=.1,Precision=1})
        shared('CreateSlider','radius',{DisplayName='Toji Cursor FOV Radius (px)',Description='Screen FOV gate for other target methods and the optional circle preview. Closest to cursor acquires from its actual 3D world hit point.',Min=10,Max=1000,Step=1,Precision=0})
        shared('CreateSlider','cursorRayRange',{DisplayName='Toji Cursor Ray Range (studs)',Description='Maximum distance for the actual world cursor ray and its target acquisition. Native skill reach and confirmed-victim followup checks keep their separate range.',Min=1,Max=20000,Step=1,Precision=0})
        shared('CreateDropdown','actors',{DisplayName='Toji Actor Types',Description='Hard eligibility filter. Prefer Players and Prefer NPCs in Who To Aim At only affect ranking.',Options={'Players','NPCs'},Multi=true})
        tab:CreateToggle({Name='Rupture End Aim Assist',Description='Aim the exact retained Rupture victim during an observed native second use, through the existing character Skill aim owner. Uses shared Toji range and target exclusions; stops on the native end cue or interruption. Your camera remains free.',Default=false,
            JujutsuerPortTab='Automatic',JujutsuerPortGroup='Toji',PortRelatedNames=sharedRelated,Callback=control.setRuptureEndEnabled})
        for _,key in {'Whiplash','Rupture','Flourish','Transcend','Lasso'}do
            local feature=control.features[key];local prefix=feature.spec.label..' Aim '
            local toggle=feature.spec.toggle or prefix..'Assist'
            local names={toggle,prefix..'Targets',prefix..'Range (studs)',prefix..'Height Y (studs)',prefix..'FOV Radius (px)',prefix..'Show FOV',prefix..'FOV Color',prefix..'FOV Transparency (%)'}
            for _,name in sharedRelated do table.insert(names,name)end
            local function add(kind,name,config)
                config.Name=name;config.JujutsuerPortTab='Automatic';config.JujutsuerPortGroup='Toji'
                config.PortRelatedNames=names;config.QuickSettingsOnly=name~=toggle
                return tab[kind](tab,config)
            end
            add('CreateToggle',toggle,{Description='Aim this manually started native skill using the shared Toji target choice, range and cursor FOV. Your main Lock On wins. Right-click for shared targeting and this skill’s FOV preview.',Default=false,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'enabled',value)end})
            remember('targets',add('CreateDropdown',prefix..'Targets',{DisplayName='Toji: Who To Aim At (shared)',Options=methods.choices(),Multi=true,Default=control.shared.targets,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'targets',value)end}))
            remember('range',add('CreateSlider',prefix..'Range (studs)',{DisplayName='Toji Range (shared)',Min=0,Max=200,Default=control.shared.range,Step=.1,Precision=1,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'range',value)end}))
            remember('height',add('CreateSlider',prefix..'Height Y (studs)',{DisplayName='Toji Height Y (shared)',Description='Shared vertical reach, centered on your character. 90 covers 45 studs above and below.',Min=90,Max=200,Default=control.shared.height,Step=.1,Precision=1,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'height',value)end}))
            remember('radius',add('CreateSlider',prefix..'FOV Radius (px)',{DisplayName='Toji Cursor FOV Radius (shared)',Min=10,Max=1000,Default=control.shared.radius,Step=1,Precision=0,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'radius',value)end}))
            add('CreateToggle',prefix..'Show FOV',{DisplayName='Show Cursor FOV',Default=false,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'showFov',value)end})
            add('CreateColorPicker',prefix..'FOV Color',{DisplayName='Cursor FOV Color',Default=feature.color,GetTransparency=function()return feature.transparency end,SetTransparency=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'transparency',value)end,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'color',value)end})
            add('CreateSlider',prefix..'FOV Transparency (%)',{DisplayName='Cursor FOV Transparency (%)',Min=0,Max=100,Default=0,Step=1,Precision=0,Callback=function(value)return control.setOption(key,'transparency',value/100)end})
        end
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()control.finish(nil,'Paused by Failsafe')end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.finish(nil,'Unloaded');control.alive=false
        for _,hook in control.hooks do
            hook.active=false
            local key=hook.key or 'automaticAimContext'
            if hook.owner[key]==hook.wrapper then hook.owner[key]=hook.original end
        end
        for _,c in control.connections do c:Disconnect()end
        if control.fovGui then control.fovGui:Destroy()end
        table.clear(control.scopes)
    end
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function()control.finish(nil,'Character removed')end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()control.finish(nil,'Window unfocused')end)
    local presentation=host.presentationRunService or run
    connect(presentation.RenderStepped,control.presentFov)
    control.attachFaceOwner()
    return control
end
return NativeTojiAim
end)()

local NativeTojiTimings = (function(): any
-- Owned Toji second uses, driven by native accepted effects/check clocks.
-- No first-cast wall-clock fallback, key synthesis, cooldown writes or first cast.
local NativeTojiTimings = {}
local SPECS = {
    ['Perfect Rupture']={service='RuptureService',cue='SkillCheck'},
    ['Auto Flourish']={service='FlourishService',cue='Spin'},
    ['Auto Flourish ISOH']={service='FlourishService',cue='Spin',sharedWith='Auto Flourish'},
    ['Auto Whiplash']={service='WhiplashService',cue='Spin'},
    ['Auto Transcend']={service='TranscendService',stance='ISOH'},
}
-- Three manual dummy captures produced native Hit2 + Swing2 for second inputs
-- .244740, .270001 and .321399 seconds after the actual owned Stab callback.
-- The first failed late input was +.356303. This is observed calibration,
-- not a recovered universal server-perfect window. Check.Start predates Stab
-- by variable native travel time (.42s and .97s observed), so it is identity
-- evidence only and must not impose a cast-global .70/.75-second deadline.
local RUPTURE_CONTACT_SECONDS=.28
local RUPTURE_CONTACT_EARLIEST_SECONDS=.245
local RUPTURE_CONTACT_LATEST_SECONDS=.32
local function finite(value)
    return type(value)=='number'and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
end
local function active(value)
    return value==true or type(value)=='number' and value>0
end
function NativeTojiTimings.new(host,menu)
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local input=host.game:GetService('UserInputService')
    local run=host.game:GetService('RunService')
    local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
    local world=host.game:GetService('Workspace')
    local clock=(host.os or os).clock
    local control: any={alive=true,focused=true,ready=false,features={},connections={},characterConnections={},native=nil,dispatching=nil,flourishEffects={}}
    for name,spec in SPECS do
        control.features[name]={name=name,spec=spec,enabled=false,ready=false,requests=0,starts=0,cues=0,nativeFollowups=0,
            timingSource=if name=='Auto Flourish'then 'Native animation Function=Continue'elseif name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then 'Exact owned native Flourish Hit during the same SSK cast; one logical Special request'elseif name=='Auto Whiplash'then 'Native Spin / WhiplashAgain second-use window, exact ragdolled victim at 15–25 studs'elseif name=='Auto Transcend'then 'Owned native Transcend Function=Await and exact live InSkill window; native continuation acceptance unverified'else 'Native owned Stab contact + 0.28 s (observed Hit2/Swing2 calibration)',
            perfectWindowVerified=false,nativeAcceptances=0,lastReason='Disabled'}
    end
    control.features['Auto Flourish ISOH'].variantAcceptanceVerified=false
    control.features['Auto Flourish ISOH'].nativeHitContractObserved=false
    control.features['Perfect Rupture'].calibratedContactSeconds=RUPTURE_CONTACT_SECONDS
    control.features['Perfect Rupture'].earliestContactSeconds=RUPTURE_CONTACT_EARLIEST_SECONDS
    control.features['Perfect Rupture'].latestContactSeconds=RUPTURE_CONTACT_LATEST_SECONDS
    control.features['Perfect Rupture'].observedSuccessfulCaptures=3
    control.features['Perfect Rupture'].timingAdjustmentMs=-15
    control.features['Auto Whiplash'].timingAdjustmentMs=30
    local function connect(signal,callback,list)
        if signal and type(signal.Connect)=='function' then table.insert(list or control.connections,signal:Connect(callback))end
    end
    local function disconnect(list)
        for _,connection in list do connection:Disconnect()end
        table.clear(list)
    end
    local function aimControl()
        return menu.nativeTojiAim
    end
    local function finishAim(feature,reason)
        local aim=aimControl()
        if aim and type(aim.finish)=='function'then aim.finish(feature.name,reason)end
    end
    local function finishFollowup(feature,reason)
        local followup=feature.followup
        if not followup then return end
        if followup and followup.connections then disconnect(followup.connections)end
        feature.followup=nil
        finishAim(feature,reason)
    end
    local function acceptVictim(feature,target)
        local aim=aimControl()
        if aim and type(aim.acceptedVictim)=='function'then aim.acceptedVictim(feature.name,target)end
    end
    local function cancel(feature,reason,keepAim)
        local record=feature.pending
        if record and record.connections then disconnect(record.connections)end
        feature.pending=nil
        if not keepAim then finishAim(feature,reason)end
        if reason then feature.lastReason=reason end
    end
    local function cancelAll(reason)
        for _,feature in control.features do
            local followup=feature.followup
            cancel(feature,reason,followup~=nil)
            if followup then finishFollowup(feature,reason)end
        end
    end
    local function paused()
        return menu.isFailsafePaused and menu.isFailsafePaused()==true
    end
    local function toolFor(feature)
        local character=player.Character
        local moves=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        if not moves or character:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Toji' then return nil end
        if feature.spec.stance then
            local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info');local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
            if not stance or not stance:IsA('StringValue')or stance.Value~=feature.spec.stance then return nil end
        end
        for _,tool in moves:GetChildren()do
            if tool.Parent==moves and tool:GetAttribute('Service')==feature.spec.service then return tool end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function permitted(feature,record)
        local character=player.Character
        local humanoid=character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        if not control.alive or not control.focused or paused() or not feature.enabled or not feature.ready
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox() or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand
            or not info or not toolFor(feature) then return false end
        if record and (record.character~=character or record.tool~=toolFor(feature) or humanoid.Health<record.health)then return false end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Knockback','TrueStun','Block','DomainClash','Throwable'}do
            if active(character:GetAttribute(name)) or info:FindFirstChild(name)then return false end
        end
        -- A native own-cast false Stun may coexist with the second-use cue.
        -- A true stun (or lost health above) is incoming interruption, never erased.
        local stun=info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
        if active(character:GetAttribute('Stun')) or stun and stun:IsA('BoolValue') and stun.Value==true then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function callNative(callback,...)
        if menu.nativeCounter and type(menu.nativeCounter.callNative)=='function' then return menu.nativeCounter.callNative(callback,...)end
        return pcall(callback,...)
    end
    -- False when the native Special action cannot be requested. The Special
    -- variants then use the move's own native second use (the double tap).
    -- Special shares the character's M2 cooldown (M2_CD seconds from the LastM2 server stamp). While it
    -- is cooling down the Special variants cannot fire, so every variant uses its move's double press.
    control.specialCooldownCheck=true
    function control.setSpecialCooldownCheck(value)
        control.specialCooldownCheck=value==true
        return true
    end
    function control.specialCooldownLeft()
        local character=player.Character
        local cooldown=character and tonumber(character:GetAttribute('M2_CD'))
        local last=character and tonumber(character:GetAttribute('LastM2'))
        if not cooldown or not last or last<=0 then return 0 end
        local ok,server=pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow,world)
        if not ok or not finite(server)then return 0 end
        return math.max(0,cooldown-(server-last))
    end
    local function nativeSpecialReady()
        local bindings=menu.bindings
        if not bindings or type(bindings.sendNativeSpecial)~='function'then return false end
        if control.specialCooldownCheck and control.specialCooldownLeft()>.05 then return false end
        if type(bindings.nativeSpecialAvailable)~='function'then return true end
        local ok,available=pcall(bindings.nativeSpecialAvailable)
        return ok and available==true
    end
    -- When on (default), a Special variant that cannot use Special falls back to the move's double press.
    control.specialFallback=true
    function control.setSpecialFallback(value)
        control.specialFallback=value==true
        return true
    end
    local function serverNow()
        if not world or type(world.GetServerTimeNow)~='function'then return nil end
        local ok,value=pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow,world)
        return if ok and finite(value)then value else nil
    end
    local function ruptureContext(record)
        local character=record.character
        local info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        if not stance or not stance:IsA('StringValue')or stance.Value~='ISOH'then return false end
        local reference=record.ruptureReference
        if not info or not reference or reference.Parent~=info or info:FindFirstChild('RuptureCheck')~=reference
            or not reference:IsA('BoolValue')or reference.Value~=false or reference:GetAttribute('Start')~=record.ruptureStart
            or record.stabReference~=reference or not finite(record.stabContactAt)then return false end
        local target=record.target
        local humanoid=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local targetInfo=target and target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        return humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')==record.targetRoot
            and record.targetRoot~=nil and not active(target:GetAttribute('Dead'))and not(targetInfo and targetInfo:FindFirstChild('Dead'))
    end
    local function dispatch(feature,record,cue)
        if feature.pending~=record or record.sent or not permitted(feature,record)then cancel(feature,'Native second-use cue was interrupted');return false end
        local maximum=if record.track and record.track.IsPlaying then 30 else 6
        if clock()-record.at>maximum then cancel(feature,'Native second-use cue expired');return false end
        local aim=aimControl()
        if feature.name=='Auto Whiplash'and aim and type(aim.beginWhiplashFollowup)=='function'
            and aim.beginWhiplashFollowup(record.character,record.tool,record.target,record)==false then
            cancel(feature,'The confirmed Whiplash aim cast changed before its second use');return false
        end
        if aim and type(aim.beforeFollowup)=='function'and aim.beforeFollowup(record.character,feature.name,record.target)==false then
            cancel(feature,'The owned Toji aim target is no longer available');return false
        end
        record.sent=true;cancel(feature,nil,true)
        local dispatching={feature=feature,thread=coroutine.running(),tool=record.tool,dispatched=false,cast=record}
        -- Native effects can arrive before UseTool returns. Install only the
        -- Whiplash second-hit observer now, and never recreate it on return.
        local whiplashFollowup
        if feature.name=='Auto Whiplash'then
            whiplashFollowup={character=record.character,tool=record.tool,target=record.target,at=clock(),health=record.health,sourceCast=record}
            feature.followup=whiplashFollowup
        end
        control.dispatching=dispatching
        local ok,message=callNative(control.native.UseTool,control.native,record.tool,'Activated')
        if control.dispatching==dispatching then control.dispatching=nil end
        if not ok then
            feature.lastReason='Native second use failed: '..tostring(message)
            if whiplashFollowup and feature.followup==whiplashFollowup then finishFollowup(feature,feature.lastReason)else finishAim(feature,feature.lastReason)end
            return false
        end
        if not dispatching.dispatched then
            feature.lastReason='Native tool returned without submitting the second use'
            if whiplashFollowup and feature.followup==whiplashFollowup then finishFollowup(feature,feature.lastReason)else finishAim(feature,feature.lastReason)end
            return false
        end
        -- A successful Lua call is a request, not proof of server-perfect timing.
        feature.requests+=1
        if not whiplashFollowup then feature.followup={character=record.character,tool=record.tool,target=record.target,at=clock()}end
        if feature.name=='Perfect Rupture'and record.track and record.track.IsPlaying and aim and type(aim.beginFollowup)=='function'then
            local followup=feature.followup
            -- The End-only aim lease is tied to this actual owned track. Its
            -- first native Swing2/Hit2 is outcome evidence, not an End marker.
            followup.keepAim=aim.beginFollowup(record.character,feature.name,record.target,record.tool,record.track)==true
            if followup.keepAim then
                followup.track=record.track;followup.connections={}
                local function ended()
                    if feature.followup==followup then finishFollowup(feature,'Owned Rupture follow-up animation ended')end
                end
                connect(record.track:GetMarkerReachedSignal('Function'),function(value)if value=='End'then ended()end end,followup.connections)
                connect(record.track.Stopped,ended,followup.connections)
            end
        end
        if feature.name=='Auto Flourish'then cancel(control.features['Auto Flourish ISOH'],'Native Flourish continuation owns this cast',true)end
        feature.lastCue=cue
        if not whiplashFollowup or not whiplashFollowup.completed then feature.lastReason='One native second use requested at '..cue end
        return true
    end
    local function stepRupture(feature,record)
        if not record.ruptureReference then
            local candidate=record.ruptureCandidate
            if candidate then
                local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                if candidate.Parent~=info or not info or info:FindFirstChild('RuptureCheck')~=candidate or candidate.Value~=false then
                    cancel(feature,'Native Rupture check changed before its clock replicated');return
                end
                local now=serverNow()
                if now and record.stabContactAt and now>record.stabContactAt+RUPTURE_CONTACT_LATEST_SECONDS then
                    cancel(feature,'Native Rupture clock did not replicate inside its contact-relative window')
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if not record.stabContactAt then
            feature.lastNativeBranch='Native check without first Stab (short/ragdoll branch)'
            feature.lastReason='Native Rupture check is live without a first Stab; waiting for a verified native perfect cue for the shorter/ragdoll branch'
            return
        end
        local now=serverNow()
        if not now or not ruptureContext(record)then cancel(feature,'Native Rupture check, ISOH stance or accepted target changed');return end
        if now<record.ruptureStart-.1 or now<record.stabContactAt
            or now>record.stabContactAt+RUPTURE_CONTACT_LATEST_SECONDS then
            cancel(feature,'Native Rupture contact-relative calibration expired; no late second use');return
        end
        local phase=math.clamp(RUPTURE_CONTACT_SECONDS+(record.timingAdjustmentMs or 0)/1000,
            RUPTURE_CONTACT_EARLIEST_SECONDS,RUPTURE_CONTACT_LATEST_SECONDS)
        if now>=record.stabContactAt+phase then
            feature.lastRequestedPhase=now-record.ruptureStart
            feature.lastRequestedContactPhase=now-record.stabContactAt
            feature.lastRequestedAdjustmentMs=record.timingAdjustmentMs or 0
            dispatch(feature,record,'native owned Rupture Stab contact with bounded signed timing adjustment')
        end
    end
    local function targetRagdolled(target)
        for _,name in {'Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll'}do
            if active(target:GetAttribute(name))then return true end
            local info=target:FindFirstChild('Info')
            local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild(name)
            if marker and marker:IsA('BoolValue')and marker.Value==true then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function stepWhiplash(feature,record)
        local reference=record.whiplashReference
        if not reference then return end
        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        if not stance or not stance:IsA('StringValue')or stance.Value~='COATM'
            or reference.Parent~=info or info:FindFirstChild('WhiplashAgain')~=reference
            or not reference:IsA('BoolValue')or reference.Value~=false then
            cancel(feature,'Native Whiplash second-use window or COATM stance changed');return
        end
        local target=record.target
        local humanoid=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local ownRoot=record.character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local targetRoot=target and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        local targetInfo=target and target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local state=humanoid and type(humanoid.GetState)=='function'and humanoid:GetState()
        local deadState=host.Enum and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType and host.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
        local stateDead=state and ((deadState and state==deadState)or tostring(state)=='Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead')
        local excluder=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        local excluded=target and excluder and excluder(target)
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or not ownRoot or not targetRoot or targetRoot~=record.targetRoot
            or active(target:GetAttribute('Dead'))or targetInfo and targetInfo:FindFirstChild('Dead')or stateDead or excluded then
            cancel(feature,'Exact Whiplash victim is no longer available');return
        end
        local ragdolled=targetRagdolled(target)
        if record.sawRagdoll and not ragdolled then cancel(feature,'Exact Whiplash victim recovered before the second use');return end
        record.sawRagdoll=ragdolled
        local distance=(targetRoot.Position-ownRoot.Position).Magnitude
        feature.lastDistance=distance
        if not finite(distance)then cancel(feature,'Exact Whiplash victim distance is unavailable');return end
        if ragdolled and distance>=15 and distance<=25 then
            record.whiplashEligibleAt=record.whiplashEligibleAt or clock()
            -- The native window/victim gates above remain live throughout the
            -- adjustment. A negative offset cannot precede native eligibility.
            local delay=math.max(0,record.timingAdjustmentMs or 0)/1000
            if clock()-record.whiplashEligibleAt+1e-8<delay then
                feature.lastReason='Waiting for timing adjustment inside the same native Whiplash victim/window';return
            end
            feature.lastRequestedAdjustmentMs=record.timingAdjustmentMs or 0
            dispatch(feature,record,'native WhiplashAgain window with exact ragdolled victim at 15–25 studs')
        else
            record.whiplashEligibleAt=nil
            feature.lastReason=if not ragdolled then 'Waiting for the exact Whiplash victim to ragdoll inside its native second-use window'else 'Waiting for the exact Whiplash victim to enter 15–25 studs inside its native second-use window'
        end
    end
    local function continueFlourish(feature,record)
        if feature.pending~=record or not record.accepted or not record.continueReady then return end
        feature.cues+=1;dispatch(feature,record,'native Flourish Function=Continue marker')
    end
    local function continueTranscend(feature,record)
        if feature.pending~=record or not record.awaitReached or record.sent then return end
        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local marker=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        if not permitted(feature,record)or not record.track or not record.track.IsPlaying or info~=record.info
            or not marker or marker.Parent~=info or record.transcendWindow and marker~=record.transcendWindow then
            feature.lastAwaitDecision='Native Transcend ISOH cast, track or exact InSkill window changed'
            cancel(feature,'Native Transcend ISOH cast, track or exact InSkill window changed');return
        end
        record.transcendWindow=marker
        -- This exact manual activation, owned track and live native window are
        -- the continuation proof. Cooldown attributes may advance only later.
        feature.cues+=1
        local submitted=dispatch(feature,record,'owned native Transcend Function=Await with exact live InSkill window (acceptance unverified)')
        feature.lastAwaitDecision=if submitted then 'One native Transcend second use submitted after owned Await'else feature.lastReason
    end
    local function queueTranscend(feature,record)
        if feature.pending~=record or record.sent or record.awaitQueued then return end
        record.awaitQueued=true
        local function afterNativeMarker()
            record.awaitQueued=false
            if feature.pending==record then continueTranscend(feature,record)end
        end
        -- Let the game's other listeners for this same marker open their
        -- native continuation state; this is not a guessed millisecond delay.
        if host.task and type(host.task.defer)=='function'then host.task.defer(afterNativeMarker)else afterNativeMarker()end
    end
    local function continueFlourishISOH(feature,record)
        if feature.pending~=record or record.sent or not record.accepted or not record.hitConfirmed or not record.track then return end
        local track=record.track
        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        local target=record.target
        local humanoid=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local targetInfo=target and target:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local excluder=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
        if not permitted(feature,record)or not track.IsPlaying or not stance or stance.Value~='SSK'
            or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')~=record.targetRoot
            or active(target:GetAttribute('Dead'))or targetInfo and targetInfo:FindFirstChild('Dead')or excluder and excluder(target)then
            cancel(feature,'Owned Flourish first-hit victim, SSK stance or animation changed');return
        end
        local bindings=menu.bindings
        -- Special cannot be requested: the Flourish second use (double tap) stands in.
        local function secondUse(why)
            if not dispatch(feature,record,why)then return false end
            feature.lastReason='Special unavailable; native Flourish second use requested instead ('..why..')'
            cancel(control.features['Auto Flourish'],'Flourish second-use fallback owns this cast',true)
            return true
        end
        if not control.specialHook or not nativeSpecialReady()then
            if control.specialFallback then secondUse('Special unavailable') else cancel(feature,'Native logical Special action is unavailable') end
            return
        end
        local aim=aimControl()
        if aim and type(aim.beforeFollowup)=='function'and aim.beforeFollowup(record.character,feature.name,record.target)==false then
            cancel(feature,'The owned Toji aim target is no longer available');return
        end
        record.sent=true;cancel(feature,nil,true)
        local dispatching={feature=feature,thread=coroutine.running(),dispatched=false,kind='Special'}
        control.dispatching=dispatching
        local ok,result=callNative(bindings.sendNativeSpecial,true)
        if control.dispatching==dispatching then control.dispatching=nil end
        -- Release only the provider-owned edge. Its release method preserves a
        -- physical Special key the player is still holding.
        if ok and result==true then callNative(bindings.sendNativeSpecial,false)end
        if not ok or result~=true or not dispatching.dispatched then
            -- Special failed or the game ignored it (no RightActivated request):
            -- hand the cast back and use the native second use instead.
            -- A suppressed press (result false, e.g. manual Block) is not a fallback.
            if(not ok or result==true)and control.specialFallback and not paused()then
                record.sent=false;feature.pending=record
                if secondUse('Special was not accepted')then return end
            end
            feature.lastReason='Native Special returned without an observed Toji RightActivated request';finishAim(feature,feature.lastReason);return
        end
        feature.requests+=1;feature.lastCue='Exact owned Flourish Hit during SSK';feature.lastReason='One native Special requested after Flourish first hit; variant acceptance is unverified'
        feature.followup={character=record.character,tool=record.tool,target=record.target,at=clock(),kind='Special'}
        cancel(control.features['Auto Flourish'],'Flourish Special variant owns this cast',true)
    end
    local function attachFlourishTrack(feature,record,track)
        if feature.pending~=record or record.track or not track or not track.Animation
            or tostring(track.Animation.AnimationId):match('%d+')~='88959376775614'
            or track.IsPlaying~=true or feature.name=='Auto Flourish'and track.TimePosition>=1 then return end
        record.track=track
        connect(track:GetMarkerReachedSignal('Function'),function(value)
            if feature.pending~=record or not track.IsPlaying then return end
            if feature.name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then
                if value=='End'then cancel(feature,'Owned Flourish ended without a confirmed Special variant')end
                return
            end
            if value=='Continue'then record.continueReady=true;continueFlourish(feature,record)end
        end,record.connections)
        connect(track.Stopped,function()
            if feature.pending==record then cancel(feature,'Owned Flourish animation stopped before its Continue marker')end
        end,record.connections)
    end
    local function attachRuptureTrack(feature,record,track)
        if feature.pending~=record or record.track or not track or not track.Animation
            or tostring(track.Animation.AnimationId):match('%d+')~='104330988826871'or track.IsPlaying~=true then return end
        record.track=track
        connect(track:GetMarkerReachedSignal('Function'),function(value)
            if feature.pending==record and value=='End'then cancel(feature,'Owned Rupture animation ended before its second use')end
        end,record.connections)
        connect(track.Stopped,function()
            if feature.pending==record then cancel(feature,'Owned Rupture animation stopped before its second use')end
        end,record.connections)
    end
    local function attachTranscendTrack(feature,record,track)
        if feature.pending~=record or record.track or not track or not track.Animation
            or tostring(track.Animation.AnimationId):match('%d+')~='75909247131455'or track.IsPlaying~=true then return end
        record.track=track;record.accepted=true;feature.starts+=1
        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        record.transcendWindow=info and info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        feature.lastReason='Owned native Transcend track observed; waiting for its authored Await and live InSkill window'
        connect(track:GetMarkerReachedSignal('Function'),function(value)
            if feature.pending~=record or not track.IsPlaying then return end
            feature.lastNativeMarker=value
            if value=='Await'then
                feature.awaitMarkers=(feature.awaitMarkers or 0)+1;feature.lastAwaitAt=clock()
                record.awaitReached=true;queueTranscend(feature,record)
            elseif value=='End'then cancel(feature,'Owned Transcend ended before its native continuation')end
        end,record.connections)
        connect(track.Stopped,function()
            if feature.pending==record then cancel(feature,'Owned Transcend animation stopped before Await')end
        end,record.connections)
    end
    local function findFlourishTrack(feature,record)
        local humanoid=record.character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        local animator=humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
        if animator and type(animator.GetPlayingAnimationTracks)=='function'then
            for _,track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()do attachFlourishTrack(feature,record,track)end
        end
        if feature.name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then continueFlourishISOH(feature,record)end
    end
    local function flourishCue(object)
        local feature=control.features['Auto Flourish'];local record=feature.pending
        if not record or object==nil then return end
        local assets=record.character:FindFirstChild('SetAssets')
        local weapon=assets and assets:FindFirstChild('SSK')
        local handle=weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild('HandleSSK')
        if not handle then return end
        local attachment=object
        if object:IsA('ParticleEmitter')then attachment=object.Parent end
        if attachment and attachment:IsA('Attachment') and attachment.Parent==handle then
            local shine=attachment:FindFirstChild('StarShine')
            if shine and shine:IsA('ParticleEmitter') and not record.existingShines[attachment] then
                record.shine=attachment
                feature.lastVisualCue='Native Flourish StarShine (telegraph only)'
            end
        end
    end
    local function bindCharacter(character)
        disconnect(control.characterConnections);cancelAll('Character changed; waiting for your next owned cast')
        control.character=character
        control.boundAnimator=nil
        if not character then return end
        local function bindAnimator(animator)
            if not animator or not animator:IsA('Animator') or animator.Parent~=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')or control.boundAnimator==animator then return end
            if control.boundAnimator then cancelAll('Owned animation controller changed')end
            control.boundAnimator=animator
            connect(animator.AnimationPlayed,function(track)
                local rupture=control.features['Perfect Rupture']
                if rupture.pending then attachRuptureTrack(rupture,rupture.pending,track)end
                local transcend=control.features['Auto Transcend']
                if transcend.pending then attachTranscendTrack(transcend,transcend.pending,track)end
                for _,name in {'Auto Flourish','Auto Flourish ISOH'}do local feature=control.features[name];local record=feature.pending
                    if record then attachFlourishTrack(feature,record,track);if name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then continueFlourishISOH(feature,record)end end
                end
            end,control.characterConnections)
            for _,name in {'Auto Flourish','Auto Flourish ISOH'}do local feature=control.features[name];local record=feature.pending
                if record then findFlourishTrack(feature,record)end
            end
        end
        connect(character.DescendantAdded,function(object)
            flourishCue(object)
            if object:IsA('Animator')then bindAnimator(object)end
        end,control.characterConnections)
        connect(character.GetAttributeChangedSignal and character:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Moveset'),function()cancelAll('Moveset changed')end,control.characterConnections)
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid then
            connect(humanoid.Died,function()cancelAll('Character died')end,control.characterConnections)
            bindAnimator(humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator'))
        end
    end
    local function effect(feature,kind,caster,...)
        if not control.alive or paused() or caster~=player.Character or not feature.enabled then return end
        local record=feature.pending
        if feature.spec.service=='FlourishService'and record and kind=='Hit'and not record.hitConfirmed then
            local target=select(1,...)
            local kindOfTarget=(host.typeof or typeof)(target)
            local humanoid=(kindOfTarget=='Instance'or type(target)=='table')and type(target.IsA)=='function'and target:IsA('Model')
                and type(target.FindFirstChildOfClass)=='function'and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if humanoid and target~=record.character and target.Parent and humanoid.Health>0 and target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')then
                record.hitConfirmed=true;record.target=target;record.targetRoot=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                acceptVictim(feature,target)
                if feature.name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then
                    feature.nativeHitContractObserved=true;feature.cues+=1;continueFlourishISOH(feature,record)
                end
            end
        end
        if feature.name=='Auto Whiplash'and record then
            local reference=select(1,...)
            local kindOfReference=(host.typeof or typeof)(reference)
            if kind=='Start'and (kindOfReference=='Instance'or type(reference)=='table')
                and type(reference.IsA)=='function'and reference:IsA('BoolValue')and reference.Name=='WhiplashChain'
                and reference.Value==false and reference.Parent==record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                and reference.Parent:FindFirstChild('WhiplashChain')==reference then
                record.whiplashStarted=true
            elseif kind=='Hit'and record.whiplashStarted and not record.target
                and (kindOfReference=='Instance'or type(reference)=='table')and type(reference.FindFirstChildOfClass)=='function'
                and reference~=record.character and reference:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')then
                record.target=reference;record.targetRoot=reference:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');record.sawRagdoll=targetRagdolled(reference)
                acceptVictim(feature,reference)
            end
        end
        if feature.name=='Perfect Rupture'and kind=='Stab'and record then
            local target=select(1,...)
            local reference=select(2,...)
            local kindOfTarget=(host.typeof or typeof)(target)
            local kindOfReference=(host.typeof or typeof)(reference)
            local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
            if (kindOfTarget=='Instance'or type(target)=='table')and type(target.FindFirstChildOfClass)=='function'and target~=record.character
                and (kindOfReference=='Instance'or type(reference)=='table')and type(reference.IsA)=='function'
                and reference:IsA('BoolValue')and reference.Name=='RuptureCheck'and reference.Parent==info
                and info:FindFirstChild('RuptureCheck')==reference and reference.Value==false then
                if record.target and (record.target~=target or record.stabReference~=reference)then cancel(feature,'Native Rupture Stab victim or check changed');return end
                if not record.stabContactAt then
                    record.target=target;record.targetRoot=target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    record.stabReference=reference;record.stabContactAt=serverNow()
                    feature.lastNativeBranch='Native first Stab contact branch (empirical timing)'
                    feature.lastContact={at=record.stabContactAt,target=target,check=reference,start=reference:GetAttribute('Start')}
                    acceptVictim(feature,target)
                end
            end
        end
        if kind==feature.spec.cue and record then
            if not permitted(feature,record)then cancel(feature,'Native cast cue was interrupted');return end
            record.accepted=true;feature.starts+=1
            if feature.name=='Perfect Rupture'then
                local reference=select(1,...)
                if not record.checked then
                    record.checked=true;feature.cues+=1
                    local referenceKind=(host.typeof or typeof)(reference)
                    if referenceKind~='Instance'and type(reference)~='table'then reference=nil end
                    record.ruptureCandidate=reference
                    local function sample()
                        if feature.pending~=record then return end
                        local start=reference and type(reference.GetAttribute)=='function'and reference:GetAttribute('Start')or nil
                        feature.lastCheck={at=clock(),reference=if reference then reference.Name else nil,start=start,
                            value=if reference and type(reference.IsA)=='function'and reference:IsA('BoolValue')then reference.Value else nil}
                        local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                        if not reference or reference.Name~='RuptureCheck'or not reference:IsA('BoolValue')or reference.Value~=false
                            or not info or reference.Parent~=info or info:FindFirstChild('RuptureCheck')~=reference then
                            cancel(feature,'Native Rupture check identity changed; second use withheld');return
                        end
                        if record.ruptureReference and start~=record.ruptureStart then
                            cancel(feature,'Native Rupture check phase changed; second use withheld');return
                        end
                        if start==nil then
                            feature.lastReason='Waiting for the exact native Rupture check clock to replicate'
                            stepRupture(feature,record);return
                        end
                        local now=serverNow()
                        if not finite(start)or not now or now<start-.1 then
                            cancel(feature,'Native Rupture check lacks a usable clock phase; second use withheld');return
                        end
                        record.ruptureReference,record.ruptureStart=reference,start
                        feature.lastReason='Owned native Rupture check accepted; waiting for its calibrated contact-relative phase'
                        -- A matching cue/clock can arrive after contact+.28.
                        -- Evaluate it now; waiting another frame can miss+.32.
                        stepRupture(feature,record)
                    end
                    record.sampleRuptureCheck=sample
                    if reference and type(reference.GetAttributeChangedSignal)=='function'then
                        connect(reference:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Start'),sample,record.connections)
                        if type(reference.GetPropertyChangedSignal)=='function'then connect(reference:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Value'),sample,record.connections)end
                        connect(reference.Destroying,function()if feature.pending==record then cancel(feature,'Native Rupture check was removed')end end,record.connections)
                    end
                    sample()
                elseif reference~=record.ruptureCandidate then cancel(feature,'Native Rupture check identity changed; second use withheld')
                elseif record.sampleRuptureCheck then record.sampleRuptureCheck()
                end
            elseif feature.name=='Auto Whiplash'then
                if not record.checked then
                    record.checked=true
                    local reference=select(1,...)
                    local kindOfReference=(host.typeof or typeof)(reference)
                    local info=record.character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                    if record.whiplashStarted and record.target and (kindOfReference=='Instance'or type(reference)=='table')
                        and type(reference.IsA)=='function'and reference:IsA('BoolValue')and reference.Name=='WhiplashAgain'
                        and reference.Parent==info and info:FindFirstChild('WhiplashAgain')==reference and reference.Value==false then
                        record.whiplashReference=reference;feature.cues+=1
                        local function invalidate()
                            if feature.pending==record then cancel(feature,'Native Whiplash second-use window changed')end
                        end
                        connect(reference:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Value'),invalidate,record.connections)
                        connect(reference.Destroying,invalidate,record.connections)
                        stepWhiplash(feature,record)
                    else cancel(feature,'Native Whiplash window lacks the exact owned first-hit victim')end
                end
            else
                feature.lastReason=if feature.name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then 'Owned Flourish accepted; waiting for a confirmed native first Hit on its live SSK track'else 'Owned Flourish Spin accepted; waiting for its native animation Continue marker'
                findFlourishTrack(feature,record)
                if feature.name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then continueFlourishISOH(feature,record)else continueFlourish(feature,record)end
            end
        elseif feature.name=='Auto Whiplash'and feature.followup and feature.followup.character==caster and clock()-feature.followup.at<=3 then
            local followup=feature.followup
            local value=select(1,...)
            local kindOfValue=(host.typeof or typeof)(value)
            if kind=='Dash'and not followup.accepted and (kindOfValue=='Instance'or type(value)=='table')
                and type(value.IsA)=='function'and value:IsA('BodyPosition')and value.Parent==caster:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')then
                followup.accepted=true;feature.nativeAcceptances+=1;feature.lastNativeEffect=kind
                feature.lastReason='Native Whiplash second dash accepted; waiting for the exact victim hit'
            elseif kind=='Hit'and followup.accepted and value==followup.target then
                followup.completed=true
                feature.nativeFollowups+=1;feature.lastNativeEffect=kind;feature.followup=nil
                feature.lastReason='Native Whiplash second hit observed on the exact first victim'
                finishAim(feature,feature.lastReason)
            end
        elseif feature.name~='Auto Flourish ISOH'and feature.followup and feature.followup.character==caster and clock()-feature.followup.at<=3
            and (kind=='Swing2' or kind=='Hit2' or kind=='ChainGrab')then
            local followup=feature.followup
            if followup.observed then return end
            followup.observed=true;feature.nativeFollowups+=1;feature.lastNativeEffect=kind
            feature.lastReason='Native follow-up effect observed: '..tostring(kind)
            if not followup.keepAim then finishFollowup(feature,feature.lastReason)end
        end
    end
    function control.refreshNative()
        if not control.alive then return false end
        local folder=replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local module=folder and folder:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local serviceFolders=module and module:FindFirstChild('Services')
        if not module or not serviceFolders then return false end
        local ok,knit=pcall(host.require,module)
        if not ok or not knit or type(knit.GetController)~='function' or type(knit.GetService)~='function'then return false end
        local found,native=pcall(knit.GetController,'ToolController')
        if not found or not native or type(native.UseTool)~='function'then return false end
        control.native=native
        local aim=aimControl()
        if aim and type(aim.bindNative)=='function'then aim.bindNative(native)end
        for _,feature in control.features do
            if not feature.spec.sharedWith and not feature.hook and serviceFolders:FindFirstChild(feature.spec.service)then
                local got,service=pcall(knit.GetService,feature.spec.service)
                if got and service and service.Activated and type(service.Activated.Fire)=='function'and service.Effects and type(service.Effects.Connect)=='function'then
                    local hook={active=true,signal=service.Activated,original=service.Activated.Fire}
