                    feature.hook=hook;feature.service=service;feature.ready=true;control.ready=true
                    hook.wrapper=function(self,...)
                        local args=table.pack(...);local created
                        local own=control.dispatching
                        if hook.active and own and own.feature==feature and own.thread==coroutine.running()and args[1]==own.tool and self==hook.signal then own.dispatched=true end
                        -- Rupture variant: a manual first use starts the hold or the use-twice wait.
                        if hook.active and feature.name=='Perfect Rupture' and self==hook.signal and not(own and own.thread==coroutine.running()) then
                            pcall(control.beginRuptureVariant,args[1])
                        end
                        local castFeatures=if feature.name=='Auto Flourish'then {feature,control.features['Auto Flourish ISOH']}else {feature}
                        for _,castFeature in castFeatures do
                        if hook.active and (not own or own.thread~=coroutine.running())and args[1]==toolFor(castFeature)and permitted(castFeature)then
                            if castFeature.pending then cancel(castFeature,'Your manual second use took priority')
                            else
                                finishFollowup(castFeature,'A new manual native use replaced the previous follow-up')
                                local character=player.Character
                                local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                                created={character=character,tool=args[1],at=clock(),health=humanoid.Health,accepted=false,sent=false,existingShines={},connections={},
                                    timingAdjustmentMs=castFeature.timingAdjustmentMs}
                                if castFeature.name=='Auto Transcend'then
                                    created.info=character:FindFirstChild('Info')
                                    created.transcendMetadata={LastUse=args[1]:GetAttribute('LastUse'),ReadyAt=args[1]:GetAttribute('ReadyAt')}
                                    local selectedAim=aimControl();local lease=selectedAim and selectedAim.current
                                    if lease and lease.character==character and lease.tool==args[1]and lease.key=='Transcend'then
                                        -- Retain the existing cast selection without claiming a
                                        -- native victim hit or selecting a different target.
                                        created.target=lease.target
                                    end
                                end
                                if castFeature.name=='Auto Flourish'then
                                    local assets=character:FindFirstChild('SetAssets');local weapon=assets and assets:FindFirstChild('SSK');local handle=weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild('HandleSSK')
                                    if handle then for _,child in handle:GetChildren()do created.existingShines[child]=true end end
                                end
                                castFeature.pending=created;castFeature.lastReason='Waiting for native accepted cast and second-use cue'
                                if castFeature.spec.service=='FlourishService'then findFlourishTrack(castFeature,created)end
                            end
                        end
                        end
                        local result=table.pack(pcall(hook.original,self,table.unpack(args,1,args.n)))
                        if not result[1]then for _,castFeature in castFeatures do cancel(castFeature,'Native first activation failed')end;error(result[2],0)end
                        return table.unpack(result,2,result.n)
                    end
                    service.Activated.Fire=hook.wrapper
                    connect(service.Effects,function(kind,caster,...)
                        if feature.name=='Auto Flourish'and caster==player.Character then
                            -- Bounded public native-signal metadata, including
                            -- unknown variant names. Never infer a hit from it.
                            local row={kind=tostring(kind),at=serverNow(),args={}}
                            for index,value in {...}do
                                if index>6 then break end
                                local kindOfValue=(host.typeof or typeof)(value)
                                if kindOfValue=='Instance'or type(value)=='table'and type(value.IsA)=='function'then
                                    row.args[index]={class=value.ClassName,name=value.Name}
                                elseif type(value)=='number'or type(value)=='boolean'or type(value)=='string'then row.args[index]=value
                                else row.args[index]={type=kindOfValue}end
                            end
                            if #control.flourishEffects>=32 then table.remove(control.flourishEffects,1)end
                            table.insert(control.flourishEffects,row)
                        end
                        effect(feature,kind,caster,...)
                        if feature.name=='Auto Flourish'then effect(control.features['Auto Flourish ISOH'],kind,caster,...)end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local variant=control.features['Auto Flourish ISOH']
        if not control.specialHook and serviceFolders:FindFirstChild('TojiService')then
            local got,service=pcall(knit.GetService,'TojiService')
            if got and service and service.RightActivated and type(service.RightActivated.Fire)=='function'then
                local hook={active=true,signal=service.RightActivated,original=service.RightActivated.Fire};control.specialHook=hook
                hook.wrapper=function(self,...)
                    local own=control.dispatching
                    if hook.active and self==hook.signal then
                        if own and own.feature==variant and own.thread==coroutine.running()then own.dispatched=true
                        elseif variant.pending then cancel(variant,'Your manual Special took priority')end
                    end
                    return hook.original(self,...)
                end
                hook.signal.Fire=hook.wrapper
            end
        end
        -- No Special requirement: without it the variant uses the native second use.
        variant.ready=control.features['Auto Flourish'].ready
        return control.ready
    end
    function control.setEnabled(name,value)
        local feature=control.features[name]
        if not feature or type(value)~='boolean'then return false end
        feature.enabled=value;finishFollowup(feature,if value then 'Waiting for your next owned native cast'else 'Disabled')
        cancel(feature,if value then 'Waiting for your next owned native cast'else 'Disabled')
        return true
    end
    function control.setPerfectRuptureEnabled(value)return control.setEnabled('Perfect Rupture',value)end
    function control.setAutoFlourishEnabled(value)return control.setEnabled('Auto Flourish',value)end
    function control.setAutoFlourishISOHEnabled(value)return control.setEnabled('Auto Flourish ISOH',value)end
    function control.setAutoWhiplashEnabled(value)return control.setEnabled('Auto Whiplash',value)end
    function control.setAutoTranscendEnabled(value)return control.setEnabled('Auto Transcend',value)end
    function control.cancelWhiplashForNewAction(character,tool)
        local feature=control.features['Auto Whiplash']
        local record=feature.pending or feature.followup
        if record and record.character==character and record.tool~=tool then
            cancel(feature,'A new owned native action replaced Whiplash')
            finishFollowup(feature,'A new owned native action replaced Whiplash')
        end
    end
    function control.setRuptureTimingAdjustmentMs(value)
        if not finite(value)then return false end
        control.features['Perfect Rupture'].timingAdjustmentMs=math.clamp(value,-35,40);return true
    end
    function control.setWhiplashTimingAdjustmentMs(value)
        if not finite(value)then return false end
        control.features['Auto Whiplash'].timingAdjustmentMs=math.clamp(value,-30,150);return true
    end
    -- Rupture variants for the ISOH stance. 'Hold Special' keeps the logical
    -- Special action down through the cast; 'Use twice' makes the second use
    -- once the native RuptureCheck window has been open for the set delay.
    -- Independent of Perfect Rupture, which keeps priority over 'Use twice'.
    control.ruptureVariant={enabled=false,mode='Hold Special',delayMs=280,holdDelayMs=0,debug=true}
    -- Console trace while the variant is armed, so the real in-game markers and
    -- timing can be read from the output. Set control.ruptureVariant.debug=false to silence.
    local function rlog(record,message)
        if not control.ruptureVariant.debug then return end
        local info=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local names={}
        if info then for _,child in info:GetChildren()do table.insert(names,child.Name)end end
        local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        trace(string.format('[Shenaniganism] Rupture variant +%dms: %s | stance=%s | Info=[%s]',
            record and math.floor((clock()-record.at)*1000)or 0,message,stance and tostring(stance.Value)or'?',table.concat(names,',')))
    end
    local function ruptureInterrupted(character,info)
        local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or humanoid.PlatformStand then return true end
        for _,name in {'Dead','Ragdoll','TrueRagdoll','CompleteRagdoll','Knockback','TrueStun','DomainClash'}do
            if active(character:GetAttribute(name))or info:FindFirstChild(name)then return true end
        end
        local stun=info:FindFirstChild('Stun')
        return active(character:GetAttribute('Stun'))or stun~=nil and stun:IsA('BoolValue')and stun.Value==true
    end
    function control.endRuptureVariant(reason)
        local record=control.ruptureVariantRecord
        control.ruptureVariantRecord=nil
        control.ruptureVariantReason=reason
        if record then rlog(record,'ended: '..tostring(reason)..(if record.pressed then ' (Special was pressed)' else ' (Special never pressed)'))end
        if record and record.holding then
            local bindings=menu.bindings
            -- Releases only the edge this feature pressed; a Special key you
            -- are physically holding stays held.
            if bindings and type(bindings.sendNativeSpecial)=='function'then callNative(bindings.sendNativeSpecial,false)end
        end
    end
    function control.beginRuptureVariant(tool)
        local settings=control.ruptureVariant
        local feature=control.features['Perfect Rupture']
        if not settings.enabled or control.ruptureVariantRecord or not control.alive or not control.focused or paused()
            or menu.recording or input:GetFocusedTextBox()or tool~=toolFor(feature)then return end
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        if not stance or not stance:IsA('StringValue')or stance.Value~='ISOH'or ruptureInterrupted(character,info)then
            rlog({at=clock()},'not armed: stance is not ISOH or the character is interrupted')
            return
        end
        local record={character=character,tool=tool,at=clock(),mode=settings.mode}
        rlog(record,'armed on Rupture activation ('..settings.mode..')')
        if settings.mode=='Hold Special'then
            -- Special is pressed later, once the cast is live (see the step).
            -- Pressing it at activation only switches weapons.
            if not nativeSpecialReady()then
                -- No Special action: use the Rupture second use (double tap) instead.
                if not control.specialFallback then return end
                record.mode='Use twice'
                rlog(record,'Special unavailable; using the native second use instead')
                if feature.enabled then return end
            end
        elseif feature.enabled then return end
        control.ruptureVariantRecord=record
        feature.lastReason='Rupture variant started ('..settings.mode..')'
    end
    function control.stepRuptureVariant()
        local record=control.ruptureVariantRecord
        if not record then return end
        local settings=control.ruptureVariant
        local character=player.Character
        local info=character and character:FindFirstChild('Info')
        local now=clock()
        if not settings.enabled or character~=record.character or not info or not control.focused or paused()then
            control.endRuptureVariant('Disabled, paused or character changed');return
        end
        local stance=info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        if not stance or stance.Value~='ISOH'or ruptureInterrupted(character,info)
            or now-record.at>(if record.mode=='Hold Special'then 8 else 6)then
            control.endRuptureVariant('Interrupted or timed out');return
        end
        local skill=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        local check=info:FindFirstChild('RuptureCheck')
        if skill then record.sawSkill,record.lastSkillAt=true,now end
        if skill and not record.loggedSkill then record.loggedSkill=true;record.skillSeenAt=now;rlog(record,'InSkill appeared')end
        if check and not record.loggedCheck then record.loggedCheck=true;rlog(record,'RuptureCheck appeared')end
        if check then record.sawCheck,record.lastCheckAt=true,now;record.checkSeenAt=record.checkSeenAt or now end
        if record.mode=='Hold Special'then
            if not record.pressed then
                -- Wait for the native Rupture window (RuptureCheck), then apply
                -- the delay. On a short branch with no window, press once the
                -- skill has been running for 0.6 s.
                -- Observed in game: InSkill appears 50-70 ms after the press, which
                -- is when the cast is registered. Pressing Special before that
                -- only swaps weapons, so hold from that moment (plus the delay).
                -- If the cast never registers, do not press at all.
                if not record.skillSeenAt then
                    if now-record.at>1 then control.endRuptureVariant('Rupture cast did not register (no InSkill)')end
                    return
                end
                if now-record.skillSeenAt<settings.holdDelayMs/1000 then return end
                local bindings=menu.bindings
                local ok,result=false,nil
                if nativeSpecialReady()then ok,result=callNative(bindings.sendNativeSpecial,true)end
                if not ok then
                    if not control.specialFallback then control.endRuptureVariant('Native Special unavailable');return end
                    -- Special cannot be sent: switch to the native second use (double tap).
                    record.mode='Use twice'
                    rlog(record,'Special unavailable; using the native second use instead')
                    if control.features['Perfect Rupture'].enabled then control.endRuptureVariant('Special unavailable; Perfect Rupture owns the second use')end
                    return
                end
                record.pressed,record.pressedAt,record.holding=true,now,result==true
                rlog(record,'pressed and holding Special (provider-owned='..tostring(result==true)..')')
                return
            end
            local checkDone=record.sawCheck and not check and now-(record.lastCheckAt or now)>=.1
            local skillDone=record.sawSkill and not skill and now-(record.lastSkillAt or now)>=.2
            if now-record.pressedAt>=.25 and(checkDone or skillDone)then control.endRuptureVariant('Rupture variant finished')end
            return
        end
        if record.sent then
            if now-record.sentAt>1.5 or not check and now-(record.lastCheckAt or now)>.2 then control.endRuptureVariant('Second use submitted')end
            return
        end
        if not check or not check:IsA('BoolValue')or check.Value~=false then return end
        record.checkSeenAt=record.checkSeenAt or now
        if now-record.checkSeenAt<settings.delayMs/1000 then return end
        local native=control.native
        if not native or type(native.UseTool)~='function'then control.endRuptureVariant('Native tool unavailable');return end
        record.sent,record.sentAt=true,now
        local dispatching={feature=control.features['Perfect Rupture'],thread=coroutine.running(),tool=record.tool,dispatched=false}
        control.dispatching=dispatching
        callNative(native.UseTool,native,record.tool,'Activated')
        if control.dispatching==dispatching then control.dispatching=nil end
    end
    function control.setRuptureVariantEnabled(value)
        control.ruptureVariant.enabled=value==true
        if not control.ruptureVariant.enabled then control.endRuptureVariant('Disabled')end
        return true
    end
    function control.setRuptureVariantMode(value)
        if value~='Hold Special'and value~='Use twice'then return false end
        control.endRuptureVariant('Mode changed');control.ruptureVariant.mode=value;return true
    end
    function control.setRuptureVariantDelayMs(value)
        if not finite(value)then return false end
        control.ruptureVariant.delayMs=math.clamp(value,0,600);return true
    end
    function control.setRuptureHoldDelayMs(value)
        if not finite(value)then return false end
        control.ruptureVariant.holdDelayMs=math.clamp(value,0,600);return true
    end
    function control.onFailsafePause()control.endRuptureVariant('Paused by Failsafe');cancelAll('Paused by Failsafe')end
    function control.onFailsafeResume()bindCharacter(player.Character)end
    function control.step()
        if not control.alive then return end
        if control.character~=player.Character then bindCharacter(player.Character)end
        pcall(control.stepRuptureVariant)
        for _,feature in control.features do
            local record=feature.pending
            local maximum=if record and record.track and record.track.IsPlaying then 30 else 6
            if record and (not permitted(feature,record)or clock()-record.at>maximum)then cancel(feature,'Cast interrupted or native cue expired')end
            if record and feature.pending==record and feature.name=='Perfect Rupture'then stepRupture(feature,record)end
            if record and feature.pending==record and feature.name=='Auto Whiplash'then stepWhiplash(feature,record)end
            if record and feature.pending==record and feature.name=='Auto Flourish ISOH'then continueFlourishISOH(feature,record)end
            local followup=feature.followup
            if followup and feature.name=='Auto Whiplash'then
                local target=followup.target;local humanoid=target and target.Parent and target:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                local excluded=menu.isCombatExcluded or menu.isExcluded
                if not permitted(feature,followup)or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 or target:GetAttribute('Dead')==true
                    or target:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')~=followup.sourceCast.targetRoot or excluded and excluded(target)then
                    finishFollowup(feature,'Confirmed Whiplash follow-up was interrupted');followup=nil
                end
            end
            if followup then
                local followupMaximum=if followup.keepAim and followup.track and followup.track.IsPlaying then 30 else 3
                if followup.character~=player.Character or clock()-followup.at>followupMaximum
                    or followup.keepAim and (not followup.track or not followup.track.IsPlaying)then
                    finishFollowup(feature,'Native follow-up observation ended')
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function control.createControls(tab)
        local aim=aimControl()
        local shared=aim and aim.relatedNames or {'Toji Aim Targets','Toji Aim Range (studs)','Toji Aim Height Y (studs)','Toji Aim FOV Radius (px)','Toji Aim Actor Types'}
        local function add(config,skill,kind)
            local related=table.clone(shared);table.insert(related,skill..' Aim Assist');table.insert(related,config.Name)
            local adjustment=if skill=='Whiplash'then 'Whiplash Timing Adjustment (ms)'elseif skill=='Rupture'then 'Rupture Timing Adjustment (ms)'else nil
            if adjustment and adjustment~=config.Name then table.insert(related,adjustment)end
            config.PortRelatedNames=related;config.JujutsuerPortTab='Automatic';config.JujutsuerPortGroup='Toji'
            tab[kind or 'CreateToggle'](tab,config)
        end
        add({Name='Perfect Rupture',Description='Use the native Stab contact and its exact Rupture check, then request one second use at a phase calibrated from three accepted dummy follow-ups. Short/no-Stab branches wait for a verified native perfect cue. Skips late or interrupted checks; the server’s exact perfect window is not exposed.',Default=false,Callback=control.setPerfectRuptureEnabled},'Rupture')
        add({Name='Auto Flourish',Description='Reactivate your owned Split Soul Katana Flourish at its native animation Continue marker. Follows actual animation speed; does not start the first skill for you.',Default=false,Callback=control.setAutoFlourishEnabled},'Flourish')
        add({Name='Auto Flourish ISOH',Description='During your manually started SSK Flourish, request Special once after an exact native first Hit on the same live cast. Uses your native Special action; does not switch weapons before the first skill. Variant acceptance still needs native confirmation.',Default=false,Callback=control.setAutoFlourishISOHEnabled},'Flourish')
        add({Name='Auto Whiplash',Description='After your manual Chain Whiplash hits, use its native second-use window once the same ragdolled enemy is 15–25 studs away. Waits inside the game’s real window; never starts the first skill or changes target.',Default=false,Callback=control.setAutoWhiplashEnabled},'Whiplash')
        add({Name='Auto Transcend',Description='After your manual ISOH Transcend, request one second use at the actual native animation Await marker while the same InSkill window is live. Uses native animation speed and pauses; server continuation acceptance remains unverified.',Default=false,Callback=control.setAutoTranscendEnabled},'Transcend')
        add({Name='Special Cooldown Counts As Unavailable',Description='While your Special (M2) is on cooldown, Rupture Hold Special and Auto Flourish ISOH use the double press (second use) of their move instead, the same as when Special is unavailable. Needs Special Fallback To Double Press on.',Default=true,Callback=control.setSpecialCooldownCheck},'Rupture')
        add({Name='Special Fallback To Double Press',Description='When Special is unavailable or the game does not accept it, Toji Special variants (Rupture Hold Special and Auto Flourish ISOH) use the double press (second use) of the move instead. Off keeps the old behaviour: the variant just stops.',Default=true,Callback=control.setSpecialFallback},'Rupture')
        add({Name='Auto Rupture Variant',Description='ISOH stance only. After your manual Rupture, runs the selected variant: Hold Special keeps your native Special action held until the Rupture finishes (or you are interrupted); Use twice makes the second use once the native Rupture window has been open for the set delay. Never starts Rupture for you. If Perfect Rupture is on, it owns the second use.',Default=false,Callback=control.setRuptureVariantEnabled},'Rupture')
        if type(tab.CreateDropdown)=='function'then
            add({Name='Rupture Variant',Description='Hold Special: hold your native Special action through the whole Rupture. Use twice: make the second Rupture use automatically.',Options={'Hold Special','Use twice'},Default='Hold Special',Callback=control.setRuptureVariantMode},'Rupture','CreateDropdown')
        end
        if type(tab.CreateSlider)=='function'then
            add({Name='Rupture Hold Special Delay (ms)',Description='How long after the game registers your Rupture cast (about 50 ms after the press) before Special is pressed and held. 0 holds Special as early as is safe; raise it if Special lands too early. Only for the Hold Special variant.',Min=0,Max=600,Step=1,Precision=0,Default=control.ruptureVariant.holdDelayMs,Callback=control.setRuptureHoldDelayMs},'Rupture','CreateSlider')
            add({Name='Rupture Use-Twice Delay (ms)',Description='How long the native Rupture window must be open before the automatic second use. Only for the Use twice variant.',Min=0,Max=600,Step=1,Precision=0,Default=control.ruptureVariant.delayMs,Callback=control.setRuptureVariantDelayMs},'Rupture','CreateSlider')
            add({Name='Rupture Timing Adjustment (ms)',Description='Signed shift from the observed Stab-contact +280 ms calibration. Default -15 requests 15 ms earlier. Clamped to +245–320 ms after the exact Stab; no timing is guessed for the short/no-Stab branch. Changes apply to your next manual cast.',Min=-35,Max=40,Step=.1,Precision=1,Default=control.features['Perfect Rupture'].timingAdjustmentMs,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=control.setRuptureTimingAdjustmentMs},'Rupture','CreateSlider')
            add({Name='Whiplash Timing Adjustment (ms)',Description='Wait inside the exact native Whiplash window after the same ragdolled victim reaches 15–25 studs. Default +30 adds 30 ms. Negative values clamp to the earliest valid native phase; range, victim and window are rechecked throughout. Changes apply to your next manual cast.',Min=-30,Max=150,Step=.1,Precision=1,Default=control.features['Auto Whiplash'].timingAdjustmentMs,QuickSettingsOnly=true,Callback=control.setWhiplashTimingAdjustmentMs},'Whiplash','CreateSlider')
        end
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.endRuptureVariant('Unloaded');cancelAll('Unloaded');control.alive=false
        for _,feature in control.features do local hook=feature.hook;if hook then hook.active=false;if hook.signal.Fire==hook.wrapper then hook.signal.Fire=hook.original end end end
        local special=control.specialHook;if special then special.active=false;if special.signal.Fire==special.wrapper then special.signal.Fire=special.original end end
        disconnect(control.connections);disconnect(control.characterConnections)
    end
    control.refreshNative();bindCharacter(player.Character)
    connect(run.Heartbeat,control.step)
    connect(player.CharacterAdded,bindCharacter)
    connect(player.CharacterRemoving,function()bindCharacter(nil)end)
    connect(input.WindowFocusReleased,function()control.focused=false;cancelAll('Window focus lost')end)
    connect(input.WindowFocused,function()control.focused=true end)
    connect(replicated.DescendantAdded,function(object)
        if object.Name=='RuptureService'or object.Name=='FlourishService'or object.Name=='TranscendService'or object.Name=='TojiService'or object.Name=='ToolController'then control.refreshNative()end
    end)
    return control
end
return NativeTojiTimings
end)()

local FrontDashReadiness = (function(): any
-- Observe the native front- and side-dash resources. This module never submits a dash,
-- changes a cooldown, or removes a character state.
local FrontDashReadiness={}

function FrontDashReadiness.new(host: any,menu: any): any
    local player=host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
    local world=host.workspace
    local control: {[string]: any}={alive=true,connections={},characterConnections={},infoConnections={},markers={}}
    local shared=host._G or {}
    local cache=shared.__ShenaniganismFrontDashReadinessProfiles
    if type(cache)~='table' or cache.version~=1 or type(cache.profiles)~='table' then
        cache={version=1,profiles={}}
        shared.__ShenaniganismFrontDashReadinessProfiles=cache
    end
    control.profiles=cache.profiles
    local resources=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local markerResources=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})
    local advertisedChains={}
    local resourceIn
    local function finite(value)
        return type(value)=='number' and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge
    end
    local function now()
        local ok,value=pcall(world.GetServerTimeNow,world)
        return if ok and finite(value) then value else nil
    end
    local function disconnect(connections)
        for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
    local function connect(connections,signal,callback)
        if signal then table.insert(connections,signal:Connect(callback)) end
    end
    local function signature(model,info)
        local custom=model:FindFirstChild('CustomChar')
        local customChase=custom and custom:GetAttribute('CustomChase')
        local item=info and info:FindFirstChild('Item')
        local itemDash=item and item:FindFirstChild('Dash')
        local stance=info and info:FindFirstChild('Stance')
        local stanceValue=stance and (stance:IsA('StringValue') or stance:IsA('NumberValue')) and stance.Value
        local route=if itemDash then 'Item' elseif customChase then 'Custom' else 'Chase'
        local function part(value)return (tostring(value or ''):gsub('|','/')) end
        local kit=model:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        local modelStance,infoStance=model:GetAttribute('Stance'),info and info:GetAttribute('Stance')
        local key=table.concat({part(kit),part(model:GetAttribute('InUlt')),
            part(info and info:GetAttribute('InUlt')),part(info and info:FindFirstChild('InUlt')~=nil),
            part(modelStance),part(infoStance),part(stanceValue),route,part(customChase),
            part(item and (item:GetAttribute('Item') or item:GetAttribute('Tag') or item.Name)),part(itemDash and itemDash:GetAttribute('Tag'))},'|')
        local function tojiWeapon(value)
            return value==nil or value=='' or value=='Toji' or value=='ISOH' or value=='COATM' or value=='SSK'
        end
        -- A surviving native DisableChase instance is still the same recovery
        -- when Toji swaps weapons. Its duration profile remains weapon-specific.
        local continuity=if kit=='Toji' and route=='Chase' and tojiWeapon(modelStance) and tojiWeapon(infoStance) and tojiWeapon(stanceValue)
            then table.concat({part(kit),part(model:GetAttribute('InUlt')),part(info and info:GetAttribute('InUlt')),
                part(info and info:FindFirstChild('InUlt')~=nil),'Toji weapons'},'|') else key
        return key,route,customChase,item,continuity
    end
    local function remember(key,duration)
        if not finite(duration) or duration<=0 or duration>1800 then return end
        local profile=control.profiles[key]
        control.profiles[key]={duration=duration,samples=if type(profile)=='table' and finite(profile.samples) then profile.samples+1 else 1}
        -- A reload preserves measurements, never character or executor objects.
        local count=0
        for _ in control.profiles do count+=1 end
        if count>64 then
            for other in control.profiles do if other~=key then control.profiles[other]=nil;break end end
        end
    end
    local function resourceDuration(object)
        if not object then return nil end
        local lastUse,readyAt=object:GetAttribute('LastUse'),object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt')
        local duration=if finite(lastUse) and finite(readyAt) and readyAt>lastUse then readyAt-lastUse else object.Value
        return if finite(duration) and duration>0 and duration<=1800 then duration else nil
    end
    local function watchMarker(marker,fullStart)
        if marker.Name~='DisableChase' or control.markers[marker] then return end
        local key,route,customChase,item,continuity=signature(control.character,control.info)
        local names=if route=='Custom' and type(customChase)=='string' then {customChase,'Chase','Dash'} else {'Chase','Dash'}
        local object=resourceIn(if route=='Item' then item else control.character:FindFirstChild('Moveset'),names)
        local profile=control.profiles[key]
        local duration=resourceDuration(object) or (type(profile)=='table' and profile.duration)
        local previous=object and markerResources[object]
        local fingerprint=object and {lastUse=object:GetAttribute('LastUse'),readyAt=object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt'),skipTo=object:GetAttribute('SkipTo')}
        local stale=fullStart and previous and fingerprint and previous.lastUse==fingerprint.lastUse
            and previous.readyAt==fingerprint.readyAt and previous.skipTo==fingerprint.skipTo
        if object and fullStart then markerResources[object]=fingerprint end
        control.markers[marker]={key=key,continuity=continuity,continuous=true,learnable=fullStart,
            started=if fullStart then now() else nil,
            -- Display chronology belongs to this actual marker instance. A
            -- weapon/resource swap cannot restart or erase the same recovery.
            displayDuration=if finite(duration) and duration>0 and duration<=1800 then duration else nil,
            staleResource=if stale then object else nil,staleFingerprint=if stale then fingerprint else nil}
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        if fullStart and dash and type(dash.noteFrontDashStarted)=='function' then
            pcall(dash.noteFrontDashStarted,control.character)
        end
    end
    local function removedMarker(marker)
        local record=control.markers[marker]
        if not record then return end
        control.markers[marker]=nil
        if record.started and record.learnable and control.character==player.Character and control.info and control.info.Parent==control.character then
            local key=signature(control.character,control.info)
            local ended=now()
            if key==record.key and ended then remember(key,ended-record.started) end
        end
    end
    local function refreshSignature(key,continuity)
        if key==nil and control.character and control.info then
            local nextKey,_,_,_,nextContinuity=signature(control.character,control.info)
            key,continuity=nextKey,nextContinuity
        end
        if key==control.signature then return end
        control.signature=key
        -- Keep exact observed chronology, but never teach a lifetime spanning
        -- weapon/form/route changes. Incompatible route changes also discard
        -- numeric continuity; returning later cannot revive a mixed estimate.
        for _,record in control.markers do
            record.learnable=false
            if record.continuity~=continuity then record.continuous=false end
        end
    end
    local function bindInfo(info)
        disconnect(control.infoConnections)
        table.clear(control.markers)
        control.info=info
        refreshSignature()
        if not info then return end
        local function watchStateChild(child)
            if child.Name=='Stance' and (child:IsA('StringValue') or child:IsA('NumberValue')) then
                connect(control.infoConnections,child:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Value'),refreshSignature)
            end
        end
        -- A marker already present at attachment has an unknown start time.
        for _,marker in info:GetChildren() do watchStateChild(marker);watchMarker(marker,false) end
        connect(control.infoConnections,info.ChildAdded,function(marker)watchStateChild(marker);refreshSignature();watchMarker(marker,true)end)
        connect(control.infoConnections,info.ChildRemoved,function(marker)removedMarker(marker);refreshSignature()end)
        for _,attribute in {'InUlt','Stance'} do
            connect(control.infoConnections,info:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute),refreshSignature)
        end
    end
    local function bindCharacter(model)
        if control.character==model then return end
        disconnect(control.characterConnections)
        control.character=model
        bindInfo(model and model:FindFirstChild('Info'))
        if not model then return end
        connect(control.characterConnections,model.ChildAdded,function(child)
            if child.Name=='Info' then bindInfo(child) end
        end)
        connect(control.characterConnections,model.ChildRemoved,function(child)
            if child==control.info then bindInfo(nil) end
        end)
        for _,attribute in {'Moveset','InUlt','Stance'} do
            connect(control.characterConnections,model:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute),refreshSignature)
        end
    end
    local function nativeState()
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        if not dash or type(dash.readNativeState)~='function' then return nil end
        local ok,state=pcall(dash.readNativeState)
        return if ok and type(state)=='table' and finite(state.wallNow) and finite(state.lastNativeAt) then state else nil
    end
    resourceIn=function(parent,names)
        if not parent then return nil end
        for _,name in names do
            local object=parent:FindFirstChild(name)
            if object and object:IsA('NumberValue') and finite(object.Value) and object.Value>=0
                and (finite(object:GetAttribute('LastUse')) or finite(object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt')) or finite(object:GetAttribute('SkipTo'))) then return object end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function resourceStatus(object,serverNow)
        local lastUse=object:GetAttribute('LastUse')
        local readyAt=object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt')
        local skipTo=object:GetAttribute('SkipTo')
        lastUse=if finite(lastUse) then lastUse else nil
        readyAt=if finite(readyAt) then readyAt else nil
        skipTo=if finite(skipTo) then skipTo else nil
        local deadline=skipTo or readyAt or (lastUse and lastUse+object.Value)
        if not deadline then return nil end
        local maximum=if readyAt and lastUse and readyAt>lastUse then readyAt-lastUse else object.Value
        local remaining=math.max(deadline-serverNow,0)
        local record=resources[object]
        if not record or record.lastUse~=lastUse then
            record={lastUse=lastUse};resources[object]=record
        end
        local paused=object:GetAttribute('Paused')==true
        if paused then
            record.pausedRemaining=record.pausedRemaining or remaining
            remaining=record.pausedRemaining
        else record.pausedRemaining=nil;record.pausedFraction=nil end
        local ready=remaining<=0 and not paused
        local fraction=if ready then 1 elseif maximum>0 then math.min(math.clamp(1-remaining/maximum,0,1),.999) else 0
        if paused then record.pausedFraction=record.pausedFraction or fraction;fraction=record.pausedFraction end
        return {fraction=fraction,
            remaining=remaining,maximum=maximum,ready=ready,name=object:GetAttribute('Tag') or object.Name,
            source='Native cooldown resource',resource=object,paused=paused}
    end
    local function markerDisplay(status,marker,key,object,serverNow)
        local record=marker and control.markers[marker]
        if not record then return end
        status.displayRecharging=true
        local duration=record.displayDuration
        local lastUse=object and object:GetAttribute('LastUse')
        local deadline=object and (object:GetAttribute('SkipTo') or object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt'))
        local resourceStart=if finite(lastUse) then lastUse
            elseif finite(deadline) and resourceDuration(object) then deadline-resourceDuration(object) else nil
        local old=record.staleFingerprint
        local stale=object==record.staleResource and old and old.lastUse==lastUse
            and old.readyAt==object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt') and old.skipTo==object:GetAttribute('SkipTo')
        -- A stale previous-cast resource must not pin a fresh marker's bar at
        -- 99.9%. Only timestamps belonging to this recovery can own its fill.
        local currentResource=object and not stale and key==record.key and finite(resourceStart)
            and (not record.started or resourceStart>=record.started-.5)
        if currentResource then
            markerResources[object]={lastUse=lastUse,readyAt=object:GetAttribute('ReadyAt'),skipTo=object:GetAttribute('SkipTo')}
            local nativeDuration=resourceDuration(object)
            if nativeDuration then record.displayDuration=nativeDuration end
            status.displayFraction,status.displayRemaining,status.displayMaximum=status.fraction,status.remaining,status.maximum
            status.displayPaused=status.paused==true
            status.displayIndeterminate=status.paused~=true and status.remaining<=0
            return
        end
        if not duration and key==record.key then
            duration=resourceDuration(object)
            if duration then record.displayDuration=duration end
        end
        local elapsed=record.started and math.max(serverNow-record.started,0)
        status.displayFraction=if duration and elapsed then math.min(math.clamp(elapsed/duration,0,1),.999) else 0
        status.displayRemaining=if duration and elapsed then math.max(duration-elapsed,0) else nil
        status.displayMaximum=duration
        status.displayPaused=false
        status.displayIndeterminate=not duration or not elapsed or elapsed>=duration
        status.displayEstimated=true
    end
    local function advertisedChase(model)
        local kit=model:GetAttribute('Moveset')
        if type(kit)~='string' or kit=='' then return false end
        local replicated=host.game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
        local cached=advertisedChains[kit]
        if cached and cached.replicated==replicated then
            local parent=replicated
            local valid=true
            for _,entry in cached.path do
                if entry.object.Parent~=parent or entry.object.Name~=entry.name then valid=false;break end
                parent=entry.object
            end
            if valid then return true end
        end
        advertisedChains[kit]=nil
        local knit=replicated and replicated:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local module=knit and knit:FindFirstChild('Knit')
        local services=module and module:FindFirstChild('Services')
        local service=services and services:FindFirstChild(kit..'Service')
        local remotes=service and service:FindFirstChild('RE')
        local chase=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('Chase')
        if not chase then return false end
        -- Cache only positive exact-instance paths. Parent/name checks catch
        -- replacement immediately; missing paths remain live for late arrival.
        advertisedChains[kit]={replicated=replicated,path={
            {object=knit,name='Knit'},{object=module,name='Knit'},{object=services,name='Services'},
            {object=service,name=kit..'Service'},{object=remotes,name='RE'},{object=chase,name='Chase'}}}
        return true
    end
    local function chargeStatus(state,domain)
        if not state or not state.profile or not finite(state.charges) or state.charges<0 or state.charges>2 or state.charges%1~=0 then return nil end
        local gate=if domain then state.domainGate else state.shortGate
        local refill=if domain then state.domainRefill else state.refill
        if not finite(gate) or not finite(refill) or gate<=0 or refill<=0 then return nil end
        local elapsed=math.max(state.wallNow-state.lastNativeAt,0)
        local charges=if elapsed>refill then 2 else state.charges
        local maximum=if charges>0 then gate else refill
        local remaining=math.max(maximum-elapsed,0)
        local ready=remaining<=0 and charges>0
        return {fraction=if ready then 1 else math.min(math.clamp(1-remaining/maximum,0,1),.999),remaining=remaining,
            maximum=maximum,ready=ready,name='Front Dash',source=state.profile,charges=charges}
    end
    local function blocked(model,info)
        for _,name in {'NoDash','Stun','Block','Knockback','TrueStun'} do
            if info:FindFirstChild(name) then return true,name end
        end
        local ragdoll=model:GetAttribute('Ragdoll')
        if ragdoll==true or finite(ragdoll) and ragdoll>0 then return true,'Ragdoll' end
        local inSkill=info:FindFirstChild('InSkill')
        if inSkill and inSkill.Value==false and not info:FindFirstChild('AllowDashInSkill') then return true,'InSkill' end
        return false,nil
    end
    function control.getStatus(model,serverNow)
        if not control.alive or not model or model~=player.Character or not model.Parent then return nil end
        bindCharacter(model)
        local info=control.info
        if not info then return nil end
        serverNow=if finite(serverNow) then serverNow else now()
        if not serverNow then return nil end
        local key,route,customChase,item,continuity=signature(model,info)
        refreshSignature(key,continuity)
        local moveset=model:FindFirstChild('Moveset')
        local names=if route=='Custom' and type(customChase)=='string' then {customChase,'Chase','Dash'} else {'Chase','Dash'}
        local object=resourceIn(if route=='Item' then item else moveset,names)
        local status=object and resourceStatus(object,serverNow)
        if not status then
            local domain=info:FindFirstChild('DomainClash')~=nil
            if domain or model:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Naoya' then status=chargeStatus(nativeState(),domain)
            elseif (route~='Chase' or not advertisedChase(model)) and not info:FindFirstChild('DisableChase') then return nil
            else
                local marker=info:FindFirstChild('DisableChase')
                local record=marker and control.markers[marker]
                local sameRecovery=record and record.continuous and record.continuity==continuity
                local profile=control.profiles[if sameRecovery then record.key else key]
                local maximum=if type(profile)=='table' and finite(profile.duration) and profile.duration>0 then profile.duration else nil
                local elapsed=if sameRecovery and record.started then math.max(serverNow-record.started,0) else nil
                local progressKnown=marker==nil or maximum~=nil and elapsed~=nil
                status={fraction=if marker then (if maximum and elapsed then math.min(elapsed/maximum,.999) else 0) else 1,
                    remaining=if marker then (if maximum and elapsed then math.max(maximum-elapsed,0) else nil) else 0,
                    maximum=maximum,ready=marker==nil,name='Front Dash',source='Info.DisableChase',
                    estimated=marker~=nil and progressKnown,indeterminate=not progressKnown}
                -- The shared native request timestamp also changes on side
                -- dashes. It is not the ordinary Chase resource: only this
                -- character's DisableChase lifetime drives its front bar.
            end
        end
        if not status then return nil end
        if status.ready and info:FindFirstChild('DisableChase') and route=='Chase'
            and model:GetAttribute('Moveset')~='Naoya' and not info:FindFirstChild('DomainClash') then
            status.ready=false;status.fraction=math.min(status.fraction,.999)
        end
        markerDisplay(status,info:FindFirstChild('DisableChase'),key,object,serverNow)
        status.blocked,status.reason=blocked(model,info)
        return status
    end
    function control.getSideStatus(model,_serverNow)
        if not control.alive or not model or model~=player.Character or not model.Parent then return nil end
        bindCharacter(model)
        local info=control.info
        if not info then return nil end
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        local state=nativeState()
        -- A live native timestamp reader is required. The configured interval
        -- has its own validated owner status and does not depend on optional
        -- charge-layout metadata, which ordinary dash routes may not expose.
        if not dash or dash.alive==false or not state then return nil end
        local status
        local configured=if type(menu.getFailsafeRequested)=='function'then menu.getFailsafeRequested(dash,'enabled')==true else dash.enabled==true
        local setting=menu.entries and menu.entries['Main/Modify Dash Cooldown']
        if setting and setting.widget and type(setting.widget.Get)=='function'then
            local okay,value=pcall(setting.widget.Get)
            if okay and type(value)=='boolean'then configured=value end
        end
        if configured then
            if type(dash.getIntervalStatus)=='function' then
                local ok,interval=pcall(dash.getIntervalStatus)
                if not ok or type(interval)~='table' or not finite(interval.maximum) or interval.maximum<0
                    or not finite(interval.remaining) or interval.remaining<0 or not finite(interval.fraction) then return nil end
                -- The owner applies signed adjustments and its own monotonic
                -- deadline. Reading raw base seconds would mis-scale the fill.
                status={fraction=math.clamp(interval.fraction,0,1),remaining=interval.remaining,maximum=interval.maximum,
                    ready=interval.remaining<=0,name='Side Dash',source='Configured client dash interval',
                    base=interval.base,adjustment=interval.adjustment,effective=interval.maximum}
            else
                local maximum=dash.seconds
                local deadline=dash.nextAllowedAt
                local clock=if host.os and type(host.os.clock)=='function' then host.os.clock else host.tick
                if not finite(maximum) or maximum<0 or type(clock)~='function' or deadline~=nil and not finite(deadline) then return nil end
                local timed,localNow=pcall(clock)
                if not timed or not finite(localNow) then return nil end
                -- Compatibility with controllers before the interval API.
                -- This deadline belongs to os.clock, not the server clock.
                local remaining=if deadline then math.max(deadline-localNow,0) else 0
                status={fraction=if maximum>0 then math.clamp(1-remaining/maximum,0,1) else 1,
                    remaining=remaining,maximum=maximum,ready=remaining<=0,name='Side Dash',
                    source='Configured client dash interval'}
            end
        else
            if type(state.profile)~='string' or state.profile=='' then return nil end
            local domain=info:FindFirstChild('DomainClash')~=nil
            if domain or model:GetAttribute('Moveset')=='Naoya' then
                status=chargeStatus(state,domain)
                if status then status.name='Side Dash' end
            else
                local maximum=state.refill
                if not finite(maximum) or maximum<=0 then return nil end
                local elapsed=math.max(state.wallNow-state.lastNativeAt,0)
                local remaining=math.max(maximum-elapsed,0)
                status={fraction=math.clamp(1-remaining/maximum,0,1),remaining=remaining,maximum=maximum,
                    ready=remaining<=0,name='Side Dash',source=state.profile}
            end
        end
        if not status then return nil end
        status.blocked,status.reason=blocked(model,info)
        return status
    end
    function control.clear()
        bindCharacter(nil)
        table.clear(resources)
        table.clear(markerResources)
        table.clear(advertisedChains)
    end
    function control.Destroy()
        if not control.alive then return end
        control.alive=false
        control.clear();disconnect(control.connections)
    end
    connect(control.connections,player.CharacterAdded,function(model)bindCharacter(model)end)
    connect(control.connections,player.CharacterRemoving,function(model)if control.character==model then bindCharacter(nil) end end)
    bindCharacter(player.Character)
    return control
end
return FrontDashReadiness
end)()

local DashPreferenceSync = (function(): any
-- Reconcile only passive dash configuration. This never requests movement.
local DashPreferenceSync={}
function DashPreferenceSync.new(menu: any): any
    local control: any={alive=true,repairs=0,lastError=nil}
    local definitions={
        {'Main/Modify Dash Cooldown','dashControl','enabled','setEnabled'},
        {'Main/Assist Guided Dashes','frontDash','assistGuidedEnabled','setAssistGuidedEnabled'},
    }
    function control.sync(): boolean
        if not control.alive or menu.alive==false then return false end
        for _,definition in definitions do
            local entry=menu.entries and menu.entries[definition[1]]
            local owner=menu[definition[2]]
            if not entry or not entry.widget or type(entry.widget.Get)~='function'
                or not owner or owner.alive==false or owner.pendingNative==true
                or type(owner[definition[4]])~='function'then continue end
            local requested=entry.widget.Get()
            if type(requested)~='boolean'then continue end
            local current=if type(menu.getFailsafeRequested)=='function'then menu.getFailsafeRequested(owner,definition[3])else owner[definition[3]]
            if current~=requested then
                local okay,result=pcall(owner[definition[4]],requested)
                if not okay or result==false then control.lastError=tostring(result);return false end
                control.repairs+=1
            end
        end
        control.lastError=nil
        return true
    end
    function control.Destroy()control.alive=false end
    return control
end
return DashPreferenceSync
end)()

-- debug.info supplies function metadata, not an executing thread's globals.
-- Keep the required environment lookup behind this explicit compatibility API.
local environmentOf = getfenv
local host = environmentOf(0)
local shared = host._G or host
local buildId = '2026-11-05-shenaniganism-native-v54-block-pass-cache-r120'
local displayVersion = '42.69491b-r120'
local player = host.game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
assert(player, 'Shenaniganism is waiting for LocalPlayer')
local savedLive
local savedHitMarks,savedHitCharacter={},player.Character
local previous = shared.__ShenaniganismMenu or shared.__CullingMenuEnhancements
if not shared.__ShenaniganismRestoreOriginalPreset and previous and previous.nativeStandalone and previous.nativeStartupComplete and previous.ui and previous.ui.ready and previous.configStore and previous.configStore.ready and not previous.configStore.blocked then
    local ok,value=pcall(previous.configStore.snapshot)
    if ok and type(value)=='table' then
        savedLive=value
        for model,at in previous.visuals and previous.visuals.hitOutlineTimes or {}do savedHitMarks[model]=at end
    end
end
-- A partially initialized old window is not a settings source. Its defaults
-- must never replace the complete on-disk preferences during a lobby reload.
if previous then
    if not savedLive and previous.configStore then previous.configStore.blocked=true end
    previous.reinjecting=true
    local ok,message=pcall(previous.Destroy)
    if not ok then host.warn('[Shenaniganism] prior runtime cleanup: '..tostring(message)) end
end
-- Retire the old root rather than hiding it beneath another window.
for _,container in {player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui'),host.game:GetService('CoreGui')} do
    if container then
        for _,root in container:GetChildren() do
            if root:IsA('ScreenGui') and (root.Name=='Cullinghub' or root.Name=='ShenaniganismMenuLauncher' or root.Name=='Shenaniganism' and root:GetAttribute('ShenaniganismOwned')==true) then root:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end
-- The old window's "S" icon lives in the top bar; remove any copy left from an earlier load.
do
    local playerGui=player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui')
    for _,object in (playerGui and playerGui:GetDescendants()) or {} do
        if object.Name=='ShenaniganismLauncher' then object:Destroy() end
    end
end
local environment=setmetatable({}, {__index=host})
environment._G=shared

    if not perPlayer[name] then perPlayer[name]={} end
    return perPlayer[name]
end

local manager=NativeFeatureHost.new(host,environment,NativeFactories,{
    buildId=buildId,blackflashProfiles=BlackflashProfiles,knownBindings=knownBindings,targetMethods=TargetMethods,actionOverlap=ActionOverlap,failsafe=Failsafe,friendExclusions=FriendExclusions,targetFilters=TargetFilters,stunControls=StunControls,selfHUD=SelfHUD,targetJumpDash=TargetJumpDash,threatFeed=ThreatFeed,enemyRings=EnemyRings,menuGrid=MenuGrid,menuEffects=MenuEffects,fovStyle=FovStyle,cursorReticle=CursorReticle,dashFX=DashFX,blockFX=BlockFX,hitStateFX=HitStateFX,deckMenu=DeckMenu,multiToggles=MultiToggles,liveData=LiveData,menuSkin=MenuSkin,dataEditor=DataEditor,menuTheme=MenuTheme,combatPriority=CombatPriority,

for _,module in {NativeBaseFeatures,NativeAppearanceFeatures,NativeAutomaticFeatures} do
    if module then
        local backendName=if module==NativeBaseFeatures then 'NativeBaseFeatures' elseif module==NativeAutomaticFeatures then 'NativeAutomaticFeatures' else 'NativeAppearanceFeatures'
        local backendHost=menu.failsafe and menu.failsafe.hostFor(host,backendName) or host
        local ok,value=pcall(module.new,backendHost,environment,menu)
        if ok and value then
            if menu.failsafe then menu.failsafe.guardController(value,backendName) end
            if module==NativeAppearanceFeatures then menu.nativeAppearanceFeatures=value end
            table.insert(backends,value)
        else host.warn('[Shenaniganism] native feature backend: '..tostring(value)) end
    end
end
menu.nativeBackends=backends
if FrontDashReadiness then
    menu.frontDashReadiness=FrontDashReadiness.new(host,menu)
    local nativeStatus=menu.frontDashReadiness.getStatus
    menu.frontDashReadiness.getStatus=function(model,serverNow)
        local status=nativeStatus(model,serverNow)
        if not status then return nil end
        local dash=menu.dashControl
        local interval=dash and dash.getFrontIntervalStatus and dash.getFrontIntervalStatus(model)
        if type(interval)=='table' and interval.remaining>0 then
            status.fraction=math.min(status.fraction,interval.fraction)
            status.remaining=math.max(status.remaining or 0,interval.remaining)
            status.maximum=math.max(status.maximum or 0,interval.maximum)
            status.ready=false
            status.source..=' + custom front-dash interval'
        end
        return status
    end
end
local backendDestroy=menu.Destroy
local teardownStarted=false
local teardownResults: any=nil
local rootDestroyConnection: any=nil
menu.Destroy=function(...)
    if teardownStarted then
        if teardownResults then return table.unpack(teardownResults,1,teardownResults.n) end
        return
    end
    teardownStarted=true
    if rootDestroyConnection then rootDestroyConnection:Disconnect();rootDestroyConnection=nil end
    for _,backend in backends do if backend.Destroy then pcall(backend.Destroy) end end
    local result=table.pack(backendDestroy(...))
    panel:Destroy()
    if shared.__ShenaniganismMenu==menu then shared.__ShenaniganismMenu=nil end
    teardownResults=result
    return table.unpack(result,1,result.n)
end
rootDestroyConnection=panel.Root.Destroying:Connect(function()menu.Destroy()end)
local tabs={}
for _,name in NativeCatalog.tabs do tabs[name]=panel:CreateTab(name,'') end
for _,declaration in NativeCatalog.controls do
    local config=table.clone(declaration)
    local tabName,kind=config.tab,config.kind
    config.tab,config.kind=nil,nil
    config.FailsafeGameplayAction=kind=='CreateButton' and tabName~='Settings'
    if config.CallbackSourceId==533 then
        local originalId=tabName..'/'..config.Name
        local reason='The original callback is an external loader; its implementation has not been recovered.'
        menu.nativeUnresolved[originalId]=reason
        -- Keep the saved value in the retained configuration, without exposing
        -- an unimplemented toggle that would falsely appear to be working.
        tabs[tabName]:CreateParagraph({Name=config.Name..' Availability',Title=config.Name,Content=reason,NoConfig=true,NativeBackendUnavailable=true})
        continue
    end
    local callback
    for _,backend in backends do
        callback=backend.callback(tabName,config.Name,config,config.CallbackSourceId)
        if callback then break end
    end
    -- Native wrappers replace these with the imported assist/visual owners.
    -- An unported action has no invented gameplay callback.
    config.Callback=callback
    if tabName=='Main' and config.Name=='Info ESP' then config.Callback=menu.visuals.setInfo end
    if config.DynamicOptions=='ServerPlayers' then
        config.Options={}
        for _,actor in host.game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() do if actor~=player then table.insert(config.Options,actor.Name) end end
    end
    local originalName=config.Name
    tabs[tabName][kind](tabs[tabName],config)
    local registered=menu.entries[tabName..'/'..tostring(config.Name)]
    local effective=registered and registered.config or config
    local resolved=callback~=nil or effective.SourceCallback~=nil or (kind~='CreateToggle' and effective.Callback~=nil)
    if kind~='CreateParagraph' and not resolved then
        local id=tabName..'/'..tostring(originalName)
        if menu.entries[id] then
            menu.nativeMissing[id]=config.CallbackSourceId
            config.NativeBackendUnavailable=true
        end
    end
end

if AppearanceSettings then
    menu.appearanceSettings=AppearanceSettings.new(host,menu)
    menu.appearanceSettings.createControls(tabs)
    if menu.hitOutlineStyle then menu.appearanceSettings.addRelatedProvider(menu.hitOutlineStyle) end
    table.insert(backends,menu.appearanceSettings)
end
if ColorAppearancePanel then
    menu.colorAppearancePanel=ColorAppearancePanel.new(host,menu)
    table.insert(backends,menu.colorAppearancePanel)
end
if NativeGlyphs then
    menu.nativeGlyphs=NativeGlyphs.new(host,menu)
    table.insert(backends,menu.nativeGlyphs)
end
menu.ui.editor=LayoutEditor.new(host,menu,menu.ui)
menu.ui.editor.finishSetup()
menu.restoringControls=false
if DashPreferenceSync then
    menu.dashPreferenceSync=DashPreferenceSync.new(menu)
    menu.syncDashPreferences=menu.dashPreferenceSync.sync
    table.insert(backends,menu.dashPreferenceSync)
end
do local lp=SharedHooks.loadProfile;lp.marks[#lp.marks+1]={'before config store',os.clock()-lp.t0,true} end
menu.configStore=ConfigStore.new(host,menu)
local restored,problem
if savedLive then
    restored=menu.configStore.start({restore=false})
    if restored then restored=menu.configStore.restore(savedLive) end
else
    restored,problem=menu.configStore.start()
end
if not restored then
    menu.configStore.blocked=true
    host.warn('[Shenaniganism] saved settings need attention: '..tostring(menu.configStore.lastError or problem))
end
if menu.configStore.skippedValues and #menu.configStore.skippedValues>0 then
    host.warn('[Shenaniganism] skipped '..#menu.configStore.skippedValues..' saved value(s) that no longer fit their control: '..table.concat(menu.configStore.skippedValues,', '))
end
do local lp=SharedHooks.loadProfile;lp.marks[#lp.marks+1]={'config restored',os.clock()-lp.t0,true} end
if menu.tojiSettingsTab then menu.tojiSettingsTab.apply()end
if menu.generalESP.syncAppearanceAliases then menu.generalESP.syncAppearanceAliases()end
if player.Character==savedHitCharacter and menu.visuals.hitOutlineEnabled then
    for model,at in savedHitMarks do
        local humanoid=model.Parent and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if type(at)=='number'and at==at and math.abs(at)<math.huge and menu.visuals.infoActorAlive(model,humanoid)
            and not(menu.isExcluded and menu.isExcluded(model))then menu.visuals.hitOutlineTimes[model]=at end
    end
    menu.visuals.updateTargetESP()
end
if menu.syncDashPreferences then assert(menu.syncDashPreferences(),menu.dashPreferenceSync.lastError)end
if menu.ui.syncBlackflashTiming then menu.ui.syncBlackflashTiming() end
if menu.autoLock and menu.autoLock.bindSafeLockCleanup then menu.autoLock.bindSafeLockCleanup() end
if menu.ui.indexSearch then menu.ui.indexSearch() end
if MenuWarmup then
    menu.menuWarmup=MenuWarmup.new(host,menu)
    table.insert(backends,menu.menuWarmup)
    menu.menuWarmup.start()
end
panel:Present()
if MenuRenderGate then
    menu.menuRenderGate=MenuRenderGate.new(host,menu)
    table.insert(backends,menu.menuRenderGate)
end
menu.nativeStartupComplete=true
shared.__ShenaniganismRestoreOriginalPreset=nil
local controls,missing,pending=0,0,0
for _ in menu.entries do controls+=1 end
for _ in menu.nativeMissing do missing+=1 end
for _,record in manager.pending do if record.pendingNative then pending+=1 end end
print('[Shenaniganism] ready',buildId,'controls',controls,'restored',menu.configStore.restored,'native pending',pending,'unported base controls',missing)
do
    local lp=SharedHooks.loadProfile
    local parts,spans={},{}
    for _,m in lp.marks do
        if m[3] then table.insert(parts,string.format('%s@%.1fs',m[1],m[2])) else table.insert(spans,m) end
    end
    table.sort(spans,function(a,b) return a[2]>b[2] end)
    local top={}
    for i=1,math.min(14,#spans) do top[i]=string.format('%s %.2fs',spans[i][1],spans[i][2]) end
    print('[Shenaniganism] startup timeline: '..table.concat(parts,' | ')..string.format(' | ready@%.1fs',os.clock()-lp.t0))
    print('[Shenaniganism] slowest components: '..table.concat(top,' | '))
end
return menu
